286180.title: Salticidae Story
286180.short_description: A cosy jumping-spider keeping game. Feed them, mist them, and help them through every moult. Breed lines through a 120-trait genome and six species, catch wild jumping spiders, beetles, roaches and mantises, dress your Keeper, and play online with friends.

304830.title: No Signal: Chornobyl
304830.short_description: No Signal is a strictly online co-op psychological horror game set in the abandoned Chornobyl Exclusion Zone. Explore decaying towns, solve tasks together, and question everything—because you and your partner may not be seeing the same reality.

352500.title: Task Bar Isekai
352500.short_description: Kenta worked himself to death at 3:47 AM… and was reborn under your taskbar. An idle ARPG that fights while you work: loot, forge to +15, beat bosses that break out onto your desktop, and seal your best drops as real Steam items to trade or sell on the Steam Community Market.

382370.title: BreakFree
382370.short_description: A first-person block breaker from 1995: you are the paddle. Keep your fireballs alive and break the walls of 72 levels. Chase medals and the Daily Challenge, or build levels for Steam Workshop. Runs natively on modern PCs, with the original DOS game included.

432120.title: Age After Age
432120.short_description: Age After Age. Build a thriving settlement, shape society across multiple eras, and dominate a living world economy. Choose your path - classic history, Steampunk, Gothic, and more in a deep city-building strategy with evolving logistics, citizen classes, diplomacy, and research.

451770.title: Aurora: Firebreak
451770.short_description: Break through self-replicating warforms in fast neon expeditions, evolve a new ship build every flight, recover lost technology, and rebuild humanity's last uncorrupted fleet across a branching campaign for survival.

473750.title: Feudums
473750.short_description: Lead your noble house through brutal wars, shifting allegiances and economic strife in an asynchronous multiplayer 4X strategy. Shape the narrative with or against real players in a medieval world where diplomacy isn't binding, there is NO pay-to-win, and only strategy determines your legacy.

503540.title: Fables of the Kingdom Remastered
503540.short_description: Help the brave hero Kevin restore a beautiful kingdom ruined by the evil sorcerer Balen and rescue the kidnapped princess! Clear roads, gather resources, construct buildings, and wield magic in this remastered, fast-paced time-management strategy game.

521180.title: Slip Angle
521180.short_description: Arcade drift racing where being sideways is almost mandatory! Find the perfect balance between speed and angle to clear objectives and slide your way through multiple game modes - enjoy the drift flow state or challenge yourself to be one of the best, the choice is yours.

522290.title: Super Cucumber
522290.short_description: Super Cucumber mixes Saturday morning cartoon charm with fast-paced action platforming. Play as Cucumber, an aardvark superhero, dashing, leaping, and comboing through 100+ handcrafted levels filled with new abilities, hidden secrets, and delightfully devious foes.

534120.title: HEX Defense
534120.short_description: HEX Defense is a tower-based strategy game set in a hexagonal world where you have to fight enemy forces by combining simple blocks into complex tower patterns.

537680.title: Sheep Tag 2
537680.short_description: Your friends are sheep. You are the wolf. Hunt them down as they build ridiculous farm fortresses to keep you out. Sheep Tag 2 is a Free-To-Play chaotic team-based RTS that's easy to learn and brutal to master. Play solo with bots or battle multiplayer with up to 32 players. Build. Hunt. Survive.

563600.title: Buratino
563600.short_description: Buratino is a 2D arcade game with light adventure elements for the ZX Spectrum 8-bit computer.

581150.title: Project: Bits
581150.short_description: Project: Bits (Pronounced Beats) is a complimentary music and rhythm game. It's primary goal functions as a distribution platform for various songs and steps. Listen to the music. Feel the groove. Hit the arrows.

586290.title: Crimson Crisis
586290.short_description: A fast-paced action roguelike where skill beats firepower. Outmaneuver swarms, harness Poison/Inflame/Traumatize, and expand the game with mods & co-op.

592770.title: Copter Besieged
592770.short_description: Copter Besieged is a multi-copter survival arena shooter. Realistic multi-copter flight with arcade style weapons, items, powerups and escalating monster waves. Dodge incoming attacks, shoot monsters, collect coins, level up your copter. Or race against your friends ghosts on the flight courses.

611610.title: Pineview Drive 2 - Rising Storm
611610.short_description: For years, Lisa has been haunted by dreams of a burning mansion. When she recognizes the place from a late-night television documentary, she decides to uncover the truth behind the nightmare in this story-driven first-person horror adventure.

616780.title: Age of Space
616780.short_description: Evolve from being a nobody to being the center of power! Age of space combines real time resource management with tactical combat. Work as a mercenary for clients in our solar system as you gradually get dragged into a liberation war between the Martians and the UEA. Who will you side with?

617310.title: Mamma Mia
617310.short_description: Play in co-op as the staff of Italy’s worst restaurant. Your kitchen is falling apart, customers’ safety barely makes the list, and weird things happen in the back alley.

618440.title: Stencil of Judgement
618440.short_description: Step into a realm where every shadow whispers of forgotten power and ancient relics hold unimaginable might. A magic and melee take on the Musou genre: hack-and-slash games where a single, overpowered hero battles hordes of enemies including bosses on massive, tactical battlefields.

637340.title: Solar Core
637340.short_description: Survive to the end of each track in fast, rhythm-driven combat in this top down twin-stick roguelike.

639590.title: Cartoon Craft: Rise of Mutation
639590.short_description: A story-driven real-time strategy game inspired by classic RTS. Experience a mission campaign filled with memorable characters, unexpected alliances, and humor. Build your kingdom, command Humans and Orcs, create custom maps, and share your battles with the world.

640840.title: Gohan Quest
640840.short_description: Gohan Quest is a humorous adventure RPG that takes place in modern Eastern Europe. Play as anime girls, explore the typical russian town, beat the shit out of gopniks and find the missing "children"! Inspired by golden age JRPGs, from fans to fans.

651950.title: Collapsus
651950.short_description: COLLAPSUS™ is a one-of-a-kind block-crunching puzzle game all about gravity manipulation and resource management! Join Leon the Chameleon as you twist, tilt, turn, & flip to solve your way through endless, mind-bending puzzles!

655750.title: Trigger Spree
655750.short_description: Putting the FUN back in FPS

660800.title: Blossoming Yandere 満開 ヤンデレ
660800.short_description: A girl was sleeping in the garbage outside of Kazuki's apartment, until he decided to take her in. Now a home for two, he must remember that all actions have consequences, and words can be laced with poison. But you know that all too well, don't you?

664370.title: Still Above: Orbital Refuge
664370.short_description: A 3D space-station survival builder. The Earth below is gone; your station is still falling. Salvage the orbital graveyard, fit out empty hulls rack by rack, and keep air, water, power and fuel flowing long enough to turn one fragile module into humanity's last refuge.

668750.title: Cthulhu's Cleanup Crew
668750.short_description: You’re Employee #1 at Cthulhu’s new reality repair business. In this relaxing restoration game, clean up impossible disasters with a cosmic paint gun and upgrade your gear and workspace. Just try to ignore whatever’s screaming behind the walls.

687440.title: In The Valley of Gods
687440.short_description: From the creators of Firewatch, In the Valley of Gods is a single-player first-person adventure. Explore a remote and ancient valley in the Egyptian desert, uncovering treasure and treachery in pursuit of a discovery that could bring you fame and fortune—or leave you for dead, buried beneath the sands.

689370.title: Azzy Battles the Darkness
689370.short_description: Unleash elemental powers through your bionic arm in a story-driven 3D action-platformer inspired by the PS2 era. Explore 5 sprawling elemental realms, master explosive mobility upgrades, battle chaotic bosses, and search for your missing father before the Darkness consumes everything

702490.title: Seclusion: Islesbury
702490.short_description: Seclusion: Islesbury is a new horror point-and-click adventure in the vein of genre classics such as Scratches and Dark Fall. Can a decade-old murder case be solved? Is it safe to wander on these streets? Will anyone help you in this town? Find it out in this tale of personal tragedy.

709460.title: Moonsteader
709460.short_description: Start a new life on a distant moon in this cosy sci-fi Western. Grow crops, mine resources, craft equipment, repair machinery and transform a rundown homestead into a thriving settlement. Meet the locals, lend a hand and become part of a frontier community.

718550.title: Usurpator
718550.short_description: USURPATOR is an EXTRACTION MELEE SLASHER. Rally your allies, clash with rival players, and battle the forces of evil. Master powerful weapons, unlock new talents, and carve your path to glory—then fight to make it out alive.

720190.title: Wizards
720190.short_description: Four wizards. One arena. One furious ball. Protect your library & spellbook, sling five arena-warping spells, and outlast everyone. Local AI and Steam multiplayer.

726680.title: Better Together
726680.short_description: A 2 to 6 player co-op psychological horror. Become neighbors with your friends in an underground experiment. Complete the studies, get paid by doing tasks, while the Institute notes your routine. Betray your friends before they do. In the end you'll know exactly who your friends really are.

728570.title: EREBUS
728570.short_description: EREBUS is a third person element focused fighter, where players can face off in a free for all fight. Players will choose an element and utilize one of the four abilities specific to that element, each win is cataloged and the winning element will have the map change to showcase that change!

731830.title: Warpflux
731830.short_description: Warpflux is a top-down action based resource management game. As the commander of Earth's colony ship and a fleet of autonomous drones, collect supplies and defend against hostile forces during a thousand year voyage to save humanity.

737340.title: Wild Light: Darkest Isles
737340.short_description: Survive unforgiving nights in this topdown roguelite... explore the island, set up camp, and slay Titans in souls-like combat as you hunt the source of the desolation. But beware, the longer you survive, the darker the nights become

739330.title: PROTOCOL: Requiem
739330.short_description: Fight through the Hyperstructure in this Turn-based Tactical Roguelike. Using the Energy Deck and complex Characters, you must optimize every turn to have a chance at rescuing the last human DNA sample. Build your party of Replicas, customize them, and use your strategic mind to finish the mission.

744200.title: Altiros
744200.short_description: Build! Craft! Destroy! Jump on clouds and fight cute monsters in skill-based battles of steel, magic and spirit in this online sandbox adventure set in a fantastical world of sky islands!

746530.title: Plague hunter
746530.short_description: Plague hunter is an indie platformer game in the dark fantasy vein. In the game you’ll be using sword and gun to cut your way through hordes of zombies and other terrible monsters, avoiding deadly traps.

748250.title: Hellsplit: Labyrinth
748250.short_description: A rogue-like VR action RPG with brutal, physics-driven medieval combat. Collect seven crystal shards across procedural dungeons. You get one life. No second chances.

749820.title: Villages™
749820.short_description: Villages™ is an Open-World Sandbox game that has rules to encourage People to make a complex society and economy.

749950.title: The Six Dragons
749950.short_description: Welcome to The Six Dragons Discover 256km2 of Open-World full of surprises, escape 1 billion dungeons, craft and enchant items

757550.title: Football Story
757550.short_description: Football Story is a cozy football RPG and life sim about growing up, friendship, and a dream. Develop your skills, explore the town of Lumen Bay, help its residents, and build your own street football team. Rise from your first neighborhood matches to victory over the pros!

772980.title: DECONSTRUCTION
772980.short_description: DECONSTRUCTION is a fast-paced, hardcore, shooting game.

780030.title: Kids of Karendow
780030.short_description: Kids of Karendow is a pixel-art fantasy sci-fi JRPG about a war built on lies. Play both sides: join Elmo, a resistance fighter who can't look away from injustice, and Kommander Krewl, the Daughter of Death, as the truth forces former enemies together against something far worse.

804280.title: Starwake
804280.short_description: Starwake is a free-to-play sci-fi MMO! Crew ships, battle enemies, mine asteroids, craft goods, run businesses, climb navy ranks, and conquer territory in a persistent universe with 75 star systems!

809430.title: The Floor is Lava
809430.short_description: The Floor is Lava is a parkour and adventure game with mountains, rocks and even floating objects that defy the law of physics! But remember, if you fall in the lava. You'll have to do it all again!

812910.title: Zodiac Legion
812910.short_description: Zodiac Legion is a turn-based tactical RPG where you take command of an arcane chivalric order. Launch daring raids through ancient ruins and treacherous dungeons. Advance in steadfast formations to disrupt enemy ranks with cunning stratagems. Hold your ground in a world of reawakening cosmic magic.

823820.title: Fallen Dungeons
823820.short_description: Fallen Dungeons is a grid-based dungeon crawler which melds modern aesthetics and mechanics with old school game design.

828190.title: M.E.C.H.A.: Memory Erasure Control of Hover Attractor
828190.short_description: M.E.C.H.A. — an indie survival shooter in a dystopian cyberpunk world! Scavenge for resources, build your relationship with Rika, and upgrade your gear in the world of androids. Experience the gameplay mix of dating simulator and bloody action with all the consequences.

833020.title: Wail of Despair
833020.short_description: A lonely girl left unaccompanied is followed into the colorful tunnels of her local fast food play place.

837520.title: The Night Janitor
837520.short_description: You were hired to clean. Nobody mentioned the ghosts. Craven & Moor Associates needs their offices spotless before the morning shift. What their employees can't know won't hurt them. Mop up the mess, take out the trash, and don't let anything catch you doing it. Five nights. One mop. Don't die.

848220.title: Split Drive
848220.short_description: Split Drive is a roguelite arena shooter where you have to find your way home through a hostile galaxy, numerous locations and a variety of bosses, all generated procedurally.

854850.title: RAD: Ascension
854850.short_description: Some runs you race the clock. Some you just flow. RAD is a movement game built around speed and experimentation. Pump, jump, swing and glide through neon courses, race leaderboard ghosts, shave milliseconds off every run, and play it all to your own music. Instant restarts; one more run, every time.

857650.title: Trebuchet Hold’em
857650.short_description: Conquer castles with poker in this medieval roguelike deckbuilder. Your deck is your army: soldiers gain experience, get wounded and fall. Play poker hands against walls and garrisons, collect war banners, march through three regions and storm the Royal City.

858200.title: Scratch The Cat
858200.short_description: Grab your headphones and step up to the turntable in Scratch The Cat - a vibrant action-adventure 3D platformer. Play as DJ Scratch, explore a sprawling musical world, fight bosses, and reclaim your stolen records. Turn up the volume and set the stage for the purr-fect comeback.

859020.title: Crop Dead
859020.short_description: You aren’t quite dead yet, but you're slipping. Play as a ghost defending your own comatose body from endless hordes of ravenous enemies. Plant magical crops, harvest bizarre weapons, and cultivate an automated defense of undead flora to survive the tower and complete your resurrection ritual!

861360.title: Windwalkers: Below the Storm
861360.short_description: Lead high-risk surface rescue operations across a storm-scarred Earth. Power your rover, tools, and modular pack with limited energy resources as you recover survivors, salvage critical supplies, and help reclaim the world above.

864170.title: Midnight Horde
864170.short_description: Leap, slash, and soar through gothic ruins in Midnight Horde, a high-mobility auto shooter where parkour meets reverse bullet hell. Battle through swarms of monstrosities, upgrade deadly weapons, and build strongholds to push back the creeping dark.

865450.title: SCORCHED EARTH
865450.short_description: SCORCHED EARTH is a chunky PS2 mecha-action game with massive amounts of customization, where you play as a mercenary taking on dirty jobs across a planetary war.

867300.title: Ricochet: Moonlit Gardens
867300.short_description: One clever shot. A glorious chain of light. Ricochet: Moonlit Gardens is a cosy arcade puzzler about bouncing through jewels, unleashing magic and chasing the perfect combo. Explore eight worlds, 112 story missions and 112 challenges, plus a fresh Daily Challenge.

871160.title: LoopCraft
871160.short_description: Loop Craft is a game about economics. There is an item trading system within the game. This game has a variety of item mix systems. And have a reservation system to set up a factory to produce products for sale in the game.

876240.title: The Psychic
876240.short_description: Be a Psychic to experience a larruping adventure. Living in the foggy place and exploring the unknown. Collecting resources and discovering magic treasures. Build and expand your own castle.

878210.title: MATCHO
878210.short_description: MATCHO is a narrative first-person action adventure. Tag targets, build chains, and execute combos with an innovative real-time Match-3 combat. Join Max as he fights through an alien invasion, uncovers the truth behind his illness, and races to find a cure before Earth falls under alien control.

881940.title: Guns 'n Goblins
881940.short_description: Face a deluge of monsters in this incremental horde survivor FPS. Build your Bastion, level up your character, and upgrade your arsenal to rise from Apprentice Bell Ringer to Master Dragon Hunter.

912000.title: Mike goes on hike
912000.short_description: Leave the city behind in a first-person hiking adventure. Explore mountain trails, take photographs, and fill Mike’s travel journal with memories — from a thrilling zipline ride to a quiet evening by the campfire.

926200.title: Sandtable Engine
926200.short_description: Welcome to the sandbox world full of creativity! With a free and open gameplay mode and a creative platform, whether you are a player or a developer, you can find highly scalable gameplay and game modes, or DIY your own game ideas here!

938970.title: IRON RAIL GIRLS : Last Train Draisine
938970.short_description: While converting the armored train (or is it a trolley?) “Draisine” into the “world's mightiest moving fortress,” they embark on a one-way journey (a breakthrough battle) back to their hometown. A 2D side-scrolling, top-down train shooting game.

949740.title: Godsend
949740.short_description: Godsend is a melee slasher set during the Crusades, where you must defend the grail against endless waves of enemies. You only pass the wave if you max your Fear meter out - which you can do by *rapidly* defeating enemies or using "Intimidator" items to help. Original Soundtrack by Shaun Finnegan.

955090.title: Welcome to Graymount
955090.short_description: WELCOME TO GRAYMOUNT is a narrative VR action-adventure game using advanced locomotion mechanics set on the bleak island of Graymount, featuring "push-forward" combat, wall-running, jumping, and magic.

980700.title: Unsung Warriors
980700.short_description: Unsung Warriors is a 2D action-adventure game. The game can be played solo or in couch co-op mode. Enjoy beautiful handcrafted levels. Fight against ferocious enemies and discover the many secrets of this ancient world.

993600.title: Cyberdelic
993600.short_description: Cyberdelic is an immersive FPS - Use a combination of weaponry to pierce hostile shields, armour and flesh. Swap out cybernetic components to best suit your combat encounters. Explore an interconnected environment acquiring additional tools to your arsenal.

1001520.short_description: Space flight arcade focused on maneuvering.

1007760.title: Omni Axes
1007760.short_description: Trust your instincts - evade, aim, and shoot! Omni Axes is a shooting game that takes place in a 3D space where you can take down an endless number of enemies coming from all directions.

1008340.title: Insect Worlds
1008340.short_description: Immerse yourself in the world of insects. Explore fascinating forests and learn about their way of life. Complete quests and mini-games, fight or collect resources and cards. Admire the microcosm from a completely different perspective and learn new facts about plants and insects.

1018780.title: Warden Tycoon
1018780.short_description: Build a prison from an empty plot into a four-level giant, then run it. A thousand inmates each have needs, moods, friends and grudges. Feed them, keep them busy and watch them closely, or they will fight, riot, smuggle, dig and climb their way out.

1019160.title: Card Chronicle
1019160.short_description: A story-driven card roguelike about a world losing its memory. Play Aria, a scribe who recovers people's stories as cards. Chain matching tags to double your damage, and make choices that permanently evolve your cards. 3 chapters, 116 cards, three endings.

1020280.title: Deslot
1020280.short_description: A realistic miniature racing game featuring Die-Cast, Slot, and Mini-RC cars. Master momentum, throttle, and precision driving across handcrafted and procedurally generated diorama tracks. Build your own circuits, customize your cars, and race through Career, Challenges, and Multiplayer.

1038080.title: FortressCraft : Phoenix
1038080.short_description: The third iteration of the game that invented the Factory genre, FortressCraft :Phoenix takes the over-the-top base building and survival gameplay and cranks it up a hundred times. Build your mining base with hundreds of thousands of machines in it, explore alien landscape, heading deep underground.

1039440.title: Star Fighters
1039440.short_description: Star Fighters is a fully cross-platform shooter RPG where you can hunt down other players' spaceships or AI bots, either by yourself or as a team with your friends.

1043460.title: Anchor
1043460.short_description: Anchor is a large-scale underwater multiplayer survival game. Build your base, craft tools and weapons, explore, loot and prepare for battle. Every player is a potential threat in a persistent world where bases can be raided, alliances broken, and the ocean itself hunts you.

1044700.title: Hereditas
1044700.short_description: Found your house or lead one of eight noble families in a medieval realm. Raise a castle stone by stone, furnish its halls, command companions and armies, and win the crown through war, trade and diplomacy – or hold what you built against every siege.

1051070.title: Oni Hunters
1051070.short_description: Journey through Gironia's lands, where monsters roam and secrets await. Battle, fuse creatures, and decide your fate in the grand Monster Jubilee. Ready for the adventure?

1054190.title: Parkour Bot
1054190.short_description: Parkour Bot is a fast paced, rhythm based, physics platform game, with an unique movement set of main character. Show your skills and get a lot of achievements in 100 dynamic levels.

1063700.title: ProtoDungeon: Episode III
1063700.short_description: A bite-sized, 2D top-down exploration adventure in an interconnected world. Fall into a lonely seaside cove, find a magic leaf beneath a shriveled lotus tree, summon sacred fire, and learn to jump, swim, and dash your way toward the chapel. No map or quest markers here; the way through is up to you.

1064250.title: Huni Kuin: Beya Xinã Bena
1064250.short_description: A 2D platform game that comes to life through the myths of the Huni Kuin people. Overcome challenges in the Amazon, use the knowledge of the shamans and explore the world of spirits in this adventure illustrated by indigenous artists.

1068590.title: Project Sundive
1068590.short_description: Project Sundive is wave-based arena auto-shooter roguelite, focusing on ship customization and ridiculously overpowered builds

1077660.title: Drift
1077660.short_description: Drift is a narrative sci-fi horror adventure set on a desolate deep-space outpost. With your mission gone horrifically wrong, you face an unspeakable, monstrous foe. Explore the station's dark recesses, restore failing systems, survive terrifying encounters, and confront your own tormented past.

1101370.title: Wind Runners
1101370.short_description: Wind Runners is a high-speed bullet-hell dogfighting roguelite where you start as a lone pilot, turning each flight into a fight for freedom. Face the ruthless technotheist Realm, take on relentless fleets and colossal bosses, and let your victories ignite a growing resistance across the star system

1111150.title: Fault & Fragment
1111150.short_description: Fault & Fragment is a game about exploring the ghost of a world, searching for a way to lay it to rest. Travel far, contend with terrible foes, and reignite the leylines that once powered your kingdom.

1111740.title: Cross Reverie
1111740.short_description: Follow the story of Eight of the land of Xylera’s bravest combatants and their descent into the madness known only as The Trial of Nightmare in this JRPG-inspired title featuring turn-based combat and a character-focused narrative.

1123240.title: Greyskin
1123240.short_description: Crawl through countless dungeons, fighting hordes of monsters in this unique, fast-paced Action RPG. Class-up, mutate, and survive as you loot, shoot, upgrade, and repeat. Descend into the depths of a strange and dark world filled with mysteries and uncover its secrets.

1128990.title: Iron Slugs
1128990.short_description: Explosive, fast-paced 1-4 vehicular brawler. Shoot your friends, lay traps, explode almost everything you see on the screen going for elaborate environmental kills

1138880.title: Stemmies
1138880.short_description: Stemmies™ is a groundbreaking biological simulation. Command a fully voiced, AI-driven Chief Medical Officer with a DLC, manage a sprawling 2.5D bio-punk city, harvest cellular resources, and manipulate a live stock market fueled by ATP.

1139230.title: PilotXross（パイロットクロス）
1139230.short_description: VR flight game developed for VR devices.The player becomes a [Pilot] flying in the sky with a VRM model, wearing an equipment called [Xross], you can enjoy various ways of flying. The fastest time is to take a commemorative photo and share it on SNS!

1141060.title: Spirit of Midnight
1141060.short_description: Play as a house cat who gains the ability to leave home and embark on a supernatural adventure after encountering a strange spirit. Befriend a badger and meet other adorable creatures along the way, all in an effort to restore balance to the forest and uncover the truth behind its mysteries.

1152260.title: Demonarch
1152260.short_description: Demonarch is the First-Person Real-Time Strategy game about summoning uncontrollable demons and keeping them happy enough that they eat all of your enemies before they eat you too! Emphasis on chaos, language, and information flow across the battlefield. Last exhibited at PAX West 2019

1153750.title: Food Industry
1153750.short_description: Build and expand in agriculture, industry and commerce. Evolve in the food industry sector, and weather the storms by helping your people build the new world.

1154960.title: Ardenfall
1154960.short_description: Inspired by classic The Elder Scrolls games, Ardenfall is a first-person, open-world RPG of ancient cultures and rival factions. Explore windswept plains and forgotten dungeons, forge your path with steel, magic, or persuasion, and shape the fate of those you meet.

1155850.title: Lost Viking: Kingdom of Women
1155850.short_description: While traveling to the East the Vikings fall into a trap. Ragnald is saved by the accompanying wolf and must find his loved ones. The Viking and his companion are forced not only to survive, but properly manage time, space and energy to achieve the goal.

1158190.title: Do Not Buy This Game
1158190.short_description: Are you really reading this to find out more? ...FINE! If you DO buy this game, expect me to narrate in your ear for around 2 hours about your poor life choices, all while I'll try to create something resembling a game for you to walk around in.

1159150.title: BOC: Birth of Cultures
1159150.short_description: The 4X where you shape 50,000 years of human history across planet-scale worlds.

1170900.title: Killbot General
1170900.short_description: Satisfying roguelite tactics packed in 5-minute battles. Controller-friendly with emphasis on tactics, not speed (low APM), no micromanagement, all in a wild and irreverent roguelite campaign for solo or co-op. Put anything you want on your flag...

1171980.title: Neverlooted Dungeon
1171980.short_description: Venture deep into the Neverlooted Dungeon in search of its legendary treasure, and face its treacherous, deadly traps. Using your creativity and magical items in a highly interactive physics-based world, find your own ways to outsmart the dangers, and be the first to uncover its darkest secrets.

1173980.title: Shadow of the Road
1173980.short_description: Shadow of the Road is a story-driven, turn-based RPG where feudal Japan meets magic and machine. Assemble your team from a diverse set of characters and test your skills against yōkai and steampunk contraptions. Carve your own path through an immersive story and change the fate of the Empire.

1184860.title: Banneret
1184860.short_description: Roguelike deckbuilding meets tactical auto-battling in this party building strategy game! Recruit and upgrade fighters, customize your deck, explore treacherous lands and battle fierce enemies.

1188960.title: Send & Defend
1188960.short_description: Send & Defend is a competitive multiplayer tower defense game. Carve your own maze, build towers and send creeps to grow your income. Watch your rivals, steal their lives and be the last one standing.

1192230.title: Octopus City Blues
1192230.short_description: In a world of ice, the last human city is tearing itself apart. Explore the underbelly of a monstrous metropolis in a surreal adventure about everything and nothing.

1198710.title: Typhoon Unit ~ Butterfly Requiem
1198710.short_description: Squad up! Switch heroes on the fly, and chase down the Steel Butterfly in a world where magic and technology intertwine! Are you the right team for the job?

1205030.title: Not Your Eyes
1205030.short_description: Your eyes cannot be trusted. A girl finds herself questioned by a twisted psychiatrist, helping a fallen angel, and followed by a bizarre stalker, descending to a beautiful, terrible world where nothing is as it seems.

1205570.title: Adventures of Ruby Rabbit
1205570.short_description: "The Adventure of Ruby Rabbit" is a light action shooter adventure game. In the game, you can control Ruby the cute bunny, fight the bunny balls, and grow as she grows.

1207360.title: Medieval Frontiers
1207360.short_description: First-person colony simulation where strategy meets survival in a demanding, medieval wilderness. Construct gridless settlements, establish production chains, and manage the needs, desires, and work morale of your villagers to ensure their survival through the harsh realities of nature and disease.

1208500.title: Former Future
1208500.short_description: Vaporize evil robots and reclaim Saturn’s cities in this strategic shooter. The path you choose shapes the enemy's strength, the tools at your disposal, and the final stand you'll face. Overcome adaptive AI in solo or co-op play where distinct characters and synergistic abilities reward teamwork.

1208890.title: Civlands
1208890.short_description: Rule a medieval fantasy kingdom in this pixel-art real-time strategy game. Your people build, farm and haul on their own while you decide what matters. Trade with rivals or march on them, bind spells to your armies, and build a wonder worth defending. Reign well, or not for long.

1209970.title: Blind Descent
1209970.short_description: Blind Descent is an open-world survival adventure into the mysteries of the Martian depths. Play solo or with friends in 4-player co-op as you search for the missing team. Adapt to survive by building custom tools, upgrading your base, and/or mutating in this bizarre alien world.

1212030.title: ARIDA 2: Rise of the Brave
1212030.short_description: Journey through the 19th-century Brazilian backlands in this narrative, culturally rich adventure. Face the drought to explore arid biomes, craft and manage resources, complete quests, and guide Cícera to Canudos - the mythical village promising to change the story forever.

1213250.title: Wagrrr
1213250.short_description: Give your viewers more FUN and INTERACTIVITY with your broadcasts! Let your viewers respond live on-screen to your gameplay, send text and questions, and make FUN wagers on your Battle Royale Games! ADD AN EXTRA LAYER OF FUN TO YOUR BROADCASTS!

1216340.title: Vampire vs Devil
1216340.short_description: Control Vampire, use corpses of your enemies as weapons. Run through 666 levels to hell.

1220670.title: 奥丁为什么没胡子
1220670.short_description: Creating a horizontal version to explore RPG

1221770.title: Homeplanet
1221770.short_description: Homeplanet is a space combat simulator with Newtonian physics and a story-driven campaign. Step into the boots of a combat pilot of the Troiden clan! Take part in the saga of exile from your home world—and the struggle to conquer a new one.

1225770.title: Sorted by Christmas
1225770.short_description: It’s almost Christmas and there’s a mountain of 100,000 presents still to sort. Round up your Gonk Squad for first-person co-op chaos with vacuums, black holes and Festive Dynamite. Up to 8 players, or solo.

1233680.title: Legends of Astravia
1233680.short_description: Dynamic battles, twisting dungeons, and countless secrets await you in the magical world of Astravia. Journey alongside your companions as you unravel the mystery of your past and uncover the truth behind a mysterious trio’s plot... before the Cataclysm brings forth another age of ruin.

1234990.title: Pry Into The Void
1234990.short_description: Delve into the hearts of monsters and people in this bleak monster-taming RPG. Exploit enemy weaknesses, confront difficult moral choices, and recruit surreal creatures by uncovering the truths hidden within their souls.

1238190.title: Ant Colony: Wild Forest
1238190.short_description: Build and automate your own ant colony – a nest that runs itself! Freely dig and shape your underground kingdom, produce different types of ants, and grow it block by block. Then it's time for conquest: scale up your swarm, crush enemy bases, and lead your colony to victory in the wild forest!

1244600.title: Let's Drive - learn driving simulator
1244600.short_description: There are 1.3 billion cars in the world. But how many good drivers are there? Is every one of them trained and competent? Find out while playing Let's Drive, a driving school simulator that shows you hazardous situations on the road and puts you right in them.

1259770.title: Sovia: Five Year Plan
1259770.short_description: A cozy competitive card game in Sovia's broadcast station. Race to complete five plans, hand your building resources to rivals, scout their cards, and survive disasters. Six seats by default, with computer players and friend rooms.

1267290.title: Field of Heroes
1267290.short_description: Swords, sorcery – and soccer. Assemble your friends and get on the Field of Heroes, the wildest, most radical online sports brawler ever. Sharpen your weapons, focus your spells, and SCORE!

1297450.title: Horu
1297450.short_description: Command hundreds of thousands of units across land and space in a galaxy-spanning RTS and 4X hybrid.

1299950.title: Unwalkable
1299950.short_description: Unwalkable is a silly physics based open-ended puzzle platformer where you control a wobbly character. Without just one way to solve puzzles, you must use your imagination and ingenuity to create solutions to unthinkable problems.

1300350.title: Mike & Tyler
1300350.short_description: Investigate a mysterious murder with Mike and Tyler in a Miami Vice–inspired point-and-click adventure. Solve puzzles, analyze clues, and deduce suspects — all without a single line of dialogue.

1303850.title: Alchemic Beasts
1303850.short_description: A monster-taming RPG where the social chemistry between your beasts shape how they bond, battle, and build. Join Zieg and Mioni to reclaim the wild paradise of Mizu, tame powerful monsters, and restore the resort to its former glory.

1307150.title: MLF: Pro Catch
1307150.short_description: Grab a friend and feel every fish fight back. A fishing sim with 50+ species across six diverse waters, real casting and trolling, and authentic gear. The official Major League Fishing game.

1312660.title: Be My Mom - maternity simulator, take care of your child
1312660.short_description: Become a mother and experience the best of maternity. The game is for future mothers, so they know what to expect, and also for their partners, so they can experience things their women do. The adventure begins just as you see the pregnancy test is positive.

1313960.title: Detonation Sauce University
1313960.short_description: An ordinary new student faces monsters after dark. With no superpowers, they use ketchup to blind monsters, creating escape gaps.​Gameplay: Evade, find ketchup, escape via hidden routes. Clear levels by escaping monsters, unlocking new campus dangers to uncover the monster secret.

1314040.title: Wteruna
1314040.short_description: It's been a long day, without you my friend. And I'll tell you all about when I see you again.

1314190.title: Treasure Islands
1314190.short_description: Take to the seas with Nick and Pippa on an exciting isle hopping adventure, as you search for new exhibits for their old Museum!

1314430.title: Still Rooms
1314430.short_description: A cozy, pixel-art decorating game where you design and furnish unique homes across 7 themed locations — from modern apartments and rustic houses to retro 80’s interiors, student rooms, rooftops, and even a spaceship.

1316330.title: Quarantine Cutz
1316330.short_description: A hilarious cartoon simulation where you're absolutely terrible at cutting hair. Can you overcome your nerves and total pop culture ignorance to give your family a haircut that won't crush their dreams? Probably not, but you're gonna give it your best shot!

1318180.title: WiccAtriX
1318180.short_description: Wiccatrix is a story driven ARPG with a spellcrafting system that allows the player to create custom spells to use in combat and to solve puzzles. Your goal is to explore the lands of Terra and help restore the elemental order back to harmony.

1318610.title: The Sewers
1318610.short_description: As you are having a rest in your humble abode you have the urge that something is present, something dangerous. Now you trust the urge and decide it's time to leave. You've been pushing your luck for too long down here. As you walk to exit this place you once called home, your urge becomes a reality.

1319530.title: Dunar: Dimension Two
1319530.short_description: A traditional turn-based JRPG featuring unique moments and a fascinating story centered around the forgotten past of the Purple Light, blending fantasy with inspirations from Himba culture and Indian aesthetics.

1320170.title: Lifeguard Simulator
1320170.short_description: Guard the beach, react fast, and save lives using quads, jet skis and drones. Patrol the bay, help those in need and uncover a hidden criminal intrigue beneath the waves.

1322780.title: Unexpected Tasks
1322780.short_description: Relax with a cozy Time Management adventure. Clear obstacles, gather resources, rebuild the kingdom, and enjoy satisfying progress at your own pace - with or without a timer.

1327040.title: Truck World: Australia
1327040.short_description: A trucking simulator set in Australia. Haul cargo on highways and off-road, step out of the cab, hitch trailers, connect hoses, refuel, and service your truck by hand. You don't just drive a truck - you work as a trucker.

1333120.title: Backlight War
1333120.short_description: A 3D top-down, level-based post-apocalyptic survival delivery game. Players control a debt-ridden character, take "Crisis Emergency System" tasks to enter ruined cities, fight oncoming zombies and mutants, pick up items via buttons to boost abilities, finish deliveries for debt repayment.

1333130.title: Flee
1333130.short_description: The leading role is a group of treasure adventure lovers, each to a place to find treasure will be booked in advance a dwelling to rest, but they have no awareness of hidden in the dark a pair of eyes are staring at them, waiting for the opportunity to kill!

1333150.title: Miracle Warrior of Mountains and Seas
1333150.short_description: A puzzle, monster-fighting game blending time-travel wuxia and The Classic of Mountains and Seas. A righteous modern youth falls into an ancient well, opens a time portal to ancient times, Defeat monsters, collect items to boost stats; weapons grow with abilities. Solve puzzles.

1333930.title: World's Worst Handyman
1333930.short_description: Suit up as the "World's Worst Handyman" in this comedy stealth game where every job is a chaotic adventure! Dodge disgruntled clients, bungle repairs, and save your beloved animal shelter from bankruptcy.

1336650.title: Crown Yer King
1336650.short_description: A 3-D precision platformer where you, The Crown, must hop and glide your way through challenging levels to reach your bald Kings head! Meet his requirements and don't make him angry!

1337410.title: Amethyst
1337410.short_description: Eight heroes. Infinite decisions. One winner. Amethyst is a deep 1v1 tactical strategy game — draft your team, level your heroes, contest objectives, and wager your matchmaking rating on your read of the game.

1339980.title: HS of Death
1339980.short_description: A first-person horror visual novel with point-and-click investigation. Six people are dead and you were there. Search rooms, solve puzzles that never give the answer away, and make the choices that decide whether you walk free or face execution.

1340050.title: Hand Shadow
1340050.short_description: Challenge your mind with puzzles that are based on optical illusions. Find the perfect position and angle by rotating the hands until order is restored, and discover a story of protagonist Morgan with professional voicing.

1342150.title: The Cabbage Effect
1342150.short_description: A cartoon-pop-surrealistic twin-stick shooter with brawl elements that takes place in an apocalyptic narrative.

1349460.title: Bravers
1349460.short_description: Build your own ship, recruit a crew to man it, and fight your way through the underground caves of a world wrecked by the Great Impact. Lead your crew through a fascinating journey full of danger, mysteries, friends and foes. Are you brave enough?

1353450.title: VoltHaven
1353450.short_description: Build electric grid in small settlement. Advance from outdated generators to modern powerplants, use fossils and renewables. Accomodate growing customer base and weather changes. Farms or mines provide extra income. Map-free layout with drag-and-drop simplicity. Simulation based on european data.

1355900.title: Tattered Banners
1355900.short_description: Lead a mercenary company in a turn-based tactics RPG set in a dynamic, simulated world shaped by your actions. Recruit, equip, and evolve your warband to survive a medieval-fantasy realm where cities rise and fall, noble houses pursue personal agendas, and the land bears the scars of your decisions.

1358780.title: SKAZ: Shadow of the Tsar
1358780.short_description: An isometric action-RPG where memory is your weapon and four fractured realms shape your fate. Wake without a name — and survive. As long as you’re remembered, you live.

1362000.title: Skyclimbers
1362000.short_description: Build your kingdom, choose your class, and tame monsters in this Multiplayer City-Building RPG that takes place in a procedurally generated anime-themed universe.

1364490.title: Constellations: Beyond the edges
1364490.short_description: After an accident at a space station, you lose all communication with the earth and are no longer able to locate yourself in space, your best chance of returning is to use the space monitoring system to identify known constellations and configure the route back home.

1368160.title: Heart Of Muriet
1368160.short_description: Your faction is in your hands in this 4X real-time strategy game. As a powerful mage, build thriving settlements and diverse armies to discover the secrets and stories at the heart of Muriet.

1369480.title: GNOMONIC
1369480.short_description: GNOMONIC – An ART-PG! Walk through watercolor paintings, fight in real-time projectile battles, solve puzzles with shadows, meet friends with creative talents in worlds themed by artistic mediums, and discover a story about how we experience art... and how art experiences us.

1375140.title: The BridgeMancer
1375140.short_description: Harness the power of Bridgemancy in this wholesome puzzle adventure. To rescue the citizens of Dolion, you must salvage materials, conjure bridges, and create escape routes for the townspeople. Just be sure not to block their path! Can you muster the magic, logic, and wit needed to save the kingdom?

1375790.title: Kakurenbo Neko
1375790.short_description: Kakurenbo Neko, a cozy hide & seek kitty collecting game.

1387110.title: Hyper Snatch
1387110.short_description: 5v5 Capture the Flag. No guns, just tag. Skill-based movement.

1390140.title: NIA
1390140.short_description: Drill, smash, leap and slide through this 2d puzzle platformer mashing retro graphics & icepunk aesthetics. Explore dozens of hand crafted worlds in well over 100 different levels.

1391150.title: Hack The Stars
1391150.short_description: Earth, 2040. The powerful are quietly preparing to leave for the stars. Fly a drone into their facilities, plant access, then command AI agents from your illicit Shadow Cloud to breach layered networks, train stolen models and expose who gets to go.

1391560.title: Oddsmaxxing
1391560.short_description: The odds manipulating roguelike. Oddsmaxxing lets you flip loaded coins and try to achieve specific outcomes and combos while chasing increasingly egregious targets. Unlock and use special coins to increase your chances in this satisfying gambling roguelike. May the odds be ever in your favor.

1391680.title: Sondro Gomez: A Sunova Story
1391680.short_description: "Sondro Gomez: A Sunova Story" is an action-adventure platformer following the story of a failing musician named Sondro, who must seek and recover the wish-granting Mystic Orbs to repay his debt to the mysterious Masked Man. Can he find them before the many rogues of Sunova beat him to the punch?

1394650.title: Detained: Too Good for School
1394650.short_description: ☆A 2D action RPG delinquent schoolgirl simulator!★ Take control of a delinquent schoolgirl freshly liberated after half a year behind bars. Attend classes, fight gangsters, work various part-time jobs, and cause all manner of mischief however you choose in this gorgeous 2D action RPG!

1397440.title: EXOMECHA
1397440.short_description: EXOMECHA™ is a brand-new multiplayer shooter that takes place in OMECHA, an untouched planet with exotic environments. It offers you a breathtaking sci-fi gaming experience with its infantry, vehicular and mecha combat.

1399870.title: Bedtime Horror Stories
1399870.short_description: Late night. A young man called Sam is home alone. He finds a mystical book that takes him into a world of horror stories that come alive. Start reading, but you must not break the most important rule. Once you have started the book, you must finish it!

1400710.title: Gowf: A Golf Adventure
1400710.short_description: Gowf is an arcade style golf game featuring a single player adventure mode and 8 player online multiplayer. Win tournaments, complete side quests, level up, and take on friends in a variety of courses and game modes!

1405000.title: TREAD: Arcade Tank Combat
1405000.short_description: Fast-paced top-down online tank battles where skill, teamwork, and strategy decide every fight. Customize your tank with specialized hulls and turrets, each with unique stats and abilities.

1407750.title: Midnight Laundry
1407750.short_description: Midnight Laundry is a short first-person horror game where a long night at the laundromat takes an unexpected turn.

1410040.title: Necro-Matcher
1410040.short_description: A match-3 rogue-lite! Traverse through multiple floors battling baddies and discovering secrets in every unique run.

1420700.title: Defensia
1420700.short_description: Defensia is a turn-based strategy game. Build structures, Grow carrots, Recruit bunnians, Kill enemies, Keep your castle safe!

1426580.title: Situation Normal
1426580.short_description: You're a secret agent. Get in. Destroy the boss. Get the hell out. An action platformer where the faster you move, the more chaos you unleash at once.

1426870.title: Dune Mechanic : Survive The Steampunk Era
1426870.short_description: This is a game about the painstaking and gradual process of building a fully functional, resource-harvesting, and self-defending base in the desert from scratch. Cut, mine, dig, shoot, build, research, design, craft, explore and more in the unknown deserts!

1429060.title: Your place
1429060.short_description: A cozy solitude simulator where a rainy night, a computer, and music create an atmosphere of calm and relaxation. Play an arcade game, explore the internet through an in-game browser, and import your own music to create the perfect atmosphere to unwind.

1440860.title: Past Visiting Hours
1440860.short_description: Past Visiting Hours is a 1v3 asymmetrical multiplayer horror game. Diagnose cursed patients, survive the hospital's monstrous inhabitants, or take control as The Board and turn the hospital into a living nightmare. Your shift is about to get a whole lot worse.

1442250.title: Sus Squad
1442250.short_description: Lie, sneak and vote in Impostor, or pass the bomb-ticking potato before it explodes in Hot Potato! Gather up to 14 friends or fill the room with bots, unlock special roles like the Sheriff and the Jester, and hang out in a lobby full of secrets.

1445480.title: Determinant
1445480.short_description: Realistic physics-based open-world survival game set in the future. Survival, crafting, exploration and base building are the main focus. Hunt for food and water and survive against environmental hazards. Combat is possible, but more defensive in nature.

1445880.title: ROCKBEASTS
1445880.short_description: A darkly funny narrative RPG where you manage a 90s grunge band from garage obscurity to stadium glory. Book gigs, wrangle egos and navigate a cutthroat music industry. Every choice shapes your band’s story and your own. Make it big without selling out.

1456080.title: Abyss Delvers
1456080.short_description: Abyss Delvers is an Online Hack'n'Slash Action RPG. Adventure out alone or party up with your friends on an epic journey and fight the monstrous hordes of the Abyss. Featuring randomly generated campaigns, dungeons, items and more!

1459800.title: Fakutori
1459800.short_description: Fakutori is a laid-back automation game with a lot more going on beneath the surface. Combine elements, build sprawling production lines, and chase down the Legendary Blocks that only the most dedicated builders ever find. All at your own pace.

1463320.title: Residuum
1463320.short_description: Defend your base on Mars from invaders in Residuum. A thrilling mix of tower defense and shooter gameplay, upgrade weapons and choose your crew for a unique experience each time. Play with a friend for even more excitement!

1468340.title: Gravity Blasters
1468340.short_description: Gravity Blasters is a real-time multiplayer game that recreates the classic artillery style of aiming and shooting by adjusting the angle and power. A game that mixes artillery games like Worms and Angry Birds with MOBAs like League of Legends or Dota.

1476380.title: 东方时裂空 ~ Numerology of Artifacts
1476380.short_description: 在一个本应该无事发生的冬季，幻想乡内各处发生了时空错乱的异变；不同区域的时间流动速度不一样，甚至还有其他时空的事物出现在幻想乡……但异变产生的原因和源头都不得而知，一切都是突如其来的。 不论如何都要解决掉黑幕，让这场异变停下来，要不然幻想乡就乱套了！

1482470.title: Pirates Republic
1482470.short_description: Build your pirate republic from nothing. Survive, cook, trade, and plunder your way through a procedurally generated Caribbean in this open-world survival sandbox. No fantasy - just history, grit, and freedom. Play solo or with friends in co-op.

1483000.title: Phantom Beasts - Redemption
1483000.short_description: Phantom Beasts - Redemption is a free to play cyberpunk 2.5D shooter that has the appealing blend of story, special ability system, and an explosive, gore-filled combat.

1490990.title: Isles of Krom
1490990.short_description: Isles of Krom is a dark fantasy top-down roguelike where progression is carved into the world itself. Master challenging, Souls-inspired combat as your Wards push back the Pestilence, claim each isle's lasting power, and reclaim the Krom Archipelago run after run.

1491520.title: Tales of the Realm: Arisen
1491520.short_description: A story rich and action packed fantasy game, that takes place in the fictional kingdom of Mythuras. Defend the kingdom against the ruthless undead in this retro-styled adventure game.

1493290.title: Bring Me Hope
1493290.short_description: Bring Me Hope is a bittersweet adventure RPG about love, loss, and family (and boss fights!)

1499010.title: Project Hypnagogia
1499010.short_description: An experiment set up by a mad scientist called "Hypnagogia" to reveal absolute fear by revealing the subject's most terrifying images into reality. The line between dream and reality is blurred. It's not easy to find a way out when there's only one scary dream going on around you.

1502460.title: B-17 Squadron
1502460.short_description: Take control of a B-17 in a realistic bomber simulator. Destroy key targets by dropping tons of bombs on them. Command each member of the crew and feel their stress and tension. Take part in the historical campaign across occupied Europe.

1505940.title: Orc Warchief: Strategy Story
1505940.short_description: Carve a war camp out of an ancient forest. Grab, drop and rally an unruly Horde with the Hand of the Warchief. Rescue goblins, claim forgotten sites and storm human castles. Every conquest brings new power and a Kingdom eager for revenge.

1510520.title: Immune Simulator Type Z
1510520.short_description: In the game "Immune Simulator," the world is losing to zombies. The protagonist finds a computer with historical records of conflicts. Altering data changes the real-world balance, affecting her companions. Is it a divine salvation or devilish trap? Unravel the hidden secrets to find out.

1517590.title: Municipal Ghosts
1517590.short_description: Drift to charge your boost in Municipal Ghosts, an arcade racer built around Time Attack and a single-player Route Book. Race salvaged industrial machines through the city's forgotten infrastructure, take on crew challenges, and chase your next personal best.

1520540.title: Hear My Light
1520540.short_description: A short narrative puzzle-shooter about bringing your brother home through a contaminated combat zone by guiding him with drones. He and the enemy are blind and catatonic, responding only to your drones' sounds — so every signal to shoot has to be your tactical decision. Especially when the dead rise

1523460.title: Dstroy 2
1523460.short_description: Dstroy 2 is a bombermania local multiplayer game.

1526850.title: Paid in Blood
1526850.short_description: Bet your blood in a twisted baccarat game to pay off your mob debt.

1526940.title: Trains Together
1526940.short_description: Trains Together is a relaxing cargo railway builder. Build your train empire, starting with small steps - lay tracks, transport goods and refine the routes as they transform into a dense, optimized system. Play with your friends or solo!

1527040.title: Den
1527040.short_description: Together you explore, together you survive. Lead siblings with unique abilities through a co-op survival Metroidvania. Scavenge diverse biomes, coordinate every move, and master interdependent powers. Uncover a nostalgic story of family as you fight to build a new home, a new Den.

1527470.title: Dying Byte Survival
1527470.short_description: Dying Byte Survival is a Gun-Fu shooter with a variety of weapons, Slow motion effect, Diving, Cloak of Invisibility and very detailed particle and effect system in a Open World with closed quarters but also open fields, with storyline and persistent gameplay.

1529270.title: Sidera Caeli
1529270.short_description: A first-person multiplayer space sim with no loading screens: gear up at the station, walk to your ship, power it up and take off. Fly in six degrees of freedom, jump between worlds, land and explore on foot or by rover, and take contracts with your squad in a persistent shared universe.

1537440.title: Bosslords
1537440.short_description: Gather an army of monsters and misfits to march on the Imperial Capital in this fantasy roguelite auto battler. Explore procedurally generated worlds filled with powerful weapons and artifacts as you gather new recruits to take to battle and show them who's boss!

1540370.title: Hans in the Internetz
1540370.short_description: Hans in the Internetz is a first-/third-person meme platform adventure game. His dream to become a wizard lays deep within the internet and you, as his apprentice must do the dirty work and “figure thiz out” Expect puzzles, toilet humour and legal drugs!

1540720.title: Forgery Craft
1540720.short_description: Master the art of forgery in this story-driven simulation game. Start with altering documents by changing single signatures and dates. End up forging entire art pieces that could fool any museum expert.

1543610.title: see you: a brief exile
1543610.short_description: may this swordless adventure leads you to a peaceful new world

1549860.title: DOLYA'
1549860.short_description: Atmospheric fantasy 2D-RPG. In a world where everything has a Plot, Fate, and a Name. Your role is to save Fate. To find that Name that was erased from reality.

1550000.title: TRYPAN
1550000.short_description: TRYPAN - A exploration based survival horror FPS. Return to Stagmon, the city where your father disappeared. Fight intelligent enemies. Improvise and use limited resources to defeat them.

1550150.title: Biomes: Survival Era
1550150.short_description: Your last memory is a bright, glistening light in the water ... then you woke up in a world in which primates never existed and you are fighting for your life.

1552280.title: Dice Mice
1552280.short_description: Dice Mice is an fast paced arcade puzzle game inspired by classic 90s gameplay. Score massive combos or better yet, steal them from your opponents. Choose a mouse and roll some dice.

1553150.title: Anima Reaver
1553150.short_description: A co-op space shooter where you fly with a squad of up to four, online or on split screen, through missions, boss fights and deathmatch. Take flagships apart turret by turret, master 18 ships, and unveil the secrets of the universe.

1553590.title: Saveseeker
1553590.short_description: Embark on a quest to overwrite save points in Saveseeker, a turn-based RPG about a time-traveling girl who must save the world from her father.

1553640.title: There's no way that tsundere girl I met in the infirmary will be my girlfriend
1553640.short_description: "B-baka! Who said you could get in!? I'm not prepared yet!" "Oh well... since you're already here, why not stay for a while?" "D-don't misunderstand, okay? It's not like I asked you to stay because I like you or anything..."

1554440.title: Avalon: Sacred Crusade
1554440.short_description: Return to the days of 90s RPGs, and the unmatched satisfaction that came from besting their unforgiving gameplay. Now, in a TRUE Massively Multiplayer Online experience (MMO), you can team up with friends or strangers in a shared world that all players can adventure in, siding with Good or Evil.

1555680.title: Sphere Wars
1555680.short_description: Sphere Wars is a fast-paced, class-based fantasy multiplayer shooter where Guardians, Warriors, Scouts, Mages, and Assassins clash in intense objective-based battles. Capture the spheres, master your class, and dominate the battlefields.

1556340.title: Jamir
1556340.short_description: Jamir is a free-to-play fast paced sci-fi tactical shooter created by one person. Master your abilities and items to destroy creatures and enemies. Upgrade your character, guns, abilities and items to become the most powerful along the globe.

1561540.title: Ship of Theseus
1561540.short_description: Steal your ship back from other realities, even from yourself. The Theseus is stranded, and every part it needs is held by a crew who needs it too. Rebuild it piece by piece and ask if it is still the same ship. A sci-fi roguelite FPS, solo or online co-op.

1562410.title: Slime 64
1562410.short_description: Slime 64 is a 3D collect-a-thon platformer inspired by the classics! Play as elemental Slimes and collect assorted Bells & Whistles to help these unlikely heroes combine their abilities, schmoove through 8 worlds, and dismantle the robotic Wurltson's evil enterprise.

1565070.title: Aletheia: Return of Odysseus
1565070.short_description: Embark on an accurate retelling of Homer’s Odyssey. A classic-inspired CRPG that puts you in control of Odysseus during his return home from the Trojan War. The game features turn-based combat, detailed character creation, choices and consequences, and a faithful depiction of Homer's Greece.

1570260.title: Time Loop Nibiru
1570260.short_description: Your death is your greatest weapon. A sci-fi Metroidvania shooter where you are trapped in a time loop on the war-torn planet Nibiru. Explore a vast interconnected world, solve puzzles, and cooperate with the ghosts of your past lives to survive and escape.

1571770.title: Ever Fallen Empire
1571770.short_description: A Strategic Empire Collapser. As The Authority. Manage a living galaxy, and plan large-scale actions according to your needs. Collapse governments, inflame rebellions, seed new factions, and sacrifice your own. All for purposes grander than any Empire could hold.

1572950.title: CAT Interstellar: Episode II
1572950.short_description: A short story inspired by Robert Heinlein's: Starship Trooper

1574400.title: Mirror Land
1574400.short_description: This is an optical illusion space puzzle game with an original core mechanism. It uses MAGIC MIRROR to GRAB and RELEASE characters and cooperate with moving the MAGIC MIRROR to complete incredible space puzzles.

1577020.title: MicroMayhem
1577020.short_description: The party game that doesn't give you time to think: 100+ five-second micro-games, faster and faster. 4 players on one screen, up to 8 online, or solo, with RICO and ZIP calling it live. Remote Play Together: only one copy needed!

1578970.title: JUST A GUY :  Online Multiplayer Ragdoll Game
1578970.short_description: JUST A GUY is an online multiplayer ragdoll game. Play with physics, explore small open worlds, drive vehicles, use fun items and complete objectives to earn new cosmetic outfits!

1579210.title: Riot Control Simulator
1579210.short_description: Take on the role of a Riot Control officer and control a riot. You can either brutally deal with the crowd or use more reasonable options. Will you decide to support a nascent dictatorship?

1580680.title: Psychonesis
1580680.short_description: Psychonesis is a survival extraction pursuit co-op game where you play as patients imprisoned by an evil billion dollar corporation. Betrayed by those you trusted most, you must outsmart and outmaneuver their private security in this ultimate prison break/police chase game!

1584590.title: Suburban Manager:From Corner Store to Regional Price Cartel & Supply Chain Trust
1584590.short_description: Suburban Manager is a hardcore supermarket sim based on Chinese business logic. Scout locations in a 3D sandbox and build a gridless store. Procure goods via App, manage logistics, and handle realistic payrolls including net salary and social security. Experience a pure retail journey.

1586260.title: BLACKFROST: The Long Dark 2
1586260.short_description: A year after the Aurora’s appearance & the world went dark, the people of Harmont & its vast wild environs struggle to survive the Quiet Apocalypse. Survive alone or with others against a host of new hazards & a fresh new survival sandbox from a pioneer of the genre. Live together. Die alone.

1589820.title: Denari
1589820.short_description: Denari is a narrative action game about a boy with telekinetic powers who must fight to save his people from the invasion of an empire. Master fast-paced hack and slash combat, take down epic bosses and follow a young warrior's coming-of-age journey as he becomes the protector of his people.

1591250.title: Lo-Fi Life
1591250.short_description: Get up? Or stay in your bed just a few more minutes? A peaceful, small-scale life sim. Go through your mornings and forge your fate with the consequences of your everyday choices.

1595160.title: Radioactivity
1595160.short_description: Radioactivity is a co-op survival horror. You are a Liquidator! Together or alone, help your state clean up post-apocalyptic radioactive wilderness. Plan each deployment, fight radiation spread and the creatures that it produces. Together, make WEA flourish once more!

1600110.title: Void Skirmisher
1600110.short_description: VOID SKIRMISHER is an arcade co-op shooter for up to 8 players: jump the warp gate, hold off endless waves of hostile fleets far past any front line, and drop in or out whenever you like.

1602090.title: Beware of Dog
1602090.short_description: Beware Of Dog is a fast paced Action Adventure game with RPG elements set in eclectic insane world where our heroes grandpa Domkrat and his faithful Dog embark on their journey to buy some meat.

1608720.title: Enlightened
1608720.short_description: Enlightened is a survival horror game with strong focus on puzzle solving. Explore the hotel in which you woke up, find clues about what happened, solve puzzles and find a way out, while surviving horrors that awaits you there.

1608920.title: Future Fall
1608920.short_description: A multiplayer post-apocalyptic survival action game with RPG elements set at the crossroads of two realities. Explore the Exclusion Zone, hunt artifacts in anomalies, manage your sanity, build your personal bunker, engage in free trade, and lead your clan to victory.

1611840.title: Formula Team
1611840.short_description: Formula team management. The Formula Team will allow you to play the role of a team director, the success of the entire team will depend on you. If you are a huge Formula fan and have always been excited about the racing atmosphere? This game is made just for you.

1619810.title: BUNNY-HOP
1619810.short_description: A first-person bhop and surf game inspired by Counter-Strike’s community servers. Hop across rooftops, ride ramps, and find out how your friend took half a second off a run you thought was clean.

1621640.title: Potion Pals
1621640.short_description: A co-op witches’ shop game for up to 6 players where you brew potions for woodland critters and turn your friends into frogs. Chop, grind, and stir witchy ingredients, fill orders, and try not to blow up the shop. Drink your own stock to explore the woods and uncover forbidden recipes.

1622500.title: Turf Wars: Slumika
1622500.short_description: Build a crew and run the streets of a generated city in the country of Slumíka. Cook and deal, fight rival gangs, dodge police heat, buy houses and stash your goods in this top-down crime sim. Every new game is a new city.

1635500.title: Elements Destiny
1635500.short_description: Use the power of the elements and face your destiny. Elements Destiny is a 2D Fantasy RPG with pixelated retro visuals. An emotional journey with a deep story, challenging turn based combat and handcrafted artworks. And yes, the soundtrack is massive!

1637460.title: TankRat
1637460.short_description: A dying world, flesh given way to steel. Swarms of corrupted mech-monsters roam a desolated land. Search and destroy, scavenge and dismantle, rebuild yourself from the wreckage. What you take becomes what you are. Survive the wasteland. Make it to Highpoint.

1638030.title: Generation Ship
1638030.short_description: Humanity's last hope is you. As its AI, build a generation ship, until the rotating ring can leave a dying Earth behind. Recycle everything your crew needs, keep them alive and fly supply missions in a realistic real-time colony and space simulation.

1640900.title: Bato Battō
1640900.short_description: Bato Battō is a 3D platformer-fighter set in classic arena-style multiplayer. Fight with unique direction based melee combat, athletic movement, and multi-chain combos using stylized physics. Compete a variety of game modes - Deathmatch, CTF, King of the Hill, Multi-Team and more!

1643220.title: Atahion - Tower Defense
1643220.short_description: Build your defense base to repel alien invaders. Atahion is a strategy and tactical defense game in which you have to extract resources, build defense towers and use bonuses to complete the mission.

1645700.title: A Wake Inn: Rebooked
1645700.short_description: A singleplayer FPP horror-action game in which you are an awakened mannequinn on a wheelchair. You're exploring the mystery of your existence in the dark corridors of Silver Inn hotel, discovering the secrets of its past, facing its current unparalleled inhabitants and solving various logic puzzles.

1646340.title: BLOOD ENGINE 血焰引擎
1646340.short_description: 《BLOOD ENGINE》是一款Metroidvania类的横板ACT游戏。我们在平台跳跃和动作游戏的基础上尝试融入我们设计的“瞬杀”系统。尝试增幅击败敌人时带给玩家的打击感和爽快感。玩家需要随时面临由怪物，机关组成的各种各样的危机，并灵活做出反应，化解危机，击败敌人。

1646520.title: Clock Overwhelmed
1646520.short_description: Organize tasks within your routine, but be careful not to overlap activities and get overwhelmed!

1647220.title: Once,in Times of Chaos
1647220.short_description: Once, in Times of Chaos is a live-action FMV espionage game set in Republican-era China. You will take on the role of an operative codenamed “Oak” and live through an extraordinary tale of intrigue in 1920s China.

1648200.title: Stellations
1648200.short_description: A game about going in circles.

1648700.title: Unoffensible
1648700.short_description: A VR strategy game where you are big, powerful and in control. Command your forces to build, defend, and destroy.

1650070.title: MAHOU SHOJO REVENGE!
1650070.short_description: MAHOU SHOJO REVENGE! is a visual novel where you follow an ex-magical girl on a quest of revenge against her former squad mates that betrayed her.

1660130.title: First Spartan
1660130.short_description: Zeus has banished his ancient enemies into a parallel world – and they are about to break free. Enter as a warrior without gear, survive, build and craft, and reawaken the energy temples. A co-op action survival RPG in a procedural world inspired by Greek mythology.

1660340.title: Colors Assemble
1660340.short_description: Help Brad reunite with his family and complete all hand-crafted 2D platform challenges in a colorful twisted world.

1661330.title: SacriFire
1661330.short_description: SacriFire is an upcoming RPG boasting a unique combat system, elaborate pixel art, and music by genre legend Motoi Sakuraba. Ezekiel Ridan, a young priest, struggles to keep his faith as the world he loves is threatened by a war between gods and demons. The adventure begins!

1662150.title: Ardent Azur
1662150.short_description: Ardent Azur is turn-based tactical by genre, dynamic by design, and narrative at its core. Lead Azur Lionswill’s troops in story mode, hone your strategy, and challenge your friends in versus battles to prove you're the ultimate commander.

1670650.title: Espiocracy
1670650.short_description: Espiocracy is an espionage grand strategy game where you lead the intelligence agency of one of 74 playable countries. Rewrite history from the shadows as you influence ideologies, stage coups, and wage proxy wars. Subterfuge takes center stage as you establish a new world order.

1672320.title: Fragile Existence
1672320.short_description: Save humanity from the brink of extinction in this sci-fi strategy game of survival. Travel among the stars to seek out resources, establish and develop colonies to sustain civilization, and grow your military might to push back against an overwhelming threat.

1674120.title: Red Rust
1674120.short_description: As a tough Soviet KGB agent you travel around the world fighting street gangs and giant mechanical monsters on direct order from Comrade Stalin.

1678570.title: Farwoods
1678570.short_description: A world of storybook roleplaying inspired by works like Redwall and Ironclaw. Join a player-driven living world of fantasy and adventure, contribute to the player-run economy, and help contribute to the organic narratives created by the community.

1681830.title: CityZen
1681830.short_description: Build a city from humble beginnings into an industrial metropolis. Manage supply chains, meet your citizens’ needs, and keep essential services running in a deep economic simulation that rewards good planning without demanding perfection.

1687540.title: Showa American Story
1687540.short_description: Showa American Story is an RPG steeped in retro pop culture. In the late 1980s, a dominant Japan culturally colonized America. Resurrected from the grave, Chigusa Choko embarks on a road trip of combat, exploration, and growth across a world both absurd and strangely familiar.

1689340.title: Island of Winds
1689340.short_description: Journey through a mystical 17th century Iceland inspired by authentic folklore and mythology. Play as Brynhildur, a young Balance Keeper who uses magic, empathy, and puzzle-solving to uncover ancient secrets and restore harmony to a fractured world.

1690100.title: Cosminers
1690100.short_description: Cosminers is a 1-4 player co-op FPP sci-fi building and mining game with survival elements based on day/night cycle. As a space miner kill various aliens on procedurally-generated planet's undergrounds. Craft and upgrade your tools, weapons & base to get countless hours of thrilling gameplay.

1693940.title: TrackShot
1693940.short_description: TrackShot is a fast-paced tank PvP game where doing tricks earns you ammo. Grind rails, perform some flips, and land clean to load your shells, then fire them at your mates. Battle it out across a bunch of arenas and modes as you compete for air superiority.

1699050.title: Sanctuary: Shattered Sun
1699050.short_description: Command vast armies across the surface of a star-encompassing Dyson Sphere in this next-gen RTS. Shatter the map itself with superweapons, freeze oceans to create new invasion routes, and control hundreds of units in your quest to dominate humanity's greatest megastructure.

1699300.title: Caboosh
1699300.short_description: Caboosh! is a roguelite where you build a train one silly wagon at a time. Every car has its own effects and synergies, so line up the combos, stack the crates waaay up high and pray the money outruns the fuel bill!

1700050.title: Red Memory
1700050.short_description: Honoring history and preserving the spirit of heroes, "Red Memories" invites you to immerse yourself in this historical journey. Get ready to delve into this chapter of "Red Memories" and feel the historic moments of struggle for peace.

1700400.title: Dead Detective: Zombie Conspiracy
1700400.short_description: Step into the shoes of Margh, an undead private detective, in this hilarious and bizarre adventure that combines classic point-and-click gameplay with an elaborate “deaduction” system. Use your brain (or what’s left of it) to solve strange and unconventional mysteries in a world ruled by zombies.

1700930.title: Furcifer's Fungeon
1700930.short_description: An autoscrolling roguelike where everything you do impacts your talent options. Become a necromancer goose, or a berserker wielding a thunder blade! Collect legendary items in each run, and bring them back home for even more build options in the future.

1702620.title: Nautilus Epoch
1702620.short_description: On an island in the Adriatic Sea lives a girl called Lily. Her world is turned upside down when she comes into contact with a mysterious seashell and finds herself lost in an endless cosmic ocean. Help her find her way back home.

1702960.title: Heroes of Abyss
1702960.short_description: Heroes of Abyss - a rogue-like tactics army battler. Guide the heroes through rooms full of different creatures. Equip and sacrifice your heroes in procedural dungeons as you fight your enemies!

1706960.title: The Mysterious Cat Tower
1706960.short_description: In this turn-based RPG, follow the story of a woman fighting off a terrible curse in order to save a loved one. Discover spells, choose talents, adjust attributes, recruit powerful allies, and reset your build to explore new strategies in order survive the treacherous world ahead.

1708050.title: Agent Simulator
1708050.short_description: If you are a sharpshooter, you would be a great fit for us. Within a short period of time, select 3 options from the list and deal with your enemies. Do not forget that the ability of using time efficiently and aiming your targets are crucial. Complete each mission and earn an agent certification.

1709330.title: AS ABOVE SO BELOW
1709330.short_description: AS ABOVE, SO BELOW is a Survival Horror Open World Action/RPG. You play as a recent college graduate offered a job in a small town, but upon arrival things are not what they seem. Face a series of unexplained events that unravel history, and ultimately change the future. Explore, Fight, Survive.

1711990.title: TOCOViX
1711990.short_description: Place Crosses on the game board and complete "Shapes". Earn "Stops" to block your opponents and make your way to victory! Play with your friends on the same device or challenge other players Online.
