1712580.title: 東方霊守祀 ~ Consciousness' Unity of Opposites
1712580.short_description: Gensokyo, the sacred land of the forgotten, mysterious spirits whisper silently from every corner. Burning torii lintels, an uncanny full moon—where do these visions of the present world lead? Become a maiden within the barrier and uncover the truth behind the strange tale of the world of stillness.

1713130.title: Aledorn
1713130.short_description: Spiritual successor to many old school hard-core RPG/Dungeon masterpieces, that combines tactical combat system, exploration in the first person view and intriguing travelling system between main map locations.

1714390.title: My wife is a princess
1714390.short_description: A traitor appeared in the kingdom, and the seal of the demon king was lifted. In order to save the kingdom~the beautiful queen sent a rescue request to the brave...The price was to become the wife of the brave!

1716760.title: Trinity Archetype
1716760.short_description: Create busted builds and unleash crazy combos in this Skill-Crafting Roguelike RPG! Mix and match bazillions of runes, boost it up in battle, and shatter the chaos consuming your broken world.

1719930.title: Tokyo Stranger 东京诡事
1719930.short_description: Tokyo Stranger is an aerial genre of text horror game inspired by the opening ceremony of the 2020 Tokyo Olympic Games. You play as a tourist from an exotic country, looking for any possibility to escape Tokyo in a static world.

1721000.title: Property Pro
1721000.short_description: Your tower is falling apart and your staff came from the classified ads. Build the rooms, take in the guests, then hire the people to keep it standing. Send the plumber to the burst pipe, not the front desk. Put the wrong worker on the wrong job and you'll watch your guests walk out.

1721790.title: Summon, then build an invincible harem
1721790.short_description: Spiritual Summoners-They can use the Mana in their bodies to summon spiritual people from another world. Your mother is going to travel far, and only left you a letter, and a...beautiful spirit war girl "Shirley". what are you going to do with the summoning technique of the spirit?

1724080.title: Plastic
1724080.short_description: You're a plastic soldier battling on 5 acres of backyard. Fight on foot, crew tanks, fly helicopters, and command bots in a combined-arms shooter. Capture toy cities, requisition equipment, and establish defenses as you advance toward the enemy base.

1725710.title: Demi and the Fractured Dream
1725710.short_description: In this action adventure, play as Demi and venture through the wondrous world of Somnus. Tasked by a mysterious voice, you must destroy the legendary Accursed Beasts to save the world. Use your attacks and abilities to slay enemies, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind an ancient history.

1725810.title: Myrne 6313
1725810.short_description: Myrne 6313 is a mix between the extraction shooter genre and corporate life. Survive an hostile office space where each step can be your last. Help HR find their stapler, get chased by security dogs, clear your inbox, fight cultists in the parking lot, learn magic… And more!

1727760.title: Mars Tactics
1727760.short_description: The Red Planet is at war. Lead either Capital’s corporate army or Labor’s worker revolutionaries and wage war across a vast strategic map, then assume direct control in turn-based tactical battles featuring artillery, vehicles, and fully-destructible environments.

1728450.title: My Cozy Home
1728450.short_description: My Cozy Home is a relaxing house building game where you get to build the house you always dreamed of. The game offers a huge library of items to create a bedroom or a kitchen or a gaming room or anything you can dream of. Choice is yours. Add to Wishlist now!

1728620.title: IKUMA - The Frozen Compass
1728620.short_description: Embark on a haunting journey into the cold in this narrative adventure - either alone or with a friend. IKUMA tells the story of Sam, a teenage boy who finds himself stranded in the Arctic with his dog. He must face not only its harsh environment, but also something lurking deeper in the shadows.

1729330.title: SkyCruise
1729330.short_description: Race a solar-powered ship from the mines to orbit before the sun goes down. Steer, jump and burn through 35 zones of drop hammers, traffic and open gaps, then chase Gold and Ace medals against the ghost of your best run.

1730600.title: Bolero: The Shifting Isle
1730600.short_description: In a genre defying blend of Tactics-Adventure gameplay, unravel the story of the four adventurers who braved the unknown and solved the mystery of The Shifting Isle.

1731290.title: SPINE - This is Gun Fu
1731290.short_description: SPINE is a single-player action game about close-quarters gunfights with aesthetics of Gun Fu movies. Step into the stunning cyberpunk world with rebellious street artist Redline and her sentient combat implant Spine as they defy the autocratic AI regime in search of Redline's captured brother.

1734130.title: Concerto on White
1734130.short_description: Rhythm Action? No, this is MUSICIAN SIMULATION! Concerto on White is a musician simulation game featuring classical music. Unlike any typical rhythm games, players are required to actually play the main melody. In the main story, you will experience adventurous campus life in the academy.

1735080.title: High Elo Girls
1735080.short_description: High Elo Girls is a Visual Novel set in the esports scene where you play as the latest recruit for a new all-girls team. Can you help your squad achieve their true potential, or will you only squander your own?

1736200.title: Sealed Gate
1736200.short_description: Sealed Gate is an exciting pixel 2D MMORPG with a huge world, lots of quests, crafting and social gameplay. Engage in battles with monsters, explore mysterious locations and become the hero of your own fantasy story!

1741170.title: Fools, Maniacs and Liars
1741170.short_description: A narrative-driven game of suspense, crime, and dark humor. Amid exquisitely crafted art and a gripping story, the Wushan Great Buddha's demise unfolds.

1747470.title: Road Diner Simulator
1747470.short_description: Start as a cook in Becky’s roadside diner and become her business partner. Cook dozens of dishes, keep guests happy, hire and manage staff, then expand and decorate the place your way. Play solo or in online co-op.

1747630.title: For The Hive
1747630.short_description: Survive as a tiny insect in a big harsh world. Fight your way to the top of the food chain. Build a strong colony that stands the test of time and become the ruler of the insect world.

1748140.title: Slimeception
1748140.short_description: Who's sus?! Work together to find out who's lying to you.

1749050.title: Revasion
1749050.short_description: Breakout, turned inside out. Spin a glowing ring of blocks around a ball that always curves back to the centre. Break every block, survive the bullet-storm Evade phases, and hold on as the whole game speeds up.

1749810.title: Lair Land Story 2: Mist of Sea
1749810.short_description: After traveling far to the southern end of Lair Land, seven knights have reached Chainch Bay. Settled in a small tropical fishing village surrounded by ruins, they will spend the next few years building a new life here while facing the most challenging quest they will ever meet.

1751820.title: Project OutFox
1751820.short_description: Project OutFox is mod friendly, cross-platform rhythm game engine based on StepMania, featuring 21 different modes simulating different dance, sensor, instrument and key-based rhythm games. Play your way through 25+ years of community content and relive your nostalgia and try to outfox your friends!

1752080.title: HUNGER
1752080.short_description: HUNGER throws you into the chaos of plague-ravaged Napoleonic Europe. This multiplayer extraction RPG blends brutal melee and ranged combat with deep long term character progression, questing and crafting. Scavenge for resources, battle unspeakable horrors, and outlast rival Living.

1753150.title: MoltKeeper
1753150.short_description: Build a creature from parts and watch it fight. Each win pays samples of the parts your enemies wore, until they are yours to research; the rarest are carried only by wild creatures. Release builds into the Wilds to fight other keepers while you're away. A free creature builder and auto battler.

1754880.title: Vowless Blade: A Fleeting Hope
1754880.short_description: A wuxia roguelike deckbuilder with loot and extraction. Turn martial arts into card tactics: strikes beat feints, feints beat guards, and guards beat strikes. Outsmart your foes, refine your deck, and steadily build a powerful band of heroes. Victory rewards strategy, not reflexes!

1757350.title: ILL
1757350.short_description: A realistic first-person action horror game that takes you into a dark fort overtaken by a mysterious entity. Unpredictable monsters, a visceral dismemberment system, and realistic physics create an atmosphere of relentless terror.

1757380.title: One More Wipe : Raid Night
1757380.short_description: One More Wipe : Raid Night — Lead a 25-player raid. Alone. Nobody's late, nobody's AFK, and you will still wipe. Recruit from 10 classes, draft a new build every run and call the shots through 8 dungeons and 16 bosses. Or hand the raid to your AI agent.

1763860.title: Rabbit's Tale
1763860.short_description: Rabbit’s Tale is a hand-drawn metroidvania where portals lead into roguelike runs, and every boss you beat brings back a new power for the open world. Hunt the oppressive Steam Order, search for your kidnapped family, and survive with a symbiotic companion.

1764280.title: Dungeons of the Amber Griffin
1764280.short_description: Play as a group of daredevils who explore the world of dark fantasy in search of fame, amber and gold. Experience the classic mechanics of the iconic ‘90s Dungeon Crawlers with a new twist. Solve the mystery of the ghost that haunted the ruins and discover a bestiary based on Kashubian beliefs.

1767010.title: Echoes of the Stars
1767010.short_description: Confront fate and the gods themselves in Echoes of the Stars, a 2D Handpainted Action RPG. Explore diverse biomes, gain new skills, fight challenging foes, unlock new abilities, play mini-games, and unfold the epic journey of Eldric and Rin.

1768860.title: Bionic Shield: Battle for Space Nebula Omega
1768860.short_description: You are the Bionic Shield, humanity's last hope against the Automaton invasion. Win the space battles, drop onto new planets in your combat suit, take the wheel of drones and tanks, and shoot your way through the machine hordes. No two invasions play the same.

1773710.title: Cardseer
1773710.short_description: Cardseer is a deckbuilding game combining roguelike elements with a sprawling campaign. Choose your hero and fight your way across diverse maps filled with fearsome enemies, all while crafting your deck and collecting powerful artifacts. Can you rise to the challenge?

1777480.title: Pathbreakers: Roaming Blades
1777480.short_description: Pathbreakers: Roaming Blades is a turn-based tactical RPG where you lead a company of mercenaries in a medieval fantasy world. Try your hand at mercenary work, trading, or exploring, and keep your crew well stocked for brutal combat in a procedurally-generated open-world campaign.

1778140.title: Ghost Network : Dark Hacker
1778140.short_description: Hack your way up Neon City's underworld. Take contracts from 8 fixers, crack networks from the terminal or run them in a 3D dive, script your own hacks, steal the data and jack out before the trace finds you. A full single-player career.

1779280.title: Humankind in a nutshell
1779280.short_description: Spin the slot and decide the fate of your civilization. From seeds to kingdoms, from stone to steel. From the very first turn to a thousand years later, every choice becomes history. From the first spark of fire to a forest of skyscrapers. How long can your people survive?

1779610.title: Farm Renovator
1779610.short_description: Buy a ruined farm and give it its full glory back. Clean, repair, restore, improve. Repair machines, manage the work on your farm, take care of your animals, and choose your development strategy. We're sure you'll have many satisfied customers.

1782950.title: SpaceDominator
1782950.short_description: SpaceDominator is strategy fantasy open world where you can discover universe! Contact other civilizations, make friends or enemies, start trading or fighting, expand your own area or help others to expand, increase your intelligence level.. and much more! Follow developing http://discord.gg/cqEZJ5J

1784310.title: The Swordfish: Knight of the Deep
1784310.short_description: Embark on an epic adventure as a sword-wielding fish and restore order to the kingdom's depths. Explore an ocean world full of adorable characters, menacing foes, and hidden wonders.

1785950.title: Razgovor Online
1785950.short_description: Razgovor Online is a Social MMORPG-Lite open world game, providing ways to explore, socialise, and grow, with Jobs, Mini-Games and player housing, or even taking long drives with your friends, the freedom is yours!

1786320.title: The Wolf Is Dead
1786320.short_description: The Wolf is Dead is a murder mystery game. When the Big Bad Wolf is found murdered at a party for his biopic, you're called in. Interrogate suspects, investigate the scene of the crime and use this to travel back in time and reconstruct the events of the evening. Who killed Alexander Wolff?

1786630.title: Droid Escape
1786630.short_description: In this adventure, help Droid 07 to overcome challenges, discover mysteries and free your friend from the miniaigas.

1787410.title: Arcane Treasures: Trading Card Game
1787410.short_description: Build a whimsical deck of cartoon animals to battle foes & uncover special treasures in this cute but competitive online Trading Card Game! Collect trading cards featuring indie artists' works, open booster packs, and complete challenges to expand your collection!

1787850.title: Tianfang Funland
1787850.short_description: After being stranded in a decaying amusement park, an elementary school student and his estranged older brother discover that the city they grew up in has been tampered with. Tianfang Funland is a surreal adventure game with retro game visuals that bring players to 2010s Beijing.

1790550.title: Lady Hunt
1790550.short_description: Lady Hunt is a pixel art action platformer, set in a dark gothic world, where blood has been infected. You play as a huntress, who must find a way to purify this world, inhabited by monsters and beasts.

1792020.title: Hop Hop Delivery!
1792020.short_description: HOP HOP DELIVERY it's your little delivery company! Your goal is to find and deliver animals and objects in all genre, through crazy, creative and deformable levels, using different types of vehicles impacted by physics!

1792390.title: Life After End
1792390.short_description: Dive into the harsh world of post-apocalyptic Siberia. Extreme climate, limited resources, wild animals, and other players - all this is part of the daily struggle, where only the strongest survive. Are you ready to find out what life is like after the end?

1792430.title: RogueVirus
1792430.short_description: Grid-based action roguelike where you face chaotic encounters against computer viruses. Build and upgrade your antivirus using a vast array of commands and add-ons in order to survive.

1792780.title: Spirit Vendor
1792780.short_description: I built Spirit Vendor as a solo indie dev, and I'm excited to share it with you! In this charming world, you decide how your day unfolds—run your shop, tend your fields, and care for your animals. Explore a lively village, meet unique characters, build friendships, and perhaps even find true love.

1794000.title: Remnants of R'lyeh
1794000.short_description: Remnants of R'lyeh is a first-person survival horror that drags you from drowned ruins and the streets of Innsmouth into Abyssal City, a steampunk city in the abyss, and down to R'lyeh itself. Fight above and below the water and find a way out before your sanity breaks.

1795530.title: Catacombs Of The Yokai
1795530.short_description: Catacombs of the Yokai is an indie single player psychological survival horror game in which you must explore the twisted depths of randomly generated catacombs filled with enemies inspired by Japanese/Taiwanese urban legends and myths.

1796710.title: Finders, Keepers
1796710.short_description: Night work at St. Ossian's: go down into crypts that never end, carry up cursed and blessed relics, and sell them to the Keeper. Every curse pays better and frays your nerve. Die below and your haul stays down there with you, waiting for you to come back for it.

1797370.title: Timberquest
1797370.short_description: Embark on an adventure in our RPG game! Explore a new, wild continent and fight to survive against environmental factors and monsters. With a heavy focus on cooperative play. Customize your character's stat-driven abilities to suit your preferred playstyle.

1797740.title: Farming Sweeper
1797740.short_description: Build, manage and grow your farm in a unique way: Solving puzzles with traditional minesweeper mechanics and managing your business finances in a relaxing game with great replay factor.

1800250.title: Void Soul Awakening
1800250.short_description: Void Soul Awakening is a hyper fast action roguelite blending hack and slash combat, third person gunplay, and sorcery. As a wandering soul trapped in an ever shifting cosmic prison, master a massive arsenal, swap between powerful classes, adapt to every run, and fight your way to the Keeper.

1800670.title: Dream Loop
1800670.short_description: A first-person music-puzzle adventure. Wander surreal dreamscapes, record the world around you, and mix what you find into original tracks. Turn up your headphones and drop out.
developers: The Mad Men of Oopsy Daisy, Inc
publishers: The Mad Men of Oopsy Daisy, Inc

1801140.title: Guns Undarkness
1801140.short_description: A command battle JRPG by Shoji Meguro, known for scoring and directing on the “Persona” and “Shin Megami Tensei” series. The adventure takes place in a near-future world on the brink of destruction. Become a member of the private military company BTI's Alpha Team, and carry out grueling missions.

1802100.title: Sanity City
1802100.short_description: Start your new life in a futuristic cyber world. Team up with your friends and go on a raid. Acquire money, equipment and fame.

1802240.title: Phantom Gear
1802240.short_description: Gear up in your battle armor and take on the sinister Ocular Force! Become Josephine and put a stop to the power-mad cult and the mysterious phantom force behind their spree of carnage!

1803110.title: ASCENDANT
1803110.short_description: High stakes, high chaos, and the most unpredictable twist on capture-the-flag yet. Outwit ruthless opponents, face mutant wildlife, and secure four biocores in this fast-paced FPS where wild events can turn the tables in an ever-shifting BioPunk arena. This is ASCENDANT - bring backup.

1804730.title: DEPRISION
1804730.short_description: DEPRISION is a first-person survival horror game where you are the subject of a classified mental manipulation experiment. Explore environments distorted by memories and trauma, survive a system that adapts to your personal fears, and endure traumatic threats.

1805170.title: Evil Dreams
1805170.short_description: Travel through nightmares until you go insane. Evil Dreams is a dark adventure, telling the story of a boy living in the 19th century and forced to face ancient evil. Delve into the world of dreams to find out the truth.

1805940.title: Shrooms
1805940.short_description: Explore a dark isometric forest alone or in 1–4 player co-op. Gather and test hundreds of ingredients, brew potions and monster oils, build a home, and uncover why a dwarf village has held exactly thirty-four souls for two centuries.

1806210.title: Spellcraft
1806210.short_description: Spellcraft is a new type of strategy game: a Real-Time Battler where you actively command an entire team of heroes and cast spells to outplay your opponents. Wishlist now and play in Preseason 2!

1808160.title: Demon Spore
1808160.short_description: Blast your way out of tentacle hell as a failed lab experiment gives birth to a rapidly growing viral horror in this intense action rogue-lite inspired by 80s Monster movies. Use the lab to your advantage and improvise an escape plan before this constantly evolving life form spreads out of control.

1808960.title: Firearms Factory
1808960.short_description: A strategy-management game centered on weapons production and wartime logistics. Your candy factory is forced, by government order, to arm the military throughout both world wars. Set up production lines, supply the front lines, keep your workers alive, and determine the outcome of the war.

1809390.title: Rebirth of Arcadia
1809390.short_description: Rebirth of Arcadia is a story-rich turn-based tactics JRPG. Experience the journey of two groups of people working together to escape from the Abyss. Explore, defeat monsters, and harness the power of runestones to uncover the secrets of the Abyss.

1811360.title: Unnatural
1811360.short_description: Unnatural is a first-person survival horror game set in a dark world between life and death. Solve puzzles, manage resources, and survive invisible monsters using your firearm and supernatural light to reveal and destroy the horrors lurking in the darkness.

1812640.title: Path of Life
1812640.short_description: Fantasy RPG with large world exploration, turn based combat strategy, custom character development through character attribute distribution and skill development. You Choose to play on the evil side or the good side.

1815990.title: Pedro and Sofia's Nuclear Winter
1815990.short_description: A fantasy adventure across a nuclear-torn America! Play as Pedro and Sofia and set out on a quest in this open-world, 3D/2D role-playing game!

1818660.title: Kalyskah
1818660.short_description: Fight as a vampire while exploring a dark fantasy open-world in this 3rd person RPG. Make choices to affect the betterment of humanity– or yourself; strengthen your vampiric skills to fight bandits, trolls, and undead; and entertain yourself in fully animated seductive scenes.

1821670.title: Drachenquell
1821670.short_description: Willkommen in der Welt von Drachenquell, einem epischen Abenteuer, das dich in eine Ära voller Mythen und Legenden entführt. Erkunde die weitläufigen Länder von Drachenquell, wo jede Ecke der Karte mit Leben gefüllt ist.

1826770.title: Alice is Dead: Hearts and Diamonds
1826770.short_description: A point and click noir mystery, set in a grim and corrupt Wonderland. Alice is Dead: Hearts and Diamonds is a complete remake of the classic Flash game trilogy, including all new art, added puzzles, expanded lore, and plenty of secrets for old and new fans alike.

1826900.title: RECURSOR
1826900.short_description: An action rogue-lite inspired by platform fighters

1827200.title: RSOD
1827200.short_description: Shoot, crack, and quest in RSOD, an action game with elements of roleplaying, loot, and anime-style graphics.

1828830.title: The Beresford family
1828830.short_description: What happened on the night of July 20, 1824? The Beresford family was sleeping unaware that an ancient evil was about to resurface. An ancient evil that brought upon them a curse whose echoes resonate to this day.

1830110.title: THE SIGNAL: Stranded on Sirenis
1830110.short_description: Crash-landed on the alien world of Sirenis, you must survive, build a base and search for your missing brother. Gather, research and craft your way across a hostile planet of strange creatures, ancient ruins and a mystery far bigger than your crash.

1832170.title: RoRX
1832170.short_description: A competitive strategy game where both players plan in secret, then every order resolves at once. Build an army of Robots from over 200 cards, fight on hexagonal arenas and outthink your rival, not outclick them. Every card is earned by playing.

1833210.title: Astromine
1833210.short_description: Astromine is a survival mining game about scavenging fully destructible planets. Designed for 1 to 4 players. Land on planets and gather enough materials to fight off alien creatures, fight robot factions, build structures and spaceships, and conquer the solar system

1835080.title: Taste Of Heaven
1835080.short_description: Taste of heaven is a 2D cooking RPG with a pinch of roguelite ! Master the art of crafting dishes for celestial gourmets while forging bonds with a cast of unforgettable characters. Discover hidden recipes and explore a vibrant, ever-changing world brimming with charm and mystery.

1835670.title: Fall Up
1835670.short_description: Take a leap into a lost world of mechanical wonders and embark on a hopping adventure with our adorable Labi! You need to traverse this cartoonish world with a variety of jumps and moves, meet squishy creatures and clumsy robots and reveal the secrets of this world.

1837730.title: Loot List: Thief Sim
1837730.short_description: Rise from pauper to master thief - grab the loot list and get to work, whether it’s a roadside diner or a federal vault: slip past security and make fools of everyone, or unleash chaos and blow the place apart. Fence the haul to upgrade the hideout, gear up, and build your criminal empire.

1840410.title: Knight of the Forgotten Realm
1840410.short_description: Knight of the Forgotten Realm is a 2.5D dark fantasy action-adventure soulslike set in Austeria, a war-torn realm. Featuring visceral combat and the ability to overcharge your soul, you and a godlike being known as an Eternal head east to uncover lost knowledge. Will you survive the Eternal's call?

1842340.title: Hurling Herman
1842340.short_description: A unique platformer where you hurl vials to create temporary platforms, navigate sprawling caves, and battle creatures. With an original soundtrack and immersive environments, a challenging adventure awaits you.

1843450.title: Link: The Unleashed Nexus RH
1843450.short_description: "Link: The Unleashed Nexus RH" is a high-speed 3D action game. You dash through the world known as "HAVEN", which is controlled by the mysterious object "Nexus", making full use of various actions.

1843480.title: Autobahn Racing
1843480.short_description: No limits, no rules: 300 km/h on German autobahns and through authentic cities. Brutal street races, dense traffic, cops on your tail – pure adrenaline rush from Munich to Berlin.

1843790.title: Check x Mate
1843790.short_description: A fantasy visual novel set in a magical world of chess. Gameplay consists mainly of decision making and chess puzzles that represent what is happening in the story. There is a beginner difficulty for those new to chess and expert difficulty for those who seek more of a challenge.

1846700.title: Witchbrook
1846700.short_description: Discover magic and mystery in Witchbrook, a spellbinding witch life-sim for up to 4-players! Start your life as the newest resident witch in the bustling seaside town of Mossport. Make friends, find love, and discover a world filled with wonder and charm on the road to graduation and beyond...

1847310.title: Trailer Park Life
1847310.short_description: Build and manage your own trailer park to either become a peaceful haven or a pit of unruly partiers. Expand on services and amenities to keep tenants happy. Manage staff to keep your park safe and clean or let chaos run amuck and risk it all for higher gains.

1853440.title: Tropico 7
1853440.short_description: Get rich or die trying! In Tropico 7, you step into El Presidente’s shiny boots again to build your island nation and – literally – move mountains. As glorious leader you guide your loyal citizens (and your Swiss Bank Account) through the ages toward untold prosperity.

1854570.title: Colossal Citadels
1854570.short_description: A fantasy strategy, featuring turn-based factory building over procedural resource types. Expand and optimize your network of towns, grow your heroes, and excel in deep tactical seamless auto-battler combat.

1857810.title: DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 3
1857810.short_description: DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 3 is a wholly-new Dragon Ball experience, where you decide the hero you want to be in an unexplored Dragon Ball world: AGE 1000.

1859970.title: Pseudo-Psy Play
1859970.short_description: A 21st Century Noir Horror Game. Pseudo-Psy Play is an eccentric blend of a side-scrolling shooter and a point-and-click adventure. The time has come – face your fears in this bone-chilling story-driven horror game that feels (and looks) like nothing else in the genre. Are you ready, Joseph?

1860010.title: KEEPERS 1477
1860010.short_description: A story-driven action RPG set in medieval Ottoman Istanbul, featuring authentic Ottoman and Turkish miniature art. Explore the city, complete quests, master brutal melee combat, cast powerful spells, discover hidden secrets, and battle hordes of undead and demons to protect the capital.

1862300.title: Catch The Train
1862300.short_description: Catch The Train is a chaotic co-op cooking game where the kitchen is rolling down the tracks. Chop, cook, and serve hungry passengers while your crew scrambles to shovel coal and keep the engine moving. Work together, manage the madness, and outrun the storm before it consumes you.

1864570.title: Sender Unknown
1864570.short_description: Work the night shift in an underground sorting facility. Weigh packages, compare their contents, and meet your quota by 6 AM. But beware, some packages hide dark secrets. Identify bad batches, earn cash, and survive the night in this tense PSX-style horror job simulator.

1867920.title: No Humanity - Internship
1867920.short_description: No Humanity - InternShip is a chaotic physics-based space survival game where interns swing, smash, and build their way to survival. Use rope mechanics to collect resources, battle enemies, and expand your space colony. Explore humorous cave biomes and survive absurd corporate tasks in deep space.

1868210.title: Bunker Builder Simulator
1868210.short_description: Plan your work, dig a hole and build a bunker, that will survive anything! Manage safety, needs and moods of your clients, so you can become the best architect and earn a fortune. Will you be able to meet the expectations?

1868750.title: Secrets For Taking
1868750.short_description: Take the others' deepest secrets--including your own. Find out where you belong in this decaying world.

1871640.title: The Backworld
1871640.short_description: Slip through the cracks of reality and explore a vast, open-ended RPG world where surreal horrors collide with fantasy kingdoms and sci-fi cities. Fight in strategic turn-based battles and tense real-time action. The more your sanity breaks, the more the world and its monsters warp around you.

1872800.title: EVE Vanguard
1872800.short_description: EVE Vanguard is an extraction-adventure FPS set on the ruthless planets of New Eden. Raid crash sites, assault forward bases and seize exotic tech before colossal Nemesis Drones hunt you down. Every mission is a race against time. Every extraction shapes a larger war. This is only the beginning.

1876210.title: Illusion Fight — Season 1
1876210.short_description: A dark fantasy tactical universe. Fight in hex-grid combat, collect cards, raise creatures, read the novel, and watch the webtoon — all free, all connected. Built over 23 years by a solo developer. Free to play. Season 1 is live now.

1877480.title: Miuma
1877480.short_description: Miuma is a cozy game about a little, modest bakery with unexpected twists. The game features the significant feat of Kevin, the bakery’s new owner, and his venture within the middle of nowhere of which he calls his home.

1877940.title: Western Brawl
1877940.short_description: In a quiet western town, the righteous gunslinger Hannah finds herself surrounded by enemies from all directions inside a saloon. Draw your revolver, take down waves of ruthless outlaws, and fight your way through intense gunfights to carve out a path to survival!

1889850.title: SIM Chef: Restaurant management
1889850.short_description: SIM Chef is a restaurant sim that starts on an empty lot. Build the dining room and the kitchen, choose from over 200 dishes and drinks from around the world and hire a team that knows how to make your menu. Win over the judges and take home awards.

1890270.title: Trailthread
1890270.short_description: Trailthread is a turn-based JRPG where players weave together brand-new attacks each turn. Follow three young adventurers as they scale Anvite Mountain and tumble through time to defeat the Obsidian Drake. Use game-changing Augments to cast dynamic combos and carve your path to the summit!

1890350.title: Greed Hunters
1890350.short_description: Collect artefacts. Trade them for power. Betray your friends. Greed Hunters is a chaotic roguelike for up to 8 players, where even the worst artifacts fuel your rise to dominance.

1891280.title: Everbloom
1891280.short_description: Everbloom is a cute and cozy social farming sim set in a world of whimsy - grow buckets of popcorn right on the plant and make chocolate milk by feeding your cows candy bars. Grow, care, build, decorate, and explore the world of Everbloom solo or with your friends.

1891970.title: BOOOOST!!!!
1891970.short_description: BOOOOST!!!! is a skill-based, sci-fi themed action platformer with some narrative driven elements and some minor puzzle elements.

1892080.title: BLEAK Remastered
1892080.short_description: Immerse yourself in the dystopian world of Pinnacle with BLEAK Remastered. Experience stunning new artwork and enhanced gameplay in this dark adventure. Can you navigate the relentless hostile world and save your sister, Asha?

1894890.title: Beckon
1894890.short_description: Salvation lies deep beneath blood-soaked earth. Survive horrors born of Scottish folklore alone or with your friends - improve your camp, hunt and forge powerful weapons and find ancient, game-altering magic. From the dark, you hear her Beckon - eat a hearty meal and get ready to descend once again.

1897660.title: The Main Menu
1897660.short_description: The Main Menu is a psychological horror thriller where you wake up trapped in a room with only a corrupted main menu to interact with. Changing the menu physically changes the room around you. Manipulate its buttons and hidden systems to solve puzzles and uncover what controls the screen.

1902860.title: Light Odyssey
1902860.short_description: Light Odyssey is a soulslike boss rush where every battle is a test of mastery. Play as Bandi and fight to restore light to a world consumed by shadows. Face off against towering colossi in three deadly phases that demand precision, patience, and adaptation.

1905210.title: Hero Chest
1905210.short_description: In a role reversal in Hero Chest, take control of a chest tired of being looted and frighten the heroes back to their guilds! Create your way with the cards, ally with the monsters, save the chests and earn gold Have fun with the perfect combination of Roguelike, Dungeon Crawler and Card Game!

1905550.title: BATTLESAGE
1905550.short_description: Fly, dash and strike to save a kingdom in peril, in this fast third- person aerial action-fantasy where movement is your only weapon. Dive into a fight, break away, keep your flow, and grow from novice flyer into a true BattleSage.

1905580.title: Kloa - Child of the Forest
1905580.short_description: Consumed by a mysterious curse, restore a once lush forest and its inhabitants to their natural state in this action adventure tale. Experience fast-paced combat, puzzles, and the beauty of nature captured in handcrafted pixel art.

1906430.title: Halve
1906430.short_description: Two spirits wake up separated in a broken world, with no memory of what they once were. Control them simultaneously in an atmospheric, immersive journey about separation, memory, and the hope of becoming whole again.

1908380.title: Binary Golf
1908380.short_description: 3D sci-fi mini-golf where you hit targets until the last target becomes the hole. Every target grants a unique ability; chain abilities mid-flight and curve your shots. Compete for stars in 4-player Battle Mode or explore a story full of bosses and secrets.

1909310.title: Snowtracked
1909310.short_description: Feel like a kid again. The door is open to a beautiful winter landscape. Wrestle your way over rocks covered in thick snow. Build anything you want, stick by stick. Play solo or with your friends (1-4).

1909940.title: Badger Tactics
1909940.short_description: You stole and lost your sister's favorite figurines. Get them back or face her wrath! Fight, collect, and track down the missing figures before SHE finds you. In this retro turn-based tactical RPG, your fate is decided by the roll of the dice!

1910170.title: Deflectorium
1910170.short_description: Deflectorium: 2D sci-fi rogue-lite singleplayer. Deflect deadly shots back at your enemies to become unstoppable. With unique deflection system, you'll dominate battles while upgrading your skills and stats. Prepare for adrenaline experience where defense isn't just a tactic but an art.

1911340.title: Dimakerus
1911340.short_description: Dimakerus is a social deduction combat game for up to 4 players. Disguise as anyone. Mimic their ways. Ambush your friends. Discover cursed Roman relics in procedural catacombs and wield their might to obliterate those who stand in your way.

1917470.title: Into The Haunted Land
1917470.short_description: An online co-op horror game for up to 6 players. Team up with your friends to explore ruins, loot cursed items, hide from monsters and extract safely. Do whatever it takes to meet the Guild’s quota.

1919410.title: Hero Dungeon
1919410.short_description: An incremental auto-battler with a twist. Collect 50+ heroes and send parties into dungeons that keep growing while you are away. Team up with friends in mega dungeons, or descend into the Endless Depths: a hand-played rogue-lite mode, solo or co-op.

1920290.title: Barkour
1920290.short_description: BARKOUR is a fast-paced action platformer with a stealthy twist, starring Agent T.H.U.N.D.E.R. - a tail-wagging master of parkour, high-tech gadgets and getting into trouble. Jump, sneak and fight your way through a spy adventure packed with action, canine chaos and delightfully absurd surprises.

1924470.title: Cursed Dungeon Raider
1924470.short_description: Embark on an exploration adventure with spooky and horror elements, tasked with recovering real historical artifacts from excavation sites around the world. Beware of local traps and monsters inspired by the mythology of each region.

1926550.title: Orbit Or Beat Extended Edition
1926550.short_description: Get ready for new type of rhythm action game you may have never experienced before. Listen to various awesome music, control your ball, and dodge all the obstacles to get through all the levels. But be prepared to any unexpected and "unfair" gimmicks designed throughout the levels.

1926720.title: The Adventures Of Bryan Scott
1926720.short_description: "The Adventures of Bryan Scott" is a classic 2D point-and-click adventure game, inspired by masterpieces like "Broken Sword" and "Deponia".

1927200.title: near the fear
1927200.short_description: Lost in an unknown world, alone and desperate, you're driving towards the light. On an ever-shifting road, turn inwards and face your ancient enemy to find the freedom you crave.

1931860.title: OctaRace
1931860.short_description: OctaRace is an explosive racing game. It pays tribute to the good old top-down multiplayer titles, offering fun and intense races.

1936310.title: Sugoi Adventure! DragonSlayer
1936310.short_description: A game of choices where you get to become a hero, impress hot girls, and slay a dragon. 💕 Choose your own adventure and make it truly sugoi!

1937610.title: A Ruthless World
1937610.short_description: Embark on an adventure through a ruthless, puzzle filled 80s-inspired world.

1937960.title: Throwing Hands
1937960.short_description: Jump and dash your way to victory in this vibrant side-scrolling platformer. Navigate through stunning environments and intricate puzzles on your quest to punch powerful enemies and save your kingdom.

1941920.title: Factory Island
1941920.short_description: Factory Island is an experimental game built to display 3D worlds inside a 2D renderer. Explore procedurally generated maps, build voxel structures, invite your friends to multiplayer, experiment with water and simple electronics, fight creatures and create mods for this game-engine project.

1946380.title: Eternal Remnant
1946380.short_description: Dive into the unforgettable tale of two siblings on the run in this emotional RPG journey. With only their wits and a cursed power too dangerous to control, they must fight, explore and scavenge to survive in an unfamiliar world. Will their bond be strong enough to endure the road ahead?

1947020.title: Ukrainians: Our battle
1947020.short_description: Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of military events, become one of the volunteers of the country, where your every decision can become critical. Explore locations, make decisions, complete challenging missions. Everything is in your hands. Good luck!

1947030.title: Love In a Bottle
1947030.short_description: Ankora the Love Demon only has a month to prove she can make it on her own! Can she settle down and find love?!

1949610.title: Luminous Nights
1949610.short_description: Embark on a HeartsLike action-RPG inspired by 1001 Arabian Nights. Master fast-paced melee combat and powerful magic, unlock new abilities and weapons, explore the mystical city of Noor through 3D platforming, and rally memorable allies against the Masked King.

1950230.title: Galactic Diner
1950230.short_description: Galactic Diner is a cooking-themed RPG full of minigame mayhem. Explore a planet full of friends, food, and mysteries, and cook your way to the top of the galaxy!

1953430.title: DearMyFriend
1953430.short_description: Set off to the unknown world Stargather Land now. The shadow of chaos is shrouding here for so long, a girl from another world shoulders the responsibility of saving this land. Travel with the power of elements until the end of destiny, only fight will lead her to the finish.

1953850.title: VICE Undercover
1953850.short_description: VICE Undercover is a point & click narco-thriller set in an alternate 1980s Miami - where every choice matters. You play as undercover agent Vida, and for one hour per day, you're taking control over a cartel-run computer using Amigo OS, a fully-functional 1980-inspired operating system.

1954240.title: Galaxy Gang
1954240.short_description: JUMP into the Ultimate Universe as Danny, a ten‑year‑old kid who suddenly finds himself wrapped up in a cosmic adventure way bigger than he ever expected. Galaxy Gang gives you a fast, colorful introduction to the worlds, characters, and movement that define the game.

1963680.title: GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT
1963680.short_description: Become the pilot you were born to be. Change humanity’s fate in GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT, a high-mobility action game that delivers a bold new take on Gundam, blending a fast-paced cinematic story with intense, hard-hitting combat in an all-new universe.

1964900.title: Soul Dust
1964900.short_description: A third-person bullet-heaven roguelite where six factions wage war around you. Parry and brawl the horde, let your build do the killing, or mix both. Play hands-on, hands-off and break the game.

1966090.title: VoidMania
1966090.short_description: A neon arcade territory game. Carve lines through the void and seal them to the wall to claim space, but if an enemy touches your open line, it burns. Trap the sector bosses, chain your cuts and reveal every sector across 48 levels.

1968210.title: Nosher
1968210.short_description: Nosher serves up the perfect platforming meal. Nosh on a variety of 'enemy treats' to possess their powers and movement, opening up more of the stages to find those hidden secrets you remember from classic '90s platformers.

1970220.title: Walk Hero
1970220.short_description: Go forward. Kill enemies. Collect loot. Get stronger. And again. An unusual mix of genres will allow you to focus solely on the choice of equipment and upgrades.

1971470.title: Crystals Of Irm
1971470.short_description: Crystals Of Irm is an old school RPG with a distinctive combat system and dungeon crawl elements. With three heroes you explore Irm, visit the different regions of the land and climb deep down into the darkest dungeons.

1971740.title: Road Warriors
1971740.short_description: Survive on the road in this post apocalyptic world! Road Warriors is a casual game with rogue-lite elements where your goal is to create the strongest build in one run!

1972940.title: Second Saga
1972940.short_description: Second Saga is an adventure RPG where you can level up, raise your stats, learn from an extensive skill tree, and make important decisions while traversing a large, expansive, and rich stylized 2D world.

1973760.title: Shell Soldier
1973760.short_description: " Shell Soldier " is a high‑octane first‑person shooter set in a bleak dystopian future. Featuring frenetic firefights against a diverse range of enemy combatants, each employing unique tactics and weaponry, and offering a wide arsenal of lethal tools at your disposal.

1975380.title: Kaiju Catastrophe
1975380.short_description: Crush, smash, and eat thousands of enemies showing humanity what the meaning of destruction is! Kaiju Catastrophe is an arcade game with roguelite mechanics. Mutate devastating weapons, unlock permanent evolutions, and wreak havoc with a variety of monsters to tear humanity apart!

1976110.title: Dreaming Worlds
1976110.short_description: Dive into the dreaming worlds of the four dream keepers and find out why they don't answer anymore. Rescue the trapped inhabitants of the dream worlds, change the dreams back to good and discover mysterious places and puzzles. But something dark will stand in your way.

1977100.title: Timeless Heart VR
1977100.short_description: Timeless Heart VR is a story-driven VR action adventure. Join Lycaena in battle, wield different weapons, and use your Chain Claw to race through four kingdoms frozen on the eve of ruin. Only by defying fate again can you reach the final answer.

1977610.title: Long Gone
1977610.short_description: Explore an abandoned suburban neighborhood decades after the outbreak. Solve environmental puzzles with your cat companion and uncover the secret lives of the people long gone through the belongings they left behind in this atmospheric 3D pixel narrative adventure. Oh, and watch out for the zombies.

1980460.title: Skykipelago
1980460.short_description: Skykipelago is a chill strategy game where you build happy little cities in the sky. Explore a variety of colorful islands, care for your buildings' happiness, evolve your buildings to help you grow, and when solid ground is no longer cool enough for you - expand onto the cliff sides.

1981230.title: Tales Of The Death
1981230.short_description: Join a comic adventure in a hand-drawn book with a life of its own. Rearrange the panels of an animated comic to reveal the stories of the world of The Death.

1985940.title: Abyss Fantasia
1985940.short_description: In the city of Cynthia, the young girl Eucaly, in order to find her lost past, steps into the abyss at the edge of the city. Along the way, she will experience complex and treacherous emotions, encounter various strange creatures, and finally uncover the deepest secrets of the Abyss.

1988270.title: Samuda Interval
1988270.short_description: Samuda Interval is a visual novel, slice-of-life, murder mystery & supernatural game. You play the daily life of Park Haewon or Park Sae-il, a college freshman attending classes, working part-time jobs, and meeting new people. Solving the serial kidnapping & murder case is your highest priority.

1990240.title: Void Ledger
1990240.short_description: Board abandoned ships. Take what you can. Get out alive. Void Ledger is a solo or co-op space salvage game of cards, dice, and hard choices. Push deeper for a bigger haul, or escape while you still can. Sell salvage, upgrade your ship, and pay off your debt before it's too late.

1993410.title: Laws of Nadragia
1993410.short_description: Become a prosecutor in the totalitarian Nadragia. Convict criminals: use the laws and facts of court cases to get a verdict at any cost... But can you keep your conscience?

1998220.title: Twin Jet Racer
1998220.short_description: Two jets. Two triggers. That’s all you need to swerve, drift, corkscrew, loop or even fly to reach the next checkpoint and top the leaderboard. Master the controls and the physics to progress to the next class of racer and unlock greater challenges. Compete against friends or against the clock.

1999830.title: Pin City
1999830.short_description: Pin City is a VR bowling game with the spirit of mini-golf! Silly yet challenging, strive for a perfect game and explore the bowling alley!

2002360.title: GRUBWERK
2002360.short_description: Manufacture the tools and assemble the bombs that will raise our great nation above all others. You and your comrades will expand our new munitions factory in the eastern block.

2003070.title: Orc Warchief: Prologue
2003070.short_description: Prologue version of Orc Warchief. Become an Orc warchief and fight for survival of your race. Rebuild your village and train your warriors. Gather resources and craft your weapons. Raise your warbanner and gather The Horde.

2007590.title: Chromahertz
2007590.short_description: Chromahertz is a colorful and dangerous bullet hell boss rush game. It's all about weaving and warping through patterns to evade and reflect bullets. Be careful where you stop!

2008670.title: RalphGame
2008670.short_description: A handcrafted action-comedy RPG packed with fresh mechanics and surprises. After your friends are mysteriously kidnapped at sea, it's up to you to bring them home.

2009160.title: System Purge: Hollow Point
2009160.short_description: Faced with a horrifying tragedy, you must delve into a flowering realm of memories and nightmares to save your dead lover. SYSTEM PURGE - Hollow Point is a challenging, atmospheric, and action-packed 2D platformer.

2015050.title: Tattie Bogle
2015050.short_description: You are the scarecrow. On a small farm at the edge of the woods, a Tomte's magic pulled you off your post and gave you a job: keep the harvest alive. Can you turn the place around before it all falls apart? A challenging fairytale roguelite, solo or 2-4 player online co-op.

2015450.title: Void Inside
2015450.short_description: In a world devastated by radiation, the surface of the Earth has turned into a lifeless wasteland. People long ago sought refuge in underground shelters, but even there, death caught up with them through disease. The protagonist is the last survivor in his shelter

2016400.title: Echoed Realms
2016400.short_description: Echoed Realms is a Casual Stylized Fantasy RPG focused on player experience and dynamic gameplay. Play it your way, even if that changes every day.

2017120.title: Nowhere Manor
2017120.short_description: House of stolen devil bargains and indolent angelic aristocracy: Nowhere Manor is doomed to disappear. You can leave if you’ve got a soul … but that’s not an option for an artificially created servant such as Liber. Just how far are you willing to go escape?

2017940.title: Pony Island 2: Panda Circus
2017940.short_description: Pony Island 2: Panda Circus is a phantasmagorical voyage through time, myth, divinity, and video games. Escape the lordly deities of the underworld with your soul, and your sanity, intact. This is not a game about ponies.

2018300.title: Beyond the Pier
2018300.short_description: Set sail for an uncharted New World. Explore unknown islands, build thriving colonies and compete with rival factions in a living world where every voyage, battle and decision spreads rumors that shape your reputation, economy and diplomacy.

2022640.title: CALX
2022640.short_description: Flow across the WARP-corrupted planet Syro. Master movement as the Seeker. Double jump, dash, levitate and grapple through atmospheric ruins. Scan, solve puzzles, and engage in measured combat in waves of stillness and frenzy.

2022890.title: Diode Arena
2022890.short_description: Design, build, and pilot bots with wildly varying movement abilities and weapons, then use them in online cross-platform PvP matches. Earn cash and advance through the tiers of the tech tree to unlock new parts and build better, faster, stronger bots.

2028270.title: Super Vecter Elite Turbo
2028270.short_description: Explore, fight and race across the real world in the sequel to one of the best runner games out there. Real cities, real mountains, real scale, all waiting for you to discover and unlock. Customize your ship, unlock new ones, and fight enemies at crazy speeds.

2051360.title: Skip Lake 2
2051360.short_description: “Solve beautiful puzzles and listen to the melody of crashing Pots going deeper into the story of Skip Lake!”

2051890.title: Game Cafe
2051890.short_description: Game Cafe is a casual game where you can play games like Spades, Okey, Backgammon and more with your friends or other cross platform players.

2052300.title: Glaciered
2052300.short_description: Soar the seas at the end of time. 65 million years in the future, the world has frozen over, and the oceans have been sealed under a thick layer of ice. Become a Tuai—a species that evolved from birds—and protect the Everwinter in this futuristic underwater action game.

2056130.title: Grand Arms: March of the Red Dragon
2056130.short_description: Squad-based tactical RPG, with auto turn-based combat and real-time-with-pause map movement. Build your army, defend your territory, and unite Wales against the English invaders. Inspired by classic JRPGs including Ogre Battle and Ogre Battle 64.

2056960.title: Merauders: Tides of Fate
2056960.short_description: Navigate family secrets and cultural divides as mysterious abilities awaken. Every choice ripples through relationships. Every conflict resolves through understanding, not violence. What you learn and the choices you make can change everything.

2058320.title: Space gold rush TD
2058320.short_description: Join in on the next gold rush and become a prospector in space. In this unique tower defense you can set up and reposition towers for maximum efficiency and adapt to the environment.

2059270.title: The Last Station
2059270.short_description: The Last Station is a visual novel. It's loneliness. This is the absence of a second attempt. It's the lack of happy endings.

2064310.title: Dark Age Dinos
2064310.short_description: A multiplayer tactical roguelike for 1-4 players set in a medieval world of sword wielding dinosaurs. Strategize your way through short adventures where teamwork is the key to success!

2064710.title: Luminescence
2064710.short_description: Illuminate the path in this Parkour experience across the constellations of Space

2065580.title: Kitsune: The Journey of Adashino
2065580.short_description: "Where will their light lead them?" Kitsune is a fox girl who finds herself on Adashino Island and starts travelling with her Frog friend. Neon signs give light and color to the island with a Japanese-inspired atmosphere. Something is lurking in the shadows, inching ever closer...

2066000.title: Cops N' Zombies
2066000.short_description: A multiplayer horror social deduction game where you and your friends are all police. Survive the zombies, do missions, make money, and buy fun items. But wait, there is a zombie police among you that can transform that is trying to get rid you. Do you trust your friends?

2068650.title: Northanda Chronicles
2068650.short_description: Master role-based deckbuilding in this tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Build your party around the RPG holy trinity, craft a shared deck with powerful synergies, and fight to save Northanda from the devouring Void.

2069330.title: Changer Seven
2069330.short_description: 3D Single-Player Action-Adventure! Explore a Vibrant World, Recruit Colorful Teammates, and Swap them during Combo-Driven Battles! ❤️ A Love Letter to the Toku-Sentai, Shounen Anime, Mahou Shoujo, and Classic Morning Cartoon Shows of our Childhood!

2073980.title: SUMMER ROAD 10-Minute Auto Roguelite
2073980.short_description: Dress them up, feed Mogmo, pick your path. A cozy roguelite RPG you can finish in 10 minutes a run. Battles play out on their own. Your choices shape the adventure.

2075460.title: They Speak From The Abyss
2075460.short_description: Lost in a cursed world. Surrounded by the tortured souls of the damned. Is the only way out truly a baptism in blood? Face demons head-on, talking or fighting your way through this surreal, psychological horror, dungeon crawling RPG.

2079920.title: NAME OF THE WILL
2079920.short_description: You are trapped in HOPE, a masked cult where pain is salvation. Every thought is tallied. Every smile is a lie. Conform for happiness, or face your guilt to escape.

2081500.title: BITGUN Survivors
2081500.short_description: The first of its kind open-world vampire-survivors game. Explore a dynamic environment, encounter random events, and adapt to survive a zombie outbreak. With upgrades and challenging gameplay, test your skills and adaptability to increase your chances of survival.

2082690.title: Burial for a Butterfly - a Singing World
2082690.short_description: Learn to listen to the melody of this singing world and explore an ongoing slice of life story of my personal experience seeking refuge in the woods, befriending trees, talking with mysterious doomer owls, burying a butterfly and grieving the dying of species and forests.

2083940.title: DROSS
2083940.short_description: DROSS is a procedurally Generated FPS, set in a derelict facility infested with alien bugs. Explore, collect powerful weapons and equipment, to upgrade your gear and fight the Dross.

2084440.title: Parkdens
2084440.short_description: Parkdens is a minimalistic and relaxing nature park building game where you can place tiles and choose variety of objects ranging from statues, sitting areas, shelters to bushes, playgrounds, trees etc. to populate the placed tiles.

2086790.title: This Is Land of Mysterious
2086790.short_description: Fate throws you into an mysterious island adventure! Try to survive a perilous voyage across the Island! Build your own home, solve a puzzles and gets more trophy but be wary! You will need a lot of effort to survive.

2087880.title: Ending Tau
2087880.short_description: Ending Tau is an action roguelike where you morph your body parts with curses that completely change the game. Walk, fly, teleport, or dig your way across the jungle. Explore unique mechanics with endless mix-and-match upgrades, unravel a beautiful pixel art land, rebuild your village, and End Tau.

2088020.title: UNDEFEATED: Genesis
2088020.short_description: Become the hero Voltissia needs. Fly freely across a vast alien planet, master extraordinary superpowers, and battle ferocious mutants in an expansive superhero action RPG.

2089820.title: Wolfstar Adventures in the Inu System
2089820.short_description: A sci-fi action-adventure platformer. Travel the Inu System and talk to a colorful cast of NPCs across various worlds. Explore maze-like levels by running, double jumping, and dashing. Fight off various robotic enemies using special melee attacks, and eventually take down the boss of each dungeon.

2089850.title: Sky On Fire : 1940
2089850.short_description: Fight in the skies of WWII Europe in an accessible, single-player flight sim. Control every crew member, from pilots to defensive gunners. Realistic airfoil physics, modular damage model, full HOTAS/TrackIR support, and 20+ authentic aircraft across the 1940 and 1944 European theaters.

2089870.title: RouteDom
2089870.short_description: Build your kingdom tile by tile! Draw, place, and connect roads, fields, and resources to your city in a strategic puzzle inspired by the great tabletop classics. Easy to learn, hard to master: every placement counts.

2090210.title: Threads of Time
2090210.short_description: Threads of Time is an era-spanning, turn-based RPG inspired by the timeless classics. Embark on a journey through time, gather a party of charismatic heroes from across ages, and uncover a plot that threatens to unravel the past, present and future.

2091030.title: Timepunk
2091030.short_description: Retrofuturistic bullet-hell roguelike where you play as a rogue time traveler, fighting through hundreds of historical foes! Every run reshapes history itself— Shoot weapons from different eras, use time-manipulating skills, and create unique builds to survive until you reach the end of all time!

2097940.title: Theatre of War: Rearmed
2097940.short_description: Command real-time WWII battles across the complete Theatre of War series, unified on the latest version of its original engine. Experience deep tactical combat, realistic ballistics, and over 100 missions, enhanced for modern systems.

2099450.title: CUBOID
2099450.short_description: CUBOID is a challenging spatial puzzle game with minimalist design, where you progress through a labyrinth of levels using a unique mechanic of merging with world blocks.

2099730.title: BURN THE WITCH
2099730.short_description: THEY TOLD ME TO MAKE THE BURN THE WITCH. ROGUELIKE IN THE DARK FANTASY SETTING. I'M NOT AGAINST IT

2099750.title: GOD PLEASE HELP ME
2099750.short_description: Horror roguelike highly inspired by the 00s and 10s. BOO

2102300.title: Eternal Mist
2102300.short_description: A real-time tactical game about making the right decisions with incomplete information. Choose your battles, prepare your squads, and adapt on the fly when enemy waves unfold in unexpected ways.

2104080.title: Discharge Pending
2104080.short_description: Everyone was evacuated. Except you. A first-person psychological horror game set in an empty hospital. Ride down ten floors and decide on every floor whether anything has changed. One mistake sends you back to floor 10. Speak, and something in here learns your voice.

2106150.title: 琉奈と悪夢の館
2106150.short_description: One day, the unlucky girl "Runa Ichiya" wakes up in a haunted house.

2106280.title: Moonbriar
2106280.short_description: Delve into a dark fantasy visual novel where evil isn't always as it seems. Make your choices and grow your skills to help determine who survives the Great Culling. Featuring the voice talents of Ralph Ineson, Simon Callow, Savannah Steyn, and more.

2110020.title: 第二公主的魔塔The magic tower of the second princess
2110020.short_description: A minimalist portrait roguelike built for lightweight PC gaming. Build tag combos while enjoying mini-games like fishing, blind chess, and brawls. Play P2P duels with friends. Ultra-lightweight, code-drawn visuals, playable with just a mouse. Easy to learn, deeply strategic.

2110150.title: Thesis of Love 心动论证
2110150.short_description: During the endless summer in Chishima, you join a graduate program hoping to become worthy of your crush. Little do you know what awaits... In this otome dating sim, experience campus life with three lab members trapped in toxic relationships. Your choices may lead them to new paths.

2111430.title: Forgotten house
2111430.short_description: Be QUIET, otherwise he will notice you. You want to find a way out of this house? Game inspired by Gnarled Hag and Granny.

2112310.title: Doomsday Sector
2112310.short_description: Survive relentless waves of U.M.F. cyber-zombies in this gritty, retro-futuristic survival FPS. Play as an elite Vindex soldier, explore a non-linear desert bunker, unlock 18+ weapons including a devastating Microwave Gun, and multi-upgrade your arsenal at the Proto-Max station!

2112370.title: World of Yggdrasil
2112370.short_description: Become an emperor, a criminal, or a merchant in the ruthless world of Yggdrasil... Choose your own path, or carve it in blood.

2112780.title: GOMAN -stuck in the avici hell-
2112780.short_description: "Die fast, retry faster. GOMAN is a hardcore side-scrolling action game where memory and reflexes are your only weapons. Beat who you were 3 seconds ago!"

2113880.title: Cave Crawler
2113880.short_description: Embark on an adventure inspired by Gameboy era games. Explore, fight bosses, and earn resources! Travel across islands and towns to engage in subtle, lore rich story.

2113960.title: KVLT
2113960.short_description: Fight your way through armies of Nazi occultists, religious zealots, and unspeakable cosmic horrors to unveil the Eldritch secrets behind the war theatre in this 2000s-era-inspired grimdark singleplayer FPS where WW2 meets Cthulhu Mythos.

2114160.title: Red Rebellion
2114160.short_description: A sapphic fairy tale mashup as Robin Hood teams up with Red Riding Hood to save their town set in a historically accurate medieval England.

2126960.title: PANDECROWN
2126960.short_description: KILLOMINA collapsed in 2019 after the virus escaped from the Medical Hospital in LAUCTHI City, which held the corporation liable for compensation in the LAUCTHI City Incident in 2019. The verdict led to bankruptcy, causing them and their subsidiaries to close for the year Following.

2131760.title: SANKAN
2131760.short_description: Kill the customer the voice in your head names. Clean up the blood and bury the body before dawn. Or refuse the voice, and it starts hunting you. A story-driven co-op horror for 1-3 players: the night shift at a mountain gas station, Japan, 1999.

2132860.title: Hanoi Puzzles: Spin Match
2132860.short_description: Inspired by the classic Tower of Hanoi, Assemble towers by spinning pieces to get the right pattern on a hexagonal board with a mysterious and relaxing atmosphere.

2132990.title: Pay-to-Win Simulator
2132990.short_description: 敢承诺无内购无广告无付费DLC，3年坚持做完全免费单机游戏。

2135560.title: Arcane Survivors
2135560.short_description: Write your own spells by joining a verb to a noun. ArcaneSurvivors is a horde-survival roguelite set in a library that is falling apart. Build from 1,008 combinations, gamble your sanity for stronger runes, and survive 20 minutes.

2139040.title: Cook, Serve, Delicious: Remustard!
2139040.short_description: Welcome back, Chef! Take your restaurant from a one star abomination to a five star wonder in this new take on a million-selling classic. With new art, a new campaign, and a new local co-op mode, there's never been a better time to get cooking.

2139330.title: Auto Immune
2139330.short_description: Auto Immune is a physics-based autobattler set in the human body. A virus is attacking your cells, and its up to you to defend them! Buy and combine cells to assemble your immune response. Discover powerful synergies to overcome a constantly evolving enemy. Can you achieve IMMUNITY?

2141130.title: Road Kings
2141130.short_description: Drive a 40-ton semi hauling cargo across the coastal plains of the American South, managing multiple jobs, trailers, and routes. Grow reputation from rookie to veteran owner-operator, dodging disasters and rivals to become the hero of the open road.

2141350.title: Jasper's Dream
2141350.short_description: Jasper's Dream is a first person puzzle game set in a techno mystic Egyptian world. Help Jasper, a robot programmed to create games, by solving his mind-bending puzzles. You will also explore an abandonned futuristic pyramid and unravel its many mysteries.

2142420.title: Wonderland Quest
2142420.short_description: Wonderland Quest is a casual point & click adventure game. Travel across Wonderland teeming with colorful challenges, surprises and creatures, brought to life with beautiful artwork.

2144580.title: Super Bio-Man
2144580.short_description: Super Bio-Man is the ultimate gunslinger and the guardian of our galaxy. Using his arsenal and metal fist, he shows the invaders from outer space - who's the boss here.

2146470.title: Miramar
2146470.short_description: Set in a hard sci-fi universe, Miramar follows a group of Tac Marines sent to investigate why contact has been lost with a far off colony. Exploration, turn-based combat, and roguelike gameplay collide. Can your squad survive?

2150120.title: Survivter
2150120.short_description: Arenas, dungeons, rooms, a huge amount of monsters and bosses. Roguelike + first-person autoshooter. Unique weapons, various modifiers for the character. All this is waiting for you in Survivter.

2153760.title: Stronghold 4
2153760.short_description: Wood needed! Return to the green roots of Stronghold in this narrative prequel to the original 'castle sim'. Immerse yourself in a cinematic campaign, hone your siegecraft with new mechanics in skirmish mode and customise your castles with a wide selection of castle pieces and cosmetics.

2155070.title: Fate/EXTRA Record
2155070.short_description: Fate/EXTRA Record is the chronicle of a war fought by modern magi who stake their existence on the bonds they form and the wishes they hold. This emotional story unfolds with a sleek, reimagined art style and a new strategic battle system. The first true RPG in the Fate series is reborn!

2156390.title: WorldShards
2156390.short_description: Build, explore, and master professions in WorldShards - a life sim sandbox MMORPG. Create your dream island paradise and journey through an exciting world.

2156890.title: Murder on the Stella
2156890.short_description: It's a murder mystery. It's an adventure. It's a cruise vacation simulator. It's different each time you play.

2159980.title: Wild Area
2159980.short_description: "Wild Area" is a game of survival and adventure while exploring wild areas. It is a rogue-like survival RPG game that produces production through gathering and hunting during the day, or goes on an adventure, and defends against zombies at night.

2160270.title: Desktop Trains
2160270.short_description: Turn your taskbar into a railway line! Help Sonya restore the railway after the cataclysm. Transport people and cargo, build new routes, and unlock shiny new trains in this cozy idle game for your desktop!

2161710.title: NO LAW
2161710.short_description: Welcome to Port Desire, a city that doesn't belong to anyone, but where everyone wants a piece. You’re Grey Harker, an ex-military attempting to live a quiet life after near fatal injuries in the field. All you want now is peace - but in a city of no laws, what you want isn’t always what you get.

2165280.title: RAGINGSTRIKE
2165280.short_description: Master the three weapons that change according to the humanoid robot form and fighter form, destroy the scattered enemy attack targets, and finally defeat the boss standing in your way!

2167470.title: Born from the Soil
2167470.short_description: Conquer the apocalypse using gritty dirt bikes and explosive ordnances in Born from the Soil, a blend of classic turn-based tactics, modern gameplay polish, and 16-bit retro charm.

2168060.title: C.C.C.: Special Cleaning
2168060.short_description: C.C.C.: Special Cleaning is a third-person bullet hell shooter. Join Cosmo Clean Co.'s Special Cleaning Division, drop onto high-risk planets, and recover the planet cores a former operative stole. Absorb incoming fire, slow the field with Time Dilation, and hit glowing weak points.

2168330.title: Helmscape
2168330.short_description: Lead a party of fantasy heroes in action-packed battles...in SNAKE formation! Choose your party and venture forth into an ever-changing world as you discover new heroes and find better loot to keep gearing up.

2174060.title: Sincognito
2174060.short_description: A social deduction investigation horror game where one of you is secretly possessed by a Deadly Sin. Use stealth and proximity chat to cooperate or deceive as you gather clues and compare findings to deduce which Sin is haunting the castle.

2176490.title: Star Shift Freelancers
2176490.short_description: In a galaxy where loyalty is tested and alliances shift like stars, Captain Max Triton and his crew find themselves embroiled in a sea of treachery. When their own government betrays them, Triton and his crew must forge their own path, or lose everything.

2179210.title: My Hidden Pets: Find My Duck
2179210.short_description: Step into the unique world of duck searching. Bring a friend and see how many ducks you can find in the latest adventure of the My Hidden Pets series

2179480.title: Ardem
2179480.short_description: The zombies ended the world. You're going to switch it back on. Ardem is an open-world zombie survival game in an immersive handcrafted world. Restore electricity, rebuild vehicles, construct your base, and permanently reshape the world. Solo, co-op, or on up-to-64-player PvE, PvP, and RP servers.

2182610.title: Thorny Times
2182610.short_description: Lead a mercenary company through story-driven fantasy scenarios. Capture castles, manage scarce resources, evolve your fighters, and solve puzzle-like turn-based battles where positioning matters more than brute force.

2183820.title: ノロワレサイクル
2183820.short_description: Mayuhara City, Tokyo. The wounds of the mass suicide event of Mayuhara Academy from eight years ago have finally begun to heal. The rumors of the “Mayuhara Curse” are still whispered amongst the students.

2185100.title: Children of the Forest
2185100.short_description: Iki and Tika live deep within a mysterious forest. Follow their enchanting journey as they find themselves amidst an imminent new threat. Children of the Forest is a story-driven adventure game about two siblings venturing through a land filled with extraordinary remnants from an ancient past.

2188870.title: Hyper Drill
2188870.short_description: Hyper Drill is a speedrunning runner game, where you fly at hyper speed. Drill through any obstacle, master your timing, learn level layouts, and jump between different galaxies.

2189050.title: Think And Co-op
2189050.short_description: Think and Coop is an exciting arcade game built for local and online co-op. Travel through forests and fairy-tale worlds, complete levels, and face new challenges. Coordination and teamwork are the keys to success in this fantastic adventure.

2190650.title: Mion and the Cursed Killer Hamster
2190650.short_description: The Magnificent Mion is a warrior queen from Wharevarland. She battles a malignant verse-making kraken, tries to win the love of Count De Loboda, studies at an ordinary magical school, and she's also... crazy! Absurdism. Ridiculousness. Idiocy.

2194690.title: Blazing War World
2194690.short_description: 3D Apocalypse Level-Based Action Game. Players navigate radiation-ruined areas, using walking, jumping, shooting, exclusive ultimate skills to fight mutated zombies, wasteland thugs, agile creatures, elites. Core goals: defeat bosses or finish tasks to advance, with classic level challenges.

2195450.title: Aether Wizard Life
2195450.short_description: Aether Wizard Life is a cozy wizard life sim where you apprentice as a young mage in a haunted town. Grow your skills, craft magical items, explore mysterious dungeons, build relationships, and restore a forgotten corner of the world.

2196010.title: Evergrind
2196010.short_description: Evergrind is an idle adventure like you've never experienced before! Discover unknown regions, face dangerous creatures, and create the ultimate loot loop. Master skills, process rare resources, and forge powerful gear on your journey to absolute perfection!

2196920.title: President Noir
2196920.short_description: The ultimate "President" card game app! Packed with tons of unique house rules and features cross-platform online multiplayer.

2199730.title: Crimson Deluge
2199730.short_description: Command a besieged camp from its walls. Top-down zombie horde defense: survive seven brutal days, pick new weapons as the waves speed up, fortify your camp from scrap barricades to a military fortress - and keep your survivors alive.

2202650.title: Crescent County
2202650.short_description: Crash headfirst into this witch-tech world, drifting and driving on the back of your new motorbroom. Make deliveries, trick out your broom, and race your new friends (and crushes) as the sun sets. Get into gossip, sort your life out, and discover what it means to find home.

2205960.title: RACE: Rocket Arena Car Extreme
2205960.short_description: RACE is a fast-paced combat racing game where speed, weapons, and destruction rule the road. Tear through post-apocalyptic tracks, battle massive bosses, and challenge up to four players in local split-screen.

2207350.title: Pararecords
2207350.short_description: As a counselor in a mysterious facility, you are to examine children with strange powers and fill in their "Paranormal Records". In this story-based, choice-driven game, you will have to pry open your subjects' minds... but what you find inside them could prove dangerous.

2207620.title: Fellowship of the Oak
2207620.short_description: Fellowship of the Oak is a cozy crafting sim where you gather a fellowship of heroes, providing them with everything they need to succeed on their adventures. Build cozy homes, craft gear, farm provisions and manage expeditions in order to collect powerful loot!

2210150.title: At Fate's End
2210150.short_description: At Fate’s End is an action-adventure game where you fight the ones you love and your skill tree is your family tree. Explore a lush fantasy world, defeat the foul creatures of the realm, and face your estranged siblings in intense, emotional duels to decide your family’s fate.

2211940.title: Doge Simulator
2211940.short_description: Doge wants to destroy! Doge wants this whole damn city to be destroyed! Smash the shops, cafes and even the damn palm trees! In our game you play as Doge, and you have to destroy, smash and break!

2212470.title: Mountain Resort Manager
2212470.short_description: Build a cozy alpine resort where gondolas glide, guests explore, and your mountain evolves through seasons. Place trails and buildings, manage staff and finances, and watch the resort come alive at your pace.

2216570.title: PROJECT NULL
2216570.short_description: You wake up in a dark forest and you don't know how you got here, and you don't remember anything. But somehow everything changed. You meet strange creatures, and no one is very friendly in this world. Soldiers, monsters and basically everything in this place is trying to end your journey quickly.

2217040.title: Far Dawn
2217040.short_description: A classic dark fantasy real-time strategy game, set in a state engulfed in an internal ethnic conflict. Witness centuries-old hatreds and newly reignited distrust fuel the flames of war, and be forced to pick your side: will you fight for the integrity of the realm, or the freedom of your nation?

2219850.title: Cartomantic
2219850.short_description: A tactical Tarot roguelite deckbuilder, where positioning matters just as much as the cards themselves. Craft decks of Minor and Major Arcana, create powerful combos, make your power reach the millions, and overcome the formidable Arcana Trials to see what lies within.

2220950.title: Rustwater
2220950.short_description: Rustwater is a cozy post-opocalyptic cleanup simulator. Pilot your boat across a flooded world, using immersive cutting mechanics to dismantle structures and rotting ships to gather resources.
