Sail through isolated settlements, repair homes, and trade goods to help survivors rebuild their lives.

2221530.title: Vangaro Tactics
2221530.short_description: Command your cartoon army against pointy-nosed officers in this colorful turn-based strategy game with asymmetric factions, mining, and tactical Stealth Missions. Capture buildings, recruit exclusive troops, and use each commander's Power to advance through the Vangaro War.

2221690.title: Afterschool Adventurers Club
2221690.short_description: Oh no! An evil Game Master has taken over the school's tabletop role playing club and is terrorizing its members with twisted dungeons and strict rulings! As the new kid in town, do you have what it takes to stop the tyran and bring peace back to the Afterschool Adventurers Club?

2223860.title: Shardana
2223860.short_description: Shipwrecked on an island inspired by ancient Nuragic Sardinia, explore, fish, build your shelter, and help the villagers. But beware: when night falls, the infected turn into dangerous creatures. Survive alone or in online co-op with up to 6 players.

2226880.title: Redneck Redemption
2226880.short_description: 100% authentic redneck alien hunting simulator. Drink, fight, stalk and piss your way through an alien invasion.

2227160.title: 无生之荣
2227160.short_description: Murder in a back room? Headless corpses? Disappearing murder weapon? Deadly messages?Murder? Suicide? You want it, it's all here. Let's start from the bloodshed in the Imperial City that shook the nation, pull them out of their cocoons, and get a glimpse of the truth behind them.

2227480.title: Congratulations, You Failed!
2227480.short_description: Pilot a rocket through tough training courses in a physics-based arcade game where failure comes with commentary. Dodge machinery, deliver swinging cargo, and upgrade your rocket while an unimpressed announcer keeps track of your mistakes. Prove them wrong, eventually.

2228840.title: Whispers of West Grove
2228840.short_description: You're trapped in a psychiatric hospital. Your dreams are turning into nightmares. And your flashlight can change reality. Explore the twisted worlds of West Grove, solve puzzles that defy expectations, and use your strange new power to escape. Just remember: every world plays by different rules.

2229960.title: Nightmare of Nady
2229960.short_description: Nightmare of Nady - is an old-school 90s survival-horror, third-person action game with fighting elements. Inspired by Van Helsing.

2231750.title: The Wonderful Adventures Of Sip
2231750.short_description: Follow a journey of discovery, thunder, and destiny. Guide Sip through a world that judges, fears and misunderstands him. Uncover the ultimate purpose behind his existence. Your actions will shape the future. Choose wisely.

2233390.title: Nuclear Sub
2233390.short_description: A realistic nuclear submarine simulator will allow you to take command of your crew and battle your fiercest enemies. Arm yourself with missiles, dive into the ocean and fight for your country

2233430.title: Horse Reality
2233430.short_description: Join a thriving community in this realistic horse breeding sim! Collect 30+ breeds, breed unique foals, train champions, manage your estate, and compete or trade with real players. Discover over 500 billion possible genetic combos with our realistic genetics system!

2234380.title: The Doll Sitter
2234380.short_description: This is a psychological horror game where you play as a nanny taking care of dolls in a strange house. Watch over the dolls, complete tasks, gather clues, and uncover which one is the impostor.

2234670.title: Not Us
2234670.short_description: A solitaire style card game where you forage for plants, manage your inventory, and try to stay alive.

2234780.title: AI Kills All Humans
2234780.short_description: AI Kills All Humans is a Tactical RTS game in which you play as an AI sending robots to kill all humans. You however don't have direct control of your robots, but robots independently decide how to execute your commands, like a general telling troops to attack, but troops themselves decide how.

2239750.title: Gus & Stella's Stellar Adventure
2239750.short_description: Help Gus find out where his family is, and who was behind the attack that left his ear bitten off. Craft, Climb, Solve Puzzles, Win Battles, and Get to know the Cats at the Kitten Intergalactic Taskforce station!

2240240.title: Four Hundred Catapults
2240240.short_description: A large-scale survival strategy game with up to 3000 units on the battlefield. Build and manage your settlement, produce resources, research weapons and technologies, and recruit your army to survive in the war against the Half Dead Legions.

2242270.title: Captain Disaster and The Two Worlds of Riskara
2242270.short_description: A new Captain Disaster adventure; this time he is more of a hero than a disaster! ... Or is he? A point and click adventure game with cartoony graphics, epic storyline and more bad jokes than you can possibly imagine. Wishlist this game. It is your destiny...

2242340.title: Car Rental Simulator
2242340.short_description: Car Rental Simulator tests your skills in management, marketing, and fulfilling customers' unexpected needs. Solo or in co-op! Grow a small rental company into a true empire in Winston Springs.

2243310.title: Locus Equation
2243310.short_description: You are an anthropod, a synthetically crafted life form. Your objective is to save the ones who are stuck on an uninhabited planet. Persuade, charm, manipulate: use your ultimate power—freedom of choice—in sci-fi role playing hyper variative game LOCUS EQUATION.

2244430.title: Color Lim
2244430.short_description: Set in a post-apocalyptic world, Color Lim follows Lim, a colorless slime on a quest to find his true color. Change colors to navigate, transform into enemies to use their abilities, and solve puzzles to shape Lim's unique journey.

2244650.title: HexLands
2244650.short_description: Forge an island kingdom one card at a time. Each card you play raises a farm, mill, or harbor on procedural hex islands. Crack the challenge each new shore gives you before setting sail, carrying your relics and upgrades onward. No combat. The land, the weather, and your own draw are the challenge.

2245130.title: Handshakes: Hands On
2245130.short_description: Handshakes: Hands On is a wholesome puzzle game all about shaking hands. With puzzles designed to foster discovery and gently guide the player towards their own solution, you can play alone or with a friend and get your hands dirty in this simple and surprising puzzler.

2245760.title: Optiminer
2245760.short_description: Optiminer is a minimalist incremental about mining radioactive materials. Dig through the rock to extract raw ore and radioactive materials, then pour it all into a branching upgrade tree and go deeper.

2245790.title: Kendo Warrior
2245790.short_description: Kendo Warrior is a realistic samurai sword fighting simulator. In the game, the player will take part in exciting duels in medieval Japan. Realistic animations of the most important moves of kendo warriors will introduce the player to the world of this martial art.

2246590.title: GlitchStorm
2246590.short_description: Fight with style, hack enemies, and chase viral fame in a dying world. Earn credits, upgrade your ship, and reach new planets. Explore a city of broken Artificials—and save the only friend you have left before it’s too late.

2249060.title: Edenfall: Legacy of the First Wardens
2249060.short_description: Unveil a mystical action-adventure where you shift between human, wolf, raccoon, and raven. Weave fluid combos across forms, purge corruption, and awaken the land’s lost beauty. Together with your spirit fox companion, embark on a soulbound journey of transformation, memory, and inner peace.

2250230.title: House spirit cat
2250230.short_description: House spirit cat is a visual novel with interactive features. It’s a story about a kind spirit of a house in the shape of a cat who is searching for a new owner. Will it find a new home or a place of despair? You are to choose.

2250460.title: Knightward
2250460.short_description: Build towers to safeguard your crystal while you loot treasure-filled rooms and grow stronger. Knightward is a tower defense action rogue-like for 1-4 players. Will your defenses hold off enemies long enough to discover the deepest levels of the dungeon?

2252000.title: Diehexegy
2252000.short_description: Diehexegy is a hex grid turn-based 4x game with a unique twist: your armies are composed of dice. It has multiple victory conditions and straightforward gameplay.

2255720.title: Whisperwood Werewolf
2255720.short_description: Whisperwood Werewolf: open-world action adventure RPG. A villager becomes a night-walking werewolf; as Revna, explore, upgrade, uncover secrets, and hunt it; talk to all characters for clues.

2256340.title: Final Remedy
2256340.short_description: You wake up in an unfamiliar, snowy place. You don't know how you got there or who you are. Solve the mystery, avoid or defeat enemies, and escape... An atmospheric, story-rich, post-apocalyptic walking simulator with puzzle elements and crafting mechanics

2256840.title: Holy Ocean
2256840.short_description: Ride your bike through the ocean of meat, alone or with friends. Raiders on your tail. They built a tower on that head island. Sneak in. Take down their leader. Destroy the whole island if needed. It is all for the love of Rose

2259240.title: DESPA
2259240.short_description: DESPA is a fast-paced multiplayer arena shooter built for after-work warriors with more bills than free hours. Neon kill-boxes, railguns, and carbon katanas meet a five-second respawn loop, so every death flips into revenge before your coffee cools.

2259390.title: NINE ROUNDS RAPID
2259390.short_description: Blast your way to freedom through a possessed, fragmenting space station. Upgrade abilities, mod your weapon builds, and manipulate time to defeat the station's nine gatekeepers. Power up, progress, and learn the ugly truth with every escape attempt.

2262120.title: Merchant Legends: The Founding
2262120.short_description: Build a new town in a Game Boy inspired fantasy world... Gather resources, recruit citizens, trade goods and grow your empire to push back the forces of evil! A love-letter to retro RPGs.

2262630.title: Wish Upon A Llama
2262630.short_description: Wish Upon A Llama is a cozy life sim RPG for animal lovers! As Llama Town's rancher, breed and raise adorable furry friends while rekindling a forgotten bond between the community and animals. Get to know the townsfolk, build lasting friendships, and perhaps discover romance. Adventure awaits!

2263120.title: OutRune
2263120.short_description: A fast-paced, psychedelic room-clearing action game blending mystery and memory. Battle relentless enemies, discover and upgrade powerful items, and help Orillia survive long enough to uncover her past… and ESCAPE!

2263450.title: Endless Samurai
2263450.short_description: A turn-based action RPG centered around parrying. Roguelite × Loot draws you into the Infinite.

2265800.title: 最弱骸骨兵 The Weakest Skeleton
2265800.short_description: You wake up from the Evil Skeleton Legion as a skeleton soldier. Take control of female minions to help you fight, obtain human skins, blend into towns, and get resources. Explore dungeons, collect materials, expand your team, and become the sole master of this world in this land of danger!

2265830.title: Virnap
2265830.short_description: Virnap is a 3D horror game planned to release in 2023 made primarily for VR that will get you into a nightmare especially chosen for you from your fears.

2265940.title: Evil Dungeon
2265940.short_description: ¡Fight the heroes trying to conquer your dungeon! Choose a class and fight along your comrades to stop invaders, level up, pick up loot, buy upgrades and become the greatest anti-hero

2266750.title: LightSup!
2266750.short_description: LightSup is a chaotic 1–4 player couch co-op adventure where darkness drains sanity while the Altar of Light keeps you alive. Battle monsters, gain powerful Blessings, endure dangerous Curses, and choose your path to save the world from an eternal eclipse.

2266890.title: BECROWNED
2266890.short_description: A non-linear survival horror drawing inspiration from the surrealist dark satire of VHS-era Horror and lurid atmosphere of classic Grindhouse cinema. Step into Richard Torrance's shoes and survive a complex web of relationships as you phase between industrial ruins and a tragic fantasy kingdom.

2268520.title: Divided Land
2268520.short_description: Explore a vast medieval world haunted by the undead. Craft gear, build a settlement, farm, and tame animals as you develop your skills. Adventure alone or join other players to reclaim cursed lands, restore life to the wilderness, and defend what you've built.

2269360.title: Unwound
2269360.short_description: Earthquakes are threatening idyllic Candy Island! Pull yourself together and get to the bottom of what’s troubling the island and its eccentric residents before your whole world breaks apart. UNWOUND is a rollicking yarn: a narrative RPG where people are objects and candy is currency.

2270360.title: MOKI - The Escape
2270360.short_description: Awaken without memory in a seemingly peaceful world. In this 2.5D puzzle-platformer, use the gift of the Streak (short-range teleportation), whose potential unfolds over time. Encounter fascinating creatures and uncover the truth that waits in hiding.

2271240.title: Ape Express
2271240.short_description: A co-op delivery adventure for 1-4 apes. Pile into your battered pickup and haul explosive, ticking and occasionally alive cargo across a wild valley — over mountains, through caves and past things with teeth. No signature required.

2272360.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
2272360.short_description: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.

2276300.title: Age of Sail
2276300.short_description: A co-op pirate adventure where you trade goods between islands, fish for resources, upgrade your ship and fight hostile pirate NPCs with friends.

2278110.title: Tower Builder
2278110.short_description: Tower Builder is online Co-op or single player building and design game.

2278200.title: Compicactus
2278200.short_description: Compi is a little cactus on your windowsill, and it wants to keep a diary. Help it write about your days with a few taps: the people you love, what you did and how you felt. Watch it grow and bloom, dress it up, and read your days as Compi saw them.

2278570.title: Mahalle Kıraathanesi
2278570.short_description: Welcome to the neighbourhood coffeehouse! Play Okey, 101 Okey, Backgammon, Kız Tavlası, Pişti and Yekta with your friends or with regulars who remember you, tease you and hold grudges. Buy a round of tea, put your chips on the table and become the boss of the coffeehouse.

2278950.title: Stars of Icarus
2278950.short_description: From the devs of Guns of Icarus comes the ultimate spaceship PvP experience. Captain frigates, pilot fighters, and man the guns. In the forgotten arenas of space, communication with your crew is key. Victory or death, together.

2284660.title: Everything Bites
2284660.short_description: The whole wild wants you gone. Defend the Barnes family farm in a top-down pixel-art horde survivor. Fight off waves of hostile wildlife with pitchforks, shotguns, leaf blowers, and traps. Earn coins, upgrade your arsenal, and keep the harvest alive!

2285020.title: Toxic Frontier
2285020.short_description: The world ended a long time ago. Unlock powerful cards and build a safe haven for your people within its ruins. In this roguelike city-builder, deploy cards across a hex grid to expand your colony and purify the land, buying another day of survival in the noxious wastes.

2286090.title: QUADREMOR
2286090.short_description: A first-person shooter where you play as one of the last human mercenaries, driven by vengeance for the annihilation of humanity. Dive deep into a dark and unforgiving realm fueled by cruelty.

2286590.title: 反击战
2286590.short_description: Enter Counterattack, and instantly travel back to the smoke-filled southern border battlefield of 1979. Every detail here echoes the historical authenticity, immersing you in the thick of battle.

2287430.title: Metropolis 1998
2287430.short_description: A fresh, modern city builder with charming aesthetics. Detailed agent-based simulation and scheduling. See inside buildings. Design and customize almost anything. Business-specific zoning, and mixed use zones too!

2287780.title: TouHou Legend of Fairy Souls
2287780.short_description: “TouHou Legend of Fairy Souls” is a TouHou fan game.In the game, because of someone's conspiracy, Reimu turned into Kedama and caused her power to weaken.Reimu then had to embark on an adventure to recover herself and finally uncover who was behind the scenes.

2288760.title: Night Run EX
2288760.short_description: Race your motorcycle through an endless neon night. Hit checkpoints fast to build your multiplier to 99x, weave through traffic, and chase the ghost of the rider one place above you on the leaderboards. Ride and vibe to the underground electronic soundtrack in this first person arcade racer.

2290130.title: Dawn of the Zombies: Survivors
2290130.short_description: Face the horde in a world of shifting light and rainy nights. Choose from 4 heroes and 3 weapons to survive 2 deadly maps. Customize your run with 100+ nodes. Play solo or split-screen across 3 difficulties. Start at 6 AM. When the colors fade to gray, the real fight begins.

2290140.title: Subway Outbreak
2290140.short_description: In Subway Outbreak, defend and rebuild your metro station against mutant hordes in this pixel strategy game. Manage tasks like fortifying defenses, launching assaults, and gathering resources to survive 30 days of increasingly fierce attacks. Lose by death or generator destruction.

2290870.title: Clown Meat
2290870.short_description: Clown Meat is a Precision Platformer with an emphasis on speedrunning and replayability. Tumble through a butchered world where humanity is barely a memory on your naïve journey to cheer up the monolithic clown that came from the Depths of Jupiter.

2294120.title: Magic Potion Liberators
2294120.short_description: A bullet heaven action game that gives you a comfortable feeling of being a warrioress. Knock down the onrushing monsters and push forward deep into the enemy territory! Create powerful builds with reinforce potions and crush the witch's servants!

2294250.title: Speed Golf Royale
2294250.short_description: Ready, set, swing! Whack the ball and dash through chaotic courses. Scored on shots taken and how fast you reach the flag. Outplay your rivals in a fast-paced, fun scramble to victory!

2294620.title: Blood Peace
2294620.short_description: Blood Peace is a fast-paced rogue-lite dungeon crawler where you embody a cybernetic warrior with extraordinary abilities. Engage in epic battles against a diverse bestiary across 7 unique biomes. Each playthrough generates a procedurally created world, ensuring infinite replayability.

2295170.title: Emberville
2295170.short_description: Awaken with no memories inside the Vitromotus, a vast underground world created as a magical dungeon where death no longer lasts. Explore its depths, battle dangerous creatures, rescue survivors, and rebuild the ruined town of Emberville while uncovering the truth behind this prison.

2295430.title: Dungeon Cleaner
2295430.short_description: IT'S NOT CLEANING, IT'S SAVING THE WORLD. Grab your trusty detergent and join the bubble guy in this rogue-lite with unique mechanics. Bounce on walls doing acrobatic stunts, meet charismatic characters and dive into dungeons to clean up the chaos that plagues the world of Dungeon Cleaner.

2298250.title: GearGrit
2298250.short_description: Tansy Geargrit, charged with some crimes she did commit, and some she didn't... Explore, platform, and blast your way through GearGrit, an Action Platformer inspired by your favorite PS2 games!

2298660.title: Fallen Symphony
2298660.short_description: The world of Fallen Symphony is full of heated battles, engaging puzzles, and fearsome dungeons. Prepare yourself for a unique battle system which is inspired by brawlers from late 90s and gameplay based on the JRPGs of old.

2298890.title: The Forgemage
2298890.short_description: An auto-battler roguelite of rune-forged magic. As a Forgemage, carve runes and chain their power into your spells until they break every law of magic. Walk into the horde alone and unleash what you forged.

2299490.title: Zombie Warz
2299490.short_description: Zombie Warz is a tower defense RTS game with rogue-lite gameplay elements. Play as the king of a kingdom under siege by zombies and survive to discover their origins.

2299940.title: The Button Effect
2299940.short_description: Every button has a purpose. In this short, minimalist first-person puzzler you explore a dense, interwoven architecture – a museum, full of hidden connections and spatial insights.

2300620.title: Art Gallery Simulator
2300620.short_description: Enjoy a side of art with a serving of business building! Go rags to riches! Start by fixing up an art gallery in the slums and work your way up in the world. Sell thousands of unique pieces of art and eventually open up your very own art museum in the high class downtown commercial district!

2300890.title: Meritaton
2300890.short_description: The story of a pharaoh's daughter who decides to challenge her destiny. The mysterious and fragile world of Ancient Egypt hides more than meets the eye.

2302120.title: Infinitum: The Backrooms Story
2302120.short_description: INFINITUM is a horror open-world survival co-op story game for up to 4 players. Explore Infinite procedurally generated levels and uncover multiple endings, with every playthrough offering a unique experience.

2302230.title: Within Time
2302230.short_description: Six months remain before the end of the world. With the power of the Scions, Yunis, Estella, Angie and Rictor cross into Iolade to stop it, in a turn-based RPG about grief, friendship and fate. Fate changes for no one.

2303550.title: Zehlar
2303550.short_description: Explore a world full of secrets and magic, inhabited by creatures with unique elemental abilities. Ally with them to embark on your adventure, and train alongside your creature companions to become stronger and conquer the challenges of the world.

2303850.title: Toxic Crusaders
2303850.short_description: The Toxic Crusaders return for an all-new, all-action beat 'em up for one to four players! Grab your mop, tutu and attitude, and get ready to clean up the mean streets of Tromaville and beyond, one radioactive menace at a time!

2304360.title: Mainland
2304360.short_description: Enter a cooperative medieval realm, forge alliances, lead armies, and engage in epic battles. Shape history with dynamic politics, or test your mettle against others in fierce player-vs-player combat.

2304480.title: Elite Rogue
2304480.short_description: Elite Rogue – BOUNTIES. CHAOS. BETRAYAL. Every contract is a high-stakes gamble in this unpredictable roguelike! Hunt alone or with up to 10 players, earn Darkmatter to unlock game-breaking powers, manipulate reality, and outsmart rivals. Adapt or be erased. WISHLIST NOW!

2304590.title: Bloody Horror Plant
2304590.short_description: Bloody Horror Plant – probably the bloodiest casual point and click adventure game ever! Help Horror Plant solve interesting and funny point and click puzzles, kill evil dwarfs, save the forest and its creatures!

2305190.title: Limbo Control
2305190.short_description: Limbo Control is a 1v4 asymmetric horror game where a supernatural creature takes over the area in an attempt to anchor itself in our world, while four hunters fight to reclaim control before it’s too late.

2305510.title: Deaded
2305510.short_description: Build your defences, scavenge for loots and survive the zombie infested city saturated with a mysterious fog. Survivors will ask for help but its up to you to save them, or leave them for dead. How long will you survive before you become... Deaded...

2306130.title: DOPASPIN
2306130.short_description: Air hockey with a twist! Rotate your paddle to fire pucks that warp across the arena edges, and smash them into your opponent's Core. Match events fill the arena with pucks! Play 1v1, 2v2 or 3-player battle royale, locally, online or against the CPU.

2307020.title: Alien Boom Boom
2307020.short_description: In Alien Boom Boom you will send your enemies flying utilizing a powerful arsenal of weapons and upgrades. The game features a fully voiced story campaign, several distinct levels, several enemies, bosses and frequent player/weapon upgrades that are customizable at the start of each level.

2309900.title: Shadows Of Deceit
2309900.short_description: Shadows of Deceit is a first-person psychological horror game. As Janet prepares to leave Havenbrook, one last visit to the Sheperd Hotel becomes a nightmare. Investigate a friend's death, connect clues through the Mind Palace, confront anomalies, and uncover memories that refuse to stay buried.

2311200.title: Test Cricket Manager
2311200.short_description: Take managerial control of the National cricket team (of your choice) and prepare to take them to Glory! YOU pick and train the players, YOU hire and fire the staff, YOU choose the tactics under pressure, YOU get the glory when things go right ... but YOU take the blame when things go wrong.

2317550.title: Tidal Forces
2317550.short_description: Explore a galaxy of 300 systems as you control your fleet in a top-down 3D style, navigating through Star-lanes, Warp gates, and Black holes. Customize and upgrade your fleet, complete missions, trade, hire your crew, wage war and determine the fate of the galaxy in this grand sim saga.

2317790.title: Titan: The Ascension
2317790.short_description: Titan: The Ascension is a colony management strategy game on Saturn’s moon Titan. Build and expand an off-world industrial colony, extract ice to produce water for Earth, trade resources, and defend against ancient automated systems that react to technology growth. Will you prevail?

2318300.title: DI: Debt is Inevitable
2318300.short_description: A wave-based arcade shooter where between waves you visit a shop with prices that increase with each purchase/rental. Keep your combo high and grab as many coins as you can, and you can delay the inevitable. Powered by GZDoom.

2318330.title: Neverway
2318330.short_description: After quitting her dead-end job, Fiona starts over on a farm and becomes the immortal herald of a dead god. Make friends, fight through horrors and pay your debt in this nightmarish life sim RPG.

2319410.title: WhyTaoism
2319410.short_description: Why Taoism Is an adventure game that explores spirituality and transcendence. In this game, players will take on the role of a group of beings who follow the legends of the ancient immortals and hope to ascend in order to transcend.

2320740.title: Exodus of Descent
2320740.short_description: Descend into an online third person PvE RPG dungeon looter inspired by RuneScape and Dark & Darker. Party up with your friends to solve escape-room type puzzles, collect over 150+ lootable items, level up your character, create unique classes and unlock new abilities. Escape Your Descent!

2321070.title: Dungeons and Tiles
2321070.short_description: An Action Role-Playing dungeon crawler, with randomly generated dungeons and challenging bosses to defeat for loot and glory.

2321200.title: Fire and Brim Co.
2321200.short_description: Embark on a wild and wacky adventure in this top-down action RPG! Take on the role of Ned, a disgruntled demon employee seeking to restore Hell's former glory. Fight your way through the corporate ladder of Fire and Brim Co., to confront its leaders and its evil CEO Satan!

2321890.title: Swordeye
2321890.short_description: Persistent PvPvE dungeons. Full loot extraction. 120 tick duel servers. 6-directional blocks and attacks. Master your sword or die trying.

2321950.title: Fantasy Boy
2321950.short_description: Fantasy Boy is a 2D platformer that follows the adventures of Boy. Explore a fantasy world, battle numerous enemies, and most importantly, have FUN!

2322260.title: Don't Kill Them All - Orc Slay Prevention Sim
2322260.short_description: Orcs don’t die: THEY RAGE! Embody their Warchief and lead them out of misery in this brutish strategy game with base-building, where one Orc outburst can turn victory into disaster. Forge bonds between units, shape their personalities, and unleash their true potential both in and out of battle.

2322700.title: Predatory Islands
2322700.short_description: After an emergency aboard their starship, groups of settlers were evacuated to an ocean planet. Lead an island outpost in an online RTS about survival, building, trade and wars for influence across a living archipelago.

2323500.title: Shattered Souls
2323500.short_description: Hell hath no fury like a woman scorned, and you will not forget the betrayals inflicted upon you. With a mark that ties your fate to seven men, you’re determined to lay waste those who tried to shatter you. Will you try again?

2324220.title: VICCP 2 Core
2324220.short_description: The Very Important Central Control Panel is back. Keeping the mysterious atmosphere and with even more mysteries. Control the omnipotence remote, experiment, and find many endings. Brainstorming in retro sci-fi style / Puzzle / Quest / Point Click.

2325200.title: Legends of Castile
2325200.short_description: To fulfill her dream of becoming a nun, María de Salazar must outsmart the creatures of Castilian folklore using her wit and a mysterious bestiary in this comic fantasy point‑and‑click adventure set in 19th‑century Spain.

2325390.title: AirBoost Airship Knight
2325390.short_description: the blonde Airship Knight Dorota, during a battle in the ruins, accidentally discovers an amnesiac girl, Agate. This also draws the attention of sky pirates, leading to fierce battles. The game offers rich levels and exciting battles, with many companions who will fight alongside you!

2325530.title: THE SUSPENSE
2325530.short_description: Discover the story of a man tortured by the hardships of life among “endless rusty walls”. Explore the world of a terrifying alternative future, overcome challenges, and maybe you'll be saved (or at least learn a hint of the truth).

2326200.title: NEO BERLIN 2087
2326200.short_description: Uncover the truth as Nolan, a troubled detective chasing a conspiracy shaking the foundation of Neo Berlin: a cyberpunk city split in two by technology, wealth, and class.

2326430.title: NANOVOID
2326430.short_description: NANOVOID is a 2D tactical space shooter that puts you in command of your own modular spaceship. Engage in intense, physics-driven battles, strategize with ship customization, and outsmart your enemies

2327110.title: Snap Quest
2327110.short_description: A Photo Collection Adventure Game. Complete your research notebook, solve creature puzzles, earn research grant money. Buy upgrades for your camera, rebuild the town, bond with the locals, and reveal the paranormal mystery of Star Island.

2327300.title: Machikado Roastery
2327300.short_description: Roast coffee across Japan, right from your taskbar. Run a tiny corner roastery along the bottom of your screen: roast beans, stock the display case, hire staff, and move your shop from Tokyo’s backstreets to snowy Sapporo as the seasons turn.

2327870.title: Goblin's Journey
2327870.short_description: Goblin's Journey is a humorous adventure game with a stupid plot and even more idiotic characters. You play as a greedy bastard goblin named Alastar. You are about to save you king's life - in exchange for gold of course! An adventure full of gold, mischief and innapropriate content.

2329050.title: Charon - Zhetan Chronicles
2329050.short_description: A turn-based pixel-art 2D Queer Magitech Fantasy (J)RPG where you overcome the chasm ordained by divine fate! An epic story with diverse characters, strategic battles and handmade artworks awaits you!

2329290.title: MR.E
2329290.short_description: A turn-based sci-fi puzzle adventure where every move costs power. Navigate a failing spaceship, solve environmental systems, and uncover the truth behind a rogue AI and your stolen human past.

2329900.title: The Last Exam
2329900.short_description: Dylan hasn't left his home since the pandemic. As he struggles to move forward, his dreams pull him back to one day from his youth: the day of his final exam. Explore his memories in a hand-painted watercolor point-and-click adventure, solve puzzles, and uncover why he can’t let that day go.

2330160.title: One More Try
2330160.short_description: Fight your way through the lands of the magical kingdom in this turn-based, roguelike deck builder game. Fight your enemies by combining powerful poker combinations, enhance their effects, endow them with new properties, find magical relics and choose new classes for your hero.

2332060.title: BLIGHTWRECK
2332060.short_description: Stuck at the bottom of the sea floor, escape a sunken ocean liner in this handcrafted 2D METROIDvania! Find powerful upgrades, and fight strange bosses. You may be isolated from your shipmates, but you're not alone...

2332730.title: DAO
2332730.short_description: DAO is a platform action adventure game. You travel back to a dark era. As the last Daoer of your sect, you set off on a journey of vengeance. Combine diverse weapons and talismans to fight numerous foes, and piece together the kingdom's lost memories from fragments.

2333410.title: Bullet Maidens
2333410.short_description: Protect a school from demon soldiers. Battle followers of the occult. Discover a chilling revelation that just might lead to doom...or salvation? A turn-based tactical shooter that doesn't rely on luck about Taiwanese schoolgirls saving their refuge in a world at war.

2334900.title: Libi
2334900.short_description: A survival horror where you peek into the mind of a hero saving her kidnapped lover while making excuses for her crimes. fight an undying jestress ruling an uncivilized world, scavenge for limited resources, avoid enemies, trick them with food and lay traps. for you are the hero... right? ​

2336250.title: Stop the Crawl
2336250.short_description: Stop the Crawl is a roguelike autobattler where you assemble a deck of monsters to defeat the invading heroes. Discover which monsters work well together, strengthen them with items, and create an unstoppable team.

2338890.title: Starship Colony
2338890.short_description: A deep starship colony sim. Build your starship, manage air, water, food, fuel, energy, temperature and psychology to keep your crew alive across vast distances. Closed-loop system in space. Mining, wiring, plumbing, in-ship factory, (alien?) radio signals & translation, diplomacy, combat, and more.

2339000.title: Portabellows
2339000.short_description: Explore a whimsical island to find… pie recipes?! Bake them by gathering or growing ingredients, which may be the key to helping out your new found quirky friends leave the island! In this wholesome 3D platformer collectathon, you can enjoy discovering the world freely at your own pace.

2339130.title: Adventures of Steve the Cat
2339130.short_description: You are a cute cat Steve, who has to go through a lot of beautiful, exciting and dangerous locations. On the way you will meet a lot of enemies created by a crazy professor.

2339720.title: SCP: Distorted Spacetime
2339720.short_description: SCP: Distorted Spacetime is a thrilling horror game based on the SCP Wiki. In this game, you work in the dangerous world of Site-DE2 and can choose from various jobs such as Class D Personnel, Mobile Task Force Alpha 1, Omega 7, Epsilon 11, as well as O5 and Scientists.

2340620.title: Battle for the Void
2340620.short_description: You will annihilate your opponents with an arsenal of over 40 types of weapons across multiple online game modes. Strange creatures and the destructible environment will make each gaming session unique! Level up and obliterate everything around you! are you ready to survive in the void?

2340970.title: Railborn
2340970.short_description: Railborn is a survival game where you build your train piece by piece. Navigate a world entangled by branching tracks. Find rare plants to cultivate on your farms. Upgrade your train - manage its power systems, direct resource flow, and distribute water. Designed for 1 to 4 players.

2341620.title: Alpine Lake
2341620.short_description: Build, decorate, and customize every detail of your inn to welcome guests to your cozy escape in the woods. Entertain tourists, farm, cook meals, research wildlife, and ski, all while helping a colorful cast of townspeople save the struggling mountain town from a hostile takeover.

2343780.title: THE SONG OF THE NIGHTRIDER
2343780.short_description: Unravel the secrets of evil love with sword and song. Become a sound witch and break the Nightrider's curse!

2345030.title: Hexoria
2345030.short_description: Harness the power of magical cards and become a master strategist in Hexoria, a turn-based roguelike deckbuilder game. Explore a dangerous world, build and expand your village, gather resources, and use your cards to gain obedience. Survive the unknown and lead your cult to glory!

2345290.title: Automatonics
2345290.short_description: Inspired by games like Super Mario and Megaman, in this adventure a little round robot is on a mission to save Earth. Lead your crew into exploring different planets in search of resources, fight enemy robots, collect different power-ups and upgrade your powers, while solving the planets' mysteries.

2345340.title: Space
2345340.short_description: A unique open-world space sandbox simulator set in the year 2343. Travel across the galaxy, trade, discover uncharted worlds, fight, build bases and factories, form alliances, and embark on new adventures!

2345940.title: Lost Lands
2345940.short_description: A minimalistic, chill city builder inspired by Nordic culture and landscape, with mysteries to uncover and a unique world to discover.

2348250.title: 13Z: The Zodiac Trials
2348250.short_description: Go solo or team up with up to three friends in online co-op for this fast-paced, anime-inspired action roguelike. Master stylish hack and slash combat, craft overpowered builds, and conquer mythological trials to claim the title of the thirteenth Zodiac.

2349640.title: Zeta Wolf Chronicles
2349640.short_description: "Date" one of four girls on the path to enlightenment. Prom awaits. Will you be led astray by an old crush? The realistic dating-sim that "teaches" through its gameplay. Follow Rayen, a young disillusioned teen who desires a girlfriend by year's end. Is there hope in his future or endless despair?

2351990.title: Anseion - Fantasy MMORPG
2351990.short_description: Get ready for a journey to the world of Anseion, an immersive 2D MMORPG. Choose your faction: good or evil. Fight against players and monsters, explore the fascinating world, collect items and create your own. Make a unique character. Participate in events and faction battles, increase your rank.

2352960.title: Squid Grid
2352960.short_description: Each puzzle reveals a ray of light scattered across this moody hand-inked Steampunk Ocean. Can you crack the peculiar yet (eventually) obvious logic of the Squid Grid?

2353050.title: WTF - Waifu Tactical Force
2353050.short_description: Multiplayer Anime Movement FPS. Wall-run, slide, pilot your mech, and run the map in PvP and PvE. Win matches, earn loot, build your Mother Base. Customize your guns and squad of anime operators. No sweats, just vibes.

2354240.title: Tiles of War
2354240.short_description: A turn-based tactics game, where every tile can be captured to become part of your territories. More territories, more money, better troops. Finish the three campaigns or become number one in competitive multiplayer with an Elo ranking system! Don’t worry, there is also a skirmish mode.

2354460.title: EXODUS: Sunflower on the Horizon
2354460.short_description: An original sci-fi RPG like you've never experienced before...

2354810.title: Elysium
2354810.short_description: Wake up on a paradise-like abandoned island with your friends. Explore the lands of an ancient civilization and uncover the mysteries behind their collapse as you build, craft, and tame corrupted machines. Most importantly, survive the unwelcome lands of Elysium!

2355020.title: Lost Hellden
2355020.short_description: Resist your Sin. Reclaim your fate. Lost Hellden is an action JRPG from a team of genre veterans, featuring a gorgeous hand-painted 3D art style, a vast world to explore, and a unique phased battle system that blends turn-based and real-time combat.

2356750.title: Rogue Kingdom
2356750.short_description: Rogue Kingdom is an Online Roguelike with every dungeon persistently simulated! Claim dungeons, settle colonists, and defend!

2358150.title: Not Waste Wood
2358150.short_description: Forge your path in True Men Ascend, a dark fantasy action RPG with cultivation-inspired progression. Choose from 20 classes, hunt loot, master relics and Inner Arts, and challenge dungeons and bosses solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

2358590.title: ASMR Food Experience: Prologue
2358590.short_description: Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full game. If you are looking for tones that will put you in an amazing mood, you've come to the right place! In the game, we have connected the game with the tones of the world around us. Open, manage, and listen to your own restaurant!

2359100.title: Enfilade
2359100.short_description: Enfilade is a fast paced low poly multiplayer fps game with 30 levels and 18 weapons If there are not enough players there is bot support. Level up and unlock new weapons

2359660.title: Arisen Force: Vonimir
2359660.short_description: Gather allies, fight the shadows, and uncover the secrets of Vonimir. In a land of pixel beauty and epic battles, your legend begins.

2360430.title: Lexomancy
2360430.short_description: A fantastical deckbuilding rouguelike, all packed into a traditional word game. Play as a Lexomancer, a magic user who can channel their power through Runic Tiles, and venture fourth on a quest to find the ever elusive Necrolexicon

2360800.title: Qubica
2360800.short_description: A next-generation sandbox game heavily inspired by The Blockheads. All about exploring, building, and playing together. Mine resources, craft tools, build a cozy cabin or an entire city.

2360820.title: Tempus Vitae
2360820.short_description: You are Alex, a time-displaced astronaut unraveling the space station Theia doomed in both the war-torn 2185 and the post-apocalyptic 2385 to find your lost brother. Master an arsenal of time travel abilities and weapons in this sci-fi metroidvania FPS: Tempus Vitae.

2361560.title: Dr. Emmerson's Nocturnes
2361560.short_description: Dive into the worlds of the best classic weird fiction and cosmic horror writers. Try out our original approach to bringing literature into the interactive medium. Relax and let Dr. Emmerson guide you through all the colors of dread.

2361830.title: Slum Dweller
2361830.short_description: Slum Dweller is a physics-based fighting game about typical situations that slum dwellers encounters on a daily basis. Try on the role of a slum dweller trying to survive in a harsh criminal environment or a street fighter taking part in underground tournaments.

2362070.title: Hollow Home
2362070.short_description: A narrative survival RPG set in a city under siege. No weapons, no combat, just the choices you make and the people you make them for. Inspired by real events. Made in Ukraine.

2362330.title: Neko's Rage
2362330.short_description: Neko's Rage is a pixel art rogue-lite platformer set in a post apocalyptic future overrun with dangerous biomechanical robots. Play as the cyber Neko-01 unit and collect always more loots to upgrade your Hub and character.

2363230.title: 大野逐龙
2363230.short_description: 欢迎游玩这个步步新奇的东方大陆。在这里玩家将扮演一名刀笔吏——萧辰，在天下倾颓、诸侯割据的时代，萧辰背上行囊，游历东南西北，探索山海秘境、见识无数宝物，结识众多神奇有趣的伙伴，当然，也会遭遇强大的敌人……游戏介绍【不一样的东方大世界】狐国、密库、衣锦城、驼母宫、博望馆、龙府、人鱼岛、冰夷渡、古战场、高耳山、北境村庄等等，游历不一样的山川河流、秘境洞窟带来的别样氛围。【沉浸式体验海量剧情】丰富世界观和故事细节，希望能有大量支线填充。领略当地的风土人情，并且完成他们的委托来增加代入感，以及世界观的可信度。同时，游戏文案的整体风格会朝部分写实的方向靠拢，给玩家带真实的体验。

2364230.title: Pandash
2364230.short_description: Pandash is a rogue-lite platformer with different perks to discover and balance their powers. On your search for peace for your world, you wander through different areas, which will change every run. You need to get strong enough and unlock everything to survive and reach your destination.

2364740.title: Undercroft
2364740.short_description: A first-person pixel-art roguelite. Climb a dead king's castle from its sewers to his throne as one of three heroes, through rooms laid out fresh every run. Read each enemy's tell, take what relics you find, and when you fall, start again from the camp.

2365790.title: Let's Build a Dungeon
2365790.short_description: Manage a game studio making the world’s greatest MMORPG. Hire designers, coders, and testers, create a fantasy world, then welcome hundreds of virtual players. If they get bored they will cancel their subscription and your investors will have your head. You can even play the game you create.

2366290.title: Ants in Space!
2366290.short_description: A roguelike strategy game where you evolve and mutate your space ants to repel an invasion of asteroid termites! Combine fast-paced exploration of tiny planets with spaceship travel across the galaxy. Find the ultimate ant DNA combination to withstand the unstoppable force.

2367460.title: Outlaw Raiders
2367460.short_description: Lead your outlaw crew on raids to rob, steal, and fight for riches. Build up your camp and recruit more outlaws so you can become the ultimate outlaw.

2368530.title: Forum Mortuorum
2368530.short_description: Take the reins of a Roman gladiator school. Hire and equip your team, freely combining powerful gear effects to create overpowered panoplies. Accept challenges wisely: once in the arena, your gladiators must fend for themselves until they find glory or death!

2369780.title: Unnatural Worlds
2369780.short_description: Innovative yet familiar real-time strategy game in development. Grand-scale RTS game played on maps/planets of any 3D shape. It emphasizes strategy, base building, logistics, and reduces micro-management of individual units.

2371240.title: DOLOS: Your Best Future
2371240.short_description: A sci-fi political thriller. Live the life of an operator of DOLOS, a social regulation system predicting everyone's future. Analyze applicants' profiles and decide about their lifetime career. Apply DOLOS' logic or find how to counter it ... but don't get fired!

2373130.title: Dungeons of Edera 2
2373130.short_description: Return to the land of Edera, where you play as a sword-for-hire, exploring environments, competing for contracts, and waging guerrilla warfare to become a legendary mercenary, alone or with friends.

2373970.title: Indie Game Farmer
2373970.short_description: Grow crops. Fund your game-making dream. Tend your pixel farm, sell the harvest, and upgrade your tools while dividing each day between farming, part-time work, and game development. Turn your first potato into your first release, and build a living from crops and games.

2376260.title: Mariachi Legends
2376260.short_description: Mariachi Legends is a brutal, pixel art, combat-oriented Metroidvania set in the heart of Mexico.You play as Pablo Cruz, a detective who has agreed to a deal with Death herself. She has given Pablo the ability to transform into the mighty La Sombra allowing him to fight back against evil.

2376720.title: Shred-A-Bunch!
2376720.short_description: Shred zombies in slow-mo while drifting with your good old tractor?! Harvest crops, slaughter zombies, overcome epic boss fights and upgrade your vehicle. Rinse and repeat.

2377160.title: Not Only Nine
2377160.short_description: A cat soul journeys through The Afterlife to save their human. An ancient being (helps?) defeat the Reapers in this narrative RPG adventure.

2379070.title: Operation Excision
2379070.short_description: Operation Excision is a retro styled first person shooter with visuals inspired by 1980’s vector graphic arcade games, and a setting and story influenced by 1970’s and 1980’s science-fiction movies, books, and comics.

2379200.title: Sol Uknight
2379200.short_description: Delve deep into a mystical realm, from two distinct protagonist story perspectives! Communicating with your musical "Constellator" or uncovering cryptic symbols with "The Wheel of Life", solving mysterious puzzles, adventuring realms, or revealing key story elements will put you to the test of time!

2379980.title: Ibboran
2379980.short_description: The Empire is aflame! Lead your fantastical troops through a 15-battle, turn-based strategy campaign. Build your army by achieving objectives to fill your Treasury. Recruit mercenaries to tilt the battle in your favor and use your General to improve your units or blast the enemy. To war!

2380990.title: Endless Anime Golf
2380990.short_description: Are you an anime lover with a passion for golf? This exciting game combines the best of both worlds, with stunning anime visuals and challenging golf gameplay. Best of all, Endless Anime Golf features procedural generation, which means every round is unique and unpredictable.

2383240.title: Ecumene Aztec
2383240.short_description: Ecumene Aztec is a brutal action-adventure game with stealth elements, set in the time of the Aztecs. Take on the role of a fugitive who has escaped being sacrificed. Fight, climb and survive in a dark and bloody world. Decide which side of the conflict you will take...

2385970.title: Kardaviik
2385970.short_description: Kardaviik is a 3D factory automation game set in a voxel asteroid belt. Your mission: harness energy, ascend the Kardashev Scale, and save Earth. Conquer the expansive procedurally generated belt by harvesting resources and extracting fuel, and build your ultimate space factory!

2386000.title: Machina of the Farthest
2386000.short_description: "Wouldn't it be awesome to fly?" Travel to the world's end in this warping-boomerang adventure with its beautiful pixel art.

2386370.title: Last Life
2386370.short_description: Last Life is a breathtaking adventure game set in NeoNova, a cyberpunk city where high technology and dark secrets intertwine. Our protagonist, a cute cat controlled by players, will embark on a mysterious journey to find their lost lover.

2387140.title: Lazy Jiangshi
2387140.short_description: A visual novel about lazy jiangshi Mao and her even lazier mistress.

2387670.title: As One We Survive
2387670.short_description: Survive in a harsh post-apocalyptic world. Scavenge resources, build up a homestead, form a community, and defend yourself against a lawless world in a challenging survival sandbox.

2388010.title: Drone Operator Guerilla Warfare
2388010.short_description: Drone Operator is a game where you will use civilian drones to conduct military operations against an overwhelming occupying force. Use your technical skills to turn harmless flying toys into deadly weapons, and outsmart your enemy. But remember - stay vigilant.

2388030.title: LogiGolf
2388030.short_description: LogiGolf is a relaxing golf puzzle game where you place walls to guide the ball. Journey between islands to uncover new challenges and surprising discoveries.

2388350.title: Good Luck, Little Truck!
2388350.short_description: Good Luck, Little Truck! Is a genre-bending cozy navigation puzzler/narrative delivery sim. Set in a recovering post-collapse world where robots and humans coexist, help North Pacifica Island bounce back one delivery at a time!

2388440.title: Battlecore Robots
2388440.short_description: Customize your own mech: Use swords, bombs and all kind of weapons to defeat your oponents in frenetic battles with unique abilities! Play up to 4 players locally or online. Enter the Battlecore arena!

2392010.title: Heat Division: Rescue Team
2392010.short_description: Rescue civilians from natural and man-made disasters in this Speedrunning 2D Platformer. Featuring 4 playable characters: Jack Red, John Blue, Jane Orange & Chief Green

2392900.title: Mechanical Keyboard Building Simulator
2392900.short_description: Create and expand your own mechanical keyboard venture as you master the art of maintenance, repairs, and custom builds. With real-life components and realistic hardware, refine your skills, ignite your creativity, and craft a keyboard that truly resonates with you.

2392970.title: Mind Vessel
2392970.short_description: An autobattler roguelike in which you are a Vessel formed by the unification of dead people's spirits. Dismember and graft them to customize their abilities, as you use them to find a way out of the void.

2393420.title: Silence of Elven Mage Rin
2393420.short_description: A puzzle game featuring a beautiful elven sorceress.

2394250.title: Rich Dad Simulator
2394250.short_description: Run your own chain of markets. Start from a small shop to the biggest business in town. Manage staff, control inventory, set prices, and keep customers happy. Build new locations and expand your retail empire. Can you succeed and become the king of retail?

2397360.title: Arctic Unrest
2397360.short_description: Arctic Unrest is a quest driven experience of survival set in a hand-crafted frozen arctic world. Hunting, fishing, building, crafting, farming & fighting are all covered. Vehicles to explore by Land, Air or Sea. "Old School" Far Cry like Story driven quests. Wishlist Arctic Unrest today!

2398100.title: ЭОН
2398100.short_description: Welcome to "Volga" summer camp! Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of a summer camp and find out what it's like to start living anew in such an amazing place. Shift 2032 is declared open!

2398480.title: Keystone Titans VR
2398480.short_description: Keystone Titans VR is a VR Autobattler where units will need to be strategically selected and arranged to dominate your opponents. Outsmart the enemy with clever drafting, positioning, and economy management to form the strongest team.

2399700.title: 荷莱Horae
2399700.short_description: 或许，这是你见过最自私的故事。

2400840.title: Phantom Line
2400840.short_description: Join the paranormal SWAT. PHANTOM LINE is a co-op (1-4) shooter set in the post-nuclear European continent. Your mission is to search and contain paranormal events and activities (anomalies) hidden from the public eye, in an open world map full of dynamic events.

2402470.title: World of Anterra
2402470.short_description: The prophecy foretold your coming, Traveller, but are you here to save Anterra or yourself? Explore an expansive living world, with thriving towns, wild animals, and monster filled dungeons. Discover secrets, lore and mysteries, and uncover the truth about the Eye to become Anterra's Champion.

2402540.title: Crab Rhapsody
2402540.short_description: Earn Claw Coins and become unstoppable! Help Mr. Claw stop Crab-GPT and its agents from monopolizing music copyrights. Build your band, unlock ability dressup, and buy Claw Chips anytime, anywhere to upgrade weapons, trigger wild combos, and craft insane builds.🤘🦀🎸

2403550.title: Where is My Son?
2403550.short_description: Step into a story of mystery, drama and the supernatural as a father searches for his missing son. Solve puzzles, follow clues and uncover the hidden truth.

2404630.title: Coding Day
2404630.short_description: In "Coding Day", you are a videogame developer whose project is about to be released, but a sinister entity threatens its publication, and you must survive it throughout the night in a dark office building full of mysteries and dangers.

2405640.title: VISK
2405640.short_description: Enter the bleak world of VISK, an online co-op horror game for 1-2 players. You and your friend are sent to a desolate village. Uncover the dark secrets of this place and cautiously explore your surroundings. After all, you might not be alone…

2406810.title: Emblems: Sunless Vow
2406810.short_description: Unravel a mystery where you know the outcome from the start…in this turn-based roguelite RPG. A strange mage and his two captives must regain their memories to escape from a hostile void. But can they stop *arguing* first? A playful character drama with unusual combat.

2407530.title: Money Glitch
2407530.short_description: Create and manage your own online shop in the shadows of the Darknet. Build factories, craft products, and ship orders by hand. Keep your reputation high to dominate the underground economy.

2408670.title: April '86
2408670.short_description: April ’86 is an atmospheric first-person psychological horror about returning to Pripyat, where the past never truly died. Explore the abandoned city, uncover the mystery behind the disappearance of children, and confront what was hidden behind the Chernobyl disaster.

2409010.title: The Battle for Vega
2409010.short_description: Inspired by the classic Space Invaders, The Battle for Vega takes the old-school gameplay you know and love and adds new features that make it a fresh and exciting experience.

2409320.title: Drill Keeper
2409320.short_description: Build impenetrable fortresses of mining to defend against relentless hordes of aliens and make a name for yourself as a famed Drill Keeper! Roguelike deckbuilding meets siege defense as you travel the galaxy and dig through fully destructible worlds to strip them of their riches.

2409660.title: Wardens of Avalon
2409660.short_description: Restore the former glory of a corrupt Camelot in Wardens of Avalon, an Action RPG set in a Dark Arthurian world. As a new member of the Twilight Knights, establish your fiefdom, explore, craft and gear up for thrilling adventures against the fallen Knights of the Round Table, alone or with friends.

2410860.title: The Truth
2410860.short_description: A psychological horror experience where a routine investigation turns into something far more unsettling. Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth hidden within the house.

2411190.title: Card To Conquer
2411190.short_description: Conquer your enemies in this roguelike deckbuilder. Win by upgrading your deck, purchasing powerful items and combining your cards in battle to find overpowered synergies.

2411280.title: The Bornless
2411280.short_description: Welcome to The Bornless, an action horror FPS. Face off against other players, summon demons, and build factions in a Lovecraftian world. Use Black Magick, acquire powerful weapons, upgrade your Safehouse, and strategize to survive.

2413370.title: Tribes of the Ridge
2413370.short_description: Lead your tribe in this side-scrolling colony sim! Grow a humble settlement into a thriving civilization. Survive harsh winters, manage resources, build efficient production chains, unlock new professions, and raise glorious monuments!

2414140.title: Longjuice Squeeze
2414140.short_description: Shoot, parry, and slash your way to self-awareness in Longjuice Squeeze, a roguelite fighting game where the winner steals gear from the loser. Featuring billions of possible builds, tons of collectible gear, and single-player, local, or online duels with rollback netcode.

2414790.title: Food Magician
2414790.short_description: Food Magician is an fantasy action-adventure game that filled with hidden treasures, dangerous creatures, and ancient ruins. With stunning graphics and beautiful music, Food Magician features various gameplay mechanics, including real-time combat, traps, and puzzle-solving.

2415000.title: BLACKOUT: Zero Point
2415000.short_description: Blackout is a hardcore co-op shooter for up to 4 players. Become a near-future special forces operative and eliminate infected creatures and monsters fused with machines. Complete missions through intense combat and teamwork, and escape the hellish battlefield.

2417900.title: Squiigee
2417900.short_description: Use your momentum to swing, launch and fly, cleaning cityscapes in record time to earn some sweet, sweet cash!

2418040.title: Beyond The Plastic Wall
2418040.short_description: Set off on an adventure set in a sprawling world that blends satisfying, mechanical puzzles with a rich narrative. Explore a stunning pixel-art world, repair intricate machines & meet unforgettable characters in a story about connection, resilience, and life that clings on in a world left to ruin.

2418840.title: Schoolmare
2418840.short_description: Schoolmare is a survival horror game where you fall in love with a teacher. But it was a trap… You need to get out of the school and not be killed by a horrible monster.

2419950.title: World War 2027 : Taiwan
2419950.short_description: When diplomacy collapsed, the world descended into chaos. Nations burned, alliances shattered, and every battlefield became a fight for survival. From the ruins of major cities to the flames of the Pacific, soldiers now fight not for victory — but for humanity’s last future.

2420700.title: Creej's Corruption
2420700.short_description: Creej's Corruption is a Combat Based First-Person Action RPG set in a pre-apocalyptic suburban town. When reuniting with your family, an ominous building in the distance suddenly collapses causing a massive chain of events. Your brother has been taken. You're the only one who can save him.

2420800.title: Sol Mates
2420800.short_description: Blast and laugh your way through space with up to 4 friends in this chaotic roguelike co-op. Every run is a new adventure so steer, shield, and work together to take on unpredictable challenges - or at least go out in style.

2423670.title: Let's bounce! Popsicle boy!
2423670.short_description: Let's bounce! Popsicle boy! is a casual rogue-like game with mechanics inspired by Breakout. As you venture through different game chapters, fight against unique brick mechanics and powerful enemies while upgrading different skills to change the pace of the game!

2425200.title: HARUKA: Beyond the Stars
2425200.short_description: HARUKA: Beyond the Stars is a juvenile sci-fi RPG about the intergalactic adventures of the protagonist, Yuuki, and a mysterious girl named Miiya. Set out on a spaceship and explore unique planets. Enjoy a thrilling adventure in the latest 3D anime art style.

2426280.title: Dwarf Legacy
2426280.short_description: A Bullet-Hell Precision Platformer. Climb up Vertical Dungeons of The Mountainhome, battling Swarms and navigating Traps. Uncover the secret of your Legacy hidden atop the highest peak and secure the future of your village.

2426390.title: Farmion
2426390.short_description: Build your dream farm and grow a village around it in this cozy voxel farming and life sim, solo or with friends. Grow crops, raise animals, and turn your harvest into meals, bouquets and cheese for your own café, grocery store and flower shop. Your farm keeps growing while you’re away.

2428390.title: NovaLight Z
2428390.short_description: Novalight Z is a zombie shooter. Shoot and cut your way through an infected colony ship. Survive and explore to find the artifact and uncover the mystery behind the outbreak.

2430980.title: Staircase55: A SCP-087 Story
2430980.short_description: An atmospheric psychological horror game that has you exploring a dark deep and paradoxical stairwell. Equipped only with a flashlight, navigate through the this strange staircase and uncover the secrets of the seemingly infinite stairwell, SCP-087.

2431590.title: Starship Crafter
2431590.short_description: Take on the role of a starship mechanic and pay off the immense debt your father left behind. Craft components, build starships, and take contracts from factions. Follow galactic events, and pay the debt before the deadline.

2436130.title: Polyroll Pocket
2436130.short_description: An all new, Pocket-Sized adventure starring Polyroll! Kaiser Kiwi has landed on the moon with a diabolical plan to wipe out the Polyrolls. You'll need to uncover secrets, reclaim the stolen batteries from Kiwi's goons, and power up your rocket ship to blast off for the final confrontation!

2437310.title: Onslaught Rift
2437310.short_description: An arcade hack and slash where you rapidly switch between three heroes to decimate waves of enemies! Master each of the heroes' abilities as you fight your way through dangerous areas, each with unique monsters and bosses.

2437390.title: Enginefall
2437390.short_description: Session based survival where players upgrade and live aboard their own personal trains. Team up with friends, make new ones or go solo. Board colossal Titan Trains to fight, build, craft, gather and steal much needed resources. Fortify and stock your personal train fortress. Will you survive?

2437550.title: Elidriel
2437550.short_description: Elidriel is a story-driven pixel-art RPG that combines reactive turn-based combat with character customisation, a range of non-combat activities and a mystery surrounding a lost love. Explore a world of wonders, crafting, cooking, fishing, playing songs and mining gems to upgrade your weapons.

2437830.title: The Killing Rooms
2437830.short_description: A first-person psychological horror where hidden odds shape every procedural run. Choose between unknown doors, evade relentless horrors, and survive an endlessly re-playable challenge.

2438630.title: Apocalypse Blitz
2438630.short_description: Be Courageous! Again, Be Courageous! Overwhelming evil is unleashed! Fight against terrible amounts of enemies to free the helpless. Are you brave and strong enough to defeat the Apocalypse Blitz?

2439030.title: Vaunted
2439030.short_description: The score of a lifetime hangs in the balance – can three cut-throat criminals look past their differences to pull it off? A story of bullets, bravado, and brazen lies unfolds across a galaxy of treasure hunters and crime syndicates in this sci-fi tactical RPG.

2439280.title: Clockwork Revolution
2439280.short_description: CHANGE THE PAST. CONTROL THE FUTURE. Alter the course of history and rewrite the future in this steampunk first-person RPG.

2439770.title: PROJECT MIX
2439770.short_description: PROJECT MIX is a VR anime narrative adventure. Can you find happiness after losing everything you once had?

2439980.title: Glitch Core
2439980.short_description: In the far future where AI has been deemed too dangerous and sent to the moon, you play as a rogue AI agent fighting through battle simulations to unravel the true purpose of your design in this tactical, immersive, procedural FPS rogue lite with split screen co-op where the code FIGHTS BACK!

2439990.title: Rocket Penguin
2439990.short_description: A challenging flying game controlled with just two buttons. How high you can fly is another story. Now join Peeo and dive into the world of penguins, soaring to space. Push your limits and become a true flying legend!

2440860.title: Reinforced Machine
2440860.short_description: A fast-paced mech arena shooter mixing arcade intensity with skill-based unlocks. Unleash powerful ultimate forms, mix and match skills to define your playstyle, and master each unique combat machine to unlock their signature abilities.

2444850.title: Neverending Check-in: The Hotel Stories
2444850.short_description: Immerse yourself in The Neverending Check-In, a pixel RPG filled with mystery, quests, cats, humor and life universe. Rebuild a once-glorious hotel and uncover its secret past in this captivating journey of deep plots, lively characters, and abundant quests.

2445200.title: Cards n' Varmints
2445200.short_description: Cowboy lizard roguelike with jobs, cards, and creature management. Build a ragtag team of varmints from over 50 weird jobs such as Gunslinger, Cactus, and Hotel Manager. Your team is your deck: think hard and play cards before each round to turn the tide of battle!

2445410.title: Checkmate MAGIC
2445410.short_description: Lead your King into tactical 6v6 battles alongside five loyal companions. Recruit allies, customize Runes and Gambits, forge powerful gear, and unleash coordinated attacks to deliver CHECKMATE. Defeat seven rival Kings, collect their relics, and unlock the mysterious Corrupted Gate.

2446520.title: Pixel Piracy Online
2446520.short_description: Pirate MMORPG with zero microtransactions. Set sail alone or with friends, and build your pirate empire using force or trade. In this pirate simulator game, you write your own RPG story.

2447480.title: Dungeon Raiders
2447480.short_description: Dungeon Raiders is a roguelike dungeon crawler game with cards to acquire and loot to find! Make your way through perilous dungeons, battle monsters with cards, outfit your raiders with the best gear and sell any extra loot you find in your customizable shop for profit!

2451050.title: Maid In Wonderland
2451050.short_description: Your fate, your duty, your suffering / love.

2451080.title: Geometry TD
2451080.short_description: Tower defense on a starship you build and fly yourself. Explore open space, mine asteroids, trade, and lead a crew of astronauts. When pirates board your ship, place geometric towers, merge them into stronger shapes, and stop every wave.

2451390.title: Witchmarsh: Tea Party of the Damned
2451390.short_description: Create and lead a team of four investigators in this action RPG set below Jazz Age New England.

2451550.title: Jeller Fellers
2451550.short_description: Bounce, squish, and launch through a vibrant, stylized world in Jeller Fellers, where you *attempt* to control a wobbly jelly cube. Solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, and explore diverse environments in this challenging, physics-based precision platformer

2453830.title: DollHouse: survive  or death
2453830.short_description: A stately, huge, beautiful mansion... Where is this?Opened the door of the mansion with a nervous heart, and the moment , I knew there was no turning back.

2454280.title: Hundred Battle
2454280.short_description: Grow like a roguelike, draft your party like an auto-battler, command like an RTS — a semi-auto-battler roguelike of a hundred battles.

2455870.title: Bite Size Terrors: Speechless
2455870.short_description: Find what was taken from you at any cost in this Minimalistic Survival Horror.

2455930.title: SwingHard VR
2455930.short_description: Dodge with real footwork against challenging bosses. Move your arms as fast as you can to do damage. Swing hard, move often, you'll need to exercise your mind and body to win in this boss rush dark fantasy VR action game. Git Gud, Git fit, Workout guaranteed.

2458240.title: Self Simulated
2458240.short_description: Self Simulated is a fast-paced precision platformer about a robotic copy of yourself, waking up with no memory of a severe accident. Dash, dodge, and double jump through 100+ handcrafted levels, reboot instantly on every fail, and uncover the truth behind your past.

2458280.title: Tribe Quest
2458280.short_description: Fight, craft, and survive. Swap between characters in your party as you navigate procedurally generated levels and complete quests. Rebuild your home from the rubble and hunt the warlord who destroyed it.

2458590.title: Wizavior
2458590.short_description: 3D platformer that will pull you into a whirlwind of adventure! Step into the shoes of the powerful Zavior a retired wizard who, with humor and determination, sets out once again to save the world from evil.

2459560.title: Paris Transylvania
2459560.short_description: A vampire-slaying pachinko roguelike deckbuilder. Collect a powerful deck of cards, strategize, aim, and pop pegs to power up and deal massive damage with relic synergies. Play as one of the unlikely heroes, conquer Transylvania, and free the people in this turn-based RPG.

2464520.title: Surviving Deponia
2464520.short_description: Explore, craft, build and fight your way through the harsh landscape of Deponia. Meet allies and make enemies while surviving the perils of the junk planet. It might be garbage - but it’s your garbage!

2465030.title: 3D Nuclear Reactor Simulator
2465030.short_description: Operate and maintain a nuclear power plant in this immersive first-person simulator. Control a pressurised water reactor, diagnose equipment failures, repair machinery, manage critical systems and respond to emergencies where every decision matters.

2465230.title: Crafted Legends
2465230.short_description: Build awesome racing tracks, challenge other players' ghosts, and discover what happens when realistic physics meets questionable driving skills. Create, race, crash, repeat. Roads are optional. Gravity isn't. Welcome to Crafted Legends, where even your worst ideas deserve a test drive.

2465690.title: Dice Captain
2465690.short_description: Dice Captain is pirate roguelike about managing luck. Roll dice, adapt and outsmart bad luck to win battles at sea. Build wild artifact combos and upgrade your dice faces between runs to turn pure chance into a strategy you control.

2469440.title: Martial Law: Our Spring
2469440.short_description: Grey blocks of flat, Militia and tanks on the streets, the desire for a better tomorrow and your drunk buddy on the bench. Welcome to Martial Law: Our Spring.

2469560.title: Cantos
2469560.short_description: A persistent RTS where survival comes before expansion! Secure a foothold, outlast rivals, and earn the right to build your colony in shared servers shaped by players or on your own in single-player!

2470770.title: Triple Treble Triumph
2470770.short_description: How many genres have you mastered? Is it enough to play 3 of them simultaneously? Triple Treble Triumph puts 27 games into 1. Accept its trial to prove how much of a Gamer you are.

2470790.title: INFERIUS
2470790.short_description: Descend through nine dominions of Hell in a first-person horror roguelike deckbuilder. Wield Major Arcana tarot cards, upgrade your deck between deaths, use your lantern to survive the dark, and defeat each ruler before your sanity breaks.

2470910.title: Evie: The Echo Condition
2470910.short_description: Explore a dangerous, forgotten world to find the cure to save your best friend’s life, in Evie, an HD-2D action-adventure game that weaves a wordless fantasy tale out of the real-life battle against childhood leukemia.

2471330.title: Cathedral: Crow's Curse
2471330.short_description: Set in the same universe as Cathedral, but with its own story and style, Cathedral: Crow's Curse is an action-adventure with tight combat and a focus on exploration. Parry, dodge and fight your way through numerous enemies in a rich detailed world as you uncover the events leading up to Cathedral.

2471710.title: Dragon Jump
2471710.short_description: One button, one dragon, one desire. Finish every level as fast as you can to regain your human body. Practice, build or cheat using machine learning. In Dragon Jump everything is permitted.

2471750.title: Archangel: Demon Rush
2471750.short_description: Build your fortress while the horde is already attacking, then fight inside it. Freely place turrets and combine brutal weapons, cards and abilities until a desperate defence becomes an unstoppable demon-killing war machine in this third-person action roguelite.

2473670.title: Followers of Krow
2473670.short_description: Medieval Fantasy RPG Autobattler in a 3D Pixel Art style, where you buy and upgrade abilities to fight monsters and explore to uncover secrets about the world.

2474220.title: Death the Guitar
2474220.short_description: "Death the Guitar" is a pop and violent 2D Platformer action game. The player is a killer electric guitar whose owner was murdered, and the goal is to take revenge on the humans by manipulating "sound" and "electricity".
developers: トロヤマイバッテリーズフライド

2476610.title: Summoner Arise!
2476610.short_description: Turn-based. Tactics. Roguelike. Summon units and battle your way past wave after wave of enemies. Start with a fixed amount of mana as you ascend a mysterious ruined world. Run out and you lose. With 300+ upgrades available, customize and command your army to victory!

2477470.title: The Chronos Event
2477470.short_description: Bend time to your will in The Chronos Event, a fast-paced third-person roguelite shooter. Rewind the clock, team up with your past selves, and battle hordes of enemies. Master time-looping, gain game-changing upgrades, and face down a hostile future in this time-bending sci-fi adventure.

2477750.title: Dunderbeck
2477750.short_description: Cincinatti: The Queen City, the Paris of America, Porkopolis. This city is a mess, Dunderbeck. Your job is to fight that mess, build with that mess and - I'm sorry to say - eat that mess. It's a dirty job, but that's how the sausage is made.

2478130.title: Wild Wild Eden
2478130.short_description: Survive a primitive fantasy world in Wild Wild Eden, an open-world survival crafting game where monsters are family. Pet, feed, and protect your companions. As a tribal chief, raise your monster friends, build a thriving base, and explore a harsh yet heartwarming world together.

2478710.title: Football, Tactics & Glory 2
2478710.short_description: XCOM meets Football Manager. Embark on the career of an unknown coach: tactically outsmart opponents in turn-based matches, earn money and experience, search for talented players, manage a club, build your reputation to get invited to lead the national team, and win the World Championship!

2480350.title: Rise Of The General
2480350.short_description: 246 BCE. Pick one of 9 lives, from a slave in the headman's grain store to a kid raised by hill bandits. At 16, the levy takes you to war. Climb from conscript to general in a narrative war RPG with turn-based 5v5 battles, duels, and no plot armor.

2480840.title: Wesley Smith's Repair Game
2480840.short_description: Collect items, craft weapons and defeat your opponents in this frustratingly funny arcade game. Compete against the merciless bots or up to three friends in couch co-op mode to become the master blacksmith!

2481190.title: Kamigami: Spirits of the Nature
2481190.short_description: Get ready for another card battling adventure on Kamigami! Easy to play, hard to master, collect brand new cards, face over 80 opponents, build your strategies and restore peace to the gods!

2481240.title: HavenCraft
2481240.short_description: Build a Safe Haven! An alchemy accident has devastated the mainland and the people are looking for a new home. Take the lead and rebuild society, house by house. HavenCraft is a third-person town builder and management game, playable in single- and multiplayer.

2481970.title: Sunny Side Down, by Muno!
2481970.short_description: Sunny Side Down is a frantic arcade puzzle-platformer where you're a tiny mouse working at a breakfast diner, guiding eggs toward a frying pan while a line of angry customers looms over your head. How long can you last in this hectic work environment without getting fired?

2482110.title: Rogue Mech
2482110.short_description: Take control of a rogue mech pilot in a world of ash and ruthless factions. Explore the wasteland, upgrade your arsenal and forge alliances. Create a safe haven, grow crops and scavenge for resources in this hearty, post-apocalyptic adventure.

2482560.title: Lefka 空垣
