2482560.short_description: 《Lefka 空垣》是一款中式赛博灵异RPG。在位于阴阳两界之间的观测站，你将扮演新上任的部长曹麟，与部员列夫卡一起调查由「桃源抛尸案」引入的诸多灵异事件。在这人鬼混杂，乱象丛生的时代下，你们能否探清名为「空垣」的怪象？

2482980.title: Just in Crime
2482980.short_description: Just in Crime is a detective video game in which you play a detective dog and a wizard cat. With a twist; you are able to travel back in time and examine the crime scene a few seconds before it happened.

2483140.title: Containcorp
2483140.short_description: An absurd Corporate Horror & Logistical Management Sim where you contain & milk anomalies for tremendous profit. Construct your facility across multiple floors, design containment areas, employ brilliant minds to study anomalies. Contain, Research, and build a machine of Profit.

2483270.title: Bubbits
2483270.short_description: Pop your way to victory in a colorful next generation Bubble Shooter! Beat 24 other players in battle royale, play VS mode with friends or go on a singleplayer adventure. Bubbits is packed with cute customization, explosive power ups and crazy battle events to shake up the game!

2483660.title: Bamboo Spring: A Story Cast in Bronze
2483660.short_description: After saving an exiled prince of the fallen State of Wei, you are granted an abandoned homestead. Farm the land, raise livestock, fish and hunt, forge bonds with the townsfolk, build a militia, and defend your home against invading forces.

2483880.title: 龙之塔
2483880.short_description: Dragon Tower is a light ROGUE game set in a different world, where players take on the role of a brave adventurer exploring inside the Dragon Tower. They will assemble their own team to create unique strategies and defeat the monsters within the Dragon Tower.

2484890.title: Deeper Still
2484890.short_description: A hard immersive sim set in a dystopian and nihilistic world. To complete each level, start with a plan by choosing weapons, paths and abilities. Die. Find a better plan. Die again. Repeat until you finish the level. Then replay the levels to find new creative ways to beat them. Co-op mode included.

2486140.title: Dōbumon
2486140.short_description: Dōbumon is an RPG monster collecting/battling game. Experience tactical battles as you choose 4 Dōbumon to fight with on the battlefield. Grow, evolve, and customize your attacks while developing different strategies in order to win, as you fight and explore your way to become the Dōbumon champion.

2487730.title: Medimon
2487730.short_description: Medimon is a medical-themed monster-taming RPG. Capture, battle, and evolve creatures symbolizing medical concepts, turning intricate organ systems and diseases into an interactive and captivating game experience. Dive in and make medicine an adventure!

2487740.title: Fabled Frontier
2487740.short_description: An open world survival action rpg set in a procedurally generated world inspired by fairy tales. Build your hero as well as a home!

2489340.title: The One Who Stands Behind
2489340.short_description: You are a God of Destruction. Realize your strength through powerfull card combos and burn your enemies from existence in the unique deckbuilder combined with hex-grid tactics.

2490390.title: Choking Hazard
2490390.short_description: Build giant toy sets with up to 3 friends, online or split-screen. One enormous pop-up manual, no adult supervision. Argue over step 8 together, or take it slow on your own. Finish a set and watch it spring to life. In Creative mode, build your own sets and share them on the Workshop.

2491550.title: Wandersky
2491550.short_description: Wandersky is a skybound top-down adventure with a single arrow and a flying house. Kuu and her companion Tama are on a mission to restore the land of Hyndara. Explore a huge world filled with puzzles, enemies and quests: the sky always carries those who dare to wander…

2496330.title: Tremble of Towers
2496330.short_description: Co-op tower defense for 1-4 players where you fight alongside your towers! Build any structure from any mineral: ice slows, magma burns, lead extends range. Mix traits into countless combos and hold the Golden Vein across ever-changing, randomly generated maps.

2497020.title: Sick Samurai
2497020.short_description: It's 1972 on Furikyu Island. A jazz-hop record spins up. Your deranged mentor lights his cigarette. Slash every enemy before it burns out. One-hit-kills, no mistakes... well, maybe a few.

2500200.title: Run Away
2500200.short_description: A first-person story horror. The hospital has sealed itself shut: steel over the windows, doors that won't open. Inside are you, a few survivors and a creature that can't be killed. It remembers where you run and where you hide, and next time that's where it looks.

2500500.title: Survival Of Runt
2500500.short_description: An open-world PvPvE survival shooter where cooperation and betrayal coexist. Choose between Chaos and Order to claim victory, and if you fall, revive as a formidable Mutant Player to hunt down the remaining survivors.

2500690.title: Dumbriel: Magnificent Adventure in Hell
2500690.short_description: Dumbriel is a 2D metroidvania action-adventure set in Hell. Play as a clumsy fallen angel in a twisted underworld. Slash, craft, and dodge through deadly arenas, weird monsters, and hellish traps. Die, upgrade, and dive back in.

2503620.title: Little Monster
2503620.short_description: Little Monster is a hand-painted side scroller beat ‘em up where you play as Stormy, a monster under the bed who protects us from our nightmares. Protect the dream! Explore the realms! Rescue your friends!

2504810.title: Arcane Arena
2504810.short_description: Arcane Arena is a fast-paced multiplayer action game where spellcasters clash in team-based combat. Choose your class, master powerful abilities, and dominate the arena. Manipulate time, summon creatures, wield the elements, and combine magic with your team to claim victory.

2504980.title: Moochy
2504980.short_description: Your coins are your health. Spend them on guns, or hold onto them and stay alive longer — your call. Dumb co-op for 1 to 4.

2505230.title: Dreadwinter
2505230.short_description: Take control of Dreadwinter, your very own magical coffee shop! Explore a vibrant, fantasy world, master your craft, and turn a small café into a legend in this spooky, cozy coffee shop sim!

2505370.title: Future Weapon
2505370.short_description: Future Weapon is an online space shooter where you can host a server for you and your friends to annihilate the universe together. Grab a gun, grab a spaceship, punch rocks, upgrade everything, and wreck the world. Join The Fleet! https://discord.gg/WN4UJaEc

2507320.title: Tinkerpatch
2507320.short_description: Tinkerpatch is a bright first-person voxel workshop on a small island floating in the mist. Farm, keep cows, sheep and bees, then build machines that harvest, smelt and haul for you. Buy the land next door and watch the island grow. Nothing runs out, and nothing needs you standing there.

2507770.title: Grandma(88)
2507770.short_description: Of course Grandma loves you — but she loves it even more when you simply listen. Dive into her labyrinth of memories, challenge her stories and watch everything around you fall apart. Can you escape her version of the past?

2508730.title: Specters of the Sun
2508730.short_description: Specters of the Sun is a challenging 2D action platformer with action-packed levels. Take on the role of an elusive specter to reclaim your old corpse, now possessed at the heights of your former kingdom.

2509440.title: Nightborn
2509440.short_description: Fight, sneak, or charm your way through a gothic modern New Orleans as a Vampire detective of your creation. Unravel a vast centuries-old conspiracy involving Vampire factions, Werewolves, and far stranger horrors. Try to survive as a Nightborn without losing yourself to madness or damnation.

2511300.title: CODE EXIT
2511300.short_description: Enter Pantheon, a futuristic city swallowed by darkness and ruled by a rogue AI. Team up with up to 4 players and survive an adaptive pursuer that learns from every mistake. Complete the mission, uncover Minerva’s secrets, and find a way out before the city consumes you.

2511400.title: Project: rEvolution
2511400.short_description: Project: rEvolution is a tower defense game set in a dystopian Cyberpunk world. With placeable and wieldable turrets, modular upgrades, and evolving enemies, it blends strategic depth and replayability, offering a fresh experience within the genre.

2511430.title: The Mirror Dimension
2511430.short_description: The Mirror Dimension is a co-op psychological thriller and horror game for 1 to 4 players. Players investigate paranormal activities, solve mysteries across dimensions, and eliminate spiritual entities to find problems. Are you ready to explore different dimensions?

2512880.title: CrisisX
2512880.short_description: Immerse yourself into a realistic open world experience and find your way out in the ruins of a dying world. Survive the threats from the Infected, the living and most importantly, the wilderness. Fight or cooperate with others, and establish your territory. Build your own new post-apocalyptic world

2513150.title: Archi Vista
2513150.short_description: Dig, wash, and uncover the lost artifacts in Archi Vista, a relaxing first-person excavation game. Break through layers of earth, clean forgotten ruins, find hidden treasures, and restore extraordinary places one satisfying discovery at a time.

2513200.title: Mystic Land: The Search for Maphaldo
2513200.short_description: An old-school RPG inspired by Wizardry 7, Might and Magic and Eye of the Beholder series. 2d grid-based movement, strategic turn-based combat and lots of places to visit and puzzles to solve.

2513270.title: UvsU: You vs You
2513270.short_description: Outsmart your past self in a battle of cause and effect. Explore an interconnected clay world, discover its hidden rules, and uncover the secrets it would rather keep buried.

2514420.title: Idle Isekai - An idle RPG
2514420.short_description: Idle Isekai is a strategic idle RPG with roguelite elements designed for players who love managing complex growth systems. Whether you are battling fearsome monsters or meticulously managing your character's progression, the path to power is yours to define.

2515480.title: Frame of Mind - A game of thoughts.
2515480.short_description: Frame of Mind - A game of thoughts is a brief and cozy narrative game that lets you explore a character via thoughts and momentos you find in stages of their life. Its an introspective game, meant to share some experiences a peer-group of neurodivergent queers, including the dev, had growing up.

2516650.title: The M/S Cornelia II Incident
2516650.short_description: On a small, snowy skerry somewhere in the Nordic Archipelago a man wakes up with no memory of who he is, where he is or why he is there. A point-and-click mystery where atmosphere and unusual puzzles are at the heart of the game.

2517080.title: Psychotic Bathtub
2517080.short_description: Have a psychotic episode in your bathtub. Argue with a rubber duck, flood your bathroom and drown Jesus. Find your very own ending – or all of them.

2519750.title: Pulp Friction
2519750.short_description: Fruit-on-fruit kitchen brawls! Roll, slice and parry as one of 18 living fruits, carve chunks off your rivals until their core shows and be the last fruit standing. 15 party modes for up to 8 players online or 4 on one couch, plus co-op raids against the mold.

2519860.title: Ecosphere
2519860.short_description: A Fantasy / Steampunk Visual Novel in which you'll make hearts skip a beat! You are Arane Kross, a talented engineer capable of controlling nature with a machine: the Ecosphere! What will be your impact?

2520400.title: Nox Mortalis
2520400.short_description: Nox Mortalis is a retro-style open world survival game where you must gather resources, craft essential gear, and explore sinister dungeons. Face hellish creatures and fight to survive in this world.

2520700.title: Lonely Coast: Echo of the Deep
2520700.short_description: You wake up on the Lonely Coast, your treasure ship wrecked, it's seven relic cores stolen by deep-sea pirates, and the island has nothing—not even a bird turd. No engineering, no botany, not even bloody magic (oh, my word). Well, well. At least you know a little Alchemy!

2520780.title: Net Raiders
2520780.short_description: Net Raiders is a strategic roguelike deck-building game where you play by performing Card Merge.To survive the dangers of a crumbling virtual world, merge the cards in your hand and find the best moves to defeat the enemies you face!

2520840.title: Cluck Up!
2520840.short_description: Climb from a farm all the way to the moon, where one missed jump can undo it all. Dodge lava floors, leap between skyscrapers, ride rockets through space, then storm Clawrence's castle. Grab the stolen eggs and try not to fall. Play solo or with 4 friends.

2523800.title: Isolation One
2523800.short_description: Exciting action with puzzle elements and an interesting plot, which takes place on the huge spaceship Transporter P18. In this game, players will encounter an incredible mixture of science fiction and horror. Immerse yourself in a dark world where you need to survive at any cost.

2526190.title: Tiny Queendom: An Ant Terrarium
2526190.short_description: A living ant colony on your desktop. Build a glass terrarium of sand, water and plants, add one queen, and watch her family dig tunnels, forage, learn from danger and raise new queens on its own. Keep it in a small window in the corner of your screen while you work.

2526600.title: Herosbine : The Unknown Island
2526600.short_description: Explore a mysterious open world, battle hundreds of uniquely assembled Herosbines, and claim their Hero Parts to combine their powers and shape your own combat style. Guide Tim through a story-rich journey of grief, identity, and self-discovery.

2527940.title: Little Cheese Works
2527940.short_description: [Co-op Action × Voice Chat] Work together to carry cheese without waking the cat! Use voice chat—but be careful, even small sounds can alert it. As overworked mice in a shady company, can you overcome traps and escape to a peaceful life?

2528170.title: The Hearth and Harbour
2528170.short_description: Transform a run-down restaurant and build a new life for yourself in this management RPG. Decide what kind of restaurant you want to create and what kind of person you want to be. As a storm brews outside, every choice you make has consequences.

2530580.title: Tactics And Cards
2530580.short_description: Feel like a hero in a classic RTS! Build your army and crush the enemy team with spells, incremental upgrades, and tactics! Battle it out in a quick match against bots or friends in a 2D battle in the best traditions of auto-battlers, Tower Defense, and Castle Fight!

2531840.title: Goeland: Seagull Adventure
2531840.short_description: You're a seagull. The island is your playground. Everyone on it is your problem to solve, bother, or befriend. Explore freely, solve things your way, mess with everything, and create absurd moments worth sharing.

2532110.title: Trivals
2532110.short_description: A team hero sport with one rule: no passes, no score. Pass to charge the Elderball, borrow your teammate’s power, and take down the enemy Guardian, a goal that fights back and evolves with every hit.

2533000.title: Small Kingdoms
2533000.short_description: Small Kingdoms is a streamlined grand strategy and RTS game with procedurally generated campaigns. Build up your cities and armies on the world map and command your troops on the battlefield. Rule a medieval fantasy kingdom and conquer your rivals.

2534390.title: triMIno
2534390.short_description: A tile-matching roguelike. triMIno is a satisfyingly strategic tile puzzler where you crack open booster packs, draft your perfect tile set, and connect colours and shapes to unleash huge scoring chains. Every tile counts. How far can you push your next run?

2536140.title: Red Dust Colony
2536140.short_description: The spirit of the space race lives on in this Mars based colony sim. Mine, craft and research in order to build up your initial lander into a self sustaining colony. Keep oxygen levels high and CO₂ levels low. Discover and grow a variety of plants to balance out colonist nutrition.

2537270.title: 4:AM
2537270.short_description: Hide. Solve. Run. Survive. Aila must avoid detection and find their way to a new future in a world ravaged by the Yellow. 4:AM is a dystopian cinematic puzzle adventure where you rely on nanobots to duplicate objects and find unique solutions.

2537910.title: Black Otaku 2: Taekwondo is in my Blood
2537910.short_description: Join Sahara B. Shabazz as she honours that Korean man's sacrifice by winning this martial arts tournament with the Taekwondo that flows in her veins.

2540650.title: Keyframes
2540650.short_description: After chance meetings in your second year of college, decide how you want to spend the last two years of undergrad with your friends— both old and new— in this partially customizable amare visual novel.

2541560.title: ARCHETYPE BLUE
2541560.short_description: Archetype Blue is a JRPG-style role-playing game that blends the fun of building your party and planning strategies with an engaging story. Mix and match companions with unique abilities and personalities to form your own party and enjoy the thrill of strategic battles!

2541770.title: Ether@Net
2541770.short_description: Become a Netwalker — a paranormal investigator navigating between the haunted streets of Hong Kong and a digital ghost realm. Uncover urban tragedies, forge a bond with your ghost companion, and unravel the truth that lingers beyond the Net.

2541950.title: Sirens
2541950.short_description: Become a deadly Siren and hunt down the most dangerous sea creatures that have ever swim in the depths of the oceans! Experience a fascinating journey through the world as seen from the perspective of Sirens at various stages of their evolution.

2542310.title: Fatal Run 2089
2542310.short_description: Atari’s Fatal Run 2089 delivers over-the-top driving action across a post-apocalyptic landscape. You’ll have to race against a countdown clock at incredibly high-speeds and destroy enemy vehicles by any means necessary. Fail to complete your missions and you put humanity in jeopardy.

2542580.title: Rodolfo Mascarpone y Ramón Cazanuecos: Amenaza en el Molinillo
2542580.short_description: ¡Prepárate para vivir una emocionante aventura de acción en 3D sidescroll con nuestros queridos personajes Rodolfo Mascarpone y Ramón Cazanuecos, creados por Borja Pavón y The Catacroquer, quienes también han prestado sus voces para esta emocionante historia cooperativa para dos jugadores!

2544040.title: Starfire Skies
2544040.short_description: Your fireworks are your cards in this turn-based roguelike deckbuilder. Launch fireworks now or save them for the finale to keep your audience of animals entertained. Open card and talisman packs, discover unique shops and events, and earn your stars so you can put on an unforgettable show!

2544730.title: Gateworlds
2544730.short_description: Gateworlds is a colony sim about exploring and surviving a fantasy wilderness. Find your way in a world of floating islands, strange creatures, and fickle gods.

2546030.title: Two Putt
2546030.short_description: Two Putt is a 1-4 player wacky mini golf game. Help Komakai and Kyoichi conquer 100+ courses and 20+ wacky mini games to become mini golf champions! 🏆 Hit the links solo, or grab some friends (1-4 players)

2546650.title: Breach Signal
2546650.short_description: Breach Signal is a 1-6 player co-op cosmic horror game. As a recruit of the FNA, lead expeditions into strange places and investigate mysterious anomalies that threaten our reality.

2547010.title: Mik
2547010.short_description: A narrative first-person platformer set inside a decaying megastructure. Traverse through ruined architecture, solve environmental puzzles, and descend into the depths of a dying world to uncover an unsettling truth.

2548280.title: Conquest of Eldinar
2548280.short_description: Conquest of Eldinar is a Action Combat / Real Time Strategy hybrid game where you choose from one of 16 different Factions to play as while you build your base, train an army, and engage in large scale battles. The game supports both single-player campaigns and online multi-player matches.

2549980.title: RANGER COMMANDO
2549980.short_description: Nostalgic '80s-inspired isometric tactical shooter. Explore randomly generated missions, assassinate officers, free hostages, blow stuff up. No handholding, but easy to pick up!

2551250.title: Hexforger
2551250.short_description: Craft your spells in ONLINE CO-OP with your friends in this SURVIVORS-LIKE! Slaughter monsters, gain gold, upgrade your spells to infinite heights. Crush challenges and unlock new spells, upgrades, pickups, realms. Up to 4 players in this unique twist on the survivors-like formula!

2553330.title: Elemdian
2553330.short_description: A mystical action-adventure where you shift between human and wolf, combining elemental powers to cast powerful spells. Explore islands alongside a fairy survivor, and uncover the connection between a mysterious attack and a spreading Dark Mist.

2554970.title: Hell Games
2554970.short_description: Get ready for Hell Games: In this action packed player vs player arena brawler 4 fallen athletes, once cheaters and dopers, battle it out in the depths of hell. Knock out opponents with sports gear, power up, and strive to be the last one standing.

2554980.title: Last Warrior Arena
2554980.short_description: Build your warrior. Outsmart your next opponent. Last Warrior Arena is a 1v1 roguelike auto-battler where equipment, skills, and enemy choices shape every run. Combine elemental powers, discover powerful builds, and take on deadly bosses as your warrior fights automatically.

2556470.title: Fantastic Haven
2556470.short_description: Restore the equilibrium of magic by saving endangered fantasy creatures. Build your shelter to welcome and protect them, explore unique regions, rally neighboring populations to your cause and rehabilitate creatures in their natural environment.

2559510.title: Omnivael: Chronicles of the realm
2559510.short_description: Free sandbox RPG at kingdom scale: trade, craft, fight, buy land, raise a family, and leave a legacy in Year 1500 Omnivael. No main quest — Early Access starts in Mystria.

2560470.title: Apostle of Mustard
2560470.short_description: A difficult 3d precision platformer. Hop, skip, and skid your way across an eerie purgatory. Thread though a rage inducing gauntlet of platforms while unraveling a mustard flavored mystery. Will you make it home, or will you be stuck forever?

2561120.title: RATKING
2561120.short_description: Become The Salary Man. Unleash ZA BLADE. Save Your Boss. Experience a life OFF ZA CLOCK. a Uniquely Surreal Action Combat, Player Choice Fueled, Point & Click Adventure.

2562130.title: Sternly Worded Adventures
2562130.short_description: Sternly Worded Adventures is a roguelite word puzzle RPG inspired by Bookworm Adventures where you travel through a forested peninsula with Yorkshire-sounding place names fighting monsters with the power of words to uncover whatever dark secrets may be lurking beyond.

2562710.title: LEVEL UP YOUR BODY
2562710.short_description: LUYB - Hit or Box objects to the beat, dodge obstacles. Enhance strength, endurance, coordination, reflexes. Dance to the Rhythm and Elevate in a virtual world.

2563780.title: Rift Saviours
2563780.short_description: Rift Saviours is a sword-fighting roguelite where you battle endless waves of enemies. Survive longer to earn upgrades that offer great build customization. Step into the rift and fight for your survival!

2564480.title: Nomad: Steppeborn Saga
2564480.short_description: Nomad: Steppeborn Saga is an open world co-op survival crafting adventure set in a vast, ever changing world of nomadic culture. Explore, trade, forge alliances, and face threats while packing up camp, migrating, and forging your legacy.

2564680.title: Power Line Rider
2564680.short_description: It's time to ride! Dodge colorful animals and Defeat Bosses to conquer the Power Lines in this Retro Arcade game with a short Story Mode. Complete the Story to unlock Endless Mode and explore the infinite "NegaZone". You'll enjoy simple controls, classic 8-bit visuals, and an energetic soundtrack!

2566700.title: The Last General
2566700.short_description: Lead thousands of units in this large scale modern war RTS as you manage economy and logistics, build your war machine, and fight across millions of procedurally generated scenarios, or jump into the battlefield controlling any unit in first or third person at any time.

2566920.title: About LAST Chanks: Prologue
2566920.short_description: A free puzzle-platformer for solo players and online co-op. Two damaged robots struggle to survive as their energy slowly runs out. Explore forgotten ruins, overcome dangerous obstacles, and begin the search for the legendary Chank.

2567320.title: The Heirloom
2567320.short_description: Uncover the secrets of your family and your grandfather's old lighthouse as you seek the truth behind the unusual happenings in The Heirloom, a mysterious thriller adventure inspired by the atmosphere of the Hebrides and Scottish folklore!

2568890.title: DRINKRIME
2568890.short_description: On the first day of a long weekend, you pick up a talking liquor bottle on a bridge. It's Jin, a demon judged by the Demon King. Cursed to stay by his side, you team up to Jinterrogate sinners hiding around town. A Fill-in-the-Crime Interrogation Adventure in retro, limited-palette pixel art.

2569020.title: Centuries
2569020.short_description: Grow a small camp into a thriving medieval settlement. Shape its expansion, develop its economy and care for the households that call it home. Balance your ambitions with the everyday needs of a growing community.

2572590.title: Underground Nomads
2572590.short_description: You command a drilling train, leading a dwarf clan through the underground depths toward the planetary core. Manage the crew, complete expeditions, gather resources, upgrade gear, and make tough choices to reach the abandoned city and bring your people back home.

2576700.title: Starry-巡星之旅
2576700.short_description: 为了打倒毁灭世界的大魔王，少年和少女们踏上长长的旅途，开启了一段跨越两个世界的恋爱、幻想奇谭。 本作品搭载了中日语的文本和配音，L2D动态立绘以及超过200张的基本CG；此外还有立绘触碰等独特系统。

2577730.title: Golel
2577730.short_description: Immerse yourself in the disturbing world of a first-person, Dungeon Crawler, Golel. Leverage the environment to your advantage, drop a bookshelf on an enemy, or kick them into a pit. Golel brings innovation to turn-based combat.

2578050.title: Fishing Echoes
2578050.short_description: Fishing Echoes is a fantasy fishing game where you catch elemental fish to save the realm from a world-devouring maelstrom.

2580040.title: Code5erpent
2580040.short_description: The game where numbers are a weapon. On a simulated Earth, add, multiply, or combine the numbers which comprise the matrix's code, and take advantage of a rich equipment system of weapons and scrolls in order to come up with devastating combos to annihilate your enemies.

2580160.title: Angry Mother Earth
2580160.short_description: Angry Mother Earth offers a one-of-a-kind strategy experience within an fully simulated world. Wield and merge a variety of abilities to release cataclysmic forces—ranging from hurricanes and earthquakes to blizzards—upon the world of humans. But be warned: humanity won't go down without a fight!

2581850.title: HUMANKIND™ 2
2581850.short_description: Build a civilization that spans the ages in this historical turn-based strategy game. Combine evolving cultures, raise cities, command armies and expand your empire as a changing climate reshapes the world and your path through history.

2582200.title: The Wake of the Wyrm
2582200.short_description: A crown upon your head, danger all around. Rule, marry, scheme, raise heirs, wage wars, fulfill prophecies, and survive the waking Wyrm. An interactive text-based dark fantasy novel, 850,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects.

2582400.title: Five Day Detective
2582400.short_description: Five Day Detective is a point and click style adventure game featuring multiple murder cases and a twisted sense of humour.

2582710.title: Mikene's Aspects
2582710.short_description: Guide Mikene in the search for the 7 Aspects of Balance to achieve Omnipotence and put an end to the problem plaguing the city of Farzin once and for all. Dive into hordes of enemies in this frantic hack n' slash in the best Soulslike style!

2587940.title: Photophore - Chapter 1
2587940.short_description: An arcade game that oscillates between shooting, brick-breaking and reflection... with a single projectile!

2587970.title: Embrasure
2587970.short_description: Run a nation at war, from the steel up. Mix and heat-treat armour steel, design tanks plate by plate, lay out the factories that build them, then command them on battlefields cut from real terrain. Hand any branch to an AI chief. Three eras: 1941, 1985 and 2024. Built on published real-world data.

2588090.title: Eternal Wanderer
2588090.short_description: Live. Die. Reincarnate. Return decades later as a human, rat, dog, bird or other lifeform and face the world your choices created. Carry karma and knowledge across dozens of lives in a narrative RPG spanning centuries, where every life becomes part of your story.

2590240.title: METRO 2039
2590240.short_description: METRO 2039 is the next landmark FPS from acclaimed storytellers, 4A Games. Journey into the dark heart of post-apocalyptic Moscow in a harrowing conflict for the very soul of the Metro.

2590550.title: AAS Mos Apocalypse
2590550.short_description: A small accident was occurred in the laboratory, which lead to an apocalypse. Not just an apocalypse, but a 'mos apocalypse'. What's a Mos? It's is a bigger version of a mosquito. Those mos are the reason many people have gone missing. Play as every member of the AAS team and stop the apocalypse!

2590750.title: Cosmorons
2590750.short_description: The Overlord demands you Conquer the Universe! Grab your friends in a 1-4 co-op roguelite shooter and deploy as grappling robot Drudges. Battle the alien swarms, complete missions and destroy the Cosmos! Stack outrageous upgrades to build the Ultimate Drudges or delve deeper into the Universe!

2591700.title: SetPoint Volleyball
2591700.short_description: Build your athlete and hit the sand! SetPoint Volleyball blends arcade beach volleyball with competitive matches online or on the same couch. Serve, spike, block, challenge your friends and climb the ranked ladder. Just watch out for the seagulls.

2593060.title: Witches' Grove
2593060.short_description: Pick a fighter, train them up and send them into the Grand Rumpus! Buy techniques and potions between rounds, weather a witch's wild spells and race through the Grove Games. Twelve quirky fighters, countless builds, one Champion's Wish. How far can you take them?

2593320.title: Catechesis
2593320.short_description: Embrace the darkness as a demon-possessed altar boy in this Horror RPG. Explore the city, battle demons, upgrade your weapons, and embark on an unforgettable journey with unique characters and anime-style cutscenes.

2594620.title: Figure Drawing Garden
2594620.short_description: Grab your sketchbook, relax, explore, and draw in your very own Figure Drawing Garden - an immersive virtual garden designed for you to practice and improve at figure drawing.

2594630.title: Beautiful in Death
2594630.short_description: A first-person game with a focus on dialogue and historical accuracy, set in the Victorian Era. You will step into the shoes of a photographer with a stern mustache who specializes in post-mortem photography. The game is emotionally heavy, melancholic, and full of skeletons in the closet.

2594980.title: Brickhaven
2594980.short_description: Create your gang from nothing. Start off with just yourself and take it from a single member to a sprawling criminal empire. Extort businesses, deal drugs, sell guns, and much more. Customize your gang to partake in whatever crimes you want them to. What kind of boss will you be?

2595110.title: Love Nest
2595110.short_description: 《爱之巢》是一场关于血肉、爱与救赎、恨与纠缠的冒险。密室逃脱也好、视觉小说也好、电子宠物也好……这些都只是这场冒险的冰山一角。唯一重要的只有……属于你的少女——『晴』，永远在你们的《爱之巢》，微笑着等着你。

2596940.title: Isometria
2596940.short_description: Explore an isometric world solo or with friends. Battle goblins, giant crabs, mysterious machines, and powerful bosses to gain their powers. Build a community and help the locals take back their world!

2597090.title: Gravity well
2597090.short_description: Explore vast galaxies through gravity wells and realistic physics. Launch and combine celestial bodies to uncover mysterious stories hidden in space. Race friends and players worldwide for the top spot, or slow down and enjoy a tranquil deep-space atmosphere beneath the stars.

2597610.title: Mononoke No Kuni
2597610.short_description: Restore villages, purify yokai, and reclaim a lost world in this Japanese-inspired action-adventure set in an otherworld inhabited by Mononoke. Journey through the corrupted Mononoke no Kuni, recover the stolen soul of Musashi the Shiba Inu, and set out on a grand adventure to return home.

2598210.title: Infernae
2598210.short_description: Where you walk, death follows. Duel those who resist in challenging, adrenaline-filled boss battles. In this hack-n-slash bullet hell, don't run from bullets — weaponize them. Fear is no shield.

2600820.title: The Journey Home
2600820.short_description: Some answers can only be found by going within. In a world beyond the boundaries of time and space, your journey awaits. A stress-free atmospheric side-scrolling adventure.

2601840.title: Paper Play VR
2601840.short_description: Experience creative minigames as the world's biggest paper playground unfolds right in front of your eyes! We have crazy games, difficult challenges and a heartwarming story for you and your friends, so come and join the party!

2601980.title: Space Scum
2601980.short_description: Lead a band of mercenaries through battle after battle in this Sci-Fi, turn-based RPG. Fight your way across different planets, earning loot and equipment to outfit your team – and remember, no option is off the table when survival is on the line.

2603630.title: Foederatus
2603630.short_description: In this kingdom management RPG, you assume your father’s throne in Dalmatia to lead the kingdom, build alliances, fight rivalries and hear the pleas of your people. On the brink of change, you will define the political order. By your decisions, the future of Dalmatia is in your hands.

2603850.title: Shadow Mate
2603850.short_description: A horror action adventure game. Cynthia awakens in a ruined secret research facility with the vicious parasite “Belial” hidden inside her body. Surrounded by grotesque creatures and maddened researchers, she must use Belial’s power to escape and uncover the horrifying truth behind the laboratory.

2605430.title: The Lab Thing
2605430.short_description: The lab thing is a first-person phycological horror game. Explore the mysterious life of an architect through a series of his nightmares. Gather all the mind notes, upgrade backpack items, solve puzzles and try to go deeper and deeper in the psyche of the lab thing!

2605970.title: Fairy Comedy: A Love Hard To Find
2605970.short_description: 只能复述别人话语的鹦鹉精灵，该怎样向喜欢的女孩表达心意？扮演不谙世事的李素武，收集语句卡牌，在约会中努力接上她的话，也可能一不小心说出令人啼笑皆非的怪话！在这段融入轻度卡牌互动的恋爱视觉小说中，与徐清茗从相识走向相恋，在欢笑、心动与成长中，寻找属于自己的幸福。

2606690.title: Protocol Non-Human
2606690.short_description: A realistic first-person horror deduction game. Identify NON-HUMAN entities and navigate critical decisions within the Zone. Earn your survival, upgrade your booth, and-above all-don't let the NON-HUMANS in.

2607570.title: Foosball Manager
2607570.short_description: Foosball Manager is a table football management sim. Scout, sign, and train your squad. Set your tactics, then call the shots from the sideline as your players act on their own across a physics-driven table. Climb the divisions and become a foosball legend.

2607680.title: Illegourmet
2607680.short_description: From underground kitchen to culinary empire. Cook and distribute illegal food across a city obsessed with healthy eating. Expand your network of kitchens, automate production, and take over the black market for flavor.

2609460.title: Phantasist
2609460.short_description: Phantasist is a game about a boy living with social anxiety!

2610390.title: Convenient: Fiend
2610390.short_description: Quickly dig graves and run for your life while solving puzzles to solve the mystery of the Wendigo

2610840.title: Daomei Village: Prologue
2610840.short_description: The Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version. In order to return to the Emperor's favor, you must make an effort. Repair, build, cultivate fields and fight various adversities. Meet new friends and learn their stories. Do whatever it takes not to be banished forever!

2611920.title: Unguided
2611920.short_description: Escape a digital prison, upload yourself back into the real world, and get revenge on the ones who framed you in this fast-paced, challenging roguelike slasher. [RUN], [suffer], [EOL], [RUN]

2612620.title: 秘封最后旅 ~ Edge of Realm
2612620.short_description: A Touhou fan game and a 2D pixel shooting survival game, telling the story of Renko looking for her friend Merry in the destroyed Gensokyo, finding the truth about the destruction of Gensokyo and saving the world.

2614840.title: DOPAMINER
2614840.short_description: DOPAMINER is a short and intense incremental mining game. Delve deep into the mine to blast rocks, gather gems and artifacts, and unlock powerful new abilities in the skill tree.

2615150.title: Hyper Tanks
2615150.short_description: Choose your tank and fight in neon-lit arenas where shots ricochet off walls! Beat challenging campaigns solo or in co-op, or battle your friends and bots in explosive multiplayer modes. Use powerups, special weapons and tank abilities to survive the mayhem of Hyper Tanks!

2615750.title: Simulacro
2615750.short_description: In this first-person philosophical journey, Poísis, an enthusiastic art student, explores a mysterious island in Greece. As she solves the local puzzles, she uncovers traces of its ancient inhabitants, leading her to question her own reality.

2616100.title: The Plague Lords: Black Death
2616100.short_description: A turn-based tactical party RPG with base building, set during the Black Death. Assemble peasants, craftsmen, and warriors, investigate the plague's mysterious origin, develop your settlement, and fight the infected as disease consumes medieval Europe.

2616540.title: Croak
2616540.short_description: Tongue-grapple and pinball-bounce the frog prince across levels to reach the Witch’s Banquet in this hand-drawn 2D platformer. Each whimsical world has its own wacky boss, hidden collectibles, and a unique traversal ability. Grit your teeth! You're gonna CROAK. -DEMO OUT NOW!-

2616750.title: Witchhammer
2616750.short_description: Face relentless hordes of enemies and overthrow the Inquisition in our gripping real-time deckbuilding roguelike. Harness the magic of your tarot deck to shape your destiny and avenge your fate. The future lies in the cards, witch!

2621770.title: Hexrite
2621770.short_description: You are a sorcerer seeking to fulfil a magical ritual to summon an ancient dead deity. Cast mystical domes, explore fantastical realms and meet a peculiar cast of characters in this stylized PS2-inspired action-platformer!

2623060.title: Shatterbelt
2623060.short_description: A short incremental asteroid shooter. Blast rocks that crack and split, scoop up their gems and spend them on a tree of 100+ upgrades where every level counts. Break the belt in an evening, then keep diving: Endless, branching roguelite Expeditions and a prestige that pays you for depth.

2623270.title: War Trigger
2623270.short_description: Destroy, smash and blast your way to victory! Use advanced weapons and vehicles to dominate the battlefield.

2624160.title: Roguelike Story
2624160.short_description: A Strategy JRPG Story Driven Roguelike

2627420.title: The Coldest Winter
2627420.short_description: Making decisions has never been harder. Guide Jovanna through a psychological horror adventure in a freezing New York City. Navigate unstable characters, uncover the truth behind the unnatural weather, and struggle to make choices as her emotions fight your every move.

2628470.title: 嘉离代战
2628470.short_description: One Chariot. Thousands of Enemies. Fight numbers with speed. Break formations with precision.

2628740.title: Dead Meat
2628740.short_description: A murder mystery interrogation game - where you can ask the suspects literally ANYTHING! Dive into a macabre conspiracy of burgers and billionaires, getting up-close and personal with an eccentric cast of cold-blooded killers - using voice or keyboard.

2628880.title: Blood & Chaos
2628880.short_description: Ancient sacrifices saved the world, but their legacy is unraveling. A party based roguelike inspired by classic '80s RPGs, where every descent into cursed dungeons carries permanent consequences.

2629630.title: Chessire
2629630.short_description: A roguelike tactical auto-battler where you build an army of chess pieces infused with items and magical abilities. Assemble an army, discover synergies and master the combat system. Guide your army's strategy and watch it auto-battle or take command and control your pieces in turn-based combat!

2629690.title: Undermaze
2629690.short_description: Driven from the surface, your faction settles on the inner walls of spherical caverns and searches for the resource that will bring it back to the surface — before pollution catches up with it. But the next cavities are blocked by mazes: guide your heroes turn by turn and design your own maze.

2630480.title: BROODSAC
2630480.short_description: BROODSAC is a 2.5D survival management game where every visitor could save your community or destroy it. Manage your resources, interrogate strangers at your door, and decide who deserves your trust as an invisible threat spreads.

2634710.title: Stardust Rain
2634710.short_description: A momentum-driven 2.5D anime fighting game. Build velocity, adapt on the fly, and always be on the move! Easy to pick up, hard to master, with rollback netcode.

2635310.title: Skele TONS
2635310.short_description: A short incremental game about stopping a massive skeleton army.

2635320.title: Crime: 1997
2635320.short_description: Newport, 1997. Waterside gang member Henry Gallagher is thrust into a lethal spiral after a failed deal. Trapped between a police crackdown and the Sorvino Mafia, Henry must navigate a city ignited by "Pulse"—a volatile new drug turning every street into a warzone.

2636240.title: PocoDoro
2636240.short_description: PocoDoro is a tiny virtual pet that lives on your desktop. Hatch a squishy slime, then poke it, stretch it and toss it around. Feed it, play with it, put it to bed and clean up after it. It lives in real time, and how you raise it shapes who it becomes.

2636460.title: Dungeons Deep
2636460.short_description: Plunge into the Dungeons Deep! A dark-fantasy ARPG featuring vast underworlds full of horrifying monsters and ancient treasures. Liberate the plagued lands of Antioch for those who still remain.

2639930.title: The Neath
2639930.short_description: Beneath you go. Below the bones of the earth and lower into the darkness. Find your way through twisting passages past vile monsters. Explore, discover and conquer your way to greater depths and greater rewards.

2640090.title: Arcane Eats
2640090.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder with a delicious twist. Think like a master chef, balancing resources as you strategically combo ingredients to subdue hungry hordes. Recruit a legendary kitchen crew, and rise through the heroic cooking guilds—before The Hunger consumes us all!

2640300.title: Evolution Survival
2640300.short_description: Evolution Survival is a survival game where the universe evolves around you. The plants and animals you saw at the beginning will be different at the end, They may not even be there, the star may have gone supernova or shrunk into a white dwarf. Use the time you have to ensure your survival.

2642390.title: The Whims of the Gods
2642390.short_description: The Whims of the Gods is a strategic, cooperative city-builder created for joint gameplay in online co-op mode. Build and protect the ancient city, face enemies, and manage resources together! 🏠

2645250.title: October Nightmares | Cauchemars d'octobre
2645250.short_description: Explore a Montréal neighborhood in the 70s, investigate a supernatural phenomenon that inflicts nightmares on its residents, and delve into the depths of the world of dreams to save their lives. October Nightmares is a point & click cosmic horror game where exploration mixes with puzzle solving.

2645990.title: 999 Seconds! Survivors
2645990.short_description: Reject boring stat stacking! We've restructured the gameplay with limited talent resources—talent combinations are just as important as character selection! With 300+ items and 40+ pieces of equipment, what insane builds can you create? —Depth! Difficulty! And high replay value!

2646170.title: My Arms Are Longer Now
2646170.short_description: You are a yucky long-armed thief. Snake through levels, retract like a vacuum cord, or put on a sock to seduce a lonely guard - whatever it takes to pull off the perfect heist!

2648940.title: Beyond the Curtains
2648940.short_description: "Beyond the Curtains" is a cozy idle game. Watch a town, train journey, or graveyard through a window. Click to interact, press "nap" to move time, or simply observe. No tutorials, no goals—witness changes across three themes and piece together their stories.

2649280.title: Moons That Belong
2649280.short_description: Embark on a journey of strategy and domination in Moons That Belong, a 2D space strategy game that challenges your tactical prowess. Command your fleet, conquer planets, and outsmart your opponents in this visually captivating and intellectually engaging adventure.

2651980.title: ノウ
2651980.short_description: "Know" is a cute, eerie, and slightly melancholic adventure game. Explore, evade "Kaibutsu" (monsters), and uncover the secrets of this world!

2652120.title: 驱邪师
2652120.short_description: Exorcist is a first-person horror role-playing game where players step into the shoes of an exorcist, visit haunted locations, follow clues, complete specific tasks, and gradually uncover the truth behind the haunting

2654010.title: Slimes & Dusters TO
2654010.short_description: Lead an army of slimes on the offensive against the dusters that have invaded your planet and restore your home to its former glory in this Tower Offense game!

2657010.title: Club House on Haunted Hill
2657010.short_description: A story driven golf game, challenge friends locally or online or experience the cinematic story. Customize your golfer with the right set of clubs and delve into a haunted golfing adventure!

2657960.title: Spada
2657960.short_description: Enter the arena in Spada, a brutal gladiator combat game where every strike counts. Master fast reflexes and rhythm-based button sequences, survive with deteriorating armor, and win the crowd to claim your freedom. Precision, timing, and courage are your only weapons, any mistake could be fatal.

2659410.title: Elta: Defy All Gods
2659410.short_description: Brawl your way out of corrupted worlds alongside your dragon-god companion in an adrenaline-fueled action-platformer blending free-form melee combat, fluid platforming and sci-fi exploration. Become the champion of your fallen god, Elta.

2659460.title: Blood of Rome
2659460.short_description: Lead a Roman legion through enemy hordes in a survivors-like where every level-up adds a new soldier. Evolve your troops, strengthen your general, and build an unstoppable army. Conquer for Rome.

2659880.title: Journey to the West(暴躁西游)
2659880.short_description: A classic nostalgic side scroll game！
developers: 冲锋牛独立游戏工作室
publishers: 冲锋牛独立游戏工作室

2660600.title: Hellmet: Seven Circles Down
2660600.short_description: Your helmet is your weapon. Plunge through the seven circles of hell, swap cursed Hellmets for absurd new powers, headbutt demons into paste, and shred the hordes with bullets and blades. A boss guards every circle on the way down to the Ultimate Lord of the Underworld.

2661880.title: T-Ghoul :: Dorobou Yameta Youkei Poppu!
2661880.short_description: A mischievous Thai ghoul trades haunting for farming in this 2D isometric horror-comedy. Steal, sell, or raise chickens, avoid shamans, and decide your fate in a ghost-filled village. Survive, thrive… or devour.

2661960.title: Ginger Snap: Islands of Rot
2661960.short_description: Two games in one! GingerSnap: an action platformer with a unique ability combination system. YMIR: a non-linear puzzle platformer with collectable upgrades.

2662450.title: 下九泉
2662450.short_description: 《下九泉》是一款国产剧情向解谜游戏。主角孟存真死后魂归地府，成为行走于九泉的实习判官。孟存真从一个因受诅咒而不能入轮回的亡魂展开调查，追寻亡者被诅咒的真相。游戏围绕人性中“贪、嗔、痴、慢、疑”展开5个截然不同的单元故事。不到最后一刻，你永远想不到事件背后令人细思极恐的真相…

2662550.title: Roam
2662550.short_description: "Roam" is a 2D Action-RPG platformer set in a procedurally generated world. Explore the surrounding lands and delve into the depths of mysterious caves that have lain hidden for centuries beneath the Azure Lake.

2665550.title: Suspended Animation 💽
2665550.short_description: A sci-fi first person exploration game about a ship in danger, and the evil AI tasked with saving it: you.

2666750.title: Winter of the Arbyen
2666750.short_description: 'Winter of the Arbyen' is a game that combines adventure and store manage simulation. In the world where the Ice Age has come, you must survive as a shopkeeper in a coal mine village. Find the missing father, chase the 'Firestone'. Various characters are waiting to help you or take advantage of you.

2667360.title: Apathic
2667360.short_description: Apathic is a first-person psychological horror game. Investigate your brother's disappearance in a mysterious facility. Shift gravity, decipher sounds, and explore underground ducts while evading a creature determined to capture you at all costs.

2667460.title: KEMURI
2667460.short_description: KEMURI is a Yokai-Possession Action Adventure set in KEMURI CITY, where the everyday and paranormal cross paths. Explore as a Yokai Hunter, uncover the unseen with the FOXWINDOW, and wear their powers. Run the streets, race across walls, and cut through the air to dive into the supernatural!

2668410.title: Feed Your T-Rex: Desktop Companion
2668410.short_description: A tiny T-Rex lives at the bottom of your screen while you work. Feed it rabbits, chickens and other critters. Once it's big enough, you can even feed it... humans! Decorate its Containment, keep it happy, and when it dies, use its DNA to breed an even better one.

2668600.title: Escape from the Collector
2668600.short_description: "Escape from the Collector" is a first-person puzzle adventure set inside an old house filled with strange mechanisms and secrets. Explore its rooms, follow the traces of a forgotten story, and solve the puzzles standing between you and the way out.

2668780.title: Peggy's Farm
2668780.short_description: Combine the cozy crafting of a farming sim with the satisfying physics of a pachinko game.

2669030.title: Phenomena Embattled
2669030.short_description: From the far reaching void of space. To the very cores of planets. This is where Phenomena Embattled takes place. Pilot your alien trans-medium craft through aerial battles, underground caverns and deep sea trenches.

2669060.title: Beyond Astra
2669060.short_description: Lead your civilization in a galaxy brimming with life and intrigue. Seamlessly explore and expand across uncharted worlds, from their surfaces to the stars. Forge your destiny in this sci-fi 4X offering a unique blend of grand strategy, planetary city-building, and RTS combat.

2669250.title: Rewind And Reclaim
2669250.short_description: REWIND and RECLAIM is a horror adventure where time moves when you move. Explore different outcomes for each movies by using your wits and your environment. Uncover their behind the scenes to unfold the story linking them all and protect your familly from the curse that took your mother's life.

2669710.title: Tearoom of Terror
2669710.short_description: Congratulations on your inheritance: one tearoom, one murdered aunt, 22 regulars who know where the *ahem* bodies are buried. Brew tea, bake treats and try to solve the mystery of your aunt's murder before Halloween - or end up on the menu yourself.

2669720.title: Kelp Keeper
2669720.short_description: Take on a vital role in the ecosystem in this action-packed bullet hell. Control a charming sea otter and protect the kelp forest from an endless onslaught of devious sea critters. Skillfully dodge attacks, grab your prey, and eat them all at the surface for a huge satisfying snack.

2671300.title: Trailblazers: Into the March
2671300.short_description: Embark on a thrilling adventure in this roguelite colony-sim strategy game. Command your Landship in tactical battles, care for a crew composed of all sorts of characters, shape your home, manage resources, and lead expeditions into the March. Discover what lies at its heart... and in yours.

2673530.title: PathoBLASTA RK
2673530.short_description: Immerse yourself in this Vertical Shoot 'Em Up 80's Style Arcade, with unique Graphics & Sound. The game includes Ships, Missiles, and Special Weapons upgrades. Shoot enless waves of Viruses, Amoebas, Spores and Bosses. Protect the Containment Wall, do not let the Exuoa virus through.

2673600.title: DeskTrack
2673600.short_description: A cozy desktop companion with toy cars and a focus timer. Let a little car cruise while you work or study, earn miles to collect cars and scenery, then build your own tracks or take the wheel for a break.

2674550.title: Electric Alps
2674550.short_description: You are an electrician, moving back to your hometown in the Austrian Alps, which you find lacks a certain... spark. Promptly tasked with wiring up the village, you solve electrical puzzles, blow fuses and master real-world circuitry techniques. Electrify the Alps, one circuit at a time.

2674640.title: The Hydra Experiment
2674640.short_description: Solve puzzles and fling flasks as a member of a mad scientist collective in this action-adventure RPG. Unlock prototypes and discover new mechanics, using them to explore deeper into 0-Laboratories. Build or burn bridges as you sculpt your persona with branching dialogue and consequences.

2675650.title: Decrepit
2675650.short_description: Decrepit is a first-person action game with souls-like combat where every death drags you back into the depths. Learn the dungeon, master the combat, and find your way out of the forsaken castle.

2675700.title: Dark Lessons
2675700.short_description: Trapped in your teacher's home, your only defense against the dark is a flickering candle. Unearth a family’s twisted history and solve puzzles in this Lovecraftian nightmare to find a way out. But be warned: Something else is lurking in the shadows ... and a voice is pleading for your help.

2676270.title: Teo Dove Am Skater 2
2676270.short_description: Skateboarding game in the spirit of THPS. Perform flip tricks, grabs, grinds. Insane lines. Level up your character and learn new tricks. Find hidden secrets. And challenge your rival to a classic game of skate HORSE!

2676290.title: Heroes Of Isekai
2676290.short_description: An auto-battler with roguelike elements, and no unit cap. Run your camp, buy creatures, buildings, spells, gear and runes, assemble your build — then crush your enemies!

2677980.title: Choppy Waters
2677980.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you build your cards, not just your deck. Combine ingredients, each with its own effect, into sushi, then serve it to hungry pirates in turn-based battles. Spend gold to grow stronger, but run out and your voyage is over.

2678750.title: Psychological Hacker 2044
2678750.short_description: 「Psychological Hacker」is a turn-based combat game featuring HD-2D pixel visual style. Explore the inner worlds of others, gain their cognitive experiences and secrets, and uncover the hidden mysteries in this city.

2680770.title: ForMind
2680770.short_description: A horror shooter set in the ZiroTech underwater complex, where every sector is a fight for life. Battle the infected, use the environment, hack terminals, and learn from mistakes. A time anomaly gives you a second chance — don't waste it.

2682200.title: Trope Tales
2682200.short_description: A somewhat comical take on classic JRPGs. Take on the role of Hero, a Silent Protagonist, as you venture across the world to defeat the Main Villains with the help of your friends: The Chick, The Smart Guy, and The Childhood Friend.

2684550.title: Work In Progress
2684550.short_description: It’s your first day in office and half of the staff is already on burnout... Here is your gun, your contract. Now go fire some people.

2685100.title: NOIR BLOOM
2685100.short_description: NOIR BLOOM is a high-octane 2D Gun-Fu action game, where adrenaline-fueled gunfights and skull-crushing close combat collide in a neo-noir rhapsody. Embark on a deadly rampage to honor the vow—strike, disarm, and turn foes into weapons. Every move is a calculated ballet of bullets and blood.

2686570.title: Waltz and Jam
2686570.short_description: Waltz and Jam is a single-player action-adventure platformer following the adventures of Waltz, a pure soul, and Jam, his lovable dog companion. It is set in an afterlife born from a unique reimagination of the Seven Deadly Sins.

2686820.title: isekizima: Ruins and Tails Journey
2686820.short_description: isekizima: Ruins and Tails Journey is a 2D action game. Kijino, a cat-eared adventurer with two tails (Nekomata), embarks on a journey to Isekizima (Ruins Island of dreams and romance: as it was written in the tourist brochure). Explore ruins buried in the forest while enjoying folk music.

2687040.title: 9Cat Saga
2687040.short_description: 9Cat is a Co-op shooter/action game. Gather your friends to forage and extract in the procedurally-generated landscape. Nourish and furnish your collection of 9Cat, refine your combat styles and overcome various missions and defeat great enemies.

2691020.title: LIMINOUS
2691020.short_description: An exploratory first-person survival horror story about travelling the gaps in our reality. Risking everything to keep the lab funded and the board members happy.

2691080.title: Godreaper
2691080.short_description: Godreaper is a dark third-person action-adventure where the fate of your homeland hangs in the balance. As the bogatyr Zaremire, explore every corner of a world inspired by East Slavic mythology. Defeat the creatures of Navi, battle almighty gods and save your homeland from inevitable destruction.

2691090.title: 14:  Overmind
2691090.short_description: 14: Overmind is a first-person survival adventure in a cosmos where anomalies warp space and gravity. Mine ore on asteroids, cut open wrecks with a laser, outfit your base, and upgrade your exosuit to uncover what caused the catastrophe and unravel the mystery of your origins.

2691410.title: Gossip & Potions: Tales from the Witch Shop
2691410.short_description: Gossip & Potions is a potion-brewing and gossip-listening simulator about a witch named Owi, the small town she just moved to, and the very specific potions its very specific inhabitants need. Help them. Or don't. Watch what happens.

2691780.title: Reports from Vera Cruz
2691780.short_description: Investigate the country of Vera Cruz in this journalistic first-person adventure! Solve puzzles, take photos of clues and report news exposing the horrific truths behind General Galba and his bizarre government!

2692420.title: Idlescape
2692420.short_description: Idlescape is an MMORPG combining idle mechanics with RPG elements. Progress continues offline, allowing mastery of skills like Mining, Fishing, and Combat. Engage in crafting, gathering, and strategic battles. Perfect for casual and hardcore gamers alike.

2692660.title: Car Mechanic Simulator 2027
2692660.short_description: Build, repair, and grow your automotive empire — now also in co-op mode! Run a workshop together, fix cars, and expand your collection. Hundreds of configurations, thousands of parts, and full customization await!

2695590.title: Origin of Storms
2695590.short_description: Dive into Origin of Storms, a visually striking fighting game where elemental warriors clash in epic one-on-one battles. Unleash primal transformations, master distinct elemental powers, and compete globally for supremacy in this electrifying arena. Are you ready for the storm?

2695720.title: Piece Quest Idle
2695720.short_description: Shape a party that keeps growing while you’re away. Gather resources, upgrade your base, craft gear, customize hero skill trees, and tune auto-battle strategies to conquer powerful bosses

2697210.title: Detective Bass 2: The Case of the Stolen Pearls
2697210.short_description: Crime never rests... but thankfully, neither does Detective Bass! Put on your detective hat and help Detective Bass get to the bottom of a robbery, in this witty, narrative-driven detective game!

2698830.title: My Dear Neighbor, edition 404
2698830.short_description: My Dear Neighbor, edition 404 is a survival horror game that tells the story of your neighbor. Go to your neighbor's house and end up in a glitchy nightmare. Fight your way out of this glitched nightmare amid bugs and nightmarish visions in this psychological horror game.

2699570.title: Ooga
2699570.short_description: Help Ooga to retrieve his stolen food stockpile in this fast-paced, spear-based parkour platformer. Play the first world and a half in the free demo, secrets included!

2701870.title: Ark Odyssey
2701870.short_description: Ark Odyssey is a top-down arcade shooter that lets you command an army of starships to fight against the force of void! Gather your fleet into formations, and build your team of evolving synergistic compositions. Order your army of Starforce through space and protect the cosmos!

2702430.title: Usual June
2702430.short_description: Fight monsters, talk to ghosts, and get to the bottom of a mystery threatening to obliterate an entire city in Usual June, a third-person action-adventure game about combat, cupcakes, and community.

2702850.title: Greed Realm: Hero from Another World & the Soul Tree
2702850.short_description: Greed Realm is a Roguelike Deckbuilder fused with Monopoly elements. As Priestess Gladis, enter the "Soul Tree" to cure your mother. Master deck building, dice manipulation, and backpack management to survive the gap between desire and nightmare.

2704780.title: Hyper Gravity
2704780.short_description: A physics-based platforming challenge where you harness gravity to roll, bounce, and dribble a gravity ball through 40 handcrafted challenges. Master your momentum, find your flow, and get the ball in the goal!

2704840.title: Poetry in Purgatory
2704840.short_description: After dying under mysterious circumstances, Isobel awakens in the afterlife... with a dangerous mission. Explore a strange world of mystery, character and heart as you uncover Purgatory's secrets in Poetry in Purgatory, the first part of The Dead Poetry Trilogy of visual novels.

2707440.title: Floralis
2707440.short_description: You are born from a tree in a post-human world ruled by sentient plants. Hide from predators, reawaken machines, and outwit living traps as you search for your twin and the truth of your birth in this cinematic puzzle adventure.

2707850.title: Heptic Arena
2707850.short_description: Squad up, hunt monsters, and crush the competition! Chase fame and fortune in Heptic Arena - the galaxy’s deadliest game show where infamy is power and ratings are king. Step into the spotlight and make them watch!

2708040.title: Keelblade
2708040.short_description: Sail across a fantasy world in your own pirate ship. Master souls-like combat and powerful magic to hunt deadly bosses. Discover new islands and loot them for hidden treasures to craft upgrades for both you and your ship. (1-6 Players)

2708860.title: Canyons
2708860.short_description: Canyons is a third-person action shooter set in a procedurally generated world. Fight mysterious Awakened alone or in co-op for up to 4 players, command giant Crawlers, build your haven, and survive a brutal living world.

2708920.title: Haunted House
2708920.short_description: You wake up in an eerie mansion, beside the one you love. To take her home, you face six lost souls — not enemies, but tragedies to understand. Each room hides a love never spoken. But when you think you've finally escaped, some truths only appear once you walk out the door.

2710920.title: Aeterna Lucis
2710920.short_description: Aeterna Lucis is our purest metroidvania yet and the sequel to Aeterna Noctis. Become the Queen of Light, explore a vast, hand-drawn interconnected world, awaken new powers and face epic bosses to stop the Supreme God Chaos.

2710960.title: EINS
2710960.short_description: Narrative focused 3rd Person Drama-Horror experience set in the near future! As Lauren begins her new job in the global tech company, she is about to learn what hides behind the mirror.

2712390.title: One More Tower
2712390.short_description: This is a horde survival tower defense, I hope you'll like it! Expand the board, build towers, and hold out against the onslaught of enemies. How long can you survive? >:3

2712530.title: Imagisty Card Collection
2712530.short_description: You are playing a casual game “I want to spin more gachas!” “I achieved something more by collecting more things!” Have you ever wondered...? Imagisty Card Collection is a simple game that focuses on collecting cards by opening packs of cards like a trading card game!

2713380.title: Shadows of Chroma Tower
2713380.short_description: Choose your faction and fight for control of the Tower! Shadows of Chroma Tower mixes together the best features of Dungeon Crawlers and ARPGs. Choose between steel, wit and magic to face hordes of enemies and huge bosses in PvE dungeons while participating in Asynchronous PvP modes.

2713680.title: REVENGE CRYSTAL
2713680.short_description: Awaken in a fallen knight’s body, kept alive by a mysterious living crystal. Explore a ruined world with top-down Soulslike combat, elemental magic, and Metroidvania progression. You are not the knight—you are the will driving him.

2714930.title: Harbor
2714930.short_description: Harbor is a first-person PvP survival game in a post-apocalyptic wasteland. Scavenge, craft and build a base you can upgrade and defend. Team up, raid other players and chase down the War Truck and Blackrail train. Harbor is the only safe zone. Die out there and you can lose everything you carry.

2716830.title: Don't Fret
2716830.short_description: A sentient guitar trapped inside a nightmare music school. Hide, distract, and survive horrifying creatures as you tune your way through musical puzzles and fractured memories to uncover the truth.

2718260.title: Dawn of Demons
2718260.short_description: Become a medieval monk and confront the demon that has haunted the Boar Lake village.

2719670.title: The Milgram Experiment
2719670.short_description: A single-player moral dilemma simulator where you are judge, jury, and executioner. Investigate subjects through their personal items such as phones, diaries, and voice logs and uncover their darkest secrets. Judge if they fit a mysterious figure's new secret society. Terminate the unworthy.

2720230.title: Xplorite
2720230.short_description: Explore, fight, and uncover the secrets of planet Nargal in Xplorite, a hand-drawn action-exploration Metroidvania. Battle enemies, discover powerful upgrades, and explore hidden paths. The research team disappeared. Now it’s your turn to find out why.

2720780.title: Artemis VR
2720780.short_description: As an Artemis astronaut, face the challenges of space flight in the newest manned system that will take humanity back to the Moon thanks to NASA resources and consultation in terms of Artemis MIssions. Manage the mission using VR glasses.

2720820.title: Hexistence
2720820.short_description: Hexistence is a Tower Defense Roguelike Deckbuilder. Expand a procedural map, build towers, and cast spells while managing your hand in real time. Optimize your resources to survive increasingly demanding waves!

2721200.title: ジグソーローグ
2721200.short_description: A deck-building roguelite where jigsaw puzzle pieces are your weapons. Master the "placement" and "combination" of pieces with unique abilities to claim victory. The game system is simpler than it looks — easy to pick up and play.

2721470.title: Neon Extermination
2721470.short_description: In this cyberpunk FPS, players navigate a dystopian city corrupted by a malevolent computer virus. You, armed with weapons and skills, unravels the secrets behind CyberCorp's experiments.

2721990.title: Breath of the Pasture
2721990.short_description: A heartfelt life-sim about love, land, and the magic of the countryside. Compose your very own pastoral symphony— Listen to the rain as it falls. Chase the breeze on sunny days. Watch crops reach for the sky. Let your cows and sheep rest in peace. Fall in love. Grow a farm. That is THE GAME!

2722660.title: Fraudulent Idols
2722660.short_description: Investigate the sprawling pharmaceutical mega-facility, STRATA, where every choice matters. Uncover hidden secrets, forge alliances, solve complex puzzles, and fight your way through a cyberpunk conspiracy in a true immersive sim where no two playthroughs are ever the same.

2722940.title: Agecraft
2722940.short_description: Agecraft is a city-builder strategy where you guide a settlement through thousands of years of human history. Manage individual citizens, grow your economy, trade or wage war with other states, and advance from the Stone Age to the Space Age.

2724830.title: Elementum
2724830.short_description: Elementum is a spell-crafting roguelike with bullet-hell elements. Fight your way out by defeating a wide range of enemies and discover a variety of spells and items to customize your build and play style!

2730940.title: MyRummy® 2
2730940.short_description: The legendary tile-laying classic – combine cleverly, make smart moves, and add a little luck to be the first to play all your tiles.

2731030.title: Dungeon Automata
2731030.short_description: Dungeon Automata「Algolemeth」is an "autologic": a JRPG dungeon crawler meets auto battler where you control your party with visual node-based programming. Program your party and conquer dungeons automatically. Master the dungeon through trial and error!

2732360.title: Consult Me Before Opening A Snack Shop
2732360.short_description: What, you want to open a snack shop? Better call me!

2732480.title: Emery Hearts
2732480.short_description: Step into the shoes of Lug, an ordinary boy with the power to shape the fate of humans and machines in a world on the brink. A retro-inspired action JRPG where you explore a vibrant voxel world, battle deadly mechanoids, solve puzzles, and uncover a story of legacy, mystery, and heart.

2733890.title: Bloody Shrine
2733890.short_description: Bloody Shrine is a twin-stick horde survivor roguelike where you build a growing Shrine on the battlefield, forge dark pacts and shape every run through cards, tokens, and blood.

2734480.title: Trade Tales
2734480.short_description: Trade Tales is a cozy rags-to-riches life sim about building your dream business in a living fantasy town. Start with nothing as you forage, farm, craft, trade, and run your own shops, deciding what to sell while forming friendships, finding love, and helping your town flourish with your choices.

2736380.title: OMAPELI
2736380.short_description: OMAPELI is an action RPG setting in a medieval fantasy world. Explore different biomes and enter underworld dungeons. Meet friendly NPCs, hear their quests and trade. Fully customize your character. Craft your weapons - swords, bows and magic.

2736590.title: Hexplorando
2736590.short_description: Take a trip around the world in this cozy hex-tile puzzle game. Rebuild iconic locations from New York to Sydney, unlock and collect landmarks with real photos and stories, and build landscapes of your own. 🗽🗿⛩️🕌

2737490.title: Infinite Void
2737490.short_description: Embark on an endless cosmic odyssey in Infinite Void! Master retro-inspired space shoot 'em up gameplay with procedurally generated universes, dynamic upgrades, & simple controls. Every run offers a unique challenge. Will you conquer the "Infinite Void" or succumb to its celestial challenges?

2738140.title: Horn of Balance
2738140.short_description: Explore an intricate new world of secrets and adventure. Features solid 2D Zelda-like gameplay, 12 vast non-linear dungeons and a wholesome story about the young golem Linden.

2738170.title: Edge of Memories
2738170.short_description: The population of Avaris is ravaged by the Corrosion, a terrible affliction that mutates all it infects into grotesque abominations. Play as Eline, a young nomad, and lead fierce battles alongside your allies to save the world from extinction.

2738960.title: Soaked
2738960.short_description: Soaked is a multiplayer platforming sandbox. Push, grab, throw, dive, crawl, climb, spin, and dig into a variety of game modes!

2742920.title: Silent Planet - Elegy of a Dying World
2742920.short_description: Silent Planet is an exploration-focused, gothic sci-fi metroidvania rooted in Cosmic Horror. Explore the claustrophobic corridors of a massive underground complex filled with the remnants of technological and biological horrors created by a dead civilization.

2744110.title: VTumbler
2744110.short_description: Dive into the vibrant world of VTubers in an unparalleled free-to-play arcade puzzle fighting spectacle in VTumbler!

2748420.title: Ascent: Rivals
2748420.short_description: Ascent Rivals is an Award-Winning Indie Combat Racer. Race. Shoot. Upgrade. Outplay Your Rivals.

2751070.title: Paleokin
2751070.short_description: Paleokin is a brutal prehistoric survival game set in an infinite procedural world. Fight mammoths and dinosaurs, build a settlement, farm the land, breed your own dinos, and stay alive. Alone or with friends.

2751560.title: Decurion
2751560.short_description: Decurion is a skill-based, top-down shooter about scoring under a one-shot, one-kill rule. You get the score via combo chaining while trying to defend your base.

2755690.title: Zero Distance
2755690.short_description: Fight overwhelming zombie hordes in a 3D bullet heaven where packing your case shapes your firepower. Arrange weapons, gear and supplies to unleash fire, lightning and explosive combinations. Survive 20 minutes, defeat the boss and earn your extraction.

2755890.title: Amberia
2755890.short_description: A side-scrolling pixel MMORPG set in a miniature world lit at dusk. Become a warrior, mage or thief, level up with friends, take on bosses together, and light the amber lamps that brighten the whole land for everyone. Free to play.

2755950.title: Tidebound
2755950.short_description: Chill, catch, sell, upgrade! Tidebound is a fishing game with a relaxing, cozy atmosphere where you upgrade your boat, and sail further to fish for more expensive and exotic sea animals. Casual yet engaging, the game offers a sense of progress with tons of equipment and hundreds of species to catch.

2757950.title: Project Cradle
2757950.short_description: Save humanity in the blink of an eye! Project Cradle is a fast-paced action platformer. Pilot a nimble HelperBody drone, a robo kangaroo capable of all sorts of acrobatics! Zoom, burst, and grind through a maze of mysterious underground facilities as you search for the last remnants of humanity!

2758190.title: Our Freedom: Medieval Village
2758190.short_description: Our Freedom is A Medieval Colony Sim with Action RPG Adventures. Build a village, lead your people, produce food and materials, forge powerful weapons, recruit an army to protect your village in epic battles and castle sieges. Stand up for your people and help them defend their freedom!

2760620.title: Deathly Reprieve
2760620.short_description: Strategize, adapt, and shoot your way through enemy lines. In this ruthless, story-driven tactical shooter, precision is the difference between life and death. Lead a mercenary organization through a blood-soaked, near-futuristic world, as you uncover a global conspiracy. Do you have what it takes?

2760720.title: Bestiario
2760720.short_description: Bestiario is an exciting turn-based combat JRPG based on Spanish mythology and folklore, full of surprises. Should we call it an ÑRPG?

2761020.title: A Little Less Desperation
2761020.short_description: When a peaceful farmer is abducted by an alien, he cannot imagine how this experience will turn him into a hero that needs to save the galaxy. Suddenly, alien abduction is funny again.

2761360.title: Hi Sudoku
2761360.short_description: Sudoku should be pure logic—never guessing. Solve 10,000+ fair puzzles across five difficulties. Stuck? Step-by-step hints show the next move and why it works, so you can spot it yourself next time. Play comfortably with mouse, keyboard, or controller in calm themes.

2761860.title: GameChanger - Episode 1
2761860.short_description: Take on the challenge to close the Great Five Portals in this varied 2D-Action-Adventure with Twin-Stick-Shooter Gameplay! Explore the vast Interworld, solve tricky puzzles in complex dungeons, shoot your way through hordes of mysterious entities and stop the dragon!

2763250.title: Unconventional Fantasy
2763250.short_description: I have blended card game and action game genres to create this unique deck-building game. Craft your one-of-a-kind deck, encounter quirky NPCs, discover powerful cards, make choices at every turn, uncover the secrets of this world bit by bit, and embark on an adventure in this otherworld!

2763310.title: Untethered
2763310.short_description: Untethered is a space survival-sandbox set in our own cosmic backyard. Explore zero-gravity environments, build and operate realistic space stations, and fight to stay alive in the unforgiving realm of deep space.

2763980.title: MEMORYLEAK™
2763980.short_description: Immerse yourself in MEMORYLEAK, a unique FPS that blends 2D, 3D, and VR gameplay. Set in 2000s Texas with a gripping narrative, it offers stunning Unreal Engine 5 visuals and a dynamic, interactive world. Ready for an adventure that redefines gaming?

2764530.title: Purble Place 3D
2764530.short_description: This is Purble Place 3D! - three exciting adventures in an updated classic! Create and win, just like in the good old days!

2764550.title: Bagsy
2764550.short_description: Dive into the colorful and captivating world of Bagsy, an infiltration game where cunning and strategy are your best weapons! Take on the role of a daring thief whose goal is to steal carefully guarded treasures from a variety of shops and banks.

2765870.title: My Paper Plane Is Better
