2987920.short_description: FPV Military Kamikaze Drone Simulator is an advanced and realistic sim with physics-based flight, analog video, kamikaze strikes, grenade drops, heavy bombers, night vision and thermal. Fly with keyboard, gamepad or your own EdgeTX/OpenTX radio: RadioMaster, Jumper, BetaFPV and more.

2988120.title: Never Be Alone
2988120.short_description: Never Be Alone is an open-world zombie survival game for solo play and seamless co-op. Explore a world reclaimed by nature, protect a fragile safezone, and uncover the truth behind your forgotten past 10 years after the outbreak.

2989080.title: The Lonely Tree
2989080.short_description: A serene, narrative-driven experience where you document important life events as diary entries, watching your personal tree grow and connect with others' stories. Explore the evolving environment and form connections with anonymous players based on shared experiences.

2991680.title: 十元怎么买下世界
2991680.short_description: 一款笑点密集的沙雕休闲游戏，主要玩法是经营+放置+AVG+收集，风格轻松愉快，有大量有趣的剧情和插图。沙雕画风加上脑洞大开的爽文剧情，玩法简单易懂，经营你的商业帝国，探寻世界未解之谜，名利双收，走上人生巅峰。

2991870.title: Arenion
2991870.short_description: An anime-style 3D Metroidvania adventure with fast-paced combat, varied weapon abilities, puzzle-solving, free exploration, and a mysterious journey filled with unexpected turns.

2992610.title: RHYTHMETRIC
2992610.short_description: A pseudo-rhythm top-down shooter game, where your actions will loop to fight geometric foes!

2993210.title: SkyLeague
2993210.short_description: Master an acrobatic Skycar in competitive car-soccer. Build speed, control the air, outplay rivals with advanced mechanics, and shape a machine that is unmistakably yours.

2994190.title: Money Simulator
2994190.short_description: Hustle to the top through jobs, deliveries, street races, gambling, and risky crypto plays. Buy, upgrade, and flip cars and motorcycles for profit. Build your empire by launching businesses, managing operations, and hiring staff. Take bold risks, make big moves, and rise!

2994630.title: Children's Garden
2994630.short_description: Welcome to the Reincarnation Ethics Program "Children's Garden." This is a puzzle game where you seek eternal rest.

2996420.title: ADAPTERS: Tower of Primus
2996420.short_description: A playful & cute handcrafted pixel art Roguelite / Hack & Slash Action RPG! Play as an "Adapter" with extraordinary growth potential—take on quests to save a small village raided by bandits, and reach the top of the mysterious tower! Supports up to 4-player local & Remote Play Together co-op!

2996550.title: Auto-Astra
2996550.short_description: Auto-Astra is a voxel-based automation game set in a space sandbox. You design and build ships block by block and then use scripting to control them. Your logic, your empire.

2996650.title: True Vikings
2996650.short_description: Choose your own path: become a powerful jarl or a legendary king, or perhaps switch sides and follow the path of a knight, reliving the story of the Duke of Normandy.

2997870.title: The Standard Model
2997870.short_description: The Standard Model is a narrative walking simulator/slice-of-life game set in different worlds throughout the multiverse. The player takes on the role of an undergraduate student that gets to explore and experience 5 different worlds on a quantum adventure.

2997970.title: Underground: World War
2997970.short_description: A brand new game inspired by the Def Jam series. Create your own fighter or play as some of your favorite rappers in this over the top fighting game.

2998700.title: Playable Alpha
2998700.short_description: As researcher with great ambitions, and lack of talent, you are sent to a newly discovered planet far away from civilization. In this VR first person survival, you will need to build an outpost and survive the hostile environment. While exploring the planet, unveiling its secrets.

2999570.title: Magengaard
2999570.short_description: Magengaard is a 3D PvP arena game where spells are cast by drawing glyphs. Explore the fantasy world of the Academy, meet its inhabitants, uncover its mysteries, and master your skills in the arena.

2999670.title: Front Edge
2999670.short_description: The «Front edge» is a real-time multiplayer tactical game dedicated to a clash between the modern armies of the world’s leading countries. Great attention is paid to logistics and control of small groups of troops on various maps.

3000510.title: Noblemen: 1941
3000510.short_description: Noblemen: 1941 is a third-person shooter mixed with real time strategic elements. Set in a gritty, alternate reality World War 2, you will deploy units, build fortifications, capture and defend key locations, use powerful abilities, and manage resources across a vast multi-faction campaign.

3000980.title: Echoes From Below
3000980.short_description: Echoes From Below is a mystery dungeon tactical RPG. Lead four hunters into the dungeons, where every fortune you bring home comes at a price. Fight side by side as bonds grow into love, rivalry or grief that changes how they fight, and the dead never return. How many will you bring home?

3001110.title: Olaf and the Crowning Hangover
3001110.short_description: Olaf wakes up with a legendary hangover and a missing royal crown. Retrace your drunken rampage across the kingdom to save your head! In this comedic puzzle adventure, fixing the mess creates the maze: every object you repair becomes an obstacle blocking your path.

3001460.title: 九州之士
3001460.short_description: 战国时代背景，剧情向 RPG 为主，融合大战略玩法。战国时代九州大地列国纷争，百姓流离，原本一介庶民的你，陷入了一场巨大的阴谋中，被亲情、友情与仇恨交织裹挟，踏上了拯救自己与万民苍生的旅途。

3001790.title: Nuclear Sub: Prologue
3001790.short_description: The Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version of the game. A realistic nuclear submarine simulator will allow you to take command of your crew and battle your fiercest enemies. Arm yourself with missiles, dive into the ocean and fight for your country

3002010.title: Split Decision
3002010.short_description: In a dying town where boxing is the last stand of entertainment, you hold the judge’s pen. Bribes, threats, and loyalties will decide whether you live to judge another day… Or get knocked out cold. Split Decision is a tense narrative game where every point makes a difference.

3002520.title: Gummy Nightmares
3002520.short_description: Step into the enigmatic world of Gummy Nightmares as a little boy who wakes up in a mysterious amusement park with no memory. Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover lost memories while evading sinister plushie robots. Use weapons, set traps, and find hideouts to survive and reveal the truth.

3002550.title: Shadow Sacrament: The Roots of Evil
3002550.short_description: Shadow Sacrament is a grim horrorvania where you play as a tormented detective who must investigate the secrets of an ancient, horrific monastery. Explore hidden chambers, solve intricate puzzles, and face terrifying nightmares that lurk in its shadowy halls. Hunt the Haunt.

3002580.title: SkullStars: Supernova
3002580.short_description: SkullStars: Supernova looms over us in the funk of outer space! A 2D anime fighting game with stylish 3D models. Fight your way to become a SkullStar with an electrifying soundtrack. The five points of the universe will reconnect!

3002610.title: Pebbles Quest
3002610.short_description: The Princess has been kidnapped by evildoers! It is now Pebbles Quest to breach the Castle, face a gauntlet of traps and trials, all to rescue his one true love.

3002820.title: ForgeCraft
3002820.short_description: Explore, craft, fight and develop an automated technological civilization complete with airships and robotic drones!

3003760.title: Come to my party!
3003760.short_description: Jimin dreams of finally having her first birthday party, but what begins as a childhood wish unravels into social pressure, fragile friendships, family expectations, and consequences that hit closer than you’d like. Join Jimin in this coming-of-age story where every choice carries weight.

3004170.title: Palettopia
3004170.short_description: Paint beautiful island cities with a brushstroke in this cozy puzzle game. Explore endless islands and solve puzzles while balancing the serene landscapes and your growing urban districts. Discover vibrant biomes and their adorable inhabitants as you paint your own perfect utopia in Palettopia.

3004280.title: World of Magic: Rise of Magic
3004280.short_description: An open-world Medieval Punk Action RPG. Combine and modify spells in real time while enemies adapt to your combat tactics. Choices shape a living fantasy world filled with cities, monsters, and escalating conflict.

3004410.title: Love in Space
3004410.short_description: A Sci-Fi Karaoke-Musical where your choices shape the story and your decisions become the lyrics. Escape Earth, make questionable friends, find unexpected love, and sing your way to a better future. And don't worry about hitting the right notes, you've got bigger things to worry about.

3004810.title: OPERATIVES: Revolve
3004810.short_description: Every card is both cover and weapon. In your hand, they block bullets, blades and death itself. It’s a visually intense deckbuilder built on strategic play. Your cards are destructible, their position, sequence and play matter more than just the cards you pick during a run.

3005440.title: FESTERED
3005440.short_description: Brave the terrors of a contaminated research facility, where every step could be your last. PSX style survival horror game.

3005720.title: Ink Escape: Coven Conundrum
3005720.short_description: Ink Escape: Coven Conundrum is a puzzle-based escape room. Solve puzzles and discover the stories of your ancestors in the books you have inherited.

3006440.title: Aeronesia
3006440.short_description: Aeronesia is a non-linear platform RPG with emphasis on exploration, combat, dialogue and quest-based progression. After an accident transports you and hundreds of other people into an alien world, it's up to you to find a way to survive and discover some means of getting back home.

3009440.title: Dungeon Baller
3009440.short_description: Pinball meets RPG in this fast-paced roguelike. Launch tiny heroes, battle bumper enemies, and choose your fate through mystery doors. Wield hundreds of powerful items and defeat bosses to reclaim your soul in this retro-inspired reimagining of pinball.

3010150.title: BLOODY HELL 2
3010150.short_description: Pulverize demons as a small angelic birb wielding a giant demonic hammer. Explore hell's deepest layers, and uncover the truth behind the fall of heaven in this bullet-hell metroidvania. Will you succeed, or die in the chaotic depths of BLOODY HELL 2?

3010490.title: Evoplasm
3010490.short_description: Evolve and fight in this creature building Roguelike. Grow a creature by attaching new cells, add mutations to create powerful synergies, fight real-time tactical battles against weird enemies, and strategically choose a path across multiple campaign acts. Inspired by games like Spore and FTL.

3010870.title: Match Tree
3010870.short_description: Match Tree is a breathtaking puzzle experience (...it's actually a match 3 game). Embark on an epic journey with pixie, gnome and witch full of adventure, mystery (huh?) and sheep. Become the master of combination and create magnificent mansions from trees, flowers and carrots (I swear, it's fun!).

3012070.title: Eldorion: Guardians of the Crystals
3012070.short_description: A pixel art exploration game where you must face various challenges and collect crystals to save Earth from its impending doom. An RPG with multiple continents that have emerged, ushering in a new era of mysticism.

3012410.title: Everise
3012410.short_description: Reach the top of the Tower before raiders destroy your town. Scavenge the furniture and loot monsters to collect resources along the way, then empty your inventory down balconies to upgrade and defend your town!

3013600.title: Age of Transport - Blue Marble
3013600.short_description: Classification yards, waybills and live dispatch — on a 1:4-scale Earth. Build a multi-modal freight empire across rail, sea and air through twelve eras of transport history, in a persistent world shared by up to 255 companies.

3014660.title: NO FURTHER ACTIONS
3014660.short_description: You have been assigned as an operator, reading protocols that force you to make decisions using buttons and switches. Every decision shapes your fate — and decides whether you’ve done what was expected of you.

3015820.title: To Kill a God
3015820.short_description: Craft your skill tree in this action roguelike where you must utilize skill and creativity to unleash devastating builds, all for one purpose. Break the Cycle. Kill a god.

3016940.title: Garden of Ants
3016940.short_description: Become the architect of a thriving ant colony in this real-time simulation. Establish and evolve your ant colony, grow specialized worker castes, cultivate fungus, and explore a living world above and below ground where day and night bring shifting challenges and resources.

3017820.title: Dangerous Connections
3017820.short_description: 1987. The Soviet Union is cracking from within. As special agent Dan Morris, navigate a world of shifting loyalties, covert operations, and ideological fractures in this story-driven Cold War FPS.

3018390.title: PSYCHO DEAD
3018390.short_description: A third-person survival horror game that you play as a girl with psychic power who tries to escape from a secret lab and is pursued by deadly stalkers.

3018460.title: Fatal Dopamine/ 致命多巴胺
3018460.short_description: Play as a nameless gambler who arrives at a mysterious gambling table, constantly challenging different opponents. At this table, the stakes are not money but life itself.

3018500.title: Broken Shell
3018500.short_description: Broken Shell is a short, hand-drawn puzzle adventure about two hermit crabs searching for a place to call home. Explore a vibrant underwater world, solve gentle puzzles, and experience a heartfelt story told entirely without words.

3018900.title: MiniTank: Desert Strike
3018900.short_description: This is a twin-stick shooter in the style of The Binding of Isaac. A MiniTank, was sent on a mission to destroy an Enemy Base producing zombies was found in the Desert and Arctic.

3018990.title: Eversiege
3018990.short_description: Eversiege is a roguelike, tower defense in which you'll defend a castle in procedurally generated terrain. Establish a production, build defending buildings and survive waves of enemies coming from everywhere! After defeat, buy new buildings, unlock new leaders and prepare to fight again.

3019020.title: Unseen Beings
3019020.short_description: Unseen Beings is a short survival horror game where you avoid or confront invisible entities while exploring, solving puzzles, and overcoming horrors to pay off your debt. Use special goggles, a taser gun, and your wits to survive the night.

3021410.title: Mouse Holme
3021410.short_description: Your precious mouse home has been destroyed! 🐭 Start from scratch, build a thriving nest... and defeat the villainous cats! 🐈

3021550.title: Flock Off!
3021550.short_description: Flock Off! is a first-person action-adventure game for 1–4 players. Team up with friends to survive a strange and woolly uprising in the remote Scottish Highlands. Improvise with oddball weapons to fend off mutant sheep and uncover unexpected twists. Will you survive the Sheepocalypse?

3021700.title: Astrostrike
3021700.short_description: You are the captain of the Galactic battleship, building hundreds of gun turrets, raising dozens of space fighters, establishing aircraft carrier groups, space stations, and conquering the entire Milky Way

3022470.title: Rotten Sails
3022470.short_description: A co-op horror about looting cursed islands for a cartel that won't go ashore itself. 1–4 players, in-game proximity chat, no weapons.

3022910.title: Fortune and Glory
3022910.short_description: Fortune & Glory is a text-parser action RPG about leaving home to become a hero! Decide who you are as you explore an ailing world in a detailed retro-inspired style. Gain help from your personalities and their internal dialogue to solve puzzles and fight monsters in a realtime battle system.

3024700.title: Sweet Order: Candy Shop Tidy Up!
3024700.short_description: A magical candy shop is a sticky mess! Play as an adorable marshmallow in this cozy first-person cleaning and organizing sim. Vacuum up gummies, scrape away syrup, and sort colorful candies to perfection. No timers, no stress, just pure satisfaction!

3024730.title: Department of Gravity Management
3024730.short_description: Starting a new job is tough. But when your boss is a clueless AI, things get weird. Navigate your way through a seemingly abandoned space station in this gravity-defying FPS Metroidvania. Solve physics-based puzzles, interact with tools in your environment, and find out what happened.

3025870.title: Ecliptic
3025870.short_description: Ecliptic is a 3D Puzzle Adventure Game set in the Stars! Inspired by the mythological figures of the horoscope, embark on the hero's journey with the mysterious protagonist on a journey of identity and discovery.

3026330.title: Path For The Seeker
3026330.short_description: Path For The Seeker is a detective adventure in which a young nun investigates the disappearance of a famous inventor in a city on the border of two worlds.

3029250.title: Hyper Hadron Racing
3029250.short_description: Hyper Hadron Racing is a futuristic racing game set in space. Choose your spacecraft and battle your way to first place across a multitude of tracks and environments rich with power-ups, features and hazards! Or create your own unique tracks to share and compete online.

3030570.title: Silks & Glory
3030570.short_description: Build your racing legacy in a premium horse racing game with a full single-player career, direct jockey gameplay, deep stable management, worldwide competition, online leagues, 2–4 player split-screen, and LAN multiplayer.

3031750.title: Dino Cleanup
3031750.short_description: Clean giant dinosaurs and save cute prehistoric friends in a world flooded with goop! Unlock vacuum overdrive abilities for new ways to play and collect tons of hats in this nostalgic 3D platformer.

3032140.title: Shine On, My Little Sun
3032140.short_description: When the Sun fell, darkness covered the world. In the snowy wasteland, the town of Svargo thrived under its faint light. But the Sun did not go out. The small Sun sleeps atop a grim lighthouse. What happens when the Sun awakens, seeking a few days of simple childhood?

3032210.title: Detective NEKKO - ディテクティブネッコ -
3032210.short_description: Mystery adventure where no one dies. Use your “ability to see too much” to uncover an inconvenient truth.

3032360.title: THE MOST GIGACHAD SURVIVORS
3032360.short_description: Dive into a giga-action roguelike about GigaChad who have spent his entire lives in the gym and are stepping outside for the first time! Explore the unfamiliar world, fight the city's inhabitants, and complete wild quests. Help the GigaChad discover this complex world and understand himself!

3032540.title: Triad
3032540.short_description: Embark on an epic journey across the realm of Lyria in this real time fantasy RPG paying homage to classic games. Assemble your Triad from 15 unique classes, engage in strategic tab-targeting combat, and uncover ancient secrets in a world of danger and mystery.

3033420.title: Nuclear Apocalypse Merchant Simulator
3033420.short_description: A post-apocalyptic single-player simulator where you sell resources to survivors to withstand internal and external threats. Work with scavengers to gather supplies, keep your shelter secure, and uncover the secrets of the bunker.

3034170.title: Daimyo Reign
3034170.short_description: Unify Medieval Japan in this real-time tactical grand strategy game. Build your domain, recruit armies, plan your attack, and fracture your enemies with rebellions to win!

3034290.title: Loot Goblin Inc.
3034290.short_description: Break into homes, steal valuables, and sell them online to make big cash money! Join the corporate goblin world in this very cool Loot Goblin Simulation!

3034810.title: STRIKER!
3034810.short_description: STRIKER! is a retro-inspired football-golf game set across 40+ levels. Control your team of Strikers and shoot your ball over a wide range of different courses and mechanics.

3035270.title: Backrooms
3035270.short_description: Explore an abandoned liminal space. Uncover dark secrets through eerie exploration and environmental storytelling. Evade unpredictable supernatural entities and face psychological horror. Will you reveal the truth or become another lost soul?

3035870.title: Dream Runner
3035870.short_description: Soma is just a kid who doesn't want to grow up. Test your limits in this fast and whimsical platformer where new challenges wait around every corner! Master powerful abilities, solve puzzles, and catch butterflies, all while unearthing a dark conspiracy hidden just beneath the surface.

3038620.title: Starbump
3038620.short_description: Starbump combines fast-paced action, Third Person platforming and competitive modes in vibrants worlds. It’s designed for party nights where you and your friends battle it out for hours, packed into colorful arenas and quick-fire game modes. It's a pure cozy brawl !

3039130.title: Rogue Wheels
3039130.short_description: Rogue Wheels is a turn based roguelike deckbuilder where your car is your character and timing driven combat defines every run. Build fun and crazy decks!

3039370.title: You Died!
3039370.short_description: How will you cope with the loss of yourself? Each episode of You Died! will give you an opportunity to experience a stage of grief for yourself. Make choices, deal with the consequences, and interact with your environment to express the emotions of the main character.

3040850.title: Light Up the Dark
3040850.short_description: Light Up the Dark is a colony survival sim set in a dark world filled with unseen horrors. Collect, build, automate, research techs, and explore the procedural map. Manage three classes of colonists; keep them sane, or make use of their insanity. Solve endless interesting problems, your way.

3040930.title: Just A Shadow Game
3040930.short_description: Hear me, pitiful mortals, for I shall reveal to you the path to true power - a demonic fusion of deckbuilding, ritual duels, and roguelite! I speak of a realm shrouded in darkness, where only the most wicked may thrive. Behold my masterpiece, "Just A Shadow Game" .

3040940.title: Order of Renewal
3040940.short_description: Order of Renewal is a multiplayer fantasy indie RPG game with co-op and PvP. Detailed combat system with realistic swordsmanship, physical interaction, unusual, and fresh mechanics will require tactics and skill in every battle.

3041800.title: Scramble Heart City
3041800.short_description: Scramble Heart City is a 3v3 tag-team fighter that's easy to pick up and play. It's time to beat up your friends and find new ones! Battle anywhere with local and online multiplayer and browser cross-play.

3042160.title: Raven Gold
3042160.short_description: Raven Gold is a classic-style RPG featuring a handcrafted world. Explore unique dungeons, defeat powerful enemies, and conquer challenging puzzles to find rewarding treasure! Manage your resources carefully, especially your money, to achieve long term success as a fledgling adventurers guild.

3042270.title: Alex's Sketchbook World
3042270.short_description: The RPG where you fight enemies by drawing and coloring them.

3043280.title: Legend of the Corndog(s)
3043280.short_description: Finding yourself out of food, you decide to venture into the outdoors for the first time in an embarrassingly long time in order to satiate your growing hunger.

3044060.title: Race to Ruler
3044060.short_description: Race to Ruler is a deck-building roguelike where your cards are your army as you embark on a journey to defeat the ruler of an empire. Draft and train new units, summon epic beings, defeat your rivals, and claim the crown.

3044450.title: 地球勇者 Earth Fighter
3044450.short_description: “Knights of Earth Realm” is a 2D platform shooter action light rogue game. Synthesize various homemade or advanced weapon equipment, lead your pet, and fight against human looters, out-of-control mech, evil insectoids, and other threats on the post-disaster wasteland.

3044580.title: Magtong
3044580.short_description: Airhockey meets magnets! Magtong is a fast-paced, physics-driven sports game where magnetic mayhem rules the rink. Play solo or in teams, locally or online, and outmaneuver your opponents with skill and polarity!

3045070.title: MetalMercs
3045070.short_description: Destroy. Salvage. Upgrade. PROFIT! Command your own mercenary company in real-time-with-pause tactical mech combat. Hire pilots, customize your mechs, and take contracts across a war-torn universe filled with riches, glory, and bitter defeat.

3045110.title: Boss Slayers
3045110.short_description: No game to play with a friend? Now you're a team of boss hunters. Challenge the most dangerous monsters! Dodge rains of projectiles, seize the right moment to attack and discover the weaknesses of cunning bosses.

3045220.title: Mutant Hunter
3045220.short_description: As the numbers of combat ready soldiers in the ranks of the remaining army continue to dwindle, High command devised a plan to use convicts as manpower via mind control. Now your task is to hunt mutants around the sector using this experimental technology.

3045340.title: SHATTERFARMS
3045340.short_description: Farm. Forage. Fight. SHATTERFARMS is a first-person farmcore roguelike where you'll scavenge and fight through the Calamity, while cultivating a mysterious farm to survive and grow stronger. Creatures are untamed, magic unstable, and horrors unimaginable. Welcome to SHATTERFARMS.

3045390.title: Newma Holiday
3045390.short_description: On a rare holiday, Newty's plans were disrupted by an urgent deadline. His computer was infected with a virus, and his desktop pet Ema, now self-aware, asked for help to fix it. Newty and Ema teamed up to solve puzzles and remove the virus.

3045520.title: Sea Sniffers
3045520.short_description: Dive! Punch! Catch! Sea Sniffers is a unique take on collecting fish where you play as a seal that throws a mean punch! Upgrade your gear, ship and companions to become the best Sea Sniffer!

3045640.title: Water Walls
3045640.short_description: Enlist the help of UFOs to collect and evaporate water! Use the falling blocks to contain the water for collection by building Water Walls. Can you create a solution to bring you to the top of the leader boards in this easy-to-play hard-to-master block stacking game?

3046610.title: L8R SK8R
3046610.short_description: L8R SK8R is a 3D platformer inspired by the classics of the fifth generation but with a unique twist that will make you feel like a speedrunner.

3046820.title: Tailgate
3046820.short_description: Hyde, an aging labrador retriever, wakes up and realizes that Derek, his beloved Human has disappeared. The doggo reluctantly leaves the house to investigate, only to find himself in the middle of an ancient dog prophecy.

3047000.title: FFS: Football Freekick Simulator
3047000.short_description: This is a simple free-kick game in which you kick the ball by literally choosing the contact point, power, and direction between the foot and the ball. There are no hidden stats that magically assist the trajectory for you, so it's actually your skill that matters!

3047910.title: Toilet Zone 2
3047910.short_description: Toilet Zone 2 is a 2.5D momentum based platformer, starring a duck (in a toilet). Use water-powered flight to navigate past obstacles, and master the controls.

3048330.title: Mirage Noir
3048330.short_description: Mirage Noir is a detective romance visual novel where every lead could bring you closer to love—or straight into a killer’s hands.

3049240.title: Spaceborn Awakening
3049240.short_description: Start as a mortal. End as a god. Carve through corrupted hordes, evolve your arsenal and unlock cosmic powers that clear the screen with a wave of your hand. A narrative-driven bullet-heaven roguelite.

3050090.title: Thalassomania
3050090.short_description: A PS1-style co-op horror game for 1–4 players. Set at sea, you run a fishing trawler with your crew. Haul, gut, steer and repair while something lurks in the shadows. Keep the ship alive. Get home. You're not alone out there.

3052540.title: Chemist Wanted
3052540.short_description: Run a cosy chemistry lab on a sleepy space station. Identify mystery samples with real flame tests and fizzing acids, grow glowing crystals on your windowsill at night, and find out why the last chemist vanished. No timers, no fail states: just you, A.L.F.E. and a shelf of dusty jars.

3053470.title: MR. RECORDS
3053470.short_description: ​Meet George, an old dreamer with an extraordinary gift that lets him transcend through music. After a lifetime of standing still, he breaks free from routine and opens the store he always wished for. ​

3053490.title: Bomber Hero
3053490.short_description: BomberHero is a thrilling multiplayer game inspired by Bomberman. Up to 4 players can join online battles or play against bots. Customize your hero, collect power-ups, and dominate diverse arenas. Are you ready for explosive fun? Join the action on Steam!

3053530.title: Coming Home, Little Oak
3053530.short_description: As a little oak, your life was turned upside down when you were kidnapped from your village and family by giant robots. Survive, overcome the challenges, and find your way back home!

3054910.title: Day Trader Tycoon
3054910.short_description: Play as a day trader gambling on people's pension money and try to beat the stock market. Engage in a comedic story with multiple endings. Meet different characters and get insider info to use for your own advantage. Gamble on cryptocurrency and quickly react to market events.

3055110.title: Light Dude
3055110.short_description: The level hides when you move in this skill-based action game. Scan the level, then step into the dark. Dodge deadly threats, outmaneuver enemies, and defeat brutal bosses to reclaim the stolen sun. No map. No safety. Just your skill. Demo Out Now!

3055150.title: R.E.A.P.E.R. Corp.
3055150.short_description: EARTH is mutated and destroyed. You are a R.E.A.P.E.R, one of the lucky humans tasked with preparing earth for the return of humanity! Collect valuable loot and S.C.I.E.N.C.E! Travel from the REAPER space station to the infested, ancient ruins of EARTH with your fellow REAPERS.

3056570.title: Deck of Memories
3056570.short_description: Deck of Memories is a nostalgic deckbuilding adventure about the stories your grandfather left behind. Explore fragments of his life as a lighthouse keeper, manifested inside atmospheric dioramas. Craft and combine cards to restore these memories and discover the secrets they hold.

3057720.title: Adventure Paws
3057720.short_description: Adventure Paws is a pixel-style 2D side-scrolling adventure game where you and your friend will play as two cats, embarking on an exciting journey across a mysterious and unknown continent. Join the black and white cats and set off on this journey full of challenges and surprises!

3058660.title: HARK THE GHOUL
3058660.short_description: Emerge from a cocoon under the light of an ominous star. Just who were you before your rebirth? HARK THE GHOUL is a first-person dungeon crawler based on freeform exploration and discovery, set in an amber-crazed city full of secrets, shortcuts, and adversaries.

3058740.title: Odds Chronicles
3058740.short_description: Defy impossible odds in a tactical roguelite RPG where every dice roll shapes your fate. Master grid-based battles, forge powerful builds, and uncover a world inspired by tabletop adventures.

3058960.title: Manipulus - A Deck Building Odyssey
3058960.short_description: Manipulus is a thrilling deck-building, choose-your-own-adventure game with rogue-like mechanics and perma-death. Trapped by mysterious forces, you are made to relive your past, guiding a band of survivors through perilous times. It's time to FORM THE MANIPULUS!

3060390.title: Aetherian Chronicles
3060390.short_description: Aetherian Chronicles is a 3D Casual SideScroller MMORPG focused on interaction with AI controlled players. Explore, train, party up, make friends and trade with real people or AI controlled players! Customize your character to your hearts content and choose your own way to experience your adventure!

3061140.title: Nephelia: Through the Clouds
3061140.short_description: Take control of your own airship, hire people for your crew, help them on their personal stories, follow the trail of a whimsical inventor of the colonisation era, trade, fight, discover, and try to stay afloat.

3061930.title: CLUTCH
3061930.short_description: CLUTCH is a cinematic open-world action-driving game where the worlds of professional and underground street racing collide across the French Riviera.

3062560.title: A Forest Tale: Porasy
3062560.short_description: Embark on a journey through a new mythological realm as Porasy, an Indigenous warrior. Explore uncharted landscapes, unleash the power of Muiraquitãs, unravel your story, and vanquish the Seven Legendary Beasts to carve your own legend. Are you ready to dive into this epic adventure?

3062700.title: Rebel Roar
3062700.short_description: Build two decks at once in REBEL ROAR, a tactical deckbuilding roguelike where each rebel unlocks a different way to play. Combine an animal deck with a class deck to create Ninja Cats, Hacker Opossums, and hundreds of unique builds as you lead the rebellion through a cyberpunk animal world.

3063680.title: Battle of Arachnidia
3063680.short_description: Battle of Arachnidia is a fast-paced top-down shooter in which you fight back against hordes of arachnid robots. Protect your base by destroying all enemies by coming up with different tactics, improving your robot and using different help bonuses.

3064880.title: Codebreakers VR
3064880.short_description: Codebreakers is a chaotic VR Action Shooter that takes place in a dystopian future where various organizations are fighting for control of the world order.As a breaker, you will have to infiltrate, defeat enemies and avoid security systems to extract data.

3065070.title: Touhou Rumble Banquet
3065070.short_description: Touhou Rumble Banquet is an unofficial Touhou Project platform fighter for up to 4 players. Choose from 11 fighters from the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil, play locally or against CPUs, or go one-on-one online with rollback netcode.

3065710.title: Lucky Coin Pusher
3065710.short_description: Lucky Coin Pusher is a coin pusher simulator focused on deck-building. Combine characters, coins (or bowling balls), stickers, items and other elements to build unique synergies and hit the jackpot.

3068090.title: Wänder OutWorld - Mount Hollow
3068090.short_description: ~"By the whims of Yargha. Her soul, etched in Chaos." Survive and explore absurd scenarios. Switch realities. Hunt powerful monsters for loot. Encounter horrors beyond your comprehension. An open world game filled with challenges to overcome, bosses, enemy encounters, puzzles and mysteries to solve.

3071390.title: Bladesmith Shop Simulator
3071390.short_description: Rule the anvil! Harness magic-infused ores brimming with otherworldly effects to forge legendary weapons. Stock a thriving smithy, scour wild lands for epic loot, and outsmith fierce rivals in grand tournaments to crown yourself the continent's ultimate bladesmith tycoon!

3071860.title: WARAG
3071860.short_description: A modernized old-school boomer shooter with progression, upgrades and a gory combat system. Fight in a dark Byzantine-Gothic setting, gain experience, power up your weapons, build your playstyle and become a true Varangian berserker.

3074390.title: Built By Force
3074390.short_description: Merge Titanfall-style gunplay with Satisfactory base-building and Minecraft exploration in a living, randomized world. Transform at will, master a single-resource economy, and join with up to 11 friends to face adaptive AI enemies.

3076200.title: Ashwood Conspiracy
3076200.short_description: Ashwood Conspiracy is a dark Slavic mystery adventure. Follow in your late uncle's footsteps to uncover the truth behind the town’s most devastating event. Find, collect, and combine items to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles. Will you dare to finish what your uncle started?

3078140.title: Five Laps at Freddy's
3078140.short_description: Welcome to Five Laps at Freddy's, The premier animatronic kart racing circuit featuring your favorite and lovable Fazbear friends! Sponsored by Fazbear Entertainment

3078760.title: LIVING HELL
3078760.short_description: A co-op horror where you must escape a city in ruins, as solar radiation twists animals and humans into terrifying mutations. From the creator of DEVOUR.

3078800.title: MMORPG Merchant Simulator
3078800.short_description: Travel back to 2008—the year where it all began—with nothing but a dismantling machine. Break down crystals, brew potions, run your stall, hunt bargains, stockpile goods, and trade the markets. Climb from your parents' basement all the way to a villa and a sports car.

3079190.title: PACS - Post Apocalypse Courier Service
3079190.short_description: 1-4 players in the postiepocalypse! Drive across treacherous environments, customize your delivery vehicles, and secure 5 star reviews for corporate by supplying the apocalyptic miracle of a package delivered on time.

3079730.title: Cartomancy
3079730.short_description: Turn-based RPG style experience with emphasis on RNG and hints of team building strategy. Uncover a metaphysical mystery from an unlikely inheritance. Cipher the code and face the powers that may be. This isn't just a game, It's an initiation.

3080370.title: DOCTRINEERS
3080370.short_description: DOCTRINEERS is a turn-based strategy game where no two games are ever alike. Strategize and plan with your unique doctrinal units and adapt to new battlefields in a single-player campaign and online multiplayer.

3081510.title: Gang of Frogs
3081510.short_description: Sail through the galaxy as a fearless outlaw frog. Plunder loot, upgrade weapons, eat flies and fight through hordes of monstrous bugs in an intense 1-4 player co-op shooter.

3082440.title: KACHIN!
3082440.short_description: Din Dino, the mob's top ex-hitman, runs away from their past to pursue their true passion: selling custom t-shirts. Design T-shirts, get to know your clients and confront your past!

3082530.title: Lux Leonarii - A Mechanical Puzzle Adventure
3082530.short_description: Lux Leonarii is a Puzzle game revolving around guiding beams of light throughout an ancient structure using a multitude of mirrors and devices, ranging from simple A to B connection to multiple colours and complex interactions.

3082730.title: HYPERyuki: Snowboard Syndicate
3082730.short_description: Race, trick, and explore across vibrant slopes with a cast of unique riders. Master speed, style, and control in this fast-paced arcade snowboarder. Prove it where it counts, split-screen with friends or head-to-head online multiplayer. Shred the mountain. Rip the competition.

3082910.title: Classified Chaos
3082910.short_description: Classified Chaos is a multiplayer horror, action title, where you fight through creatures of various sizes, and danger. Use whatever equipment you can to fight, defend, run, or die for your team so someone gets out alive.

3083980.title: 夜空色的魔法少女 - Nightsky Blue Magical Girl
3083980.short_description: You will play Wong YukChan, a high school student in Shenzhen. While enjoying campus life, you should investigate the monsters and seal them. In addition, you will act together with the cute girl Pak HoLing to defeat the monster, and develop a romantic relationship with her during this process.

3084190.title: Golfadillo
3084190.short_description: Hurl yourself across vast landscapes filled with coins and obstacles in this action incremental game! Upgrade your skills and unlock abilities so you can travel even further and reach blazing speeds!

3084630.title: Program Penguin
3084630.short_description: Program Penguin is a humorous, tightly paced action-adventure game with an unforgettable cast. Think classic Zelda meets Club Penguin all rolled up in a classic retro style.

3084700.title: Whispers Of The Shadow
3084700.short_description: After a report comes in about Detective Grace Lawson’s missing stepsister, Amy, two officers head to an abandoned house. When Grace arrives, she finds one of them dead and suddenly becomes trapped inside. But something else is waiting for her.

3084890.title: Rebel Sector
3084890.short_description: RebelSector is a horizontally scrolling shoot-em-up inspired by HudsonSoft Caravan shooters.

3085710.title: Trifoil
3085710.short_description: A puzzle game about drawing lines that cross, merge, and interact in unique ways. Uncover secrets, decipher symbols, and trace paths that satisfy every rule.

3086590.title: Gods, Death & Reapers
3086590.short_description: An innovative ExtrAction RPG set in an afterlife where mythology is real and the gods are dead. Fight through PvPvE, PvE, or as a party to claim valuable loot and bring balance to the shattered realms.

3087040.title: Roleplay Passion
3087040.short_description: Step into a universe where every word matters and every choice opens unexpected paths. This is not your typical dating sim: here, the characters don’t follow fixed scripts they listen, react, and evolve with you.

3087670.title: Questing
3087670.short_description: A satirical love-letter to classic 16-bit adventure games, about a chosen hero who never wanted to be chosen.

3088760.title: Fay Keeper
3088760.short_description: Battle, catch, and morph hundreds of Fays in this new turn-based creature collector RPG! Traverse the vast realm of The Faylands, filled with bustling cities, challenging dungeons and arenas, hidden routes and unpredictable weather. Ascend ranks to become the ultimate Fay Keeper!

3090010.title: Retro Game Store Simulator
3090010.short_description: Run your own Video Game Store in 1984. Everyday until the end of 1989 gives you the opportunity to stock shelves, cycle your inventory, manage your prices, and analyze historical trends to make your game store profitable. Use era-relevant technology and systems to prove that gaming is not dead!

3091040.title: Haul Yeah!
3091040.short_description: Load it, strap it, drive it. A colourful delivery-driving sandbox for one or two players. Stack real physics cargo, tighten the straps and haul it across a mountain county in split-screen co-op or solo. Build your business with better trucks, custom parts and bigger jobs.

3091110.title: Burnout Inferno Office Girl
3091110.short_description: Tokyo, 1992. Office worker Satomi endures one absurd day after another. When she hits her breaking point, she can download alternate versions of herself from other worlds. Borrow their unique personalities and abilities to fight back against work, relationships, and life's everyday nonsense.

3092220.title: COLIVING
3092220.short_description: COLIVING is an interactive narrative adventure where you play as a hard-boiled detective and a relentless journalist on two distinct paths. As their cases converge on a shared apartment, your choices shape a complex, branching story. Trust no one—the real danger lives right behind the wall.
developers: Taiwan Computer Graphics Manufacturing Co., Ltd.
publishers: Taiwan Computer Graphics Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

3092530.title: Fate Trigger
3092530.short_description: Fate Trigger is a 3D Anime-style, hero-based tactical shooter powered by UE5, available across multiple platforms. Dive into a dynamic world of floating islands, become a sharpshooter with extraordinary special skills, and engage in thrilling, spectacular life-or-death showdowns!

3094750.title: The Nightmare Chronicles - Devil's Drive
3094750.short_description: When Jason’s dad leaves him home alone to go on a business trip, sinister things start happening in the usually quiet ‘Devil’s Drive’. Can you survive playing as young Jason while uncovering the secrets of Devil’s Drive?

3094870.title: Amarillo's Desktop Pets
3094870.short_description: A physics-powered 3D desktop companion engine where crazy ragdoll physics meet living, reactive characters. Import VRM characters, or create your own, and let them live on your desktop.

3095020.title: Madness Afloat
3095020.short_description: Pilot customizable steamships through a Lovecraftian Polynesian archipelago. Explore and survive handcrafted missions, manage cursed cargo, and balance sanity against power. Face the deep alone or in optional co-op expeditions.

3095070.title: The Dark Aegis
3095070.short_description: The Dark Aegis blends visceral third-person combat with deep base building. Build up your fortress between missions, then defend it from relentless alien hordes solo or with up to 4 players.

3096150.title: High Rollers: Dice Drop Duel
3096150.short_description: Challenge your friends to high stakes arcade puzzle action in High Rollers: Dice Drop Duel! There's something for all types of players with a variety of solo, multiplayer and online modes.

3096320.title: Death and Tactics
3096320.short_description: A post-apocalyptic turn-based strategy game where death is permanent and every decision counts. Experience unique events based on how you play, sell the organs of party members you don't like, transform your enemies into monsters, and much, much more!

3096450.title: Decaying Salvage
3096450.short_description: A modern sci-fi survival horror built for people who miss fixed cameras, puzzles, scarce ammunition and being afraid to open the next door.

3096690.title: SAIGAI
3096690.short_description: You wake from cryosleep aboard a drifting deep-space freighter. The crew is gone. The ship is dark. Something is moving through the corridors with you. Search the vessel, uncover what happened to the crew, and learn what this ship was never meant to carry before it finds you.

3096870.title: Mechs and Muskets
3096870.short_description: Mechs and Muskets is a 2D isometric tactical RPG set in an alternate Napoleonic era where mechs rule the battlefield. Customize your squad with unique mech parts and abilities, and lead them through turn-based strategic combat in a story-driven campaign

3096940.title: Club Defenders
3096940.short_description: Club Defenders is a co-op action tower defense game where music becomes humanity’s ultimate weapon. Build towers, control enemy paths and stop alien invasions inside vibrant nightclubs with weapons and instruments. Master four powerful music genres that shape every strategy and combat ability.

3097220.title: Gray Planet
3097220.short_description: Explore a open world set in a post-apocalyptic background, gather resources to craft various equipment and build your base. Defeat different types of monsters while investigating what happened on this planet.

3097640.title: 玫昙 She From TheFuture
3097640.short_description: Mei can see hidden memories. Two years ago, Her lovers Tan died in a fire, ruled suicide. She became a detective. Then she discovered she can travel through time. She must return to the night Tan died—can she change it or just watch it burn again?

3097730.title: Re:VER PROJECT -TOKYO-
3097730.short_description: "Re:VER PROJECT TOKYO" co-developed by Toei Animation and indie developer Nestopi, is a survival suspense adventure game set in modern Tokyo depicted in pixel art. Yukinori Amane whos falsely accused of a crime, uses his survival skills to evade the police and uncover the real culprit.

3098360.title: Shaft 29
3098360.short_description: You are alone in Shaft 29...Descend into old, pitch-black, and hazardous labyrinth to restore the failing power grid. Scavenge the dark for scrap, repair components in safe room, and brave anomalies hiding in the depths. Keep the lights on, and keep moving down...

3098910.title: Japanese Salaryman
3098910.short_description: A 1990s office-noir RPG. By day, survive office politics at METTA and protect your relationships. By night, hack into company servers in grid-based hacking puzzles, spy on people for upgrades, and sell stolen secrets to escape crushing debt.

3099830.title: Darkest Darkness
3099830.short_description: Darkest Darkness is a roguelike deck-building game with extraction elements. Choose your identity and venture into a Lovecraftian town. Craft every card yourself—collect materials, build powerful cards, plan your route, or extract with your gathered materials to gain an edge in your next run.

3100680.title: Untold Tales: A Scarlet Way
3100680.short_description: Meet Devil May Cry about Little Red Riding Hood. A Scarlet Way is an isometric hack-and-slash where Scarlet wields her beloved scythe to tear through enemies in a dark Victorian fantasy world — all to the sound of heavy metal and dubstep.

3100820.title: Draft Fever Bowl
3100820.short_description: Draft Fever Bowl is a competitive multiplayer football management game focused on scouting and the draft. Study prospects, outsmart rivals on draft day, and trade with real teams. With no visible attributes, success depends entirely on your eye for talent. Enter the war room.

3101840.title: Weiß Schwarz Online
3101840.short_description: Battle with cards from your favorite titles! Weiss Schwarz, the world’s No. 1 card game by number of participating titles, is now a video game! With a full tutorial and online battles, players of all skill levels, from beginners to experts, can enjoy the game.

3102450.title: Gravepact
3102450.short_description: Gravepact is a survival roguelite where the goal is to destroy as many incoming enemies as possible, while collecting experience to spend on attacks, passive items and skills to build your character into a powerful conduit of destruction that lays waste to everything in your way.

3103560.title: SideEye High
3103560.short_description: A grounded detective mystery set in the most dangerous place in America: a 1997 public high school.

3104660.title: Metro Station Designer
3104660.short_description: Think you could design a metro station that actually flows? Build multi-level concourses, platforms, ticket gates, and escalators in this crowd simulation game. Send over ten thousand rush-hour commuters through, scrub the replay, and refine your layout until the whole station runs smoothly.

3104900.title: Tungsten Moon
3104900.short_description: First-person 3D spaceflight sim on a tungsten moon. Master accurate rocket physics in a vast, open world that shows no mercy, while a shadowy figure tries to help you survive. Or do they want you dead?

3105040.title: Seasons Turning
3105040.short_description: A farming sim focused on exploration instead of repetition, where you must discover every seed you plant, solve puzzles, explore dungeons, and appease the mafia cat army. No stamina bar. No combat. Save whenever and play at your own speed.

3105190.title: CHILDREN OF SATURN
3105190.short_description: A found footage coming-of-age story about a group of teenagers growing up under an orange sky.

3105600.title: Eco: Planet Reboot
3105600.short_description: Imagine taking down a megacorporation with just a vacuum. Join Eco, a robot with one mission: save the world from the greedy billionaire Smogborne. Vacuum up your enemies, absorb and expel elements throughout the world to solve puzzles, and heal the corrupted biomes.

3105650.title: Chaotic Conundrum
3105650.short_description: Hit the ground running in a frantic and fast adventure through a broken world made of lost fragments of time and space. Featuring a 90s-graffiti artstyle and a headbanging dynamic soundtrack.

3106270.title: HELLCARD II
3106270.short_description: Hellcard II is a unique co-op deck-builder roguelike game. Descend into the paper dungeons on your own or invite friends to fast-paced tactical card battles against hordes of evil and dragons. Lots of dragons!

3108030.title: Man in the Mocha
3108030.short_description: An active incremental game where you own a coffee shop, but your hidden agenda is to hack the customers who connect to your WiFi. Buy upgrades and grow your business!

3108560.title: Mystery House
3108560.short_description: A first and third-person horror revival of Roberta Williams' Mystery House - the 1980 classic that invented the graphic adventure. A game night in an abandoned Victorian House turns deadly. Solve its puzzles, uncover a buried legacy, and escape before the house kills you.

3108570.title: ENTWINE
3108570.short_description: A first-person psychological horror videogame. In St. Agnes’ Forest, Man bears a mark he cannot wash away. Walk the opened body of photoreal 1990s Americana as Lucas, an ex-police officer; search the estate, defenseless, in an ever-changing nightmare. “At the end of my life, I find the devil.”

3108650.title: Extinction Force
3108650.short_description: Battle across time to save humanity from giant arachnids in this multiplayer third-person action shooter.

3110610.title: Deeplands
3110610.short_description: Explore the Deeplands, an ancient underground world harboring the remnants of a lost civilization. Fight and parkour your way through destructible caves and dungeons, acquire mysterious powers and tools to grow stronger and recover the ancient dwarven crown in this open-cave roguelike platformer!

3113400.title: Cosminomy
3113400.short_description: The colorful universe of Cosminomy offers unique colony building challenges on nice little planets. Form thriving settlements, develop them step by step, turn a profit, and expand your colony across the cosmos.

3113670.title: The Barkeeper
3113670.short_description: Swap the espresso machine for a cocktail shaker! Mix, shake and serve drinks against the clock, master new recipes in bars across the city and keep your customers happy - solo or with a friend in 2-player co-op. One wrong ingredient and it's straight in the trash!

3114100.title: Cardinal Descent
3114100.short_description: Cardinal Descent is a card building roguelike where you craft elemental synergies and find game breaking sticker combos.

3114420.title: UNCRACKED
3114420.short_description: Crack your enemies with an arsenal of weapons and various tactics in this 2D egg-splosive, gore-filled, yet kid-friendly action platformer, teeming with splattering yolk and shattering eggshels and survive the fierce cage wars.

3115330.title: SHAROTANK - ROAD TO KYSHTYM
3115330.short_description: Drive a spherical tank across the dried remains of the Aral Sea. Scavenge resources, haul heavy cargo with a magnetic trailer, upgrade modules and survive encounters with mutated machinery.

3115480.title: Diviner
3115480.short_description: Explore isometric dungeons and derelict castles, defeat dark foes in first person turn based combat, customize your build and create gear arrangements with a slot based inventory. You have been tasked by the Diviner to rebuild a dead lord’s body by obtaining their organs scattered across the lands.

3115870.title: TrophyRC
3115870.short_description: A scale off-road trial experience. Customize your crawler and conquer challenging obstacle courses. Remember, it's not about speed, but accuracy and precision!

3119170.title: Peddlers Between Pulsars
3119170.short_description: Peddlers between Pulsars is a story focused shop sim with light logistics. Play as one of five peddlers as they try to fulfill odd tasks from a frustrated researcher.

3119690.title: Sa[meow]rai: Silverwing Stray
3119690.short_description: "Sa[meow]rai" is a top down action role-playing game centered around one-hit kills and rich interactivity.You play as a law-enforcer with an implant called "Gyakugawa Emergency Reboot Device," fighting for every second of your remaining time in a morally ambiguous cyberpunk city.

3119710.title: Impious
3119710.short_description: Impious is a dark turn-based RPG set in a world where human imperfection is no longer tolerated, those deemed impious are captured and dragged underground. You wake inside a system designed to break you and your only way is forward:fight, negotiate, gear up and find your way out.

3119830.title: Chaos Bringer
3119830.short_description: Outsmart foes in fast-paced tactical dungeons, then become a raid leader who stops time to command your party. Explore, craft, and conquer giant bosses single-handedly for the ultimate MMORPG-level satisfaction.

3119860.title: FATAL HEELZ
3119860.short_description: Third-person, cyberpunk-vampire brutal action game. Play as Silo, a female vampire-assassin. Kill your target and uncover the secrets behind the organization you work for.

3119990.title: Eclipsi
3119990.short_description: Embark on an epic 3D space shooter adventure featuring dynamic space combat and thrilling planetary exploration. Battle in single or multiplayer modes from 1v1 to 5v5, strategizing to achieve victory through base destruction, resource collection, or base capture. Dominate with our ranking system!

3120770.title: SketchBrawl
3120770.short_description: Sketchbrawl is an auto-battler: draft squads from six factions, deploy them on the grid, and watch hundreds of units clash on their own. Promote squads to ★★★, let your commander’s skill turn the tide, and survive ten rounds to clear the Arena.

3121420.title: Monolith: Dark Matter
3121420.short_description: A round-based co-op FPS for 1–4 players set inside the Monolith — a brutalist complex shaped by living dark matter. Fight escalating waves of its zombie marionettes, earn points to unlock new sectors and build your arsenal, and find out how long your squad can last.

3122600.title: Glintseeker Island
3122600.short_description: Descend into mysterious caves with countless treasures to excavate in a mining exploration adventure. Upgrade your gear, fight bosses, uncover secrets and save the island from an ancient threat below!

3122680.title: Night of the Living Toys
3122680.short_description: A cozy co-op toy sorting game. Play with three friends or solo. Two modes to choose from: dig through a huge pile of toys or open boxes and complete sets. Fill every shelf before the store opens and keep its secret!

3123130.title: Moon Princess
3123130.short_description: 🌙A daughter-raising game in a world of wuxia and mythology — raise her as a martial arts master in a rich wuxia world. Train, fight, manage, and shape her future! With 50+ branching endings and 60+ story characters, forge your one-of-a-kind heroine and change the fate of the Jianghu!

3123420.title: 领航员计划 Navigator Project
3123420.short_description: A twin-stick bullet hell roguelite with anime-style Navigators to meet and evolve. Dodge barrages, combine weapons and upgrades, chart branching routes, and take on massive bosses. Unlock new Navigator forms and discover their stories.

3123670.title: COMING HOME
3123670.short_description: A retro slasher horror game, with a focus on home defense. In the dead of night, you hear someone lurking outside - but you are not defenseless. Watch the cameras, barricade your doors, and have your gun at the ready - anything to keep the Sundown Rippers from claiming their next victim.

3126410.title: Expedition: Into Darkness
3126410.short_description: Brave forbidden dungeons in a quest for knowledge and treasure in this medieval PvE co-op extraction looter. Craft weapons, customise gear and join forces with up to four allies. Survive the ruins together—or lose everything you carry.

3127520.title: Untitled Project
3127520.short_description: Unravel the secrets of a sprawling metropolis in this gripping third-person adventure. Explore a vast cityscape, engage with intriguing characters, and unravel mysteries and crimes. But beware—the shadows hold danger, and thugs lurk around every corner.

3129330.title: Blood Dice
3129330.short_description: Roll or hold dice to get patterns and reach blood quotas. Modify dice, buy items and sign some suspicious pacts to escape. Craft your build, and test it against the odds or lose it all.

3129970.title: Fio and the Doomed City
3129970.short_description: A “city-building” x “tower defense” SLG by a young girl, Fio. Fio and her guardians, the Flora Bears, are building a city in the last city of humanity. Increase facilities, residents, and resources, and prepare for battle. Withstand enemy attacks and defeat the boss with your big beam cannon!

3130220.title: Sagas of Lumin
3130220.short_description: Sagas of Lumin is a single-player, semi-open-world action RPG. Master dragon riding as you soar across the skies, engage in thrilling aerial battles, and explore a vast world. Seamlessly switch to ground combat with swords, spells, and firearms. Find your path in this fallen realm.

3130880.title: Solaria
3130880.short_description: Collect various androids known as "Pvas" on the futuristic colony planet named "Solaria", deploy them for battles, construction, farming, crafting; pilot your own mobile base to explore the vast world. This is a brand-new, single player open-world survival and crafting game.

3131340.title: Lelu
3131340.short_description: Get your gears in motion for a captivating monochromatic adventure where you play as Lelu, a small but determined clockwork toy who has gained consciousness and found a taste for freedom!

3132910.title: FreeCat
3132910.short_description: ［Features］Girl + 10 cats with unique skills. ［Action］Blocking, aerial combos,bosses trained with real kung fu fighter. ［Puzzle］Chinese puzzles. ［Art］Maps: Sky, Underground, Ocean, Jungle, Snow. ［Metroidvania］64+ achievements/quests. ［Fun］Funny enemies. ［Story］Plot twists

3133250.title: Desk Fantasy
3133250.short_description: Desk Fantasy is an anime idle companion that lives in a transparent window on your desktop. While you work, Noa auto-battles mischievous yokai on a tropical island. Grow her on a 75-node Evolution Grid, roll dice in a 10-chapter visual novel and find one of 4 endings.

3133600.title: Worlds Explorers
3133600.short_description: Explore alien planets with carefully designed ecosystems, weather, resources, dangers and unique phenomena. Hunt animals for food and collect resources to craft equipment and repair devices on your ship. Escape each unique planet and unlock crew members and new ships.

3135380.title: Verse Project
3135380.short_description: In this multiplayer game you have to explore the Solar System in real scale. Control spaceships of the near future, explore planets, moons and asteroids, mine resources, fight for space domination and build the future of the universe.

3136000.title: They Are Rising
3136000.short_description: They Are Rising is an RTS strategy game set against the backdrop of the apocalypse. Combine skills, build a massive army, establish shelters, and fight against large numbers of enemies. How long can you survive?

3136340.title: Echoes Below
3136340.short_description: Echoes Below is a tactical first-person shooter set in an unforgiving open-world survival environment. Build and fortify your base, craft essential gear, and recruit companions to fight alongside you. Explore a hostile archipelago, hunt for resources and engage in intense firefights.

3137010.title: Meat Engine
3137010.short_description: Meat Engine is a Sci-Fi boomer shooter inspired by Scorn, Quake, Dusk and Doom. The game is set in a dark and distant future stricken with war and death. Featuring fast and brutal retro combat.

3137770.title: Gatto's Pizzeria
3137770.short_description: Run a cozy first-person pizzeria as an adorable cat! Prepare authentic Neapolitan pizzas step by step, serve hungry human customers, and upgrade your restaurant with new recipes, ovens, and decorations while relaxing in a hand-drawn 3D kitchen.

3138010.title: Realms at War
3138010.short_description: A chess-inspired fantasy tactics game where every move matters. Command armies, outthink your opponent, and experience the depth of wargaming with the clarity of chess.

3140190.title: God, Save the Queens!
3140190.short_description: You are God. The king’s five daughters have been taken. Fight thousands of enemies, unlock powerful skills, and defeat the evil wizard Zaharad in this brutal 2.5D roguelike!

3140580.title: Escape From Streamer House
3140580.short_description: Trapped inside a dangerous streamer's house, you must find his computer, delete a compromising private video, and escape before he catches you. Hide, solve puzzles, explore dark rooms, and survive a terrifying game of cat and mouse.

3140710.title: Trellis
3140710.short_description: TRELLIS is a puzzle/adventure game featuring Fig, a robot caretaker tending to its plant. Shine the Spotlight to guide Fig and solve dozens of unique puzzles, uncovering the mysteries of an ancient alien temple long forgotten… but not abandoned.

3142470.title: Shellbound
3142470.short_description: Shellbound is a 2D metroidvania set on a gigantic snail. You’re a parasite exploring a living world, battling and controlling enemies that will cause the ecosystem to evolve around you. Platform through diverse biomes, solve puzzles, and unravel your role in the giant creature’s life cycle.

3142910.title: Financial Freedom
3142910.short_description: Why can't games teach as much as books? I read 50 business books and trainings and made a short funny game about a businessman's journey. Follow the story from a factory worker 🧑🏻‍🏭🏭 to a millionaire! 💸💸

3143510.title: Pixel Frenzy
3143510.short_description: Pixel Frenzy is a fast-paced first-person shooter game where you create your own combat style in fully destructible environments. Defeat the pixel monsters invading the real world. Grab your weapon and save the world by destroying everything in your path!

3144810.title: Forbidden brew
3144810.short_description: Run a tavern in a dystopian city where magic is illegal. Serve ordinary customers by day, sell forbidden potions in secret, identify informants, hide the evidence and survive government raids.

3150160.title: Another Pint
3150160.short_description: Build and run your own medieval tavern in Another Pint, a systems-driven management game. Starting with little more than an abandoned shack, it is up to you to turn it into a thriving establishment. Grow your tavern, discover ingredients, and brew special drinks to keep your patrons coming back.

3150450.title: Dragon Spirits 0
3150450.short_description: A skeleton from my childhood, the original edition of Dragon Spirits, which I developed in middle school, is a creature collector RPG that serves as the origin of the Dragon Spirits series. I still keep it as a memento. (Almost) no one can make a good game from the very beginning.

3150710.title: PhantomZone labyrinthos ファントムゾーン・ラビュリントス
3150710.short_description: “There’s no escaping a nightmare that never ends.” When the protagonist wakes up, a young girl stands before him. She introduces herself as “Entropy (entourfe), the Management Support Android.” Spreading out before the protagonist is a confined underground facility.

3151570.title: Thor's Wrath
3151570.short_description: Embody a formidable and somewhat brute warrior, face hordes of enemies alone while protecting the city's treasures. Your goal is to climb the ranks of the best warriors ! The real challenge lies in your ability to wield yourhammer and cast spells with precision.

3151840.title: Umblight
3151840.short_description: Descend through the corrupted underworld in Umblight, a gearpunk roguelike deckbuilder about merging your cards together. Build a deck of shadow and light cards strong enough to survive, but is it enough to reach the bottom of the world?

3152060.title: Croak Crusader: the Champion of Canada
3152060.short_description: Do you dare save the Land of the Maple Leaf? Croak Crusader is a fast-paced, momentum-based action platformer featuring tight controls, explosive combat, and a versatile grapple mechanic.

3152110.title: Founders
3152110.short_description: Founders is a city-building survival game for 1-10 players, where medieval robots with evolving memories and unique personalities create a truly living world. Build and defend your city against relentless threats while shaping your character’s skills.

3152740.title: HeHe Remake
3152740.short_description: When the crimson moon rose, the HeHe were forced to abandon the surface and descend into the depths. Now, hunted by ReRe’s spawn, survival is no longer about mining — it’s about defying extinction.

3152830.title: Love's Time Cycle
3152830.short_description: A grand sci-fi romance healing masterpiece. Overnight, the beautiful girl around you have falling in love with you. Just as you think you can sink into this sweet trap, the one you love suddenly bids you farewell. In this endless cycle, will you be able to reclaim the love you’ve lost?

3154460.title: Office Party
3154460.short_description: Office Party is a fully 3D edgy comedy adventure game inspired by classic comedies of the '90s, and also the long awaited sequel to House Party. Dive into the craziness and debauchery with all new characters, game mechanics and locations, and maybe a visit from some old party friends.

3154620.title: Baba Yaga
3154620.short_description: A turn-based roguelike game of strategic combat and sinister magic. Decimate the king’s loyalist forces, grow your powers, and discover the reimagined origin story of Baba Yaga, the most feared witch of Slavic folklore!

3155100.title: AI Peace Protocol
3155100.short_description: Pilot the anti gravity glider, explore world, transports goods, repairs infrastructure and decide the true mission of AI life on the new planet.

3156680.title: Rules: Motel Horizon
3156680.short_description: Work the night shift at a remote motel where monsters wear human faces. Check in suspicious guests, uncover hidden rules, and survive 14 nights where every decision could be your last.

3157670.title: Office Aberrations
3157670.short_description: Office Aberrations is a first-person, spot-the-difference game set in a looping hallway. Study your surroundings for changes ranging from subtle to silly. The search area grows as you progress, testing your memory and attention. Knowing whether anything has changed is your only way through.

3158390.title: Scavengers of Mars - Rover Survival Simulator
3158390.short_description: Drive a damaged rover across Mars, scavenging wrecks and mining ore to upgrade it. Every find has to fit a tight cargo grid, and every trip runs on sunlight, so a dust storm or a cold night can decide whether you push on or head back to an outpost.

3159690.title: Nut Clicker
3159690.short_description: Click a nut. Hire a squirrel. Then Bubba shows up, and nobody called Bubba. A chill, absurd idle game about a backyard that slowly stops making sense.

3161250.title: Bleeding Nightmare | 血に染まる悪夢
3161250.short_description: Descend into the fever dreams of a traumatized young man in a first-person psychological horror game about grief, trauma, and fractured memories. Confront the horrors of your past and find a way back home from Hell. KNOCK, AND THEY WILL ANSWER.

3161310.title: Hela: of Mice & Magic
3161310.short_description: See the world through the eyes of a brave little mouse in this enchanting 3D co-op adventure. Explore breathtaking landscapes inspired by Northern Sweden, solve puzzles, and be a force for good in a land where heartwarming storytelling and the beauty of nature intertwine.

3163400.title: Milkman
3163400.short_description: Explore the corrupted Kellsworth Hotel, crawling with twisted enemies. Slash your way through the nightmare, solve Puzzles, collect elevator buttons as you descend the hotel floors towards the ground floor.. Uncover the truth behind the disappearance of your husband

3163460.title: The Waiting Game
3163460.short_description: With This Game, You Can Wait!

3163760.title: Voodoo Dolls
3163760.short_description: The only way to save his beloved Jill from her death, is for Jack to shoot through hordes of Voodoo Dolls at the Witch's Halloween Party. Voodoo Dolls is an original FPS Video Game packed with fast paced action and non-linear 90s style dungeons.

3163860.title: 紅茶とともに飲みこんで
3163860.short_description: Is there something you wish to forget or remember? You are running a cafe, harboring a specific purpose within your heart. An ADV where you use tools like a pipette that extracts emotions and medicine that erases memories and feelings to select, manipulate emotions, and intervene in fate.

3164360.title: Age of Respair
3164360.short_description: Age of Respair is a medieval strategy castle-builder. Build massive castles with fortifications while managing resources and production chains. Assemble a large army and lay siege to enemy castles. Lead your people and bring respair to your kingdom🏰⚔️

3164440.title: Monstrobus Quiz
3164440.short_description: Monstrobus Quiz is an online trivia game for 2-16 players! Answer questions and use tricks or boosts on yourself or others. Create custom question packs to keep each game session unique. Gather your friends and dive into the Monstrobus Quiz fun!

3165640.title: You Can't See Ghosts!
3165640.short_description: You Can't See Ghosts is a puzzle game about spatial awareness and deductive reasoning with a charming story where you play as an invisible ghost. Bump into walls, step on glass, and other clues to locate yourself and reach the exit. Perfect for both experienced players and newcomers alike.

3165740.title: Minato
3165740.short_description: Minato combines classic minesweeper with roguelike elements. Progress through increasingly challenging stages, discover unique items, and face guardians that add unexpected twists before proceeding to the next floor.

3166900.title: Dragons Invade Scotland
3166900.short_description: Match-3 Tower Defense. Defend real Scottish castles from waves of dragons. Real Scottish stories and legends. Includes a full map of Scotland to scale where 1 tile is 19.5 meters.

3168560.title: Dragon's Brew
3168560.short_description: Run the board game cafe of your dreams! Craft food and drink, deliver orders to the townsfolk, collect board games, and customise your space, your way!

3169700.title: Factories in Factories in Factories
3169700.short_description: Build a fractal world. Automate the automation of your automation. Put Factories in Factories in Factories.

3169840.title: Wild World: Online
3169840.short_description: A multiplayer third-person werewolf action game. Be the tank who guards and soaks up the damage, pull rivals in with Gravity, or vanish and strike from the shadows. Alone or with your pack, forge your own playstyle. So, how will you hunt?

3170130.title: Red Recon: 1944
3170130.short_description: Red Recon is an isometric real-time tactics game with stealth elements, where you command a squad of Soviet scouts deployed into East Prussia in the autumn of 1944, on the eve of the Red Army’s strategic offensive. Be the first in the enemy’s lair!

3170720.title: Spot the Pet!
3170720.short_description: Find all 600 adorable pets 🐱🐶🐥🐰🐸🐷 hidden in two hand-drawn locations! Can you spot every one? 🔍

3172540.title: WATERTRIX ONLINE
3172540.short_description: A Tetris-style puzzle game where you control water to battle enemies! It's a casual game featuring cute characters and beautiful water that will soothe you. You can compete in 1v1 online matches and challenge rivals from all over the country.

3172600.title: StellarFighter: Galactica
3172600.short_description: Lead your starfighter as a bounty hunter, complete contracts and fight your way to free your home system from a criminal empire full of conspiracies and underworld secrets, in this hard boiled action old school arcade shooter.

3174440.title: Hasteventure
3174440.short_description: Become a beginner adventurer in this co-op RPG. Select and complete one of the many quests to earn promotions. Choose your playstyle to defeat enemies and help those in need. Enjoy quick gameplay sessions, either solo or with friends.

3175290.title: Craterlands
3175290.short_description: Craterlands is a 2D sandbox adventure set in a post-apocalyptic world filled with danger, mystery, and endless possibilities! Mine, build, craft, and fight your way through diverse environments as you uncover the secrets of a shattered civilization.

3175550.title: Idle Archery
3175550.short_description: Shoot targets, earn gold, hire more archers. An idle incremental game about turning one lone archer into a sky full of arrows.

3176290.title: Fishing Up
3176290.short_description: Catch 48 unique fish and complete collections in a relaxing fishing game. Explore different locations, use various baits and rods, and enjoy a peaceful angling experience.

3177730.title: Rottenroots
3177730.short_description: You play as Salem, torn between family and forbidden love, thrown into a three-day death tournament. Can you help him survive, love, rescue and betray... while figuring out who he wants to be? 25+ endings and 300+ choices await in a hauntingly beautiful dystopia.

3179960.title: Cambrox
3179960.short_description: Cambrox is an online co-op or single player creature-collection adventure with over 200 unique Cambros. Battle with your Cambros against other trainers and see what the world of Hoch has in store!

3181660.title: ASTHENIA
3181660.short_description: Separated from his partner Eve, Adam is cast into a decaying world ruled by cosmic entities. To survive, he must fight distorted foes and unravel the mysteries of a brutal war and a ravaging disease, wielding a primordial gauntlet and tainted artifacts to escape before he is consumed by Asthenia.

3181720.title: Project:Null Hypothesis
3181720.short_description: You will play as Elias found recordings, exploring the anomalous space with him. Uncover the sinister secrets of the Backrooms as you wander through endless corridors and frighteningly familiar rooms.

3182310.title: SubDuctis
3182310.short_description: Traverse a puzzling metallic landscape by folding away space itself. Bypass obstacles, form conductive paths, and discover new areas by folding, unfolding, and folding again.

3182560.title: Dorifto!
3182560.short_description: Push your car to the limit of grip and chase perfect lap times on winding back roads where drifting isn't just a technique, it's the only way to drive! Settle rivalries and prove your skill in online multiplayer and local split-screen.

3184440.title: Finares
3184440.short_description: Explore a world abandoned by humanity. Rescue lonely dogs and welcome them into your pack on a heartfelt journey of friendship, survival, and second chances.

3185170.title: A Developer Nightmare
3185170.short_description: You’re stuck in a dream and must run a special program on your computer to escape. Anomalies in the house disturb you, increasing your stress. Work with 2 or more Players to clear them before your stress consumes you.

3185520.title: Purrfect Galaxies
3185520.short_description: Purrfect Galaxies is a text-based strategy game. As the ruler of the planet Cataris, hungry cats await your decisions. Will you let your meowpurrlation bask in catnip bliss, or will they unsheathe their claws and seal your doom?

3185880.title: Wish Of Hers
3185880.short_description: Wish of Hers is a round-based 2.5D roguelike about surviving in unstable dreams. Each run is shaped by unlocked abilities, combined aspects, and your decisions. Experiment, adapt, and break your own builds!

3187080.title: Reply All
