3187080.short_description: A single player roguelite deckbuilder where emails are turn-based combat and you build a deck of devastating responses that will bring even your most passive-aggressive coworker to their knees.

3187650.title: Jigrift
3187650.short_description: You crash onto the shores of a long lost island! This strange land is a gigantic jigsaw puzzle that you must assemble to explore. Earn your place among a tribe of three-eye’d voodoo frogs and put the island back together. They’ll allow you to stay if you succeed!

3187960.title: METACRAFT: Arena
3187960.short_description: METACRAFT: Arena — an online action RPG with a wide selection of melee and ranged weapons, PvE and PvP raids, leveling and build customization, clan activities, base upgrades, crafting, player trading, and much more!

3188490.title: Epoch Reset
3188490.short_description: Unravel a narrative-driven 2.5D anime adventure as Hector, a dirt-poor genius and creator of the world’s first time machine. Travel between timelines, meet intriguing characters, and explore futuristic cityscapes as you seek to save reality from time-bending forces beyond imagination.

3188510.title: Project SEVER
3188510.short_description: Project Sever is an adventure submarine simulator with a touch of horror. Master the controls of an old Project "Sever" submarine and learn to maintain it in working order to escape a deadly underwater trap and solve the mystery of the Anomalous Zone.

3189720.title: Feral Scape
3189720.short_description: Feral Scape is a single-player open-world dark fantasy RPG set in a strange wilderness inspired by Australia. Explore as a feral animal, gather resources, craft tools, build a place in the world and form relationships with three rival factions as your choices affect the story.

3190570.title: Chante: Fortress of Spores
3190570.short_description: In this third-person, tower defense/ puzzle game, you play as the adventurous little fungus, Chante! Explore, gather, and craft to uncover resources that will fortify your defenses, while surviving waves of enemy attacks. Join us in discovering the oddities of Chante: Fortress of Spores.

3191070.title: Sova
3191070.short_description: Descend into a surreal sci-fantasy world in this narrative-driven action roguelite, where every run reshapes your story. Sova’s expressive combat meets deeply branching dialogue and world-shifting decisions. Compose your violence, rewrite your past, and bend a crumbling realm to your will.

3191150.title: 妖精牧场 - Fairy Ranch
3191150.short_description: Fairy Ranch is a fast-paced multiplayer co-op management simulation game. Players engage in a variety of production activities across diverse biomes—including grasslands, forests, deserts, mountains, and snowy plains—gathering products to complete orders.

3191490.title: ZOMBIE KEBAB VR
3191490.short_description: Cook kebabs and fight zombies in this fast action game. Explore streets, gather ingredients, and feed survivors. Unlock new tools and recipes as you survive each night. Fast, funny, and brutal. Known online as the “4 a.m. fast-food simulator”

3192150.title: Mist Of Time
3192150.short_description: Embark on a thrilling, historically accurate medieval adventure in this point-and-click MMORPG! Enjoy a simple yet addicting experience with an old-school vibe, rich content, and realistic gameplay. Dive into a unique world where casual clicking leads to endless discoveries, battles, and rewards!

3192410.title: 机影：夏夜梦寻
3192410.short_description: "A Midsummer Night's Dream with the Android Girl" — As Deputy Director of the AI Oversight Bureau, navigate the cyber metropolis alongside your robot assistant, Dill. Investigate rogue AI cases, uncover the truth behind dreams, and unlock multiple endings.

3192590.title: Labyrinth of the Crystal Princess
3192590.short_description: A horror adventure that tasks you with detecting the Unseen to escape the facility's labyrinths alive.

3193990.title: Trading Kingdom
3193990.short_description: Embark on a journey from a humble farmer to a powerful merchant in 15th century Venice. Compete against rival traders, expand your influence, and build your Trading Kingdom in a land where wealth is power.

3194590.title: Tickets, Please!
3194590.short_description: Become a train conductor and run your own train in a relaxed cozy simulation! Check tickets, keep everything clean, repair defects, and upgrade your train. Experience humorous chaos on rails in a relaxed yet hectic single-player experience.

3194740.title: FUMEHEAD
3194740.short_description: FUMEHEAD is a hero-focused turn-based RPG set in an underground world. Play as Dart and Ami as you try to eradicate the new alien disease that calls itself Slither.

3194860.title: Lost Key - The Path of Illumination
3194860.short_description: An ancient order that protects a secret, kept hidden for centuries. An unexpected crime that causes you to be accused of the murder of a friend. Solve the mysteries and puzzles of a story full of esotericism to prove the truth about your innocence and hold the real murderer responsible.

3195180.title: Remnant Afterglow Tower Defense
3195180.short_description: This is a creative and challenging real-time strategy tower defense game where players need to constantly expand, build complex battle lines on the map, and fight against groups of enemies. The game has unique rules and beautiful pixel style, with each level filled with tense and exciting battles.

3196390.title: Gorecam
3196390.short_description: GORECAM is a hardcore co-op horror survival game, designed after found-footage horror films. Play with up to 4 friends and try to escape with your life, and maybe some of your sanity.

3197180.title: Hack Fate
3197180.short_description: Hack Fate is a fast-paced hack-and-slash game with Chinese cyberpunk pixel art. Manipulate the timeline, switch identities, and kill enemies in one hit. Turn traps and foes into weapons and find multiple routes through every level. Ancient myth meets cyberpunk, each choice defying fate.

3197200.title: Emptiness Sire
3197200.short_description: Uncover a story told in fragments across 160+ challenging turn-based puzzles steeped in cosmic horror. Switch between three survivors, anticipate enemy moves and rethink your strategy with unlimited undo.

3197670.title: Arcane Mayhem
3197670.short_description: Master the arcane in this fast-paced action roguelike. Grow your spellbook, draft your loadout, and trigger chaotic elemental reactions as you blast through relentless waves of enemies.

3199080.title: HellPunk: Purgatorium
3199080.short_description: HellPunk: Purgatorium is a roguelite that combines stylish action with inventory management. Equip gears, manage your grid, and conquer the tower.

3201040.title: Anasozas: Another Surreal World
3201040.short_description: An ISEKAI, RPG, CRAFTING GAME!? You and your best friend got transported to another world!! Obtain Skills that allow you mine, fight and build. Sadism is rampant in this world where anyone can level up, how will you influence this world with your power?

3201370.title: ON ANY JOURNEY
3201370.short_description: Designed exclusively for two players, < On Any Journey > is a co-op adventure packed with varied gameplay challenges that call for teamwork, coordination and a healthy dose of sabotage. Play locally or online with a friend!

3201710.title: Overpowered Tactics
3201710.short_description: The 'Nexus' stops time, giving you the power to predict every enemy move in advance. Outsmart their attacks and optimize your actions. Each turn becomes a tactical puzzle where planning and anticipation are key, rather than reaction.

3202250.title: Bosslife Office Manager
3202250.short_description: Set up your own office. Expand your office as you wish. Transform from a small office to a large company.Don't forget to make your employees happy too.

3204000.title: Chrome Carnage
3204000.short_description: Machines took all jobs but one - urban blood sport. Chrome Carnage is a multiplayer top down shooter set in vibrant chaotic cyberpunk cities.

3204820.title: RippleLoop
3204820.short_description: Skip stones as far as you can in this relaxing incremental game. Launch, bounce across the water, upgrade, and go further with every throw. Buy new upgrades and powers to become the ultimate stone skipper.

3205260.title: Barty's Adventure
3205260.short_description: The world resets every three days, but not everything has to be forgotten. Choose what carries into the next loop as you uncover secrets in a cozy metroidvania set in a world of children's toys.

3205500.title: Digital Legacy of Zero
3205500.short_description: Battle with creatures you collect to defeat the evil Ruler of the Digital World. Hack and slash through enemy domains, upgrade your basement to achieve ultimate evolutions, and summon legendary beasts. Unlock powerful upgrades with devastating combos to conquer the Digital World.

3206220.title: BRAINSHELL
3206220.short_description: Have you ever wondered what it would be like to become an Intercontinental Ballistic Missile? A psychological horror experience focusing on immersion, storytelling and audiovisual torment.

3206730.title: Arraywrap
3206730.short_description: A strange world filled with mystery. Bend space to go through impossible passages and explore the Sky Archipelago. Discover its secrets and rules. What does it all mean?

3207310.title: Stellar Raven
3207310.short_description: On a flying laser tank, fight the armed forces of the Empire and, after overcoming several planets, meet the Empress and fight her in a mortal battle.

3209590.title: O.T.B.R.O.S.: Haze of Kazantip
3209590.short_description: O.T.B.R.O.S.: Haze of Kazantip is a shooter about the Crimean Exclusion Zone in the style of OLR, Anomaly, and Lost Alpha mods, black humor and harsh social satire. Collect anomalies in jars, treat hemorrhoids, and fight evil spirits. Absurdity, hardcore, and complete freedom in the world await you.

3209950.title: MARINES VS GOD
3209950.short_description: One of you is God. Up to four friends are Marines on a mission. Finish the objective before time runs out while your friend summons monsters, drops meteors, and ruins your plans. Can the Marines outsmart God?

3210800.title: Crow Boss
3210800.short_description: Feared for countless acts of brutality, the former warrior known only as Boss returns from the depths of Limbo. Betrayed by those he once served, he now walks among the living once more, driven by a single purpose: to take revenge on those responsible for his downfall.

3211250.title: Morphing
3211250.short_description: Morphing is a 2D adventure puzzle game where you possess the ability of morphing. This power allows you to transform and acquire the traits of certain objects or creatures. Use this unique skill to overcome challenges and explore the world.

3211560.title: Die Deep
3211560.short_description: Die Deep is an action game focused purely on the confrontation with your enemies. No exploration, no puzzles, The only core is Combat. One reckless move or greedy strike, and it’s all over. Answer the silent call of the abyss. Descend into the depths to find your forgotten desires.

3211980.title: Embers Of Spiritflame
3211980.short_description: Embers of Spiritflame is an Emotional Point & Click detective adventure about the exploration of an old abandoned house. Inside, you go through comic book-inspired levels and begin to uncover why everyone is missing. View events and memories of the place and piece the story together.

3214200.title: I will not Flee
3214200.short_description: Lead a nation across a contested galaxy. Build your fleet, develop planets and negotiate with rival powers, then land with your troops and fight as your commander. I Will Not Flee combines real-time strategy with direct ground combat in a single-player campaign.

3214740.title: Wild Island
3214740.short_description: You are stranded on a mysterious island, trying to escape. A sandbox where you stack items, craft synergies, and turn simple weapons into pure power. Experiment with runes, accessories, and pets. Discover the island’s mysteries and rebuild your sanctuary to uncover what the island truly wants.

3216150.title: Scourge of the Reptiles
3216150.short_description: Command dinosaurs. Master tactical combat. Shape your fate. Scourge of the Reptiles is a party-based tactical RPG set in a prehistoric low-fantasy world, where a devastating meteor grants magical powers to humans, elves… and dinosaurs. The result? War. Chaos. And something far worse.

3216280.title: Wretch
3216280.short_description: Find the violent stalker hiding inside an abandoned school. Piece together broken lore and solve a long lost mystery. What happened here and who's to blame?

3216570.title: Game Of The Chosen
3216570.short_description: Enter the horror escape game *Game of the Chosen*, where your decisions can mean survival or death. Navigate through rooms filled with puzzles and traps while ghosts and demons make your journey more difficult. Each game is unique, with randomly generated levels and interactive objects.

3218070.title: Project JS
3218070.short_description: You are the one chosen by Nezha. This time, you will carry out justice on behalf of Heaven. The player takes on the role of the next Jishen, successor to the novel’s protagonist Jay, becoming the chosen one of Nezha and using pog card to battle demons and spirits.

3219960.title: ICE on the EDGE
3219960.short_description: Become a coach in ICE on the EDGE, a figure skating simulation game. Train your athlete, master skills, and craft the perfect routine to win. Face fierce rivals and experience a dramatic story carved on the ice. Can your guidance lead them to the highest stage?

3220130.title: 2 FAST 4 YOU
3220130.short_description: Race through challenging levels and annihilate killer bots. Master your movement to create your own fastest paths to the finish line. Use unique abilities to speedrun your way to the top of the leaderboards. Catch and banish the evil folder - your cat’s life depends on it!

3220150.title: Dungeon Ward
3220150.short_description: Dungeon Ward revives old‑school grid‑based dungeon crawlers and focuses on fast‑paced combat with flexible character progression. Level up, master powerful skills, and defeat challenging bosses in this action‑packed RPG.

3220200.title: Rise of Lambs : Awakening
3220200.short_description: 《Rise of the Lambs: Awakening》 is a 3D Roguelike where you play as a young lamb. After a brutal coyote pack invades your peaceful sheep tribe, you must protect your home, uncover the truth, and awaken your powers to stop the war and save the world from apocalypse.

3220360.title: Flowering Void
3220360.short_description: Alone and newly awakened, uncover the secrets of this dark and unusual world by fighting and defending against the cruel environment.

3220710.title: Master Thief
3220710.short_description: Become the ultimate burglar in this witty 1-4 player co-op heist game. Craft your character, hone your skills, and pull off daring thefts as you rise from small-time crook to Master Thief!

3220770.title: Tales of Eldoria
3220770.short_description: The sun is gone. In a world trapped in eternal moonlight, guide Liora and her companions through the Arcadia dungeons in a story driven JRPG about sacrifice and the bonds formed when the world is already broken.

3220820.title: Bilingual Crosswords
3220820.short_description: Learn languages by solving crosswords. Solve crosswords → encounter new words → review with spaced repetition → repeat → learn.

3222240.title: Rogue Battalion
3222240.short_description: Command your troops in Rogue Battalion, a WW2 auto-battler blending strategy and action! Build your forces, unlock upgrades, and use powerful abilities like airstrikes and artillery to survive relentless waves. With meta progression and endless tactics, every run brings new challenges.

3223030.title: RUIN: Beast City
3223030.short_description: Assassinate your targets with style, as you uncover a plot of world domination and ancient horrors in this boss fight action game. Dive deep into the dark ruins of the Beast City, where only lunatic killers remain.

3223130.title: Duel Paean
3223130.short_description: Experience the most exhilarating third-person, free-form combat! Players can use uniquely designed characters and a combat system that is easy to learn but hard to master. This allows you to effortlessly grasp combat techniques while engaging in exciting and diverse battles with other players!

3223200.title: The Tower to God
3223200.short_description: A tower built to reach God. A wound that never healed. It is bleeding the world dry. Ascend it anyway. Defy a structure that even does not want to be reached. Hope is your only weapon.

3224270.title: Pixel Quest: Guild
3224270.short_description: Your guild fights at the bottom of your screen. Hire heroes, merge them, take on bosses, collect Arcanas, call in your Steam friends, and see how deep you get before you ascend and start over.

3224600.title: Am I Nima
3224600.short_description: Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you.

3224710.title: Blitloop
3224710.short_description: A fast-paced, side-scrolling retro shooter where you play as “Blit" on a mission to rescue orb pods. Blast enemy swarms and face off against bosses in this bullet-hell shoot 'em up. Earn power-ups and get ready for fluid arcade action in a stylish world with an 80s synthwave soundtrack.

3225640.title: Sneak Pit
3225640.short_description: Sneak Pit is the working title for an EXTREMELY alpha stealth / immersive sim experience. Use a variety of weapons and items to outsmart the enemy and access restricted areas crucial to your mission. More details and features to come.

3226070.title: Belatoris
3226070.short_description: Lead your legion in an open-world RPG with tactical combat, settlement management, and meaningful choices.

3227040.title: Dress the Duel
3227040.short_description: "Dress the Duel," is a roguelike deckbuilding game where your cards are your wardrobe and your outfit is your arsenal!Build a versatile wardrobe, disrobe strategically, layer outfits for powerful effects, and Dress the Duel!

3227960.title: Stip
3227960.short_description: Assign, undo, deduce! Solve a series of minimalist number puzzles. Use constraints to assign numbers to the correct stips. Navigate the interconnected puzzles to uncover secrets. Please ignore any odd Stip behavior.

3229420.title: Danger World
3229420.short_description: Explore an epic fantasy world alongside three heroes on a quest to recover a stolen jewel. Guide your party to victory in turn-based battles, make decisions that will determine the events of the story, and uncover the ancient secrets of Eldora as you race to catch the mechanical thief.

3230210.title: Tasty Business
3230210.short_description: In Tasty Business, turn small restaurants into a culinary empire. Manage your businesses, source fresh ingredients, and attract customers as you expand your empire. Challenges, flavors, and new connections await. Are you ready to become the culinary mogul?

3230350.title: Monsterful Tavern
3230350.short_description: Become the owner of a tavern for monsters where knights are on the menu and the menu is your deck. Monsterful Tavern combines roguelite deck-building and resource management mechanics with ridiculously dark humor. Bon appétit, kek!

3230960.title: EXODUS
3230960.short_description: Step forward into EXODUS™ — a cinematic, single-player action RPG set in a new, far-future sci-fi universe. Rise from salvager to Traveler, discover new worlds ravaged by the effects of time, and search for the key to humanity’s survival across the most dangerous reaches of space.

3233500.title: ZombMe
3233500.short_description: Old school platforming...with a twist. It's another zombie game....except this time YOU are the zombie...and instead of trying to stay alive....you're trying to stay dead! Jump, flip, throw, and avoid health powerups as you try to (not) save your neck.

3233860.title: The Witch's Fairy Tale
3233860.short_description: "The Witch's Fairy Tale" is an action rogue, role-playing game developed by "a little Han Han Duck OVO", you will play a witch, to find magic around the world, your adventure along the way will be written as a fairy tale to pass on.

3234980.title: D.A.D.S.
3234980.short_description: Use your special ops units to construct base facilities and towers to protect them from the ever-increasing threat of alien invaders in this Tower Defense game with a city-building element! Research their weaknesses and develop defenses before mankind runs out of time.

3235590.title: 大学物语
3235590.short_description: "University Story" is a college simulation game where you play as a freshman. Experience family, friendship, and love over four years in university. How will you balance studying, socializing, and daily life? What kind of person will you become ? Every choice you make shapes your future!

3235700.title: Starball Pachinko
3235700.short_description: Spend the night in a back-alley izakaya where a fox-masked owner pours the drinks and the regulars wear festival masks. Play the old pachinko machine in the corner, build your board, and win prizes that help them. A cozy pachinko roguelike.

3236560.title: Revertices
3236560.short_description: Directed by one of Cuphead's developers, Revertices is an action combat sidescroller where you will be forced to fight the corrupted remains of your friends: your duty is to reset the cycle at all costs, but in doing so you doom yourself and your companions to repeat the same horrors.

3238940.title: A Simple Life with My Unobtrusive Sister
3238940.short_description: A fully animated and voiced sister life-sim with roguelite runs. Find a cure for Mio’s illness. Share meals and quiet nights at home, then enter the Abyss each day to fight, loot, and push deeper to protect your simple life together.

3241270.title: Into the Void
3241270.short_description: Into The Void is an action packed high-speed retro shooter that follows the story of John Void, a man returned from the dead with no memories. Will you uncover the secrets of his life? Or will you simply do as you’re told?

3242050.title: Sort It Together
3242050.short_description: PLAY FOR FREE WITH FRIENDS! Clean, sort, and restore messy places together. Enjoy a relaxing tidy-up experience or turn up the chaos! Take on jobs, earn money, and build your own cleaning business. Just leave every place cleaner than you found it. How hard could that be?

3242730.title: VERISMO
3242730.short_description: A ghost and a carnival clown plot revenge on the man who ruined their lives. An operatic-tragedy visual novel set in 1920s Sicily.

3244080.title: CarveLight
3244080.short_description: CarveLight is a turn-based artillery game fought on fully destructible terrain. Take turns piloting physics-driven cars, carve the battlefield apart with lasers, grenades, and force fields, and be the last one driving. Free-for-all or in teams, against friends or CPUs, on the couch or online.

3245190.title: Arjybeasts
3245190.short_description: Arjybeasts is a Turn-based RPG where colour means everything! Draw your own PNG, battle and delete other images, open chests and make space so that HE can install things. Combine creativity with strategy and uncover a mystery by viewing the computer from different perspectives.

3245640.title: Starfinder: Afterlight
3245640.short_description: Starfinder: Afterlight is a party-based RPG that brings Paizo's beloved science-fantasy universe to life. Battle across the Pact Worlds, lead a legendary crew where your choices shape their destiny, and well, save the galaxy while you're at it!

3246120.title: No Way Home: BLAMMO!
3246120.short_description: No Way Home: BLAMMO! is a tactical arcade roguelite that's all about fast-paced twin stick space combat. Every run is a new adventure!

3246430.title: Ved : Journey Beyond the Cube
3246430.short_description: You are a cube. But you weren't always. Solve story-driven 3D puzzles, uncover the truth behind an ancient curse, and fight your way back to being human

3246880.title: City of Dolorosa
3246880.short_description: You've just died—and your trial for the ultimate sin begins. City of Dolorosa is an interactive fiction and first-person exploration game with handmade india ink graphics. Meet the Five Great Powers and uncover all the secrets that lie within Dolorosa, the cruelest city in Hell.

3248700.title: Fox Arcana
3248700.short_description: FOX ARCANA is a pixel art roguelike survivor. You play a fox against hordes of monsters, backed by the creatures you free, in a world that shifts to a new season with every boss you defeat.

3248910.title: Deserter
3248910.short_description: An immersive isometric stealth RPG about a thief surviving in a decaying totalitarian city. Plan every move, evade traps, and pull off daring heists right under the Party's nose.

3248990.title: The Detectorist Guild
3248990.short_description: A cosy village-life RPG set in Yorkshire, England, in 1999. Follow James as he explores a quintessential British village with his metal detector, uncovering lost treasures and slowly unravelling a dark mystery that draws him and his family into its depths.

3250420.title: Talewarden: Riders of the New Day
3250420.short_description: In this adventure visual novel, you travel across an alien planet stuck in an endless sunset. Shape the fates of 7 companions from different worlds. Uncover the truth about anomalous locations, hidden corridors, and a child who aged in a day. See what remains of a world abandoned by its creators.

3250960.title: 异世轮回录：If
3250960.short_description: 诸君！这个世界很无趣。生为牛马，我只是一个行走的NPC。谁不想当主角？ 在地球OL已经不可能办到了。但至少在异世轮回录中，我们可以！《异世轮回录：If》是一款多结局多周目轮回式人生模拟团队卡牌肉鸽游戏。你被女神召唤来到剑与魔法的异世界，新的人生你要选择怎么样的天赋？本以为是一次王道转生，但没想到这个世界危机重重，选错一步就只能迎接死亡。无数次轮回，你一点点探寻这个世界的隐秘，在最后的世界线，或许就是所有人都能幸福的Happy End?

3251170.title: Lirai: Heir Of Darkness
3251170.short_description: Lirai: Heir of Darkness is an upcoming third-person action game set in a post-apocalyptic world of zombies and demons, where the obsession to dominate and control the world leads to fear, violence, destruction and, worst of all, extinction.

3252930.title: TritonXR: Reality Warfare
3252930.short_description: TritonXR turns ANY space into a dynamic combat arena with your friends - duck behind your living room couch to reload, throw a grenade down your hallway or jump over your bed to avoid an attack. This is the world's most advanced XR FPS.

3254300.title: POLYSTRIKE
3254300.short_description: POLYSTRIKE is a competitive top-down tactical shooter where every angle, every utility and every decision can change the outcome of the round. Coordinate with your team, master tactical combat and outplay your opponents in intense 5v5 objective-based battles.

3254420.title: Galaxy Frame
3254420.short_description: Galaxy Frame is a space Roguelite game players control their aircraft to survive the attacks of alien insects. By understanding the characteristics of aircraft, skills, and props, players can build their own decks and challenge stronger enemies. Arcade mode to challenge the world leaderboard.

3254800.title: UnepicTale
3254800.short_description: The dragon stole the princess, and now your path leads through dark forests and eerie swamps, teeming with fairy-tale creatures. Flip the card and prove you can handle the choice in the card game UnepicTale!

3255110.title: Grave Seasons
3255110.short_description: Grave Seasons is a narrative farming sim with a terrifying twist – someone in the town is a supernatural serial killer. Farm, romance, and investigate your way through the unsettling town of Ashenridge.

3256000.title: 井底-与奇迹邂逅的井底之人
3256000.short_description: 《井底》是一款2024年3月立项的文字类galgame，题材是“超能力悬疑推理故事”，画风是日系校园风格的 故事主要讲述了游戏女主王语韴作为一个业余“侦探”，遇到各种疑难问题，并在侦探事务所所长天翔及其妹妹天音的帮助下，解决案件的故事。 游戏主要使用鼠标点击来推进剧情

3256040.title: Shardbreakers
3256040.short_description: Start with a spell. Build a storm. Combine magical shards into a spell engine that turns one hit into a barrage, then unleash it on hordes and bosses. An action roguelite where you don't find combos - you design them.

3256050.title: Far From The Darkness
3256050.short_description: A first-person multiplayer game inspired by the Werewolf concept. Depending on your role, investigate and hunt werewolves or betray your squad. Strategize, collaborate, and survive while communicating through proximity chat!

3258010.title: Tesera
3258010.short_description: Beyond the familiar lies a world of uncharted lands, strange creatures, and the remnants of a lost civilization. Explore, gather, craft, build, and fight - make this alien world your own, solo or with friends.

3259670.title: Age of Medieval
3259670.short_description: Age of Medieval is a single-player medieval real-time strategy game. Found a village with four families and a wagon, build it house by house, open roads and trade routes, then raise an army for battles and sieges. When your lord dies, his heir inherits it all.

3260830.title: A Tiny Wander
3260830.short_description: An exploration mystery adventure where the setting and narrative become the riddle. Hurry through the night, lantern in hand. And occasionally respite with a cup of coffee. Explore, discover, gather insight from interactions, delivering your parcel to the farthest reaches of the forest.

3261050.title: Hats and Guns
3261050.short_description: Become a cardslinger in this roguelike deckbuilder with tactical elements. Fight, gather weapons and items, face unexpected events and upgrade your cards for hundreds of possibilities. Every run is unique and so are you, the best shot of the Far West looking for your upcoming revenge.

3261250.title: Dodgeball Blast
3261250.short_description: Dodgeball Blast is a colorful 3D action-adventure where dodgeball is your greatest weapon! Explore a wild overworld, battle 10 massive bosses, master 9 wacky minigames, unlock new abilities, discover secrets, and play solo or with friends on your quest to become the Dodgeball Master!

3261390.title: Death Infection
3261390.short_description: In a zombie-filled post-apocalyptic MMO, each city can host up to 10,000 players online at once. Take control of your character’s body and sexual interactions. No cash shop, no premium currency—all currency and equipment are earned in the game world.

3261780.title: Artemed
3261780.short_description: In a world consumed by The Black Echo, a pandemic spread by whispers within 2 meters, play as Alex, a grieving uncle facing loss and humanity’s collapse. Explore haunting environments, manage scarce resources, and survive the chilling echoes of a shattered past.

3262820.title: Uncanny Valley: Checkpoint
3262820.short_description: Pass. Quarantine. Kill. Run a Soviet checkpoint together in co-op after a nuclear meltdown unleashes a viral mutagen. Inspect papers, spot lies, and judge twisted bodies while battling radiation, paranoia, and the deadly cost of every mistake.

3263440.title: MythoMania
3263440.short_description: You angered every god from every mythology! Stack powerful items, unlock new skills, and make tenuous alliances with gods to fight back in this platformer Roguelike inspired by Risk of Rain and Hollow Knight.

3263640.title: The Gambit Lost to Time
3263640.short_description: Become a time-travelling goddess entrusted with saving the world in this tactical RPG! With powers capable of altering time and terrain - serve one of three distinct, warring factions, and unite them over many timelines to break free from a time loop of doom.

3264140.title: ZaciSa: Idle Defense!
3264140.short_description: A Tower Defense game mashed with Idle Clicker mechanics set inside a wonderful world of crayons. Build out your defenses, go grab a snack and watch your forces take on enemy units.

3264630.title: Astral Enterprises
3264630.short_description: As CEO, build a ruthless corporate empire! Solve spatial factory puzzles, master complex supply chains, and manipulate dynamic markets to maximise profit. Mobilise local workforces, fund high-tech R&D, and construct colossal megaprojects to satisfy your demanding Parent Company.

3265340.title: PIPELINE
3265340.short_description: PIPELINE is a 1-6 player online co-op, physics-based, action FPS, rogue-lite where every bullet counts. Progress levels, ride around in the shopping cart, discover game-altering upgrades, get strong, fight even stronger enemies. Death is not the end. The cycle will repeat.

3265420.title: Nine Lives Hospital
3265420.short_description: You are clumsy cat doctors in a chaotic co-op hospital - a vet clinic in reverse, where the patients are human. Grab and haul ragdoll patients, X-ray, transplant and stitch against the clock, drive the claw-machine bed. For 1-4 online. Your patients don't have nine lives. meow!

3266900.title: The Prophecy of Horn
3266900.short_description: Lead your heroes through a psychedelic grimdark world in a fast-paced hybrid turn-based mode, where heroes take turns while hordes of enemies attack simultaneously. Execute devastating combos and gain extra turns through Rampage to annihilate the legions of the Demon Horn!

3269430.title: Melted Time
3269430.short_description: Candle, your path is full of puzzles. Can you handle it? Hurry, your time is already melting away.

3269550.title: Rhythm of Resistance
3269550.short_description: In a future ruled by silence, your playlist is your weapon. In this Rhythm Metroidvania you fight to the beat, explore a dark interconnected world, and use forgotten songs to ignite the resistance. Every beat, a rebellion. Every song, a revolution.

3270900.title: Aura Farmers
3270900.short_description: Outlast your rivals, lock down the zone, and farm that aura. Forget hunting for kills—it's about relentless control, crazy plays, and aura farming. Engage in intense 1v1 duels, coordinate brutal team assaults, or unleash chaos in frantic multi-team brawls. Every round is a wild, skill-testing party.

3272390.title: Gaucho: Subway Escape
3272390.short_description: The shelter is not safe anymore. You must venture into the Buenos Aires subway, defeat colossal Demon Bosses in a frenetic parry-based combat, explore branching stations, improve your equipment, level up, and claw your way to the surface to save your kitten, Gaucho.

3277270.title: Quarter Lie
3277270.short_description: A narrative adventure game where you take on a role of a fake exorcist on a demon-ridden ship in a long sea voyage. Remember; you can’t lie your way out of everything!

3277770.title: Cult: Manos
3277770.short_description: Rediscover true meaning of Manos. Delve into a psychological mystery where movie making mistakes the key to uncovering the true horror. The survivors are waiting for you to discover it. Jackey Raye Neyman Jones (The Original Debbie) is 'looks forward to seeing' this dark restoration.

3278790.title: Precinct IX
3278790.short_description: Precinct IX is a cyberpunk police management and turn-based combat game. Receive visitors, manage cases and resources, dispatch unique officers to unstable scenes, and change case outcomes—and your relationships—through dialogue, command, and battle.

3279760.title: The Time Forgotten
3279760.short_description: The Time Forgotten is a highly immersive hardcore Battle Royale set on a massive forgotten Island, where YOU play as a dinosaur. Discover the story and fight for survival against other dinosaurs in a struggle for victory by gathering EVO points and making your dinosaur as strong as it can be.

3280210.title: Soul Trader
3280210.short_description: Welcome to the NecronomiCon! Choose two eccentric minions, combine their unique cards, and trade souls for power as you battle rival necromancers in this colourful roguelike deckbuilder.

3281110.title: Crooklock
3281110.short_description: You're in a stolen ship, your turret is stuck in one position, and you have the entire Galactic Federation breathing down your neck. An 80's styled shmup that has you shooting and running from the law across fifty nail-biting stages. Can you beat the odds... and your high score?

3281500.title: Danu: Rise of the Templars
3281500.short_description: Danu: Rise of the Templars is an open-world MMORPG & co-op action RPG set in a fantasy medieval world inspired by the legends of the Knights Templar. Explore dangerous lands filled with mystery, battle powerful enemies alongside friends, and earn rare gear through PvE adventures & 4–8 player raids.

3281570.title: Disc Out!
3281570.short_description: Harness the power of magical discs to overcome obstacles, solve puzzles, and uncover secrets in this top-down Disc Golf adventure. Master your timing, level up your skills, and meet a colorful cast of characters as you help Cary, a talking bag, on his quest to save Paradisc Island!

3281660.title: Starlight Brigade
3281660.short_description: Starlight Brigade is a realistic space action-adventure game with a precise combat system and full 6DOF controls. You command the Wayfarer, an aging light cruiser centuries past her time. Plot missile salvos, hunt down your enemy, design munitions, manage your crew, and send engineers to fix damage.

3282110.title: Sakichan - Track Of Fury
3282110.short_description: Join Saki-chan, the fierce shark girl, on her wild ride to conquer Earth! Race through deadly tunnels, mow down Tentamons, and chase after rebellious traitors. Customize Saki-chan with cool costumes and relax in the interactive massage room. Ready to unleash her fury? The chase is on!

3282130.title: Exo Helljumper: Descent X
3282130.short_description: Enter the chaotic world of Exo Helljumper: Descent X, filled with mutated foes and lurking dangers. Combine items and strategy to conquer relentless levels. Face unique foes and formidable bosses, test your cunning and skills, and feel the thrill of battle as you push beyond your limits!

3283690.title: THE HELMINTHS
3283690.short_description: The Helminths is a 2D pixel art platformer that pays homage to classic games and blending environmental puzzles, precision platforming, and fast-paced action. Confront the grim realities of exploitation in dystopian sci-fi world and embark on a dark journey of survival.

3284080.title: Liber Magus
3284080.short_description: Liber Magus is a magic extraction game where every dungeon run is a test of your magical talent. Build your own spells, push through dangerous dungeons and extract with your reward.

3284120.title: Sokogeek
3284120.short_description: Sokogeek is a block-pushing logic game with electrifying mechanics. Help Flux, a robot vacuum cleaner, escape each level by building the energy circuit that powers the exit. The complexity of the puzzles will test your spatial awareness, abstract thinking, and analytical skills to their limits.

3284200.title: Muri: Wildwoods
3284200.short_description: Play as Pelle, a curious cleaner muri tasked with restoring an island back to life! Explore mysterious ruins, clean away corruption, befriend cute critters, collect sketches, and save the Wildwood’s forest spirit in this cozy cleaning-sim adventure!

3285390.title: SeverLink
3285390.short_description: SeverLink is a retro stealth action, inspired by the console classics of the early 2000s like Splinter Cell, MGS2-3 and Hitman Contracts. With the art direction emulating the distinct look of the Playstation 2 library of games.

3288420.title: Auctus
3288420.short_description: Auctus is a deep sci-fi RPG where your body is a cybernetically enhanced tool of destruction. Talk your way out of danger, sneak past enemies, or shoot your way through. Soar above danger with jet-augmented legs and blast enemies with arm-integrated rockets. Level up, gear up, and solve quests.

3289160.title: Paddle Cats
3289160.short_description: Paddle Cats is a cozy two-player couch co-op fishing adventure where two cats share one boat. Paddle together, explore the waters, catch fish and bring your haul back to camp.

3289400.title: ARMED FRAME
3289400.short_description: A fast-paced TPS & FPS where you control a mech in battle. Customize 12 parts: head, torso, arms, legs, booster, FCS, and 6 weapons. Weapon and frame colors are changeable. Use weapons, jump, boost up, run on walls, do rapid boosts, quick turns, and high boosts.

3290100.title: MoonLit Journey: The Age of Deth
3290100.short_description: Join us on an Epic Journey into the warped minds of life long gamers who are creating a nostalgic game, setting the player deep into a fantasy realm with a rich story line and many interactive features.

3291440.title: Astro Architect
3291440.short_description: A space station city builder where your employees vote on what gets built. Play the cards they choose, keep them fed and productive, endure Void waves and roll the dice on expeditions into deep space. The CEO is watching.

3291450.title: The Vow: Vampire's Curse
3291450.short_description: You are Sir Richard in a tactical card battler set in a dark fantasy roguelike. Master your cards, execute deadly combos, and survive cursed nights to rescue your fiancée from the vampire’s grasp.

3292300.title: Golf-Like
3292300.short_description: A golf roguelike where the ball never stops. Tee off onto a road over the sea that sinks behind you, steer through the air, shoot down the spiked escorts hunting you and face the Kraken. Pick your route through portals, sports arenas and hidden caves. New road, new deck, every run.

3292730.title: Death In Your Dice
3292730.short_description: Roll the dice… or cities die. Learn lethal rules, twist outcomes, accept the cost. One bad throw calls the bombs. Win to delay death. Lose to become a murderer. Every choice reshapes your ending. Fate is loaded. Your turn is encoded?

3293030.title: UnderPath
3293030.short_description: UnderPath is a single-player horror FPS that takes you into a dark, dangerous world. Explore abandoned locations, fight zombies and demons, solve puzzles, and shape your fate in an atmospheric open world filled with challenges.

3294180.title: KOTA: The Survival
3294180.short_description: In a post-apocalyptic world abandoned by humans, control robots as they gather resources, fight enemies, and rebuild the planet using recycled materials. KOTA: The Survival lets you revive nature and craft a new future!

3294700.title: My Little Sister Is an Angel
3294700.short_description: "Hey, wanna try becoming a god?" After saving an angel, introvert Yuki gets pulled into divine training, and the Archangel moves in as his “little sister” to guide him. A warm supernatural romance VN where your choices lead to 4 endings.

3295000.title: ReVamp
3295000.short_description: A Tower Defensevania where you rule as Dracula. Shape your fortress room by room, command an army of monsters, and step into battle yourself to protect your throne from relentless mortal invaders. A war waged for eternity, for the love you couldn’t save.

3295190.title: Touhou Chronicle of Youkai Prayers
3295190.short_description: "Touhou Chronicle of Youkai Prayers" is a Touhou fan-made roguelike action game.Due to a Kedama incident in Gensokyo, Flandre Scarlet eagerly takes the initiative to resolve it. Or rather, she's actually just causing chaos, definitely not trying to solve anything!

3296770.title: HAECHE_Ism
3296770.short_description: HAECHE_Ism is a pixel-art roguelike SRPG - a tactics game where you command the "Crows," the special task force of "Headquarters," to clear each stage.

3296970.title: Häxeri
3296970.short_description: Häxeri is a grid-based first-person dungeon crawler DRPG with turn-based combat. Form your own party, explore and map the sprawling corridors of the dungeon, and battle the monsters therein. Gain extra turns by exploiting their weaknesses, but be careful or they will exploit yours!

3296990.title: Fearwoods
3296990.short_description: Fearwoods is a 4 co-op survival horror where light and silence are your only weapons. Explore the cursed forest, uncover Aveline’s story, evade a relentless demon, and fight for escape before the darkness consumes you.

3297040.title: Adventurers Guild Inc.
3297040.short_description: Run the business behind the heroics by managing your own Adventurers Guild! Turn the world's problems into appealing quest and take your cut. Support your adventurers by selling them the services they don't even know they need. Then reinvest your earnings and grow the greatest guild of them all!

3297110.title: Anemorie
3297110.short_description: A girl with a fragile heart. A gift to see forgotten memories. Dive into Anna’s world where every object holds a story—and one memory may change her life forever.

3298140.title: The Guardians Realm
3298140.short_description: Open-world Fantasy Action-RPG with a focus on combat, crafting and gathering.

3298920.title: psy-relic
3298920.short_description: A cooperative horror game in which you collect "psy-relics" that have abnormalities caused by psychic phenomena.

3299300.title: Magicians: The Devil's Deal
3299300.short_description: Magicians: The Devil’s Deal is a narrative driven FPS where stage magic becomes real. You play as Jacob Menteuro, a fallen illusionist bound by a pact with The Devil and cast into Hell. Master deadly tricks, steal the powers of rival magicians, and escape the infernal world of Theatreland.

3299450.title: Calame
3299450.short_description: In this turn-based tactical RPG, renown can change the course of a war. Lead Kenmare and the Panthers against the King of Light, shape the Chronicle through your choices, and wield the Legend to turn battles around.

3299780.title: Grinding Guilds
3299780.short_description: Grinding Guilds mixes the loot hunt and character building from ARPGs, with the strategy elements of Auto Battlers. Pick your hero, level up, get loot and upgrade abilities. Hire allies for your guild, equip Pacts, position your units and find the best strategy to beat all bosses.

3299850.title: The Last Phoenix
3299850.short_description: The Last Phoenix is a roguelite inspired action platformer RPG where death fuels your power. You grow stronger with every death. Felix, a goblin who possesses a demonic power of reincarnation, must save his kind from eradication at the hands of a cult!

3299920.title: Liminal Point
3299920.short_description: Classic Survival Horror. Drawn to Ashen Point by a cryptic voicemail, Lyra returns to the island where her band’s story ended in tragedy. Shrouded in fog and prowled by horrors, confront deadly creatures, explore the desolate town, and reveal the truth behind the night that changed everything.

3299990.title: MEMORALYSIS: The Scorched Home
3299990.short_description: A murder mystery visual novel about catharsis.

3300520.title: The Ardron Universe
3300520.short_description: Your choices carve scars across realms. One universe. Multiple games. No second chances.

3300860.title: Meow Below
3300860.short_description: Meow Below: Roguelike pachinko in hell. Play as a cat in a devil's parlor. Buy marbles, pull the lever, chase random multipliers, and upgrade your machine. Manage coins, debt, and stamina. Cash out or risk it all?

3301300.title: Wild Terrain
3301300.short_description: You're a wild pig on a quest to find all of your missing piglets. Smash obstacles, forage through trash for food, discover special mushrooms, and poop flowers to restore balance as you grow closer to your piglet family and the wild around you.

3302540.title: Veil : Black Blood
3302540.short_description: Veil : Black Blood is a game about a witch named Dalia on her journey to the Witches' Sabbath. Perform arcane rituals and uncover the symbolic language of magic. Draw and combine shapes to craft powerful spells on the fly. Explore the world in search of clues and secrets.​
developers: State of the Art Game Studio
publishers: State of the Art Game Studio

3302550.title: Tumbletail
3302550.short_description: Tumbletail is a 1-4 player chaotic, fast-paced party platform brawler where adorable animals race to collect ten stars while knocking rivals out of the way! Jump, dash, and brawl across colorful pixel-art arenas in a frantic free-for-all. Play locally, online, or over LAN!

3302880.title: Curry Princess GOLD
3302880.short_description: A casual kawaii action game where you collect falling spices, earn gold, and cook delicious curry.Including Classic mode, Story mode, and 2P mode offers both competitive and cooperative play. There is also a curry catalog and leaderboards.

3303340.title: Zomb Zerro - 999
3303340.short_description: Psychological VR horror built around immersive physical interaction. Protocol 9-9-9 is compromised deep in a secret mountain facility. Science collided with occult rituals - something horrific awoke. Explore, scavenge scarce ammo, fight for survival, and uncover the truth.

3303670.title: The Dropouts
3303670.short_description: A spooky choices-matter mystery set in 2004 Switzerland. Many students have disappeared in Noirmont High over the past century. You're Lou, you just transferred here, and weird stuff immediately starts happening... will you be the next dropout?

3303870.title: Underground Security Inc
3303870.short_description: Defend your dungeon against relentless waves of “heroes”. Manage your minions, mine ores, construct traps and cast spells to strengthen your defenses. Each run brings new challenges in this roguelite dungeon defense game.

3303890.title: Other World Strike: Helicopter Rescue
3303890.short_description: A third-person helicopter action shooter featuring realistic physics-based flight enhanced by alien technology. Extract stranded soldiers before hostile alien forces capture them across open maps set in three distinct biomes, with optional first-person gameplay and four selectable camera views.

3304120.title: Delusional
3304120.short_description: Delusional is a chaotic top-down roguelike shooter where you battle absurd enemies with hundreds of ridiculous weapons, all in a desperate bid to defeat the eccentric artiste who created you.

3304530.title: Haparoot
3304530.short_description: Step into a dream world. Become the sole source of light in the darkness and Explore an authentic handcrafted landscape in third-person. Solve layered environmental puzzles, discuss some familiar issues and uncover secrets shaping the journey toward balance.

3304540.title: Abstract Dwelling
3304540.short_description: 《Abstract Dwelling》 is a game that’s “just about building houses.” There’s no complicated currency system, no complex menus, and no intricate storylines.

3305820.title: Infinite Ball Well
3305820.short_description: INFINITE BALL WELL is a Pachinko Roguelite Deckbuilder with fast-paced runs. Launch Pinballs into Pegs to score points, mix and match hundreds of distinctive Pegs and Relics, and explore endless build possibilities as you clatter and ricochet ever deeper underground!

3305870.title: Mindwarp: Island Detective
3305870.short_description: Up to 4 players in online co-op. Talk to characters, learn their stories, search for clues and pass judgment before sunset in this unique detective.

3305910.title: Faceless Residence
3305910.short_description: Explore an abandoned mansion shrouded in mystery and danger. Face eerie creatures, solve challenging puzzles, and uncover hidden secrets that could be your key to escape – or something far darker.

3305930.title: Panzer Strike
3305930.short_description: Authentic RTS gameplay straight out of the 2000s. Command your troops, develop strategies, and win World War II battles. Huge maps, thousands of units, long-range firepower, and no building mechanics!

3307620.title: No Gods, Only Ducks
3307620.short_description: No Gods, Only Ducks is a chaotic mix of boomer shooter, wave survival, and extraction shooter gameplay. Fight through increasingly dangerous waves of corrupted creatures, collect powerful weapons and equipment, and do whatever it takes to survive long enough to escape.

3309070.title: Zombie Must Dead!
3309070.short_description: Guizi Must Dead is a historical FPS with Tarkov-like gameplay and survival base-building. Infiltrate enemy lines, loot supplies, fight foes, and extract safely. Use resources to farm and fortify your base. Inspired by WWII guerrilla resistance, supports up to 4-player co-op.

3309250.title: The Rift Tower Defense
3309250.short_description: The Rift is a tower defense game with elements of RPG gameplay that will appeal to players of all skill levels. Enemies from an alternate universe are attacking and it's up to the player to stop them by strategically building defensive towers.

3310870.title: DICTOCRACY
3310870.short_description: Take charge as the President of a newly independent country, Adelphia. Build infrastructure, approve policies, juggle between conflicting priorities of the public, your ministers and other countries' leaders - All with only one action per turn and a different political landscape in each playthrough

3310910.title: SPACE WALK
3310910.short_description: SPACE WALK is a hands-on first-person astronaut simulation where you operate an orbital station and conduct surface expeditions across the Moon.

3311470.title: NO EXIT
3311470.short_description: No Exit is a small chapter based indie horror game. You'll have to face challenging enemies, and perhaps make some allies, as you try to escape the crooked dimension you're trapped in.

3312040.title: Space Diner Simulator
3312040.short_description: After buying a rundown diner, you need to repair it and bring it to its full glory. Manage, renovate and upgrade the diner to attract more customers, and meet their demands. Bring a piece of home to the edges of space with Earths best recipes.

3312290.title: Dimension L
3312290.short_description: Dimension L is an online turn-based strategy RPG set in a world where dinosaurs have evolved, mastering elemental powers. Join the Duty Cup, a tournament where the mightiest L warriors earn the honor of fighting to save their homeland.

3312590.title: Helrift
3312590.short_description: Helrift is a free-to-play old-school MMORPG, built around the war between Aresden and Elvine. Shape your build through stats, weapons and spells. Hunt monsters, gather materials and craft your supplies, then join your allies in open-world PvP and battle for dominance in server-wide events.

3313640.title: Giggy Shangri-La
3313640.short_description: Welcome to [Giggy Shangri-La], an exhilarating staff music action x live house management simulation. With guitar in hand, conquer dungeons and experience being a bartender at a live music club visited only by monsters! Would you like to explore the cute and eerie world with Yu Furuiido?

3314270.title: Planetary Delivery Boys
3314270.short_description: A co-op horror comedy about delivering furniture with your friends across the galaxy! Up to 4 players must physically lift couches and chairs, handling them carefully to reach rogue planets.

3314300.title: Gnawer No. 44 Observation Report
3314300.short_description: Due to "special" work requirements, you've been assigned by your superiors to live in a very remote and desolate villa. You thought your dull and monotonous life would just carry on as usual, but every midnight, strange sounds emanate from the pitch-black attic...What kind of beginning awaits you?

3315010.title: Mitch
3315010.short_description: Mitch just landed! Will you help her begin her new life?

3315320.title: Pico Drift
3315320.short_description: Explore the city as your ultimate racing arena. Dodge traffic, outsmart the cops, and challenge your friends. Experience official campaign tracks and game modes, or create your own playgrounds. This is your world - drive it your way

3315390.title: Buggy
3315390.short_description: BUGGY is a multiplayer insect catching game! Fill your collection book, hop on with your friends, Relax and Catch a LOT of critters! Personalize your character to your liking and grab some cool cosmetics for yourself!

3315700.title: Unsound Love
3315700.short_description: Unsound Love is an open-world horror escape room where nothing is explained. You are born into a new world through the backseat of a wrecked car. Trapped in a time loop. Understand it — or stay trapped forever.

3316080.title: Mine of despair
3316080.short_description: Sentenced to death, then pardoned... into a mining sentence. 1-8 player co-op with proximity voice: dig, pay the prison, come back up alive. You do not kill the monsters here: you understand them, or you die. And something down there blows out the torches, one by one.

3316150.title: The Doll Museum
3316150.short_description: This 2D psychological horror game traps you in a pastel-pink doll museum, where you help Valentine to survive the cruel Doll Queen!

3316610.title: Orium
3316610.short_description: Aboard your ship, exterminate your enemies, exploit planets and weave your enterprise across the stars of a dying procedural galaxy. Orium is a Lovecraftian space roguelite, infused with streamlined 4X elements.

3317230.title: Killing Baby Hitler
3317230.short_description: Stop fascism in the cradle. Travel through time and hunt down history’s most evil infant in this satirical old-school FPS.

3317390.title: Magic Scavenger
3317390.short_description: 《Magic Scavenger》 is a casual looting game. You arrive at an unfamiliar continent, free to explore this medieval land. While scavenging items across the map, you'll also encounter potential enemies

3318140.title: Workaholic Simulator: Leaving the Dream
3318140.short_description: NOT your typical simulator! A surreal and dark descent into human psyche, burnout and the horror of the working culture. Work fast while escaping the monsters roaming these eerie spaces. There are no texts or dialogs in this game, putting raw feelings, abstraction and environment storytelling first.

3319140.title: Purge Phalanx
3319140.short_description: Unleash heavy weaponry to exterminate the demonic horde alone or up to 4 players online and/or in splitscreen

3319450.title: Armada Pet Wars
3319450.short_description: Armada Pet Wars is a 4X-lite asynchronous turn based space-themed strategy game... with pets. Design Starships, make or break alliances, setup your fleets for victory in this strategic, space-themed, auto-battler.

3320250.title: Timeater
3320250.short_description: Timeater is a 2D pixel art scrolling game with roguelike elements and a narrative focused on bending the time of the game to our will with a bilinear progression that will be spiced up with some gameplay/narrative secrets inherent in time itself.

3320450.title: Mica King
3320450.short_description: Mica King is an original top down action adventure game. Travel as an adventurer of variety skills to the once great and magical kingdom of Virrdale. Uncover the power of Mica and face the dark forces behind the bitter downfall of the king.

3321100.title: Chaosfall
3321100.short_description: Push your luck in a cursed slot machine. Cash out or lose everything to a machine that fights back.

3321290.title: Cold Sweat
3321290.short_description: Cold Sweat is a PvE single player extraction shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world. Collect loot, complete missions for traders, upgrade your base, customize your firearms, and shoot your way through other survivors and the undead.

3321410.title: Keep Chopping!
3321410.short_description: Keep Chopping! is a local multiplayer game for 2-4 players where you plant and chop trees to outgrow your rivals. Earn Acorns by chopping trees, then use them to plant more or buy bonuses to help you dominate the forest.

3321650.title: ココロトーカーズ
3321650.short_description: 舞台は廃校。記憶喪失の少年と、「モノ」を自身に宿すことができる「モノマネ」の力を持つ少女。 校舎内のあらゆる「モノ」と会話してモノだけが知っている情報を聞き出し、失われた記憶を取り戻そう！

3321760.title: Levels of Fear: Voidwalker Act I- An Undying Devotion
3321760.short_description: A Survival Horror game: Paranormal Investigator, Jonathan Hunter, awakens in an alternate realm finding himself fighting to survive. Forced to team up with a ghost girl named Angel trapped in a strange artifact, they must work together to escape an underground laboratory and evade dangerous enemies.

3322730.title: Nocturnal Visitors: Book One
3322730.short_description: An interactive isekai about Aliorbis, a world where magic and science, chaos and order, are two sides of the same coin. But remember: you are not this world's hero.

3323970.title: Pinbleton Park
3323970.short_description: Pinbleton Park is a small open world cosy adventure game where the whole world can transform into a giant pinball table. Help the villagers, rescue lost spirits, craft new pinball elements, and take down the corporation bent on destroying the forest!

3324140.title: Sever's Zone
3324140.short_description: "Sever's Zone" is a 3D first-person shooter about survival in the Anomalous Zone, full of artifacts, anomalies and dangerous inhabitants of the Zone - living and not so. The plot of the game is based on a series of books in the genre of science fiction.

3324260.title: Shepherd's Plan
3324260.short_description: An office point-and-click puzzle game mixed with visual novel-style storytelling set in a noir-fabled world. As you are fired from the job, to save yourself from a collapsing dream, it’s time to investigate, discover the black company’s secrets, and take sweet revenge for the money you deserve.

3324490.title: Emberhold
3324490.short_description: An action adventure game where you explore fantastical floating islands, fight powerful enemies, and rebuild a long lost bastion of hope for a kingdom in disarray

3325330.title: Eionis
3325330.short_description: Enter the world of Eionis in a dynamic, free-to-play 2D MMORPG. Choose one of 9 unique character classes - from a samurai to a destroyer, and many other diverse playstyles. Explore an open world, fight monsters, collect items, and develop your character through both PvE and PvP battles.

3325710.title: Flashback Dream
3325710.short_description: "Hope leads to despair." Welcome to Lethia, a paradise where dreams are forbidden. Amnesiac Jin takes up his sword to uncover the truth hidden by the cult and find his way back home. A top-down 2D pixel art action-adventure. In this lonely world, the future is yours to choose.

3325820.title: Consortium's Fall: Echoes of Xo'lara
3325820.short_description: Consortium’s Fall is a sci-fi roguelite twin-stick shooter about a people’s budding rebellion against a ruthless oppressor. Infiltrate enemy territory, defeat those who stand in your way and uncover secrets necessary to free your people once and for all.

3326170.title: CHI Project
3326170.short_description: Sci-fi fantasy visual novel, turn-based RPG, and murder mystery -- all in one!

3326420.title: Hoops Ahead: Basketball Manager
3326420.short_description: A new basketball league has been founded! Manage, trade, and sign players to help lead your team to a championship.

3326950.title: Whispers of Kurogane Castle
3326950.short_description: A psychological horror mystery set inside the legendary Kurogane Castle. Explore atmospheric Japanese environments, solve ritual based puzzles, and uncover a deep hidden story crafted through memories, symbols, and shifting reality.

3326980.title: CapyBash
3326980.short_description: Jump, stomp, laugh and dominate. Think you can beat your friends in the ultimate capybara showdown? Prove it!

3327090.title: Shadowbridge - The Genesis
3327090.short_description: Restore the balance in the dimensions! Help Ezra solve the biggest mystery of them all in this mind blowing point and click adventure.

3327280.title: I Need To Go
3327280.short_description: A naive metalhead wakes up in a strange, dreamlike cave with no idea how he got there, and no sign of his girlfriend. A fully voiced pixel art point-and-click adventure where humor meets the heart.

3327880.title: Leap Galaxy
3327880.short_description: Leap Galaxy is a 2D platformer with a minimalistic aesthetic and gameplay that puts speed and flow first. Take advantage of momentum and master the recoil of your shots to reach insane speeds and beat each level as fast as posible!

3328170.title: Guesslings
3328170.short_description: Guesslings is a silly, cozy 2-8 player party game. Everyone gets a name on their forehead that only they can't see. Ask your friends yes/no questions until you guess who you are. Or cheat at chess, lose at darts or just goof around. PS. Remember to pet the cat.

3328270.title: Desecrated Deck
3328270.short_description: Desecrated Deck is a first-person psychological horror card game where you face a spectral opponent in a forbidden occult ritual of Rock, Paper, Scissors, powerful Item Cards, and supernatural Perks. Win the game — or discover what happens when you don’t.

3328670.title: 咏唱魔女 witch's Aria
3328670.short_description: "Witch's Area" is an RPG game with a core gameplay mechanic centered around combining cards to create spells, featuring light strategic roguelike elements. Combine different cards to craft your unique spells and uncover the truth behind the little witch's cyclical dreams!

3328950.title: Conversations with My Imaginary Friends
3328950.short_description: A free collection of explorable scenes capturing conversations spanning two decades between the creator of To the Moon and the fictional characters they've created. About life, making games, and everything in between.

3328960.title: Monad Tachyon
3328960.short_description: Accelerate beyond the speed of sound! Monad Tachyon is the ultimate high-speed Metroidvania .

3329520.title: LabyrinTheam
3329520.short_description: Welcome to the Labyrintheam Tavern! Where we serve riddles that will test your wit and ingenuity. In this game, you will team up to escape from rooms filled with mysteries. Use your brains to open the door that will help you escape. Good luck to you!

3329660.title: RoMiMiMi
3329660.short_description: RoMiMiMi is a simple board game. Win the game and reach the last floor.

3330050.title: MESS
3330050.short_description: MESS is a multiplayer first-person jailbreak game where strategy, deception, and survival collide in a prison environment. Experience yourself in a role of Warden to maintain order, or Prisoner to try to break free and escape the prison.

3330290.title: CactusBandido
3330290.short_description: Love your friends? Too bad: in Thorn City, you're going to steal their loot. Face off with up to 6 players, outsmart the sheriff, and let the richest cactus win!

3330570.title: PaceBreak
3330570.short_description: Pacebreak is a first-person parkour speedrunning game. Compete against yourself, your friends or the top of the leaderboard. Play official levels, community maps, or create and share your own courses using the in-game level editor.

3330730.title: Kitty Convenience
3330730.short_description: Join the adorable kitty crew in Kitty Convenience, a chaotic co-op adventure! Manage a bustling store solo or with friends in modes from Kitten Mode (ages 3-6) to high-stakes challenges. Play locally or online with emote-only chat. Adapt, team up, and keep customers happy! 🐾🛒

3333190.title: Road Truckers: New Beginning
3333190.short_description: Be a TRUCKER, not a truck. Haul cargo, restore a forgotten town, and grow your trucking business in the first true trucking RPG. Get on foot to forge relationships, then jump back into your fully customizable rig to rule the road.

3333500.title: Redline Express
3333500.short_description: REDLINE EXPRESS - Immersive cold war themed packaging & inspecting simulator. Every mistake is treated as a sabotage, every package can be a danger. It's simulator of loyalty and survival in very thin boundary between order and paranoia.

3333850.title: Arkheron
3333850.short_description: No two runs are ever the same. New loot, new enemies, new strategies, new memories. Arkheron is a fast-paced, isometric PvP where every item you grab rewrites how you play mid-fight. Take two friends up the Tower, pull off strats that shouldn’t work, and fight your way to the next floor.

3334170.title: Tales of Tuscany
3334170.short_description: A choose-your-own-adventure RPG with fast-paced bullet hell battles! Play as a small chaotic sheep named Lambypoo, gaslight enemies into joining your party or defeat them for EXP as you save your cousins, rebuild your village, and BAAA loud enough to destroy everything in the overworld.

3334350.title: Mech Log Zero
3334350.short_description: Take control of a mechanized pilot and its Mech. Blast through Colossal Machines and secure the last remnants of life inside a dying God.

3334640.title: Time Jump
3334640.short_description: In this adventure comedy, you are a Wrestling Champion. A Kid. A Professor. A Rock. A Ghost. An Evil Maniac. Fight yourself or save yourself. Your choice, Time Jumper!

3335690.title: Typing Valley
3335690.short_description: Typing Valley is a cozy farming game powered by typing. Type to gather, plant, harvest, and run a cozy restaurant that brings warmth and happiness to the town. Start now, and let every keystroke become visible growth.

3336220.title: Pingbert's Snow Ride
3336220.short_description: Slide, soar, and deliver! Join Pingbert, the upbeat penguin mail carrier, in Pingbert’s Snow Ride—a fast-paced, endless platformer where you'll slide down snowy slopes to deliver mail at high speed!

3336270.title: How Much is Happiness?
3336270.short_description: You lost Bun, a cheerful orphan girl, who was the only joy for you in this cruel world. Tired of the harsh life, she went to Paradise, but you didn't accept it. At great cost, you dragged her back into the place she desperately wanted to escape. “How Much is Happiness” is a story of joy and despair.

3338020.title: Bloodstone Rising
3338020.short_description: Bloodstone Rising is a high-intensity co-op FPS roguelike. Gather your fellow space dwarves, mine resources, forge upgrades, and fight off relentless zombie hordes as you reclaim your ancestral kingdom.

3338240.title: DAUGHTER OF PAIN
3338240.short_description: "DAUGHTER OF PAIN" is a top-down action game with Roguelike elements. You will explore in dreams and create after waking up... provided that you can defeat the powerful enemies who are the incarnations of pain. Don't be afraid of nightmares - sleep, wake up, create, and repeat this cycle.

3338350.title: Wheelchair Together
3338350.short_description: 1-2 player physics based platformer. Play solo or with a friend in chaotic mini levels, master wheelchair movement, and learn to work together.

3338450.title: アスクギア リブースト
3338450.short_description: A new, straightforward RPG! Hot scenarios and battles that go right to the heart of JRPGs. For those of you who still feel your youth in the RPGs of the PS1 and PS2 generations, this is the game for you.

3339000.title: Chesstris
3339000.short_description: Chess meets Tetris in a series of handcrafted puzzles. Drop chess pieces to checkmate rival kings while avoiding checkmating your own. Become a beloved champion or a despised victor, find true love or ruin friendships. In Chesstris, your choices in and out of puzzles shape your destiny!

3339280.title: From Basement with Love
3339280.short_description: Conduct a high-stakes espionage operation at the height of the Cold War. Intercept and decipher classified intelligence to uncover a hidden threat. Break codes, cover your tracks, and escape before it’s too late.

3339560.title: Vertigo Enigma
3339560.short_description: Congratulations! You have been chosen for Vertigo Enigma. A narrative puzzle experiment where your logic and observation are the test. Until it glitches. Until you understand what "chosen" means...

3340510.title: Sculptor
3340510.short_description: Create and paint statues of beautiful women, improve your skills and follow the kinetic novel of a sculptor who fell in love with his creation. The game is inspired by the Greek myth of Pygmalion.

3340880.title: Silicone Heart
3340880.short_description: Build a self-sustaining cyber farm on a planet-sized junkyard. Grow biomechanical crops, automate production, repair discarded robots, and secretly reshape a mechanical society from the inside in this cozy farming and automation adventure.

3341600.title: Roof by Roof
3341600.short_description: Climb up, lay clay tiles row by row and watch the light change over the village. Roof by Roof is a cozy first-person roofing game: lay patterns for rewards, take on roofing orders and grow from apprentice to roofing legend, all at your own pace.

3342670.title: Crypts Of Carith
3342670.short_description: Explore the village of Carith, dank sewers, forgotten cellars, and ancient tombs, battle deadly creatures, and uncover powerful loot in this classic party-based dungeon crawling RPG built on a familiar D20 system.

3343280.title: Trenchhold TD
3343280.short_description: Trenchhold TD is an incremental tower defense game set on the battlefields of World War I. Hold your trenches against thousands of enemies, strengthen your forces through permanent upgrades, and launch full-scale counterattacks to crush their defenses!

3343350.title: Pitfalls 64
3343350.short_description: Take on a brutal, platforming gauntlet in Pitfalls 64! Clamber upwardly as a homesick gnome in search of his way back home, butt proceed with caution; one careless slip could spell a hard bonk back to the bottom...

3343480.title: SeedGod
3343480.short_description: In SeedGod, your mission is to strategically plant in a field full of bugs. Choose the best positions, and you can discover unique plants, capture bugs, find tools, and access areas that will challenge your survival tactics.

3343600.title: Conjunctivitalizer
3343600.short_description: Take on six stages of vertical shooting mayhem full of looney pixel art characters and locales. Gamers who are tired of bullet hell and Compile-like shooters can finally rejoice.

3343710.title: Rendagor
3343710.short_description: Rendagor is a 2D Top-down Shooter starring a service bot. Just a simple machine... or something more? Uncover dark secrets in Story Mode or master the challenge of Arcade Mode. Shoot, smash, and demolish enemies and destructible environments with a devastating arsenal.

3343970.title: Simulario
3343970.short_description: 2D physics based game. Particle physics, soft bodies, rigid bodies, motors, jet engines, forces, vehicles and space ships, explosions and realisic destructability - all kinds of physics stuff. The game contains very different levels, that utilize various aspects of physically simulated world.

3344550.title: KAPICI
3344550.short_description: Cover your friend’s night shift as the caretaker of an old apartment building. Take out the trash, clean the halls, and handle the usual complaints. It’s only one night—until one complaint leads you inside an apartment you can’t leave.

3345800.title: First Kingdom
3345800.short_description: Build your kingdom, develop your city, and defend it against waves of giants! Empower towers with elements, fuse defenses, create powerful building synergies, and use limited space wisely to shape your own strategic defense.

3346340.title: Grill'd: The Vanishing
3346340.short_description: [Grill'd] is a dinner party detective game played from the first-person perspective of a royal investigator. Trapped in a mansion located in the estate of a fallen aristocrat, collect clues about the cases, connect them to one another, and interrogate the suspect to uncover the truth.

3347170.title: Project Horizon
3347170.short_description: Project Horizon is a 1-4 player co-op first-person spaceship simulator where the entire crew needs to work together to carefully maintain the nuclear reactor, take up arms against enemy ships, and repair every leak and faulty electrical panel to survive.

3347690.title: Among the Waves
3347690.short_description: Carry the Divine Child. Bend the laws of physics and uncover the mystery of the Doors of Birth. The fate of a world where artificial intelligence has learned to believe lies in your hands.

3348610.title: Encryption
3348610.short_description: Encryption is a cinematic first-person psychological horror adventure set during a climate catastrophe burning through southern Italy. A father searches for his missing daughter in Matera, one of the oldest inhabited places on Earth, now evacuated, while something awaits in the darkness below.

3348640.title: TSAREVNA. Age of Tales
3348640.short_description: The world's first ballet-inspired action. Become the Tsarevna and carve your way through a dark Slavic fairy tale where beauty becomes a weapon. Chain stylish combos, master graceful swordplay, and turn every battle into a deadly dance.

3348920.title: Skill Eater
3348920.short_description: Skill Eater is a roguelite game where you've been turned into a slime with no choice but to steal opponents' skills to grow stronger. Eat your way through the humans and monsters that stand in your way, claim their powers, and aim to defeat the final boss that awaits you.

3349290.title: Returnless
3349290.short_description: Eyeball Gun is your weapon. Use it to fight shadow enemies, manipulate time, and escape a city consumed by black fog - no pause, no checkpoints. Progress is saved at the end of a run.

3349520.title: Iris Dissolution
3349520.short_description: Iris Dissolution is a classic survival horror game where you explore increasingly surreal places, manage scarce resources, and fight for your life against horrid creatures as you struggle to come to terms with loss.

3350570.title: Kingsbane
3350570.short_description: Raid gothic fortresses in a 2D action-platformer RPG. Choose from heroes with distinct fighting styles, hunt for rare gear, and defeat the infernal kings. Replay stages to try new routes and builds. Play solo or team up with up to three friends in local or online co-op.

3350860.title: Trifolium: The Adventures of Gary Pretzelneck
3350860.short_description: Discover hidden truths about the world in this 3D adventure about a giraffe with an unreasonably long neck. Figure out the rules, solve strange mysteries, and stumble upon unexpected twists. Choose your own path.

3352140.title: Satellite Odyssey: Jupiter
3352140.short_description: 🪳🤖 Rogue machines, mutant insects, and jazz echoing through deep space 🎷🎶 A stylish blend of survival horror and noir detective mystery wrapped in a decopunk aesthetic. Beautifully unsettling.

3352930.title: Dino Citadel
3352930.short_description: Command a castle-on-a-dino through a corrupted world. Rescue fallen allies, lead them in battle, and build your deck. Manage your economy to draw cards and confront the Voidrift in this tactical roguelike deckbuilder.

3353060.title: Ninja Kaizen
3353060.short_description: Free-to-play, turn-based ninja RPG. Master the elements, build your jutsu, bring a pet and join a clan to fight bosses and rivals worldwide. Rise from Genin to Sage and carve your name into the global rankings. Free Ninja Kaizen account required.

3353450.title: Rev. NOiR
3353450.short_description: Drawn together by chance, Asch and Finé set out to stop the Lightfall, a calamity that brings death to all it touches. As their journey to save the world unfolds, they uncover a fate neither expected... Defy cruel fate in the all-new RPG, Rev. NOiR.

3354950.title: RE:AKTOR
3354950.short_description: RE:AKTOR is a metroidvania about going fast and rewinding time. Race the clock, unlock new abilities and shortcuts, and solve temporal puzzles. Tear through walls and enemies with damage that scales with momentum, and punch ever deeper into a mysterious underground facility.

3355230.title: Smol Adventure
