3355230.short_description: A short 3D exploration role-playing game with a click-to-move movement system.

3355740.title: Legacy of Ashes
3355740.short_description: Dive into a horror adventure where you solve puzzles, explore a mysterious island, battle vicious dinosaurs, and escape terrifying chases—all while uncovering the hidden goals of Nova Corp. Secrets await at every turn.

3355980.title: Exoplanet Outpost
3355980.short_description: Establish a base on a distant planet. In this immersive sci-fi colony building sim, you'll balance economic growth, tourism, and defense against hostile alien forces. Your decisions shape the fate of your settlement and its inhabitants. Are you ready to thrive on the frontier of space?

3356660.title: Game Quest: The Backlog Battler
3356660.short_description: This Arcade Hack & Slash answers the age old question: "What if the games you never play could attack you?" Fight back your backlog! The more you paid, the more damage they will do to you! (just like in real life).

3356810.title: The shield of the Kingdom
3356810.short_description: "The Shield of The Kingdom" is a defense strategy game where player needs to protect their realm from enemies. Within the game, player controls 3 heroes and command troops in battle to repel invasions. Effective hero combinations and masterful tactical control are keys to achieving ultimate victory!

3356920.title: The Voodoo Soldier
3356920.short_description: In The Voodoo Soldier, your weapons consume your life. Miss your shots, waste your life. Kill enemies to make them drop what keeps you alive. Aggression fuels survival, and high health unlocks your deadliest weapons. Shoot. Heal. Survive.

3357050.title: Cozy
3357050.short_description: Build your dream farm, make lifelong friends, and experience the joys of small-town living in Cozy Town. Plant crops, raise animals, fish, craft, and enjoy seasonal festivals. Escape the hustle and bustle—relax and live your best life in a charming countryside adventure.

3358030.title: Polly's Gone
3358030.short_description: Polly's Gone is an action-RTS with shoot'em up elements. Lead a team of sheep through challenging levels in Story Mode to find the missing Polly. Explore diverse environments, defeat enemies, and test your skills in Survival Mode.

3358060.title: Catena
3358060.short_description: Catena is a deck-building roguelite where the freedom to customize your allies feels as powerful as programming. Dive into strategic, grid-based battles and create tactics uniquely your own to conquer the mysterious island and defeat the formidable enemies that await.

3358590.title: Prolegomena To a Hyperdimensional Interface That Will Be Able to Manifest From Three-Minute Interchanges
3358590.short_description: This is a collaborative experiment between you and I. We will participate in a series of interchanges, each lasting three minutes. What will be revealed across our interfaces during that limited time?

3358800.title: 见诡
3358800.short_description: A single-player Chinese folk horror RPG puzzle game. As a photographer, you venture into mysterious places with two paranormal vloggers. Explore scenes, gather clues and reveal hidden truths through environmental interaction. Full playthrough takes 2 to 5 hours.

3359110.title: Total Victory: World Conflict 1939-1945
3359110.short_description: The ultimate turn-based World War 2 grand strategy game wargamers have been yearning for decades. The best ideas born from players and from wargames so huge they overtook your dining room table, and your wife’s patience. From the developer of the WarPlan series.

3359700.title: Runes & Revenue
3359700.short_description: Welcome to the enchanting world of magic retail! Runes & Revenue is a cozy, hands-off management game where you manage your own magic shop. Recruit staff, unlock new mystical services. Strategically purchase upgrades to keep up with customer demand and ensure every adventurer leaves happy.

3361190.title: ZOPHARION
3361190.short_description: They react to your every move. Fight, run, or disappear. Every decision buys time. Every mistake gets you killed.

3361540.title: TYRONE vs COPS 2
3361540.short_description: Awaken the latent power of your melanin and kill cops in this thought-provoking game on police brutality in America... Again!

3363400.title: Escape With Friends
3363400.short_description: Investigate with your friends in this hilarious hand drawn game. Draw your own skin and go on a journey filled with minigames: darts, mini car races, electrical panels... From 2 to 8 players.

3364630.title: A Story About Forever: Transience
3364630.short_description: A Story About Forever is a space exploration action RPG game with heavy emphasis on story and character interaction, (inspired by Star Control II). Features Asteroids-style dogfights, an upgradable ship, a deep conversation system, and hundreds of characters with novels' worth of dialog to discover.

3364720.title: Rich Flavors
3364720.short_description: Rich Flavors is a game in which you deliver "goods" to "customers" and get paid in "coupons". Can you collect enough to buy your dream cake before your contract ends?

3364740.title: Heavenly Book
3364740.short_description: The Book of Heaven — Your Destiny, Your Path A regular office worker stumbles into The Book of Heaven. Explore vast lands, face trials, and uncover your destiny. Your choices shape your future — hero or villain, light or shadow. An epic journey awaits. The Book of Heaven is open — destiny awaits.

3366850.title: Snipers & Airdrops
3366850.short_description: A competitive sniper game for you and your friends, 1v1 or 2v2. Fight over airdrops falling into the middle of the map, outplay each other with agent abilities and wild movement, build a rifle that's all yours, and spend your winnings at the Black Market.

3367460.title: Whistle Willie
3367460.short_description: A Steamboat Willie-inspired first-person, open-world horror game. Navigate a haunting world by boat, upgrade your vessel, and arm yourself to survive. Uncover the chilling secrets needed to free the inhabitants from Willie’s relentless attacks.

3367710.title: The Abyss Break
3367710.short_description: Hardcore first-person co-op horror game. Explore the worlds beyond the Abyss alone or with a team, gather what you need to survive, and discover how far consciousness can change before it is no longer your own.

3367950.title: Five More Minutes
3367950.short_description: Build your deck and strategize to defeat foes as you traverse videogame worlds. Choose between 3 unique starting genres, and combine them to create unstoppable combos! Five more minutes is a love letter to growing up with the emotional support of our best friend: videogames.

3368470.title: Road To Yvhalon
3368470.short_description: Road To Yvhalon is an action RPG specifically designed for Virtual Reality. Explore stunning maps, craft epic swords, defeat mysterious demons, and steal their souls to harness their powers!

3368550.title: Panzer Planet
3368550.short_description: The ultimate fast-paced twin-stick shooter roguelite where you command tanks on spherical mini-planets battling hordes of aliens, zombies, and monstrous insects! Strap in, gear up, and prepare for chaotic arena survival action packed with explosive upgrades, weapons, and non-stop bullet-hell mayhem.

3369220.title: BitBeasts
3369220.short_description: Can you survive humanity's deadliest drones? Build your ship, evolve alien Beasts, unlock powerful talents, and fight through an ultra-hard roguelite space shooter where every run is different.

3369720.title: Nuria's Redemption
3369720.short_description: How many waves of rabid babies could you survive? Join your friends in Nuria's Redemption, a frantic co-op and PvP shooter. Choose from 4 classes, level up in combat, and defend your base from random events. Save the timeline!

3369910.title: Drunk Golf
3369910.short_description: Drunk Golf is a 1-8 player multiplayer game where the more drunk you are -> the further you shoot, but it also makes you wobblier. Master the physics-based swings, race & drift across multiple courses, customize your look and mess with friends on the way to the lowest score.

3370270.title: Backrooms
3370270.short_description: Survive relentless entities, solve mind-bending puzzles, and uncover the dark secrets of your surroundings. With an XP system, crafting, and resource management, every decision matters. Will you find your way out or become another lost soul?

3371320.title: WildAge
3371320.short_description: A platformer-puzzle game You play as two dragons with different abilities. One dragon can jump, and the other can push magical stones.

3372610.title: Uncanyon
3372610.short_description: Uncanyon is a puzzle-first adventure that drops you into a forgotten world, tucked into the seam between unparallel realities.

3373410.title: Katakamuna Idle
3373410.short_description: Experience cosmic harmony in this Katakamuna-inspired idle game. Gather "Ka," the essence of all existence, and weave the 80 verses of the Katakamuna Utahi. As an idle game, actions automate as you progress, allowing you to create harmony through color and sound, even when offline.

3374060.title: Ruins of The Titan
3374060.short_description: A 2D Rougelike action game with pixel art style. You are a summoned "hero", in exhilarating combat, smooth action and dazzling combo, defeat and execute enemies. Build from 100+ skills! Blending adventure, action, and strategic builds, the journey offers endless possibilities in every fight.

3375350.title: Floorball Practice
3375350.short_description: Run, dribble, shoot, score—repeat! Unleash your inner pro through practice and determination. Hone your Floorball skills, level up, and upgrade your gear with advanced Floorball sticks, stylish clothing, and more.

3375520.title: One Nation Under the Old Gods
3375520.short_description: A Rogue-lite Deckbuilder set in early 1800s United States. Play as members of a secret organization that investigates occult activity in an effort to stop various cults from summoning Eldritch Gods. Acquire cards to create combos and synergies to defeat your enemies in turn-based combat!

3376580.title: Raiders Rise
3376580.short_description: Explore hostile planets, face endless hordes of devourers, collect crystals, and upgrade your equipment. Choose the hero that best suits your playstyle, cooperate with your allies to survive… or betray the other team at the perfect moment and claim victory.

3376960.title: Nighthold
3376960.short_description: Sandbox survival RPG where days are for preparation and nights are for survival. Gather resources, build and fortify your shelter, fight the Rot and raiders - solo or with friends in online co-op.

3377830.title: Backroom Cleaners
3377830.short_description: Purge the unknown Backrooms in this 4-player co-op TPS roguelike. Experience endless combat with fresh build combinations every run.

3377840.title: Jeff and Crackhead
3377840.short_description: Explore a quirky top-down RPG/platformer as Jeff and Crackhead! Solve puzzles, dodge traps, and uncover secrets in the overworld. Battles mix turn-based strategy with real-time action—dodge, parry, and unleash powerful combos. Fast-paced, simple, and packed with nonsensical fun!

3379860.title: Chinese Strange Stories
3379860.short_description: Step into a living Chinese painting that blends the mystical, supernatural, and the struggles of daily life in the final years of the Ming dynasty. Experience a unique mix of classic turn-based RPG mechanics and dynamic card battling, where strategy and fate intertwine.

3380100.title: Estella
3380100.short_description: A brand-new 3D rhythm game for mouse & keyboard. Ride a golden comet through the cosmos and compose your own adventure with every song and every note.

3380410.title: Cybreach
3380410.short_description: Cybreach is a cooperative FPS with tower defense elements. Set traps, use abilities, and destroy hordes of incoming cyber-zombies!

3380470.title: RabbitConquest
3380470.short_description: In a world ruled by rabbits instead of humans, this is an adventure story about labyrinth appraisers who get caught up in a conspiracy surrounding a "magic fruit." It's a traditional 3D command RPG that anyone can play through to the ending in about 4 hours.

3380640.title: Wildlife Sports : Untamed
3380640.short_description: Join your friends in a silly sports Showdown! Choose your totem animal and compete in wacky games. With simple yet entertaining gameplay, enjoy quick matches or all-night sessions of endless fun and laughter. Who will reign supreme?

3380650.title: Rabanaz
3380650.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder set in a steampunk casino run by ravens. Rewire the machine in your favour and they won't take it quietly. Blend your chips into new colours and change what "random" means to steer a run toward the build you have in mind.

3380790.title: 风旅人 Wind Traveler
3380790.short_description: This is a semi open world ARPG game with HD2D pixel style. In the game, players will play the role of the story protagonist "Red haired Suka" and embark on an exciting adventure in a beautiful continent called Wind Canyon.

3381470.title: Eggstraordinary Goose Chase
3381470.short_description: Not your everyday goose chase—this time, the goose is on the hunt! Sprint through vibrant levels, dodge obstacles, collect berries, stomp enemies, and take bold risks! Keep running, push your limits, and reclaim what’s yours!

3381740.title: Eisenkiefer
3381740.short_description: Eisenkiefer is an asymmetrical horror multiplayer game for quick sessions with friends. Play as a Pig, hide, sabotage a giant meat grinder, and rescue your teammates – or become the Butcher and process the Pigs before they destroy your machine.

3381860.title: Ratscension
3381860.short_description: A top-down roguelite action dungeon crawler. Ascend the tower and fight the evil rat wizard. Avoid dangerous enemies. Find valuable loot. Build your character and explore the tower. Play solo or online co-op with friends!

3382130.title: Time Champions
3382130.short_description: Recruit units from different historical periods and defend the timeline against alien invaders in this action-roguelike. Mix and match units to discover game-breaking synergies and use hero powers to survive enemy hordes. Unlock new units and evolve them to wreak absolute chaos on the battlefield!

3382460.title: The Remains
3382460.short_description: The Remains is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror where an intelligent AI enemy hunts your team whilst adapting to your tactics. Stay quiet and out of sight, or get picked off one by one.

3382760.title: Black Flame Tactics
3382760.short_description: A dark fantasy autobattler roguelike. Build your party and lead it to the bottom of the world, where the Black Flame burns. Every run brings new heroes, relics, mysterious events, bosses, ancient pacts and more. Brave the descent solo or with a friend in online co-op.

3383140.title: 能動的ダンジョン
3383140.short_description: This game is a simple, high-difficulty RPG for people who are tired of the same old turn-based command-based RPGs.

3384340.title: Rico's Theater
3384340.short_description: Rico's Theater is an extremely intense first-person online multiplayer horror game. Choose multiple classes that vary in weapons & abilities & work together with friends in fighting dangerous entities.

3384570.title: Planet Party Time
3384570.short_description: "Planet Party Time" combines social sim & party games. As an alien, team with robot PADI to restore a planet via unique recruits. Become a Cube Galaxy Hero Candidate: explore space, play minigames for rewards. Build custom minigames via intuitive editor & host parties!

3384600.title: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam
3384600.short_description: A new adventure in Professor Layton, the puzzle-filled fantasy adventure series that has sold over 20 million copies worldwide. Professor Layton and Luke find themselves drawn into a mysterious case in Steam Bison, a remarkable town of invention powered by steam engine technology.

3384820.title: Broken Relic
3384820.short_description: On his first day as an archive intern, Tim unleashes an ancient conqueror and gets fired. Now the boss who fired him is relying on him to save the world. A fully voiced fantasy point-and-click comedy.

3385140.title: EverCastle
3385140.short_description: Evercastle is the story of a young girl who sets out on an adventure to the mysterious castle. In this magical action RPG, you must master various spells to overcome monsters and traps, defeat powerful enemies, and reach the castle's depths to rescue beloved family.

3385580.title: Chill Chess
3385580.short_description: Relax, strategize, and master chess in a sleek 3D sci-fi world. Play against friends or other players online, or challenge smart AI.

3386410.title: 天罚
3386410.short_description: A 3D xianxia RPG of spell duels. Explore a vast world to hone your cultivation, compete with fellow cultivators in martial arts, and duel to prove your Dao.

3386520.title: Frontier Control : Invasion
3386520.short_description: Frontier Control: Invasion is a Real-Time Strategy survival game in which you play the commander of a human space colony under the attack of outer space robots. Build your base, train your colony, and fight herds of enemies and bosses.

3386670.title: Dr.Mememe want to sleep
3386670.short_description: The lazy genius scientist "Dr. Mememe," who just wants to sleep forever, has invented Kawaii Sheep that induce sleep with their mysterious healing powers. An exponentially cute sheep-carrying game with expanding production × easy 3D action for casual enjoyment.

3387240.title: My Fairy Princess
3387240.short_description: In My Fairy Princess, you raise a daughter in a vibrant world of multiple endings. Plan her life and journey beside her through a fabled realm of humans, yaoguai, and immortals. Your choices shape not only the life she leads, but the one she comes to love.

3387340.title: DebugDebut
3387340.short_description: A debugging simulation game in which you complete debugging requests from a game generation AI that suddenly appears. Debug games of various genres and aim to win high rewards.

3387870.title: SLAMTOWN - Brawl Together
3387870.short_description: SLAMTOWN is a co-op beat 'em up arcade style 2.5D game for 1–4 players — punch, kick and throw enemies at your teammates for devastating chain combos. Slam bosses with powerful and unique arena movements and make your way through a city where wrestling is the only law.

3388420.title: Don't Forget the Phone
3388420.short_description: Experience a point & click time management game that puts your multi-tasking to the test. Complete all of your tasks before sunrise, but watch out for anything that may have escaped the lab below.

3389620.title: The Shadow Beneath
3389620.short_description: Rescue Akhenaten, the banished pharaoh, from an eternity beneath the sands. Wield the gifts of Aten's last disciples, unleash sacred techniques and battle the relentless guardians of the forgotten tombs in a fast-paced Action Roguelike.

3390520.title: Word To Angel
3390520.short_description: Play as five human heroes in this pacifist 2D RPG taking place in a world where some friendly (and not so friendly) angels conduct balance and harmony together... and where your only instruments for fighting are words and melodies.

3390830.title: Astrosembler
3390830.short_description: Astrosembler is a sandbox factory survival FPS game. Main focus is fusion — blending factory building with FPS mechanics. Build, Defend, Explore!

3391130.title: SHOCK
3391130.short_description: With only a wheelchair for mobility, Jack, a disabled war veteran, must use stealth, solve puzzles, and crawl into tight spaces to escape a cybernetic creature. Explore a psychological survival horror experience in third person and uncover the truth behind this nightmare.

3392040.title: OMEGA PHENEX COMMENCED PROJECT SIX
3392040.short_description: Intuitive operation! High speed! Missile barrage! [OMEGA PHENEX COMMENCED PROJECT SIX] is a mech action game in which you control a humanoid mech [Icarus] that can be freely customized.

3392220.title: Bake Until Done
3392220.short_description: Bake Until Done is a baking-themed, turn-based roguelite. Take control of a muffin as you battle devious desserts to break the spell of a magical bakery that is endangering your town. Fight back with your muffin’s morsels, but be careful not to lose too much…

3392480.title: MATRYBALL
3392480.short_description: Matryoshka meets football in a roguelike cup. Every hit can crack a shell off your players. Pick a fantasy club, unleash its special power and climb the ranks of Matry Champions, where every win upgrades your build. Or play local matches with friends.

3393850.title: Dicewood
3393850.short_description: A tiny pack of tiny creatures was lost in the woods. The food was scarce, they had to choose who will be left behind... Fight through the dark forest and save all the creatures.

3394790.title: Strider Arena
3394790.short_description: Strider Arena is a fast-paced mobility mech arena fighter designed to be played with a group of friends. Inspired by the likes of Titanfall 2, Armored Core, and Hawken, kit out your strider, drop into the arena, and make sure your team is the only one left standing once the smoke clears.

3395180.title: Rose in the Mist
3395180.short_description: A fantasy adventure visual novel featuring choices that shape the heroine's personality and the ultimate ending she will reach. Meet the residents of the Mist Witch's estate and grow closer to her mysterious guests. Love, friendship, and hatred in a captivating story.

3395390.title: Infested
3395390.short_description: Infested is a simple First Person Shooter. You will encounter many zombies as you fight your way through the zombie-infested city. Will you make it to the hospital to find the first infected victim? Only with its DNA samples will science be able to create an antidote.

3395430.title: MachineCorps
3395430.short_description: Build factories, solve puzzles, and send robots to explore the desert planet of Drath. With each release comes a new planet with stranger challenges, smarter enemies, and more advanced tech. It will take a logical mind, cunning, and a yearning for adventure to succeed. Do you have what it takes?

3396160.title: Warfactory: Automation RTS
3396160.short_description: Warfactory is an automation RTS where production defines the war effort. Build assembly lines to forge an army of machines, then feed thousands of units into massive real-time battles where every loss must be replaced by your factory.

3396350.title: Macaronpolis
3396350.short_description: Design your own 'all-in-one' macaron factory and become the CEO of your dream bakery. Decorate recipes at your own pace, or dive deep into optimizing production and adapting to ever-changing customer demand. Start from a small shop and conquer the world as a legendary CEO!

3397260.title: Liminal City: Axiom of Maria - Chapter One
3397260.short_description: A 3D Metroidvania set in Seoul, left empty as humanity dwindled and now tended only by AI. Chain wall runs, air dashes, and a growing set of movement abilities to uncover hidden places and the stories tangled within them.

3399610.title: Tokatonton: One-Armed Blacksmith
3399610.short_description: "Tokatonton: One-Armed Blacksmith" is a medieval forge management sim. Craft unique weapons, satisfy demanding customers, or take risky deals for profit. Rebuild a crumbling forge with two struggling blacksmiths.

3399660.title: Ant Mill Inc
3399660.short_description: Feed the nest. Grow the swarm. Devour the world. A dark incremental ant colony game where one ant becomes thousands. Gather food, upgrade the nest, uncover strange offerings, and fight for survival. Face the HUNGER - or become it...

3400110.title: Ironweld
3400110.short_description: Ironweld is a 2D side-scrolling action RPG where every encounter feels like PvP. Survive opponents that use the same moves and parts as you. They chase, punish, launch, and pressure you back. Repair and rebuild your squad between stages as you push deeper. Lose them all and it's over.

3400130.title: Tombstone Tactics
3400130.short_description: A pixel-art roguelike autobattler where you play the Lich. Raise an undead army from the souls of fallen heroes, set the board, and let it fight. Lose a battle and your army returns; the Lich pays instead. March on the royal family and take it apart, one crown at a time.

3401160.title: Ceaseless
3401160.short_description: An unknown element has escaped containment and is devouring the universe! Assemble a powerful, layered starship, collect synergistic modules, explore an infinite world, and battle enemies in fast paced, interval-based combat to stop it.

3401960.title: JOIN US
3401960.short_description: Start a doomsday cult of your very own! Recruit followers, build your compound, customize your cult’s beliefs, and defeat enemies in this 1-4 player co-op, action-packed, open-world survival experience. Can you survive the Apocalypse?

3403780.title: The Stick Figure Game
3403780.short_description: The most convoluted game of capture-the-flag we've ever seen! In this turn-based strategy game, make choices to bring new units into play, position forces, fire on the enemy, dig tunnels to avoid enemy line-of-sight, and more. Play solo vs the computer player, or head-to-head against a friend!

3404190.title: Uncharted Sectors
3404190.short_description: A grand strategy game built on a deep economic simulation and orchestrated by an intelligent AI storyteller. Ensure the survival of your domain at the edge of the galaxy: colonize worlds, manage populations, navigate politics, design custom goods, and master dynamic markets.

3404340.title: Chronicles of Humanity
3404340.short_description: Chronicles of Humanity is an expanding anthology of historical visual novels. Enter different eras, weigh conflicting testimony under political and personal pressure, and shape who is protected, what is recorded, and how each life is remembered. Complete stories are released as separate DLC.

3404680.title: test
3404680.short_description: A classic side scrolling game level that combines platform jumping, action combat, and puzzle exploration. Players control their characters to move horizontally on a two-dimensional plane, gradually solving puzzles and defeating enemies through jumping, attacking, and obstacle avoidance operations.

3404780.title: Metronome
3404780.short_description: Metronome is a short semi auto-biographical interactive story about the life of a British musician spanning from the early 90s to the late 2020s.

3405080.title: Smile Thief
3405080.short_description: Join Eva, a young apprentice minstrel, on her mission to save her village’s joy in Trimeria - The Thief of Smiles. This graphic adventure invites you to explore a magical world, face unique challenges, and unravel the mystery of the demon threatening to steal all smiles.

3405120.title: Hide The Corpse
3405120.short_description: Hide Gus before the cops arrive in this chaotic VR physics sandbox. Drag, throw, and cram a fully simulated body into absurd hiding spots across unique environments while the clock ticks down. Includes the Gusimir Mansion DLC.

3405180.title: 杀剧回环：衔尾之蛇 Killing Tragedy Samsara: Ouroboros Reincarnation
3405180.short_description: A.D.2046 Spring, Hecate, the great novelist, was invited to La Stella Domani Detective Competition, and unexpectedly forced to play a murder game among gifted and criminal teens. With the power of time loop, could she crack those perfect crimes?

3405680.title: Teamcrafter
3405680.short_description: Gather resources, craft powerful gear, and build the perfect adventuring party in Teamcrafter, a cozy crafting roguelite where your heroes fight the battles, but you craft the victories. Explore serene procedural biomes, optimize your team’s build load out, and uncover the mystery of the Portals.

3409540.title: Tap Monster: Forest
3409540.short_description: Welcome to the world of monsters! Tap the screen, fight alongside your monsters, and conquer levels—easy to start, thrilling to master. Get stronger even while lying down!

3409590.title: Just do it ! (干就完了! )
3409590.short_description: This game combines Mount & Blade: Warband and The Elder Scrolls V, featuring battles in a magical, multi-racial world. Be a mercenary, lord, or wealthy tycoon. Play solo or online for fun!

3409870.title: TreasureTails
3409870.short_description: A cozy, relaxing and casual adventure game where you play as a curious cat searching for treasures. Explore peaceful landscapes, follow treasure maps and solve clues to find and unearth many hidden wonders and mysteries.

3410020.title: Moonstone Resort
3410020.short_description: Find tranquility in a peaceful farming life while building a cozy hotel for guests. When you're ready for an adventure, explore the depths of the mines, encountering unique creatures and uncovering valuable resources.

3410250.title: Final Absolution
3410250.short_description: Final Absolution is an upcoming survival-horror first-person shooter with a focus on exploration, inspired by Super Metroid and Doom. A mysterious force has overtaken the N-Space rocket launch site and corrupted the artificial intelligence that manages the remote island spaceport.

3410410.title: ApocaShift
3410410.short_description: ApocaShift is a solo-developed extraction looter that throws you into high-stakes expeditions across the wasteland, where survival hinges on the gear you carry, the base you build, and the few allies you can count on.

3411590.title: Survivor of Egypt: The Ancient Curse
3411590.short_description: Build your inventory. Break the horde. Escape the curse. In this Egyptian action roguelite, arrange gear, transfer item abilities and forge powerful synergies. Fight solo or challenge recorded player runs in optional asynchronous PvP. How long can you survive?

3412340.title: Two Robots: Unleashed
3412340.short_description: The first competitive card game where players can create their own cards. Build your robot, craft your deck, and brawl in 1v1 arenas in the sci-fi world of Rennova. Climb the ranks, earn your place among the elite, and design cards that change the game forever.

3412690.title: MicroJumper
3412690.short_description: A tiny 2D precision platformer where you navigate the human body as a pathogen. Evade relentless white blood cells, master newfound abilities, and use power-ups while you search for a new home.

3412860.title: Destiny Code
3412860.short_description: Beautiful girls and thrilling card battles, all in one RPG! As factions clash over the relics of a lost civilization, the fate of the world — and your companions — hangs on your choices. A dramatic tale where your strategy and decisions shape destiny!

3413490.title: The (mis)adventures of Magical Girl Luna
3413490.short_description: In another world, where magic and technology go hand in hand, lives Luna - a young but formidable magical girl. Raised by the powerful witch Solaire, Luna is about to embark on an incredible adventure, one that will put both her idealistic nature and her starry-eyed view of the world to the test.

3414020.title: Heroic Musical Chairs
3414020.short_description: Face off against your friends and family in this epic take on musical chairs! Play locally or online as tiny wizard athletes ready to do anything to win. Special powers, dirty tricks, and dozens of crazy arenas: when the music stops, chaos begins!

3414460.title: Pizza Super Slice
3414460.short_description: Cartoon-exploration-platformer in which you play as an living slice of pizza. Explore a strange, cartoon town full of little secrets, dark corners and secret passages. There's something interesting in every nook and cranny!

3414870.title: Will O Wisp
3414870.short_description: This is a platform action game in which you control light in a world shrouded in complete darkness and rely on it to progress. Use the light to travel from place to place and illuminate the buried truth.

3415310.title: Don't Die, Dummy!
3415310.short_description: Who knew the secret to robot destruction was the perfect spin kick? Dance now, explain later!

3415870.title: GREX
3415870.short_description: Become a swarm. Think as one. Mutate. Multiply. Overwhelm. A roguelite auto-shooter built around hive-mind powers — craft broken builds, survive the chaos, crush enemies with sheer collective force! All to a thumping trance-techno soundtrack and neon-glow visuals.

3415910.title: Magic Cells
3415910.short_description: A life-or-death war between cells and germs! 20+ bosses lead 100+ minions to invade—cunning, multiplying, mutating, and parasitizing your turf! Summon 24+ magic cells, wield 100+ tech cards to fight back, and harness 9 divine powers to win!

3418090.title: Death's Legacy
3418090.short_description: Embark on an open-world adventure as a necromancer wielding dark magic. Explore vast landscapes, summon the monsters that were once your enemies, and uncover ancient secrets in an immersive experience.

3418870.title: Ninja Baseball League-Man: Bases Loaded
3418870.short_description: Throw, hit, and brawl! The legendary 90s arcade beat 'em up combining baseball and martial arts returns in HD! Packed with new characters, modes, stages, and music, plus up to 4-player co-op!

3419080.title: The Regreening
3419080.short_description: Restore a deserted world in a cozy soilpunk simulation. Grow plants, rebuild wildlife habitats, and revive entire ecosystems. Upcycle abandoned junk into tools and decorations, befriend ancient nature spirits, and hug ALL the animals as you transform a forgotten world into a thriving paradise.

3419090.title: Take Me to the Ending!
3419090.short_description: Huh... umm...? Meet Yuu, our hero who just can't jump high enough to escape their tiny little world. But wait—here comes YOU, the super hacker extraordinaire! 💻✨ Hack Yuu's parameters, tweak the world itself, and guide them all the way to their happy ending! Let’s get hacking!

3419240.title: Saintess of the Golden Bow
3419240.short_description: Trapped in a time loop as the Saintess of the Golden Bow, every choice matters and every death is a second chance. Use knowledge from past timelines to unlock new paths and strengthen bonds in this otome visual novel. Can you rewrite fate, or are you bound to relive despair forever?

3419270.title: Deliver Together
3419270.short_description: In Deliver Together, You control either (or both) of the two trucks attached to the same loooong trailer. And who's driving? Oh, just you. Or you and a friend. Or maybe eight of you, all screaming different directions at once. Your goal is to reach the finish line in chaotic tracks.

3419510.title: CE-III Protocol: Last Drop
3419510.short_description: Dozing off in class won't kill you… unless you wake up in a strange, creepy place surrounded by monsters. On the bright side, you're not alone, nor completely defenseless. But to escape this nightmare, you'll have to do more than just survive…

3419710.title: Zoe's Game
3419710.short_description: Escape from a mansion full of puzzles, traps and characters who may not be what they seem! Can you survive to this deadly birthday party?

3420060.title: Dark Gun
3420060.short_description: Dark Gun is a modern roguelite survivor where guns clash with dark magic. Survive endless waves, build unstoppable power, and fight the abyss in stylish, fast-paced chaos.

3420770.title: Dark Dungeon Feminized
3420770.short_description: This FPS game has dark and beautiful art style. A tragic accident turns the strict laboratory into a dark dungeon. You are trying to escape from here with wisdom and strategy, and discover its unknown dark secrets.（Has Customizable female villain with costume damage）

3420860.title: Mei tales
3420860.short_description: "Mei tales" is a narrative card game set in a Chinese fantasy world. In the game, you can choose one of several protagonists to seek out companions, make decisions, and accept the twists of fate, embarking on a legendary journey uniquely your own.

3422660.title: FlowerBots
3422660.short_description: Flowerbots is an incremental game you can play in active or idle modes. Upgrade bots. Balance harvesting and planting. Explore synergies. Crush anomalies. And watch your plan unfold as the numbers go up.

3422990.title: CacheAdventure
3422990.short_description: CacheAdventure is a new open-world adventure sandbox game. Dig, explore, fight, loot, and build in infinite procedural landscapes. Enjoy persistent free updates/optimizations—more playable content coming!

3423030.title: AERA Flying Heroes
3423030.short_description: An adventure for all those who dream of conquering the skies. Choose your pilot, upgrade your ship, and make battles against waves of enemies and colossal bosses. Collect stars, unlock new missions and write your legend.

3424380.title: From Misfortune Comes
3424380.short_description: A broke high-school senior tries to rebuild his life, while secretly exploiting a supernatural second world to acquire money, power and opportunities that transform his ordinary existence.

3424940.title: Prize Denied
3424940.short_description: Prize Denied! In this cozy-evil claw machine roguelike, assemble rigged setups and play shady cards to stop customers from ever winning! Discover quirky combos to trap them in an endless addiction loop, draining their pockets dry until they finally win… or go completely broke!

3425440.title: The Mirrion
3425440.short_description: Dive into a harsh open world where every choice can mean the difference between life and death. Explore untamed lands, build shelters, hunt, craft tools, and defend yourself from threats. Nature, weather, and unexpected events will test your will to survive.

3426270.title: SuperHookGirl Ultra Challenge!!
3426270.short_description: Soar through the skies with your mouse! Experience high-speed hook-swinging action in Super Hook Girl Ultra Challenge!! Simple controls — but tough to master! Hook onto anything to discover shortcuts and advanced movement techniques!

3426510.title: LATITUDE OF THE CULT
3426510.short_description: Christmas Eve, 1997. A Michigan town sells its Dogman legend to tourists. It never speaks of the cult , or the song beneath the frozen lake. This winter, all three came back. Seventeen walked into the fog and never returned. The sheriff has vanished. Survive the night. Find out what the town buried.

3427020.title: Kumori Village
3427020.short_description: Shine your flashlight into the darkness and navigate a survival horror experience where you must evade monsters. Use, equip, and combine randomly spawned items to uncover the village's mysteries and survive.

3427820.title: Lemonade Apocalypse
3427820.short_description: Make money selling lemonade. Optimise your product. Build your workforce. Sell, sell, sell. But money is not enough. Become president! Fuel climate change! Manipulate geopolitical events! Lemonade Apocalypse is an incremental game about business decisions that are technically legal.

3428050.title: INFECT½
3428050.short_description: 《Infect½》is a Cthulhu-themed group portrait micro-horror AVG, players can control a total of seven characters in the game to advance the story. As members of the last remaining human settlement, as you explore, you slowly uncover the truth that led to the beginning of all this catastrophe...

3428060.title: SEALAND 2124
3428060.short_description: Sealand 2124 is a story-driven adventure puzzle game that takes you to a utopian city on the ocean. Join Anja and her clever albino magpie, solve challenging puzzles, and uncover the secrets of a world that blends hope and danger.

3430090.title: Satoyama Note: Spring Walk
3430090.short_description: Satoyama Note: Spring Walk is a point-and-click game where you explore the woods in the springtime. Talk with animals and observe plants as you head through the forest on your journey to enjoy a meal under the cherry blossom tree!

3430150.title: Billiards Warrior
3430150.short_description: 《Billiards Warrior》is a strategy action game that combines billiards physics, roguelite building, and fantasy monster battles. Aim, charge, and strike to launch the cue ball across the table in combos, defeat monster balls, collect relics and skills, and create your own adventure style.

3430600.title: Fecal Freighter
3430600.short_description: Become a sewage truck operator and survive the foul dangers: drive your ZIL, battle sludge demons, complete tasks, explore a grim world, and uncover the mystery of an alien conspiracy.

3430930.title: Malloc
3430930.short_description: Malloc is a short atmospheric exploration game. Wander through a nostalgic city on a summer afternoon, explore on foot or in a utility mech, meet the residents, and bring the district back to life one small repair at a time.

3431620.title: Kowloon 666
3431620.short_description: Sequel to "School 666". Welcome to Kowloon Walled City!!! A co-op horror game about Kowloon, made by Lokin who still living in Kowloon.

3431650.title: Digital Artmaster: Volume 8
3431650.short_description: Explore the artistry behind stunning digital worlds with this exclusive visual artbook. Featuring high-resolution artwork, intricate designs, and breathtaking environments, it offers a glimpse into the creative process, perfect for fans of imaginative storytelling and digital art.

3433080.title: Cube & Seek
3433080.short_description: Relax and find hidden objects in handcrafted 3D tiny cube worlds. Search for hidden treasures and enjoy fun interactive surprises along the way!

3434920.title: SAGE
3434920.short_description: SAGE is a multiplayer adventure game about frog wizards. Play solo or with friends on a journey to master elemental magic, explore a corrupted world, rebuild mushroom villages, and share tea with other frogs.

3435460.title: Bloodfly Keeper
3435460.short_description: Breed unruly bloodflies, craft forbidden cures, and rise from outcast to underground healer in a city ruled by a corrupt medical regime.

3435700.title: Evolized
3435700.short_description: Evolized is a fast-paced evolution roguelite where your creature changes in real time. Build your biology, push deeper into a storm that escalates the world every minute, and extract before you are wiped out.

3436500.title: Typewriter Monkeys
3436500.short_description: Infinite monkeys with infinite typewriters will eventually write Shakespeare... right? Find out in this cozy automation idler! Strategically place different kinds of monkeys with typewriters then level them up as you type longer and longer words!

3437190.title: Always With You: Meow & Mystery
3437190.short_description: "Always with you" is a cute and relaxing action-puzzle game. Switch freely between controlling a girl and a cat, solve clever puzzles, explore the ancient Alto civilization, and defeat unruly guardians. Embark on an exciting adventure with three cats to find your mother!

3437600.title: Fear Hour
3437600.short_description: Insane mistakes brought you to a life-or-death judgment. Fight off a terrifying Killer, or kill those who trespass on your territory in this tense (1v5) online experience. Where following your instincts might help you escape, or kill them all.

3437620.title: Ember of Origins
3437620.short_description: Ember of Origins is a dark fantasy 2D side-scrolling pixel action shooter. Explore the ruins of a world consumed by infernal flames, scavenge resources, upgrade powerful weapons, and battle demonic hordes as you embark on a dangerous journey to rescue your missing companion.

3438070.title: Sword of Mejor
3438070.short_description: A unique rpg experience where you follow the path of a sword, rather than 1 set character! Follow the Sword of Mejor as it travels the lands swapping hands through battles, trades, gifts and more! With more paths and endings to count, every playthrough is different!

3438600.title: Battle-Lines
3438600.short_description: Like playing Go with puzzle pieces. Build, recolor and steal lines to dominate the board! Play local, online or against AI.

3438880.title: With Dream
3438880.short_description: This is a story about two doctors who travel back in time to fulfill the last wish of a dying old man.

3438920.title: VOID DIVER: Escape from the Abyss
3438920.short_description: Dive into a city swallowed by the Abyss. Slay aberrations, grab artifacts, and survive until the Diving Booth arrives. A 2.5D pixel art extraction action RPG with up to 3-player co-op. Run the antique shop 'BALUSHA' and uncover the city's secrets.

3439870.title: Nexus Storm
3439870.short_description: A fast-paced arcade shoot 'em up inspired by 90s classics! Blast through waves of alien enemies, unleash devastating weapons, and destroy your surroundings. Play solo or team up with a friend in local co-op as you fight to save Earth!

3440130.title: Songs of the Shore
3440130.short_description: Explore a mysterious island full of musical shells and secrets to discover in this point-and-click 3D collectathon. Immerse yourself in an ambient and serene soundtrack which is remixed as you collect more shells.

3440510.title: Zap Colony
3440510.short_description: Zap Colony⚡ is a minimalist defense sim where you build a power grid and match tower energy to enemy colors. How long can you keep the colony safe?

3440770.title: The Glued
3440770.short_description: The peg doll faces from your childhood bedroom reappear at every turn. Struggle to find a path forward through your own personal hell in this bleak visual novel with light puzzles and point-and-click elements.

3441180.title: Battle Swap
3441180.short_description: Battle Swap is an auto-battler with a single player campaign and a unique twist: when you win a battle, you trade your deployed units for your enemy’s, rewarding you for using fewer units. Unlock upgrades, items, and spells as you go, and revisit past battles to improve solutions and reclaim units.

3442000.title: Swingin'!
3442000.short_description: Swingin’! is a physics-based action game where you stick a pole to your environment to control your character’s movement.

3442430.title: When Livia Disappeared
3442430.short_description: A fantasy visual novel set in the 1920s. Perform ritual magic, craft potions, and uncover the secrets of the Order that maintains the balance between worlds.

3442650.title: Lootspire
3442650.short_description: Co-op roguelite dungeon crawler for 1–4 players. Pick a class, choose abilities, gear up, and fight through a procedural spire that gets harder the higher you go. Gear and Hero Level reset every run, but Unlockables persist.

3443110.title: Hexamonia
3443110.short_description: A cozy, strategic board game where every choice matters. Place hex tiles, make the most of the options you’re dealt, and build the most valuable kingdom in the land.

3443710.title: RitualRX
3443710.short_description: RitualRX is a brutally violent, blisteringly fast, adrenaline-filled shooter set within a pastel paradise ruled by cults. Control excommunicated sinners as you shoot, slash, and slaughter your way through a city where ritual is prescribed and the only treatment administered is an overdose of lead.

3443790.title: Throw A Life!
3443790.short_description: "Throw A Life!" is a chaotic party survival game for up to four players! Work together to mine, craft, build, and hunt on a dangerous island. Divide roles to survive efficiently—or embrace the chaos and have fun with friends!

3443800.title: Scaledeep
3443800.short_description: Roguelike. Turn-based dungeon crawler featuring procedurally generated environments, over 200 unique monsters, and dynamic class customization. 20 different storylines. 6 professions. Countless deaths. Play solo or team up in local couch co-op and battle hordes of enemies.

3443990.title: Ismene
3443990.short_description: The story of Ismene, floating through space with her trusted robot companion, trying to figure out where she is going, and where she came from.

3444580.title: Taishō Romance Theater
3444580.short_description: A romance-suspense visual novel set in Taishō Japan. Amnesiac actor Kotori Sakuma grapples with a dear friend's bizarre death, the awakening of his magic, and the blood ties that haunt him. As the truth unravels, shape Kotori's final choice: return to his bloodline's embrace, or pursue true freedom?

3444810.title: Wonderfall
3444810.short_description: Paris, 1920. The city is collapsing into sand. Play as Léon, an orphan able to manipulate sand, as you explore a reimagined Paris consumed by Entropy. A story-rich narrative adventure where exploration reveals what happened to the city and what still lies beneath its ruins.

3444830.title: Wizard Hand
3444830.short_description: Wizard Hand is a magical deckbuilder game where solitaire meets roguelike. You play solitaire by using your magical cards to uncover dazzling combos and accumulate magical points with the help of enchantments, crafting, and a collection of powerful artifacts.

3445170.title: 🎧 Yellowcake - The Audio Game 🎧
3445170.short_description: A first-person audio game, telling the tale of a blind yet gifted hero. Make your way through a 3D environment without receiving any visual cues. Put all your faith in your ears and help our hero in his quest to uncover the sinister secrets of these twisty uranium mines, which he calls his home.

3446760.title: Multi Deck Hero
3446760.short_description: Multi Deck Hero is a roguelike deckbuilder where you command three unique decks to create powerful synergies. Strategically combine cards, unlock game-changing charms, and battle against increasingly powerful enemies. Will you master the perfect deck or fall to the challenge?

3446770.title: Sakura Arms ~Radiant Duels~
3446770.short_description: Sakura Arms is a unique on-the-spot deck-building card game. Choose two Megami, combine their martial arts, anticipate your opponent’s tactics, and build a 10-card deck after seeing both sides’ selections.

3447010.title: Knightmared
3447010.short_description: Auto-attack roguelike where you forge a knight into an unstoppable demon slayer. Survive 15 minutes, build devastating synergies, master your weapons.

3447030.title: Idle Bones Magic
3447030.short_description: Raise hordes of zombies and other un-dead beings to automate your dreams of conquest in this idle incremental game. Make your armies grow and snowball and then sit back and watch them take over the world.

3447100.title: Collapsed Horizon
3447100.short_description: Travel between galaxies, dig planets, collect ores, sell them, upgrade your equipment, and earn your ticket back to Earth.

3447150.title: Feral Metaverse
3447150.short_description: Feral Metaverse is an Online Multiplayer Game, where players are dropped naked and voiceless into a bleak environment. Their only path to survival is kindness.

3447420.title: Marble Run Maker
3447420.short_description: Build marble runs in a room with realistic physics. Stack random objects to make a wobbly track and watch the ball roll down! Explore puzzles with unlimited solutions.

3447460.title: Gravity Circuit 2
3447460.short_description: A new Ark has emerged. Play as one of two adept fighters, Gravity and Power Circuit, in this action-packed 2D platformer inspired by console classics. Gravity Circuit 2 is the sequel to the critically acclaimed Gravity Circuit.

3448680.title: THREAT VECTOR
3448680.short_description: Battle across the solar system as annihilation looms over mankind in this action sci-fi horror FPS. Powered by id Tech, THREAT VECTOR delivers classic FPS combat throughout a suite of concise, potent levels infested with deadly horrors… and loaded with enough firepower to destroy them all.

3450100.title: Gretel's Honesty
3450100.short_description: A comic-like visual novel, expressing a new story based on the fairy tale “Hansel and Gretel”.

3450270.title: DineInn
3450270.short_description: DineInn is a cozy horror restoration sim where you clean, repair, cook, farm, explore, and manage a forgotten diner and inn to restore it for profit. Uncover its buried secrets while maintaining your sanity, or the horror will begin. (Single dev project)

3450880.title: Hunter: Into the Abyss
3450880.short_description: Fight through ever-changing dungeons in this fast-paced action rogue-like, mastering brutal combat, powerful upgrades, and epic boss battles. Hunt the Elders of the Abyss and stop them from rising

3450900.title: DOSMIC
3450900.short_description: In a world teeming with colossal beings, a boy named Nero sets out to find the missing girl Snoa. Use a range of movement abilities, solve mysterious puzzles and sometimes fight otherworldly horrors in DOSMIC, a cinematic puzzle platformer.

3451830.title: Dignaut
3451830.short_description: Take on a peaceful mining mission that leads to something far more mysterious. Dig, upgrade your tools, and slowly awaken an ancient alien temple buried beneath the surface, bringing its forgotten music and light back to life.

3452060.title: Tiny Takedowns
3452060.short_description: The Rebels thought they had their shrinking weapon under control, until the Spies turned it against them! Uncover the Spies or cause chaos as a Rebel in Tiny Takedowns! With unique skills and chaotic rounds, every match offers a fresh and thrilling experience.

3453420.title: Shroud of Gloom
3453420.short_description: Shroud of Gloom is a point-and-click horror adventure. Investigate an old manor, gather items and clues to solve environmental puzzles and discover dark secrets. Can you uncover the mystery… and make it out alive?

3453430.title: Rush Your Band
3453430.short_description: Start as an unknown artist. Record your own songs using your real voice, release them online, grow your fanbase and build your music career.

3453470.title: 恋爱泡馍！青春老陕：Shannxi Love Story
3453470.short_description: Shannxi Love Story is a visual novel-style game set against the backdrop of university life in Shaanxi, infused with local cultural flavors. Discover Chinese culture through a brand-new lens, explore the youthful spirit of Xi'an, and discover the myriad possibilities life has to offer.

3454620.title: Social Hook
3454620.short_description: Catch powerful monster cards with your fishing rod and battle against other players in exciting duels.

3454750.title: In Another World
3454750.short_description: In this Isekai Anime RPG. Enjoy a more realistic skills system. Bring a race to extinction. Or live the quiet life farming in a pocket dimension. Fast paced real-time combat. Mostly medieval ecstatic. Hope you enjoy and find all and more of what you are looking for in another world.

3455120.title: Everforge Legacy
3455120.short_description: Single-player action RPG inspired by Final Fantasy XI. Six Jobs, weapon skills, skillchains, elemental days, and Named hunts, rebuilt for one hero, with up to two Trusts at your side. Three origin stories through a complete Chapter 1 storyline.

3455380.title: Chemical-Burn
3455380.short_description: Chemical-Burn is a first person shooter action-adventure set in Hazard City—one of the last few cities on Earth, where the remaining human populations have been placed. Engage in thrilling first person combat as Cindy using a variety of weapons & your dog Buddy. Plan. Execute. Survive. Repeat.

3456640.title: Hopfall
3456640.short_description: Build your team in this froguelite autobattler. Tame corrupted frogs, equip them with powerful items, and discover team synergies to overcome mysterious enemies.

3458140.title: NimerWorld: Shadows of a Promise
3458140.short_description: Welcome to Valdix, a kingdom consumed by darkness. Rescue the kingdom's ducks and put an end to the plague. As you progress, everything becomes stranger. Will you be able to reach the top and overcome this challenging journey?

3458290.title: G.E.M. Grab & Exit
3458290.short_description: Hand-Drawn Twin-Stick Shooter in space where one must survive the robotic ships onslaught and extract with the loot to exchange for ship upgrades.

3458390.title: Rot Forever
3458390.short_description: Rot Forever is a surreal FPS horror game, set in a decaying megastructure.

3458880.title: Hammam Simulator
3458880.short_description: Hammam Simulator lets you experience the authentic rituals of a traditional bathhouse. Scrub, foam, and cleanse as you manage the daily operations of a bustling hammam. Feel the warmth of marble, hear the soothing sound of water, and immerse yourself in a world of relaxation and tradition.

3458920.title: A.V.E.N.A.
3458920.short_description: Pilot disposable combat drones through the Primal Portal in a sci-fi action roguelike. Customize your drone, fight through various missions, recover research data and alien technology to enhance your drone setup for the next session.

3459510.title: Blitzpoint
3459510.short_description: A minimalist modern military strategy tower defense game where you build and defend a forward operating base. Strategically place defenses, manage resources, and repel relentless waves of enemies. Build by day, defend by night, and command your forces in fast-paced, action-packed gameplay.

3459990.title: Cosmic Composer
3459990.short_description: Casual puzzle game on a cosmic scale. Build stars, planets and other cosmic objects. Evolve your cosmos using abilities of the stars from stellar winds to supernova.

3460400.title: Harrowlands
3460400.short_description: Harrowlands is a medieval fantasy colony sim where you build your settlement, manage Fateborn with unique traits, shape relationships, survive raids, magical threats, and the demands of a powerful kingdom.

3460610.title: Mars Era
3460610.short_description: Mars Era is a turn-based strategy game about Mars colonization. Build your base, welcome settlers, gather resources, research technologies, and overcome the harsh conditions of the Red Planet. Manage your settlers, develop infrastructure, and turn Mars into a new home for humanity! 🚀

3461150.title: Blood Vow: Survive the Night
3461150.short_description: Defend the people of Sodermark from the hordes of darkness. Fight as an army of one, or online with up to four-player PvE multiplayer in this wave-based, action-survival game.

3461810.title: Threaded Dungeons
3461810.short_description: A world threaded in death. Can you cultivate a party of four that defies all odds? Make every action count in tactical turn-based combat. Choose your allegiances carefully. Scour dungeons in search of loot and secrets. Resist or acquiesce to tempting whispers in the darkness.

3462190.title: PHASE ZERO
3462190.short_description: A grotesque illness binds the town of Flint Peak. Several survivors try to escape with their lives as mysterious creatures roam the streets. Face horrific monsters, solve puzzles and uncover the truth in this classic survival horror. Can you escape the nightmare?

3462240.title: Warmace: Miniature Shop Simulator
3462240.short_description: Build the ultimate miniature hobby store! Order model kits, paint stunning miniatures, negotiate with collectors, and grow your business into every hobbyist's favorite shop.

3462580.title: Factory Life
3462580.short_description: Factory Life is a first-person factory simulator with colony-management elements. Start alone in a small garage, assemble electronics, and scale your business. Hire workers, manage their daily needs, and choose to be a fair leader or a harsh exploiter. Find your path to the top.

3462780.title: Bee Space
3462780.short_description: Plant flowers and deploy tech from orbit in this roguelike deckbuilder! Terraform tiny hex grid islands as advanced space Bees. Contend with fickle weather, strange creatures, mysterious artifacts and meddling bosses as you reclaim Earth for all Bee-Kind!

3463000.title: Les Nominés du Néombre
3463000.short_description: Les Nominés du Néombre is a cooperative and strategic card game where you play as a group of explorers embarking on a collective adventure. Each battle tests your strength in the Vermalian lands, which have turned hostile since the emergence of the Néombre Rift.

3463440.title: GridController
3463440.short_description: An online power company tycoon. Start with an exercise bike wired to a car battery and a street full of dark houses, and grow it into a utility that lights whole regions with solar, wind, gas, hydro and nuclear, on a grid you wire yourself.

3463690.title: Sojourn Saga
3463690.short_description: Sable and his party are trapped in a town nobody can leave. A retro turn-based roguelite JRPG inspired by Lufia II’s Ancient Cave: build your party, raise evolving Foomy companions, master gear and ornament combinations, and delve into the ever-shifting Warren to find answers.

3464040.title: HOLE WAR -The Abyss-
3464040.short_description: 「今こそ語りましょう。『もしも』の物語を……！」本作は、「職」と「食」から力を得て戦う長編RPGの体験版です。時には職業を変えて新たなスキルや能力を得て、時には料理を食べて一時的なバフを得て冒険しましょう。

3464360.title: tower sequence KNIGHT LOBSTER
3464360.short_description: YOU WILL LOSE EVERYTHING. YOU WILL GAIN EVERYTHING. THIS WORLD WILL REACH PEACE, AT ANY COST. YOU MUST REACH THE TOP. YOU MUST REACH THE TOP. THIS WORLD WILL REACH PEACE, AT ANY COST. YOU MUST REACH THE TOP. YOU MUST REACH THE TOP. THIS WORLD WILL REACH PEACE, AT ANY COST. YOU MUST REACH THE TOP.

3464710.title: Tiny Bomber
3464710.short_description: Survive the countdown in a fast-paced vertical bullet-hell roguelite. Collect coins to extend your run, graze bullets for aircraft-specific boosts, build wild upgrade combos, turn defeated bosses into companion drones, tweak map spawns, and team up in 2-player co-op to push toward the final boss!

3465440.title: CitaDrill
3465440.short_description: Captain a giant drill-city in this roguelite citybuilder. Dig deep into an infested planet, collect resources, expand your city under the dome, upgrade your drill, and protect yourself against waves of fearsome creatures together with your mettle and paw-some cat crew.

3466240.title: Valkyrie Iteration: Mecha Pilot Raising Pocket Simulator
3466240.short_description: Step into the role of a technomaster in Valkyrie Iteration, a sci-fi visual novel. Train and guide Lana, a young pilot, and her sentient mech, the Valkyrie, as they prepare for high-stakes battles against otherworldly foes.

3466530.title: Hathor's Peak
3466530.short_description: Hathor's Peak is a roguelike solitaire, reach the needed score before being out of cards. Progress through the levels, some of which will be boss battles that impose special rules and require you to use your action cards wisely.

3468090.title: Wanderdawn
3468090.short_description: Explore various worlds in a hack-and-slash action game - In a world ravaged by an unknown disaster, face various monsters with the diverse weapons you find.

3468800.title: Warmongers: Empires Reborn
3468800.short_description: A single player RPG inspired by oldschool MMORPGs created by a Solo dev. Play as an Orc, Saurak or Human. Explore an open world, complete quests and fight your way through dungeons and raids. Master all of your gathering and crafting skills.

3468900.title: Flow of Fortune
3468900.short_description: Build fortunes in a digital board game of economy, strategy, and no violence. Manage time, expand businesses, and shape your success.

3469350.title: High Mountain Abbey
3469350.short_description: Do you dare to meddle with the mad god? High Mountain Abbey is a stop-motion point-and-click puzzle game that throws you into a strange space. Navigate hand-crafted and photographed dioramas and solve trippy mechanical challenges to contain the forces of madness that have swallowed the abbey.

3469760.title: Click Click Chicken
3469760.short_description: A short incremental game about catching chickens, pigs, cows and sheep.

3470100.title: 气运之子The One of Fortune
3470100.short_description: Step into the mysterious and boundless world of Chinese-style fantasy. Gather the mysterious power of destiny. You can either assume the role of the revered leader of the righteous path, or transform into the powerful Demon Lord of the evil path.

3470490.title: Mindbreak
3470490.short_description: Mindbreak is an exploration driven tile-based puzzle adventure game about the escape from a corrupted insane asylum. Play as the supernaturally gifted asylum patients as you build and combine their unique abilities to explore and master the vast interconnected asylum.

3470500.title: Ember and Blade
3470500.short_description: Become the immortal hunter and stand against the archdemon Asmodeus. Cut through bullet-hell swarms, clash with Souls-like bosses, and harness celestial blessings that reshape your powers each run. The demons are rising—raise your sword.

3470690.title: Warlocks Maze
3470690.short_description: A Warlock has unleashed chaos upon the World of Eld! Lead a band of heroes into his shifting labyrinth in this brutal turn-based dungeon crawler. Outsmart deadly foes, conquer traps, and adapt to ever-changing challenges. Will you emerge victorious or be lost to the maze forever?

3470850.title: Void Martyrs
3470850.short_description: A grimdark survival horror about a nun in space. Scavenge amongst the drifting space-Basilica, balance your faith with survival, and craft the tools of your salvation.

3473440.title: Sparrow Warfare
3473440.short_description: Play ever-crazier combinations of 3 tiles to free the birds in our synergy-rich deckbuilder. Let your mind take flight as you scheme and strategise. This… is Sparrow Warfare!

3473710.title: DARK IN LIGHT
3473710.short_description: A man who falls asleep while working late wakes up in an unfamiliar city overrun by monsters. Survive with limited resources and explore the city by following clues through the darkness. You must press on to make it back to the son waiting for you.

3474240.title: Dracula: The Disciple
3474240.short_description: To cheat death, you must uncover the secrets hidden within Count Dracula’s castle. Only by mastering the occult arts and solving mystical puzzles can you save yourself. Eternal life comes at a price!

3474260.title: Perfect Sword
3474260.short_description: Create Your Very Own "Perfect Sword"! Immerse yourself in the life of a medieval blacksmith. Take charge of every step in the forging process. Every detail has been meticulously recreated to provide you with a truly immersive experience.

3474620.title: EXONAUTIS
3474620.short_description: Crashlanded on Calliope 4348A, your objective is to navigate the vast oceanic biomes, survive and construct your vehicles and bases to dive deeper and uncover the mysteries behind the disappearance of the Kappa crew.

3474670.title: Non-Euclidean Design
3474670.short_description: Design your home in the non-Euclidean world.

3474890.title: SuperCitycon
3474890.short_description: A city builder with a retro-inspired look and the freedom to shape your world. Build roads, railways and entire neighborhoods in a creative sandbox. Customize buildings, vehicles and more with SCC Studio, the in-game voxel editor, and share your creations through Steam Workshop.

3475070.title: Arrow & Fang
3475070.short_description: Take on the role of Lena Morwyn. Explore, slash and shoot arrows in this action-adventure title.

3475130.title: Immortal Boy
3475130.short_description: A 2.5D Turn-Based RPG where you battle enemies with Minigames! - And also emotional abuse.

3475190.title: Death Fortress
3475190.short_description: "Death Fortress" is an action Rogue lite game. You wake up from the darkness and kill in the darkness. The super refreshing hack-and-slash experience brings endless fear to this desperate world.

3475450.title: TohoKids
3475450.short_description: Shinjuku doesn't forgive. A village panda chasing neon lights. Join the legendary TohoKids, hack your enemies, and remember: here, your data is worth more than your life. How far will you go to avoid becoming just "meat for the slaughter"?

3475880.title: Train Goes Right
3475880.short_description: A cozy physics based railroad simulator where you chop trees, drive trains, transport materials, and build track one rail at a time in the early steam age. The goal is simple: go right.

3476980.title: Parthas
3476980.short_description: Parthas is a first-person survival adventure set in a reimagined mythological world inspired by european folklore.

3477450.title: Kaizen Kitchen: A Restaurant Simulator
3477450.short_description: Open a restaurant in the heart of a cozy little Japanese town. Cook authentic Japanese dishes, serve hungry customers, and decorate your restaurant however you like. Take part in local events and become the town’s most popular restaurant!

3478990.title: NecroMerc
3478990.short_description: Play as X a mercenary whose job is being replaced by robots and is reskilling into necromancy.

3479370.title: Deck & Defense
3479370.short_description: Tower Defense, deckbuilder and roguelite where strategy meets action. Summon allies, cast devastating spells, and upgrade your tower! Create powerful card combinations to stop waves of enemies in this unique fantasy defence game.

3480620.title: Super Magic Book
3480620.short_description: The legendary Grand Mage Jeruf is hailed as the most exceptional mage in history, with his masterpiece recognized as the ultimate grimoire in magical arts - the Super Magic Book. In the game, players will take on the role of Lucy to uncover the hidden secrets within the Super Magic Book.

3481370.title: Firewheels Shop Simulator
3481370.short_description: Co-Op Firewheels Shop Simulator lets you manage a diecast model store. Organize shelves, assist customers, and expand your shop in a detailed, realistic world. Hunt for rare and chase cars, trade with customers, and grow your diecast empire.

3481580.title: Spin Power
3481580.short_description: A short incremental building game where everything functions with your Spin Power. Build structures, mine resources, unlock new lands, upgrade yourself inside the big skill tree, automate resource mining to increase your income and awake the mysterious water tank from eternal slumber!

3481840.title: Escape from Planet Pan: Scam Center
3481840.short_description: A fake job offer traps you inside the notorious Planet Pan Scam Center. Enduring daily abuse from guards, you are forced to scam strangers into fake investments while secretly planning an escape. A unique Butterfly Effect system brings past characters into future runs so you can change their fate.

3482200.title: Trucker 2056
3482200.short_description: The year is 2056. Democracy is a memory. The highways of future Finland are controlled by the fascistic Institute. Embark on a perilous journey to find medicine for your dying daughter. A high-octane adventure inspired by classics such as X-COM, Space Rogue, and Pirates!

3484010.title: Immortum
3484010.short_description: A story-driven sci-fi horror inspired by classic horror. Trapped in a decaying spaceship, escape mind-bending traps, navigate shifting realities, solve puzzles, and uncover an impossible truth — as Romi, a mother desperate to find her dying child. Can you discover the truth before you’re erased?

3484520.title: ODDLI: A satisfying game
3484520.short_description: ODDLI is a casual puzzle game about creating satisfying loops. Solve moving puzzles where the only obstacle is your past self. Reach the goal with your character, avoid your previous movements and watch it repeat your path. Continue reaching goals, while creating mesmerizing choreographies!

3484960.title: Ultakia
3484960.short_description: Ultakia is a turn-based space 4X strategy game with distinctive resource management. Explore exotic systems and acquire powerful technologies. Exploit your planets, trade with other races and destroy those who stand in your way.

3485200.title: Whatever It Takes
3485200.short_description: Whatever It Takes is a hardcore first-person Action RPG in a dark fantasy setting. As a fallen god, master elemental magic, absorb enemy powers, and engage in tactical duels. Use a harpoon for traversal and shape the Omnisphere’s fate through your choices. Reclaim your throne. Whatever it takes.

3485290.title: Crimson Tale
3485290.short_description: Crimson Tale is a short first-person narrative puzzle game where Elizabeth uses blood magic and vampire powers to defy the oppressive nobility. Avoid sunlight, travel through time, and hunt the Golden Guard to end their reign.

3485410.title: Chef of Sherwood
3485410.short_description: Will you take from the poor to feed the rich? A satirical cooking & management game where choices matter. As Prince John’s new cook, scrounge ingredients from the population by day, serve lavish feasts to a spoiled royal family by night, and decide who pays the price: the people, the crown… or you.

3485990.title: Memoridian
3485990.short_description: Special knights and explorers that study and fight against the dangerous creatures called Memories. These are dangerous creatures that one day started showing up one by one. Uncover the truth about their origin while protecting your town.

3486000.title: Starcatcher
3486000.short_description: Wish upon the starry sky for the power to slay your enemies in this hack 'n' slash action roguelite.

3486200.title: Shift Happens
3486200.short_description: Ever wanted to live out the American dream of working an abysmal 9–5 with rude management? No? Well too bad, I made a game about it anyway. Shift Happens is a first-person experience where you order stock, fill shelves, and keep the store running. The job is simple. Enjoy your shift.

3486420.title: Road To School
3486420.short_description: Road to School is a physics-based parkour platformer where you ride a bicycle up a treacherous mountain. Jump, balance, and explore hidden paths while tackling brutal challenges on your journey to school. Play alone or with friends in a co-op experience.

3486500.title: Aftershock
3486500.short_description: When your own mind becomes the enemy, can you protect the one who matters most?

3486940.title: The Last Liftboy
3486940.short_description: Being a liftboy is easy… until it’s not. After thirty years, a letter brings Ted Grady back to the Hôtel Grand Valmont. The hotel is barely breathing. Carry luggage, run the elevator, restore the rooms — and save the place that made him.

3487410.title: Idle Circles
3487410.short_description: Relax and watch your marbles fill circle after circle. Make strategic improvements then unwind in this retro futurist, idle arcade game.

3488620.title: Birdoo
3488620.short_description: Birdoo: Feathered Fury is an indie action game were you assume the role of a bird embarking on a quest for revenge against the humans who wronged him. No longer will you tolerate being called a "flying rat" or being shooed away. It's time to exact your revenge!

3488670.title: Villainville
3488670.short_description: Join the outcasts of Villainville in this cozy farming sim adventure where Stardew Valley meets Shrek. Grow magic crops, tame the tiny unicorns, sneak into the night market, and befriend misfit fairy tale characters. Bonus? Find the misery mushroom plague saboteur and redeem the irredeemable.

3488740.title: Red & Blue
3488740.short_description: Play as two housecats causing chaos while their owners are gone! Jump on each other, get chained to each other, and help each other solve color-coded puzzles.

3489210.title: What Lies Within
3489210.short_description: What Lies Within is a co-op first person psychological horror. You and your team must work together to complete objectives within abandoned facilities owned by your employer, 'M-E-L'. A bioengineering company conducting top secret biological experimentation on aliens, humans and more...

3489220.title: Kkokko Industry
3489220.short_description: Kkokko Industry is a relaxing idle game where you manage a chicken farm. The game runs on one side of your monitor, allowing you to enjoy it comfortably while working on other tasks.

3489450.title: Ashcrown Gauntlet
3489450.short_description: A dark-fantasy roguelite of turn-based, three-on-three battles, played out in a living book. Your mercenaries share one pool of energy. Beat challengers to keep them for good, steal their abilities, and climb a ladder of crowns where every boss plays by its own rules.

3490700.title: EVAC
3490700.short_description: EVAC is the Worlds Greatest Helicopter Game. Fly explosive combat missions, high-speed races, rescue missions, and a variety of utility operations.

3490730.title: Fuzz & Dizzy: Part-Time Heroes
3490730.short_description: Fuzz & Dizzy: Part-Time Heroes is a charismatic turn-based RPG with platforming elements where you control two characters simultaneously. Together, you’ll journey through a colorful, lively world packed with humor, secrets, and interactive combat.

3490760.title: Song of Maka
3490760.short_description: Enter the wholesome Kingdom of Birds in Song of Maka. As a newborn bird, explore beautiful sky islands through song and flight. Uncover charming stories, hatch adorable companions, or simply relax to soothing melodies and breathtaking views.

3490880.title: The Great World of Time and Space
3490880.short_description: Chrono Realm is a 2D pixel-art open-world RPG. Explore a vast fantasy continent, command contract summons, master arcane arts and combat techniques, collect a comprehensive encyclopedia of all things, and forge your own legend across space and time.

3490910.title: Agent Panda
3490910.short_description: You are Agent Panda - a fearless detective trying to solve the mystery of Puzzle Islands. You must solve many puzzles and interview many quirky witnesses in order to find the mastermind! Who has been setting up all the puzzles? A light-hearted detective puzzle game with character.

3491640.title: Mindbound
3491640.short_description: Mindbound is a short single-player horror game that revolves around uncovering what has happened. After a business trip, Marty returns home eagerly anticipating seeing his wife and daughter. But, things turn out differently than expected. The game emphasizes a deep atmosphere.

3492110.title: GOP POST
3492110.short_description: It's 2090. GOPPOST is a co-op Papers Please-style game about defending a MEGA-TOWER. You and your GOP-SQUAD must hold the stairwell check papers, keep the beer flowing, and stop whatever's crawling up from below. Will you survive the shift?

3493100.title: Tetrabonk
3493100.short_description: Tetrabonk is a 1–4 player co-op roguelike. Explore procedurally generated locations, fight with swords, bows, or firearms against hordes of enemies and powerful bosses, and build your character through upgrade cards — no run is ever the same.

3493230.title: 悪夢祓いのアリス
3493230.short_description: Defeat enemies in a real-time card battle using magical energy that builds over time. Unlike turn-based games, enjoy the dynamic thrill of real-time strategy. Adapt to a constantly changing deck and discover your own optimal solutions.

3493730.title: Hot Stuff
3493730.short_description: Hot Stuff is a casual action oriented party game, with procedural elements and simple controls, suitable for different types of players to quickly pick up and play together, achieving cooperation within the chaos.

3498110.title: Love Notes
3498110.short_description: Love Notes is a romance game that can be completed in ??? minutes.

3498500.title: STENCH
