3498500.short_description: STENCH is a story-driven life-sim RPG set in the 80s. A strange diagnosis brings you to the city. Live day by day, make weird friends, earn money, roam the city, and fight clueless thugs, while a conspiracy grows in the shadows.

3498720.title: Rain98
3498720.short_description: Tokyo, 1998. A rain that never ends and a girl who wants everything to end. Two lonely youths will change the world with their choices.

3500430.title: The Depths of Duskraven Manor
3500430.short_description: First-person dungeon crawling meets turn-based horror. Lead five fugitives into the depths of a cursed manor—and survive what’s waiting below.

3500460.title: Above Land: Rhapsody
3500460.short_description: A chaotic 1-3 player co-op action roguelite above the clouds. Grab a toy. Save the world.

3501850.title: Echoes of the Outworlder
3501850.short_description: Explore a shattered land in this isekai Metroidvania, mastering fluid movement, battling monsters, clashing with Outworlders, and uncovering the truth behind a world on the edge of collapse.

3502310.title: SYNCO PATH: AUTOMATON PRISON
3502310.short_description: Trapped in a surreal prison cell, Avery Stardust, a rogue automaton, has only 17 days to enter his reset code and accept a new life as determined by the Stagnation Protocol. But when the mystery of the SYNCO PATH program unravels, Avery will question everything he believes to be true.

3502940.title: Rage of the Elder Gods
3502940.short_description: Rage of the Elder Gods is a turn-based tactical game blending board game mechanics with RPG elements. Hunt down fanatical cults across the mythical locations of H.P. Lovecraft’s universe. Face cosmic horror and survive the madness!

3503500.title: Appa
3503500.short_description: Appa is a surreal narrative-driven card battler about two siblings dealing with the death of their father. Predict, counter, and outmaneuver manifestations of grief while uncovering a heartfelt story somewhere between dreams and reality.

3503690.title: Dark Omen
3503690.short_description: Push back the encroaching darkness and the Architect's foul designs, then return to rebuild your village and reunite its people. Forge powerful artifacts and arrange mystical Omens to shape your next build as you battle relentless hordes and bosses in this low-poly Action RPG Roguelite.

3503810.title: 「TERROR」type:【A.L.C.H.E.M.Y.】
3503810.short_description: 「TERROR」type:【A.L.C.H.E.M.Y.】is a stealth-action immersive sim about resistance, redemption, A.L.C.H.E.M.Y. explosions. Craft potions and bombs to sabotage a tyrannical regime. Master forbidden alchemy, navigate a vertically-layered city in stealth, and ignite a revolution.

3504290.title: The Witch's Realm
3504290.short_description: Escape and explore a mystery puzzle adventure where you must manage sanity, solve challenges, and uncover the dark secrets of a cursed town. Navigate eerie environments, find hidden objects, and survive the witch's realm.

3504310.title: Ghost Sector
3504310.short_description: Ghost Sector is a survival horror game where you play as M-07, a prototype machine trapped in a cybernetic facility during lockdown. Outwit the automated defenses, search for answers uncovering secrets, solving puzzles, and upgrade your abilities while preserving your finite energy.

3504340.title: SORROW: Rise of Divinity
3504340.short_description: An open-world action survival game combining fast-paced battle royale, competitive deathmatches, trophy hunting, and intense missions—where strategy and skill determine your fate.

3504400.title: Blade of Mercy: Bloody Countess
3504400.short_description: Blade of Mercy: Bloody Countess is a 2D action with metroidvania elements set in a 16th-century fantasy world, drawn with cozy pixels. Explore a mysterious realm, battle ruthless enemies, and uncover powerful weapons and abilities. And remember: beer is the best medicine in these grim times!

3505320.title: 十品芝麻官
3505320.short_description: Strange History Mystery is a HD2D ancient style pixel role-playing + reasoning and decryption game. Players will play the role of the newly appointed county magistrate Bao Cheng, and seek the truth in the treacherous officialdom and confusing cases, and find their own "way to be an official".

3505400.title: LETS GO HUNTING
3505400.short_description: Hunt silly animals with up to 3 friends in a colourful low-poly world. Track them down, drag the loot home on a sled or in a truck, sell it at camp, upgrade your gear and take on the mighty Wolpertinger King.

3506470.title: Little Woody
3506470.short_description: Little Woody is a 2D point-and-click puzzle adventure where you guide a small wooden soul through a mysterious world of shifting environments. Meet unusual companions along the way, solve handcrafted logic puzzles, explore atmospheric locations and uncover a forgotten past.

3506740.title: In Banjiha
3506740.short_description: It is a first-person horror game. Escape the damp, dark semi-basement. Overcome your fear and find a way out.

3508560.title: Hallow Maze
3508560.short_description: Hallow maze is a soulslike metroidvania set in a gothic world in 2D. Use transformations into different creatures to open your way, as well as incredible tools of energy. Discover the origin of the scourge that is infecting the lands of the Evernight Valley and venture into The Hallow Maze...

3508900.title: Cereal Reaper
3508900.short_description: Cereal Reaper is a top-down turn-based RPG with a heavy focus on exploration. Talk and fight your way into finding the greatest breakfast item of all time.

3509340.title: Clean
3509340.short_description: Every room has something to hide.

3509380.title: GrimKeep
3509380.short_description: GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder in a nightmare fairytale. Find items, roll your dice, and optimize your build to fire off massive damage. Cut through the horrors in the cursed city to get to the Princess. Then end her.

3509420.title: Planetbase 2
3509420.short_description: Colonize the Solar System. Command a group of near-future humans trying to establish a base on Mars and beyond. Grow food, mine resources, manufacture goods and face the challenges these unforgiving worlds will throw at you.

3510360.title: Ethereal: Clash of Souls
3510360.short_description: Ethereal is a 6v6 third-person MOBA featuring a first-of-its-kind class system and extreme vertical lane design. Fly, climb, teleport, and destroy as you push lanes to defeat the enemy Elder. Play Early Access for exclusive skins, premium currency, monthly patches, and direct dev feedback.

3510530.title: SANGRA
3510530.short_description: Classic survival horror with a modern feel. Solve puzzles, search for items, manage your inventory, and pray you'll return to the safe room alive in this decaying twisted facility consumed by a mysterious metallic corruption.

3511010.title: Cursed Bloodline
3511010.short_description: A narrative psychological horror where past and present slowly blur inside a remote house. The line between memory and reality is gone.

3511730.title: 終末メイドロイド
3511730.short_description: A choice-type adventure novel game in which the ending is determined by the percentage of parts recovered from the “receive,” “don't receive,” and “take” options.

3511850.title: Hell Worlds Reinvigorated
3511850.short_description: A necromantic named Cyris leaves his homeworld for a strange odyssey through unknown realms, each one more horrible and bizarre than the next. Use your necromancer abilities to save the earth realm in this retro FPS filled to the brim with fantasy & mystery.

3512280.title: WILDERLOCKE
3512280.short_description: WILDERLOCKE is a tactical monster-taming roguelike. Build up a team of diverse & powerful monsters. Find the perfect combinations of moves, passives & stats to create devastating synergies. Triumph in increasingly challenging 2v2 turn-based battles and become unstoppable.

3512720.title: Unmasked Truths: Shattered Dreams
3512720.short_description: 10 world-renowned experts are trapped together and must cooperate to survive... until conflicts arise, and they discover the greatest threat to their lives isn't the system they're resisting: it's each other! Discover the truth of who's living a lie in this fully voiced murder mystery adventure.

3513120.title: YAKOH SHINOBI OPS
3513120.short_description: Four ninjas speed through the darkness, moving as one to fulfill their mission. YAKOH: This is the way of the ninja—a mission undertaken by the shadows known as Shinobi. A new-generation cooperative Shinobi stealth action game brought by ACQUIRE Corp. and SHUEISHA GAMES.

3513580.title: PLEASE KNOCK: The Sloppy Researcher's Life
3513580.short_description: PLEASE KNOCK: The Sloppy Researcher’s Life is a top-down story adventure game about an unusual research life between a sloppy senior student and a helpful junior.

3514400.title: Prism Warriors DX
3514400.short_description: The Prism Warriors return for another helping of retro-styled bullet hell action. Face off against the sinister Twilight Four, and fight to save more than just your friends...

3515120.title: 雨中的生命之歌
3515120.short_description: 《雨中的生命之歌》 是以虚拟主播社团ReliveProject其附属世界观扩展而来的一款视觉小说游戏

3515160.title: Carcade
3515160.short_description: CARCADE is a fast-paced racing game with a bold art style by ICONIC GARAGE. Compete in time trials, race against ghost opponents, AI, or real players. Tune your car for different terrains, master hidden mechanics, and unlock secret achievements. Speed, strategy, and skill will define your victory!

3515450.title: Duoshift
3515450.short_description: Defend The Wall on the tactical grid using your pair of Battle Vehicles called Duoshifters. Outmaneuver waves of scavenged war machines, unleash game-breaking hacks and chain synergies. Draft, fight, and survive in this endlessly replayable tactical roguelite.

3515660.title: Just a simulation
3515660.short_description: Just a Simulation is a futuristic strategy game where you master a vast arsenal of weapons, upgrade your tools, and dismantle enemy systems. Go in guns blazing or hack your way to victory.

3516350.title: BENBOWARS
3516350.short_description: FIGHT or KILL your way thru a world under attack by THE EVIL SKELETON ARMY—Episodic 2D+ Super Action Platforminger Adventurevania—The Most Indie Game Ever Made—

3516460.title: Shoot for the Moon
3516460.short_description: Shoot your spear at flying creatures, feed them to the monster beneath your feet, and grow big enough to escape the forest in this fully-voiced arcade action platformer!

3517740.title: Frostrail
3517740.short_description: Through the frost, death follows the tracks. Dive into a ruthless survival FPS, solo or co-op. Explore, scavenge, craft and fight to endure a frozen, corrupted world. Operate and upgrade your steam-powered train through an unforgiving wasteland, where every choice is a matter of survival.

3517880.title: Clawsome
3517880.short_description: Help Clawby find unique friends in this wholesome adventure! Collect cute figurines with the help of Clawby to create colorful dioramas in this cozy claw machine game.

3518470.title: Roughly Crafted
3518470.short_description: Roughly Crafted is a laid-back crafting shop sim with a comedy story and creative freedom. Iron makes a fine sword. So do watermelons, zombie fingers and other things never meant to be weapons. Figure out what customers need, and haggle over every coin while your uncle runs his business schemes.

3520410.title: 10hit
3520410.short_description: With the ability to hijack the minds of anyone who answers a phone call, "0" builds an army of remote controlled assassins to overthrow his twin brother, "1" as standing president.

3520490.title: Dragon Defense
3520490.short_description: Dragon Defense is an action-packed, wave-based defense strategy game where you must build, craft, and protect your island from relentless monster invasions.

3520750.title: Hardkill System
3520750.short_description: Take control of a powerful mech in this hardcore roguelite mech shooter where every projectile is simulated and hit angle makes all the difference.

3520800.title: GraviTech
3520800.short_description: In this 3D puzzle you will need to turn your perception of the world. After all, the actions of the game take place in the laboratory on the study of gravity changes. Forget about the attraction to the ground.

3521810.title: Team Buddies
3521810.short_description: A fast-paced action and strategy game where you build teams, craft weapons, and destroy enemy bases in intense online and campaign battles.

3522240.title: Overrun Protocol
3522240.short_description: OVERRUN PROTOCOL is a solo survival game where you face hostile machines on a mysterious island. Explore, hack systems, craft weapons, and uncover the secrets of an out-of-control AI. Your survival will depend on your ingenuity and adaptability.

3522540.title: Death of a Dungslinger
3522540.short_description: Abruptly reincarnated as a dung beetle, you’ll battle a colorful cast of the neighborhood’s baddest bugs as you scoot, scuttle, and shoot your way through charming 3D worlds. Ball up whatever material you can find, then sling it at your foes—or hop on and ride it around to outmaneuver them!

3522860.title: Project Enceladus
3522860.short_description: Fourteen scientists dead aboard a station orbiting Enceladus. One survivor: the killer, who encrypted all the data and went silent. Enter his mind, gather evidence, expose his false memories and uncover why. A first-person psychological sci-fi investigation with logic puzzles.

3524050.title: Creature Containment
3524050.short_description: Creature Containment is a hardcore base-building Action RPG. As a fresh Militia Commander, you've been tasked with infiltrating and wiping out an underground goblin infestation. Manage your base, equip your Operators, and fight hordes of creatures in the depths below...

3526420.title: Rebels of the Realm
3526420.short_description: Grab your friends, pick your class, and raid dungeons in this lighthearted co-op fantasy RPG, where chaotic spells and hilariously bad ragdoll deaths keep the realm unpredictable.

3526870.title: Vizarri
3526870.short_description: A monster-taming RPG set on the planet of Valaar. Capture and train mystical creatures known by the locals as Vizarri. Battle other trainers in tactical, turn-based combat on a dynamic grid. Explore islands, collect items, and outsmart a rising enemy force. These are the Adventures of Valaar.

3527030.title: Mister Gato Idle - The Meowsiah
3527030.short_description: Mister Gato Idle is an idle and incremental game where you can play minigames for rewards. There are no red dots, no ads, no P2W, no daily tasks, no MTX! Find unique items that change your gameplay, choose what randomly generated skills you use. Play the minigames Banjo Hero and Grand Theft Meowto!

3529010.title: Blood Curse Legions
3529010.short_description: This is a RTS game where you primarily control cavalry units in battle. Utilize the vampire's abilities to command in battle, develop unique vampire heroes based on the game's evolving situation, and form a powerful Blood Curse Legion to dominate the world and establish a vampire nation.

3529110.title: Bushcraft Survival
3529110.short_description: In this realistic bushcraft survival sim, a helicopter drops you in a frozen forest with what you packed. Build a shelter from logs and moss and keep your fire alive. Fish through the ice and keep your food away from bears. Survive the days you planned, then fly home and unlock new tools.

3529930.title: The Great Tribes
3529930.short_description: Blending the best of classic and modern 4X strategy! Lead humanity from nomadic tribes to space conquest. Shape the land, mix cultures, and forge your own laws. Face a fair AI system, which learns and explores the world just as you do.

3530110.title: Once Upon a Knight
3530110.short_description: Once Upon a Knight is a single-player adventure game with an isometric view, focused on exploration and combat. Control a hero, face enemies, overcome challenges, and master shifting perspectives as you progress using keyboard, mouse, or controller.

3530740.title: Die Meeple
3530740.short_description: Die Meeple is a roguelite dice deckbuilder where classic board games have risen in revolt. Reclaim forgotten boards, battle their rebellious pieces, and unlock new dice, upgrades, and artifacts.

3531170.title: GAL BOCCHI
3531170.short_description: GAL BOCCHI is an internet artist simulator ADV where you control the dogshit female artist “aimisu_u” and become the legendary artist she so desperately wants to become! All the time left for the not-so-young-anymore aimisu_u to escape reality for her dream is…drum roll…1 single year!

3531220.title: MECHBORN
3531220.short_description: A fresh roguelike deckbuilder where YOUR MECH IS YOUR DECK – With 7 cards always in play on a conveyor belt victory is down to skill and not luck. Master pilot skills and unlock Mech parts to reveal powerful cards, as you carve your path across 3 ever-changing continents to repel the Kaiju invasion.

3532640.title: Waste Force
3532640.short_description: <Waste Force> is a post-apocalyptic PvE extraction shooter. Drive a garbage truck with your crew and survive oncoming mutants and scavengers. Repair the vehicle during chases and collect resources. Connect special trailers to complete your own vehicle. Cleanse the surface as part of Waste Force!

3533430.title: Newtone's Gospel
3533430.short_description: Newtone's Gospel is a top-down roguelike shooter. Unlike typical Survivors-likes, it is more about exploring huge procedurally generated maps, planning your route, turning limited resources into more resources and finally into increasingly powerful builds.

3533500.title: Leaforia
3533500.short_description: Run your own farm, craft unique items, and battle your way to success. Pay off your debt to the city, befriend the locals, and maybe even find true love. Raise animals, train your loyal dog, and ride across the land on horseback.

3534090.title: Dealicious
3534090.short_description: Dealicious is a cooking-themed kitchen management deck-builder card game. Discover and stack cards together to cook meals, manage your kitchen space and expand eventually hiring staff as you grow your empire. Discover unique cards which offer special abilities/bonuses! Can you collect them all?

3534150.title: POSTAL 2 VR
3534150.short_description: POSTAL 2 VR lets you loose in the most chaotic sandbox shooter ever, fully reimagined for VR. Survive a week in Paradise, Arizona—buy milk, return books, or go completely POSTAL with an arsenal of absurd weapons and unpredictable NPCs. The choice is yours…but good luck staying out of trouble.

3534490.title: Axelball
3534490.short_description: Blast off in a battle of physics with AXELBALL. With 2 player local shared keyboard controls this game is ready to play right on your keyboard against your friends, coworkers or siblings right away. Rocket speeds with real-time physics strategy will bring the fun right to your home or workplace.

3534650.title: Jet Birds
3534650.short_description: A challenging, physics-based, 3D platformer where you fly jetpack-powered birds through ring circuits suspended through nature. Not a casual flying game or a flight simulator, but a precision platformer that demands (and rewards) determination and practice.

3535030.title: Sweets & Dragons
3535030.short_description: Sweets & Dragons is a simulation game of maid cafe management in another world. The player becomes the owner of a maid cafe, and while managing the shop and training beautiful maid androids, collects money and grows the shop.

3535170.title: Lumoryn: Whispering Worlds
3535170.short_description: Lumoryn: Whispering Worlds is an MMO of true rarity. Unique quests, permanent NPC deaths, unpredictable bosses, evolving worlds, and legendary items only one player can claim. Knowledge, not grind, shapes the world.

3535210.title: Stealer
3535210.short_description: Platformer with elements of metroidvania. Begin your adventure as a thief who is immersed in darkness. Use your lantern to explore eerie locations, search for clues, and interact with surrounding objects to uncover secrets and achieve your goals.

3535320.title: Memories Of Zattera
3535320.short_description: Memories of Zattera is a visual novel that merges fantasy and science fiction. Explore moral and political dilemmas from multiple viewpoints as tradition, progress and freedom collide. Will you see the world the same once all truths are revealed?

3535730.title: Kiki's Nightmare
3535730.short_description: An adventure RPG where you step in the shoes of a fearless hero. Navigate through unhospitable terrain, fierce enemies and save Kiki from her own terrifying dream!

3535870.title: Bayaya
3535870.short_description: A story-driven fairytale adventure about Prince Bayaya. Explore village life, help with simple work, and experience the beginning of a larger fairytale journey.

3537960.title: Puppeteer: No Strings Attached
3537960.short_description: In a world controlled by strings, YOU are not attached. Fight your way through champions of ancient fairy tales in this action packed boss-rush game, escape the grip of The Puppeteer, and write your own ending.

3539480.title: Back of Beyond
3539480.short_description: Eldritch cult meets roguelite deckbuilding. Something stirs in a misty town... Recruit cute animal townsfolk, build your cult's deck, and grow your secret cult. Place buildings, pair them with townsfolk, and turn faith and devotion into forbidden power. Can you resist the Eldritch Gods' corruption?

3539880.title: Alchemia Rogue: Mia and the Mystery Labyrinth
3539880.short_description: Join Mia, an apprentice alchemist, in the Alchemy Roguelike RPG. Alchemy brings new layers of strategy to traditional grid-based, turn-based roguelike gameplay. Gather materials, transmute them into powerful items, and conquer the dungeon!

3540180.title: TabletKid Activity Book
3540180.short_description: A growing collection of animated, interactive pop-up books set in a cozy playroom space filled with hidden minigames. Point-and-click to explore the library: grab books to read, play with the busy board, and find other surprises. Intended for kids ages 3-5.

3541100.title: DigSite: Archeology in Egypt
3541100.short_description: DigSite is open-world archeology sandbox game located in Egypt where you dig, clean and document artifacts you find. Donate rare artifacts to a museum and build your legacy as a legendary archeologist.

3541140.title: BattleSail
3541140.short_description: Fight pirate ships in turn-based naval battles during the Golden Age of Piracy. Earn gold, hunt hidden treasures, lead your fleet through a story campaign, and challenge friends in local and online multiplayer.

3541320.title: Scarlet Hunt
3541320.short_description: Dive into a world of fleeting hope in this thrilling dark romance visual novel! Feel the fear, survive the hunt and navigate through danger on a daunting quest for freedom.

3541820.title: Galactic Space Guard
3541820.short_description: Galactic Space Guard is a turn-based tactics game. Lead your squad of elite soldiers to defend humanity’s space stations, upgrade your squad, prepare for battle, and restore peace across the galaxy!

3542850.title: ATTENTION DEFICIT - A story about ADHD
3542850.short_description: An abstract visual novel about a girl dealing with the challenges of having ADHD while trying to complete a school assignment before the deadline.

3542870.title: Ecosystem Architect
3542870.short_description: What happens when an elephant shares its habitat with a Spinosaurus? Design ecosystems with nearly 50 species of plants and animals, shape the land, and balance predators and prey in a science-inspired simulation where every creature lives, hunts, and raises a family of its own.

3543370.title: μ of the M World
3543370.short_description: 魔王としてこの世に生まれたのに、すでに世界は壊れていた。主人公の μ は何かを壊す事で、何もない世界の中から一つずつ大切な感情を手に入れていく。過去の正義を遡る3Dアドベンチャー『μ of the M World』は連載型のアクションゲーム。物語とアクションを同時に進めていくこのゲームは、無料アップデートで徐々に世界が広がっていきます。

3543400.title: Knightstones
3543400.short_description: Build your medieval Order in this atmospheric autobattler. Deploy your elite warriors on the war table, face off against the mighty Lords of the Inquisition, and invest your rewards to rebuild your fallen Order. Be prepared… or perish in the final battle.

3543620.title: Wiz Hunter
3543620.short_description: Wiz Hunter is a rogue-lite deckbuilding card game. Embark on a deadly quest to hunt down wizards through strategic, turn-based combat. Kill, die, learn, repeat.

3543940.title: Aspiel: Edge Of Chaos
3543940.short_description: Aspiel: Edge of Chaos is a third-person fantasy Action-RPG. Explore numerous locations ravaged by the dark power of Death, face various creatures consumed by Chaos, and harness the power of Life to save the continent of Aspiel.

3544060.title: Farol del Diablo (Devil's Lantern)
3544060.short_description: Our protagonist ventures into a dark, abandoned village in search of the treasures said to be guarded by the mysterious Luz Mala. Before long, what began as a quest for riches turns into a desperate fight for survival as she unravels a dark conspiracy that has remained hidden for years.

3545250.title: Imperial Bureaucracy Hero
3545250.short_description: IBH is a rich role playing game at the end of time. You're a mid-level official in a dying sci-fi regime, given the impossible task of fixing a faltering machine; explore a vast world, define your mind, flex your authority, and become a sinner or a savior in countless other stories.

3545590.title: Salary-Mon | Hiro Versus His Demons
3545590.short_description: Help Japanese Salaryman Hiro overcome his inner demons by facing his fears head on, battling his worst traits, and becoming more powerful with each victory to ultimately take down his oppressive boss in this Poke-like JRPG adventure.

3546980.title: Friday at Ours
3546980.short_description: Friday at Ours is a time management-adventure game about overcoming your anxiety and visiting a party you weren't invited to.

3548080.title: The Voynich Project
3548080.short_description: A choice-driven romance visual novel where every decision shapes your relationships and the story. Meet unique characters, explore multiple routes, and unlock different endings. Featuring high-quality anime-style art, an immersive soundtrack, and deep storytelling. Your journey begins now!

3548810.title: Ritual Tides
3548810.short_description: Ritual Tides is a story rich, psychological horror game set on the dark, atmospheric, isolated British island of Hortus. Explore the island, uncover its dark past, loot food, ammunition and supplies, evade the cult of the Fallow Parish, as you fight for survival against Lovecraftian horrors.

3550940.title: JIAOHUN
3550940.short_description: Welcome to JIAOHUN. Today is Dec 31, 1999. Happy New Year. And a message from Fairy Town's end. Grab your pager and step into the strange night before the new millennium. Investigate the mysterious Fairy Town in Baishoi County. Explore deeper, uncover the townfolk's secrets, and find the dark truth.

3551150.title: Metal Coffin
3551150.short_description: War has been raging for decades with no signs of it stopping. Take your chance in bringing an end to it in this high focus strategy game. Manage your troops, your supplies and protect your flagship at all costs and you might just be able make it to the capital of the nation.

3551290.title: Tidy Garage
3551290.short_description: Tidy Garage is a relaxing game about organizing a garage. Sort tools, parts, and all sorts of odds and ends, admire their details, and turn a cluttered garage into a pleasant, tidy space at your own pace.

3551800.title: Little Timmy
3551800.short_description: Blast through hordes of monsters and tear enemies apart with brutal executions. Feed your blood-thirsty shotgun until it upgrades, graft boss organs into yourself, team up with up to 3 friends, and descend into the depths to rescue your mom before it's too late.

3551950.title: Tribes
3551950.short_description: In a Stone Age–like war, stranded on a lush, isolated island, it’s up to you to command your tribe and conquer and colonize the island by any means necessary! Tribes offers Skirmish, Multiplayer, and a full Campaign mode for you to experience with friends or play alone!

3554390.title: Shadow of Backrooms
3554390.short_description: Shadow of Backrooms is a co-op horror game set in endless liminal rooms. Explore the Backrooms with up to 4 friends, solve puzzles and escape the entities before they catch you. But be warned: you are not alone.

3554960.title: Wish for Eternity
3554960.short_description: Wish for Eternity is a cozy-spooky 2-player co-op adventure across 7 Deadly Sin domains, each with unique mechanics, enemies, and an epic boss battle. Combine asymmetric spirit powers to fight and solve puzzles, then retreat to your warm, magical Lantern to rest, decorate, and recharge together.

3555360.title: Skippy's Grand Escape
3555360.short_description: Escape increasingly complex mazes as fast as possible. Select skills tactically for each level. Optimize your path. Watch out for enemies, traps, anomalies and more in this space themed top down maze runner.

3555440.title: Lich Lords
3555440.short_description: A Lovecraftian roguelite where you wake up as a Lich with no memory, trapped in a world where everything wants to kill you. Forge deadly builds, slay rival Liches and monstrous horrors, and uncover the truth behind this strange new world.

3556110.title: You've Changed
3556110.short_description: You've Changed is like scary "spot the difference". Observe changes in the environment and catch enemies before they attack in this retro-inspired, anomaly horror game! You've Changed features hand-animated rotoscoped enemy graphics and finely-tuned gameplay balance.

3556940.title: Rune Runners
3556940.short_description: A colorful 3D action platformer for one or two players, on one couch or online. Mix water, fire, thunder and wind into combos, take on twenty bosses and come home to a cozy village between the worlds.

3557060.title: Lull: Rest After Crying
3557060.short_description: A horror action-adventure in which a young girl carrying a baby on her back attempts to escape a mysterious facility twisted by endless renovations.

3557870.title: Bad House
3557870.short_description: Welcome to your new home. The previous tenant left some things. You can have them, but there's just one condition: don’t go into the basement. Explore the many rooms of a mysterious basement in Bad House, an auto-battler dungeon crawler.

3558410.title: Swifty
3558410.short_description: A fast-paced 2D platformer where speed, precision, and perfect timing are key. Dodge traps, master challenging levels, and become the ultimate "Swifty".

3558670.title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
3558670.short_description: Experience a stunning reimagining of Lara Croft’s debut adventure to discover the lost secrets of Atlantis with jaw-dropping visuals, modern gameplay, and new surprises that honor the spirit of the original.

3558830.title: Grave Benders
3558830.short_description: A co-op horror heist for 1 to 4 players. Rob the graves of the rich after curfew. Dig with your friends, which is loud, in a cemetery that listens... It's 1947 and the plague never ended. Keep your voices down. The watchman can hear you, and not every grave is as quiet as it looks.

3560080.title: Eight Bells
3560080.short_description: A pixel-art naval roguelike in the spirit of FTL. Command a Navy warship room by room, crew it with humans, merfolk and stranger things, and hunt pirate captains in real-time-with-pause broadsides on a sea where 10+ monsters lurk. Keep your crew alive. Keep the sea outside.

3560430.title: Evolvania
3560430.short_description: Explore a colossal creature by blending in with the environment and enemies. Evolve and gain new powers in this hand-drawn metroidvania where you can experience a unique adventure or create your own with a special level editor.

3560940.title: Drift Wars
3560940.short_description: A new style of RTS that focuses heavily on terraforming and changing terrain to different types to overcome your opponent ! Inspired by old-school RTSes but with next-generation RTS ideas !

3561810.title: 100 Cats Philippines
3561810.short_description: Find 100 Cats hidden in Philippines! Can you find them all? 😺

3561930.title: Liquid Lungs
3561930.short_description: Liquid Lungs is a high-speed FPS blending fluid parkour with intense combat. Inspired by free-running action games and fast-paced shooters, it delivers a seamless mix of movement and marksmanship in a dystopian world. Run, jump, and fight in a nonstop adrenaline rush where every motion counts.

3562510.title: Tomebound
3562510.short_description: Rescue corrupted books from your library, harness their power and rally their forces to fight for you in this hexgrid tactics deckbuilder! Combine cards to create uniquely powerful spells. With thousands of permutations to explore every turn, no two battles will ever be the same.

3563500.title: Rogue Maze
3563500.short_description: Tower defense is reinvented in this maze-defense roguelike! Design devious labyrinths fit to exhaust the unfortunate souls that enter by using special tiles that act as both your "towers" and pathway. Deploy gadgets, distractions, and tools to stay a step ahead!

3564380.title: The Echo of MeMe-For You Adrift in the Sea of Reveries
3564380.short_description: Welcome to the Meme Space—a dream of scattered fragments. Cross the plains, descend to the deep-sea city, link time, and ride to the Silver River. A denpa-style roaming text adventure, made for you.

3564580.title: Tricky and the Dream Caster
3564580.short_description: A surreal, retro-inspired, free form 3D platformer that takes you through a world of dreams and nightmares!

3564750.title: Bite the Crown
3564750.short_description: In a world ruled by sugary tyrants, an unlikely hero rises from the shadows: Pom the Mold. Build your secret guild, gather rogue treats, lead the rebellion and battle through candy-coated chaos to topple the Candy Kingdom. The Sweet Revolution begins—bite back!

3565090.title: Goobies 2
3565090.short_description: Blow up blobs and battle bosses in co-op! Find your favorite goobie and master its abilities and evolutions. Combine mutations into unique builds and collect powerful evolving omens in this roguelite shooter.

3565260.title: Shadows of Midnight - They Watch Me Sleep
3565260.short_description: The game is a narrative-driven horror experience inspired by the Silent Hill and Fears to Fathom franchises. Live through two terrifying stories: a man’s summer getaway turns into a nightmare at a shady hotel, and a child grows up knowing something watches from the forest—always waiting.

3565340.title: LingoRogue
3565340.short_description: The language flashcard roguelike. LingoRogue is a dopamine machine of a deck-builder. Find the cards you need to spin crazy combos off your words. Play with endless variety and learn new languages without effort.

3565600.title: レビィのスライムファクトリー
3565600.short_description: なぜかスライムになってしまったししょーを元に戻すため、みならい錬金術師レビィが日夜奮闘！スライムと錬金術の不思議な世界で繰り広げるカラフルで魅力的なパズルゲーム。

3565610.title: The Blackout Project
3565610.short_description: Manage your contry energy requirements, avoid blackouts, sustain industrial developpement, avoid civilization collapsing.

3566470.title: better.game
3566470.short_description: A game without lag or ping advantage. Client-side customizable. Players can see and hear different things. Moving spherical zone. Build, fight, or just go to zone. Jetpack, glide, grapple, ascend, teleport or drive across the map. Lose, view an instant replay, then reboot and get back in the fight.

3566480.title: Switcheroo
3566480.short_description: A kangaroo named Jade escapes from an evil mad scientist who's obsessed with color! Along the way, she'll hop past vibrant obstacles, kick pesky robots out of the way, and use her new color-switching powers to solve the lab's mysterious puzzles.

3566650.title: Martian Elevator
3566650.short_description: Travel the world as a cute ufo and ruin everybody's day! Unlock new methods of mischief in over 30 levels, each with unique setting and objectives. This is an cartoonish UFO simulator!

3566660.title: Ammo Garden
3566660.short_description: Bullet-Hell Roguelite where you Grow and Defend the last Farm in a Post-Apocalyptic Wasteland. Farm Crops, Upgrade Weapons and Kill every Creature that tries to invade your Farm!

3566900.title: TreeTale
3566900.short_description: TreeTale is a HACK&SLASH ARPG that combines limitless customization with strategic combat. Players can freely build their characters using an extensive Passive Tree, while the Skill Customization System allows them to refine their combat style to perfection.

3567090.title: Golemcrafter
3567090.short_description: Golemcrafter is a single-player survival crafting game where you, as a golem, explore a magical world, gather resources, build a base, harness the local wildlife, and craft powerful golems like yourself. Make friends, gain powers!

3567260.title: Herbalist Roman
3567260.short_description: Step into the role of a medieval herbalist. Study your herbal book, craft macerations, and help your clients by easing their ailments. Christianity is reaching the Slavic village of Drebor, and your choices will determine whether these changes unfold in peace.

3567890.title: The Julian
3567890.short_description: Work at a supermarket, pack groceries into your inventory, and spend your wages on shopping and cooking to survive. Manage satiety and sanity while building friendships that set the story in motion. Your choices lead to multiple endings. A survival simulation fusing puzzle, daily life, and narrative

3568230.title: Galo's Strife
3568230.short_description: 『ガロゥズストライフ』は、人間が異形の怪物に変わる事件の最中、超常の力を得た主人公の少年ガロゥと少女ハイマを中心に描くダークファンタジーRPGです。バトルやイベントシーンでは、鮮やかなドット絵のキャラクター達が賑やかに動きます。仲間を集め「ルラガルド」へ旅立ちましょう。

3568530.title: Argol II - Curse of Nemesis
3568530.short_description: Argol II - Curse of Nemesis is an action, platform and adventure game. The action takes place in mythological times. Argol and his companions must face Nemesis the goddess of vengeance.

3568740.title: THE FATUM
3568740.short_description: The Supreme Committee congratulates you on your promotion. Your task is to identify citizens infected by the unknown virus. Interrogate, inspect, pass a verdict. Test your deduction in a world of total control. Remember: the Standard above all.

3569020.title: Souls End
3569020.short_description: Souls End is an auto-battler roguelike where you'll draft unstoppable armies, placing units and items in just the right way to create awesome synergies! Cast spells while battles unfold and find relics to further elevate builds. Will you defeat life itself-or will you meet a Souls End?

3569060.title: 90FX
3569060.short_description: Straight from the 90s, 90FX recreates the feel and experience of once revolutionary racing games of the early 90s. 90s Kids will remember this.

3570510.title: Weebles vs Grebals
3570510.short_description: Battle endless Grebals in a fast-paced isometric roguelike bullet hell. Master unique Weebles, create powerful builds, and survive solo or in online co-op.

3571080.title: Delving The Depths
3571080.short_description: Escape imprisonment by delving into the caverns below your cell and exploring until your group reaches the surface in this first-person grid-based dungeon crawler with turn-based combat.

3571580.title: ABSTRACTICA
3571580.short_description: In this fast-paced third person shooter with roguelike elements, you are tasked with recovering art that has mysteriously gone rogue. Fight abstract shapes like triangles, tangrams and even an abstract Mona Lisa to uncover the mystery of ABSTRACTICA.

3572310.title: Ministry of Order
3572310.short_description: Inspect the parents’ medical record and match the newborn who can only be theirs — that is the day’s work in this 1920s dystopian puzzle. A fire burned the birth records, and the Ministry put you in charge of giving the children back. Your choice goes into the report.

3573190.title: Revive! Onsen Town!
3573190.short_description: Revive! Onsen Town! is a cozy life simulation set in the Japanese countryside. Play as a girl on summer vacation or the mayor revitalizing the village. Catch bugs, fish, work part-time, cook, and help locals. Shape the town with your choices and bring this quiet hot spring town back to life.

3574550.title: Zombie Dog
3574550.short_description: Zombie Dog is a zombie herding sheepdog game set in Yorkshire. It combines strategic coordination and timing with puzzle solving and comedic physics-based mayhem through its unique zombie herding mechanic.

3574570.title: Roots Of Ruin
3574570.short_description: Build your defenses, fight beside them, and reclaim your kingdom from the corruption. Expand your land, command powerful towers, and take direct control of one of four unique heroes to defend against relentless enemy waves and devastating bosses.

3574810.title: Shadow Of The Union: Survival
3574810.short_description: Fight back against the rebellious machines in an alternative USSR! Join forces in a team of up to 4 players and survive in a dangerous open world. By day, explore and gather resources. By night, defend your base against waves of combat robots!

3575210.title: Isle of trees
3575210.short_description: Revive the lost forests of the Isle of Trees in this cosy open-world game. Wander around, make friends, catch worms, and restore forests back to life! Dinner’s at seven!

3575920.title: Curse of Dominion
3575920.short_description: Lead captains in grid-based battles across a conquest map where every victory expands your territory and income. Invest in regions, upgrade gear, and build class paths and loyalty bonds in a campaign focused on strategy, growth, and momentum.

3576240.title: Drug Dealer 2049
3576240.short_description: Drug Dealer 2049 is about building a fully automated factory that produces ever purer drugs, in a 2D world. Design your production lines, cross plants into new strains or cook synthetic drugs, sell your production to customers, and protect yourself from every threat.

3576920.title: Loco: Rails & Tails
3576920.short_description: Chaotic co-op for 1–4 players! Build rails, protect the train and deliver cargo on time. Pick your favourite animal hero and embark with your friends on wild west adventure!

3577570.title: Project Leo
3577570.short_description: Advanced physics based rally racing game. Set in Englands' picturesque countryside, rally through highly detailed beautiful english rally stages and test your mettle on dirt, gravel and asphalt surfaces.

3577830.title: Elemental Shifter
3577830.short_description: Elemental Shifter is a top-down 2D roguelite where you harness the power of 'Elemental Shifting' adapting your abilities based on the last damage you took. Choose your path, battle mages, grow stronger, discover new weapons and defeat powerful bosses on your way to the Mage King.

3577850.title: Astro Amigo
3577850.short_description: ASTRO AMIGO is a story-driven sci-fi adventure game where a bullied kid named Austin searches for his missing dog, Amigo. Explore a strange Wisconsin town, uncover its secrets, play nostalgic mini-games, and make story-shaping choices as the mystery unfolds.

3578080.title: Wee Boats
3578080.short_description: The chill multiplayer boaty honk game! Explore with your friends as miniature boats in this lil nautical adventure!

3578430.title: Paresis® II
3578430.short_description: Paresis® II throws you into a twisted supernatural nightmare. As FBI agent David, you must relive your past, solve sinister ritual-like puzzles, fight off grotesque morphs, and conquer brutal bosses. Survive…if you can.

3578820.title: SUPER ADVENTURE
3578820.short_description: Turn around to parry and block! Equipped with a shield on your back, jump your way through vivid levels, meet funny characters, and face challenging bosses. Fight using a quick-firing Alien Blaster or a melee-focused sword! Choose the path you want to go in this SUPER ADVENTURE!

3579640.title: SolBound
3579640.short_description: A 4X turn-based strategy game where energy is everything. Build a power network, grow your forces, and fight your rivals for the best ground on a planet where day and night are always on the move.

3579900.title: Grapple Car
3579900.short_description: A car with a grappling hook! Twist and turn with tight driving controls around colorful tracks to complete challenges, customize your car, and race for a spot at the timed global online leaderboards.

3580890.title: Into the Rootforge
3580890.short_description: Into the Rootforge is a unique fusion of runner, roguelike and card-based action combat. Master customisable attacks to delve further with each attempt. Uncover the secrets of the Rootforge and grow your true power through the skill trees of The Garden.

3581030.title: Edge of Madness
3581030.short_description: Edge of Madness is a Lovecraftian RPG with tactical card-based combat. Explore the grounds around the Marsh Estate, find equipment, combat cards, and combine them with character skills. Find a way to defeat your enemies without losing your sanity.

3581040.title: Bharat Police
3581040.short_description: > Lead a police department in India where officers grow and react to how you use them. Develop their skills, shape your squad through perks, and manage the buffs and setbacks they pick up on duty. Choose your team, plan each response, and keep your officers ready for the next call.

3582810.title: Dandelion Void
3582810.short_description: Survive the jungle-choked halls of a derelict arkship adrift between the stars. Establish a refuge and forage resources from the skeletal remains of your ancestors. Explore solo or with your friends. Fashion what weapons you can, for the jungle is alive and hostile…

3584060.title: BONEBUILDER
3584060.short_description: Fight imposing enemies in this 3D third person action roguelike. Collect bones and weapons from defeated enemies to build the most powerful skeleton possible through BONEBUILDER's unique crafting and talent systems!

3584260.title: Fogreaver
3584260.short_description: Shoot zombies. Earn cash. Take back your Base Camp and clear the surrounding areas. Bring home supplies, upgrade your weapons and head out for more. Wake the hordes, lure them into traps or fight from horseback. Kill every last infected to keep what you earned. Then gear up for the next run.

3584280.title: Full Steam Undead
3584280.short_description: OPEN WORLD STEAM TRAIN + ZOMBIE VR ACTION! Ride the rune train, explore Necropolis Island and slay the undead. For Queen Victoria, it's time to roll: all aboard for undead destruction!

3585260.title: TailofScorpios
3585260.short_description: "Scorpion's Tail" is a AVG set in an alternate historical timeline. In the war-born nation of SouthXi, a conspiracy involving girls begins to surface.Investigator Zhang Cheng meets a mysterious girl. After accepting request, he is drawn into a web of secrets.

3585660.title: Pirate Pillage and Plunder
3585660.short_description: PIRATE PILLAGE & PLUNDER is the unique blend of card game and auto battler, wrapped together in a neat roguelike package. Choose your faction, amass an army from thousands of "willing" participants, and lead them to greatness! (or agonizing defeat)

3586710.title: 拉斯普特的龙与魔女
3586710.short_description: 由蒸汽和魔法驱动的世界——人类创立的先进都市拉普斯特 肩负重任的落魄贵族之子于此邂逅龙与魔女 在友情与爱恋的迷宫不断回旋，指向出口的答案究竟为何？

3586730.title: 3Souls
3586730.short_description: A world at the crossroads of forgotten technology and magic, filled with grim guardians and anomalies. Guide three heroes through the mysteries of a floating archipelago, upgrade your camp, and unlock their potential in an isometric action RPG with immersive mechanics.

3586850.title: ROCKABILLYHOSTEL
3586850.short_description: ROCKABILLY HOSTEL is a simple walking simulator based on pixel art. It is just a game to walking around and look around the beautiful abandoned buildings and the scenery. There is nothing more about this game but it is OK as long as the girls and the graphics are pretty.

3588410.title: Jacob's Ladder
3588410.short_description: Jacob’s Ladder is a haunting first-person puzzler where YOU are the solution. Swap bodies and stack puzzle pieces to please The Maker. Question the nature of the soul and earn your humanity - before it’s too late.

3588500.title: Wasteward
3588500.short_description: Turn trash into treasure in this charming 2D Physics-based puzzle game! Use garbage to build contraptions for a colorful cast of clients! You'll have to get creative if you want a 4 star review!

3588790.title: Tree's Love Crossing Above
3588790.short_description: This is a BL-themed FMV game where players will control the protagonist "Xiaoshu" make choices for him, and experience four completely different love stories. Will they lead to a sweet ending or end in regret? Every choice you make will determine the protagonist's ultimate romantic destination.

3588980.title: Age of Legacy
3588980.short_description: A turn-based roguelike RPG where every enemy has a plan and you only get one life. Read their tricks, counter them with your abilities and runestones, and fight through a broken kingdom to the general who murdered the King.

3589190.title: COCOBOY
3589190.short_description: Rediscover the lost ‘80s platformer COCOBOY in an alternate 2005! Hack a forgotten game with bizarre mods, decorate your bedroom with rare collectibles, and scour the forums of a budding fandom for clues to deeply puzzling secrets. Demo Disc is available now!

3589430.title: Heidi's Legacy: Mountains Calling
3589430.short_description: Heidi's Legacy is a cozy narrative sim where you care for goats, craft mountain goods, and help villagers rebuild their lives. Experience a peaceful pastoral life, inspired by the Heidi novels, celebrating nature, healing, community, and self-discovery.

3589740.title: Charlie Spotlight
3589740.short_description: Meet Charlie, the next King of Comedy! Or at least its' Little Prince. It's a steady grind to get to the top, until on a night like any other, after one of his sets, Charlie is approached by a couple of rather unusual fans.

3589910.title: Voivod: The Nuclear Warrior
3589910.short_description: A brutal action game set in a collapsing sci-fi nightmare. Battle biomechanical mutants, traverse shifting landscapes, and uncover fragments of your lost mind as you descend into a twisted post-apocalyptic world.

3590080.title: Omega Redux
3590080.short_description: An episodic sci-fi adventure where you explore doomed open worlds one hour before their destruction. As a relic hunter and his playable robot companion, search for strangely meaningful artifacts while cinematic catastrophe approaches with every passing second. Get out in time—or meet the end!

3590180.title: Hoard's LLC: Limited Labyrinth Corporation
3590180.short_description: Rotate, slide, and explode your way through more than 60 levels of corporate labyrinths in this story-rich puzzler! Find a path for Barry to meet with all his monstrous coworkers and learn about their struggles. Defeat the evils of poor management with the power of unionization!

3590370.title: Insanitation
3590370.short_description: It’s Chaos VS Order in this fast-paced battle against family & friends. Will you create Chaos as a Cat - spreading fur, mayhem, & hairballs everywhere? Or restore Order as a Keeper - cleaning & mopping up the muck before Chaos takes over? Pick a side & grab your kibble or gear, & claim victory.

3590520.title: Vampires Die
3590520.short_description: Hired by the "Council" to take out a rogue coven, you must gather your clan and travel through the dark streets, graveyards, and crypts to battle for hierarchy against the deadliest of your own bloodline. Roll the dice in this "chill" turn-based board game, but remember, sometimes even Vampires Die!

3590570.title: Bar of Betrayal
3590570.short_description: A social deduction party game for 4-10 friends in a 1927 speakeasy. Regulars play the bar's games, find the body and vote out the killer. The killer stabs in secret, hides the body, mops the blood and blames someone else.

3590670.title: Gloctopus
3590670.short_description: Eight guns is better than one — if you have eight arms. Gloctopus is a bullet heaven roguelike where you equip, mutate, and build your tentacles into a one-octopus army. The ocean didn't stand a chance.

3590870.title: Ripley [Remembered]
3590870.short_description: A surreal, story-driven puzzle game set on a train caught in a time loop. Solve narrative-driven puzzles, battle psychic bosses, and uncover the truth about memory, grief, and a girl named Ripley—before the day resets again.

3591430.title: Nono & Soso
3591430.short_description: Nono & Soso is a puzzle game built around magnets. Switch between N and S poles to push and pull your way through blocked paths and reach the goal.

3591750.title: Little Dungeon
3591750.short_description: LittleDungeon is a third-person loot-driven action RPG. Choose from eight classes and tackle seasonal dungeons solo or in online co-op. Collect gear, combine sets and class weapons, and grow through equipment upgrades, weapon refinement and character advancement to shape your own combat style.

3592540.title: Niverium
3592540.short_description: Niverium is a survival game in a harsh world where you have to take on the role of a man sent to the very bottom. You will have to do any dirty work for those who stand above you, under threat of death.

3592770.title: Gravitus
3592770.short_description: Enter a massive battlefield where two teams clash over resources, strategy, and firepower. Start as infantry, pilot hover tanks or flying pods, and unleash laser-based combat in a sci-fi warzone reminiscent of classic space battles.

3592940.title: Flesh & Wire
3592940.short_description: Delve into the psychological roots of the POSTAL series in Flesh & Wire, a horror first person shooter that ventures into the twisted reality of a hapless victim seeking enshrouded answers and grisly vengeance against the crazed gunman who changed her life forever.

3593290.title: The Town That Died In The Night
3593290.short_description: You must escape the town, while trying to beat 2 clocks. An incoming nuke, and a viral infection. Can you make it out in time?

3593470.title: 1992: Rasputie
3593470.short_description: Take a place of a politician in the post-Soviet space and immerse yourself in the struggle for power amid the ruins of the former empire. Your decisions will determine the path of the young state's development.

3593620.title: 幻蝶：双生对立的少女
3593620.short_description: “当幻蝶振翅，灵魂的共鸣将改写命运——是选择沉溺于过去的阴霾，还是握住那双伸出的手？” 《幻蝶：双生对立的少女》是一款以 Unity 引擎开发的美少女视觉小说游戏，在宁静的海滨岌川市，体验日常与奇幻交织的故事。在游戏中，体验主角与每一个少女之间的故事，感受彼此友谊与情感的回响，如蝴蝶振翅般，故事的齿轮开始转动。形形色色的人物如生命中的旅人，伴随在身边，他们拥有他们自己不为人知的故事，而这一切，都可以在游戏的探索中逐步发掘。在各自背负着自己过往的人之间，相互理解，互相认知，在陪伴与爱中，度过着似乎与昨天不同的今天。

3594200.title: No Crown Eternal
3594200.short_description: Apparently the Romans with Dynamite are really broken. Grow a village into an empire in this turn-based Roguelike. Explore, build buildings and wonders, adopt civilizations and research technologies in 30-minute runs.

3594550.title: Billy the Hero
3594550.short_description: Billy woke up on Hell Island as a bear. No memories. No regrets. Apparently, this is just who he is now. A Dark Fantasy Turn-Based RPG where math kills, heroines are unhinged, and the truth about Billy is the one thing the game won't hand you easily.

3594750.title: The Last Resourcer
3594750.short_description: Survive a hostile world with your droid. Build your base, automate with robots, and manage the energy that keeps you alive. Beware. The tech you rely on may save your life – or destroy it.

3595350.title: UnGodly
3595350.short_description: Ungodly is a dark fantasy RPG where visceral real-time combat meets collectible hero strategy. Build your roster, chain elemental powers through seamless team swapping, and forge bonds that unlock devastating synergies in a world on the edge of ruin.

3595480.title: Shuttle Mining
3595480.short_description: Shuttle Mining is a Noita- and Terraria-inspired cozy & chaotic mining game. Craft your own unique lasers, burn, taze, and make things explode. The goal is to craft new batteries so you can use stronger lasers and dig deeper...

3595810.title: MaskuLand Survival
3595810.short_description: You are Masku, an explorer who crash-landed in an unknown world carrying a rare cure for your son! To breathe you need special Masks, each one grants you a unique ability! Repair your balloon and get supplies, fight you way back home! His life depends on you! You need to SURVIVE!

3596130.title: Chaos Coin
3596130.short_description: Your coins are your actions in this roguelike coinbuilder. Slot sequences of coins to shove, evade, and attack in turn-based combat. Fight in pairs using coins unique to each character. Upgrade and replace individual coin faces to build complex combos. Chaos is coming, so use your heads (and tails)!

3596380.title: The Guiding Spirit
3596380.short_description: Mix and match hundreds of traits, flaws, and skills to design unique heroes with complex personalities and ambitions. Watch them love, hate, help, and hinder each other. Roll the dice and become the Guiding Spirit of your group of misfits in this story-rich fantasy campaign simulator!

3596440.title: Di Renjie:  The Legendary Investigator
3596440.short_description: Become a legendary detective of ancient China! In "Di Renjie: The Legendary Investigator", play as Di Renjie, solving thrilling cases across Bianzhou and Bingzhou in the Tang Dynasty and uncovering the truth.

3597310.title: Critter Cosmos
3597310.short_description: A cozy 3D adventure where you play as a Capybara Astronaut, hopping from planet to planet, befriending cute animal pals, saving communities, and building a new home together.

3597650.title: Ultimate Gym Simulator
3597650.short_description: Build your dream gym with Ultimate Gym Simulator

3598060.title: Reviving An Angel
3598060.short_description: How do you revive an angel? Reviving An Angel is a turn-based RPG set in a world where Archangels, the greatest creations of the Almighty, are in a path of war. Wanting to revive his beloved, Harold, a young Fallen Hunter, saw himself facing an Archangel as he challenged the limits of his mortality.

3598290.title: 秋之轻语
3598290.short_description: VN.Your neighbor died in a fall — yet the very next day, she appeared inside your mind, as if an unseen hand were pulling every string. Everything feels dreamlike, unreal. You seem to have boarded a train that accelerates beyond control; in the chaos, you clutch at something — perhaps the truth.

3598980.title: Whist
3598980.short_description: Become a healer in Whist – a single-player turn-based RPG. Challenge cunning diseases. Learn the art of healing, brew and stock up on potions, and solve puzzles. Plan your moves ahead, allocate your talents, and don’t rush to reveal all your cards — illnesses are not as simple as they seem!

3599410.title: Everything is Gun!
3599410.short_description: Dominate in a brutal, lightning-fast old-school FPS. Modify yourself into the perfect weapon, unleash mass destruction, conquer runs, invade others, and ascend to global supremacy. Prisoner #11 18 1978, you now belong to A1KTRZ. Your survival is broadcast to billions. What will remain of your soul?

3599440.title: IZEA:10puzzle Rogue-Lite RPG!
3599440.short_description: "Make 10 is mightier than the sword!" IZEA is a fresh strategic battle game that fuses “Make 10” × Puzzle Calculation × RPG × Roguelite. Use number cards and arithmetic operators to calculate the enemy’s designated Weak Number and fight your way to victory!

3599920.title: ARTIUS: Pure Imagination
3599920.short_description: ARTIUS is a fast-paced, momentum-based 2D platformer where you play as artists battling to preserve creativity in a world on the verge of artistic extinction! Dash, swing, and smash your way through a vibrant, hand-drawn world in this adrenaline-fueled platformer where art is your strongest weapon.

3599930.title: Mooncrawler
3599930.short_description: Wield your magical lantern and survive the endless night in this 2,5D roguelike. While a cosmic entity is slowly corrupting the moon the world is drowning in darkness only you can overcome. Collect perks and fuel your lantern with light to grow stronger and to fight against the outwordly intruders.

3600060.title: [REDACTED]
3600060.short_description: You're a government officer. Documents hit your desk, you scrub out the secrets, and you hope nothing leaks. Miss a word? Maybe it's fine. Miss a few? Well, ██████████. You've got limited ink, limited time, and frankly, limited ████████████. Cheaper than a ████████████.

3600220.title: Woe Reigns Unending
3600220.short_description: Lead a cursed party through a ruined world in this grimdark side-scrolling RPG. Build your team, master tactical combat, and unleash forbidden powers to survive an endless parade of nightmares. Decide what, if anything, is worth salvaging from a world that has been reduced to ashes.

3600380.title: Clan fantasy adventures
3600380.short_description: Clan fantasy adventures is a turn-based 2D RPG. Play Marco, a young boy who wants to become a swordsman, through various adventures that will plunge him into the heart of a major conflict.

3600740.title: OmniRing
3600740.short_description: OMNIRING is a world-hopping tactical RPG for multiple playthroughs. Build a squad of Samsarans, fight, interact, and shape events through your choices. Grow your squad through cycles of adventure, face the Apocalypse's final battle, and become an immortal Ascendant.

3601330.title: Safety Check YOSHI!
3601330.short_description: This is a game where you earn points by identifying hazards (near-miss incidents). If you successfully point them out, say, "Safety check, YOSHI!"

3601810.title: Clear the Snow
3601810.short_description: Play with up to 4 friends and help clear the city of snow. Work together using shovels, snow blowers, and heavy machinery to complete jobs and upgrade your gear. Enjoy cozy winter vibes, and the freedom to play your own way!

3601970.title: CAT-A-STROPHIC
3601970.short_description: CAT-A-STROPHIC is a goofy 3D rogue-like city destruction game where you play as Bluu, a colossal kaiju cat, rampaging through different cities to rescue your precious kittens! Embrace the purr-fect blend of chaos and relaxation as you level multiple towns and cities.

3602000.title: The Black Bahr
3602000.short_description: The Black Bahr is a sandbox colony simulation RPG blending ocean exploration, crew management, and dynamic faction politics. Freely chart your course as a pirate, merchant, or honorable captain, shaping your destiny across the open seas.

3602210.title: Deus Exia
3602210.short_description: “Before your planet gets blown into smithereens, take this sword and protect yourself.” Embark on a colorful 2D pixel action adventure in Deus Exia! Slash, parry and combo through four distinct lands. Collect cards and skills to craft powerful builds — then overcome deadly enemies and bosses.

3602270.title: Whisk
3602270.short_description: Whisk is a two-player platformer about shared movement and communication. Coordinate jumps, climbs and throws with a partner to get every Dreamcat home.

3602700.title: Sketchbook
3602700.short_description: Familiar places hide mysteries, the laws of reality no longer apply, and childhood fears lurk in everyday objects. Embark on a journey through distorted memories of the past in a first-person horror game.

3602780.title: Kanji Grinder
3602780.short_description: Kanji Grinder is a spaced repetition flashcard system, purpose-built for Steam Deck. Designed for immersion learners who want a no-nonsense way to drill Kanji vocabulary, your daily reviews will be a breeze. Plus, for those who enjoy quiz games or flexing their skills, plenty of challenges await!

3602900.title: Spirit of Diwata
3602900.short_description: Heal instead of fight. A co-op action JRPG inspired by SNES classics, for up to three on one screen or online. Play instruments to calm the angry creatures of an Asian fantasy world, and watch each one become a friend who brings a little more hope.

3603000.title: Maneater 2
3603000.short_description: The splash-hit ShaRkPG returns in Maneater 2! Eat, explore, and evolve as you try to escape an invite-only preview event for Neptune’s Kingdom—an ultra-luxury seaside theme park destined for disaster, where YOU are that disaster.

3603650.title: Cubic Blitz
3603650.short_description: Cubic Blitz is an isometric puzzle game where you control a cube and solve loads of hand-crafted levels. With the power of paint, sponges, and much more, your task is simple: PAINT THE WORLD.

3603960.title: Sunyata CCG
3603960.short_description: Sunyata is a tactical, action‑packed card game where you command fantastical creatures in Earth's magical future. Ride dragons, summon the undead, and evolve magical beasts in duels that reward creative deckbuilding and adaptive strategy.

3604040.title: Occult Trap
3604040.short_description: Within the test chambers filled with horrific traps and unidentified creatures, you must analyze the creatures’ behavior patterns and use the environment to escape their relentless pursuit. Search the surroundings to gather items, disable or exploit traps, and forge your path forward.

3604100.title: Et le grain mourut
3604100.short_description: A visual novel set in 1920s Paris. As summer draws near, young students are revising their end-of-year exams. Olivier is one of them.

3604490.title: Dining Deck
3604490.short_description: We fused co-op strategy, deckbuilding, and restaurant chaos into the ultimate roguelike dining experience! Build your deck, serve customers, master the kitchen, and secure your place amongst the Hall of Taste!

3605560.title: Ping Profit - Internet Tycoon
3605560.short_description: Run the internet your way. Build infrastructure, control traffic, stop outages, and grow a basement hosting startup into a global powerhouse.

3605570.title: Hyper Bun Buster: Rocket Hammer Action
3605570.short_description: Take control of Tess, a bunny girl who uses her huge hammer to send enemies flying into other enemies in this top-down bump combat action game! Dodge projectiles, control space and outmaneuver bosses in Arcade mode or explore dungeons, solve puzzles and unlock abilities in Adventure mode.

3605940.title: Ocean City Killer
3605940.short_description: Ocean City Killer is an open-world corporate dungeon crawler. You play as Rick Atlanta, a private eye investigating the death of a former colleague. What starts out as a routine case pulls you into the dark labyrinth of a seedy megacorp. Hop in your muscle car to explore the city!

3606620.title: Pileus Bad Trip
3606620.short_description: Put yourself in the role of a surviving village mushroom and try to fix what happened while you were asleep!

3606780.title: Chunky JUMP!
3606780.short_description: Chunky JUMP! is a survival-horror platformer where you must survive through the night on your BIRD BOY. But beware... the Ghabbit is hunting, and you must restore the gas station's power before it's too late!

3606840.title: Evolution Of The Ancients
3606840.short_description: Survive as a vulnerable hatchling, grow into a fierce predator and lead your own herd. Craft armour from the bones of your prey, recruit NPC companions and join other players to defend your nesting grounds. In a world where dinosaurs never went extinct, build a future worth fighting for.

3606970.title: Brass Rain
3606970.short_description: Join your friends and fight through defining battles of World War II in BRASS RAIN, a co-op combined arms combat game built around infantry, tanks, and heroic last stands. Inspired by real events, each mission recreates a unique historical battle with its own objectives, and unforgettable stories.

3607570.title: Ghost Merc: Frontlines
3607570.short_description: A fast-paced, team-based FPS. Engage in intense firefights, coordinate with your clan, and adapt your strategy to dominate the battlefield. Featuring a competitive clan system, objective-based modes, and deep customization, every match is a test of skill and teamwork.

3608090.title: Ultimate Lemon Basket
3608090.short_description: 🍋 A Speed-Running platformer where you can’t drop any lemons.🍋 Between you and the goal are Ghosts, Cows, Acid Rain Clouds, Monster Trucks, Hopes, Dreams and other things AS WELL!! There are leaderboards.

3608460.title: Spinning My Wheel
3608460.short_description: Build a physics‑powered hamster‑wheel, master rocket‑boosted moves, to lead a brain chipped enhanced hamster through puzzles, mining, and laboratory‑runner mayhem.

3609130.title: Skyland Farmer
3609130.short_description: In Skyland Farmer, farm in peace on your own Sky Isle. Till the fields, enrich the soil and breed better crops in this farming sim. Sell your harvest at your farm stand or put it to the test in contests. Your endless farming life starts here!

3609600.title: The Road 66
3609600.short_description: The Road 66 is a 2D pixel art adventure where Kai and childhood friends Sue and Nile hit the road to find the brothers' missing mother. Along Route 66, they’ll encounter talking cats, dancing fire gods, and eerie folklore. Start the engine—adventure awaits!

3609610.title: Meat Market
3609610.short_description: Outside the last human city, you keep a butcher shop. Your customers shamble in at dusk. Stock comes from the city beyond. Village is home - they tolerate you because you keep the dead calm. And somewhere in that city is the one who took your daughter.

3610030.title: DIGGY DIGGY
3610030.short_description: In DIGGY DIGGY, you dig up rare fossils, collect shiny minerals and showcase your findings in a museum. Explore unique locations and bond with eccentric townsfolk in this delightfully silly, cozy adventure.

3610360.title: Phatastrophe
3610360.short_description: Turn the pond into a warzone in this chaotic action roguelike! Dual-wield outrageous weapons, unleash devastating back-mounted firepower and create wild builds as a Phrog, Chrab or Phlai. Survive solo, team up in co-op or blast your friends in online battles.

3610770.title: Dead Miles
3610770.short_description: Dead Miles is a 3D co-op horde shooter where your vehicle serves as a mobile base that you can equip with weapons and upgrades. Explore dangerous locations, fight massive hordes on foot and behind the wheel, and grow stronger through survivor-like character progression.

3614730.title: Monster Pod Quest
3614730.short_description: Monster Pod Quest is an experimental creature collector with infinitely many procedurally generated monsters. Create completely unique creatures, build your party and battle through a huge variety of worlds to vanquish the bosses of the land.

3615510.title: UNDER WORLD
3615510.short_description: A deck-building roguelite game set in a devastated underground world after the war. Your choices will change your moral and soul, affecting your strategy and rewards. Venture deeper underground in search of the world's truth...

3615970.title: Vesper's Hunt
3615970.short_description: A turn-based deduction game where you play as a detective hunting vampires. Use a mirror to reveal hidden beasts and holy water to strike them down. But beware—the undead grow stronger with every attack. Outsmart the vampires… or become their next victim!

3616280.title: Mr Magpie's Harmless Card Game
3616280.short_description: A surreal corporate horror deckbuilder where you gamble your life for cash, dodge murderous JERRY cards, and “maximise synergies” to climb the company ladder in Mr Magpie’s office nightmare.

3616390.title: Absolute Cinema
3616390.short_description: Build your own movie empire! Create blockbusters by combining a huge variety of themes and genres, hire star actors at castings, and develop your studio and technologies. Crazy random events, references to real stars, and lots of humor. Prove that you are the best director! 🎬

3616930.title: Yami Kare - His mind trying to bind me mentally
3616930.short_description: This game is a confinement suspense & love romance escape game in which the main character, who has lost her memory, aims to regain her memory and escape from the room she was confined in.

3617080.title: Short Short Fictions
3617080.short_description: A short short mix tape of one story that connects three shorter stories. On the NewWave, a magical game console that is retro but new, enjoy DON'T SAY YES, TO:NORTH, and a secret tale nobody yet knows. Welcome to a slightly fantastical and nostalgic world of painful, toilful, and beautiful stories!

3617510.title: Drone Armada
3617510.short_description: Pilot and command massive drone swarms in real-time action-strategy battles. Research powerful tech, upgrade your fleet, and adapt your tactics to push back the invasion spreading across Kaelisia.

3617530.title: Endwell
3617530.short_description: One determined cat, one big backpack, and a whole lot of deliveries to make! As a Cat Courier, it's your job to deliver packages across a cozy town on the eve of the world's end. Help residents find connection, hope, and meaning before the last sunset.

3617990.title: Star Wrath
3617990.short_description: Star Wrath is a multiplayer space extraction-action where you design your own ship and fight other players for resources in intense PvP and PvE battles.

3618040.title: Star Pulse:The War
3618040.short_description: Star Pulse: The War is an independent real-time strategy game that merges science fiction with fantasy. Players will command a sci-fi faction, harnessing the power of star pulse to gather resources, construct buildings, train troops, and nurture heroes in the fight against invading magical forces.

3620350.title: Two Realms: Whispers from the Rift
3620350.short_description: Point & Click Fantasy Thriller: A burst of light - a crystal devours your little brother's life force. Desperate to save him, you must uncover the truth behind magic, while a dread mage closes in to tear the crystal from your hands - and with it, all hope.

3620390.title: Aberrate Inc.
3620390.short_description: Guide N.T.R.N., a curious little maintenance robot, through cozy logic puzzles by splitting, moving, and combining red and blue boxes to power doors, platforms, and odd office machines. Winner of SXSW Sydney’s Best Student Game Award 2025.

3620520.title: IN SILICO
3620520.short_description: In a distant future humanity is enslaved in a simulation. Now that you are awake, can you escape from reality too?

3620530.title: Police Stories 2
3620530.short_description: Serve the law. Protect the innocent. Command the grittiest precinct in town in Police Stories 2 - a brutal tactical top-down shooter where arrest is the goal, force is the last resort, and every decision has an outcome.

3620610.title: Primal Survival
3620610.short_description: A realistic prehistoric survival game where you play as Homo habilis or Homo erectus. Craft primitive tools, build shelter, hunt massive beasts, and survive the harsh forces of nature in a vast multiplayer world.

3620620.title: Gatekeeper's Week
3620620.short_description: Become a guard of the glorious kingdom of Cardenia! Your task is to let only law-abiding travelers into the city, while repelling bandit attacks and sending swindlers to jail! Be attentive and vigilant! For the glory of the King!

3620760.title: At the Bottom
3620760.short_description: You’re nobody. Until you become someone. Build a street empire from dirt, pain, and rage.

3620860.title: Kung Fu Addiction
3620860.short_description: An auto-battler RPG where anticipation is everything. Predict your enemies' moves, shape your hero's progression, and channel the souls of ancient warriors to resurrect with a new fighting style as you overcome escalating challenges across multiple combat modes.

3621060.title: Taptron 1999
3621060.short_description: Taptron 1999 is a short roguelite clicker where you must prevent Y2K using the power of a mouse click.

3621350.title: Apprentice of Darkness
3621350.short_description: Play as a dark magician, gather your party of all sorts of evil, unspeakable creatures and spread darkness! A hand-drawn, turn-based rogue-like experience! Sacrifice your enemies to Evil Gods, unlock new powers and recruits, build your Tower of Darkness to spread corruption throughout the continent.

3621510.title: Burger Rush Simulator
3621510.short_description: Burger Rush Simulator is a fast food simulator where you manage your fast food restaurant, order supplies, restock containers, take payments at checkout and drive-thru, prepare meals, hire staff, expand your kitchen and dining area, and unlock features like storage and touchscreen checkout.

3621690.title: My Eerie Lair
3621690.short_description: A dark cozy ‘Romantasy’ furnishing game where a vampire kidnaps his beloved and tries to win her heart by turning his eerie castle into their dream home.

3622150.title: Sci Wars
3622150.short_description: Sci Wars is an exploration survival shooter set in a hostile alien desert. Use your jetpack, powerful weapons, and scavenged resources to survive deadly creatures and defeat powerful bosses.

3622220.title: The Grand Planto Heists
3622220.short_description: The neighborhood will never be the same! Play as a raccoon obsessed with the front gardens of The Grand Planto Heights in this 3D digging adventure, dodging Animal Control with your woodland critter friends and stealing whatever you can scamper away with in your paws & jaws!

3622370.title: Trick Eight
3622370.short_description: On a remote village shrouded in bloody tradition, a centuries-old ritual endures. You are a detective with unique skills, yet branded as a traitor. Will you surrender your limbs to ascend like an immortal? Or risk everything at the edge of science and plunge into the abyss of truth?

3622430.title: Study Abroad Simulator
3622430.short_description: Four years abroad. A whole new life. Take on college in near-future America! Ace your classes, earn your keep, fall in love, and play your cards right. Then start again to uncover a hidden conspiracy. Your next big decision could change more than your future—it could change the world.

3622600.title: Scratchcard Hero
3622600.short_description: Get to scratchin' in this realtime rogueli*e deckbuilder where all your cards are lottery scratch-off-micro-game tickets! Make your build of scratchcards and gadgets, and 1v1 battle other scratcher enthusiasts on your way to the source of your town's gambling problems.

3623100.title: INNERWHY
3623100.short_description: You just dissociated from reality. Unfortunately, the imaginary world you've landed in is as disturbed as your mental state. Gather your courage and confront your darkest thoughts in this 8-bit psychological horror RPG.

3623230.title: Midnight Souvenirs
3623230.short_description: Find unique artifacts and solve charming puzzles in this cozy yet mysterious Hidden Object Game with a Lovecraftian twist! Explore a Victorian mansion, interact with strange visitors, and unravel the house’s dark, eldritch past in this all hand-painted 2D game.

3623360.title: The Big Cleanup: Hotel Palm Beach
