As an Alchemist, hatch powerful dragons, discover devastating spells, and manage your empire in a persistent world shared by hundreds of players. Will you bring peace through science or rule over the ashes? The throne awaits.

3732810.title: Deadhold
3732810.short_description: Deadhold is a roguelite zombie survival/strategy game where your choices impact who lives and who dies. Rescue survivors, scavenge resources, fortify your base, and protect your community against stress, infection, and zombies! Can you find a sense of normalcy in this cruel new world?

3733130.title: Piecekeeper
3733130.short_description: Draft cards, build synergies, and battle through a whimsical and fun roguelike deckbuilder where combining factions creates endlessly replayable experiences.

3733310.title: Corpse Burger
3733310.short_description: Grind humans into “tofu” burgers, keep your customers hooked, and fight or avoid twisted mutants. Manage your secret meat supply, don't get caught, and deliver the most addictive meals in town.

3733660.title: IsekaIdle
3733660.short_description: A fantasy idle progression game inspired by deep skill-based systems. Train skills through use, conquer dungeons, manage your settlement, and optimize every system at your own pace, with no prestige resets and permanent progression.

3733880.title: Path To Freedom
3733880.short_description: Path to Freedom is a multiplayer first-person tactical shooter emphasizing squad-based coordination and combined arms warfare.

3734220.title: Guns of Eschaton
3734220.short_description: This soulslike FPS pulls you into an apocalyptic Western by the legendary Viktor Antonov: a land of dust, blood, and horror. Study your enemies, count your bullets, forge your own style with gunpowder and prayers. Solo or in co-op—go West, gunslinger, go West and die with the country!

3734710.title: ADutopia
3734710.short_description: What if advertising could change reality? In ADutopia, you transform the city through advertising: create lines at restaurants, clear away trash, plant trees, and help animals.

3734940.title: Hextalia
3734940.short_description: Build the path. Then defend it. Hextalia is a hex-based tower defense where you control the battlefield. Shape enemy routes with your towers, combine abilities to discover your own build combinations, and survive levels that punish careless builds.

3735850.title: Night Run Club
3735850.short_description: Feel the ultimate rush of overtaking 999 runners in a massive night marathon! Weave through dense colorful crowds, chain satisfying overtake combos, and upgrade your stats on the fly. Can you push your way from Rank #1000 all the way to #1 in this high-tempo casual runner?

3735980.title: Guardian Order
3735980.short_description: 1-4 co-op action roguelite where you explore ever-changing dungeons with your allies. Choose from various weapons and talents, and defeat enemies through strategic combat using environmental elements like water, fire, and electricity. Develop the Order’s base to unlock new abilities

3736070.title: Survivors Guild
3736070.short_description: A survivors-like bullet heaven with 1-4 player ONLINE CO-OP. Battle across the realm and take on hordes of monsters! Strategically choose your weapons and items to craft powerful builds, challenge bosses, and complete quests. Unlock new characters and unleash their unique weapons and abilities.

3738130.title: Economic Miracle
3738130.short_description: Take charge of any nation and lead it to greatness in the most ambitious geopolitical simulator of the modern era. Manage economy, laws, military, and diplomacy. Build the future without compromise!

3738890.title: Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare
3738890.short_description: A pausable real time tactical and resource management sim driven by dynamic battlefield events. War isn't just about combat; It’s about the daily lives of your soldiers. Keep logistics running, scavenge every usable resource, and do what you can to ease the harsh reality of life on the frontlines.

3739920.title: math is hard
3739920.short_description: math is hard is a sokoban-style puzzle game where the numbers are blocks you push around until the math works out. Line them up into equations, hit the target value, and master special blocks that change the rules.

3740710.title: Fireteam Breach
3740710.short_description: Fireteam Breach is a competitive 5v5 PvPvE tactical shooter built on destruction. Every round plays like an operation gone wrong. Civilians panic and get in the way. Get reckless, and they call the police, who can turn the round. Play by day, at dusk, or in a night storm where the power fails.

3741240.title: Jesus Christ: Necromancer
3741240.short_description: This is a fast, brutal gothic metroidvania: reap the damned with the scythe, raise their bones to fight beside you, grow stronger at every shrine, and carve your way through a dead [un]holy city to the Four Horsemen. Jesus is back... and he's back for Blood.

3741890.title: Gladiators of Roma Revixit
3741890.short_description: Gladiators of Roma Revixit is a unique, story-driven roguelike, set in world in which, after the nuclear fallout, a new Rome and thus a new colosseum rises from the radioactive-ashes. Rise the ranks, enjoy the celebrity of being a Gladiator, and make decisions that impact the story.

3742700.title: TheDowsing / ダウジング
3742700.short_description: You have entered a sealed gold mine, dreaming of a fortune. All you can rely on is your dowsing rod. Is it gold that lies beyond your reaction, or is it......?

3743070.title: TwinGrip
3743070.short_description: TwinGrip is a twin-stick physics-based puzzle-platformer video-game. That's a lot of hyphens. Control each leg of your vessel individually with a controller, or both at the same time with the mouse! Master this unique control scheme and find your way home!

3743810.title: Pact, Passion, Puchimon!
3743810.short_description: Journey across a continent teeming with diverse monsters! Capture them through intense bullet-hell battles and grow stronger together. With an in-depth nurturing system, you can build bonds with your "Puchimon" to unlock exclusive storylines and turn them into your ultimate battle partners!

3744110.title: What Do You Meme?® The Video Game
3744110.short_description: The smash-hit card game has gone digital! What Do You Meme?® The Video Game brings internet humor to the living room. Use your phone as a controller to battle your friends and build hilarious memes!

3744440.title: Hadvoron: The Godhunters
3744440.short_description: Find the way through the Shattered Cities while slaying numerous enemies and looting infinitely stacking items, in this Roguelike combining fast paced third person combat system and exploration. Playable Singleplayer or up to 4 players.

3744670.title: STAR FISH
3744670.short_description: Cast your line from your cozy asteroid home and reel in Space Fish, each with their own unique feel! Sell catches, upgrade gear, and tackle legendary fish with unique challenges when reeling them in. Customize your asteroid home! Because nothing says “Gone Space Fishin” like a well-furnished rock.

3745230.title: The Great Hatch
3745230.short_description: Help goblins take down a giant floating egg

3745860.title: Space Revolver
3745860.short_description: SPACE REVOLVER is a puzzle adventure game that follows the journey of a protagonist caught in a catastrophic black hole accident. With your spaceship critically damaged, you must explore uncharted planets, solve puzzles, repair your ship, and find your way back home.

3749580.title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe™: Dragon Pearl of Destruction
3749580.short_description: Grab your sword. Eternia needs you. You have the power!

3749760.title: Sushi On Wheels
3749760.short_description: Sushi On Wheels is a cozy management game where you run your dream sushi truck business in a Japanese setting inspired by the real life Izu Peninsula. Prep ingredients, customize your truck, and serve handmade sushi to hungry locals as you travel around Japan and complete your grandmother’s dream!

3750540.title: Fly to Butterfly Valley
3750540.short_description: Her eyes were glued to those wings as they danced across the clear blue sky, heading towards a new world.

3751230.title: Danganronpa 2x2
3751230.short_description: While on a school trip to Jabberwock Island, students are ensnared in Monokuma’s deadly game, forced into mutual killing and Class Trials to expose the culprit. Break through contradictions with high-speed detective action. Includes both a brand-new scenario and the enhanced original!

3751720.title: Dungeon Directive
3751720.short_description: You’ve taken over the guild hall in the center of town near a mysterious dungeon portal. With a small roster of heroes and limited resources, it’s your job to rebuild the guild, send parties into the depths, and shape a legacy that lasts for generations. What future will your choices create?

3753100.title: Drift.Wav II
3753100.short_description: Drift.Wav II - a synth-wave inspired drifting game that does not attempt to emulate actual drifting mechanics. But more serve as a fun game to slide around in single-player or multiplayer with over 200 car options, work your way to the top of our many leader-board's.

3753840.title: FrostBite
3753840.short_description: You buy your grandfathers house again after he died, but that was the biggest mistake you ever made. You listen to the tape the previous owner left behind and find the secrets of this old looking cabin.

3754970.title: Mysticore: Towers & Timber
3754970.short_description: Mysticore is a survival strategy game for 1-4 players. Explore the shattered realms, build your base and defend it against massive enemy waves - all while leaving the busywork to your gnomes.

3755200.title: Cannon Keep
3755200.short_description: Build your city block by block and defeat waves of mechs in this tower defense roguelike! Combine powerful cannons with unique effects to survive the unforgiving wasteland and explore the underground to gather resources and find powerful relics.

3755250.title: Life Overhaul
3755250.short_description: Design, build, and live the ultimate garage life. Create vehicles, trailers, and homes from scratch, customize every detail, and shape your own open world. Play solo or host friends in a growing community-driven sandbox of creativity and craftsmanship.

3755560.title: Lots at Stake
3755560.short_description: Build a property development company from the ground up. Find undervalued land, negotiate acquisitions, design profitable estates, navigate planning and construction, finance your projects and sell into a changing property market where every decision affects your return.

3755650.title: Radiant Sky
3755650.short_description: You and a group of adventurers must travel the world and unite the factions of weather spirits to stop constant natural disasters and stop an inevitable world ending catastrophe once the sky turns "radiant".

3756110.title: Runaway Rumble
3756110.short_description: Runaway Rumble is a fast-paced PvP action-sports game where players chase or escape using parkour and powerful abilities. Set in multiverse arenas, each character brings unique powers and style. Run. Chase. Rumble!

3756910.title: Catgirl Rage: Claws of Fury
3756910.short_description: Demon invasion has shattered the dimensions, filling the world with corrupted souls. Cat girls with unique stories unite through friendship to restore balance by purifying souls and facing fierce bosses. An exciting and adorable side-scrolling action adventure!

3757460.title: NCH: Chronos Rebirth
3757460.short_description: A sci-fi narrative visual novel focused on historical intervention, espionage, mind games, and tactical choices. You are a life scientist from the future, sent back to the eve of the Great Cataclysm. How will you rewrite the past to change a divided future?

3758090.title: Necrofane
3758090.short_description: A dark power is rising. Defeat the necromancer and his generals before they conquer the kingdom. In this old school dark fantasy RPG, explore cursed dungeons, battle monstrous foes, master forbidden magic, and gather powerful loot in a world teetering on the edge of ruin.

3758260.title: Brickstrike
3758260.short_description: Brickstrike is an online multiplayer first-person shooter set in a fully destructible and buildable voxel battlefield. Team up to dominate in a variety of competitive game modes. Featuring a variety of official and player-created maps. Enlist today!

3758780.title: Star Squadron
3758780.short_description: Star Squadron is a narrative-driven space combat simulator built for maximum immersion. Command your wing with freeform voice recognition and experience a dynamic campaign that calls you by name using our proprietary Voice Mimic System. Don't just play the game—live it.

3758980.title: NO STRAIGHT ROADS 2
3758980.short_description: Metronomik and Shueisha Games are thrilled to announce NSR2 – the explosive sequel to the hit action-music adventure NO STRAIGHT ROADS – coming to Steam in 2026.

3760140.title: Nocturnals: Cacti Coast
3760140.short_description: A narrative-driven, choose-your-own-adventure game where a young survivor must make difficult decisions in order to survive the foggy wasteland of Cacti Coast and find a community to call home.

3760470.title: Boy Escape from School
3760470.short_description: Help the Kid escape from school by solving puzzles and riddles in the latest installment of this thrilling adventure series! You’ll need wit, attention to detail, and ingenuity to break out of the locked school.

3760540.title: Dungeon Manager
3760540.short_description: This is a PVE auto Battler! Right after graduating from the management school but before getting degree certificate, you are snatched away by a red dragon and forced to be a dungeon manager. You need to fighting against the invaders of the evil empire together with the cute creatures in the dungeon.

3760980.title: DeckTerra
3760980.short_description: DeckTerra is a 4X strategy game built around cards. Explore procedurally generated maps, research new technologies, develop your settlements, and raise armies all while building a deck that complements your strategy.

3761130.title: Ash and Flame
3761130.short_description: Ash and Flame is an interactive cinematic thriller set in the dark fantasy world of Erwintal. You are Raynar, a war veteran who takes up his sword once more to face an ancient evil. Your choices shape the kingdom’s fate: ashes… or the flame of hope.

3763300.title: Punch Punch!
3763300.short_description: 在节奏明快的夏日小镇中参与单词挑战！输入单词、连续出拳，把敌人痛快击飞！与小镇居民轻松互动，通过基于记忆曲线的复习机制，让背单词更有趣，也记得更加牢固。

3764180.title: Lone City
3764180.short_description: Lone City blends romance, shooting and survival in a post-apocalyptic open world. Explore ruins, scavenge supplies and fight zombies and mutants. Drive a sports car through the city with your dog. At home, grow closer to beautiful women with distinct personalities and build a life together.

3764290.title: Re:Burn The Bonfire of Taiwan
3764290.short_description: A classic Asian drama series is reborn in anime style, and you’re the director with power to guide the clash between rival families! Re:Burn The Bonfire of Taiwan puts you in control of the narrative, allowing you to guide the beloved characters to endings from the original show.

3764510.title: Eavad
3764510.short_description: A VR roguelite dungeon-crawler where you dive into Dragonian cultist lairs—mine resources, gather intel, and settle vendettas with axes, bows, and more—then return to your cozy village to forge gear and plan your next descent.

3764550.title: Rodent Company
3764550.short_description: Battle enemy pests using randomly generated toy guns, powerful perks and unique abilities! Join with friends in up to 4-player couch co-op and gather the best arsenal to win!

3764730.title: Winter Resort Simulator 3
3764730.short_description: Run your own ski resort in Winter Resort Simulator 3. Operate ropeways, groom slopes and manage snow. Explore the biggest world in the series alone or with friends. Whether you're operating lifts, grooming slopes, or preparing for the next busy season, WRS 3 puts you in charge of the mountain.

3764950.title: Sin Hunter
3764950.short_description: An innovative roguelike deckbuilder with a fresh card combat system and character-driven relationship stories. Become a Sin Hunter, slay the Original Sins, meet four demon girls, uncover the secrets of Hell City, and become their salvation—you are this world’s “Hope.”

3765000.title: Seaworks: Trap Season
3765000.short_description: Seaworks: Trap Season is a hands-on crab fishing life sim set in the remote pacific northwest in the 1990s. Take fishing bounties by fax, maintain and customize your boat, brave changing weather, sort your catch and build a small life on the edge of the sea.

3765610.title: Desktop Pet Engine
3765610.short_description: Place your favorite characters on your desktop!A desktop idle game for work, study, and fun. Summon cute companions to keep you company, vent stress, or collect characters. Quickly access productivity tools like notepads, Pomodoro timers, and task lists—making your desktop lively and efficient!

3765790.title: coalescent || tidal rapture
3765790.short_description: In the ocean depths, merpeople are evolving, and there are whispers of a new form of connection. Dive into deep waters, deeper desire, and trying to get over your ex in this hypnagogic 3D swimming adventure game and dating sim about separation and entanglement.

3766630.title: OCULUM
3766630.short_description: OCULUM is a challenging first-person platformer set within a strange and unsettling world. Every step is a gamble, and every mistake is brutal. Climb toward the summit, uncover its secrets, and face whatever is waiting above. Will you endure?

3766830.title: Grow a Girlfriend
3766830.short_description: You accidentally grew a mushroom girl! Overcome your social anxiety to help her live her brief life to the fullest! Or don't.

3767190.title: Untamed Ehizia
3767190.short_description: Untamed Ehizia is a sandbox MMORPG with unusual game mechanics built around cooperation and social interactions. Come with friends or find new ones, and tame the world of Ehizia together.

3768050.title: Top Drifters
3768050.short_description: A minimalistic top-down racer with simple old-school arcade controls, Experience physics-based, drift-focused driving at ultra-high-speed. Master 10+ different cars with unique driving stats. Challenge your friends online in 20+ semi-destructible, chaotic races and become the world's "Top Drifter".

3768880.title: Torebia Online
3768880.short_description: Torebia: Island Odyssey is an old-school sandbox MMORPG. No classes, no pay-to-win. Craft, fight, trade, and rise through the Adventurer's Guild ranks your way. One shared world. Pure adventure.

3769010.title: Nildigo
3769010.short_description: Spicy-zen puzzle roguelite with dangerous money grids, hundreds of Perks and Powers, and a high degree of exponential breakability.

3769800.title: Elevator
3769800.short_description: Embark on a journey through The Elevator. This is not a simple trip to the top. Each stop will open your eyes to the mysteries of the Elevator. What floor will it stop on? What will it show? The Elevator decides your fate now!!! From the makers of Elevator: Source comes Elevator, the sequel.

3769870.title: RUNE GUNNER
3769870.short_description: RUNE GUNNER is a 1-4 player co-op roguelite shooter where you combine guns and magic to create game-breaking synergies. Each room hits harder, so you must mix classes mid-run and collect runes to become overpowered.

3770340.title: Bull Gone Wild
3770340.short_description: Play as a bull where you build momentum, chain attacks, and slam into enemies as everything around you explode into chaos. It’s all about feeling powerful, out of control in a good way, and turning every fight into something loud, messy, and fun.

3770490.title: Suspect None
3770490.short_description: Suspect None is a top-down open-world game where you explore the city by day and plan and pull off heists at night. Follow the story and take part in activities around the city.

3771500.title: One Matter, One Hexagram
3771500.short_description: A little ink-turtle lives on your desktop. Ask one question, tap the coin jar, and watch it cast six throws. A woodblock-printed leaf slides in - tear it off, keep it, or export it. Fully offline.

3771510.title: EURGAVA™ - Pathforgers
3771510.short_description: Here's a challenge: In this simple, 2D-isometric hack'n'slash boss rush game, the Pilgrims need you to win against the Naga Cult in 100 weeks!

3771690.title: Gunlands
3771690.short_description: Gunlands is an FPS action roguelike about crafting weapons and fighting an evil cult ready to overthrow the world with an army of ascended, mind-controlled soldiers. Find gun parts, assemble them into weapons of mass destruction, and let the chaos rain down upon your enemies.

3772860.title: Project: Shinova
3772860.short_description: The young boy, Quill, finds himself accidentally travelling through different worlds to prevent a total restart of the universe while fighting corrupted fallen angels. And while doing so, he discovers a dark and hidden history of humanity.

3773720.title: SlopTuber Simulator
3773720.short_description: SlopTuber Simulator is a short incremental adventure about filling the internet with worthless video content for fun and profit (Mostly for profit)!

3774190.title: Whispers of Elenrod
3774190.short_description: Deck-building meets strategy map exploration. Craft powerful decks. Discover mysterious artifacts on procedurally generated maps. Defeat enemies in turn-based combat and gain experience to evolve your hero. Create your best build…and find all the Whispers of Elenrod!

3774270.title: Gold Rush
3774270.short_description: Stake your claim on the frontier in this fast-paced Wild West RTS.

3774430.title: Shadowless
3774430.short_description: Shadowless is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore a creepy house marked by tragedy, where dark entities and the past haunt you. Defenseless, you face a nightmare that consumes you before you can escape.

3774800.title: Atomic Age
3774800.short_description: Criminal case in the cabaret stage Atomic Age, a comedic, retro-futuristic 2D point & click adventure in the shape of the 50th and 60th years
developers: Matthias Huber, Jill Peeters, Chris Kohler

3775270.title: Doctor Dreams Simulator
3775270.short_description: A Simulator/Adventure game where you attend, craft, manage, and enter the nightmares of your patients. Each dream changes the rules and combines exploration, combat, and stealth.

3776320.title: Fawn's Gambit
3776320.short_description: Guided by fate, you enter a mysterious card-and-board battle. Collect monster cards, build your deck, defeat legendary heroes, and uncover buried secrets. When the truth emerges, you will fight alongside heroes of old against the darkness.

3776960.title: The Legend of Zen Town
3776960.short_description: The Legend of Zen Town is a classic turn-based RPG driven by a rich narrative. Explore a world where Chinese folklore blends with vibrant street culture, hidden beneath a modern city. Uncover supernatural mysteries and ancient secrets through striking art and storytelling.

3777040.title: The Alchemist Of Alderglen
3777040.short_description: The Alchemist of Alderglen is an alchemist simulator where you nurture rare plants, harvest exotic ingredients, and brew potions using your recipe book and alchemy tools. Unlock new plants, upgrade your workspace and run a thriving potion shop.

3777110.title: Irredeemable
3777110.short_description: Irredeemable is an Open World First Person Shooter where you can explore the war and the criminal world directly on the hood.

3778400.title: Master of the Mow
3778400.short_description: Become the Master of the Mow. Cut grass, clear trash, and uncover buried treasures across the overgrown grounds of an old manor estate. Upgrade your tools and grow stronger with each trinket you sell and solve the mystery of why the grass grows back every morning. Rise and mow...again. And again.

3778810.title: Alienhead
3778810.short_description: Alienhead is a linear narrative zelda-like dungeon adventure, inspired by Binding of Isaac & dripping with nerd references & 90s nostalgia.

3779110.title: Argot's Laboratory
3779110.short_description: Argot's Laboratory is a 1-bit science simulator that puts you in charge of a high tech science lab! Modify, inspect, and evolve strange creatures, all while trying to not to lose your job... Can you complete the genetic tree before time runs out or will your boss finally snap?

3779800.title: EONA
3779800.short_description: Dive into Eona’s dark and strange tale. Survive the castle’s dangers and Melusine, the evil fairy who rules over it for she has waited so long for a soul to torment. Escape this cursed place with your loot, hoping to save your mother.

3780020.title: Artisan Acre
3780020.short_description: Artisanal Culinary Simulator: Craft aged cheeses, vintage wines, sourdough bread, and gourmet delicacies in your own workshop through manipulation of seasonal temperature and fermentation - to supply the newly annexed territory and help rebuild your nation after The Great War.

3780520.title: Mercy Incore
3780520.short_description: Solo indie character-action. You are a medieval knight in a techno-dimension. Become a jet-boosted vampire to survive. Follow a full-metal spaniel to escape

3780570.title: pond thing
3780570.short_description: PondThing is a micro-horror narrative puzzle game. It follows Shen Qingheng, a narcissistic young man who is drawn into a sacrificial ritual. As his mind grows numb and begins to break down, he is ultimately saved by his family’s “love.”

3780580.title: RogueBike GP
3780580.short_description: Race, rebuild, and adapt! create the optimal racing team and chase the world championship in this 2D Motorbike Roguelike.🏭🏍️🏁

3780630.title: CANGATO: A Cat in the Backlands
3780630.short_description: By day, a cat. By night, a man. A Brazilian roguelike that blends deckbuilding and auto-shooter mechanics in battles full of strategy and unpredictability. Face a fantastic sertão filled with monsters, poetry, and danger.

3780750.title: Flarebound
3780750.short_description: Tiny dungeon puzzle game. One flare. Ten steps. Draw a path through a forgotten dungeon before your light runs out. Avoid dangerous traps and evil creatures. 20 quests, 100 rooms.

3781350.title: Jerry the Zombie Slayer
3781350.short_description: Shoot, loot, craft, and explore in this absurdly funny roguelite against hordes of different zombies. Every death gives you the chance to build and upgrade your base… and your ego. How long can you survive?

3781420.title: southbound
3781420.short_description: A thousand years after collapse, the southern wilderness is the last frontier — and something is fracturing at its edge. Push deeper into a procedurally generated world of ruins, monsters, and growing strangeness. A survival roguelite where every run takes you further south, and further from normal.

3781570.title: No Death In Wild West
3781570.short_description: Play as time travelers wiping out cowboys with high-tech weapons. Overcome brutal terrain against an unforgiving timer. Master unique heroes with different movement styles to conquer the Wild West.

3781790.title: Eternal Anima
3781790.short_description: Embark on an adventure across eras in this love letter to JRPGs. Journey between the past and present to uncover the truth behind a lost history. Control your fate in turn-based combat by using Future Sight to foresee enemy actions and strategically rewrite the future.

3782280.title: OS95 Plus!
3782280.short_description: OS95 Plus! is the newest first person puzzle adventure game from Gev Creates. You're stuck in a mysterious facility and are forced to indefinitely partake in software testing. You must navigate rooms and solve puzzles to escape and uncover the truth behind the experiment.

3782570.title: Mystery of Prophecy
3782570.short_description: Mystery of Prophecy is a pixel art Metroidvania based on biblical prophecies, health, and parkour.

3782840.title: Mingle
3782840.short_description: Mingle is a hidden object puzzle game where you move through a crowd to find your identical twin. Each match transforms you into someone new, with hundreds of chatty little characters and surprising level twists.

3783070.title: Ether Void
3783070.short_description: New York, the 90s. Detective Frank Miller investigates a murder in a grim metropolis. Your window to the truth is an old terminal. Analyze data, crack codes, uncover digital trails. Remember: not everyone here wants you to succeed.

3783250.title: The Frutiger Utopia
3783250.short_description: An exciting puzzle-platformer based on the Frutiger Aero artstyle of the 2000s!

3783630.title: WorldWasGray
3783630.short_description: A relaxing game about painting a gray world back to life.

3783820.title: Love Bird
3783820.short_description: The next hit reality dating show is here, and YOU are the star! Your job? Win hearts, stir drama, charm the nation—or crash and burn while trying. Can you make memorable TV, uncover the secrets hidden behind the scenes, and still find romance in the chaos?

3783840.title: Knightwatch
3783840.short_description: By DAY - Build defenses and towers. BY NIGHT - grab weapon of your choice and fight off relentless waves of zombies, undead, werewolves and other monsters. In a FPS x Tower Defense game where you defend a winter town overshadowed by the King’s castle.

3784140.title: Kuny-Kuny Hog
3784140.short_description: A porky bullet hell, as chaotic and radioactive as it gets. Go after your acorns while you blast through by shooting and using your trusty roman shield to bounce back projectiles and mutant squirrels. Grab all the power ups you can in the midst of the battle!

3784360.title: Die to Play
3784360.short_description: Die to Play — a deckbuilder with dice, set on a cozy retro computer inside a medieval English mansion filled with horrors and mysteries.

3784470.title: Burakku Jakku Samurai
3784470.short_description: A tactical pixel-art roguelite. Manage your Ki up to a lethal limit of 21. Bend the rules of the duel with special cards to alter combat conditions. Risk it all to hit exactly 21 for a Perfect Focus lethal strike. Plan your route and survive. Your strategy is your sharpest weapon.

3784570.title: Gabby's Odyssey
3784570.short_description: Embark on a journey through the fantastical world of Larion in this action-adventure inspired by timeless classics of the genre. Solve clever puzzles, overcome perilous dungeons, and unlock new abilities — while discovering that imagination is not a weakness, but a force that can change everything.

3784850.title: The Way of the Ace
3784850.short_description: Compete for dominance of the court and experience the thrill of volleyball! Serve, receive, set, spike, and block your way to victory! Do you have what it takes to be the ace?

3786640.title: Fred's Idle Garden
3786640.short_description: A cozy idle farming simulator that sits anywhere on your desktop while you work or do other things. Grow and sell crops in your own little shop, earn coins, unlock upgrades and expand your garden!

3786990.title: Happy Door
3786990.short_description: Magic, Horror, Co-op Survive together in Happy Door, a mysterious space with fellow wizards. Gather resources through co-op play and purchase powerful spells to endure the horror.

3787050.title: It Works: Electronics Repair Simulator
3787050.short_description: Step into the shoes of an electronics technician and repair damaged devices: receivers, phones, speakers, and more. Solder, diagnose, replace components, earn money, and grow your workshop!

3787130.title: Rescue Heli
3787130.short_description: In this arcade style simulation game, be the pilot of a life saving helicopter and a member of a life saving crew. Whenever lives are in danger you will make a difference by ensuring that the help is there.

3787890.title: Stellar Freight: Echoes of the Void
3787890.short_description: Take command of a freight ship traveling through deep space. Every jump brings danger, every decision matters. Manage your crew, upgrade your ship, trade, fight, and survive in a hostile galaxy where resources are scarce and every day could be your last.

3788110.title: DungeonBox
3788110.short_description: A fantasy party game for up to 8 players, where everyone joins in from their phones. Type what you want to do, vote for the best idea, and roll dice to see if it works!

3788160.title: Terminal War
3788160.short_description: Terminal War is a grounded, team-based third-person shooter set in a fractured America during the late 1990s. Engage in intense combat across war-torn cities, forgotten towns, and contested territory where every bullet, every strike, and every decision counts.

3788310.title: Grimmdustry
3788310.short_description: Grimmdustry is an automation game with adventure and RPG elements. After finding yourself stranded in a medieval world full of fantasy tropes, use your knowledge of modern technology to find a way home, or use it to make this new world your own!

3789230.title: Kalit
3789230.short_description: A unique survival adventure, animated in a 1930s rubber hose style! Fight to survive: capture creatures, farm, mine, and craft everything you need: from gear and vehicles to your base. Explore strange lands and an underwater world of shipwrecks, dangers, and hidden wonders.

3789740.title: Şehri Racon
3789740.short_description: Şehr-i Racon is a humorous 2D side-scrolling beat 'em up inspired by the streets of Istanbul. Fight colorful enemies, unleash powerful special moves, use unusual weapons, explore vibrant locations, and face challenging bosses!

3790810.title: Coasteroid
3790810.short_description: Build stellar rollercoasters across alien worlds, carve tunnels through planets, and launch trains into orbit. Customize every track element, scenery decoration, and environment before subjecting riders to the forces of the universe! The galaxy is your theme park!

3791850.title: Instruments of Power
3791850.short_description: Prime the battlefield with the spells you built. Consume what you laid down to summon an army of your selves, then strike the shadows before your tether to this world gives out. A turn-based tactical RPG where every spell you cast is one you built, and every summon is a choice.

3792120.title: Rogue's Odyssey
3792120.short_description: Explore, Grind, Loot, Die, and repeat! Face hordes of monsters and challenging bosses in a 2.5D co-op roguelike ARPG. Combine skills across classes, creating thousands of unique builds, such as a potion-brewing Warrior or a wizardry Cat, the choice is yours!

3792170.title: LOVE WMC
3792170.short_description: "Love wmc" is a visual novel game based on music games. It tells a series of stories about the protagonist who came to a small county town to study alone due to family conflicts, and accidentally got involved with four female protagonists because of an arcade music game.

3793270.title: Bygoner
3793270.short_description: A medieval road-movie parable blending rogue-lite action and journey management, wrapped in vintage cinema aesthetics. Follow a nameless knight through the southern lands of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania (modern-day Ukraine) at the beginning of the 16th century.

3794190.title: Sliding Dungeons
3794190.short_description: Slide, survive, and escape a deadly dungeon full of traps, monsters, bosses, and weird villagers.

3794520.title: Rebounder
3794520.short_description: Nail the run. Deliver your line. Rebounder is a hand-crafted precision platformer about a roughneck worker recruited for a hazardous job on a distant planet. A tough-but-fair gauntlet set in a surreal comic-book world of ink, paper, and print.

3794620.title: Sails
3794620.short_description: Plunder, craft and live the pirate’s life. This is a multiplayer pirate survival game where you mine, craft, trade and plunder to survive. Form alliances with other players to strengthen your crew and wage war on your enemies. Fight to keep what’s yours before others take it.

3794760.title: MonsterGirl 3:Wukong
3794760.short_description: "Monster Girl 3: Wukong" is an interactive narrative game that combines strategic battles with branching storylines. Collect various mystic elixirs for trading, and unlock enchanting demoness characters to keep as desktop companions.

3796220.title: Timber trail
3796220.short_description: You take over as the new ranger overseeing the infamous Timber Trail, a trail known for mysterious disappearances and the Timber Trail Murders.

3796670.title: The Legend of Simurgh
3796670.short_description: You are a small bird traveling through 7 valleys to find the Simurgh and bring life back to your village.

3798020.title: Ponchorado
3798020.short_description: Ponchorado is a satirical Wild West survival-action game with roguelite elements in a 1930s cartoon style, set in the ruins of a never-finished western movie. Play as Poncho, a forgotten stuntman battling through chaos, clichés, and caricatures.

3798350.title: InOut
3798350.short_description: A minimalist puzzle platformer where each level is more than they seem. Change your perspective on levels to discover new areas. Explore the world to unearth its hidden secrets.

3798500.title: Tower of Elyndium
3798500.short_description: Tower of Elyndium is a single-player action RPG featuring souls-like combat, where you ascend a mysterious tower. Face challenging enemies and bosses while exploring puzzle-filled floors and uncovering the secrets hidden at the tower’s peak.

3798560.title: KAL
3798560.short_description: KAL is a first-person psychological horror game. Trapped in an old, abandoned Creole house, immerse yourself in a time loop and relive the story of a slave who became a true legend.

3798860.title: Shutter Story
3798860.short_description: Examine a family's photo album to reveal signs of the paranormal, as the horror unfolds in the house around you. Their fate is in your hands.

3798930.title: Analog - MIRROR
3798930.short_description: An unopened 90s shooter game offers an unexpected distraction during a quiet weekend at home. What seems like a harmless way to pass the time may lead to consequences you never expected.

3798950.title: Buff Climbers
3798950.short_description: Physics-driven rogue-like platformer for you and your friends. Each run brings new hazards, fresh loot, and betrayal. Buff Climbers is in early development. Please excuse the lack of polish.

3801400.title: Sovia: Box & Order
3801400.short_description: Run a busy little paper warehouse. Shelve chilled, fragile and bulky goods, pack the right boxes, rest a tired crew and chain their skills into an ensemble. Follow eight stops to recover a lost route book, then reshape any warehouse in the level editor.

3801590.title: Ponchyo: A Platypus Adventure
3801590.short_description: Ponchyo: A Platypus Adventure is a charming 3D platformer collectathon full of adventure - and a hint of nostalgia! Play as Ponchyo the platypus and journey through a variety of vibrant worlds. Collect coins and discover new furniture to decorate your home.

3801690.title: Var Game Simulator
3801690.short_description: Var Game Simulator allows you to manage critical moments of football like a VAR referee. Carefully examine offside, penalty and card decisions and make the right decision. Experience the excitement of football through the eyes of a referee with realistic scenarios!

3801750.title: Exile 2097: Space Odyssey
3801750.short_description: Exile 2097: Space Odyssey is a near-future hard sci-fi epic. Lead the Human Continuity Government, build solar-system colonies, upgrade space stations, shape society, uncover the AI rebellion threat, and guide humanity’s final return to Earth amid unknown dangers.

3802140.title: Cassette Beasts 2002
3802140.short_description: Record, battle, and fuse with 250+ beasts as you adventure alongside diverse companions in this monster-collecting RPG. Set in London in 2002, play in single-player or online to unmask an enigmatic occultist who threatens the realms of man and beast! When worlds collide, take the leap beyond!

3803060.title: Evelume
3803060.short_description: An atmospheric 2D adventure about a schoolkid in a small town where adults are stuck in a gray, monotonous life. Explore, fight, solve puzzles, and try to uncover the something that has drained people of joy.

3803380.title: Arena
3803380.short_description: Directional, team-focused medieval PvP. Fight 1v1, 2v2 or 3v3 with sword, bow and staff, choose your abilities from a wide selection, and outplay your opponents with timing, reads and teamwork. Climb the ranked ladder. Now in open alpha.

3803720.title: Meowniverse
3803720.short_description: Merge endless cats on your desktop! Every cat you adopt becomes a unique part in your Collection. Evolve your cats, complete the Collection, and enjoy their company. They’ll embark on adventures, bringing you coins and fish! Get ready to huff cats and let their sweet meows lift your spirits!

3804470.title: Defiled West
3804470.short_description: A top-down Western Action RPG set in a desolate & mutated frontier. Discover and overpower furiously unstable foes that waver the rules of life and death. Collect and upgrade powerful weapons and wield a variety of otherworldly gadgets. Reclaim what was lost, one building at a time.

3805350.title: Aghori
3805350.short_description: Aghori is a psychological horror game set in the Himalayan foothills. Unravel dark rituals, cursed forests, and forgotten villages as Rudra searches for his missing friends in a narrative-rich journey through fear, mysticism, and the unknown

3805540.title: Runic Prophecy
3805540.short_description: Runic Prophecy is a challenging third-person soulslike action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Explore Eyjusheim, unleash magic and a dragon in combat, battle supernatural creatures, and uncover the hidden lore of a shattered world.

3805560.title: CyberQuest
3805560.short_description: Explore CyberQuest, where your decisions define you. Journey from a novice freelancer to a skilled hacker. Choose your path: white hat, black hat, or hacktivist, and embrace the cyber challenge!

3806010.title: Polaria
3806010.short_description: Polarium is a relaxing idle game set in the serene world of Antarctica. Discover peaceful marine life, learn about polar ecosystems, and find comfort in nature. Inspired by real research, the game blends healing gameplay with subtle messages on climate and biodiversity.

3806160.title: electric strategy
3806160.short_description: A turn-based tactics game where every action costs energy. Command robots across a grid-based battlefield, transfer power between units, and help machines reclaim their will.

3806350.title: Harventure
3806350.short_description: Harvest, collect and upgrade! Harventure is a short incremental game about harvesting and using resources on upgrades to purify islands from corruption.

3806530.title: OneMore
3806530.short_description: Can you tell which definitions are fake and which aren't? OneMore combines traditional word-building games with rounds where you try to pick the one true definition out of four - three of them built by an AI.

3806610.title: Light&Claw
3806610.short_description: Light & Claw is a 3D top-down ARPG. In a godless era, White Mage Dboy runs a magic hospital using nature’s power. After a freak accident, he fuses with the White Tiger Brek. Now, Dboy can transform into Brek to fight! Join them and sister Luceria to find the lost God.

3807200.title: Low Battery
3807200.short_description: A puzzle game inspired by sokoban. Play the role of a power-recycling robot. Plan your route carefully to maneuvering other units and make your way out. Collcet power little by little, locate the source of Infinite Power and Leave this Factory.

3807260.title: A Cut Above: Mow & Grow
3807260.short_description: Build your lawn-care business from the mower seat. Take on contracts, cut generated properties, upgrade your equipment, manage fuel and clippings, and expand into new service areas as the jobs get bigger.

3807740.title: FreedomBot
3807740.short_description: Turn-based roguelike where you play as a rogue bot surviving in procedurally generated cities. Features sophisticated character development and in depth combat using a detailed anatomical damage system .

3809040.title: The Exalted Descendant
3809040.short_description: Rebuild a fallen species in this dark sci-fi 4X strategy game. Extract and refine real elements, command drone swarms, and make tough choices as you guide The Exalted Descendant toward resurgence—or extinction—in a procedurally generated galaxy. No diplomacy. No mercy.

3809580.title: Homelander’s Valor
3809580.short_description: Become a hero of Eastern legend. Explore ancient secrets, plan your defenses, combine tower types and modifiers, and build an indestructible fortress in a tower-defence game with survival elements.

3809850.title: Heroes of Might and Magic III Remake
3809850.short_description: Rediscover the critically acclaimed turn-based strategy classic and its two expansions, faithfully rebuilt in full 3D and 4K. Explore a vibrant fantasy world and lead mighty heroes in epic battles.

3810050.title: Rabona
3810050.short_description: Rabona is an online multiplayer soccer game with physics-based gameplay. Take total ball control with precise touches. Join the real football action with your friends. Feel the game.

3810840.title: Cairns
3810840.short_description: Balance. Patience. Perfection. Cairns is the quintessential Stone Stacking game. Experience diverse and atmospheric environments, and master the art of building the freestanding stone towers know as Cairns.

3811320.title: Meow Recruit
3811320.short_description: Meow Recruit is a casual strategy game where you play as HR in an animal company. Recruit employees, arrange workstations, optimize your team, and build facilities to maximize company's profits. Are you the real HR master?

3811700.title: Greeblings
3811700.short_description: Greeblings is a chaotic multiplayer platformer where silly creatures use abilites and crafty builds to escape the hunters who use traps and sharpshooting to stop them

3812220.title: Versalis
3812220.short_description: A fast-paced, grid-based, card-flipping tactical CCG for up to 4 players! Archetypes and team Dynamics bring powerful abilities to move, defend, swap, or reorient cards. Capture the board and flip your way to victory!

3812700.title: CORINNE
3812700.short_description: Navigate Corinne through a realm of pixel horrors, surrounded by neighbors that are turning into bloodthirsty monsters. Discover the secrets of this twisted dimension before it's too late for Corinne and her friends.

3812730.title: SOS (Save Our Ship)
3812730.short_description: SOS is a 4-player online co-op horror-action game. Operate your ship, explore dangerous islands, loot valuable treasures, and escape deadly enemies to repay your soul’s debt. Strategy and teamwork are key to survival!

3812890.title: Chain Corp
3812890.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder about hunting for CEOs. Survive the endless hordes of CHAIN CORP. Collect the rarest cards and combos for future runs.

3812930.title: Caribbean Tide
3812930.short_description: Sail the 17th-century Caribbean as John Nelson. Smuggle or trade, upgrade your ship, manage your crew and colony, and uncover buried truths across 10+ ports, 50+ branching quests, and a vast open world shaped by shifting alliances and moral choices.

3813070.title: Cyberpunk Crafter
3813070.short_description: A cyberpunk open world crafting simulator, immerse yourself in a neon-lit city of your own design. Vibe out while unlocking your way to a spaceport and win your freedom on the interstellar stage.

3813870.title: BLOK
3813870.short_description: BLOK is an Orwellian psychological horror game set in post-communist Poland. You play as a political exile who fled the country during the communist regime. Years later, after the system’s collapse, a strange letter from your mother draws you back home. But something is deeply wrong.

3813960.title: Ragga-Dagga
3813960.short_description: An Action Roguelite where Aggressive Play is Rewarded Handsomely! Explore a Non-Euclidean Dungeon filled with hidden mysteries in this oh so cute adventure about a catling and his sentient floating sword!

3814440.title: Petty Kings
3814440.short_description: A pixel art Survival RTS where you rebuild a fallen kingdom by day, defend against brutal night raids, and march out to crush enemy outposts. Take back your crown!

3814960.title: miniopolis
3814960.short_description: Create, shape, and customize a miniature metropolis with intuitive and satisfying tools. Construct towering cityscapes, fine-tune their look and layout, and give every structure its own distinctive character. Build the way you want in this resource-free city-building sandbox.

3815100.title: Soulscape2 Fragments of The Present
3815100.short_description: Dive into a dark cyber noir conspiracy in this solo developed, story rich CRPG. Set in a dystopian near future, guide Blake Turner and his squad through isometric exploration, deeply strategic turn-based combat, branching dialogue, and infinite post game progression.

3815560.title: Ashfield Hollow
3815560.short_description: Build a life in the ruins. Ashfield Hollow combines deep survival, real-time combat, farming, crafting, and fishing in a post-apocalyptic world that nearly didn't make it. Ten years after the outbreak, Camp Ashfield is one of the last places left. Whether it stays that way is up to you.

3816220.title: WingWhiz
3816220.short_description: WingWhiz brings classic arcade shoot 'em ups into 3D with roguelite progression. Destroy everything in your path, level up, build your plane, unlock new weapons and planes, and try different playstyles as you fight through new worlds.

3816260.title: JungoJam
3816260.short_description: JungoJam now boasts a hip downtown strip, tranquil beaches, and islands perfect for unleashing your creativity. Here, you can be anyone you dream of! Team up with friends from across the globe to explore an interactive wonderland, design your Original Characters！

3816400.title: Super Carpark Walking Parking Simulator Turbo
3816400.short_description: Super Carpark Walking Parking Simulator Turbo is the definitive animated carpark chaotic parking simulator!!! Park cars before its too late!

3817210.title: Unicycle Gorilla
3817210.short_description: Ride a motorized unicycle as a gorilla in Unicycle Gorilla! Casual 3D speedrun with global leaderboards, hilarious crashes, and wild levels. Balance with L1/R1, dodge bombs, and rule the urban jungle!

3818770.title: SuperWEIRD: Automation Roguelite
3818770.short_description: An automation roguelite for 1–4 players. Set worker bots to craft and deliver supplies while fighting bots battle the Goofy Goo. Piece a broken planet back together, strengthen your production network and try new strategies on each run.

3818950.title: PanzenTD
3818950.short_description: A charming tower defense game where heroic panda warriors defend their homeland against waves of destructive robots. Build towers, deploy unique heroes, and outsmart your enemies across stylized jungle battlefields.

3819070.title: Between Two Lights
3819070.short_description: Between Two Lights, an adventure shooter that explores the importance of awareness and the value of choice: give in to love and escape, or sacrifice everything for the truth.

3820000.title: BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy
3820000.short_description: Listen up, comrade! Tired of feeling like a terrible chess player? Ditch the flashy modern tools. My routine is simple: I teach you a sharp concept, you apply it in a puzzle, then I unveil the secret twist. Survive my training, and become a true Chess Master!

3820870.title: Gridpaper
3820870.short_description: If you're shooting more than once, you're doing it wrong. At the junction of the physical and informatic realms, Gridpaper is a high-precision FPS headshot speedrunning game where missed shots are punished. Destroy brains, harvest their Informatica for speed, and climb the global leaderboard.

3821020.title: Wheel Wills
3821020.short_description: A roguelike where every attack is a gamble. Spin the Wheel to decide what each day throws at you, fill your grid with Gambits that either hit or miss, and repaint the Wheel itself to bend the odds your way

3821140.title: The Horror Quest
3821140.short_description: The Horror Quest is a project of a secret organization that creates bloody shows under the guise of games. There are no scripts and safe zones here - only real danger, primal fear and the fight for life. Will you be able to get out of the game alive?

3822370.title: 祓ノ狐
3822370.short_description: Purifying Fox is a Japanese-style action adventure inspired by a book found in an old shrine storehouse. The story shifts between two phases: Escape, where you cannot fight and must survive, and Purification, where you seal the spirits and restore balance.

3822860.title: Bottom-Up Beatdown: Hostile Takeover
3822860.short_description: Bottom-Up Beatdown: Hostile Takeover is an intense 2D beat em' up set in a world dominated by corporations led by monsters! The only way out is up! Begin your freelance kaiju career in campaign mode, or play with friends in the traditional, challenging arcade mode!

3824000.title: Small Living World 2
3824000.short_description: Is a peaceful ecosystem simulator, bringing every aspect of nature to life. From the water cycle and plant growth, to animal behaviors and reproduction, observe your small living world evolve. All the tools are at your disposal to create your perfect forest.

3824590.title: Decision Point: Battlegroup Operational Simulator
3824590.short_description: Plans meet friction in Decision Point, a wargame where you issue NATO-standard orders, observe AI execution in real time, and adapt as the battlefield evolves. At key Decision Points, the action pauses—giving you time to reassess, redirect your forces, and outmanoeuvre the enemy.

3824680.title: Quantum Quartz
3824680.short_description: Steampunk pixel-art precision platformer where you toggle platforms on and off using colored crystals. With only one active at a time, each grants a different movement ability, changing how you move and how the level works, blending high-skill platforming with spatial puzzles.

3824720.title: Descent Of Lunaris
3824720.short_description: Assemble your squad and explore a lunar base where cosmic horrors warp your reality, challenge your strategy, and break your sanity. Descent of Lunaris is a grid-based dungeon crawling RPG inspired by Wizardry and Shin Megami Tensei.

3824730.title: Chronal Chain
3824730.short_description: "TIME CONTROL" bullet hell action. Overcome impossible odds by slowing, stopping and rewinding time!

3825470.title: Ta-Miu
3825470.short_description: Play as a cat chosen by the goddess Bastet. Solve ancient puzzles, unlock magical powers, and uncover the secrets of Egypt filled with myths, temples, and tombs. Embark on a mystical adventure and stop an ancient evil!

3827200.title: Shrouded Siege
3827200.short_description: Design dastardly mazes in this co-op roguelike tower defense set in Irish mythology. Combine divine boons to make unstoppable towers and sculpt the terrain to make the ultimate death traps for your enemies.

3827480.title: Angels Die
3827480.short_description: Play as a group of female intelligence agents in this turn-based tactical espionage RPG set in 1976 during the Cold War. Build your own characters, get them more and more skills until they become a modern day Leonardo Da Vinci. Unless they die first.

3828560.title: Car-Nudge
3828560.short_description: Car-Nudge is a party game with cars. Play locally or online with up to 8 players, through different minigames and levels. Demolish your friends (or enemies) to win and unlock new customizations and cars to play with.

3828740.title: Chicken Jump, Puppy Jump
3828740.short_description: An online multiplayer party game for 4–8 players. Build your crew of robo-animal thieves, roam across insane locations to snatch treasures, or simply STEAL goodies from rival players — all to become the MOST WANTED crew on the Bounty Board!

3829320.title: Margin of Error
3829320.short_description: Princess Elyra is bound to a cursed grimoire. Lead her party through six monster-filled regions in this deckb-building roguelite RPG, where every attack is a numbers puzzle: play number and operation cards to hit each enemy’s exact target. Miss it, and the monster makes you pay.

3830030.title: Rollout Rally
3830030.short_description: Race solo or with friends in Rollout Rally, a physics-based marble racing party game. Play with up to 4 players in split-screen on one PC, or up to 6 online or over LAN. Team up in 3v3 races, steer, boost, shove rivals with Pulse, block hits with Shield and roll to victory!

3830400.title: The Calling
3830400.short_description: An anime-inspired free-to-play PvP arena shooter where every match is shaped by your build, strategy, and creativity. Customize your abilities, adapt to dynamic weather and day-night cycles, and outplay the competition in fast-paced battles.

3831050.title: Smash Simulator
3831050.short_description: Inherit a failing company and transform it into a destruction empire! Build and manage your own Rage Rooms, let clients smash objects to relieve stress… and turn it all into profit!

3831390.title: Boundless world
3831390.short_description: Enter the vast forest of Boundless World , no traditional map boundaries, procedural random details/buildings make battles variable; battlefield has differentiated destruction (explodable procedural buildings as key variables); agile AI feels like real players, single-player has multiplayer tension.

3831610.title: Yatai Master
3831610.short_description: Run Neko Ramen, the street food stall you inherited in Fukuoka, for one last year. Shop at the markets, cook more than 100 dishes by hand, and get to know 40 regulars who come back night after night with their own stories.

3832050.title: Rising Fox
3832050.short_description: Embark on an unforgettable adventure. Explore a mysterious world, uncover the secrets of the Zoodiacs, and face a threat that could destroy everything. Save your village as you dive into a story where nothing is as it seems.

3833330.title: The Friendliest Skunk
3833330.short_description: Skunk is the friendliest critter in the forest — but his natural scent makes making friends a bit… tricky. Help Skunk traverse a musical forest, in this charming rhythm-based platformer! Meet adorable forest friends, outwit hungry predators, and prove that kindness (+ good timing) conquers all!

3834020.title: Supa-Market: Japanese Super-Market Simulator
3834020.short_description: Build your own Japanese supermarket! Stock unique products, organize shelves, serve customers, hire staff, set prices, and grow your cozy anime-inspired store into a thriving business. Every decision shapes your supermarket!

3834100.title: Hunt for the Lost Folktales
3834100.short_description: A folklore hunting, turn-based battling, creature collector adventure where you follow trails to hunt escaped folktale beasts, engage in strategic tactical battles where fear is your strength, and capture the lost folktales so they may live on in memory. Will you be another folktale to be written?

3834160.title: HOTLIME
3834160.short_description: Chaotic PvP party game for 2–4 players. Citrus fighters battle to the death in a hellish skyscraper — one hit decides everything. Escape, if the bartender lets you!

3834770.title: DIVINE CRAFTING WORKSHOP
3834770.short_description: Ancient China handcraft sim with shadow puppet art & multiple endings. As a craftsman, take orders, craft works, unlock dynasty stories. Full version: 7 dynasties, 28 categories, 110+ collectible handicrafts, 300+ event/40+ main endings, 50+ panda events & letters—immerse in traditional crafts.

3835080.title: Terrafarmer
3835080.short_description: A roguelite farming strategy game where every tile matters. Choose from randomly offered polyomino crop tiles, arrange them for powerful synergies, and terraform a dead planet before your debt catches up.

3835100.title: Pinkwilds
3835100.short_description: A sci-fi multiplayer survival RPG with no guns - fight with weapons and magic instead. Explore an alien world, gather resources, craft gear, and build your base. Trade, form alliances, raid, or betray other players to survive.

3835430.title: Golden Steam
3835430.short_description: Golden Steam is a thrilling arcade-puzzle adventure where you collect Golden Steams and activate machine parts to recover artifacts scattered through fractured time. Navigate 10 worlds, master geometric rotations, and control time itself in a steampunk sci-fi universe where every second counts.

3836490.title: Lead The Dragon
3836490.short_description: Join your crew and conquer the narrow roads of America. Explore the open world, earn respect and money by competing in street races, but breaking the law will bring you serious trouble with the police.

3836750.title: Uncivilized
3836750.short_description: A short-form empire building strategy game. Explore the planet and grow your colony, while attempting to negotiate with the many characterful rival factions. Make friends, break allegiances, or just drop nukes on them.

3836940.title: Realm Nine
3836940.short_description: On the land of Jiuzhou, there are fragments of your plundered Elf Wings hidden. You will play as five types of real-time shapeshifters and embark on a journey to find the lost fragments.

3837160.title: Strawberry Flavor Sci-Fi
3837160.short_description: Like strawberries? If they went extinct, how would we find their taste again? This fundamentalist suspense & sci-fi visual novel lets you step into the shoes of an Ocular to unravel a series of conspiracies woven from tech ethics and human nature in a near-future world that could arrive anytime.

3837280.title: Born Without Rights
3837280.short_description: Born Without Rights is a third-person, story-driven action-adventure with stealth, gunfights, and exploration. Inspired by The Last of Us and Max Payne, experience a tense linear story of survival and resistance in a world without freedom.

3837790.title: Fathoms
3837790.short_description: Fathoms: Narrative psychological horror meets anomaly game. Survive 24 days in a row with your wife in an apartment in the underwater city of Fathoms while you lose your mind or die – and the nightmare starts all over again...

3838040.title: Dukun
3838040.short_description: a relentless, psychedelic bullet-hell FPS where you harness black magic and carve a blood-soaked path through seven powerful shamans to ascend as the ultimate witch.

3839180.title: POSTAL 2 Redux
3839180.short_description: POSTAL 2 Redux lets you loose in the most chaotic sandbox shooter ever, fully reimagined for a new generation. Survive a week in Paradise, Arizona - buy milk, return books, or go completely POSTAL with an arsenal of weapons. The choice is yours…but good luck staying out of trouble.

3839400.title: WOLF OF THE DESERT
3839400.short_description: Infiltrate Qamaria tower. Sneak through shadows, observe your surroundings. Gather ability chips to destroy and hack security devices, vanish, teleport past enemies, outsmart them using clones. Combine and upgrade ability chips for the ultimate loadout and bring down a corporate empire.

3839680.title: BLIGHTFALL
3839680.short_description: A fast-paced roguelike FPS built on momentum. Slide-jump, air-strafe, and bunny-hop through relentless hordes, chain mid-air dash-executions, charge shrines for loot, and break the game with stacked builds before time runs out. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

3840100.title: Miraclawns
3840100.short_description: A unique roguelite strategy where you strengthen slimes through gambling. As the Demon King, use fate-altering bets to boost your small slimes' stats and deploy them to the frontlines. Will your judgment or overwhelming "luck" overcome the brutal battlefield?

3840240.title: Tiny Kitchen: Burger Edition
3840240.short_description: Stack, flip, and drop your way to burger glory in this cozy physics-based cooking game. Whether you’re actively grilling or letting orders wait, Tiny Kitchen is perfect for focused breaks and relaxed chaos.

3840770.title: Shapesetter
3840770.short_description: An open-ended puzzle game about building machines that make modernist art. Program mechanical arms to paint, cut and weld shapes into finished pieces, then refine your machine to be faster, smaller or cheaper.

3841840.title: Loopstructor 2: Skyspine
3841840.short_description: Build rail networks, deploy battle trains, and use turret enchantments to create mobile fortresses. Hold the line in the wasteland left by the Sinking, uncover the floating city's dark truth, and choose between conviction and rebellion.

3842110.title: Bookmark Hero
3842110.short_description: Bookmark Hero is a fantasy, peripheral-idle RPG. Play from a bookmark-sized window on the side of your screen and instruct your hero with queued tasks. Watch as they explore lands, conquer monsters, hone skills, craft gear, and embark on quests. Even as you work, their legend unfolds.

3842660.title: XX Fulfillment Center
3842660.short_description: You've been hired as a Part-Time Contract Packaging Worker at the fulfillment center.Can you find your own happiness amid the speeding conveyor belts and ever-growing list of rules?

3842830.title: ANDREAD
3842830.short_description: Complete randomly assigned errands in Torpa, a strange neighborhood trapped in an endless time loop.

3843710.title: 永恒少女和天使
3843710.short_description: A cute shota game that heals both your body and mind

3844300.title: Frame of Suffering
3844300.short_description: Master both man and machine to escape the Ancient Temple. Customize your Hero and a modifiable Combat Frame to slay hordes and gatekeepers. Scavenge tech, uncover the Temple's history, and evolve your build in this Sci-Fi Action RPG. You're a prisoner - freedom lies at the heart of the Temple.

3844370.title: Codename Sunday
3844370.short_description: A top-down, fast paced hero shooter. Kill tanks to upgrade yourself and become an undefeatable killing machine. Fight friends or foes in multiple engaging gamemodes and become the best of your kind.

3844880.title: Terragoat
3844880.short_description: Take up the responsibilities of terraforming an entire planet through a newfangled technological invention which could be roughly surmised as putting a goat inside of a pocket dimension to generate a potentially infinite amount of energy.

3844950.title: Depth Perception
3844950.short_description: It’s the 1980s. A rural cop investigates a fellow officer’s disappearance. With limited ammo and failing gear, you'll explore eerie landscapes, piece together clues, and face your own fears; no jumpscares, just tense psychological unraveling. Will you find the truth… or lose yourself?

3845020.title: ASTROBURROW
3845020.short_description: Embark on an epic journey through uncharted galaxies. Build new space civilizations, and fight for the future of the species in this pixel art space strategy game.

3845250.title: Sector 73
3845250.short_description: Top-down coop shooter. Fight down through nanite-infested research labs and uncover what the executive found in the Oram ruins. Flip on the flash light and keep firing until nothing is left standing.

3845350.title: Ignitement
3845350.short_description: Shape your flame in this explosive roguelite and survivorslike inferno. Craft unique fire magic, unlock new masks and abilities, collect ancestral loot, and incinerate hordes of enemies in a never-ending battle against your inner demons.

3845950.title: Farm of the unseen
3845950.short_description: Something is wrong on this farm. Shadows and horrors lurk in its corners, waiting as you uncover buried secrets and solve twisted puzzles. Explore lakes, stables, and fields. Wander through mazes and cursed chambers. The unseen are waiting. They have always known you were coming.

3846390.title: Late Night Empire
3846390.short_description: Run your own late-night TV show in a living entertainment industry. Book guests, write monologues, manage staff and money, battle rival shows for ratings, and survive your network. Every night is a fight for attention. Build the show. Run the room. Become the empire.

3846560.title: ClickiBrick
3846560.short_description: In ClickiBrick matching is the name of the game. Match at least 4 colors together to break them, chain them, and score points! See how high you can get! Easy to get into, and hard to put down.

3846690.title: Contact Protocol
3846690.short_description: Contact Protocol is a starship job simulator set aboard a corporate vessel bound for Jupiter. Investigate incoming ships, uncover suspicious activity, and make impossible choices as you protect your crew - while the company watches your every move.

3846890.title: First Layer: 3D Printing Simulator
3846890.short_description: Build and run your own 3D printing business, from a single garage printer to a full print farm. Slice models, keep all printers running, paint your prints and fix your machines. Fill orders online and in your own store, manage filament stock, grow your business layer by layer.

3847530.title: ChildStory 2: Say Cheese!
3847530.short_description: Say Cheese is a farmer simulator with roguelike elements, in which Sonya will not only develop her own cheese factory, but also find out the reason why everyone in the city has nightmares at night.

3848350.title: Emocre
3848350.short_description: Emocre is a retro-inspired monster-taming adventure where you explore dreamlike worlds, tame living emotions, and discover a story about self-discovery and inner peace.

3848440.title: Mimic Sleuth
3848440.short_description: No chest is safe in this logic puzzle roguelite! These mimic-filled dungeons are just waiting to be looted... but only the most observant and clever adventurers will make it out alive.

3848760.title: Pax Astralis
3848760.short_description: A real-time strategy game in retro vector graphics. Settle an eleven-world star system where no single world can feed an army, ship ore and troops along the orbits, and storm the Imperial Palace on Imperia, throne world of the Empire.

3849030.title: Tired of Being the Hero
3849030.short_description: You saved the realm. Now you just want to chop wood, but monsters won't let you retire. Train your villagers, pull them out of harm's way, unlock new abilities to outlast the next assault, and try to remember why you became a Hero. Hold the line together in this short, story-rich, fantasy action RPG

3849050.title: Witch War 1
3849050.short_description: Wage a war...with witches! Take control of islands one battlefield at a time in this team-based action roguelike. Play alone or with friends and become the last witch army standing!

3849100.title: Sven Rescues a Princess
3849100.short_description: Sven Rescues a Princess is a 3D co-op horde brawler for 1–10 players. Hack and slash through 30–45 minute runs to save six princesses, then live with whatever you brought home. Hordes keep time with the music. Unlock everything by playing. No microtransactions or loot boxes.

3849330.title: Chaos The Devil
3849330.short_description: Ps1 era inspired 3D platformer. Run, jump and fly your way through a new adventure, done the old way. A multi-year solo passion project, handcrafted from scratch.

3849950.title: Barzakh: Star Gardener
3849950.short_description: Survive a plane crash and enter the veil between life and death. Solve physics-bending puzzles, collect lost stars, and cultivate a garden within your mind. In this atmospheric journey inspired by The Little Prince and Sufi mysticism, the only way out is within.

3850090.title: Coup de Koala
3850090.short_description: Seize back the crown in Coup de Koala, a cute bullet hell roguelite of furious rebellion. As an exiled koala king, unleash spells and steel against relentless undead legions to reclaim your throne. Build your deck of cards, die, upgrade your character, repeat.

3850310.title: Inuyo High: Lesson 1
3850310.short_description: Welcome to Inuyo Academy, an all-ages school once filled with joy. Something terrible happened after the school’s mascot staff was revealed to the public, and it’s your job as an officer to investigate the abandoned building, in search of evidence to figure out the truth.

3850340.title: Pain-Hatching
3850340.short_description: Game about a rooster, friendship, family, a cult, WOMAN, and chthonic horrors.

3850490.title: Mega Hasan 2: Wallet Detective
3850490.short_description: Mega Hasan is back! Last time he had to find his own wallet. This time he's here to find other people's crap! Run and jump through 56 levels across 7 worlds. Battle bosses, unlock characters and team up with a friend in local co-op!

3850920.title: SPEEDING
3850920.short_description: An arcade-style racing game — experience the thrill of speeding on over 30 tracks! Drive over 30 cars and explore over 5 different game modes! Linear difficulty progression, from easy to hard — each stage brings a new challenge.

3850980.title: 687 Days on Mars
3850980.short_description: 687 Days on Mars is a survival game where you are stranded alone on Mars - your task is to manage resources, build a base from scratch, grow food, and explore the red planet in search of supplies and other hidden challenges. Every breath and decision counts - can you survive on the Red Planet?

3851160.title: Principal Panic
3851160.short_description: Principal Panic is a multiplayer school party game filled with chaotic humor. Each round, one player becomes the principal, while the others try to create chaos by completing mischievous tasks, dancing, and managing energy. Distinguish real students from bots and survive.

3851460.title: Smash 'N Grab
3851460.short_description: Smash obstacles, fight guards and zip through the environment as you grab the loot and race against the clock for the perfect heist in this jazzy, noir speedrunning beat ’em up!

3851480.title: 12 nights
3851480.short_description: A survival-horror game about a detective searching for his sister in a mysterious victorian mansion that shifts its shape. The mansion is their family home - and their family curse. Fight monsters, solve puzzles, explore the mysterious estate!

3851730.title: Desktop Legends
3851730.short_description: Desktop Legends is an idle desktop action game featuring fantasy character progression, incremental resource management, and visual customization. Help your hero take their legendary stand against the forces of darkness right on your desktop!

3852130.title: Akashic
3852130.short_description: Akashic is an AI-powered interactive storybook game that blends Roguelite elements with role-playing narrative. Every adventure is unique — driven by AI-generated dialogues and dynamic worldbuilding, where your choices, emotions, and conversations shape the unfolding story.

3852390.title: CubeMate
3852390.short_description: Chess meets the Rubik's Cube. Rotate a 3D cube until every face satisfies a chess challenge: check, checkmate, advantage, equality or a classic solve. A 34-level campaign tree from 2×2 to 7×7, Free Play, a Daily puzzle and shareable seeds.

3852610.title: Lost viking somewhere in Byzantine Empire.
3852610.short_description: Enter an alternate history where Vikings rule the Byzantine Empire. In this retro hero simulator, master sword & magic, manage hunger, and use the Valknut artifact to cheat death. Fight through a world torn apart by warring gods to prove your destiny.

3852830.title: HYVE
3852830.short_description: HYVE is a competitive online 2v2 card game set in a cyberpunk future. Build your deck, team up with another Hacker, and combine your cards to create powerful synergies. Infiltrate the enemy network and destroy their C.O.R.E.

3853110.title: Crusaders Quest : Tactics
3853110.short_description: Crusaders Quest: Tactics is a roguelike auto battler where you build a party of charming pixel art heroes. Recruit heroes from Shasha's shop, promote them, and craft Soulbound Weapons. Find the right hero synergies and take on bosses across five acts.

3853280.title: Sinner's Grimoire
3853280.short_description: Descend through the Nine Circles of Hell as a forsaken spellcaster bound to a cursed grimoire. Unleash chaotic magic, dodge relentless hordes, and craft devastating spell combinations in this infernal bullet-hell survivor. Only the damned survive.

3853380.title: Tiny Kitchen: Sandwich Edition
3853380.short_description: Click to drop ingredients and build your own chaotic deli-style sandwich in this cozy physics cooking game. Stack it tall, stack it wrong — just don’t forget the bread!

3854080.title: Interwoven Dream
3854080.short_description: 《Interwoven Dream》 is a Victorian-era visual novel with multiple POVs. In 1884 London, four friends reunite after a string of disappearances, each with their own motives. Together, they dive into the city's darkest secrets, where dreams and reality blur.

3854680.title: Bet Shop Simulator
3854680.short_description: Run the neighborhood betting shop! Print bet slips, count out change and watch the match with your customers. A goal shakes the whole shop, a losing slip gets a TV smashed. Clean up, decorate, expand.

3854950.title: You're Nuts!
3854950.short_description: Wake up, little robot: it's time to plan your escape. Solo or with up to 3 friends, crack the factory's puzzles, craft gear, open shortcuts and upgrade your base to go faster and further every day, until you carry the key to the exit. Set it up your way, from super cozy to nearly impossible.

3855320.title: ABYSS REBEL
3855320.short_description: ABYSS REBEL is a tactical RPG focused on turn-based combat and character progression. In a dark, frozen world, assemble a squad, sail to the most dangerous archipelagos in the universe, and defeat the lurking dark forces with strategy, heroes, and mechs.

3856200.title: SOKO 1977: Anti-Terror Task Force
3856200.short_description: Take command of a special police task force in 1970s Germany. Uncover terrorist networks, coordinate operations, and make far-reaching decisions. Experience an intense, historically inspired scenario that explores the balance between security, freedom, and the rule of law.

3856360.title: Donkey Jump: In the Loop
3856360.short_description: A cult donkey hops around a tiny island. You build the loop it hops on, play Rite cards mid-jump and dress it for the end of the world. Fill six quotas before the Ritual Candle burns out and Krakhaw, the donkey-kraken of the deep, rises to carry you into the sunset.

3856480.title: Soulcery: Deck of Shadows
3856480.short_description: A spell-slinging hack-and-slash action roguelite. Devour enemies and seal their abilities into cards. Draw cards to switch spells and chain them together to destroy everything in your path!

3856490.title: Salt and Spice
3856490.short_description: From Mogadishu to Calcutta, master the bustling trade networks of the Indian Ocean during the golden age of maritime commerce.
