3856530.title: About Fishing
3856530.short_description: Cast your line into calm waters and feel the quiet pull beneath the surface. Each cast brings rewards, but some things you reel in were never meant to be found.

3856590.title: Bone-Bound
3856590.short_description: Bone-Bound is a turn-based roguelite strategy game where you summon creatures, evolve cards, conquer castles, and build your deck across 12 species in lane-based combat with quests, fog of war, and castle upgrades.

3856780.title: Cardboard Cowboy
3856780.short_description: Cardboard Cowboy, the cardboard Wild West shooter. Blast through handcrafted paper shooting galleries, dual-wield makeshift revolvers and shotguns, and chase high scores across three outlaw-filled regions. Beat timed weapon challenges. Collect tarot cards. Unlock the ultimate cardboard loadout.

3856950.title: Bridgelands
3856950.short_description: Bridgelands is an action roguelite where you embark on expeditions with Flora across mysterious islands. Choose your routes, face dangerous creatures, and combine powerful perks to create a new build with every journey.

3857400.title: Screenbreak
3857400.short_description: Screenbreak is an action roguelike RPG set inside a corrupted computer system overrun by a dangerous virus. Fight through glitching programs, broken files, infected security systems, and unstable digital worlds as you uncover the truth behind the infection.

3857940.title: Island Core
3857940.short_description: The Otherworld invasion left one island base standing. You are the Core, a central AI with the personalities of fallen scientists. Mount lasers, saw guns, flamethrowers and drones, and hold the line through snowfield, desert and swamp. Single-player horde defense × character builds.

3858030.title: Immortal Coil
3858030.short_description: Build powerful decks to confront the Gods in this lane-based, strategy card game. Play the Roguelike Adventure Mode or ascend the Tower of Battle in Gauntlet Mode. Discover wild deckbuilding synergies to unleash spectacular combos against formidable foes.

3859060.title: SCP: Scavenger Project
3859060.short_description: Asymmetric co-op horror set in the SCP universe. 1-12 survivors trapped in a collapsing Foundation site, and one of you is infected. They know it, and they're hiding it. Complete objectives, trust no one, and try to escape.

3859070.title: Furniture Restoration Simulator: Garage Edition
3859070.short_description: Step into your own garage workshop and breathe new life into forgotten furniture. In this immersive first-person simulation, sand away decades of wear, apply vibrant paints, and polish each piece to a showroom finish—one satisfying restoration at a time.

3859230.title: Crow's Requiem
3859230.short_description: A narrative-heavy, comic-infused survival visual novel & puzzle game where you are a licensed body collector navigating a dystopian world of moral dilemmas and resource management; where belief, rebellion, or control will prevail through your choices.

3861270.title: Pip sellfish
3861270.short_description: Catch fish by drawing circles around them, sell them in Pip's little beach shop, and reinvest everything. Fish, sell, upgrade, repeat. A cozy fishing incremental game.

3861510.title: UGOMEKU NOTE
3861510.short_description: A world more real than reality itself— It begins to wriggle into life.

3862360.title: Goblin Mode: Loot & Lunacy
3862360.short_description: A chaotic 2–4 player online co-op physics sandbox where goblins live for loot, destruction and mayhem. Explore, steal and build ridiculous contraptions with your friends. From platforming to car chases to fighting giant beasts, these little goblins can do it all.

3863190.title: Alt梦魇救赎
3863190.short_description: Psychiatrist Marine and her assistant Felix make an emergency visit to Egas Psychiatric Hospital for her important patient Edward on Christmas Eve, but they get caught up in a crisis...

3863400.title: Not My Floor
3863400.short_description: Not My Floor is a horror game set in the grim stairwell of a Soviet-era apartment block on the outskirts of Kyiv in the early 1990s. After a long shift at the factory, all you want is to get home—but the elevator and the entire building have their own sinister plans, driven by a mysterious entity.

3863410.title: Novella Divina
3863410.short_description: 🍀A philosophical fairy tale about art and catgirls, inspired by Dante, Nietzsche, and Scriabin. The Musical Aether drives everyone mad—but you are the Hero...

3864520.title: 时漏界限-edge-
3864520.short_description: 一场神秘的“梦”，打破了你平静的生活。横贯两个世界的旅程，却总是遭遇同一场危机。你遇到了意味不明的茶味男，看起来很好说话的异瞳少年，突然出现的神秘妹妹头，呆傻的美丽学长，好久不见突然变成金色的幼驯染。你们的故事打破了两个世界，人们的命运就此交织…… 《时漏界限-edge-》是一款文字avg乙女冒险游戏，正式版包含4位可攻略男主角，一位隐藏可攻略男主角。正式版游戏文本量在50w字以上，拥有50张以上精美cg。 在游戏中，你将扮演一名即将毕业的大学生，在穿越两个世界的旅途中寻找世界的真相，并作出自己的选择。游戏拥有多个分支结局，等待你在游玩过程中逐步解锁。

3864920.title: 骤雨终日
3864920.short_description: "Endless Rain"is a pixel plot game driven by dialogue that incorporates elements of suspense, crime, humor, and more. Players will explore the truth behind a murder case in two different time and space, gradually uncovering the true face of a small town shrouded in the haze of the past.

3864940.title: Trainwatch
3864940.short_description: A time-management psychological horror set in a fogbound railway crossing. What seems like a simple 1-month job as a gatekeeper operating a crossing turns into an exploration of occult grounds, meeting unsettling folk, and trying to fix your own life.

3865080.title: Humanity Echo: Cyberpunk Tactical RPG
3865080.short_description: Humanity Echo is a turn-based tactical RPG set in cyberpunk Odesa, 2044. Lead a squad as an engineer: prepare for every contract, fight from cover, overload transformers, set off explosive barrels, loot better gear, and make choices the people around you will remember.

3865320.title: 小角色
3865320.short_description: 这是一个增加了移动维度的类杀戮尖塔卡牌DBGrogue游戏。构筑中的移动维度将发挥重要作用，你将扮演武士，刺客，猎人，法师等角色体验一段战胜心魔的故事。

3867020.title: Delete the World
3867020.short_description: Delete the World is a completely normal visual novel… unless you decide to help her kill everyone.

3867160.title: Rance Quest Magnum
3867160.short_description: Rance sets off on another grand (though not always grave) adventure across the Continent to find a cure for the curse and get his life back in order!

3867290.title: Eredian Stronghold
3867290.short_description: Push lanes, capture buildings, and defend your base in this fast-paced Action RPG. Slaughter hordes of enemies, find legendary loot, and fight your way to the Stronghold of Eredian.

3867450.title: SUPERPANEL
3867450.short_description: SUPERPANEL is a hardcore tactical shooter with high lethality for solo players or groups of friends. Customize your gear and squads, take on dangerous missions through urban labyrinths, and fight your way to the heart of Megaslavia. Enemies are both humans and monsters.

3867520.title: Frozen Feathers
3867520.short_description: Throw snowballs, slide across the ice and shove your friends into the sea in short, chaotic penguin battles. Play online with up to 4 players, split-screen on one PC, or tap PLAY and fight bots in seconds.

3868160.title: The Mortal
3868160.short_description: 《下凡》是一款俯视角角色扮演模拟经营游戏。怀揣憧憬，你告别故土踏入喧嚣陌生的大城。前路万千，没有唯一的活法：务工谋生、寻玉赌石、卜算吉凶、赶海远航，在市井烟火与机缘变数里，邂逅羁绊，书写属于你的人间际遇。

3868460.title: Tiny Kitchen: Pizza Edition
3868460.short_description: Sauce it, top it, drop it! Build pizzas with flying ingredients and bouncy physics in this charming, low-pressure cooking sim. Tiny Kitchen: Pizza Edition is part chaos, part calm — all cozy.

3868550.title: Mini Shopkeeper
3868550.short_description: Run your cozy little shop from the bottom of your screen, decorate to attract unique customers, hire assistants, and send adventurers for rare treasures - all in a lively, charming management sim!

3868710.title: Tokyo Shop Simulator
3868710.short_description: Run your second-hand shop under Tokyo’s neon lights! 🏮 Find, buy, and sell unique Japanese goods and grow your store! 💰🎎

3868820.title: 2048 Bosses
3868820.short_description: 2048 Bosses is a puzzle roguelike where your 2048 score is your weapon: every merge builds Power, and merging into your hero's attack tiles strikes the boss. Combine skills and heroes into game-breaking builds and discover the routes that lead to each boss.

3868940.title: Math and Guns
3868940.short_description: Math and Guns is a top-down roguelite shooter where every right answer reloads your gun. Pick the problems you want, or bring your own flashcards, then fight through seven floors of the Necromancer’s base to rescue your captured squad.

3869250.title: Auto Grind: Dungeons
3869250.short_description: AUTO GRIND: DUNGEONS is a singleplayer auto-attack dungeon crawler that fuses party management with snap decisions. Build your party, synergize skills and masteries, discover unique relics, craft items and adapt your allies' combat tactics in real time as you fight your way through enemy hordes!

3869320.title: Stroom
3869320.short_description: Stroom is a precision platformer built for speed. Master the dash, chain your moves and find the fastest path through 100 handcrafted levels across 5 worlds.

3869540.title: Summer☆Dash: Our Track Team's Summer Training Trip
3869540.short_description: As coach of the girls' track team, go on an exciting retreat in the countryside with the three best girls of your team, where you'll help them overcome their struggles and unlock their full potential!

3870720.title: World Tree Defender - Tower Defense
3870720.short_description: A mazing tower defense. Every tower is a tetromino-style hex piece that bends the path: rotate it, drop it on the grid, wind the swarm into a labyrinth and keep the World Tree alive. A campaign across biomes with ancient guardians, solo or with friends.

3871050.title: Ascend and Fall
3871050.short_description: Ascend and Fall is a dark-fantasy multiplayer autobattler where the order of your spells decides the outcome. Build your spell loadout, fight monsters for loot, and unleash powerful arcane combos against rival players. Sequence your magic right to rise while they fall.

3871310.title: Rustmire
3871310.short_description: In this side-view pixel-art world, you captain a landship—survive by combat and scavenging, and grow your modular vessel into your own city. Among roaming cities and underground enclaves, records and wreckage hint at why people live this way… or how you become wreckage.

3871920.title: The Attic: Fear of the Dark
3871920.short_description: The Attic is a first-person psychological horror set in a haunted house. Explore forgotten rooms, solve challenging puzzles, and gradually uncover the family’s haunting story. The atmosphere is full of tension and psychedelic vision.. Don’t let fear and tormenting memories take control over you.

3871940.title: Still Stars Echo
3871940.short_description: An atmospheric science-fiction journey across distant alien landscapes. Traverse monolithic structures, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the story of a lost civilization written among the stars.

3872160.title: Envido
3872160.short_description: Grab your cards, play against wandering souls, unlock items at the pub and win all the matches to survive. Scheme your plays, perfect your bluffs and make strategic decisions based on your macumbas. Your match against Mandinga is about to begin!

3872550.title: Rhea of the Remnant
3872550.short_description: “Rhea of the Remnant” is a mecha Tactical RPG where you command a small group of allies to take on a powerful enemy force. Anticipate enemy moves, combine your allies' abilities, and devise the best strategy to secure victory!

3872580.title: Stackatalbi
3872580.short_description: Stackatalbi is a survival game where you stack cards to collect resources and craft new items. Drag your hero over an open world, hunt, fish, farm and grow stronger to fight new foes. Play solo or online co-op with a friend.

3872630.title: Badass Brad
3872630.short_description: They killed your wife. They killed your dog. Now it's your turn to kill them in this fast paced roguelike!

3872940.title: Ruin and Rebirth
3872940.short_description: Ruin and Rebirth is a fantasy open-world factory building game with creature taming and breeding. In this playable creation myth, bring life back to a surreal, shattered, post-divine apocalyptic world where the gods have died.

3873230.title: Liar-for-hire
3873230.short_description: Follow the new worker of the disinformation agency day by day. Decide how to oppose news and people through the use of fake scandals and redirections. Ensure a win for your employers - or find some conscience after all.

3873360.title: Chumaky
3873360.short_description: Chumaky is a game about traveling, trading, farming, and building your own homestead. Discover mysterious locations and enjoy atmospheric landscapes.

3873460.title: ExoDomia
3873460.short_description: Exodomia is a narrative-driven, action-adventure game set on the robotic world of Salakar V! In this fast-paced combat experience, you will encounter many dangerous creatures and enemies as you navigate a story of struggle and survival.

3874910.title: Watamari Part2 - A Fake Marriage?
3874910.short_description: This is a yuri game where you as an angel of love must help guide the heroines. Do your best, little angel (you) and take care of your mistress's wellbeing!

3875670.title: Winemaker Simulator
3875670.short_description: Step into the Medieval Mediterranean and live the life of a winemaker. From growing your vineyard to harvesting, from crafting wine to trading, every decision shapes your future. Will you be the one who creates the most exquisite and valuable wine? 🍷

3875930.title: Lawless Streets
3875930.short_description: Build your own criminal empire and dominate the city’s underworld. Command your soldiers, capture territories, expand your businesses, and make choices that will shape your future.

3876300.title: Drunk Dork On Pitchfork
3876300.short_description: Drunk Dork on Pitchfork is a unique rage arcade game. Play as an Imp dragging a hefty Dork through hellish traps & mazes to throw the ultimate party! Control both characters with special fork mechanic – keep yourself and your living cargo alive while he slipping away into lava!

3877130.title: The Princess's Reongemt
3877130.short_description: In a world ruled by alien gods, the last kingdom "White Crown" secretly creates an artificial human with foreign memories. As their only weapon against the divine oppressors who control all resources, this being may hold the key to humanity's rebellion———

3877340.title: 星と塔と冒険者
3877340.short_description: A 2D × 3D fantasy RPG where you investigate a mysterious tower that suddenly appeared. Fight, explore, and uncover the truth of the world.

3877650.title: SMU News: Strange events recorded
3877650.short_description: In this game, play as Shenming University News Department members. Explore strange incidents—no need for truth. Write compelling reports from clues; eye-catching content excites readers. As for what really happened…do readers actually care? If you care, go find out yourself.

3877660.title: Monster Forest 怪物森林
3877660.short_description: The ancient forest has been corrupted by void energy into a fleshy spawning ground of mutated beasts. Choose two exiles from different factions to form a pact, and wield two distinct card builds to fight your way out of the suffocating woodland depths!

3877830.title: Beachside Cafe Simulator
3877830.short_description: Run your own dessert restaurant in a French beach town! Cook crepes, waffles, ice cream and more. Serve tourists and locals, and expand your menu. Manage supplies, hire employees, upgrade your equipment, and grow your space to build your dream seaside dessert spot.

3877960.title: Blast Bebop
3877960.short_description: Blast Bebop is an easy-to-pick-up action-incremental game, combining dodging, shooting, collecting, and upgrades, set to retro pixel visuals and psychedelic music for a short, relaxing combat experience.

3878300.title: Veriventure
3878300.short_description: Combine a toolbox of enemies, hazards, items and objects to build dungeons filled with puzzles, traps, and combat. Alternatively, cartwheel into levels created by other players, or ready your weapon and explore the story mode, in this retro-inspired 3D Dungeon Maker.

3878630.title: Veils of the Past
3878630.short_description: A cinematic mystery visual novel about a vanished woman. You're the detective on the case. Twelve years ago, your sister disappeared the same way. Four investigations lead to four different answers about what really happened — and none of them is the wrong one. The truth is whichever one you find.

3880420.title: Fix & Flick
3880420.short_description: Congratulations! You have been selected as this year's officer for the SICRED SYSTEMS Game Weeks. Your assignment is to buy, sell, and fix second-hand consoles while managing your shop. Serve customers. Uncover secrets. Complete your duties. We look forward to your outstanding service.

3880790.title: Tinker's Ascent
3880790.short_description: Explore floating islands in Tinker's Ascent, a cozy open-world platformer and crafting adventure. Run, jump, and dive through the skies, gather resources, craft tools, and build structures as you discover a world high up in the clouds.

3881530.title: Lens Of Fear
3881530.short_description: Realistic, hyper-immersive, intense action-adventure horror game. Developed by PlayableGraph as their debut title. This game combines a portable camera perspective with highly detailed environments and immersive sound design to deliver an authentic horror experience.

3881910.title: THE FORMIO PROGRAM
3881910.short_description: Terraform the moon Io from an isolated, fully simulated outpost as an operator for the F.O.R.M.I.O program. Master interconnected devices, take your (MANDATORY) daily dose of RADOX, and ignore the robot :)

3882400.title: 救済の日
3882400.short_description: "The Day of Salvation" is a horror game in which players must escape from giant humanoid creatures by hiding in the fog and discovering their true identities.

3882690.title: GunJong
3882690.short_description: Aim. Shoot. Match. Mahjong Solitaire with guns: shoot matching pairs to clear the board. Relax in Zen mode or chase the leaderboards. Import own art and make game yours

3884310.title: Kayotica
3884310.short_description: In Kayotica, you play as April—a clever but manipulative student caught in a web of friendship, rivalry, and dark crimes. What begins as ordinary campus life quickly turns into a mystery of betrayal, hidden truths, and a shocking murder. Can you solve the mystery, or will you become the next victim?

3884660.title: My Cozy BookShop
3884660.short_description: Run your own magical bookshop in a cozy fantasy world! Stock your shelves, decorate your shop, meet curious customers, and venture beyond town in search of rare books, magical ingredients, and secrets. Build the bookshop of your dreams ~one adventure at a time~

3885030.title: Ashen Vow
3885030.short_description: You are a knight sworn to God’s word, wielding only a sword against the darkness. But not all believers walk in good faith. The Black Maw has sunk its claws into the misguided, twisting their devotion into madness. Explore a once familiar castle now warped by evil, and cut down the corrupted horde

3885170.title: Rentcthulhu
3885170.short_description: A dark fairytale deckbuilder where you serve Ancient Gods. Reconstruct shattered stories using card suits and racial synergies. Stack high scores to complete Oracle challenges in this twisted roguelike adventure. Can you mend the fragments before the darkness wins?

3885300.title: Echo Protocol
3885300.short_description: A sci-fi survivors-style shooter. Hold the line across boarded stations, neon extraction runs, convoy escorts and frozen outposts. Level up mid-fight and stack elemental rounds, drones and auras into a run-ending build — or gamble on pacts that cut as deep as they hit. Every run feeds your Echoes.

3885720.title: Murals
3885720.short_description: Express yourself through stylized combat in the hand-painted worlds of Murals, a twisted isometric action-adventure where fairytales have gone spectacularly wrong. These are not the tales you were told.

3885850.title: Tour - Chess Puzzles
3885850.short_description: Move the chess pieces to visit all the light squares. Explore a dozen mechanics and their interactions across 300 hand-crafted puzzles.

3886430.title: Wade: Fly Fishing
3886430.short_description: Step into a Quebec river and fly fish in VR. Hand-crafted rod and line physics, living currents, and fish fights that demand real focus, hook it, fight it, and try not to lose it.

3886530.title: Westlanders
3886530.short_description: Survive a wild-west open world alone or with friends. Travel the land with your wagon, build settlements, fend off foes, and weave a powerful economic network across the wilderness. Forge your legacy in the Westlands.

3887660.title: Blue Dynasty:Town Defense
3887660.short_description: Blue Dynasty is a Medieval ARPG blending fast-paced Hack & Slash combat with strategic Tower Defense. Upgrade your hero's equipment, master a massive passive tree, clear deadly dungeons, and build impenetrable defenses to protect your kingdom from relentless hordes.

3888010.title: 白噪
3888010.short_description: What?! Mr. Boring is trying to invade the universe? No way! Grab your shotgun, power gauntlets, rocket launcher, and the 24/7 rock ‘n’ roll bass cannon! Unleash a storm of bullets to the beat of the sickest rhythm and save the world the only way a true superhero can, White Noise!

3888070.title: Dystopia RPG
3888070.short_description: Dystopia RPG is an 8 bit style fantasy RPG where You lost a duel to a government's shaman and ended up trapped and sealed in a Cell Phone application. Explore the Dungeons, Combat monsters, Collect and Trade Items, Glitch the game & break free.

3888250.title: HexBrandPre
3888250.short_description: Story of VoltSpark. Choose the most suitable set of equipments for you, then dodge the bullets and crash the enemies. A bullet-hell game, which is quite difficult. Instant reactions, level understanding, strategies are requird to beat this game. As agile as leopard, ruin everything like thunder.

3888530.title: Crystal Adventures: The Ascent
3888530.short_description: Crystal Adventures: The Ascent - an isometric 2D puzzle-adventure. Chain commands based on real programming to build routes, dodge traps, fight bosses, and collect crystals. Learn to code through play.

3890110.title: Dick Shortson. The Detective.
3890110.short_description: Dick Shortson – The Detective. You've been hired by a woman to find her missing mother. Grab your gun and uncover the secrets hidden in another godforsaken village. Shoot, solve puzzles, and catch the vibe.

3890260.title: Edenwound
3890260.short_description: A brutally difficult dungeon crawler rpg with elements inspired by the survival and roguelike genres. Face the horrors of Eden and discover what lies at the bottom of the abyss...

3891160.title: CRYMELIGHT
3891160.short_description: CRYMELIGHT is a roguelike action game set in the world of the afterlife, where girls confront their sins as they fight to gain their freedom.

3891420.title: Slot Machine Gun
3891420.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder shooter where you wield an ever changing weapon : The Slot Machine Gun! Every reload spins up a fresh combo of guns and chaotic effects to create game breaking synergies.

3891450.title: Cube Party
3891450.short_description: Cube Party is a 2-8 player co-op puzzle and adventure game! Team up with friends, stack your box characters into walls, solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, and find the key to clear 40+ unique levels!

3891520.title: TUNE
3891520.short_description: You lost everything in the war, except the memory of a faint prayer of a being who stayed beside you. Years later, you return to trace its prayer across a ruined Earth. Search through static, uncover the truth, and remember what others have forgotten.

3891790.title: Caution! Platforming Ahead
3891790.short_description: Caution! Platforming Ahead is an abstract precision platformer starring Platformo. Run, jump, and blaze throughout the ether of a mysterious dimension utilizing incredible energy to defy gravity. Twenty scenes of classic platforming action await.

3891900.title: FLINT
3891900.short_description: Multiplayer survival in an open world. Build your base, farm, hunt different creatures, survive in a harsh world, fight or team up with other players and evolve through the ages.

3892890.title: Infinite Soul
3892890.short_description: Infinite Soul is a breath of fresh air for competitive fighters. Every battle will test your skill, cunning, and resolve. Attack and defend with Water, Earth, Fire, and Air; choose wisely because each one has a strength and a weakness.

3892940.title: Dungeon Hunting Grounds
3892940.short_description: A deck-building video game featuring single and two-player local co-op battles against monstrous foes in treacherous dungeons.

3893230.title: Bifröst: Prelude to the Storm
3893230.short_description: Bifröst: Prelude to the Storm is a BL visual novel set in an epic fantasy world — told through 8 POV characters, 30+ fully illustrated cast members, accompanied with 40+ soundtracks and 50+ event CG's. The story branches based on your decisions, shaping relationships, loyalties, and personal fates.

3893340.title: DREADSHELL
3893340.short_description: DREADSHELL is a first-person sci-fi horror game, built on quiet tension and paranoia instead of constant jump scares.

3895050.title: Chronia: The Rotcore
3895050.short_description: Chronia: The Rotcore is a medieval themed turn-based RPG set in the fantasy land of Tinotella. You are a newbie mercenary, travelling across the land to find your origin. Part with teams, slaying monsters, achieving quests... It is your choice to shape your own journey.

3895110.title: The Road of Dust and Sorrow
3895110.short_description: The Road of Dust and Sorrow is a tense, story-driven pixel art horror inspired by ’90s classics. Survive a world gone wrong and protect what matters most: your daughter.

3896560.title: BLOODSONG: ECLIPSED!
3896560.short_description: Amongst all else that is you resides a gaping absence. One way or another, BLOODSONG will make you whole. A surreal, psych-horror visual novel.

3897630.title: RUST MOON
3897630.short_description: RUST MOON is a cyberpunk pixel side-scrolling action game. Play as ALPHA-7, whose memory has been rewritten, and cut through blockades with firearms, blades, and cyberware abilities — from the neon city all the way to a lunar base. Someone wrote your past for you. What comes next is up to you.

3897770.title: Occult Office: Lofi Rituals
3897770.short_description: Occult Office: Lofi Rituals is a cozy desktop companion that blends witchy aesthetics and real productivity tools. Plan your day, care for plants, read fortunes, pet magical familiars, customize your desk and avatar, and play minigames during your breaks.

3897830.title: Frog Knight
3897830.short_description: A brave little frog and his talking sword climb a cursed well in this precision platformer. Jump, bounce, and master your timing to save the world. No checkpoints. No shortcuts. Just one long climb... or fall.

3899920.title: Recycling Shift
3899920.short_description: Work at a recycling facility! In this tactile cozy job simulator, sort discarded items into categories, process them into raw material and sell valuable items for money. Could be trash or treasure! Upgrade your workflow, sort and process efficiently.

3900160.title: Misdecayed
3900160.short_description: An adventure RPG about life, death, rebirth, and robots, from the team that brought you vivid/stasis.

3900220.title: Proximity
3900220.short_description: Proximity- game about exploring randomly generated galaxy, combining RTS and FPS mechanics. Build factories, manage colonists and their needs. Design any vehicles with polygonal modelling and fly seamlessly from the surface into space. Adjust design to handle realistic physics. Have fun with friends

3900570.title: Black Stars - The M87 Conflict
3900570.short_description: Command a rising interstellar empire in the M87 cluster. Explore and colonize distant worlds, build powerful economies, terraform hostile planets, deploy specialized fleets, and wage war against rival factions in a VR-exclusive galactic 4X strategy game where every decision shapes the conflict.

3900700.title: Noël macabre
3900700.short_description: Noël macabre is a narrative-driven horror FPS that blends dark comedy with cosmic horror. Play as Georges, a police officer forced to return to work on Christmas Eve. Investigate a mysterious threat and save those who can still be saved. Will you see your duty through to the end?

3902150.title: Rift Tavern
3902150.short_description: Gather materials, cook meals, serve patrons, and defeat foes! Welcome to your new life as the owner of the 'Rift Tavern'. Restore the former glory of your run-down tavern by night, and explore the depths of dangerous portal zones by day!

3902160.title: A Game About Breaking A Cube
3902160.short_description: Take on the role of a factory worker oppressed by an evil corporation. Break stranger and stranger cubes in pursuit of ore and truth. Upgrade your tools, explore the underground facility and learn the secret of NullCorp. Later, relax at home with a cold can of drinkable meat.

3902550.title: Antichrist
3902550.short_description: As a journalist, you made headlines back in 2006 with a groundbreaking story. Years later, an anonymous call tied to that very event leads you to an horror house. But this house may belong to the Antichrist believed to appear at the end of days. You’re chasing a story… but it might be your last.

3903050.title: Shapes N Music
3903050.short_description: A brutal bullet-hell rhythm game where every death is your fault. Dodge hazards, dash and die to a varied soundtrack synced to intense levels. Master 4 more game modes built to steal your evenings. Can you beat each level without taking a hit?

3903580.title: Titanic
3903580.short_description: A simulator of the operation of the most famous ship Titanic. Become the owner and captain of the Titanic, sail around the world! Carry passengers and cargo, make money and prosper!

3904080.title: Fishing Tales: Neko's Journey
3904080.short_description: A relaxing idle fishing game focused on companionship, featuring over 40 fishing destinations and 260 fish to discover. Easy to enjoy without much effort. You can place the game anywhere on your screen while studying or working, without it intruding on your tasks.

3904230.title: Oops! I Got Hit by Cupid's Arrow
3904230.short_description: Live-action interactive romance game. Play as an archery coach meeting three heroines. Your choices shape the story, unlock different romantic routes and multiple endings. Movie-grade production with immersive experience.

3905170.title: Castles & Castellans
3905170.short_description: Castles & Castellans is a hybrid of real-time strategy and third-person action. Rule from the castle-building RTS view - construct, manage, and fortify against looming threats. Then step into the castellan’s boots in TPP, fighting side by side with your soldiers atop the very walls you built.

3905700.title: White Noise: Ghost Signal
3905700.short_description: You are the new caretaker of a polar station. The assignment came unexpectedly, but you accepted it without hesitation. A lonely outpost in the middle of an endless frozen wasteland — a place where you must simply survive, follow the instructions… and keep your mind from breaking.

3906090.title: Where's My Red Ball?
3906090.short_description: A lonely cat is waiting for her red ball. Only the right one will do. In a charming hand-drawn world, open boxes, wipe away paint, and tinker with curious machines to find it. No timers, unlimited retries, just a cozy point-and-click puzzle that slowly reveals why that ball means so much to her.

3906280.title: Anubria
3906280.short_description: Exploration. Silence. Echoes. Wander a shifting pyramid where rooms change and reality bends. No monsters, just atmosphere, isolation, and subtle unease. Uncanny, immersive, and unsettling. Solve light environmental puzzles across 8 levels. Experience the pyramid alone - empty, yet somehow present.

3907570.title: Silent Authority: Blood & Bourbon
3907570.short_description: Strategy meets action RPG in the 1920s New York criminal underworld. Build your empire through front businesses and bootlegging, lead your crew in brutal top-down tactical combat, and rule the city through cunning diplomacy or pure bloodshed.

3908520.title: SYDI
3908520.short_description: SYDI is a turn-based JRPG inspired by tabletop RPGs like by D&D, where every battle comes down to the roll of a die. Explore a silent, colorless world and find your friends again, and face the question waiting for you at the end.

3910140.title: 残阳 1645/1937
3910140.short_description: As a Ming officer in 1645’s Yangzhou & Jiangyin massacres, shield a girl from shouma fate while obeying orders. In 1937’s Battle of Yangzhou, protect a war journalist returned from Japan. Your choices decide their survival and shape their fates across 300 years.

3910330.title: Mayak
3910330.short_description: A signal from a star // 3571 → 3559 → 3557 → … → 0 // 336 years remain // You and her, staring up at the sky. A hand-drawn sci-fi adventure about first contact.

3910860.title: Chinese Black Dragon Legend
3910860.short_description: " Chinese Black Dragon Legend" is a daily comedy Cantonese-style visual novel (galgame). The story follows Sino-French footballer Zhong Guolong's romantic journey with four heroines: Bai Xiaotong, Aisha, Frolana, and Kim Sung-ae.

3911120.title: Date Survivor
3911120.short_description: Date survivor is a dating simulator mixed with escape room puzzles and psychological horror. Four dates, four houses, and multiple ways to either get closer — or get out before it’s too late.

3911770.title: Village of the Ages
3911770.short_description: Raise a village of quirky little people, turning their bright ideas into new tools, and steering them through the ages, fires, tornados and all. No tech trees, no progress bars: just a community that grows up and starts making its own choices.

3911890.title: Elemency Island
3911890.short_description: Elemency Island is a cozy farm and automation game in coop multiplayer. Plant, raise animals, sell your ressources to unlock technologies and automate your entire farm. Alone, or with your friends, come discover this island full of surprises and unknown creatures.

3912940.title: 宥蘿的巫女修行錄 Miko Yuro: Training Record
3912940.short_description: The sequel to the Japanese-style adventure game Yuro’s Fantasy Adventure, set several years later on an ordinary day, Yuro continues her journey as a shrine miko of Kanai Jinja, training relentlessly to refine her swordsmanship and onmyo magic, the entire game is played from a third-person.

3913420.title: Stabjack
3913420.short_description: It’s just you, a deck of playing cards, and a knife that won’t shut up. Stabjack is the roguelike, blackjack deckbuilder where you cheat to win. Tuck cards up your sleeve to use later, change your deck, and invoke supernatural items as you investigate a dark, devilish, comic-noir world.

3914430.title: Aethelon
3914430.short_description: Aethelon is an infinite, open world creative voxel sandbox. Build across massive procedural worlds with realistic biome systems. Share your world with reproducible seeds. Experience infinite creative freedom at impressive scale.

3914970.title: Lucky Newt
3914970.short_description: Join Lucky Newt, Amelia Axolotl, and Murphy Mudpuppy on a vibrant, platforming adventure to stop the evil Salazar from stealing the legendary 5 Leaf Clover and taking over their home.

3915630.title: Worn By The Forgotten
3915630.short_description: A forgotten god, worshipped in countless forms, was vanquished by the evil deity Yanutan—but left behind a mask holding four beliefs and the divine beasts that embody them. As Worn, the girl who finds it, wield the beasts, uncover the world's lost secrets, and overcome every trial.

3915640.title: Cardoom
3915640.short_description: Cardoom is a roguelite deckbuilder where you start with a basic deck. You collect new cards and items that affect your gameplay as you go.

3915940.title: Ekholux
3915940.short_description: Ekholux™ begins with escape-room puzzles. Solve physics-based challenges inside sealed chambers to break free.

3916010.title: Lurking In Fear
3916010.short_description: Enjoy the love of zombie games without the feeling of being locked down to a story mode! Enjoy a open world zombie era, loot, and explore! OR if you want a change in pace, Play a new round based zombies mode that will keep you loving or Re Loving Round based zolmbies!

3916030.title: Stellar Nemesis
3916030.short_description: A high-definition arcade shooter blending old-school action with modern polish. Battle across the Solar System, upgrade your weapons, and unlock tougher challenges in Nemesis Mode - all set to a hypnotic, retro-electro soundtrack.

3917230.title: Shrine Raider
3917230.short_description: Help Regina recover an important relic that was stolen from her shrine, while saving her sister and stopping a secret organization from creating the ultimate weapon in this unique danmaku adventure!

3918200.title: 港警成雙：來自城寨 Dual Fire Walled City
3918200.short_description: Dual Fire Walled City is a story-driven co-op game for two players. Featuring close friends who grew up together in the Kowloon Walled City, only to be pulled onto vastly different life paths by a twist of fate. Get ready to immerse yourself in a classic Hong Kong-style movie.

3918220.title: Fastrak : Metro
3918220.short_description: Fastrak: Metro is a simcade train game where you drive Aussie trains on real railways to get the highest score!

3918370.title: Korean Noodle House
3918370.short_description: A Singleplayer cooking experience. Exploring Korean cooking recipes and culture in a cozy environment. Make customers happy with delicious dishes, gain experience and level up, earn achievements and discover pieces in the art gallery!

3921280.title: Project Zarya
3921280.short_description: Project Zarya is an open-world adventure set in post-apocalyptic Russia, where every day is a fight for survival. Explore, gather resources, build shelters, craft equipment, and battle the infected alone or with friends.

3921650.title: Sign My Petition
3921650.short_description: Sign My Petition is a beat-’em-up adventure about a mouse trying to save their tribe from extermination. Explore bizarre neighboring apartments, fight off strange enemies and bosses, and meet oddball characters along the way.

3923050.title: Slide Soldiers
3923050.short_description: Slide Soldiers is a cozy sliding puzzle game where you aim for the enemies instead of reaching the exit. Play at your own pace and discover the perfect path in 5,000 levels. Pick your targets and plan your moves, cause once you start sliding, there’s no stopping!

3924640.title: THE GREEN HOOK FIGHTER
3924640.short_description: THE GREEN HOOK FIGHTER finally lands on Steam with intense battles, unique characters, and indie soul. Get ready for electrifying 3D fights in a universe full of style, personality, and urban legend inspiration.

3924650.title: Dismal Night
3924650.short_description: A story-driven 2D folk-horror mystery set in 1990s Poland. A man has vanished near a house in the woods that should be empty, yet someone still tends its flowers. Search for clues, keep them in your police notebook and solve puzzles to uncover old crimes and village secrets.

3925240.title: Otaku Love Story
3925240.short_description: Behind the keyboard, you're a struggling web novelist. In reality, a socially anxious shut-in. Your life is a simple loop of writing, gaming, and binge-watching, until four very different girls crash into your world—right through the internet.

3925800.title: Little Guy Friday
3925800.short_description: Enter the Uncool Underground and face the Leet 14 in this irreverent creature collecting roguelike! Gather your ragtag team of silly Little Guys and guide them towards ascension... or just crash out and try another run!

3926130.title: INKARO
3926130.short_description: INKARO is a brutal Parkour FPS that crosses flow-state platforming and push forward combat against anomalous enemies - doling out punishment with a toybox of weapons. Roam megastructures of plastic and concrete in a desolate journey of revenge and violence, clad in armor of ink and bone.

3928950.title: Duckload
3928950.short_description: 1,000,000 rubber ducks have been dumped deep in a mountain forest. Alone. Scared. Squeaky. Ship every last duck downstream for cash. Start with your bare hands and scale up across a massive upgrade tree to increase your duck harvesting power!

3929160.title: Secret of Havendor
3929160.short_description: Can you preserve your humanity in a world ruled by blood and gold?

3929340.title: We Build Below
3929340.short_description: Get rich or get eaten. Build underground factories, automate production and defend against parasites in this 1-3 player co-op roguelite.

3929660.title: The Rules Kaidan: Night Watch
3929660.short_description: In this side-scrolling horror adventure game, explore multiple eerie spaces rooted in Rules Kaidan. Every adventure, you will encounter all kinds of terrifying beings born from kaidan legends. Follow and memorize every rule — however conflicting or bizarre — to survive each trial.

3929800.title: Valdrin
3929800.short_description: A low-fantasy kingdom sim where you never command a single subject. Shape laws, set priorities, and watch an autonomous society build, trade, worship, and fight under your rule.

3930570.title: Tower of Wizard
3930570.short_description: Tower of Wizard is a survival rogue-lite where you ascend a cursed tower filled with monstrous foes and fallen wizards. Collect powerful relics, craft broken builds, and uncover the mystery that waits at the top floor.

3931270.title: Wolf Plot
3931270.short_description: Wolf Plot is a tricky puzzle-platformer. Help your wolves catch the sheep in over 100 levels. Use a variety of tools to control your wolves: rockets, fans, bombs, bridges, and more.

3931380.title: Little Red Riding Hood
3931380.short_description: Experience an expanded retelling of the famous fairy tale, Little Red Riding Hood, in this terrifying yet beautiful adventure horror game. Discover an enchanted forest as you solve puzzles, run, hide, and sneak to avoid the Big Bad Wolf.

3931390.title: Spooky Lord
3931390.short_description: Become the Lord of Fear! Command a team of spooky spirits, each with unique powers, to haunt or outwit humans in this tactical ghost game. Choose your approach, master your minions, and control the world of the living!

3931980.title: Paccarat
3931980.short_description: The 10-rats-in-a-trenchcoat roguelike deckbuilder. Recruit a rag-tag team of rats, craft a curated deck for each, and discover devastating multi-deck combos. Build your team & masterfully pilot multiple unique decks to take down increasingly difficult enemies.

3932020.title: ころコロ 2
3932020.short_description: corocoro 2! A gyro-exclusive casual game where you tilt the ground to guide 5 uniquely shaped balls to the goal. Overcome the obstacles across all 50 stages!

3932560.title: Essentia: A monster catching adventure
3932560.short_description: Isometric dungeon crawler with procedurally generated levels. A wide variety of cute monster characters to collect. A turn-based battle system with unique mana mechanic. Uncover the secrets of the calamity that has left this world in chaos.

3932730.title: Why's It Getting DARKER?!
3932730.short_description: The light is your only lifeline. Descend into a crushing, thalassophobic abyss where every photograph could be your last. Investigate unpredictable deep-sea horrors and explore the vast, dark unknown - all while being 'assisted' by a darkly sarcastic AI.

3932780.title: Crime & Anomaly
3932780.short_description: Fight to keep your mind in the shadow of crime and the unknown. Crime & Anomaly is an indie psychological horror that drags you through the dark corridors of 1860s Saint Petersburg. Inspired by Dostoevsky’s Crime and Punishment, every creaking floorboard and flicker of light can shatter your sanity.

3933180.title: Torii: Beyond The Gates
3933180.short_description: The spirit realm has broken. Your brother has gone missing. Forge the path you were destined for. Explore the gates and find out why the links inside the spirit realm have been broken. Battle, discover and find the secrets, and make new connections in a beautiful hand-drawn 2D style.

3934280.title: Pledged to a Princess
3934280.short_description: A cute and wholesome yuri visual about a young princess, Katarina Mikhailovna Vassilieva, who (finally!) gets to meet her online friend and fellow anime fan, Audrey McMahon. Is the power of cute girls enough to bring a princess and a pauper together?

3934450.title: Bloodshot Eyes
3934450.short_description: THIS IS A WORK IN PROGRESS!!! IGNORE EVERYTHING ON THE PAGE!!! DEMO IS UPDATED PRETTY REGULARLY.

3934590.title: Donjon: The Dark Fantasy
3934590.short_description: Can the Hero reach the donjon of the dark castle looming over the village he once called home? An immersive first-person RPG with old-school graphics.

3935200.title: North Pole Workshop
3935200.short_description: Explore the magical North Pole Workshop in this festive co-op toy-making game for 1-4 players. Team up with your merry elves and lightly strategize how to complete various toy recipes. Craft, wrap, and deliver toys to Santa's sleigh for all the good boys and girls!

3935520.title: A Service Call
3935520.short_description: Your first assignment alone. An island where no one has lived for thirty years. A lighthouse that stopped shining. The job was only supposed to take a few hours.

3936220.title: The Grand Praetor
3936220.short_description: As the seventh heir to the Empress, you have been appointed Grand Praetor to investigate a string of serial murders.Will you seek the truth and expose the conspiracy—or indulge in pleasure and power, doing as you please?

3936320.title: フリと忘れじの都 -FRI the Unforgettable City-
3936320.short_description: An adventure game where your choices change the world. Fri, a girl working at a coffee workshop, lives in a town that feels strangely mysterious. What will she encounter in this town while suffering from amnesia, and how will the world changing?

3937100.title: SeArena
3937100.short_description: Hoist the sails and prove who rules the waves! Pirate Arena is a fast-paced naval PvP brawler inspired by the chaotic fun of Sea of Thieves. One player becomes the Host, setting rules and map hazards, while rival captains trade broadsides, boarding actions, and daring maneuvers until only.

3937330.title: No Walls In Heaven
3937330.short_description: No Walls In Heaven is a first-person exploration platformer about losing yourself in the hostile vastness of the cosmos. Grapple, leap, and fight your way through the towering concrete and metal landscapes of a lost megastructure that seems to disobey all laws of physics and reality.

3937680.title: Arcane Shores
3937680.short_description: Arcane Shores is a city-building strategy game infused with magic. Build, defend, and expand your settlement while casting powerful spells that bend nature, restore what’s broken, and turn the tide against your enemies.

3938050.title: Vein-Weaver Knitting
3938050.short_description: Activate, Jump, Bomb, Out Run, Get Power Ups, Find Hidden Items, Speed Run, Pull Levers, Activate Switches, Out Smart Enemies, And Unravel The Story And Destroy The Dimension Crafted By An Ancient Craft Called Vein-Weaver Knitting.

3938410.title: Ikigai: An Alternate Cold War Simulator
3938410.short_description: The history of East and West has been reversed. Take command of the United Provinces of Kinshu, the foremost superpower during a volatile Cold War. Surrounded by global conflict, corruption, and conspiracy, your decisions alone will determine the fate of the world.

3939120.title: Sumalia
3939120.short_description: Foreign trawlers are emptying your sea and dumping their waste on your shore. Nobody is coming to help. Grab three friends, a skiff and whatever fuel you can scrape together, and go reclaim what once was yours, and then some. 4-player co-op piracy with proximity voice.

3939300.title: Barista Dream
3939300.short_description: Barista Dream lets you create a variety of coffees, including espresso, Americano, latte, and cappuccino, with meticulous precision. It aims to provide both fun and learning while making coffee. Manage your cafe wisely and prepare as many orders as possible to boost your popularity.

3939420.title: Launch Hazard
3939420.short_description: Launch Hazard is a single-player physics score attack game. Send a rocket-powered athlete crashing through arenas, steer mid-crash to chain targets, and complete objectives to score higher and earn better ranks in 90-second runs.

3939570.title: The King's Bargain
3939570.short_description: Thirty years ago the King sold his wife to the devil. Now Hell's collections department wants its money. Team up with up to 3 friends in online co-op, build your King with a skill tree and devilish boons, raid dungeons and smash Hell's middle managers in a darkly funny ARPG.

3939660.title: Mewts
3939660.short_description: Handcrafted party Clayhem! A PvP game full of chaos and innocent violence. Fight your friends or challenge bots. Play as Mewts, cute, wiggly creatures. Use your body as a slingshot and hit each other! Play a variety of game modes in handcrafted clay arenas!

3939690.title: Shrine Labyrinth
3939690.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op Japanese horror game. Beyond the torii gate lies an otherworldly labyrinth whose layout changes randomly. Work together to escape as you run from, hide from, and sometimes confront terrifying supernatural entities!

3940180.title: SacriFrogos
3940180.short_description: A roguelike strategy and survival game where ever-growing sacrifices are required to keep the mysterious Eternal Flame alive. Build a colony of Frogos and create unique builds every run.

3940470.title: KILLSEC
3940470.short_description: Breach containment and carve your way out of a megacorp black site in this hardcore top-down shooter roguelite. Master your control of physics weapons to parry swords, bullets, lasers, everything. Time moves faster when you move, but staying still won't get you anywhere.

3940850.title: Pilot Tycoon
3940850.short_description: A pilot career sim-rpg where you climb from regional first officer to mainline captain. Bid for schedules by seniority, handle emergencies through quick-time events, manage finances and stress, and build your reputation with decisions that can make or break your career.

3941390.title: RabbitHole Island : Turn-based Vtuber Battles
3941390.short_description: A vtuber-coded RPG with dynamic boss fights, curious exploration, and silly shenanigans. FREE to Play!!

3941430.title: KREIS AREN ashes of the uprising
3941430.short_description: A 2.5D action RPG where you play as an inventor-hero, battling invaders, crafting unique gear, and exploring a mysterious world. Your decisions determine the fate of your people and the outcome of the uprising.

3941960.title: Ghost Hunter
3941960.short_description: Ghost Hunter is a co-op horror escape game for 1–4 players. As the owner of a supernatural agency, you accept ghost-related cases and carry out cleansings. You’ll need to choose your gear wisely, and you can tackle the cases solo or team up with others to survive and succeed.

3942240.title: War of Blobs
3942240.short_description: Massive multiplayer slasher combat, reduced to circles and sticks. Directional swings, real parries, two hits to die...and 60+ other blobs in the lobby trying to kill you first. Everything that doesn't sharpen the fight has been cut.

3942270.title: Midnight Video Store
3942270.short_description: Midnight Video Store is an idle game where you play as Jeff, the sole employee of a retro video store. One night, the video store is attacked by a horde of monsters. Make Jeff more powerful with the help of a gigantic and monstrous talent tree !

3942390.title: Falcon Fall™
3942390.short_description: Dropped deep in hostile territory with no backup and no way out but through. Every street is a kill zone, every shadow a threat. Built in UE5 by seasoned VR devs and combat vets, Falcon Fall™ delivers the most unforgiving tactical VR combat experience. Wishlist now - deployment scheduled for 2026.

3942630.title: Rogue Reigns
3942630.short_description: Rogue Reigns is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder about trust and sacrifice. Lead selfish antiheroes through a world where death is no more, and something still hunts them. Build synergies that bind them or rivalries that break them. Nobody dies, some are sacrificed, but everybody is condemned.

3942690.title: SCP 1985
3942690.short_description: Welcome to Site 78 in 1985 where the foundation would experience one of its first major breaches. Escape the facility and survive the scps.

3943110.title: Goreticulture
3943110.short_description: Nurture a visceral garden as you clean up a bloody aftermath. Mop, water, and shear your way through retro levels. Use every drop to grow plants that earn piles of coins. Turn your green thumb red in Goreticulture, where doom meets bloom!

3943190.title: PenguPult
3943190.short_description: Grab your hammer and launch yourself through ice and snow in PenguPult! Climb the mountain with precise jumps or slip and fall back to the bottom. If you crave a challenge you need to try this!

3943240.title: UpperCart
3943240.short_description: UpperCart is a chaotic physics-based arena brawler where toy cars roll out of the drawer and fight for bedroom glory, solo or with up to 6 players. Punch, crash, wreck the other toys, and stay in one piece before the kid’s hand cleans up the mess.

3943450.title: Island Keeper
3943450.short_description: Island Keeper is a cozy exploration and restoration adventure. As maintenance robot Ferrum-1, clean up a polluted archipelago, recycle rubbish into gear and stations, and watch every island turn green again as wildlife returns.

3943550.title: I Have Been Here Before?
3943550.short_description: A psychological exploration through a liminal dreamscape: no guides, no paths, just you and small environmental mysteries.

3943670.title: Stakeroom: The Final
3943670.short_description: A turn-based gambling game where every round brings a different threat: poison, electricity, and more. One player, one table, and the same rules every time. How much are you willing to risk?

3944310.title: ByteCrawler
3944310.short_description: Pick a hero, build your swarm, and hold off enemy waves. Place units, watch your energy, and level up to survive in this lane-defense strategy game!

3944330.title: Sundae Drive
3944330.short_description: Hit the road in your very own ice cream truck! 🍦 Explore a cute neighborhood, park in the perfect spot, and serve adorable animal customers their dream sundaes. Scoop, drizzle, and top to perfection. Upgrade your cute truck, restock supplies, and create your own ice cream flavors!

3944380.title: Woodland Werewolf
3944380.short_description: The mist came without warning. One morning, the residents of the village woke to find their lakeside settlement wrapped in an impenetrable fog—thick, cold, and utterly wrong. Within hours, people began to vanish. No screams. No signs of struggle. Just empty spaces where lives used to be.

3944620.title: The Everything Building
3944620.short_description: Press up and down, elevator goes brrr! Deliver customers to the correct floor and max your score. Serve many customers including but not limited to surfers, astronauts, cars, ghosts, cheerleaders, horses, and cheerleader horses. 1-2 players! 50 different floors! HORSE MODE included!

3944900.title: SUBSELF: Lies Deep
3944900.short_description: You are a prisoner offered a single chance at freedom. In exchange, you must descend into the depths of an alien ocean and recover lost data from a sunken research station, abandoned under mysterious circumstances by a powerful space mega-corporation.

3946090.title: HINO
3946090.short_description: Hino, a girl with a red ribbon, and the white Monimoni Skeleton journey through a world of darkness in this 2D dark fantasy game. Having lost her memory, Hino seeks a safe haven in a land overrun by monsters, uncovering the truth of the dark world as she travels.

3946240.title: Demon With A Candy Crisis
3946240.short_description: A quick and easy 3d platformer playing as a demon that needs to quench its thirst for candy. Travel through hell to get to the surface to find someone's secret stash of candy.

3946330.title: Snap & Print
3946330.short_description: Run the cutest little photo & print shop in town! 📸 Snap & Print is a cozy job simulator, where you take portraits, edit and restore pictures, and decorate shots with hats, flowers, stickers, and more. Upgrade your studio, unlock new props, and make every customer smile.

3946550.title: Sunny Orchard
3946550.short_description: Run your own sunny fruit orchard! 🍇 Grow, harvest, and package fresh produce, complete orders for friendly customers, and upgrade your farm with new crops, tools, and decorations. Collect all cute premium fruit stickers to show your customers the quality and care of your fancy produce.

3946640.title: The Abyssal Diplomat
3946640.short_description: Humans and Monsters can't agree on what year it is, a conflict that threatens to tear apart their sense of shared reality. A mysterious creature is called upon to bring the two communities together. The Abyssal Diplomat will do its best. But will its best be enough?

3947270.title: Road Survival: Bigger on the Inside
3947270.short_description: In a toxic, zombie-ridden wasteland, survival is brutal. Upgrade your RV into a foldable-space mobile base—farm, craft, gather resources, and fend off the undead to build your last safe haven.

3947860.title: Steps
3947860.short_description: Embark on a narrative puzzle-adventure in a world made of blocks. Play as a block on a quest to find your place, meet other blocks on their journeys, and help them shape their stories. Explore hidden areas, discover treasures, and unlock abilities that open new paths in every level!

3948000.title: Man from Hell. Exodus.
3948000.short_description: 3D first-person shooter with elements of survival horror and stealth action — "Man from the Underworld. Exodus."

3948460.title: Teach My Little Sister How To Drive
3948460.short_description: TEACH MY LITTLE SISTER HOW TO DRIVE is a chaotic simulation game where you have to teach your sister who's driving on deadly roads. Trapped in the passenger seat, the only thing you can do is to give proper directions to your sister through your voice.

3949000.title: Incralife
3949000.short_description: Live an unpredictable life shaped by evolving choices, random opportunities, and the habits you build over decades. Grow your skills, build wealth, form relationships, and discover which unique Life Archetype your story becomes.

3949970.title: Gloom Punks
3949970.short_description: Not your average co-op roguelike. Where the price for power is death, and you’re trapped in a gloom-scape of fever dreams and fairytales gone feral, you can only rely on Punks like yourself. Cheat death, bounce back, and take on a world that so badly wants you dead!

3950060.title: Pip & Bones
3950060.short_description: Pip & Bones is a score-based deckbuilder roguelike with domino rules. Connect really long chains, score a lot of points, forge your perfect deck, enchant tiles, unlock new strategies with powerful idols and win the title of Tavern Champion!

3950670.title: Fireworks Incremental
3950670.short_description: Bad Wizard covered the land with a Magical Dome and the only way to destroy it is with fireworks! Hire units, unlock buildings, buy upgrades, discover powerful synergies, turn a few tiny explosions into a ridiculous spectacle and ultimately defeat The Bad Wizard himself!

3950720.title: Wander Her Way VR
3950720.short_description: Explore incredible interactive locations with your gorgeous companion. A sandbox VR experience with mini-games. Shoot enemies, destroy objects, drive a car, dance with an amazing girl, defend a tower, catch mischievous kittens, watch a fireworks show. Realistic female character, advanced physics

3950730.title: Tidy Tidy
3950730.short_description: A casual healing organizing game. No complex controls—just click and drag to logically sort and arrange items across scenes, turning clutter into order. With no time limits, savor the relaxation and healing of tidying up.

3950840.title: Grannies on Wheels
3950840.short_description: Battle it out in chaotic single screen party game where Monster Truck driving Grannies fight for jam and survival! Smash, crash, and outwit your rivals in dynamic arenas, packed with physics, mini-games, and laugh-out-loud chaos.

3950950.title: Shadowbound
3950950.short_description: Shadowbound is a minimalist 3D platforming and puzzle journey where light is your enemy and shadow your only ally. Overcome short challenges, manipulate light, and recover lost colors to rebuild the memories of a lifetime.

3952010.title: Jump Frog
3952010.short_description: A determined frog leaps ever higher, risking its life in a perilous climb where every slip could send it tumbling back to the start. driven by the call to find the perfect mate. Will this frog have what it takes?

3953390.title: Salvebringer Ninjas
3953390.short_description: As the outbreak spreads and civilization crumbles, humanity's last hope rests with an order of mysterious ninjas that have been hiding from the world for decades—the Salvebringer Ninjas!

3953700.title: Your Judgment, Inquisitor
3953700.short_description: Medieval Spain. You serve as an Inquisitor in the shadow of the dreaded Tomás de Torquemada. Cast out demons from the possessed. Burn heretics. Spare the innocent or condemn them. Every wrong choice will bring you closer to the wrath of the Church… or the fury of the mob.

3954600.title: Proto Trigger
3954600.short_description: An arcade shoot'em up with unique power-infusion gameplay. Face down an unknown army alone or with a friend in online or local co-op. Navigate the cosmos to save the remants of humanity, or join them in extinction!

3955010.title: Love Letter to a Vampyr
3955010.short_description: Love bites … especially when you’re in love with a Vampyr. In this survival horror game, travel to the ominous ruins of Castle Helenox in order to deliver your personal love letter to the monster who stole your heart. After all, who said that love has to be a pain in the neck?

3955700.title: Grid Forge TD
3955700.short_description: Stop continuous waves of enemies by building a maze in this free flowing tower defense game. Purchase upgrades between runs to become even more powerful and go further next time.

3955720.title: The Marsh Manor Mystery
3955720.short_description: Something strange happened in the old manor, but the Pond's premier puzzle-solver is here to uncover the truth. In this ribbiting and cozy mystery, explore the grounds, journey into the past, and unearth the secrets buried at Marsh Manor.

3956080.title: Arsenic & Absinthe
3956080.short_description: A Bartender point-and-click simulator game mixed with visual novel-style storytelling set in a noir-fabled world. As you have only 7 days to live, to save yourself from a collapsing life, it’s time to investigate, mix the drink and discover the secret recipe of success you deserve all along.

3956200.title: Memento Memori
3956200.short_description: You died, but the Angel gave you a chance for a revival. Memento Memori is a rogue-lite incremental matching game, where every second matters. Flip symbol, match pairs, collect blessings and buy your way out.

3956860.title: Battlethorne: Reckoning
3956860.short_description: Fight, build, and strategize in a massive third-person action-strategy RPG with hundreds of units and large-scale tactical battles across vast battlefields.

3957510.title: Chip Sweeper
3957510.short_description: A color-matching falling-blocks puzzle game. Position chips as they fall on the board. Match four colors in a row. Delete every bug before you top out. Play through a story, go against some friends, or chase the high score.

3957900.title: A Day with Wuki
3957900.short_description: Wuki is a real cat, and today the whole neighborhood is his. Slip through open windows, push mugs off tables, hunt mice, complete little cat mischief in every house and collect polaroids of the real Wuki. Or just nap in the sun.

3958200.title: FROB
3958200.short_description: The happy life of a whimsical little frog called Frob was turned upside down when his tadpoles were tadnapped by a heron. Now it's his quest to collect them all in this silly 3D platformer!

3958830.title: After Hours: Library
3958830.short_description: Survive a haunted library's overnight shift by balancing authentic librarian duties with stealth as a relentless supernatural entity hunts you. Uncover hidden secrets, survive until morning, and discover what waits between the shelves.

3959230.title: Daisy la Fleur
3959230.short_description: A PS1-esque art nouveau action-adventure game inspired by classic 90s games. Something strange has arrived in early 1900's France! It looks like Daisy is the one to stop it! Uncover the mystery behind these, tentacle monsters, jelly fish creatures, and even escaped brains! Welcome to Daisy la Fleur!

3959370.title: 8-bitBot
3959370.short_description: 8-bitBot is a programming puzzle game where you place simple instructions in a program to make your bots transport objects in a factory environment.

3959460.title: Stellar Mole
3959460.short_description: You will play a role of Agent Vanø—infiltrating an alien colonial corporation. Your mission: gather Earth intelligence for alien while weaponizing every dirty trick to torment your alien colleagues, dismantling their operations from within.

3959750.title: Grove Bound
3959750.short_description: Grove Bound is a cozy incremental woodcutting RPG where you chop, fish, cook, mine, and craft to explore a dark forest. Manage fatigue, light your way with a lantern, and upgrade tools while meeting quirky NPCs and uncovering secrets at your own pace.

3959870.title: Soul Stream
3959870.short_description: Soul Stream is a 2D fantasy Tarkov-style adventure with the thrill of gathering loot. Explore an interconnected world and fight your own battles. What awaits at the end of your fate?

3960090.title: Withering Age
3960090.short_description: Withering Age is a real-time strategy roguelike set in a dark fantasy, medieval world brimming with magic, danger, and decay. Build and expand your kingdom, train loyal troops and mighty champions, and defend your lands against relentless hordes.

3960140.title: Underpond
3960140.short_description: Delve into the depths of the amphibian afterlife, the eponymous UNDERPOND, in this procedurally generated, hand-drawn, frog-hopping roguelite.

3960500.title: Death & Taxes Multiplayer RPG
3960500.short_description: Become a trader, a hero, a legend...even a god. In Death & Taxes you can pursue anything...but only two things are certain.

3960760.title: Enlighted
3960760.short_description: Enlighted is a dark fantasy, dungeon crawler game that shows no mercy for mistakes. Explore randomly generated dungeon levels, find a legendary equipment and manage your light - it protects you quick death.

3961370.title: Tornado Hunter
3961370.short_description: Become a Tornado Hunter! Join the thrilling race across the American plains to predict, track, and document the deadliest storms of the century. Risk everything in pursuit of perfect data, but be careful: one wrong move and you'll become a storm victim.

3961690.title: I Saw a Flying Saucer
3961690.short_description: An interactive fiction about a man who lost his wife and goes in search of a UFO that shouldn't exist.

3961940.title: Liora's Price of Dignity
3961940.short_description: A fantasy RPG focusing on the concept of negotiating contracts. To save the love of her life from a deadly illness, Liora must ask for the help of Edgar, an ambitious mercenary who wields the power of magical contracts - once agreed upon, the absolute rules of these contracts cannot be disobeyed.

3961950.title: Layang Atma
3961950.short_description: An isometric survival horror about grief and loss. Fight terrifying manifestations, search through distorted memories, and uncover the truth behind the person Yus cannot let go.

3962240.title: Quiet Express: Cabin 909
3962240.short_description: “Do you know anything about Cabin 909?” In Quiet Express: Cabin 909, you spend seven days on the titular train, journeying from one side of the continent to the other.

3962250.title: Puzzle Mage
3962250.short_description: Puzzle Mage is a top-down game where you replace traditional ARPG combat with spellcasting puzzles.

3962430.title: Gata Guressi
3962430.short_description: Learn to communicate with the people of Hierre by speaking their languages and understanding their cultures in this sci-fi translation game. Use your translation skills to navigate Kallay Tirridor, uncovering its dark secrets while solving the sudden disappearance of your brother.

3963730.title: Overland Journey
3963730.short_description: Drive cars or trucks across uncharted terrain, manage fuel and supplies, carry as many resources as possible to upgrade your vehicle, and explore deeper into the wild.

3963760.title: The Immolation Apartment
3963760.short_description: An ancient cult lurks in an old apartment; a mother sacrifices her daughter. A decade later, her son enters the Netherworld to save his family from a deity’s torment, evading spirits to reach "Penglai Island" and destroy the Soul-Refining Furnace. Uncanny Abode blends 1990s Taiwan with cult horror.

3963860.title: Tax It Easy
3963860.short_description: Uncover shady expenses as a full-time Tax Scrutinizer! Check tax files, spot suspicious invoices, and decide: approve, reject, or pocket a bribe in this satirical inspector sim. Upgrade your office, build connections with big companies, make the most money for the government... or for yourself!

3964340.title: MMORPG NPC Simulator
3964340.short_description: Play as an NPC in a living MMORPG world. Run your shop, trade with players, give quests, and send raid parties after rare loot. Build your reputation, unlock Game Master abilities, and take control of the server from within.

3964620.title: Flutterfield
3964620.short_description: Flutterfield is a cozy and relaxing idle game. Buy butterflies and raise them in real time, or catch fully grown ones yourself. Unlock, upgrade, and customize habitats while filling your collection with real-life butterfly species!

3965050.title: Chrysanthemum: On the Way to Sweet Dreams
3965050.short_description: A high school senior with superpowers longs to confess her feelings to her chemistry teacher, but the island’s mysterious anomalies turn her world upside down. A non-linear otome visual novel filled with sinister mysteries and complicated choices.

3965090.title: Cardboard Tanks
3965090.short_description: Co-op tank roguelite for 1–4 players. Blast through a fully destructible world, online or on the couch.

3965200.title: Fake World 2: Real World 1
3965200.short_description: Fake World 2: Real World 1 is a VR first-person shooter where weapon color matters. Match red and yellow weapons to enemy attacks while you grapple, jetpack, and teleport through surreal sci-fi environments in a fast-paced, atmospheric campaign.

3965290.title: Keep Crafting
3965290.short_description: Keep Crafting is an asymetrical cooperative party game : One player must guide the other players using a manual to craft complex items !

3965650.title: Drift Market
3965650.short_description: Destroy supermarkets, fight absurd bosses, and turn your trolley into a weapon of mass destruction! Drift through chaotic stores as a furious mutant fruit and unleash over-the-top, physics-driven mayhem in this ridiculous smash ‘em up.

3965700.title: Moonlight Cradle
3965700.short_description: This is a traditional simulation management and raising game with multiple endings featuring beautiful girls.

3965730.title: Celestial Golf
3965730.short_description: It’s 2D golf on an astronomical scale. Bite-sized missions will teach you the techniques of real space flight, without having to worry about fuel or crew. Precisely plan orbital trajectories over the moons of Mars, through the rings of Saturn, and boldly go where no golf ball has gone before.

3965780.title: HYPER DETONATOR
3965780.short_description: HYPER DETONATOR is a chain-reaction bullet hell shooter set in cyberspace. Blast through the virus spreading across the mainframe, and detonate bombs to set off devastating chain reactions. How long will you survive?

3965940.title: Gunfetti
3965940.short_description: Pick a hero, jump in and start shooting. Fast multiplayer action in pixel art.

3967230.title: Alchemortis
3967230.short_description: Alchemortis is a roguelike inventory-management auto-battler about alchemy. Transmute and combine items to merge their stats, properties, and forms, then organize your inventory to unlock powerful synergies. Experiment, optimize, and craft the perfect build through the power of alchemy.

3967730.title: World of Dynasty: Shadows of Sagas
3967730.short_description: Dynasty World: Shadows of Tradition Epic MMO with survival elements and RPG. A fugitive from a destroyed dynasty, you enter the magical world through a flaming obelisk. Fight, solve the secrets of dungeons and create a new great dynasty in the harsh world of magic and warrior!

3968490.title: Train Cargo: NightShift
3968490.short_description: October 21, 1998. You are the night clerk at Hollow Pine freight yard. Weigh the crates, check the seals, sign the manifests. Follow the rules on the board in the booth. When the signal is red, do not move. Do not look at the train that is not on the schedule.

3969500.title: Knight Paths
3969500.short_description: A free, chess-inspired strategy duel where every square can be used only once. Control a single knight, outmaneuver your opponent in online PvP, or challenge five AI difficulty levels offline. Simple rules. Every move matters.

3969630.title: Taste of Power: Medieval
3969630.short_description: Master the art of war in brutal action-RTS across an alternate medieval world. Lead Europe, China or the Timurids to supremacy through strategic brilliance and lightning-fast tactics. Expand your realm, advance powerful technologies and lead massive armies. DISCOVER NEW HORIZONS OF THE MEDIEVAL WARS

3969770.title: Anachron
3969770.short_description: What if Joan of Arc fought alongside Blackbeard? In Anachron, you weave a dream team of 4 historical heroes to clash in a tactical, turn-based Arena. Build a custom deck for each champion from their unique abilities and unleash history-defying combos.

3970080.title: Zombies Hate to Die
3970080.short_description: Precise character slashing, scavenge resources along the way, and upgrade absurd gear. In this Roguelite loop, every escape is a brand-new journey.

3970510.title: Mind Scraper
3970510.short_description: Mind Scraper is a story-driven graphic adventure. Play as Robert and dive into dying minds—built from unresolved regrets—to explore memories and learn why those choices were made.

3970880.title: Eggspedition
3970880.short_description: ENTER THE EGGSPEDITION - A TERRIFYING SURVIVAL HORROR WITH DINOSAURS! Play solo or team up with up to 4 players to explore unknown planets, abandoned facilities, complete missions, and make daring extractions. It’s inhabited by… dinosaurs. Furious, massive, and very much alive.

3970990.title: Chain Shotgun
3970990.short_description: Chain Shotgun is a fast paced movement shooter where your only weapon is the multi-barrelled CHAIN SHOTGUN. Two barrels are way too few! With an up-to-infinite amount of barrels, it can shoot anything from sniper rounds, rockets, slime - LEGS? Why not even load it with yourself?

3971050.title: Be the Block
3971050.short_description: Be the Block is a Sokoban-inspired 2D puzzle game where you don’t just push the blocks, you ARE the blocks. Solve a collection of carefully hand-crafted puzzles that are by design simple yet challenging.

3971340.title: Something is Wrong with the Library
3971340.short_description: Shelve hundreds of real books in a library haunted by blood and meat. A spooky narrative organizing simulator by the studio behind I Am Your Beast and Clickolding.

3971680.title: Shogi: AI’s Forbidden Move
3971680.short_description: A groundbreaking shogi game created entirely without a game engine. From rule design to thinking algorithms, everything has been conceived and built by AI. Experience a unique worldview and gameplay that sets it apart from any shogi game before.

3972140.title: Shifting Chambers
3972140.short_description: Shifting Chambers is a solo / co-op survival horror game where you need to escape from a mansion where rooms shift when the bell rings. Explore the rooms, reorient yourself, solve puzzles and survive the unpredictably intelligent guardians.

3972230.title: Investment Fund Game
3972230.short_description: Investment Fund Game is a singleplayer sandbox simulation where you become the manager of an investment fund. Buy stocks, bonds, commodities. Test different investment strategies, track your performance, and compete with AI-driven funds using their own approaches.

3972290.title: SCRIMBLO SCRAMBLE
3972290.short_description: Put it all on the line in this roulette-themed incremental game where you torment your scrimblos in order to manage and eventually escape hell.

3972560.title: Spider Matrix
3972560.short_description: Expedition is dead, but your mind woke inside a mechanical spider. Become a fatal glitch in the Machine Swarm network, which arrived for a fifth-dimension fragment. Scale walls, strip enemy weapons, and destroy the Hive Mind to save the planet.

3972970.title: Super Egg & TCG Card Shop Simulator
3972970.short_description: Run your own TCG Card Shop! Crack open surprise eggs, collect rare cards and toy parts, and raise birds to produce eggs on your farm. Stock shelves, set prices, and serve customers as you grow your store in this shop simulator.

3973220.title: Cruise Control
3973220.short_description: Manage a cruise ship in this time-management strategy game! Build the dream cruise experience for your guests, work fast to solve problems, keep up with demand, upgrade your offerings to make every voyage even better, and keep the chaos from going overboard!

3973820.title: Corban's Station
3973820.short_description: In this first-person puzzle exploration game, walk the liminal spaces of a long-abandoned service station. Reprogram aging computers, physically reroute damaged and fading connections and restore fragments of their waning memory.

3974460.title: Wizard Tower Wars
