3974460.short_description: A multiplayer fantasy RTS with deckbuilding. Choose your wizard and tower, customize your spellbook, and battle up to 3 friends. Summon armies and buildings, cast spells, and level up while your forces fight on their own, so planning beats micro. Ally, betray, or fill empty seats with AI.

3975250.title: Merry Crisis
3975250.short_description: Three loves. One week. Merry Crisis is an intimate, character-driven romance visual novel about love, loss, and belonging—is home what you left behind, or where you're headed?

3975490.title: Castellan of Aurelwatch
3975490.short_description: Rebuild Aurelwatch, explore a world of medieval fantasy, and lead your heroes into turn-based battles. Discover its past, gather allies, and use clever tactics to overcome your enemies.

3975870.title: BrokenLore: MIKI-CHAN
3975870.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game set in a Japanese high school. Meet Miki-chan, your personal virtual assistant, and survive a nightmare where jealousy and obsession distort reality.

3975960.title: Everything Store
3975960.short_description: Everything Store is a game where you can manage your own thrift shop! Buy items, fit them into your store and sell them by negotiating with customers!

3976200.title: Punch Lunch: Foodtruck Fighter
3976200.short_description: Beat up punks in fast isometric combat, then win them over with burgers from your food truck. Brawl through the city, upgrade your kitchen, learn combat moves, and unlock new neighbourhoods. Grab your spatula and take back the streets!

3976380.title: No Way Back: Dark Horizon
3976380.short_description: Your son is counting on you, alone on an island crawling with creatures that stir in the dark. Feed him, build shelter, set snares, grow a garden and hunt to survive. The days are barely safe, but when night falls the real horror begins. Free demo available now.

3976680.title: MonstrousPark+
3976680.short_description: A workplace ensemble visual novel about sixteen cast members — monsters — working at a small amusement park that opens only at night.

3976980.title: Velo Victory
3976980.short_description: Velo Victory is a new cycling management PC game. Build your legacy through scouting, transfers, facilities, staff, and tactics. Shape future champions, meet sponsor goals and lead your team to victory.

3977410.title: The Seventh Screening
3977410.short_description: ESCAPE THE LIMELIGHT. Outsmart, outwit or outrun your demons in this cinematic first person survival horror.

3977770.title: Tiara
3977770.short_description: Tiara is an exploration-focused narrative game where you play through days (and dream through nights) to uncover the story of Tiara's life.

3977920.title: Barge
3977920.short_description: Grow crops, raise animals, and harvest resources that you can sell in towns you pass as you and your barge float down an endless river in this top down, pixel art, farming sim.

3978490.title: Diatonic
3978490.short_description: Diatonic is a piano roguelike that sharpens your sight-reading. Learn songs one run at a time, no matter your skill level. Best played with a MIDI keyboard.

3978590.title: Warp Bound
3978590.short_description: In this roguelite auto battler, you've been thrust into an uncharted sector of the Galaxy, discovering friends and foes alike. Traverse different environments, seek out and deal with traders, equip unique parts for your ship, form varied strategies, and fend off a variety of hostile factions.

3979370.title: Shit-Stealing Gnomes
3979370.short_description: Co-op adventure in which you play as little gnomes robbing houses. Be stealthy and steal the dirtiest things you can find.

3979490.title: AZUR
3979490.short_description: AZUR is a fast-paced PvP survival FPS on the French island of Belmas. No crafting, no extraction: drop into persistent servers, complete missions, and secure rare gear via Black Drip drops, with the risk of losing everything.

3979570.title: Factomancer
3979570.short_description: The Order sends you on a mission. Armed with technology powered by magic, build production chains, plan, transform, optimize, and prepare for the unexpected. In this automation roguelite, the Eye of the Order watches your moves: failure is only a step toward perfection.

3979590.title: Beerhouse Simulator
3979590.short_description: Brew beer your own way! First-person homebrewing simulator where every batch can go brilliantly wrong or surprisingly right — and clients might just notice the difference, or not. Brew, experiment or cause total beery mayhem.

3980070.title: OVERCRASH
3980070.short_description: Devastate the roads with your vehicle, wreck objects, explode traffic, take down helicopters, boost everywhere and chain combos to unlock new rides and challenges.

3980340.title: Imprinted
3980340.short_description: An audio restoration job becomes an investigation into the occult, as an elusive musician’s damaged cassette tapes are exhumed in northern Italy. Use a fully-operational desktop to sift through files, descending into the artist’s world in this slow-burning ghost tale of creativity and obsession.

3980550.title: Who Am I
3980550.short_description: Lost in amnesia, face a horrific past rising from nightmares. Uncover the truth hidden in a diary. In this psychological horror where reality and hallucination blur, piece together memories before madness consumes you. When the truth is out, ask yourself: Who was I?

3980790.title: Red Tide
3980790.short_description: Red Tide is an EXTRACTION FISHER set in the irradiated wastelands. Radioactive fish? Heavily armed Game Wardens? Exploring a vast open world with a rod in one hand and a rifle in the other? Scavenge what's left of the former nuclear site among the Calem Islands, alone or with friends.

3980930.title: Nitrania
3980930.short_description: Race. Boost. Unlock. A blazing-fast 90s-inspired arcade grip racer with 4-player split-screen. Master nitro to overtake 19 rivals, collect points, and unlock cars, upgrades, and vibrant track regions. Featuring an original soundtrack by the legendary retro racing composer BARRY LEITCH.

3981150.title: Bhangarh: The Untold Story
3981150.short_description: Inspired by the legends surrounding Asia's infamous Bhangarh Fort, set in 1985. When his wife, Vanya, mysteriously goes missing, an investigator follows a lead to the abandoned ruins of Bhangarh Fort. What begins as a rescue mission soon becomes a fight to survive the untold story of Bhangarh.

3981510.title: Broom Broom
3981510.short_description: Grab your broom, fly over to people in need and brew them potions after a catastrophic snowstorm has hit your village! Talk to your lovely (but mostly grumpy) neighbours as you find your place in this short and cozy adventure.

3981530.title: Emoji Guess Party
3981530.short_description: Think you can guess the answer from a few emojis? Emoji Guess Party is a lighthearted emoji puzzle game filled with idioms, wordplay, internet slang, and brain-teasing riddles. Play solo or guess together with friends.

3981680.title: Carte Blanche
3981680.short_description: Carte Blanche is an original adventure and card game in a fantastic world with the style of Japanese animes. Travel the world in search of the Cards. Collect them, develop them to participate in the Tournaments of the game. Discover the fabulous story of two children who love each other.

3981970.title: Platform Anomaly
3981970.short_description: Platform Anomaly is a co-op horror game where you and your friends hunt for anomalies — or hide them yourself and watch the search unfold. Scary and fun at the same time!
developers: macrayb is the coolest and Nikolai Tapchenko contributed 23 percent of the game

3982150.title: Low Level Hunters
3982150.short_description: Low Level Hunters is a low-poly, cold war era helicopter combat flight simulator. Pilot Cobra attack helicopter, Huey II utility helicopter, or MD-500 Defender by directly interacting with switches and control devices using mouse, joysticks, and VR controllers to defeat ruthless rebels!

3982430.title: Omertà: Mafia Novel
3982430.short_description: Noir visual novel set in 1950s New York. Infiltrate a prison, build a smuggling network, and shape fates through tough choices across branching paths.

3982440.title: Deep Claims
3982440.short_description: Deep Claims is a space exploration game where you upgrade your ship and equipment in order to mine increasingly valuable and hazardous asteroids. Can you make it to the core?

3982690.title: Pocket Racer Shop Sim
3982690.short_description: Create the ultimate Pocket Racer hobby shop. Stock the shelves, open car packs, build miniature race cars and expand your store over time. Design custom tracks and invite your friends over to help run the shop or to throw down on the latest track setup.

3982770.title: Love and Peace Simulator
3982770.short_description: 《大爱仙尊模拟器》是一款开放世界RPG，身为掌门不仅要提升自身修为，还要强大宗门实力。您扮演蓝夏与蓝珂兄妹，不择手段的活下去。黑暗孕育出恶之花，在没有人伦道德的约束下，在未来等待着的，是何等的欢愉……

3982900.title: Wall Street 1929
3982900.short_description: Wall Street 1929 is a business sim set in the Great Depression. Start before the crash and live through collapse and recovery. Found companies, acquire shares, buy real estate, run charities, and bid on collectibles to build your empire.

3982970.title: 魂途 Xoul
3982970.short_description: Xoul is a uniquely styled 2D ARPG. You can use the game's distinctive "Custom Combo" feature to create your own chain attacks, defeat various enemies, experience diverse stories, unravel the mysteries of this world—and then make your choice.

3983040.title: 白銀のユークロニア
3983040.short_description: ”Silver Eucronia” is an exploration RPG where you wander through a post-apocalyptic world covered in white. Through interactions with allies, world exploration, and deadly battles against threats, you will witness the conclusion of your own world and carve out the future beyond.

3983630.title: 无言初雪与奇迹书
3983630.short_description: 江城是个很少下雪的南方城市。 倘若是哪个冬天见到了，就随手纪念一下吧… 在难以成团的雪籽融化成水之前，在眼前的人尚未走远消失之前 将“白色的奇迹”封存在相片里，记录在记事本里，铭刻于脑海里……

3983930.title: Tokyo Supplier
3983930.short_description: As a post robot in a future Tokyo under lockdown, deliver packages under pressure. Dodge blockades and hostile bots, beat the clock, and unlock skins for your bot, dog companion, and delivery van.

3985280.title: Song of Kings
3985280.short_description: Song of Kings is a puzzle platformer inspired by Sri Lankan myth. A Yaksha boy, captured by humans, must escape a ruthless king. Guided by his grandfather’s spirit and armed with a magical flute, he uncovers his heritage and fights to return to his people.

3985880.title: INTERVOID
3985880.short_description: A co-op horror game for 2–4 players. You have been brought back from the dead to uncover what happened in an underground complex. Solve its puzzles, survive its trials, and stop the one who killed you.

3986110.title: Escape from Ruin: Greymart Simulator
3986110.short_description: A post-apocalyptic loot-fight-extract survival game with escape-style raids by day and black-market shop management by night. Fans of Tarkov-like gameplay — and players who love running management sims — will feel right at home.

3986560.title: FIND KITTENS 12: Cave Town
3986560.short_description: Light your lantern, traveler, for a journey into the depths of the earth awaits you! What are you waiting for?! Explore and find cute cats to fill this black-and-white world with different colors.

3987140.title: LOOPR
3987140.short_description: A fast-paced puzzle platformer where you must loop through variations of the same level in order to win! Collect artifacts to make the previously impossible actually possible.

3987350.title: Protocol Paradox
3987350.short_description: Protocol Paradox is a fast-paced roguelike shooter blending twin-stick combat, anomaly-based weapons and branching lore. Survive procedural sectors, customize builds with weapons and passives, face concept-driven bosses, and replay for new revelations.

3987430.title: Roads & Riches: Traveling Merchant Simulator
3987430.short_description: Hit the road and set up shop, solo or with friends! Take your caravan wherever demand leads, sell wonderful wares, and find magical treasures - all to win over the hearts, minds, and wallets of a vast, dynamic world!

3987670.title: Drawing Dead
3987670.short_description: A grid-based roguelike deckbuilder where you swap cards to trigger cascading poker hands, or sacrifice them for power. Summon demons, strike bargains, and enchant your deck into an infernal scoring engine.

3988040.title: Legal Beagll: Justice is Argued
3988040.short_description: Legal Beagll: Justice is Argued is a courtroom simulation RPG where every trial is a battle of wits. You’ll take on the role of Harold Beagll, a golden retriever attorney navigating a legal system filled with sharp-tongued rivals, eccentric clients, and unpredictable witnesses.

3988220.title: KAKUREONI: Hide-and-Seek Horror
3988220.short_description: This is an asymmetrical multiplayer horror game. Play a 3-minute game of hide-and-seek in an abandoned school at midnight. With only the beam of a flashlight to guide them through the darkness. Experience the thrill of a deadly hunt.

3988400.title: Burdenfall
3988400.short_description: Burdenfall is a story-rich roguelike deckbuilder about personal growth and inner struggle. Ascend a mysterious castle with your shapeshifting companion, whose transformations shape and evolve your deck. Survive the climb and uncover the truth behind the Weeping Crown’s message.

3988560.title: Astro Loopers
3988560.short_description: What if you could rewind time — and team up with your past self? Astro Loopers is a Sokoban-style puzzle game set in a cosmic universe, where every move echoes through time. Your past characters repeat their actions as time loops stack up — coordinate them to solve increasingly mind-bending stages.

3988640.title: Forbidden Love
3988640.short_description: Love for forbidden dreams, Forbidden Love is a visual novel about the love between a teacher and a student, in pursuit of a forbidden dream.

3988850.title: SPARK! -PHOTON BLAST-
3988850.short_description: "SPARK! -PHOTON BLAST-" is a sports action game where players face off in a futuristic stadium, rendered with stunningly beautiful photorealistic graphics. Your goal is to score by launching a sphere into your opponent's goal. Enjoy the heart-pounding, high-octane action where every second counts!

3988880.title: Cthulhu 1920
3988880.short_description: Step into the eerie world of Cthulhu 1920, a strategic card game where sanity is your lifeline. Players navigate a grid-based playfield, battling enemies, collecting items, and using weapons and long forgotten artifacts to survive.

3988990.title: 我的灵气吸不完
3988990.short_description: "My Qi Is Unlimited"is a yuri-themed suspense puzzle game that combines 3D first-person exploration with 2D visual novel elements. Explore a secluded manor, solve mechanisms, and combine items. Shape relationships through choices, leading to vastly different endings.

3989540.title: Dive and Glide
3989540.short_description: Dive, glide and smash your way through colourful sky-high challenges! Explore floating islands, earn stars to unlock new worlds, and master wildly different courses filled with rings, obstacles, enemies and secrets. Race your friend, race a penguin, fight aliens, hours of fun for everyone.

3989720.title: Rolling Rogue
3989720.short_description: Explore dungeons in a stylish roguelike with turn-based combat. Use a deck of dice to give your abilities unique effects. Create your own dice and combine them with equipment, carving your way through hordes of enemies.

3989750.title: One Try Only!
3989750.short_description: A hardcore platformer where you only get one attempt. Fall once, and the game is locked forever.

3989790.title: Cranked
3989790.short_description: Explore, race, and freeride in Cranked and experience the raw thrill of downhill mountain biking. It’s fast, responsive, and grounded -- we're chasing what it really feels like to ride. Easy to pick up, impossible to put down, and packed with virtually endless skill depth.

3989800.title: FIND KITTENS 13: Pirates
3989800.short_description: Yo-ho-ho and a bottle of rum! Are you ready to travel on an exciting journey with pirates? What are you waiting for? Explore and find cute cats to fill the black-and-white world with bright colors.

3989950.title: My Death as a Duchess
3989950.short_description: My Death as a Duchess is a survival game where the player embodies a duchess taking control of a cursed duchy. This game combines both narrative intrigue and strategy, alternating phases of managing the duchess's schedule and the unfolding of her day in the form of a graphic novel.

3990000.title: Echoes of Fire
3990000.short_description: Survive the relentless cold in a stylized, post-apocalyptic wilderness. Gather wood, build fires, and fight to stay alive against the wind, snow, and the wild.

3990340.title: Royal Verdict
3990340.short_description: A medieval court simulation where every verdict matters. Hear cases, uncover lies, and balance the King, the People, and the Church as your reputation shapes the fate of the kingdom.

3990360.title: The Darkside Detective: Backside of the Moon
3990360.short_description: You'd think that after 20+ cases, there'd be no crime left in Twin Lakes - but that's not how crime works, rookie. Six new mind-melting mysteries await Detective McQueen and Officer Dooley - just as soon as they get the mustard out of Dooley's gun.

3990610.title: Escape Path
3990610.short_description: Navigate through complex non-linear mazes dotted with traps, enemies and unique mechanics to rebuild a protective crystal. Watch and think, because rushing in headfirst will lead you to death! Ready to take on the challenge and find the pieces before it's too late?

3990710.title: Invasion Of Britannia
3990710.short_description: Lead Rome’s conquest of Britain in a third-person strategy RPG. Fight, craft, trade, lead armies, and manage settlements in a living world where towns grow, caravans travel, people gain experience, shortages spread, and conquest reshapes the land, even when you are elsewhere.

3991140.title: The Hambagu Shop
3991140.short_description: The Hambagu Shop is a cozy horror simulator where you work in a Japanese Hamburg Steak Shop. Cook Hamburg, serve customers, and upgrade your shop for more menu items.

3991360.title: Space Dash
3991360.short_description: In Space Dash, every move is an explosion. Click to dash into swarms of rock enemies, unleash devastating area damage, and spend gold to unlock upgrades, gravity pulls, turrets, and missiles for nonstop action

3991760.title: Night Portable
3991760.short_description: Night Portable is a night-shift survival horror set in a used game store. Clean, restock, and hide from ■■■ until 6 AM. Play three retro handheld games and cash out for items—or risk losing them. Manage light, noise, and resources as a side-scrolling adventure uncovers the past behind the curse.

3992340.title: One Arrow
3992340.short_description: Freeze your arrow in midair and then use it as a platform in this challenging precision platformer. Carve your own paths, outsmart your enemies, and uncover the secrets of your magic arrow.

3993170.title: Bloomed Ghoul
3993170.short_description: Eat your enemies and replace your body parts. A ghoulish action roguelike where your abilities, weapons, and power come from what you choose to become.

3993630.title: Femboy Detective
3993630.short_description: Dark yaoi horror game about learning who to trust. Investigate leads, interrogate suspects, and unravel a doomsday conspiracy in the search for your missing friend.

3994460.title: Drone Farmer
3994460.short_description: First-person farming sim in the middle of a drone war. Shoot down AI drones and explore the village to find seeds and ammo. Use your farm drone to fulfill vegetable quotas faster. Will you let AI replace you, or will humanity prevail?

3994560.title: Sirin's Feather
3994560.short_description: The Bird of the Dead has taken your beloved. How many times will you have to die to bring her back? Gather companions, uncover their secrets, and shape the story in a world where pagan myths come alive.

3994860.title: Sweet Dreams in Midnight Kingdom
3994860.short_description: Sweet Dreams in Midnight Kingdom is a medieval puzzle game where the player, a king, has his divine right to rule tested when tasked with putting his own subjects to bed before the sun rises. Use logic and patience to solve each level in this grid-based, hand-drawn game.

3994960.title: Intersecta
3994960.short_description: "Intersecta" is an intense tactical top-down space combat game with a stylized sci-fi aesthetic. Devoid of humans, the game is set in another dimension where only cybernetic insects have evolved. The player takes control of an Intersecta fighter pilot hoping to survive an intergalactic invasion.

3995310.title: Trivia Fantasy
3995310.short_description: TRIVIA FANTASY is a trivia-based adventure with RPG progression. Crawl your way through a decayed tower filled with forgotten knowledge and defeat the dying deity that that awaits at the summit!

3995340.title: Frog Odyssey
3995340.short_description: A turn-based strategic auto-battler where you buy ingredients, craft special dishes, and feed them to your frog adventurers to unlock powerful bonuses! Embark on a heroic journey to confront those causing chaos across the realm.

3996460.title: Dokuro・Maguro
3996460.short_description: Awaken in a psychiatric hospital and become trapped in an endless loop of madness. Explore bizarre hellscapes, battle monstrous tuna creatures, and fight your way out of a surreal nightmare in this absurd escape horror FPS!

3996490.title: Polly's Puzzle Box
3996490.short_description: As a small flea, explore a strange puzzle box full of secrets. Gather shapes and combine them to reveal hidden abilities. Polly is always watching… Can you escape?

3996700.title: Yrdenwatch - The Dragon from Lidoriya
3996700.short_description: This game is about piloting a giant mech with wings that has multiple guns attached to it. It's explosive, fast-paced, skill-based, and full of gun violence. It's also a story-driven game where you explore a spaceship and talk to your fellow crew members!

3996910.title: TomaDO!
3996910.short_description: TomaDO! is a fast, quirky multiplayer platformer where tomato heroes race through floating obstacle courses, dodge hazards, and respawn at checkpoints. Jump, dash, and explore golf and other modes to reach the finish first.

3998040.title: Fossilfuel 3
3998040.short_description: Navigate an open-world Siberian island overrun by dinosaurs. Circle the island high above the ground on a monorail while a relentless Giganotosaurus hunts you below. Lock and load for the explosive third entry in the Fossilfuel series!

3998640.title: BUG SQUASH
3998640.short_description: Defend your Command Centers against relentless waves of mutated insects! Customize powerful tanks with an arsenal of weapons and tactical modules in this action-packed tower defense game. Go solo or team up with friends in online co-op.

3998660.title: What a Wonderful Venom World
3998660.short_description: "What a Wonderful Venom World" is a difficult survival sim. All food is poisoned, and you must find an antidote through endless trial and error. Face countless deaths and share info with other players to speed up your research. This game is for players who enjoy a serious challenge.

3998940.title: Demondemon Demon Tamer
3998940.short_description: Demondemon Demon Tamer combines swarm-survivor and monster raising. Manage, take care, and train your demons during the day. Survive the swarm of attacking demons at night. Raise your reputation among three factions of demon tamers, and unravel their hidden motives in this doomed city, Laknakarta.

3999020.title: Adept
3999020.short_description: Conquer the world with fire and sword in a world where chaos reigns.

3999040.title: Devoid
3999040.short_description: Devoid is an immersive journey into the medieval world of vampires who feed on human souls. You will have to put an end to their power with the help of sword and magic. Use an arsenal of tools and magical abilities on your way to defeat the most ancient evil.

3999220.title: Meal Quest
3999220.short_description: Explore the magical world inside your fridge, plan meals, and fight your way to the Dream City. Your in-game nutrition choices grant you combat bonuses that reflect each vitamin’s actual role in the body.

3999370.title: Deadlight Manor
3999370.short_description: A stylized survival horror built on community. Squad up with your team, battle endless waves of the infected, and let your stream audience fuel the chaos in real time.

3999630.title: Friends of a Feather
3999630.short_description: An absurd adventure RPG: ruin weddings, break into dinosaur mansions, and sleep with 3 or 4 opossums.

3999820.title: Make The Dead Dead Again
3999820.short_description: Lux is dealing with a paranormal outbreak, and every loot drop could be a gun, a jacket or maybe a fresh dye job. She’ll prioritize accordingly. Clear the streets, then make her drop-dead gorgeous. Because the apocalypse is no excuse for a bad outfit.

3999950.title: Frozen Echo
3999950.short_description: Venture into the endless frozen wastelands alone or with friends. Stay warm, manage and upgrade your camp, hunt, and learning your skills to survive the harsh cold and wolf attacks.

4000520.title: Purrfect Collars
4000520.short_description: Purrfect Collars is a cozy single-player shopkeeping adventure. As a witch, design collars, enchant them with potions, manage your shop and meet interesting new customers! Each collar holds meaning, every cat a story!

4001420.title: Rare Metal War: The sins of memory
4001420.short_description: Iron beasts. Furry heroes. One last hope. In a world where humanity has fallen, unlikely saviors rise from the animal kingdom. Strap into your customized mech, unleash devastating firepower, and fight through endless waves of enemies in this action-packed survivor roguelike.

4001430.title: Seres Universalis:Three Kingdoms
4001430.short_description: Return to the Three Kingdoms period. On the grand strategic tactical battlefield, use terrain for defense setup and resource allocation to shift the battle situation. Control the war via hexagonal grid movement and tactical ability activation, and unify the realm.

4001660.title: Undying Knights
4001660.short_description: Undying Knights is a couch and online party game that fuses strategy and reflexes. Enjoy quick rounds with flexible team fights, unique weapons and deadly traps, all with a handicap option that keeps every battle fair.

4002220.title: Follow These Steps
4002220.short_description: In the mood for a bit of puzzle building? Put on relaxing tunes, open the box, and start putting together things out of colorful pieces — step-by-step instructions included!

4002700.title: Fist of Goal
4002700.short_description: Fist of Goal is a soccer tournament for one-wheeled robots with levitating fists. Score goals, outsmart your opponents, knock them off their wheels, and use anything you can get your hands on. Preferably for its intended purpose. / Keep going / Think fast / Beat 'em up /

4002900.title: FireFly
4002900.short_description: A momentum-driven 2D platforming adventure where mastering movement unlocks exploration. Leap, slide, and swing through vibrant open maps as a grounded firefly searching for family and hidden secrets.

4003590.title: Dungeon Gambler: All In, No Out
4003590.short_description: Hit the jackpot in this gambling-infused dungeon crawler. Pay what you owe. Survive the dungeon. Play your cards close to your chest and defeat Skelly.

4004160.title: Depth Loop
4004160.short_description: A werewolf game set in a deep-sea lab, where the survival of humanity is at stake—does justice lie with humankind or the werewolves?

4004550.title: Crystals Bureau
4004550.short_description: Command your Escort Cart and navigate freely across the map! Plot your own defense routes, build towers, hunt for powerful artifacts, and defeat Umbra monsters to bring the Crystal Core home.

4004630.title: Pizza Syndicate
4004630.short_description: Run your pizza empire in this quirky retro tycoon! Manage restaurants, hire staff, craft menus, and outsmart rivals. Dive into the underground syndicate—rob banks, hire hitmen, sabotage competitors, and use any scheme to dominate the city with humor and strategy! WISHLIST NOW!

4004820.title: FreeStyle Football 2
4004820.short_description: Freestyle Football 2 is a fast-paced, 5v5 match-based online multiplayer soccer game. Each position has a unique role, and you'll utilize a variety of strategies and skills to achieve victory with your team. Stylish play and unique characters transform the pitch into a stage.

4004990.title: SOS Cannibals
4004990.short_description: From 2 to 12 players. Gather food and scavenge for clothes to survive cold and hunger after your plane crashed on a remote island. But beware, some of you are secretly island cannibals trying to take everyone out before help shows up!

4006370.title: Santa's Legacy
4006370.short_description: Become Santa and run Christmas. Build your workshop, manage mischievous elves, craft millions of gifts, and deliver them all before Christmas morning.

4006570.title: Scrapborne
4006570.short_description: A Helldivers-inspired desktop overlay RPG where your actions shape the universe. Gear up in your bunker and join the galactic struggle from the corner of your screen. Impact the global economy, faction wars, and story. Adapt to World Events in a living, community-driven world.

4006670.title: Titanic: Honor & Glory
4006670.short_description: Explore the entire Titanic inside and out, from the hull and promenades to every saloon, boiler room, and cabin in a rich and detailed 3D environment with the highest level of accuracy possible, situated beneath our virtual Arrol Gantry in our digital shipyard.

4007330.title: Fall of the Final Age
4007330.short_description: Take command of the last Stronghold of humanity, fighting back against the advancing monsters. Decide where to prioritize the forces of your Heroes, as the number of turns before the invasion is limited. A turn-based tactical strategy with RPG and roguelike elements.

4007640.title: Signal Station
4007640.short_description: Remote listening station. 1984. You're the operator decoding an impossible signal using oscilloscopes, tape machines, and analog equipment. Align satellites. Analyze waveforms. Make choices that determine humanity's response. Multiple endings. DISCOVER THE TRUTH!

4007950.title: Gorilla Attack 2: Rampage
4007950.short_description: Your favorite gorilla (kind of) is back! Smash a massive new city, take on unique challenges, and interact with a fully destructible world. Team up with friends or let them join your chaotic VR adventure!

4008580.title: Vapor Strange
4008580.short_description: Select a Universe to explore. Then jump into bizarre psychedelic worlds, encounter surreal creatures, while experience shifting rulesets, and mini-games for a wild and truly strange experience.

4008690.title: REVOLVER
4008690.short_description: Tired of immortality, the Demoness has lured you into a trap and asks for a favor: remove the curse from her revolver, bet your life and rip the lost soul of suffering. This rendezvous will make you take full risks. But remember: once you sign the Act of Blood, no chance to turn it back.

4008790.title: King's Courier
4008790.short_description: King’s Courier is a free roam, party-based RPG. Carry out perilous quests for the King while exploring dungeons, enchanted forests, deadly swamps, and monster-filled caves. Build your party, learn magic, battle in real-time or turn-based, solve puzzles, and uncover the kingdom’s secrets.

4008840.title: Erehwon(エレフォーン)
4008840.short_description: The gear you acquire completely transforms your party’s roles. Erehwon is a loot-driven dungeon crawler where you progress by reshaping your builds around the gear you find.

4009100.title: Fallen Valkyries: Prologue
4009100.short_description: An Anime Wave-based Arena Shooter, Kill Goblin > Collect Bounty > Buy Upgrade > Survive

4009810.title: Starweaver
4009810.short_description: Deckbuilding roguelike game where you become a Priestess of Light and restore a sky consumed by darkness. Discover key cards, place stars across the sky, break curses, and complete constellations. Before it's too late, stand against the God of Night and drive back the darkness.

4010020.title: Patchwork Home
4010020.short_description: Patchwork Home is a dating action game where you help a colorful cast of characters build a home in a world that has broken more times than they can count. But, for some reason, these goofballs think this time it'll be different. Make sure that it is. Currently in Alpha.

4010050.title: Rule of Iron: Dark Age
4010050.short_description: Build your realm in a turn-based campaign. Command your armies in real-time battles.

4010070.title: Lumber Plumber
4010070.short_description: Lumber Plumber is a game about tree felling, water plumbing, ore mining, rock crushing, metal bending, resource exploring, and wonder assembling. Transport lumber across long distances using steam locomotives and conveyor belts.

4011130.title: Ants Megapolis
4011130.short_description: Command a colony on the brink in Ants Megapolis. Survive an unforgiving world by forging your unique Pheromone, a weapon that dictates your evolution. Carve out an empire from the dirt as an interactive narrator chronicles your savage, epic story of survival.

4011630.title: Not My Base!
4011630.short_description: Build, defend, adapt… or just watch your base burn. Not My Base! is a Tower Defense game where you build up your defenses and fight through various levels. Strengthen your fortifications, choose your upgrades, and craft new strategies to withstand the chaos and havoc unleashed by angry armies.

4012160.title: Fire Crew Simulator
4012160.short_description: A co-op firefighting sim for up to 4 players. Fly helicopters with water buckets and drive the fire engine against a forest fire that spreads tree by tree, all on the same map. Or run the lookout tower campaign on your own.

4012170.title: Spellbroker
4012170.short_description: Become a master Spellbroker — wield magic and money in a fast-paced, isometric pixel art marketplace. Buy low, sell high, and bend the market to your will as you build your fortune in a world where profit is pure magic.

4012280.title: Tempered Heart: Pilgrim's Mark
4012280.short_description: Play as Esther, a retired knight journeying through a world of monsters and hidden truths. Master skill-based combat against fast and unique enemies using precisely timed blocks. Uncover the past and confront the question that has kept the world in stagnation: When will we be ready?

4012380.title: Cut the Strings
4012380.short_description: It's a battle to become a sacrifice. A TPS where the bride <sacrifice> girl shoots down abandoned synthetic soldiers on the battlefield. A fictional post-war world, a corrupt city, unreasonable fate and choices. Explore vast fields, enhance your body and weapons, and carve out her path.

4012720.title: Posse of 3
4012720.short_description: Posse of Three is an RPG Maker game that takes place in a wild west setting with heavy fantasy elements! You will play as 3 main characters. Sammy a young settler, Ahiga a native man, and Fennic a wild fawn. Expect traditional turn based rpg combat with a gripping wild west story.

4012830.title: Magic Tower: Legion
4012830.short_description: "Magic Tower: Legion" is a roguelike Magic Tower-like game. You will play as a legion commander and lead your team into the magic tower. Use each character's strengths to defeat powerful enemies. Remember to plan every step carefully, for all resources in the magic tower are non-renewable.

4013860.title: Drowned in the Light：Gloom
4013860.short_description: Drowned in the Light: Gloom is a high-difficulty, real-time turn-based, story-driven character development game. Players will explore the unknown world.

4013910.title: Some Puzzles
4013910.short_description: A surreal, FMV puzzle adventure. "It's got some puzzles."

4013930.title: Lock In
4013930.short_description: An escape-the-room puzzle game. Solve locks to unlock locks. Unlock locks to unlock more locks. Lock in.

4014030.title: Maidle Cafe
4014030.short_description: Run your own maid café in this charming idle incremental game! Hire and upgrade maids, decorate with unique items, and grow your café into the ultimate cozy hotspot—all while earning profits even when you’re away.

4014180.title: Car Rental Simulator: Prologue - Early Days
4014180.short_description: Free introduction to the full Car Rental Simulator game puts you behind the desk of a small-town rental office in Winston Springs. Manage customers, grow your fleet, and deal with surprises along the way

4014190.title: Teddy Won't Help
4014190.short_description: One night, your plushies whisper a warning: Three monsters from under the bed will come for you before dawn. The only way to survive is to play their games… and win. Fail, and you won’t live to see the morning.

4014210.title: Sweep Squad
4014210.short_description: Sweep Squad is a 1-4 player arcade sweep-em-up where you and your ambiguous rodent friends team up to sweep away the bad guys and hit your quotas. Crank up the earnings with overtime and use various sub-weapons at your disposal to sweep away the competition.

4014610.title: Necromancer's Workshop
4014610.short_description: Necromancer’s Workshop is a fantasy tycoon game. Craft zombies, work the land. Build a cozy countryside business, worth waking the dead for.

4015780.title: VASED
4015780.short_description: VASED is a simple, yet challenging fast-paced arcade against-the-clock puzzle game about vases.

4015800.title: Deck Breach
4015800.short_description: We fused roguelike deckbuilders and autobattlers to create a whole new experience. Pick your favorite weapon, craft a unique deck, create your unique playstyle, and play powerful cards to influence the outcome of the battle in a unique combat style where your Hero’s actions are your resources.

4015840.title: Gumblaster Mayhem
4015840.short_description: Gumblaster Mayhem is a 3D retro-style first-person shooter game where you, as a player, shoot out some gumballs using the three weapons that you must use to take down the sour mutants to survive.

4015890.title: Labyren
4015890.short_description: Labyren is a medieval-themed Tower Defense game centered on multi-waypoint mazing and vision. While traversing through the campaign, discover countless unique strategies building with your ever-expanding arsenal and unravel the story underneath!

4015970.title: The Story about princess 8 out of 10
4015970.short_description: A fairy-tale comedy visual novel about a princess rated 8/10 and her questionable decisions. Rescue a prince, adopt a cat, or discover the cost of independence. Choose your own mess in a hand-drawn world of sharp jokes and very unsuitable suitors.

4016500.title: Point In Time
4016500.short_description: Use time travel to cooperate with your past self and conquer seemingly impossible puzzles. Can you craft the perfect timeline without altering history? Design your own escape.

4016690.title: Tad-Bubble!
4016690.short_description: Tad-Bubble is a boss rush shoot ‘em up for the Game Boy Color! Fight off waves of dangerous boss bugs, boss fish, and boss more in this brand-new retro experience.

4016990.title: Purrfect Tanks - The Yarnpocalypse
4016990.short_description: Command adorable cats in chaotic cardboard tanks and battle for the last yarn on Earth! Play a fast-paced arcade shooter packed with explosions, lasers, catnip-fueled madness — and lots of cardboard. 🐱📦🔥

4017940.title: Captain Speedfin
4017940.short_description: Captain Speedfin is stuck with an hourglass and needs to be fast! Race against the clock through 60 challenging levels of pirate parkour, where every second counts. Grab your treasure and get out before time runs out!

4018120.title: Element TD 3 - Tower Defense
4018120.short_description: Element TD 3 takes the tradition of combining powerful elements for unique towers and adds heroes. Infinitely replayable and endless, this is a Tower Defense that blends classic gameplay with modern additions. Play with up to 8 players cooperatively or competitively.

4018380.title: Chronoscript: The Endless End
4018380.short_description: “Chronoscript: The Endless End” is an exploration-based action-adventure game where you, an editor trapped within a manuscript, must unravel a thousand-year story that writes itself beyond its end—across 2D pages and a 3D manor.

4018520.title: Waffles' Cranked Stories
4018520.short_description: Waffles' Cranked Stories is a selection of mini-games set in the same universe as Inspector Waffles, originally released exclusively on the Playdate console. This time, follow the adventures of Chance and Spike and discover new stories that expand on the previous ones!

4018610.title: A Game About Digging A Hole™ Together
4018610.short_description: A minimalist game about digging a hole at the beach, now with friends. Dig together, collect resources, sell them, upgrade your equipment and search for a promised treasure buried deep beneath the sand. Play solo or with friends (1 to 4 players), with crossplay.

4018940.title: The Beginner Investor
4018940.short_description: Start from scratch, learn the market, and build your fortune in this accessible stock market tycoon game. Buy, sell, and diversify your way to wealth!

4018980.title: Faraway Galaxy
4018980.short_description: Faraway Galaxy is a new roguelite deckbuilder framed as a bizarre tabletop adventure narrated by a battle-hardened space wolf. Master intense tactical battles and meaningful choices between them. Fight alien pirates, collect artifacts, and uncover new encounters!

4019040.title: One Last Sacrifice
4019040.short_description: Most autobattlers reset after every match. One Last Sacrifice doesn't. Unlock skills across a branching skill tree. Build a deck. Improve creatures by crafting. Compete in 1v1 duels or 8-player elimination tournaments - sync and async play supported.

4019190.title: Pradera
4019190.short_description: Pradera is a first-person psychological horror. You play as Clarice, an ambitious lawyer taking on an impossible case. Nine people were decapitated. The bodies remain. The heads are gone. A gamble for fame becomes a real nightmare.

4019440.title: Wanderer's Deck
4019440.short_description: “Wanderer’s Deck is a dark fantasy roguelike deck-building game. Every choice reshapes your fate: build your deck, step through mysterious doors, battle deadly foes, and face powerful bosses lurking in the dungeons.”

4020470.title: Echograve
4020470.short_description: You have been appointed warden of an underground complex. Check documents and identify dangerous citizens by their behavior and sounds. Decide whom to let through the airlock and defend against threats from below. Until your shift ends, their lives — and yours — are your responsibility.

4020800.title: A Trivia Roguelike
4020800.short_description: Your actions are dictated by trivia questions and answers in this roguelike RPG with a trivia twist. Collect loot and level up to impact your chances of survival, take down dangerous foes and defeat the evil Trivia Arch Lich.

4021090.title: ALPENGLIDE
4021090.short_description: Glide down an endless, ever-changing mountain range as a wind spirit lost in alpine peaks. Graze cliffs and dive through canyons to build up your multiplier, survive the fog and snow, and race to the top of the daily and all-time leaderboards.

4021110.title: Factory Time
4021110.short_description: A factory automation incremental game at the end of the universe. Start crafting by hand, automate production, and build the Chronoforge to escape.

4021250.title: Pages of Tomorrow
4021250.short_description: Challenge fate in this psychological visual novel about a juvenile psych ward patient who discovers a book that can predict the future.

4021290.title: Shake
4021290.short_description: A Revolutionary Fillet Action Game! Control a salmon fillet, something you never knew you wanted—until now.

4021650.title: Redline District
4021650.short_description: A turn-based tactical strategy about evacuation coordination. As the voice on the radio, guide survivors through real-world city streets, manage squad roles, and calculate every move in deterministic combat before the expanding hazard zone engulfs the district.

4021890.title: Pizzapocalypse: A Slice of Hope
4021890.short_description: Use your pizza to bounce, swing and dash in this 3D platformer! Explore different countries, and put a stop to the greedy corporation selling Pizza-in-a-can!

4022050.title: Turbo 16
4022050.short_description: Turbo 16 depicts a coming-of-age narrative through combining arcade racing and storytelling. Turbo 16 is a racing game and provides players with racing challenges (3 modes), the game is equally an environmental narrative experience.

4022070.title: SHROT
4022070.short_description: Welcome to SHROT! A fast, funny, and unapologetically stupid first-person boomer shooter where a Slavic trucker gets stuck in an alien apocalypse and handles it the only way he knows how: with beer, cigarettes, and unresolved anger issues.

4022200.title: Destiny Is Dice
4022200.short_description: A dungeon of chaos determined by a few dice rolls. The only one you can rely on here is Grin, the witch who rules the all of this place. She’ll gladly rig the dice for you. Use this to create options that never existed before and build the strongest team! Until, one day, you no longer need her help.

4022310.title: Wheelie Bad
4022310.short_description: Grab the wheels solo or sync up in co-op. Race a high-speed wheelchair through deadly tracks, dodge brutal hazards, and restart on every hit. Push your reflexes, beat the timer, and claim 3 stars on every stage.

4022420.title: Hellborn: No Survivors
4022420.short_description: Hellborn: No Survivors is a cute, unique survivors-like/bullet heaven where you descend into hell and slay hordes of undead, demonic creatures. Balance risk versus reward, master the flames of hell, collect powerful relics and evolve to unlock your potential and take on endless waves of the wicked.

4022580.title: Hero's Unison
4022580.short_description: Hero’s Unison is a 2D pixel action RPG where you are summoned as a hero to a mysterious new world. Form a 3-hero party, link souls with your allies, and unleash unique powers to stand against the darkness threatening all realms.

4022820.title: Before the Silence Claims: In Absentia
4022820.short_description: "The truth is not found in what you see… but in what you tune into." Survive a deceased scientist's memories in a strange 1930s German town. Manipulate frequencies to reveal what is hidden, face unsettling entities, and keep an impossible promise in a tactile, HUD-less psychological survival horror.

4022970.title: Infinity Rising
4022970.short_description: Infinity Rising is an open‑world sandbox set between Cornucopias—the Nation in the Sky—and Earth Below. Players traverse both worlds to explore, gather, craft, build bases and land plots, trade in a player‑driven economy, and respond to rift‑related events and Terra through PvE.

4023590.title: Neon Dreams
4023590.short_description: Live the life of an aspiring arms dealer in a Cyberpunk city. Complete thrilling bullet-hell combat simulations with your trusty battle mech, while managing your high-stakes business. Drink coffee, buy weapons, collect stickers, and overcome difficult battle modifiers.

4024450.title: From Ruins – A Detective Adventure
4024450.short_description: A new-gen detective adventure combining deduction gameplay with a gripping story full of twists and turns. Gather clues, establish connections, and solve a series of increasingly challenging cases. Will you uncover the feud that began at the end of the world?

4024550.title: Temple Siege TD
4024550.short_description: Relaxing 3D fantasy tower defense game with an RPG/MOBA vibe: Hero-towers, distinct roles, unique abilities, powerful combos and rising challenge.

4024750.title: INNOCENTS - The Lost Echoes
4024750.short_description: An open-world detective action-adventure. Switch between a fox's investigation and a wolf's combat to solve gruesome cases in a dystopian animal city and uncover a dark conspiracy by venturing deeper into a surreal psychological mind maze.

4024950.title: Space Arcade
4024950.short_description: A 3D arcade space shooter where you defend your base against endless waves of enemy ships. Earn credits, buy upgrades and perks between waves and fight Boss Waves a every few waves. Play alone, in split screen with up to 4 players on one PC, or online with friends.

4025380.title: They Come in Fives
4025380.short_description: You are the Reaper on Lucifer's payroll. Hand over souls, keep the bodies. Build an army of empty vessels on Earth, then risk them all in brutal permadeath runs through Hell. Overthrow the Boss. Claim the Throne.

4025640.title: Shadows Across The Sun
4025640.short_description: You are one of the last to fight back — a scavenger, a soldier, a changeling — surviving run after run across the wreckage orbiting the dying star. Each attempt takes you closer to the truth buried at its core.

4025850.title: Botlands
4025850.short_description: Connect code blocks together to build bots to compete against other players in various simulated mini-games.

4026160.title: CONTRAXIS
4026160.short_description: Contraxis is a fast-paced 2.5D arcade action game where you trace, capture, and command escaped prisoners in the prison city of Axis. Master quick reflexes, summon assists, and survive escalating bosses to chase the highest score.

4026370.title: Last Watchtower
4026370.short_description: A short tower defense game where you gather resources and survive waves of monsters. Spend your resources on a variety of upgrades to incrementally grow stronger. Experiment with different builds and discover powerful synergies.

4027620.title: Lufia I & II The Sinistrals Saga
4027620.short_description: Lufia and its sequel, Lufia II, return! In a love letter to JRPG fans, these two dramatic tales of love and loss, which moved countless players to tears, are back!

4027700.title: OVERTYPE
4027700.short_description: Overtype is a roguelike typing action game set in a neon-drenched post-apocalypse. Type to fight, dodge, and survive against waves of cyborgs and corrupted machines. Every keystroke is your weapon master speed and precision to uncover Zyra’s legacy and type out humanity’s last hope.

4028630.title: Hadal
4028630.short_description: Guide a Nereid Freight submarine crew through Nadir’s hostile under-ice oceans. Deliver essential cargo, salvage wrecks, repair failing stations, hunt dangerous lifeforms, and survive in the crushing darkness where every dive carries risk — and nothing stays quiet for long.

4028760.title: Cosmo Cargo
4028760.short_description: Cosmo Cargo is an inventory autobattler roguelike PvE game in which you fight to maintain chaos in the galaxy. Collect and combine items in your ship to gain powerful effects and defeat the Administrators.

4029090.title: Rizz Dungeon: Skeleton Key to My Heart
4029090.short_description: Fighting is hard, right? Let your party do it for you! Romance Monster Girls and traverse the Dungeon! Hopefully they'll all get along... right?

4030230.title: 伴我同行 Walk alongside me
4030230.short_description: "Walk Alongside Me" is a tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Command a dynamic duo, using seamless rotation and card synergy to build a unique combat system on your quest to rescue your family and save the world. Choose your heroes and begin your journey!

4030270.title: White Crow Castle: Loop
4030270.short_description: A fantasy mystery otome RPG with time loop mechanics. Explore a cursed castle, collect clues, solve puzzles, make critical choices, and experience branching storylines, emotional bonds, and life-or-death survival in an inescapable cycle.

4030350.title: BloodSpiller
4030350.short_description: Brutally blast through Dracula's minions and rescue your girl in this retro action platformer. Upgrade, discover, and destroy with retro flair and modern attitude.

4030360.title: Undertaker
4030360.short_description: Hunt eldritch horrors in the cursed lands of Transylvania. Stalk your prey with blades and bullets, craft your ideal loadout, and conduct unnatural rituals in this gothic shooter.

4030920.title: Gardoon
4030920.short_description: The blackjack roguelite of the Persian Book of Kings. Beat the Deev at 21 to win the right to rule on a hero's prayer, then grant it or deny it. Five chapters of Rostam and Sohrab, four starting decks, and a demon that plays to win.

4030970.title: Sweatpants Savior: Worlds Beyond
4030970.short_description: Shipwrecked in Antarctica, survivors cross the frozen glaciers and step beyond an ice wall into the boundless Great Thousand Worlds. A sandbox RPG centered on exploration and experimentation, featuring deeper systems, a vastly expanded world, and long-term progression shaped by player choice.

4031300.title: WORLD WAR V: LAST CALL
4031300.short_description: Lighthearted comic war action! Battle across voxel and pixel worlds to stop the V Empire’s ambition. Break terrain, uncover items, and face unique bosses. Behind the cute visuals lies a truly challenging game waiting for you!

4031700.title: Amazon Warrior
4031700.short_description: A Puzzle with Bossfights! Join Tayana and save the Amazon exploring amazing Scenarios, Enemies and Bosses! An Evil is haunting the heart of the Amazon! Among breathtaking landscapes, forge powerful alliances and unleash divine powers to survive deadly trials and shape the fate of the forest.

4031860.title: Tic Card Toe
4031860.short_description: A Turn Based Strategy Roguelike with Deckbuilding elements that transforms Tic-Tac-Toe into a High-Stakes Combat Tournament!

4032050.title: RTG
4032050.short_description: RTG is narrative sci-fi puzzle/platformer about a guy with no memories stranded inside strange world, where initially nothing makes sense. Solve gradually challenging puzzles and, piece by piece, unravel mystery behind what you see and experience.

4032320.title: All AI Must Die (Read Only Memories ii)
4032320.short_description: All AI Must Die (Read Only Memories II) follows Turing in 2066 as they confront a world that fears or seeks to control them. Explore Neo SF, shape relationships, and face urgent questions about AI, identity, and the future we are racing toward.

4033640.title: Delivery Survivors
4033640.short_description: Delivery Survivors is a survivor-like action roguelite game. Gather powerful relics and weapons, level up your character, create unique builds and slaughter your way through endless minions and bosses in the dungeon.

4033660.title: Mr Bear Goes to Washington
4033660.short_description: A satirical hand-drawn 2D action platformer where a grizzly bear runs, jumps, and mauls his way through enemies in solo or local co-op. Blending fast-paced combat and platforming with a nostalgic, poster-inspired art style, every level feels handcrafted and full of character.

4033840.title: Vicky The Fox
4033840.short_description: Where did the lost days go? Join Vicky on a magical and relaxing journey! Befriend nature spirits to learn new abilities, discover sweet fun facts about animals, and collect magical grapes to restore harmony in the forest. 🦊🍄

4033990.title: Mimix
4033990.short_description: Create equipment through synthesis and break out to face incoming heroes in this strategic roguelike auto-battler. With limited actions, choose and combine materials to build the optimal loadout. Battles are fully automatic, making preparation the key to victory.

4034130.title: COUNTERSUN
4034130.short_description: A classic real-time strategy game set in 1953, the year a second sun rose. Build a base, mine ore, chop wood, drill for oil and command armies on land, sea and air against the Umbral. Two campaigns, ranked online, skirmish, LAN and a map editor.

4034160.title: ナカノ人格移植研究所
4034160.short_description: "The Nakano Laboratory" is a loop-based mystery 2D adventure game. Within each loop of 15 minutes, you take over researchers' bodies to gather clues around the ship, then present your evidence at the meeting.
developers: 麺屋すぱいす 東京支店
publishers: 麺屋すぱいす 東京支店

4034220.title: Chaos Orbit
4034220.short_description: Fight through a machine-controlled orbital station in this fast-paced action roguelite. Master precision mouse-aim combat, unlock powerful mutations, and battle deadly robotic enemies as you push deeper into the chaos.

4034350.title: Loss Prevention
4034350.short_description: Loss Prevention is a social deduction game where you can shoplift your local grocery store with up to five friends. Experience the joy of petty crime as a shoplifter, or keep your eyes peeled for suspicious activity as the shopkeeper. Can you grab all the items on the shopping list?

4034580.title: Stunt Paradise 2
4034580.short_description: Stunt Paradise 2 - more speed, more explosions, more madness! Jump over ramps, dodge lasers, buzzsaws, and rockets while performing insane stunts. With new traps, improved graphics, and pure arcade chaos - get ready for the ultimate stunt challenge!

4034790.title: Little Devil
4034790.short_description: Little Devil is a top-down horror-comedy roguelike. Combine primary and secondary weapons, fuel a soul-powered ability, and stack Boons as you go. Survive permadeath, beat three random Deadly Sins, and face Lucifer at the end of every run.

4035760.title: 斗虎INDOMITABLE  SPIRIT
4035760.short_description: The player will play the role of an anti-Japanese soldier. In the icy and snowy forest wilderness, relying on secret camps, villages and deep mountains, they will carry out a series of dangerous tasks and ultimately expose the conspiracy of the Kwantung Army.
developers: 哈尔滨智云科技开发有限公司
publishers: 哈尔滨智云科技开发有限公司

4036440.title: Metamorph Clicker
4036440.short_description: An evolution clicker where you guide a larva from simple forms to incredible creatures. Click, collect resources, unlock upgrades and progress through stages. At the end of each stage, a spectacular metamorphosis awaits - a complete transformation into a new species!

4036920.title: Everbrew
4036920.short_description: Farm, cook, and design your very own woodland café in Everbrew, a cozy pixel-art management game. Harvest ingredients, craft delicious meals, and welcome woodland creatures as they gather to relax, eat, and feel at home.

4037100.title: Tower of Creation
4037100.short_description: Immortality became a curse, so humans chose to return their souls to the Creator. You are the last one left. As you take the same Path as your lost love, you discover that paradise is a lie and that the real mystery has only just begun.

4037370.title: Laica
4037370.short_description: Live with Laica, a mysterious girl alone aboard a drifting space station, and explore the nightmare spreading beneath your quiet days together. A first-person sci-fi adventure that fuses survival horror with a slow-burn relationship. Is what waits ahead love, or despair?

4037840.title: BunnyOps
4037840.short_description: BunnyOps is a tactical PvP shooter where bunnies are the apex herbivore, carrots are scarce, and everything can be destroyed.

4038300.title: Lost In Your Eyes
4038300.short_description: Lost In Your Eyes is a 2 Player co-op Puzzle Adventure game where you and your friend face the challenging puzzles to escape uniquely designed levels together. Communication is a key element for every puzzle to be solved but do you trust your friend or your EYES?

4038890.title: Total Destruction
4038890.short_description: A 2D side-view action game focused on dynamic destruction and awesome explosions, featuring tanks, helicopters, jets, bombers, ships, APCs, IFVs, artillery and more. May contain nuclear weapons.

4039300.title: GUNGRAVE G.O.R.E: BLOOD HEAT
4039300.short_description: Full Rebuild with Unreal Engine 5, GUNGRAVE G.O.R.E BLOOD HEAT delivers stunning visuals and an evolved action system. Experience the explosive fusion of stylish Bullet Ballet and Gunkata in an immersive, adrenaline-pumping action spectacle!

4039450.title: Girl of the Ruins
4039450.short_description: “Girl of the Ruins” is a horror-mystery adventure game set in the future. One day, a girl who looks exactly like you suddenly appears. As you follow this suspicious girl, you will eventually uncover the truth of the world.

4039480.title: 恋语彼方
4039480.short_description: 这是一款青春恋爱百合视觉小说，讲述温曦瑶与顾晨曦于大学校园重逢之时，终于将暗藏多年的心意诉诸彼此。然而，一场意外让两人分别。可距离不曾磨灭眷恋的火种，跨越过记忆与厄运的障碍。最终，她们选择紧握彼此的手，以坚定的温柔共赴命运，写就一段关于勇气与深情的动人恋章。

4040060.title: Model Kit Studio
4040060.short_description: A rich and relaxing model-building simulator. Enjoy the meditative flow, meet fellow builders, and unwind to a soothing soundtrack as you build, pose, paint, and display your collection.

4040130.title: Ghosts With Hats
4040130.short_description: Ghosts With Hats is a fast-paced top-down arcade racing game where ghosts compete on dynamic tracks. Collect relics, upgrade your unique character, and dash to victory!

4040160.title: Burrowlings
4040160.short_description: Grow four tiny hard-hatted burrowlings into a swarm of over a hundred and dig to the planet's core before the oil lamp burns out. A short incremental game: spend the gold in a web of upgrades, dig again, deeper. Solo, or online in co-op and versus, where a block of ice freezes a rival's shaft.

4040340.title: IIT Quest
4040340.short_description: Is it okay to kill 6 billion people to avenge the deaths of 2 billion? In this epic sci-fi visual novel, make tough choices to solve "impossible" problems, unlock branching paths and achieve multiple endings.

4040480.title: 桂冠之人 Laureate
4040480.short_description: “世间仅此一件的视觉小说，一件没什么用，却又独一无二的艺术品。”

4040750.title: Paradoxical
4040750.short_description: Portals are physical objects. In this mind-bending puzzle game, portals can be carried, repositioned, and used to create impossible connections through space. Uncover the fate of a desert world that sought salvation through portal technology.

4041260.title: Feed The Lone Bastion
4041260.short_description: An Incremental-Ish game about evolving The Bastion.

4041410.title: Noir Tycoon
4041410.short_description: Build your criminal empire in the turbulent 1960s, manage rackets, outsmart rival gangs, and rise from the streets to the top of the underworld.

4041580.title: Scraps Of The Machine
4041580.short_description: FPS Mech Action! Pilot a mass of steel through a single player campaign set in a desolate landscape. Target enemy armor or weapons to wear them down piece by piece, find upgrades to improve your mech or change its loadout, and survive in a world of rust and decay. Discover, Destroy, Scavenge.

4041780.title: Dungeon Buster
4041780.short_description: Build the dungeon. Send in your hero. Extract the loot. Grow stronger. Dungeon Buster is an incremental dungeon-building autobattler RPG built around permanent progression and deeper expeditions.

4043810.title: Syncblade
4043810.short_description: A rhythm game where you can play any song thanks to our advanced music analysis system, or create and share custom levels with players around the world. Play as Akemi, a unique samurai girl, and slash through waves of Zombeats to the beat of the music you love.

4044690.title: Farming Mushroom
4044690.short_description: "Let's run a mushroom farm!" The story of novice farmers growing mushrooms begins.

4044990.title: DEG
4044990.short_description: A non-linear pure puzzle game where you solve various puzzles using logical reasoning. Explore unknown puzzles in the game world.

4045600.title: L'Agence - The Hearts of Paris
4045600.short_description: Paris, 1888. In debt after taking over her grandmother's marriage agency, Marie has 7 days to find a wife for her creditor's nephew. But everyone in this case is lying! In this Ace Attorney-style detective visual novel, unmask the client and the suitors, and let love triumph!

4045720.title: Squadron 42
4045720.short_description: Enlist in the UEE Navy in a cinematic, single-player space adventure. Pilot combat ships, fight on foot, and explore capital ships, space stations, and frontier outposts. Live and work alongside your crew as you battle on the front lines of a galactic war.

4045810.title: City God Alice：城隍愛麗絲
4045810.short_description: Cursed with only a year left to live, serving her in this City God temple is the only way you can stay alive long enough to uncover the truth behind the curse.

4046540.title: 白日梦Daydream
4046540.short_description: "Daydream" is a light puzzle game that is based on the connection between real life and dreams. The inspirations gained by the player in the dream give them strength, which makes them more powerful in reality.

4047640.title: Demon World: Raya's Way of Life
4047640.short_description: In this turn-based RPG, you play as the mercenary Raya, completing missions with cunning, force, or diplomacy. Benevolent choices may come at a hidden cost, while ruthless ones could end up saving humanity.

4048230.title: SATSUBATSU SUCCUBUS
4048230.short_description: YOU HAVE BEEN CURSED BY A SUCCUBUS. KILL THE ANGELS. FOR ECSTASY.

4048250.title: Jiří Kára Simulátor
4048250.short_description: Jiří Kára Simulátor is a retro FPS inspired by the 90s Czech legend. Explore various districts of post-communist Prague in a fast boomer shooter. Fight your way through pubs, dirty streets and defeat bosses. No common weapons, only street scrap, crowbar and gloomy wild atmosphere.

4048270.title: Out of Body
4048270.short_description: Out of Body is a block-pushing puzzle where your own death is the solution. Turn into a ghost, possess the dead, and use their bodies as tools to free trapped spirits from their own regrets to save your sick child after making a deal with a hooded stranger in over 100 hand-crafted levels.

4048480.title: Last Ride
4048480.short_description: YOU are launched at full speed into the arena, determined to crush your opponents at the wheel of your racing car. But even when your car gives up the ghost, the fight isn't over. You continue the battle on foot until there is only ONE SURVIVOR left!

4049200.title: Moon Stop
4049200.short_description: In a silent, isolated lunar base, a lonely astronaut embarks on a moving journey to recover her daughter’s final memory. Through cold corridors and fragments of the past, a profound story unfolds about love, loss, and the human need for connection.

4049230.title: 颠倒世界 World Inverted
4049230.short_description: The sky lies beneath our feet.Above stretches a vast plane. From it hang forests of inverted buildings, linked by narrow corridors and pipes. They stand in silence, like upside-down obelisks pointing toward the eye of the sun.This game reveals an upside-down world through words and unique visuals.

4049820.title: Rest Here
4049820.short_description: Your world above, the ever changing Shadows below: Terraform your world, mine resources, craft gear, fight monsters, make alliances, rescue who you can, extract what you carry. Make it back and your cozy world thrives. Die? and the Shadows keep it all.

4049990.title: Logistics Simulator: America
4049990.short_description: Drive across the United States as a professional trucker. Deliver cargo on highways and backroads, manage your fleet, develop your warehouses, and run a realistic logistics business. Plan routes, manage fuel and time, and take on the real challenges of life behind the wheel.

4050070.title: Infinite Bloom
4050070.short_description: Embody beings from vast cosmos to tiny plankton, and even your mind in Infinite Bloom! Use your hands to flap or swim. Power, identity, and scale become fluid. Faced with the vastness of the world, human is only a drop in the ocean, part of a continuum of life far greater than us.

4050110.title: Custom Hero vs Epic Boss
4050110.short_description: A dark fantasy 2D platformer with RPG elements. Lead expeditions, level up your entourage, and loot rare gear from monsters. Master challenging platforming levels, defeat epic bosses, and uncover the secrets of the ancient Pact.

4050260.title: King's Haven
4050260.short_description: A combo-driven roguelike, where every Citizen is a card in your deck. Draft a Knight, Vampire, Rat King, Chef or over 100 other unique Citizens to chain together powerful synergies. Construct landmarks, survive seasonal threats and defend your Haven in this quirky roguelike deckbuilder.

4050290.title: Rise of Sorcery
4050290.short_description: A narrative card-based RPG where every choice shapes your destiny. Master magic by assembling occult whispers, but beware: each spell permeates your body. Manage your magical impregnation or risk the Darkism. Balance your power before magic consumes you.

4050580.title: Toxoplasma
4050580.short_description: You are trapped on an abandoned space station, developing a bio-weapon that makes the infected hallucinate demonic entities. Spot any anomalous signs of infection before they kill you, complete your research, and unmask the conspiracy that brought you here.

4050710.title: Loot And Defend
4050710.short_description: A short, relaxing incremental game about slaughtering millions of attacking zombies. Take a load off, the end of the world doesn't have to be stressful.

4051320.title: Cap 'n Barr's Adventure
4051320.short_description: Cap 'n Barr's Adventure is a retro 2D platform action game packed with gameplay—cute capybaras, chip-tune music, and challenging levels, with solo or local two-player co-op. If you love platformers, humor, and hidden stages—give it a try!

4051470.title: BrokenLore: ASCEND
4051470.short_description: BrokenLore: ASCEND is a first-person psychological horror with climbing and stealth mechanics. Follow Ren and Yui, two rooftop climbers facing a cursed tower and the terrifying Rokurokubi. The higher they climb, the closer they get to madness and to the truth about themselves.

4051500.title: Gensou Bullet Battle
4051500.short_description: This is a top-down shooter designed primarily for multiplayer. Players control a variety of unique characters and battle across stages filled with intense bullet patterns. (This game is an unofficial fan game based on the Touhou Project.)

4052010.title: Third Wind
4052010.short_description: In this turn-based roguelite where magic is commonplace, YOU get to be the lucky coach of a brand-new team of Magefencers! Your story choices will determine what your captain of choice evolves into—so choose wisely. Draft teammates, help them grow, watch them bond, and try to become Champions!

4052030.title: Heart of Vinterium
4052030.short_description: There is an artifact capable of granting any wish, but only the strongest are destined to find it. In Heart of Vinterium, you must explore grim and shifting worlds where every step could be your last. Fight, collect magical cards, and solve mysteries.

4052120.title: EpiDexa Racing
4052120.short_description: EpiDexa Racing is an arcade racing game focused on time trials and online multiplayer. Play with keyboard or controller, climb the leaderboards, and prove your skills against friends or players from around the world.

4052280.title: Forest of Fear - Into the Woods
4052280.short_description: A first-person horror journey through a haunted forest, created by a solo developer. Explore a single large map, uncover hidden story fragments, and survive unpredictable scares in this atmospheric debut made with Unreal Engine 5.

4052750.title: You are fired
4052750.short_description: A fast and chaotic roguelike deckbuilder set in the absurd Hell’s Office. Build a powerful deck, collect twisted artifacts, and outplay your demonic coworkers as you claw your way up the corporate ladder. Face bizarre encounters, slay vicious foes, and crush your boss to earn your freedom.

4052840.title: AINUR
4052840.short_description: AINUR is an open-world survival and building game set in a fictional fantasy wasteland. Centered on the core themes of "survival and reconstruction," it utilizes an in-game "deep construction system" to alter the state of the game world, unlock storylines, and combat natural calamities.

4052850.title: Night Fantasy 夜色幻想
4052850.short_description: Night Fantasy is a turn-based strategy RPG about building a team of three adventurers. Enter the Demon Tower, shape your party with classes, skills, talents, and relics, and forge your own strategy through randomized runs to defeat the Demon King and restore the light.

4052920.title: Fragments of Chaos
4052920.short_description: Want to explore dungeons, master spells, hunt monsters, or spend the afternoon fishing? Go for it. Want to paralyze another player, steal their loot, and disappear before their friends arrive? That works too.

4053550.title: The Hilarious Three Kingdoms 2
4053550.short_description: This is a traditional turn-based strategy game set in the era of the Three Kingdoms.Control different feudal lords, step onto the historical battlefield, experience the funny plot, strategize and unite the world!

4054200.title: Deliverance Protocol: Ironrot
4054200.short_description: Atmospheric first-person retro horror. You are a courier — a disposable tool of the System. Sort, deliver, collect archives. Obey… or uncover what lies inside.

4054750.title: Tidewake
4054750.short_description: Tidewake is an arcade naval roguelite for one to four captains. Sail, fight and loot your way up a shelf of bottled sea battles, bolt on cannons, stack relics that bend every shot, and beat the lackey at the top to win your soul back from Davy Jones.

4054790.title: Beatrix
4054790.short_description: Beatrix is a dark roguelite card battler set in Dante's Hell. Place tarot cards on a grid and surround enemy cards to flip them to your side. Between battles, you build the board by placing effects on its cells that fire whenever a card lands on them.

4054850.title: Forgotten - Whispers of the Past
4054850.short_description: Something in this abandoned boarding school refuses to rest. Use your flashlight to survive what lurks in its hallways and solve the puzzles that reveal its dark past. Will you find the truth, or will you be the one forgotten tonight?

4054990.title: Crystal Realms
4054990.short_description: Crystal Realms is a MMO game where you can gather resources and make your own worlds! You can fight enemies, complete quests, craft items, build worlds, make friends and much more.

4055030.title: Red Moon Cafe
4055030.short_description: Red Moon Cafe is a story-driven barista sim set in a rough Russian neighborhood. Survive on your paycheck, manage the protagonist's well-being, and save for the essentials. The authentic city and lifelike NPCs are so detailed that the atmosphere and daily grind feel almost like real life.

4056000.title: Cleaning Raccrew
4056000.short_description: Bonk your friends and knock them away to become the proud owner of the coveted Golden Broom in Cleaning Raccrew! Cleaning Raccrew is a multiplayer game, both online and local, inspired in games like sumo, where you must knock your opponents out of an area to win, using wacky powerups!

4056170.title: Filled Up
4056170.short_description: Filled Up is a first-person survival horror/comedy hybrid featuring LGBT characters and themes. After a horrific accident, you awaken in the town of Hunksville, alone. An ancient and corrupt evil has taken over the town - can you save not only your friends, but the town of Hunksville itself?

4056670.title: Havenreach: Last Refuge
4056670.short_description: Fight for your people’s survival in this turn-based strategy game as you compete against other refugees for land. Expand tile by tile, defend your borders, and sustain your people through gathering or force. A streamlined 4X experience designed to finish in one sitting.

4056990.title: Rust Born
4056990.short_description: Rust Born is a neo noir top-down shooter about survival, loss of self, and a city devoured by corporations. You are Detective Gabriel, trapped in a twisted dystopian city where every shot could be your last, and every decision changes the world. Atmosphere, plot, survival.

4057470.title: Mayfly
4057470.short_description: Mayfly is a first-person psychological horror game set aboard a narrowboat in Northern England. You wake alone to find your husband is missing as you weave through a shifting, unstable reality. Search your confined surroundings to unravel the mystery in this focused narrative horror game.

4059040.title: Snake Fusion
4059040.short_description: Snake meets roguelike. Eat everything in your path, fuse matching pieces into stronger forms, choose powerful upgrades, and build an absurdly powerful snake as you fight to survive increasingly dangerous waves.

4059090.title: VITA: Observa.Momento.Adservo.
4059090.short_description: VITA is a third-person exploration game centered on observation, discovery, and the relationship between mother nature and human nature. You play as VITA-UNIT-05, an autonomous Ecological Observation Unit that awakens on an unfamiliar Earth.

4059620.title: PixelHeroScramble Plus
4059620.short_description: Intercept the surging waves of pixels with a variety of units! Experience the ultimate fixed-route tower defense! Summon a wide variety of units to defend and conquer the battlefield. Where and when you deploy, upgrade or replace your units is up to you. Discover synergies and hone your strategy.

4059710.title: MineEngineer
4059710.short_description: Build physics-driven ships and automated factories block by block in a 2D space survival sandbox. Mine planets and asteroids, program machines, explore a hostile universe and survive solo or with friends.

4060200.title: Ghost Node
4060200.short_description: Play as a freelance hacker breaking into high-security facilities to steal corporate secrets in this stealth game. Use your drone to scout ahead, hack and rewire systems to slip past security, grab the data and get out unseen.

4060580.title: Moove
4060580.short_description: Saddle up with your friends and drive a herd of cows across a wild frontier. Cowboys, lassos, tornadoes, wolves and a lot of shouting. Lose as few cows as you can, or die trying and come back as one.

4060700.title: Desktopper!
4060700.short_description: A multiplayer game that lives right on your taskbar. In Desktopper! you can customize your character, collect items from blind boxes, chat, and hang out with friends all while multitasking. Jump into a lobby and make new friends!

4060820.title: Shrouded Suns
4060820.short_description: In the midst of a seemingly hopeless war among the stars, take control of highly customizable spacefighters to experience classic space combat action throughout a story-driven campaign.

4060990.title: The Bold Bogey
4060990.short_description: The Bold Bogey is a 3D golf adventure that combines open exploration with satisfying platforming. Explore a vast world filled with dungeons to dive into, bosses to fight, and new ways to upgrade your ball in a golf game unlike any other. Do you have what it takes to become the Boldest Bogey?

4061170.title: SlashZero
