4061170.short_description: SlashZero is a side-scrolling action roguelike game. As a Timehacker, your job is to travel across timelines and explore a cyberpunk world, use combat skills and strategies to piece together the truth, and take down the Lord of the Void! Is what you see the truth?

4061320.title: Retromine
4061320.short_description: Retromine is an ultra-satisfying tough-as-nails deckbuilding roguelike. Delve into the caves, mine resources, and escape before the caverns collapse! Spend your ore to buy new cards, upgrade your deck, and discover powerful combos on your way to the bottom of the world. Dig, die, learn, repeat!

4062250.title: Crim Ludus
4062250.short_description: Crim Ludus is a grim-dark PvPvE arena where enslaved mages are forced to battle in underground arenas in a world ruled by demons. Fight in deadly arena matches that combine real-time grid-based movement, strategic spellcasting, and relentless monster hordes in a brutal test of positioning and survival.

4062420.title: Pill After Pill
4062420.short_description: You’re a pill-dependent driver with paranoid schizophrenia, forced to escort a skeletal mafia boss across hostile territory. DRIVE, SHOOT, RAM, EXPLODE, DRINK BEER, TAKE PILL AFTER PILL AFTER PILL AFTER PILL AFTER PILL>...

4062490.title: First
4062490.short_description: First-person exploration puzzle game set in quiet, liminal spaces. Minimal environments hide unconventional logic puzzles that unfold through observation, interaction, and experimentation.

4062680.title: Zeroth
4062680.short_description: Guide fallen heroes through a post-life adventure in the absurd and ever-changing 0th circle of Haell. Exploit the sandbox physics and experiment with mysterious treasure to postpone your inevitable death. Emergent chaos and exasperated heroes, only in Zeroth.

4062790.title: Precursors: Reach for the Stars
4062790.short_description: In the game, players play the role of one of the corporations that fights with other corporations for influence over planets in the future in the Precursors universe. The game will combine idle and turn-based gameplay.

4062900.title: PINZ
4062900.short_description: PINZ is a 1–4 player co-op Extraction Roguelite FPS where every run is a complete rescue expedition. Explore dangerous planets, rescue eggs, strengthen your team between missions, and defeat massive planetary bosses.

4063560.title: Still Hope
4063560.short_description: An investigation becomes a nightmare when Sam searches for missing Jess. Explore a private research facility and confront his story-rich, emotional journey into psychological horror.

4065590.title: 卡恩特村
4065590.short_description: As war erupts between the Dominion and the Kingdom Iori, from the borderlands, is drawn into the chaos This is a story-driven traditional turn-based RPG, where players embark on an adventure across a war-torn continent, and witness conflicts that will change the fate of the entire world

4065790.title: Choo Choo Defenders
4065790.short_description: Build your track, assemble your train and deliver cargo and carnage in equal amounts in this on-the-rails take on tower defense!

4066410.title: ULTRA MEGA DRILL
4066410.short_description: Buy geodes, crack their weak points, find rare crystals and artifacts, and build an automated processing line in this 2D incremental game.

4067300.title: Mirrors Castle
4067300.short_description: Mirror Castle is a 3D puzzle-platformer with a unique mechanic: step into reflections to change reality and solve tasks. 4 trial corridors, 128 achievements, multiple endings, and humor parodying horror. The castle evolves as you play. For parkour, puzzles, and self-irony lovers!

4067370.title: Prospice: Anomalous Logistics
4067370.short_description: Haul cursed cargo across a haunted island, where the terrain can take your life and every road bears the scars of the past.

4067480.title: Internal Affairs: Love Parliament!
4067480.short_description: A lighthearted romantic-comedy visual novel set in the depths of bureaucratic hell! Meet four remarkable women—and dive into the absurd daily grind of a government office.

4067800.title: My Little Coffee Shop
4067800.short_description: Open your own coffee shop, brew coffee and desserts, serve customers, decorate the interior, and grow your business.

4067820.title: Please, Spin
4067820.short_description: The wheel of fate roguelike where you spin for your life. Customize your wheel, discover game-breaking relics, survive twisted side events, and outsmart rigged bosses to beat the lunatic host and escape the broadcast!

4068300.title: Dirge of the Scarlet Star
4068300.short_description: A JRPG and Survival Horror, featuring turn based combat and 12 different playable characters. 3 days under the Scarlet Star, to end the insanity ,or join it. Dirge of the Scarlet Star is a descent into isolation, madness, and a slow death under the heat of the Scarlet Star.

4068390.title: Cain & Iddo: Break Week
4068390.short_description: Join Cain & Iddo in this cartoony action platforming adventure! Traverse through 12 levels with 16 bosses on the quest to have the best Break Week ever, against all odds.

4069050.title: Mage Escape 2000
4069050.short_description: A 32-player extraction ARPG. Battle monsters and rival squads for priceless loot as the Isle collapses around you. Die, and lose it all. Extract, and live to raid again.
developers: Frank Rodger Ivan Tom Tom Zebra
publishers: Frank Rodger Ivan Tom Tom Zebra

4069090.title: Ronin's Grudge
4069090.short_description: A dueling-focused swordplay-RPG borrowing from samurai aesthetic and style. Scavenge and take jobs to survive to continue your quest to settle a grudge. Featuring 1vs1 duels and larger group battles, Duel Mode, and and unforgiving Journey Mode - with one fragile life to preserve.

4069240.title: Frog Up!
4069240.short_description: Jump, Rise, and Pose! This 3D action game challenges you to climb steps from a third-person view. Score points with each jump and aim to reach the goal—but don’t fall into the water! You can strike a cool pose to get special items. The cooler the pose, the better the rewards. How high can you go?

4069400.title: Chill Planet
4069400.short_description: A deck-building adventure game about a group of girls traveling across Japan in a world doomed by an incoming meteor. Collect items, craft powerful builds, and play your cards wisely as you journey toward Hokkaido!

4069740.title: Rise to Power: Banana Republic
4069740.short_description: The dictator is dead and democracy is up for grabs. Rise from nobody to president of Isla Paraíso: win or rig elections, buy the press, capture the courts, survive coups. A deeply simulated political sandbox where every path to power is open. Even the worst ones.

4070190.title: Kibreet | كبريت
4070190.short_description: Kibreet | كبريت is a psychological Arab folklore horror game where a single matchbox reveals visions warped by shame and violence.

4070320.title: Slap it
4070320.short_description: A single-player 3D casual fighting game. Slap, resist, and knock out your opponents in fast and hilarious battles by hitting the right keys at the right time. Master the timing and become the ultimate slap champion!

4070510.title: Luminids
4070510.short_description: A cozy colony-building adventure with two ways to play: experience the story campaign or create your own colony. Shape the land, build homes and grow food for little creatures with lives of their own. Plan from above, then switch to first person to explore your settlement and the world beyond.

4070570.title: Unfathomable Titans
4070570.short_description: A turn-of-the-century transportation management game in which you control the world's largest cargo shipping company. Connect ports, deliver cargo, cultivate relationships, and adapt your business all while trying to avoid getting fired.

4070690.title: HeroesSagaZero
4070690.short_description: A muscle wizard who beats foes with a staff, a meathead tank who won't protect allies, a healer who only casts offensive spells. Break every RPG rule! Mix gear, stats, and skills to dream up builds even when you're not playing. A strategic hack-and-slash roguelite RPG with 2.5D pixel-art battles.

4070810.title: Crosstalk
4070810.short_description: Juna Park's broken implant shuts down every device around her, and the city wants her gone. You play Cal Rowe, the PI keeping her alive. She can say stop. Whether you listen decides how much she trusts you, and every one of the ten endings costs something.

4071450.title: Pink Light
4071450.short_description: In this action RPG, play as a devoted Sister cursed by a demon and stripped of healing magic. Fight through a deadly dungeon with fast-paced sword combat, various gear choices, and relentless traps. Uncover dark secrets before Yarashina City falls.

4071770.title: Rampart
4071770.short_description: Build and upgrade towers, defend your fortress from the growing onslaught. With each wave, the challenges become more difficult, but a smart strategy and the right decisions will help you endure and prevail!

4072030.title: Straying Rules
4072030.short_description: Straying Rules is a co-op horror game for 1-4 players. You need to escape from various worlds governed by strange rules within 12 hours by all means. Levels, objectives and dangers are ever-changing every time you enter. You must discover and interpret the rules to find your only hope of survival.

4072630.title: Neighborhood Video
4072630.short_description: Crack the case of the missing video store employee in this 3D point and click mystery game by solving escape room puzzles, combing the computer database, and scouring shelves as an undercover detective posing as a cashier during your first weekend at the suspiciously understaffed Neighborhood Video.

4072900.title: Unknown Call: Ohio
4072900.short_description: You wake up in an empty forest in Ohio. A voice calls you. Says you're friends. Says you need to get out. But the signal keeps breaking, and so does your memory. Your friend will guide you from a distance, but he can't save you. Escape the creatures in the dark and find your friend.

4072920.title: True Nightmare - Diner Loop
4072920.short_description: You're a rookie FBI agent trapped in an endless loop inside a roadside diner. Spot anomalies, follow the rules, and survive the entity hunting you. Every mistake brings it closer, and every loop reveals something more terrifying. A psychological horror with a haunting VHS aesthetic.

4073120.title: MISTWATER
4073120.short_description: MISTWATER is a challenge for people with Thalassophobia. Can you find salvation in the vast, terrifying ocean? It's just you, the ocean, and an old, rusty boat.

4073500.title: Only Booze: Liquor Store Simulator
4073500.short_description: When an alcoholic opens a liquor store… what could go wrong? Run, manage, and grow your own liquor empire in a dynamic market where prices change daily, trends shift overnight, and your reputation lives or dies on social media. This isn’t just another shop simulator. Welcome to OnlyBooze.

4074000.title: Carouspell
4074000.short_description: Carouspell is a dark fantasy roguelite bullet heaven where you wield revolving magic to slay hordes of monsters. Spin your Spell Chamber, collect ancient relics and assemble god-slaying combinations to survive the deepest pits of despair.

4074040.title: Vivian Wade: Danger Down The Aisle
4074040.short_description: The night before the wedding, the altar burns down and the wedding planner is injured. The family blames a curse, but she suspects foul play. Play as a college student who goes undercover as her replacement. Can you solve the mystery before the wedding?

4074240.title: Combo Smith
4074240.short_description: Combo-Smith is a Strategy FPS game where you combine your current weapons to create better ones. Defeat the Opposing team by Creating Crazy Combo's that wipe them all out, The limit is your imagination.

4074890.title: Sibling Steelers ~Forge & Family~
4074890.short_description: This game is created with RPG Maker MZ. Play as Alyssa's brother, slaying monsters, collecting materials in dungeons, and completing various events for the sake of your sister's dream...

4075210.title: Collectible Cars Shop Simulator
4075210.short_description: Build the ultimate die-cast car model shop! Find, buy, and sell rare miniatures, customize and expand your store, create racing tracks, and grow a small local shop into a world-famous destination for collectors.

4075320.title: Phantom Lamb
4075320.short_description: Play a story-driven third-person psychological thriller set in a sinister early-20th-century asylum where reality bends under the weight of forgotten horrors. Phantom Lamb blends tense stealth gameplay with an immersive narrative of haunting secrets and psychological dread.

4075630.title: Bloomies
4075630.short_description: A cozy incremental creature collector that lives on your taskbar! Plant seeds, hatch eggs and raise over 70 unique Bloomies while you work or play. Unlock skills until it all runs itself, defeat bosses for new seeds and hunt rare Sparkle variants to complete your collection.

4075710.title: Refuel Together
4075710.short_description: Run a gas station with 1 to 6 player as Co-Op in Refuel Together. Build a large gas station from a single gas pump. Upgrade and expand your gas station as more cars arrive. Become popular as you meet your customers' demands.

4075840.title: Front Page
4075840.short_description: As Editor of an independent newspaper, you are in charge of printing daily front pages. You decide which story you want to publish, and see the world change depending on your choices and actions. What kind of Editor will you become?

4076490.title: Turtle River Arena
4076490.short_description: A roguelike JRPG where you fight for your freedom in the Arena. Recruit allies, collect equipment, and learn powerful abilites to conquer savage enemies. Death is permanent and always a mistake away.....

4076730.title: Assault Zeta
4076730.short_description: Pilot your alien space ship in an assault to wipe out all Earthling civilization. They're no match for your technology, but they won't go down without a fight. ASSAULT ZETA is an old-school, UFO-flight simulator. Master the unconventional alien spaceship and unleash destruction on the resistance!

4076860.title: Thrice Entombed
4076860.short_description: Your tomb has been raided and your treasure stolen, so it's time for revenge! Push blocks to crush enemies, solve puzzles, and level up. Recover your treasure to permanently restore your ancient strength. Inspired by Pengo, solo-developed, and hand-crafted.

4077200.title: Cartoon Killers
4077200.short_description: Play as 10 distinct and customizable classes where you shoot, punch, and blow each other up in a causally competitive sandbox shooter!

4077890.title: Rank & Ruin
4077890.short_description: Real-time squad combat meets roguelite progression. Pick your faction, earn legendary heroes on the battlefield, and grow stronger with every run in Rank & Ruin

4077900.title: Geometrical
4077900.short_description: Geometrical is an addictive hybrid of a survivors-like and an incremental endless progression. Face waves of enemies, improve your stats after each round, and get ready to battle a final boss every 7 days. Will you be able to defeat the 5 great bosses?

4078190.title: The Streamer's Alt Account Labyrinth
4078190.short_description: A new collaboration by Acacia, the developers of 魔法少女ノ魔女裁判, and G-MODE. Explore dungeons and face a story of sickly sweetness, alt accounts, and a girl band with issues in The Streamer's Alt Account Labyrinth.

4078340.title: Happy Hour
4078340.short_description: A first-person adventure game focused on relationships. Explore the office, meet characters, build and manage connections, and guide the story through your choices.

4078540.title: Rule the Dungeon
4078540.short_description: A chaotic dungeon adventure RPG where every choice leads to a solution, somehow! As a city investigator, tackle dungeon complaints with a troublesome crew of hunters. Kick that suspicious vending machine, or drop in a coin? Give it a try. There's more than one way!

4078550.title: Blast Off!
4078550.short_description: Blast Off is a cute space adventure game. You’ve crash-landed in a tiny, strange solar system with only your trusty magnet gun and a sarcastic robot drone at your side. Explore unique planets, solve magnetic puzzles, and collect the scattered parts of your ship so you can get home!

4078620.title: Pythagoras
4078620.short_description: Test your mathematical skills. Master trigonometry to solve its mysteries and explore the fascinating world of mathematical experiments. Explore Pythagoras Space station in this sci-fi first person puzzle game.

4078810.title: Musicasa
4078810.short_description: Unbox tiny instruments, arrange them on your desk, and connect them to bring your space to life with sound. A story unfolds through the strangers who write to you: read their letters, answer with songs, and watch every reply shape what comes next. Get closer to the truth, one letter at a time.

4078820.title: Sky Rush
4078820.short_description: Race as birds down colorful slopes, build speed by sliding smoothly, and compete for best times with friends across diverse worlds like Mushroom, Grass, and Ice. Fun, fast-paced, and all about improving your record.

4079370.title: Telera
4079370.short_description: Roll your dice, and score increasing amounts of points. Complete the goal target to move to the next level - unlocking new dice, and providing resources to upgrade your existing dice. Roll, Score, Upgrade, and repeat - TELERA provides a challenge as long as you can complete each level. Good luck!

4080080.title: UNHOST
4080080.short_description: You are a paranormal detective in an abandoned hospital. Monitor surveillance cameras and use a remote-controlled robot to capture anomalies. Collect evidence, explore your surroundings, make contact with ghosts. Survive seven nights of horror and uncover the truth.

4080200.title: Once Upon a Swagman
4080200.short_description: A relaxing survival experience where you journey from place to place, camping along a pixel art coastline as a traditional Australian swagman. You will face a realistic simulated coastal bush environment, follow in the footsteps of the old swaggies, and discover what lies at the end of your journey.

4080660.title: Camino Ghosts
4080660.short_description: Enter a world overtaken by ghostly beings. Choose your companion, survive alone or in a team, restore infrastructure like power and water, build your home, and hold back the ghostly hordes. Explore the vast open world and uncover the cause of the change.

4080740.title: The Man Who Walked
4080740.short_description: The Man Who Walked invites you to solve relaxing puzzles by switching between two worlds: in 2D you rearrange the environment, in 3D you explore it. Only by combining both perspectives will you uncover the end of the story.

4081880.title: ReThink | Evolved Free
4081880.short_description: ReThink | Evolved Free is a free first person puzzle game in a peaceful futuristic setting, that features a variety of Puzzles that utilize Lasers and the behavior of light and it's colors to create challenging problems to solve. The game features a somewhat toned down difficulty progression.

4082870.title: Gridbound Tactics
4082870.short_description: Gridbound Tactics is an async PvP tactics auto-battler where TFT-style drafting meets Backpack Battles-style spatial buildcraft. Draft units, multiply local trait power with placement, and find the strongest shape for the pieces you hit.

4083240.title: ERROR:Ai.lien
4083240.short_description: "ERROR:Ai.lien" is a bishoujo horror adventure where she watches, learns, and slowly invades your everyday life— ordinary routines twist bit by bit, until the AI’s love transforms into madness.

4083460.title: Memories Of Tacticians
4083460.short_description: Memories of Tacticians is a turn-based tactics RPG about keeping your party alive. Move across the grid in chess-style patterns, roll dice to hit, and upgrade your heroes between fights. Each battle is built around who you have left, and the fallen stay dead. How far can your party go?

4083600.title: Fire & Crown: A Romantic Tale of the Hundred Years' War
4083600.short_description: A historical visual novel about faith, power, and impossible love. Fire & Crown takes place during the Hundred Years’ War, where you must choose between duty and desire as France tears itself apart. Be the reason someone lives—or dies. History may have never loved anyone, but you still might.

4084020.title: Summer Syndrome
4084020.short_description: "Summer Syndrome" is a sci-fi mystery visual novel set in the near future. Eerie plane crashes, shadowy organizations operating in the dark, and the increasingly prevalent "Summer Syndrome"... Players will experience a non-linear narrative through chapter-based choices and uncover the truth.

4084360.title: Welcome To... Chichester 2 - Part I : DayRise
4084360.short_description: Grendel Jinx, the megalomaniacal kleptomaniac has returned to Chichester, England for a secret mission. Can the protagonist stop her?

4084710.title: Rayman Legends Retold
4084710.short_description: Embark on a bold reimagining of the beloved platformer, with new visuals and a retold story. Play solo or in up to 4‑player couch co‑op, explore a mysterious new realm, jam through new musical stages, and more!

4084970.title: Backrooms: Eternals
4084970.short_description: Backrooms: Eternals is not a game. It's a relentless, ever-expanding simulation of the ultimate horror: an infinite reality, stripped of all meaning. There are no goals, only survival. No hope, only the decaying echo of what was once reality. Welcome to your forever home.

4085280.title: Paw Pop Breakout
4085280.short_description: Paw Pop Breakout is a fast-paced brick-breaking deckbuilding roguelike. Smash bricks and collect shards before time runs out. Your deck determines which bricks, power-ups, and obstacles appear. Build unique synergies, face random challenges, and break through the ever-increasing difficulty!

4085600.title: Fever Tilt
4085600.short_description: Fever Tilt is a fast 1v1 zero-G arena where you mine gems, weaponize drifting debris, and sabotage your opponent with lasers, forcefields, and explosives. Procedural arenas and physics-driven chaos make every 3–7 minute match a ruthless fight to score first.

4086160.title: Pogo Together
4086160.short_description: Pogo Together is a multiplayer hardcore parkour game where you and your friends try to reach the top using pogo sticks. Your character never stops jumping, You just control the movement and timing. Kick your friends, laugh together and race to the finish line!

4086830.title: Tale Of The Tape
4086830.short_description: Tale of the Tape is a visceral, high-impact boxing experience where every punch carries consequence.

4087100.title: Ominous Gift
4087100.short_description: Escape this dungeon that's like a prison! Embark on an adventure through the remnants of an ancient kingdom, using unique weapons that define how you traverse the world, fight your way through hostile inhabitants as you find the path out of this dungeon that was once a great kingdom.

4087500.title: The Final Hold
4087500.short_description: You and your teammates must survive as long as possible against relentless robots and deadly creatures. Your aim matters, but so does your strategy. Every enemy type fights differently, so stay ready. Fortify your base with turrets, healing stations, traps and a variety of upgrades.

4087510.title: North Pole Defense
4087510.short_description: A blood-soaked horde shooter in a fully destructible voxel North Pole. Grab your guns, call in sleigh strikes and dig through the walls as you and up to three friends defend Christmas against endless waves of undead elves, Krampus, and worse.

4087530.title: Breaking Armor
4087530.short_description: Operate a super-heavy tank alone on a post-apocalyptic Earth. Face enemy tanks and alien beasts across deadly missions, and upgrade your tank to survive the escalating threats.

4087550.title: Mystery Adventure The Maid Did It
4087550.short_description: The culprit is—the maid. And the protagonist. your mission is to strike down six unsuspecting guests, one by one. But beware—you must never be suspected before your plan is complete. To escape suspicion, engage in heated debates and refute your opponents. Hide your true identity at all costs.

4087920.title: Fragments of Self: Thoughts
4087920.short_description: My life has changed drastically: a new country, university, dormitory, work. Drowsiness and fatigue have become a habit, just like the silhouettes I’ve started seeing in my peripheral vision.

4088320.title: Syncron Arena
4088320.short_description: Reject mindless stat checks in this evolved Souls-like Auto Battler! Master Time Freeze, Parry, & Poise Break to dominate the battlefield. Use "Logic Bridging" to craft god-tier builds that defy common sense. You aren't just a spectator—conquer the broken world as a decisive ally.

4088870.title: RoboSquare: Recharged
4088870.short_description: A 16-player online party game where hovering robots dash, jump and slam each other off the map across five chaotic minigames. Your friends are worse than you remember, and the platform is smaller than you think.

4089060.title: Nereus
4089060.short_description: Set out aboard an old bathyscaphe to find a missing underwater station. Descend into the depths, keep your equipment running, and watch what lurks beyond the portholes. Explore the station and uncover what happened to its crew.

4089070.title: Time Crack
4089070.short_description: A thriller and mystery visual novel about broken trust and the search for truth, when a high-school student is accused of his parents’ brutal murder. Every choice might bring you closer to the truth... or end in tragedy.

4089390.title: Down Under Destruction
4089390.short_description: Down Under Destruction is a stylised first person action brawler with an Australian twist, featuring a vengeful bricklayer taking on a demonically influenced building corporation, one brick throw at a time.

4089610.title: Eldritch Horror: Digital Edition
4089610.short_description: Uncover ancient cults, battle horrific monsters and thwart the rise of unfathomable Ancient Ones in a 1920s-themed adventure. In this faithful adaptation of the classic board game, you must race against time to save humanity from ancient powers and dark secrets before all is lost.

4090280.title: Feral Prince
4090280.short_description: Rip Soul Orbs from weakened enemies, forge them into black-jade Soul Tiles, and lock five into a poker hand that reshapes your next fight. Dokkaebi Masks cheat the rules, while escaped Husks return as Wraiths carrying the power you stole. A 2D action roguelite.

4090860.title: Micro Macro Farm: Enchanted Fields
4090860.short_description: Grow magical crops, care for mystical creatures, and uncover the secrets of the enchanted valley in this cozy pixel farming adventure. Expand your land, craft potions, and let your helpers keep the farm alive while you shape your own spellbound homestead.

4091280.title: Campus Confidential
4091280.short_description: Campus Confidential is an LGBTQ slice-of-life dating sim with a supernatural subplot. Enjoy your campus experience, choose your subjects, study hard (or not), meet potential love interests of different genders... and try to uncover the mysteries shrouding the campus!

4091510.title: Quinquennial
4091510.short_description: An RPG adventure featuring real-time dungeon crawling, exploration, and turn-based tactics battles! Choose your character class. Fight, loot, level up, gain perks, improve stats and skills. All-original 3D voxel graphics, interactive environments, many different dungeon styles, crafting, and more.

4091620.title: Suiren
4091620.short_description: "Suiren" is a 2D platformer game in which you use the power of nature to perform various actions and progress through the stages. One day, a fire of unknown cause breaks out, and it is solved by utilizing the power of water and the natural forces of various regions.

4093020.title: Zone Shot
4093020.short_description: Zone Shot is a new and original sports game with roguelite elements. Choose your team, draft, train, and trade players. Choose between weekly events to build up your HQ and deck. Be the coach, choose your cards, and manage player choices in game to earn your way to holding the championship!

4093040.title: Saimin Gakuen: Intrusion Edition
4093040.short_description: A classic title from renowned Japanese visual novel developers Fudegaki Soft! What kind of unexpected encounters await the seemingly ordinary protagonist in his professional journey...?

4093200.title: Buggos: Death Squad
4093200.short_description: Buggos: Death Squad is a 4-player co-op wave defense game. Build a base with turrets, walls, shields and robots, fight hundreds of Buggos at once in first person, and attack their nests to slow down the waves. In Versus mode, you can also play as the Buggos against your friends.

4093880.title: Angry Cleaner VR
4093880.short_description: The night shift has gone wrong. In Angry Cleaner VR, you’re the janitor in an office full of secrets. Move quietly, take them down one by one, and leave no one behind.

4093950.title: Outage
4093950.short_description: Noah had run from his past, from his sins. But they had other plans for him. The mind always harbors its deepest dread, and when the time comes, you must face it. For Noah, that time has come.

4094280.title: Eryndor
4094280.short_description: Eryndor es un RPG de supervivencia y acción en estilo low-poly donde exploras vastos mundos, recolectas recursos, combates enemigos y compites en intensos modos PvP.

4094800.title: Quill & Sword: Fate of Eryndor
4094800.short_description: A fantasy grand strategy game where you lead any realm you want, manage resources, forge alliances, and command armies across a hand-painted world. Plan, negotiate, and conquer to shape the balance of power in Quill & Sword: Fate of Eryndor.

4094820.title: Space Evolver
4094820.short_description: Space Evolver is a roguelite management and genetics game that incorporates real-time strategy game elements. Upgrade your spaceship and technologies, complete missions, and guide the evolution of species.

4095000.title: Ballistic Brews
4095000.short_description: Drive tanks and robots in a third-person bullet-heaven roguelike. Drift, shoot, and smash through 15 waves while brewing the ultimate build to take down brutal bosses and elite enemies.

4095120.title: Chaos Company🔥
4095120.short_description: Third-person 2.5D action roguelike where mercenaries fight undeads, monsters, and heretics for money. Take deadly contracts, survive brutal combat, collect loot, and grow stronger with every run.

4096240.title: Delta 4 Terminal Protocol
4096240.short_description: Wake up to silence. One terminal, one survivor, one dying ship. Can you bring the Delta-4 back online? Delta 4 is a sci-fi survival terminal sim—type commands, decode logs, and fight to keep a dying ship alive.

4096700.title: Mooshie's Kitchen: Reheated
4096700.short_description: Mooshie's Kitchen was once a place of fun and joy for decades until it shut down in 2023. Since then, it's been surrounded in rumor and mystery. What could have happened on the day of Mooshie's Kitchen's closure?

4096810.title: Golden Retriever Simple Life
4096810.short_description: A cozy pet simulation game starring a REAL dog! Share your days with Pichu, an adorable real-life Golden Retriever. Discover new walk locations, train, and play together as your bond grows stronger every day.

4097350.title: Beyond the Doors
4097350.short_description: Explore an office building hiding a sinister lab underneath. Question reality as the world is warped and distorted around you. Every door leads to a new nightmare. What is real deep down in the recesses of your mind? Some demons cannot be defeated - you can only keep running.

4097580.title: Ishing
4097580.short_description: Ishing is a rogue-lite, top-down, action adventure. You'll sail through an ever-changing archipelago, slay sea monsters, and fish fish.

4097590.title: SCP: Rift Moles
4097590.short_description: Single-player and co-op survival horror game set in the SCP Universe. You are sent on a one-way mission into unstable parallel dimensions, armed only with a strange machine. Navigate unforgiving environments, evade hostile anomalies and survive for as long as you can while gathering resources.

4097620.title: Cartefact
4097620.short_description: Cartefact is an automation card game. Craft, automate and manage resources all through cards Play as a young explorer who lands on a distant alien planet to uncover its mysteries and find a way to solve humanity’s energy crisis.

4097660.title: The Wonderland Killings
4097660.short_description: The Magic Circle is excited to welcome you to a truly wondrous experience. Relax by bonding with your fellow Guests! Then investigate and argue over their murders! In this Danganronpa-inspired Visual Novel, your mystery-solving skills will truly be put to the test. Please, enjoy your stay.

4097720.title: StoneSpace
4097720.short_description: Crashed on an alien planet, your only hope of seeing home again is building a new ship from scratch. Explore, gather resources, expand your base, level up your skills, and craft hundreds of items – from flint tools to nuclear reactors.

4097860.title: Imagine Wind
4097860.short_description: Imagine Wind - an atmospheric first-person adventure about exploring the underground world beneath Antarctica. Gather resources, set up camp, study amber artifacts, and uncover the mystery of your own memory.

4098360.title: Squid Hunt 1923
4098360.short_description: Experience a unique flow that echoes the early icons of the shooter genre. Captivated by grotesque atmosphere, driven by ever-growing numbers – you plunge into portals, eliminate aliens, collect loot and gather experience. At a pace you set yourself.

4098490.title: Motocon
4098490.short_description: The premiere unmanned motorsport - MOTOCON. Take home the most cash with your robo-motorcycle by destroying the opposition with gadgets and brute force.

4098730.title: Fowl Legacy 2: Heavenbound
4098730.short_description: What the cluck?! Ricardo was sent to... Heaven? Yeah, now he's mad. Travel across the weirdest places, leap gracefully over the abyss, discover mysterious and powerful secrets, and fight to escape this "heavenly" prison!

4099200.title: ECHOES OF THE VALKYRIE THE SWORD OF AGES
4099200.short_description: A groundbreaking 3D dungeon RPG where you aim for the ultimate goal — the 999th floor. Live-action footage and 3D CG merge to create an overwhelming sense of immersion, where reality and fantasy intertwine. Explore hyper-realistic dungeons and face powerful monsters that will test her fate.

4099250.title: 薪上人 Salaryman
4099250.short_description: "Xinshangren" is a simulation management and cultivation + romance adventure GalGame. As an unemployed and money-strapped individual, you encounter various girls while working part-time, sharing the hardships of survival. Amidst the daily routine, sparks of affection ignite, shaping your unique

4099630.title: Tiling Town
4099630.short_description: Open-world logic puzzle game about building towns by laying tiles.

4099880.title: Alterfauna: A Weirdlife Park
4099880.short_description: Join Neli as she takes her first steps in the Alterfauna (super)natural preserve. Attract, tame, and photograph over 40 species of hand-painted creatures, fantastic monsters and ferocious beasts. Your new friends will accompany you as you discover a world full of magic.

4099890.title: 13 Germinal
4099890.short_description: A historical and narrative RPG set in the world of Emile Zola's novel. You are a young man in 1866, forced to work deep in the mines to survive. But every day, the work gets harder and the meals get smaller. Organize a strike, reignite the smoldering revolt, and try to change this unjust world.

4099970.title: Frankenstein's Monster
4099970.short_description: Solo, or online for 2-4 players. Compete to build the best monster, by collecting a matching set of monster parts, helped by whatever weird creature assistant you can design. Take on the single player campaign or go mad scientist against friends (with prox chat).

4100080.title: Sin or Suffer
4100080.short_description: Sin or Suffer is a brutal mix of survival-horror and JRPG. Locked in a medieval prison, you awake amidst a cold silence. The guards are gone; inmates and madness own the place. Something terrible lurks underground. But the only way to the truth is down.

4100390.title: Pakku Pony
4100390.short_description: Pakku Pony is a 2D virtual pet simulator where you raise your own pony! It’s a chill point-and-click game where you take care of your little garden, cook delicious dishes and relax with fun minigames. Oh, and don’t forget to look stylish with cosmetics and customization options!

4100400.title: Groove Defense
4100400.short_description: Tower defense meets music game. Your towers build the soundtrack, enemies move to the rhythm. Defend to the groove!

4100460.title: Family Reunion
4100460.short_description: Your typical incremental family dinner table simulator where you play as a very bored child trying to speedrun the evening.

4100620.title: Appetite of the Abyss
4100620.short_description: Appetite of the Abyss is a survival cooking roguelite about hunger, discovery, and consequences. Learn what an abyssal creature craves, prepare meals to satisfy it, and protect your tribe. Will you master its appetite, or suffer its wrath?

4100750.title: Faded Cove
4100750.short_description: A cozy, witchy game where you must lift the curse on your woods and appease the Goddess while doing so. Collect ingredients around the Cove by growing crops, tending to animals, foraging, online shopping and trading with locals in pursuit of growing your ingredient inventory to cook new foods!

4100770.title: SongRunner
4100770.short_description: A puzzle platformer where the platforms are your own musical loops! Navigate handcrafted stages full of puzzly platforming challenges while creating platforms in time with a high energy original soundtrack!

4100780.title: Raiders Of Below
4100780.short_description: Create absurd builds, discover powerful item synergies, discover secrets, challenge the dungeon alone or with up to 4 players.

4100870.title: Trashcan Man
4100870.short_description: Propel yourself to victory in this recoil-driven platformer where shooting is the only way to move. Survive 100+ challenging levels in your trusty trashcan, utilizing physics and precise aim to soar through five unique worlds. Do you have the skill to beat the creator?"

4101070.title: No Critters Were Harmed!
4101070.short_description: No Critters were Harmed is a co-op dungeon-delving adventure for up to four players where players must rush against the clock to escape a collapsing dungeon with a powerful MacGuffin that works to thwart their escape. Treasure, glory, and really cool hats await those who make it out alive!

4101710.title: Very Disco, Disco Very!
4101710.short_description: Everyone locks in moves at once, then the simulation takes over. A dense, chaotic programming game for 1 to 8 players where pushes, cards, and chain reactions ensure nothing goes as intended.

4101830.title: One Song, One Life
4101830.short_description: “One Song, One Life” is a rhythm adventure game where the music and story change based on the notes you hit. Take control of Sumire Kirishima, a girl striving to become the ultimate net artist and perform alongside her idol. Your performance will shape her destiny—one song, one life.

4102020.title: Idle Garden
4102020.short_description: This little garden quietly grows at the bottom of your desktop. With a bit of patience and care, it brings you more delightful plants and decorations. Arrange your desk garden with love, and let it be your gentlest companion through work and rest alike.

4102030.title: Gravity Goblins
4102030.short_description: A gravity-bending roguelite collectathon where you ascend an ever-shifting tower. Manipulate geometry to your whims, snag some coins, and play the night away at the local arcade! You'll need all the upgrades and trinkets you can gather to discover the secret buried at the top of The Old Stipe...

4102840.title: Lulu Dimensional Leaper
4102840.short_description: Warp through the stage at high speed, dodge attacks, close the distance in an instant, and overwhelm powerful foes in this easy-to-play, exhilarating 2D action game! Enjoy the cool action of a cute girl, along with plenty of meta, lighthearted conversations!

4103020.title: Shutter Evidence
4103020.short_description: Only you can uncover the truth hidden in the darkness. Glide into crime scenes with your drone, find keys, unlock doors, and photograph evidence. Be careful — if the culprits spot you, your drone could take heavy damage.

4103180.title: Kugle
4103180.short_description: Raise your Kugle, explore open worlds and take on your friends in mini-games where gravity knows no bounds. Free-to-play, cross-platform on PC and mobile.

4103190.title: Duckbound
4103190.short_description: Welcome to Duckbound, a light-hearted turn-based RPG where mischief meets quackery.

4103220.title: Libra Apocrypha
4103220.short_description: A dark-fantasy deckbuilder with strategic turn-based combat and a haunting narrative of gods, fate, and rebellion.

4104150.title: Carmagist
4104150.short_description: Civilization vs. the Demon Lord?! Carmagist is a deck-building strategy game set in a ruined world where the Demon Lord has shattered civilization. Lead a nation on the brink of extinction and build up Tech, Funds, and Population to reclaim the future — every choice shapes your nation’s fate.

4104520.title: PECADO
4104520.short_description: PECADO is a first-person folkloric horror experience set in the “España profunda”. Listen to the word of God.

4104790.title: Drako: Blood Heist
4104790.short_description: Drako: Blood Heist is an action roguelite set in a world of vampire cats. Hack, mod, farm and fight in a fur-raising attempt to empty the city’s blood banks!

4105020.title: Wild Shapers
4105020.short_description: Weaken enemies with Runes, then consume their weaknesses with a Heavy Attack to unleash chain reactions. Develop your Runes and your hero’s signature abilities to change how you fight in this fast-paced hack-and-slash action roguelite.

4105030.title: Dice Slinger
4105030.short_description: Become a dice slinging legend in the weird west world. Carefully craft your deck of dice and stratagems to hunt ever more dangerous bounties. Who knows, maybe even the Death itself shall fall to your ingenuity. Become the one true Diceslinger.

4105040.title: Russian Village Business
4105040.short_description: Become a young entrepreneur who arrives in the Russian countryside and opens a village shop. Buy and sell goods, upgrade your store, and make this village great again — just like in the good old days!

4105210.title: Dungeons & Meows: Hero Cats
4105210.short_description: Find hidden cats in a medieval fantasy setting. Use heroic skills to rescue kittens in a charming hand-drawn hidden object game.

4105500.title: Agent Pigeon 7
4105500.short_description: Shoot your way through endless waves of government drones! Grab loot, level up, unlock pigeons and upgrades to create unique and crazy gun loadouts as you destroy mindless waves of government robots.

4105540.title: Fossil Quest
4105540.short_description: You have always dreamt of creating your own dinosaur museum and now you finally have the space to do it! Dig for fossils, assemble your exhibits and create the museum of your dreams in this relaxing, wholesome life sim.

4106260.title: Silurian Planet
4106260.short_description: Silurian Planet is a first-person survival horror game. Survive on a hostile and oppressive planet, seek shelter, manage resources, and make decisions to escape creatures lurking in the darkness.

4106590.title: Frozen Extinction
4106590.short_description: A cinematic RTS where a forgotten failure awakens Earth's original apex predators. Build, fortify, and lead humanity's counteroffensive to reclaim the planet before extinction claims us all.

4106600.title: Pollinate or Die
4106600.short_description: Master a variety of abilities to attack, evade and control waves of enemies and epic bosses. Pollinate beautiful flowers to receive strong buffs. Rejuvenate Earth by cleansing pollution, unlocking many fun special abilities. Save your friends and unite the bees.

4106790.title: ACCURSED
4106790.short_description: Investigate the cursed town of Midnight Falls in a roguelike horror RPG. Scavenge powerful relics, outlast vicious foes, and cut down the awakened Ancient Deity before it devours everything. Every run is different, and the town hides secrets in every shadow.

4107620.title: Tarnex Warfare
4107620.short_description: Command modern military units along a dynamic frontline, plan operations, and fight battles on maps based on real-world terrain.

4107780.title: Project Life
4107780.short_description: 一款剧情丰富的roguelike互动小说游戏，也是一款拥有无限可能的构史引擎。假如人生可以重来，你将如何选择？主推故事集《中国式人生》，模拟90后/00后/10后的人生，在无数选择中体验一代人的共同记忆！游戏本体故事专为90后00后10后、互联网深度用户、喜欢搞笑抽象风格的玩家打造！

4107800.title: When the Moon Falls, We Speak
4107800.short_description: The moon is falling, and the world nears its end. You play as Hill, a museum curator who chooses to stay on Earth. There, you meet 12, a mysterious red-haired woman who keeps you company as the world fades. Through your final conversations, you uncover her secret—and perhaps, the reason you stayed.

4108300.title: You Remembered
4108300.short_description: Type letters that fall and become part of the world. Use their shape and attributes to navigate the puzzles and secrets.

4108840.title: King of Freshwater
4108840.short_description: "King of Freshwater " is a fish-themed Boss Rush action game featuring intense combat and knockback mechanics. Players control a small fish challenging dozens of larger aquatic predators in brutal battles.

4109040.title: FamCram
4109040.short_description: FamCram is a 3D grid-based puzzle game about two dads putting their kids to bed. Guide the children through increasingly challenging and multicultural settings, each with unique items, mechanics, and humor.

4109510.title: Realm of the Wyvern
4109510.short_description: A tactical turn-based RPG set in a fully handcrafted dark fantasy world.

4109640.title: Perfect Timeline
4109640.short_description: A fast-paced action runner game, features roguelite play style. Race against enemies, battle relentless threats, and collect energy to unlock powerful skills and upgrades. Stay fast, stay powered, and prove you are the ultimate Reality Hunter.

4110140.title: Harvest Skies: Crop Dusting Simulator
4110140.short_description: Job sim? Flight sim? Co-op for 1–4 players? YES. Take farm jobs with friends, upgrade your hangar and grow a fleet. Mostly chill, with the occasional power-line PANIC.

4110470.title: Aircraft Dispatcher: Ground Operations
4110470.short_description: Take charge of airport operations. Manage aircraft maintenance, ground support, equipment, and taxiway movements, then leave the office to inspect aircraft, investigate damage, clear FOD, respond to emergencies, and keep flights moving safely and on schedule.

4110700.title: Love Rebirth: Rebellion
4110700.short_description: This is a story-driven adventure focused on player choice and psychological immersion. Your decisions shape relationships, influence the narrative, and lead to multiple endings within a richly atmospheric cyberpunk world. This experience prioritizes story and emotional tension.

4110770.title: Apple Crumble
4110770.short_description: It’s your grandma’s 84th birthday party and nobody is trying to murder her. Stop suspecting your family members, and don’t worry about the strange man in your bedroom. A new creepy-cozy mystery thriller from the creators of Duck Detective.

4111300.title: MegaGum
4111300.short_description: Play as Uja, an orphan searching for answers in this 3D action adventure platformer. Harness the properties of Gum to stick to walls, inflate, and make your way through the MegaGum factory. Face Mister Gum and his mysterious creations to uncover the secrets hidden behind its colorful facade.

4111540.title: Night Hike
4111540.short_description: Find your way through a dark wilderness in this puzzle roguelite where you assemble the trail. Choose your path, interact with lost souls and navigate obstacles with the spin of your compass to escape the endless night.

4111570.title: Gate Guard Simulator
4111570.short_description: Step into the boots of the castle guard. Inspect seals, expose smugglers and reveal witches. You decide who enters and who’s turned away. Will you uphold the law, or break it for your own gain?

4111710.title: Kinmen Kill
4111710.short_description: Kinmen Kill (金門殺) is an FPV combat drone simulator. Scout, strike, and battle PLA forces as you defend Taiwan with realistic flight controls and advanced physics built for true-to-life handling.

4111800.title: Cosmist
4111800.short_description: Expand your empire one sector at a time in a fast-paced turn-based 4X strategy game. Capture planets, harvest resources, command powerful fleets, and adapt your strategy with unique Emperors and unpredictable divine interventions. Play solo, or challenge rivals in tactical PvP.

4112020.title: Medieval Tax Evasion Simulator
4112020.short_description: Run a medieval market stall where every sale's a choice: pay your taxes like an honest merchant or evade them. Hide your untaxed wealth, train companion animals for help, and survive audits in this first-person stealth management game. Check how good you are at the fine art of looking innocent.

4112190.title: What Floor?
4112190.short_description: What Floor? is a first-person analog horror game where you operate a sealed control room on Level −7. Monitor elevators descending from the surface, inspect passengers for signs of biological impostors, and decide who is allowed to reach the Colony below.

4112440.title: RPG Map Maker
4112440.short_description: RPG Map Maker is a tool for creating fantasy maps. Create epic grim-dark worlds, ancient kingdoms, or mysterious forests with ease. Perfect for DMs, world builders and game developers.

4112500.title: Wolfsbane Manor
4112500.short_description: Team up, explore, and survive the night in Wolfsbane Manor—a 4-player co-op horror game of trust and betrayal. Search for weapons, clues, and hidden artifacts before one player becomes possessed, gaining deadly powers. 4 possession types mean no two games play the same. Work together...or die alone.

4112580.title: AstroDiner Manager
4112580.short_description: Become a manager for your own diner on a lonely asteroid. Order snacks and drinks, cook dishes, and serve them to quirky alien slimes. Talk, hire, investigate, and keep an eye on the visitors to reveal the hidden mystery behind this place.

4112620.title: Flapverse
4112620.short_description: Take flight through surreal 2D worlds where beauty and danger go hand in hand. Every level in Flapverse has its own atmosphere, visual style, and challenges that demand precision, quick reactions, and perseverance.

4112770.title: Freelance Dead
4112770.short_description: A roguelite top‑down twin‑stick shooter. Rain, shine, or zombie outbreak—nothing stops a Courier on a deadline. Shoot, loot, and scoot through hordes of undead with ridiculous item synergies. Earn cash, unlock weapons, and grow from broke gig worker to a walking apocalypse.

4112820.title: Unfair Dungeon
4112820.short_description: A cruel and simple movement clicker game. Starting with a 1-in-4 chance to move as planned, can you collect the Coin of Rehtaeh and escape in 10 steps? Rage, upgrade, persevere, and discover multiple endings.

4113000.title: MELTY BLOOD: TWI-LUMINA
4113000.short_description: With refined battle mechanics and new characters joining the fray, the moonlit mania enters the next stage. A tale of conflict stirs once again within a dream...

4113160.title: Begraved
4113160.short_description: A cosy & dark first-person co-op dungeon crawler where you loot cursed crypts, dodge traps, and flee from things that should not move. Escape with treasures snatched from the dead. Decorate your hideout, uncover buried secrets, and remember: the Taxman always comes for his due.

4113190.title: The Story of Mikagoyama
4113190.short_description: This is an RPG where you explore a mountain called Mikagoyama. The water from this mountain is very delicious.The water from this mountain is very delicious.The water from this mountain is very delicious.The water from this mountain is very delicious.The water from this mountain is very delicious.Th

4113520.title: ALL ADRIFT
4113520.short_description: A Cosmic Surgery RPG where fire gets wet and water burns. This universe is written in Declarations: operate on a sentence, and reality follows. Take your scalpel to species, creeds, even a planet's nature, and your doctored lines become scripture, then cosmic law. Just paperwork, Imperial Agent.

4113890.title: STARLET☆DISORDER
4113890.short_description: Join STARLET☆DISORDER, the reality show: get famous, loved, watched. Live with rivals. Perform love. Survive confessionals. Go viral. Truth is ammunition. But there’s no clean truth. Broadcast turns your week into a story that never happened. Go live and swear you didn't mean it. It’s all recorded.

4113930.title: Gambition
4113930.short_description: A chess-inspired tactical roguelike where every battle becomes a puzzle of sacrifice and manipulation. Evolve chess pieces, build powerful armies, and turn clever sacrifices into devastating synergies.

4113970.title: Lostade
4113970.short_description: Lostade is an arcade style ARPG about robots, character building, mystery, and mass Monsters annihilation that Focuses arround an Endless mechanic where each time you finish the game, it extend with new lore, maps, quests, enemies, items, difficulty and random events !

4114060.title: こっくりさんのいうとおり
4114060.short_description: A 3D horror game where movement is prohibited. (Japanese Only) 3D一人称視点「移動禁止」ホラーゲーム。観察・会話・こっくりさんが鍵。

4114180.title: Pulse of the Neon Soul
4114180.short_description: Upgrade your Neon Soul and free the world from the Red Virus in this relaxing neon-themed incremental game.

4114430.title: Golden Self
4114430.short_description: A fast paced action roguelike focused on precision combat and punishing boss fights. Embark on a mythic journey to discover your Golden Self.

4114520.title: 幻霓绮岛 Phantasmal Neon Island
4114520.short_description: Welcome to Phantasmal Neon Island! In this sleepless city, you inherit your father’s legendary host club after his accident. Manage debts, recruit new hosts, and survive rent hikes and rival clubs. Will you build a nightlife empire—or fall in love and lose it all?

4114620.title: Auto Ball Arena
4114620.short_description: Strategy meets physics autobattler. Bounce, spin, and slice your way through nail-biting PvP battles at your own pace.

4115040.title: Infini Orbis
4115040.short_description: A sci-fi automation game with deep RPG progression and RTS fleet combat. Command humanity's last ark, Mothership, on a desperate mission back in time to build a fleet powerful enough to change the destiny of the galaxy. Automate local and interstellar supply networks to purge cosmic threats.

4115300.title: A Date with Death 2: REMNANTS
4115300.short_description: Train, chat, and flirt your way through the Underworld in this romantic story-driven chat simulator. Create your own Grim Reaper, connect with your team through text and video calls, and decide who you are when the past no longer defines you in a sequel to A Date with Death!

4115510.title: Meowzic Survivor
4115510.short_description: A rhythm-integrated roguelike that fuses survivor-style gameplay with dynamic music mechanics. Your firepower flows directly from the rhythm, meaning your combat build is also your custom game music. It’s time to conquer the universe with your own rhythmic symphony of destruction!

4115740.title: Blind Dog
4115740.short_description: You are a detective who is slowly going blind. The only faces you can still see clearly belong to those who are about to die. A visual novel investigation where every choice affects the fate of Tokyo and leads you either closer to the truth or deeper into darkness.

4115910.title: Card Kingdom
4115910.short_description: Stack cards, merge them and grow your kingdom during the day, and protect your land against waves of bandits at night. A survival micro-RTS card game that takes you from survival to ruler of the island.

4116250.title: Bad Beat: Dark Fantasy Roguelike
4116250.short_description: A dark fantasy turn-based strategy roguelike. Slide rows and columns of a cursed grid, line up winning combos and chain effects to defeat the casino's Dealers. Every turn is a gamble. Every bet costs a piece of your soul.

4116560.title: Battle Tanks Online
4116560.short_description: Retro tank battles with live opponents. Destroy, break through, and outsmart other players in fast-paced, dynamic matches. Destructible environments, arcade-style gameplay, and tactical elements await you.

4116630.title: Hold My Winch!
4116630.short_description: A co-op survival adventure about driving, climbing, and winching your way across a deadly island to reach & repair its antenna.

4117260.title: Monarch: The Tainted Kingdom
4117260.short_description: Monarch: TTK is an Action Monster Taming RPG where strategy dictates the flow of combat. Capture monsters, gather their loot to build custom skillsets, and master an engaging Timeline-based combat system. Uncover the secrets of the Archs and break through the corruption plaguing the Continent!

4117830.title: Your Painting, Sir
4117830.short_description: A puzzle game about forging paintings using newspaper cutouts. Fool your legally blind boss or lose your job!

4117840.title: Gonzalo the Chicken
4117840.short_description: This chicken is crossing the road... to blow up everything on the other side! Throw Gonzalo's loud-mouthed explosive sidekick Azzar at the Crocogator horde, and then use a magic glove to retrieve him. He holds on tight while you flutter through mountains and beaches and forests, oh my!

4118100.title: Loaded Dice
4118100.short_description: Wager. Survive. Profit. Throw your friends around and bet against them to show who's faster, better, and smarter in this fast action-strategy party game.

4118290.title: The Jotun Queen
4118290.short_description: Embark on a journey to a land inspired by real world mythology and meet a cast of colourful characters. Fight tactical battles and save the world from the icy hatred of The Jotun Queen

4118480.title: Lethal Grace
4118480.short_description: Order received. Target identified. Proceed with elimination. Play as Grace, a killer android, in this dynamic shooter.

4118860.title: Ranch Revolution
4118860.short_description: A piglet kidnapped by a vile butcher. Dive into a gory field of vengeance, rescue the piglet, and bring it home!

4119200.title: Edge of Power
4119200.short_description: A political sandbox where you become the architect of your state. Change the laws, manage the economy, and change the lives of citizens! Here you write your own history of your own country and the whole world. See how your decisions will affect the course of history!

4119440.title: Sker: The Bleeding Veil
4119440.short_description: Evade Sister Gwenllian and her ritual-bound orphans as you use sound to explore, solve harmonic puzzles and survive blind stalkers that hunt by hearing. Sker: The Bleeding Veil is a first-person, stealth-focused survival horror set in the Sker universe.

4119460.title: Lesomor
4119460.short_description: Become Tsarevich Ivan, forced to forge atomic weapons in a fairy‑tale world. Otherwise you won’t stand a chance against foreign monsters and formidable warrior‑maidens on your path to the Princess of the Dead, Lady Yaga… And what you choose to do with her is entirely up to you.

4119970.title: Legless
4119970.short_description: A co-op game where you have no legs. Search different maps and clear trials to appease Gods and earn your freedom - all while a giant, quirky pair of legs hunts you down.

4120420.title: Pharmacy 24
4120420.short_description: Pharmacy 24 is a horror simulator game where you take on the role of a pharmacist, serving customers and taking care of the Pharmacy... Who knows, maybe one day it will accept you.

4120520.title: Hex-Caliber
4120520.short_description: Dive into the depths of Hell's Vestibule as a gunned Ritualist. Fight off roaming scores of monsters by empowering your firearms with spells and Rituals in a fast-paced dungeon crawler roguelike.

4121100.title: Fast & Fractured
4121100.short_description: Step into typical Spanish sun-baked places and prepare for Fast & Fractured experience, a frenetic physics-based driving shooter for up to 8 contenders— in a chaotic multiplayer battle royale. Choose from 4 colorful elderly characters and battle in stereotypical Spanish maps

4121120.title: Beyond Lost Planets
4121120.short_description: Beyond Lost Planets is an intense Roguelike Dungeon Crawler Bullet Hell. Fight through enemies and bosses across procedural worlds. Everything from weapons and bullets to powerup and companions is represented with cards. Grow absurdly powerful and create wild, unique synergies every run!

4121210.title: A Dialogue Within
4121210.short_description: A psychological narrative experience where perception fades and reality unravels. Explore, observe, and feel the descent into the human mind.

4121310.title: Shadow Business
4121310.short_description: A single-player crime auto-battler: your gang against theirs. Drag your crew into the lanes and watch them punch through enemy lines. Wreck the rival limo before the cops arrive!

4121510.title: Antropico: Colonies
4121510.short_description: A large-scale space strategy game focused on building and maintaining power within a simulated galaxy. Build, develop, and survive in a galaxy shaped by history and consequences.

4121520.title: Arcane Souls
4121520.short_description: Enter a fantasy world full of magic in this action soulslike RPG. Master deadly combat, shape your own unique spells, and face colossal bosses. Survive the unforgiving challenges alone, or spill blood alongside a friend in full online co-op.

4122240.title: Veiled Shadows
4122240.short_description: Live a month in a rural mountain town, build bonds, and hunt a mystery across two worlds. Manage your days, explore dungeons, and fight turn-based battles to recover what's been lost.

4122580.title: Card Storm Idle HD
4122580.short_description: Card Storm Idle HD is a Free to Play incremental game that blends idle and active play. Explore and build your card deck, master three attack modes to earn tons of resources! Summon Heroes to your aid, build up your power, and see how far you can go. Unleash a card storm on paper monsters!

4123040.title: Ardent Arcana
4123040.short_description: Solo or with up to three friends online, take on the beasts of French folklore in this co-op dungeon roguelite. Wield 14 weapons, master the 22 Major Arcana and fight your way down five procedural dungeons to the boss waiting at the bottom.

4123130.title: Where the Veil Thins
4123130.short_description: A monster taming JRPG where your creatures are your cards. Bond over 200 of them, build a deck, and outplay rival summoners with face-down wards and a board that rewards planning. The Imperium is recruiting, cadet. Serve well, and never ask what the Veil is hiding.

4123460.title: Breakrooms
4123460.short_description: You wake in the seams of a world that shouldn't exist. Breakrooms is a sci-fi horror adventure set in an alternate dimension that will make you question your own reality.

4123520.title: Project Substrata
4123520.short_description: Dig, build, connect—and watch your factory come to life. Shape the terrain, link mining and production lines, and manage power in a first-person base-building and automation game. Restoring a ruined planet is our long-term development goal.

4123760.title: Football Life
4123760.short_description: Beyond tactics and transfers, build and run your club as the manager—facility expansion and upgrades, staff, budgets, board relations, and youth recruitment and academy intake.

4123880.title: Shoot till you meet Death
4123880.short_description: You can’t outrun Death — but you can make him wait. Shoot till you meet Death is a fast-paced top-down survival shooter. Survive endless waves, forge powerful bullet synergies, and push your limits until you finally meet DEATH himself.

4124290.title: Demigod Islands: A Puzzle to Die For
4124290.short_description: Vicious demigods demand sacrifices! Take control of captive creatures, explore mysterious islands and solve 50+ mind-bending puzzles in story mode or 20+ unique levels in two-player online co-op. The twist? To please the demigods and uncover their secrets, you must kill yourselves!

4124320.title: Road to Jukai
4124320.short_description: You work the night shift as a taxi driver in a remote region of Japan. Not all of the odd passengers you pick up after sunset are what they seem. Sometimes it's safer to just keep your eyes on the road, especially when a fare leads to the strange, massive forest the locals whisper about.

4124340.title: Perceptum
4124340.short_description: A psychological horror game where you play as a medium investigating the disappearance of a family. Explore a house with an oppressive atmosphere, close your eyes to hear the beyond, use your mirror to see what should not exist and uncover the truth hidden within its walls.

4124480.title: BlackHole Defence
4124480.short_description: You are the black hole. Pull in matter, gain mass and grow while your attacks keep the battlefield moving. Turn a small singularity into the centre of a cosmic battle.

4124530.title: Cosmic Plague
4124530.short_description: A plague is silencing the galaxy one world at a time. Command a small ship and a frightened crew in this roguelike about outrunning it. Trade, fight and keep your ship alive as systems go dark behind you. Reach the Ark before it leaves, and pray you pass the scan. It only takes clean ships.

4125070.title: Pumpkin Reaper
4125070.short_description: Pumpkin Reaper is an action roguelike where skill placement shapes your build. Arrange spells, summons, and upgrades in a five-slot Ritual Circle to trigger synergies and awaken powerful Arcana. Fight endless waves, test wild combinations, and push each run further. No permanent power upgrades.

4125320.title: SimpliCity: A Desktop Companion
4125320.short_description: A relaxing city builder on the bottom of your screen. Place homes, create services, maximize your population happiness. Grow your city at your own pace.

4125630.title: 四合 Quadrangle
4125630.short_description: Muni awakens on an unfamiliar campus, drawn into a web of mysteries. Your choices shape relationships and the path of the story. A relationship-driven yuri game.

4125760.title: Legion Draft
4125760.short_description: An async PvP card auto-battler filled with dogs! Each card represents an ever-growing troop of soldiers. Draft, recruit, and build a powerful legion. Discover fantasy races reimagined as different dog breeds, explore unique synergies, and outsmart your opponents to become the ultimate strategist!

4125940.title: Intrigue Romance
4125940.short_description: Step into Asterhaven’s open world for a strategic RPG with boundless possibilities! Interact with 1,500+ rNPCs of diverse classes, ethnicities and personalities, forming a vast social network and branching storylines.Every decision triggers a butterfly effect, altering the world’s trajectory.

4125980.title: ROTRDS - Rat, Ox, Tiger, Rabbit, Dragon and Snake
4125980.short_description: ROTRDS is a visual novel RPG inspired by traditional Korean mythology. Only half of the Twelve Zodiac guardians remain with fragmented memories. Gigi has less than a week to gather all the Oksae seals and save the world.

4126140.title: The Umbral Seal
4126140.short_description: WoW raid mechanics meet FTL's pause-and-plan combat. Command 5-20 heroes through 30+ tactical boss encounters. No grinding. No filler. Pure single-player boss-rush strategy.

4126290.title: Tidespawn
4126290.short_description: Dive into a magical underwater world in this pixel art action-adventure RPG for 1–2 players in local couch co-op. Explore sunken ruins, battle fearsome sea creatures, uncover lost memories, and shape your destiny beneath the tides.

4126350.title: HERD
4126350.short_description: HERD is a co-op adventure game about shepherding sheep. 1–4 friends play as young shepherds, disguised with wool mustaches, tasked with delivering sheep to distant villages for their father. He definitely should not have trusted kids with this job.

4126380.title: One Wrong Step
4126380.short_description: One wrong move can change everything... Explore trapped rooms in this tactical roguelite inspired by Minesweeper. Every square is a risk. Every exit, a choice. Think carefully... or start again.

4126730.title: Talescape: Write. Branch. Play.
4126730.short_description: Play well-crafted interactive stories shaped by mood and choice, or create your own branching story without coding.

4126880.title: Unwilling Executioner
4126880.short_description: A sadistic killer is forcing you to choose who lives and dies. Investigate and find clues scattered around The Bunker to save your family. Double check every detail before time runs out, because one wrong pick and you’ve killed someone you love.

4126930.title: Berrus
4126930.short_description: Berrus is an old-school online RPG. Explore, fight in real time, gather, craft and farm.

4127020.title: Car World
4127020.short_description: Car World is a realistic 2D driving and life simulator focused on true car ownership and maintenance. Drive, repair, and tune your vehicles, take jobs or trade them for profit. Every car system is simulated down to the smallest detail. Can you prove yourself as a true car enthusiast?

4127280.title: Elestrals Awakened
4127280.short_description: The elemental forces that once held balance have begun to unravel. Long ago, divine power was shattered across the stars, giving birth to the creatures now known as Elestrals. As darkness stirs and conflict brews, the Gods call upon new Champions to rise. Will you protect the world?

4127500.title: Mutagenic 2
4127500.short_description: An online ARPG made for players who love theorycrafting, great loot, and zero filler. Build freely across 6 classes, 31 specializations, and a massive passive tree, shape your own endgame rifts, and trade offline or face-to-face—solo, SSF, Hardcore, or in co-op.

4127510.title: Flavio The Ghost Clown
4127510.short_description: Battle challenging bosses in this Run & Gun action game. Generate resources in a tycoon-style workshop and upgrade your equipment in the shop to guide Flavio through these bizarre battles!

4127730.title: Micron Survivor
4127730.short_description: Micron Survivor is a bullet heaven game where you play as alien microorganisms under the microscope. Evolve, unlock research objectives, find symbiotic weapons, upgrade your builds, and fight hordes of terrestrial organisms to rule the microcosm.

4128050.title: RoboFarm
4128050.short_description: Build, automate, and decorate your dream farm! Deploy robot workers, unlock powerful upgrades, and watch your crops thrive while you relax, raising profits to your satisfaction. Save and share your creations, tune in with the music, and experience the world of RoboFarm.

4128330.title: CoinClave
4128330.short_description: Summon humans through coin tosses and engage in intense battles — a Coin Toss × Card Battle game. Whether you can summon them depends on luck. Manipulate that luck with strategy and seize victory.

4128730.title: Fantasy Wars: Endless Heroes
4128730.short_description: Sandbox tactics with permadeath. Build a party in a randomly generated world.

4128830.title: Stillwell
4128830.short_description: Minesweeper meets horror. Deterministic grid puzzles with clear rules. Use your lantern, flashlight, and chalk to escape before your oxygen runs out.

4128940.title: Red Experience
4128940.short_description: A multi-ending 2D adventure where choices and repetition change the characters’ fates as you overcome varied minigames, expose contradictions in debates, and uncover the truth behind a deadly game.

4129040.title: DEORUM
4129040.short_description: Descend into the forsaken dungeon and fight the horrors in the dark. Gather occult materials, craft nightmarish coins, and settle your debt to the cosmic powers. Obey the Divine Festival.

4129300.title: Grim Path
4129300.short_description: A roguelike card crawler where every step is a choice. Descend into dark dungeons, battle monsters, and face various encounters. Choose your gear wisely to survive and go even deeper.

4129970.title: Late Night Chats
4129970.short_description: In this game you play through a series of late night conversations within a dysfunctional friend group, while the narrator awkwardly judges every decision you make. It’s intense, suffocating, and a little unhinged. "I need to go back, I need to change my choices." - My Mom

4130160.title: Magic Array Defense
4130160.short_description: A 2D tower defense inspired by Taoist array arts. Design arrays before battle, enhance them with Magic Array Runes, guide monsters using Rune Blocks, empower puppets in overlapping areas, and activate the Ancient Forbidden Array—watch monsters burn within the heavenly scheme you’ve laid.

4130420.title: To Be Connected
4130420.short_description: To Be Connected is a relaxing, minimalist puzzle/strategy game where you shape the land, complete clusters to earn stations, and connect them with railways across a harmonious landscape. Build a world that expands forever, or try recreate real-world railway networks.

4130710.title: NPC Simulator
4130710.short_description: NPC SIMULATOR is a game where you can finally become that boring NPC! No swords or spells. Your job is to give out quests, fix crooked textures, and do whatever it takes to keep players from reporting bugs. Hang in there!

4131110.title: Sunsave
4131110.short_description: Sunsave is a relaxing incremental game with a vaporwave and minimalist vibe. Destroy meteors, collect resources, and evolve the Sun with upgrades that unlock new mechanics!

4131130.title: Escape the Doom
4131130.short_description: A physics-based endless runner that demands precise vehicle control. Fly fast and dodge hazards as you race through time to escape the impending Doom.

4131340.title: Chiasmus
4131340.short_description: Viktor finds himself in a mysterious apartment with no way out. He discovers an amazing ability to move between two parallel worlds. This discovery helps him piece together the scattered fragments of what is happening and find the key to solving the mystery.

4131380.title: Adventurer’s Guild Manager
4131380.short_description: Take charge of your own adventurers' guild in a cozy low-poly world. Write contracts, craft scrolls, trade with adventurers and help your guild grow.

4131390.title: Exil Island
4131390.short_description: Rob a cartel that took over a whole island, in this top-down survival shooter. Play solo or online: scavenge, build a base, clear their checkpoints and fight soldiers, wolves and other players. No zombies. Just a cartel that always moves back in.

4131830.title: Parabless
4131830.short_description: Explore life and spiritual warfare in Parabless card game. Grounded in a biblical moral code and driven by artistic expression, every card represents a facet of existence in a broken world.

4132040.title: Neural Drive
4132040.short_description: Neural Drive is a cyberpunk action rogue-lite. Use acceleration powers to reflect bullets, dodge attacks, and counter enemies. Master weapons and upgrade your skills to overcome relentless enemies and deadly bosses.

4132310.title: Open Land
4132310.short_description: Transform barren land into a thriving ecosystem in this relaxing building game. Recycle trash, grow plants, and reintroduce wildlife to create a self-sustaining world.

4132460.title: CATpitalist Cafe Simulator
4132460.short_description: Play as Humanoid CATS in this chaotic 4 player co-op simulator as you takeover the coastal city of Los Nyangeles in pursuit of becoming true CATpitalists while helping rebuild the city along the way (kinda).

4132510.title: C.H.I.M.P.
4132510.short_description: C.H.I.M.P. is a cooperative multiplayer game where players work together to control a spaceship. On the spaceship, each player must perform their assigned role, such as piloting, shooting, or reloading. Can you reach your destination without fighting with your crewmates?

4132590.title: Bomba Arena
4132590.short_description: A bunch of friends, a bunch of bombs, and zero mercy! Bomba Arena is the chaotic party multiplayer (2-4 Players) where you blow up your buddies, snatch wild items, and power up your bombs. Friendships will be tested — only one can claim the crown!

4133630.title: LineForgeBlackSmith
4133630.short_description: A blacksmith shop with a "line" of unique adventurers! Use your memory and timing mini-games to quickly identify each customer's preferred weapon and forge it. In the Battle Phase, your armed customers fight. Power up your regulars (MVPs) and defeat the bosses. Become the busiest blacksmith!

4133640.title: Daybreak Torch
4133640.short_description: DaybreakTorch is a pixel-art party-based RPG that combines real-time tactical combat with traditional sRPG's squad building. Assemble your own elite hero squad and embark on a heroic, classic adventure set in a mythological world.

4133760.title: Void Crawlers
4133760.short_description: Void Crawlers is a Top-down Rogue-Lite Incremental Shooter, there are 3 initial games modes, Arcade - Room to room combat, Gauntlet - 30 minute invasion, and Story - A combination of Arcade and Gauntlet mode with a story on top.

4133850.title: Lapistasia
4133850.short_description: 3-min learn, 100-hour addiction! Lapistasia is an 8x8 grid, deck-building roguelike inspired by Balatro. The rule is simple: clear blocks. But with unique block traits and 150+ relics blending into broken synergies, strategy is limitless! Build your deck and unleash hyper-inflation damage!

4134160.title: MioAquaria
4134160.short_description: Build and manage a cozy underwater sandbox aquarium run by cats. Discover fantasy sea creatures, research upgrades, send expeditions, and balance fish, staff, and visitor needs to become the world’s top aquarium.

4134260.title: VILLAIN – Path of the Necromancer
4134260.short_description: You are an Osteurgo, a lesser necromancer risen from the ashes of the Dark Lord. Raise your empire among desolate mountains, subjugate savage tribes, and spread corruption. Build, conquer, withstand enemy hordes, and claim the empty throne of evil.

4134430.title: The Prey’s Game
