4134430.short_description: "The Prey’s Game" is a dark romantic visual novel where you, a revenge-driven heroine, must survive and manipulate six dangerous, obsessive men. Every choice determines if you end as prey or hunter. Navigate a web of lethal attraction with over 30 possible endings.

4134620.title: IIIIIIlI
4134620.short_description: "Draw. Disguise. Kick the can." An asymmetric versus game of drawing and can-kicking, set on pixel-art stages. "Mimicry" by doodling on yourself and the stage to blend in, plus fast-paced mind games that end in minutes. Enjoy online matches for up to 16 players — casually, with AI bots or friends.

4134790.title: Guildmaster’s Quest
4134790.short_description: A turn-based isekai guild management strategy game. Summoned to another world by a goddess, you found a guild, send adventurers into dungeons and win over or blackmail the courts of seven great kingdoms, while every death in the world brings the Demon Lord closer.

4134930.title: Ball Bots
4134930.short_description: Kick, punch, and steal your way to victory in this frantic online and local sports-brawler. Knock off your opponent’s head and throw it to the goal in chaotic arenas. Grab a teammate for 2v2 or play 1v1 in 5-minute match where losing your head is part of the game!

4134940.title: The New Year's School
4134940.short_description: The world's first cooperative survival quiz! Face challenging questions in this pixel-art horror JRPG and survive through 7 fields of knowledge with your friends!

4135010.title: Chess Club Manager
4135010.short_description: Tycoon game to build and manage your own chess club from the ground up. Balance training, sponsors, tournaments and turn a tiny local club into a global success.

4136150.title: Caster Crew
4136150.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op action roguelike where your voice becomes your spellbook. Speak incantations to cast magic, explore procedurally generated dungeons, collect powerful loot, visit shops, and face deadly multi-phase bosses together.

4136190.title: The Book of the Alchemist
4136190.short_description: 1980s America. A dying doctor follows the call of an ancient book to a fog-shrouded town of disappearances, unsolved murders, and secrets. Dark alchemy offers a cure—at a horrific price. Will you die human, or kill your humanity to survive?

4136460.title: Blux
4136460.short_description: Engage in a non epic adventure of slimy goodness - Shoot, loot and level up your skills! Create your own weapons and play style by combining the heck out of all these skills we were too lazy to balance properly.

4136610.title: Magnet Agent
4136610.short_description: Magnet Agent is a puzzle adventure game based on “magnetic power”. Magnet Agent N-52 and his robot vacuum, Dustino, use their shockingly cool magnetic spy kit to explore the world and thwart Magnet Empress's evil plan before it's too late. They are drawn to danger, are you?

4136620.title: Emissary One
4136620.short_description: Co-op horror (1 to 6+ players). The squad was sent to the next site, but contact was lost. Find them and team up for the current mission. It seems you're not alone here again.

4136870.title: Asteroid Patrol
4136870.short_description: An incremental arena shooter where asteroids rain down and bounce back for more. Blast them apart, dash through creature swarms, protect the settlement’s houses and watch your numbers explode as you upgrade, beat bosses and push into new biomes.

4137780.title: Doterra Industries
4137780.short_description: Doterra Industries is a 2D factory-building sandbox about exploring a strange mineral world, building production lines, and slowly turning a rough outpost into an automated industrial network.

4138220.title: Residue Of The Lost
4138220.short_description: A cursed spirit from your past life has slipped into the modern world with your reincarnation. As a sorcerer stripped of all memory, uncover the truth within a single house, reclaim your forgotten powers, and prepare for the confrontation awaiting you. The real fear begins here.

4138400.title: SUS!
4138400.short_description: One of them is a thief. Blend into the crowd, steal, knock out your targets and escape, but you have to cough now and then. Spies watch the streets through CCTV, scan the crowd and get one clean stun shot. Stun an innocent and it costs you. Online PvP for 2 to 10 players, or play against bots.

4138540.title: Stuck in a Trench
4138540.short_description: You are the High Command. Guide generals as they send soldiers through wartime trenches, make agonizing strategic choices, learn from campaign outcomes, and build a lasting legacy across many fronts.

4138550.title: Rondo's Romp
4138550.short_description: Join Rondo, a cheerful Akita pup, as he explores 6 whimsical worlds, digging up coins, items, and throwable objects to solve puzzles, battle enemies, and uncover secrets... all with the charm and challenge of a classic 2D platformer!

4138920.title: Aliya: Timelink2 Dawn
4138920.short_description: A truth spanning time—connect with Aliya and meet diverse characters from 1,000 years later. In this real-time synchronized adventure, help her escape the Courtyard and team up to uncover the massive corporation’s hidden secrets...

4138960.title: Po10tions: Silver Path
4138960.short_description: Po10tions: Silver Path is a deck-building business simulation game. Start your business in a magic world in the 18th-century. Produce 3 types of goods and sell them. Play cards to produce more, trade for better prices, or stop your opponents. Make money faster to win!

4139000.title: Ominous Room -不気味な部屋-
4139000.short_description: Destroy quantum spheres that record human deaths and escape together in this co-op exploration extraction horror game. Each sphere you destroy alters the space and materializes the deceased's experiences. Hostile entities born from their emotions emerge. Escape, or push the investigation deeper.

4139020.title: AUTOMA
4139020.short_description: A VR action-adventure with deep physics-based interactions, systemic gameplay, and a gripping near-future mystery as a rogue AI overruns a Southeast Asian city. In a near-future city seized by AI, you made a deal to save your family—but at what cost?

4139530.title: Frank and Stein
4139530.short_description: Trapped in one stitched body, Frank & Stein must swap heads to survive this gloomy Metroidvania. Wield light and psychic powers to explore a castle shrouded in darkness, solve puzzles and reveal the unseen. Discover abilities and secrets, but beware of threats lurking in these twisted corridors...

4139660.title: Witchland: Trinity Blight
4139660.short_description: Lead an Inquisition expedition into a land consumed by corruption. Choose your missions, manage precious time, build your company, and survive brutal turn-based tactical battles as the world grows more dangerous around you.

4139890.title: TROLLHEIM: GNOMES
4139890.short_description: Explore an ancient, living forest as a tiny gnome in this co-op PVE survival crafting adventure inspired by Nordic folklore. Gather, craft and build a home for your gnome family amongst the treetops, and encounter the Väsen, mythical beings both friendly and dangerous. Play solo or up to 8 players

4140220.title: Backstage Football
4140220.short_description: Manage transfers, staff, and finances like a real sporting director. Backstage Football takes you behind the scenes of professional football. Football isn’t just a game — it’s an empire to build. Take control of the club and decide everything… except the score.

4140740.title: Motorsport Park Manager
4140740.short_description: Build and customize your own motorsports park in this classic tycoon simulation. Start with local go-kart tracks and grassroots circuits, and grow into a world-renowned racing destination.

4140770.title: Khinkills
4140770.short_description: As a cute khinkali dumpling, fight over the last piece of cake through fast paced and chaotic arenas. Smash your frenemies, steal their candies and kick everyone’s butt in this cute’n gore world.

4140890.title: ARO: Tales In The Dome
4140890.short_description: "ARO: Tales in the Dome" is a 2D hand-drawn action-adventure game. Play as Aro and explore an elemental world sealed beneath the dome. As the journey unfolds, uncover the hidden conspiracy and face the truth about the world, the dome, and yourself.

4140990.title: FOGBOUND
4140990.short_description: A retro psychological horror game set in a polluted city taken over by toxic fog that hollows out its inhabitants. Place air monitors, hold your breath, and get her out of here.

4141240.title: Thothic
4141240.short_description: Thothic is a logic puzzle game where you land stones on their glowing targets. But all stones move together, in the same direction — so you'll need to find the one path that brings every stone home at once.

4141410.title: Venture Pals
4141410.short_description: Choose your own Pal and venture out to grind skills and gather loot right from your desktop. Forge powerful gear, cook and brew invigorating meals and potions, and discover rare cosmetics. Manage energy, cleanliness, and training to grow. Or, just enjoy the company of your Pal

4141760.title: NERO
4141760.short_description: Become a chain-smoking, tax-dodging restaurateur on the brink of ruin. Sail blood-churned seas to feed starving killers who demand fine dining. Expand your empire from beach shack to world-class dining, or die trying.

4142080.title: GREED
4142080.short_description: GREED - "roguelite" with "drag-drop" elements and item physics. Сhaos of constantly falling random items and advancing enemies. Create items from a variety of combinations, expand the tower in the upgrade tree, use magic to apply effects, and buy what you need to plan your steps ahead.

4142130.title: WOLFOUT
4142130.short_description: A Wild West social deduction game. You and your gang of outlaw coyotes have one goal: crack safes, rob the bank, and loot the saloon before time runs out. But some of you are secretly sheriffs. Same look, same gang - opposite mission.

4142520.title: MANIFESTO: The Capitalism Roguelike
4142520.short_description: Hire employees. Arrange your office. Turn burnout into profit. MANIFESTO is a corporate roguelike auto battler. Combine worker abilities, stack upgrades, and replace exhausted staff to meet totally unrealistic sales targets. Good luck, CEO. The shareholders expect results.

4142530.title: Tsumamigui 3
4142530.short_description: A romantic adventure story developed by the popular Japanese studio ALICESOFT! That bittersweet memory in his heart, never fading away— Akihito Natsuki, forced by company circumstances to take a long leave, decides to return to his hometown.

4142550.title: Is This Farming?
4142550.short_description: A co-op first-person farming game where your crops fight back. Till, plant and water, then grab your hoe when the harvest wakes up swinging. Ship what you beat, craft turrets and bombs, and take down Guardians with up to three friends, or on your own.

4142590.title: Democracy Manifest
4142590.short_description: Hijack the vote in this 3-7 player social deduction brawl! Juggle with ideologies to play your cards perfectly, rig elections through deals, bribery & manipulation and backstab your closest friends to get ahead.

4142990.title: Atomic Blastman
4142990.short_description: Remember those epic LAN afternoons with your dad or friends? Atomic Blastman brings them back. Pick a color, suit up, and blast your way through huge arenas. Power-ups, sudden death, chaos, and laughs guaranteed. Just... please... don’t blow yourself up! Chaos and madness, guaranteed.

4143130.title: Fishy Business
4143130.short_description: A story-driven adventure where you captain a fishing boat. Explore a strange island, catch fish, trade and collect records of classical music.

4143850.title: Diabolocracy
4143850.short_description: Diabolocracy is hatemail for corporate bureaucracy in roguelite turn-based tactics form. Build your team of corporate hellions, battle other Sins for supremacy, survive meetings, and choose your SIN-ergies wisely. Can you complete your hostile takeover before the boss gets back from vacation?

4144410.title: TiNk
4144410.short_description: Connect each part of your life, and make your own path in your worlds. Draw, take notes, and enjoy your mind :)

4144550.title: Cosmic Cubicle
4144550.short_description: Cosmic Cubicle is a magical crafting puzzle game where you create the elements that make up the world. Watch the elements explode, splash, and crackle with simulated physics as you combine and hurl the elements at each other.

4144910.title: Fairyland Journey
4144910.short_description: A Hall-of-Fame competitive turn-based RPG. Cultivate Eudemons (Mythical Beasts) exclusive to you, and utilize hundreds of skills to make every battle more intense and diverse. Unleash their true power and dominate the PvP arena!
developers: 雷爵網絡科技股份有限公司
publishers: 雷爵網絡科技股份有限公司

4144950.title: Picatso
4144950.short_description: Play as Picatso, a calico cat painter searching for a creative spark. Navigate through underground ruins with his ability to paint the environment which allow him to advance in this platforming adventure!

4144960.title: The Grant Grover Anthology
4144960.short_description: In Neo Naarm in the 22nd century, augmentation technology has run amok. Combining deduction, visual novel and point and click gameplay, play as Grant Grover, private detective, one of the only remaining citizens without augmentations, as he solves crimes across the city.

4145100.title: G Squad
4145100.short_description: Run the gauntlet with G Squad in this hand-crafted autobattler with roguelite and RPG elements, designed to scratch the strategy itch without the spreadsheets. 9 unique heroes, in-run rewards, permanent progression, and boss challenge modifiers to test yourself against.

4145180.title: Water is Heavy
4145180.short_description: Become an ordinary fish descending endlessly into the pitch-black abyss. In this 3D marine roguelite, master bubble attacks and combine diverse skills and powerful items to survive the crushing pressure of swarming enemies. At the end of the harsh abyss, what belief will you ultimately forge?

4145770.title: The american dream of Gunther Aims
4145770.short_description: A retro puzzle shooter built around ricochets, where every shot counts. You play as Gunther, a revolver and a family man, in a constrained turn-based system: one action at a time, until it fully resolves.

4145790.title: Mystic Rest Stop: Weekend at Stillpoint
4145790.short_description: Leo Carter, a content creator, arrives at SteelPoint to investigate the local urban legends. What seemed like a peaceful getaway soon turns into a nightmare when he discovers that the forest hides a cult willing to do anything to keep its secret.

4145840.title: Her in the Abyss
4145840.short_description: You pick up a distress signal from an unknown source. A girl codenamed C804 is in trouble in the freezing Iron Curtain. Over 72 hours in real time, every reply and every silence shapes her decisions. Chat with her as you explore, negotiate, and carry out missions together.

4145970.title: KLITTER
4145970.short_description: KLITTER fuses the precision of arena combat with the chaos of glitchcore and the flow of a movement-driven brawler. Every dash, every shot, every kill defines your rhythm - stop moving and you die, flow perfectly and the system collapses. PURE FLOW. ZERO MERCY.

4146080.title: Bring It
4146080.short_description: A stylized retro arcade game about a motor courier hustling through the city to deliver meals, coffee and groceries with skill and style. Chain boosts, drifts, air dashes and double jumps, then spend your earnings on home upgrades,new licenses and bikes with unique abilities for the next day’s rush.

4146620.title: Riftbound Survivors
4146620.short_description: Riftbound is a survivor-like bullet heaven focused on spell combinations and massive enemy waves. Defeat thousands of enemies, experiment with elemental chain reactions, and break the game with overlapping status effects. Play solo or in co-op.

4148090.title: SpaceRabbit
4148090.short_description: A space bunny working for a ruthless delivery company! Dodge asteroids, collect stars, customize your rocket, and compete with players worldwide. Survive the harsh life of a space courier!

4148210.title: REALM ARCANA
4148210.short_description: REALM ARCANA is a 1v1 online strategy card game. Take turns deploying units, combine abilities and positioning, and adapt to randomized battlefields that change the rules of combat. Read the field, outplay your opponent, and find a new path to victory each match.

4148370.title: < STRECT >
4148370.short_description: Control your ship and destroy all the enemies and bases that have appeared through teleportation! < STRECT > is a score-attack vertical shooter for 1 or 2 players. Enjoy simple shoot-and-dodge gameplay, rich destruction effects, and tons of hidden features.

4148440.title: Dadum The Dice
4148440.short_description: Plan, roll and outsmart your enemies in this turn-based tactical puzzle adventure. Show a higher number to defeat foes, discover new mechanics in every world, and face challenging bosses that twist the rules. Think ahead, take your time… and master the Great Die.

4148470.title: Serenity Sketch
4148470.short_description: Relax and paint with water in Serenity Sketch, a guided mindfulness sandbox. Create ephemeral art, follow gentle voice prompts in atmospheric landscapes, and find stillness in letting go. A self-care ritual where each evaporating brushstroke brings freedom and reflection.

4148770.title: DIVEBOMB: Weaponized Racing
4148770.short_description: Realistic driving meets weaponized vehicular combat. Shoot straight, lay traps, and drive fast to win. Fight for victory in this high-octane, high-stakes combat racer.

4148890.title: Dribble Deck
4148890.short_description: Dribble Deck is a basketball card game about leading your team through a tough league. Build a deck, upgrade players and trade with NPC’s. Master the game’s flow as you face ruthless coach bosses. The owner has already written you off so you’ll have to win every match or get cut before the finals.

4148940.title: Crystal Vein
4148940.short_description: The "Crystallization" a disease where crystalline veins course through the body, eventually encasing it entirely in crystals. A girl, afflicted by this illness, embarks on a journey to find a place of salvation. A 2D action adventure game about loss and coming of age.

4149030.title: Ad Iterum
4149030.short_description: Ad Iterum is a turn-based top-down 2D roguelike set in a decaying, ever-shifting world. Flesh is fragile, but you can hack it. Enhance your body, embrace mutations, or form ancient blood pacts. Descend into the depths, scavenge what’s left of humanity, and crawl back...if you can. Kill. Die. Repeat.

4149080.title: Ittzy Fearless
4149080.short_description: Ittzy Fearless is a difficult physics-based action game. Play as Ittzy the fire spirit and use your swift moves and devastating strikes to tackle chaotic waves of enemies, projectiles and explosions.

4149390.title: SILKRUN
4149390.short_description: SILKRUN is an arcade racing game! Master silky smooth powerslides around insane tracks, even on a keyboard — race against time, computer opponents, and online in different weather conditions and time of day. Super Cars 2 meets Slicks 'N Slide, Outrun, Stunts & The Need for Speed in modern 3D racing!

4149610.title: Young Suns
4149610.short_description: Build a home on your own spaceship and take it adventuring across a newly liberated Jupiter. A cozy 1-4 player narrative life sim where you explore, salvage, and repair to help a huge cast of lovable characters make society better.

4149640.title: On the Rocks
4149640.short_description: Run a bar in a toxic wasteland, solo or in co-op with up to 4 players. Scavenge the wasteland, brew with what you find, and serve whoever comes through your doors. In a world gone to ruin, the last bar standing is yours to run together.

4150060.title: FragFrame
4150060.short_description: FragFrame is a fast-paced Arena FPS with a modern take on classic shooters, set in a dark dystopian, neon sci-fi world. Battle friends in intense multiplayer matches fueled by high-energy electronic music and a rave-like atmosphere. Create and share custom arenas with the built-in level editor.

4150110.title: Guardian Demon
4150110.short_description: Protect the helpless peasant Myson from an army of angry orcs for as long as possible in this action arcade game. Defeat hordes of orcs with simple and easy to learn intuitive controls, earn gold to customize Myson's appearance and compete with others to see who can survive the longest!

4150210.title: Undying War: Gate Of Pioneer
4150210.short_description: Undying War: Gate of Pioneer is a subculture-style multiplayer brawl action game where unique characters clash in real time. Enjoy fast-paced and thrilling battles that unfold within five minutes.

4150720.title: Drunken Goddess Reflux
4150720.short_description: Face off in a Russian roulette drinking survival with a demon who'd kill for you—or kill you—where it's puke or be puked on for your soul. The more you drink, the more the rules break down, until it all spills into one hell of a night you'll never forget.

4150970.title: Five Shifts at Zlata’s
4150970.short_description: Five Shifts at Zlata's is an atmospheric horror night-shift simulator where you play as a security mechanic in a family restaurant hiding dark secrets. Monitor cameras, manage power, restart the generator, and keep the animatronics-mascots away. Survive five shifts… if you can.

4151050.title: Divided Empire: SENGOKU
4151050.short_description: Lead your clan through Japan's turbulent Sengoku period. Craft wise strategies to expand your domain and use cunning tactics to defeat your enemies on the battlefield. Emerge victorious, restore order, and claim the title of Shogun!

4151270.title: ATOMIC LANCE
4151270.short_description: Wield heavy weapons. Fly faster than a bullet. Nuke your enemies. You are a Black Project, an ATOMIC LANCE.

4151300.title: Sublustrum
4151300.short_description: Enter a mysterious machine built to explore the human subconscious and complete your brother’s final experiment. Descend into a world where memories become places, solve sound-driven puzzles, and uncover a hidden truth in this first-person narrative adventure.

4153180.title: So Stoked
4153180.short_description: A chill and cozy surf game about timing, flow, and discovery. Travel between islands, ride clean waves, and enjoy a calm, skill-driven ride with light RPG-style tasks and progression.

4153310.title: Plants One Shot!
4153310.short_description: 《Plants One Shot!》 is a party game for up to 4 players. Your sect has been attacked by villains. To revive your sect and uphold justice, you must kill monsters and obtain better spells and equipment so that you can gain enough power to defeat the villains!

4153760.title: BOLD: Networked Newt Action
4153760.short_description: BOLD: Networked Newt Action redefines multiplayer stealth action for the modern day, with a return to classic Spies vs Mercs style 2v2 asymmetrical gameplay in a dark Sci-Fi world with anthropomorphic animals. 3rd person stealth is pitted against 1st person action in maps set across exotic locales!

4153900.title: Zoomalia
4153900.short_description: In a world conquered by Zealotory harvesters, Zoomalia’s survival rests in your hands. Build a team of over 100 unique creatures, then fuse, evolve, and mutate them into powerful forms. Adapt your strategy, destroy obelisks, and reclaim the planet in this strategic roguelite.

4154160.title: Andromis
4154160.short_description: Mission-driven third-person action game with 50 explosive missions. Fight rogue machines, rescue civilians, and battle across a war-torn city and iconic locations. Drive cars, armed vehicles, and a tank while unleashing heavy weapons and large-scale urban destruction.

4155160.title: Card Cricket Quest
4155160.short_description: Card Cricket Quest is a single-player roguelite deck-builder that combines deep card-matching gameplay with the ball smashing action of cricket! Complement your deck with outrageous special cards, wield powerful willows, and collect obscure trinkets to become a cricket legend. One RUN at a time.

4155330.title: Pulse Citadel
4155330.short_description: An incremental defense game where each run funds your next upgrade. The Citadel shoots automatically. Pick what to research, then time your abilities to keep it alive.

4155560.title: Iron Tracer
4155560.short_description: Iron Tracer is a tactical shooter where you play as a spec-ops soldier sent across the globe to stop threats before they happen. Every mission demands stealth, precision, and quick decision-making, one wrong move can end the the mission.

4155970.title: Chrono Seoul
4155970.short_description: Chrono Seoul’s unique Time Table combat lets you use the hero’s mechanical arm and future-reading ability to predict enemy actions and respond with precise attacks, defense, and evasion. Each run offers new patterns, and at every chapter’s end, an Existence corrupted Seoul awaits.

4155990.title: Dice chess
4155990.short_description: A new-age chess game combined with math. Free to play with your bro offline, your friends or any players online.

4156060.title: Anna's Bakery Shop
4156060.short_description: You’re Anna, a young woman who ditches the boring city life to open a cozy bakery in a small town. Along with your animate mannequin friend Can Doe, you will embark on a delicious journey, decorate your beautiful shop and meet locals who are curious about the new bakery in their town.

4156160.title: Devoris
4156160.short_description: Formerly known as Devora,now changed name to Devoris. You become a bird living in the sewers, killing and eating other inhabitants to fill your stomach. Of course, as an adventurer, you can choose to explore the underground world to obtain new weapons, new delicacies, discover the stories here.

4156300.title: Fragment Collapse
4156300.short_description: Fragment Collapse is a satisfying tile matching rogue-like deck-builder where you defragment your hard drive by matching clusters of files. Discover powerful cartridges to upgrade your computer, boost your files with enhancements and build massive combos for file-busting mayhem!

4156710.title: Coin Maker Simulator
4156710.short_description: Enjoy the crafting process in this immersive, relaxing simulator about making money, literally. You've been locked in a dungeon, and your only way to freedom is to craft coins for the King!

4156730.title: fCorvus
4156730.short_description: Solve puzzles, uncover riddles, and hunt crows and ravens through layered scenes of mystery. Reveal the hidden truth in a world where every shadow tells a story. Learn about the fabulous corvus.

4157190.title: Sandnight Hill Revelation
4157190.short_description: In order to find her runaway cat,a girl ventures into the deep mountains where monsters roam. However, this mountain hides the truth of the world. By collecting the journals of lost wanderers who entered the Black Forest, she gradually approaches that truth. What, indeed, awaits her ahead...

4157220.title: Mt. Quack Legend
4157220.short_description: A single player 2D anime rogue-lite RPG. Join a new born duck girl's adventure in a aggressively cute world. Beat up cute wild creatures and level up to different bird classes as you explore this place.

4157420.title: Deep Hunger
4157420.short_description: A short incremental game about cleaning the ocean, and feeding the insatiable hunger of a deep sea creature.

4157560.title: WishBreaker
4157560.short_description: A genre-fusion ARPG. Every class plays differently, Warrior plays as Hack n' Slash, Rogue as Stealth rougelike, Cleric is decision based, Druids play creature collecting/farming, Wizards are puzzles, secrets, and code casting and many more! PVE and PVP including Bullet Hell and Soulslike areas!

4157660.title: Life Balance
4157660.short_description: A physics ragdoll climber where life choices become literal baggage. Climb a tower in the sky alone or in 2-player split-screen co-op: give each other a leg-up, grab each other, and share the load. Can you reach the top, or will your responsibilities drag you down?

4158030.title: Call of Donuts
4158030.short_description: Race solo against the clock or challenge your friends in a hero shooter where you and your teammates share the same ammo pool while dodging traps and defeating minions. Join forces or face off in up to 8 teams of 1–3 players on a procedurally generated map where every match is a brand-new adventure.

4158090.title: GambaSim
4158090.short_description: Build and expand your own casino in a high-stakes gambling and manager simulator. Play classic casino games, beat rival casinos with unique playstyles, and climb through increasingly dangerous tiers where every bet can make, or break, your future.

4158560.title: 代号: Gabby's adventure
4158560.short_description: Gabby's Adventure is a 3D sandbox adventure game. In this game, uou will play as little Gabby who were brave and whimsical , embarking on an adventure to save your home.

4158600.title: No Man's Land
4158600.short_description: A First World War turn-based strategy game. It's you versus them, versus No Man's Land.

4158700.title: The Final Like
4158700.short_description: THE FINAL LIKE. A fruit machine with a mind of its own. An authentic UK AWP simulator built around the world of social media - where the machine’s AI is watching, and has no intention of letting you walk away a winner.

4158810.title: Shadow Hills Manor
4158810.short_description: Shadow Hills Manor is a first-person psychological horror experience focused on exploration, puzzle-solving, and looting. Break into the manor left behind by greed and decay. Search for valuables, but the more you take, the angrier the manor becomes. Your choice of greed shapes how the manor reacts.

4158880.title: ZEROSEGI
4158880.short_description: A TRPG × Visual Novel led by the roll of the dice. You arrive at Seiria Magic Academy just one week before the centennial 'Violet Eclipse.' Immerse yourself in campus life, romance seven heroines, and uncover the world's hidden secrets. Your choices alone will reshape the fate of this world.

4159160.title: Ellsydia
4159160.short_description: Welcome to Ellsydia! Escape to a small cozy medieval fantasy haven where you can build, customize, and manage your dream village. Make it thrive and ensure the well-being of its villagers so they feel truly happy and fulfilled.

4161010.title: Moon Lake Town
4161010.short_description: Moon Lake Town is a life-sim that cares more about who you become than what you produce. Slow down, reconnect with nature, and rediscover joy. Farm, fish, explore, gather, learn, craft, build, and create at your own pace. Every day is a chance to grow — and begin again. 🌙

4161260.title: As We Planned
4161260.short_description: Stealth PVE heist with friends. Steal valuables, solve puzzles, use tools, upgrade your base, and complete quests. You can go quiet or loud — the choice is yours. Up to 4 players. Every raid is unique!

4161510.title: 红夏
4161510.short_description: 《红夏》是一款以剧情体验为主的视觉小说游戏。八月末的某天，二十多名师生被神秘地困在学校里，等待他们的将是一场自相残杀……

4161710.title: Follow Dalian
4161710.short_description: Hack, Slash, and Loot! A pixel-art Action Roguelike built on two pillars: the visceral thrill of mowing down hordes and the endless addiction of grinding for gear. Meticulously craft your build with weapons, armor, gadgets, and skills, evolve it inside the run, then unleash satisfying carnage!

4162610.title: Project Lighthouse
4162610.short_description: Trapped inside a scientific anomaly, solve puzzles with evolving teleportation tech and uncover the fate of the vanished “keepers”. Built alongside our community, props we made for Project Lighthouse are free for other game developers.

4163520.title: Mermaids are Seafood
4163520.short_description: You're a new hire at a company that sells mermaids as seafood. Bet your blood, navigate conspiracies, and cook for customers in this psychological horror game with 11 endings. Are mermaids more like fish, people, or monsters?

4164330.title: Oomi’s Nook
4164330.short_description: Oomi’s Nook is a cozy and relaxing sticker decor game. Decorate a little room with hand-drawn style stickers according to the drawing or unleash your creativity! Follow the lighthearted everyday life of the adorable Oomi family and watch them live leisurely in the world you create!

4164650.title: SNAKEPIT [USA]
4164650.short_description: A short puzzle game about comparing URL vs. IRL

4165030.title: Beatcore
4165030.short_description: A simple rhythm game where you hit beats as they come down the lanes. Level editor included.

4165170.title: Beatcore zero
4165170.short_description: Try Beatcore for free! A simple rhythm game where you hit beats as they come down the lanes. This version does not permit access to the workshop.

4165660.title: Dungeon Treaders
4165660.short_description: A classic-style 3D dungeon crawler that blends nostalgic challenge with modern comfort. Enjoy flexible character creation and a classic world, now with streamlined, trial-and-error gameplay.

4165680.title: Dices golf
4165680.short_description: Turn-based golf where your choice of die balances reach and precision. Beat courses to welcome visitors, reinvest their earnings in your estate and skills, and take on ever tougher challenges, all the way to Hell.

4166450.title: Dadi Kingdom
4166450.short_description: Action RPG: You're the king. Everyone wants something from you, and you've got a sword. Every morning you judge your people: release, gold fine or dungeon? Then you walk out the gate yourself and fight bandits, skeletons and worse. Father an heir before your time runs out.

4166900.title: Drunken Hog: Dystopian Pub & Brewing Simulator
4166900.short_description: Run your own pub in this atmospheric and story-rich job simulator. Featuring a full brewing pipeline, dynamic NPCs, side quests, bar upgrades and expansions, branching dialogue, a freely explorable city, and a deep narrative set in dystopian Napolis City.

4167640.title: Horde of Distraction
4167640.short_description: An incremental game inspired by classic RPGs. Fight monsters, collect rare gear, progress through a vast skill tree, and defeat powerful bosses!

4168190.title: Crimson Banner: War of Liberation
4168190.short_description: Command the Chinese People's Liberation Army in Crimson Banner: War of Liberation. Fight through the campaigns of the Chinese Civil War in a turn-based wargame played on a hex grid.

4169090.title: VERDGE
4169090.short_description: VERDGE is a dynamic speedrun plaformer, where the player can decide which content is generated.

4169510.title: Mount Tartarus
4169510.short_description: Survive the underworld in Mount Tartarus, a bullet heaven roguelite. Cut through endless monster hordes and combine skills and passives into devastating builds. Every run earns gold for permanent upgrades, so each death makes you stronger. Besides, where else would you go? You are already dead.

4169530.title: FatSheep Crisis:RE
4169530.short_description: Baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa, baa. Baa.

4169890.title: 5th ERA
4169890.short_description: A techno-fantasy JRPG inspired by 16-bit classics. Explore Helgon, the city on the comet, and build your ideal team from a roster of 9 distinct characters, each with their own classes. Engage in strategic turn-based combat against the deadly Brightlings to uncover the truth behind the white portals.

4170350.title: M.A.Y.A
4170350.short_description: Take on the role of sci-fi warrior Maya. Capture uplinks, master a complex move-set along with weapon upgrades, and survive on a hostile planet.

4170660.title: C6: Frontlines
4170660.short_description: C6: Frontlines is a bullet hell co-op roguelike where only YOU (and your friends) can bring the Azapall galaxy to peace. Wield 30+ weapons and gadgets of mass destruction to even the playing field, wave after wave, against a seemingly endless onslaught of evil!

4170670.title: Atlas Proxima: Tether
4170670.short_description: Stay in touch with earth as you travel the solar system, in this co-operative online multiplayer idler world filled with curated content to discover and play together.

4170790.title: The Fridge
4170790.short_description: THE FRIDGE is an action-roguelite with procedurally generated maps. Find or purchase weapons in each run and face increasingly challenging waves of enemies. Obtain magical catalysts to boost your weapons’ power and experiment with different combinations to adapt your combat style.

4170840.title: Akina
4170840.short_description: Akina is an arcade drift game set in early-90s Japan. Drift down mountain passes, race friends online, and explore a peaceful summer countryside shaped by the golden age of Japanese street-racing culture.🗾🎌

4171050.title: VIVID
4171050.short_description: Be a plant in this cozy, narrative-driven plant survival simulation about nature, responsibility, and interconnected systems. You will grow procedurally over time, explore evolving environments, and shape a fragile ecosystem through meaningful choices.

4171110.title: Timberflow: Sawmill Simulator
4171110.short_description: From a single tree to an entire industry! Manage and automate your lumber business in this relaxing, yet challenging Sawmill Simulator. Start small, grow rich, dominate the market.

4171130.title: Isekai Guardians
4171130.short_description: Text-Based MMORPG in an isekai anime fantasy world.

4171150.title: Auspicious Clouds
4171150.short_description: A unique turn-based game featuring Auspicious Cloud Cards. Wield the power of the Five Elements to unleash skills and vanquish foes. Unlock a vast roster of character skills, collect Cultivation Orbs, and devise your own one-of-a-kind tactics to conquer every opponent.

4171200.title: The Lost Study
4171200.short_description: A forgotten study. Lost because no one remembers it. Solve puzzles, recover stories, and restore it — one chapter at a time. 14 stories, 14 worlds. Cozy, eerie, funny, and strange. They seem completely unrelated. Until they're not.

4171620.title: Cozy Craft
4171620.short_description: A relaxing soft crafting and resource gatherer game. Explore, collect materials, refine them, and restore a ruined castle to rescue the kingdom's princess. No rush. No danger. Just build, collect, and watch your cozy world come to life.

4171930.title: PNEUMA Division
4171930.short_description: Pneuma is an online co-op sci-fi paranormal investigation game for up to 4 players. Operate advanced paranormal tech to investigate, analyze, and outmaneuver deadly ghosts before you are possessed. Speak rituals aloud with your own voice to bind, expose, or provoke what hunts you.

4172060.title: DRAMAtical Murder re:code NITRO ARCHIVE
4172060.short_description: NITRO CHiRAL's hit BL adventure game DRAMAtical Murder re:code is now available on Steam! Aoba, our protagonist, spends his days working part-time at Hum-Drum Junk. All he ever wanted was to live a peaceful life. However, strange events have begun transpiring in places beyond his fathoming.

4172090.title: The Hundredth Floor: Extraction
4172090.short_description: A 3D dungeon crawler ARPG blending looter-slasher & extraction mechanics. Delve into a 100-floor abyss where you must choose: play it safe or risk it all! Craft unique builds with massive talent trees & 1,000+ affixes. Defeat bosses and extract with epic loot, or lose everything to greed!

4172340.title: pyTexas
4172340.short_description: Completely free Texas Hold'em game, play with your friends, find public lobbies around the world, or play alone with bots. You can also add bots when your lobby doesn't have enough players.

4172350.title: Forest Whiskers
4172350.short_description: Rescue kittens, care for your growing cat family, and watch new generations inherit their parents' traits. Explore, craft, train your cats, and bring the forest back to life.

4172750.title: 4DEAD
4172750.short_description: ‘4DEAD’ is a high-speed roguelike action game where you control the invincible creature “No. 42,” which dies if it doesn't consume prey within 4 seconds. Devour invaders relentlessly to survive! Keep devouring enemies within 4 seconds and save humanity from extinction with your own hands!

4172830.title: Jash Retro
4172830.short_description: Inspired by classic retro games such as Double dragon/Target renegade, Ikari warriors/Commando, Contra, Golden axe. Follow the story and explore all the games for fun moments!

4172880.title: Hacker The Dark Shadow
4172880.short_description: Become a young programmer diving into the dangerous world of cybercrime. When the elite hacking collective Dark Shadows challenges you with a series of ruthless trials, you must push your genius to the limit. Will you prove your worth or become another digital casualty?

4172970.title: One Last Push
4172970.short_description: Survive the horrors of WW1 in this intense PvE survival shooter. Scavenge supplies, earn your regiment’s respect, and fight for reinforcements before you become another name lost in the mud.

4173010.title: Ninja JaJaMaru: Yokai Night Parade
4173010.short_description: Ninja JaJaMaru-kun returns in a yokai-filled hack-and-slash action game! Stray into a dungeon party, defeat dancing yokai, master flashy Ninpo, and amass an arsenal of ninja gear! Clear special "Yokai Night Parade" rules for loot, decorate your base for stat boosts and save Princess Sakura!

4173530.title: Recalibration
4173530.short_description: Take down all your enemies using as few bullets as possible. Be both stylish and efficient – that’s what a true assassin is all about. Uncover the betrayal, track down the culprits, and bring them to justice in the name of global peace.

4173560.title: Jacaro: Looming Dread
4173560.short_description: A single session of Jacaro stands between you and a fate worse than death. Whilst something is lurking and waiting for a mistake.

4173600.title: SkyRen
4173600.short_description: Race, climb, and free-run through dynamic cityscapes! Build your character, master movement, compete with players, earn gear, level up, and climb the leaderboards to become the ultimate free-runner in this anime parkour MMO!

4173950.title: Asylum 1966
4173950.short_description: A forgotten asylum. A missing daughter. A man with nothing left to lose. In Asylum 1966, descend into a decaying institution where reality bends and shadows whisper secrets. What you uncover will test your sanity and your choices will shape your fate.

4174280.title: Dungeon Potato
4174280.short_description: Dungeon Potato is a fast-paced, top-down action roguelike where your loadout shapes the story. Survive unpredictable encounters, forge unique builds, and battle through a perilous labyrinth. Will you rise as a servant of the Potato God or rebel against it?

4174420.title: Millennium Slumber
4174420.short_description: Survive 400,000 years on a planet infested with an alien calamity! Gather resources, build a base and defend against hordes of nocturnal monsters in this rogue-like with cryostasis mechanics.

4174550.title: Super Space Crystals
4174550.short_description: Flow through a glowing field of musical crystals in this relaxing and immersive zen bullet hell. Shatter the crystals to collect their magic and upgrade your powers. Fend off enemy spacecraft, and save the galaxy from The Fraternal Brotherhood of Evil Magic Space Robots - or just enjoy the vibes!

4174850.title: Friendgeist
4174850.short_description: An online co-op horror comedy for up to 5 players. You wake up trapped in a house haunted by the Friendgeist, a spirit that takes the shape of a friend to deceive and possess you. Find the way out. If one of you gets possessed, exorcise them before it's too late. Or escape, if they let you.

4174880.title: Kōyō
4174880.short_description: Fast, satisfying top-down combat meets cozy progression. Slay yokai, grab loot, craft upgrades, and explore an Edo-inspired valley in a stylized 2.5D action RPG.

4174980.title: SHATTERSHAPE
4174980.short_description: SHATTERSHAPE is an arcade-style shooter in which you are a lone circle fighting hordes of enemies with evil vertices. SHATTER your enemies with numerous power-ups. ONLY THE ROUND SURVIVE.

4175040.title: Beyond: Fire & Ice
4175040.short_description: A mythological action RPG where Fire and Ice collide. Play as Shangdi, the Emperor of Flames, and Skadi, the Ice Queen, as they battle through the war-torn world of Athos to uncover the dark force manipulating their kingdoms.

4175110.title: TAKE OUT
4175110.short_description: "Take Out" is an emotion-driven visual novel and rhythm adventure about 30 days with Morning, an android delivered to your home. Your choices shape your bond, while each day's emotions unfold in webtoon-style cutscenes and rhythm gameplay as she grows from a household assistant into a band vocalist.

4175510.title: Moony Mayhem: Cheeks Unleashed
4175510.short_description: You are randomly assigned “Civic Disturbance Duty” and must complete tasks using the power of your butt. Explore a world filled with absurd gameplay, chaotic tasks, and mediocre visuals.

4175680.title: Midnight Manhunt
4175680.short_description: Hunt down a hidden target through a cyberpunk city in this turn-based game of cat and mouse. Coordinate four Grid Runners to eliminate his escape routes one by one, deduce his position and close the net before he completes his mission. Or become the Ghost, laying false trails to survive the night.

4175810.title: Space Daram
4175810.short_description: Become a cute space chipmunk and manage your ship with companions as you explore alien planets, build and upgrade your base, and craft gear by generating power and refining resources. Meet unique alien species, grow your foothold in the universe, and play solo or with friends in multiplayer.

4175930.title: 悠久教室 - Perpetual Classroom -
4175930.short_description: A horror adventure where you confront supernatural phenomena and unravel mysteries in a school transformed into another world, all to save your childhood friend. Exploration, combat, and psychological terror await you.

4176140.title: End of Eden
4176140.short_description: End of Eden is an open world RPG where you arrive unwanted on a cursed island and must earn every inch. Master tight melee, archery and magic. Join a faction, grow deep talents, craft gear, and explore a living world with real routines, tough bosses and meaningful quests.

4176230.title: Milkraid
4176230.short_description: Defend the milk at all costs! Place towers, build your base, recruit minions, and battle endless swarms of enemies. Unlock new towers, characters and base upgrades, and upgrade them to create ridiculous builds. Every run is unique.

4176320.title: Haamupeli: Wrath of the Iku-Turso
4176320.short_description: Haamupeli: Wrath of the Iku-Turso is a fantasy-themed action RPG adventure game about vanquishing an ancient threat. Recruit allies, find powerful items, develop your character and interact with the game world and its inhabitants to archieve your goals.

4176330.title: Colosseum
4176330.short_description: In this Fast Arena FPS, you play as a prisonner in hell, forced to battle for eternity to please the crowds of the Colosseum ! Wave after wave of enemies, you battle ancient warriors to the rythm of their songs.

4176430.title: Disquieted
4176430.short_description: Disquieted is a hand-drawn action platformer set between a dreamlike Naples and an underground world distorted by anxiety. As Connie, fight, dodge, choose power-ups, and face the demons hiding beneath the city.

4176440.title: Crystalia
4176440.short_description: Crystalia is a first-person tower defense game mixing automation, management and exploration set in a utopian sci-fi world built on crystal extraction. Dig into caves, build autonomous defense zones and uncover the history of a civilization shaped around crystals.

4176450.title: Magic Island New Era
4176450.short_description: Following the guidance of the goddess Gaia, elf Lumina arrived at the island country of demons - Mogapo. The Demon Lord Nora helped and took her in. After living in Mogapo for some time, Lumina gradually fell in love with this place and Nora, who led her to start this new life...

4176600.title: Phoe
4176600.short_description: Phoe is a classic single-player platformer where chaining momentum is the key to speed; how fast you go is up to you. Master tight controls and refine your route through levels designed to push your platforming skills to the limit.

4176740.title: Tiny Desk Pot
4176740.short_description: Grow and nourish your own vegetables in a tiny desk pot! Let your leafy companion grow idle in a corner of your desktop while you do your things. Discover new soils, unlock new types of vegetables, and customize your pot with cute stickers. Relaxing music included!

4177020.title: Demra: Rifts of War
4177020.short_description: Real-time strategy in the spirit of the 90s classics. Build your base, seize mines and lead your army with a spell-casting hero against a demon invasion – or command the demons yourself.

4177350.title: Quack Ball!
4177350.short_description: Defend your goal as a rubber ducky in chaotic 4-player 3D pong! Battle friends in local multiplayer across wacky arenas. Lose a round? Draw a power-up card. Stack synergizing cards into wild builds and quack your way back to victory.

4177420.title: Fatemender
4177420.short_description: A Tarot puzzle adventure where you collect cards, cast spells, and place paths to reshape an ever-shifting Labyrinth. Outsmart the Fates, collect powerful Artifacts, and attempt the impossible—escape Purgatory.

4177580.title: Crazy Islands
4177580.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer party game where unpredictable events turn every round into pure madness.

4177830.title: Life of a Cockroach
4177830.short_description: Yes, you’re a cockroach, so your top priority now is to survive. Explore an urban environment from a whole new perspective in this open-world 3D adventure filled with challenges, tasks, and dangers. Discover hidden places, master your skills, and become the ultimate survivor insect!

4178060.title: おばけなんて怖くないJK　VS　学校迷宮
4178060.short_description: Curious about horror but bad with scary things? This is a not-so-scary horror game made by a developer who feels the same way, created for players who want to enjoy horror without being truly frightened. A pixel-art side-scrolling action adventure with puzzles and light action elements.

4178650.title: This Is Not For You
4178650.short_description: After a ghost ship crashes into an isolated lighthouse, Ulysses’ memories come back to trap him in an endless, twisting maze full of riddles, blood, and magic. Draw your own map, and find a way to burn it all down.

4178960.title: Kneel!
4178960.short_description: A dark, stylized simulation about control and devotion. Build influence, exploit human weakness, and reshape a forgotten city districts through faith, fear, and obedience.

4179170.title: Noble Steed
4179170.short_description: A fast, funny 2D platformer where every level throws you into chaotic combat and questionable heroics, all to rescue your runaway horse… again.

4179640.title: Overtake: Taskbar Racer
4179640.short_description: Overtake is an idle racing game that lives on your taskbar, built for people who spend all day at the keyboard. Your car cruises along while you work, and every keystroke gives it an extra push. Collect skins and trade them on the Steam Community Market, climb the leaderboards and never stop moving.

4179770.title: Kindling Hour
4179770.short_description: A short psychological horror text adventure guided by a single candle. Random encounters and fragments of lost memories weave a story in the dark. Eerie and unsettling, yet a little cute and quirky. A narrative experience to gently light a fire in your heart.

4180840.title: Shadowstone
4180840.short_description: Play solo or with up to 4 players. Plan your turns together, chain your heroes’ skills into combinations that break the run open, and fight your way out of a labyrinth that changes every time. A turn-based tactical roguelite about what your party can do together.

4181130.title: Greys the Dream Slayer
4181130.short_description: 自幼和妹妹相依为命的时引光在考入英南大学后，自称“葛瑞希”的魔女赐予他五根能实现他人愿望的火柴。“美梦成真，亦要付出相应的代价。”表面上力量无穷的火柴，却是撕开这世界虚伪面纱的钥匙。当时引光回过神，才发现自己早已陷入了魔女制造的漩涡中。人啊，究竟更愿意直面现实，还是沉湎在虚妄的美梦中？

4181990.title: The Industrial Council
4181990.short_description: A cozy AI driven game where you play a journalist in a steampunk fantasy city. Change is coming to Raversul, and with the help of your imp and your newspaper you will play a powerful role in shaping it. Solve mysteries, uncover stories, and shape politics in this revolutionary new game.

4182190.title: Too Deep To Quit
4182190.short_description: Grab your gear and your friends for a hilarious, golden-age co-op adventure! Dive into cursed temples, hunt for the ultimate treasure, and work together to stay alive. Beware of everything and everyone... after all, only the survivors get to split the gold!

4182240.title: Minotaur Hotel
4182240.short_description: A mythology-inspired gay visual novel about the legendary Minotaur. Manage a magical hotel, explore the stories of mythical beings from around the world, and uncover the realm's dark history.

4183920.title: Pumpkin Is Yummy!?
4183920.short_description: Your own little farm village, tucked into the corner of your desktop. Raise a chatty pumpkin, tend your crops, and collect critters in this quirky, lighthearted idler. How you raise your Pumpkin decides who they become.

4183980.title: Caliban
4183980.short_description: A strategic blackjack roguelike. Stack drinks, runes, and gems into game-breaking combos. Beat cursed bosses. Chase the leaderboard. One deck. One dealer. Infinite builds.

4184000.title: Tidal Life
4184000.short_description: Tidal Life is a first person open world exploration game. On this vast and boundless island, you must survive through diving, fishing, and beachcombing. Use the resources you gather to upgrade your equipment, complete the illustrated guide, enrich your island. collect or defeat them all !

4184130.title: Foxy Dumplings
4184130.short_description: In Foxy Dumplings, you’ll run your own food truck and make friends along the way. Cook dumplings from all over the world, take good care of your customers, and discover how a meal can mend more than just hunger in this cozy cooking sim. Rise to the top of Foxtagram, one heartfelt dish at a time.

4186460.title: The Hole Never Ends
4186460.short_description: An intense VR adventure where you crawl through twisting caves, face unseen terrors, evade creatures, mine for relics, and upgrade your gear as you descend deeper into the hole.

4186590.title: Captain Contraption’s Safari Park
4186590.short_description: A pixel-art run based safari park sim. Clone lions, medieval knights and sentient trucks into a park with no fences, then route your visitors past the chaos. You control the paths, the buildings and your robot staff. The one thing you don’t control is the animals.

4186890.title: Kitman
4186890.short_description: KITMAN is a 1-4 player job simulator set in the backrooms of a football stadium. Run the team by running the locker room. Clean the team’s boots, patch jerseys, mop floors, and when no-one is looking… sneak into the gaffer’s office and fix the game plan!

4187010.title: Kiosk 199X
4187010.short_description: Run a tiny 90s kiosk in a chaotic Eastern country - Kolkhozland. Serve quirky customers, survive inspections, pick a side in a local power struggle, and uncover a hidden conspiracy - all in a story-driven retro management sim full of humor and choices.

4187450.title: Gothic Steel
4187450.short_description: Gothic Steel is a grimdark, retro, survivor-like, wave shooter. Command a heavily armed tank against the horde, assemble your crew, and forge an unstoppable war machine.

4187750.title: Grimtrace
4187750.short_description: A monster-themed deduction game focused on solving brutal murders. Investigate crime scenes by uncovering hidden evidence, analyzing fingerprints, and testing blood samples. Identify the killer, determine the creature responsible, and solve seven thrilling cases

4188160.title: LOVEKO
4188160.short_description: Aha… so you want to know what real love is, huh? Then maybe… try this RPG.

4188500.title: Crawl To The Depths
4188500.short_description: Crawl to the Depths is a first-person dungeon crawler where you venture into a forgotten underworld. Explore procedurally generated voxel caves, battle dangerous creatures and build increasingly powerful weapons to face what lurks below.

4188590.title: The Interpreter
4188590.short_description: You are The Interpreter. Use voice recognition to interogate suspects and find out if they have been tainted. Explore the dystopian world of B26, controlling technology with your voice. Be the judge, jury and executioner.

4188900.title: Dulat
4188900.short_description: Dulat is a puzzle-platformer where you manipulate how you interact with matter to overcome obstacles and restart the universe. Embark on this adventure, unravel its mysteries, and discover the secrets behind a broken world.

4189120.title: Debauchery & Magic
4189120.short_description: In Haven, magic thrives and debauchery is strictly forbidden. Defy a ruthless new ruler as you and your friends quest, loot, party, and battle your way across the kingdom to bring freedom back to its people.

4189690.title: SuperBird
4189690.short_description: SuperBird is a roguelike deckbuilder starring birds and bugs. our cards crawl, grow, and even devour one another. Learn each bug’s quirks, build around them with powerful trinkets, and time your plays to perfection under the arena spotlight. Climb your way to the top and claim the crown!

4190310.title: CHOP CHOP FOR THE OLD GOD
4190310.short_description: Chop trees, throw logs into a wormhole, unlock upgrades, brew potions, find teleporters, unveil the map, and explore multiple endings.

4190610.title: Mini Pond Farm: Frogs & Lilypads
4190610.short_description: Collect all the cute frogs! Shape your pond paradise, fill it with colorful hoppers, make them happy with reeds and lilies, and enjoy pure cozy serenity.

4190760.title: The Fish Corner
4190760.short_description: Run your own cozy fish shop, collect unique breeds, care for your tanks, and decorate your home. Breed rare fish, manage customers, and grow your store. Build, customize, and create the aquarium life you dream of.

4191040.title: Punk Runner
4191040.short_description: A flying-car racing game set in a cyberpunk city, with spontaneous open-world outruns, heavy car customization, and high-speed chases that test your build.

4191980.title: Zip Up
4191980.short_description: As a stylist working for Hollywood's biggest celebrities, dress up your troublesome clients for their showbiz events and somehow manage a romance with a celebrity in this story-driven dress up game inspired by reality TV & Hollywood culture

4192370.title: Droste Detective
4192370.short_description: A recursive anomaly and psychological horror where you wake up stuck in an office corridor and find out there is a framed photo of the corridor on the wall. There is something very strange about this picture...

4192590.title: Poreia
4192590.short_description: Manipulate magnetic forces to solve puzzles and uncover the truth of the world in this 3D puzzle adventure - become a memory-lost cat robot and explore a mysterious world!

4193310.title: 水浒女神录
4193310.short_description: Every word you say will directly touch the hearts of Liangshan heroes through advanced AI technology, awaken their dormant star power, and even change their fate trajectory.

4193690.title: Terranigma
4193690.short_description: Thematic boldness. Stunning character design. Excellent music. Smooth gameplay. Terranigma had it all... except a modern re-release. Now, the beloved action JRPG classic is back for the first time since 1995!

4193770.title: Car Wash Together: Prologue - Early Days
4193770.short_description: A free introduction to the full version of Car Cleaner Simulator is your chance to make dreams come true in a fabulously clean business. Run a car wash for Clever Emma in Winston Springs.

4194230.title: Stream Survivors
4194230.short_description: Build a growing camp in a fresh take on the incremental genre. Farm endlessly spawning resource nodes, unlock upgrades and new buildings, and climb multiple leaderboards designed for both idle and active players. Play solo or in multiplayer with full Twitch integration.

4194570.title: Gray Space
4194570.short_description: Light is a luxury. Sanity is vital. Group up with your friends to escape a crumbling medical organization in GRAY SPACE. Scavenge for tools and resources. Run and hide from fear entities and other anomalies that lurk. Extract the antidote at all costs. A lo-fi first-person survival horror nightmare.

4194840.title: Mombo Combo Legacy
4194840.short_description: The most tongue-tastic hero is back! Jump, fight, and complete MOMBO COMBOS in a new journey packed with action, intense challenges, and monstrous bosses. Explore new worlds in this 2D platformer with powerful forms and a mighty army of pets! The world needs our little purple hero once again!

4194890.title: Reel Tiny
4194890.short_description: Become the fisherman you were always meant to be in Reel Tiny. Experience life as a tiny creature in a big world as you catch fish and make friends. Trade with the town to upgrade your lures and fishing rod. Earn new fishing licenses to explore new sections of the creek and become an angling legend!

4195000.title: SWOM
4195000.short_description: SWOM — a game where you survive after memory loss, using magic based on basic laws you discover during gameplay. Build shelters, explore the unexplored world, collect items and resources to survive and understand why you are here.

4195090.title: Sexy Chicken Girl Kisses Rotten Rabbit Man
4195090.short_description: Win over a hot girl in a silly point-and-click parody game! Explore her bedroom, solve clever puzzles, survive chaotic minigames, and discover unique relationship-based endings, from wholesome romance to ~youre in control~. A unofficial silly game made for the FNAF community, it's up to you.

4195200.title: Feast of the Beast Unleashed
4195200.short_description: "Top-down action and survival shooter, playable solo or cooperatively. Explore Valachia with your brother and face off against humans, lycanthropes, and rival vampiric clans as you advance toward the origin of TOX-Z, the toxin that is consuming the world."

4195210.title: Real Life: Dorm Affairs
4195210.short_description: Mike’s new job at a women’s dorm leads him into unexpected bonds, rising danger, and tough choices as local gangs target vulnerable students. Protect the girls, navigate romance, and face the city’s hidden threats.

4195890.title: Heather's Haunted House Party
4195890.short_description: While trying to plan a party that’s to die for, a high school queen bee finds she has an uninvited guest that is much scarier than your average teenage girl. A Visual Novel about gossip, grief and ghosts.

4196280.title: Tamerlane Chess
4196280.short_description: Not a chess. It is a war strategy. Tamerlane Chess is the digital version of the board Timur used to shape his battlefield tactics. With a larger board, unique pieces, and deep strategy, every move demands the mindset of a true commander.

4197010.title: Voidfall
4197010.short_description: Epic space strategy with 4X elements. Digital implementation of the printed board game by Mindclash Games. Base Game holds the competitive mode with 20 Scenarios and 14 playable factions. 1-4 players. AI opponent with 4 difficulty levels. Cross-platform and live and asynchronous gaming.

4197090.title: Scratch your Luck
4197090.short_description: Scratch tickets, upgrade your odds, and pay deadlines before you go broke.

4197280.title: Kingfisher - An Autism Tale
4197280.short_description: Experience how people with autism see, feel and interact with the world around them in this thrilling detective adventure, taking place near the Belgian coast and in the woods around a local nature reserve.

4197340.title: WHO THE HELL OPENED THE PORTAL?!
4197340.short_description: A funny pixel art roguelite strategy. You manage a fantasy island kingdom connected by magical portals. By day — build, gather resources, hire heroes, and dive through portals to expand into new lands. By night — defend! The same portals unleash hordes of demons straight from Hell.

4197390.title: FENDERSHOT
4197390.short_description: A lawless street racing league with the fiercest rivals and the latest Race Tech™. Can you and your crew handle the heat? Included in the box: Wild sense of speed. Split-Screen local multiplayer. Underglow Neons. 60+ FPS on Steam Deck.

4197690.title: 164: Fragile Ascent
4197690.short_description: 164 Floors. The ultimate test of mind and body. The ascent is simple, mechanical, yet unforgiving. Every step brings you closer to the summit… or your own annihilation. 164: Fragile Ascent is a first-person rhythm challenge where the certainty of the machine clashes with the fragility of the mind.

4198100.title: The Eternal Experiment
4198100.short_description: The Eternal Experiment is a first-person horror game set in a collapsing futuristic lab. A deadly creature hunts in total darkness. Survive by managing your inventory, crafting, and creative problem-solving as you navigate the lab and fight to escape with your life.

4199010.title: BOKUKAN5 TOKYO (HND) I am an Air Traffic Controller
4199010.short_description: The latest air traffic control puzzle is here! Set at Tokyo International Airport (HND/RJTT), experience two ways to enjoy the airport: Air Traffic Control Puzzle and the all-new Terminal Side. BOKUKAN evolves into a game where you can immerse yourself in the airport experience.

4199110.title: Gravitten
4199110.short_description: Take control of Gravitten, the gravity-defying kitten, and master the environment's shifting physics. Journey through 5 distinct biomes, manipulating gravity and perspective to solve intricate puzzles.

4199250.title: War Tactics
4199250.short_description: 《War Tactics》is a turn-based tactical game inspired by "Advance Wars". Command military units on square grids in modern warfare scenarios. Features deep tactics, intuitive controls, rich unit variety, complex terrain interactions, and single-player campaigns. Plan and conquer with your intellect.

4199690.title: War of Light: Liberation of Aetherquill
4199690.short_description: A 2.5D dark-fantasy action RPG with roguelike builds and a multi-ending story. Choose your hero, face unpredictable battles, draft items and equipment, and summon Roundtable allies. Shape Aetherquill’s fate through your decisions. Play solo or in two-player local co-op.

4200020.title: Chess You
4200020.short_description: Play classic chess against girls who tease, provoke, and challenge you.

4200110.title: Nekome: Nazi Hunter
4200110.short_description: Hunt and kill Nazis in a stealthy single-player campaign with bloody and brutal melee combat. Study your enemies, confirm your approach, and become an unexpected assassin fueled by violent revenge.

4200350.title: Twilight Haven
4200350.short_description: Twilight Haven is based in a wonderful, magical but also strange and dangerous place hidden far north of the country known as Hazeldawn. It is not a place you will find on any map, nor in any book, it is hidden from the eyes and minds of all those but the few souls that it chooses to bring home.

4200880.title: Unbowed
4200880.short_description: Choose your fate in this single-player pirate Soulslike where you explore cursed lands, battle eldritch horrors, and pillage any treasure you find. Death is only a temporary setback on the path to mastering brutal combat.

4200910.title: COREDUMP: 口口口口
4200910.short_description: COREDUMP: 口口口口 is a Metroidvania inspired puzzle platformer where you recover lost colliders, switch between phasing through walls and charged bouncing, and uncover hidden paths across an interconnected world.

4200960.title: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered
4200960.short_description: The shadows are your ally. Return to the city as Garrett, master thief, in this remastered classic by Nightdive Studios. Pickpocket, prowl, and outsmart in a world where trust is a luxury and every stolen secret comes at a price.

4201140.title: Dungeon of Departure
4201140.short_description: Trapped in a mysterious cave system, four dungeon explorers struggle to find a way out before the light fades forever... Navigate a mysterious underground as you navigate through multiple story paths in this text-based, pixel-art, dark fantasy rpg, visual novel computer game

4201250.title: FingBlade
4201250.short_description: Fingblade is a physics-driven Rogue-lite action game. Swing your mouse to control the weapon's real inertia, slashing through endless waves of enemies. Unlock 4 unique weapons, master Chain Lightning and Necromancy builds, and collect gems for permanent upgrades. If the blade breaks, you die.

4202020.title: Koimori
4202020.short_description: Turn your desktop into a living pond with this peaceful idle overlay. Let koi drift around while you work or relax, drop snacks to see them gather, and unlock rare koi patterns as you spend more time with your little friends.

4202190.title: VIRUS_31.EXE
4202190.short_description: Minimalist survivors-like built for short, snack-sized sessions. Pop enemies, earn bits, get stronger.

4203240.title: Childrens Story
4203240.short_description: Childrens Story is an Anthology Game that presents a growing collection of stories on VHS Tapes. Each tape contains a one-off story with unique plot and setting elements that evoke fear, wonder, and live entertainment. Tune-in Next Time!

4204240.title: Liar's Lift
4204240.short_description: Liar's Lift is a 3-8 player social competition. Use the elevator's emergency phone to communicate and solve challenges. Lie or play fair to earn points across multiple rounds. No one dies, but only one winner exits. In this lift, your reputation is the only thing at stake.

4204430.title: Maum
4204430.short_description: An online co-op horror game with up to 6 players. Collect potions and spells, use them wisely against enemies for protection or fun.

4205030.title: Legend Of Asha
4205030.short_description: Enter the Kingdom of Ngoma in the Legend of Asha, a Top-Down adventure set in a unique and vibrant Afro-Fantasy setting. Explore unique and beautiful landscapes, use and upgrade powerful elemental abilities, fight off enemies and defeat Thonarka the Ravager to restore balance to the land.

4205090.title: Heartlines
4205090.short_description: Heartlines: A choice-driven FPS. Under an angel's threat, you have 10 days to kill the demon hiding among 5 friends. Who is the victim? With 15+ endings, every choice leads to salvation or hell. Will you obey the light or find the truth?

4205170.title: Son Of A Dealer
4205170.short_description: Turn forgotten treasures into a thriving business in this narrative-driven second-hand shop simulator. Haggle for the best prices, uncover the stories behind every item, and build deep relationships with the townsfolk. Your choices shape not just your shop, but your life.

4206080.title: Neidfyre
4206080.short_description: Neidfyre is a turn-based duel game forged in fire and steel. Step into a cursed land of no escape. Survive against those who stand in your way and fulfill your purpose.

4206100.title: SlotsNStocks
4206100.short_description: Rig the market in this deckbuilding slot machine roguelite. Draft hundreds of bullish and bearish symbols, build money-making combinations, and manipulate the odds in your favor. Adapt to an ever-shifting market and make enough to survive your next margin call.

4207360.title: 2P连接中
4207360.short_description: In the virtual world known as MoMoLand, bugs are no longer glitches but the tools you rely on for survival and breaking the rules. Your goal is to navigate through limited, sandbox-style maps, using various bugs to evade patrolling service robots and ultimately reach the exit.

4207450.title: FlockSol
4207450.short_description: FlockSol is an incremental top-down survival game. Light up the dark and defeat the monsters hiding inside. Spend their essences to unlock and upgrade your skills. Summon your past souls to fight alongside you. Reach your full potential, survive the night and cleanse the world of darkness.

4207560.title: Gay It Loud
4207560.short_description: Dating in the dreamy shopping mall of 1995! Hang out at the food court, have sloppy makeouts in the dressing room, loiter in the arcade, and collect nostalgic toys.

4207610.title: Down We Go
4207610.short_description: A roguelite horror descent across the dimensions under the whim of a supercomputer planet; you are a delver, tasked with exploring, researching, and cataloging what you can find.

4207650.title: Almamon
4207650.short_description: Bond with mons and uncover a clash of cosmic powers in this turn based RPG. Choose to battle with deep strategic moment to moment decisions or as a chill autobattler.

4207890.title: Giri-Jump Star Rush
4207890.short_description: Experience the ultimate Giri-Jump! Looks impossible, but can you make the jump? Escape all kinds of close calls with a single jump! Master Giri-Jump in this extreme side-scrolling action game! Meticulously crafted Giri-Jump points, tuned down to the pixel, await your challenge.

4207980.title: Cook Together
4207980.short_description: Cook Together is a chaotic co-op drug creating game where you and your friend run a basement lab, to create drugs for big boss. Finish the product in time without blowing yourselves up. Upgrade your lab, perfect the purity of your products and become the biggest producer in town.

4208160.title: Frontiers of the Realms
4208160.short_description: Build a realm and a deck to match. Grow villages into cities, shape production chains and play cards for supplies, expansion and tactical support. A turn-based strategy game where rivals act in the same round. Play against AI or challenge friends online.

4208390.title: DELUCID
4208390.short_description: An atmospheric horror game set within an inescapable dream. Trapped in a dark forest, you must explore, forage, and uncover rare ingredients to craft the one potion capable of waking you up.

4208630.title: Wheels Echo: The Winter Chronicle
4208630.short_description: Wheels Echo is a winter survival story where your thoughts shape the journey. As Fred Walker, explore a silent frozen world, write down clues in your notebook, uncover mysteries, survive the cold, and piece together what happened to everyone — and to you.

4208990.title: Black Autumn: 1438
4208990.short_description: A realistic medieval pixel art RPG set in the Hron valley in the autumn of 1438. Fight in armour you put on piece by piece, ride horses into battle, pick locks and purses, and gamble with cards or dice. No magic and no monsters, only the real Hron valley as it was in 1438.

4209850.title: Rustown
4209850.short_description: Five years after the “idiot virus” pandemic, a letter arrives from the father you thought was dead. Rustown is a story-driven stealth adventure about finding him in a slum where the infected live. Evade watchful eyes, follow clues, and discover the stories of those caught up in the city's troubles.

4209930.title: 挂机后花园.放置牧场AFK back garden.idlepasture
4209930.short_description: Create your personal oasis in the corner of your desktop.​ This is a laid-back idle simulation game where simple clicks allow you to grow plants and feed adorable animals. Watch them thrive and multiply, receive surprise letters and gifts, and let the serene ambiance of nature fill your screen.
developers: 她山之石Stones from Other Hills
publishers: 她山之石Stones from Other Hills

4209940.title: Monster Meals: Big Bite Diner
4209940.short_description: Cook bizarre meals for hungry monsters using ingredients you gather while exploring. Upgrade your diner through a daily loop of exploring, cooking and serving. Play solo or with friends in full co-op.

4210030.title: W.A.R.D.
4210030.short_description: Assume control of an evil intergalactic megacorporation in this sci-fi tower defense. Build a mining infrastructure on alien moons and exoplanets, exploit their precious resources, and defend your operation against defiant natives.

4210100.title: AENIGMA
4210100.short_description: Set in the year 4XXX, humanity lives disconnected inside underground megastructures to escape the threat of the ever-expanding silicon-based lifeforms.

4210140.title: Brofish
4210140.short_description: Brofish is an autobattler roguelite with Tower Defense elements. Catch and upgrade bizarre fish, combine items, effects, and hold back waves of undead to save the village from the Sea King!

4210370.title: Guardians Planetfall
4210370.short_description: From the creators of Guardians Frontline, Guardians Planetfall drops you into a galaxy-wide war for the fate of humanity. Fight assembled into squads of up to 4 soldiers in fast, tactical VR combat across space and dangerous planets filled with aliens, Void soldiers, and massive war machines.

4210400.title: Lounge Café
4210400.short_description: Lounge Café is an atmospheric coffee shop simulator where you play as Sara from Lucerne, running a small café in Binoville. Choose beans, craft drinks, and compete in the city’s major coffee tournament to become the best.

4210810.title: NIGHT SHIFT: HAUNTED MALL
4210810.short_description: The mall closed at midnight. The ghosts didn't. 1–6 friends. 5 lost items. 1 date with Mika… and only one of you gets it. Frying pans, bazookas, banana peels: anything goes. And don't scream: the ghosts can hear your mic.

4210820.title: Pirate Troops
4210820.short_description: Follow the journey of Sammy Shortlegs in this fun yet mysterious tale! Uncover the whereabouts of powerful pirate relics lost to time, and confront the terrifying Shadowbeard.

4211060.title: Meaningless Random Numbers
4211060.short_description: Meaningless Random Numbers is an Incremental Horror Game about earning money through Random Number Generators but be cautious, God is Watching...

4211350.title: MAEVOR
4211350.short_description: MAEVOR is a 1-4 player co-op horror game set in a cursed forest where every sound can get you killed. Recover three ancient artifacts, break the Harpy Vampire Demon's curse, and survive against creatures that hunt by sound while fear distorts your senses.

4211380.title: Loop Tower
4211380.short_description: Loop Tower tells the story of adventurers climbing an endless tower. Place it on a corner of your desktop and help them continue their ascent. Experience a fresh blend of desktop idle gameplay + roguelike + RPG right now!

4211490.title: Fast Food Wars
