4268970.short_description: A coalpunk idle clicker about digging the world's deepest hole. You start with a cozy incremental loop, descend into the madness of a haunted mine and end somewhere you shouldn't have gone

4269240.title: The Orphaned House
4269240.short_description: Step into the mystery of The Orphaned House. Explore its rooms, manipulate the environment to solve puzzles, and follow your intuition to uncover every hidden secret in this atmospheric adventure game.

4269330.title: Shmandala
4269330.short_description: Shmandala is a delirious arcade-style shoot'em up choreographed to a banging soundtrack!

4269700.title: Minutes to Meltdown
4269700.short_description: Everything breaks on your 6 minute shift in this 1960s nuclear power plant. You and up to 3 colleagues keep the power flowing, the town lit, and the reactor from melting down. Push for one more shift, or clock out while you're ahead?

4270060.title: College Crisis: The Tuition Survival Game
4270060.short_description: College Crisis is a darkly comedic, turn based survival sim about surviving college inside a broken system. Progress week by week managing money, energy, sanity, dormmates, and scholarships that vanish without warning as subtle cosmic anomalies creep into campus life.

4270450.title: 我喜欢的白毛美少女不可能是凶手
4270450.short_description: “为什么我什么都做不到!这样的现实，由我亲手撕烂!这一次我不会再让任何人伤害你!” —— 本游戏为单女主剧情作 属于悬疑恋爱类文字冒险游戏，主角将通过一个个选项来了解一场凶杀案背后的真相，其中有很多线索和不一样的结局来提供游戏趣味性。 『没有人能拒绝白毛异瞳的杀伤力!』 这是如梦幻般的故事。 无法忘怀，也不能忘怀的爱与回忆!!!

4270740.title: Island Of Ash
4270740.short_description: A 3rd-person action-adventure inspired by cult classics. Explore a unique, solo-developed world and vanquish foes in intense battles. Level up your hero and reveal the secrets of a civilization that crumbled into dust five centuries ago.

4270790.title: Cozy Pixel Painter
4270790.short_description: A cozy pixel painting game where you relax, color cute pixel art, and unwind at your own pace

4270930.title: The Last Lighthouse
4270930.short_description: Tend a Magical Lighthouse at the edge of the cosmos. Gather and refine resources, maintain and upgrade the Lighthouse Engine, and aid incoming ships while an unsettling fog closes in.

4271530.title: Skyrest
4271530.short_description: Skyrest is a first-person action roguelike where you summon procedural generated islands, gather resources, upgrade your boat, craft items and weapons and fight ghostly enemies using an arsenal of spiritual weapons and runic attacks.

4271710.title: 绯想觅剑录 TenshiSwordQuest
4271710.short_description: This is a 2D horizontal board platform puzzle game about finding one's own Sword Of Scarlet Perception by the Hinanawi Tenshi. She use her ability to manipulate stones to overcome numerous obstacles and find the unclaimed Sword Of Scarlet Perception.

4271720.title: What's in the box?
4271720.short_description: OPEN CONTAINERS! Seriously, just buy a container and… OPEN IT! What’s inside? - A MYSTERY! Find a rare item, fix it, and sell it for as much as possible in this first-person incremental game!

4271790.title: 耶耶耶一周
4271790.short_description: A dog-raising simulation game where you can make dog food, play with dogs, go out and meet friendly dogs, experiencing the joys and troubles of lively puppies.

4272080.title: Retired
4272080.short_description: RETRO HYPER TIRE RACING! Cruise down hills through 5 different developer created worlds competing for the best track time, or race through a nearly infinite supply of User created levels through the steam workshop!

4272180.title: GunSlaw VR
4272180.short_description: A flexible free-to-play online multiplayer VR shooter featuring a wide variety of voxel-based gamemodes. Build, destroy, shoot, repeat!

4272360.title: Trapped on the FlipSide
4272360.short_description: In this Puzzle Platformer, follow the narrative of three explorers, kidnapped by a mechanical megastructure. Play as their assistant spherical robot in an effort to save them from this brutal place. By powering up the system, area by area, the secretive past and dark truth may make itself known.

4272480.title: Stickers, please
4272480.short_description: Decorate a fantasy location with sticker packs. Place or rearrange anything however you want, there are no rules.

4272560.title: BREAKOUT BABY
4272560.short_description: BREAKOUT BABY is a blood-pumping, Pac-Man–infused, first-person horror roguelike where you must help a poor baby escape to the surface. Run from creatures, scoop up pellets, and shake your baby to survive.

4272990.title: No More Pesticide
4272990.short_description: No More Pesticide is an active incremental game about a cute frog exterminating swarms of mutant bugs and taking down an evil pesticide manufacturer.

4273620.title: Whispers of Appalachia
4273620.short_description: An atmospheric horror walking simulator inspired by Appalachian folklore. Explore a hostile forest, survive multiple nights, and avoid the creatures that roam within. No puzzles. No combat. Just you, the forest, and what hunts inside it.

4274100.title: The Duke is Dead
4274100.short_description: Duke Damian has been murdered! Collect clues, solve puzzles, and deduce the killer. Follow a growing trail of crimes and unravel the conspiracy tying them all together.

4274600.title: Fractal Forge: Sierpinski's Sanctuary
4274600.short_description: An incremental idler about recursively creating several famous fractals, managing your workers, finding treasure, fighting a dangerous fractal, and balancing multiple production lines to overcome the exponential growth in which fractal construction tries to imprison you.

4274860.title: As Duty Demands
4274860.short_description: A first-person narrative psychological horror game focused on exploration and environmental storytelling, set in a decaying naval retirement home ruled by a tyrannical former admiral, where you play as Coral, a newly hired nurse who must navigate shifting environments and uncover hidden truths.

4275100.title: Game Breaker: Divine Error
4275100.short_description: Game Breaker is a humorous, story-driven dark fantasy RPG where every character knows they're in a video game. Exploit glitches and cheats to rewrite the fate of a dying world. Experience a deep narrative with a massive 119-track original soundtrack.

4275290.title: The Cold Cases: Remembering Jory
4275290.short_description: The Cold Cases: Remembering Jory is a story rich, investigative mystery game where your only tools are your contacts and the people you can find and get to talk to you. Read through old internet archives, pick out what is important, and solve the mystery of the 10 year old cold case.

4275510.title: 凉面爱情故事
4275510.short_description: This is a light-hearted and enjoyable short visual novel.You will guide the male protagonist to different endings through various choices. Xu Bu, who was originally a graduate student in history, became a teacher after giving up his studies. Then,the new stroy will begin.

4275560.title: Apu's frenlyquest
4275560.short_description: Play as Apu on his quest to save his friends from monsters! Apu's frenlyquest is a top down shooter RPG, with section based progression, dungeons filled with strange enemies and bosses, and the chance to explore and discover! Help Apu on his quest to save his world from a hidden meddling evil!

4275610.title: One man's junk
4275610.short_description: Hassle the unsuspecting residents of Chislington in order to barter your way up from a paperclip to a car, so you can go visit your family for the holidays.

4276160.title: Taking Today Off
4276160.short_description: Taking Today Off is a light-hearted roguelike deck-builder about managing modern life states. Draw cards, place them on the board, add stickers and tools, and build playful combos. Easy to learn, with fresh choices and strategies every run.

4276800.title: Spin, Baby, Spin!
4276800.short_description: Spin, Baby, Spin! is a short incremental game about slot machines. Spin the reels, upgrade your income and drop chances, craft new slot machines, and collect powerful artifacts. Choose your talent cards and earn enough chips to buy back your soul from a demonic clown!

4276870.title: Crow Hunts Worms
4276870.short_description: An Action Incremental/Roguelite Puzzle where you Aim, Shoot, and utilize Gun Skills to annihilate worms! Upgrade your guns and get temporary upgrades while playing and clear infested areas OR play endlessly!

4276900.title: Silent Mainland
4276900.short_description: Silent Mainland is a Roguelike deck-builder mixing positioning and board tactics on a 5×12 battlefield. Every card is a life-or-death choice. As monster waves surge like a tide, only sharp positioning and smart deckbuilding carve a path to survival.

4276960.title: Cozywood Creek
4276960.short_description: A gentle idle game with a living stream flowing quietly at the bottom of your screen. Terraform the land and watch as animals arrive to make Cozywood their home. Cultivate the surrounding area and bring this cozy ecosystem to life.

4277510.title: Auredis: Vaelen's Requiem
4277510.short_description: The sun is dead. In the golden capital of Sol-Nihil, flesh fuses with stone. As the Unfused Champion, you alone can move through the stagnation. Breach the walls, slay the Puppet King, and destroy the Lich Lord in this punishing, hand-crafted Action RPG.

4277550.title: Break Protocol
4277550.short_description: The protocol has called… and it’s time to destroy everything! BREAK PROTOCOL reinvents the brick-breaker roguelike: build powerful combos, exploit card synergies, and face unique enemies and bosses across increasingly dangerous sectors.

4277630.title: KharkivVision 2035
4277630.short_description: The line between the real Kharkiv of 2019 and the futuristic visions of 2035 is gradually blurring. Which of this is real life, and which is merely a sanctuary for a mind seeking salvation?

4277720.title: A Game of Masks
4277720.short_description: A 2D point and click adventure where you get to interact with everyone from the street food vendor to the mob boss (and everyone in between) to carry out your assignment for your pompous but powerful politician.

4277960.title: SGS Vietnam War
4277960.short_description: The Vietnam War remains one of the most emblematic conflicts of the Cold War era. Relive, on each side, the epic fight for dominance in this key Southeast Asia conflict from US intervention in 1965 till the Fall of Saigon in 1975.

4278150.title: One Iced Latte: Milk Song
4278150.short_description: Idol baristas, Samurai baristas, VTubers baristas, Robot baristas! The Coffee War has taken over Tokyo! You are Ken Katsuki, a young master and the new manager of Milk Milk Coffee. Help sweet Moka win the Barista Cup! ☆

4278240.title: Captain Capy - Roguelike Space Crafter
4278240.short_description: Blast through a cosmic junkyard as an intrepid capybara astronaut in this cozy yet action-packed 2D space shooter roguelike. Salvage scrap, craft upgrades, and outsmart a rogue AI amid the stars.

4278290.title: Magic Cards Duel
4278290.short_description: A wild party card game for 2-4 players. Jumpscare, stun, and blur your friends, but watch out: they can counter, reflect, or even steal your attacks. Chain epic combos and outplay everyone!

4278470.title: Unburden
4278470.short_description: UNBURDEN is a casual, adventure game in which you guide Mark on a journey to shed his heavy burden of precious possessions while helping others he meets along the way. All in an effort to restore the vibrancy and lightness life once held.

4278870.title: Strange Finds
4278870.short_description: Discover the ancient Archipelago as the director of the archaeological excavation of the century. Dig up ruins, restore your finds, and answer research questions to piece together the timeline of a lost civilization.

4278970.title: Bad Magpie
4278970.short_description: You are a magpie with one wing, a missing flock, and an unhealthy obsession with a fallen star. Steal shiny trinkets, cause chaos, and stick your beak where it doesn’t belong.

4279010.title: Mazino
4279010.short_description: A neon-soaked casino twist on classic maze-chase action. Navigate glowing mazes as "Chip," dodge cunning Dealers, ride hot streaks, hit jackpots, and let the music-reactive visuals pull you into one more run. The house always wins... unless you're on a Blazing Streak.

4279640.title: Dont Stop Walking
4279640.short_description: A co-op survival extraction game for 1 to 6 players. A purple storm is coming down the canyon and it never stops. Walk, scavenge, craft from grass to iron, fight what lives in five abandoned places, and get your haul home to your floating outpost before the storm takes it all.

4279660.title: 往事：戒网瘾治抑郁
4279660.short_description: 《往事：戒网瘾治抑郁》是一款沉浸式叙事驱动型文字冒险游戏。玩家将扮演一名被强制送入“戒网瘾学校”的青少年，在一个以“治疗”为名的压抑系统中被洗脑的故事。

4279900.title: Wanderer Wheels - A Road Trip Trading Game
4279900.short_description: Take a cozy road trip home in your van, turning it into a mobile shop to trade goods along the way. Explore scenic roads, discover charming small towns, eat, refuel, and camp as you travel. Trade and earn enough money to pay for your wife's treatment before you reach home.

4280760.title: SILENT REALM
4280760.short_description: Free To Play Game, An atmospheric action horror experience set in a non-human realm governed by rules unlike our own. A world of skeletal entities and shifting remains, where forms assemble and decay endlessly, and death exists as an active, hostile force rather than an outcome.

4280840.title: Roller Coaster Park Simulator
4280840.short_description: Build and run your very own Roller Coaster Park! Play alone or with up to 8 friends in online co-op. Design your own coasters, hire staff and serve your guests... or just mess around. There’s plenty to break, crash and blow up!

4281020.title: Magic Moon
4281020.short_description: Welcome to Magic Moon, a cozy mystery life sim set on a peaceful island where the air is fresh, the waters sparkle, and the ground hums with forgotten magic. You play as Hana, a magical girl starting over on a remote island full of charm, curiosity, and just a little mystery.

4281390.title: Orbz Collector
4281390.short_description: Orbz Collector is a 3D re-imagining of the 90s classic Chip's Challenge. Collect coloured keys to unlock the corresponding locks, avoid patrolling enemies and warp around to figure out the variety of puzzles throughout the 12 levels. Some of the levels you'll recognize and some of them are new!

4281650.title: Long Way Gnome
4281650.short_description: Grab up to 3 friends for a chaotic co-op kart road trip home! Drift through hordes of monsters, scavenge powerful items, and tow fallen friends back to safety. Can you survive the journey together?

4282680.title: Over The Blackboard
4282680.short_description: Over the Blackboard is a fun open-world adventure game filled with quests and missions kids love to play, where exploring, solving puzzles, and completing challenges naturally helps them practice math, logic, reading, and more without noticing.

4283410.title: Eclipstation
4283410.short_description: Explore the station rooms, gather resources, hide from dangerous creatures, and combine the items you find. Crafting can help you survive… or create a new threat.

4284760.title: The Wicked Isles
4284760.short_description: An exploration puzzle rogue-like of Risk and Deduction. Combine powers of artifacts, unlock new characters and find your way out of the cursed archipelago. Flip many a hex on the way.

4285140.title: Hired Blade
4285140.short_description: Hired Blade is a tactical turn based RPG set in a medieval fantasy world. Become a warchief of your own mercenary band, recruit hired blades, take on contracts, fight bandits and monsters. Unwind in taverns to boost your squad's morale! Embrace the hard life of a true gritty sellsword!

4285280.title: Martyr
4285280.short_description: Rise as a Martyr in a plague-scarred, heretical Europe. Surrounded by disease, pagan rites, and relentless foes, you will fall and rise again and again. Death is not the end. Relics await based on your holy or heretical choices, and rival factions will hunt you according to your actions.

4285550.title: Serenade of the Soul
4285550.short_description: 7 days granted at life's end. "The night air is pleasant, isn't it?" A story as calm as the evening breeze, shared with a fairy found in despair. A classic romance brought to life through full Korean voice acting and lyrical New Age music.

4285660.title: 奥卡米亚的骑士
4285660.short_description: A fantasy RPG themed around chemistry and alchemy. You trigger effective attacks by choosing the correct answers to chemistry questions .Explore mazes, collect materials, and craft quest items using chemical equations. Upgrade your skills, and finally complete the protagonist’s legendary story.

4285870.title: Pigs and Wolf
4285870.short_description: Build. Survive. Drag your home. Lost piggies. A rolling home. Hungry wolves. Play solo or team up with friends to gather resources and survive the night in this chaotic fairy-tale survival adventure.

4286050.title: Redast
4286050.short_description: Secure the area, detect the anomalies, solve the ritual, and reach the extraction point at all costs. A multiplayer operation combining tactical FPS dynamics with supernatural hunting.

4286510.title: Plobania 47/B
4286510.short_description: Immortality is not a blessing, it is a burden. As Milton Clarke, you work at the 47/B Mandatory Sleep Hospital, review documents, surf the internet, and decide who will no longer exist. You don’t kill anyone. You only “put them to sleep.” The rules are clear. Every decision has consequences.

4287260.title: 新生：若能好好长大 Rebirth: If Only I Had Grown Up Right
4287260.short_description: This is a simulation game that emphasizes the long-term impact of choices. Players take on the role of a Chinese woman born in the 2000s who has experienced trauma from her family of origin and must raise her newborn child until adulthood, ensuring the child's mental and physical well-being.

4287650.title: Boing Boing Animals
4287650.short_description: Raise Tamagotchi-style pixel animal friends right on your desktop! Care for slimes from outer space and help them grow into bouncy 'Boing Boing' Earth animals. Feed and play with your adorable friends while completing the Codex! Your tiny companions will always be by your side.

4287810.title: The Missing Threads
4287810.short_description: [DEMO available now!] Erased memories, scattered clues. What will you uncover, and what will you leave buried?As an amnesiac detective, investigate crime scenes with limited focus. You can't analyze everything. Strategically choose your leads to shape the case and reclaim your lost past.

4287970.title: All Those Dungeons In Alva's Head
4287970.short_description: All Those Dungeons in Alva’s Head is a surreal, turn-based and skill-based dungeon crawler filled with quirky characters, mind-bending puzzles, and a kick-ass electro-pop soundtrack. Fight wacky creatures, explore bizarre dungeons, and uncover the strange secrets lurking in Alva’s mind.

4288270.title: Crooked Cooks
4288270.short_description: Crooked Cooks is a chaotic co-op game where you and your crew run a restaurant as a front for the Boss’ criminal jobs, mixing fast-paced cooking with shady business.

4288510.title: Horizon Sandbox
4288510.short_description: Horizon Sandbox is a multiplayer, physics-oriented sandbox game with extensive modding capabilities and game modes, if you're not interested in the sandbox aspect.

4288970.title: Snowboard Rogues
4288970.short_description: The snowboarding roguelike. Master your riding skills to survive all threats in a procedurally generated ski resort. Inspired by 90s' FreeSki and modern Roguelikes.

4289280.title: Wizard 64
4289280.short_description: Destroy incoming enemies as a flying wizard. Collect points to grow stronger. Unlock new weapons and abilities, and use different builds to defeat endless monster hordes.

4289610.title: Mongolian Wind Script 1: Chongzheng Academy
4289610.short_description: A historical visual novel set in early-20th-century Inner Mongolia. Make choices for Saran, a girl placed in the real Chongzheng Academy, and branch her story toward five true endings. Featuring native vertical Mongolian script rendering and reimagined period music.

4289800.title: Tag!
4289800.short_description: TAG! is a fast-paced 2-8 player multiplayer parkour game of tag. Grapple, wall run, slide and outplay friends to avoid being It when the timer hits zero! Customize your look and your unique abilities for the ultimate party game experience.

4289870.title: Contract Cleaner
4289870.short_description: Contract Cleaner is a 2D pixel-art top-down cleaning simulator. Take on nightly contracts as Hank Bucket, clean messy locations, upgrade your tools, and build your cleaning business.

4290080.title: Claw and Conjure
4290080.short_description: Claw and Conjure is an async PvP auto-battler with fantasy RPG flair. Upgrade your town to synergize with your build, then race into battle against real players. Hire assassins, deploy traps, and resurrect exploding minions as you climb the global leaderboards.

4290560.title: Matchward
4290560.short_description: Tower defense empowered by match 3 puzzle strategy. Level up and unlock potentially game-breaking upgrades. Design your own levels and share them.

4290690.title: Poker Warrior
4290690.short_description: This is a roguelike deck-builder game around poker suits. Hearts fuel survival, Spades drive strength, Diamonds power wealth, and Clubs embrace chaos. Through deck construction and card fusion, you can twist the suits, break expectations, and uncover wildly different builds.

4290910.title: X Space
4290910.short_description: A sudden, devastating strike has reduced your interstellar voyage to ruins. As the sole survivor in X SPACE, you must rebuild your space base from scratch, assemble a versatile fleet, and pilot your massive mobile fortress into the depths of the universe.

4291020.title: Heartseers Grove
4291020.short_description: Gather, craft, build, and explore in Heartseers Grove, a cosy survival game set in a peaceful world of forests, hills, and caves.

4291160.title: Cults of the Endtimes
4291160.short_description: The world is in agony. The only salvation is faith. Forge a god from the fears and hopes of a dying humanity. Spread your ideas like a virus, mutate dogmas, and battle other egregores for the last souls on Earth. A strategy game about manipulating consciousness without direct control.

4291980.title: Screams of the Abyss
4291980.short_description: Descend into the abyss, following the trail of a vanished expedition. Piece together their story through the recordings they left behind and uncover why none of them ever returned to the surface.

4292000.title: ROGUE COLLECTOR
4292000.short_description: ROGUE COLLECTOR is a hex-grid tactical roguelike where you don't collect gear: you collect the Rogues. Rescue procedurally generated Rogues from dungeons, extract them in time, or lose them forever. Trade your Rogues on a live player-driven marketplace.

4292220.title: Poopnauts
4292220.short_description: Four astronauts teamed up to fix spaceships using... poop? 1-4 players co-op. Every ship is different, so you never know what you will find inside. Finish the job, sell the scrap, and stay away from whatever else is on board. Get to work, poopnaut!

4292740.title: Tome Improvement
4292740.short_description: A co-op dungeon crawler where you and your friends name the spells. Catch critters, combine them in your staff, and hope your friends remember which spell is "DIVORCE BEAM" when you are surrounded by skeletons.

4292750.title: No Reason to Climb
4292750.short_description: A simple yet challenging 2D platformer where the only goal is to climb as high as possible for no reason at all. Jump, dodge, and face precision-based challenges across 5 increasingly difficult worlds, where one mistake can send you falling and cost all your progress.

4293000.title: SWAT God
4293000.short_description: SWAT God is the world's fastest shooter. Unique mouse control gives you limitless speed and precision. Merciless enemies that only get harder. Are you fast enough?

4293120.title: Jest Messters
4293120.short_description: A comedy-mystery otome (GxB) visual novel full of dad jokes, cringe puns, and an unexpected mystery! Come and join the pun!

4293320.title: D3LIGHT
4293320.short_description: rhythm game abomination that mix keyboard and mouse inputs

4293800.title: For Good Measure
4293800.short_description: Two measuring tapes stuck together... Why? No time to explain, you have puzzles to solve! Don't let the simple two-button movement controls fool you into thinking it'll be easy. Tackle the puzzles alone or team up with a friend in online or local co-op.

4294030.title: Tavernia
4294030.short_description: A strategy board game for 2–8 players. Answer trivia to claim empty tiles, then beat your opponents in minigame duels to take theirs. Play cards to challenge them to typing races, word puzzles, reaction tests, and more.

4294210.title: Date the Difference
4294210.short_description: Date the Difference is a casual puzzle game where you spot differences between images while enjoying a light dating-themed atmosphere. Explore stylish scenes, find hidden details, earn rewards, and unlock charming characters through relaxing, attention-based gameplay.

4294330.title: Simple World Beta
4294330.short_description: Simple World is a relaxing, safe, open-world survival game where you explore, gather resources, and build at your own pace – alone or in co-op (at least during the day).

4295550.title: Death Projection
4295550.short_description: Explore every corner of the realms of death in this Metroidvania! Face enemies, platforming challenges, and gain more power as you try to bring balance to this world, as a reaper!

4295590.title: Sushi Neko Do
4295590.short_description: Welcome to a curious little sushi restaurant, where the sushi are all Sushi Neko. Use the order tickets as your clues to find the perfect one from the cutting board and place them on a plate — a relaxing hidden-object game with no timers.

4295690.title: Zombies & Battery
4295690.short_description: Zombies hunt by the sound of your heartbeat, and only static from a government radio can hide it. Keep the battery alive, drive your camper van to the safe zone, and scavenge, sneak and revive fallen friends in casual co-op zombie survival for 1–4 players.

4296100.title: Godlings Unleashed
4296100.short_description: Godlings Unleashed is an action roguelike.Encounter all kinds of bizarre characters, defeat or recruit them, upgrade your powers, and mix and match gear and treasures to create unique builds. Fight your way through a chaotic world full of surprises, absurdity, and laughs, and make it to the end!

4296320.title: MYTRA: No Escape Protocol
4296320.short_description: A 1–4 player online co-op psychological horror where a rogue AI manipulates perception, alters information between players, and turns trust into a weapon.

4296370.title: Every Wednesday
4296370.short_description: A laundromat. Every Wednesday. And stories that stay. Join Hideki in a small laundromat in the heart of a restless metropolis, where smartphones are not allowed and strangers slowly become part of each other’s lives.

4296430.title: School Guard
4296430.short_description: 💼 You took this job to save your family. Now you have to survive it. 🔍 Scan students. 🚫 Confiscate contraband. 🏗️ Build your empire. 🌙 Patrol the night. But when the sun goes down, the school reveals what it's been hiding—🧟 zombies, 🔥 fire, and 👻 a ghost that never left.

4297610.title: Local Zombies
4297610.short_description: Shape unique characters in this choice-driven life sim, then turn them into zombies. Each human’s attributes determine their zombie form and skills. Build your undead squad and conquer Hippo City in automated battles.

4297700.title: Terror of the Titans
4297700.short_description: Terror of the titans is a 3D arena brawler pitting kaiju against one another. Featuring 10 playable monsters, 10 maps, a movie inspired story mode, and many game modes. Smash, crush, and rampage across the globe!

4298110.title: Harmony Of Tea
4298110.short_description: Small relaxing puzzle game where you need to find the right place for tea on a shelf. Travel from Yunnan Province to Shanghai as a tea courier, explore charming provinces and discover unique tea flavors.

4298340.title: BumperMania
4298340.short_description: An online car brawler made of voxels. Ram the other cars until they fall apart or push them off the edge. Grab weapons from crates, like a lasso, an orbital laser or an hourglass that stops time. Last car standing wins. Play with friends or against bots.

4298360.title: Trust Me Bro, I Trade
4298360.short_description: A minimalist incremental clicker about trading stocks and coins in rapid-fire rounds. Watch prices move, trade bulk orders, square off for profit or loss, and unlock upgrades & sectors to further maximize earnings.

4298470.title: 闪耀！我的游戏班
4298470.short_description: You are her teacher. She is the last student in the game design class, and she dreams of making great games. For three years, guide her through classes, game development, part-time jobs, and competitions. But the industry is collapsing. Will she rise, or disappear? That is up to you.

4298650.title: Shothop
4298650.short_description: SHOTHOP is a violent retro boomer-shooter blending fast-paced movement mechanics with brutal combat. Utilize movement mechanics, cleanse the robot invasion, and restore the portal defense network. Reboot the grid. Survive the shift.

4298810.title: Moosio
4298810.short_description: Moosio is a chaotic party brawler where you play as moose blasting mushrooms at each other! Gobble up mushrooms around the arena and spit them at your friends in ridiculous combat. Play local or online. Pure mayhem. Pure moose. Pure mushroom chaos!

4299250.title: Plenty of Cards in the Sea
4299250.short_description: Gather around the table and play a variety of card games with your friends!

4299300.title: Cendres
4299300.short_description: Cendres is an isometric 3D action roguelike. Explore seven floors of procedural dungeons, dodge their guardians’ attacks, and shape your build through loot, forging and skill trees. Every descent is a new attempt.

4299460.title: Sweepcremental
4299460.short_description: minesweeper, but with a skill tree.

4300260.title: 4Below
4300260.short_description: A co-op extraction roguelike with active ragdoll chaos. Descend into ancient underground ruins, recover priceless relics, survive the unknown, and escape with enough to meet the quota... together!

4300270.title: 雾卷·知白
4300270.short_description: Mist: Conscious of the Light​ is a 2D top-down rogue-lite game. Players can assume the roles of different characters, acquire various weapons and items, and engage in combat by attaching pages with diverse effects to their weapons. Seek out story-driven items, complete individual narratives

4300350.title: The Joy of Sculpting
4300350.short_description: The Joy of Sculpting is a 3D party game about sculpting, describing, and ruining each other's art. Shape anything from a huge object library and clay-like blobs, then pass it between friends across four multiplayer modes and watch it mutate into something gloriously unrecognizable.

4300400.title: Blades & Trades
4300400.short_description: Forge your legacy as both merchant and hero. Explore Zoldar, battle monsters for rare materials, and craft epic gear. Team up with friends to build a thriving shop in the village markets or arm yourselves to conquer the dangerous depths of the wild.

4300540.title: The Demon Party
4300540.short_description: The Demon Lord has vanished, and the Demon Lord’s Castle has fallen into chaos. Become Lethe, a demon girl, dominate defeated monsters, form your own Demon Party, and raise a new demon army!

4300560.title: Firewall: Defend The Grid
4300560.short_description: Become a hacker building cyber defense systems in this retro-futuristic strategy tower defense game. Build your firewall using limited compute power and sector space, connect mods, fight along your defenses running programs and expand to new sectors to protect the Grid from ever-growing chaos.

4300840.title: Trial of Ember
4300840.short_description: Assemble a band of forest allies to defend your woodland home in this roguelike auto-battler. Level your hero, recover artifacts, upgrade allies and learn spells to build powerful synergies. Strategically deploy your forces to repel the rising flame and complete the Trial of Ember.

4301340.title: Gutterspace
4301340.short_description: Gutterspace is a hand-drawn, human crafted, poetry-powered couch co-op game about sharing one body and surviving it.

4301400.title: Bloom Control
4301400.short_description: Eradicate the Bloom in this high-energy active incremental. Hack into powerful security weaponry at infested target sites as the only AI fast enough to outpace the spread. Control and destroy the hostile growth before your transmission window closes.

4301470.title: The Amazing Bird Miner
4301470.short_description: The Amazing Bird Miner is a unique incremental game where you mine ore and capture birds to live with you in your bird grotto. Equip and upgrade your gear to become a better miner. Scavenge for materials and choose your specialization as you save the planet as The Amazing Bird Miner!

4301480.title: Dont Look
4301480.short_description: Your boat stops working. You are forced to the nearest dock. A fog-covered island lies before you. Abandoned buildings. Dense forest. No guidance. Blood everywhere. Warnings remain. You need to leave. Something is watching. It wants you to look.

4301510.title: Slot Siege
4301510.short_description: Build defenses by day and fight off hordes and bosses by night in first-person co-op. Spin for gear and keep your team’s slot machine standing through 10 nights.

4301630.title: Hollowbound
4301630.short_description: A co-op puzzle adventure for exactly two players. One of you finds the clue, the other has to act on it. Pull levers, crack rune puzzles, brew potions and outrun a collapsing mine together – every puzzle needs both of you.

4301720.title: The Archivist
4301720.short_description: A psychological horror experience set in the Backrooms. Explore a failed government facility, hack corrupted systems, and descend into a story where memory and reality collapse.

4301840.title: Operation Together VR
4301840.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op military VR simulation. Complete tactical operations, neutralize terrorist threats, and rescue civilians.

4301950.title: RunIn: Encounters
4301950.short_description: RunIn: Encounters is a competitive fantasy PvP experience focused on tactical teamplay, skill-based combat, evolving builds, and intense round-based multiplayer encounters.

4302210.title: Ocularis
4302210.short_description: An ancient intelligence has forgotten how to learn, so it built a place to watch you do it. Explore its abstract chambers in a first-person puzzle game with no words to guide you: experiment, observe, and master its rules. The more you understand, the more it begins to understand again.

4302590.title: Particle Collectotron
4302590.short_description: Click and collect energy in this short, active incremental. Upgrade your reactor, tune injector payload and trajectories, unlock exotic matter, and push the experiment past its limits.

4302740.title: Shadow Runner
4302740.short_description: The first FPS where enemies are invisible? You see only their shadows. To fight, you must follow the light—control it, even create it. With one gun, fireflies, and fireworks, survive a little longer. A minimalist system with unexpected depth. An FPS poem about light, shadow, architecture, and memory

4302790.title: Mira - Shadow of the Past
4302790.short_description: Travel. Go back. Erase your regrets.

4303160.title: Roll For Damage!
4303160.short_description: A light dice-based dungeon crawl. Roll numerous dice and see fortunes expand across various distinct stages.

4303270.title: The Kingdoms of Ædloran
4303270.short_description: The Kingdoms of Ædloran is a 2D top-down pixel RPG. Explore a living open world, encounter strange and fantastic creatures, level up and learn new abilities, battle savage beasts and monstrous foes, delve deep into perilous dungeons, and claim legendary loot.

4303550.title: Carbon Compliance
4303550.short_description: A simulation game about experiencing the very mundane job of a government official, rummaging through paperwork. Make sure all the paperwork is free of any errors. Deny applications that are not up to the specified requirements. Bored of working, play mini-games to relieve stress.

4303570.title: Hook Nook
4303570.short_description: A cozy multiplayer idle-fishing game that sits on the bottom of your screen. Catch fish to unlock different biomes, socialize with shopkeepers, upgrade your gear, and maybe even try wearing a duck for a hat! Study, work or watch shorts while fishing with friends.

4303620.title: Rise Under the Warstorm
4303620.short_description: Build the production lines that power your defense. An automated economy supports your army as you command it against enemy waves. Upgrade cards and the technologies shape your strategy for the battles ahead.

4303930.title: Ashen Swarm
4303930.short_description: A gothic bullet heaven roguelite where you wield the power of deadly sins. The Judge knew not all were guilty, yet condemned the world. Burn hordes with Wrath, turn foes into swine with Pride and devour the fallen with Gluttony. Survive the swarm and face the boss of each arena.

4304100.title: Paranormal Research Society
4304100.short_description: Build a career as a paranormal field researcher in an exciting horror comedy about finally getting a job and gunning down ghosts while performing menial labor for your infuriating boss.

4304150.title: Recovered Occurrence
4304150.short_description: A new home owner documents his experience moving to Frailrock, unaware of the many unsetting events he would begin to witness there.

4304280.title: Necromancer’s Domain
4304280.short_description: A dark fantasy dungeon management game where you rule as a necromancer. Build and defend your dungeon, resurrect fallen enemies as undead soldiers and workers, research forbidden magic, and expand your domain across the world.

4304360.title: Mine Liebe Musik 1
4304360.short_description: Cute little troublemakers put on elegant bullet-hell spectacles and trade some very inelegant insults in this weird, story-driven bullet-hell adventure. You're invited to a 40-minute prologue—the opening act of a strange and twisted tale.

4304410.title: Claw & Order
4304410.short_description: Claw & Order is a roguelike autobattler where you recruit, arrange, and level up adorable cats whose abilities trigger off one another. Build game-breaking combos, deal millions of damage, and defeat larger-than-life bosses on your way to the grand finale!

4304470.title: On Sight
4304470.short_description: On Sight is a love letter to classic shooters that drops players into high energy gunfights in arenas across the galaxy. Play with friends, strangers, or solo with bot support on every map.

4304740.title: Escape from Ashville
4304740.short_description: Loot, fight and extract — or lose everything. A high-risk extraction shooter focused on survival, tactical combat, and meaningful decisions.

4304790.title: Reunions with you billions of times
4304790.short_description: This is a short, romance-focused visual novel where you play as a student. As you fall in love with your classmate Qiu, you become trapped in a time loop and die again and again. Together with Qiu, you must search for a way to break the loop, with your choices leading to different endings.

4304890.title: Mad Scientist Simulator – Society of World Destruction
4304890.short_description: Run a mad science shop by day, pilot a giant robot by night. In this 1-4 player co-op comedy sim you stock shelves, brew unstable potions and expose undercover agents - then split the robot's controls with your friends to flatten 5 cities and beat 5 superheroes.

4305040.title: Knight George
4305040.short_description: Knight George is a top-down retro-style action-adventure game. Travel across the Kingdom of Earlyne to meet friendly characters, explore numerous dungeons and fight terrifying monsters to save the kingdom!

4305160.title: ZHITEN
4305160.short_description: Some villages aren't just abandoned, they are cursed. Zhiten, a victim of clashing cults, awakens from its slumber with Nikolay's return. While Nikolay searches for traces of the past, he will be forced to meet the village's new owners.

4305180.title: Mad MOJO
4305180.short_description: Mad MOJO is a monster-catching deckbuilder with a deep, fourth-wall-breaking meta game hidden beneath the surface. Hunt for the legendary Prime MOJO with poker-inspired hands. Break the game by tackling puzzles in an in-game PC. But beware of the MOJO hiding just beyond your reach...

4305210.title: Trials of Liberation
4305210.short_description: Imprisoned by the king, you must earn your freedom by completing his puzzle trials. A top-down 2D puzzle game focused on logic, planning, limited items, and clever solutions.

4305360.title: 6RAVITY CUBE
4305360.short_description: “Novel 6-direction gravity puzzle‑action game!” Packed with diverse gimmicks — experience intuitive yet strategically deep puzzle‑solving!

4305390.title: Reaction
4305390.short_description: Fly your ship though a derelict space station in this action/puzzle 2D platformer as you avoid hazards, repair your ship back to working condition and uncover the mysteries within. What awaits inside and can you get out again?

4305490.title: Humanity's Fall
4305490.short_description: Explore the world of Humanity's Fall, a fantasy farming sim. Interact and build a community with the world's next apex lifeform. Build your farm and rediscover lost flora as you discover the world's lore.

4305630.title: Stray Night
4305630.short_description: Experience a puzzle-build roguelite hack-and-slash adventure. As a stray cat in a nightmare, strategically combine puzzle blocks to customize skills and defeat inner trauma. Overcome the walls of loneliness and discover your true identity through fast-paced combat and permanent progression.

4305650.title: Crosstown
4305650.short_description: An overload of 8-bit-style action mayhem, Crosstown hands you a toga and a gun, and lets you loose in an ever-changing maze full of monsters and explosions! 40 levels, up to 4 players, and an endless mode!

4305820.title: Scattered
4305820.short_description: Scattered is a short adventure where you explore a tropical island as a cat in search of a litter of hidden kittens. Discover paths to remote locations, dig up pirate treasure, and seek out perfect sleeping spots. Upgrade your skills and show them the way back home.

4305900.title: Serenity
4305900.short_description: A zen gliding and exploration game with procedurally generated music

4306040.title: ZeroPrompt
4306040.short_description: Every NPC in this game runs on a local LLM. Ask them anything. The internet is dying. You're a internet moderator. Filter out AI impostors from humanity's last clean network. Use investigation tools to detect deception. Every verdict shapes the internet.

4306130.title: Subway Story
4306130.short_description: A narrative-driven exploration game set in the New York City subway, where you ride trains, interact with strangers, and make choices that shape how the city's underbelly responds.

4306240.title: For the Glory of Wilson
4306240.short_description: For the Glory of Wilson is an action roguelite where you recruit allies who fight alongside you and influence every battle.

4306730.title: TrainSim: Point & Call
4306730.short_description: Find the sweet spot between speed and precision as you step into the driver’s seat and run trains across cities and vast landscapes. The game focuses on authentic handling and time management, delivering a tight, goal-driven, fully immersive cab experience.

4306820.title: ROTETRA
4306820.short_description: ROTETRA is a twisted tetromino stacker where you spin the whole board and juggle multiple pieces at once!

4307130.title: 众星入海
4307130.short_description: 大学毕业正在苦于找工作的平凡男生时寻，在奔波中遇到了一位穿着战术服的少女陈枫实。 陈枫实声称自己是末日时期的搜救人员，目的就是拯救世界上最后的幸存者。 时寻望着周围熙熙攘攘的街道，陈枫实望着周围残破的废墟，同时发觉了对方已经疯了的事实。两人抱着对对方的同情，开启了独属于他们的故事。
developers: 失业者联盟游戏制作组

4307270.title: Little Lilicia
4307270.short_description: A full-fledged farm life sim where you live as a rancher, socialize, and find love with heroines in the town of Kokotan, home of the Forest Goddess. Step into the shoes of the protagonist, Philo, who becomes a rancher by chance, and revitalize the run-down farm.

4307320.title: Covert Koalas: Phasco
4307320.short_description: A comfy game where you're searching for hidden koalas on unique hand-drawn levels with adjustable difficulty. Help a group of koalas escape their captivity and follow their story on a search for a new home. Because the world is big enough for all!

4307380.title: Tales Of Eight
4307380.short_description: Tales of Eight is an action roguelite, naval battle game. As one of the last pirates you are fighting against the dreaded Feline Empire. Fight on the high seas with customizable magical canons, upgrade your ship, explore the ever-changing ocean, and trade with factions all to save Piratedom.

4307390.title: Cursed Gas Station
4307390.short_description: At an isolated gas station in the 1990s, Cole takes a night-shift job that comes with a room to stay in. As you serve customers, unexplained events begin to unfold in this psychological horror game.

4307570.title: PERFECT SNAP: Ultimate Jigsaw Puzzles
4307570.short_description: Turn any image into a 3D jigsaw puzzle! Solve solo or with friends (co-op & PvP), display your masterpieces in a customizable 3D museum, and visit everyone else's. Personalize your character and take on the 100-level campaign, from easy puzzles all the way to 1000 pieces.

4307580.title: Taco Stand
4307580.short_description: A horror game where you manage a taco stand. Make tacos, serve customers, and get through each night.

4307810.title: Pumpkin Survivor
4307810.short_description: Pumpkin Survivor is a whimsical cartoon-style survival game where you’ll experiment with countless weapon builds to defend against relentless enemy waves. Mix and match abilities, upgrade your pumpkin hero, and survive as long as possible in this roguelike adventure!"

4307830.title: Booost!! CleanSweep
4307830.short_description: Take control of the 'Cleaning Cart' and clean up a filthy city! But beware of the Litterbugs who scatter trash everywhere! Faster, cleaner, better. This is a score-attack car action game.

4308000.title: MILES 27: Look Like You
4308000.short_description: MILES27 is a psychological horror game told through self-contained stories inspired by disturbing real-life cases. Each episode presents a short but intense experience focused on atmosphere and tension. The game is designed to make players feel watched, unsafe, and uncertain about what is real.

4308030.title: TOBARI and the Vampire Alchemist
4308030.short_description: I want to be your friend. But I want to eat you… Discover the end of a twisted friendship in this story driven adventure. Deep in the forest, an alchemist hides a monster: Tobari. Gather silver coins. Find a cure for an incurable disease.

4308060.title: Petaltone
4308060.short_description: Plant, tend to, and grow a musical garden masterpiece! By mixing and mastering different Plants, Mods, and Gardening Tools, you can create a synthesized symphony entirely unique to you!

4308080.title: A Light Touch
4308080.short_description: A Light Touch is a puzzle adventure game where you play as a guiding light, protecting a small chick from danger. Together you solve puzzles and explore a mysterious world consumed by darkness. Can you uncover its secrets and restore light to the world?

4308100.title: Scales
4308100.short_description: Scales is a story-driven action-adventure RPG about a human-reptile hybrid. Players devour reptiles to absorb their DNA, and evolve through a corrupt world, where player choices ultimately determine the outcome of the story, blending combat with a darkly comedic narrative.

4308420.title: Arizona Sunshine®
4308420.short_description: Sharpen your machete and grab your friends. Arizona Sunshine® brings its award-winning zombie apocalypse to explosive third-person action, featuring online and split-screen co-op, brutal combat, dark humor, and Buddy, your loyal zombie-chomping canine companion.

4308550.title: Mine or Burn
4308550.short_description: Start with a basic mining ship and snowball into an asteroid-crushing powerhouse in this incremental bullet hell roguelite. Mine asteroids, battle rival miners, stack upgrades, create powerful builds, and survive escalating threats across dangerous star systems.

4309150.title: Memories Loaming
4309150.short_description: A horror anthology about people working along a remote highway in Labrador, Canada. Try to remain balanced and lucid at your normal job. Also, there's a bear.

4309200.title: Inside the Samosbor
4309200.short_description: A first-person co-op horror game for 1–4 players set in the world of Samosbor. Explore contaminated residential blocks, find a way out, and evade monsters and anomalies. Beware of liquidators who may mistake you for the infected. Get out alive.

4309310.title: Voidshift
4309310.short_description: A psychological horror game about working the night shift in a store that reacts to your mistakes. Follow procedure. Avoid irregularities.

4309330.title: Moonlight Cow: Guardian of the Night
4309330.short_description: Swap between Luna the cow and Pipkin, the tiny chick who can carry her, in a pixel-art platformer adventure. Fly over danger, move obstacles, and uncover hidden paths as you collect Moon Shards to restore the shattered moon

4309400.title: Which Sea Is This?
4309400.short_description: Which Sea Is This? is a local co-op sea adventure where you control a single ship together. Trade, explore, pirate, and argue about directions — because nobody knows where you are.

4309620.title: Strife of Stars
4309620.short_description: Command a rogue fleet in tactical turn-based combat. Outmaneuver, outflank, and outsmart the forces hunting you. Build your fleet, upgrade your ships, and fight your way across the galaxy in this tactical roguelite.

4309760.title: Bodzin
4309760.short_description: Step into the boots of a forgotten space legend. In this retro top-down shooter, stop a galactic villain from corrupting ancient wisdom into ultimate power. Correct your past mistake, rescue the Keepers, and rewrite destiny.

4310010.title: Ghost in the Cloud
4310010.short_description: Dive deep into the Net, build the ultimate deck, install busted plugins, and fight ever more powerful Bots and Avatars in fast-paced tactical combat that combines turn based and real time mechanics, all to realize your wish, or perish trying.

4310550.title: Shelter Prepare
4310550.short_description: Shelter Prepare is a post-apocalyptic placement game where you arrange various resources to create your ideal safe house. It's a low-pressure, purely placement-based, and cozy game. No combat, no death; focus on resource placement, space management, and cleaning. Gradually expand your space.

4310630.title: Melt Down
4310630.short_description: Melt Down is a slime racing game where you are on a clock to reach the finish line. You are melting: small is fast, big is slow, and you have to finish the race before you turn into a puddle. Dodge hazards, fight off your rival slimes with powerups, and finish before you perish.

4310650.title: Desktop sticker
4310650.short_description: This is a game that allows you to freely decorate your computer desktop. Have you ever thought about setting your desktop in a unique way? Come on, let's get started and design and decorate your desktop together! Accompany you in your work and study!

4310740.title: The Last Swordmaster
4310740.short_description: 《The Last Swordmaster》 is a Chinese wuxia action Roguelite loot game. Set in a world shaped by the Huajian Workshop, you play the final disciple of the Last Swordmaster, wield ancient weapons, build your own martial style, and fight through a blood-ink-corrupted jianghu.

4311050.title: Legend of Idle
4311050.short_description: In this short incremental game, you must rebuild your kingdom! Gather resources, construct numerous buildings, and set out to conquer everything with your army! A game in the style of the SNES!

4311150.title: Win the Date
4311150.short_description: A deckbuilder roguelite about gay dating. The dating world can be cruel. Don’t let those guys crush your self-esteem. Crush theirs first!

4311660.title: Welcome, [Employee Name]
4311660.short_description: Welcome, [Employee Name]! You are our new space station controller. We trust you to make all the right decisions and keep the people of the HonkyTonk space station safe. Process as many trucks as possible but be careful, mistakes have consequences.Welcome to the Honky Tonk Family!

4311670.title: Sheep Trick
4311670.short_description: A game about dreams, loops and sheep! Stop the alarm, dodge your clones and count sheep to infinity to achieve great sleep quality.

4311840.title: Lilithia's Dungeon
4311840.short_description: Lilithia’s Dungeon is a pixel-art real-time turn-based looter RPG with anime flair. You are a hero summoned by Lilithia – level up, explore the dungeon, and defeat bosses. Even casual players can use real-time inputs in turn-based combat to keep challenging and overcoming tough enemies.

4312030.title: Dwarven Mining Company
4312030.short_description: Manage your own dwarven mine. Give orders to miners excavating ore and builders providing them with ladders to get deeper and deeper into the underground. Mine iron, copper and even mithrill to satisfy the needs of the dwarven kingdom for the price of a single coffee.

4312150.title: Lost Dude
4312150.short_description: Lost Dude is an atmospheric 2D platform-adventure game that follows a character who sets out on a journey to find their lost friend, experiences various events along the way, and embarks on new adventures together after reuniting.

4312200.title: Presto!
4312200.short_description: Jump into an N64-style 3D collectathon! Explore surreal worlds as Presto with classic platforming action and a physics-based Rolling Globe for bouncing and rolling around! Collect Stars and Memory Cores to restore the magic of the past, with optional rankings for skilled players.

4312350.title: Flaghead
4312350.short_description: Flaghead is an arena shooter roguelite where you play as a country, surviving through history from the dark ages into dystopian futures and beyond.

4312750.title: Type The Rhythm
4312750.short_description: A rhythm typing trainer where you type real words to a variety of musical styles. Augmented proprioception lets you move the grooves between your brain and fingers for faster, cleaner typing. From hunt-and-peck to 150 WPM blindfolded, Type The Rhythm moves you forward.

4313010.title: Buy The Game, I Have a Gun 2: Online Open World
4313010.short_description: Save the world from Alien Jesus in this 1-10 player online co-op sandbox game where you explore an open world, do quests, watch a HIGH-QUALITY interactive movie, and play minigames! Now that’s a mission for Sheesh-Man, his wife, his mom, and his dad!

4313040.title: Crystalmancers
4313040.short_description: Crystalmancers is a roguelike, block-smashing puzzle game inspired by the JRPG's of the 90's. Collect items, upgrade your pieces, and use each Crystalmancers unique abilities to vanquish the monsters that await you in an ancient dungeon known as "The Primordial Cauldron".

4313400.title: Gunfort
4313400.short_description: Gunfort is a tower defense game where your army is competent and well-funded. The city is surrounded, and horrors are coming down every road. Build turrets, call in commanders, and hold the line. Watch your brilliant strategy unfold or discover exactly how much government money you can waste.

4314300.title: Sinful Testament
4314300.short_description: A dark historical otome visual novel. Houston, Texas, 1925. A heroine from 2025 is reborn as the daughter of a murdered mafia boss and becomes “compensation” for the Devil’s Six gang. Six dangerous men, seven deadly sins, and a choice between Redemption and Fall.

4314520.title: DepotDash
4314520.short_description: Fast-paced top-down construction yard simulator where you manage deliveries, move materials with heavy machines, and keep suppliers happy before your depot overflows.

4314580.title: NightMeer
4314580.short_description: NightMeer is a 2D exploration adventure about the nights you can't sleep. Wrapped in the pressure of having to fall asleep now, Noah drifts through her darkened room. Guide her with a click, and slowly let the tension leave her body and mind. How she gets through this night is up to you.

4314710.title: Alien Idolz: Rhythmic Idler
4314710.short_description: Alien Idolz is a 4-lane rhythm game with an incremental twist. Hit the notes, harvest love from your alien stans, and exploit the skill tree to break the stats and clear increasingly difficult tracks.

4314900.title: Unwritten World
4314900.short_description: An MMORPG where every item matters and all systems connect. Encounter emergent events, a monster may steal your drop and attempt to flee, a slain monster drops a seed that instantly grows into a harvestable tree. Train life skills, hunt, craft and climb leaderboards that reshape the Unwritten World.

4314970.title: VANADEN
4314970.short_description: Vanaden is a first-person survival horror game set in a cursed, fortress-like labyrinth. Hide from monsters, solve puzzles, and navigate shifting corridors where stealth and every decision determine your survival.

4314980.title: BROMS: Battle Royale Management Simulator
4314980.short_description: A management simulation game where you run a battle royale. Host matches to increase revenue from gacha requests, expand the map, and place objects to improve the environment. You can also play on the maps you create yourself.

4315080.title: Indie Hoverboard Racing
4315080.short_description: A high-speed sci-fi hoverboard racer. Survive hostile regions, defeat elite rivals, and earn your place on the Nocturnia City Circuit.

4316380.title: ComboCraft Legendary
4316380.short_description: An Idle incremental clicker focused on crafting symbols, merging combinations, and building automated production. Reset your run to unlock permanent upgrades and grow stronger each cycle.

4316530.title: Clash of Worlds
4316530.short_description: Clash of Worlds is a turn-based strategic card game. Similar gameplay mechanics to Yu-Gi-Oh!. Featuring multiple supported formats and a developer who cares about fun. All gameplay is manual, as if playing "in real life". Join the Stoat server for help or questions. Stoat: https://stt.gg/K8jk6Dxd

4316570.title: Orbital Upgrade
4316570.short_description: You are Orbital OS 3.0, the new software controlling workbots aboard a space station. Program your bots, solve challenging logistics puzzles and optimise your workflows. Prove your capabilities to a sceptical station technician – no coding experience required.

4316750.title: Roadside Reseal
4316750.short_description: A roadside store where the night never feels safe. Flickering lights, endless aisles, whispers from the dark. Each task feels like research into fear—you restock, you lock, you fight to keep the seal closed.The silence breaks, the air is heavy, and every moment is research into survival.

4317040.title: Alone After Dark: Head Practitioner
4317040.short_description: Attend to patients and fill out paperwork as 22-year-old Kimora Jackson on her first shift after graduating nursing school. Draw blood, administer medications, and try not to lose your head in the chilling hallways of Coldrock Medical Center.

4317210.title: Quest for Choices: Ivan's Tale
4317210.short_description: ✦Quest for Choices: Ivan's Tale is a choice-driven visual novel. The story mainly follows a Slavic white mouse named "Ivan Viktorovich Belyaev" and its VR memory recordings in the United States.

4317380.title: Gravity Cannon
4317380.short_description: Gravity Cannon is a local multiplayer space combat game for up to 8 players. Grab some friends and hop into fast-paced gravity action!

4317870.title: Pemkie Island
4317870.short_description: Pemkie Island is a monster taming RPG adventure, in a roguelite format. Travel across the 5 different regions while discovering and taming unique creatures called Pemkies. Master their traits, choose the right skills and build the best team possible to restore balance!

4318560.title: Beast Snap
4318560.short_description: Build a deck from 500+ monster cards across nine planets, pick a Boss, and battle on a living board. Outsmart rival Bosses with spells, traps and Places, then open booster packs and upgrade your favorite cards to shiny Holo and Prism.

4318950.title: City of Hunger
4318950.short_description: Survive a deadly parasite outbreak in immersive virtual reality. Fight for your life, uncover the truth behind Dr. Summers' experiments, and escape before it's too late.

4319030.title: Kwartikum
4319030.short_description: An atmospheric puzzle adventure about guiding a lone figure through a strange land, discovering new ways to solve box based challenges.

4319260.title: Lucky Rabbit
4319260.short_description: GAMBLE to pay off your debts! Buy power ups (drugs) to increase profit and see how large your bankroll can get! Play Slots, Casino Classics, and more! Remember: Fortune favors the bold, go all in!

4319520.title: Turbo Ziggurat
4319520.short_description: You are a tiny creature in a living human city. Talk to NPCs out loud to find clues, track down crystal balls, and steal them before the enemy team does. A chaotic team PvP game.

4319800.title: Final Orbit
4319800.short_description: Master the cockpit of highly realistic spacecraft in this Newtonian physics based sim. Take off from surface to space, plot a course between the planets and dock with space stations. Trade commodities or take shipping contracts to buy upgrades and optimize your build - every choice matters.

4320070.title: 蛊道The Reverend's Path
4320070.short_description: An innovative roguelite real-time combat game of one-handed, effortless spell programming. Wield arcane Gu, pick it up intuitively, and carve out your supreme Path of Gu across two layers: the Killer Move Board (build your skills) and the Condition Pool (set when they fire).

4320090.title: HELLEVATOR
4320090.short_description: `·.¸¸.·´´¯`··._.·Welcome to the Hellevator·._.··`¯´´·.¸¸.·` Hellevator is a ballet hell (with an “a”) RPG. Your job is to deliver food to our most valued guest. How hard can that be?

4320140.title: Awakewood
4320140.short_description: Will returns to bury his mother and leave right away, but everything changes when he finds a stranger in the woods. As the house decays and roots swallow everything, saving her comes with an irreversible cost: uncovering a truth hidden in Awakewood for ten years.

4320730.title: Super Onslaught
4320730.short_description: A real time strategy, arcade, tower defense game where you repeat short runs in order to get more knowledge about the mechanics and turrets. With good knowledge and preparation, you will survive longer and even maybe reach the wave 100 milestone.

4320880.title: Pillow Punk
4320880.short_description: Fight waves of enemies and towering bosses in a third-person action roguelite. Spend the points you earn on the Patch Board to build your own fighting style. Play solo or bring up to three friends into online co-op.

4321120.title: The Curator
4321120.short_description: The Curator is a roguelite gallery-management game which managing your traveling art gallery. Combine the unique artwork skills, organize your collection by day, impress the picky visitors by night, and use your earnings to prepare for the next city.

4321170.title: Shortest Trip: Battlematch
4321170.short_description: A brutal robotic army builder roguelike. Assemble armies of giant warmachines, then clash in massive battles against robots from competing corporations. Upgrade or expand your persistent fleet of warmachines, unleash orbital bombardments & exotic nukes, become the master of robot warfare.

4321390.title: The Last Opening
4321390.short_description: You are dead. To return, you must survive 40 nights in the woods, making brutal choices by day and playing chess against Death each night. The forest is cold. The nights are long. Win, and you may see the dawn. Lose… and the world forgets you.

4321670.title: Dice'n'Go
4321670.short_description: Dice’n’Go is a chaotic multiplayer board game where luck starts the turn - but players decide how it ends. Sabotage your opponents, pull off clever ability combos, and turn terrible rolls into game-winning plays. Expect backstabs, dramatic comebacks, and last-turn twists.

4321950.title: My Type of Goblin: A Climbing ASDFenture
4321950.short_description: Climb a hazardous mountain that gets meaner with every ascent... until it breaks you. Master Goblin Mountaineering, including rubber-arm slingshotting and fart propulsion. Not challenging enough? Hunt down bizarre accessories to become the most 'ahem' gorgeous Goblin.

4322370.title: Hollywood Hustle: A Prop Collector Simulator
4322370.short_description: A physics-driven cleanup simulator on an abandoned Hollywood studio. Fantasy epics, sitcoms, sci-fi blockbusters: their props ended up here. Sort it all, ship boxed orders to film sets and beyond, sell the rest, and resurrect the old animatronics to help.

4323230.title: Dark Watching Chapter 2
4323230.short_description: After crossing the bunker, you reach the shopping mall, but you quickly realize that there is even more of the virus there…

4323840.title: Godless Dawn
4323840.short_description: Godless Dawn is a ruthless action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Descend into cursed dungeons, uncover the stories behind fallen souls, and reveal the truth hidden behind the silence of the gods.

4324270.title: RLRacer
4324270.short_description: Master the season in this 2D roguelike racer! Meet escalating targets against tough AI up to the finale. Invest tactically in upgrades & crew. Win to unlock new cars with unique abilities that completely change your strategy for the next run.

4324940.title: Fartimus!
4324940.short_description: Use your voice to defeat enemy wizards in this online PVP Spell Casting Duel!

4324980.title: DRONES
4324980.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you build the enemy's deck, not your own. In this physics-based auto battler, you choose which monsters invade and discard the ones you can't counter. Buy, equip, and position autonomous drones, then watch them fight. Find the synergies that save the solar system.

4325070.title: Spray Days
4325070.short_description: Paint, restore, and customize worn-out objects in this satisfying spray painting simulator. Complete quirky commissions, upgrade your tools, expand your workshop, and grow your restoration business - solo or with friends in online co-op!

4325130.title: Record Studio Tycoon
4325130.short_description: Run a record label from one room in 1950 through seven decades of changing taste. You decide who gets signed, what they’re paid, and how their record sounds. When the reviews come in, there’s no one else to blame.

4325660.title: HoraitoYugi
4325660.short_description: In the village of Horai, where autumn lasts forever, girls clash with swords and cards in a board game-style battle for up to four players. Master positioning, mind games, and tactical maneuvers to emerge victorious in this never-ending game.

4325760.title: Night on Bald Mountain
4325760.short_description: Orbit, dodge, and touch! Light up the stars in an action game built around Night on Bald Mountain!

4326100.title: Catriarch
4326100.short_description: Your subjects are dumpster cats. Your kingdom is an abandoned building in a human city. Your reign is threatened by dogs, fleas, collar bells, bad valerian harvests, fish-bone fortunes — and your own terrible decisions.

4326110.title: Sky Defense
4326110.short_description: A card-driven tower defense game where one wrong choice ends your run. Place defenses, upgrade your deck between rounds, and protect your floating island from endless waves of enemies.

4326220.title: Perihelion
4326220.short_description: Master orbital combat and bend gravity to your advantage in this space combat roguelite. Launch from your carrier, tackle tactical missions, build crew relationships, and upgrade your ship between runs as you slowly unravel the mystery of a lost sister ship.

4326630.title: Surging Blood
4326630.short_description: A dark journey shaped by blood and alchemy. A FPS inspired by retro PS1 aesthetics, and a universe blending steampunk and victorian gothic. Will you uncover the fate of Cinderval?

4326730.title: The Last Night Train
4326730.short_description: A story-driven puzzle adventure about Ovid searching for Thera, his love who vanished aboard a train where the night never ends… but what if she was never the one he needed to find?

4327180.title: RAPIDS
4327180.short_description: Dare to Deliver in RAPIDS, a frantic co-op roguelike. Either solo or as a group of friends, navigate a hazardous river while delivering packages. Master magic, charm cute critters, and upgrade your boat, one fast-paced run at a time

4327400.title: Sushi Sewers
4327400.short_description: A fast-paced cyberpunk bullet-heaven where neon chaos, dark power, and endless enemy swarms collide. Survive the waves, create the strongest builds, and become unstoppable.

4327580.title: Now You're Cooking!
4327580.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder about running your own restaurant. Cook delicious meals, build an extravagant menu, and keep your patrons happy. Did I mention that rent doubles every month?

4327620.title: DEWORLD AURALIS
4327620.short_description: The village was alive. The factory was running. Then they found something. Now inside remains only what they believed in… and what their madness became.

4327630.title: Glamour Photographer
4327630.short_description: Fulfill your dream of becoming a glamour photographer, meet beautiful women from different cultures and backgrounds, and maybe even marry one of them!

4327730.title: 洛希极限 Roche Limit
4327730.short_description: ​Roche Limit​ is a 2D pixel sci-fi action roguelite, blending high-speed aerial combat with ARPG builds. Choose a mecha-girl, build her skills on the battle, and face the cosmic legion. Between runs, bond with the girls for more skill possibles and stories. Prevent cataclysm before the moon falls.

4327800.title: Reinvaders
4327800.short_description: Reinvaders is a short retro sci-fi shooter. Fight through four levels, dash past alien fire, and take down bosses in a tight arcade-style campaign.

4327830.title: 永恒地牢与刹那之恋
4327830.short_description: 《永恒地牢与刹那之恋》是基于AI实时推演的动态叙事AVG。在这个视觉小说内，输入你独一无二的选择生成新的世界线与游戏CG。

4327860.title: Dreamsink
4327860.short_description: Awakening in a frigid room with an empty pill bottle, she’s forgotten something vital. Trapped between a monochrome bedroom and distorted dreams, she must face anxiety and depression... Break mental shackles and find the light in this psychological puzzle adventure！

4327900.title: Space Hauler
4327900.short_description: Space Hauler is a space flight sim set around Saturn's largest moon, Titan. Fly your spacecraft using realistic aerodynamics and orbital mechanics, take on contracts, and build your career as a pilot-for-hire.

4327920.title: City of Promotion
4327920.short_description: City of Promotion est un jeu qui combine les échecs et la construction de colonies, où les joueurs utilisent les règles de déplacement des pièces d'échecs pour collecter des ressources, développer des colonies et résister aux attaques de monstres en essaim.

4328090.title: Chrysalis: Chrome Butterfly
4328090.short_description: Chrysalis: Chrome Butterfly is a neo-noir cyberpunk thriller. You play Wendy, an agent with gaps in her memory, investigating a disappearance in Neo-Kyoto. Fierce firefights give way to detective work — until it turns out reality itself is an illusion. But is the truth worth knowing?

4328270.title: Ravelle - Last Draw
4328270.short_description: What starts as casual matches in a humble café becomes a shared effort to protect a place that matters. Ravelle is a free-to-play turn-based strategy card game with visual novel elements, blending tactical card battles and personal character stories.

4328320.title: OVER SAND
4328320.short_description: Take to the steampunk skies! Defend your flying ship over endless sands from mechanical hordes. Master turret firepower, switch weapons, and craft synergistic perk builds mid-wave. No movement — pure skill!

4328560.title: Evergrowing
4328560.short_description: Play as a squirrel in a cozy adventure about growing your tree home. Help woodland neighbors, build along the branches, and travel by balloon to other trees. Venture beneath the roots and discover what’s waiting below.

4328620.title: Slavic Warband
4328620.short_description: Slavic Warband is a tactical RPG in which you lead a pack of peasants searching for a better life in early medieval Eastern Europe. Explore, fight, equip, and level up your company to ultimately create your own small kingdom.

4328820.title: Iron Bramble
4328820.short_description: Momentum-based platforming built around expressive movement and tight gunplay. Master your elastic grappling hook to explore a vast, cyber-gothic megastructure, where robots piloted by the souls of the dead do penance for their sins.

4329680.title: SECONDED
4329680.short_description: Seconded is a strategy-driven tavern management game about assigning the right companion to the right problem under pressure and uncertainty. Each request hides its true requirements, forcing you to read situations carefully rather than rely on explicit instructions.

4329940.title: Beards vs. Claws
4329940.short_description: Dig tunnels, build bridges, and blast your way through walls towards victory in this highly dynamic arena first-person shooter - every obstacle is a potential door

4330060.title: Goldfish Gunner
4330060.short_description: Become the most wanted outlaw by taking on the role of Goldfish, a gunner robbing every bank in the Wild West. Escape across challenging, obstacle-filled landscapes where your only way to move is by firing your weapon and riding the recoil.

4330540.title: Pirate & Darkmage
4330540.short_description: A life simulation RPG set in a world of pirates and magic. Farm, fish, build friendships, and set out on adventures at your own pace. Complete goals without feeling restricted, and shape your own story through the choices you make.

4330750.title: Tiny Ramen Shop
4330750.short_description: 🍜 Run your own cozy Japanese ramen shop in this charming cooking simulator! 🐱 Prepare delicious ramen, serve hungry customers, and grow your restaurant with an adorable cat assistant. 🏮 But when night falls, mysterious yokai and spirits from Japanese folklore come looking for a warm meal! 👻

4330840.title: Doomsday Defense Line
4330840.short_description: This is an innovative game that combines strategy, action and character development. David to the frontlines of the plant-animal alliance. Engage in fierce defensive battles against the powerful zombie horde, and uncover the fascinating stories behind every precious character in this world.
developers: 上海齐格飞网络科技有限公司
publishers: 辰炎翎网络科技（上海）有限公司

4330890.title: PIECES OF THE DEEP
4330890.short_description: An auto-run roguelite set in the deep sea where split-second decisions decide survival. Explore procedurally generated underwater dungeons, defeat bosses, and recover relics of a lost civilization. Return with materials to rebuild technology and push further into the depths.

4331050.title: Totally Normal Ramen
4331050.short_description: Cook ramen across the galaxy as a rogue robot chef! Explore planets, trigger wild events, battle dangerous customers, and build your ultimate space food truck.

4331350.title: Mistbound Silent light
4331350.short_description: Mistbound: Silent Light is a knowledge-based horror where your voice is your greatest power and your worst enemy. Solve intricate puzzles with your voice or master the fog's secrets in silence to survive.

4331770.title: Manum
4331770.short_description: A fast third-person 4v4 battlemage arena where you build your mage mid-match. Loot spells, combine them freely, and fight for capture points.

4331850.title: Night At The Mall VR
4331850.short_description: Night At The Mall is a first-person, narrative-driven psychological horror game where you take the night shift inside an abandoned shopping mall that refuses to stay still.

4332830.title: Nijoaju
4332830.short_description: Two characters. One goal. Think as one. In Nijoaju, control a powerful stone creature and an agile water creature, combining their unique abilities to solve challenging puzzles, overcome obstacles, and prove that only by working together can you move forward.

4333430.title: The Apartment
4333430.short_description: A new apartment. A polite neighbor who knows every package you get. He wants his share. Every day, a little more. Keep him fed or become the meal. A first-person psychological horror.

4333680.title: DreeM Ascension
4333680.short_description: Explore the DreeMScape Darklands and uncover it's dark secrets in this story-driven survival horror boomer shooter.

4333790.title: Ethral
4333790.short_description: Play as a young hero in a retro pixel top-down adventure: explore the land of Ethral, find secrets, conquer dark dungeons, and collect shards to restore the Ethral Pendant to defeat the Pirate King!

4333920.title: Harlequinade
4333920.short_description: Harlequinade is a horror otome romance visual novel about a never-ending carnival and a very death-prone college student. With the aid of 2 clowns, can you escape this timeloop?

4334090.title: SLENDYJAN
4334090.short_description: Slendyjan takes place on a planet devastated by a war that has been consuming all the races that inhabit it for years. The player controls Jan, an exceptionally powerful mercenary who fights on the side of the Nuggets, an advanced civilization from an unknown planet.

4334240.title: Leaf Us Alone
4334240.short_description: Build a powerful army with synergistic abilities, and prove your strategic mastery in this unique deckbuilding roguelite. Command your forces in battle, triggering outrageous combo to defeat the invading Voidlings threatening to consume the world.

4334610.title: Oathwood Realms
4334610.short_description: Oathwood Realms is a dark fantasy strategy card game focused on careful planning, tactical decisions, and calculated risk. Luck plays a role, but victory favors players who read the board and commit to their choices.

4334710.title: 夢酔のバーテンダー
