4334710.short_description: A hazy, dreamlike visual novel with a touch of the surreal. Step behind the bar of a mysterious, ethereal space. Craft cocktails, share quiet conversations, and connect with your guests' hearts. Mix drinks as you please, and lose yourself in this gentle, dreamlike world.

4335140.title: Quarantine
4335140.short_description: A co-op multiplayer survival game where players run a quarantine checkpoint together during an outbreak. Inspect survivors, manage shared resources, argue over decisions, and survive the consequences... or sabotage each other when panic sets in.

4335170.title: Chaoslands
4335170.short_description: This game is a pixel-styled, turn-based sandbox game. Collect around 50 items and build or find 100 obstacles accross the world. Build ships to cross water and enter the caves to collect advanced resources. Fight 2 bosses and level up.

4335470.title: Voidboy
4335470.short_description: A roguelite platformer filled with speed, action, and bullets! Shoot down all the enemies, upgrade your run, and take them all down. With your trusted grappling hook the game never stands still, and with the fast bullets and big explosions, you won't want it to.

4335690.title: Sea Pets: Match & Merge
4335690.short_description: Drop adorable sea creatures into the ocean and merge them into bigger ones in this relaxing yet addictive physics puzzle. How long can you keep the ocean under control?

4335990.title: Plura Ingenia: Patient 16
4335990.short_description: Face yourself, endure surreal trials, and survive a clinical evaluation that adapts to how you think and behave. Your intake begins in a psychological horror experience where your fears, choices, and personality profile carry into future chapters.

4336090.title: Bad Tides
4336090.short_description: BAD TIDES is a chaotic 4 player co-op pirate adventure! Explore the seven seas, dive for treasure, upgrade your trustworthy vessel, and fight creatures of myth.

4336250.title: Wind's Heartbeat
4336250.short_description: In this semi-open world, cozy horse game, form a deep bond with your horse while you explore, forage, and craft. Using training techniques and knowledge passed down through the ages, tame a wild horse to ride through and discover the land's rich natural history in 1800s Idaho.

4336330.title: Delete The Hypercube
4336330.short_description: Delete The Hypercube is a chill active incremental which tasks you with destroying an extradimensional cube that feeds on Earth's core.

4336420.title: Crow Heist
4336420.short_description: The HOA have taken everything from Crowley... His nest, his ability to fly, and most important of all, his trinkets! Break into their homes as Crowley for revenge in this 2.5D Platform Comedy game. Unlock their drawers, break their belongings, and steal everything you can to rebuild the crow's home!

4336520.title: AntiMatcher
4336520.short_description: Merge, pop, burst and... annihilate?! Play with bubbles and antibubbles to discover their strange properties in this abstract puzzle game.

4336860.title: Amalu, Wells between worlds
4336860.short_description: Amalu: Wells Between Worlds is a pixel-art 2D platformer, and Metroidvania blending Atmospheric exploration, Spell-casting puzzle mechanics, Amazigh/North African mythology and an emotional storytelling

4337230.title: Midnight Train: New Moon
4337230.short_description: A 2D exploration-based horror adventure game set in a creepy train and mysterious buildings.

4337400.title: Please The Orb
4337400.short_description: Please The Orb is a roguelike puzzle deckbuilder about creating game-breaking chaos. Draft bizarre artifacts, arrange them on a grid, and trigger massive cascading chain reactions. Deceptively simple to play, but infinitely complex to master.

4337550.title: Rifles & Runes
4337550.short_description: A real-time strategy game blending extraction, cards, and fantasy exploration. Lead a modern army through a portal, scout unknown lands, build mines and radar, repel counterattacks, hold your outposts, and extract before the world’s attention overwhelms you.

4338300.title: Cardcraft
4338300.short_description: Make the card you wish you had. Choose its cost, stats and skills, build a 30-card deck, and test your combinations against AI or in online PvP. Explore the five-act Endless Workshop and share your cards and decks on Steam Workshop. No card packs required.

4338360.title: Dynasty Rush
4338360.short_description: "Dynasty Rush" is an official Chinese-themed TD game. Command legendary heroes and unique towers across iconic Chinese landscapes. Experience deep strategy infused with rich culture as you defend the realm. The vast empire awaits your command!

4338730.title: Neuroma
4338730.short_description: A fast-paced vertical shmup where a living brain controls a combat ship to battle grotesque alien creatures across biomechanical worlds filled with massive bosses and intense arcade action.

4338750.title: Stack Order
4338750.short_description: Stack Order is an enigmatic deckbuilding adventure. Engage in tense one-on-one card duels, use strategy to stack up synergies, and uncover the source of the corruption spreading over this mysterious, handcrafted world.

4338910.title: Nascentiar
4338910.short_description: A classic turn-based roguelike dungeon crawler with D20 dice combat. Three unique classes — a soul-projecting Cultivator, a monster-recruiting Mask Master, and a shadow-stalking Rogue. 117 monsters, randomized identification, and procedural dungeons make every run a new adventure.

4339260.title: Under the Eye
4339260.short_description: You are a prisoner. The Major wants names from the resistance and she is willing to play cards for them. Win a hand and your next lie holds up better. Get caught three times and she kills you. You can always save yourself with the truth, but every name you give her buys another execution.

4339630.title: The Eye of Vala
4339630.short_description: Colonel Moorehead disappeared without a trace while searching for what he called “The Eye of Vala.” His desperate family hires MacNaughton, a treasure hunter, to look for clues to his whereabouts. The search for Moorehead will soon become a much greater challenge.

4339840.title: Walking With The Wild
4339840.short_description: Nature so serene… yet so violent. In this adventure-thriller, you are cast into a mystical world with nothing but your mind and body. To survive, you must leverage your five powerful senses and overcome the horrors that surround you. Can you make it home, or will the journey be too draining?

4339850.title: Dust
4339850.short_description: DUST is an online survival shooter. Gather, build and lock down your base, then raid your enemies with C4, RPGs and a rocket launch site. Talk with proximity voice, fight in x1000 and Battle Royale, survive the infected. Everything you build can be lost.

4340090.title: Magic Store Simulator
4340090.short_description: Inherit an abandoned magic shop and bring the neighborhood back to life. Renovate, upgrade, and customize your shop to attract more customers. Unlock new workshops and expand your product range to meet their needs.

4340180.title: Ash of the Covenant
4340180.short_description: A fast-paced action roguelike where brutal melee combat meets dangerous divine power. Accept blessings from forgotten gods, build powerful synergies, and face the hidden cost behind every gift.

4340200.title: Shipping and Handling
4340200.short_description: A chaotic co-op delivery game about traversal and teamwork. Get a shared payload through hostile environments while navigating terrain hazards, managing limited resources, and dealing with enemies along the way. AND DONT FALL OVER!

4341190.title: Eternal 4 Rounds
4341190.short_description: A dynamic low-poly Tower Defense. Command mobile squads and repel attacks from 4 factions. Collect gold from settlements during battle to craft equipment—the currency for hiring new troops. Defeat titanic bosses, upgrade your camp, and unlock elite tiers for your army!

4341230.title: Mythalia
4341230.short_description: Build your team and challenge the tower in this turn-based roguelite monster catching game. Unlock new beasts and upgrades as you play, discover mutations and champions in the 2v2 designed system.

4341550.title: After Hours
4341550.short_description: Survive until 6:00 AM in a cooperative asymmetric horror game. Watch cameras, control doors and lights, guide teammates, and complete deadly tasks inside a hostile facility. Communicate under pressure as systems fail, monsters adapt, and one mistake can get you killed. Finish the work. Repeat.

4341570.title: Hold My Cargo
4341570.short_description: A first-person smuggling sim. Buy low, sell high, stash the good stuff where customs won't look and talk your way past inspection. Grow from a rust bucket to a freighter, escape the galaxy, then do it again. Online co-op for 1–4 players arrives in the first major update.

4341780.title: Settle
4341780.short_description: A cozy puzzle about decor and history. Explore different eras by arranging authentic items from diverse cultures. Restore harmony to interiors of the past and enjoy the meditative flow.

4342900.title: Belua
4342900.short_description: Build a team of monsters, plan your moves carefully, and escape this unjust prison. This unique mash-up of turn-based combat and auto-battlers requires strategy and wits. Every win unlocks a new cute or creepy creature to join your side.

4343180.title: 6-7 In-A-Row
4343180.short_description: A strategic board showdown for 2-4 players. Race to connect six, time your blocks to earn extra tokens, and build lines for power-ups. Play locally, online with friends, or against AI. Every turn pits your plan against everyone else’s. Six wins... technically! Seven earns bragging rights.

4343800.title: HaCo
4343800.short_description: "Deliver or Destroy? The choice is yours!" High-speed jet action meets heist mechanics in this up to 4-player online co-op. Pilot rusty robots, master the inertia, and dodge missiles to steal packages. Can you meet the quota before time runs out?

4344270.title: Tiny Misery
4344270.short_description: A sick mother and her young son move into the home of a lonely old woman. A tragic story inspired by the dark puppet animations of the 80s and 90s.

4344380.title: PAWA
4344380.short_description: P.A.W.A is an auto-chess roguelike inspired by TFT and Slay the Spire. Build a team of cool and cute creatures, combine and position your units wisely, create powerful synergies, and defeat challenging bosses.

4344620.title: Void Eaters
4344620.short_description: Play as a powerful mage shaping an army of mythical creatures in this semi-idle incremental game. Destroy enemies and gather resources by casting spells or simply watch your army at work. Explore, upgrade, craft, and customize your forces to fit your strategy.

4345840.title: Bakkal Simulator
4345840.short_description: Hang up your degree and take over your grandfather's corner shop. Step into a deep narrative simulation where your choices shape the neighborhood, your reputation defines your path, and every interaction crafts a unique story.

4346020.title: Typeoids
4346020.short_description: Wield your keyboard and destroy incoming asteroids by typing their words before they crush you. Typeoids is a fast arcade-style typing game inspired by Asteroids to sharpen your typing skill and mental focus with different game modes.

4346110.title: Blood Arena Path of Steel
4346110.short_description: Fight your way through brutal medieval arenas with physics-driven melee combat, effective armor systems, and violent consequences. Master swords, maces, and shields as you rise from fighter to champion.

4346780.title: Supernatural Haven
4346780.short_description: 1 or 4-player online co-op horror survival game featuring supernatural entity capture and search-fight-retreat gameplay loops.

4347280.title: GAS
4347280.short_description: A co-op road trip horror for 4 players from the fan of Spintires, MudRunner and SnowRunner. Loot by day. Survive the night. Defend your car from skeletons, monsters and bad decisions. Go GAS! Go FUN!

4347660.title: Bros of Bench
4347660.short_description: Bros of Bench is a minimalist cooperative platformer in which two players form a dumbbell connected by an adjustable bar. Take turns lifting each other and using the jetpack. Mastering coordination, physics, and timing will be key to winning!

4347690.title: Mine Climbers
4347690.short_description: Mine Climbers is a vertical platformer where you'll be dashing and jumping your way out of a collapsing mineshaft while avoiding the falling rubble. An unlikely mix of falling block puzzle gameplay and traditional platforming.

4347710.title: Project: Story about
4347710.short_description: An RPG where you live life after life in a constantly evolving world, and your choices and relationships influence future cycles.

4347770.title: Fiets-Together
4347770.short_description: Fiets-Together is a chaotic co-op bike game for 2-4 players where each of you controls one shoe on a pedal. Together, you control the bike's acceleration and steering. Agree on which path to ride, chase best times, customize your shoe and try to preserve your friendship.

4348190.title: In Vino Veritas
4348190.short_description: Explore a desecrated cathedral to find your missing wife in this psychological horror adventure. Uncover the dark truth behind the Elohim, solve ancient puzzles, and survive a chilling journey where faith and reality collide. The Bible was mistranslated; the truth is much darker

4348370.title: Hemlon the Grey
4348370.short_description: Hemlon the Grey is a deflection-based 2D Souls-like where life and death are decided by a blade. Follow the story of Hemlon, a half-demon warrior, as she uncovers the dark secrets of the Reinz Republic and the Broken Wings.

4348560.title: Slotlander
4348560.short_description: A short incremental game about a gambling addict whose trip to rehab goes wrong. After a plane crash, you wake up alone on a tropical island with a broken slot machine on the beach. One wish brings it to life. Spins are free. No penalties. No one telling you to stop.

4348610.title: Codex Arcana: Grimoire of Monsters
4348610.short_description: Summon an army of Monster Girls to face your enemies in strategic battles! Defeat the Dark Lord's minions and expand your collection with cool, fierce and cute Monster Girls of all variety in this "Capsule Monsters" inspired game!

4348630.title: Bus Station Simulator
4348630.short_description: In Bus Station Simulator, take over a forgotten bus station and bring it back to life - solo or in co-op! Take care of passengers, your fleet, and the infrastructure as you transform a rundown terminal into the beating heart of Winston Springs.

4348670.title: Darn Guy Adventures
4348670.short_description: Darn Guy Adventures is an RPG adventure following the titular Kishan "Darn Guy", Tinta and Norton as they are sent into a mission they are utterly underqualified for. Encounter verbose bushes, mathematical rocks and very loud wolfmen on the quest to save a town with an expiration date.

4349020.title: Late Night Manifest
4349020.short_description: As Marco, you wake up to a reality where the world is shrouded in darkness, forcing you to fight for survival while seeking answers in abandoned darkness.

4349270.title: Sworn to the Depths
4349270.short_description: A text-driven dungeon crawler inspired by Ironsworn: Delve. Travel to a forbidden site full of treasure, roll dice, make choices, face danger, and find out the hard way why the site was forbidden in the first place! Or maybe you'll find the treasure. It could happen!

4349350.title: Rush Tower
4349350.short_description: Rush Tower is a Tower Defense game where new paths are procedurally added over the course of the game. Can you keep up as the enemy builds more paths in this ever more hectic war?

4349430.title: Goojeegoop
4349430.short_description: Click ClIcK CLICK your way through endless rounds of enemies in an exciting new point and click roguelike and become insanely strong! Click on enemies to unlock new slots, increase your level and create crazy and spectacular builds!

4349470.title: KADI: Ottoman Judge
4349470.short_description: You are a kadı in 1300s Ottoman Empire. Judge cases rooted in real history across ten provinces, from Gemlik to Damascus. Grow wise through knowledge or fall to bribery the balance is yours. Marry, raise a child, and choose between conscience and a never-ending purse. Every ruling shapes your fate.

4349580.title: The Gauntlet
4349580.short_description: Fight a diverse cast of characters each harder than the last! A boss rush game where you face many bosses back to back until you beat them all. Will you survive The Gauntlet?

4349700.title: Alone After Dark: A Short Drive
4349700.short_description: Experience the chilling solitude of a nighttime drive through the woods. You are not the only person—or thing—on the road tonight. Drive carefully and try to stay calm behind the wheel. Can you make it to the sunrise?

4349850.title: Revenant Maze
4349850.short_description: A first person, action-roguelite that centres around going fast. Enter a procedurally generated maze filled with prototypes and architects intent on defeating you. Create the strongest synergies and blitz all in sight.

4349950.title: Alchemist
4349950.short_description: A magic-focused action battle* RPG where research and alchemy shape your path through combat encounters, puzzles, and challenges across diverse locations.

4350100.title: Orbrix
4350100.short_description: Orbrix is a bullet heaven where you craft a unique build to defend against a swarm of bricks. Discover devastating synergies across 60+ upgrades. Survive 10 waves and bosses, then push your build to absurd limits in endless mode. Plus, there are alien pets!

4350110.title: Bullet Time Agent
4350110.short_description: Bullet Time Agent is a sci-fi action-adventure bullet hell. Slow time and dodge storms of bullets as you punch your way through robot-filled arenas. Leap past laser obstacles with super-powered jumps. Take down increasingly intense bosses as you rewind your own death...again.

4350470.title: Wendtale
4350470.short_description: A brilliant breakthrough in turn-based strategy! Just as the enemy attacks, your turn is only beginning—Preemptive Strike, Defense, or Counterattack. Anticipate enemy targeting, manage your resources, and take them out by surprise between turns!

4350480.title: Flywheel
4350480.short_description: Flywheel is a 2D action game where you dash through the skies using jumps and flight. Each run challenges you with ever-changing terrain. With retro pixel art, nostalgic sound, and simple controls, the game is easy to pick up and enjoy.

4350720.title: Unlucky
4350720.short_description: A bullet-heaven wave-based survival gambler roguelike where gambling-powered abilities determine your fate. Survive endless waves in an open world, level up with randomised upgrades, and master the chaos with luck on your side... hopefully.

4350960.title: Defense Of Village
4350960.short_description: This is a roguelike tower defense game focused on builds and decision-making. In every run, map layouts, enemy compositions, shop offerings, and rune rules are procedurally altered. There are no fixed solutions you can rely on—only choices made under constantly changing conditions.

4351280.title: Super Robot Survivors
4351280.short_description: A Roguelite Bullet-Heaven where you rescue astronauts, repair reactors, and hack terminals while blasting hordes of robots in high-stakes, 10-minute showdowns. From the Creative Director of Destroy All Humans! 2 and co-creator of TY the Tasmanian Tiger.

4351820.title: Farming with lasers
4351820.short_description: Incinerate various pests with your giant laser, as you grow your farm. Purchase incremental upgrades to expedite the process.

4352090.title: Liminal:Childhood Memories
4352090.short_description: Exhausted by the gray reality of adulthood, a 21 year old awakens in his forgotten past. Childhood Memories is a puzzle-free, melancholic exploration experience driven by the nostalgic atmosphere of 'Liminal Space' and 'Kenopsia'. No monsters, only memories.

4352540.title: Sekigahara
4352540.short_description: The fate of Japan is in your hands! Sekigahara is a digital adaptation of the acclaimed two-player strategy board game set in 1600, during the epic campaign that unified Japan. Command hidden armies, manage loyalties, and outmaneuver your rival!

4352900.title: Tiny Fortress
4352900.short_description: [Previously called "Tiny Towers"] A short incremental game about defending your tiny fortress from hordes of tiny mobs. Place towers, gain resources by defeating enemies, and unlock new upgrades in the skill tree to strengthen your goblin stronghold.

4353450.title: Astrolander
4353450.short_description: Astrolander is an action-packed modern take on retro platformers featuring innovative 2.5D+3D gameplay and unique optional local co-op chaos! Attack enemies with your CDjector, dodge cassette launching boomboxes, and more on your quest to save the Most Valuable Programs!

4353570.title: Ember Glimmer
4353570.short_description: This is an anime-styled 3D third-person shooter that seamlessly blends real-time combat with loot mechanics. It features a diverse weapon system including a wide range of distinctive firearms and melee weapons, with combat enhanced by characters' elemental specialty skills.

4353710.title: DHALMAN
4353710.short_description: DHALMAN is a single-player action adventure featuring Metroidvania exploration and fighting gameplay across countries, with curry restaurant management between battles. Join DHALMAN on a flavorful journey to face evolving bosses, discover new worlds, and build the world’s greatest curry restaurant.

4354230.title: SheepHoundra
4354230.short_description: A sorting action game where you expose goats disguised as sheep with a blower and use stolen ink to dye sheep for shipment. Create "Rare Sheep" in specified colors within the time limit and aim for maximum profit!

4354320.title: Crime Empire Idle
4354320.short_description: Build your criminal dynasty in a deep idle/incremental game. Run crimes, launder dirty cash, upgrade your empire, use the black market, craft weapons & gear to fight criminal opponents while you balance heat and notoriety.

4354570.title: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION
4354570.short_description: The final battle to decide the fate of the world has begun. Take to the skies, chart your course, and stand with your companions against Sephiroth one last time. A vast planet awaits. Everything leads here.

4354890.title: Pale Cure
4354890.short_description: A first-person survival horror game where you explore a mutating house, evade a delusional family, and live through the nightmare.

4355160.title: What the House Remembers
4355160.short_description: A narrative-driven psychological horror game where a secluded house twists memory into reality. As your sanity deteriorates, uncover a buried truth hidden within its walls before the house reveals what you've tried to forget.

4355180.title: MonsTile
4355180.short_description: A groundbreaking roguelike deck-building defense game on an 8x8 board! Strategically place monsters and trigger synergies to fend off adventurers. Having fled across dimensions from an unbeatable hero, you arrive in worlds of fantasy, apocalypse, wuxia, and cyberpunk to battle their heroes.

4355220.title: Heritage Flipper
4355220.short_description: Cozy house renovation simulator where you renovate historic old ruins into luxury estates. Clean, restore & decorate homes in American, French, English, Spanish, Dutch, Japanese, Chinese & more styles. Uncovering the secret history of each home.

4355260.title: Power Off One
4355260.short_description: You're Sparky, the smallest part inside a giant dying machine. Solve mechanical puzzles to keep its failing chambers alive, and uncover why you were really sent to save it.

4355430.title: VoxelForge
4355430.short_description: Build block by block. Furnish down to the smallest detail. VoxelForge is a single-player creative building game combining a cubic world, realistic materials and built-in interactive furniture. Design your home, shape its surroundings and explore your creations in first person.

4355810.title: Shatterlight
4355810.short_description: Shatterlight — survival horror platformer. Play as Agnes as you enter a Victorian mansion swallowed by the Dark World, where fears take physical form. Use light and a mirror shard to survive living darkness, uncover a family’s nightmare, and find your missing brother.

4356150.title: Plunderfall
4356150.short_description: A co-op action-adventure where you sail a flying ship through floating islands and plunder loot for gold to meet the Captain's demands.

4356310.title: BuzzKill
4356310.short_description: Squash waves of nasty bugs! Swat them, kill them with fire, or pull out the Orbital Death Laser. Your mouse is your weapon in this EPIC Bullet Heaven Roguelike loaded with crazy weapons, items and upgrades! Now go spank some bugs 🎾 🐝

4356460.title: WingsSimulations Flight Simulator 2027
4356460.short_description: Fly anywhere on Earth with realistic weather, detailed aircraft, and thousands of airports. Design your own planes, tackle landing challenges, and experience full-fidelity flight simulation without the usual performance cost.

4356560.title: Before the Walls Break
4356560.short_description: Build your village, fortify your walls, and survive relentless waves of enemies in this strategy tower defense game with resource management and active battlefield abilities.

4357130.title: SnatchDeck
4357130.short_description: Steal, Adapt, Survive! SnatchDeck is a fast-paced and addicting card game that can be played both casually and strategically. Build a powerful deck on the fly by stealing cards from your opponents mid-round. You'll have to adapt your strategy round by round to avoid death.

4357240.title: Relicfall
4357240.short_description: Forge your own class in this Bullet Heaven Action Roguelite. Combine 3 professions to shape a unique skill tree, hunt for powerful loot, and socket relics to create game-breaking synergies. Slay endless hordes and push your build to its limits.

4357470.title: Pubes
4357470.short_description: A 3D action game where you control a strand of body hair and move around a 3D room! Use the unique fluffy floating and sticking abilities of body hair to safely reach your destination!

4358180.title: Shadow Rush
4358180.short_description: Slay hordes of Shadow Demons in this Action RPG with roguelike elements. Fast-paced combat, quick runs, build experimentation, and re-rolling characters. Spells are collectable, equip-able 'Shards' that trigger when you attack. CAN YOU BEAT THE SPEED OF DARKNESS?

4358190.title: Zero Trust
4358190.short_description: An action hacking simulator set in a fully simulated world. Choose your path, craft your own tools, exploit vulnerabilities, and build your reputation. Every company, hacker, and law enforcement agency operates independently — nothing happens by chance. Every playthrough is unique.

4359360.title: Scrappy Craft
4359360.short_description: A shop keeper game where you run a small forge. Scavenge trash and combine it to craft over 10,000 absurd weapons like banana swords or frisbee shields, buy upgrades, unlock new recipes, and sell your bizarre creations to quirky customers like tie-wearing otters or spaghetti monsters.

4360230.title: Be Positive!
4360230.short_description: Move Mr Positve around the arena by converting the cubes around him to reach his goal, Ms. Negative. Play on desktop or in VR.

4360690.title: 银色记忆
4360690.short_description: 扮演失忆的主角在一个充满秘密的小镇生活，探索和恋爱

4360760.title: Gemini X
4360760.short_description: The Heretechs have seized Gemini Colony! Explore, upgrade, and blast your way to victory in Gemini X: a Metroidvania built for fans of classic 32-bit run-and-gun platformers.

4360780.title: Scaredy Cats
4360780.short_description: Where resource management meets dungeon crawler. Collect rare loot, strategize monster encounters, and push your luck to descend to the bottom of the dungeon!

4361120.title: The Mire of Miss Audacity
4361120.short_description: After waking up in a world without her sister, Miss Alexandra Audacity believes she's been left out of a conspiracy between her flaky friends and secretive husband. Guide her through five timelines mired by false memories while trying to keep her sanity, and yours.

4361220.title: DARKDRAW
4361220.short_description: Descend into the Abyss with a fading torch. Darkdraw is a roguelike deckbuilder where every battle is fought on a board, creature against creature, and the dying light changes the rules. Pick your clan, build your deck, keep your flame alive.

4361640.title: OutSpin
4361640.short_description: Ram, bump and launch enemy spinners out of the arena! OUTSPIN is a physics arena brawler roguelite with living arenas, epic boss fights and 10 Heat levels. Pick your spinner, build your run and master the ring-out – on PC and Steam Deck.

4362480.title: Castle Away
4362480.short_description: Build and command your own flying fortress. Battle your way through a hand-drawn realm and craft the strongest keep imaginable. Will your castle hold up against the Archdemon?

4362490.title: 99 NIGHTS IN THE APOCALYPSE
4362490.short_description: A 1-5 player co-op survival game. Team up with friends to survive 99 nights in a post-apocalyptic world. Gather resources, build your camp, craft weapons, explore different biomes, and fight off waves of enemies and powerful bosses.

4362620.title: Your Maid
4362620.short_description: A desktop companion simulation featuring a charming 3D character living on your screen. Drag, rotate, and pose your companion. Collect poses across rarity tiers, unlock costumes, play 7 mini-games, and set alarms while your fantasy friend keeps you company throughout your workday.

4362660.title: Stellar Frontline
4362660.short_description: A unique tower defense game where you build and upgrade defenses by placing hex tiles. Protect your rocket from hostile spaceships to unlock new tiles after each defeated wave.

4363730.title: Bonk Universe
4363730.short_description: Explore an infinite universe with unlimited possibilities, Conquer the Celestials, Build civilizations, and more! This is an open universe sandbox game, and not even the sky is the limit!

4363880.title: Ashes - Doomsday Borer
4363880.short_description: A side-scrolling game featuring adventure, exploration, level progression, boss battles, and puzzle-solving. Take on the role of a modified rodent warrior, piloting an underground vehicle to fight against an artificial intelligence and save the creatures living beneath the surface.
publishers: Homeless Network Technology Guangzhou Co., Ltd

4363890.title: Slay the Slime
4363890.short_description: An incremental game where you slay thousands of slimes in an epic power fantasy. Stack upgrades, master unique classes, equip powerful relics and defeat mighty bosses on your way from rookie to the guild's top adventurer.

4364220.title: This is not Chess, It's War!
4364220.short_description: Use your voice to command your army and lead them to victory in an intense game of chess!

4364310.title: Cook The Dungeon
4364310.short_description: Cook the Dungeon is a first-person roguelike deckbuilder where every fight feeds the next. Descend through branching paths, forage for herbs, hunt strange creatures, and build a deck of Cuts, Preps, and Seasons. Land precise cuts, harvest monster parts, and cook meals for the battles ahead.

4364880.title: 键盘农场 Keyboard Farm
4364880.short_description: "Keyboard Farm" is a desktop idle farming game. Place it on your desktop and focus on your work. Every key is a plot of land—each keystroke helps plants grow. Harvest crops to collect coins, unlock various keycaps, and create your own keyboard world.

4364920.title: CHEAT
4364920.short_description: CHEAT is an exam-themed card Roguelike game. You play as a student who must collect and use various bizarre cards and skills. Stay vigilant, dodge the teachers, improve your scores and rankings, and ultimately achieve victory in the exam!

4365430.title: Striders
4365430.short_description: Plunge into the sea trenches and command an army of summoned allies. Upgrade you and your team, stack devastating synergies, as you overwhelm the relentless HORDE. Transform from a lone diver into an unstoppable force backed by an ocean of allies in this Vampire Survivors–inspired action roguelike.

4365610.title: Creatures
4365610.short_description: Breed, teach, and guide your Norns as they grow into independent creatures. Explore the world of Albia, develop their skills, and build new colonies by sending your strongest Norns into unexplored worlds!

4366220.title: Evolution: Code of 6 Desires
4366220.short_description: In this evolutionary simulation game, you play as a deity sowing the seeds of life. Each human you create possesses a unique genome, where the combination of desire genes determines their behavioral patterns and fate trajectory. A sandbox about life, choice, and destiny awaits your discovery.

4366240.title: Silent Still 3
4366240.short_description: Silent Still 3 is a first-person psychological horror experience focused on sleep paralysis, limited movement, and environmental tension. Fear builds slowly through silence, observation, subtle audio cues, and realistic spaces, creating a lasting sense of unease as control gradually slips away.

4366510.title: Lattice Defense
4366510.short_description: A tower defense game meets top-down shooter. Build a maze of walls and elemental towers by day. Defend yourself by night. Dash, build, and blast your way until dawn. Play solo or in online co-op.

4368520.title: pieces/渡り鳥のソムニウム
4368520.short_description: 不愿入睡的少女，渴望长眠的少年。 当两人的梦重叠之时，传说将再度流转。 最终，与你一同坠入浅眠之国。

4368650.title: Impulse Vector: Fighter Ops
4368650.short_description: As an independent contractor aboard a corporate carrier, pilot your Space Superiority Fighter on missions for rival organisations. Protect miners, strike enemy stations, and patrol the void to earn your keep and build your company’s name across the frontier!

4368670.title: Two Demon Catgirls: A Nocturne of Evil
4368670.short_description: 🍂🍷A mystical and devilish visual novel about two demonic catgirls, a lonely author, and the nature of Evil — with music, philosophy, dark humor, and hand-painted gouache artwork.

4368880.title: RatSpire
4368880.short_description: RatSpire is a top-down survivor roguelite focused on minion progression and auto-battling, choosing your own path. Recruit quirky classes, stack weapons, potions, and relics to craft absurd builds, and the higher you climb, the better it feels. Hands off — let your legion fight for you.

4369040.title: Infected Zone Survival
4369040.short_description: "Infected Zone Survival" is an open world zombie apocalypse survival game. The game is mainly based on third person action shooting, and can be searched, disguised, built, made, cultivated, fished,hunted, recruited NPCs, simulated management, etc.

4369260.title: Act! Autonomy: Cell-Tones
4369260.short_description: Act! Cellular Tuning—a rhythm game with fully innovative free-input gameplay—is set to launch in Winter 2026! Relax, immerse yourself fully, and tune your unique movement in the ocean of the subconscious!

4369680.title: Moldborne
4369680.short_description: A dark fantasy co-op turn-based roguelike. The Father stopped answering prayers years ago. Then the mold came up out of the ground, and the dead started getting back up. They remember everything. So do you.

4370190.title: Refrain: Verse of Fate
4370190.short_description: A garden caught in eternal recurrence. A god who forgets everything. A witness without rest. In this narrative-driven 2D exploration game, walk, listen, and read your way through four cycles to piece together a truth hidden beneath the surface.

4370670.title: To the Stars: Do Maid Robots Dream of Electric Grapefruit
4370670.short_description: This is a Visual Novel RPG where you role play as a maid robot in a post-apocalyptic world, where pollution made the ground surface no longer liveable; Your purpose is to help your USER build her spaceship "The Golden Star" and eventually witness her journey into the sapce.

4370780.title: TileShire
4370780.short_description: TileShire is a low-stakes, high-depth strategy game. Combine tiles on a living landscape to grow a home rich with life.

4370840.title: Purrfect Ascent
4370840.short_description: A minimalist Foddian-style precision platformer with an unusual control scheme: the character automatically jumps when moving left or right, and jump height scales directly with horizontal speed up to a maximum. A brutal ascent to rescue your frightened kitty. Meow.

4370930.title: Harvestville: Song of the Ancestress
4370930.short_description: A farming/life-sim game with a folk horror twist. An enigmatic deity has convinced the residents of Harvestville to conduct an unorthodox ritual. Grow crops, connect with the townsfolk, and uncover the terrifying secrets waiting beneath the surface...

4371220.title: Ash Dawn
4371220.short_description: Dodge or Die! You are out of potions.

4371380.title: March of the Kingdom
4371380.short_description: A party-management roguelite RPG auto-battler where you explore diverse lands, hunt the enemies of the kingdom, and face unpredictable encounters. Build your team, level up, and collect powerful weapons, artifacts, and relics to aid you on your journey.

4371400.title: Kintsugi
4371400.short_description: Take a cinematic adventure through the world of Kintsugi as you use different movement abilities to traverse through its magical landscape and save wounded creatures from the Corruption.

4371490.title: XENOBLAST
4371490.short_description: XENOBLAST is a chaotic party game where you battle for glory throughout the unknown universe. Use lasers, missiles, phasers and many more weapons to devastate your opponents. With a heavy focus on movement, this game encourages the use of gravity fields and movement devices to dominate your foes.

4371600.title: Dice Brawl
4371600.short_description: Dice Brawl is a dice customization roguelite map crawler game. Progress through different areas defeating enemies to unlock additional customization options. With different die face actions, rarities, and modifiers, dice customization has never been so rewarding. Roll for your destiny!

4371900.title: Case File: Archived 3:12AM
4371900.short_description: At 3:12 AM, someone knocked. The door was locked from the inside. A story-rich psychological horror where you explore and investigate a Kolkata home as reality begins to repeat, change, and remember.

4372450.title: Almarti: Trade in the Woods
4372450.short_description: Almarti: Trade in the Woods is a point-and-click puzzle game. In the woods by the lake, a female who calls herself Almarti hopes for your help. Please follow her guide, do sort of things, and finally achieve that ulterior purpose……

4372600.title: Fables of the Kingdom 3
4372600.short_description: Fables of the Kingdom 3 is a new chapter in the fairy-tale time-management strategy series. Manage resources, construct buildings, and wield powerful spells to protect the Great Tree of Life and stop the mad sorcerer Balen.

4372780.title: Muv-Luv: Tactics Kalidasa at Nightmare
4372780.short_description: The heir to the legendary "Muv-Luv Alternative" series, "Muv-Luv: Tactics Kalidasa at Nightmare" is a tactical simulation RPG devoted to pure gameplay excellence.

4372990.title: EVO Card
4372990.short_description: A biopunk roguelike deckbuilder where you evolve by stealing enemy organs. Devour rivals, mutate your entire body, fuse material cards, and build the ultimate chimera. Kill or be eaten—become the apex predator.

4373420.title: All Haul the King
4373420.short_description: A co-op game where you and your friends embark on an epic journey to drag the goblin king’s dead body across the kingdom to resurrect him. Use brains, brawn and crazy goblin magic to navigate the tricky terrain and puzzles that lie in your path.

4373910.title: Unending Watch - Dead Man's Fingers
4373910.short_description: A steampunk extraction survival game built on brutal melee combat and constant tension. No guns—only heavy strikes, smart counters, and raw survival. Enemies hunt, adapt, and ambush. The world shifts mid-run. Extract with loot… or be claimed by the dark.

4374200.title: Snack Factory Together
4374200.short_description: Manage a snack factory together! Produce various treats for maximum profit. Upgrade machines, unlock new products, and deliver massive orders. Can you handle the demand?

4374270.title: Hustle
4374270.short_description: Hustle is a VR adventure game where you play as a Bounty Hunter taking on various jobs for interplanetary corporations and conspiracy groups. What will you do for a taste of everything?

4374530.title: Keep It Up!
4374530.short_description: Keep It Up! is a 4 player co-op physics game where you and your fellow genetically [redacted] test subjects slap a balloon through a mysterious obstacle course without it touching the ground. You've gotta Keep It Up!

4374750.title: Bound By Fate - Cursed Soulmates
4374750.short_description: Break the cycle and find new love, or embrace your handsome (but creepy) Yandere soulmate in this horror romance visual novel.

4374870.title: Fun World
4374870.short_description: Explore the Nightmares of Fun World — a once-cheerful children’s park that has fallen into ruin, now twisted and corrupted by dark forces beyond understanding. What was once filled with laughter and bright colors is now drenched in shadows, echoing with distant sounds you can’t quite explain.

4375030.title: Strawberry Cafe
4375030.short_description: Build your own strawberry cafe and farm in this cozy, casual management sim. Grow strawberries for customers to pick, or harvest your homegrown strawberries to cook delicious strawberry-themed food and drinks. Complete missions and keep customers happy to unlock new furniture and recipes.

4375040.title: Dwarfspire
4375040.short_description: Dwarfspire is an idle shopkeeper that sits on the edge of your screen. Manage a shop of hand crafted gear while sending expeditions of dwarves up mountains to gather rare materials and forge new items. Mine ore, craft items and become a master shopkeeper!

4375090.title: Key Krusher
4375090.short_description: Krush the keys coming at you in this arcade-style typing game.

4375130.title: Mage On The Move
4375130.short_description: Mage on the Move is a rouge like game with many upgrades and things to unlock to avoid dying from the robots that will chase you through your runs. Purchase stat upgrades with skill points and physical upgrades with the legendary currency of the Vietnamese dong (in game currency only).

4375510.title: Lane of the Eternal Night
4375510.short_description: An exploratory, self-chosen experience type of light roguelike turn-based pixel indie game, currently without much storyline. Although the combat is turn-based, it’s more like a rock-paper-scissors style game mode, and it also includes skills.

4375740.title: Island
4375740.short_description: Island is a post-apocalyptic visual novel. You appear on the beach of the island, not remembering your past, and your goal is to survive. The wildlife, the other inhabitants of the island all around want you dead. Make the right choice, because it may be the last one!

4375930.title: Undead Apocalypse: Hellbreak
4375930.short_description: Fire, throw, and ride your way through a zombie-infested city. Shoot them down, blast with grenades, and escape on a motorcycle - a survival TPS built on constant action and momentum.

4376030.title: Failover
4376030.short_description: Take command of civil air defense under constant threat. Build radar networks, manage power and resources, and decide when to sound the sirens. Every choice has consequences. Hold your cities together as escalation turns survival into strategy.

4376210.title: Whirlwind Survivor
4376210.short_description: Movement IS damage. A roguelite survivor with 100+ skill cards across Fire, Frost, and Lightning. One stick, total carnage. Every run builds different, every run plays different. Pure chaos and flow state.

4376500.title: Miracle Mage: Awakened Elements
4376500.short_description: "Awakened Elements" is a match-three strategy RPG where chaos spreads as the Demon King shatters elemental balance. As a young mage, awaken lost powers, rally elven allies, and battle through thorny paths to restore order before darkness consumes the world.

4376810.title: That One Dungeon Room
4376810.short_description: An action-infused Idle/Incremental game that blends effortless play with satisfying combat. It combines rewarding incremental progression with action and RPG elements, creating a deep, grind-driven progression system focused on upgrades, long-term growth, and a highly addictive gameplay loop.

4376830.title: V.E.C.T. Impact
4376830.short_description: Smash through geometric hordes with your lance. Spend each run’s credits on permanent upgrades in your skill tree to unleash orbitals, sword waves and chain lightning. Keep upgrading until every enemy you smash ignites a blast. Click. Charge. Cue the fireworks.

4377120.title: Way to Oasis
4377120.short_description: Way to Oasis : a post-apocalyptic visual novel. You lead a six-member caravan after the captain’s death. Manage scarce resources, navigate moral dilemmas, and face hidden threats. Your choices decide if the group survives or perishes.

4377330.title: Streamer vs. Chat
4377330.short_description: An interactive game with Twitch and Kick integration where every message matters. You vs. your Chat. Are you ready to fight against your viewers?

4377480.title: Burn-9
4377480.short_description: A spy thriller where you’re not the spy. Safe behind your screen, guide the last survivor of an elite black-ops team in a desperate attempt to salvage a mission gone horribly wrong. Caught between military command and your agent, information is your greatest weapon.

4377860.title: Bumpers & Dragons
4377860.short_description: Drop balls. Slay dragons. Bumpers & Dragons is a pachinko roguelite where physics meets strategy. Engineer your luck, create wild combos, and crawl deeper into procedurally generated dungeons.

4377960.title: GNOSiS
4377960.short_description: Lost, alone, & vulnerable, a voluntary candidate of a twisted treasure hunt attempts to survive inside someones sadistic nightmare . . Explore this Open-World Survival Horror carefully & let the guiding signals orientate your escape from this hellish reality!

4378400.title: Minesleeper
4378400.short_description: You wake up in a distant part of the universe 27.000 years after being deployed on an urgent mission to save humanity from extinction. A minesweeper gets a dangerous makeover in this hexagonal roguelite. Outsmart devious puzzles, bend the odds, and turn failures into triumph.

4379620.title: The Lonely Meadow
4379620.short_description: In The Lonely Meadow, you are a wandering spirit in a silent world. Glide over yellow plains to spark vibrant life in your wake and seek out 16 shattered landmarks. Reassemble the past to restore colour, sound, and soul to this forgotten sanctuary. Will you wake the meadow?

4379870.short_description: "Who do you want to save? Or rather... who are you prepared to abandon?" A midnight "Unsend" trapped them in a rift in time, and awakened the dead "You." Become a "Ghost" inhabiting screens and surveillance feeds. Pry into perfect disguises and rotting hearts.

4380220.title: NULL
4380220.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game about grief, obsession, and love. Sleep to enter dreams, take control of them, and descend into deeper layers where time moves slower. Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover the mystery of a grieving father who created a world frozen in time.

4380350.title: Buckshot Bunny
4380350.short_description: Buckshot Bunny is a single-player, fast-paced 2D action platformer, testing your speed and agility, navigating challenging locations as the cybernetic rabbit, Buck. Run, smash and bullet-jump through hazards and enemies to free your family and find your way back home.

4380730.title: Red Passport: Deported
4380730.short_description: A sequel to the adventure game Red Passport. After being deported from Japan, the hero faces a long journey home to Moscow. With no money or documents, you must hitchhike, ride freight trains, work odd jobs, and solve local problems to survive the road.

4380860.title: Fool King
4380860.short_description: Dethrone the Fool King in this tactical autobattler with asynchronous PvP! Amass your troops, apply powerful upgrades and set your battle formations. Watch your plans come together or fall apart in frantic simulated combat!

4381120.title: Virtual Driving School: Trucks
4381120.short_description: Train like a professional HGV driver. Master trucks and buses, manage blind spots and long loads, avoid bridge strikes, navigate level crossings, and operate vehicle-mounted cranes. Real rules, real risks — zero real-world consequences.

4381370.title: FEMBOY SLEEPOVER - Episode 1
4381370.short_description: You're invited to the Femboy Sleepover! In Episode 1 get to know your new femboy roommates, but watch out— your succubus might have other ideas...

4381390.title: When I'm Not Drawing
4381390.short_description: In this cozy life-simulation RPG, you play as a young artist who moves to a new city to pursue your dreams. Plan your schedule, balance life and career, explore the city, and meet new friends! Live a fulfilling year on your own, at your own pace.

4381810.title: Adaptive Wilds
4381810.short_description: Learn the land. Make a life in it. Adaptive Wilds is a hardcore survival RPG with deep character progression, interacting physical and psychological states, and a wilderness you can reshape. Develop your skills, work with NPCs, experiment with nature, and explore dream realms.

4381890.title: Sky Pirates
4381890.short_description: Set sail with your friends aboard a flying pirate ship! Explore mysterious islands, plunder ships and treasures, and amass a fortune… But beware: the richer you get, the more you attract unwanted attention!

4382260.title: Castaway Diary: Portal to the Unknown Isles
4382260.short_description: Castaway Diary is a bright and charming anime-style survival adventure. Are you ready to escape to a relaxing island life with a group of lovely girls?

4382360.title: Lucky Sip
4382360.short_description: This is a time-management restaurant simulation game with roguelike elements. Master a wide range of tasty drinks, meet all kinds of customers, and learn diverse management skills. Combine your options wisely to conquer both casual stage runs and the rent challenge!

4382680.title: River Drift
4382680.short_description: Paddle in sync or sink together. River Drift is a chaotic co-op rafting game where you and a friend fight wildlife, repair your raft mid-river, and survive deadly branching routes. Teamwork is optional, panic is guaranteed!

4382760.title: EonDeluge
4382760.short_description: Welcome to EonDeluge, a turn-based bullet hell game. Two players take turns. One draws the bullet patterns in real time while the other steers through them; at the end of the round you swap, and it goes on until someone's energy runs out.

4383110.title: 2080 - Operation Sunshield
4383110.short_description: Can a giant umbrella save Earth? Be part of the most important mission in human history and join the crew onto a daring trip into space! Will you save mankind from global warming? Be the engineer of our future in this humorous hand-drawn point-and-click-adventure (alpaca inside).

4383190.title: Intravenous 3
4383190.short_description: Tense stealth action, tactical hardcore gunplay, and missions & story shaped by the way you play. Step into the roles of Steve and Sean, outnumbered and forced to survive a relentless manhunt.

4383210.title: Splatt
4383210.short_description: Race your friends to the finish line while carrying a very breakable egg. Throw eggs at the racer ahead, dodge their traps and try not to drop yours. Win Drips, unlock Carties and perk cards, and paint your racer into a masterpiece or a mess.

4383270.title: Trip to the Core
4383270.short_description: Build three decks at once in a roguelike deckbuilder where 15 rebels fuse modular gear into broken combos across five shifting acts.

4383310.title: GraveDiggers
4383310.short_description: Online co-op horror for 1 to 6 undertaker cats. Every day, find the body, drag its coffin across a cursed Louisiana swamp and bury it before sunrise. Skeletons, Lazarites and the midnight mist will try to stop you. Eat cheese whenever you can.

4383480.title: PowerCorp
4383480.short_description: A space sim survival where each decision costs power. Every system drains your dying reactor. Pilot a crippled spacecraft across a real-scale solar system using true orbital mechanics, manage critical systems, scavenge for resources, while you try to uncover why humanity seems to have disappeared.

4383780.title: Anomalift
4383780.short_description: Everything is normal. Or is it? Anomalift is a cooperative anomaly-spotting game where observation is your greatest tool. Search each area, and report your findings. One mistake leads you somewhere you were never meant to be.

4384430.title: Arcane Spellforge: Core Defense
4384430.short_description: Forge spells with your hands, build tactical defenses, and unleash devastating power in VR. Upgrade modular weapons and towers, adapt your strategy, and survive relentless waves of robotic enemies attacking your core from every direction.

4384510.title: HANAE // PRIMARY
4384510.short_description: A first-person psychological story game: You are Hanae, trapped in a distorted game world. Evilnae wants to take your place and rebuilds everything after every escape attempt. Find the cracks, write everything down and escape... before it's too late.

4385210.title: CastleOn Scriptum
4385210.short_description: Build a castle and defend it from your enemies! Construct towers, place traps, train and command units in this historical, manuscript-themed mix of Tower Defense and classical Real Time Strategy.

4385430.title: The One Who Returned
4385430.short_description: A single-player action RPG set in a fantasy world. Discover your forgotten identity while fighting enemies and completing quests. Enjoy total freedom of character development with no fixed classes—build your hero exactly how you want.

4385500.title: HERE AGAIN
4385500.short_description: You wake up in a silent underground facility with one simple instruction: REMEMBER THE BUTTON. Weird dreams and changing surroundings haunt this place. Explore, observe, and unveil the mystery that envelopes this place in this Retro Psychological Horror Game.

4386140.title: Arrow Hell
4386140.short_description: Play as a Magical Arrow and Fight for your Survival in the Space. A fast-paced arcade game packed with relentless and sci-fi enemy waves. Dodge, Attack & Upgrade and stand until the end in this Short & Minimally Designed Action Arena.

4386230.title: Void Sanction
4386230.short_description: A sci-fi action RPG. Battle alien hordes with fast-paced combat, evolving weapons, and a combat drone companion. Upgrade your arsenal, defeat challenging bosses, and explore a hostile alien world.

4386260.title: REDSTREAM DISPATCH
4386260.short_description: REDSTREAM: DISPATCH casts you as a police officer responding to multiple Dispatch Scenarios. Routine patrols spiral into a violent nightmare tied to a sinister streaming group. Randomized encounters and reactive gore make every run brutal. Rescue the girl. Get out alive.

4386360.title: Death Denied
4386360.short_description: Death Denied is a brutal, fast-paced top-down action game focusing on skull-crushing close combat in medieval England. Every encounter is an unforgiving deadly dance. Break walls, bones and necks. Strike with precision. Embrace divine blessings that modify the way you fight.

4386570.title: Click to Medieval Roguelite
4386570.short_description: Don't want to play a massive complex campaign? Grow your medieval province with just a few clicks, sell your meager hamlet/kingdom then unlock auto hire workers with incremental upgrades for a more idle playstyle, watch your kingdom grow wealthy and powerful with ease.

4386950.title: くろねこ・ぷれい・ろーる！
4386950.short_description: 「くろねこ・ぷれい・ろーる！」は、3D空間で主人公のねこを操作し、会話でストーリーが進行するRPGです。VR・PC（Windows）の両方でプレイ可能です。プレイヤーであるあなたは、不思議な本に閉じ込められてしまった主人公の「ゆかいなくろもふねこちゃん」になり、問題を解決しながら本から脱出しましょう。

4386990.title: Victorian Pier Tycoon
4386990.short_description: Build and manage your own Victorian seaside pier in this nostalgic pixel-art tycoon game. Construct steam-powered rides, balance the delicate needs of the Aristocracy against the Working Class, and maintain structural integrity. Will your resort become a world wonder, or crumble into the sea?

4387050.title: SCP Tower
4387050.short_description: You were hired as a ranger into National park. Your job? Taking care of Suntop Lookout. However once you get there, ceiling trapdoor is blasted open, showing continuation of Suntop Lookout. Will you enter?

4387490.title: Purge Of Evil: Age of the Fallen Spirits
4387490.short_description: A dark action RPG inspired by Vietnamese mythology, where ancient legends, restless spirits, and forgotten sins shape a land on the brink of collapse.

4387750.title: Concrete Polishing Simulator
4387750.short_description: Turn rough concrete into polished floors in a hands-on first-person simulator developed by a real concrete polisher. Operate professional equipment, complete every stage from preparation to sealing, and build your reputation one job at a time.

4388300.title: Farming Pixels
4388300.short_description: A unique indie progression game. Collect resources, complete quests, and level up. Expand the game world and visit locations like the forest, the arcade, or the market.

4388470.title: TetraDice
4388470.short_description: Forget everything you know about falling blocks. TetraDice blends classic arcade strategy with Roguelite powers and dice-driven chaos. Bend gravity, unleash explosions, and use 50+ Perks to survive and beat the high score.

4388690.title: Poor Samantha: An Agoraphobic Visual Novel
4388690.short_description: "Noodles are the food of solitude." Trapped by agoraphobia and social anxiety, your only friend is Samantha. She is your courage to open the door. But in a room of broken mirrors, who is actually speaking? A short psychological visual novel about isolation and the lies we tell ourselves.

4388880.title: Star TD
4388880.short_description: Command your defense in an ever-changing roguelite TD. Harvest resources from mine nodes, explore the fog of war, and repel alien waves. With a deep branching tech tree and permanent progression, every defeat is just a step toward ultimate power. Build. Die. Research. Repeat.

4390680.title: Horror Pipes
4390680.short_description: You are a disposable employee of PIPECORE. Descend into infinite, procedurally generated sewers to clear blockages and survive. Manage your flashlight, wield your shotgun, and navigate claustrophobic tunnels where industrial filth meets horror. Clean the pipes or die trying.

4390710.title: RUIN'S HOUSE
4390710.short_description: A unique fusion of "Lady" × "Haunted Mansion"—a 2.5D horror action experience emerges! Who is the lady? What happened in this place long ago? Collect the scattered Fragments of Memory throughout the mansion and uncover the truth!

4390830.title: VilaGod
4390830.short_description: VilaGod is a god simulator where you shape the destiny of civilizations on giant maps. Unlike other god games, every action generates dynamic chronicles: from political revolts to legendary discoveries, watch your world's history unfold in 14 different languages

4391110.title: Dead Man Waiting
4391110.short_description: Await your verdict in a luxury apartment that can execute you. Your behavior is judged. Survive long enough and you might be pardoned.

4392520.title: Ex Decreto
4392520.short_description: Ex Decreto puts you in the role of governor of a province recently conquered by Rome: Dalmatia, in the 1st century AD. Administer justice wisely to maintain peace and assert Roman rule! Be careful, however, not to make too many errors in judgment.

4392560.title: Line of Contact
4392560.short_description: A linear, story-driven first-person shooter focused on intense combat and a dark military narrative.

4392620.title: DJINN SCROLLS
4392620.short_description: Djinn Scrolls is an action roguelike set in a dark world inspired by ancient Jinn folklore. Wield elemental magic and Prime Scrolls that unleash spells through conditional triggers. Craft deadly synergies, adapt your build mid-run, and survive relentless enemies and cursed bosses.

4393200.title: Poop Deck
4393200.short_description: Step onto the Poop Deck™ in this chaotic online co-op game! Collaborate with your crew to keep the dysfunctional ship moving. Repair engines, patch leaks, and manage crises as you race to the destination. Can your team survive before the vessel falls apart?

4393240.title: Portal Fall
4393240.short_description: Portal Fall is a turn-based roguelike where your skill set evolves mid-combat. Battle endless waves of enemies across fractured realities ruled by an ethereal Jester.

4393470.title: Burned Out!
4393470.short_description: Burned Out! is a chaotic office co-op game for 1-4 players where pointless computer tasks and paperwork spiral into full-blown workplace mayhem. Type, print, sign, stamp, staple, and deliver orders while the backlog keeps growing. Coordinate through workplaces designed to break you.

4393700.title: Elderfeast
4393700.short_description: Hunt. Carve. Cook. Elderfeast is a co-op action game where the monsters are the menu. Hunt Lovecraftian horrors across the galaxy and slice them apart for ingredients to make your next meal. The better you cook, the stronger you become, but there's always something more terrifying to hunt next.

4394090.title: Thorner
4394090.short_description: Thorner is a horror visual novel with multiple endings. You attempt to escape your past by fleeing to the wilderness, but spilled blood can never be forgiven. The land knows what you did. The land judges. Thorner awaits.

4394130.title: Unbox the Room 2
4394130.short_description: The cozy unboxing and interior design experience returns — bigger, warmer, and more reactive. From homes to small businesses, each space responds to your choices and reflects its owner’s personality.

4394180.title: The Pactmaker
4394180.short_description: You are a professor who forged pacts with otherworldly entities to save your daughter. Dive into the memories of others, alter reality, and use your new supernatural abilities to uncover the truth in this dark point-and-click thriller.

4394410.title: Inner Rooms
4394410.short_description: Wander through vast, unsettling liminal spaces as a quiet presence grows alongside you. Inner Rooms is a psychological atmospheric exploration game set in a world that appears calm and peaceful, yet constantly radiates unease.

4394420.title: Dinosaur Tree
4394420.short_description: Explore the ocean in your sailboat as a curious little dinosaur. Discover charming islands and meet friendly pals along the way. But beware! There may be something trying to tempt you off your path.

4394720.title: The Warden's Rite
4394720.short_description: The Warden's Rite is a fantasy tower defense game set in a world consumed by the Fire God. You are humanity's last hope. As the Warden, command Earth, Air, and Water with the power of the Elemental Gods. Combine elements to create traps, block paths, and place towers to set your strategy.

4395320.title: Logisticats
4395320.short_description: Move to a floating island and start a new life alongside a colony of cats with unique personalities! In this cozy business sim, you'll help your cats to plant crops and build buildings before taking to the skies in your airship to lead your feline crew in search of treasure and adventure!

4395460.title: Guns, Princess and Braves
4395460.short_description: Fast-paced Roguelike: inventory management meets tower defense. As a princess in love with a dragon, strategically layout weapons in limited space. Take direct control in battle to crush "righteous" braves with flashy bullet!

4395800.title: ONIGASHIMA: Awakening
4395800.short_description: A predictive deck-building RPG! Build your strategy from over 300 cards! Form powerful formations with unique animal companions! Master countless combinations and claim overwhelming victories! Your adventure to defeat the ONI begins now!

4395850.title: Rocksowers
4395850.short_description: Co-op Survival Sandbox meets Bullet Hell. Explore the corrupted surface on a moving base, scavenge for resources and craft GAME-BREAKING weapons using many unique modules to defeat ever-stronger foes. Fight to reclaim what The Bloom took from humanity!

4396030.title: OKEYABILITY
4396030.short_description: Rediscover the thrill of Classic Okey (Tile-based Rummy) in a neon-lit, robotic atmosphere! Enjoy traditional rules or use unique abilities to shift the balance. Define your strategy, customize your robot, and claim your spot at the table of the future!

4396110.title: NOSBALL
4396110.short_description: Nosball is a fast-paced car drifting soccer game with demolition derby chaos. Smash rivals, master physics-based control, and score goals on dangerous pinball-style arenas set in global locations with dynamic weather.

4396230.title: FishingMaster: Catch Giants Together
4396230.short_description: Fishing Master: Catch Giants Together is a first-person fishing simulation focused on realistic float fishing. Cast your line, watch the float, set the hook, and fight powerful fish. Control your rod angle, manage line tension, and enjoy peaceful lakeside scenery between thrilling catches.

4396550.title: Outdraft
4396550.short_description: Lead an esports team in a MOBA discipline, draft heroes, manage players, and guide your organization to championship glory in a strategic autobattler with deep management elements.

4396830.title: Dfiance: Dominance
4396830.short_description: Three worlds at war. Grind ranked, crush enemies, or go for tournament glory. Build your deck, trade skins, play solo or with friends. Three factions, endless strategies. Free to play. Your dominance starts now.

4397360.title: The Flying Feather Shotgun
4397360.short_description: There's tales told about a shootgun that can burst dreams into reality... Well, no, to be honest, it's just a single succubus that illegally entered MacDude's room that tell that. Let's believe her! And off we go to a 2d arena shooter with movement bound to the recoil of your weapons!

4397880.title: ReEvolution Project
4397880.short_description: A singleplayer story-driven horror game set in a desolate post-apocalyptic world. Explore a decaying abandoned house, scavenging for supplies and uncovering fragments of its story. Solve environmental puzzles that challenge your perception, and decide how deep you're willing to dig.

4398650.title: Doom ChessMaster
4398650.short_description: The end has come. Who will save us? You are the "Player" surviving in ruins. No chosen heroes—only the strong remain. Gather them, plan carefully, use gear to change fate. Truth lies in the wreckage. Dare you play?

4398680.title: Moon Reader
4398680.short_description: Become a Fortune Teller in this Narrative Life-sim set in a Neo-futuristic Moon Colony. Read Tarot Cards and influence people, manage your Time and Money, Pay your Bills, and Make Decisions that would change your life and the lives of the people around you.

4399010.title: wonderful florescence
4399010.short_description: Winter is drawing near.As a girl from the Lower City, you'll journey to Midcity and meet the people who will change your life—and whose lives you'll change in return. Experience a heartfelt story of dreams, growth, and unexpected encounters.

4399080.title: PapyPanic
4399080.short_description: Dive into the chaos! Play as an object in a wacky Prop Hunt with friends, or try to survive behind the wheel of a brake-less "Grandpa-mobile" with unforgiving physics. The twist? Your Twitch chat controls the action in real time. Will you survive your viewers?

4399120.title: Smart Train Simulator
4399120.short_description: Take the controls of the classic 81-717 and modern 81-765 on Moscow Metro Line 7. Master authentic cab controls, braking and safety systems, and explore stations and depots on foot. Built on professional train simulator technology.

4399160.title: INORIGAMI HACK DOWN
4399160.short_description: A point-and-click horror adventure where you battle evil spirits to escape. You take a part-time job at the "House of Saschiumi," a place said to grant happiness through prayer. Instead, you find yourself hacking into the vengeful spirits' data to survive.

4399300.title: Bandit Life
4399300.short_description: Build a hideout, gather your gang, and live off what others cannot defend. Explore a medieval world, set ambushes, develop your outlaws, and face the consequences of decisions that could make you the terror of the roads—or bring your entire gang to ruin.

4400550.title: Superheroes Inc: #VictoryLeague
4400550.short_description: As a social media influencer recruited to a team of heroes, can you earn their trust, defend the city, and prove you’re worth more than your follower count? A text-based interactive superhero novel.

4401350.title: The Sound of the Conch in the Age of Declining Dharma: War of the Last Buddha's Relic
4401350.short_description: War erupted over the last Buddha Relic. In the land where Maitreya Bodhisattva is destined to descend and attain Buddhahood, Gesang lost all memory in an air raid. Doubting salvation itself, Gesang met Udum—same fate, rare disease, yet utter faith. They became inseparable as cruel reality closed in—

4401360.title: The Necessary Evil
4401360.short_description: The Necessary Evil is a tactical RPG about making difficult decisions and preparing for the unpredictable. Lead "volunteers" into the dark and rotting recesses of the collective unconscious, colonized and industrialized and plundered for profit. Every decision matters, and every choice has a cost.

4401840.title: EPOCH EXPRESS
4401840.short_description: A roguelite action game where you control a train, build and customize deadly wagons, and face enemies that evolve across eras by learning from how you play and how you die.

4401950.title: Indie City Mixtape 2026
4401950.short_description: The Indie City Mixtape features seven small games, all contained within a 3D Platformer launcher. Ranging from shaving llamas to horror narrative, there's something for everyone in this ABSOLUTE BARGAIN of a collection!

4401980.title: Ashes of Darkness
4401980.short_description: Ashes of Darkness is a 2D Soulslike Action RPG set in a dark medieval world. Master fast-paced combat, defeat powerful enemies, collect rare artifacts, and forge your own build as you grow stronger and challenge deadly bosses.

4402040.title: Gangsta Bean 3: Night of the Rising Bread
4402040.short_description: Gangsta Bean, Krazy Karrot, T-Mato, and Brock Lee gang up to fight hordes of reanimated rotten food zombies in this retro arcade-style twin-stick beat 'em up sequel to the classic Flash games.

4402300.title: Derby Life: Ranch & Race
4402300.short_description: Derby Life: Ranch & Race is where great racehorses are made, not born. Breed, raise, and train your own on a living open-world ranch, then saddle up and race the World Tour. Roam, fish, explore, compete. Your ranch, your horse, your glory.

4402340.title: A day at preschool
4402340.short_description: Welcome to A Day at Preschool. Care for the cutest yet most troublesome creatures—human toddlers. With strange requests and emotions that turn into tears, use light logic and simple puzzles to organize everything and guide them through a chaotic but adorable day.

4402360.title: Mech Support
4402360.short_description: Mech Support is an action focused, multitasking game, featuring frantic tower defense elements. Up to four players take control of "US Inc" engineers, tasked with defending military outposts and crafting powerful ammunition, in order to destroy waves of dastardly "THEM Co" enemy mechs.

4402490.title: ScareZone: Haunted Attraction Tycoon
4402490.short_description: Build the haunted attraction of your nightmares! Design chilling walkthroughs, fill them with animatronics and actors, then watch your victims - er, guests - scream their way through your twisted creation. Grow your empire season after season and prove you have the guts to be a world-class haunter.

4403090.title: My Unicorn Ranch
4403090.short_description: Your unicorns are waiting for you! Pamper your magical friends, create your own unicorn paradise and explore dreamy landscapes. Saddle up for exciting tournaments, fun contests with friends and enchanting adventures!

4403620.title: Dinonid
4403620.short_description: Dinonid tells the story of two dinosaurs in love who want nothing more than to be together. But mountains of freshly laid eggs block their path. Help these two lonely souls and clear a path for them through the landscape of eggs!

4403880.title: Chronicle Island: The War of Dinosaurs
4403880.short_description: This is a light roguelite PvP deckbuilder. Play as distinct characters, unleash unique abilities, and battle rivals across the island to seize powerful dinosaurs. With each species possessing its own diet, traits, and skills, assembling the ultimate dino squad is your key to victory.

4403890.title: Peekaboom
4403890.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer battle royale where standing still makes you invisible. Hide, ambush and outsmart your enemies to become the last one standing!

4404050.title: The American Dream: Past Due
4404050.short_description: The American Dream: Past Due is a realistic choice-driven sim. Play as a suddenly laid-off middle-aged man keeping up appearances. Balance family finances and emotions while facing mounting bills... Can you get your life back on track before your family falls apart?

4404410.title: Chicks vs Ducks
4404410.short_description: Tag, push and parkour your friends off the map. Chicks vs Ducks is a 2–10 player online party game: team hunts, free-for-all brawls on rising lava, and co-op egg heists against sharks. Wall-run, dash, grapple and get back up, or drag a friend up with you.

4404760.title: Backrooms Stories: The End
4404760.short_description: Read, choose, survive. A horror visual novel set in an infinite dark library deep within the Backrooms. Explore towering bookshelves, hide from hostile entities, and decide your fate across 11 possible endings. Every choice matters, and not every path leads to salvation.

4404830.title: Utopia: Haven
4404830.short_description: Explore three distant planets in this retro-inspired 2D metroidvania, developed for the Game Boy Color. Face mysterious creatures, discover powerful upgrades and uncover lost secrets. The fate of humanity is in your hands!

4404850.title: Grass and Cash
4404850.short_description: Bad news: you're in debt. Good news: there's cash buried in the grass. Worse news: you're starting with nail scissors. Start mowing.

4404900.title: Dominos
4404900.short_description: Dominos is the classic tile game reimagined with multiple modes, tactical depth, and stylish customization. Play solo or with friends, battle players online, climb the ranks, unlock cosmetics, and make the experience your own.

4405120.title: Creepy Horrors: Blood Cult 2
4405120.short_description: Build your roster of Creepy Horrors in this spooky occult creature-collector RPG. Crawl through crypts collecting cursed curios and ingredients, combining them to summon adorable Horrors, wielding them in strategic 3v3 battles against rival sects. The Crypts are calling. Will you answer?

4405250.title: The Last Shift
4405250.short_description: Psychological horror meets an old-school text adventure during a lonely night shift at a police station. Type commands and solve puzzles as sounds, lights and movement in the office echo what you read. How long can you keep your eyes on the screen?

4405850.title: Spikehead
4405850.short_description: Spike your friends from below in this fast-paced local multiplayer party game!

4406340.title: Jade Simulator
4406340.short_description: This is a hardcore jade processing simulator. Players inspect raw stones for color and cracks, then operate machinery to cut and polish them. Learn to distinguish natural jade from fakes while upgrading equipment. Experience the full journey from a rough rock to a translucent masterpiece.

4406410.title: DARK MACHINE THE GAME
4406410.short_description: DARK MACHINE THE GAME is a team-based mecha action shooter where your custom machine evolves through three combat classes. Clash in up to 7v7 PvP or battle overwhelming hordes in PvE across destructible, ever-changing arenas.

4406990.title: Cafe Card
4406990.short_description: Cafe Card is a coffee shop game where you prepare drinks and desserts by creating card combinations and serve them to customers.

4407370.title: Homo Sovieticus
4407370.short_description: Homo Sovieticus is a short, indie psychological horror that tells a story of a secret Soviet experiment that you are now a part of. Will you be strong enough not to break and let yourself slip into madness?

4407490.title: Project Prison: Prologue
4407490.short_description: Start as a small-time dealer in a prison full of the world’s most ruthless inmates. Push pills, craft contraband, smuggle it past drones, dogs and cops, and hire a crew. Then the gangs come for you. Fight to survive and build a criminal empire from behind bars.

4407770.title: Silent Click
4407770.short_description: A first-person psychological puzzle horror where you escape control using a TV remote. Explore surreal rooms filled with CRT televisions, switch channels to solve logic-based puzzles, and uncover a haunted smart home system that constantly observes you.

4408120.title: Infinity Arena
4408120.short_description: Create and customize your hero in Infinity Arena. Combine skills, items, and upgrades to craft unique strategies and conquer the final arena. Get ready for the ultimate battle!

4408130.title: Alive Hunter 2 Mugen hunt
4408130.short_description: Alive Hunter 2 is a third person shooter, open world game with cinematic narrative, it's a direct sequel of Alive Hunter (2019) Alive Hunter 2 is a climax from beginning to the end, designed to impact and delivery the most epic journey ever. Do not fear the hunt, be a part of it.

4408210.title: Crossline
4408210.short_description: You are an ecologist forced onto a sudden rescue mission inside a secret complex. Face parallel worlds and creatures unknown to science. Piece together the events that led to the tragic disaster and uncover the facility's dark secrets before the cold and madness consume you.

4408560.title: Split Happens
