4408560.short_description: Manage an old, rundown nuclear power plant with up to 5 friends in online co-op. Fix hazards before you put the reactor in critical condition, manage the chaos to avoid a meltdown, and try not to get in the way of your coworkers.

4408740.title: Dawn of the West
4408740.short_description: Fight for control of the frontier in this competitive multiplayer Wild West FPS where precision gunplay, tactical movement, and class synergy decide every match. Capture objectives, master stamina-based traversal, and dominate the frontier through pure skill.

4409320.title: Money Under the Bed
4409320.short_description: You complained to a strange roadside statue about being broke—and the next day, a jar of money appeared under your bed. How do you plan to spend this windfall? Of course, you’re free to squander every cent... as long as you can survive until tomorrow.

4409390.title: Pogo Froggo
4409390.short_description: Two frogs, one bar, zero coordination. Bounce up the mountain before your tank breaks... and before you blame each other.

4409740.title: SaviorS : Oath of the Blade
4409740.short_description: SaviorS: Oath of the Blade is a roguelite action RPG with flexible party building and deep, beat 'em up–style combat. Choose your path on the world map and combine companions, sword skills, spells, and gear to face powerful foes. Grow your favorite party and see the journey through together.

4409920.title: Tower.defense(): Program The Fight
4409920.short_description: Program three distinct towers with readable visual logic, then solve handcrafted tower-defense puzzles where placement, line of sight and every code block matter. No programming experience required.

4410080.title: ULTRA
4410080.short_description: The Ascendancy inherited the Earth, and gave humanity the ULTRA. Humanity gave you in return: a Runner. Navigate the trails of the Evergrowth with quick feet, rhythm, grappling hooks, ice bombs, and forgotten tech. Race with friends or alone to save humanity.

4410310.title: Exul: Beyond the Gate
4410310.short_description: Exul: Beyond the Gate is a top-down retro-sci-fi action RPG shooter where you play as an Exul on his journey to an unknown galaxy. Play with your friends in a Co-Op experience where you loot, shoot, pilot, explore, trade, and much more — all to stay alive.

4410710.title: Fields of Aaru
4410710.short_description: A cozy life sim set in the mystical afterlife of Ancient Egypt. Farm along the Nile, befriend the locals, and decorate your eternal home. Venture into the desert and discover oases, pyramids, and tombs. Unlock magical powers by restoring ancient obelisks and making offerings to the gods.

4410730.title: The Rule of Adult
4410730.short_description: Unable to find work, you unwittingly join ruthless HarborTech. A strange contract traps your soul. Manage time and resources, meet KPIs and fight turn-based battles to reclaim your soul and quit within 10 weeks. Uncover its secrets in this workplace psychological horror RPG.

4410830.title: Robust Island
4410830.short_description: A relationship-driven farming sim with time pressure and consequences. Grow crops, raise animals, manage stamina, and build relationships while racing against daily deadlines that shape your success—or force you off the island.

4410930.title: Eilands
4410930.short_description: Create and explore your own islands. Sculpt the land, plant trees, draw paths, place and build houses. Inhabit your creations. There is no combat or management, just the joy of creating and experiencing your own island.

4411110.title: To The Deep
4411110.short_description: Dive into a surreal deep sea dream. Survive by devouring and evolving, and encounter a cast of strange, mysterious companions. Explore, upgrade, and uncover the "truth" hidden beneath the beautiful waves. This is more than an adventure—it is a dimension-breaking dive to the deep.

4411240.title: DEADRIFT
4411240.short_description: A fast-paced sci-fi shooter where a failed experiment unleashes mutated horrors inside a secret research facility. Armed with experimental weapons, you must fight through swarms of twisted enemies, and survive the collapse of a world-breaking project.

4411250.title: E.S.D.E
4411250.short_description: Humanity is nearly extinct, and the few who remain have become soulless anomalies. Enter deadly zones, scavenge valuable loot, sell it, and upgrade your gear to investigate the horrors humanity has become.

4411420.title: 迷宫：囚笼 Maze : Captivity
4411420.short_description: A relaxing puzzle game. Combine spells and items to better traverse the maze. Through the maze trial, we shall select mages who possess both wisdom and talent. Come, contribute your strength to the nation! Seek the final exit and solve the mystery!

4411580.title: Geareo
4411580.short_description: Real gears that don't slip in a mechanical invention sandbox. Build freely with resizable parts and shapes, overcome physics challenges, and follow kit instructions. Unleash your engineering creativity with precision machines and intricate clockwork contraptions.

4411890.title: RK Roulette
4411890.short_description: RISK YOUR LIFE IN HORROR. Risk it however you want: Play Russian roulette with up to 4 players, customizable bullets and gamemodes, or else, survive hard enemy waves also fully customizable. Buy items on the black market and create unique matches with your own personal touch. YOUR life, YOUR rules.

4412380.title: Breaking Up Is Hard To Do
4412380.short_description: When you tell your girlfriend you want to break up, she refuses to accept it. Is your resolve strong enough to become single or will you cave and stay together? A 30-minute visual novel - Breaking Up Is Hard To Do

4412580.title: DEFAUT
4412580.short_description: DEFAUT is a 2.5D platformer. As a restoration unit, collect flowers to gain resources and trigger special actions. Your choices in restoration shape the world's fate across different endings. Through overlapping footprints, a hidden narrative slowly reveals itself.

4412610.title: The Wind And The Snow
4412610.short_description: An amnesiac dream agent, a snarky black cat who claims to be his subconscious, and a girl in red he can’t quite remember. Wander a snowbound dream of Wilder’s own childhood, school days and lost years, and find out what he’s spent so long trying to forget.

4412620.title: 日本一周漢字の旅
4412620.short_description: Everyday Japan, in a quiz! Interested in Japan? Don’t miss this! Join Hina-chan for fun Kanji challenges!

4412930.title: BricksPhilosophorum
4412930.short_description: [点金方块]BricksPhilosophorum is an automated game that uses an assembly line to study alchemy. The game starts with collecting minerals, purchasing land, unlocking technology, and building automated production lines.

4413130.title: Battlespace Command
4413130.short_description: Take command of modern warfare across land, air, and sea in a real-time strategy sandbox. Direct every unit, from infantry to aircraft carriers, across vast, real-world scale battlefields where sensors, strategy, and coordination decide the outcome.

4413220.title: Streetball Legends
4413220.short_description: No rules. No fouls. Just baskets and beatdowns. Team up in co-op or go solo against increasingly tougher opponents in chaotic arcade basketball. Unleash devastating Power Shots, earn game-changing gear, and keep your run alive. Or go PvP and challenge a friend in Versus mode.

4413250.title: Falling Up
4413250.short_description: Falling Up is a 3D adventure game, your goal is to get to the top of the mountain. There will be a lot of challange duration your trip, you have to either beat them, or be sneaky. Don't be frustracted when you fall from the mountain, you are leveling up each time you fall.

4413280.title: Rituals & War: Shan Hai
4413280.short_description: In the mountains and seas of pre-Qin myth, the way to Heaven is severed; the gods are silent. A turn-based tactical card game with hand-painted ink-wash art: read clues to enemy moves, sequence your actions each round, then cross swords on one shared timeline. One miscalculation can turn the tide.

4413430.title: SHAPE & SHADE
4413430.short_description: SHAPE & SHADE is a multiplayer game that combines Prop Hunt and Social deduction mechanics, draw your own disguise and survive until de train reach the Station. Watch your friends slowly go crazy trying to figure out what's real and what’s not !

4413510.title: Starship Contractor: Galactic Tycoon
4413510.short_description: Shape the Galactic Arms Race. As CEO of a private space arms company, design modular ships, research breakthrough tech, and win faction tenders. Outmaneuver rivals in prototype races and make critical choices that make every playthrough unique, from a startup to galactic dominance.

4414110.title: WATERFUL: a tiny oasis builder
4414110.short_description: A relaxing puzzle game inspired by nature. Dig riverbeds to guide water through desert valleys and grow a variety of plants, then zoom in to discover hidden animals drawn to new habitats. Earn points for your discoveries and unlock new contraptions to transform the dry landscape into a lush oasis!

4414230.title: Peace by Piece
4414230.short_description: Restore peace - one piece at a time. Start a rebellion with a handful of loyalists in this chess roguelike, and grow your army as you free a war-torn kingdom. Gain banners that bend the rules and build devastating synergies as you race to topple a tyrant before his army returns!

4414620.title: Book Nook
4414620.short_description: Build miniature diorama scenes, piece by piece. Complete beautiful book nooks as you place furniture, decorations, and small details. Relax and enjoy the peaceful satisfaction of every detail falling into place, as you discover more about each moment in time.

4414800.title: Tutsak
4414800.short_description: Tutsak is a 1–4 player co-op horror game where you complete objectives and escape before the creature catches you. Caught? You're locked in a cell until your friends break you out. Sometimes, you can sell out a teammate instead.

4414820.title: Peppermint Academy
4414820.short_description: A cute western bara visual novel with RPG combat, where you can build a party, collect monsters, and have a romance with hot guys. Peppermint Academy is a strange school that brings together humans, demons, and angels from many different worlds.

4415050.title: The Tram
4415050.short_description: Discover tram driving on routes inspired by Eastern and Central Europe of the 2000s. Realistic physics, demanding weather and operating conditions, and a richly detailed city turn every trip into a true driver’s challenge.

4415580.title: 犯人当てラジオ
4415580.short_description: This is a mystery novel game where you read short mystery stories and identify the culprit. The game features a total of six scenarios. Read through various mystery stories set in different times and places, and use cards and charts to deduce the answer.

4416070.title: Naishitai: The parts I'm missing.
4416070.short_description: Accompany Nai in her normal Sunday routine of watching TV, eating ramen and ruminating on her past.

4416230.title: AKASHA
4416230.short_description: Welcome to AKASHA. This zen-puzzle platformer will have you questioning your every move. Discover the abilities of the Soul Sphere, solve abstract puzzles, and reunite the Lost Eidolons to reconstruct the pieces of your inner self.

4416300.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX
4416300.short_description: A new semester begins as fan-favorite RPG card game Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE 3 is reborn as Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX with modern visuals, enhanced Dueling, and nostalgic cards from the Yu-Gi-Oh! GX anime era.

4416460.title: Too Many Flies
4416460.short_description: Too Many Flies is an incremental game about exterminating many many flies, exploring a mysterious house and getting that sweet sweet cash.

4416970.title: Zombies Per Minute
4416970.short_description: An orbital AI dropped you on Earth to take it back. She judges you on ONE number: how many zombies you can kill per minute. Automate a factory that turns raw ore into mass extermination. Stack wild upgrades and keep ammo flowing so hordes melt at your walls. When you fall, drop back in stronger.

4417060.title: Dark Roll 2
4417060.short_description: A physics-driven 3D precision platformer where you roll, bounce, dodge traps, snatch gems, and race against other players’ ghosts through a dark-fantasy gauntlet designed to make “one more try” a deeply questionable life choice.

4417400.title: Bloomvale: Bouquets & Scents
4417400.short_description: Bloomvale: Bouquets & Scents is a cozy 2D game where you grow flowers, craft beautiful bouquets, and blend fragrant perfumes for your customers. A relaxing experience focused on gentle progression, creativity, and cozy daily routines. 🌸🌿

4417410.title: Rush B: Esports Manager
4417410.short_description: Take control of a fps esports team and lead them from underdogs to world champions. Scout talent, develop players, manage personalities, and adapt your strategy in a deep, realism-driven management sim. Are you ready to break records and leave your mark on the esports world?

4417600.title: Yarn-Ball!
4417600.short_description: Yarn-Ball! is a multiplayer sandbox game where you can create & explore various worlds as a silly cat!!! :3

4417710.title: 13 BONES
4417710.short_description: A fast-paced card battler. Like BLACKJACK, but with added MONSTERS and VIOLENCE. Build your DECK and push your LUCK to earn your freedom !

4417840.title: The Book of Prosperity
4417840.short_description: The Book of Prosperity is a 2D action RPG in a surreal pixel-art Hong Kong where ancient magic seeps through modern streets and skyscrapers. Student Cyrus must master rhythmic combat, rooftop parkour, and buried secrets to uncover prosperity's hidden cost.

4418020.title: Deck paper scissors
4418020.short_description: It's rock paper scissors, but as an incremental roguelike deck builder.

4418080.title: False Echo
4418080.short_description: False Echo is a narrative cryptography thriller set in the darkest depths of the Stelantic, aboard a secret military submarine. Operate the Obscura machine, decode messages, and decide what gets through in a regime where even the smallest mistake means a huge death toll.

4418720.title: Edroseph's Tower
4418720.short_description: A dark fantasy turn-based roguelike RPG with 25 classes and deep buildcraft. Climb the tower solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players, combine talents and equipment, and adapt your party to every run.

4419320.title: Scourge Realms
4419320.short_description: Slay monsters in evil realms inflicted with scourge. Find Majestic Loot, Collect powerful enchanting materials and xp to survive the scourge and obtain god-like power.

4419700.title: TERRORSTORM: Ground Zero
4419700.short_description: TERRORSTORM is a single-player FPS action-horror game with Soulslike-inspired combat. Survive brutal, high-stakes encounters against dangerous and terrifying foes, uncover dark secrets and bring down horrific underground crime ring. Resident Evil tension meets Dark Souls punishment.

4419990.title: The Heroic Tale of Illumina: 0
4419990.short_description: The great world tree, Yggdrasil, has long stood watch over the world, providing shelter and bounty for its people. However, the arrival of Dark Lord Asmodeus has Yggdrasil and the world at large on the brink of ruin.

4420220.title: Oogie’s Chicken Quest
4420220.short_description: A short, quirky 3D action adventure where Oogie sets out to find his legendary chicken, Cluck Cluck, who lays diamond eggs. Explore small open worlds , solve puzzles, battle odd enemies, and uncover hidden secrets in vibrant levels!

4420390.title: AstroFrame
4420390.short_description: Take a seat, engineer! AstroFrame is a 2D sci-fi roguelike that challenges your strategic planning, adaptability, and spaceship designing skills. The cosmos is hostile and your survival depends on your ingenuity in an ever-changing galaxy.

4420510.title: Emocritical
4420510.short_description: A story-rich urban battle RPG. As a Nikko University transfer student, freely explore bustling Xijing, raise stats, make friends, and live your days. But beneath the peaceful daily life, dark undercurrents surge. Collect clues, shatter the facade, and face the ultimate crisis when it arrives.

4420530.title: TUSK
4420530.short_description: Top-down 3D action-adventure with the spirit of 90s classics. Tight combat, handcrafted dungeons, clever puzzles, and modern pacing. Collect enchanted masks to channel primal powers, brave ancient alien trials, and awaken the island’s lost protectors.

4420790.title: Gecko: Wall Hacker
4420790.short_description: A stealth action-puzzle game where you climb walls and ceilings, blend into surface materials, and hack security systems. Use full-surface movement, adaptive camouflage, and spatial positioning to infiltrate guarded environments.

4421190.title: Shatterswarm
4421190.short_description: Command Captain Hope's ship in this strategic 2D space game. Build structures, deploy fleets, and manage resources to defend the Citadel against waves of enemies. Combine direct ship combat, tower defense, and base building as you face epic boss battles.

4421540.title: Mauled Horde
4421540.short_description: Mauled Horde is a free-to-play 1–3 player PvE horde shooter. Survive waves solo or in co-op, spend points at Citadels, and choose upgrades that change how your weapons, perks, and gadgets behave. Combine equipment to unlock build synergies and survive tougher enemies and bosses.

4421580.title: 找勺子LOOKING for MYSPOON
4421580.short_description: A horror walking simulator play as a character searching for a lost spoon in a fantastical world You will experience a surreal world, from diverse swimming pools to strange houses. I hope you enjoy it.

4421630.title: Soul Tripper
4421630.short_description: Action roguelite with autoshoot, a parry system and randomly generated levels. Loot resources from your enemies to craft your gear and grow stronger with every run. Dozens of items, skills and characters to unlock.

4421670.title: The Kingsward
4421670.short_description: Explore an open-world Sandbox RPG with isometric ARPG combat, a flexible hybrid class system, and an epic story with satirical humor. Create your own build and seek the legendary Kingsward.

4421810.title: Lyden Lys
4421810.short_description: Lyden Lys is a knowledge-based metroidvania about an existential journey through a lost homeland. Control the surroundings through music, explore a smoldering world, discover what happened to your people, decide the fate of your successors, and find yourself.

4421980.title: Realm's Last Stand
4421980.short_description: An unforgiving tower defence game focused on strategic placement, unique enemy mechanics and progressively demanding levels

4422000.title: Lost Floor — Not My World
4422000.short_description: An auto-battler dungeon crawler with visual novel elements. A tired office worker got off on the wrong floor and ended up in another world. The locals look suspiciously like his coworkers, and to get out, he'll have to do some work.

4422050.title: Lighthouse Keeper: Lost At Sea
4422050.short_description: An atmospheric survival and life simulation where you live alone as a lighthouse keeper, maintaining the light, braving storms, and surviving the quiet weight of isolation at sea.

4422260.title: Hakoniwa Electric
4422260.short_description: "Hakoniwa Electric" is a cute relaxing puzzle game. Explore adorable isometric stages, solve puzzles, and light them up. Why not spend a leisurely year as Akari, who's taken over grandpa's electronics shop, helping with the monthly troubles from the townsfolk?

4422560.title: Rectangle Dudes
4422560.short_description: Prepare to be one of the dudes! Challenge yourself in one of the best, precise yet silly, skill-based platformers. Built for co-op fun, mastery solo... or absolute chaos in party mode! Take a trip back to the age of classic platforming, with awesome secrets, arcade energy, and satisfying challenges.

4422660.title: BLOODMOORED
4422660.short_description: BLOODMOORED is a first-person psychological horror. Revive a derelict factory by restarting its machinery. The spirits here are unpredictable: one moment they hunt you, the next they are your only key to salvation. Uncover their past to understand their motives and escape this trap alive

4423030.title: Brush Burial: Bruiseland
4423030.short_description: You are a hunter of men, and your quarry is numerous, armed, and afraid. Bind and break them. This is a first-person immersive sim with tightly interconnected environments, sleek and sadistic melee combat, and over a hundred cosmetics to unlock.

4423040.title: Euphausia superba: The Antarctic Krill
4423040.short_description: Swim, let yourself carried with ocean currents, and search for phytoplankton alongside krill, a small crustacean. Guide a krill on a fascinating journey to reach the ice floe in this relaxing, interactive wildlife documentary.

4423690.title: Within The Box
4423690.short_description: Within The Box is a fantasy survival horror game that mixes Resident Evil and Dungeons & Dragons, all wrapped into a puzzle solving, spell slinging, story driven adventure.

4423970.title: Catrium
4423970.short_description: This idle anomaly management game is set in the bottom right corner of the screen and progresses at a leisurely pace. Grow and manage the mysterious cat-like substance "Catrium" at your leisure, earn money, and upgrade your lab.

4424180.title: Square Mining Builder
4424180.short_description: Build a village inside the mine of your dreams! Collect resources, catalog up to 200 different rare ores, manage your villagers and face random events, all in a procedural map with cozy pixel art!

4424220.title: Specshong
4424220.short_description: Cyndi wants you to turn up the volume and paint the town red. Import any song to generate chaotic levels in this intense rhythm shooter. Master absolute free movement, execute precision shots, and destroy the digital static to your favorite beats.

4424600.title: REQUIRED SYNERGY WORKSHOP: Deja Damnation
4424600.short_description: A participant disappears during a mandatory corporate workshop. The System restarts the session but keeps your answers, and the people around you remember how you treated them. A choice-driven psychological horror story about workplace rituals, surveillance, and a reality coming apart.

4424760.title: Hellcrown
4424760.short_description: You are dead. But your ghostly hand still commands. Hellcrown is a roguelite strategy game where every run unfolds into a chain of random stories, sieges, and consequences.

4424900.title: WARD 107: SILENCE
4424900.short_description: WARD 107: SILENCE is a first person psychological horror. Your microphone is the key: use your voice to solve vocal puzzles and uncover the atrocious experiments of Project H.O.P.E. Speak to progress, but silence is your only defense when they hunt you. Make noise, and you die.

4424940.title: One Must Rule
4424940.short_description: An empire-building auto-battler set in a harsh medieval settlement where every strategic command shapes your kingdom’s fate. Build your empire from the council table, discover game-breaking card synergies, and battle against rival players. Every choice counts, only one will rule!

4424990.title: World Football 2030
4424990.short_description: A football strategy game where every match is fully simulated. Choose a national team, set the formation and tactics, then watch your decisions play out on the pitch. You don’t control the players directly, your job is to prepare, adapt, and lead your nation to the world title.

4425010.title: Nappy Knight
4425010.short_description: You wake up in a strange land, you don't know who you are but you know what you must do - kill, loot, repeat.

4425090.title: DOOBAK
4425090.short_description: While you were sleeping, a blizzard buried the entire village in snow. Now you need to evacuate alone or with a team of up to 4 players! Dig tunnels, scavenge for supplies, warm up by campfires, and try to call for rescue.

4425600.title: GODBOX
4425600.short_description: GODBOX is a coding god-sim where you program life, grow your power by unlocking divine domains, and compete against rival deities. Help your devoted Folk survive while you harness their faith to fuel your divine ascension.

4425700.title: 技能贪吃蛇 , Skill Snake
4425700.short_description: "Skill Snake" is an innovative casual game that adds skills and new mechanisms to the traditional Snake game and combines it with simulation management.

4425810.title: Pirate Royalty
4425810.short_description: A free to play fantasy pirate MMORPG where you choose one of four classes, assign your own stats, learn skills, hunt rare loot, forge gems into gear and enter timed dungeons with other players. Every advantage is earned through play, with no power for sale.

4426010.title: Seven Nights Ghost 2
4426010.short_description: "This Love, This Curse — Only 7 Days Left" Live together with a flashy ghost girl for seven days—and survive her over-the-top love attacks. A stylish, slightly dark, yet heartfelt horror romance about youth, fear, and self-control.

4426150.title: Gobelinus: The Cursed Deck
4426150.short_description: Gobelinus: The Cursed Deck is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where a debt‑ridden goblin builds cursed card hands to survive. Equip bizarre relics and trigger outrageous score combos to defeat relentless monsters in each run.

4426260.title: Hidden Shore
4426260.short_description: After many years, you have finally reached this mysterious place. Now, will you be able to uncover all its secrets and finally find what you have been seeking for so long? Explore a secret island, solve puzzles and riddles to uncover the truth.

4426370.title: Clinical Memory
4426370.short_description: Clinical Memory is a first-person psychological horror game set in the abandoned Ward 7B hospital. Experience distorted memory cycles, explore a changing environment, and make choices that may bring you closer to the truth or send you back to the beginning.

4426390.title: Evidentia
4426390.short_description: Evidentia is a cooperative detective card game for friends. Each deck is a unique case. Analyze evidence, take risks, question everything — and find out if you can solve it before the final reveal.

4426490.title: Rhomfaya: The Rays of Liberty
4426490.short_description: A land invaded, with a web of lies and bloodshed serving as a catalyst. Build an army of over 40 unique characters and liberate the Kingdom of Ezebar from the chaotic shadows that threaten it, in this sprite-based tactical RPG!

4426560.title: CARDaCOMBS
4426560.short_description: A retro roguelike deckbuilder where cards cost more than just energy. Descend the CARDaCOMBS, defeat monsters, and upgrade your deck with cards that cost energy, discards, blood, and MORE!!!

4426730.title: STILL WATCHING: The Night Caregiver
4426730.short_description: Your real smartphone is your only weapon... Sync your phone with the game and pray it doesn't ring while you're hiding in the closet.

4427080.title: Dubai Chewy Cookie Simulator
4427080.short_description: You opened a little dessert café, and now the line runs down the street! Make Dubai chewy cookies by hand, ring up every order, and run the whole place on your own in this hectic first-person management sim set in a Korean university neighborhood.

4427200.title: NoOneKnowsME.
4427200.short_description: You are not human—and no one can ever find out. NoOneKnowsME. is a psychological horror adventure set aboard a spaceship. Complete daily tasks, survive tense conversations, and hide your true identity for seven days as you make your way back to Earth.
developers: 箱詰めプロダクション

4427250.title: False Flame
4427250.short_description: Single player social deduction auto battler where YOU are the impostor. Steer two hidden cultists through a colony under siege: win your party’s trust, then murder whoever trusts you most. Kill too many and the siege takes you all. Plan the perfect kill, bluff your way out, then get away with it.

4427620.title: Tilelings!
4427620.short_description: A chaotic battle of wits with friends!? A fresh new competitive party game combining puzzles and action! Online multiplayer for up to 4 players! Have a blast with your friends in a variety of game modes that test both your puzzle-solving and action skills!!

4427670.title: Is Gambling Bad For Business?
4427670.short_description: Grow a company from one tiny office into a billion dollar HQ tower, then bet it on a coin flip. Hire from CVs, survive crises, keep the board happy and don't go bankrupt. Build only with gambling winnings. Then go online: buy land from cities and conquer other players' plots at blackjack.

4427720.title: Pigs On Wings
4427720.short_description: Pigs On Wings is an open-world cooperative flight sim featuring extraction mechanics and global guerrilla warfare. Work together to pilot a temperamental aircraft: battle ground forces, deliver cargo, repair systems, and upgrade your gear.

4427770.title: The Falling Skies
4427770.short_description: Explore a cursed forest where the past refuses to die. As a new forest ranger, uncover the truth behind a forgotten tragedy, navigate shifting paths, and face mysterious distortions that blur the line between reality and nightmare.

4427810.title: DRAWCERY
4427810.short_description: Draw your spells. Command the elements. DRAWCERY is an online PvP spell-summoning game with unique, draw-to-cast combat. Sketch elemental symbols in the heat of battle to unleash real-time magic and outplay your rivals like a true wizard.

4427980.title: THE WITCH'S GRIMOIRE
4427980.short_description: An atmospheric experience in the dark and eerie world of classic fairy tales, progressing solely through your choices. No complex mechanics; just sit back and focus on the story. Make the right decisions to avoid danger and try to survive the twisted endings of these tales.

4428070.title: Ram Fights
4428070.short_description: Get ready to headbutt your way to glory in this hilarious physics-based brawler! Customize your ultimate animal gladiator, master the art of the perfect charge, and send your rivals flying with epic ragdoll physics.

4428380.title: Infiniterra
4428380.short_description: A voxel sandbox focused on atmosphere and contrast. Explore layered worlds, survive eerie nights, and uncover what lies beneath the surface.

4428560.title: Incrawler
4428560.short_description: An incremental dungeon crawler where you slay enemies, collect loot, and build powerful hero synergies. Master skill trees, invest in unique traits, and prestige to push deeper and defeat challenging bosses.

4428590.title: Screams Echo
4428590.short_description: Screams Echo is a dark top-down action roguelike where you must fight through hordes of mutants in a procedurally generated underground complex. Find powerful items that can completely change the course of a run, combine them with weapons and hero abilities, and build insane synergies that turn desperate survival into total chaos.

4428600.title: Pikku Adventure
4428600.short_description: Befriend the Pikku to decipher a mysterious alien language and deliver a crucial message. Small colorful planets filled with secrets and charm await clever deduction from sharp puzzle-venturers and exo-linguists.

4428780.title: Perry's Pizzeria
4428780.short_description: Build the ultimate pizza deck! Collect ingredient cards, create delicious pizzas, discover massive flavor combos, satisfy quirky customers, unlock new chefs, and upgrade your restaurant in this tasty deckbuilding roguelike.

4428800.title: The Derailed: Devour the Harvest
4428800.short_description: The Derailed: Devour the Harvest - a standalone story set in the world of The Derailed. While investigating a mass disappearance, you find yourself at an abandoned factory. Answers lie within - but they come at a high price. Are you ready?

4429290.title: The Incentive Program
4429290.short_description: A dopamine-fuelled match-3 roguelite set within a surreal corporate nightmare. Rig the odds, exploit the system, and unleash impossible combos as you fight to escape the program.

4429710.title: Spellogger
4429710.short_description: A slow-paced, cozy fantasy RPG where you play as a Wizard Lumberjack. Take on daily tasks and upgrade your character in a relaxing work cycle similar to Stardew Valley, while setting out on Elder Scrolls-style quests and exploration.

4429900.title: Robot Vacuum Cleaner Quest
4429900.short_description: Robot Vacuum Cleaner Quest is an exploration adventure game. Reveal the house of Detectif Poirry as a robot vacuum cleaner, bump its inhabitants for stories, and clean your way to victory.

4430020.title: Hamsteria
4430020.short_description: Hamsteria is a difficult 2-player co-op game where you play as two hamsters in attached wheels. Online co-op, local co-op, and single-player are all supported!

4430250.title: Three Kingdoms Stratagem
4430250.short_description: A retro-inspired, narrative-driven turn-based tactics RPG. Enemies telegraph their attacks before executing them, and it's up to you to disrupt them. Lead your heroes to victory to restore the Han dynasty!

4430350.title: 幻想乡毋宁
4430350.short_description: Grow crops, build a home, and venture into Gensokyo in this 3D Touhou Project fan game. Explore the Human Village, get to know familiar characters, and combine everyday life with journeys and action combat beyond your fields.

4430580.title: But in briefs
4430580.short_description: Reach the exit… until it runs away, everything collapses, and your pants catch fire. Six zones of chaos in a minimalist platformer.

4431100.title: Moonlight Apothecary
4431100.short_description: Brew concoctions, befriend Ravensport's many fantasy inhabitants, and unravel the mystery of the Evernight as the newest apprentice of the Moonlight Apothecary.

4431230.title: Super Chasm Hunter
4431230.short_description: An unforgiving extraction-roguelite adventure. Gear up and descend alone into the Chasm, fighting enemies and searching for loot. Take risks for better rewards, or extract and return home with what you've earned to sell, craft, decorate, and farm.

4431400.title: Smersh: Wolfhound
4431400.short_description: A stealth action game set during World War II. You play as a SMERSH operative. Use disguises to get close to your target. Take out your foes with weapons or plan “unfortunate accidents.” No two playthroughs are alike.

4431470.title: Gravedigger
4431470.short_description: Game is about a gravedigger and funeral home owner. Your goal is to grow business by taking care of the cemetery and its residents. Serve you customers, upgrade your tools, and expand your business. If customers run out, you can always look for them in other ways...

4431610.title: PSYKOS
4431610.short_description: A co-op horror where your voice can get you killed, monsters can break into your hiding spots, and captured players must be rescued before it’s too late.

4431890.title: Barely Developers
4431890.short_description: Build a gaming empire in this first-person, co-op game development simulator! Start in Mom's garage, create hit games, hire chaotic employees, design your own consoles, and grow into a AAA studio. Play solo or with up to 3 friends.

4432100.title: polymorphite
4432100.short_description: Rhythm-dodging adventure game about a mysterious set of murders. Come then; decide the past, so that we may glimpse at a better future.

4432150.title: Soulstonia
4432150.short_description: Recruit Summoners with minds of their own in this single-player 2.5D fantasy RPG. Control them individually, as a party, or set goals for them to gather, craft, and fight on their own. Explore five regions in a procedural world, complete quests, train 20+ skills, and summon an army. Free to play.

4432380.title: Tsuki Journey
4432380.short_description: A relaxing slice of life adventure game where Tsuki travels between beautiful cities, meets new friends, uncovers stories, and fills out collection logs at his own pace, combining cozy idle activities with short, meaningful bursts of progression.

4432620.title: StarshipFighter
4432620.short_description: Build and customize your own starship, then survive escalating waves of enemies and intense boss fights. Unlock new parts, upgrade your loadout, choose your difficulty, and climb the leaderboard in this fast-paced 2D top-down space shooter.

4433020.title: Blood List
4433020.short_description: "Blood List" is a hardcore action game specialized in boss battles. As the "Contractor," you will eliminate every formidable foe standing in your way.

4433030.title: Interactive Language-Learning Novel: Interview with Emma
4433030.short_description: Emma starts journalism school: new friends, awkward first meetings and maybe her first love. Listen to voiced dialogue, click any word and learn English, Spanish, French, Italian, German, Portuguese or Turkish inside a living story. The free demo is out now.

4433410.title: The Cave of Doubt
4433410.short_description: Lovecraftian horror game with elements of psychological and survival horror genres. Where Allen is lost in a cave and is forced to face horrors beyond his imagination. Survive the cave, solve mysteries, reveal the lore lost in time.

4433420.title: OpTek
4433420.short_description: An interactive co-op repair game with horror elements. Up to 4 players will work together to survive routine maintenance sessions conducted in chambers that store dangerous entities. Work together to survive and bring the chamber online before certain death...

4433430.title: FLOWSXTY
4433430.short_description: FLOWSXTY is a minimal action game. A brutal trench runner where you WASD between four lanes.

4433460.title: Is This the Way
4433460.short_description: Is This The Way is a chaotic 1–4 player online co-op survival game. Escape adaptive robot enemies, conquer physics-based parkour, and respawn to try again as teamwork turns into hilarious sabotage in unpredictable, fast-paced matches.

4433720.title: Tartaria: Frozen Frontier
4433720.short_description: Lead the ruling clan of a confederation in early-medieval Siberia. Develop cities and crafts, manage specialized vassals, prepare supplies for the harsh winter, and defend the entire confederation in this turn-based survival strategy game.

4434030.title: 戚继光 Qi Jiguang: Art of War
4434030.short_description: Gunpowder vs Samurai: A Tower Defense + Auto Battler. Wield the Ming dynasty's cluster bombs, rockets, drones, and cannons against pirate fleets from the sea. Build formations, set up artillery, can you replicate Qi Jiguang's legendary 0:2000 kill-to-loss ratio?

4434240.title: Just an Ordinary Bike Ride
4434240.short_description: In this adventure horror game you experience nothing but a calm bike ride home, your chauffeur is late and it's starting to rain. You only have a bike but you need to get home, it's a rather empty street aside from some debris. It's just a bike ride home.

4434360.title: The Creator: Live Together
4434360.short_description: The Creator: Live Together — a world built for creativity. Take on jobs, build your career, or create freely in Sandbox Mode. Design dream homes, craft cozy spaces, and play with friends.

4434480.title: Applied Shamanism
4434480.short_description: A cozy 3D game about a rookie rabbit shaman. Diagnose quirky illnesses with X-ray spirit vision, gather and grow elemental ingredients, and brew always-useful potions. Each patient is a bite-size mystery of folk ailments and guardian spirits, with no combat, damage, or timers.

4434510.title: The Old Parish
4434510.short_description: A cozy top-down farming and life sim in a rural Irish parish. Sow and harvest the family farm, mow and bale the hay, raise cattle and sheep and fish the lake. Then head into a town where every door opens, for Sunday Mass, a pint at O'Brien's and a hand of Twenty-Five.

4434530.title: 9 Layers of Hell
4434530.short_description: Carve through thousands of demons on your way down the nine layers of Hell. Combine your own spells, chase legendaries that rewrite your build and craft the perfect gear between waves. A horde survivor with the loot of an action RPG. How deep can you and your party go?

4434610.title: Hunter: The Reckoning – Deathwish
4434610.short_description: In the bustling streets of New York, passersby are unaware of the evil lurking in the shadows. You, however, know. Hunt the creatures of the World of Darkness in this action RPG, where your choices determine whether you live another day.

4434630.title: Fancy Farm Brawl
4434630.short_description: Farm by day, fight by night! Fancy Farm Brawl blends top-down action combat, tower-defense challenges, light farming, and a quirky island adventure. Plant crops, earn coins, meet colorful residents, overcome obstacle courses, and unleash powerful attacks to defend your home on Qilin Island.

4434640.title: The Long Mine
4434640.short_description: An incremental mining game with fully destructible caves. Every pickaxe strike removes an actual piece of rock. Mine ores, sell them, and buy upgrades. Upgrades are not just +10% damage. Equipment and Curses change how you mine, move and explore. Combine them to create your own build.

4434700.title: Postponed: Game Dev Management Roguelite
4434700.short_description: An addictive wave-based arcade roguelite, in which you are the manager of a game development studio. You get a project each week, that your team and you have to work on to get paid. With that money get upgrades, skill your employees and even unlock characters. Ever wanted to lead a game dev studio?

4434770.title: We’re In Trouble
4434770.short_description: A CO-OP stealth game about a problem that can’t wait until morning. 🕵️‍♂️ An empty office, a body, and absolute silence. Work together, avoid guards and cameras, handle unpredictable physics, and escape unnoticed. One mistake can ruin everything.

4434820.title: WorldLoop
4434820.short_description: WorldLoop is a story-driven RPG about cycles, sacrifice, and irreversible choices.

4434980.title: Don't Wake the Queen
4434980.short_description: Protect the peaceful sleep of Your Meowness in this infinite incremental tower defense. Place fierce warriors, build your own path, unlock a ton of new skills and infinitely upgrade EVERYTHING.

4435040.title: 郑成功传 Clash of Armadas: Koxinga
4435040.short_description: Auto Chess +Tower Defense + Naval Battle Choose from the legendary captains of the Age of Sail – Blackbeard, Francis Drake, Horatio Nelson, Zheng Chenggong… and more. Command 10+ ships. Position your fleet. Broadside fire. Enemies come in waves on fixed routes.

4435100.title: Incredigble
4435100.short_description: Uncover dinosaur fossils as you mine through rocks, earn money and upgrade your abilities! Fill your museum with your discoveries to reach the goal of becoming world renowned!

4435920.title: Fifth Sun: Coop racing
4435920.short_description: Run solo or share the ship's cockpit with a friend. Use the ship's unique abilities to outmaneuver or outlast your opponents in cylinders, flight sections, and other crazy hazards. A player shoots while the other one runs, and if you're fast enough or aggressive enough, you might win the Grand Prix!

4436130.title: Protect the President
4436130.short_description: A night-time tower defense auto-battler where you protect the President at all costs. Draft cards to deploy defenses, switch to night vision or thermal, take over a gun and fire it yourself, and grow your command between runs.

4436410.title: Thousands of Chroma
4436410.short_description: A layered logic puzzle game, where thousands of colors come to life using only □(0) and ■(1).

4436520.title: Zebulon 3D
4436520.short_description: Meet Zebulon once more in a new adventure now in 3D and crispy voxels! Jump, dash, explore, and gather back your siblings in this new exciting game about purpose and family.

4436550.title: Hey, Focus!
4436550.short_description: Hey, Focus! is a productivity game featuring light visual novel elements. Xiaoning, a girl who loves gaming and anime, is here to accompany you while you work and study. Complete focus timers to unlock over 200 voiced interactions, personalized outfits, and perhaps... a few hidden secrets?

4436840.title: Barbie™ Horse Ride & Rescue
4436840.short_description: Start your Western horse riding adventure with Barbie at Roaming Hearts Rescue Ranch. Rescue and rehabilitate charming horses, test your riding skills and customize your style as you uncover the mysteries of Moonrise Valley!

4437050.title: Air Hockey: Magical Heroes
4437050.short_description: A magical roguelite twist on air hockey! Battle forest animals, collect power-ups, and survive a series of intense air hockey matches.

4437240.title: K2-18b: Legacy
4437240.short_description: Immerse yourself in the mysterious atmosphere of exoplanet K2-18b. Traverse its unusual labyrinths, uncover a captivating story, and reveal the world's secrets - all set to an atmospheric original soundtrack.

4437310.title: The Oath of Runeveil
4437310.short_description: An online-enabled 3D action RPG set in a vast world to explore. Centered on real-time battles and character progression, it can be enjoyed both solo and in cooperative play.

4437580.title: Dali's Adventure: Lost Worlds
4437580.short_description: A mysterious vortex pulls you out of reality. Play as Max, trapped between unknown worlds. Explore, observe, and solve puzzles to progress… but something may try to stop you. 🎮 Demo available — add it to your wishlist.

4437650.title: Stinker Golf
4437650.short_description: An online 1-16 player destructive golf game where you build the course while you play. Annoy your friends without ruining the hole for yourself, all inside a fully physics simulated pixel world.

4437750.title: Worst Airline Ever
4437750.short_description: Build an airline from scratch in this multiplayer co-op airline management game. Fly airplanes inspired by real aircraft, design and upgrade your plane, serve passengers, and grow your airline from a small regional carrier into a world-class airline.

4438080.title: Call It a Day
4438080.short_description: A physics-based online co-op game where you and your friends play as the world's worst renovation crew. Drag the couch up the stairs, water down the paint and throw the trash out the window - but don't work too hard. Cracking open a cold one with the boys is also part of the job.

4438340.title: Heng Rover Mission
4438340.short_description: Build, launch, and survive. Design your own rover and automated robot workforce to conquer the harsh Martian climate, fulfill Mission Control directives, and uncover the secrets of the red planet in Heng Mar Mission.

4438360.title: I Can Never Love Another
4438360.short_description: A realistic visual novel based on a true story. As a lawyer trying to save a rock singer from her toxic family, you uncover the suffocating truth of "Codependency." Will you leave, sink into the abyss, or g◼︎ai◻︎n the c#our%ag◼︎e to f◼︎ac◻︎e the p#ai%n? Your choices decide.

4440440.title: FLEETING ESCAPE
4440440.short_description: FLEETING ESCAPE is a wave-based survival horror game where every choice could be your last. You must escape to a different island at the end of each wave to survive. Each island has monsters, items, and loot to be discovered.

4440650.title: KAGE
4440650.short_description: Anime MEGABONK with friends. Unleash anime-style techniques — shout them to activate their true power! Fight hordes of enemies, hunt massive bosses, gather rare loot, and craft insane builds in a fast co-op action game for up to 4 players. Upgrade your village. Become a legend 👹

4440930.title: ESTELLA - The Sin of Time -
4440930.short_description: Switch between multiple protagonists in this suspense visual novel and follow the event of the three days leading up to Halloween. Piece together clues from each perspective to uncover the truth, as your choices reshape the fates of the others.

4441010.title: 囚人カウンセリング
4441010.short_description: An interactive prison adventure. You play as a psychiatrist, working one-on-one with inmates who have committed crimes. Use case files to choose appropriate responses and hand out items from the drawer to maintain their trust. Your choices can either open up or close the inmates.

4442220.title: The Altar Boy Adventures
4442220.short_description: Step into the shoes of Józef, a young man and altar server in a Polish village. Repair electronic equipment, prepare the sacristy for Mass, and help your neighbors. Experience a unique and moving adventure centered around liturgical service.

4442290.title: Criterion
4442290.short_description: Criterion is a space optimisation puzzle game about designing efficient solutions under constraint. Process the color fluxes. Control their strength. Solve increasingly complex networks where every tile matters. There is always a solution, the question is how elegant yours will be.

4442750.title: Void Hunters
4442750.short_description: Lead fearless rebels in a dark fantasy, turn-based RPG where tactical decisions and strategic squad-building shape every battle against the world-devouring Void.

4442870.title: Battle of the Kyoshin
4442870.short_description: A miko gal and a Kyoshin go head-to-head with an enemy Kyoshin! Power up your Kyoshin as you fight, and take them down! Finish them with a trump-card Kamiwaza!

4443240.title: Legacy of Epstein: Noncompliance
4443240.short_description: Scandal strikes the nation and J. Epstein is in the thick of it. What follows is a web of mystery that exposes the institutions that are rotten to the core. Who's compromised?

4443330.title: Blood Arena Path of Steel: Prologue
4443330.short_description: Fight your way through brutal medieval arenas in this free prologue featuring physics-driven melee combat, effective armor systems, and violent consequences.

4443400.title: This Flash Contains Horrors
4443400.short_description: Psychological horror collection, which includes 5 games: GambleHeart, ROMASHKA, You Are Doxxed, B*tch!, LOOP and COLORFOOD Inc. These are stories about anxiety, pressure, and internal tension linked by a shared atmosphere.

4443420.title: TETE
4443420.short_description: TETE: A wobbly climbing adventure featuring a clumsy little golem. Can you conquer the hardcore controls and jiggling physics?

4443440.title: NS Drive Simulator
4443440.short_description: A driving simulator featuring realistic driving, diverse vehicles, and multiple driving environments.

4443560.title: The Tape: Origins
4443560.short_description: The clock is ticking. Investigate real found footage, uncover the cult's secrets, and solve escape-room puzzles to escape the hotel before they return to sacrifice you.

4443610.title: PredaDeck
4443610.short_description: PredaDeck is a trading card game that transforms the brutal yet exquisite real-world food chain into a competitive strategic duel. Here, knowledge is your sharpest claw, and strategy is your only law of survival.

4443820.title: Silentia
4443820.short_description: In Silentia, the monster is blind. It sees only what it hears. Hunt as Krav, a creature that grows stronger with every sound, or survive as one of the many, escaping in total silence. Make a sound, and it finds you.

4444210.title: The Man of Iron: Shadows of Haensburg
4444210.short_description: Step into the boots of a guard in the dark megapolis of Haensburg. Master first-person combat and exploration in a striking 2D-in-3D stylized world. Caught between powerful factions, your decisions will shape the city's fate. Will you uphold the law or survive the shadows?

4444330.title: Quackoban
4444330.short_description: In Quackoban you will push blocks that fuse into shapes, teleport and move in groups. A new and challenging twist on the Sokoban block-pushing classic, bringing it to new dimensions where you have to think in shapes.

4444420.title: Rows Of Earth
4444420.short_description: A detailed zombie-survival colony sim where you create a settlement on an infested island. Guide your workers as they build walls, grow crops, dig trenches and plant their flag in the land. Help them to fight hordes, form families, and uncover old technologies. Write their story...

4444610.title: ToMyX
4444610.short_description: Inspired by its creator's love life, face his ex-girlfriends in a blend of arcade action, puzzles and Visual Novel. Survive a surreal TV show where memories become battles and feelings become gameplay. It all really happened... more or less.

4444730.title: Celestial Crusader
4444730.short_description: Strategic isometric roguelike in waves. Position mobile defense units, combine elemental powers, and use cards to protect the portal. Fight, die, and evolve!

4445020.title: Grandpa Golf
4445020.short_description: A golf roguelike about making really big numbers. Sink shots, buy powerful items, and build ridiculous score combos as you push deeper into Grandpa Golf’s golf course.

4445120.title: William 2
4445120.short_description: Explore a connected world of villages, snowy mountains and underwater passages in William 2, a 2D action-platformer. Complete quests, battle enemies, collect treasures and unlock new paths as you face bosses inspired by the Seven Deadly Sins.

4445170.title: ProtoPunk
4445170.short_description: ProtoPunk is a fast-paced, steampunk movement FPS. Gun down clunkers with your revolver to gain speed. Slow the gears of time to sharpen your aim. Slide and boost through the city to uncover your past and stop the corruption choking it.

4445180.title: VeriData Inc.
4445180.short_description: Solve spreadsheet-based puzzles and handle crazy coworkers in a normal day's work at VeriData Inc.

4446070.title: Splorbit
4446070.short_description: Splorbit is a physics-driven horde survival game. Bounce, split and explode balls through swarming enemies, build a loadout from upgrade cards, break the gold off named bosses, and survive 20 minutes per world across 5 worlds. Solo or local co-op for up to 4 players.

4446160.title: Patchland
4446160.short_description: Patchland is a relaxing strategy game where you create your own world by building it from scratch using tiles. Connect various biomes, earn points, complete quests, and add animals to the map to create increasingly larger and more beautiful landscapes.

4446700.title: Rimefall
4446700.short_description: Your colony ship has landed on an alien planet — but the environment kills electronics. Salvage the ark, survive the early years, and build a nation as your society regresses to medieval with remnants of modern knowledge. Grand strategy with simulated population and turn-based combat.

4446940.title: The Dream Sequence
4446940.short_description: Step into a surreal world inspired by dreams, where strange environments hide handcrafted puzzles waiting to be solved. Explore, experiment, and uncover the logic behind a collection of unusual dreamlike challenges.

4447090.title: Master of Chaos: Beat or Break the Game
4447090.short_description: Pulverize your enemies for underestimating this cute little wizard by counter attacks, deflecting projectiles, unleashing face-melting ultimate abilities and building insane combos boosting your power until you are strong enough to beat the boss or break the game - Either way you win.

4447620.title: Get to Work, Gnomes! Christmas Factory
4447620.short_description: Run a Christmas gift factory with unruly gnomes in this short management game! Wrap gifts yourself, set up production equipment, manage your gnomes, and assign tasks. Turn a chaotic workshop into a smoothly running factory before Christmas.

4448050.title: TORION:Escape
4448050.short_description: TORION:Escape is a fast-paced parkour game where nothing stops you from going forward and Escaping the simulation in record time. Run, jump, and control the environment alongside a variety of relaxing drum and bass tracks playing in the background.

4448140.title: Spirits: Unbound
4448140.short_description: Build your own deck of Spirits to battle in Spirits: Unbound. Play against opponents, then alter your cards with stickers, to make them incredibly powerful.

4448360.title: A Game About Launching A Ball
4448360.short_description: A challenging game about launching a ball to collect stars. Collect the stars as fast as you can, discover the secrets, upgrade your ball, and unlock the awards. Grab a friend to play online or split screen!

4448570.title: STILL BOUND
4448570.short_description: A weekend trip ends on a mountain road. You wake in the wreck, alone, deep in a forest where every trail promises help. A story-driven, first-person psychological horror game about searching for rescue - and finding out what answers.

4448620.title: Rovi's Diary
4448620.short_description: Rovi's Diary – A 2D pixel-art adventure with anime storytelling. On planet Lumira, an ordinary girl Rovi is chosen by "Starlight." She grows from a passive observer into a protector, teaming up with Faye and Alice to uncover the mystery behind cosmic invaders.

4448920.title: Tactics of Scarlet
4448920.short_description: Tactics of Scarlet is a Japanese-Style Tactical RPG inspired by the classics from the GBA era. Cross swords through 3 campaigns with radically different gameplay as you discover multiple sides of the story.

4449030.title: File Tower Defence
4449030.short_description: Defend your desktop from invading viruses! An OS-themed strategic tower defense game where you combine various file extensions to build powerful defense towers.

4449080.title: Bloodfell
4449080.short_description: Tear through Hell with devastating weapon and spell builds in this gothic action roguelite. Hunt powerful loot across five procedural biomes, risk another floor, and rebuild Ashenhold for your next descent.

4449170.title: Skydeck Swords
4449170.short_description: Bring a sword to a ship fight! Become a pirate and command a fleet of ships armed with massive, hull-mounted swords in this unique roguelike deckbuilder. Navigate across the stars to rescue your crew and steal all the riches!

4449470.title: The Outer Islands
4449470.short_description: Explore a quarantined island chain and an automated hospital abandoned for twenty years. Investigate a returning signal, read the evidence left behind, solve mechanical systems, and evade machines that still believe they have patients.

4449650.title: Beards Go Underground
4449650.short_description: The Mining Deckbuilder. Blow up the mountains using explosive card combos! Build your deck, prepare your strategy and BOOM! - call gold and gemstones your own.

4449750.title: Arbiters Dream
4449750.short_description: Face the God of Chaos in a cosmic tower-defense board game for the balance of the universe. Each run craft a unique deck from tower and unit cards and upgrade them with modular ability runes.

4450000.title: Kaori
4450000.short_description: Kaori is a first-person puzzle and adventure game. Explore ancient ruins on a sun-drenched archipelago and uncover the many mysteries of a lost civilization.

4450050.title: Lemony Fresh
4450050.short_description: You are a tiny lemon who cleans filthy spaces. Explore and restore a home with a warm, beating heart.

4450980.title: Dream Disc Delivery
4450980.short_description: The world is ending, but everything will be alright. Bike around the seaside town of Lighthouse City as you enjoy your last days on your home planet. If you ever get lost, you can use collectibles to improve your map. Just be sure not to crash!

4451230.title: Dr. Oops!
4451230.short_description: Treat bizarre patients, solve outrageous medical mysteries, and pay off your crushing debt in this dark comedy deduction adventure! Every diagnosis relies on your observation, deduction, and some real-world knowledge. Pay off your debt, or skip a payment if needed, and fight for your freedom.

4451340.title: Head Full Of Zombi
4451340.short_description: 1948, post‑war England. On Holy Island, a buried alien artifact known as The Eye corrupts prisoners, monks, and guards into flesh‑hungry ghouls. Technology fails, chaos reigns. You crash‑land among the wreckage—supplies scattered, hordes closing in. Survive or be consumed.

4451470.title: Traffic Monster
4451470.short_description: Traffic Monster is a fast-paced endless runner! Dodge heavy traffic, collect power-ups, and customize your dream car. Challenge real players in online multiplayer, place bets, and survive the chaos!

4451800.title: Dream Fishing
4451800.short_description: Explore atmospheric dream worlds and catch strange fish. Uncover secrets that have been submerged.

4451860.title: Dino Age: Survive the Eras
4451860.short_description: Explore one island across three prehistoric eras in a single-player 2D survival RPG. Build your camp, craft better gear and hatch prehistoric companions. Face dangerous creatures and heal fractures in time to open the way forward.

4451910.title: NGC-404: Fractured Sector
4451910.short_description: Lead a small fleet in a cut-off 2D space sector where trade, colonies, fuel, supplies and battles decide who survives. Build your faction, explore unknown systems, develop colonies, fit ships and shape a living simulated galaxy alone or with friends.

4452020.title: Turbo Trigger
4452020.short_description: Turbo Trigger is a local arena shooter for up to 4 players. Die, buy a better weapon, respawn, and get your revenge. Nobody sits out — the round doesn't stop until the final second.

4452120.title: Jingle Balls
4452120.short_description: Santa is injured and the gift list is gone. Jingle Balls is a first-person co-op horror game for 1–4 players. Search each house for clues, choose the right gift, and leave it without being seen. House layouts change between visits. Face different enemies and use a range of items.

4452630.title: Bradamante
4452630.short_description: Become one of the wandering knights of legend. Live the adventures of Bradamante, the strongest paladin in Charlemagne's court, push back against the invading Saracen Army and go on quests with allies and rivals in this action packed epic RPG about honor, duty and the sense of self.

4452700.title: STAGE TOUR
4452700.short_description: Build your band, hit the stage, and go on tour in Stage Tour, the next evolution of music rhythm games. Rock over 90 officially licensed tracks, unlock over 180 authentic Gibson®, Epiphone® and Kramer® guitars, and experience five game modes, including the all-new roguelite Tour Mode.

4452890.title: Caution Ahead: Part 3
4452890.short_description: Descend into darkness as John, a search and rescue officer, reaches the final destination of his journey. Explore claustrophobic mines in this horror experience that blends atmospheric exploration with stealth-based survival.

4453420.title: DDD: Dice, Dungeons, and Drakes
4453420.short_description: Master a unique tactical board-game battler! Roll to summon monsters and watch your dice disassemble into road-tiles to forge a path to the enemy Lord. Balance Summon and Action dice, manage crest inventories, and cast powerful spells to crush the rival Lord in DDD: Dice, Dungeons & Drakes.

4453540.title: Minesweeper: Next-Gen
4453540.short_description: This isn’t the Minesweeper you’re used to! In Minesweeper: Next-Gen, you’ll explore boards built from a variety of geometric tessellations. Boundaries can wrap around, tiles can split, and parts of the map can even contain the map itself. Rely on pure logic to gradually uncover all safe areas.

4453930.title: Daydream Drifters
4453930.short_description: A roguelike stealth horror where dungeons, enemies, and items are procedurally generated. With dynamic events over time and changing weather, hide from enemies with distinct abilities—or prepare to fight. Explore 3 seamlessly connected random dungeons and survive the daydream.

4453940.title: ANTARIUM 2
4453940.short_description: Long ago, the Old Colony filled these depths. Now your queen begins to dig. Grow a living ant colony in a cross-section of the earth, automate it with belts and machines, survive storms and raids, wake the ancient Engine, then fly to found a stronger colony.

4454020.title: Fort Synergy Demo
4454020.short_description: A funny co-op tower defense game where you and your friends need to work together to defend yourselves against all the incoming waves of monsters! Decide whether to roam the map or stay near the towers!

4454070.title: SteelFall
4454070.short_description: Pilot an armored mech and fight giant kaiju with steel fists and an arsenal of ranged weapons. Punch, parry, and shoot your way through a world overrun by monsters in a third-person beat ’em up where every hit shakes the ground.

4454280.title: ARCHIVIST: Tidy Up & Sort
4454280.short_description: A first-person archive work simulator. Sort through boxes of documents, arrange files on the shelves, and bring order to the archive by following its filing rules. Handle stacks of records, keep each section organized, and enjoy the satisfying process of restoring order step by step.

4454630.title: OmniGun
4454630.short_description: Obliterate hostile automatons in this vibrant physics-based roguelite FPS. Master the OmniGun, a prototype gun capable of firing any ammunition imaginable as you shoot, explode, burn, shock, slice, freeze, shrink, and impale your way to the exit.

4454750.title: Flushed Forward
4454750.short_description: Control a limbless sewer creature on board a large speed boat pursued by a massive sewer tidal wave in this Arcade experience! Defend against enemies by vaulting across your boat to stomp on their heads!

4454890.title: BLACKFRAG
4454890.short_description: BLACKFRAG is a fast-paced competitive arena FPS focused on precision gunplay and intense multiplayer combat.

4455180.title: Marble Machina
4455180.short_description: You wake up in a surreal factory with no memory of how you arrived. Punch cards operate strange machines, floors rise and fall beneath your feet, and teleporters lead who knows where. You’re fairly sure you haven’t gone mad. Still, just to be safe, you’d better collect all your marbles.

4455400.title: Vord
4455400.short_description: Vord is an evolving sandbox adventure where players shape the world through iterative mechanics and collaborative discovery. Navigate a shifting landscape, build unique structures, and experiment with expanding gameplay systems that grow alongside the community’s imagination.

4455610.title: Stargazer Simulator
4455610.short_description: Go from zero to a real amateur astronomer. Join the astronomy club, set up your own telescope, start with your first bright star, and go on to find the Moon’s craters and distant galaxies in the real night sky. Every star you learn in the game is really up there tonight.

4455820.title: Tech Legends Simulator
4455820.short_description: Open a tiny PC shop and grow it into a tech empire. Stock shelves from Amazoom deliveries, ring up customers at a real cash register, build gaming PCs by hand, hire staff, run a LAN café, mine crypto and expand your HQ all the way to the second floor.

4456100.title: Extraction '76
4456100.short_description: Extraction ’76 is a tactical co-op extraction shooter set in an alternate Cold War. Form a squad, infiltrate hostile zones, recover valuable assets, and fight your way to extraction in intense session-based missions built for teamwork and replayability.

4456110.title: Planet No More
4456110.short_description: An arcade-incremental game where you DESTROY planets! Build a fleet, upgrade weapons, max out your skill tree and destroy your target slowly. You'll advance deep into the galaxy, strategically shattering planets to their cores to unlock the next celestial.

4456140.title: Spy Diner
4456140.short_description: "Spy Diner" is a click-and-run adventure game combining restaurant management and spy infiltration. Players run a diner by day next to the century-old "Old Chiang's Braised Pork Rice" as a good neighbor, and execute takedown plans by night under handler orders.

4456190.title: Mighty Tiny Railways
4456190.short_description: Build a steam railway where the network you build determines how it operates. Deliver cargo and passengers on time, grow towns and industries, and optimize your network. Invite a friend to build together in online co-op.

4456460.title: Kopernicus: Incremental Suffering
4456460.short_description: Burn. Build. Survive. Escape. Incinerate nightmares with the MATEJKO flamethrower, expand your ever-growing base, and unlock devastating new weapons. Every night the planet grows stronger. So do you. Recover forgotten memories and fight your way back home (with your chihuahua's help).

4456670.title: Thieving Together
4456670.short_description: You and your crew have one goal: break in, grab everything, and get out before sunrise. Thieving Together is a chaotic physics PvP & co-op heist party game. Drag loot, dodge rivals, stack the van fast. Everything wobbles. Everyone steals. Biggest haul by sunrise wins.

4456740.title: FishInc
4456740.short_description: A minimalist incremental fishing game about mastering the sea. Time your strikes, chain perfect hits, build your boat, and design powerful trophy loadouts to survive increasingly chaotic runs.

4457050.title: Remothered: Tormented Fathers Remastered
4457050.short_description: The first chapter of the modern old school survival horror saga, rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5. Same ruthless tension, sharper everything.

4457140.title: WARONOMY
4457140.short_description: Waronomy is a turn-based fantasy strategy conquest wargame set in a medieval magic world, where strategy is everything: raise armies, empower heroes, forge elite stacks, and annihilate rival warlords until every castle on the map is yours.

4457420.title: Bermuda Bastion
4457420.short_description: Survive 33 days in the heart of the Bermuda Triangle! Build triangular structures to defend against malevolent squares, pentagons, and other geometric monsters. In this chaotic city-builder roguelike, every mistake pulls your Bastion closer to the depths.

4457530.title: THE SHOW
4457530.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op horror extraction gameshow. Enter deadly labyrinths, solve puzzles, steal valuable loot, and build a fortune for the masses' entertainment. Push your luck, go deeper, and extract before you lose everything...

4457820.title: Gravitten VR
4457820.short_description: Grab, climb, and turn your world upside down! Become Gravitten, the gravity-defying kitten, and master the environment's shifting physics. Experience 5 distinct biomes where up is down and left is right.

4457900.title: GearGrave
4457900.short_description: 2D side-scrolling strategy game. Spawn units, fight, and destroy. Your choices decide victory or defeat.

4457980.title: Spurfall
4457980.short_description: Restore life to a forgotten Wild West valley. Rebuild ruined settlements, bridges, watchtowers, farms, and cabins. bring back settlers, defend against bandits, and transform abandoned lands into thriving frontier towns.

4458000.title: Pull It Together
4458000.short_description: Pull your weight and your wagon as a crew of up to 4 on this cooperative adventure. Gather supplies, keep your wagon rolling, and band together to face unpredictable events before the storm closes in! Each journey will have different trails, different troubles, but the same trusty wagon.

4458040.title: Ninpo Renju
4458040.short_description: Link four to unleash ninpo. Link five for a chance to strike with ninsatsu. NinpoRenju blends five-in-a-row tactics, ninja combat, and roguelike builds. Collect special pieces, synthesize your deck, and challenge friends online. Five in a row is only the beginning.

4458220.title: Little Beast in the Big Maze
4458220.short_description: A fantastical, atmospheric Metroidvania platformer where you jump, fight, and expand your abilities to escape your exile and confront the beastly Queen who banished you. But will this fairy-tale end with you becoming a hero, or a beast?

4458290.title: Sovereign Strike: Submarine Supremacy
4458290.short_description: Become the captain of a Los Angeles-class attack submarine. Strike without warning, sink enemy ships with different torpedoes, dominate the global rankings, and explore a living underwater world packed with historical wrecks and forgotten secrets. Fast, tactical, and fun submarine warfare.

4458450.title: SIDEROS
4458450.short_description: Iron, the fundamental element of the world, was cursed by the magic lords of earth, water, air and fire to rust. In this high fantasy turn-based RPG you take the role of the iron knight in his quest to stop rust from destroying the world.

4458740.title: PODER
4458740.short_description: Run a district in a 12-million Latin American megacity in a political strategy about power, compromise, and dirty deals. 100+ starting combos, 75 population groups, and no decision without consequences. Can you do better than those you love to hate?

4459070.title: Travel the Backrooms
4459070.short_description: "Travel the Backrooms" is a horror puzzle game that supports 1-4 players! Explore a variety of levels, solve the unique puzzles of each level, and be careful not to get caught by the "Entities"...

4459150.title: The Legend of Wijaya
4459150.short_description: Experience a story-rich, classic 2D action RPG steeped in 13th-century Java. Play as Raden Wijaya using fluid hack-and-slash combat, archery, and magic. Outsmart the traitors and invading Mongols and forge the largest empire in Southeast Asia.

4459230.title: 字走三国
4459230.short_description: Hidden within the words lies a chilling killing intent; the chess pieces radiate a boundless fighting spirit. Tiny words weave the Three Kingdoms narrative, yet aspire to contain profound emotions.

4459420.title: Moonlight Cornelia
4459420.short_description: Akane Riho’s peaceful student life changes when she awakens as the magical girl Moonlight Cornelia. Switch between school exploration and real-time combo battles, customize skills and crests, bond with companions, and stop the Demon Queen’s revival.

4459510.title: The Nightwal Legacy
4459510.short_description: A first-person supernatural thriller where you explore a manor overtaken by darkness. Wield a mysterious power to confront an ancient evil, unravel the truth, and save your brother.

4459630.title: Radical Tower Defense
4459630.short_description: In Radical Tower Defense, harness shifting core chips to forge a unique steel defense. Each choice reshapes your combat style. Unlock architectures, explore chip synergies, ignite tactical reactions. Don’t just defend—become a blade to break formations, strike the heartland, crush the enemy lair!

4459640.title: Spell Cage
4459640.short_description: Spell Cage is an action roguelite that packs the hands-on combat and deep buildcrafting of hack-and-slash ARPGs into short runs. Fight through randomized dungeons without quests or complicated navigation, and combine skills to develop a build of your own.

4459720.title: Cyber Demon Protocol
4459720.short_description: An antique computer has granted you the ability to summon cyber demons. Seeking power from demons is like dancing on a tightrope, from Lawful Good to Chaotic Evil, how will you choose? Will you collude with the wealthy, politicians, stars, and artists, or change this decadent society?

4459770.title: Plesiotopia
4459770.short_description: A wholesome marine sanctuary sim, where you take care of giant sea reptiles from the dinosaur era. Nurse ichtyosaurs, plesiosaurs and mosasaurs, train them for the wild, then search the Pacific Ocean for a suitable marine ecosystem where you can release them.

4459930.title: The Aether Project TD
4459930.short_description: Place and upgrade towers to defend your objective. Use abilities and the terrain to hold back advancing enemies.

4459990.title: Screen Survivors
4459990.short_description: An idle survivor-like that sits in the corner of your screen.

4460050.title: Nexus Survivors
4460050.short_description: In Nexus Survivors, you don't get a pre-made fireball handed to you. You build it yourself — from cards that determine how it moves, what it does, and what happens when it hits. Every spell in your arsenal is your own creation.

4460070.title: Ibru
4460070.short_description: Born yesterday, you are a detective in a Sumerpunk city ruled by gods. Navigate shifting allegiances, make impossible choices, and decide who survives as the divine order fractures. Will you remain a pawn or shape your own fate?

4460500.title: Last Cleanup
4460500.short_description: Last Cleanup is a 1–4 player co-op horror game where you and your crew take on dangerous cleaning missions in abandoned locations. Some things lurk in the dark, so work together, make it out alive and pay your bills.

4460510.title: HOLER!
4460510.short_description: Dig, dig, and DIG! One meter deeper, one second longer. A relentless mining action game where you plunge into an endless underground world! Your only rival is your past self. The eternal challenge to shatter your own "Best Record" begins now!

4461320.title: ESCAPE: Orphanage
4461320.short_description: A psychological thriller set in Scarlet Orphanage, where every choice shapes the fate of the residents. Nothing is as it seems. Are you facing ghosts… or something far worse?

4461450.title: Backpack Roguelike
4461450.short_description: Arrange, merge, and synergize gear inside a growing backpack, then survive real-time waves and brutal bosses. Every slot shapes your build in this strategic action roguelite with persistent progression. Experiment, adapt, and turn limited space into your strongest weapon.

4461460.title: Fantasy Blacksmith Simulator
4461460.short_description: Become a Master Blacksmith in this cozy fantasy simulator. Restore and upgrade your workshop, forge magical weapons and armor, craft jewelry, and enchant powerful gear. Meet magical creatures and mysterious figures as you enjoy a relaxing crafting experience, solo or with friends in co-op.

4461560.title: Remothered: Broken Porcelain Remastered
4461560.short_description: The second chapter of the iconic modern old school survival horror saga. Remastered in Unreal Engine 5 to deliver a dramatically improved experience, while keeping every mechanic, every scare, and every secret exactly as they were.

4461590.title: Roidgrinder
4461590.short_description: Origin story of a famous roidgrinder. Mine, upgrade, trade and explore in this incremental space mining adventure. You'll interact with the ship's systems through a CLI/terminal. Crossbreed of 2D arcade, lightweight simulation and some idler elements. Note: KEYBOARD REQUIRED.

4461680.title: Bad Goons
4461680.short_description: Blast through cover, carve trenches, and build massive fortifications to dominate the battlefield. Adapt to ever-changing environments and discover new tactics with every match. Outsmart your enemies with pure War-IQ. No more gooning around! It’s time to join the fight.

4462130.title: LOVE D3ATH LOVE
4462130.short_description: In 2222, your AI secretly sends over 3,000 job applications worldwide without you knowing. Soon after, three powerful women appear, each insisting you belong with her. You’re thrown into a growing crisis, their ambitions colliding endlessly. What do they actually want from you?

4462250.title: Slime Game
