4462250.short_description: Slime Game is a retro rage platformer for the modern day! Run and jump through over 70 levels, all while collecting power-ups, stomping enemies, and finding hidden collectibles.

4462550.title: Franky Psychedelic Adventure
4462550.short_description: Join Franky on an epic journey across breathtaking dimensions to reclaim the stolen cookies. Harness powerful psychedelic abilities to overcome challenges, master impossible obstacles, and conquer extraordinary worlds.

4462890.title: Skinscribing
4462890.short_description: SKINSCRIBING is a 2D hand-drawn and dual-handed cosmic folk horror game wherein you explore environments, grief, and bodies alike to interpret and tattoo the history of a dying world as the foundation for the Era to come.

4463010.title: Alight
4463010.short_description: Photograph birds, decorate your lighthouse, and find companionable peace in Alight, a heartfelt cozy adventure about aging and absence

4463170.title: The Evaluation
4463170.short_description: A first-person horror puzzle game about solving cryptic puzzles and surviving a deadly night inside an abandoned drive-in theater.

4463500.title: DesktopSaurs
4463500.short_description: Turn your desktop into a dinosaur battleground! Defeat waves of enemies, earn rewards, and create devastating builds in this idle RPG. Adapt your strategy, defeat powerful bosses, and conquer prehistoric eras. All while you relax, work, or browse the web!

4463630.title: Chicken Must Fry
4463630.short_description: Chicken Must Fry is a survivor-like game where you play as a raw chicken refusing to be fried, wiping out monsters from the ruthless Frying Empire. Combine various skills and items, upgrade your characters, and survive the endless waves of enemies!

4463900.title: Casse-Croute Deckbuilder
4463900.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you cook your strategy. As a Cook, manage your Hero’s Appetite and Cholesterol, and build powerful combos with food cards and kitchen tools.

4464020.title: Tears of Sulfuria
4464020.short_description: Tears of Sulfuria is an emotional visual novel about two sisters in a dark fantasy world that rejects them. Marília and Adka must survive at any cost—and their choices may scar Sulfuria itself. Sacrifice yourself, lose your sanity, and do the unforgivable to move forward.

4464270.title: Beyond the Cradle
4464270.short_description: Build factories on tiny planets where every part rides a belt you lay yourself. Launch rockets with cargo to eight more worlds and assemble, module by module, a stellar engine to take your star away before the wave arrives. No enemies: pure logistics.

4464380.title: Stellar Fixer
4464380.short_description: Step into the grease-stained boots of a debt-ridden Patcher in a gritty industrial space station. Diagnose critical failures, strip panels with your automatic vortex drill, and replace complex components to bring massive ships back to life. Restore power, clear the smoke, and pay off your debt.

4464410.title: Dark Horizon
4464410.short_description: Dark Horizon is a single-player survival FPS game that takes place in Russia. After a near-fatal accident, your squad-mates have been killed, and you are deserted in the middle of a deadly conflict fueled by the city's government. Will you escape, or choose to thrive in the city until it falls?

4464430.title: Basement Server Simulator
4464430.short_description: Build a basement hosting empire solo or in co-op. Buy and place servers, install server apps, set your prices, accept time-limited customer contracts, and balance power, internet, heat, and hardware failures as you expand your operation.

4464460.title: Defender of Grids
4464460.short_description: A pixel-perfect Tower Defense game where defeat is just the beginning. Master the rock-paper-scissors balance of combat, speed up the action with 4x speed, and use your hard-earned XP to unlock powerful permanent skills. Can you hold the line?

4464780.title: When the Stars Threw Down Their Spears
4464780.short_description: When the Stars Threw Down Their Spears is a story-rich, retro space shooter inspired by DOS-era space games. Blast your way through fast-paced arcade combat, build out modular, upgradable ships, and explore a galaxy torn by war.

4464900.title: My Perfect Nails
4464900.short_description: My Perfect Nails is a retro simulation game inspired by the 2000's web games, where you create the perfect set of nails for your customers! Choose between many options and accessories to create the nails of their dreams! ✨🌸

4465290.title: Desolation Arcanist
4465290.short_description: Craft your own magic in this Action Roguelite. "Program" your wands with varied Spell Cores (Fireballs, Flying Swords... or Watermelons?) and Runes. Raise your companion Dragon, command a Puppet army, and abuse physics to knock enemies off cliffs. Your build is your destiny.

4465410.title: MMA Career Simulator
4465410.short_description: Create your MMA fighter, develop their skills, build winning game plans, and promote yourself to a global MMA superstar. Every fight is simulated based on your preparation and in-fight decisions, where smart choices can mean the difference between victory and defeat.

4465580.title: Victor's Video Vault
4465580.short_description: Survive a '90s video store where movies come to life after closing. Work the night shift as an ordinary job spirals into a reality-bending nightmare.

4465930.title: Scriven Mage
4465930.short_description: The only VR game where you cast spells by actually writing them. VR spellcasting PvP/PvE. Write real glyphs in the spellbook to prepare spells. Find every combination. Master the art.

4466110.title: Narcissist Tail
4466110.short_description: You are a player who was called upon to help a strange wolf family escape. Figure out why they were kidnapped. Find hidden secrets with an in-game screenshot system. Battle monsters in bullet hell combat. But most importantly, find a way to out together.

4466380.title: Army of the Potomac
4466380.short_description: A digital version of the grand tactical wargame published by GMT Games and designed by Mark Herman. Second in the Civil War Heritage Series, this game includes scenarios for five individual battles covering the period of 1862 to 1864, and two campaign scenarios using eight maps from the boardgame.

4466430.title: Caspian's Quest
4466430.short_description: The world of Caspian’s Quest is built around travel. Your wagon is more than transportation — it is your storage, shelter, lifeline, and symbol of progress. Preparation matters. The right meal, tool, potion, or crafted item can make the difference between a safe journey or an untimely end.

4466800.title: The Ghost Protocol: Echoes of Steel
4466800.short_description: Command a squad of broken survivors on a planet that hunts you. A tactical mech-action game, you must build your base, defend against crystalline swarms, and manage the "Icarus Drift"—a neural link that grants god-like power but costs your humanity. Will you break the enemy, or become part of it?

4467370.title: Yokai Batting Game in Kawagoe おまつりようかいバッティングゲーム in KAWAGOE
4467370.short_description: Blast yokai away with just one button! A fast and satisfying one-button casual action game set in Kawagoe! Hit the yokai. Save Kawagoe. There’s only one control. Hit! Hit! Home run! Smash them out of the park! Save the souls of the cursed yokai!! Bring peace back to Kawagoe with your bat!

4467420.title: Navinosuke: The Yo-kai Buster
4467420.short_description: The story takes place in an ancient Japan where the balance between humans and Yo-kai has begun to collapse. In this age of chaos, the Onmyo Bureau secretly creates its ultimate weapon — a karakuri Onmyoji apprentice known as “Navinosuke.”

4467600.title: Z Drive
4467600.short_description: Drive, explore, search for resources, and craft! And drive! Do it for as long as you can! This FPS takes place in a rough world after a zombie attack. Prepare your wheeled fortress for every possible adventure! Explore the dead world and search for the remnants of civilization.

4467690.title: Susia - Wolf Life Simulator
4467690.short_description: Live the fun life of a wolf! Find a mate, start a pack, hunt together and survive in the wild! Befriend other packs or defeat them to become the sole wolf pack. Adventure through the island and settle down or keep moving, it's all up to you!

4468160.title: Oh No, Meteor!
4468160.short_description: Oh No, Meteor! is a short incremental game. Chop trees with your cursor, send lumberjacks, haulers, and miners to work, then spend wood, stone, and coins on a huge skill tree, talent cards, and artifacts before the meteor hits the town.

4468520.title: Rift Haul TD
4468520.short_description: Build, upgrade, evolve, and reposition your towers to counter new threats, explore powerful synergies, and stay one step ahead in this fast-paced fantasy tower defense.

4468940.title: Keep Making
4468940.short_description: Keep Making is a fantasy room builder fit for the creation of old-timey castles, cozy corners, and trap-filled dungeons. Design and decorate without goals, to relax or to prep for tabletop play. Then, export and share.

4469210.title: Iron of Dust
4469210.short_description: The SciFi shooter that makes you think twice.

4470890.title: Expedition Idle
4470890.short_description: An idle auto-battler ARPG where you create one-of-a-kind items with crafting materials you pick up from the ground, customize your adventurers with different abilities and stats, and strategize your way through difficult bosses, unique scenarios, and dynamic monsters!

4470900.title: Up'N'Up: Mountain Express
4470900.short_description: Join the Up'N'Up delivery crew, upgrade your vehicles and climb the mountain in this off-road driving roguelike. Look after your vehicle to overcome any challenges the mountain and delivery items can throw at you. Climb solo or tackle the mountain with friends locally or online.

4471080.title: 奉先勇者:我爹是魔王?
4471080.short_description: In this world of swords and magic, a new chapter in the tale of the Demon King and the Hero is about to unfold...

4473940.title: UpUpApple
4473940.short_description: A stage-clear 3D action game! Control an apple, overcome traps, and defeat the final boss. Roll, bounce, and dash through linear courses. Too hard? Use Leaf coins to spin the Gacha for helpful items! Use their power to crush the boss and claim victory!

4474280.title: HOSHiN ENGi Re:surrection
4474280.short_description: Wield mythic treasures, ride spirit beasts, and hack and slash through ever-shifting dungeons in an all-new roguelite steeped in Chinese myth, based on Ryu Fujisaki's Weekly Shonen Jump manga. A new hero, a new story, thirty years on.

4474330.title: Rotted - A Brain Rot Simulator
4474330.short_description: Rotted is a chaotic time-survival game about doomscrolling your way through an endless list of chores. Use your phone to earn cash and build broken upgrade combos while managing hunger, anxiety, and the chaos around you.

4474590.title: HUSH
4474590.short_description: A co-op horror game where you and your friends break into monsters’ homes and wreck their stuff. Smash everything you can and escape the crime scene before they catch you — they hear every sound.

4475020.title: Dream Hackers VR
4475020.short_description: Join Dream Hackers team in this VR action-adventure. Infiltrate surreal collective dreams, where danger and discovery intertwine. Create your own builds from various weapons and artifacts to battle living nightmares, defeat their ancient bosses, and uncover the truth of the dreamworld.

4475140.title: Whispers of Primwood
4475140.short_description: Escape into art, music, and choice in this spicy romantasy otome. Whispers of Primwood is a seductive tale of trust, betrayal, and shifting morals. A simple delivery leads you into a forest both beautiful and deadly, and toward two dangerously alluring men.. Could a nightmare turn into a dream?

4475320.title: 你离开之后
4475320.short_description: 《你离开之后》是一款文字互动类乙女向游戏，再次醒来时你发现自已似乎已经是一缕魂魄了，你的爱人在你离开后变得敏感脆弱，而你的行为将会或直接或间接的影响到他，最终走向不同的结局。 一款美味的鳏夫文学，你的冷漠与无视会让向来冷静矜持的爱人在你面前发疯变得歇斯底里，你的捉弄会让他在梦里情难自已，你的一举一动都会让他改变，你离开之后，他活成了你的样子，或是你想要的样子。

4475520.title: SKINFACE
4475520.short_description: SKINFACE is a gruesome horror-thriller where you skin strangers alive to create the perfect disguise. Evade the police, earn your target’s trust and carry out the hit. Knock knock!

4475550.title: The Unfinished Melody: Prologue
4475550.short_description: Some things can never be made whole, and some melodies are never meant to be played. Pursue a lost song, unspoken feelings, and precious memories as you step into a mysterious fantasy world of light, shadow, and dreamlike adventure.

4475640.title: Veil of Despair - Episode 1
4475640.short_description: Veil of Despair is an episodic psychological horror series set in a fractured mirror world born from grief and suffering. Episode 1: Death's Reach is completely free and kicks off a descent into loss, trauma and raw emotional pain through suffocating atmosphere and intense psychological tension.

4475670.title: Last Float
4475670.short_description: Explore and survive in this shattered world. Build, defend, and repair your raft. Search for secrets and uncover information about what happened - and most importantly, don't drown!

4475790.title: Warband
4475790.short_description: Warband is a wave-crusher, boss-rusher and mystery-busting roguelite. Choose your commander, recruit for your warband and stock up at the shop to create unique combinations every run whilst fighting off waves of enemies and bosses a plenty. Can you turn the tide and get Thornhallow back on its feet?

4475890.title: Yuzutsu
4475890.short_description: Samurais. Ninjas. Snow monkeys. Hot springs. You are Taomaru, a capybara monk who treats every battle like a minor inconvenience. Casually stroll through a perilous mission, swapping places with enemies to outsmart them and turn their own attacks against them using the ancient art of Yuzutsu.

4475910.title: Praktikos
4475910.short_description: The King of the Underworld has abandoned the Throne. In Praktikos, the Deadly Sins fight tactical card duels on strategic boards. Collect relics, upgrade your deck, create positional combos, and prove which sin deserves to rule the Underworld.

4475950.title: System Status: SuperCritical
4475950.short_description: Defend your base by placing towers strategically, forming interconnected systems that depend on one another. Adapt your strategy to different environments and enemy waves, exploiting their weaknesses. In System Status: SuperCritical, resources are scarce and critical failure is always an option.

4475960.title: Hold & Advance
4475960.short_description: 2D action sandbox about exploring an underground world, crafting and tactically defending alien stations. Build turrets, combine modules and repel enemy waves to unlock powerful upgrades that radically change your playstyle.

4476160.title: Pachinko Realms: Tiki-Taka
4476160.short_description: Master the pitch in this physics-based soccer pachinko game ! Launch your ball through traditional 3D Pachinko boards, chaining "Tiki-Taka" passes to reach the next stage ! Explore diverse stadium realms, collect tactical power-ups, and face goalkeepers in epic boss fights.

4476390.title: Lost Camp
4476390.short_description: After the death of your mother and with no other choice, you take the only job available: guarding and maintaining a lonely campsite in the mountains. But what seemed like a quiet place hides mysteries that will change everything.

4478200.title: 這遺虚配信
4478200.short_description: Photograph and repel the monsters that appear in the abandoned hotel using a mysterious camera! Uncover the mysteries surrounding the abandoned hotel by relying on comments from your viewers! Use the Super Chats you receive to buy items and gain the upper hand in battle!

4478270.title: PWC Simulator
4478270.short_description: PWC Simulator is a jet ski simulator with online racing, freestyle, and mod support. Ride stand-up and sit-down skis with simulated water, hull and rider weight. Customize your rider and ski, race buoy courses or freeride in surf and flatwater, or flip and do tricks on flip skis.

4478910.title: HITORIASOBI
4478910.short_description: Cute and a little strange? "Hitori Asobi" is a deck-building roguelike x 3D board game. "This is a game where you ■■ the people you hate!" Surrounded by lots of wonderful things, Rinachi, a very happy girl, decides to play a special game devised by her dear friend Poco...

4478970.title: ASEMA
4478970.short_description: Automate your factory in space. Build logistic railguns to feed the production lines of your ever growing machines. Gravity disrupts your trajectories - master it. Connect your machines over the vast void. Find resource rich moons and asteroid streams to harvest and mine, but beware of the humans.

4479090.title: Stewart The Fox: Swing it!
4479090.short_description: A fast-paced speedrun platformer where you play as Stewart The Fox, improve your runs, and compete on worldwide leaderboards. Master the movement across 15+ maps, race against your ghost, and beat your personal best. Can you become a World Record Holder?

4480060.title: Hidden Folks 2
4480060.short_description: Search for hidden folks in interactive miniature landscapes. Scare some giraffes, ride a few rides, appreciate some art, and push around some astronauts. Wheeeeeeee!!!

4480080.title: Scream Operator: Haunted House Manager
4480080.short_description: Run a haunted dark ride from the control booth in this spooky horror management sim. Load guests, trigger scares, route carts, and keep the power alive as the queue surges. Earn cash and prestige to rebuild the mansion, automate the ride, and survive every shift.

4480100.title: Dynamine
4480100.short_description: Dynamine is an incremental mining game based on Minesweeper. Dig for ores while avoiding explosives, sell what you found, buy better tools to dig more efficiently, then rinse and repeat!

4480140.title: KILL BREACH
4480140.short_description: KILL BREACH is a brutal, fast-paced roguelite FPS where relentless horde shooting meets infinite weapon upgrades. Break into a randomly generated facility where no two runs are the same. Turn yourself into a machine of mass destruction, and RIP apart anything that moves.

4480150.title: Boonies
4480150.short_description: A One vs. Many survival horror game with proximity chat. A group of rednecks have crashed their car in dark woods. They must search for parts to fix their car and escape. But watch out! Through his countless cameras, the Observer sees all. He controls the monster, and must "protect" his forest.

4481230.title: Terra: The Voracious
4481230.short_description: "Terra: The Voracious", also known as "TTV", is a Furry-Vore RPG, using simple turn-based combat to defeat and escape stomachs, pouches, and much more!

4482090.title: A-01's Voyage.Logs
4482090.short_description: 人类已经死去。一个在宇宙里漂流的人工智能，在无法自杀的绝对清醒中，咀嚼庞大而无处安放的算力，独自面对整个宇宙的衰亡。

4482610.title: Skatebound
4482610.short_description: An action-packed 2.5D skateboarding RPG with stats, progression, and skate spots galore

4482750.title: Tower Of Hope
4482750.short_description: 30 years ago, heroes sealed an Evil God within the Tower of Hope. Now the barrier is broken. You are an adventurer seeking glory, but the truth of what really happened waits inside.

4482970.title: Overbooked
4482970.short_description: In this Roguelike deckbuilder, arrange rooms for eccentric animal guests under overbooking pressure to meet KPIs. Upgrade rooms with furniture, and squeeze in your freeloading Panda Manager at peak capacity.

4483270.title: Oscar Will Be Fine
4483270.short_description: Oscar's mother always told him he'd amount to something, but she didn't specify what. His greatest challenge: surviving a Modern Art Museum. Casual fun, no complicated instructions, no language dependency. Single player, best with a controller.

4483320.title: Lost in Art
4483320.short_description: Explore a surreal, twisted version of real-world art gallery in this atmospheric puzzle adventure inspired by classic survival horror. Use creative thinking and a mysterious power to solve puzzles, evade a sinister threat, and uncover the secret of a cursed artwork; before it traps you for good.

4483400.title: MR MAGEBOY
4483400.short_description: A cozy incremental game about an aspiring mage opening a Rescue Ranch for lost Familiars. Gather resources, upgrade your spells, explore biomes, and turn a profit to help your village thrive.

4483460.title: Dungeon Rush
4483460.short_description: DungeonRush is a top-down rogue-like game. You will traverse layers of dungeons, avoid dangerous traps, collect various weapons and equipment, challenge powerful enemies, until you finally confront the evil entity sealed deep within the dungeon.

4483920.title: TAMITOS: Tale of Understanding
4483920.short_description: A story-driven platformer where you experience the world through autistic and neurotypical perspectives. Explore a magical world, rescue Tamitos frog creatures representing emotions, and solve meaningful puzzles that teach empathy, understanding, and the beauty of seeing the world differently.

4484810.title: Winter Whiskers
4484810.short_description: In this short, cozy snow-cleaning adventure, help bring Winterlight Harbor back to life after a sudden blizzard! Vacuum up snow, turn it into steam, and power the town. Melt icy paths, help your neighbors, and prepare for the Winter Festival!

4485060.title: HAE Stack
4485060.short_description: In the far future year of 2025, society is dominated by a handful of global megacorporations that surveil everyone, everywhere, at all times. They know where you go, who you know, what you like, and sell that information to anyone willing to pay. But you need a job, and one of them is hiring.

4485080.title: Flow - The Tidal Whispers
4485080.short_description: A challenging narrative platformer built for the NES, where kindness shapes the journey.

4485320.title: Blazing Strike: R.Evolution
4485320.short_description: The fight continues in Blazing Strike: R.Evolution. This handcrafted HD beat 'em up brings Jake and his gang back to the streets to face a new, darker threat. Featuring fluid sprite-based combat, a deep Story Mode, and classic arcade action—handcrafted for the ultimate brawl.

4486030.title: Auris
4486030.short_description: Auris is a 2D Puzzle platformer where you play as a blind kid. Use echolocation to see objects, solve puzzles, fight enemies, and uncover hidden paths. Find your mother and help other trapped kids along your way out of the evil lab facility.

4486120.title: SlidefyingBadaBoom Penguin through a Slipstream: Rise of the Penguins 3
4486120.short_description: Slide, trick, and throw snowballs in this fast-paced 3D platformer inspired by Ninja Gaiden and Sonic. Play solo or local co‑op as you battle enemies, discover perks, and master icy challenges in Rise of the Penguins 3.

4486230.title: Dig n Fight
4486230.short_description: Dig for treasures, build powerful backpack synergies, and defeat all enemies.

4486880.title: Lovers Die
4486880.short_description: Juliet dies, but death is not the end. Armed with only dice, she fights through the underworld to rescue her lost love in this cozy-creepy, Yahtzee-inspired roguelite dice builder. Master the dice, beat the Devil & give ‘em Hell.

4487320.title: LastRoll
4487320.short_description: Post-apocalyptic tactical roguelike. Assemble a crew of 4, roll dice to fuel your skills and fight your way to the final boss. One lost battle means starting over. No cards. No mercy. Just dice.

4487770.title: Konomondo
4487770.short_description: Konomondo is a cozy game learning adventure where math becomes part of exploration, puzzles, and quests. Care for plants in the math-magical garden with daily exercises, solve challenges, and discover the secrets of mathematics step by step.

4487810.title: Shroomanoid: breakout action roguelike
4487810.short_description: Forget classic breakout games. In Shroomanoid, you are the projectile. Control the frantic flight of a giant mushroom, smash enemies into a bloody pulp with precise ricochets, and stack insane combinations of abilities.

4488080.title: Infinigama
4488080.short_description: Explore a universe of diverse worlds. Jump between adventures, trade, craft, and meet other players. Each world offers unique challenges, while a shared economy and evolving environments let your actions ripple across the entire connected universe.

4488270.title: RelicFairy
4488270.short_description: Abyss is a roguelike action RPG where players build powerful synergy blocks using equipment and skill items. Combine abilities, create unique builds, and fight your way deeper into a dangerous dungeon filled with unpredictable challenges.

4488460.title: worm_game_2
4488460.short_description: Currently, a point-&-click, silly tone game where you wrangle jellyfish as an axolotl using just the mouse curser & left-click; with other sandbox-lite'esc features like dragging objects/entities around, NPC-to-player dialog, &, of course, blowing bubbles :0 o o o x :)

4489630.title: This is Not a Snake Game
4489630.short_description: ▶When the classic Snake Game becomes self-aware, eating apples is no longer enough! Help this little snake exploit bugs to escape the game and roam your desktop. Collect adorable outfits and dress up its long, wiggly tail! (⦿ʌ⦿)

4489900.title: Project OC
4489900.short_description: Project OC is a multiplayer online desktop idle game. Unlock 1000+ customization options through idle gameplay and freely mix appearances, outfits, expressions, and actions to create your unique OC. Invite friends to join and let their OCs live on your desktop!

4490840.title: Lurking
4490840.short_description: Lurking is a first-person survival horror game set in a building infested by giant spiders. Search for tools and weapons to fight back and survive. Find a way out before you're eaten alive.

4490980.title: Eterno
4490980.short_description: A first-person fantasy RPG where you carve your own legend in a living world. Explore dangerous dungeons, shape your reputation, and choose your path between honor and ambition.

4491050.title: The Comyths
4491050.short_description: The Comyths is an action arcade and visual novel hybrid starring six Scholars with unique cosmic powers. Uncover their intertwined story, master their abilities, and chase the perfect S-Rank.

4492420.title: Out of Body
4492420.short_description: James wakes up one morning—and his physical body is gone. Even worse, no one seems to notice he’s disappeared. After drifting through 1993 San Francisco for months unseen, he eventually stumbles onto what he must do to get his body back and live a life worth knowing.

4494730.title: DEATH CASINO
4494730.short_description: DEATH CASINO is an adrenaline-pumping blend of tabletop strategy and Russian Roulette. Duel the deranged Glassman in an ever-escalating battle of speed and wit, where each round brings in more mayhem and strategy to master. Shoot, stab, and drink your way out of the Death Casino!

4497500.title: Conquering Other Planets Idle - COPI
4497500.short_description: A deep idle RPG where numbers go up, gear gets weirdly strong, and prestige when you want to be stronger or weaker. Build your permanent wardrobe across prestiges, pick your gear to start a run with, but be prepared to upgrade.

4498300.title: Generations: Utopia
4498300.short_description: A secret Soviet research institute is conducting an experiment to create a utopian city. Develop your city, resolve generational conflicts, and overcome the challenges prepared by the institute.

4498520.title: Rescue Drone Simulator: Second Chance
4498520.short_description: Pilot drones into burning buildings, frozen landmarks, and collapsing tunnels. Rescue survivors, build and customize your fleet, and lead a team of specialists who never got a second chance - until now.

4498560.title: Green Inferno
4498560.short_description: A new kind of horror deduction game that allows you to investigate freely. Examine detailed scenes, collect evidence in the form of clips, and use them to reconstruct events. Connect the clues, build your own theory, and unmask the macabre truth behind a doomed expedition.

4498670.title: Wonder Air: Lunara's Adventure
4498670.short_description: “Wonder Air: Lunara’s Adventure” is a fantasy flying action game where players can freely soar through a beautifully rendered 3D world.

4499240.title: Count The Draw
4499240.short_description: Count The Draw is a time-loop western mystery where every decision, conversation, and discovery could change your chances of surviving the final duel. You have twelve hours. Explore the town, learn its secrets, and prepare for the man waiting for you at sunset.

4499300.title: The Sievert Scale
4499300.short_description: A surveillance horror based inside a nuclear power plant. Monitor CCTV, Identify hazards, document incidents and keep operations running. Report too much and you fail the weekly audit, too little and danger spreads. What’s happening deeper inside the plant was never meant to be monitored.

4499620.title: Crown & Spores
4499620.short_description: Medieval CO-OP simulator where you grow magical plants, brew potions, create illegal products, trade with customers, and build your own underground empire in a fantasy world.

4500100.title: WarVara
4500100.short_description: A dark survival action game set in a world overrun by infection. Progress through story-driven levels, complete objectives, fight infected enemies in close combat, and use stealth to eliminate threats.

4500310.title: Staatio
4500310.short_description: Real-time territory conquest. Drag to send troops, swallow the map region by region, forge alliances and break them. Play solo against bots or invite friends over Steam or LAN.

4500530.title: Raging Blasters 2
4500530.short_description: The sequel to the "Raging Blasters" is here! It's called "Raging Blasters 2". This is an arcade-style vertical scrolling shmup. Players choose from three pilots to control, and head into battle. The graphics are pixel-perfect, and the music includes chiptune versions.

4500620.title: Subclidean
4500620.short_description: Subclidean is a puzzle based single-player where you traverse and navigate infinite worlds, solving non-euclidean based puzzles and uncover the truths about the secrets of why you are here and how to escape.

4500800.title: Goblins for Good
4500800.short_description: A Warcraft-inspired incremental game — grow a goblin army while raising money for charity! Upgrade your goblins, merge them into massive units, and unleash comedic, wholesome chaos! 90% of profits are donated to causes like The Alzheimer's Foundation of America and Parkkinson’s Foundation.

4501510.title: Sorcery Mastery
4501510.short_description: Magical duels meet roguelike builds in this fast-paced PvP arena brawler where you choose your entire skillset and other upgrades throughout the match.

4501800.title: AL-SARAB
4501800.short_description: A PSX-style psychological horror game inspired by Silent Hill set in a distorted Gulf neighborhood, where familiar places turn hostile and every alley hides something wrong.

4501960.title: HAIGLA
4501960.short_description: Confined to a wheelchair, explore a hospital pulled into a distorted world beneath reality. A slow psychological horror focused on exploration, tension, and the unsettling atmosphere of this place.

4502050.title: Retire in the Fairy Mountains
4502050.short_description: Retire in the Fairy Mountains is a Chinese-style farming game that integrates planting, fishing,cooking, mining and free building. Players take on the role of a farmer at the foot of the Immortal Mountain, unlock various interesting items and build their own world.

4502660.title: Homeguard
4502660.short_description: A 1-4 player strategy game. Build your fortress by day and defend it by night.

4502750.title: Infamous Keepers
4502750.short_description: Defend your dungeon—and your job! Tower Defense meets Roguelite in Infamous Keepers. Use strategy and some clever trickery to defeat waves of enemies: set up deadly traps, send your employees into the line of fire, and slaughter any intruders left standing yourself.

4503040.title: The Fancy Pants Adventures Online
4503040.short_description: Relive the classic Fancy Pants Adventures with your friends in an epic online arcade. Play through the story, mess around in platforming sandboxes, challenge each other to some friendly PvP, or tour through a round of Fancy Golf together.

4503230.title: The Letter
4503230.short_description: The Letter is a narrative-driven psychological adventure set in a forgotten town. Explore abandoned streets, follow scattered notes and hidden messages, and uncover fragments of a story inspired by real events as you piece together a mystery buried in the past.

4503800.title: Dragon and Mahjong
4503800.short_description: Dragon & Mahjong is a mahjong-combat roguelite. Play as three unlikely heroes from three very different walks of life, escape the endless games of exploitation, and take on the evil goblin corporation that rules the city—all to break free from the Debt of Fate.

4504170.title: Daxi King: Seven Kills Reincarnation
4504170.short_description: Daxi King: Seven Kills Reincarnation is a Chinese Dark Fantasy Roguelite RPG. You will play as Zhang Xianzhong, the Daxi King and peasant rebellion leader of the late Ming Dynasty. Sacrificing to evil gods to gain overwhelming power, you will unleash endless slaughter!
developers: 骷髅猫工作室 (Skull Cat Studio)

4504240.title: 搭搭大战（DaDa Wars）
4504240.short_description: Dada Dazhan is a casual real-time strategy game. No frantic micromanagement—just focus on your troop formations and city management. Grab a cup of coffee and watch these little cartoon soldiers charge into battle for you.

4504300.title: PixelWehr
4504300.short_description: Shoot down incoming missiles before they tear apart your pixel city, where every pixel can be destroyed. Draw your own buildings and missiles, arrange them into story acts with your own dialogue, and publish it all to the Workshop.

4504350.title: 26 Moves: The Queen's Plot
4504350.short_description: A point-and-click mystery game. Search for the truth in 26 days, playing as two different characters, in a town during 1907.

4504510.title: The Great Exhibition
4504510.short_description: You are the head curator of a museum. Gather ancient artifacts to expand your collection by raiding temples of long-lost civilizations with your friends.

4504750.title: Waste Of Life
4504750.short_description: You crashed on Garb'aaj, a planet made of trash, and you owe money for the ship. Scavenge, swap your body parts one finger at a time, fight drones built from garbage, and recycle the whole planet into a real one. Solo or co-op.

4504840.title: Secret Files: Tunguska - Remastered
4504840.short_description: The award-winning adventure classic returns as a remaster with modernized visuals and updated technology. Join Nina and Max on a globe-spanning investigation filled with puzzles, conspiracies, and danger – and uncover the secret of Tunguska that changes everything!

4504880.title: Sirius the Stargazer : Furry Idle
4504880.short_description: Awooo—! Follow Sirius into the starry lands! Sirius the Stargazer is a cozy desktop idle game. Start with a simple branch, defeat monsters, collect gear with random abilities, and help Sirius grow stronger. When he’s tired, let him rest by the campfire and keep you company.

4504970.title: AetherCycle
4504970.short_description: AetherCycle is a first-person action RPG featuring fast-paced combat, character leveling, abilities, and loot-driven gear progression. Explore a vast world, conquer dungeons, and grow stronger solo or in co-op as the Cycle affects the world.

4505140.title: Starting a Village from Zero
4505140.short_description: “This is your own little village.”You are a familiar summoned by the apprentice witch Lily. In her place, build houses and create a thriving village.A new kind of “garden world × roguelite × turn-based strategy” game.

4505410.title: Crystal Core
4505410.short_description: Incremental mining game about mining resources, digging up artifacts and upgrading your powers to obliterate everything.

4505790.title: Inertial
4505790.short_description: Inertial is a 2D arcade space racer. Race against the clock or against your friends in this reality-adjacent racing experience. No speed ceilings, no warped physics, just realistic gravity, thrust and skill.

4506540.title: The Final Lane
4506540.short_description: The Final Lane is a 3D Deckbuilding Roguelite about Bowling in Hell where the BALLS ARE THE CARDS! Draft a sinner-gistic deck of bowling balls, hone your skills, and battle other sinners as you climb through Hell for the ultimate prize: a shot at Satan and a chance at redemption.

4506820.title: Sand and Glory
4506820.short_description: Your father is dead. His gladiator school is yours, and so are his debts. Buy, train and arm a stable of fighters, and lead them through brutal real-time arena battles. You have 60 days to reach Rome’s Grand Games. Fail, and a senator takes everything.

4507060.title: Vanguard Valiants
4507060.short_description: Reclaim the lands taken by the Zahar. Build and lead armies to recover the villages seized by the enemy. Acquire better weapons and manage your soldiers throughout the liberation campaign.

4507460.title: Static Line
4507460.short_description: Take control of an airborne mecha and fight your way home in a side-view action roguelite. Break through enemy lines, defend key positions, and turn the tide alongside allied forces—then rebuild your machine with interchangeable parts, weapons, and movement styles.

4507990.title: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember
4507990.short_description: Born from war's flames, a Phoenix ascends. A dark fantasy Three Kingdoms action RPG from Team NINJA. Wield acrobatic Chinese martial arts and conquer the vast battlefields of the Three Kingdoms, where mighty generals and demons stand in your way.

4508820.title: Telenovela Simulator
4508820.short_description: As the head writer of the newest soap opera of a failing network, juggle a tight budget, the expectations of the audience and the chaotic world of TV production. Combine actors and locations to discover hundreds of scenes as you weave a dramatic narrative in each unique playthrough.

4509370.title: Stink Buddies
4509370.short_description: 4 dung beetles and one massive dung ball in this Physics based 4 player coop. Squad up and bring your turd home, get past predators and obstacles, because real buddies go through life together and just roll with it.

4509620.title: Ovis Mollis
4509620.short_description: A cozy pixel farm on your desktop — a whole village with fishing, a casino, and a stock exchange. Grass grows, sheep accumulate wool even while AFK. Shear, sell, pay your mortgage, collect skins from Mystery Box on Steam — and one day robots will do everything themselves.

4509930.title: SCP: Overrun
4509930.short_description: SCP: Overrun is a tower defense game where you secure a shelter while being overrun by hordes of dangerous SCPs. While things may seem hopeless at first, there is always a certain strategy or hidden mechanic that may be enough to save yourself.

4510450.title: Call into the Hollow : [ 2300 ]
4510450.short_description: HELIX — a communication device connected to the future. On the other end of the line was a girl who had lost her memories, still fighting all alone. There are no choices. Speak into your microphone to warn her of danger, guide her actions, and keep her going.

4511570.title: HOLO-KINGDOM
4511570.short_description: This is a 3D action game where you control Hololive members and fight your way through enemies to clear each stage.Carefully read enemy attacks and overcome challenging trials using parries and evasive maneuvers.This game requires keyboard and mouse controls.

4511810.title: Idle Slot Machine
4511810.short_description: Build a bustling pixel-art casino in this idle management game. Hire monkeys to spin your slots, combine machines and chain reactions, shape your skill tree, and prestige for lasting progress. Collect cosmetics and take on challenges beyond the casino floor.

4512020.title: Ivy‘s Dream Cafe
4512020.short_description: Run a magical cafe by day and step into surreal dreams by night. Use plant magic to uncover hidden clues, understand the emotions behind each story, and uncover the forgotten past behind Ivy’s own dreams.

4512340.title: Headshot Holdout
4512340.short_description: BLAST NAZI ZOMBIE HEADS (with friends)! Headshot Holdout is a retro, roguelite, FPS where squads of 1-4 start with only a rifle and build into zombie killing machines. There are no automatic weapons and no bullet sponge enemies. Strategy and accuracy are key.

4512440.title: Legendum
4512440.short_description: Start as a nobody and become a legend before old age claims you in this incremental RPG. Fight hordes in idle combat, plan your days, and train your skills. Grow your soul and unravel a dark plot across generations. Every life reshapes the world, and one will finish what the rest began.

4512690.title: Cards after Midnight
4512690.short_description: A dark, turn-based card roguelike where every action brings you closer to midnight. Survive with weapons by day and become a powerful werewolf by night. But beware: the beast's strength may cost you your humanity.

4512780.title: CENSOR
4512780.short_description: You can make someone tell the truth. But first, you need to know who to ask. CENSOR is a sci-fi detective game. Question the people involved, uncover contradictions and piece together the case on your evidence board. Then decide the fate of the accused.

4512810.title: Ares Inception
4512810.short_description: You're the intelligent electronics of a Mars mission. Four capable crew members. You are not one of them. Your job: keep them alive and happy, they're the only ones who can succeed. Built under the advice of real astronauts, engineers & planetary scientists, the big decisions are yours to make.

4512860.title: NEKO-NIN exHeart SPIN! 2
4512860.short_description: Get ready to nyan-nyan and nin-nin in the latest entry in the NEKO-NIN exHeart franchise with even more ninja catgirls than ever before.

4512970.title: Tiny Drift
4512970.short_description: TINY DRIFT is a pixel-art drift-combat survivor. Drift, charge and ram your way through waves of enemies. Upgrade your car with unique drifting weapons and survive intense battles as you build the ultimate combat machine.

4513180.title: Don't Drop The Ball
4513180.short_description: Don't Drop the Ball is a 1-4 player co-op game about keeping a beach ball in the air as you race through checkpoints together. Punch the ball, make desperate saves, and whack your friends when they get in the way. Race the clock, climb the leaderboard, and remember, DON'T. DROP. THE. BALL.

4513280.title: POK
4513280.short_description: Step into the arena where the Sun and Moon were born. POK is a 3D arcade sports game that blends competitive gameplay with fighting mechanics, inspired by the ancient Mesoamerican ball game. Compete in 1v1 and 2v2 matches where timing, positioning, and teamwork define victory. Every hit matters.

4513350.title: God's Game
4513350.short_description: A young woman is reborn as a princess in a fantasy world. Haunted by memories of her past, she feels out of place and detached, but at least there is peace... until the death game begins once again.

4513370.title: Hypnagogia 壊れた夢 Broken Dreams
4513370.short_description: A protector submerged, a mirror shattered, and a dreamscape left severed. Unravel a new, surreal dream mystery as you platform, solve puzzles, meet unique characters, and much more in this first-person exploration prequel to Hypnagogia: Boundless Dreams.

4513510.title: Beefy Boi
4513510.short_description: Beefy Boi is a job-sim horror. Clock in. Take orders. Survive your BOSS who is a giant meat monster and we intentionally broke him. Reach the highest quota and become employee of the month.

4513660.title: YGGDRA: Path of Relics
4513660.short_description: The World Tree is corrupted, and the Nine Worlds tremble. Assemble your deck with 50+ unique Valkyries and march toward Yggdrasil's heart! Only your strategy can prevent destruction. Roguelite deck-building meets Norse mythology in the world of YGGDRA.

4514030.title: Wonderking WD
4514030.short_description: WonderKing WD is a 2D side-scrolling MMORPG featuring a unique Transformation System that lets you transform and use skills in battle. Explore a colorful fantasy world, challenge powerful bosses, and develop your character through exciting adventures.

4514070.title: Barely Breathing
4514070.short_description: Spill and splash away, make your own path! Go on an adventure in this 3D Platformer with fun physics interactions and smooth controls!

4514140.title: CHEW YOUR FOOD
4514140.short_description: It didn't chew you properly. Escape its stomach by crawling, solving puzzles, listening carefully, and avoiding monsters in this survival horror.

4514350.title: Voxelantis
4514350.short_description: Voxelantis is a sandbox building and survival game set in a flat or spherical voxel world. Build anything out of your imagination, or adventure into uncharted territories to fight dangerous creatures. You can and deserve to have a small home planet of your own.

4514780.title: I WILL BE THERE: Remastered Edition
4514780.short_description: The definitive version of the beloved post-apocalyptic road trip. Fully remastered visuals, redesigned soundtrack, complete gamepad support. Tyler's journey begins again.

4514920.title: THORNSPELL
4514920.short_description: Embody a magical florist by placing plants strategically in your garden, and watering them to score points. THORNSPELL is a garden-building roguelike where you will create and unleash chains of magical effects, dispelling the corruption spreading through your home.

4515150.title: GUN MONKEY!
4515150.short_description: Help your monkey escape back to the jungle by gunning your way through obstacles and challenges. Test your skill in a open environment and find your way home! Choose how you want to play, and unlock guns that help you traverse the world!

4515160.title: Piece of Cake: Cozy Bakery
4515160.short_description: Restore a cozy café in this relaxing merge puzzle game. Combine pastries, tools, and decorations, complete customer orders, unlock new story moments, and bring every corner of your dream café back to life.

4515240.title: Heart of Ural
4515240.short_description: Heart of Ural is a pixel rhythm RPG based on the ancient epic Ural-Batyr and Bashkir myths. This is a deep story with many difficult decisions and unexpected twists, humor and drama. In this game, EVERYONE remembers what you did before.

4515360.title: Under Potion Influence
4515360.short_description: The Guild can't identify some of their potions, so they send them your way. Your job is to learn their effects. Experiment with them, drink them... it doesn't matter how. Just label them correctly.

4515470.title: Road to Brighton
4515470.short_description: Fight your way from London to Brighton in this retro arcade beat’em up inspired by the 1964 Mods and Rockers riots.

4515540.title: Error: Love - Human Bug Eradication Project
4515540.short_description: If love is an error you can’t fix… will you delete me—or choose to keep me? Step into the role of a censor and dive into a story of order, freedom, and love.

4515710.title: Wisps & Wares: A Spirit of the North Idler
4515710.short_description: Return to the enchanting world of Spirit of the North in a cozy shopkeeping idler. Send your Fox Guardian exploring, gather treasures, stock the Raccoon’s traveling shop, and journey across the Northern Isles in charming pixel art.

4515870.title: GRIMOIRE - The Lost Ritual
4515870.short_description: “On the unseen side of everyday life, a story begins.”

4515920.title: BABKA-TERROR
4515920.short_description: You are a real estate agent whose job is to determine which elderly woman is an ordinary seller and which one is a scammer granny.

4515980.title: Increment Isle
4515980.short_description: Increment Isle is an incremental game about plundering a mysterious island. Destroy everything, discover new resources, strategically buy upgrades and avoid scurvy to become the richest person in the universe!

4516140.title: Don't Let Granny Die!
4516140.short_description: Keep Granny alive during an increasingly chaotic shift while angry neighbours sabotage her home. Complete tasks, heal Granny and unlock roguelike upgrades in this crazy, absurd caretaking simulator.

4516170.title: 100 Lunar Cats
4516170.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

4516340.title: Impound Rumble
4516340.short_description: Impound Rumble is an upcoming indie platform fighter bursting with personality! Rumble online with rollback or offline in a co-op story mode or duke it out PvP-style. Pop-off and go crazy with Turbo Mode and send friends and foes flying through stages that adapt to the chaos you create!

4516370.title: It Breathes
4516370.short_description: First-person VHS horror game set in an abandoned Hungarian hospital. Hide, fight, or flee while working towards your only goal: to escape.

4516640.title: Megabait
4516640.short_description: A brutal top-down obstacle course where every second counts. Master precise movement to survive deadly hazard rooms, leave a bloody trail of your past mistakes, and uncover every secret on your path to 100% completion.

4516720.title: Rune Tale
4516720.short_description: Rune Tale is an incremental auto exploration game where you harvest and utilize rune energy by matching sets on an expanding grid to level up and become an all powerful wizard. Small game window doesn't take much space on your desktop so you can focus on other things.

4516770.title: Bloody Moon - First Fear
4516770.short_description: First-person horror with no HUD. Nostradamus and Catherine de’ Medici shared a secret that history buried on purpose. Underground, on nights the Moon turns blood red, something still hunts. Every piece of this story really existed. That’s the terrifying part.

4516820.title: Tintoria
4516820.short_description: Tintoria is a fun 2D platformer where the main mechanic is changing colors to overcome obstacles.

4516960.title: Astra Incrementalia
4516960.short_description: In this short incremental game you're tasked with growing The Company. Purchase planets, unlock specialized space stations, produce millions of resources, and dominate the solar market. How much can you accomplish in a generation?

4517180.title: SanararaR
4517180.short_description: It was something that could’ve happened to anyone… A somewhat mysterious story… One day, I was approached by a girl I didn’t recognize. She told me that she could grant any wish I desired but… While I stood in disbelief, she began to explain how it worked. A classic visual novel from NekoNeko Soft!

4517280.title: Special Agent: Aigis Pink
4517280.short_description: Aigis Pink and Blue work together under Tritonis to combat the evil organization known as Joker. A month after Aigis Blue infiltrates Joker's hideout alone and goes missing, Aigis Pink begins searching for her missing partner...

4517570.title: STARCULT Night Twisted Age
4517570.short_description: ...Everyone suspects you of murder. Become the Villainess everyone thinks you are. Create or join a cult. Manipulate people using the Emotion Palette. Enjoy power and peaceful moments... until bigger problems arise.

4517610.title: Weekend Racer
4517610.short_description: Race your way up from weekend wannabe to hired pro driver. Every pixel of the track is simulated live: rain washes it clean, rubber and dirt build up, and the dry line forms as the cars warm it up. Full weather and day/night cycle. It looks cute but it won’t be easy.

4517780.title: LUNADUN: LUNATIC DUNGEON
4517780.short_description: You choose a favorite and walk beside them. But those you left behind — where do they go while you're gone? LUNADUN: LUNATIC DUNGEON is an emotional visual novel where choices shape four characters' fates. 'The ones you loved, the ones you ignored — you don't get to walk away from either of them.'

4518100.title: War of Avareon
4518100.short_description: Conquer the lands of Avareon in a turn-based strategy game where battles are decided by preparation, not dice. Build an economy, field armies in which every unit has a counter, and recruit heroes with game-changing abilities. Join the free open beta now: campaign, skirmish and multiplayer.

4518220.title: Disciple
4518220.short_description: Peggle meets Vampire Survivors in this eldritch horror physics roguelite. Launch your disc into the Abyss, ricochet through swarms of cosmic horrors and forge powerful builds from ancient artefacts.

4519100.title: Hammer & Harvest: Dwarven Roots
4519100.short_description: A dwarf farm sim! The days of dragons'-fire have ended, and now the Dwarf King has commissioned you to reclaim the ancient halls. Grow crops, harvest crystals, mine ores, and craft works of awe & wonder. Enrich your home beneath the mountains before the Dwarf King returns to judge your progress...

4519230.title: Penguin Pirates
4519230.short_description: Penguin Pirates is a chaotic sailing party game where you catch the wind and shoot your cannons at the same time. Collect power-ups, dodge sharks, and sink your friends to prove you are the best pirate ever, arrr!

4519250.title: Die for the Rat King
4519250.short_description: Reclaim the Rat King’s realm in this dice-driven deckbuilder. Forge your dice, empower your rings, and find your best combos as you descend into a monster-infested underground.

4519470.title: Beyond the Mountains II
4519470.short_description: Uncover a vast land filled with secrets, monsters, and ancient myth in BEYOND THE MOUNTAINS II, a direct sequel to BEYOND THE MOUNTAINS. Stranded in a foreign land and armed only with your wits and curiosity, you will collect items, unlock secrets, and fight monsters to save the Oracle.

4519660.title: Cloudpaws
4519660.short_description: CloudPaws is a cozy sky trading adventure where you sail an airship, trade goods, farm, fish, and explore floating islands while helping locals and uncovering their mystery✨

4520000.title: National Park Tycoon
4520000.short_description: Build a beautiful national park where campers roast marshmallows, hikers explore trails, and wildlife roams free. What could possibly go wrong? Enter: raging wildfires, contagious animal diseases, and curious hungry bears. Keep it cozy or cause absolute chaos in this 2D park management simulation!

4520490.title: Sayagatari - Promise of the Cursed Blade -
4520490.short_description: "My love for you began with that kiss." Ex-Kendo practitioner Kanemori Tōya, comes across Saya who seals demonic blades. Saving him from his murderous impulse curse is a kiss from Saya!? The two begin living together, battling with demonic blade in hand. Break the curse with a kiss from this beauty!

4520650.title: 持镣铐者#735
4520650.short_description: 《The Shackles Holder #735》 is a female-oriented text-based game set in a steampunk world. On November 30, 1875, Police Chief Temis, known for his 100% case clearance rate, was transferred to the crime-ridden city of Nineveh.

4520750.title: Kindred Kind
4520750.short_description: Kindred Kind is a hand-drawn 2D action RPG. Hunt eight powerful beasts across a branching world, master a two-weapon combat system, and save what remains of humanity. Explore, fight, and uncover ancient mysteries, in a world teetering on the edge of ruin.

4520870.title: Seek Shellter
4520870.short_description: Seek Shellter is an arcade-style pathfinder full of cute snails who must collect batteries and seek shelter before the timer runs out. Team up with a friend or go solo to clear levels, win minigames and unlock worlds steeped in retro-60s atomic charm. Do you have what it takes to beat the bomb?

4520900.title: The City of Endless
4520900.short_description: A run-based auto-battler with asynchronous PvP. Each run you build your board as you ride the rails of an infinite city, arranging items and skills into powerful combos. How long can you keep your life on the rails?

4521110.title: The Polar Darkness
4521110.short_description: A Lovecraftian folk horror mystery set during the polar night of 1980s northern Finland. When a child preacher disappears during a revival sermon, a journalist becomes trapped in an isolated village where something ancient is beginning to awaken.

4521410.title: Between the Shelves
4521410.short_description: A cozy bookshop management game where customers step out of classic literature. Curate your shelves, recommend the perfect book, and unlock new items and mechanics as your shop grows into a living collection of stories.

4521510.title: Pokorama
4521510.short_description: Run a boutique decorating studio where every client has unique tastes, quirks and expectations. Experiment with paints, fabrics and textures to create interiors your clients will love (or not), build your reputation, and unlock beautiful materials and interiors as your studio grows.

4521620.title: Deceptive Shadows: Final Case
4521620.short_description: A paranormal detective in Sin City. A missing girl, a chained demon, and a city full of lies. Sounds like a normal investigation. It isn't. Question the demon, fight with guns and magic, solve occult puzzles, and survive its tricks.

4521690.title: Boot the Beet
4521690.short_description: Boot the Beet is a high-impact arcade brawler where the only thing between your harvest and a swarm of hungry aliens is a heavy steel toe. Forget guns and magic—this is about the raw stopping power of a well-placed kick.

4521770.title: Drunk Woodcutter
4521770.short_description: Chop wood, drink beer, hack yourself in the kneecap. A short physics-based incremental sim about splitting firewood, increasingly ridiculous equipment, and bad judgment.

4521790.title: A Farm About Digging A Tunnel To Escape Totalitarianism
4521790.short_description: A first-person co-op farming sim in a dictatorship you design yourselves. By day, your family grows the Party's weekly quota under the guards' watch. By night, you dig a secret tunnel under the border wall. Play solo or online with up to 4 players.

4522160.title: Seedfall
4522160.short_description: Earth’s time is up. In this cooperative Idle RPG, secure humanity's survival by controlling alien fauna with nano-parasites. Automate complex resource chains, unlock 30+ unique skills, and team up in massive Global Missions. Your squad evolves even while you are offline.

4522330.title: Forgotten Station
4522330.short_description: Forgotten Station is a knowledge-based narrative game, where you travel aboard trains to find your way out of a time loop. Your curiosity and observation skills will be put to the test in this relaxing game, filled with atmospheric places to uncover, characters to meet, and real human stories.

4522410.title: Ember Express
4522410.short_description: Ember Express is a sci-fi light yuri narrative adventure. Step into the role of a junior researcher at megacorporation COSMIC, uncover the truth behind the "Ember" incident, and rekindle a buried memory with your mysterious superior.

4522670.title: PBA Pro Bowling 2027
4522670.short_description: Dominate the lanes in the most realistic bowling game ever! Enhanced true-to-life ball and pin physics make every shot feel real. Forge your legacy in PBA Tour Mode, then dominate Online Leagues, Ranked Play, and Online Tournaments to defend your title. This is where champions are made.

4523590.title: TION: Hero Awakening — Idle RPG
4523590.short_description: Build your hero, collect gear, upgrade your stats and watch your character fight automatically. Push through harder enemies, bosses and new stages in this 2D incremental RPG.

4523640.title: 豆カスちゃん ～豆知識とカスみたいな嘘をランダムに語る少女～
4523640.short_description: 意外な豆知識とカスみたいな嘘を見分けながら、謎の少女「豆カスちゃん」の秘密に近づいていくADV。

4523720.title: Squid Arrives：Make Squid Great Again
4523720.short_description: In XXXX, deep-sea squids receive "nuclear food" from the islands. This unnatural feast triggers their awakening, reviving the lost memory of cephalopod world domination. Note: Inspired by fried calamari. Contains allegory. Don't overthink it! (laughs)

4524120.title: Hollow Heart
4524120.short_description: Hollow Heart is a growth‑simulation game about forbidden human transmutation and twisted sisterly devotion. As the elder sister, you gather materials, rebuild your little sister’s soul and body, and attempt to revive her in a more “perfect” form.

4524430.title: Plume
4524430.short_description: Plume is a roguelite about a tribe of birds ravaged by a volcano. As one of its last survivors, fight your way through randomly generated levels, gather and grow powerful items to create the ultimate build, and rebuild your village to its former glory!

4524600.title: Kint
4524600.short_description: A text-based fantasy multiplayer RPG where all players must decide what lore is true. Explore the world of Seram, learn everything you can. Resolve conflicts between lore by voting each week. Can you solve the mystery behind the Kilns?

4524630.title: Tillandsia
4524630.short_description: Venture through the shifting dungeons of Akirume in a mystery dungeon roguelike featuring a unique real-time / turn-based combat system and over 1900 spells. Gather threads of mana, uncover powerful magic, and carve your path across a continent shaped by ancient forces.

4524690.title: The Witch and the Wish
4524690.short_description: You are the Holy Lady of the Kanan Empire, repeating your accustomed life day after day, thinking that your life will never change. However, one day, an unexpected event occurs, and you can no longer return to the temple. What choice will you make?

4524930.title: Spellstride VR
4524930.short_description: Your legs get you there. Your spells get you through. Move to advance, look to aim, and choose the right spells as enemies approach. Take on a new route every day, level up your wizard, and collect loot in this movement-driven VR spellcasting game.

4525220.title: Farm to Restaurant Simulator
4525220.short_description: Grow crops on your farm, cook delicious meals, and manage your own restaurant in this relaxing farm-to-restaurant simulation game.

4525330.title: 三位一体の単一点
4525330.short_description: "AI is hacking into brains, driving people to suicide—" Three strangers with no apparent connection. Their fates inextricably intertwine, ultimately plunging them into a crisis that shakes the world. This is an ensemble drama where human bonds stand against a solitary justice.

4525640.title: Boxing Life Simulator
4525640.short_description: Boxing Life Simulator is a simulator game which combined with boxing mechanics. You can fight with your opponents on tournaments, you can have a social life, you can make money and spend it to improve your power and your social life statues.

4525760.title: Dolky
4525760.short_description: Dolky is a roguelike deckbuilder about hosting a sheep show, where everything goes wrong! Arrange sheep on stage to score colorful combos and earn star points. Equip magical ribbons to influence the audience and change your fate. Will you try to keep everything under control? Or embrace the chaos?

4525910.title: Square Escape
4525910.short_description: This little square keeps getting stuck in puzzling rooms, and it’s your job to help him find the way out. Push crates, interact with the environment, and think outside the box to escape.

4526010.title: Prototech
4526010.short_description: Be careful, in the darkness there are surveillance robots ready to kill you at any time. Will you discover the strangeness and secrets behind Prototech's presence at the school.

4526120.title: Mana Roots
4526120.short_description: An idle-farming game where you use magic to handle the work. Plant, expand and automate with the help of animals. All from the bottom of your screen

4526140.title: Cognomancy
4526140.short_description: A turn-based tactical strategy game where your real knowledge is your power. No spell lists. No skill trees. Every glyph you cast, you must truly understand. Your mind is your mana. INT is IRL.

4526600.title: Trouble in Potion High
4526600.short_description: Something went terribly wrong at Potion High. The school fell into the "Non-Dimension" and was placed under quarantine. If you don't break this lockdown, you'll be stuck here forever. Your wits are your weapon. Solve twisted environmental puzzles and get out of this place.

4526720.title: Pawn Within: Two Fates
4526720.short_description: A tabletop SRPG blending match-3, Skill Construction & tactics. Collect parts to craft skill discs, spin for random abilities, then merge or keep them. Equip gear, maneuver on grids, cast spells, and lead unique heroes to defeat challenging bosses in this strategic adventure.

4526760.title: Online Boxing 3D
4526760.short_description: A physics-driven boxing simulation where every punch is calculated in real time. Master timing, positioning, and footwork to outbox your opponent.

4527280.title: Vindobona
4527280.short_description: A top-down action-adventure in a Slavic-folk world grown over a ruined Roman town. A child is taken beyond the walls, and getting them back is not the end of it. Choose one of three travellers, follow the roads beyond the walls, and walk them to their ends.

4527290.title: Litter Treasures
4527290.short_description: Adopt a bunch of cute, dorky cats, play with them to earn their trust and collect the odd little treasures they leave behind. Turn your desktop into a cozy or chaotic cat shelter that grows with every new discovery!

4527340.title: Chi Chi's Magic Wash
4527340.short_description: Help Chi Chi clean grime and master her magical cleaning prowess. Make her parents proud in this cozy witchy cleaning sim. Clean with a spell-powered wand, explore charming locations, find potions, and bring sparkle back to every corner of the enchanted world.

4527360.title: Nifland
4527360.short_description: Nifland is a surreal multiplayer horror game with social deduction, set inside a paranormal dream beneath the ocean. Maintain a decaying deep-sea station, survive the entities roaming its halls, and uncover the traitor hiding among your crew before the dream consumes you all.

4527640.title: Stellar Breach
4527640.short_description: Blast through massive waves and tough bosses in this chaotic sci-fi roguelite shooter. Guide the charming duo, Barnaby and C.A.T., through a branching narrative via multiple-choice interactions where your story decisions directly alter randomized loadouts and abilities on every run!

4527650.title: Cardmare: Descent
4527650.short_description: A push-your-luck roguelike deckbuilder. Ten deadly floors, ten-minute runs, nine classes, one question every turn: Will you gain enough gold to buy powerful new cards, or become too greedy and push your luck too far?

4528060.title: Dominoir
4528060.short_description: Dominoir is a domino roguelike set in a noir casino. Match tiles to build chains, loop them back on themselves, and combine Schemes and Marks to chase huge scores. The House changes the rules, so your strategy has to keep up. Think Balatro meets dominoes.

4528230.title: Boom Boom No Guess Minesweeper
4528230.short_description: A No Guess Minesweeper RPG. Hundreds of levels, items, and Rogue skills. No more blind guessing -- pure logical deduction!

4528660.title: Dino Epoch: Fantasy Tale
4528660.short_description: 《Dino Epoch Fantasy Tale》A boy who chases mythical beasts in ring-toss adventures explores a brand-new world of fantasy creatures, awakens dormant unknown powers, captures companions across the uncharted realm, uncovers the technological secrets of this fantasy world, builds an ideal homeland.

4528700.title: Afternoon Patient
4528700.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game. As a patient tethered to a cold, mobile IV pole, you move through silent, haunting liminal spaces. Time feels frozen, and every step tests your rhythm, patience, and courage as you face isolation and psychological terror.

4528930.title: Force Typhoon
4528930.short_description: Experience the chaos and intensity of high-speed combat in this atmospheric sci-fi vertical Shoot ’Em Up, rendered in full 3D. Blast your way through relentless waves of enemies as you unleash your arsenal to defend your home against overwhelming odds!

4529080.title: Hex Machina
4529080.short_description: Assemble and control ancient machines on the island of Hexagonia. In this roguelite autobattler game, you’ll need to find the perfect synergies and tactically outsmart your enemies to ensure your survival.

4529110.title: System Says Normal
4529110.short_description: You were hired to watch. Not to ask questions. Night shift. Corporate building. Cameras, reports, anomalies. Your predecessor left no final report. Now you're going to find out why. Please proceed.

4529130.title: KEROGEN
4529130.short_description: Dredge up corpses from an oil-drenched nightmare. Lost at sea, the small crew of the 𝐀𝐓𝐋𝐀𝐒 calls for aid. Elmsfire dances in the clouds above while black beasts stir in the waves beneath. Take your meds. Hold your breath. The black sea won't let go.

4529240.title: Lumenal: A Photo Break
4529240.short_description: After a stressful day, grab your camera and hit the road. In Lumenal, you photograph animals and lovely moments, from forests full of birdsong to glaciers under the northern lights. Go solo or bring three friends, and fill your board with your best shots.

4529420.title: Mana Reactor
4529420.short_description: From stone tools to modern weapons and giant mechs — survive, craft, and conquer another world.

4529640.title: A2K: Jet Strikers
4529640.short_description: Movement-based action-shooter, inspired by the golden era of early 2000s games. Jetpacks, Momentum, Rocket-Jumps and violent Gunfights!

4529730.title: XX GAME: The Evolution Merge Puzzle
4529730.short_description: “XX GAME: The Evolution Merge Puzzle” is a physics-based merge puzzle game about evolution. Start as a tiny strawberry and evolve into insects, animals, humans, and beyond. Merge uniquely shaped characters and experience an evolutionary journey across 9 stages.

4529750.title: Hell Operators
4529750.short_description: Command a squad of military operators in a satirical hellscape. Enemy hordes don't come in waves, they fuse and evolve into emergent ecosystems. Each operator has their own class, gear progression, and permanent upgrades in the form of cybernetic implants, DNA extensions, and paranormal abilities.

4530110.title: Vaska
4530110.short_description: Meet Vaska — a cat lost in a strange and dangerous forest... Move quietly, hide, solve puzzles, and find your way home!

4530220.title: Crossarium
4530220.short_description: Dive into a story-driven game about a newspaper editor at a small American publishing house in the 1980s.

4530330.title: Action & Automation
4530330.short_description: Action or automation? In this asymmetric, side-scrolling action-RTS, fight on the front line yourself, let your machines do the work, or do both at once. Each of the three species plays by its own rules.

4530500.title: Under Review
4530500.short_description: Welcome to the heart of a 1980s bureaucracy. Review applicant files, cross-check records, and make heavy moral decisions. Amidst strange rumors of an unidentified illness, will you uncover the dark truth or become an accomplice to the system?

4530510.title: Escape the Umbra
4530510.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder with the positional combat of a turn-based tactics game. Shape your deck with weapons, spells and relics, use the battlefield to your advantage, and carry light into an ever-changing labyrinth.

4530560.title: A Vending Machine's Daily Life
4530560.short_description: You are a Vending Machine! In this hyper-local shop simulator, dispensing drinks and snacks is just the beginning. Upgrade, customize, and pay attention to the anime-inspired world around you. Each day can bring new customers and things to explore, unlocking secrets and new products to vend.

4530680.title: HODKA
4530680.short_description: Roam a wild map with your trusty metal detector to dig up scrap. Upgrade your van and tools for better loot but finish work before nightfall. For that is when the dark fog creeps in and will claim its due.

4530800.title: Monster Cuisine
4530800.short_description: Best a beast and serve a feast in Monster Cuisine, an action-RPG where you're a tavern keeper hunting fabled creatures in a forbidden forest to cook mythical meals and grow your business. Craft unique weapons and armor sets to take on stronger monsters that are as delicious as they are dangerous.

4531290.title: The Refuge
4531290.short_description: Build and upgrade your refuge, gear up, and take on dangerous missions alone or with up to 3 players. Recover valuable resources, expand your camp, and choose your contracts wisely: the greater the reward, the greater the risk.

4531440.title: MARBLE SOULS
4531440.short_description: Prepare to roll through the dense, interconnected world of MARBLE SOULS. Collect lost souls and level up your marble in the new genre-defying game from the creators of Mosa Lina & FALLSTRUKTUR.

4531580.title: The Havoc Channel
4531580.short_description: A mystery comedy visual novel game told strictly through the eyes of a news anchor. Learn about the city of Brookside, report the news as best you can, and guide the citizens toward a happy ending.

4531630.title: FISH OS
4531630.short_description: An idle fishing game that lives inside a fake 1997 operating system. Click the water to fish, then run your catch through a desktop where every window is a mechanic: an aquarium that buffs your income, a fish market, a fleet you send out overnight. 250 species. Solitaire included.

4532280.title: 裸辞修仙传
4532280.short_description: Fed up with the corporate grind? A portal to another world just appeared by your desk! Hop in! As a mere mortal, step into a strangely familiar realm, follow the legendary "First Cultivator," and explore a vibrant world of immortality in this Roguelite RPG.

4532290.title: Dragon & Alice
4532290.short_description: "Will your choices save her?" A dark fantasy adventure of Alice, an apprentice mage, and her talking crow. In a kingdom haunted by the "Dragon," your decisions will corrode Alice's mind and rewrite fate. Experience 8 endings and a world brought to life through radiant, hand-drawn art.

4532390.title: BowlTown碗镇
4532390.short_description: 欢迎来到碗镇。这是一则虚构的现实故事，讲述了少数群体的困境和自救。碗镇的居民几乎都是是兽人，如果你仔细观察会发现，他们在历史和现实中都有自己的名字，他们的故事也似曾相识。你是偶然逃到碗镇的兽人厨师，在碗镇流动设宴款待居民，在食物与交谈之中，完成自我和居民的治愈。

4532500.title: Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories
4532500.short_description: Atelier Karia tells the story of an adventurer with no memories as she faces her past. New features add to the depth of battles and alchemy. Synthesized items take on new roles during exploration, and ingredients can be eaten to gain effects.

4532690.title: 盲心：伪装的幻想
4532690.short_description: Blind Heart: Disguised Fantasy is an AVG game——At some point, my ordinary life stopped being ordinary… The doppelgängers I’d only read about in online horror stories had appeared in the real world. Before I could even process this, my lover, Lin Shiyu, knocked on my door.

4532840.title: Lemy
4532840.short_description: Condemned to Hell for a forgotten sin, Lemy receives an offer: "Hunt down the monsters that have occupied the afterlife, and I will reduce the weight of your sins." Experience a unique, mouse-driven action-adventure. Help Lemy atone and reclaim her past.

4532850.title: Weave & Wander
4532850.short_description: Weave & Wander is a cozy, atmospheric adventure where you play as a small spider finding its way through a vast, living world. Climb across walls and ceilings, weave your own paths, and leap through the unknown as you journey from the depths of a cave into the wild beyond.

4533160.title: Valley of Stability
4533160.short_description: Crash-land on a dying alien world and bring it back to life. Build automated factories, master real chemistry and nuclear physics, and terraform the atmosphere one gas at a time — while sandworms hunt the power signature of everything you build.

4533230.title: Farmed & Dangerous
4533230.short_description: Not another farming game. Plant by night, then defend your crops from dawn to dusk in a first-person roguelite shooter, solo or in 3-player online co-op. Blast crop-hungry crows out of the sky with shotguns, turrets, air strikes and the occasional RPG. Miss the truck's order and the run is over.

4533320.title: Car Crime Simulator: Prologue - Early Days
4533320.short_description: Steal cars, stash them, and make your first dirty money. Learn the basics of running a shady operation - solo or in co-op. This is just the beginning.

4533670.title: 66: Dinosaur Survival
4533670.short_description: 66 is a brutal multiplayer dinosaur survival game where you hunt, grow, hide, migrate, and fight your way through a prehistoric ecosystem where every mistake can be fatal.

4534610.title: Ask Mom: Find Objects, Learn Words
4534610.short_description: Learn a language by finding hidden objects 🔎 in a cozy, funny family game where everyone keeps losing things — except super‑mom, who can find anything. Search for items, learn words in context, and enjoy short family scenes. Free demo coming soon — wishlist the game.

4534680.title: Decommission Protocol
4534680.short_description: Edith station has been abandoned for a year - an unusually long time to sit derelict. You are a space station engineer sent up to decommission the station in a manual service elevator with the ability to stop between floors. Will you discover the truth or simply follow protocol?

4534960.title: Dear Passengers
4534960.short_description: Play in co-op as the crew of the world’s worst airline. Your plane is falling apart, your cargo is illegal, and passenger safety barely makes the list.

4535020.title: Gamarra - Street Vendor Simulator
4535020.short_description: Your family is desperate for money. All you have is a stand in Gamarra, Peru's busiest market. Start small, haggle hard, dodge corrupt police, and survive gang extortion. But every coin you earn is a choice: send it home, or bet it on your business, nothing comes free.

4535470.title: Endless Castle: Under Siege
4535470.short_description: Command your heroes, build unstoppable formations, and hold the line against endless waves. Recruit 40 unique heroes, grow stronger even while offline. Turn your castle into an unbreakable fortress.

4535650.title: Dacan Express: Logistic manager
4535650.short_description: Manage a high-stakes logistics depot where the hardest route to navigate is the human one. Negotiate ruthless contracts with e-shops, handle headstrong couriers on the brink of strikes, and build a delivery empire in a gritty management sim where every personality has a price.

4535750.title: Dragon Eggs: Survivors
