4535750.short_description: Bullets that spawn more bullets! Collect dragons to fight with you. Level up and merge them. Create unique builds to survive hordes of enemies in this 3D roguelike bullet hell survival game!

4535780.title: Love is Undead
4535780.short_description: In this adventure game, play as a scientist immune to a deadly virus. Scavenge for resources, develop a vaccine, and test it on Amber, a recently infected girl. Manage supplies, explore dangerous areas, and build a bond that could save humanity. Enjoy post-apocalyptic life with a zombie girl!

4536290.title: Last Draft
4536290.short_description: Complete your last draft before sunrise while enduring increasing paranormal activities and relentless monster stalks. Use your typing skills to progress and your instincts to hide, surviving 7 days of pure psychological horror.

4536320.title: Nexus of the Dead God: The Microcosm
4536320.short_description: You will lead a squad—formed solely for the sake of survival—as you continuously push forward across a vast hexagonal map. Recruit companions, adjust your formation, devise tactics, and carve your way out of the Bone-strewn Continent through a series of automatically unfolding battles.

4536480.title: All Rats on Deck
4536480.short_description: All Rats on Deck is an online co-op adventure game where you must navigate a paddle steam boat through dangerous waters. Forced to leave your home, you must work together to operate the boat, scour for resources, and overcome obstacles to reach the ocean.

4536500.title: Prismfall
4536500.short_description: Prismfall is a strategic incremental game about defending your Prism from waves of enemies. Earn gold, wield powerful abilities, and buy upgrades from a deep and extensive upgrade tree.

4536520.title: Abyss Card Legend
4536520.short_description: Clear stages for god-tier gear, sacrifice to summon the Boss! In Abyss Card Legends, resurrect the ultimate Demon King with your own hands and claim the most game-breaking loot!

4536670.title: Wingsuit Simulator
4536670.short_description: The most realistic wingsuit and parachute physics on PC and in VR. Discover perfect lines across a 256 km² island built for proximity flying. Skim cliffs, thread tight gaps, and attempt stunts you’d never risk in real life. Master the community’s lines or surprise them with your own way down.

4536740.title: Echoes
4536740.short_description: Immerse yourself in a first-person psychological horror experience where every choice matters. Confront the echoes of a forgotten past and uncover the truth behind your lost identity.

4536830.title: Wilderness Strike: Survivor
4536830.short_description: Players take on the role of a survivor trapped in an endless battlefield. Face massive waves of enemies swarming from all directions, gain experience by defeating foes, level up and select skills to build your unique combat build, then break through the siege and claim victory!

4536920.title: Cards & Cannons
4536920.short_description: Build your own realm and turn every path into a devious trap in this roguelite tower defense deckbuilder! Crush endless enemy hordes with mighty spells and crazy builds in unique runs. Defeat powerful bosses and conquer world after world in this colorful medieval madness!

4536960.title: Brewery Simulator
4536960.short_description: Run a medieval tavern in first person: plant 18 crops, brew beer and wine with the exact flavors your guests ask for, hire a crew, and turn a roadside alehouse into a legendary tavern. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

4537040.title: Sky Safari: FPV Drone
4537040.short_description: Take to the skies with a high-speed FPV drone and become a wildlife photographer. Track lions, bears, crocodiles and more across a breathtaking open world, master realistic flight physics and capture the perfect shot – without scaring them away.

4537180.title: Abandon West
4537180.short_description: A hand-drawn tactical roguelike where every encounter is a gamble. Trust or shoot.

4537280.title: Rulehouse
4537280.short_description: Think you know chess? Forget some of that. Rulehouse is a pawn chess adventure where every stage rewrites the game. Travel the globe and beyond, master an ever-changing board where new pieces, twisted variants, and cunning opponents keep you guessing from first move to last.

4537570.title: PSYCORP
4537570.short_description: Three siblings are given AI-Powered cybernetics by their dying CEO father to permanently bring out the worst in them. How much of your mind are you willing to lose to control your family's company, and the future of surveillance in this narrative driven AI corporate dystopia?

4537730.title: Tomo Cafe
4537730.short_description: Tomo Cafe is a Pomodoro Timer and cafe simulator game. Run a study cafe, work through your actual to-do list beside the regulars, decorate the place, and unlock the next chapter of heartwarming stories.

4537750.title: CTRLR.CLUB
4537750.short_description: The controller arcade game that hits different. Hack the board, route signals, purge the virus, and trigger cascades while your hands keep levelling up.

4537770.title: Nonogueram
4537770.short_description: Nonogueram is a fast-paced, procedural nonogram puzzle roguelike. Solve increasingly difficult puzzles, race the clock, experiment with a myriad of item combinations, and test your wits against bosses who manipulate and modify the very world itself.

4537820.title: Things to Forget – Lighthouse
4537820.short_description: Adam Foster, a 23-year-old office worker whose life is turned upside down after a breakup with his girlfriend. In an attempt to escape from himself, he takes a job as a lighthouse keeper, hoping to clear his mind. He could never have imagined the horror he would have to endure at his new workplace.

4538230.title: The Journey of the Gnomes: The Battle of the Elder Isles
4538230.short_description: One gnome wizard against an entire army of darkness. Journey of the Gnomes is a fantasy survivors-like, bullet heaven game. Cast powerful spells, mighty elemental synergies, and survive the shadow horde!

4538260.title: SeverSoul XOOKEEPER
4538260.short_description: Keep the entities fed, pacified and contained every night within a dark decaying facility. Can you survive each shift in this intense point & click horror?

4538350.title: Astral Trial
4538350.short_description: This is a deck-building game (DBG) that emphasizes symmetrical strategy. Your enemies, like you, possess decks, energy, and relics. Optimize your strategy, build your deck, challenge powerful female bosses, and save the world from collapse.

4538460.title: Hopeless
4538460.short_description: HOPELESS is a first-person psychological horror game where players explore looping, distorted environments, observe subtle changes in reality, and survive an ever-shifting space.

4538480.title: Terra Ninfa
4538480.short_description: A laid-back puzzle/exploration game about reviving forgotten, dried-up landscapes and turning them into picturesque dioramas. Manipulate water, irrigate all the plants, bring a wild beauty to a neglected world while discovering the secrets of the Nymphs.

4538520.title: Shape Sift
4538520.short_description: Build experimental sorting systems to separate, transform, and route flowing shapes in this minimalist physics-based automation puzzle game.

4538640.title: MINAGOROSHI : THE RISEN AVENGER
4538640.short_description: Sneak up and brutally assassinate enemies from behind. A hardcore stealth action game where the tension of instant death upon a single glance intersects with the exhilaration of transforming into an Asura and slashing through everything.

4538700.title: Redneck Mayhem
4538700.short_description: Redneck Mayhem is a hilarious, physics-based slingshot game where small-town grit takes on the modern world. Follow three fed-up local heroes as they lock, load, and launch random junk, and eventually themselves at the professions that drive them crazy. The Mission: Unleash the Mayhem.

4538820.title: Wasteland Light
4538820.short_description: Light of the Wasteland is a PvE survival game. Build your base in a wasteland, scavenge for supplies, gradually arm yourself, and fend off the creatures. When faced with insurmountable monster, you can awaken a mysterious power within your body, temporarily transforming to turn the tide of battle.

4539150.title: IM:VVI Galaxy Runaway
4539150.short_description: Crash-land with Team VVI’s three mercenaries on a mysterious planet inhabited by strange birdfolk. Explore unique civilizations, face enemies in combat that blends rhythm and strategy, interact with curious locals, and uncover the conspiracy surrounding the planet’s nature spirit.

4539200.title: 小岛之门 Vaulx
4539200.short_description: Vaulx is a voxel-style 3D puzzle adventure game. Braving the thick mist, you finally set foot on the legendary treasure isle, where a fun and fantastic adventure begins.

4539400.title: Solo Grinding
4539400.short_description: Solo Grinding is a Tactical RPG Roguelite. Fight your way floor by floor and enter a tournament alongside 5 powerful warriors. The goal is simple, reach the legendary Last Floor. Learn skills directly from enemies and create unique builds to fight your way to the top and uncover hidden secrets.

4539710.title: Train 404
4539710.short_description: A first-person co-op horror game where you collect coins, find the Golden Ticket, and race back to the train while monsters close in.

4539990.title: SpellFast
4539990.short_description: A fast-paced multiplayer word game. Chain letters across a shared board, bank coins, and spend them on abilities that swap, change, or shuffle tiles. Race the clock in Bullet, take your time in Rapid, or host a private lobby with friends. In English and Spanish.

4540020.title: IRON-PLUNDER
4540020.short_description: THE PLUNDER AWAITS! “KING ORANGE” and his fiendish collectors have stolen “The Chief’s” comic book collection and only “Deathwish Newyork” can get them back! Blast the hell out of "KING ORANGE'S" facilities and secure the IRON PLUNDER!

4540240.title: International Football Manager 27
4540240.short_description: Football doesn't follow a script… and neither does International Football Manager 27. Make decisions, face the consequences, and experience a more exciting, authentic, and unpredictable simulation as you lead your football team to the top.

4540290.title: Tales of the Otherworld
4540290.short_description: A single-player and multiplayer game paying homage to classic MMORPGs: Explore the MU Continent featuring low-number stats, AFK auto-battles, co-op play, farming, and fishing.

4540310.title: Bus Terminal Simulator
4540310.short_description: Experience an immersive terminal management simulator. Manage passengers, organize schedules, inspect luggage, catch smugglers, and prevent illegal activities. Not every passenger is innocent — some will try to trick you or smuggle illegal items. Stay alert and run your terminal efficiently.

4540400.title: Feed or Flee
4540400.short_description: A co-op horror game for 1-5 players. You're the pet-sitters hired to keep Wobbles, a glowing and very hungry little creature, fed through the night, every night. Scavenge the woods and the abandoned buildings around the treehouse, and run when something out there notices you.

4540550.title: Corocoro Friends
4540550.short_description: Roll, stick, and carry everything. "Coro-coro Friends" is a chaotic physics puzzle action game where you roll a sphere, cling to objects, and solve challenges in creative ways. Play solo or with a friend—cooperate or sabotage your way to the goal.

4540560.title: Forbidden buttons
4540560.short_description: Press the forbidden button to rewrite each room. Freeze gravity, make everything bounce, and teleport to objects you throw in a bright first-person puzzle game built around fast, clever aha moments.

4540860.title: Chip Away
4540860.short_description: A roulette game with roguelike progression. Bet, unlock upgrades and face a roulette that changes every run with random modifiers. How much can you earn?

4540870.title: Pact of the Black Tide
4540870.short_description: A narrative point-and-click adventure game blending puzzles and wit. Explore, interact with a cast of colorful characters, combine items, and manipulate reality through an integrated magic system. Humor, adventure, and discovery await to bring you into new and unexpected worlds.

4540970.title: Unhappening
4540970.short_description: Navigate a collapsing world where light is your only protection. Solve physics-based environmental puzzles with the help of temporary companions, and survive the darkness consuming fractured memories of humanity’s final survivor. For fans of Inside, Limbo, and Little Nightmares.

4541130.title: Div Zero
4541130.short_description: A VR puzzle adventure where dimensional fractures have torn reality apart. Explore environments destabilized by the rift, solve spatial puzzles hidden across 10 distinct scenes, and follow signals, symbols, and strange objects to uncover what caused the collapse.

4541230.title: EREBUS: The Northwest Passage
4541230.short_description: Lead the doomed 1845 Franklin Expedition through the Arctic in a survival strategy game where every month, order, resource, officer, and event can decide the fate of HMS Erebus and her crew.

4541330.title: COVR
4541330.short_description: COVR is a high-stakes tactical VR shooter built around next-gen visuals, grounded realism, and tense CQB. Deploy solo or in co-op, complete classic tactical objectives, adapt to unpredictable missions, and make every decision count. Coming in 2026.

4541430.title: Sector Scavengers: Signal & Salvage
4541430.short_description: Deck-building roguelike built on top of a basebuilding RPG. Wake into debt. Scavenge derelicts. Play risky cards. Die a lot. Every collapse unlocks new cards and perks. Can you pay off the Company, or will you be booted out the nearest airlock when the next bill comes due?

4541520.title: Serenity In Surrender
4541520.short_description: Daisy's the brilliant and beautiful girl-next-door. You haven't gone outside in a week. Still, you're determined to win her heart and if you make the right choices, you might learn to fall in love along the way.

4541880.title: Fenix
4541880.short_description: Step into a vibrant 3D open world platformer inspired by classic adventures, where you play as Fenix, a curious fox exploring a lively forest. Discover unique NPCs, memorable landmarks, enemy encounters, and hidden secrets as you freely navigate an unforgettable world full of mystery and wonder!

4541890.title: Sneakin Femboy
4541890.short_description: Play as a femboy in this short 2D stealth comedy game :3

4541920.title: GRIDLANDS
4541920.short_description: GRIDLANDS is a PvE extraction shooter set in a fallen world where sentient machines hunt what remains of humanity. Scavenge, survive, and extract through hostile industrial dead zones where every run could be your last.

4542050.title: The Blood Knight: Episode Dawn
4542050.short_description: Defeat, Devour, and Forge. The Blood Knight is a Turn-Based JRPG inspired by the classics. Guide Zeno Trillion, a boy who can turn objects into something more. Master unique skills and equipment, unleash Zeno's Critical Skills, and lead companions through a journey full of twists and turns.

4542420.title: Nav Singh's Poohopia
4542420.short_description: An open-world RPG adventure. More details coming soon.

4542460.title: Czar Ry
4542460.short_description: Physically interactive adventure where you must escape a strange abyssal structure inside a batholith by learning its secrets. Use fully interactive physical hands: reach, grab, drag, hold. No action buttons, no clicks, no hotkeys. Every door, lever, and chain requires your hands to move further.

4542740.title: Dinghai: The Ocean Pillar
4542740.short_description: Dinghai: The Ocean Pillar is an action RPG-roguelike set in the mythic world of the Classic of Mountains and Seas, where ancient gods, demons, and forgotten powers collide.

4542840.title: COOKBOT
4542840.short_description: You've been placed as a standard model COOKBOT on the transit ship ZIMA. Cook, bake, pour, freeze, cut and mix food while following recipes. Complete orders from crew members and listen to their stories. But remember - you're not human. The cake is there for company morale.

4543740.title: Bloodsalt
4543740.short_description: Bloodsalt is a dark 2D Action RPG with deceptively beautiful visuals. Step into the shoes of a warrior defending his village against an orc invasion and the dark magic of Bloodsalt. Explore a ruthless world, develop your character, and make tough choices in a story woven with intrigue and betrayal.

4544140.title: Carnholt
4544140.short_description: Build your victory upon the corpses you leave behind. Carnholt is a roguelike deckbuilder in which death is not the end, it’s just another card to play. Craft a deck of wild creatures and powerful spells, fight in tactical battles, and slay a God that refused death.

4544250.title: VVV
4544250.short_description: Raise your Voltage in a Virtual world and seize Victory!!! Chain combos, master powerful Arts, and race against time. Roguelite × 3D Action Every cleared stage brings new upgrades, while the relentless countdown pushes your Voltage even higher.

4544260.title: Lumory: A Distant Summer
4544260.short_description: Wander through bright liminal spaces shaped by distant summer memories. Ride a childhood scooter, reveal hidden paths with Dream Vision, and capture surreal moments with your camera. No combat—just calm exploration.

4544450.title: Athletics 99
4544450.short_description: Run! Jump! Throw! Compete in the Athletics World Cup through 18 different events, and represent your country against worldwide athletes. Who knows, you might even break some World Records...

4544550.title: Dinobreak: The Hatching
4544550.short_description: Race against time and teeth to save the city of Cypress Ridge from a dinosaur invasion in this 4-player online co-op remake of the 2023 game.

4544560.title: Outbreak The Fedora Files: What Lydia Knows - Known Factors
4544560.short_description: Join Lydia as she takes her fight to expose the corruption in Cypress Ridge to City Hall in the second part of the visual novel series What Lydia Knows.

4544620.title: Whispers of the Tallgrass
4544620.short_description: An atmospheric first-person survival horror set in an abandoned industrial wasteland overtaken by tall grass. Listen closely to the mysterious sounds of the night, hide from a relentless predator, scavenge for key items, uncover the secrets of this place, and find a way to escape.

4544660.title: Detective Turner: If Looks Could Kill
4544660.short_description: A point-and-click noir murder mystery where you literally read the room. Search for clues in text, photograph evidence, and interrogate suspects in visual novel-style conversations to solve the murder of a fashion icon.

4544910.title: Block Crime
4544910.short_description: Imagine GTA, but in a blocky style with a living online RP world. Block Crime is a crime simulator where you choose your role: police officer, gangster, or ordinary worker. Take over districts, participate in gang wars, create businesses, and become the boss of Los Palms city!

4544970.title: Backrooms Dream with Tung Tung Tung Sahur
4544970.short_description: Backrooms Dream with Tung Tung Tung Sahur is a first-person psychological horror game about a lonely man trapped in a surreal dream loop. Explore strange levels, solve eerie puzzles, survive terrifying chases, and uncover why Sahur keeps appearing in your nightmare.

4544990.title: DeckDEX - TCG Live Simulator
4544990.short_description: Buy low, read the room, flip it. DeckDEX is a card-flipping market tycoon: hunt underpriced cards on a live player economy, rip packs, forge duplicates into rarities, complete sets, and build a cardboard empire.

4545040.title: Unclaimed: Loot or Junk
4545040.short_description: Unbox. Sort. Collect. Become a master of discovery by exploring unclaimed packages. Complete every set, from vintage gadgets to "Golden Junk". Sell piles of everyday items to buy new shipments and hunt for truly rare treasures. What will you find in the next box?

4545060.title: Gods With Guns
4545060.short_description: In Valhalla, heroes pull the trigger to defy Ragnarok! Rogue-like shooting game. 8 mythological heroes + 36 guns + 26 types of ammo + 60 Cards.

4545080.title: Smile Run
4545080.short_description: An endless runner with adorable characters. Run through multiple environments with different play styles. Play two modes of either limited time Gift Delivery or endless Ice Cream mode. Multiple levels of increasing difficulty.

4545150.title: Reoxia
4545150.short_description: The story of an astronaut who returns to Earth in the midst of an apocalypse caused by an unknown disease. He mustn't take off the spacesuit to avoid breathing the contaminated air. The devastated world is inhabited by the bloodthirsty infected and mutants, and unknown armed men are hunting him.

4545260.title: DRONECOM
4545260.short_description: A real-time naval sensor-warfare game where EMCON is everything: every emission that finds the enemy helps the enemy find you. Design your own drones: subs, ships, aircraft, missiles, and launch them from carriers. Physically modelled radar, sonar, IR and ESM in a moddable CIC sandbox.

4545700.title: Enjoy Your Stay
4545700.short_description: Spot surreal and grotesque anomalies to escape a 1960s hotel that refuses to let its guests leave. Explore hidden liminal spaces, collect strange items, and discover the fates of those who checked in before you.

4545760.title: Sainthood Relics
4545760.short_description: Excavate layered blocks to uncover hidden relics. Carefully balance power and precision to clear each surface efficiently in this relaxing, satisfying puzzle experience. Each discovery reveals the true (and sometimes strange) histories of the saints.

4545830.title: SolTarot
4545830.short_description: Turn low cards into big scores in SolTarot, a tarot-inspired solitaire roguelike. Combine Tarot powers, modify your cards, and bend the rules to overcome bosses that challenge your strongest combinations.

4545940.title: Beencremental
4545940.short_description: Beencremental is a colorful incremental game where you guide the Queen Bee, forage pollen and turn every drop into honey. Upgrade your hive, grow an unstoppable swarm, and conquer four changing seasons as your production climbs from a few bees to a buzzing empire.

4546090.title: 危ノコ
4546090.short_description: Control a mushroom and climb toward the summit while avoiding dangerous “Abunoko.” Overcome various obstacles and carefully make your way upward. A single mistake can send you falling far back down. The higher you climb, the more dangers await, testing both your skill and patience.

4546100.title: Kircles
4546100.short_description: Kircles is a designer-driven tower defense game where players can combine 18 different turrets to create unique mechanics and prevent “bugs” from reaching the exit. 60+ levels in three campaigns. Every level can be solved with different approaches optimizing resource spending.

4546260.title: Cunning Stunt Racer
4546260.short_description: Inspired by the legendary Stunt Car Racer, Cunning Stunt Racer brings back the raw intensity of high-risk, high-reward racing — rebuilt with retro visuals with a modern twist, modern physics, and competitive gameplay.

4546440.title: LUBA
4546440.short_description: LUBA is a walking simulator with platforming elements. Explore a mysterious place and find your way using light and shadow.

4546470.title: Remain At Your Desk
4546470.short_description: Incremental hacker about faking productivity while stealing from your employer. Sell intel for credits or keep it and raise suspicion. One bad audit and you’re back to Intern.

4546540.title: Afterlight Survival
4546540.short_description: Open-world sandbox survival horror combining base-building, crafting, and tower defense. Scavenge for supplies and build your home while evading what's left of the government and the undead it created. Play solo or online co-op with up to 4 players.

4546740.title: INDOORS: Trespasser
4546740.short_description: May 7th, 1951. Five days after the Alston family vanished inside their manor. Local policeman Lucas Smith, never returned from his investigation. Now, his son breaks in to continue the investigation in this short horror and detective escape room.

4546860.title: Lights Out Chapter 2 The Unseen Reckoning
4546860.short_description: Alone again and abandoned in the house, this time even darker than usual. You return as Jack and set out to search for your missing Friend.

4546890.title: Noblefold: Kingdoms of Chance
4546890.short_description: A broke king wins back the crown at the blackjack table. Stack side-bet combos, cheat with Crown cards before suspicion catches you, and pledge villages, mines and keeps to five creditors, the Devil included. Build a kingdom worth losing.

4547090.title: The Great Hebrew Rescue
4547090.short_description: The Great Hebrew Rescue is a 2D action platformer with puzzle elements, hack and slash your way through ancient forces as Abram the Hebrew. Solve Riddles, answer questions, complete quests, level up! Craft your supplies and master movement as you navigate your way through ancient Canaan.

4547120.title: Artificial Violet
4547120.short_description: A visual novel about identity and validation on social media. Step into Violeta's shoes and make decisions that will define who you really are.

4547320.title: Six Bullets
4547320.short_description: Six Bullets is a spaghetti-western CRPG. You're a drifter with no name. Meet folk barely scraping by in a husk of a town & its canyon. Choose what kind of a man you'll be. Lend a hand or antagonize. Just remember: folk never forget and six bullets are all you're ever gonna get.

4547330.title: Hotel Beresford
4547330.short_description: 1929. The Beresford Mansion once again becomes the stage for a tragic story. Follow its new owner, Samuel Chapman, on his descent into madness in this dark visual novel.

4547550.title: Railway End
4547550.short_description: This is a hidden object puzzle game with a railway theme. Compare photos and correct differences in the scene, interspersed with a few puzzles. There is no text in the game.

4547640.title: 盲盒指挥官
4547640.short_description: Blind Box Commander is a toy brick-style RTS with deckbuilding, blind box draws, and classic base tech. Build a 24-card deck, expand your base, unlock units, and adapt your tactics in real time as every match delivers new combinations and fresh strategic battles.

4547730.title: Under A Groove
4547730.short_description: 'Under A Groove' is a rhythm game that's fun just to watch, even if you're only playing the music video. A stylish rhythm action game where visuals and music sync perfectly—simple to play, deeply satisfying to master.

4547760.title: Evil thought
4547760.short_description: Awakened by a brainwave separator in an artificial resurrection experiment, you fall into a mental maze blending reality and dreams. Corroded by the inner "Earth Mother", you follow your grandmother’s clues through distorted campuses, decayed buildings, secret labs and strange memory plains.

4547790.title: Afterschool Brawl Club
4547790.short_description: After school, clubs clash for supremacy! Afterschool Brawl Club is an AutoBattle card game set in a vibrant academy city. Easy to play, hard to master. Each round choose your allies, decide which cards to keep or cut, and adapt to survive. Step into their stories and claim the top in your own way.

4548190.title: Ironfront Express
4548190.short_description: Customize and upgrade the Ironfront Express to kingdom come in this bullet-hell, tower-defense roguelite. Engineer and command the Ironfront Express in a unique take on lane defense, where you upgrade with specialized turrets, drones, and tactical abilities. Scrap the swarm!

4548440.title: Brave Legends
4548440.short_description: Collect equipment and skill books to build your own unique build.

4548510.title: Shiki Tea House
4548510.short_description: Grow tea, brew drinks, bake desserts, and serve customers in your very own cozy tea house. Decorate and grow your shop, explore a charming semi open world, meet the locals, and discover fun side activities and hidden surprises along the way.

4548700.title: Mindreaders
4548700.short_description: How well do you actually know your friends? Mindreaders is a social party game about syncing up. One player hints, the rest guess where on the Wheel they meant. Easy to learn, endlessly replayable, perfect for couch nights or Discord calls.

4548860.title: ShipIt Galactic
4548860.short_description: Manage and grow your intergalactic shipping company! Play alone or with friends as you fly your truck, pick up deliveries and process them in your hangar. Purchase machines, place conveyor belts, hire drivers, and build the best logistics company in the galaxy!

4549190.title: Aether Oblivion
4549190.short_description: Aether Oblivion is a story-driven, tactical turn based strategy game set in 2490 during the rule of the Stellconian Empire. Command your fleet, manage resources, and lead High Admiral Caelus on his mission to uncover the conspiracy behind the late Emperor's demise.

4549270.title: Typing "New Folder (2)"Solo Dev on Desktop
4549270.short_description: An idle sim living on your desktop. Play as a cat developer where your typing and clicks are turned into progress. Conquer bugs and deadlines to turn “New Folder (2)” into a Steam hit. Check your scores, read the comments, and aim for that elusive +1 Wishlist!

4549480.title: BrokenLore: DON'T PLAY
4549480.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where a mysterious experimental video game invades reality. Face five increasingly disturbing levels and survive their consequences as Hideo slips toward identity loss.

4549600.title: Skate Mates
4549600.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer skating game where each player controls just one skate! Leap over lava, race across icy tundras, ride horses, dodge spinning blades, and even fly on dragons together. Only strong teamwork and great communication will get you safely to the end.

4549910.title: G.E.E. (Ghost Evade & Extraction)
4549910.short_description: 1-4 player co-op horror extraction. As disposable scouts, you raid dangerous zones for relics while unkillable monsters hunt in swarms. You can't kill them—only stun, repel, and control the creatures, then flee. Grab loot, drag friends out, and reach extraction... if your friendship survives.

4550130.title: Respect The Horde
4550130.short_description: You're outnumbered. Outsmart them. Lure hordes of zombies into deadly traps, shape their path with obstacles, and grow stronger with every kill. But know when to walk away before overconfidence and greed turn your strategy into uncontrollable chaos.

4550270.title: Bingo Bingle
4550270.short_description: Spin your way to fortune by cranking a bingo drum and building powerful combinations of balls and cards.

4550430.title: The Manaworks
4550430.short_description: Click, build, upgrade and automate! Click to gain resources, build to increase resource gathering potential, automate to get more and more, faster and faster, both passively and actively. Upgrade buildings, stats, and see the numbers go up!

4550700.title: Pup & Mole: Gold Rush
4550700.short_description: Join Pup & Mole on a cozy mining adventure across 7 historical areas. Hop into your minecart, build rail tracks, and dig deeper for hidden artifacts. Upgrade your gear, unlock new tools, and complete your collection while earning money by selling gold and rare treasures.

4550740.title: Kidnapped Simulator
4550740.short_description: Kidnapped Simulator is a first-person psychological horror game where you write your own replies to the serial killer holding you captive. Your words shape the encounter as you search for a way out.

4550950.title: JUNK CONNECT
4550950.short_description: Falling-block puzzle x Electronic circuit design! New to electronics? No problem. Our real-time navigation visualizes exactly where the current is flowing. Even with zero prior knowledge, you’ll discover the joy of "making it work" through play.

4551330.title: Softscape
4551330.short_description: Restore barren spaces into peaceful gardens in a relaxing first-person sandbox. Route water, shape terrain, place plants and decorations, then watch your world slowly return to life beneath the Grand Tree.

4551440.title: Linkisa
4551440.short_description: Linkisa is a hand-drawn Metroidvania set in a world inspired by Malagasy folklore and steampunk aesthetics. Play as General Linkisa, stripped of his memories, and explore the rain-soaked regions of the Empire of Orana in search of your past and the restoration of order. Masina ny orana.

4551500.title: Frame by Frame
4551500.short_description: Step directly into the film reel in Frame by Frame, an award-winning 2.5D puzzle-platformer. Restore a damaged documentary about the dawn of Italian cinema by solving environmental puzzles, repairing film splices, and bringing cinematic history back to life, one frame at a time.

4551710.title: Fat Justice
4551710.short_description: You are the newly appointed Judge in the Stone Age trying to keep a chaotic island from falling apart. Listen to bizarre testimonies while balancing absurd laws and deadly politics. Pass judgment, shape the island's fate, and uncover the truth behind your father's mysterious disappearance.

4552010.title: CounterMind
4552010.short_description: A planetary RTS against an adaptive enemy that learns how you play. Lead machine legions or the hive swarm across ground, sea, air, and space. The enemy doesn't cheat. It plays smarter. Can you outsmart the opposing minds?

4552100.title: Cars and Guns: Paper Parts
4552100.short_description: The world is flat. Everything is cardboard. Your soul is like a car made of paper parts. No thing can reach the end. Can you make it to the Garage of the Queen of Ice? Drive, scrap, and find your way through a universe made of paper and ink.

4552180.title: Jester Under Pressure
4552180.short_description: Diskarte, jester of the high castle, has one job: entertaining the queen. This would be easy except Queen Bahaghari has a penchant for magically exploding the heads of subjects falling below her exacting standards. Can Diskarte avoid this frightening fate?

4552280.title: YiShi Contagion: Versus
4552280.short_description: Plague Hunters 🏹☣️ Join the hunt with your friends in the world of YiShi Contagion, a fast-paced 1v1 action game where you fight through enemy waves, collect power-ups, build your character, and race your rival to defeat the final boss first 💥

4552430.title: ASHEN SEA
4552430.short_description: Ashen Sea is a first-person narrative experience for AXISRAY. Play as BASH, a party robot repairing arcades and tuning jukeboxes via terminal on a derelict spaceship. No combat, no time limits—explore freely. When a shuttle is the only way down, the party’s meaning blurs.

4552570.title: Root Of Evil
4552570.short_description: Survive and destroy the devastating Root that is growing and crawling around the cracks and crevasses of the Hotel. Using whatever tools you have to keep your self alive. Find the antidote that will destroy it or die trying.

4553030.title: Final Assembly
4553030.short_description: Run a chaotic factory with up to 8 players. Earn enough cash before time runs out—while a hidden saboteur quietly breaks everything from within. No voting. A rotating Leader decides who lives or dies.

4553170.title: Cozy Interiors
4553170.short_description: Ever dreamed of becoming an interior designer? Design cozy homes and get paid for it. Build and decorate charming interiors, unlock a wide variety of furniture, and create wholesome spaces filled with personality, furry friends, and perfect little details.

4553180.title: Paragon Colonists
4553180.short_description: Settle uncharted lands in Paragon Colonists, an economy-focused, turn-based 4X strategy game. Build thriving colonies, meet local Orc clans, defy the Ashen Horde and break with the Paragons to fulfill your dream of an empire of your own - solo or in asynchronous multiplayer!

4553260.title: Working From Home
4553260.short_description: You went freelance the week before lockdown. Now stuck at home with no boss and no office, your days are your own. Work enough to pay the bills, manage your needs, blow your wages on gambling, shopping, and vapes, and try to survive the lockdown that never ends.

4553270.title: Rummy Attack
4553270.short_description: "Rummy Attack" is a unique Roguelite Card Battler based on Rummy rules! Place cards on the field to create "Melds" (Sets or Runs) to unleash skills. Build your deck and overcome physical gimmicks like ground fissures to defeat the final boss. Choose between Tactical Move or High-Speed Time Mode!

4553290.title: Road From Horno
4553290.short_description: Road From Horno is a tactical narrative shooter where precision, stealth, and tactical decision-making are essential to survive as you fight to protect the people you once hunted.

4553370.title: SOMBRAS: negative frames
4553370.short_description: ‘SOMBRAS: negative frames’ is a first person narrative game with a focus on photography and light horror elements. Follow Shiomi, a Japanese-Spanish photography student, as she is spirited away in a dark mirror of her 2000s Japanese town and must confront fragments of her own psyche.

4553480.title: Ant Idea
4553480.short_description: A turn-based tactical strategy game. Lead your squad of insect people, explore the complex and ever-changing natural world, and reap unpredictable rewards from your adventures. You know that victory takes swords and food, strategy and intuition, struggle and compromise, and a touch of luck.

4553950.title: GUILDMAKER
4553950.short_description: Run a guild of valiant, procedurally generated adventurers who fight, trade, craft, and do quests on their own. Do your best as their guildmaster to provide them a place to rest and thrive, and restore an old guild to its former glory.

4553990.title: Fuman Ghoul
4553990.short_description: A two-week story about a girl whose stress summons monsters. Dodge obstacles, defeat enemies, and make it to school on time in this fast-paced action adventure.

4554020.title: Mind Mirror
4554020.short_description: A puzzle game set in a millennial-era household. Featuring immersive, retro-styled puzzles full of nostalgic vibes, alongside abundant dreamlike elements.

4554030.title: Ace & Aro: Heart-to-Heart
4554030.short_description: Welcome to the Ace & Aro Meetup! Whether you’re a-spec yourself or just curious, we hope you feel welcome here. Meet the members, try a cocktail (or two) and unwind with some arcade games. Let’s have a heart-to-heart!

4554250.title: Hellforged
4554250.short_description: Hellforged is a loot-driven, extraction bullet-heaven game. Fight through demon-infested maps, pre-craft your build, hunt powerful gear, and combine abilities into epic synergies. Every run is a tense heist. Safely extract epic gear mid-battle or risk it all for greater rewards!

4554320.title: Intercept Course
4554320.short_description: Intercept Course is a tactical space auto battler where you command a starship caught in a temporal rift while chasing a tech thief. Recruit a crew, survive with limited resources, and modify your starship to face rival factions stuck in their own conflicts across every corner of the multiverse.

4554510.title: SHIFU: Traffic Masters
4554510.short_description: Drive slow cars fast. Haul cargo that shifts and spills, keep taxi passengers comfortable and chase suspects through the packed streets of 1990s China, all in forgotten workhorse cars with more character than horsepower. Inspired by ’90s games like Midtown Madness and Driver.

4554530.title: Exile Era
4554530.short_description: In the wasteland ruled by AI, a weekly exile game unfolds.Will you choose to survive alone, lingering in the shadow of zombies and mutated creatures? Or rally your companions and build a haven of hope for old humanity on this desolate island with your own hands?

4554950.title: Pipfiend: The Demonic Domino Deckbuilder
4554950.short_description: Build a deck of dominoes, chain together powerful combos, and break the rules in Pipfiend, a roguelike deckbuilder packed with strange enemies, dangerous synergies, and countless ways to shape your run.

4555010.title: Hypocrisy
4555010.short_description: Hunt a tyrant, liberate oppressed worlds, face the monster within — in a sci-fantasy action roguelike RPG.

4555170.title: Upwell
4555170.short_description: The only way up is to blow yourself up. Rocket jump through a procedurally generated well full of rising lava and fleshy monsters in this chaotic physics-based FPS roguelike.

4555260.title: Haiju
4555260.short_description: Gather the 36 Heavenly Wind Bells from across otherworldly landscapes drawn from Japanese mythology. Charge through enemies and glide over vast gaps in a high-speed action platformer charged with electric energy.

4555580.title: Restoraether
4555580.short_description: Restoraether is a cozy magical survival crafting game where you explore the isles of magic, mysteriously abandoned by their powerful Mage inhabitants, and restore the balance of aethers to bring magic back to the world.

4555610.title: LUNAR PULSE
4555610.short_description: "LUNAR PULSE" is a single-player roguelite card game. Ultra-short battles decided within 60 seconds. Experience soulslike tension where a single move leads to instant death. It features a game system where players act simultaneously with hands revealed.

4555760.title: Container Hunter Simulator
4555760.short_description: Salvage lost containers from the depths, uncover their hidden value, and sell them at auction to build your maritime empire.

4555770.title: In Perfection
4555770.short_description: A writer is trying to finish his "perfect work," but things keep getting in his way. He is poor and full of anxiety. In this retro lo-fi visual novel, fix the problems with point-and-click, explore the depths of consciousness. Forgive yourself? or stare into the dark and fall deeper? It's up to you.

4555970.title: We Believe in No Gods
4555970.short_description: Awaken as a forgotten deity in a post-apocalyptic wasteland ruled by staunch materialists. Listen to desperate prayers—bestow miracles or watch with cold indifference. Extract faith to survive, manipulate mortal minds, and shape the ultimate fate of a world where We Believe In No Gods.

4556210.title: Castle Wars: Legacy
4556210.short_description: A fast-paced card strategy game with deck building, PvP, tournaments, and a campaign, inspired by the classic Castle Wars flash game

4556220.title: SANDSTRIKE
4556220.short_description: A free top-down shooter set in a world that ran out of humans. Blow robots apart in PvP, a 16-robot battle royale and a night-time co-op convoy run. 28 guns, 7 gadgets, 22 implants. Pay-to-win not included.

4556280.title: Decks & Dashes
4556280.short_description: Step into the arena in Decks & Dashes, a fast-paced action-deckbuilder where strategy meets reflexes. Draft powerful elemental spells, dodge incoming attacks, and unleash devastating combos in real-time combat. Do you have the skills to become the ultimate arena champion?

4556800.title: His Last Film
4556800.short_description: What happened during the filming? Stan doesn't remember. Explore the decaying depths of an abandoned subway station, piece together a fragmented reality, and discover the horrifying truth behind his last film. Some memories are better left unmade.

4557090.title: Depth-Bound
4557090.short_description: 🌊 A physics-based underwater 2D platformer. 🚀 Propel yourself out of the water, chain trajectories, and dive always more deeply. 📸 Photograph strange creatures and follow an expedition whose outcome remains uncertain.

4557580.title: Nord
4557580.short_description: NORD is a story-driven survival game set in a flooded Swedish archipelago. Alone or with friends, engineer your raft to navigate a strange, petrifying ocean.

4557880.title: The End of Allegoria
4557880.short_description: A turn-based tactical RPG where your choices determine the fate of the world. Traverse a world that changes as you explore it, find new companions, and combine different class skills by mastering a multitude of equipment.

4558430.title: Homunculeye: Seer’s Ascent
4558430.short_description: Climb a merciless ascent where every mistake sends you falling. In this brutal rage-platformer, claim the power of those who stand in your way to discover the truth.

4559070.title: There's Something Wrong with the Hero's Choices
4559070.short_description: 「その選択肢、正気か？」シンプルなノベルゲームのはずなのに、とにかく“選択肢”がおかしい！？ 予想を超える展開が待ち受ける、奇想天外なテキストアドベンチャーゲーム！

4559160.title: Endless War: Defense
4559160.short_description: Endless War: Defense returns with new missions, improved UI and modern resolutions support. Take command of fortified positions across WWII’s most iconic battlefields. Build defenses, deploy reinforcements, and let your army do the job or take direct control of any unit to turn the tide.

4559210.title: ACT LIKE TOYS! (A.L.T.)
4559210.short_description: Rescue abandoned toys and find your way back to your owner in this thrilling co-op action adventure! Evade those who seek to break or discard you by using the ultimate survival tactic: stop moving and 'Act Like Toys!' to blend in.

4559240.title: Grid Grief
4559240.short_description: A roguelite plinko style deckbuilder about escaping the space between heaven & hell. Forge powerful synergies, trigger chaotic effects and rack up huge scores to secure your resurrection.

4559420.title: Five Families
4559420.short_description: Turn-based mafia strategy. Lead a Cosa Nostra family through 40 years of New York crime: build rackets, command your crews, outplay four rival families and survive the FBI. Every decision has consequences.

4559610.title: You Will Fall
4559610.short_description: A brutal vertical parkour game where every fall costs real progress. No checkpoints. And now the water is rising. Master momentum, learn the map, find faster routes, and climb before everything below you disappears.

4559620.title: Rotten Chamber
4559620.short_description: A single-player logic puzzle disguised as social deduction. Read the claims of a corrupt city council, catch the liars and arrest them, but every wrong call brings you closer to losing it all.

4559640.title: Ciella's Casebook
4559640.short_description: Mystery adventure game set one year after the war, following the journey of a war-veteran detective Ciella and her assistant Ricky in the industrial city of Actain.

4559680.title: Heirlooms
4559680.short_description: A letter has just arrived for you, Jack. Reclaim your legacy in this lovecraftian old-school dungeon crawler. Uncover misteries, face once buried horrors and survive. Fear what should be left forgotten.

4559970.title: 落樱
4559970.short_description: 落樱是一款将AI聊天与Galgame结合的聊天恋爱模拟游戏。你可以自由与落樱对话、与落樱一起游玩各种小游戏。在游玩中你可以体验到落樱的多种性格，并触发随机事件。

4560170.title: Orblins
4560170.short_description: Orblins is a Marble-Matching Roguelike inspired by classic marble shooters like Zuma and Luxor. Create game-breaking builds with endless marbles and upgrades to defeat a host of Orblins and bosses. Choose from a large cast of characters or create your own custom class to personalize your run.

4560260.title: Backrooms Anomaly: Pools
4560260.short_description: An anomaly-spotting horror game set in looping liminal poolrooms. Study your surroundings and identify changes ranging from subtle details to terrifying entities. Turn back if something has changed, continue if everything seems normal, and then use your camera to document the anomalies.

4560300.title: WOYO!! 2
4560300.short_description: The second installment of the WOYO!! Saga— a French turn-based JRPG set in the heart of the Parisian suburbs. Rediscover Montreuil with your team of misfits and take on your terrifying enemies: pigeons, mobsters, barflies, and other shmucks.

4560830.title: Terminal Drift
4560830.short_description: Hold down the cargo bay! In Terminal Drift, automated defense systems handle the trigger, but survival is entirely in your hands. Adapt your load-out and survive 20 relentless waves, because when the Matriarch breaches the hull, firepower alone won’t save you.

4560870.title: ガッチャ！サバイバー
4560870.short_description: A roguelike action game where you absorb bullets to fight. Switch between Light and Dark, turn bullets into energy, and unleash powerful bursts! Build your skills and survive the overwhelming bullet storm.

4560940.title: Your Chibi Chicken: Lo-Fi Desktop Pet
4560940.short_description: A chicken library with a lofi library, for your Steam library.

4561330.title: Back For Loot
4561330.short_description: Smack bosses for gold, buy permanent upgrades, and push further with every run in this incremental roguelite. Lead four unlikely heroes through a fantasy kingdom that can't let anything end. Your party wants out. Your next upgrade says otherwise.

4561420.title: Drainbound
4561420.short_description: You are Drainbound, it is your time. A roguelike adventure where you must fight, suffer and sever to discover your true destination.

4561520.title: Necrocyte
4561520.short_description: In a world devastated by the infected, you play as a surviving soldier enhanced with a mechanical arm. Explore dangerous regions, gather resources, discover powerful abilities, and fight to survive in a hostile world.

4561550.title: Racetrack Tycoon
4561550.short_description: Build race tracks, expand your venue, attract racing series. Host everything from amateur club meets to world championship events in a true 1:1 scale simulation. Racetrack Tycoon challenges you to manage your budget, meet demanding series requirements, and entertain tens of thousands of fans.

4561690.title: Ruinous
4561690.short_description: Craft devastating decks, gather loot to define your build, and defeat randomized dungeons and ruthless boss fights in a journey of risk, strategy, and ruin in this fantasy roguelike deckbuilder.

4561760.title: Fieldwork
4561760.short_description: Your editor sent you to explore an abandoned ship graveyard. Photograph the evidence, stay quiet and get out alive.

4561840.title: Broken Masks
4561840.short_description: Enter an abandoned orphanage, solve unsettling puzzles, and uncover its terrible secrets. Living toys, dark presences, and haunted corridors will push your sanity to the limit. Can you survive the horror lurking within?

4561890.title: Pastry Pile Up
4561890.short_description: Drop and merge pastries to create bigger, more delicious treats! Serve your sweet creations to adorable cat customers to earn coins. Use your coins to fully customize your cozy bakery, and compete on the global leaderboard to achieve the highest score.

4561970.title: STORMY
4561970.short_description: Turn a sheet of paper into your controller using your webcam, or stick to standard controls. Journey across a vast planetary system to save your lost ally while piloting spaceships, exploring as a robot, fighting, trading, racing, mining, and cultivating life forms.

4562480.title: Peeled Eyes
4562480.short_description: Stealth-Horror where you close your eyes to see what sinister forces and secrets are hiding in the shadows. Use your senses to explore atmospheric environments, avoid supernatural surveillance using stealth, and acquire eldritch artifacts for safekeeping.

4562860.title: Extracto Proviso
4562860.short_description: Sent to a distant planet to feed a war you never chose, you are the perfect extraction machine. Build sprawling automated factories, survive a wilderness that fights back, and uncover whispers in the soil that make you question your directive. Extract everything. Then decide who it's for.

4563140.title: Ocean Homeward:Soul Summoner Survivors
4563140.short_description: Play as a Soul Summoner, sail the nether Ocean, survive monster hordes. Awaken spirits, collect soul fragments, craft gear sets and build unique combat styles. Upgrade spirits, forge affixes, unlock legendary captains and vessels. Purify the Ocean, lead spirits Homeward, uncover nether sea secrets.

4563300.title: CatDude & Karsh
4563300.short_description: A boss rush adventure with moderately challenging combat and cozy hub world activities, including fishing, hotel management, and market trading.

4563410.title: Girlfailure Art Club
4563410.short_description: Fall in love again with the cringey otaku girls who spent their school days drawing in the corner. Packed with 2010s otaku culture, memes, and second-hand embarrassment, this visual novel lets you relive a painfully cute youth with the oddballs of a Japanese art club!

4563560.title: Corrupt Receptionist Elina
4563560.short_description: A receptionist simulation set in a medieval fantasy Adventurers’ Guild, where you review documents and process rewards. You should pay for your sick sister’s medicine. Will you work honestly—or turn to bribery and embezzlement? Your paperwork and choices will shape your fate.

4563740.title: Outliers: Incrementum
4563740.short_description: An incremental ARPG about rising from a nobody to the most powerful assassin alive. Slash through waves of monsters, collect loot and upgrade your abilities. Get stronger with every run until even bosses become easy targets.

4563830.title: Penumbra
4563830.short_description: Penumbra is a minimalist color-theory puzzle game. Move lights and blocks around the screen to mix colors and cast shadows. Match the color-coded goal circles with the right shade of colored light to complete each level.

4564020.title: Ashes of Bronze
4564020.short_description: Bronze Ashes, a fantasy action roguelite inspired by Sanxingdui and Jinsha, conjures a cyclically reborn otherworld from ancient Shu's legends. Play alone or with friends: command shape-shifting arms, gather Golden Crow spells, and fight to save Shu from impending doom.

4564420.title: Sit Still
4564420.short_description: Sit Still is a first-person puzzle horror set in 1985. Bound to a rolling chair by a radio-obsessed killer, you must escape and survive while uncovering the truth behind a recurring cataclysmic storm that strikes the local town every 20 years.

4564880.title: FEMBOY SLEEPOVER - Episode 2
4564880.short_description: You've been invited to the Femboy Sleepover! In episode 2 of this cute yaoi visual novel series, look for ways to exorcise the demon you summoned.

4564970.title: I Herd Ewe
4564970.short_description: It's time for the sheep to head home! Will you command your team of dogs to round them up in as few turns as possible? Or will the sheep outsmart you with their wooly ways? Make use of each dog's unique ability to get the sheep home as efficiently as possible in this wholesome tactical puzzle game.

4565170.title: Butterfly: Twisted Thread
4565170.short_description: Butterfly: Twisted Thread is a hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania where you use a mystical butterfly to draw platforms, objects, and attack tools into the world. Explore interconnected areas, solve physics-based puzzles, fight enemies, and unlock new paths through creative drawing.

4565530.title: Divinuet
4565530.short_description: A compellingly unique deterministic musical tarot experience, which guides you through a tarot reading in two segments. In the first, each card plays its own musical theme. In the second, music and videos combine to tell the overall story of your reading. A short ritual made to be returned to often.

4565710.title: The UFO Phenomenon
4565710.short_description: In this horror strategy roguelite inspired by Dispatch, become part of MAJESTIC; a clandestine force tasked with guarding humanity’s darkest truth. Disinform, spy, and endure as paranoia, catastrophe, and the unknown threaten everything you know.

4565730.title: Taverntasia
4565730.short_description: Manage your very own tavern as a wizard! Host guests from diverse races. Brew special magical drinks with potions and herbs, and serve delicious meals. Keep your customers happy with quick and quality service. Build your reputation, earn money, and take your tavern to the top!

4565900.title: SkateFPS
4565900.short_description: When the system hates you, hate the system! Experimental FPS about shooting magic from your hands with a skateboard + text adventure with multiple endings about being cursed in your own land.

4566010.title: Red Echoes: Berlin
4566010.short_description: Berlin 1918. Amidst the turmoil of the Great War, the fires of revolution burn. With the German Kaiser's reign rapidly coming to an end, lead a group of socialist revolutionaries and attempt to change the course of history. Will you succeed and bring about a better tomorrow?

4566340.title: ECHO_
4566340.short_description: ECHO is a stylized role-playing game. Play as a young woman returning from deep space, exploring a silent Earth,solving puzzles, and following a mysterious signal to find the people and memories she left behind.

4566430.title: Daughter of Dawn
4566430.short_description: Only you can shape her destiny. Raise and guide the last princess of a fallen kingdom. Through friendship, love, growth, and loss, your choices determine her future. An emotional life simulation RPG with dozens of endings.

4566710.title: Catapulteers
4566710.short_description: A chaotic 1-4 player online co-op physics comedy where cursed Catapulteers haul weird ammo, lose their heads, load one giant catapult, and stop a Troll that really hates catapults.

4566850.title: Sepak U - Sports Fighting Game
4566850.short_description: Smash-Like Volleyball - Fighting Game meets Volleyball and Football with 1-4 players, 21 characters, 21 arenas, with over 10 hours of solo/co-op content, minigames, and epic boss battles. Based on Sepak Takraw, a cultural Asian sport.

4566900.title: Those UnderHex
4566900.short_description: A strategy roguelite about rebuilding the portal lands. Reveal dark hexes with beams of light and bring supplies home. Protect your workers, combine tower weapons and face successive monster waves. Each night, your people need food and shelter.

4567020.title: AMEN: The Quiet Exodus
4567020.short_description: Cursed the womb that bears emptiness beneath its heart. For twenty-five years children have been born without souls, and a soul can only be restored by taking another’s. Ilaya Cassette wants to know what’s wrong with her. A gothic visual novel, fully voiced in Russian. Prologue and Part I out now.

4567160.title: September 3rd
4567160.short_description: September 3rd is an iconic day. It's one of those days when the decisions made the day before completely change a person's fate. Feel the atmosphere of life’s drama and immerse yourself in the midst of events from a time when the turning of the calendar marks the beginning of a new era.

4567180.title: Giant's Heart
4567180.short_description: A mysterious journey across a collapsing island. Reforge a lost blade, defeat ancient giants, and uncover the truth about your past. Save the island before it’s too late.

4567210.title: One Coin Museum
4567210.short_description: Explore, collect, and build your very own cozy museum! In One Coin Museum, travel across the seas and use your claw to grab hidden treasures. Display your finds to attract visitors, grow your reputation, and upgrade your boat to reach even more distant wonders.

4567440.title: Ram and Hedgehog
4567440.short_description: Set off on a crazy adventure with the Ram and the Hedgehog, filled with unexpected dangers and fun challenges. They prank each other and annoy everyone around them. But one day, a great goal unites them — food. What could possibly go wrong?

4567600.title: One More Voyage
4567600.short_description: ONE MORE VOYAGE is a minimalist 4X game all about exploring strange planets. On each voyage you are on the hunt for vital resources to make your next jump. The further you get, the more points you can invest in permanent upgrades. Can you find the star cipher to chart the way to a new galaxy?

4567670.title: Chick'n Slide
4567670.short_description: An incremental arcade experience where you pull adorable chicks onto giant slides, collect resources, unlock powerful talents, and upgrade your magnet to create ever-growing, chaotic runs.

4567690.title: LUMINOUS GATE
4567690.short_description: LUMINOUS GATE is a fast-paced 3D action adventure. Master elemental abilities, wield giant weapons, and challenge powerful bosses. The current demo showcases the core combat experience, with a larger world and new adventures planned for the full release.

4567800.title: GUNDIG
4567800.short_description: GUNDIG is a roguelike twin-stick shooter where your gun is also a pickaxe. Mine your way through massive fully destructible planets, fight off hordes of aliens, and stack increasingly ridiculous upgrades.

4568000.title: POUND SAND
4568000.short_description: Every pixel simulated, including the machines. Dig into alien planets, build a factory from real blocks, and carve it into any shape you want. Ore sinks and sand rises in the greatest competition in the galaxy. Move it, grind it, melt it, freeze it, sell it, and strip the planet to bedrock.

4568010.title: Manafinder II
4568010.short_description: The world does not need saving; you do. Mankind has ended, yet the world moved on. Take the role of Rey in this turn-based RPG and fight ferocious beasts and other existential threats alongside a disparate cast of allies as you seek purpose in a world that no longer welcomes you.

4568030.title: Beyond Yardwork Simulator
4568030.short_description: Gardening has never been this rewarding! Use a full arsenal of tools – from lawnmowers to pressure washers – to transform properties and earn money to renovate your own home. With intuitive mechanics and beautiful visuals, it’s the perfect stress-free relaxation for everyone.

4568190.title: PlayLife: Life Deck Simulator
4568190.short_description: A card-based life simulation where every choice is a card. Build your deck, shape your destiny, and explore multiple paths with 21 skills and 22 careers. Marry, stay single, get rich, or start over—every run tells a new life story.

4568320.title: Flesh Grinding
4568320.short_description: Grind flesh. Gather blood. Upgrade. A first-person incremental horror game where you manage a macabre basement. Buy dark upgrades. boost your efficiency. and push your machinery to the limit while avoiding the terrifying entity that watches your every move.

4568330.title: Curse Of The Abandoned Floor
4568330.short_description: Curse Of The Abandoned Floor is a first-person Chinese horror game. It starts with a paranormal video about an urban legend: "Beware the non-existent elevator mezzanine. If you enter it, you will be trapped forever."

4569140.title: Slay the Party
4569140.short_description: Gather a party of 4, choose a class, and dive into chaotic turn-based mayhem! Navigate a board full of monsters and tricky decisions, growing stronger with every kill. Use your class skills and meme-fueled relics to sabotage and slay your party members, and be the first to achieve all winning feats.

4569170.title: Grey Heritage: Counter Gambit
4569170.short_description: Grey Heritage: Counter Gambit is the grand finale to the tactical RPG trilogy. Command a massive cast of returning heroes in the series’ most strategic entry yet. Master evolved turn-based combat, guide your army through tactical challenges, and witness the conclusion to every character's story.

4569700.title: 三位一体！超異常混沌賭博遊戯～アルティメットカオスギャンブルバトル～
4569700.short_description: Welcome to ULTIMATE CHAOS GAMBLING BATTLE! Playing cards, mahjong, and hanafuda—all mixed together! Behold an unprecedented incremental gambling roguelike! In three completely different modes, watch your bankroll skyrocket at a breakneck pace!
developers: キザミレモントースト

4569790.title: Anathema Requiem
4569790.short_description: Anathema Requiem is an atmospheric third-person psychological horror game where you must uncover the mystery of an abandoned cemetery where people vanish without a trace.

4569890.title: Fluffy Spider
4569890.short_description: A fluffy spider. Tricky jumps. A web to call home. Explore a colourful 2D platformer, find secret worlds, then build a network of insect traps in your idle hub. Collect silk, unlock talents and characters, and fill your radio with original songs.

4569950.title: The Silent Fare
4569950.short_description: A psychological horror anomaly game where you observe your apartment, report strange changes, and uncover a disturbing story hidden in the environment.

4570130.title: GridLock
4570130.short_description: Command a 3-soldier squad against AXIOM, a rogue AI spreading across the battlefield. Every turn the Grid grows, buffing enemies and punishing your troops. Destroy every Node before 75% of the map is consumed. Fast, tight, tactical.

4570150.title: This Week
4570150.short_description: A hardcore parkour game that tells the story of Ania, a kid with mental health issues and a lot of stuff to go through in life. Meant to make you experience how someone feels in a weird, but familiar way.

4570290.title: Urban Echoes
4570290.short_description: Urban Echoes is a relaxing skateboarding game demo with stylish retro graphics that encourages exploration, individuality, and self-discovery.

4570390.title: LIMICORE
4570390.short_description: LIMICORE is a dark and narratively driven experience containing uncovered mysteries. Traverse the world through various realities and solve engaging puzzles to discover the truth behind the organization's objectives.

4570960.title: GigaTroubleS
4570960.short_description: A unique giantess girl-themed exploration and puzzle work which integrating the depth of the plot and the diversity of gameplay. the past and present of the protagonist are pieced together. Three character storylines with completely different gameplay and multiple endings.

4571160.title: Rainbow Tower Defense
4571160.short_description: Your towers don't fire a single shot. You block the horde with the lines between them. Deploy the right towers and mix diverse line synergies to craft your winning strategy. Classic tower defense, completely reinvented. Test your tactical limits against escalating waves.

4572060.title: Snow Panic
4572060.short_description: An online ski race for up to 8 players armed to the teeth. Blast your friends into the trees with bazookas, call in airstrikes, unleash exploding goats and beat them all to the bottom.

4572390.title: World Railway
4572390.short_description: World Railway is a sim management game and you're a conductor reviving an old train. Produce and gather resources in stations via loops, process and manage onboard. A new world unfolds with the wheel's rumble. On your journey, forge bonds and witness the seasons.

4572720.title: GAP OR DIE
4572720.short_description: There’s only one rule: make the jump. Push your speed, commit to the gap, and survive as long as you can in this high-risk endless racing game. Upgrade your ride, and see how far you can go before everything goes horribly wrong.

4572930.title: Just More Doors : REFRAMED & REDACTED
4572930.short_description: OPEN THE DOOR TO WIN! Question your sanity in this first person exploration and puzzle game. Discover a place where anything you can dream of might just be a door away from you. Go on. Open the door. It's as simple as that!

4573270.title: 中等生
4573270.short_description: 这是一部中式校园（高三）为背景的百合向视觉小说。 只要考上大学，一切都会好起来吗？手牵着手，心跳扑通扑通，我们只是朋友吗？大家说只是开个玩笑，感到不舒服是正常的吗？想要挣脱母亲的期待，这是不孝吗？您将跟随主角周语桐，探索青春期的疑惑，帮她作出选择。

4573410.title: Apple Picker
4573410.short_description: Start with an apple tree, end with a multiverse turned to pulp in this creepy idle incremental game. Pick apples. Produce more apples. Cause the apple-fication of reality. Uncover the source of this all-consuming apple obsession. But whatever you do, (don't) shoot the unicorn.

4573500.title: Arms Race
4573500.short_description: The enemy that kills you robs your grave, takes your build, and comes back next run wearing it. A bullet hell roguelite with no chests, 100+ mutating items, and a different continent's mythology on every floor.

4573540.title: Shipolis
4573540.short_description: Shipolis is a cozy naval city builder and resource management game. Explore archipelagos with your ship. Build cities and expand in several regions. Manage production lines and automate with trading routes. Play at your own pace to build great wonders and uncover all the mysteries of the world.

4573600.title: Jaded Jade Jayden
4573600.short_description: Help Jayden get rid of those pesky workers that entered princess Yunlong palace uninvited!

4573960.title: Cauldron: Haunted Harvest
4573960.short_description: Haunted Harvest is a farming spinoff set in the Cauldron universe. Play three evolving minigames, grow some magical crops, and restore a corrupted village to its former glory. If your favorite plant is still an upgrade tree, then grab your watering can and start the harvest!

4574220.title: Cargo Runner: Faction Fracture
4574220.short_description: One wrong delivery can start a war. Smuggle cargo in a Tetris-style hold. Dodge faction inspections. Betray whoever pays. A pixel-art space rogue-like where every run is one bad jump from total loss.

4574240.title: Havenrail
4574240.short_description: “The Last Train of Humanity” is a survival strategy game. Manage your train, oversee resources, and make tough decisions that determine the fate of your passengers. Will they survive the perilous journey?

4574370.title: Sword & Banner
4574370.short_description: Mount & Blade's campaign meets classic RTS battles, in pixel art. Lead a warband across a fantasy continent at war, raise peasants into knights, trade, and carve out your own faction. Command every soldier in fast, brutal real-time battles and sieges.

4574460.title: Rabbit On The Rails
4574460.short_description: A short 3D side-scrolling puzzle horror game set on a mysterious circus train. Explore eerie train cars, solve unsettling puzzles, and guide a young girl as she tries to escape a world that feels both warm and deeply disturbing.

4574660.title: 90 Minutes Till The World Ends
4574660.short_description: 90 minutes remain until the world ends. Will you face the end with regret or go out with a bang?”

4574740.title: The Last Grave Job
4574740.short_description: Online co-op horror for up to 4 players. Sneak into a cemetery at night, find the right graves, dig up the loot and haul it back to your wheelbarrow. Stay quiet, avoid the Keeper and get out alive.

4574960.title: Prof. Bringoo's Big Dumb Block Factory
4574960.short_description: Play by yourself or with a friend in this action puzzler. With tons of power up combinations, zany sound effects and music you'll never get bored.

4575030.title: Dead Reckoner
4575030.short_description: Navigate the darkness in Dead Reckoner, a stealth-action submarine game where survival depends on more than firepower alone. Slip through the shadows, elude your enemies, and exploit their weaknesses as a new recruit in a mysterious government initiative that will determine the future of humanity.

4575080.title: Lost Exit
4575080.short_description: A psychological horror experience set in a shopping mall with an infamous history. Take on the role of a night shift security guard trapped inside a shifting nightmare of liminal spaces, deadly games, and a truth that refuses to stay buried.

4575400.title: Space Postal Service
4575400.short_description: Fly from planet to planet delivering mail to the folks who live on these tiny worlds. Get to know them, just be sure not to read the mail. Chill out and fly around this hand drawn, 2.5D simulated solar system, earn money for your deliveries while collecting stamps to fill your notebook.

4575640.title: Overserved: Food Fighters!
4575640.short_description: Overserved: Food Fighters is a fast-paced multiplayer party brawler for 1–8 players. Pick an adorable critter, dash through chaotic arenas, and hurl food-themed projectiles at your rivals in frantic matches with full cross-play across every platform.

4576540.title: Regnum Last Sanctum
4576540.short_description: Regnum Last Sanctum begins with Saga I — Combat: Wrath of the Goblins. An dark epic, Action RPG, Regnum's Quest to defend its last sanctum against the invading goblins. Master skill-based combat, fight clever foes, and progress in the realm of Regnum where death has consequences. Will you survive?

4577040.title: 致，我亲爱的
4577040.short_description: A narrative-driven psychological horror visual novel. Player's choices lead to distinct emotional paths and story outcomes. "You" navigate a shifting consciousness, making choices within fragmented scenes that buried memories.

4577070.title: Falling Apart
4577070.short_description: Falling Apart is a disturbing point-and-click puzzle adventure about a man descending into his own fractured mind through hypnosis.

4577220.title: 独属于神明的世界：第一部分
4577220.short_description: "The world of deity : Part 1" is the free first part of a sci-fi romance ADV "The world of deity" published by Cloudside Games. By cooperating with "little sister" Yiran to uncover the truth behind the chemical plant explosion, players can gradually discover the hidden secrets behind this world.

4577250.title: Court Vision
4577250.short_description: Run a basketball franchise from the front office. Draft and develop players, negotiate contracts, make trades, and manage lineups. Every decision determines your legacy.

4577310.title: ALTAR CORP
4577310.short_description: A solo rhythmic FPS in the abandoned city called Yerneth.

4577370.title: Altera Historia
4577370.short_description: A top-down action shooter where you fight by aiming in **eight directions**! Don’t just read the bullet patterns and dodge— choose the right attack for the situation, take risks, and fire your way through the chaos to turn the tide.

4577730.title: Star Seed Protocol
4577730.short_description: Star Seed Protocol is a bullet-heaven horde survival shooter where you aim your own weapons, deploy turrets and drones, reshape your build with implants, research new technology, and fight through alien swarms across varied mission types.

4577860.title: Gravity Witch
4577860.short_description: Master gravity as a witch whose mana has been stolen. With no elemental spells left, use your creativity to manipulate the weight of the world, solve puzzles, and face dangers. Reclaim your power in an action-adventure journey where gravity is your only and greatest ally.

4578640.title: Ro Sham Brawl
4578640.short_description: Ro Sham Brawl is a rock, paper, scissors fighting game where you brawl your friends in chaotic rounds of fast-paced, physics-based competition. Launch powerful attacks with crazy abilities, while destroying arenas and friendships with every shot.

4578680.title: Red Epic: War of Resistance
4578680.short_description: This is a TD & light RTS set in the Anti-Mop-up Campaigns of Central Hebei. Master village defense, ambushes, and raids on the North China Plain. Outsmart strong foes through terrain and strategy, forging an unbroken steel wall with the blood and valor of unsung heroes!

4578910.title: Skylane: Airline Tycoon Sim
4578910.short_description: Run an airline the competent way you wish they were like in real life. Open routes, buy aircraft, build the weekly schedule, and hire crew qualified to fly it. No cockpits, no cutscenes. Just the network, the numbers, and fierce rivals aiming to take a cut of your market share.

4579110.title: Courier Beware
4579110.short_description: Deliver to haunted places, solve paranormal mysteries, and struggle through the daily grind in this horror life sim adventure.

4579290.title: 回声 E.C.H.O.S
4579290.short_description: E.C.H.O.S is a narrative-driven first-person sci-fi game. Several centuries after Earth’s civilization was destroyed by an unknown cosmic force, humanity begins to awaken. Journey through virtual and real worlds, uncover the truth of a new age, and decide the future of civilization.

4579540.title: Arc of Icarus
4579540.short_description: Build and lead your colony on a lost ringworld, where deadly conditions await on both sides while the world keeps turning! Progress through technological evolution, survive cultural revolution, and govern with a wise and steady hand!

4579630.title: Bounce Rush 跟你爆了
4579630.short_description: A pinball-action × roguelike strategy game. Launch balls to smash enemies, equip turrets and skills, and craft your own build from hundreds of combinations. Three modes: turn-based tactics, real-time combat, and stage-based challenges.

4579700.title: Rites of Accord
4579700.short_description: Turn-based hex tactics with six radically asymmetric factions. Climb the Survival leaderboard or outsmart a rival in a full match in 30-40 minutes. Raise the dead as Echoes, spread living terrain, or share damage across the Choir. Free demo available now.

4579790.title: Orbital Maintenance Technician
4579790.short_description: The stations in orbit need maintenance! A handful of specialized tools and zero gravity. Drift, dismantle, clean, restore. Just you, your tools, and a job well done. Suit up and get to work!

4579930.title: Kepler Protocol
4579930.short_description: Kepler-186e. An Imperial colony on a world that wants it gone. Turn-based strategy and hard survival: secure water and Flux power, keep the supply lines alive and hold out against a swarm steered by stimulus and pheromone.

4580030.title: Papaya Plaza
4580030.short_description: Rebuild a faded tourist town as its new mayor! Place shops and decorations, staff them with quirky villagers to earn cash each day, and help out with their favours. Every night the judges score your town, so rank up, unlock new buildings, and get that coveted 5-star rating. Peep peep!

4580050.title: Sunrise Story
4580050.short_description: Run your own seaside homestay in a cozy pixel art life sim 🌊 Welcome travelers, cook Southeast Asian–inspired dishes, and build a peaceful life by the sea.

4580160.title: Caravan Bazar
4580160.short_description: Caravan Bazar is a chaotic co-op physics adventure in a procedurally generated world. Find precious loot, load it into your cart, punch gnomes, fight trolls, repair broken wheels. Try to survive and reach the end. Complete missions, fly on gliders and live the life of a goblin.

4580250.title: Smash Them All
4580250.short_description: A highly dynamic top-down action game where the car serves as both a weapon and the primary tool for survival.

4580270.title: PROTOCOL: Zero-day
4580270.short_description: Dive into a brutal isometric Action-Roguelite set in a cyber-apocalyptic world. Master fast-paced Hack'n'Slash combat during intense 5-to-8-minute incursions. Face infected hordes, optimize your build, and break the loop. Death is part of the protocol.

4580360.title: Dreadfold
4580360.short_description: A single-player dark fantasy card battler on a 3×3 grid, built on Final Fantasy VIII's core Triple Triad rules. Place a card next to a rival's: if your touching number is higher, theirs flips to your colour. Every win earns a card. A loss can cost one.

4580700.title: WE DIDN’T KNOW WHAT TO CALL THIS GAME [So... we just left it like this!]
