4580700.short_description: A comedic meta Visual Novel with a cinematic presentation and an interactive world where everything responds to your clicks, while you and the characters constantly blur the boundaries between the story, the creative process, and reality itself.

4580790.title: Mine Mage Minion
4580790.short_description: A mining game where you play as a mage digging deeper into the earth. Gather resources, craft weapons and armor for yourself and your minions, defend your operation from enemy waves and bosses, and protect your underground colony from creatures trying to sabotage your progress.

4581050.title: My Demon Academia
4581050.short_description: Raise a runt into the King of Demons, battle its siblings and overthrow the Demon King. Power is earned. Family is optional.

4581160.title: Folders On The Run
4581160.short_description: Escape the factory reset! Control two adorable folders in a failing OS. Play solo or coordinate your movements with a friend. Master shifting mechanics to survive. Perfect for testing your skills and friendships!

4581340.title: Perplexicube
4581340.short_description: Perplexicube is a challenging isometric puzzler where you must work together with your past and future selves. You'll have to think ahead as you create loops backwards in time to set your futures selves up for success.

4581370.title: Where Dolls Hang
4581370.short_description: Where Dolls Hang is a psychological survival horror game inspired by Mexican folklore, set in 1998. Investigate an island filled with hanging dolls, eerie mannequins, and horrifying rituals. Explore the forests and interiors with your camcorder, find VHS tapes, and uncover what happened.

4581600.title: import robots
4581600.short_description: Program robots in Python to collect the resources scattered across each planet. You never control them directly. You write the code, hit run, and watch it work. No programming experience needed, just learn as you play.

4581800.title: Thalyn
4581800.short_description: Build a cosy world. Then step inside. Create cottages, gardens and places to stay, from above or in first person. Shape the atmosphere with simple choices, text or voice, wander through your creation, and export it as glTF to keep and share. No coding or 3D modelling needed.

4582500.title: Withering State
4582500.short_description: Act as Premier Alexander Sants in a time of stagnation, division, and the falling of walls. Will you steer the brotherly nations of the People's Republic of Sudlivia toward the liberal West, reinforce the crumbling East, or forge a new path? Or even be ousted before becoming the General Secretary?

4582550.title: Kabsa Spilled?
4582550.short_description: Spill Kabsa everywhere in this chaotic co-op physics game. Grab a buddy and lead the adventure of two chefs delivering the Kabsa plate through deadly firepits, tricky platforms, angry vendors and much worse things that will DEFINITELY make your friendship better.

4582650.title: Amazing Slot Survivor (A.S.S.)
4582650.short_description: Spin the slot machine and see how powerful you'll become! Luck shapes your arsenal, but only skill keeps you alive in this high-stakes bullet heaven roguelite. Master unique weapons and destroy the Spawners summoning endless hordes, and push your luck to the limit.

4582760.title: What Remains
4582760.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game set in a childhood home. Explore, uncover four days of missing memory, and survive something that has been listening since you arrived.

4583070.title: Misplaced
4583070.short_description: Misplaced is a historical detective puzzle game about sorting case files and uncovering hidden connections. Read letters, witness statements, and official records, figure out where each document belongs, and piece together the truth behind a murder case inspired by real events.

4583150.title: Greda Inferno
4583150.short_description: A master potter arrives in hell under mysterious circumstances. With your skills, you must craft pieces for the inhabitants of the underworld. Survive, improve your creations, meet your new neighbors, and try to uncover the mysteries of the depths.

4583360.title: SAMURAI BRINGER - RAMPAGE -
4583360.short_description: SAMURAI BRINGER - RAMPAGE - is a deck-building auto battler where you strategically form your squad by arranging samurai units and combining weapons and abilities to suit your tactics. Build your own unique formation and unite the land under your rule!

4583540.title: Reborn As A Barbarian: A Sword & Sorcery Isekai Saga
4583540.short_description: A VN/RPG hybrid with pixel-art battles, branching dialogue, and six love interests. A tabletop nerd dies and wakes up as his own barbarian character. Survive a savage sword-and-sorcery world with massive biceps, zero survival skills, and a princess who thinks you're insane.

4584170.title: On The Ramp
4584170.short_description: Your rival is right there. A ramp. Dozens of meters of air. Suspension at its limit. Touching down at 140. You started with 120 horses and a cheap frame. Race to get noticed. Build the rest.

4584190.title: Looplash
4584190.short_description: Looplash is a fast-paced arcade action roguelite where your skills rotate around you in a constant loop. Move to control timing, position yourself precisely, and survive the chaos. Push the system to create builds that bend the rules.

4584860.title: ICU - Intensive Care Unit 8
4584860.short_description: ICU – Intensive Care Unit 8 is a single-player horror game where you’re trapped in a looping hospital corridor and must spot anomalies to find a way out.

4585010.title: Jackpot Colosseum
4585010.short_description: Your slot machine is the weapon. Spin to load guns and bullets, then unload the whole build when it hurts most. Bet bigger for stronger symbols, gamble the gold you need to survive, and climb five leagues of the colosseum. A turn-based reel-building roguelike.

4585020.title: Golgothian
4585020.short_description: Build a three-hero party in a dark-fantasy roguelike deckbuilder. Queue actions, read enemy intent, trigger class combos, equip survivors, and choose routes through doomed dungeon runs alone or in co-op.

4585250.title: Cascade
4585250.short_description: A real-time roguelike where every move starts a chain reaction. Push enemies, manipulate tiles, combine elements, and turn status effects into opportunities.

4585330.title: Tutorial Hell
4585330.short_description: Tutorial Hell is a first-person comedy game about a tutorial that wants you dead. I'm Nigel. I'm a chicken. I'm contractually required to teach you the controls. The first lesson is PRESS W TO MOVE FORWARD. Please press W. Nothing bad will happen. Trust me.

4585370.title: Bounty Gunman
4585370.short_description: Control the line of fire. Take the shot. A retro pixel-art 1v1 western shooter focused on positioning and mind games.

4585530.title: Mind The Gap
4585530.short_description: Mind The Gap is a puzzle platformer game where you and your unlikely companion work together to create your own path to freedom. Featuring 80+ handcrafted levels, unique bosses, and hidden collectables, each stage introduces new mechanics that push your abilities further.

4585580.title: Game of Warriors
4585580.short_description: Defend your city, conquer enemy lands, and build a powerful empire in this unique tower defense strategy game. Upgrade defenses and technolgy, command troops, and face massive waves, siege weapons, and war elephants as you expand across the map.

4586060.title: Script Strike
4586060.short_description: Script Strike is a strategy game where you fight with code. Command your knight and solve levels in your favorite language, from variables and loops to algorithms, debugging, and concurrency. Collect weapons, unlock skills, and face the challenges of a medieval fantasy battlefield.

4586090.title: Remaining Kingdom
4586090.short_description: Remaining Kingdom combines deckbuilding, roguelike progression, and real-time tower defense into one dark fantasy experience where each Lord changes the way you fight.

4586580.title: Astro Kitty: Space Mining
4586580.short_description: Astro Kitty: Space Mining is an incremental mining game where you dig through planets, collect valuable resources, upgrade your gear, automate your mining operation, and travel between planets on an adventure with cats.

4586780.title: Mentiss Werewolf: Human vs AI
4586780.short_description: Play Werewolf with AI players that argue, bluff and vote on their own. Hunt the wolves with the village or lie your way to a wolf win, solo or with friends while AI fills the empty seats. Watch Mode, Parallel Mode, replays and post-game Review. Free Games every day.

4586810.title: The Concrete Sutra #1
4586810.short_description: A post-apocalyptic world. Two friends haven't seen each other for 5 years are heading back home on a bike. The first episode of an epic action jrpg by yeo.

4586870.title: Leaky Business
4586870.short_description: A small deckbuilder about the daily struggle of running a business. Choose your die, craft your deck, manage resources, and fix leaks before things fall apart. The odds aren't in your favor, but with a little planning and a bit of luck, you might just make it.

4587170.title: Damned Dwellers
4587170.short_description: Play out your misery as entertainment for the all-seeing Dungeon that brought you to life in this hack-n'-slash rogue-lite. Delve uncharted rooms, puzzles, and fight monsters like yourself to learn what makes it tick, but DON'T let it grow bored...

4587690.title: ScrapCrew: Running on Fumes
4587690.short_description: Command a squad of distinct personalities in this turn based tactical RPG. Drive armored vehicles through a harsh wasteland, salvage scrap to upgrade your convoy and shape your squad’s combat style and narrative through a dynamic influence system. Can you reclaim what was stolen?

4587820.title: Unfallen Bastion
4587820.short_description: Protect your Bastion one card at a time in this roguelike tower defense deckbuilder. Deploy turrets, cast spells, and craft devastating combos to hold back bloodthirsty monsters and remain Unfallen.

4587940.title: Stray Service
4587940.short_description: What's cheaper than cheap labor? Cats! Play as Tub and Bub - two very committed felines on the clock to bus tables, wash dishes, and mop up every mess before the restaurant goes under. Solo or with a friend, it's chaotic, it's frantic, and someone's definitely knocking over a stack of plates.

4588160.title: L.L.L.Liar
4588160.short_description: Shi, a photographer and unforgivable sinner. After her train breaks down, she steps onto the platform and meets someone she'll never forget. This narrative-driven RPG takes you down a thorny path to save your loved one and face the real world together.

4588490.title: Last One Breathing
4588490.short_description: Scavenge ruined locations, manage a grid backpack, barter, craft, and keep your shelter standing through the night in a survival adventure where every item you carry can change the run.

4588690.title: Clicky Keys
4588690.short_description: Clicky Keys is a tower defense game where your keyboard is the battlefield. Every key activates a weapon. Fight off enemies and make the right upgrade choices to survive. Can you reach day 20?

4588960.title: Dendrophobia
4588960.short_description: A twisted pixel-art horror thriller about death, ancient gods, and a persistent waiter. Explore The Willow’s Embrace hotel, solve puzzles, and gather paranormal evidence. Challenge the madness to find a way out and avoid becoming part of an eternal nightmare.

4589140.title: Graveyard Warden
4589140.short_description: Inherit a neglected graveyard, prepare graves, craft coffins and tombstones, and manage daily burials. Restore your cemetery, explore the surrounding area, and uncover the secrets behind your inheritance.

4589190.title: Trimson
4589190.short_description: TRIMSON is a system-driven zombie survival game where you play as a rescue operative sent into infected zones to save survivors. Every injury, infection, resource, and survivor lost has lasting consequences.

4589360.title: They Stop for Gas at Night
4589360.short_description: A first-person horror simulation game. You owe money. So you work nights at a gas station in the middle of nowhere. Serve whoever shows up, and try not to think about what's watching from the dark. Something ancient is watching, and it isn't planning to leave.

4589690.title: HardLuck
4589690.short_description: A 100-player turn-based Battle Royale where dice decide your fate. Roll, move across a shrinking grid arena, grab weapons and gear, aim & fire all in simultaneous timed turns. Outsmart, out-position & outlast 99 rivals. Just sharp Strategy with Lucky rolls. "Fight your enemies, Fight your HardLuck"

4589700.title: The Sworn
4589700.short_description: A deep US police precinct management simulation. You are the Captain. Hire officers, manage your fleet, respond to a living city, and carry responsibility for every officer under your command. The job has a cost. So does ignoring it.

4589920.title: Into the Dust
4589920.short_description: Top-down tactical co-op extraction shooter. Up to four players scavenge, fight, and rebuild in the harsh, post-apocalyptic wastelands of Dust Bowl America.

4590270.title: Fallgrade
4590270.short_description: Bend gravity. Twist architecture. Survive the impossible. A first-person exploration game set in an analog concrete nightmare, where reality shifts around you and Karl waits for your next mistake.

4591360.title: Void Balls
4591360.short_description: A 3D survivors-like where you play as a ball. Roll, jump, dash and parry everything: every shot you catch flies back at its shooter. Stack auto-firing weapons, gears and items into a wild build, beat the balls that rule the void, then play as them.

4591740.title: Numpad Chef: Pizza Rush
4591740.short_description: Turn your numpad into a pizza kitchen. Type fast, cook faster. Master a unique number-based control system as you prepare, top, and bake pizzas under pressure in a cozy 3D farm kitchen, where every order counts and every mistake matters.

4592040.title: Just Chessing Around
4592040.short_description: A tactical dungeon crawler where your party is a chess army and the board tries to kill you. Plan around tornadoes, quicksand swallowing your pieces or flying lava stones. Turn bishops into necromancers, stack pawns on other pieces or give Jerry a BBQ. No king to checkmate, just enemies to destroy.

4592130.title: The Blinking Room
4592130.short_description: One night, young Lily wakes from a nightmare — unaware that her real nightmares are only just beginning. Uncover the secrets hidden behind closed eyes.

4592680.title: Mineral Zone
4592680.short_description: Build a factory by day, defend it by night. Mine ore, automate it over belts and keep the grid alive, then hold the line with towers your factory feeds and your own ship in the fight. Solo or online co-op for up to 4 players.

4592750.title: The Stalked 4
4592750.short_description: Desperate for work, 27-year-old George signs up for the remote lighthouse job. What starts as beautiful and peaceful scenery slowly turns unsettling day by day. Is it just your mind playing tricks on you? Or is someone else here...?

4593190.title: Elemental Lands
4593190.short_description: Build a base to support heroes in turn-based tactical card battles & defeat enemy breaches overwhelming your land! Your base-building strategy powers your spell deck, weakens foes & heals heroes. Position 3 heroes & use spell cards to seize enemy objectives for buffs. Cards are tactics, not damage.

4593760.title: Zoti's Train Workshop
4593760.short_description: Rotate pipes, restore steam flow, and repair stubborn old trains in this cozy hand-drawn puzzle game from the world of Sly Crow.

4593810.title: Pollex
4593810.short_description: Enter the pit. Bet your fingers. Survive the thumb war. Pollex is a first-person horror game set in an underground thumb war fight pit. You owe a debt you can’t pay. The only way out is through the ring ,where every match is played for keeps, and the house always takes a cut.

4593890.title: Desktop Planet
4593890.short_description: Desktop Planet is a sci-fi building game centered on automated production lines. Start with mining, smelting and manufacturing, plan your logistics and power supply, then assemble a fleet to explore new planets.

4593920.title: Gnomonatics
4593920.short_description: Gnomonatics is a third-person action-adventure game. Explore an open island, solve ancient puzzle dungeons, and battle corrupted creatures with sword and crossbow as the shadows transform everyone around you.

4594190.title: Toy Tycoon
4594190.short_description: You're the owner of a toy business. Start with a small store in a suburban area. Increase your profits, unlock new toys, hire employees, move to bigger locations, manufacture your own toys, and expand your company. Build your empire and become a toy tycoon!

4594200.title: UFO Craft
4594200.short_description: You are a UFO. Your target: anything that moves and isn't properly secured. Pilot the UFO, sow chaos, and abduct everything! Equipped with a powerful gravity beam, destruction physics, and deep ship upgrades. Abduct cows, cars, and people in this insane cosmic abduction simulator. Earth isn't ready!

4594580.title: DT.O: Hanes
4594580.short_description: When a woodcutter is hired to map the ancient forest of Ethrna, a mysterious substance called ■■■■■ shatters his reality. Face a world of forgotten memories and a past that shouldn't exist...? Can Phabius find the truth within his mind?

4594640.title: Turbo Loop
4594640.short_description: Turbo Loop is a casual slot car racing game focused on simple, fun gameplay - easy to learn, but hard to master. Challenge AI opponents or race a friend in head-to-head matches, unlock and customize cars, compete across dozens of tournament tracks, or create your own with the track editor!

4594660.title: Novus Terminus: First Flags
4594660.short_description: Novus Terminus: First Flags is a cozy logistics city builder. Found settlements, design road networks and watch your carriers transport goods from flag to flag. Three unique clans, visible supply chains and a handcrafted low-poly world await you.

4594740.title: Still Breathing
4594740.short_description: Keep your family alive in an underground bunker after the world collapses. Manage scarce resources, explore the ruined city, and make brutal decisions when desperate strangers start knocking on your door.

4595190.title: 研究生病院
4595190.short_description: A visual novel set in the modern or near-future era. You play as a male protagonist struggling with psychological trauma after graduate school, as he reconnects with three heroines. Through player choices, you will develop relationships, and uncover the past of each character.

4595270.title: Tactical Commanders R
4595270.short_description: Tactical Commanders R revives the classic large-scale sci-fi strategy warfare of the original Tactical Commanders. Command your forces, control the battlefield, and experience intense real-time strategic combat once again.

4595300.title: SHIFT: A Game Made to Be Broken
4595300.short_description: A puzzle platformer that starts by teaching you the rules—then dares you to break them. Bend mechanics, exploit systems, and discover solutions the game never intended.

4595870.title: Stack the Spells
4595870.short_description: Stack the Spells is a fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where every card is a step toward your survival. Scale a shifting, procedurally generated path, outsmart grim monstrosities in tactical turn-based combat, and forge a legendary deck to solve the mysteries of a world in ruin.

4595980.title: Ship or Burn! Coop express
4595980.short_description: Someone’s order burned? At least the train made it! Explore a dangerous open world, deliver cargo, and protect it from zombies. Out of fuel? Toss someone’s parcel, a zombie, or your annoying friend into the firebox! Online co-op for 1 to 4 players.

4596040.title: Lynehold
4596040.short_description: Break through enemy waves and destroy their base in this tug-of-war PvP auto battler inspired by Direct Strike. Counter your opponent, unlock formation bonuses and strengthen your army with items and upgrades. Balance economy with aggression, then watch your strategy unfold. Play 1v1, 2v2 or 3v3.

4596070.title: Dice Crawler
4596070.short_description: At the bottom of the dungeon lies the rotting corpse of a dead god, festering and devouring the land above. Descend into the depths. Slay the monsters. Resurrect the god. Dice Crawler is a dice-based roguelite game.

4596090.title: Your Mother Disgusts Me
4596090.short_description: Your Mother Disgusts Me is a yuri horror visual novel about 3 women taking refuge in a shipping container during the apocalypse. A mother, a stranger and a daughter have to hash out their differences, lest they attract the attention of the disgusting Parasites infecting humanity.

4596180.title: Table of Fates
4596180.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder set in a medieval tavern. Build your deck through tactical card play. Create powerful combos, make risky deals, and know when to walk away. Karma remembers every choice!

4596350.title: DeskFarm: Idle Garden
4596350.short_description: A desktop-optimized idle farm that stays by your side. Use built-in pin and hide features to grow your pixel garden without interrupting your workflow. Strategically secure rare seeds from the rotating shop and upgrade your way to discover increasingly valuable crop tiers.

4596660.title: QuilomboZ: Palmares
4596660.short_description: Lead elite warriors like Zumbi and Dandara in a real-time tactics game to defend the legendary "Quilombo dos Palmares". Use stealth, terrain, and coordinated abilities to outsmart Portuguese forces and mercenaries. Channel Orisha powers through the Axé system to overcome overwhelming challenges.

4596680.title: Pocket Paradise Restaurant
4596680.short_description: Run your restaurant on the paradise island of Isla Sabor ! Dive in the ocean to get food, design and expand your restaurant, buy supplies and cook meals for your clients !

4596780.title: The Defective One
4596780.short_description: This is a visual novel set against the backdrop of a high school student band. It is a fierce collision between gender identity, the concept of freedom, and traditional views. You will play as the band's bassist, choose your answers to these issues, and experience the story of this special band.

4596980.title: Blightrole
4596980.short_description: Blightrole is a dice-based game, a role-playing campaign you won’t escape from. Face an original dark fantasy world with a touch of black humor. Will you uncover the Master’s secrets, or will your campaign end before its time?

4597230.title: Spells and Sploobies
4597230.short_description: A tactical hex-grid card game for 2–4 players where wizards clash in strategic PvP duels. Build your deck, summon units, build structures, cast abilities, and issue commands to fight for control of the board.

4597240.title: Ark Atlas
4597240.short_description: A roguelike colony manager and auto battler. Manage humanity's last ark through alien-dominated space. Build, research, and optimize your ship's systems, then deploy your forces against alien swarms in tactical combat.

4597410.title: Midnight Hotel
4597410.short_description: Midnight Hotel is a cooperative survival game for multiple players, where you take on the role of staff at a terrifying hotel operating exclusively during the night hours. Check in guests, manage the property, keep the hotel running - and survive until dawn.

4597790.title: PIGGO
4597790.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer party card game where players race to collect four matching cards, bluff their friends, and react at the perfect moment. Play with 2-4 players through fast unpredictable rounds. In PIGGO, it’s never just the cards.

4597950.title: Tower Tanks
4597950.short_description: TEAM UP! BUILD UP! BLOW UP! Tower Tanks is a chaotic co-op vehicle combat roguelike where you and your friends build and crew giant war machines. Work together to customize your tank, power up the engines, put out fires, and man the guns as you blast apart anything in your way!

4598030.title: Endless Harvest
4598030.short_description: Endless Harvest is relaxing yet strategic incremental farming game where every crop you place changes the efficiency of your growing plot of land. Grow crops, unlock upgrades, and optimize your farm as much as possible!

4598920.title: The Pyroxene Ages
4598920.short_description: This is a top-down, loot-based RogueLite game. You can build a town, craft weapons and socket them with various gems, then embark on adventures across maps you construct yourself.

4598970.title: Finnish middleschool simulator
4598970.short_description: In this simulation, you can live the life of dreams. The game is completely open world, and besides attending school, you can also customize your moped, drink alcohol, and enjoy the sauna. If you’re not in the mood for school, you can tell the teacher to fuck off and come to school drunk.

4599010.title: New Game+ - Game Store Simulator
4599010.short_description: Run the game store you never wanted to leave, from the late ’90s to today. Buy, sell and repair games, haggle over trade-ins, and hunt for rare finds. Customize your shop and fill your shelves with parodies that make you laugh, cringe, or remember the games you grew up with.

4599110.title: Hotel Simulator
4599110.short_description: Take control of a motel in Winston Springs! Design unique interiors, care for guests, earn and invest in a hotel network. Plan room layouts and furnishings, and hire staff. Transform outdated spaces into luxurious apartments with attention to every detail. Will you create the hotel of your dreams?

4599140.title: Oath for Glory
4599140.short_description: Join the tournament as a lowly knight of a small village. A skill-based boss fighting game built around directional combat. Learn, adapt, and master precise melee mechanics where player skill determines victory.

4599170.title: Regicide: Chess Roguelike
4599170.short_description: Forget checkmate. Every capture scores in this chess roguelike deckbuilder. Gather powerful floppy disks, rig your pieces (and theirs), and ignite cascading combos as you chase scores you have no right to reach.

4599180.title: Pantheon
4599180.short_description: A visual novel about a college graduate searching for a job, finding a way out at rock bottom, and rekindling hope.

4599250.title: Moldhaven
4599250.short_description: A first-person survival horror action-adventure. Explore an anomalous zone, find your sister's missing expedition, and fight a maddened cult. Manage your resources and evade an ancient power awakened by a corporation.

4599270.title: Wanderfolk
4599270.short_description: A farming RPG where villagers remember everything. Grow crops, forage, and explore a procedurally generated world, then talk to AI-powered NPCs who form real opinions about you. Build friendships, pursue romance, fight monsters (or stay peaceful), and become part of a living village community.

4599310.title: For My Darling
4599310.short_description: Based on a True Story, "For My Darling" is NOT fiction! Lili’s ordinary life was fractured in 2023 after meeting someone strangely familiar. Her reality twists as something begins to follow her. It is tied to lost memories and a past that won’t stay buried. To understand, she must uncover the truth.

4599540.title: Antarctic Showdown
4599540.short_description: Kill your friend! Antarctic Showdown is a 1v1 roguelike shooter. Grow stronger with every defeat and claim victory!

4599590.title: Buried Magic: A Story about the Unseen
4599590.short_description: Hollowmoor is plauged by a series of strange disapperances — and at the core of it all lies centuries old Trinity Acadamy of Witchcraft. Step into the shoes of young Ruby and her house spider Mifi to discover the truth behind the schools dark secrets.

4599730.title: Irondrive
4599730.short_description: A vehicular roguelite where you manage a crew inside a moving fortress. Your base is on the move, your crew is at the breaking point: automate repairs, manage priorities, and survive relentless attacks as you cross a hostile, post-apocalyptic wasteland. Keep moving.

4599860.title: 天藻のモズクヒメ
4599860.short_description: In 20xx Japan, 200+ vacant mosques became mozuku farms! Play as Mozuku Hime, breed super strains with genetic algorithms, and turn every mosque into a glowing seaweed paradise!

4599970.title: Deep Space Survivor: Endless Starfield
4599970.short_description: "Deep Space Survivor: Endless Starfield" is a survivor-style game. Your interstellar battleship accidentally enters an unknown universe, fighting its way through endless enemies, roaming multiple star systems, and collecting meteor resources to forge your ultimate orbital weapon.

4600060.title: Seal The Breach
4600060.short_description: A 3D survival experience set within a cramped one-man submarine exploring a hostile ocean trench.

4600230.title: KeelOver
4600230.short_description: KeelOver is a crazy physics party game where weight rules everything. Your pirate ship is a giant scale, tilt the deck by hurling heavy loot at your rivals, customize your pirate, and keep your balance… or end up as shark bait!

4600380.title: ELLA in da room
4600380.short_description: A seemingly cozy (but ultimately frustrating) 2D platformer, where a little girl’s imagination transforms her room into a magical world. Jump across pillows, race toy cars, and explore nostalgic adventures in which every object becomes part of a story, all while testing your patience to its limits.

4600620.title: Twinkle Seek
4600620.short_description: Go search for sparkles to the ends of the world!

4600750.title: Don't Lose Your Head
4600750.short_description: Destroy your friendship by playing this challenging co-op game about two skeletons sharing a single head. Help each other to get out of a deep cave, be mindful of your jumps and remember - DON'T LOSE YOUR HEAD!

4600800.title: Astral Echelons
4600800.short_description: Shoot holes through enemy ships from your seat at the controls of a multi-gunned turret mounted on the bow of a dimension hopping spaceship in this seated VR on-rails spaceship turret shooter!

4600910.title: Dendron 64
4600910.short_description: With the help of a custom emulator, a lost 90s puzzle platformer game has finally been restored. Explore the secrets of the dam, find out what happened to your friends, and save the valley from the monster lying in its depths.

4600970.title: Medium Chronicles: Room 644
4600970.short_description: You must speak to survive. But speaking might kill you. Whisper rituals into your microphone — while a demon hunts every sound you make.

4601090.title: Hold Your Position
4601090.short_description: An incremental-style tower defense game where you face waves of orcs, undead, and demons. Recruit more troops, buy and upgrade skills, obtain powerful spells, and hold your position.

4601100.title: False Oath
4601100.short_description: False Oath is a retro-style survival horror game set in a medieval era. A deadly plague spreads across the kingdom. Search for a cure before it’s too late.

4601110.title: Smokey Mike
4601110.short_description: In stand-up, talent isn't always enough. In this point and click adventure you have to improvise, survive and fail with style until you craft the five minutes that could change everything.

4601370.title: Yashi - Sand Driver
4601370.short_description: In an endless desert, you are Yashi, a lone survivor... until this radio signal changes everything. Jump in your van with your faithful coyote, drive across the wastelands, survive the heat, scavenge resources, craft tools, fight the elements & find your way to New Eden in this feel-good road trip.

4601470.title: Going my way?
4601470.short_description: You're a train conductor in a world that doesn't sleep anymore. People are losing their minds, and Wanderers hide among them. Your job sounds simple: get the train to the City, watch the passengers, and never forget that the train demands sacrifices.

4601490.title: City of Tales
4601490.short_description: Reach the City of Tales, uncover the truth about the Big Bad Wolf, and choose Red's fate, one card at a time. A narrative card game set in a fairy tale world turned upside down. Will you restore the power of the Plot, or lead it into chaos?

4601560.title: Ember
4601560.short_description: Join up to 5 friends in a deadly game of hide and seek. Play as a survivor or the monster lurking in the shadows.

4601590.title: Hot Pot Pizza Edition
4601590.short_description: Slice, bake, box and serve under pressure in a fast-paced first-person pizza game. Survive chaotic shifts, unlock kitchens and truck cosmetics, and go from a messy garage to your own restaurant.

4601700.title: Incremental Defense
4601700.short_description: Optimize, automate, and scale your defense to survive increasingly challenging waves in this addictive incremental tower defense.

4601790.title: Mirage - Idle RPG
4601790.short_description: An idle incremental bullet heaven where you fight waves of enemies, collect loot, and grow stronger every run. Play four different classes, craft items, run a shop, tend a garden, raise pets and keep progressing even while you're away.

4602070.title: Supermarketeer
4602070.short_description: Build and run your supermarket solo or in online co-op. Hire employees, assign jobs to suit their strengths and train their skills. Bake goods, handle parcels, pack online orders and tase shoplifters. Customize and expand your store, and react to in-game news and supplier offers.

4602110.title: Chains of Vithra
4602110.short_description: "In a brutal, unforgiving RPG, descend into a shattered realm of massive seamless landscapes and shadowed city hubs. Forge a tormented hero through ruthless progression, engage in visceral tactical combat, and make harrowing choices that shape a grim, persistent multiplayer world."

4602450.title: Void Strike
4602450.short_description: Shred endless waves of hostile spaceships in a 1-bit arcade survival roguelite. Build absurd weapon combos, unlock pilots, upgrade your fighter, and survive escalating dogfights against swarms, elite enemies, and colossal bosses.

4602570.title: Ironfall
4602570.short_description: A survivors-like roguelite in a fallen kingdom of rune-forged relics. Pick one of 20 heroes, cut through endless swarms, fuse weapons and items into powerful evolutions, and raise the Run Curse until the Reaper himself comes for you.

4602710.title: Glassbound
4602710.short_description: Tiny creatures grow in glass bottles at the bottom of your screen while you work. Summon and fuse 200+ beings. Befriend a town of animal folk, or snoop on them and steal their secrets. Every choice tilts your compass toward Light or Darkness.

4602760.title: Anomaly Planet
4602760.short_description: A Singleplayer Horror Game about navigating an Endless, Living Labyrinth buried in a Mysterious Planet, all whilst facing Dangerous Entities.

4602770.title: Tower of Genn
4602770.short_description: Tower of Genn is a puzzle-strategy building game where you construct a precarious Tower using an expansive variety of pieces. Fulfill quests and discover new interactions with special blocks, strategically placing your pieces, to build a lasting legacy for your people.

4602880.title: Video Poker Infinite
4602880.short_description: A casino-style video poker based incremental game. Play classic Jacks-or-Better based video poker while building and upgrading your pay table. Unlock powerful abilities to boost your odds and payouts. Play minigames like blackjack and roulette to enhance your progression.

4603020.title: TRANSMIT
4603020.short_description: A 1-bit, point & click and puzzle short story about horror, mystery and deception. TRANSMIT, translate and search for coded messages as part of your telegraph operator job and figure out what's behind the new SS PURGO.

4603100.title: ASANA Visual Novel
4603100.short_description: A sci-fi dark comedy visual novel with English voices. Build your stats, choose branching routes, and try live AI conversations and persuasion challenges as Captain Asana. N.E.K.O., your judgmental cat-shaped ship AI, has opinions. He is still not impressed.

4603240.title: ARCADE LOOP: ROGUELIKE
4603240.short_description: Dive into ARCADE LOOP, a massive, ever-expanding collection of classic and modern arcade simulations. Featuring deep meta-progression, unlockable characters, powerful relics, weapons, bosses and a dynamic scaling system that keeps every run fresh.

4603450.title: Mega Squad Survivors
4603450.short_description: Become Hua Tuo and lead 50 great officers of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as women, across 25 stages. Unlock new officers and art, master 200+ skills, and combine 35 Tales of Three Kingdoms lore with 5 formations to forge a peerless legion. The physician takes the field to heal a land at war!

4603470.title: Spin Sacrifice Survive
4603470.short_description: Break the system. Test your luck. Spot the lies. Experience the thrill of gambling for your survival. Optimize your strategy to pay an crushing debt, grow your power, and survive ten nights of paranoia.

4603550.title: W.A.M
4603550.short_description: Command a bunker’s remote surveillance network to cull an infestation of Molemen from a dark, foggy forest. Upgrade your tactical hardware and pilot scout drones to survive, and keep your guard up; the threat behind you is constant.

4603700.title: Save Princess Torosso
4603700.short_description: Save Princess Torosso is a fantasy 3D action adventure with ranged magic combat, skill card progression, and 3D platforming obstacles. Instead of complex builds, it focuses on intuitive controls and stage clearing like a classic arcade game.

4603880.title: We Die Standing
4603880.short_description: Arcs, Rings, Power, Annihilation, Courage, Comradeship, Worlds, Earth, Humans, Creatures, Flood, Scourge, Starvation, Crisis. Through All, One Must Fight Unless He Dies Standing.

4604230.title: ConOps21: Subversion Protocol
4604230.short_description: Neo-London remembers nothing. The Dominion made certain of it. You are Cipher Reeve — the man their erasure failed to take - and the buried Signal you've touched carries the memory of everyone they erased. A psychological techno-thriller where truth is contraband and every choice is recorded.

4604660.title: Honel's Identification
4604660.short_description: A document inspection sim in a fantasy republic gripped by reform. Check papers from humans, elves, orcs, trolls, and beastfolk against rules that change every day. Follow the law, or your conscience? Every issuance has a cost.

4604690.title: INURE
4604690.short_description: Wrong man, in the wrong place, at the wrong time. Explore a hostile Dreamscape, manage scarce resources, and use whatever weapons you can find to survive a world shaped by cosmic dread.

4605020.title: Vem, Exu
4605020.short_description: A short narrative experience where you solve simple puzzles and explore a world where emotions become interaction. Build a kite, connect constellations, and face a storm born from your own anger.

4605200.title: Hero of the Kingdom IV
4605200.short_description: A lovely adventuring RPG. Journey across a picturesque tropical island and shape your own destiny for the first time in the series. Enjoy complete freedom in solving quests. Use thoughtful logic, master the art of bartering, and explore peacefully at your own pace.

4605420.title: Orca Girl: Idle Fishing Story
4605420.short_description: Enjoy idle fishing with your orca girl companion. Grow crops, craft bait, and collect rare and exotic fish. Decorate your own pixel aquarium and build a cozy desktop island. Play solo or enjoy relaxing fishing trips with friends in multiplayer for up to 8 players.

4605560.title: Occupancy
4605560.short_description: A detective is interviewing a survivor about a night that doesn't add up. Step into their fading memory, swap between survivor and detective to find what doesn't match the evidence, and help them remember what really happened. Something is keeping the night buried, and it knows you're looking.

4605780.title: Archerman
4605780.short_description: Two archer on a ridge. Wind blows. One arrow flies. ARCHERMAN is a minimalist 1v1 archery duel — turn-based, physics-driven, and stripped down to what matters: the arc, the wind, and the moment you release.

4605900.title: The Ninth Legion
4605900.short_description: The Ninth Legion is an RTS narrative strategy game, set during the fateful final campaign of the LEGIO IX HISPANA, Rome's famous missing legion.

4606100.title: Verbal Vendetta
4606100.short_description: DITCH BUTTON MASHING! Bark real-time orders to your champion to outplay & counter your opponent! Dominate the leaderboards, and win through words, not buttons! Built by a solo dev!

4606480.title: Nozie Tower Defense XL
4606480.short_description: Defend against waves of invading balloons in this colorful tower defense adventure. Place and upgrade 8 unique towers, including fire, slow, explosive, and sniper types, across 20 challenging levels. Mix strategies, complete goals, and try to beat the developer’s high score!

4606560.title: Finding Frankie 2
4606560.short_description: Trapped inside a deadly televised game show, you must parkour through a massive obstacle complex. Wall run, rail grind, and vault past twisted traps in the final season. Win the $10 million prize, or die trying. Frankie is waiting for you and he’s not holding back.

4606750.title: Turno Nocturno
4606750.short_description: Work for corporations on desolate planets, complete dangerous shifts, recover valuable resources, and survive strange creatures while uncovering the remains of an ancient humanity that was actually our own.

4606890.title: Aurenv - Audio Reactive 3D Environments
4606890.short_description: Aurenv is a music visualizer that takes it one step further by translating both stems and real-time audio into physical motion, dynamic lighting, and responsive elements within 3D environments.

4606910.title: Archa
4606910.short_description: Archa is a 2D platformer all about movement, combat, exploration, and score! To complete a level, you must gather a certain amount of points, and find the exit. Points are given by collecting and attacking enemies.

4607150.title: Satanic Panic
4607150.short_description: DEMONS VS ANGELS | A fantastical strategy tower defense with heavy Roguelike elements. Defend against waves of Angelic assaults with a small army of Demons, then upgrade them with a variety of abilities and buffs to tear through increasingly large and powerful hordes of Angels.

4607180.title: PulseWave
4607180.short_description: Every weapon fires to the beat you create. Mix guns, modifiers, and upgrades to build deadly combinations in this rhythm-shooter roguelike.

4607200.title: Endangered
4607200.short_description: Humanity wiped out your species. Now you're fighting back. Play as evolved animals in a brutal roguelike hack-and-slash! Hunt down humans, adapt to a collapsing world, and collect nuclear launch codes to end the fight... permanently.

4608450.title: Islecraft: Island Architect
4608450.short_description: Sail to uncharted isles and build settlements as an island architect in this minimalist city builder. Inspired by ISLANDERS.

4608460.title: MORI
4608460.short_description: Experience lightning-fast combat as self-proclaimed Grim-Reaper Mori. Armed with nothing but a scythe, cloak and a lust for revenge, carve your way through a criminal empire and discover what it means to lose yourself.

4608540.title: OVERRIDE PROTOCOL
4608540.short_description: Hack hostile AI systems in a cyberpunk hacker sim. Build proxy routes, poison live context, breach secured nodes, steal the payload, and wipe the logs before your trace burns.

4608620.title: Hackflesh
4608620.short_description: A Cookie Clicker-style idle game in a cyberpunk world. Click the terminal to siphon Data, grow a network of 20 generators from Script Kiddie to The Architect, catch Glitch Signals and Reboot for permanent Exploits. 719 upgrades, 100 Exploits, 602 in-game achievements.

4608670.title: Don't Stop The Pop!
4608670.short_description: Ready to turn a single kernel into an unstoppable popcorn machine? Build your strategy with a massive Skill Tree; discover dozens of flavors from salty to chocolatey, spicy to salted caramel, and fill the screen with pops! Earn more, pop more! Don't Stop the Pop! 🍿

4609100.title: Just Barricade!
4609100.short_description: Just Barricade! is a brutal home-defense simulator about earning money, building protection, and surviving the consequences of your own decisions.

4609150.title: Flakeparty
4609150.short_description: Build the perfect cereal bowl and reach extremely high scores in this relaxing roguelike deckbuilder. Scoop up cereals, craft powerful synergies by placing them well, earn toys by playing rule-twisting minigames and eat tasty snacks to improve your cereals as you reach the highest scores!

4609300.title: No Elevator
4609300.short_description: You as a claustrophobic guy refuse elevators and climb a massive building from the outside, using a plank gun and create your own path.

4609450.title: Магический мир Константина Кадавра
4609450.short_description: Enter Konstantin Kadavr's absurd magical world through a refrigerator in the woods. Ask a video fortune orb, click for coins, catch flying bonuses, and test your patience to earn red chairs. The game is available in Russian only.

4609500.title: Defense Front
4609500.short_description: Take command of routes and firepower in a fresh take on classic tower defense. Deploy towers, seal off key junctions, and reshape enemy routes on the fly. Turn the tide with branching upgrades, customizable targeting priorities, and direct target designation as you defend humanity across the globe.

4609540.title: ScaMMO
4609540.short_description: Incremental game where you play as a frustrated rich MMO veteran promising to make the next WoW killer. How far will you get before cashing out?

4609640.title: Wayward Crown
4609640.short_description: You don't command the heroes — you bait them. Wayward Crown is a kingdom-management sim where every adventurer has their own greed, glory, and fear. Place bounties, build a town, balance the gold, and watch your realm run itself.

4609790.title: Here's My Target
4609790.short_description: Contract killing is just another public service. As a regulator, it's your job to review the documents, listen to the client, and decide the fate of every target, then hope you made the right call.

4609950.title: Rock, Paper, Severed
4609950.short_description: You are invited to play a deadly game of Rock, Paper, Scissors to wipe away your sins. Sit down. Make your throw. Try not to lose anything you can't reattach.

4609970.title: The Midnight Dump
4609970.short_description: A first person psychological horror game of a writer locked in his office at night, trying to overcome artblock. As he types, the story begins to take shape in unexpected ways, the line between his writing and reality starts to blur. experience subtle changes and sudden scares as the night unfolds.

4610060.title: SYSTEM 21
4610060.short_description: Manipulate a blackjack game from the inside as a dealer subroutine in this minimalist roguelike deckbuilder. Read the visible card's queue, execute illegal code exploits to alter the upcoming cards, and fleece high-rolling patrons before the system anti-cheat detects your anomaly.

4610140.title: Birdflop
4610140.short_description: An intense platformer with a unique one-button control. You've fallen from your nest, and you're just learning how to fly. Can you make it back to the top?

4610220.title: Lights Out
4610220.short_description: Escape through a procedurally generated dungeon full of different monsters and dangers. Work as a team to gather resources, craft tools and use your Light to fight against the hazards of this world, before you run out of coal and all will be covered in darkness.

4610300.title: MUNer
4610300.short_description: Early this century, a school Model UN event steeped in emotional conflict and tragedy changed every participant’s life. Years later, the scattered youth reunite and seek revenge, amid fractured friendship, love, ambition and lost dreams.
publishers: ローズペタル・アトリエ

4610580.title: Apocalypse Jumpers
4610580.short_description: Welcome to the end of world(s)! Jump from one apocalypse to the next, upgrading your abilities to defeat the hordes that threaten the fabric of the universe.

4610850.title: Gorilla Tag Contagion
4610850.short_description: Join your fellow Monke to smash, climb, and roll your way through hordes of enemies! Unlock new characters, powerful weapons, endless gadgets, and crazy parkour skills as you fight through twisted monstrosities with your unique build. Will you survive the Contagion?

4611080.title: Knut
4611080.short_description: SAVE THE PLANET, FIND YOUR FISH! In this epic 2D platformer, a simple rescue mission spirals into total planetary chaos. Knut, a one-eyed rodent with a nuclear-grade grudge, engages a robotic army to find his pet. Master twitchy physics and massive upgrades. Nothing stands between you and your fish!

4611120.title: The Observation Exit
4611120.short_description: A first-person psychological horror where you must identify anomalies, choose the correct elevator to progress, and escape an endless loop in a hospital corridor while avoiding deadly entities.

4611130.title: Angler 2003
4611130.short_description: A regional television programme from 2003 that you fish inside of. Cast into ponds, storm drains, sofa cushions, and the internet. 135 "Fish" species. Hosted by everyone's favourite Pineapple Cat.

4611880.title: XiaoLuo's English War
4611880.short_description: The town is collapsing! A demonic legion is closing in, and its survival is in your hands. Words are your bullets, and typing speed is your life. Type accurately to unleash lethal skills against waves of enemies. Grab your keyboard and fight to master English and survive!

4612350.title: MindCleaver
4612350.short_description: Manipulate the minds of fully simulated NPCs as you and a rival sorcerer twist emotion, factions, and armies in a dark, emergent fantasy world.

4612380.title: Sutra Pilgrim
4612380.short_description: Sutra Pilgrim is a 2D Metroidvania inspired by Journey to the West. Awaken from an ancient seal as a monkey demon and seek the Sutra Pilgrim. Transform to explore hidden paths, collect artifacts and legendary weapons, meet allies, and face Yaoguai Kings to uncover the secrets of the journey west.

4612490.title: 終末生徒 The Last Student：Showa Era Radio Room
4612490.short_description: A Showa-era school, a radio room at night. In a building where you are not alone, you repeat broadcasts. Strange responses return. Records change, unknown logs grow. Reality begins to erode, and the story twists through your choices. Ten endings await.

4612510.title: Pitchfork Perfect
4612510.short_description: Jam to the tunes of Pitchfork Perfect - a Bullet Heaven Rogue-like Rhythm game. Press, tap and hold to the beat to cast spells and abilities to fight off swarms of heavenly forces led by oppressive bosses! Will you face the music? Or will you stay silent?

4612810.title: Bullet Barrage
4612810.short_description: Shoot. Dodge. Control the distance. Bullet Barrage is a commandless 1v1 bullet-hell action game featuring 8 unique fighters, CPU battles, local versus, and online multiplayer.

4612880.title: Dumb Dunks
4612880.short_description: Dumb Dunks! is a wildly creative, satirical twist on basketball where every level throws a ridiculous new object and target at you. Master tricky physics, perfect your timing, and embrace the chaos in this humorous physics-based dunking frenzy.

4613090.title: Remake17
4613090.short_description: Remake17 is a galgame. You play as student Liang Yu, who travels back to high school ten years ago after an accident. Amid memory and reality, you'll find overlooked traces and the fates of three girls. Facing reality and illusion, regret and dreams, what will you choose?

4614160.title: Space Cat Digger
4614160.short_description: In Space Cat Digger, you will mine resources, build machines, upgrade your equipment, and try to get the highest score possible within a limited time. Play your own way, manage your resources, optimize, automate… while something strange begins to awaken

4614260.title: 魏识的夜晚
4614260.short_description: Wei Shi becomes your reflection in your senior year. Drifting without a fixed self, they set out into oblivion—or piece together fragments of an unfamiliar youth. With your friends, they tend each other's restless hearts and share what it takes to find happiness.

4614430.title: Power Up!
4614430.short_description: Your first office job has one rule: move up by beating your manager at the company’s card game. Explore a strange corporate tower, solve workplace problems through observation and choice, build your deck, and climb floor by floor.

4614490.title: AI VS ARTISTS
4614490.short_description: Prove the power of human artists in this narrative-driven story game! Do you have what it takes to dethrone Scylla Corporation?

4614870.title: Apiary in Flow
4614870.short_description: Apiary in Flow is an incremental game with automation elements where you place bees inside a hive to build efficient honey-gathering chains. Unlock new bee types and spend your harvest on permanent skill tree upgrades!

4614910.title: Sun Catcher
4614910.short_description: Restore damaged stained glass art and immerse yourself in a charming story about lost memories and community in Sun Catcher, a cozy paint-by-numbers tale.

4614970.title: Plink Lab
4614970.short_description: A satisfying active plinko incremental where you drop and bounce fantastic creatures (tiny humans for starters) to clear pegs and earn a trillion $! Wacky balls, massive tech tree, total physics-based chaos, and a very chatty goblin shop owner.

4614990.title: Desert Struggle
4614990.short_description: Desert Struggle is a fast paced real time strategy game. It is about base building, production timing and attack waves. Units are fully automated, so there are no standing armies. It is all about production capacities, expansions and timings! Play challenges against the AI or online in PvP matches.

4615240.title: Little Joe the Dodger
4615240.short_description: A high-difficulty puzzle action game featuring monochrome minimalist graphics and extremely simple controls — you can only jump.

4615330.title: ROBOSCAV
4615330.short_description: ROBOSCAV is a turn-based extraction RPG where you command fully customizable robots into raids. Explore the planet, Scavenge for loot, Fight robots and aliens, Extract. After crash landing on a hostile planet, you must rebuild your spaceship from scratch, to escape.

4615360.title: Redacted by the Sadistic Princess from Another World?!
4615360.short_description: Socially awkward game developer Yaemori Nowa receives more than she bargains for when two characters she created for her indie smash hit eroge, Utter Obedience: Conquered by the Sadistic Princess, appear in her apartment. What's a hopeless lesbian to do?!

4615370.title: Culling Daisies
4615370.short_description: A dark yuri visual novel about a girl so terrified of being alone she will stop at nothing to ensure her loved ones can never leave her.

4615580.title: OVERCHESS
4615580.short_description: You are a pawn in an endless but not always fair chess world. Enslave your enemies and turn them into slaves. Build your own army. On the path to glory you will face alcoholism, alligators and ludomania. Test your luck in OVERCHESS.

4615620.title: Impossible Machine
4615620.short_description: My uncle invented a machine capable of changing the world... and then disappeared. Impossible Machine is a 2.5D point-and-click adventure where you explore, talk to characters, and build solutions as you try to unravel a mystery. No minigames. Lots of terrible jokes. What could possibly go wrong?

4615790.title: Null Signal
4615790.short_description: The machines won. You wake in a forsaken world where you must scavenge, build and explore to survive on your own or with friends. As nature encroaches due to humanity's absence, will you ally with it or use the technology that destroyed us to empower yourself?

4615900.title: Survival Exorcist
4615900.short_description: Survival Exorcist: A solo dev medieval survival horror with 2000s visuals. Board the sacred train and deliver it to the castle to purify ravaged plague lands. Hunt corrupted beasts with your crossbow or use dagger in stealth across diverse environments in this atmospheric experience.

4615910.title: Horde Reapers
4615910.short_description: Face hordes and bosses, solo or in online co-op with up to 4 players. Shape your build with weapons, items, and elemental powers, then bring resources back to rebuild your village and unlock permanent upgrades.

4615970.title: Might of Fate
4615970.short_description: A classic JRPG-style game about the conflict between magic and humanity in a medieval world. Experience Fate's story from his carefree childhood to becoming a powerful warrior. Assemble a party and master the combat stance system to change the fate of the world.

4616210.title: Scarecrow Simulator
4616210.short_description: No swords. No dragons. No heroic destiny. Just you, a scarecrow, standing proudly in a medieval field while the world grows around you. Surprisingly relaxing. Surprisingly addictive.

4616730.title: Supernova Deliveries
4616730.short_description: Haul cargo across a rusty asteroid belt in a duct-taped space truck. Your trailer swings with real zero-g physics, how you pack it moves your centre of mass, pirates want your load and Vito the loan shark wants his money. Don't forget to HONK.

4616970.title: S-Ranker
4616970.short_description: Fight through short dungeons in this action roguelite. Choose new powers in combat, equip runes between runs, and rise from F-Rank to S-Rank.

4617170.title: Broadside Bets
4617170.short_description: Your crew trusts you with their lives... Bad idea. You’re about to wager them on the cards! Collect rule-bending Booty and sail across the sea. Some routes lead to treasure, others lead to a merchant who will try to sell you a cursed map and you’ll probably buy it anyway.

4617220.title: Drained Creatures
4617220.short_description: Drained Creatures is a multiplayer 3D arena brawler for up to 8 players locally, playable using gamepads only.

4617520.title: Diggems
4617520.short_description: Diggems is a first-person incremental mining game. Smash gems into chain reactions, turn the loot into better gear, and watch your Grand Hall fill up as your pets haul it all home.

4617630.title: Tight Tactics
4617630.short_description: Be ready for turn-based combat in this roguelite to kick off with the enemy opening fire on you first, trying to keep you from regrouping, and one bad decision leading to the death of your entire upgraded squad

4617950.title: B面人生：存在的重量 Life:Reboot
4617950.short_description: Step into a narrative-driven social media simulator in a world dominated by one powerful platform. Here, followers are your currency and your life. You had it all—until someone set you up and banned your account for good. Start over. Climb. Be seen. Ultimately, the world's fate is in your hands.

4618110.title: Who's Got the Legs
4618110.short_description: Control a single character together in this chaotic co-op platformer where each player handles a different action. Coordination i key... or everything falls apart

4618320.title: Self-Replication /// Destruction
4618320.short_description: A third-person shooter set in a crumbling megastructure. Fight drones, explore its sectors, and survive in a system that has spiraled out of control.

4618730.title: Mana and Merlin: A Wanderful Adventure
4618730.short_description: Mana & Merlin: A Wanderful Adventure is a 3D open-world platformer filled with fun and exploration, inspired by classics like Banjo-Kazooie. Join Mana on a journey to learn magical abilities and help restore her master to his rightful body.

4618760.title: Moorhaven: Cozy Canal Life
4618760.short_description: Customise a narrowboat, live aboard, and slow right down. Fish, forage, befriend a floating community and build your dream floating home with - one very needy cat along for the ride. A heartwarming life sim about shaping your perfect floating home and community.

4618850.title: Route 340
4618850.short_description: Build your own industrial empire, connect factories, and draw your truck routes by hand. Then get behind the wheel and experience a detailed driving simulation where cargo weight, terrain, and every decision can mean the difference between a successful delivery and ending up stranded in a ditch.

4619020.title: Magical Magic World 2
4619020.short_description: All the main characters are VTubers!! A 2D pixel-art side-scrolling fantasy magical action game starring the VTuber magical girl Kohaku ♪ One year after the previous incident… Kohaku once again races across the world of Magical Magic World!?

4619040.title: Valken
4619040.short_description: VALKEN is a realistic tactical solo shooter where you play as a lone agent infiltrating a secretive military organization. Explore varied environments, make hard choices, and face the brutal consequences in an intense, unforgiving campaign.

4619130.title: Chimaera Evolution
4619130.short_description: Pixel art monster-capture RPG with tactical turn-based combat. Track elusive Shiny Chimaeras, cross-breed perfect genes through egg breeding, and craft survival gear to conquer a vast world. Master evolution and build the ultimate squad.

4619160.title: Dungeons of Delveria
4619160.short_description: A turn-based roguelike where you can shape the dungeon to your advantage. Discover terrain powers which help you to fight your enemies more efficiently.

4619500.title: Kotoha’s Sealed Sword: Hiragana Deckbuilding
4619500.short_description: Learn and master Japanese with Kotoha! Join her as she goes on a mission to find her grandfather's sealed sword. Discover new creatures. Unlock and craft new words, add them to your hand to aid you in battle.

4619600.title: Funny Rummy
4619600.short_description: A Rummy roguelike set in a surreal, hand-drawn world that blends daydream and reality. Visit the Junk Drawer between rounds to bend the rules with wild cards and sub-suits that unlock new strategies. Experiment with new decks and trinkets to build power against ever-increasing scoring goals.

4619810.title: Vatan
4619810.short_description: Vatan is a narrative-focused historical drama set in Sivas in 1892. In young Ahmet's life, caught between family, love, and homeland, every decision you make changes relationships, atmosphere, and the path to the finale; every scene carries an emotional cost

4620000.title: 拉克夏家的女仆
4620000.short_description: 「The Maid of Luxia」is an otome visual novel.Rebirth. Redemption. Rewriting tragedy. Facing the truth of the heart.Experience not only the twisted love of seven masters poured upon you at once, but also a journey of self-growth.

4620100.title: Bad AI
4620100.short_description: Rapid advances in AI have sparked a wave of unemployment—and you are one of those left without a job. Your story begins at a black market, where you meet an outdated AI destined for destruction. Left behind by a changing world, humans and AIs find warmth in one another and slowly become a family.

4620150.title: The Hollow Archive
4620150.short_description: Dive into cursed grimoires in this isometric hack-and-slash roguelike. Chain devastating skill builds, fight through shifting dungeons, and recruit rescued mythic characters to expand your library.

4620680.title: 時折記 -Tokioriki-
4620680.short_description: Every person you choose leaves someone else behind. Spend your limited afternoons building relationships, exploring the town, and recording each day in Kanata’s diary—then face timed Shadow Choices as an old book begins to fracture his ordinary life.

4620760.title: SPLATTER KING
4620760.short_description: Smash through horned demons as you plunge ever downward to save the Queen. The deeper you descend, the deadlier the enemies become. Only those strong enough to survive can reclaim their throne.

4620820.title: Immortal Sect Defend
4620820.short_description: Cultivation meets tower defense. As a core disciple, you are the last line defending the Sect Eye against waves of demonic hordes. Deploy immortal towers and formations, outthink every enemy, then take up your sword to raid secret realms and seize rare treasures. Command the battle—or fight in it.

4620990.title: Digital Civilization: Evolution
4620990.short_description: Build your own empire! Evolve from a primitive civilization and rise to become the strongest and greatest empire of all! Manage resources, construct buildings, and engage in diplomacy with other nations, as you grow your civilization step by step into an unstoppable powerhouse.

4621850.title: Beast Survivor 3D
4621850.short_description: Battle thousands of monsters in this 3D action-survival game. Harness elemental resonance to unleash magic, from ground spikes to celestial meteors. Adapt your evolution mid-combat, using rapid skill combos and domain buffs to reign as the apex predator of this savage world.

4622320.title: Magically Sorted
4622320.short_description: Tidy up a magical shop by sorting scattered potions, ingredients, and books back onto their shelves, uncovering curious lore behind them as you go. Brew potions in the cauldron to unlock magical skills and find lost recipes for legendary potions, while enjoying the shop's relaxing atmosphere.

4622380.title: Idle Mining Manager
4622380.short_description: An idle asteroid mining management simulator. Earn credits and advance through corporate tiers to expand your range of mining tools, policy upgrades and resource efficiency. Unlock the history of interstellar mining since the NofVS and, with a little help, uncover the truth behind the propaganda.

4622430.title: Annexation
4622430.short_description: Annexation is a fast-paced real-time strategy game with old-school roots. Build bases, train armies, and outmaneuver your enemy to claim victory. Start by playing the campaign and then challenge yourself in Arcade Missions, which bring the intensity of multiplayer RTS into a single-player setting.

4622880.title: 疾擎速骋Rapid Engine Speed
4622880.short_description: 《Rapid Engine Speed》 is a realistic motorcycle racing game focused on authentic handling. Ditch the convenience of automatic shifting, and experience the full manual gear-shifting process from pulling the clutch and shifting gears to throttle control.
publishers: 重庆疾擎速骋科技有限公司

4622890.title: Oneiron Expanse
4622890.short_description: Your world is abruptly erased. Only the Oneiron Expanse remains; a Plane where your mental state evokes lethal potential. Embark on a deckbuilding odyssey where every card is a fragment of your will. Find the Dreamwright and dream your reality back into being... before your memories fade

4623140.title: The Landlords
4623140.short_description: A story-driven property-trading board game built on The Landlord's Game, Lizzie Magie's 1904 original. Buy land, charge rent and strike deals with characterful rivals or friends online, under her ruthless Monopolist rules or her Prosperity rules, where everyone can win.

4623540.title: Clickomorph
4623540.short_description: Hover over enemies to kill them... Until you choose an ability! Each new ability offers a new playstyle! Build a small auto clicker army, shoot your enemies as an archer, summon a Soul Reaper to assist you or even play a mini rhythm game! And more!

4623600.title: The Wrong Ones
4623600.short_description: The Wrong Ones is a single-player social deduction game where you study characters dialogue, detect contradictions, and uncover Skinwalkers hiding in plain sight. Analyze each claim carefully and decide who can be trusted before making your final accusation.

4623720.title: HAUL
4623720.short_description: From broke and jobless to full-time flipper — source, clean, and resell your way through thrift stores, blue bins, and sketchy meetups in a small-town hustle sim.

4624030.title: 请在正确答案处咬下
4624030.short_description: When obedient top student Fang Zhu discovers her childhood friend Jiang Xiangyi is secretly a werewolf, she risks her own academic standing to protect him from their suffocating school environment, toxic classmates, and an unfeeling teacher.

4624230.title: Whale Cleaner
4624230.short_description: Take charge of a deep-sea wash station for filthy marine giants! Upgrade bizarre bio-industrial tools to scrub whales, dolphins, sharks and other mysterious beasts. Get them spotless before Mr. Claw docks your pay in this relaxing, atmospheric, and satisfying cleaning simulator. Find hidden secrets!

4624730.title: 阿宅的我被二次元女同事搭讪了！
4624730.short_description: （本作根据真实事件改编）你是一名刚毕业的程序员阿宅，入职第一天就被二次元女同事七海强势搭讪，这位爱捉弄你的可爱坏女人，用各种甜蜜伎俩猛攻你的心房！游戏拥有29个HappyEnd，从嘴硬到心动，你能扛过几轮攻势？宅男与同事的恋爱日常，就这样开始啦！

4624810.title: The Creature Mafia
4624810.short_description: A 1920s Prohibition-era action RPG where you capture creatures to take on the mob! Set in 1926 Kansas City, The Creature Mafia mixes a realistic world with cartoonish creature combat. Your creatures’ lives are in your hands - can you prevail against the full might of the mob?

4624920.title: HYPERDROP: A Pachinko Roguelite
4624920.short_description: Build impossible scoring machines in HYPERDROP, a hypnotizing physics-based pachinko roguelite bursting with satisfying chain reactions and game-breaking combos.

4625750.title: You Are Family
4625750.short_description: You’re looking to disconnect in a secluded country house. A family welcomes you in. Soon, you’ll discover that feeling at home here… may be more real than you imagine.

4625950.title: Miner Shop Simulator
4625950.short_description: Miner Shop Simulator is a hands-on mining and shop management sim. Dig for resources, refine raw ore into valuable goods, stock your shelves, serve customers, and grow a small mining shop into a thriving business.

4626570.title: Fixpert
4626570.short_description: Fixpert is a classic block-pusher style puzzle game. Help the titular Fixpert repair the factory and solve it's many head-scratching brain teasers! Using crates as bridges to cross bodies of water, buttons to open doors and power battery-chargers, managing fires and explosives, AND MORE!

4626720.title: SINEK
4626720.short_description: Sinek is a dark, cinematic adventure game set in a post-apocalyptic bunker, where you guide a swarm of flies to explore a world filled with silent stories of human resilience.

4626950.title: Grow/Tend/Reap
4626950.short_description: Every seed you plant removes a card from your deck. Every harvest brings it back. Your farm IS your deck. Grow crops. Tend fields. Reap what you sow.

4627310.title: KONBOYS
4627310.short_description: Co-op for up to 4 players. Drive through a dark and mysterious island filled with mutations created by Mycel Corp, navigate using your vehicle’s analog controls, search for the lost complex, and recover the forgotten cargo to sell it and upgrade your gear.

4627520.title: Smoke Easy: Hookah Lounge Simulator
4627520.short_description: Run your own hookah lounge! Seat guests, pack the bowl, keep the coals burning, put out fires (literally) and grow your business from a tiny spot to a place worth staying for.

4627540.title: Kinetic Conundrum
4627540.short_description: What if Rube Goldberg machine was a game? Kinetic Conundrum is a casual puzzle-platformer where you use a cue ball to wrangle target balls through a puzzle and use physics-inspired machines to overcome obstacles.

4627770.title: DOOMFRONT
4627770.short_description: Ever wonder what happens when you mix high-octane progression and a rogue-lite dungeon-crawler? Well I did, and you're about to find out. Travel from room to room at extreme speeds fighting and looting any foe who dares to stop you in your tracks.

4627900.title: Pinfinity - Incremental Pinball
4627900.short_description: Combine classic pinball physics with addictive incremental progression! Place bumpers, unlock massive skill trees, and watch your score skyrocket into the millions!

4628030.title: Tinplate Scramble
4628030.short_description: Two factions battle across land and sky in Tinplate Scramble. Win firefights and melees on foot, pilot a fighter or hovercraft into the fray, and tip the scales in open skirmishes and handcrafted missions involving 100+ fielded units.

4628120.title: Skymote
4628120.short_description: A tower defence deckbuilder with roguelike elements. Build a deck, raise towers, cast spells, and discover unexpected synergies to turn your floating island into a fortress the sky can't break.

4628560.title: What The Dog Doing?
4628560.short_description: A relaxing idle digging game that sits at the corner of your screen. Work (or don't) while your best friend digs for items, collects treasures and unlocks new biomes and outfits.

4628630.title: Vertical Momentum Revival
4628630.short_description: Engage in fast paced vertical PVP combat. Jump straight into the action on the rooftops, or flank your enemy through the alleyways below. Choose from a variety of movement abilities to compliment your playstyle. Play any existing maps, or create your own!

4628700.title: Renegade Run
4628700.short_description: Renegade Run is an immersive deckbuilder that puts you in the pilot seat of an experimental starship. Discover anomalies, carve your path, and face powerful enemies as you battle your way back to Sector 0.

4628970.title: Bullet Beast
4628970.short_description: A 3D movement based bullet hell where you swing, dash and use beast powers to survive swarms of enemies.

4629660.title: HellFactory Inc.
4629660.short_description: Run a factory in Hell. Automate production lines, hit monthly revenue targets, bribe the board of Seven Deadly Sins, and skim slush funds to seize control — before they terminate you. A roguelike fusion of factory automation and boardroom politics.

4629700.title: Kuiper Wanderer
4629700.short_description: Kuiper Wanderer is a 2D top-down space sandbox RPG. Command and deeply customize your ships and mechs, recruit a diverse crew, and freely explore, scavenge, or fight in a dynamically evolving universe. Experience highly freeform emergent gameplay wrapped in a classic retro sci-fi aesthetic.

4629850.title: Project ACCIPITER
4629850.short_description: "We’re elite, undefeated, and ready for anything. But UOOHHH~ zombies?! Nobody trained us for this!" Join Squad ACCIPITER in their story and face the chaos in this isometric zombie apocalypse!

4629920.title: Backrooms: Echo
4629920.short_description: The next level of Backrooms games. Co-op for 1–4 players. Procedurally generated levels, terrifying entities, and a realistic atmosphere. Every playthrough is a unique experience. Try to find the way out, but don’t trust everything you hear and see.

4630010.title: Goblin Kaboom
4630010.short_description: A fast-paced casual auto battler. Raise your army, fortify your base and watch invading monsters splatter upon your defenses.

4630150.title: The Life You Missed
4630150.short_description: The Life You Missed — you achieved success, but lost yourself along the way. In an old house, you uncover someone else’s life — and your own. Relive memories and face choices in your dreams. Every decision shapes the ending.

4630240.title: Co-Ed Casualty: A Chandler Chase Case
4630240.short_description: Spring break at Briarwood College turns lethal when a student is found dead on campus. Journalism major Chandler Chase finds himself caught in a murder investigation he never asked to be part of. Interrogate suspects, solve puzzles, and unravel a conspiracy someone is desperate to keep hidden.

4630600.title: Saviour & Religion
4630600.short_description: With no memory of who he is, he awakens in a dark dungeon. Twisted patients, a doctor with unknown motives, deadly trap hidden within ancient halls, and a disturbing cult devoted to an unseen god… A story of wishes, religion, reality and illusion—and salvation.
publishers: 萊斯特的帽子 Lester's cap

4630680.title: PAWSTRONAUTS
4630680.short_description: A co-op pixel art platformer about 10 animal astronauts crash-landed on a hostile alien planet. Every character is a life. Stomp, grab, and throw enemies through 6 worlds and epic boss fights. Play solo or with a friend in local co-op.

4630710.title: Backrooms: Impending Doom
4630710.short_description: The research team is gone. You're next. A first-person psychological horror in the Backrooms - explore ruined levels, keep your Synchronization steady, and uncover what destroyed your research team. Free demo: the Prologue.

4630920.title: OMG: Oh My Gravity
4630920.short_description: Space cleanup is funnier with friends! A 3-4 player first-person co-op physics puzzler: fire a gravity round to open a gravity well, then pull, push, and fling junk across the test site. Fair warning: gravity wells can't tell trash from teammates. Online and local co-op with voice chat and pings.

4631090.title: Doctor Kairokos
4631090.short_description: Play as scientist Doctor Kairokos, use a time machine remote controller and find your missing assistant in this 3D adventure game.

4631120.title: Dead Hand
4631120.short_description: A post-apocalyptic roguelike deckbuilder where your cards are both your actions and your resources. Play them to act now, keep them to last longer. There is never enough for both.

4631260.title: Slay the GoblinZ
4631260.short_description: The Princess has been kidnapped! Play as a knight hired to rescue Her Highness in this short fantasy incremental game. Craft unique equipment, experiment with deadly builds, and unlock dozens of powerful upgrades.

4631520.title: Pump Away!
4631520.short_description: A railroad adventure that sits at the bottom of your screen! Click to make the car go brrr or let it idle - this cat and dog duo will pump away and liven up your desktop.

4631570.title: Drawn into Darkness
4631570.short_description: Drawn into Darkness will have you Descend the Depths in this Deckbuilding, Dungeoncrawler, Roguelite with over 200 Cards, 200 Enemies, and 100 Floors of pure RNG Goodness. What path will you take, hmm, Hero?

4631860.title: The HOUSE
4631860.short_description: Inspired by Balatro and Vampire Survivors. In every casino game, the house always wins. In The HOUSE, you are the casino. A NY mob family runs the most crooked casino in Vegas — and you're their engineer. Rig the machines, break the odds, and launder a fortune one gloriously broken payout at a time.

4632490.title: 紀事盆栽 Potted Archive
4632490.short_description: Potted Archive is an idle desktop companion blending sci-fi storytelling with plant cultivation. Grow over 20 exotic plants in a transparent, low-energy window. As they evolve, unlock diary entries to uncover an epic tale of interstellar exile right from your screen.

4632560.title: KILLWORLD
