4632560.short_description: [KILLWORLD] is an open-world first-person shooter. Explore the territory, raid enemy outposts, battle armed patrols, use vehicles, discover secret locations, and choose your own combat style in a sandbox where freedom of action and dynamic gameplay are paramount.

4633650.title: Cluckin' Crash
4633650.short_description: Cluckin’ Crash is an asymmetrical multiplayer party game where a chicken sprints through wild platform courses while a driver tries to crash, ram, and knock it off the map. Fast-paced best-of-five rounds create unpredictable physics chaos.

4633810.title: Pitstop Panic
4633810.short_description: Pitstop Panic is a co-op pit crew game where teamwork breaks down under pressure. Work together to repair, refuel, and get the car back on track, but mistakes, distractions, and poor timing quickly turn simple pit stops into chaos.

4634610.title: Malk
4634610.short_description: You are Malk. You survived where you were meant to die. And now you are paying for it. Fanatics are hunting you. Aristocrats are playing with your life. And power is your only chance not to become dirt beneath someone else’s boots. Allies betray you. Patrons use you. No one gets a second chance.

4634840.title: Judicial Designer
4634840.short_description: A management and tycoon game where you build and manage a courthouse. From a small-town traffic court to handling high-profile criminal cases. Build your courthouse, hire and manage staff, schedule cases and balance the pressures of efficiency and reputation.

4635010.title: Dead Saints Parade
4635010.short_description: A third-person stealth immersive sim about a spy in a corrupt cathedral. Learn the patrols, put out candles to hide in the dark, pick locks and read what the clergy leave lying around. Three hits kill you, so what you know keeps you alive.

4635160.title: Dawn's Wake
4635160.short_description: Awaken as a memory-stripped supreme master in a twisted jianghu. Shatter the world's cursed formations, master strategic wuxia combat where one right technique turns the tide, and reclaim your lost throne — while idle progress and a living martial world carry on even when your sword rests.

4635550.title: SHAHED
4635550.short_description: A realistic single-player FPS set in a war-torn Middle Eastern city. Fight as a resistance fighter, ambush enemy forces, target military vehicles, and survive brutal urban combat.

4635800.title: Dronefall
4635800.short_description: Dronefall is a deck-building tower defense game where you defend humanity's last cities against relentless drone swarms.

4635820.title: YO UP!
4635820.short_description: YO UP! is a chaotic co-op physics building game where one wrong move can collapse everything. Build unstable towers solo or with friends, climb floating islands, and reach for space... if your tower holds.

4636060.title: 歴史年号1000個覚えるまで出られないダンジョン
4636060.short_description: An RPG where you climb into the past, aiming for the summit of historical date memorization.

4636160.title: Rowan Needs Shinies!
4636160.short_description: [NO AI] A whimsical incremental game with a colorful cast of critters. Help the greedy crow Rowan gather more shinies with the help of the local wildlife. Discover how to craft strange potions and empower your new friends. All so that you can gather EVEN MORE SHINIES!

4636440.title: Fractal Flyers
4636440.short_description: Fractal Flyers let's you fly through Real-Time 3D fractals using FPV drone controls (or traditional winged controls) — Lose yourself in the music across multiple hand-animated challenge levels and soar through the leader-boards.

4636640.title: increTower
4636640.short_description: A short incremental tower defense game. Upgrade your tower, upgrade your enemies, repeat!

4636700.title: Fishing Fever
4636700.short_description: An incremental roguelike fishing game. Start with one tool, end with five. Draft, upgrade and stack them, then hunt 75 species across eight oceans until the whole sea is biting at once. Rivals steal your cards. Something in the dark already knows your name. One more round. Always one more round.

4636740.title: Meteor Shower
4636740.short_description: Blast away never-ending hordes of falling meteors in this incremental tower defense game! Smash rocks to pieces with railguns, flak cannons, giant lasers and more as you work to defend your base from the stellar onslaught.

4636750.title: Loot The World: Three Kings
4636750.short_description: An infinite procedural RPG. Explore a dangerous world, roll the dice in combat, loot everything, and hunt down the Three Kings.

4636810.title: What Was Lost
4636810.short_description: A two-player online co-op puzzle game. One of you plays Ben in the family house as it was, the other plays Lily in the same house years later. You can only see your own timeline, so you solve it by talking. Chapters 1 to 4 in Early Access, with Chapters 5 to 7 coming in free updates.

4636850.title: Celestial Temple
4636850.short_description: Celestial Temple is a narrative action-adventure game from Ursa Majeur. Become Curiosity, uncover who and where you are, and journey through a dreamlike mythic odyssey across ages, facing enemies with your own face while seeking a sliver of light in self-made darkness.

4637490.title: The Line Must Not Stop
4637490.short_description: Take control of a crumbling metro line in a cyberpunk world. Transport passengers, build and upgrade your trains, enhance your systems, and complete various missions. Fight off threats, automate transit, and bring THE LINE back to life!

4637680.title: Index 1391
4637680.short_description: In this techno-gothic roguelike deckbuilder, journey to the heart of a twisted Sanctum to destroy the VIRUS infecting your faith. Wield sacred cards to defeat corrupted foes, build a powerful deck, and equip rule-altering Doctrines that reshape the rules of combat.

4637880.title: Loaded Dice
4637880.short_description: A dice-driven roguelike where you build an unpredictable deck, chain devastating charms, and roll massive Yatzy combos to hit the target score before your luck finally runs out.

4638050.title: Fates of Command
4638050.short_description: Shields up, red alert! YOU are the captain. Experience the thrill of command in this captain's chair roguelike: engage in combat, manage your crew, upgrade your ship, explore, make scientific discoveries and perform a dash of diplomacy.

4638060.title: Rogues & Fate
4638060.short_description: A fast-paced two-hero inventory management roguelike. Assemble your inventory and crush bizarre creatures. Break the game with thousands of insane builds to defeat the Fate King in this RPG auto battler.

4638280.title: Peter the Stash Hunter
4638280.short_description: A business sim + looting + strategy hybrid. Outbid rival hunters at storage auctions, ransack what you win, then run the shop that bankrolls Peter's search for his missing grandfather. Sabotage cards, Dutch vs English bidding, harpoon chases. Every box could hide a secret.

4638290.title: Card of Fate
4638290.short_description: Card of Fate is a roguelike deckbuilder where you wander the path to Heaven or Hell. Construct a powerful deck, find legendary relics, and defeat the guardians of the afterlife. Will you master the celestial arts of the Angel or the devastating fury of the Demon?

4638520.title: THE OMEGA REACH
4638520.short_description: Reach for the stars, gather their instruments, and curate the best collection in the universe! THE OMEGA REACH is a point-and-click museum simulator (and dungeon crawler) where you are a musical genius.

4638780.title: XENOFALL
4638780.short_description: A single-player anime action roguelite on a ravaged Earth. Slash and shoot through alien horrors across hostile stages, stack game-breaking item synergies, and master 5 fighter classes. Every run is different. Every death makes you stronger.

4638820.title: Contested Space
4638820.short_description: A space roguelike deckbuilder for solo or 2-4 player co-op. Command one of nine factions, deploy stations, and buy new cards mid-fight from a rotating market that reshapes your deck every combat. Build your fleet and conquer Contested Space.

4639150.title: Magic Animal TD
4639150.short_description: A cozy, tower defense adventure. Command two unique heroes and deploy a quirky squad of magical animals—like a pig, butterfly, and snail! Customize your defenders with powerful magic crystals to maximize their combat potential and repel enemies across vibrant worlds.

4639710.title: Steel Horse
4639710.short_description: Muster your knights, call upon your champions, bring forth your... M4A4 Sherman? Steel Horse is an atypical fantasy turn-based strategy game. Take control of Samuel and Andrew, two tankers from the far future of 2025 summoned to this world to save it from its own rabid wild taken form!

4639920.title: Ghostorio
4639920.short_description: Build automated factories in a bright afterlife. Mine, belt, power, and produce at massive scale, then defend your work from the spirits it attracts. A third-person factory game of automation, base building, and tower defense.

4641210.title: Get-Out-Hoomanz
4641210.short_description: A chaotic 2-4 player dungeon crawler! Sabotage your friends' dungeons with deadly traps, loot everything in sight, and escape the show alive. Can you survive your friends' hazards or just another human snack?

4641230.title: Guardians of the Abyss: Rogue Protocol
4641230.short_description: Fast-paced roguelite where you switch combat styles mid-fight, destroy the world around you, and survive an ever-escalating challenge. Adapt, master your skills, and push your limits as each run becomes faster, deadlier, and more unforgiving.

4641260.title: All Night Ascension
4641260.short_description: A cultivation backpack auto-battler built on a three-layer Bagua board. Arrange methods, artifacts, and materials to unleash flying swords and cannons, ascend through realms, and time your Domain to turn asynchronous duels. Try the free demo—three sects planned for Early Access.

4641320.title: Don't Touch The Rocks
4641320.short_description: Don’t Touch The Rocks is a fast and punishing, incremental bullet hell. In DTTR, no ship flies alone. When one ship goes down, the next one tags in. Shoot, dodge, accidentally touch rock and break ship, repeat.

4641440.title: SKY DRIFT
4641440.short_description: Cute but challenging roguelite platformer-inspired game where you fly through a strange oversized world with a broken rocket and limited fuel. Avoid deadly obstacles, collect gems, and upgrade after every crash. No checkpoints. Start over and fly further.

4641550.title: Kegs of Eternity
4641550.short_description: A roguelite deckbuilder starring seven stubborn dwarves. Build unique decks, slay cursed monsters, crawl procedural dungeons, drink plenty of beer, find broken synergies, and rebuild your ruined town, one keg, one combo, one dwarf at a time.

4641640.title: Only Humans On Board
4641640.short_description: Buy supplies and manage your resources. Serve passengers quickly from your trolley, but stay alert! something feels wrong. Some passengers are only pretending to be human...

4642050.title: Infogrind
4642050.short_description: Manage a bank of supernatural artifacts and secret information in a cyberpunk future. Solve mysteries in this new reality, explore the world, navigate the balance between influential corporations that want to rule this new world!

4642080.title: Varren's Expanse
4642080.short_description: Explore the wilderness using mice and badger legionnaires, rabbit scouts, and squirrel skirmishers. Every round builds your strength, every round brings new challenges, every round is a fresh expanse!

4642380.title: Nothing Ever Happens Here
4642380.short_description: A British life sim set in a real town, with a real Grandad at its core. Can you turn your life around, save his pub, and make something of yourself?

4642410.title: The Outpost: Outer Frontier
4642410.short_description: Lead the forces of a human empire in a brutal squad-based RTS. Capture territory, fortify the frontier and crush the alien swarm in a story campaign, survival operations or online co-op for up to four players.

4642670.title: 超时空怪盗
4642670.short_description: 是架空世界冒险喜剧！！！你将化身一位土著人，与一位来自20年后的少女一起组成跨时空搭档，前往未来世界冒险并搜集传说中能改变一切的宝物！本作是一款搞笑游戏，目的就是逗笑你让你开心！因此在冒险过程中，你会遇到各种各样让人啼笑皆非的事。 千万不要在喝水的时候游玩本作哦！不然你就………………不渴了呢……

4642770.title: Rock Diver
4642770.short_description: Become a Rock Diver as you travel across alien worlds, extract valuable minerals, upgrade your gear, and get nice and friendly with hordes of local wildlife.

4643060.title: Keeper of The Strait
4643060.short_description: You are the gatekeeper of a vital strait. Inspect manifests, collect fees, and block hostile ships in this hybrid of bureaucratic simulation and tower defense. When diplomacy fails, deploy tanks and bunkers to protect your base.

4643500.title: Rex Summons a Meteor
4643500.short_description: A short game about a large rock. You helped a wizard wish on a shooting star, and got a meteor instead. Every dinosaur talks in emoji: work out what each one wants, find it, and play absurd mini-games like skateboarding and rhythm duets. No timer, no game over. Now go save the dinosaurs.

4643870.title: Death Line: Don’t Stop 斩杀线：极限生机
4643870.short_description: If life’s pressure were a physical shredder, could you outrun it? > Balance Health and Wealth on a razor’s edge in this minimalist survival-gambit. Utilize "Class-based Speed" to outsmart Death. Can you tear through the veil and reveal the truth behind the machine before your strength fails?

4644750.title: Veil of the Black Ark
4644750.short_description: A classic fixed-camera survival horror game set in a cursed medieval town. Search for your missing sister, solve puzzles, survive the roaming dead and unveil the secrets of the Black Ark.

4644890.title: BODY COUNT
4644890.short_description: Drive to catch bodies, crash to rewind time. Road rage at your past selves in this physics-driven, arcade-style game!

4645020.title: SpringTale
4645020.short_description: Explore, fight and play together in a roguelike platformer MMO. Adventure through changing worlds, meet other players along the way and team up to take on challenging bosses. Collect powerful gear that shapes how you play.

4645670.title: one more bottle
4645670.short_description: In ONE MORE BOTTLE, every cap you twist off hides a tiny puzzle, a prize, or a wish. Collect caps, build your shelf, and chase the rare one stamped 再来一瓶 — One More Bottle. A cozy solo puzzle-meets-gacha about luck, patience, and the hope that the next one will be the lucky one.

4646010.title: Bot.by.Bot
4646010.short_description: Build and program customizable robots using simple logic systems to overcome clever grid-based challenges and help Robby reunite with his friends.

4646640.title: Capitol Diktatoria
4646640.short_description: In an authoritarian state obsessed with art, work for the Eye of the Network. Run your restaurant, survive rising inflation, outbid rival factions, and collect the most historical art to place your men in the Inner Party and install your candidate as leader.

4646740.title: Our Will
4646740.short_description: You are Astrid, a young girl tasked with leading a small company of warriors into an unknown and mystical land, in search of a cure to save your village. Be ready to face forces beyond human comprehension, titanic beasts and perhaps even the Gods themselves.

4647160.title: Raze The Realm
4647160.short_description: Lead massive armies in large-scale battles in this real-time tactics roguelite. Build your army, discover powerful relic synergies, and choose your path through a realm that grows more dangerous with every victory.

4649990.title: Floraison
4649990.short_description: Floraison is a cozy narrative game based on the language of flowers. Explore Heimat, meet its curious inhabitants, gather rare plants, and craft emotionally powerful bouquets to help them, shape the story, and convey the message of your choice.

4650100.title: 幽囚の魔法使い
4650100.short_description: “The Imprisoned Magician” is a fantasy BL visual novel that explores the bond between master and apprentice. Aim to become a fully-fledged magician under the tutelage of a master with a troubled past.

4651670.title: Polyzonia
4651670.short_description: An ecosystem sim set in the Amazon rainforest. Grow plants, create habitats for animals, and click to hunt prey, pollinate flowers, eat fruit, and poop to spread seeds. Unlock automation and make the rainforest grow and thrive on its own.

4651710.title: IN:DARK RECALL
4651710.short_description: "I'm sure you'll find me." IN:DARK RECALL is a deep sea diving action game. You wake up at the bottom of the sea, as the target you'd been hired to eliminate.

4651810.title: Adventures in tower defence land
4651810.short_description: Go on an epic tower defence adventure, collect rare parts, and craft the ultimate combination of towers, while meeting silly characters on your way.

4651980.title: Grot
4651980.short_description: Leap in and out of your mine cart hat to survive deadly, ever-changing caves in this precision platformer. Steal powerful gems and push deeper into a mysterious loop.

4652050.title: Gunshot Arcade
4652050.short_description: Gunshot Arcade combines the action of a classic arcade shoot 'em up with the meta-progression of a roguelike. Buy some weapons, upgrade your gear and survive as long as you can. Unlock much stronger guns from wave to wave and reach a new record, good luck.

4652090.title: ホワイトノウェイ（Stay on the white lines）
4652090.short_description: One day after school, a boy walks home along a white line. His curfew is 5:00 p.m. The white line is filled with treasures that spark his imagination, turning the walk home into an adventure. Become that boy and journey through Hakusen, the childhood sanctuary where imagination comes to life.

4652140.title: Dice Shepherd: Incremental
4652140.short_description: A small incremental game about rolling d4 to d100 dice on a grassy field. Every roll pays gold and fodder. Spend it on promotions and skills that sinergize. Play it idle or hands-on, the numbers keep climbing.

4652160.title: Citizen Pain II
4652160.short_description: Citizen Pain II is a unique old-school first-person action RPG experience featuring insane challenge, fast gameplay intensity and instantly rewarding combat. Begin a dark journey and experience secret dungeons, hidden hazards and terrifyng enemy encounters.

4652840.title: Waddle Detour
4652840.short_description: Help Waddly, a very likeable penguin, reach his fishing spot in a deceptively cute but seriously challenging puzzle game. Combine blocks, harness their unique abilities, and find your very own solution so Waddly doesn't stay hungry for much longer!

4653140.title: The Back Door: Emergence
4653140.short_description: It's 2015. While urban exploring an abandoned building with your friends, you lose sight of them. Suddenly, you end up in a strange place consisting only of abnormal spaces and places that seem... strangely familiar. Is this all there is? Or most importantly... are you truly alone?

4653250.title: Cats And Pillows
4653250.short_description: Run a cozy cat shelter where every whiskered guest has their own needs! Place shy cats in quiet corners, sleepy cats on soft pillows, playful cats near fun spots, and stinky cats away from sensitive noses. Each level brings a new cozy setting and a fresh puzzle full of picky little paws.

4653490.title: BRO GHOST
4653490.short_description: When you die, you don't leave the game. You become one of the deadliest things in it. A co-op horror for 4 players — return as a spirit, help your friends, or haunt them until they break.

4653530.title: Red Rising
4653530.short_description: Fight for dominance with up to 6 players in the official digital adaptation of the award-winning board game. Assemble a hand of followers, chain together powerful combos, and lead your house to victory in this clash of cards set in the dystopian world of Red Rising.

4653750.title: The Brave Few
4653750.short_description: The Brave Few is a combined arms WWII combat game. Experience historically based perspectives during major operations of World War II, from one of the brave few that fought in combat during World War II.

4653860.title: Hollow Crown
4653860.short_description: Hollow Crown is a dark idle-incremental autobattler that casts you as an ascendant claimant to a ruined throne. Assemble a court of cursed champions, relics, and sigils; set their decks, assign passive roles, and watch the spire’s floors unspool as automated skirmishes resolve

4654240.title: Beyond The Blight
4654240.short_description: A short first person, 2.5d incremental dungeon-crawler where you loot, upgrade, and grow stronger on the quest to find and defeat the source of the blight.

4654450.title: SOS! Love~Controlled
4654450.short_description: [SOS! Love~Controlled] is a live-action interactive romance game. You wander into a bar called "SOS" and meet three girls: Hiyori, a rich closet otaku; Naomi, the gentle yet dangerous owner; and Ruina, a withdrawn lolita. A casual night out slowly turns into something far more mysterious.

4654850.title: Deckrage
4654850.short_description: A grim single-player card-based tactical RPG where you assemble a party of four heroes, chart dangerous expeditions, and survive brutal battles by managing formation, stress, and resources.

4654980.title: Bio-Breaker
4654980.short_description: Fight against over 30+ different types of enemies in my super epic top-down retro wave shooter; Bio-Breaker! Buy weapons to upgrade, active abilities and passive perks to survive against the hordes!

4654990.title: Not a Trolley Problem!
4654990.short_description: A trolley-problem incremental where morals gave way to growing numbers. Instead of choosing whom to save, you throw people onto the tracks yourself, earn coins, grow an upgrade tree and hunt for rare residents.

4655010.title: Digi Dice
4655010.short_description: A rogue-like dice-building game. Craft your own dice, play them strategically, upgrade your modifiers and discover magnificent combos.

4655030.title: Legend of Gaia: Rebirth
4655030.short_description: Legend of Gaia: Rebirth is a 2D side-scrolling action-adventure. Journey across the Eternal Continent, where the Theocracy, Gaia faction, and forces of Sin struggle for power. Explore dangerous regions, battle powerful enemies, and collect the scattered fragments of the Rebirth Relic.

4655060.title: Super Galaxy Gladiator
4655060.short_description: Super Galaxy Gladiator is a survivor roguelite focused on buildcrafting and inventory management. Fight waves of enemies, buy and upgrade items mid-run, and arrange your gear to create insane builds and synergies in the galactic arena.

4655290.title: School Owner Simulator
4655290.short_description: Build and run a secondary school from scratch. Plan classrooms and facilities, manage staff and daily schedules, support student development, and improve your school through stronger performance, better results, and growing reputation.

4655750.title: Trucker: Master Drivers
4655750.short_description: Experience the realistic truck driving experience in Türkiye, and start your journey to becoming MASTER DRIVERS through realistic vehicle breakdowns and road experiences.

4655890.title: The Park Keeper
4655890.short_description: Become a ranger in a national park where people have doubles. Check visitors, explore the forest, and help its strange inhabitants. A copy might be better than the original. But does that give it the right to take their place?

4656220.title: Haunted Uni Love
4656220.short_description: Romance × Mystery × Ghost Story The heroine, who has just stepped into university life, never imagined she would soon find herself in a bizarre yet sweet campus life. With a series of haunting events happening, the heroine holds the key to solving everything.

4656770.title: Mobius
4656770.short_description: If space has no end, where is the exit? Mobius is a gravity-flipping puzzle-platformer set in a looping realm. Cross screen edges to invert gravity and find hidden paths in symmetrical spaces. Solve physical puzzles to reach the mysterious door—what secrets await on the other side?

4656800.title: Yani Again
4656800.short_description: Yani Again is a high-speed action game. Shift between reality and cyberspace, explore dangerous tracks hidden across the world, and overcome every challenge at extreme speed.

4656880.title: PATIENCE IS A VIRTUE
4656880.short_description: Something's hiding in the cassette. Rearrange the words of your enemies to investigate a small-town conspiracy in this mystery puzzle game.

4656910.title: 薪世录
4656910.short_description: Xin Shi Lu is a thrilling action-adventure RPG. Meet Fan Xin and start a new life. Explore a mysterious world, grow stronger in combat, and forge bonds with companions. Expand your influence and define your own legendary story.

4657330.title: Money Trees
4657330.short_description: Punch trees, deposit coins, and buy upgrades until you're harvesting millions from this fortuitous world. But how much can you earn before your time is up...?

4657720.title: Clickerite
4657720.short_description: Clickerite is an incremental mining game where you must collect materials, craft powerful tools, and battle evil monsters in a cube-dimensional world!

4657730.title: Grandpa Needs Fish
4657730.short_description: Grandpa Needs Fish is a cozy idle clicker game where fortune rides the waves. You are Abraham and you have one mission: catch as many fish as possible. Every cast brings new rewards and every upgrade makes you stronger. Hover, catch, upgrade, and repeat in this satisfying idle incremental adventure.

4657840.title: PolyFarm
4657840.short_description: PolyFarm is a relaxing and satisfying farm simulator in isometric view.

4657860.title: GranEndeSaga
4657860.short_description: Find the legendary hero Neo and reclaim your identity!

4657890.title: Destroy The Moon
4657890.short_description: A cosmic survivors-like where every upgrade brings you closer to becoming a living superweapon. Burn through alien hordes, rupture pocket dimensions, escape black holes, and survive the cosmic war for the Moon.

4657970.title: Nonsense Football Club
4657970.short_description: Nonsense Football Club is a 3D action football game where core football fundamentals become combat mechanics! Master the timing of slide tackles, precision passing, and skill moves to defeat defeat unconventional teams like robots, fantastical creatures, and insane bosses!

4658040.title: The Sons of Earth
4658040.short_description: An asymmetric hex wargame about occupation and insurgency. Command the alien Verkhan Empire pacifying a human world — or the fractured Sons of Earth fighting to reclaim it.

4658160.title: Reach The Banana
4658160.short_description: A chaotic two-player climbing game where you control one monkey together, one arm each, and battle physics, panic, terrible coordination, mistimed grabs, desperate recoveries, and an endless chain of bad decisions on every climb.

4658480.title: Chromagami
4658480.short_description: Rip and tear through the competition in Chromagami, an interdimensional, fast-paced, handmade (literally) hero shooter. With 3 distinct origami characters, paper-built maps, and a boxload full of wacky events, learn to outfold both your friends and foes by putting them through the shredder!

4658550.title: ALL GAS
4658550.short_description: ALL GAS is an endless traffic-weaving roguelike experience on a highway that crumbles behind you as you drive. Upgrade your vehicle and modify your environment in real-time as you weave through traffic. Find your line, stay in the flow, and earn your spot on the global leaderboards.

4659110.title: AllWheelDrive
4659110.short_description: Drive a single vehicle together, literally. In this chaotic co-op experience, gather up to four friends and share the every control of a single RV or, drive in chaos. Coordinate, argue, and try to stay on the road as things quickly spiral out of control. Fullfill your grandpa's last wish.

4659180.title: sh2dow cat
4659180.short_description: A feline game of light and shadow! sh2dow cat is a puzzle platformer that combines two 2D perspectives. Switch between a physical white cat and a shadow cat, and use the light to find your way through the levels.

4659840.title: Fantasy Weaponsmith Simulator
4659840.short_description: Become a master weaponsmith in this fantasy simulator! Combine unique parts, materials, and effects to craft countless types of weaponry. Haggle with customers, fulfill orders from across the realm, and build and decorate your dream medieval weapons shop!

4660070.title: Destructor2D
4660070.short_description: 2D racing sim with soft-body physics, car deformations, highway driving, demolition derby, professional racing, crash racing, drifting, truck racing, open wheel racing, advanced AI with up to 50 cars on track, and more.

4660170.title: Witch Shop Simulator
4660170.short_description: Step behind the counter of your very own sorcery shop. Witch Shop Simulator is a cozy first-person shop management game where you invent and brew custom potions, manage your stock, and keep your shelves full of magical wonders for customers to buy.

4660190.title: ZAIBALY
4660190.short_description: Horror-comedy boomer shooter, fantastic reimagining of a real-life experience of living under the constant threat of aerial assault

4660480.title: The Plus-One Kingdom
4660480.short_description: In The Plus One Kingdom, you are the ruler of a fragile, crumbling domain. Time is relentless—1 real-world second equals 1 in-game day. Seasons change every 90 seconds. Winter is approaching, and if you’re unprepared, everyone will perish.

4660540.title: Bloody Cleanup TOGETHER
4660540.short_description: Clean up the aftermath of terrible events in Bloody Cleanup Together, a co-op horror cleaning sim for up to 4 players. Remove blood, hide evidence, carry bodies, and restore every detail before anything is discovered.

4660800.title: Blooming Canvas
4660800.short_description: This is a visual novel game themed around "painting" and "romance." The story begins with a mysterious girl and her damaged painting. As the art exhibition approaches, you will build a bond with the girl, complete her commission, and uncover the truth behind the painting.

4660870.title: DarkCage
4660870.short_description: DarkCage is a mystery escape-room adventure where you must solve puzzles and gather clues alongside others trapped in an unfamiliar place. Only by uncovering the truth can you hope to escape.

4661090.title: Inn Kreeper
4661090.short_description: Run a spooky-cozy haunted inn as a broke lich, stress out your guests, trap them in rooms to turn them into ghost, and sell them online to rebuild your retro game collection.

4661190.title: INTERRED
4661190.short_description: He never blinks. You wake up across from a presence in a room with no exit. Play a distorted, stat-based strategy gamble on a 5x5 grid. Draw from the chest, upgrade your stones, and outsmart an opponent who learns from your fear. Every move is a sacrifice. Don't keep Him waiting.

4661790.title: 结界大阵：生灵庇护所 Warding Sanctum: Creature Refuge
4661790.short_description: A strategy game blending Xianxia (cultivation) elements with tower defense and settlement-building mechanics. Recruit and cultivate creatures, fuse them into formations, repel demon invasions from the outside world, and build your Creature Sanctuary.

4661890.title: Hexstride
4661890.short_description: Movement is combat. No attack button. Your positioning and movement patterns trigger abilities automatically. Choose your class, complete objectives, and descend deeper into procedurally generated dungeons. Every step is a tactical decision.

4661960.title: Escape to Ariah
4661960.short_description: Master deep skill trees, forge god-tier gear, and carve through relentless hordes in this dark fantasy ARPG. Endless build variety, thrilling boss fights, and endgame adventures await you.

4662040.title: Island Wolves
4662040.short_description: You are a wolf. Hunt prey and gather materials to build your camp, decorate your den and grow your pack. Fight off rival wolves or avoid combat altogether by using the environment to your advantage. Explore the islands and discover the truth behind the lost packs.

4662140.title: Goodnight, B
4662140.short_description: Goodnight, B is a single-player 2D puzzle-platformer about a little girl struggling with nightmares. Rotate and place sections of each level to complete them. Explore weird, dream-like environments, meet wacky friends, and find secrets to help B discover the ominous truth behind her nightmares!

4662150.title: We Die Below
4662150.short_description: 1–4 player co-op dungeon crawler. Choose your class and gear! Fight through procedural dungeons, complete objectives, and outrun the horrors you awaken. Deep combat. High stakes. Permadeath if your party falls.

4662350.title: Chess 2
4662350.short_description: Chess 2 combines chess-like tactics with territory control, economy, diplomacy, and special units. Expand across the map, build your position, and outplay opponents in singleplayer or multiplayer.

4662390.title: RogueBlocks
4662390.short_description: Stack Rows. Beat the Target. Survive the Chaos. RogueBlocks is a comic-inspired roguelite puzzle game that challenges the familiar rules of falling-block games. How far can you push your luck?

4662400.title: Crimson Monarch
4662400.short_description: The old Monarch is dead. Long live the Monarch. Rule over five vampire factions, forge alliances, and decide who lives or dies. Protect the Veil of secrecy or let it burn. Every judgment creates friends or enemies in a high-stakes political visual novel

4662560.title: For God and For Profit
4662560.short_description: For God and For Profit is a Renaissance investigation game. Audit the ledgers, question the merchants, and uphold the truth...for God and for profit.

4662880.title: Quarter Note Cafe
4662880.short_description: Act as Charithy, serving coffee to cultists, instruments and the regular passerby from your coffee shop in a city filled with all sorts of weird, kind and potentially dangerous people.

4662960.title: Project: C.E.L.L.
4662960.short_description: An arcade incremental where you break glucose, trigger explosive chain reactions, and turn ATP into powerful upgrades. Experiment with different builds, discover powerful combinations, and push a retro-futuristic cell simulation to its limits.

4663670.title: Defend The Nest
4663670.short_description: Help two super intelligent crows make silly weapons out of whatever junk they can find in a city park, and then watch them fight off a horde of critters. A relaxing and yet chaotic auto battling roguelike.

4663840.title: S4NCTU4RY
4663840.short_description: A cyberpunk bar that runs at the bottom of your screen. Build your menu around the synergies of 50 cocktails, and welcome 15 guests in Story Mode. Your job is to make one drink a sanctuary for the exhausted.

4664340.title: Sound of the Night - Nightclub Building & Management Sim
4664340.short_description: Build, design, and manage your own nightclub in a cyberpunk city. Shape your space, grow your business, and turn your club into a thriving nightlife destination.

4664490.title: Burger Smash
4664490.short_description: Plan your kitchen, grill burgers, and keep orders flowing in this fast-paced single-player cooking game. Design efficient layouts, prepare and serve orders under pressure, unlock playable characters with unique perks, and adapt to demanding customers.

4664610.title: Academ Dreams
4664610.short_description: An unhinged genius returns to his childhood town in search of a dream, only to uncover dark secrets from the past. People vanish in the forest, fires that raise the dead burn by the “cursed” sea, and demon bikers throw wild parties. Can he find himself amid the chaos?

4664670.title: Liminality: Chapter 1
4664670.short_description: Liminality is a Singleplayer Liminal Horror Game That focuses on Liminal Environments, and has a bunch of lore that you have to uncover - Based on the web-series and movie created by Kane Parsons (The Backrooms) CAN YOU ESCAPE THE LIMINAL COMPLEX

4664790.title: Oh, For Bugs' Sake!
4664790.short_description: Team up with a cute spider family in this cartoonish asymmetric co-op platformer where communication and coordination are crucial. Avoid electrified cables and dodge one extremely angry giant finger who really, really wants to squash you.

4664980.title: Fox Two Protocol
4664980.short_description: Hit the afterburners in modern fighter combat. Fly the campaign, duel in PvP, race through Time Attack or take on an endless mission. Build your own mix of upgrades and equipment, then find a reason for one more sortie.

4665130.title: About Thieves
4665130.short_description: About Thieves is an old-school first-person dungeon crawler with real-time combat. The character progression system rewards exploration and secret hunting, and that’s where the main focus lies.

4665270.title: Cosmic Crumbs: Bakery Simulator
4665270.short_description: Build and run your own bakery in space as orders start stacking up. Keep the machines moving, prepare sweet treats, manage your robot helpers, and turn your little shop into the galaxy’s busiest bakery — solo or with friends.

4666130.title: Echo of Me
4666130.short_description: Echo of Me is a psychological narrative game about memory, loss, and a truth that cannot be left behind. Explore a maze of memories, solve puzzles, avoid enemies, and uncover notes as you piece together a story in which every new answer changes the meaning of what came before.

4666440.title: Crounds
4666440.short_description: Crounds is a fast-paced PvP chess roguelike. Choose a powerful King, draft game-breaking upgrades, and bend the traditional rules of chess to destroy your opponent! Synergize your chaotic upgrades to create your winning strategy!

4666530.title: Signs Of Devourer
4666530.short_description: Its another night shift in the store, except this time you are trapped with monster disguised as one of the items. Keep the floor clean, shelves full, serve the customers... and try to not get devoured until the dawn.

4666620.title: Tiny Taxi
4666620.short_description: Drift, drive and survive in a top-down pixel art city! Pick up passengers with strange demands, earn cash to upgrade your taxi and choose curses that make every run tougher. Customize your cab/driver, build your mixtape and climb the leaderboard.

4667260.title: Prison Queen
4667260.short_description: In a world ruled by sharp tongues, one slip of the lip lands young Odette behind bars. Steal words from your fellow inmates, chain them into razor-sharp sentences, and talk your way up the prison food chain. Here, every sentence is a weapon.

4667450.title: Backrooms: Savior
4667450.short_description: That's a co-op horror exploration shooter set in the Backrooms. This time, you won’t just hide—grab your weapon and fight back against the entities. Explore classic and original levels, scavenge supplies, rescue survivors, and survive. Ammo is scarce. Noise is deadly. This time, fear goes both ways.

4667970.title: Coldline: Disconnect
4667970.short_description: It's not who you are, it's what you do that matters! As an agent inside the enemy base, repair devices by solving puzzles! Plant your bug in the correct device! Listen on the radio at night and transmit critical intel. You are entirely alone in every decision, but your choices will affect everyone.

4668080.title: VCR83
4668080.short_description: VCR83 is a psychological horror game where you monitor security cameras and report strange anomalies.

4668110.title: Time To Waste
4668110.short_description: Drive your little trash compacting robot across a ruined world, collect mountains of trash, and upgrade everything — until your one small bot becomes an unstoppable cleaning fleet. An active incremental about quiet, endless purpose.

4668140.title: Groove Core
4668140.short_description: Groove Core is a rhythm-based bullet heaven roguelike shooter where you arrange your weapons on a sequencer. Mix and match 200+ items, build your ship, and flood the cosmos with bullet storms as deadly as they are beautiful.

4668190.title: Earth Atlantis Abyss
4668190.short_description: A shoot 'em up roguelike where light, space and safety are things you trade away. Descend as Pypher, a lone captain chasing her grandfather's lost legacy into a drowned world. Anyone who seeks answers knows that the deeper you go, the darker it gets...

4668250.title: Mini Sushi Factory
4668250.short_description: Manage your very own sushi factory in this cozy automation game. Deliver batches of Bento Boxes during shifts, then upgrade your production lines, receive emails from customers, and get new recipes in the management room.

4668350.title: The Prime Minister's Crest: Path to Power
4668350.short_description: A political simulation visual novel set in a severe post-bubble economic crisis. As newly elected governor Kazuma Oriki, allocate tight budgets to resolve economic, security, and welfare issues. Navigate complex factional politics and ultimately forge your path to the Prime Minister's seat.

4669140.title: The Real Guest
4669140.short_description: Warning: Do not go outside. Keep your doors tightly shut. Pull the curtains closed. Only allow humans to enter. Eliminate all "impostors".

4669550.title: Orbital Drift
4669550.short_description: A dead planet. Drifting wrecks. A civilization lost to silence. Survive the unforgiving vacuum of space, master orbital mechanics, explore abandoned stations, and upgrade your ship. Uncover what destroyed an entire world—and why Earth needs to know the truth.

4669940.title: Textures Not Found
4669940.short_description: Explore a mysterious facility where colors have vanished. Restore the world piece by piece, uncover hidden secrets, and navigate unique environments guided by a sarcastic AI companion in this atmospheric narrative experience.

4670120.title: Still With Me
4670120.short_description: A short psychological horror experience about returning to a familiar place where something has been waiting for you.

4670240.title: Arx Temporis
4670240.short_description: A story-rich anime action RPG combining real-time combat, school life, and social simulation. Fight through procedurally generated dungeons, build relationships, and uncover the truth behind a mysterious temporal threat.

4670310.title: Theorycraft: Raiding Guild Simulator
4670310.short_description: Theorycraft is a single-player raiding guild simulator. Recruit raiders, tune gear and spell priorities, and command authentic MMO-style boss fights with encounter replays, win rate prediction, deep strategy, and rich combat data.

4670350.title: Hookeye
4670350.short_description: It's the end of the line. Resist the madness and use questionable bait to just keep fishing. Sacrifice everything for a bigger catch. It has to be worth it.

4670880.title: Bathory - Heritage of Blood
4670880.short_description: Play as Ursula Bathory, the vampire Princess, awakened from a centuries long slumber to claim her throne of blood in this Vampire Soulsvania inspired by Castlevania, Nosferatu and gothic victorian literature classics.

4671010.title: Rattle Spring
4671010.short_description: Rattle Spring is a surreal point-and-click puzzle adventure inspired by Rusty Lake. When your cousin vanishes from her family’s desert health resort, explore its strange rooms, solve interconnected puzzles, and uncover the secrets behind her disappearance.

4671040.title: Fool
4671040.short_description: You're a jester traveling the realm solving people's problems with the power of juggling. You'll save relationships, resolve conflicts like battles, and even make crops grow all with the mystical power of juggling!

4671270.title: Data Breach Inc.
4671270.short_description: Pilot a breach rig into hostile corporate infrastructure. Mine the firewall, crack daemon cores, extract your haul, and buy permanent upgrades between sorties.

4671410.title: Recoup 'n' Roll: Music Industry Simulator
4671410.short_description: Build or join a record label across seven distinct music markets, each with its own charts, economy, contracts, royalties, and audience behavior. Sign artists, fund releases, manage debt, survive rivals, and turn local acts into global stars.

4671450.title: World of Slime
4671450.short_description: World of Slime is a casual MMORPG where you capture, collect, and grow with all kinds of slimes. Find new slimes through field capture, synthesis, and fishing, then take them with you into battles, exploration, and puzzles.

4671460.title: 李商隐：青袍玉珂传
4671460.short_description: 这是一款古风恋爱文字冒险游戏，在晚唐历史的基础上进行了戏剧化改编。你将扮演李商隐这位才华横溢却命运多舛的贫寒少年，在恶劣的世道挣扎求存，在寒门与豪门的斗争中进行艰难抉择，一路上也会有红颜知己相伴。本作对于角色的塑造复杂立体，而非分出绝对的正邪。

4671770.title: Multiverse Escape
4671770.short_description: This is a light rogue-like turn-based strategy game. Choose unique characters, battle across countless distinct small worlds, upgrade skills, equipment and attributes to strengthen yourself, and finally break free from the bondage of endless realms.

4671900.title: Eyes Wide Open
4671900.short_description: Work for a dystopian Inspection Bureau, Determine whether the subjects are humans or not, Uncover secrets, Endure psychological horrors and reach your work quota - or else.

4672230.title: BOBABOMB
4672230.short_description: Did you ever blow boba bubbles at your friends? If you haven’t done that before, NOW YOU CAN!! Play as a cute little "Boby". Suck up ammo, slow rivals, and blow them up or knock them into hazards in chaotic playgrounds for up to 16 players!

4672330.title: Shadows Over Fog City
4672330.short_description: Shadows Over the Fog City is a Republican-era spy visual novel. As an undercover clerk inside an enemy puppet bureau, hide behind files and seals, mislead your enemies, pass intelligence, and survive audits, blame games, and purges. One mistake means death—but you have no choice.

4672750.title: Final Rites
4672750.short_description: After exorcists sent to a remote Spanish village go silent, the FINAL RITES unit is deployed. Investigate sites corrupted by failed rituals, explore hostile environments, fight the undead, and perform sacred rites to contain entities emerging from a breach beyond reality.

4672770.title: Little Writer Desktop Companion
4672770.short_description: Your little companion is an ambitious writer with very little discipline. Type, and they'll write too. Every keystroke moves their work forward. In this productivity game, help them become a renowned author while you get things done.

4673010.title: Gridbound
4673010.short_description: GRIDBOUND is a co-op arcade action game on a shifting LED floor. Dodge red hazards, activate blue objectives, and reach green safe tiles. Coordinate with your teammates, react fast, and stay alive as the grid changes around you.

4673370.title: Interzone
4673370.short_description: Branded a deserter, you are thrown into the Interzone, where survival is the only law. Technology dies here, orders fall from the sky in artillery-fired capsules, the last voice from outside. Face anomalies, radiation, contamination, the infected, rebels, and ruthless military forces.

4673650.title: Crown Control
4673650.short_description: RPG Roguelike Deckbuilder: play solo or in online co-op with up to 4 players. Choose your character, level up your class, collect and play cards to attack, defend, heal, summon allies, place traps, and alter the terrain in turn-based isometric battles to overthrow a tyrant king.

4673720.title: SMILEC++
4673720.short_description: This is an app, that allows you to program in C++, in a much more simple, and fast way. You can build your own apps, and games. Program by typing or with visual tools. You can choose how you program, and can choose among any IDE design you like the most. Export your app or game for commercial use.

4673960.title: Grim Dice
4673960.short_description: Dark medieval times. Face off in an online PvP Farkle-like duel where dice combos become damage and greed can cost you victory. Choose a hero, collect items, and defeat your opponent. Risk, strategy, and luck decide who survives.

4674650.title: Eggnob
4674650.short_description: Eggnob is a precision platformer about a flatulent egg. Guide it through multiple traps dressed up as levels. Or don't. Let it die, see if I care. Floors vanish, spikes appear, the exit lies. Drag that Egg through hell. It won't thank you. It can't. It's a stupid Egg.

4674770.title: Throneforged
4674770.short_description: Forge your empire. Claim the throne. A competitive 4X strategy game where every tile matters, every decision counts, ZERO RNG, and one win condition exists. Claim the central Throne and hold it for 10 turns.

4674810.title: Broke Street
4674810.short_description: A 1-6 player co-op roguelike trading sim where you and your friends start broke at a Wall Street hedge fund. Share one balance, make risky trades, use items to find winning strategies, and hit rising quotas to survive each day. Fail, and pay the price.

4674820.title: Disaster Crew
4674820.short_description: Disaster Crew is a co-op action-adventure for up to four players. Take on unusual contracts, explore locations packed with traps and obstacles, and share an adventure filled with unexpected dangers and spectacular events..

4675410.title: Volcano Watch
4675410.short_description: Discover an open-world volcano-monitoring game grounded in accurate volcanology and authentic phenomena. Step into the role of a lone scientist facing an active volcano, and lead the adventure at your own pace, free to follow the story or carve your own path.

4675640.title: Sellsword
4675640.short_description: Become a Sellsword in a magical kingdom. Take contracts from rival factions, battle for gold and reclaim territory in the name of mighty overlords. Forge your path through a living sandbox where no two journeys unfold alike, and every deed is etched into a growing book of legends.

4676120.title: Vestalborne
4676120.short_description: Break the world, then build your own. Vestalborne is an unlimited open-world survival crafting RPG: mine, farm, build and destroy across procedural dimensions, and fight the rising danger. Collect Embers, grow stronger, and keep the Eternal Flame burning solo, with friends, or against them.

4676610.title: A Mountain Called Hope
4676610.short_description: Explore a hauntingly abandoned late 1800s mountain coal mining town afflicted by a violent winter storm.

4676660.title: Return to Campus II: Billionaire Heir Goes to School
4676660.short_description: Return to Campus 2 brings back absurd open-world comedy, now with online multiplayer! Play as a super-rich heir exploring a modern city and a medieval world. Complete quests, meet NPCs, cruise around, pick fights, and cause chaos across two eras.

4676820.title: Trigger Range
4676820.short_description: A fast-paced, competitive shooting range game where speed and precision are everything. It's like Track Mania with guns.

4676940.title: The Bank
4676940.short_description: a finance mmo with the goal to compete in a virtual economy

4677070.title: Skill Issue
4677070.short_description: Skill Issue is a collection of competitive minigames where you can outplay the competition through pure mechanical skill-master.

4677500.title: Scholar Adventure: Lost Night
4677500.short_description: An ancient prophecy is about to awaken. Guided by a mysterious artifact, William ventures into Azig, where a secret society, ancient temples, and opposing forces await, trapped beneath the eternal sun. Uncover the truth that could change the fate of these lands.

4678230.title: Kill to Zero
4678230.short_description: Seek revenge in a frantic top-down hack and slash! Cut enemies in half, master the Parry, and take down a cyberpunk megacorporation!

4678350.title: Purrfect Waiter
4678350.short_description: Become a bartender on a tricky delivery adventure! Navigate platforms, traps, and obstacles with physics-based controls. Keep your fragile wine bottle from falling or breaking while collecting coins along the way. Learn from each failure and deliver the wine safely!

4678500.title: Crack a Pack
4678500.short_description: An incremental collectathon. Crack packs till you complete your collection. Sacrifice cards for upgrades, hire pawns, and swim in money. One question remains: Can you crack 'em all?

4678530.title: Shape Wars
4678530.short_description: A fast-paced auto-battler where Squares, Triangles, and Circles clash in an endless lane war. Build your army, manage your economy, and destroy the enemy Nexus before they destroy yours.

4679450.title: Farming & Supermarket: Clicker
4679450.short_description: Click, harvest, and build your own retail empire! In Farming & Supermarket: Clicker, process raw crops into valuable goods, design your store, and sell to customers. Start with a simple click and grow into a massive supermarket tycoon!

4679710.title: Tetrush
4679710.short_description: Based on a fake mobile game ad, "Tetrush" brings the classic puzzle game Tetris to an infinitely-rotating board of 31 columns. Because of its larger size, there also are more difficult pieces to place. Drop carefully.

4679730.title: Estancia Protocol Zero
4679730.short_description: A first-person survival horror set in Neuquén, Argentine Patagonia. Venture into a remote estate in Cerro Ocaso to search for your missing partner. Face hordes of the undead, manage your resources, and solve classic puzzles to survive the nightmare.

4680260.title: Pirates Dig Deeper
4680260.short_description: Dig with your crew. Defend with your cannons. Pirates Dig Deeper is a co-op blend of digging and tower defense. Descend into the island, fight off rival pirates, and unseal the ancient temple to steal the elixir of immortality.

4680380.title: Steinvar
4680380.short_description: Explore a mysterious, atmospheric world and cleanse creeping corruption using the power of light. Discover secrets, restore lost places, and shape your journey in a story-driven fantasy adventure.

4681180.title: A Court of Seven Crowns
4681180.short_description: Navigate a web of intrigue and assassination to make peace among warring fae! The fate of their realms and yours is in your hands! A text-based interactive novel.

4681370.title: DeadLoop
4681370.short_description: DeadLoop is an underwater sandbox set in a miniature ocean inside a glass cube. Raise a flock of water sheep, discover rare breeds and colors, and keep your coral reef thriving. Then summon a storm or a whirlpool and see how your flock reacts.

4681710.title: Now With More Plunk
4681710.short_description: A Plinko-like incremental where your coins strum harps, hit drums, and eventually create their own master orchestra. Go Plunk it up!

4681770.title: Everfront
4681770.short_description: Lead a nation through a roguelike strategy campaign where borders grow continuously. Choose your path, unlock technology and push the front.

4681870.title: Heliodawn
4681870.short_description: You start with a coal mine, an iron mine, a well, and a farm. You end with rockets flying, colonies on the Moon and Mars, and cargo flowing between every world you've built. An idle incremental game about building humanity's space program from the ground up.

4682090.title: Waywardens
4682090.short_description: Lead three heroes with one shared deck in a dark fantasy tactical roguelite. Play each card as an action or a chess-inspired move. Read enemy attacks, break their formation and turn a desperate hand into a winning plan. Build your company. Brave the road.

4682140.title: Mothville: A City of Hidden Things
4682140.short_description: The residents of Mothville are always losing things and need the help of someone with eagle eyes! Explore the town’s diverse neighborhoods, talk to the animal residents, complete their quests, and find everything that’s gone missing in this wacky, story-driven hidden object game.

4682150.title: Crafty Marbles
4682150.short_description: Build whatever you want for your marbles! Crazy machines, incredible races, spectacular chain reactions, frantic battles or anything else! Turn any idea into organized chaos!

4682860.title: Kamiya Detective Agency: High School Girl Vanished in The Summer
4682860.short_description: A mystery set in Fukuoka, Japan. Former cop Kengo Kamiya and assistant Hikaru tackle a high school girl's disappearance. A "Photoreal Novel" fully utilizing actual photos and AI. Enjoy snappy banter and unexpected twists in this simple, choice-driven mystery visual novel.

4682890.title: BaeSplit: Chaos Down Under
4682890.short_description: A turn-based RPG featuring Hakos Baelz and her friends from hololive! Discover a re-imagining of the Outback as you join Bae on a quest to save her homeland and herself.

4683250.title: Ragnarok Mining Co.
4683250.short_description: Ragnarok Mining Co. is a satisfying planet demolition interval clicker set in a dystopian future where you are just a number in the corporate world. Scan for hotspots, fire your probes, and destroy worlds.

4683390.title: Defend Your Fish
4683390.short_description: An Arcade style strategy game where you must protect your bucket of fish from crabs, seagulls, and other such enemies. The goal is to survive as long as possible to build up your score, earn coins to unlock cosmetics and upgrades to help your future runs!

4683450.title: Carpet Racers
4683450.short_description: Carpet Racers invites you to 90s good old make belief playtime chaos. Compete against your friends (and enemies) using your favorite racing machine, in and around numerous arenas from your childhood (your house, school, backyard, playground and many more).

4683940.title: Cafe Connect
4683940.short_description: Repair, upgrade, and build PCs for your first customers to pave your way to self-employment. Open your own internet café, build custom gaming PCs, and expand your shop step by step. Your success starts with a screwdriver.

4684610.title: A Knight's Fury - The Vaults of Venom
4684610.short_description: A Knight's Fury is a first-person, turn-based dungeon crawler built for one lone knight. Choose attacks to exploit each monster's weaknesses, gather loot, upgrade your gear, and venture deeper into dangerous fantasy realms—without party management or endless grinding.

4685200.title: 徘徊之碑 - Lingering Stele
4685200.short_description: "Haven't seen you in forever." A narrative-driven RPG about the heart. In a peaceful world where all conflict has come to an end, is there still a chance to make up for the words left unspoken?

4685240.title: Kiwi Boing
4685240.short_description: Triple-jump, air dash, plant your beak on walls, leap off and more in this 3D collectathon platformer about a flightless bird that gets everywhere anyway. You crashed on tiny open-world islands, and you have places to be. Find secrets, Meet the locals, fix your plane and F off home (F is for Fly).

4685400.title: Operation Paranoia
4685400.short_description: Operation Paranoia is a psychological survival horror in which you browse the dark corners of the deep web, uncover conspiracy theories, and hide from relentless killers. Manage your food and medicine supplies, run your vlog channel, and survive another day.

4686840.title: Sons of the Arena: Pollice Verso
4686840.short_description: A small ludus is yours, and it has to reach the great games. Build the estate, pick fights from the hosts’ calendar, fight off the rival. Turn-based fights on hexes: a kick drops a man, a wedge breaks a shield wall. Four classes, six weapon types, and all a man wears shows on him.

4687340.title: HOMUNCULCHU
4687340.short_description: Guide fragile homunculi with limited lifespans through humanity's final bid for survival across six hostile worlds.

4687430.title: Life and Lemon
4687430.short_description: Come get cozy in this fruit farming card game. Grow your orchard business, discover countless combinations of card fusions, and befriend a cast of quirky characters across a variety of lush and unique locations!

4687460.title: Bound Together
4687460.short_description: Explore the world, gather resources, produce ammunition, build turrets, and defend against relentless waves of monsters in a 2.5D fantasy adventure that blends base building with tower defense.

4688260.title: Heroes Frontiers
4688260.short_description: A charming, bustling colony sim in retro pixel art. Carve thriving towns out of an untamed fantasy world. Recruit heroes to defend them or send them questing for fame and loot, and survive a procedurally generated continent full of danger and adventure.

4688400.title: Cats In The Shell
4688400.short_description: Provoke explosive chain reactions and experiment ever-evolving combat strategies in this mech-building roguelike auto battler. Mix and match components and mech modules to discover powerful synergies, then watch each creation spring to life in satisfying combat sequences.

4689120.title: Heroes of the Underworld
4689120.short_description: An open world party-based RPG with turn-based combat. Heroes of the Underworld is a comfy yet challenging mid-sized adventure in a vast fantasy world, inspired by 90s games and comic books.

4689230.title: Market Manager Simulator
4689230.short_description: Build and manage your own market. Fill the shelves, set prices, serve customers, manage online orders and grow your business. Hire employees, check stocks and turn your market into a large business.

4689350.title: Iron Dogs
4689350.short_description: In Iron Dogs, take the helm of 1940's inspired aircraft in a colorful retro-inspired arcade flight-sim where you will blast hordes of enemy aircraft, naval vessels and more! Engage in dogfights (literally) with hostile aircraft, while flying through beautifully hand-crafted environments.

4689640.title: The Blade
4689640.short_description: 2.5D Action Roguelite that fuses Hong Kong-style Action Cinema environmental interaction with hardcore martial arts combat.physics is as deadly as your blade. Kick&Launch: From small tea bowls to heavy mahogany tables—one well-placed kick turns mundane furniture into lethal projectiles.

4689710.title: Chaincast
4689710.short_description: A PvP roguelike auto battler where you build a squad and arrange their skills into escalating combos. Battle rival squads and set off a chain reaction that grows stronger with every link.

4689930.title: Spin Cycle
4689930.short_description: A roguelite strategy game where you keep the books for the criminal underworld. Take contracts from cartels and sanctioned regimes, build money routes across dozens of jurisdictions, play the market of sanctioned coins. And try not to annoy Interpol.

4690030.title: Weaper
4690030.short_description: Work with or against your friends in this social spooky shooter game. Team up with others or go solo as you brave the woods, haunted house, and other creepy locations perfect for having fun, getting scared, and shooting imaginary guns.

4690210.title: Snowday Co
4690210.short_description: Start with just a shovel and build your snow plowing business across an open-world town. Take on jobs, expand your territory, and keep up with whatever the winter throws at you.

4690430.title: Sprig
4690430.short_description: Sprig is a cozy 3D exploration game about discovering real-world animals, solving gentle environmental puzzles, and filling your nature journal as a curious rabbit. Explore peaceful, no-stress levels at your own pace in a short, wholesome adventure with a clear ending.

4690580.title: Astral Industrial Complex
4690580.short_description: A space automation game with rogue lite elements. Take the role of a rogue defense drone building up a mining and defense industry in the far reaches of space.

4690740.title: The Flowership
4690740.short_description: The Flowership calls to you. To have a heart pure is what we all desire. Though a long journey, the flowers of pure soil believe in you.

4691010.title: DAMNED
4691010.short_description: DAMNED is a nerve-wracking survival/management experience where you are the only one who can keep a colossal dam from collapsing.

4691240.title: Bowl Big
4691240.short_description: An incremental bowling game where one pin becomes hundreds. Unlock a tech tree. Upgrade pins and balls. Dodge obstacles. Watch numbers skyrocket. Ditch the 10-pin limit and Bowl Big!

4691290.title: ONE MAN'S DECEIT
4691290.short_description: One Man's Deceit is a survival horror first-person game where you are on a mission to find a missing friend. Explore a world filled with secrets, search for clues, follow your instincts, survive deadly encounters, and fight different creatures on your journey.

4691340.title: Rebel Talos
4691340.short_description: Pilot your TALOS mech to defend humanity’s last bastion in this high-speed action roguelite. Craft overpowered builds, crush the Automata Empire, and expand your arsenal every run.

4691360.title: FerroFrame
4691360.short_description: FerroFrame is a real-time strategy ecology simulator — dig, dam, redirect and blast industry into high gear, then survive the world as the balance tilts in either direction. Use gigantic mechs called frames to terraform the planet to your needs and replenish your world with asteroids!

4692370.title: Orbital Code: 2044
4692370.short_description: Become a top secret agent in VR and embark on a continent-spanning stealth action adventure. After Corp One's plan to seize New York City by force is leaked, a covert international taskforce of former special operations members sends you to infiltrate the megacorp's heavily guarded downtown HQ.

4692380.title: Invariant
4692380.short_description: An atmospheric, story-driven sci-fi FPS set in Antarctica in the 1990s. Explore an isolated facility, solve environmental puzzles, uncover secrets and fight through increasingly intense encounters using a diverse range of weapons and powerful combat abilities.

4693120.title: Norselings
4693120.short_description: Guide your Norse clan from Helheim to Asgard through runestone strikes and the rise of a Norseling settlement.

4693300.title: Hole Punch Cocktail
4693300.short_description: "Drink. Kill. Drink. Kill." Enter the dream of Ms. Hangover, a young office worker with a slight alcohol dependency, fight against a twisted reality, and successfully finish your daily routine.

4693780.title: Trouble in Our Skies
4693780.short_description: A retro PS1-style action game set in a lo-fi cyberpunk metropolis, where fast-paced movement meets chaotic clean-up-and-combat gameplay. You are Lammy, a dormant caregiver bot revived to save a sky city from total collapse.

4694340.title: XGA SPECIAL EDITION
4694340.short_description: Survive the nightmare of XGA! Trapped in the rotting corpse of a space station, you must explore, fight and hide in this intense Horror-Metroidvania! But remember, XGA is hunting you.... PROUDLY USING NO GENERATIVE AI

4694460.title: Shady Business
4694460.short_description: Make lamps for villains! As a Villux employee, you create eclectic lamps for ominous clients of the underworld. Receive your design brief, build your lamp, and shape the sinister plans of your customers across a treacherous network of villains.

4694470.title: Dust till Dawn
4694470.short_description: A retro-paranormal powerwash simulator, where you're a maid restoring a quiet rural Japanese village. Dust, mop, squeegee to your heart's content...but don't stay too late!

4694690.title: Haunted Lakes of Austin
4694690.short_description: Explore the real Haunted Lakes of Austin, boat and fish for hidden treasures, and survive the darkness in this eerie adventure where every cast could awaken something beneath the surface. BOAT, FISH, SURVIVE

4694820.title: Normandie
4694820.short_description: Normandie is a narrative ocean crawler set in the wake of World War II. Suit up as Charlie, a rookie salvage diver aboard the Shomesh. Work with your crew to explore the wrecks of the legendary ocean liners that once ruled the Atlantic.

4695660.title: PLANETOON
4695660.short_description: Grab planets, place them into orbit, and grow a galaxy in this space puzzle game. Watch life and civilizations emerge, encounter UFOs and black holes, and discover over 60 endings across 12 billion years of cosmic surprises.

4695950.title: Censor Me Totally
4695950.short_description: An absurd censor simulator in the Committee of Public Happiness. Censor images and texts, wheel and deal, chase the money, solve problems, try not to get caught, spread your wings, and keep your sanity.

4696110.title: Nodebreak
4696110.short_description: Nodebreak is a fast-paced, kinetic precision puzzle game, where you launch from node to node at breakneck speeds in an interconnected branching node network. It is an easy to understand, but hard to master test of reflexes and spatial awareness!

4696280.title: Death by Taxes
4696280.short_description: A satirical incremental clicker about a billionaire facing the one thing money can’t fix: taxes. Spend every last dollar on increasingly stupid purchases before the bill kills you.

4696520.title: Arena Bot Manager
4696520.short_description: Manage a scrapyard bot-fighting team on the Lunar Ring World and prove your worth in brutal, high-stakes arena matches. Build machines from scrap, hire a team of engineers and programmers to give you an advantage, and wreck your opponents as you rise the ranks. Wreck - Rebuild - Repeat 'til you win.

4696940.title: Tenancy
4696940.short_description: Tenancy is a roguelike deckbuilder about managing the costs, risks, and unique effects of angry little ladies so you can live off their paychecks. While tenants may be lackluster on their own, when played together they can be extorted for maximum value!

4697010.title: KAELIS: Seraph Protocol
4697010.short_description: Become an Executor of Serenos Academy in KAELIS, an academy sci-fantasy JRPG where you investigate Noise incidents, fight turn-based Lumina battles, and build bonds with the Guardians who stand beside you.

4697150.title: Choo Choo Kingdom
4697150.short_description: The Rift has swallowed the kingdom. Grow one archer’s carriage into a 16-carriage war-train that auto-battles endless hordes. Place troops beside supports for synergy, upgrade a deep skill tree, chase each boss through town and free the kingdom village by village.

4697550.title: Dearest Darling Dragon
4697550.short_description: Raise your own baby dragon and date a hot dragon "daddy" in this silly and fantastical stat-raiser dating sim! 🥚🐉

4697630.title: Quillzyra
4697630.short_description: Create persistent AI characters, shape their personalities and relationships, and chat privately on your own device. Three conversation quality levels are included. Add local portrait generation with the optional NVIDIA DLC.

4698700.title: Deep Space Observatory
4698700.short_description: Scan the stars, unlock technologies, automate data collection, and build an ever more efficient observatory.

4698730.title: Traces of Ink
4698730.short_description: Wu Zhou Dynasty Visual Novel Synopsis During Wu Zetian’s reign, a destitute orphan, you are saved by a mysterious maiden. She brings you into the noble Chi Manor, offering you a new life. Yet behind her kindness lies hidden danger. Unfold her secrets and fight to survive.

4699060.title: Air War General - WW2 Air Force Wargame
4699060.short_description: WW2 turn-based aircraft war game that puts you in the USAAF/USAF, RAF or Luftwaffe air operations HQs. Build your squadrons, wings, air bases & pilots. Engage in bombing missions, dogfights & interceptions over Britain, N. Africa & Europe. Historical & what-if fighter/bomber airplane game scenarios

4699220.title: Lone Lines: RPG
4699220.short_description: An atmospheric damn stylish 3D roguelike that will hurt you. Or make you feel good. The honest randomness of the Dead World is unfair to the fragile Rover and the Pilot connected to it. Rejoice, suffer, level up, and dive deeper into a universe After Absolutely Everything.

4699250.title: Blood Being 2
4699250.short_description: Work has ended. Something told you to find the tower. You can only get in by obliterating your brain. What comes next?

4699500.title: Far Away Kingdom
4699500.short_description: A fast-paced arcade gallery shooter inspired by Wild Guns and Cabal. Play solo or in local co-op, switch between fire and ice, dodge intense bullet patterns, and take down powerful bosses. Unlock hidden routes, discover secret encounters, and chase high scores.

4699950.title: Crowned Games
4699950.short_description: A party game collection for groups of 2–8. Six wildly different minigames, one shared lobby. Bring your own images, audio, and quizzes — or just jump in and play.

4700360.title: Gearomancer
4700360.short_description: Step into the mechanical apocalypse in Gearomancer, a fast-paced twin-stick action roguelite. Play as elite V.E.R.T.E.X. agents to dodge brutal bullet hells and obliterate elemental horrors. Harvest Arcane crystals, forge permanent upgrades at your hub, and die to return stronger than ever.

4700420.title: SKEW
4700420.short_description: A first-person atmospheric exploration game set in dreamlike liminal spaces, with no monsters, combat, or jump scares.

4700460.title: Arthur’s Tale
4700460.short_description: Guide Arthur through a world that’s out to get him! Sprint, leap, and faceplant your way through a vibrant adventure overflowing with devious traps, oversized bosses, and enough "Try Again" screens to last a lifetime. It’s colorful, it’s chaotic, and yes—you’re probably going to fail. A lot.

4700540.title: Vehicle Game
4700540.short_description: It is a game where you gather resources, secure food, and build structures to survive to the very end.

4700550.title: Handwalk
4700550.short_description: Handwalk is a difficult physics-based rage game where you control each hand separately to climb a mountain on your hands.

4700740.title: Whose Story (아무개전)
4700740.short_description: A Korean-style action roguelike set in a dark Joseon-inspired world. Fight supernatural enemies and survive ever-changing dungeons.

4701200.title: Flaming Fried Nutrition: Daydream
4701200.short_description: You raise a living hamburger as a pet. Adopt more hamburgers.

4701280.title: RAT CITY: Ratocracy
4701280.short_description: Build and Manage a Rat City. Run it into the ground. Literally. Keep your Rats happy and productive. Create for them a glorious colony in the dirt! The never ending demand for the production of products to consume is all consuming. Wait, is this real life? No, it's RAT CITY!

4701810.title: Pistol Cat
4701810.short_description: Like Animal Crossing but really stupid and physics based. You are a heavily armed cat exploring a cozy yet chaotic open world island town. Discover items that give you abilities, get rich, collect custom costumes & accessories, farm, complete quests for your neighbors, unlock upgrades, and more!

4701930.title: Caracol - Wars of Religion in the 17th Century
4701930.short_description: Simultaneous turn-based strategy (WeGo) set in the age of the Wars of Religion and pike-and-shot warfare.

4702010.title: Final Life Simulator
4702010.short_description: Rise from the streets to a financial empire in continuous real time ⏱️. A deep life and economic sim ticking second by second with zero idle shortcuts: work interactive shifts 💼, manage stores 🏢, secure mortgages 🏠, invest in gold & crypto 🥇, and trade options with real Greeks 📈.

4702080.title: RWR:Renegade
4702080.short_description: Hand-to-hand combat, firearms, and an upgradable motorcycle against mimic worms. Play as a biker nomad who crushes everything in his path to the sound of rock-chip tunes.

4702350.title: Design my drink!
4702350.short_description: Create drinks! Unlock more decorations, flavors and options for your drinks. Restore and manage your little cafe and meet locals.

4702610.title: Crimson Animatronic
4702610.short_description: Choose your path, survive, break your mouse from button mashing and reach disturbing endings! In this analog horror visual novel, you play as werecat radio host Daiane, who must survive the Crimson Order, a cursed cult of vampires, and Charkelene Chan, a massive red maned wolf animatronic!

4702660.title: AI Slop TCG
4702660.short_description: A deckbuilding roguelike where a cheating AI drags you through a digital wasteland of twisted creatures. Build your deck, survive the chaos, and win a game that doesn’t want to be fair.

4702730.title: Wuxing - Elemental Array Poker
4702730.short_description: Poker hands aren't just played here — they're placed. Drop each card onto a 3×3 altar where the Five Elements feed and fight their neighbors, cascading multipliers across the board. A roguelike deckbuilder about space, not sequence.

4702900.title: Sunset Artisan Chocolate
4702900.short_description: Run a cozy seaside chocolate boutique!🍫 Weigh, melt, and craft handmade treats for your colorful customers, experiment with new recipes, meet locals, grow your chocolate brand, and settle into life in Sunset Town.

4702910.title: Scope Creep
4702910.short_description: Scope Creep is a roguelike first-person shooter set in abandoned places where strange occurrences are spreading. Each run takes you through randomly generated levels. Scavenge supplies, fight off unwanted “pests,” and push deeper to clear the area again and again much like this never ending project.

4703000.title: DRIVE IN THE RAIN
4703000.short_description: A newly licensed boy drives a highway on a torrential night. In the back seat, his girlfriend is consumed by a "Paranormal Phenomenon" born of a social media firestorm. Beside him, a self-proclaimed expert in modern Paranormal Phenomena. A horror road-movie adventure by playwright Keisuke Tagawa.

4703230.title: While 1
4703230.short_description: Don't touch the walls. While 1 is a minimalist mouse-only action game centered around this simple concept. Create a loop around the level while avoiding obstacles synchronized to the music.

4703240.title: Freshly Caught
4703240.short_description: Catch fish, arrange your stall, and run a cozy neighborhood fish stand by the water. 🎣 Set up your stall, serve customers by finding the right fish for them, upgrade your gear, and grow your tiny seaside business one catch new and rare fish!

4703250.title: Tiny Patisserie
4703250.short_description: Run your own cozy pastry shop. 🍰 Spot what customers are craving, combine and box up sweet treats, and jump into hands-on minigames for every order. Unlock new recipes, upgrade your tools, and grow your tiny shop into a thriving neighborhood favorite.

4703890.title: Impermanence
4703890.short_description: A father. A condemned theatre. A son’s voice from beyond. Step into a narrative horror game about grief, obsession, and refusing to let go as a force older than love pushes back.

4703930.title: Grilluminati
4703930.short_description: Start a cult with friends and summon one of three rivalling gods. Sacrifice customers, perform dark rituals and work together to bring an ancient evil being into the world, all under the cover of a steakhouse.

4704070.title: My Yandere Streamer
