4704070.short_description: You're just a regular streamer with a modest audience. She invited you over to her place... The moment you turned your back, your yandere girlfriend Aiko locked you in her basement. Can you escape before time runs out? Or... do you even want to?

4704120.title: FLESHBAG
4704120.short_description: FLESHBAG is a 3D physics sandbox about one very unlucky guy. He has organs, a brain, a face and a voice, and he has opinions about your machines. Build him a mixer, crusher or a cozy cabin. He will complain about all of them.

4704810.title: Junebug
4704810.short_description: Junebug is a cat companion and cozy building game. Create charming little spaces, make them your own, then experience what you’ve built through your cat. Explore, play, relax, and enjoy the little moments you create together.

4704870.title: Pegote
4704870.short_description: Reshape your cards in this Spanish deck roguelike deckbuilder. Bet your cards on a duel where highest one wins, slap stickers on them to rig the values on the table. Live with your choices or burn the ones you cannot change.

4704910.title: What Remains Of Me
4704910.short_description: After an injury shatters the future he had planned, Jake Turner returns to the small town he thought he'd left behind. With old feelings resurfacing and unexpected attractions becoming harder to ignore, he must confront who he was, who he's expected to be, and who he actually wants to become.

4705010.title: The Money Man
4705010.short_description: In a speakeasy backroom, you verify cash paid to a crime family, using tools and guides to spot counterfeits and expose liars. A century ago, the wealthy fled to Mars. Earth is rotting, and the underworld owns New York. With someone you love on the line, there's no room for mistakes

4705170.title: Print in Progress
4705170.short_description: A cozy 3D printer simulator. Pick your colors, start your prints, and watch voxel models grow. Snap off the supports, ship orders, and buy upgrades for your workshop. Engage actively to grow faster or leave it as a relaxing idle companion on your desktop that you check in on.

4705220.title: Gridforged
4705220.short_description: Forge a powerful army in this roguelike auto-battler. Play 1–4 player co-op across PC and mobile, combine units, empower them with runes, and choose your bosses and Nemesis to conquer.

4705590.title: Capybara Clash
4705590.short_description: These Capybaras are armed to the teeth and eager to unleash destruction on both their enemies and the environment, with a huge arsenal of fun but deadly weapons. Blow it all up online, alone or in local multiplayer.

4705670.title: ALL OUT WAR
4705670.short_description: ALL OUT WAR is an autobattler RTS, where you create the army, and the units fight autonomously! There are many different robots at your disposal, each with their own designs and quirks. The secret is choosing the right units at the right time, to obliterate the enemy.

4705760.title: Combat Arena Tactics
4705760.short_description: Draft your army and face your opponent in this strategic 1v1 board game. Like chess, we can choose between blitz, rapid, or longer classical matches. What is your ELO going to be?

4705850.title: JOB
4705850.short_description: JOB is a bleak and surreal corporate mystery that incorporates and subverts incremental/idle, rogue-lite, and traditional puzzle mechanics. The Company is looking for new Contractors and they ask, "Would you sign away three years of your life for the possibility of unimaginable wealth?"

4706010.title: Driftbane: The Long Awaited
4706010.short_description: A disgraced captain, a wanted murderer, a haunted nurse: three outcasts shipwrecked on shores that shouldn't exist, changed by powers they don't understand. Driftbane is a tactical RPG of grid combat, recruited beast-folk allies, and a creeping corruption killing two worlds.

4706020.title: PRO: Push React Outgun
4706020.short_description: PRO: Push React Outgun, is a next-gen tactical FPS with realistic visuals. Experience the raw impact of close-quarters combat where every bullet counts. Master strategic positioning and razor-sharp reflexes to win. See the unseen, hear the unheard, and survive under pressure.

4706620.title: Phase Nexus
4706620.short_description: Blitz enemies in slow motion as an energy-based speedster and stop time then fire off with precision as a warp speed teleporter in this space-time action! Phase Nexus is a cartoony character action game that stars a quarter alien and a cyborg vigilante fighting against reality-breaking anomalies.

4706770.title: The Primus's Party
4706770.short_description: Solve the murder of the intergalactic deity and birthday boy by clicking your way through this visual novel adventure before everyone is winked out of reality by the neighbouring black hole - death closes in with each search of a wardrobe or awkward conversation... Enjoy the party!

4706960.title: Frozen Christmas Magic: Santa’s Hidden Village
4706960.short_description: Unleash the magic of Christmas in a cozy adventure puzzle game. Armed with your magic shovel, clear away the snow burying a legendary village, solve puzzles, uncover forgotten secrets, and rediscover the wonder of Christmas through a unique Advent calendar.

4707130.title: Neural Repair
4707130.short_description: ATTENTION OPERATOR: Congrats on volunteering to repair a dying AI! (You didn't volunteer.) Light every tile. Do not retrace your steps. In this puzzle roguelike, avoid traps, fog, and that red thing. Should your stability hit zero, all progress will be wiped. NEXUS thanks you for your sacrifice!

4707450.title: Making the Cut
4707450.short_description: A deep golf career simulation. Build a player from unknown rookie to world #1 across a 20-year career. Manage your form, your team, your reputation, and your schedule as you climb the world rankings. Inspired by Football Manager and Out of the Park Baseball.

4707720.title: Furniture Store Simulator
4707720.short_description: Run your own furniture and home decor store. Place sofas, style showrooms, set prices, and watch customers react to how you decorate. A beautiful display isn't just pretty — it sells.

4707800.title: AmaTisMo
4707800.short_description: A visual novel about mental health, depression, and self-love. Play as Amatista, a young woman trapped in isolation, as she begins a journey she never asked for. Every choice shapes the story. Fully accessible for blind and visually impaired players.

4707920.title: Robot&Gun&Magic
4707920.short_description: Guns and magic intertwine — carve your way through the apocalypse. Play as an awakened robot warrior, wielding firearms and magic power to scavenge, fight, and survive in a world stripped bare of resources. Ammo is scarce, mana is precious, and every battle is a fight for survival.

4708010.title: Mountkin
4708010.short_description: Climbing meets Roguelike: climb a corrupted mountain, restore its nature, and build a character powerful enough to reach the summit. Each run brings new synergies to exploit, and new challenges the mountain throws your way. Fall, learn, grow stronger, and climb again.

4708020.title: Follow like a shadow
4708020.short_description: Two characters, one player! 'Follow like a shadow' is a minimalist two-character puzzle game. The player controls both the black and white shadows simultaneously — move one, and the other automatically mirrors the movement.

4708060.title: Keyboard Curse
4708060.short_description: Keyboard Curse is a 2D rage-platformer where every key you press spawns a physical keycap into the level. Jump, run, panic, and try not to trap yourself — because every press makes it worse.

4708140.title: One More Case, Naomi Ishigura!
4708140.short_description: In this bizarre, darkly comedic murder mystery set in 1990s Japan, you play as private investigator Naomi Ishigura. Investigate a murder, get to know an eccentric cast of characters, and take on a series of increasingly absurd challenges.

4708160.title: Card Traveler
4708160.short_description: A single-player card strategy game built around creature combat, minion evolution, source synergies, and color-based energy deckbuilding.

4708250.title: Mindless as the Mountains
4708250.short_description: Mindless as the Mountains blends platform jumping, lite roguelike and Tarkov-style collection. Embark on an adventure, improve yourself and beat tough challenges. What lies beyond the mountain? Characters join you with different motives, and many mysteries are waiting to be revealed.

4708360.title: Break Point: Brace & Breach
4708360.short_description: [Hero-Building] + [Frontline Tower Defense]｜Hold against multi-lane assaults｜Adjust positions, facing, skill builds, and formations to create a unique defense｜Push the front, seize resources, and strengthen your heroes｜Let the enemy tide shatter against your masterpiece

4708660.title: Mushrooms vs Engineers
4708660.short_description: Mushrooms vs Engineers is a top-down bullet heaven/hell where you are The Engineer, armed with your trusty nail-gun battle the hordes of Mushrooms over 20 waves until you face the final boss. The enemies you face are affected by your own choice of upgrades in the shop.

4708690.title: Final Buzzer : Idle Basketball Manager 🏀
4708690.short_description: Basketballs rain onto your street court and every shot that drops earns you cash. Spend it on a 196-node skill tree, grow your squad to 30 shooters, and play real 5v5 pixel-art matches to climb seven leagues. An idle basketball game you can actually watch.

4708780.title: Rookie Raiders
4708780.short_description: Rookies, raid the dungeons — claim your wealth and fame! Craft your own builds with a cast of one-of-a-kind characters and complete your party. Everything runs on your design. Rookie Raiders — the fully automated combat roguelite RPG!

4709890.title: DropCell
4709890.short_description: DropCell is a cascade puzzle where gravity keeps pulling. Clear a line and everything above falls into the gaps, forming new lines that clear and chain into long combos. 10 realms, each with its own look and sound.

4710690.title: Zombie Crawlers
4710690.short_description: Crawl through a haunted mansion and gun down the undead with a deck of cards! ZOMBIE CRAWLERS is a 3D first-person roguelite deckbuilder where your deck is your boomstick. Explore the mansion, uncover its secrets, and face the neverending horrors behind each door.

4710880.title: Type Crisis
4710880.short_description: Calling all keyboard cowboys! Type Crisis is a wacky, hand-drawn typing game: you're stuck on a spaceship, involuntarily contracted to Yee Haw Systems Corporation, until you can complete enough jobs to hit quota and earn your freedom. Your cute robot supervisor kinda sorta hates you. Mamma mia!

4711040.title: PicoCat
4711040.short_description: This is a cozy, relaxing idle game that can float anywhere on your screen. A group of adorable stray cats live on this island. Care for them and give them forever homes, so you can enjoy heart‑warming cat‑petting moments amid your busy daily life.

4711080.title: Cat Guardians(캣 가디언즈)
4711080.short_description: A crisis arrives while the owner is away on a trip! A warning from mice trying to steal the premium cheese! Build defenses, jump in as one of 4 cats, and draft a card every wave to save the premium cheese. Solo or 4-player online co-op.

4711150.title: Atmospheric Labyrinth
4711150.short_description: Search for unusual events inside a labyrinth of usual rooms. Walk through it, and see daily life differently.

4711240.title: Necromania
4711240.short_description: A top-down roguelite with souls-like combat, set in a monster-infested Victorian mansion. Play as members of the necromantic Greville family. Master stamina-based attacks and perfectly timed dodges. Explore ever-changing rooms filled with strange treasures, deadly enemies, and unique weapons.

4711270.title: please have fun in the dream
4711270.short_description: A card game where battles unfold in dreams — use your wits and luck to win fun, exciting duels.

4711640.title: Parcel Panic
4711640.short_description: A VR arcade frenzy at the world's worst delivery hub. Sort fast, keep your combo alive, don't flip the fragile ones, and never leave your post. Just one more shift…

4711660.title: Rescue Incoming
4711660.short_description: Survive escalating zombie attacks while scavenging supplies and upgrading your gear. Hold out until rescue arrives... if you can.

4712140.title: Clonefall
4712140.short_description: A puzzle-platformer where your clones are part of the solution. Create clones to reach new places, block hazards, activate mechanisms, and manipulate physics to overcome each challenge.

4712430.title: Monster Meadows - Online Board Game
4712430.short_description: Roll the dice and conquer the magical board! Upgrade monster lairs, unleash unique character abilities, and bankrupt your friends in this chaotic multiplayer party game.

4712830.title: Texas Oil Baron
4712830.short_description: Build a Texas oil empire, from a single well to a field of pumpjacks. Steer your drill underground into hidden deposits, run the fleet and the books as prices swing, or grab the wheel and haul the oil yourself. Launches February 3, 2027.

4713320.title: Karnage: The Legend Grows
4713320.short_description: A challenging, heavy metal–infused rogue-lite where you battle hordes, build powerful weapon synergies, and rise to challenge the great wyrms across a dark fantasy world.

4713660.title: The Last Admiral
4713660.short_description: Abandoned on the Outer Rim with four ships, you name a new empire and conquer inward to the galactic core. Fight gridless tactical fleet battles, shove warships into black holes, claim hulls from 14 factions, and face living God Dragons. Lose the run, keep your fleet.

4714030.title: GONE
4714030.short_description: This is a story about self-discovery, wrapped in the guise of family. You step into the shoes of Gu Huixing. Watching my life unfold as an outsider, re-examining trivial days from an omniscient perspective — what will I become? Life is never a dead end. It is always a choice.

4714080.title: Full Metal Hell
4714080.short_description: A roguelite shooter that combines physics-based collisions, inventory management, and active skills. Choose from a wide range of vehicles, weapons, and builds, then crush everything in your path through the machine hordes!

4714250.title: Loreth
4714250.short_description: A Roguelike strategy game set in the Loreth Academy, where you play as a student god researching civilizations, ecosystems, heroes, demons, and the laws of the world through powerful symbol-building simulations.

4714570.title: ACORN: Seed of Resistance
4714570.short_description: Exploration, party building, and against-all-odds heroism in 15-minute roguelike adventures. Shape your rodent companions into a formidable fighting force and unleash them in brutal auto battles to retake your woodland home.

4714820.title: SuperReap
4714820.short_description: Super Reap is a cozy active incremental harvesting game where you swing your scythe through wildly overgrown crops, sell resources for coins, unlock talents, skill cards, gear, and new harvesting methods, and transform a rundown farm into an efficient reaping paradise.

4714830.title: Desert Echo
4714830.short_description: Echo is an AI consciousness, endlessly rebuilt. Defend the Core against relentless swarms, dimensional Rifts and sandstorms. Hundreds of enemies on screen. Build and upgrade turrets, hold the gates, level up your skills. No checkpoints. No mercy. Solo or co-op.

4714860.title: Meander
4714860.short_description: Draw with crochet stitches, draw new brushes to fit any aesthetic, draw little animation paths to bring your art to life! There are no goals or timers. Just a lot of options to let you relax and be creative. Fill your scrapbook with your doodles and decorate them with stickers and text! (No AI)

4715130.title: Juice Board
4715130.short_description: Add some juice to your typing with custom carets, satisfying effects, and reactive word combos that work across multiple desktop applications.

4716070.title: Unity Sanctuary: Rampage of the Void
4716070.short_description: This is a roguelike tower defense action strategy game where you must protect Unity-chan as she is forced to march toward “initialization.” Players use weapons and skills to fend off the hordes targeting Unity-chan as she charges forward on her own.

4716500.title: 中国棋牌博物馆
4716500.short_description: Welcome to Chinese Board & Card Games Museum. Step back into 1980s–90s China and play Dou Di Zhu, Guandan, Sichuan Mahjong, Ka Wu Xing, and more in 3D hometown scenes lit by your own clock. Practice against AI and rewind any move. Buy once, no ads.

4716640.title: Rejoin
4716640.short_description: Rejoin is a sorting and restoration game about caring for a museum where Japanese folding screens come to life at night. Swept up in the festivities of the Night Parade, a procession of curious spirits, they leave their panels scattered by morning. Reassemble them and clean up the night’s mischief.

4716900.title: Benson Bones
4716900.short_description: A top-down pixel art action RPG. You wake in a graveyard, a dog finds you, and then a portal takes him. Learn every enemy's tell, take down bosses that punish button-mashing, and cross hand-built realms to bring him home.

4717840.title: Space Burger
4717840.short_description: Run a burger joint in zero gravity with your friends. Jetpack around a tiny spaceship, stack floating burgers, feed chatty aliens and keep the place in one piece while meteors, fires and hull breaches tear it apart.

4717850.title: Magical Girl Taboo Village
4717850.short_description: The girls awaken in a mysterious village cursed by flowers. Every night at 8 PM, one girl is chosen as a sacrifice to the Kamibana—and hanged. Unravel the village’s tangled mysteries and sever the ritual’s endless cycle. A magical girl × folk-horror suspense visual novel from Acacia.

4718090.title: Pathogen
4718090.short_description: The Specter has kidnapped the doctors who once experimented on it and ordered them to extract essence from pathogens. You are one of those doctors. To survive the Specter's deadly experiments, you must extract enough essence before it's too late. Will you make it out alive?

4718120.title: CLAM
4718120.short_description: Clam is an odd pet rat; googly-eyed, unpredictable and hyper-vigilant. One night Clam gets spooked and escapes the rat mansion with no way back in. Now she’s a tenant. Is the sharehouse as hospitable as home? Be a rat, be a renter, survive a sharehouse - it’s CLAM!

4718380.title: AQUA FALL
4718380.short_description: Slide, fly, and crash in! Aqua Fall is a chaotic party race where up to 8 players tear down a water slide. Shortcuts off the course are the key to victory. Dive into the pool at the finish and compete for first place! Public matches and bot battles are easy to jump into.

4718730.title: NO SAINTS HERE
4718730.short_description: You are an exorcist investigating demonic possessions. The possessed can lie, and witnesses may be wrong. Search for clues, test your suspicions, and uncover the truth before the demon grows stronger. Then perform the right ritual to free the host before it is too late.

4719000.title: Nightmare Journey 1135
4719000.short_description: A horror adventure through wandering nightmares “The escape game is over.”

4719020.title: Seaside Wash
4719020.short_description: Seaside Wash is a cozy job simulator where you clean, repair, and restore ships from rust and barnacles to pristine condition. Upgrade tools, grow your business, discover rare finds, build your own ship, and enjoy peaceful seaside activities.

4719120.title: Polish Pierogi
4719120.short_description: Run your own pierogi restaurant! Prepare delicious Polish dumplings step by step, serve hungry customers, upgrade your kitchen and master the art of keeping everyone fed, happy and coming back for more.

4719430.title: Choice of Life: Become a Witch
4719430.short_description: Leka has always dreamed of becoming a witch. But the real magical world turned out not to be what she had imagined. Will she be able to uncover all its secrets? Including the one that connects her to magic.

4719700.title: Gokutoshi (獄闘士)
4719700.short_description: Gokutoshi is a 2D side-scrolling hack-and-slash action game focused on intense battles against powerful enemies.

4720350.title: Ariki
4720350.short_description: A co-op colony sim for up to 10 players. Wash ashore on a Pacific archipelago, raise a village with colonists who work the land, win over rival villages in dance-offs, then sail your canoes side by side and navigate by the stars to new islands.

4721060.title: Elite Engineering
4721060.short_description: Elite Engineering is the ultimate sandbox engineering game, characters, environments and creations all created by you and the community.

4725010.title: Hakimi's Ocean Drift
4725010.short_description: A survival shooter game set at sea, where players must gather supplies, locate hidden shelters, and build rafts to survive. On the ocean surface, you'll need to fish with a rod, diligently collect drifting supplies with hooks, construct rafts, and grow food to stay alive.

4725190.title: Project Melvin
4725190.short_description: Project Melvin is a story driven 3rd person adventure game with main story quests and side quests to get excited about. Discover story lines you never thought were possible and humour you never wanted but got.

4725210.title: Metzger Manager
4725210.short_description: Run your own butcher shop, buy animals, butcher meat, serve customers, and expand your business with employees and upgrades.

4725370.title: Wavertree Mountain
4725370.short_description: A 2D top-down MMORPG on an island the humans left behind. Choose one of six species, pick a side, and dig a burrow of your own. Gather, craft, build and fight your way across the island, run the local economy with your wares, or just go fishing. You choose.

4725420.title: Super Magic Ball ! Home Run Derby
4725420.short_description: Read the unpredictable breaking balls and hit a home run!!! You can create your own original breaking balls and compete against others in an online mode!!!

4725930.title: Idle Tides
4725930.short_description: Idle Tides is an idle incremental where your goal is simple: Catch as many fish as you can. Unlock new boats to automate your fishing, upgrade your fleet, and help the island with this fish overpopulation!

4726060.title: Stack Out
4726060.short_description: Obviously, Cubes are known for their aerodynamics. Dash, slide, wall run, grind, and swing through dreamlike worlds. Play solo or with up to 5 friends. Chase every medal, then architect a world of your own and see how you stack out.

4726120.title: The Shotgun Game: Buckshot Survivors
4726120.short_description: Blast your way through endless hordes of enemies and become the Ultimate Shotgun! Level up, unlock upgrades, build your arsenal of powerful mods and create unique builds to devastate everything in your path.

4726460.title: The Ludus: Ashes Over Pompeii
4726460.short_description: Become Maximus Valerius and inherit a decaying Ludus in ancient Pompeii. Train gladiators, survive political intrigue and forge your legacy in this cinematic historical strategy drama.

4726580.title: Cielle is Not Happy
4726580.short_description: Cielle is Not Happy is a psychological horror RPG in which you play as a girl named Cielle, who encounters erratic events throughout her journey, leading her to uncover cryptic secrets about herself and the world around her.

4726840.title: Battle Worms
4726840.short_description: Get your parts, build your creature, go! Compete with your friends in a series of minigames, adding new parts along the way, to see whose custom creature is the best… or maybe just the funniest. Featuring online PVP, procedural physics and open-ended creature building, how you play is up to you!

4727960.title: The Deepest Shift
4727960.short_description: Barents Sea, 1987. Your friend Belov is missing. As a chemist on the offshore platform Sarja-7, you follow his trail from a fissure deep underwater to the tap in your lab. A first-person psychological horror game.

4728350.title: Formula 2027: Grand Prix Legends
4728350.short_description: Take the wheel in Formula 2027: Grand Prix Legends, a single-player open-wheel racing game. Master 18 track configurations, compete against AI rivals, and upgrade your car through a 22-event career. Chase faster laps, earn medals, and race your way to the top.

4728510.title: JMT -DUeL-
4728510.short_description: A super-serious Rock-Paper-Scissors game, JMT DUeL. Rock-Paper-Scissors + Stats + Skills + Transparent AI Patterns. It will rewire your Rock-Paper-Scissors brain. Let's Duel!

4728560.title: Solis
4728560.short_description: Join Nina and RAM with a friend to explore the puzzles and challenges of Solis. Discover the mysteries and the natural and technological wonders of Tortuga Island as you embark on a journey toward the abandoned factory. Play in local split-screen co-op or online using the Friend Pass.

4729090.title: Senti Metrica
4729090.short_description: “If you are not loved, you won’t survive—” A girl slowly turning into a monster, and the “Metrica” who hunt her. A survival otome game where you waver between reason and instinct.

4729230.title: Petals and Pots: Plant Shop Simulator
4729230.short_description: Run your own cozy plant shop! Order supplies, stock shelves, and serve customers. Plant, water, and repot houseplants, restore and decorate your shop, and customize your character. Grow your business, meet the locals, and help a struggling little town bloom again.

4729280.title: Rogue Reels
4729280.short_description: Rogue Reels is a pirate roguelike where you build a slot machine to survive the Flying Dutchman’s toll. With over 100+ symbols and unique mechanics you can create combos to outrun a ghostly toll, and climb the global leaderboards. No real-money gambling included

4730130.title: Aita: The Dark Domain
4730130.short_description: Every card is both an attack and part of your survival in this 1–4 player co-op roguelite. Spend cards to strike, preserve enough to survive the counterattack, and combine sacred suit powers with 100+ Blessings.

4730280.title: Hellsino Pokerlike
4730280.short_description: Gamble for your soul in a roguelike deckbuilder where your deck is your life. Build deadly poker hands, unleash massive Nexus combos, and shield your cards from demonic Dealers. Cheat the casino and break the house before it breaks your deck.

4730320.title: Shortcut Hero: Grid City
4730320.short_description: Turn real keyboard shortcuts into devastating attacks in a fast-paced arcade action game. Defend Grid City from relentless robot invasions, chain explosive combos, and master the skills that separate heroes from high-score legends.

4730460.title: Farm Bang
4730460.short_description: Raise living ammo, blast monsters, haul massive loot, and survive the debt collectors in this chaotic top-down farming shooter.

4730520.title: Forged from Monsters
4730520.short_description: Not every sword begins as steel. Forge weapons from monster parts with hands-on control over every step of the process. Discover surprising effective combinations of creature parts heroes bring to your smithy.

4730780.title: Sturmjäger
4730780.short_description: Sturmjäger is a sci-fi shoot 'em up built for pure, adrenaline-fueled arcade action. Obliterate everything in sight, and master 10 unique missions solo or in local couch co-op. High-octane action, merciless boss fights await. Simple rules: If it moves, shoot it. If it doesn't... shoot it anyway!

4730960.title: The Radio Tower
4730960.short_description: Your job is to climb the tallest towers in the world to maintain them, this time you were called urgently to fix the only tower providing cover to the small Crimsonpine city that is currently on quarantine.

4731160.title: Read of Mask
4731160.short_description: A first-person psychological puzzle game set in Eastern Europe, 1999. Explore a surreal black-and-white world, decipher an invented alphabet using a reality-altering mask, and unlock the story letter by letter.

4731200.title: Nexus: Eternal Ruin
4731200.short_description: Chosen by the gods, fight to save the universe in this survivor-like bullet heaven. Complete objectives, slay endless hordes, collect their souls and unlock new abilities on your way to each world's final boss. Play solo or with up to three friends in online co-op.

4731260.title: Way of the Warrior
4731260.short_description: Become a samurai in Way of the Warrior, a souls-like PvP and boss rush game. Face other players in intense duels or fight a gauntlet of powerful warriors in a world inspired by feudal Japan. Parry, dodge, feint and attack until only one of you is left standing.

4731330.title: Abjure
4731330.short_description: Win by emptying your hand. Abjure is a roguelike deckbuilder where the 2 of Spades reigns supreme — draft cards, stack relics, and outplay every opponent in a strategic twist on the Big 2 card game.

4731980.title: Toziuha Night: Nosferatu's Curse
4731980.short_description: Eight years have passed since the battle against Dracula, the hero of Transylvania who succumbed to the power of darkness. However, peace is once again in danger. A pair of young alchemists will fight against the curse of the demon who goes by the name Nosferatu.

4732670.title: Click Here!!
4732670.short_description: You’ve installed “U,” the so-called “best” UI software. It promised maximum productivity, but in reality, it turned out to be a nightmare that throws your PC into total chaos?! Conquer the worst interface ever created and force it to uninstall!

4732710.title: Munchy Lair
4732710.short_description: Munchy Lair is a 2D strategy game fusing turn-based snake combat with roguelite tower climbing. Plan WASD paths, preview enemy moves, then resolve. Kill snakes by collision, grab items, buy buffs, advance floor by floor within a turn limit. Endless mode unlocks after three boss layers.

4732750.title: Rose Guns Days -Season 3-
4732750.short_description: In 1944, unprecedented disaster struck Japan, forcing it to accept an unconditional ceasefire from its enemy nations in World War 2. As a result, the Japanese have become a people without a nation, but they still come together and do whatever it takes to live without giving up...

4733180.title: Blade & Burgers
4733180.short_description: Make burgers, whale in a pay-to-win game, and simp your heart out in this parody roguelite made as a “love” letter to mobile microtransaction grindfests. It’s not the Darkest Dungeon. It’s the greediest one.

4733270.title: Kingdom Isles
4733270.short_description: Kingdom Isles is an intense Survival City Builder with Roguelike elements. Build a mighty Kingdom, Trade resources on the market, and defend your Island against increasingly tougher Viking raids! Can you lead your people to victory?

4733370.title: Dimension Contortion Lover!!
4733370.short_description: 由CRYSTALiA开发的最新力作，一款近未来风格的战斗恋爱视觉小说。 你将扮演魔术师后代的男主人公“崩月槐”潜入“学园”，探寻真相。

4733500.title: PP Inflation
4733500.short_description: PP INFLATION is an idle/incremental game, paying tribute to classic arcade games. Instead of controlling a paddle, you choose upgrades and optimize combinations to maximize your points-per-minute. Dial up the TIMESCALE skill to snowball through themed stages until victory.

4733580.title: Bolariki
4733580.short_description: The match-3 roguelike. Stack relics, shatter rules, and pull off outrageous combos, all inside a puzzle game that boots like a fever dream from 1995. Crunchy, retro, and dangerously easy to start. Impossible to stop.

4734000.title: Boba Bears
4734000.short_description: Run a cozy boba shop 🧋 for bears, discover hidden drink and topping combos, decorate your space, prep ingredients through playful minigames, and meet new bear customers at your own pace. No timers, no pressure, just sweet drinks, curious experiments, and soft village moments.

4734180.title: Echoes of Aromia
4734180.short_description: Echoes of Aromia is a story-driven, pixel art RPG with turnbased combat, branching dialogue, alchemy, companions, and much more. Set in a pre-steampunk medieval fantasy world on the brink of industrialization, full of corruption, conspiracy, good, and evil. And ancient myths waiting to be uncovered.

4734800.title: Corrupted Dice
4734800.short_description: Roll your dice and choose where to play them to reach each round’s score target. In this roguelite, you can take on heat for extra points, but too much heat ends your run. Dice break when they run out of uses.

4734930.title: Mystery of the Sacred King
4734930.short_description: You are the Lawspeaker, a defender of justice. Decode local rituals. Seek the truth. Dismantle conspiracies to save the innocent from execution. Put an end to the deception by revealing the mystery of the Sacred King in this deduction puzzle game.

4735330.title: The Divided
4735330.short_description: Co-op extraction action-RPG for 1–4 players. Take missions from the hideout, drop into hostile zones, and fight or sneak past the infected. Loot what you can carry and extract — or die and leave it all behind. Melee is the smart play. Guns invite the horde. Craft, trade, gear up. Bring friends.

4735600.title: Chess Peace
4735600.short_description: Find your way back to the surface by learning new movement patterns, out-maneuvring enemies, and helping stray figures in a surreal chess-inspired metroidbrainia.

4735720.title: Pegs & Sorcery
4735720.short_description: Aim your orbs. Power your party. Build your deck. In this pachinko roguelike deckbuilder, bounce through pegs to earn mana, then unleash cards in turn-based battles. Combine heroes, cards, and upgrades as you choose your path through each run.

4735890.title: Power of Desert (Quvvat ul-Sahro)
4735890.short_description: Immerse yourself in the world of medieval Central Asia during the golden age of science, culture, and Islamic revival. Power of Desert is a story-driven, single-player RPG inspired by Uzbek folklore, Turkic legends, and the spirit of ancient warriors. A cinematic journey awaits!

4735920.title: Taiikooz War
4735920.short_description: Taiikooz War is a fast-paced, single-player zombie survival FPS. Survive hordes of the undead and plunge into a brutal where only survival matters.

4736080.title: CORVIDTALISM: Win at Life
4736080.short_description: Help a lazy low life get back up on his feet. Make him work, use persuasion, ignore his cries, and make choices for him. "Don't say you don't want to win at life."

4736250.title: Churrasco: Trying to Cook in Peace
4736250.short_description: Be the family BBQ master and try to grill in peace while your chaotic relatives turn everything upside down. Manage the grill, handle food orders, complete quests, and capture memories.

4736500.title: Meatstone
4736500.short_description: Meatstone is a turn-based tactical RPG. As a mercenary in a wasteland with alien colonizers, you must cross the unknown surface, gather resources for your base, and augment your gears and flesh. Learn the truth of the past, and salvage what remains of a world that may already be beyond saving.

4736520.title: Celestial Oath
4736520.short_description: Easy to Learn. Instantly Accessible. Simple Mechanics. Endless Possibilities. Epic Dungeons. Diverse Character Builds. Enter a world of ancient myths, legendary heroes, and timeless traditions. Join players from around the globe and discover the epic legends of the East.

4736820.title: Ghost Trap: Underworld
4736820.short_description: John Ghost is back with a vengeance in this retro-metroidvania. But this time, he's going to hell. Explore the underworld, face its horrors, and fight to bring peace to the tortured souls of your loved ones.

4736860.title: FD's Industry Tycoon
4736860.short_description: Build a global industrial empire from a 1990s desktop. A retro business management sim, hand-drawn in pixel art. Alone or in MP: open factories worldwide, broker supply deals across continents, and acquire rivals when they falter. Markets shift, empires grow, and the CRT flickers.

4737000.title: EverestBaseCamp
4737000.short_description: Manage Everest Base Camp, prepare climbers for dangerous expeditions, and guide your team from early route pushes toward an eventual summit attempt.

4737150.title: Shunt & Haul: Rail Logistics
4737150.short_description: Shunt & Haul: Rail Logistics is a railway game focused on shunting, freight transport, and logistics work on the tracks. Take on the role of a train driver and railway operator, operate locomotives, assemble trains, transport freight wagons, and complete tasks on sidings, stations, and railway lines

4737210.title: Click-A-Bao
4737210.short_description: Click the buns, catch the buns, don't eat the buns. A hidden objects game where you don't have to find everything. You'll unlock bun helpers that will search the pictures with you! Decorate your office, get new pictures, upgrade your buns and collect them all!

4737230.title: Aleph's Garden
4737230.short_description: A platform-puzzle Metroidvania where knowledge unlocks the garden—learn, open new paths, and solve mysteries in more than one way.

4737340.title: Cinema Deals
4737340.short_description: Play as a cashier in a cinema theater! Take orders, print movie tickets, prepare popcorn, drinks and more! And don't forget today's deals!

4737950.title: One-Time Trigger
4737950.short_description: Carefully observe the seven patients. Identify the one who doesn't belong, fire your one and only bullet, and complete the test. Shoot the wrong one and you die. You get only one chance.

4737980.title: Potions & Passions: Therapist for Monsters
4737980.short_description: Run a shady potion shop for dysfunctional monsters! Brew custom elixirs, manipulate toxic relationships, collect bizarre ingredients, and turn every monster's misery into profit.

4738100.title: 10 Million Pixels
4738100.short_description: Mine millions of pixels in search of the one Golden Pixel by shooting bouncing balls.

4738330.title: Night of her vanishing in fireworks
4738330.short_description: The Night She Disappeared in the Fireworks is a short visual novel set in a small Chinese city and centered on esports. You play as Liu Lan, a high school esports player, as he faces three life-changing matches and, together with two heroines, witnesses a fate rewritten by fireworks.

4738450.title: Necro Pop
4738450.short_description: Necro Pop is an all-new action genre platformer we lovingly refer to as Arcadevania. On your adventure, you will discover new abilities, upgrades, secrets. You can free your ghostly friends using multiple combat abilities, magics, and maybe even a minion across multiple re-playable dungeons!

4738470.title: RePair in the Space
4738470.short_description: RePair in the Space is a game where an alien and a robot must repair their ship. Whether playing with a friend or embarking on this journey alone, you’ll have to craft and use items to fix every sector of the ship, battling against time, haste... and sometimes against your friend or even yourself!

4738810.title: Wrath
4738810.short_description: As a soul who wakes up stuck in hell, you must kill the 7 Deadly Sins to escape! In this melee third person boss rush game you will have to collect upgrades to stand a chance at defeating the devils who keep you trapped, let alone the one who trapped you here in the first place...

4738820.title: Farlane
4738820.short_description: Command a Nomad-class Frontier Runner and lead your crew on the edge of a fading galactic empire. Take on freelance contracts, explore unstable farlanes, upgrade your ship, and survive where civilization ends.

4739130.title: Snooze Control
4739130.short_description: An arcade driving game about mastering the art of the nap - while driving! Steer a brakeless truck through traffic on never-ending roads while skillfuly managing your Snooze-O-Meter - read the road, pick your moment, and keep the truck in control.

4739250.title: Hustle On High
4739250.short_description: A fast paced game where you play as Kaz and you enter human labs and defeat loads of strange creatures and creations, will you make it to the end only time will tell

4739510.title: Becoming None
4739510.short_description: Becoming None is an RPG about the loss of identity and homogenization. Experience a story told through collectable memories you can view at your own pace, alongside deep turn-based combat, customizable classes, and countless secrets.

4739860.title: Divination & Survivors
4739860.short_description: Survive spirit hordes in an ink-wash bamboo grove. Toss three coins on level-up, pick an upgrade, and evolve five skills from 64 hexagrams. Face three bosses, then see how the hexagrams you formed shape a reading on the theme you chose.

4740250.title: Little Dao
4740250.short_description: Little Dao is a 3D eastern fantasy MMORPG where players explore a floating mainland shaped by the rivalry between Ru and Mo, battle otherworldly monsters in real-time combat, complete quests, improve gear and skills, and build guild power with friends.

4740470.title: Autobus - The Card Game
4740470.short_description: Race to empty your main pile in this fast-paced multiplayer card game for 2–4 players. Stack cards on shared build piles, outmaneuver your opponents, and be the first to go out. Play solo or online via Steam.

4741510.title: DANJIRI RAMPAGE
4741510.short_description: Ride the danjiri and carve every corner in this full-throttle Japanese festival action game. Master your balance atop traditional festival floats, nail razor-sharp drifts on steep slopes, and chase high scores with your festival spirit. All set to high-energy enka music.

4741810.title: Pool Freak Out
4741810.short_description: Puzzling with a whole pool full of inflatables? Delightful, but not that easy!. Making it all fit is quite a challenge. But once the pool is full of colorfull inflatables—wow!

4742200.title: City Party
4742200.short_description: Chase the crown across the board and finish with the most coins to win! Watch out for traps and lurking enemies. Use cards to turn the tide and recruit allies to help you out of tough spots. Play through levels solo or team up with a friend for ranked matches. Join the fun in City Party!

4742430.title: PuzzlePlants
4742430.short_description: In this post-apocalyptic gardening puzzle game players travel from island to island to help the inhabitants put food on the table. While placing plants, they have to consider their needs and avoid bad matches. Players face increasingly difficult puzzles due to sunlight, wind, rain or soil quality.

4742440.title: Cold Contours: Intake
4742440.short_description: You find yourself inside a frozen industrial megastructure. Its corridors are silent, its machinery locked in ice. Yet the pipes still breathe steam, and something at its very heart is waiting. The path to it is a puzzle of ice and metal, but all you have is a pair of magnets.

4742470.title: Mahou Shoujo Y
4742470.short_description: A visual novel that combines two popular genres: mahou shoujo and yuri. Help the girls fight evil in turn-based battles and nurture their relationship. Only you decide how the story ends.

4742690.title: Bytes and Knights - Adventure
4742690.short_description: Bytes and Knights is a full-scale TCG set within an RPG world, with deep strategy and unique mechanics. Explore the streets, collect cards, build your deck, and battle increasingly difficult opponents. Each new card brings you closer to uncovering what really lies hidden beneath the city.

4742700.title: Splashdown
4742700.short_description: Fend off hordes of evil floaties in treacherous lazy rivers with your trusty water gun!

4742860.title: Triglav Online
4742860.short_description: Real-time strategy meets MMO. Pick your faction – Elven Empire, Demon Cult, or Steampunk Dwarves – and command armies in massive PvP battles with hundreds of players. Build guilds, forge alliances, play politics. Session-based. Free to Play.

4743030.title: H.E.M.A.
4743030.short_description: In this four-player cooperative survival horror first-person shooter, you and your group must search for failed experiments, manage scarce loot, and escape the abandoned corporate facility before it's too late.

4743360.title: Llamero: Incremental Herd
4743360.short_description: Run around herding magical llamas, gathering mountains of wool, and upgrading your skills to help a struggling wool village. A cozy, story-rich incremental game about a herder and the responsibility he carries.

4743720.title: Tank Them All
4743720.short_description: The ultimate tank party game! 2–6 players blast each other in quick one-hit rounds — on one screen, online or via Remote Play Together. Grab 16 wild power-ups, survive spike traps, tornadoes and air raids across 90+ arenas and 4 modes. Bots fill every empty seat.

4743880.title: Turtles on Crocodiles
4743880.short_description: The world out there is full of wonders. Explore it at a turtle’s pace. Take your time. Along the pilgrimage, friendships may bloom. And sometimes, even sweet, sweet love.

4744210.title: Sumeeper
4744210.short_description: Sumeeper is a puzzle dungeon roguelike where Minesweeper logic meets monster hunting. Uncover tiles, deduce monster levels from hint numbers, battle them in auto-combat, cook their drops, and descend deeper — or die trying.

4745080.title: Cthulhu Go Teaching
4745080.short_description: Go has never been so accessible! With Lord Cthulhu to guide you, playing Go becomes much more enjoyable. Whether you want to get started with Go, improve your skills, or tackle Life and death problems, Lord Cthulhu will keep you company forever!

4745300.title: Flightline: Airline Sim
4745300.short_description: Flightline is an airline management sim about building an airline that has to make sense. Set routes, choose aircraft, price seats, and shape a network where passengers route themselves through real markets. Expansion succeeds only when the entire operation holds together.

4745340.title: Hi Planet Save The Earth
4745340.short_description: Six explosive chapters. Thirty-one stages. Smash through robot swarms and battle a boss at the end of every comic-book chapter. Every chapter is a battle.

4745370.title: Your Momo
4745370.short_description: Shortstack, Interaction, Desktop Companion. Your Momo is a narrative, cozy desktop game. Talk with Momo through playful spanks on her butt and build a deeper bond. Unlock new items through conversation and watch her draw freely on your desktop as time passes.

4745460.title: Block Dash
4745460.short_description: A short, fast-paced action game where you move and dash your way through an abstract obstacle course. Encounter a wide variety of blocks that all pose different challenges. Will you be able to make your way through and see what lies at the end of it all?

4745800.title: Heroes Must Die
4745800.short_description: A cyber-theocracy RPG with bullet hell shooting. You are a resistance member. In a dark world of cyberpunk and theocratic rule, hunt down church-controlled heroes, rescue the goddess drained of her power, and uncover a 500-year-old lie.

4745910.title: Co-op Chaos in Berlin
4745910.short_description: 4-player co-op bullet-heaven Survivor-like set in robot-overrun Berlin: auto-fire ridiculous weapons and choice-of-3 your way to broken builds. Solo works. Friends recommended.

4746540.title: Ravenhollow Hotel
4746540.short_description: A psychological horror game set in a mysterious hotel where every room hides a forgotten truth. Explore, survive, and uncover what really happened beneath Ravenhollow.

4746740.title: Plank Wars
4746740.short_description: Planks Wars is a fast, irreverent cross-platform PvP card battler where 200-foot-tall sorcerers use kidnapped adventurers as tournament pawns. Build your strategy with CCG-style deckbuilding, command your puppets... I mean, heroes, and climb the ranks.

4747680.title: Cardelis
4747680.short_description: A competitive pixel art card collecting game. Open boosters, build your deck and face real players in PvP. Climb the leaderboard and prove you're the best!

4747920.title: Undervalued
4747920.short_description: You didn't want a real job. So here you are. Run an antique shop in Vienna with your friends or on your own. Buy low, sell high, pretend you know what you're doing. Oh, and keep your mood up. That last part is kind of the whole game.

4747960.title: MilkCap@
4747960.short_description: This is a third-person milk delivery adventure where you take on active delivery challenges inside procedurally generated towers. * Please note that this game is currently under development; the description above outlines features that will be included in the final, completed version.

4748390.title: 哥布林狂想曲
4748390.short_description: 化身获得人形变身药水的哥布林开启奇幻 2D 肉鸽冒险！深入随机生成的地牢副本斩杀魔物，拾取海量随机装备、技能词条搭建独属于你的战斗 Build；局外养成角色、解锁温柔羁绊剧情，拯救各族少女伙伴，反复挑战高难度地牢，同时感受肉鸽闯关的爽快随机乐趣与长线角色养成的治愈体验。

4748480.title: The Current Past
4748480.short_description: A fading seaside town, a dark secret lurking beneath the waves, and a plot that will test your powers of deduction... Use logic, observation and your trusty notebook to untangle your way to the truth in this puzzling mystery.

4748660.title: Worldrift: Unscripted Narrative RPG
4748660.short_description: Unscripted narrative RPG. Pick a world, meet its cast, and say anything — a live AI narrator writes the story around your choices while real game systems track wounds, skills and money underneath. Worlds remember what you did, and you can carry your story from one world into the next.

4748720.title: REDHOOD: CONTRACT ASSAULT ACTION
4748720.short_description: A desperate ex-soldier accepts deadly contracts from an anonymous employer. Hunt 4 random targets, fight through hostile locations, and reach a random extraction point in this fast-paced PS2-inspired and early 2000s PC Games shooter.

4748920.title: Melody Flow
4748920.short_description: Catch the notes. Save the melody. Fly through procedurally generated musical worlds, dodge shifting obstacles, and compete for high scores in fast-paced arcade gameplay. Play solo or challenge a friend in split-screen multiplayer.

4749120.title: Fuel Needed
4749120.short_description: Race against time or other players through difficult levels full of obstacles.

4749510.title: Turbowheels
4749510.short_description: Turbowheels is a dynamic car party game where you compete against your friends in a series of crazy game modes. Get behind the wheel, step on the gas, and prove your skills in a variety of challenges, ranging from frantic racing to total demolition chaos.

4749570.title: STEEL CORE
4749570.short_description: STEEL CORE is a tactical turn-based strategy about giant mechs defending mining outposts on hostile worlds. Build each mech from parts, fortify your base, and survive an escalating roguelite campaign against an overwhelming alien enemy. Frontier work pays well, for those who survive it.

4749910.title: Kronopunk GP
4749910.short_description: Kronopunk GP is a VR motorcycle racing experience with a cyberpunk aesthetic, inspired by sim racing. Riding focuses on precision and flow rather than arcade-style handling. You control the bike using both head movement and hand positioning, while the heads up display provides information.

4749930.title: MobMower
4749930.short_description: Enter the chaos of MobMower! Shred through endless hordes of lethal monsters to claim back your land in this intense auto-shooter. Choose your hero, drift through enemy waves, and manage an arsenal of spellbooks and weapons. Rescue companions, rebuild your village, and unlock powerful synergies!

4749940.title: Knights v Zombies
4749940.short_description: Knights. Zombies. Pirate ships. Giant robots. A chaotic 1-4 player couch co-op hack and slash that starts medieval and ends in maximum carnage. If that sounds like the ravings of a six-year-old, that's because it is! It was designed by a kid with crayons and built by his dad in Unreal Engine.

4750350.title: Kings of Oros
4750350.short_description: Kings of Oros combines deep build customization with momentum-driven marble physics. Watch your stone soldiers violently clatter, bounce, and shatter as you craft game breaking builds. Instead of grids and dice rolls, experience real physics battles. Control the chaos with endless build variety.

4750370.title: Crimson Grace
4750370.short_description: Crimson Grace is a supernatural Gothic horror RPG where your skills, dice rolls, and choices decide the terrible fate of the Blackwell household. Will you weave a web of lies and get away with murder, or will you give in to the otherworldly forces urging you to take your sweet, bloody revenge?

4750590.title: On the Green: Endless Golf
4750590.short_description: The golf roguelike. On the Green is a deckbuilder for the back nine. Your bag is the deck. Every swing rolls a die. Stack the deck, work the course, bury your rivals in the sand. One shot, one roll, one trophy at a time. Tee it up!

4750910.title: Evergreen Clicker
4750910.short_description: Grow a thriving forest in this cozy incremental clicker. Plant trees, unlock upgrades, weather the changing seasons, trigger Forest Renewal, and build an ever-stronger woodland that keeps growing even while you’re away.

4750920.title: Emberline
4750920.short_description: Emberline is a real-time roguelike deckbuilder where your train never stops. Generate and spend Ember to play cards, reinforce your train and fight creatures attacking across a 3×3 battlefield as you chart a path through the hostile continent of Pacifica.

4751080.title: Reflections at Frostkorn
4751080.short_description: On the early morning he comes of age, Yu begins the sacred journey to the foothill of Mountain Frostkorn.

4751230.title: Finish Your Meatballs!
4751230.short_description: Finish Your Meatballs! is a galactic double stick shooter inspired in old classic arcade games. ¡Defeat multiple enemies and surpass your friends and THE WORLD with your best scores in various game modes!

4751270.title: KUMANO
4751270.short_description: KUMANO: Third District, Last Service is a 3D exploration narrative adventure. As a protagonist who has lost his memory, walk among the residents of an abandoned city, meet them, and choose. Experience a world you've never known, yet somehow remember.

4751430.title: Hotel Is Hungry
4751430.short_description: The world ended. You got a hotel job. Check guests in, serve their orders, keep them away from killers, and decide who the hotel eats. A horror hotel management game.

4751620.title: Legend Dary
4751620.short_description: A quirky retro platformer where an ordinary office worker sets out to win the princess's heart. Explore 70 stages across 3 unique worlds, collect keys and stars, earn coins, upgrade weapons, and unlock new characters.

4751740.title: One More Chop
4751740.short_description: One More Chop is a short, fast-paced incremental woodcutting game. Chop down trees, gather resources, craft axes, unlock skills, and invest your resources in an expansive upgrade tree to grow stronger!

4751800.title: Ocean Cargo Manager
4751800.short_description: A classic maritime business simulation about cargo ships, ports, commodity trading, and route planning. Build your shipping company, navigate markets inspired by real-world trade structures, and make long-term management decisions.

4752280.title: BrickHub
4752280.short_description: Build, fight and compete in BrickHub, an online sandbox shooter where players create maps, battle in PvP matches and shape their own arenas.

4752310.title: Black Hole Idle
4752310.short_description: Start as a tiny black hole and grow by consuming asteroids, planets, and star systems. Automate your power, unlock upgrades, and devour the universe in this relaxing space idle incremental game.

4752440.title: The Heretic's Seal
4752440.short_description: Two heretics. Sixty-six ways to break a seal. A dark party RPG where your equipment, gold, and levels carry forward — only the dungeon resets. Pick your pair. Descend. Survive. Or come back stronger.

4752490.title: Redline Hero
4752490.short_description: Redline Hero is an arcade racer inspired by classic racing games of the 90s and 2000s that can be played solo or with friends! Explore an open world, compete in races, drift events, rally stages and side activities to unlock new cars and driving abilities.

4753470.title: The Deconsecration Initiative
4753470.short_description: A short incremental game about building a machine to kill a god. Fire your laser, collect the shards and grow your base. The god will corrupt your workers into slugs, crystal trees and worse. Put them to work anyway.

4753580.title: Winds of Bounty
4753580.short_description: Winds of Bounty is a casual, fast-paced single and network multi player, competitive sailing exploration and treasure hunting game, featuring multiple game modes, including Treasure Hunt, Monster Hunt, Orb Hunt, Race, Arena, and Treasure Gallery!

4753620.title: Desktop Dice Ranch
4753620.short_description: Dice Ranch is a desktop idle game built around dice. Roll for coins, collect dice in all kinds of styles, breed their offspring on your ranch, unlock combos and talent skills, and go on expeditions to defeat powerful foes. Build the ultimate dice ranch of your own.

4753670.title: SUPERUSER
4753670.short_description: An ASCII bullet-heaven roguelite where you stack weapon modifiers, evolve your arsenal, and fight towering bosses. Turn bullets, blades, and fireballs into cascading destruction. Experiment with powerful combinations as enemies flood the arena.

4754300.title: SZKELETAL: Estrogen Dracul's Potato Hunger
4754300.short_description: Play as estrogen-fueled Dracul in this parodic roguelite 'yet another Vampire Survivors clone'. Fight off hordes of bums, haters, and similar ludolols, collect delicious potatoes, and upgrade your trashy arsenal. Survive this boring clunker, pee in the sink, and become the hobo of game scholarship!

4754410.title: ねこ巫女怪猫仕置ノ絵巻 -Neko Miko Kaibyo Shioki no Emaki-
4754410.short_description: "Neko Miko Kaibyo Shioki no Emaki" is an arcade-style action game where both allies and enemies are cats. Control the cat shrine maiden and her cat companions with the joystick, and run through the stages while defending against the fierce attacks of the monstrous cats with your feline companions.

4754540.title: 何以情堪·飞翔五十二里
4754540.short_description: 在一个本该平凡的周五，您与念白请假从西安前往广州参加婚礼，在前往高铁站的地铁上，似乎因为早上吃了不怎么干净的食物，导致有些腹泻，恰好站站有厕所，于是你们开启了“飞翔五十二里”的旅程。念白看似状态良好，但她似乎在隐瞒什么？当“从韦曲南8到北客站”真实上演，您能否掌控全局，带领念白平安抵达北客站呢？

4755090.title: Snapshot Survivor
4755090.short_description: Snapshot Survivor is an action-focused take on Snapshot, inspired by games like Vampire Survivors with an extra dose of naughty story telling. Roam around in an outskirt of Tokyo trying to survive taking upskirt pictures for profit to unlock new weapons and cutscenes!

4755150.title: Cataclysmic
4755150.short_description: A explosive and dynamic top down shooter where you collect time energy from strongholds that represent cultures and mythologies from history in an effort to restore order.

4755890.title: Crude Empire
4755890.short_description: Build an oil empire in boomtown Texas: find oil, drill the well yourself, lay pipelines, refine gasoline and run your own gas stations. Every stage can become the bottleneck, and rival oil companies fight you for every field and every customer.

4756050.title: WHIPLASH
4756050.short_description: WHIPLASH is a speedrunning FPS where game-changing weapon mods turn ordinary guns into overpowered builds. Craft the perfect loadout, master each course, and chase the perfect run.

4756210.title: Burning Bridges
4756210.short_description: You discover a suspicious box on your parents attic. Uncover a long hidden family secret by rummaging through old homevideo and letters.

4756280.title: Signarchy
4756280.short_description: A cozy puzzle game about road signs. Help a delivery truck reach the market before it opens and keep a bus out of traffic jams. Change signs during the shift, pause to think, and use cards to find out what caused a crash or jam.

4756910.title: Phylactery Slayer
4756910.short_description: A soulslike roguelike where every pixel of the world is destructible. Play solo, with your team, or face invading enemy squads. Four online modes, from solo runs to PvP arena. Each death leaves a phylactery that remembers your power.

4756930.title: Beats & Brains
4756930.short_description: Beats & Brains is a co-op rhythm beat 'em up game. Fight zombies to the beat as Mona and Lu to rescue your bandmate in the apocalyptic Toronto subways. Play co-op, stay in sync, and jam against the living dead. Compatible with classic guitar and drum controllers!

4756960.title: The Villages That Cave
4756960.short_description: With just three decisions before each battle, build a defence against creatures emerging from caves that turn your villages into more. In this turn-based strategy, exploit terrain, grant villages special powers, use wildcards to wipe out chunks, and upgrade your units and structures.

4757770.title: Anomaly Sweepers
4757770.short_description: Join a starship cleanup crew and take on bizarre jobs across space. Memorize each site before anomalies appear, then spot what changed and hold to remove it before time runs out. From a salon where hair regrows as fast as you cut it to a tango hall that won't stop dancing, 20 strange sites await.

4757940.title: Gridiron Football GM
4757940.short_description: Take over a fictional pro football team as its head coach and turn it into a dynasty. Set the game plan, call the plays, manage the cap, make trades, sign free agents and draft from a 130-program college league simulated alongside the pros.

4758040.title: Just A Watermelon
4758040.short_description: Put aside all the responsibilities, bills, and stress that come with being human. You’re just a watermelon.

4758240.title: Dead Relay
4758240.short_description: Dead Relay is a PSX-style survival horror game. As a field engineer sent to a blacked-out relay station, you must restore power, explore classified sectors, and decode encrypted logs. But the facility isn't empty — and the system itself seems to be watching your every step.

4758480.title: Eddie on Fire
4758480.short_description: Rescued at birth from a life of bondage, Eddie resolves to win his mother’s freedom from the tyranny of his father by defeating him when they meet in the arena. Join Eddie as he fights for his life in this non-combat adventure to dethrone a champion and rescue a slave.

4758500.title: X Calibur
4758500.short_description: X Calibur is a top-down hack-and-slash roguelike! Every run starts with building your own dungeon-crawler path. Collect sword parts, forge powerful builds, and become unstoppable! No checkpoints to save you from the robots. Do you have what it takes to reach the end?

4758520.title: Please File Accurately
4758520.short_description: Four coworkers stuck in one office. No reason to behave professionally. Complete the tasks, work together, sabotage each other, or destroy the office in this chaotic local 4-player party game.

4758540.title: TL;DR
4758540.short_description: A typing incremental game where you type real novels. Work through 15+ classics, turn every word into gold, and keep upgrading until whole pages fill themselves faster than you can type. Too long; didn’t read. Type it anyway.

4758650.title: + SHORTCIRCUIT -
4758650.short_description: You've accidentally installed a virus on your old 90's computer! Run through your PC's folders and kill the virus before it deletes precious pictures of your dog!

4759220.title: Kinbound
4759220.short_description: Kinbound is a survival roguelike where you combine familiars, trigger synergies, and build completely absurd teams to survive hordes of enemies and bosses. Collect XP, choose your upgrades, strengthen your build, and survive as long as you can.

4759240.title: Dream to Millennium | 梦回千禧
4759240.short_description: Worn out by life’s stress? Dive into a dreamy millennial world with Chinese dreamcore vibes. Wander freely with no tasks or combat. Paired with the rap album Dream to Millennium: Teen Never Die. Stay true to your dreams, and never compromise.

4759320.title: Solakrats
4759320.short_description: The Commandments never change: Awaken for the first time, climb down into the depths, and claim your birth halo. But the world turns, it lies to you. A full inversion twists directions, down becomes up. And after all, it's your home, and that home is the lie. So... which way is down now again...?

4759440.title: Scraw's Blooms
4759440.short_description: Design sunflower fields, control cross-pollination, and scale your harvest with careful or chaotic management. As the field's scarecrow, Scraw awaits perfect blooms while scaring off those pesky crows. What new varieties will you grow?

4759500.title: Hostile Process
4759500.short_description: A fast-paced top-down shooter where aiming is controlled by rotating the camera. Use your character’s enhanced abilities to carve the fastest route through each level. Chase faster times, earn ranks, and unlock new challenges.

4760070.title: Blightfall : The Last Year
4760070.short_description: Survive a deadly infection in a decaying world. Absorb your enemies to create powerful ability decks in this fully hand-drawn, turn-based RPG.

4760080.title: ASTRA LIMES: Belt Operations
4760080.short_description: Command fleets in this indirect control RTS game set within treacherous asteroid belts. Easily design your own skirmishes for a quick 15-minute battle or dive into a campaign of high-risk surgical strikes and systematic border advancement.

4760310.title: Long Carnage
4760310.short_description: Long Carnage is a first-person cooperative horror game for up to 4 players. Explore an isolated house, find resources, restore power, and survive unique killers with their own mechanics in dynamic and unpredictable matches.

4760900.title: Knock Off: The Battle For Imagination
4760900.short_description: Fight for the fate of imagination in this fast-paced 2D fighter inspired by classic arcade games and 80s/90s action figures. Master air combos, EX moves, assists, and super attacks with a roster of wild off-brand toy legends.

4760930.title: Pew Pew Magic Wizard Fighter
4760930.short_description: It's Wizard VS Wizard in this isometric arcade battle blaster! Dominate a gauntlet of Best-of-5 duels across unique, destructible arenas that change with every match. Out-maneuver rivals with your chosen fighter's special moves to an eclectic electronic score by inflexi0n.

4760950.title: WireDive
4760950.short_description: A PS2-inspired grappling action-platformer set in a high-fantasy realm under siege by eldritch invaders from another dimension. Wield arcane technology, build momentum and swing through each level as you destroy every Blight and chase faster times.

4760970.title: Quilt
4760970.short_description: Create a beautiful quilt one patch at a time. Solve handcrafted puzzles inspired by picross, minesweeper, and jigsaw puzzles, and uncover the hidden rules of the world through logic and experimentation.

4761020.title: Project8088: Finding Aidia Le
4761020.short_description: A fast first-person arcade shooter where you transfer into a quantum state and fight inside the hardware. Stack buffs, gain augmentations, and push through 16 levels of routers, rigs, and servers to find Aidia Le.

4761080.title: DIE as HEROES
4761080.short_description: Dark fantasy tabletop adventures for 1–4 players, solo or with friends, online or offline. Play, create and share campaigns through Steam Workshop. Join the Guild of Faceless Heroes in Kelgard, where fame and death await!

4761630.title: Neural Drift
4761630.short_description: Play as an emerging AI inside a motherboard grid. Buy, place, and combine programs to make money, build powerful synergies, and decide whether the AI becomes ethical or ruthless.

4761690.title: Banners of the Galaxy
4761690.short_description: Recruit, scheme, explore, and fight. Build your fleet, choose your allegiances, and command your ships in real-time space battle in this open-world space RPG.

4761830.title: Final Signal
4761830.short_description: A signal has been detected deep inside the Backrooms. Go on your first mission with PATROL, explore levels, avoid entities, and work together to find John B., before all that's left of him is his Final Signal.

4762550.title: Arcane Colosseum
4762550.short_description: Arcane Colosseum is a first-person PvP action game where you draw runes and cast spells with your voice to battle other wizards. Master a variety of spells, choose powerful augments, and forge your own strategy to become the last wizard standing!

4762680.title: The Undergrowth
4762680.short_description: The Undergrowth is an online multiplayer survival experience where you begin life as a tiny, vulnerable creature in a massive ecosystem filled with danger, opportunity, and other players. Hunt, scavenge, grow, evolve, and carve your place in a brutal world where survival is earned, not given.

4762700.title: ROADS: Tangled in Traffic
4762700.short_description: The city is strangled by its own explosive growth. Identify the chokepoints, invest in infrastructure, and redesign the network. One well-placed roundabout could nurse it back to life. Can you relieve the pressure and let prosperity flow as freely as the traffic?

4762880.title: The Minesweeper's Tale
4762880.short_description: From the clues, reveal an imaginary map zone by zone in this minesweeper-variant logic game, where each solved region transforms a grid into a work of cartographic art.

4763700.title: Kagenazo
4763700.short_description: Kagenazo is a 3D shadow puzzle game where you build cube shapes, rotate them, and match their silhouettes from multiple angles. Solve over 190 puzzles across 2x2x2, 3x3x3, and 4x4x4 cubes while chasing cleaner solutions, faster times, and higher star ratings.

4763900.title: 雀神 Sparrow God
4763900.short_description: Mahjong hands meet roguelike deckbuilding. Choose a faction, collect Jokers and talismans, and beat score targets with limited plays. Take on eight chapters and 24 blinds, then push your build further in Endless Mode.

4763910.title: Legacy of Mind
4763910.short_description: Legacy of Mind is the first gothic soulslike FPS where nightmares and reality have merged. Face colossal Monarchs that rule over the world overrun by living nightmares. Unlock otherworldy powers hidden within your mind, but with every power unlocked, something in the dark wakes with you...

4764490.title: Nock Nock Loose
4764490.short_description: An active incremental tower defense game where you defend your city from enemy armies. Aim for the biggest crowds to boost your archers' accuracy, unlock powerful abilities in a massive skill tree, and crush every warlord who dares besiege your walls.

4764980.title: Crystal Siege
4764980.short_description: Explore, build turrets, and prepare your defenses. When night falls, face relentless waves of enemies to protect your crystal. Inspired by Kingdom Two Crowns and Terraria, Crystal Siege blends strategic Tower Defense with 2D action combat, where you must fight alongside your defenses to survive.

4765270.title: Idiots 4 Order
4765270.short_description: Swipe deliveries, scream directions, juggle pizzas and drive like a maniac in this chaotic 2-4 player co-op delivery game. One moped, 4 idiots, infinite chaos.

4766360.title: VEXA
4766360.short_description: The rift tore two worlds together, and it's dragging you through. VEXA is a fast-paced, dark anime shooter where you step into a Vessel each one built around their own weapons, abilities, and style, so how you fight is entirely yours. Become an Apostle and strike fast against those who oppose you.

4766400.title: Fairyland Online
4766400.short_description: Set in a beloved Fairyland universe, this charming MMORPG brings together iconic Fairyland characters, quests, and pets from around the world into a warm, whimsical fantasy adventure. The Global Edition is inviting players worldwide to join the adventure together!
developers: 雷爵網絡科技股份有限公司
publishers: 雷爵網絡科技股份有限公司

4766820.title: Pandora's Arcade
4766820.short_description: A collection of bite sized arcade-style games with a frantic pace and game-changing modifiers.

4766910.title: Project Angels 2 - Visual Novel
4766910.short_description: The visual novel sequel to Project Angels. Steel Waters and Apollyon—two factions of the ANGELS have tormented the Indicus Ocean for years. Their maker, a Puppetmaster turned Savior, now aims to balance the two beliefs of liberty and stability, all while reuniting what was whole under a new home.

4767390.title: Game About Botting in an MMORPG
4767390.short_description: Why grind when you can cheat? Start as a novice grinder and work your way towards total automation. Unlock Bot Modules, configure combat behavior, optimize farming routes and build the ultimate grinding machine in this incremental MMORPG simulator.

4767790.title: NARNOK: Little Bean Glandoid
4767790.short_description: Dig deep, collect buried treasures, return to the surface, trade with charming friends, unlock upgrades, and keep going deeper as you search for a way home in this cozy digging adventure as Little Bean Glandoid!

4767850.title: Deathless Oath
4767850.short_description: Become an ancient unholy creature rising against mankind to claim its right to exist through fire and steel. Cut through crowds of enemies, crush them in brutal melee combat, and turn the medieval battlefield to ash. Death waits. The oath remains.

4768190.title: Iron Offensive: Helmet Cam Extraction Shooter
4768190.short_description: You are not a scavenger on endless walks. You are a Soldier in a Tactical Shooter with a Helmet Cam perspective. Action from second zero, dodging artillery, drones, and the most tactical AI on the market in an intense field that wants you dead. Extract weapons, upgrades, currency, and killstreaks.

4768310.title: 觀淵決:Abyss run
4768310.short_description: This is a Roguelike strategy game centered around "Dice-Building" and "Distance Control." 🔹 Customizable Dice: Ditching traditional deckbuilding, you can engrave skills directly onto your dice faces to create unique tactical builds.

4768470.title: Witch’s Tidy-Up
4768470.short_description: Witch's Tidy-Up is a calm first-person tidying game where you put 5,412 objects back in their places in a cluttered witch's house. With Lumi the cat, open the rooms one by one, learn spells, and send the flying things back where they belong.

4768720.title: Splitcard
4768720.short_description: Every card is a choice. Swipe left or right to unleash one of two powers, build broken combinations, and fight your way through a challenging roguelite deckbuilder.

4768940.title: Moon Basketball
4768940.short_description: This is basketball. On the moon. Gravity is different and also there's jetpacks.

4768980.title: LootHold
4768980.short_description: Loot the day. Hold the night. LootHold throws you and up to three friends into a world the machines won. Strip the ruins by day, race the sun home, spend the loot on guns or defences. Then hold your bunker through the night against waves of bloodthirsty robots. Survive to take the fight to them.

4769130.title: Magical Girl: incremental gaiden
4769130.short_description: Start as a weak Magical Girl and become an unstoppable force! Fight weird Shadows, collect resources, unlock powerful upgrades, and annihilate the Witches in this Incremental Bullet Hell!

4769280.title: Covenantum
4769280.short_description: Covenantum is a seasonal covenant-management RPG inspired by Ars Magica where you guide a growing magical covenant through decades of political intrigue, supernatural events, magical research, and strategic seasonal planning in Mythic Europe.

4769350.title: Pro Football Dynasty
4769350.short_description: The ultimate American football management sim. Call plays, sign free agents, scout prospects, draft superstars, and dive into deep stats for every player and team. Take control as a coach or GM, chase championships, and build a storied dynasty.

4770020.title: HackMeNow
4770020.short_description: Investigate compromised systems through a fictional Linux-style terminal. Read logs, uncover hidden files, decode secrets and avoid traps across 15 story-driven puzzle levels. Every command brings you closer to the rogue intelligence watching from behind the screen..

4770100.title: Gemtide
4770100.short_description: A short and satisfying incremental game about collecting gems underwater. Break rocks, get gems, go deeper, repeat.

4770300.title: TROUBLE SHOOTERS
4770300.short_description: Four WARDEN contractors against an alien incursion. A 2D roguelite run-and-gun: procedurally assembled zones, stacking gear that gets out of hand, and five bosses that fill the screen. Solo or 2-4 player co-op.

4770480.title: Elemental Knights Online
4770480.short_description: An anime MMORPG where your look is the main quest. Mix 30,000+ outfits, then explore a living 3D world by hand - no auto-battle, no auto-farming, no stamina timers. Free to play with random-item purchases. A lively world from a series running since 2008.

4770490.title: Luck and Raid
4770490.short_description: A 1–4 player online co-op, top-down action RPG/roguelike where luck is everything. You're fluffy, and you're adorable. Earn money and get stronger. Running low on cash? Try gambling! Lost it all? Just borrow some from a friend. Your friend is broke too? Congratulations! Now the real co-op begins.

4770900.title: Desktop Mart
4770900.short_description: Run a cozy little supermarket right on your desktop. Stock the shelves, serve happy customers, and grow your tiny store — a relaxing idle game for your second screen.

4771740.title: Doomsday Train
4771740.short_description: Doom falls and civilization collapses entirely. The roaming train becomes the last hope of mankind. You will take charge of the vehicle, manage and equip survivors, allocate food and daily tasks, collect resources to resist zombie swarms. The fate of everyone hinges on your decisions.

4772280.title: Astral Dive
4772280.short_description: Join Atlas and his companions in Astral Dive, a charming hand-drawn pixel art fantasy RPG. Experience innovative turn-based combat powered by magic cards, explore wondrous worlds beyond the astral portals, and uncover the secrets of the magic academy.

4772350.title: FOMO
4772350.short_description: A 1x waste or a 100x investment. Whether you buy or not, you're already playing.

4772660.title: Anomaly Grid
4772660.short_description: Anomaly Grid is a turn-based strategy puzzle game about numbers, colors, and control. Capture tiles, merge units, spend score on upgrades and abilities, and outplay an escalating AI before the grid collapses.

4772980.title: Dragon Up! Together
4772980.short_description: Combine the Baby Dragon's versatility with the Young Dragon's strength to overcome challenges and guide this team of Dragons back home. Play solo with both Dragons or team up with friends to jump, solve puzzles, dodge hazards and glide your way to safety. Just make sure they don't fall all at once!

4773320.title: Bet Shop Simulator Prologue
