4874290.short_description: IncyanSpace follows the story of Li, an artificial human, who sets out to find his long-lost original human brother Yuan. Together with surviving New Humans, they stand against Xystem, a dominant force of mechanical lifeforms that controls the surface world.

4874320.title: Dear Polder
4874320.short_description: The sea took half your fields. Dear Polder is a cozy farming life sim in a Dutch polder village, solo or in 4-player online co-op. Mend the dike, let your windmill pump the land dry, then befriend 40 villagers and dance under the lanterns on festival nights.

4874720.title: TappyCat
4874720.short_description: TappyCat is a cute pixel kitty who settles onto your desktop and turns work and study into a warm, cozy ritual. It's a desktop pet, a Pomodoro timer, and a smart productivity tracker all at once - all in one little cat.

4874970.title: Deck Forge
4874970.short_description: Forge a deck, carve your path. A dark-fantasy roguelike deckbuilder: five classes, 375+ original cards, deadly relics, branching trails that never play out the same way twice, and online co-op for up to four. Every run is a new gauntlet — die, learn, build deadlier.

4875400.title: FREEWAVE
4875400.short_description: FREEWAVE is an epic spaceship action-adventure. Explore a vast, tattered city in search of answers. Fly between crumbling buildings and become a master pilot. Fight against the oppressive tech regime ULTRASOFT and defend yourself against rotten monsters. All hand drawn with pen and watercolor.

4876110.title: Oops, No Floor!
4876110.short_description: Bring your own floor in a chaotic co-op platformer for 1–4 players. Carry, throw and place floor panels, spring over gaps, dodge factory machinery and a claw-armed robot, and pull your friends out of trouble before the clock runs out.

4876420.title: Trench Demon
4876420.short_description: An action-RPG set during WW1. The men in the trenches start to whisper about a figure in armor who walks through gunfire, cannot be killed, and won't stop. Clear the entire Western Front and become a demon.

4876600.title: 仙路烟尘
4876600.short_description: Path of Immortal Dust is a text-based cultivation sim. Train your techniques, break through realms, and explore a world of sect politics and turn-based combat. Every action costs time. Every choice shapes your fate. Immortality is but a thought away.

4876820.title: Joint Venture: Prison Commissary Simulator
4876820.short_description: Run the prison commissary from behind the window: match IDs to prisoner numbers, obey the guards' daily rules, and fill orders for profit. Then build a contraband empire in drugs, shivs, and smuggled goods, dodging patrols, x-rays, and pat-downs. Serve your time, or smuggle your way out.

4877100.title: The Gastarbeiters
4877100.short_description: The Gastarbeiters is a 1-5 player co-op game about building when the whole world is against you. Build a house through explosions, assaults, and raging storms. Will you complete the construction and survive?

4877120.title: AJ's Anomaly
4877120.short_description: Short narrative driven horror. Play as Amelia Jalisco, a fashion designer locked in her apartment. Hangout with your imaginary boyfriend, use your anomaly therapy device, and explore your dreamlike surroundings.

4877290.title: Global Parity
4877290.short_description: Lead one of 15 nations from 1999 to 2019. Balance the budget, pass laws through parliament, win elections, sign treaties and fight on a moving front line, while AI nations build, trade and go to war around you.

4877600.title: Murdok
4877600.short_description: A dark action RPG of ash and betrayal. Master 45 skills, socket runes to forge your build, and fight through five acts of horror to the Abyss Throne. Claim the Crown or shatter it, then survive a level 100 endgame.

4877780.title: HALFLIGHT
4877780.short_description: A survival horror roguelite about a house that erases itself behind you. Learn to read doors, solve puzzles, and survive things you cannot fight. Every step is permanent, there is no way back. Find the way out.

4877880.title: FlyMuse  2
4877880.short_description: FlyMuse 2 takes a “semi-conscious” electronic lifeform, based on a real fruit fly brain, on an adventure. Observe brain activity, tune neural circuits, and reshape the environment as you follow clues through homes, streets, and the underground world.

4878190.title: The Book of Plagues 2
4878190.short_description: A steam-age city is gripped by a plague called False Death. You are a doctor once wrongly condemned, but now they need you. Every patient matters: one decision in your office can change the fate of the entire city.

4878290.title: Bonsai Island
4878290.short_description: Grow, shape, and sell your own fully simulated bonsai trees to adorable animal customers! Turn your humble little bonsai cart into a thriving business on a cozy island.

4878640.title: Mereni
4878640.short_description: A casual Hexcells-like puzzle game where you reveal hidden drawings among the stars.

4878650.title: Gateshock
4878650.short_description: Every map has a code. Build yours, paste it to a friend, beat theirs. A hex-grid tower defense with 14 towers across four upgrade tiers, a hand-crafted 16-mission campaign, and a run mode where 40 relics decide how far you get.

4878690.title: Don't Pick Up
4878690.short_description: Wanted: a reliable technician who follows the rules, handles sensitive information with discretion, and does not ask questions. Fix the phones. Don't look too closely.

4878810.title: WheelJumper: The Art Of Edging
4878810.short_description: A wheelchair ski jumping roguelite about chasing victory in the Happy Friendship Cup. You time your jump at the edge of the ramp and hope your body holds out until the last hill.

4878850.title: GOLF TRIP
4878850.short_description: YOU ARE THE DRUG. Show off your accuracy while controlling an experimental substance designed to strip away human will. High skill, instant restarts, and zero room for error. DELIVER THE DOSE. DON'T FAIL. THIS IS GOLF TRIP.

4879320.title: Not Monsters
4879320.short_description: A medieval themed party game for 4-15 players where social deduction becomes ragdoll combat and monsters hide in plain sight.

4879420.title: BELTFED
4879420.short_description: You are a rogue AI with one directive: AUTOMATE DEATH. Shred, burn and vaporize overwhelming swarms of ravenous bugs as your part factory, part war machine lays waste to one world after another. In BELTFED, the factory is your weapon.

4879490.title: TOX-17
4879490.short_description: Analyze real video footage to solve a poisoning case. Discover the country, city, neighborhood and final location. Every detail may be a clue.

4879750.title: Smashteroids
4879750.short_description: A twin-stick Asteroids roguelite where you stack 190+ absurd upgrades until one fragile ship fills the whole screen with firepower. 22 ships with unique kits, 22 handcrafted bosses, mini-boss packs that crash your stage, 100+ colour palettes, and a branching campaign toward a dying star. Free demo out now.

4879780.title: MAD: Mutually Assured Destruction
4879780.short_description: Turn-based 3D artillery with real physics and cinematic free-fly cameras. Every dollar is a choice: a bigger bomb or a better bunker. Nukes, B-52 carpet bombing, deformable terrain and 25+ battlefields from the desert to the Moon. 1-8 players: online, LAN or couch. Biggest crater wins.

4879790.title: Grit & Greed
4879790.short_description: How much can you take and get away with?

4879830.title: IVORY
4879830.short_description: IVORY is a story-rich, cold weather survival game with cosmic-horror elements. Enjoy the twists and turns of its gripping, dark narrative and rich lore as you explore two open-world locations dripping with psychological terror. Play as a man driven toward his grim fate by cowardice and greed.

4880190.title: Archmage Divine
4880190.short_description: Archmage Divine is a 2D RPG featuring strategic card-based combat and deckbuilding. Explore vast cities and kingdoms, gather unique items and equipment, and enhance your deck as you progress on your journey. If you’re just looking to battle, our Roguelike mode is available at any time.

4880220.title: Idle Dig
4880220.short_description: Idle Dig is an idle mining game that sits on your desktop and plays on its own. Collect 125 unique gems and items, unlock 15 skins, complete quests, and uncover the mystery at the heart of the planet.

4880920.title: Bacon Cannibal
4880920.short_description: EVERYTHING IS GOOD IN THE PIG! Run your own pork restaurant, cook delicious pork recipes for your customers, expand your menu, manage your stock, grow your restaurant, and build your rind empire!

4881130.title: Alien Archeologist
4881130.short_description: Alien Archeologist is a chill incremental digging game. Use a variety of upgradeable tools to mine ore, blast through earth, and clean strange artifacts as you journey yet deeper toward the mystery hiding at the planet's core.

4881260.title: Ghostarium
4881260.short_description: Ghostarium blends haunted house management, ghost catching, and otherworldly exploration. Venture into another world and capture ghosts to work in your haunted house! Build your ghost collection, expand your attraction, and turn visitors’ screams into cash!

4881350.title: I SHALL NAME THE DEAD
4881350.short_description: The Nameless Dead cannot be buried, their remains pile up in a mass of indignity. You have crawled from the gutter to name them. Explore the cemetery and uncover their names before the Worm eats your insides.

4882000.title: The Hollowing
4882000.short_description: You’ve taken a maintenance job, flying between the inter-settlement comms towers in the megastructure. Land, fix, on to the next job. What could go wrong? The Hollowing is a narrative first-person horror flight sim from the creator of Lorn's Lure.

4882480.title: Family Gambling
4882480.short_description: A first-person narrative resource management game where you gamble with your son's organs to survive. Pay your debts, manage your home, and decide how much of your family you're willing to sacrifice.

4882660.title: DigiDuels
4882660.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder card game that will make you remember the classic TCGs: learn the game across a classroom desk, then ride the metro into a branching run of rivals, shops, and big choices.

4882810.title: BoxParty!
4882810.short_description: BoxParty brings multiple online party games together in one platform. Join friends or strangers, jump into quick matches, bluff, guess, trick your opponents, and discover reimagined game modes with events, jokers, and advanced rules.

4883820.title: Kitchen of Gods
4883820.short_description: Greece is starving, and even the gods have to cook! Build divine temples, gather ingredients, and feed the starving in this roguelite management adventure.

4883870.title: Expedition Bonk
4883870.short_description: A short turn-based RPG where three F-tier heroines set out to defeat the Goblin King. Time your attacks and blocks, make every skill count, and power up your party through a shared incremental skill tree. Built to be beaten in about 4 hours.

4884030.title: Pale Cantons
4884030.short_description: A first-person sandbox RPG set in a secluded canton ringed by impassable mountains. Learn trades, fight, barter, earn the locals’ trust, and search for your missing sister but remember: the only way out leads through an ever-changing labyrinth.

4885090.title: LEVELS
4885090.short_description: Explore the first true open-world Backrooms: one infinite, procedurally generated world full of unique biomes, shared by every online player. (And the entities live here too!)

4885480.title: Ruler of Empires
4885480.short_description: Command a nation through the age of steel and empire. Ruler of Empires is a turn-based grand strategy game. Seize a nation, rewrite the century, and conquer province by province across lands. Save an empire doomed to fall, or bring the whole world under a single flag.

4885560.title: TEKUTEKU: Discovery Notebook
4885560.short_description: From a corner of your screen, TEKUTEKU wanders Tokyo, finding small sparkling things for its notebook. Pack its lunchbox and the journey shifts. It scribbles along as you type, and may leave a letter if you stay a while. A hand-drawn, cozy desktop game of discovery and collection.

4885800.title: VeilRaun
4885800.short_description: Become an Explorer of fractured realities in Veil Raun, a third-person dark fantasy action RPG. Take expeditions beyond the Veil, battle Hollows, rise through the Explorer ranks, and uncover the mystery behind the Fracture.

4886180.title: My Cat Companion
4886180.short_description: Your desktop is too quiet. Pick a cat. Paint their fur. One stalks your cursor. One reacts to every click and key. One bounces when tossed. Try to get work done. You answer to them now.

4886790.title: Gökbörü
4886790.short_description: Draw a line, close the loop, crush every demon caught inside. A 3D arcade action roguelite born from Turkic mythology — every open line is a gamble. Power up with divine Boons, face 10 mythic bosses and chase the high score.

4886880.title: Bury Us Together
4886880.short_description: A cooperative survival strategy game with heroes. Explore and expand by day, build your defenses, and hold the line against thousands of enemies by night. Enjoy as a solo player or with up to 3 friends!

4887250.title: Hamlet
4887250.short_description: Hamlet is a medieval city builder where pivotal characters drive your economy and define product quality and quantity. Manage and develop your people wisely because every person counts! Can you grow your hamlet into a powerhouse that rivals even the capital?

4887350.title: This Little World
4887350.short_description: Britain has fallen silent. In a vast 1:1 recreation of the entire island, built from real-world data, begin on foot and bring harmony back to the land: restoring every road, valley, field, town, and tree. Unlock vehicles, reconnect regions, and explore all 200,000 km² of England, Wales and Scotland.

4887970.title: Borrowed Flesh
4887970.short_description: A body-horror deckbuilding roguelike where your whole party shares one deck. Pick 3 of 5 broken souls, and when one falls, every card they carried dies with them. Survive permanent mutilation and descend as far as your flesh can bear.

4888000.title: BLIGHT SWARM
4888000.short_description: BLIGHT SWARM is horde-building action roguelite where you invade Earth as an alien hivemind and run a planetary infection campaign. Turn civilians into zombies, merge your minions into stronger abominations, evolve your Beast, and spread the Blight across the globe.

4888080.title: 5-Star Taxi
4888080.short_description: A fast-paced arcade taxi game where time is your greatest enemy - find shortcuts, deliver passengers, tear through a destructible city, escape the police, and earn a perfect 5-star rating before your shift ends.

4888920.title: Stay On Track
4888920.short_description: A 3d physics based platformer where you play as marble in a marble race that must jump, boost and dodge the onslaught of other marbles to discover if there's more to explore outside the life they're used to.

4889560.title: Rush Hollow
4889560.short_description: Rush Hollow is a movement shooter with a big heart and a lot of guts! Uncover the secrets of Rush Hollow as you fight your way through it's many dungeons.

4889800.title: Void Inc
4889800.short_description: Survive corporate horror in this surreal startup simulator. A dark comedy, where you drink coffee, plan, get through the day, grow the startup, manage staff and explore the company and it's dark secrets.

4889850.title: Rollgeon
4889850.short_description: Build your own collection of customizable dice and battle your way through the dungeon in this turn-based roguelike. Roll, reroll, and create powerful combos inspired by the classic dice game Generala. Enchant your dice, manipulate the odds, and discover new builds with every run.

4890010.title: Call Me BlackJack
4890010.short_description: Build your own blackjack run in a roguelike deckbuilder built from a six-deck shoe. Play hands, buy cards, break the rules, and beat BlackJack to solve a casino mystery. Every run plays differently with new risks.

4890210.title: Mourning House
4890210.short_description: After a terrifying encounter on a lonely road, you awaken inside a mysterious house—and your wife is missing. Explore its dark rooms, solve disturbing puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, and discover what happened before the nightmare consumes you.

4890590.title: One More Rock!
4890590.short_description: A chill incremental game about satisfying mining and automated forging. Mine. Gamble. Upgrade. Repeat. Mine another rock while the lantern is burning.

4890600.title: FrontierLord
4890600.short_description: FrontierLord is a pixel strategy game to build and guard frontier forts. As lord, build villages, collect wood and ore for production. Place siege gear and wall traps, train troops to repel raiders. Balance building and defense, craft your fort and create your frontier legend.

4890660.title: FEDA : The Emblem of Justice
4890660.short_description: Three classic titles released by Yanoman in the early 1990s return for the modern era! Features tactical RPG FEDA, exhilarating action game Trinea, and classic RPG Song Master. Enjoy their iconic pixel art and sound with enhanced, smooth gameplay. A must-have collection for retro fans!

4890670.title: Trinea
4890670.short_description: Three classic titles released by Yanoman in the early 1990s return for the modern era! Features tactical RPG FEDA, exhilarating action game Trinea, and classic RPG Song Master. Enjoy their iconic pixel art and sound with enhanced, smooth gameplay. A must-have collection for retro fans!

4890680.title: Song Master
4890680.short_description: Three classic titles released by Yanoman in the early 1990s return for the modern era! Features tactical RPG FEDA, exhilarating action game Trinea, and classic RPG Song Master. Enjoy their iconic pixel art and sound with enhanced, smooth gameplay. A must-have collection for retro fans!

4890690.title: AVIK
4890690.short_description: AVIK is an atmospheric space sandbox where you explore space. Following a recent tragedy, you must begin your story from scratch, unraveling mysteries of the past while upgrading your spaceship, mining resources, crafting new parts, and fighting for survival.

4890910.title: Desk Hive
4890910.short_description: Tend a living beehive right on your desk. Harvest honey through the seasons, expand your apiary, build a processing line, and automate the work while you're away. A cozy idle beekeeping sim that runs beside you.

4891110.title: The Lost City of Gold
4891110.short_description: The discovery of an adventurer's journal starts you on an unforgettable journey into the heart of an uncharted wilderness in search of the legendary Lost City of Gold. A relaxing, first-person adventure with light puzzles and platforming across 15 levels.

4891120.title: DUSTCROW
4891120.short_description: DustCrow is a space-salvaging and exploration zero-G VR game where you strip derelict wrecks for scrap, manage your tools and equipment in a zero-G environment, and play in a live, player-driven economy. It's just industrial tools, tactile physics, and the daily grind in the vast emptiness of space.

4891840.title: The Last Call
4891840.short_description: Every run starts the same. Never ends that way. Arena, corrupted monsters, zero grind. The Last Call throws you in and lets you figure it out. Tactical combat, short sessions, honest difficulty. Only your skill matters.

4891900.title: NIGHTRAIN POOL HALL
4891900.short_description: Break and bend the rules of pool in this billiards roguelike deckbuilder! Tilt the table, swap and levitate balls, and build powerful combos. Not everything will be smooth sailing, the table itself fights back with stone balls, rising walls and gravity vortices that pull shots off course.

4891950.title: VoxMancer
4891950.short_description: VoxMancer is a voice-driven 3D magic PvP game where players shout their own incantations in battle. Magic is imagination made real: invoke elemental and arcane forces, shape magic with your words, and unleash dramatic, ridiculous, or panicked ideas as powerful spells or spectacular misfires.

4892530.title: Project Longshot
4892530.short_description: Build a space program that reaches the stars in this 1:1 scale spaceflight and colony sim. Design rockets and fly them with real orbital mechanics. Land anywhere in a procedural universe of over two million real star systems, then set up space stations, colonies and factories. How far can you go?

4892660.title: RISE99
4892660.short_description: Rise and strike, mindhacker! RISE99 is a cinematic VR surfer-slasher-shooter. Surf a flying hoverboard and infiltrate lavish high-security sky castles. Blast enemy drones and slash incoming projectiles with saberguns. Can you hack through the bullet heavens and bring down the system of mind control?

4892680.title: Pipefall
4892680.short_description: Pipefall is a fast-paced falling-block puzzle game where every piece is part of a pipeline. Connect pipes, guide the flow and keep building as the pressure rises. Play solo, cooperate with a friend or compete head-to-head in local multiplayer.

4892710.title: Delete: E.A.D Core
4892710.short_description: Delete: E.A.D CORE is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror game. Enter an underground data facility, destroy data disks in the correct systems, and escape from whatever is still inside.

4892750.title: Santa's Escape
4892750.short_description: Christmas Eve, 2003. Mid-delivery, the chimney gives way and Santa falls into a dark, silent house in Cedar Hollow, North Carolina. He isn't alone. Search the rooms, uncover what happened to the Stier family, and find a way out of the house that won't let him go.

4892810.title: HEXECUTIVE ORDER
4892810.short_description: You're a mage the government kept on a leash, and the collar just broke. Fight your way down 44 floors of a very bureaucratic cult with a spellbook, an iron cross and a lot of red barrels. Old-school, fast and messy.

4893790.title: Daily Life With The Herb Girl
4893790.short_description: A slice-of-life visual novel steeped in Traditional Chinese Medicine. Befriend Linglan, a girl manifested from medicinal herbs, learn herbal properties, and guide her through the modern world. Features Live2D.

4893850.title: The Serena Villa Files
4893850.short_description: 'FMV Queen' Wang Han's First K-FMV! At your new job as a security guard in a women's only residence, feelings blossom between you and the charming residents, but strange events also haunt you from your first day. What mystery awaits you and the five ladies of Serena Villa?

4893970.title: Elsinore
4893970.short_description: Playing as Nathan, you are invited to inspect a vacant room in your friend’s share-house. When you arrive, no one seems to be home. Search Elsinore, uncover its secrets and discover what happened to your friend, if you hope to escape.

4894120.title: Los Cuentos de Frox
4894120.short_description: Explore the vast universe of Tora in this classic 2D turn-based RPG. Delve into a deep fantasy world filled with mysteries, traverse interconnected rooms and dungeons packed with secrets, and manage your inventory in a narrative-driven adventure.

4894570.title: [ABERRATION] Yes, Jerry!
4894570.short_description: Mike is an ordinary man, tired of everything. Then he meets Jerry, a huge, purple creature who starts making his life better. Until...

4894750.title: Paper Shredder
4894750.short_description: Shred your company's paperwork to earn a $1,000,000 payout. Paper Shredder is an incremental game where a sheet-after-sheet grind scales into mass document destruction. Shred, sweep, upgrade, and cut down tower-high piles of confidential records to uncover what’s buried beneath. Will you sign?

4894770.title: Flow Treehouse
4894770.short_description: A tiny treehouse tucked into the corner of your desktop. Prince Tomato times your focus, Todudu keeps your to-dos, and Lily plays soft music. Focus, finish tasks and play with them to earn wish points for outfits, playlists and decorations. As the treehouse grows, new fairies move in.

4894870.title: Rogue Curling
4894870.short_description: Balatro-like roguelike curling where physics-based skill matters no less than a solid build. Combine synergies and precision, or just break the rules!

4895070.title: Out A Space
4895070.short_description: Out A Space is a fast-paced, top-down space roguelike combining arcade action with tactical fleet management. Deploy your fleet on a pre-battle grid, customize ship loadouts, and chain weapon effects to shatter enemy armadas from your flagship as you cross the galaxy to uncover an ancient secret.

4895690.title: The Last Stand
4895690.short_description: The Last Stand is an endless medieval wave-based survival game where you hold the line while your people escape. Fight off relentless attackers, explore the abandoned castle, upgrade weapons and gather supplies. Every decision will matter, how long can you last?

4896000.title: Falafel El Assad
4896000.short_description: Do you have what it takes to serve the best Falafel in Moscow? Defy the elements in this whacky cooking sim and earn money to gain power-ups. Test your skills, and improve them to prepare for the final boss battle that will shake your world!

4896660.title: Boxing Tycoon
4896660.short_description: Run your own boxing promotion. Scout and sign fighters, negotiate every contract, face the press, build fight cards and beat rival promoters to the biggest nights. Watch your fighters go to war in full 3D and turn them into world champions.

4896780.title: Desktop Cat Clicker
4896780.short_description: What if a cozy desktop game met an idle clicker? In Desktop Cat Clicker, cats wander across your taskbar, earn points from every click as you work, play, or relax. Collect new cats to unlock unique bonuses and grow your peaceful cat empire over time.

4896850.title: Emory Cole & The Secret at Greymar Point
4896850.short_description: A cozy, point & click first-person detective adventure where you explore a Pacific Northwest coastal town, talk to quirky townies, solve layered puzzles, investigate clues, and uncover a century-old secret.

4896950.title: Rapid Raccoons
4896950.short_description: A first-person co-op party game for 1-4 players. Haul cargo down a wild river on a raft you can barely steer, and grabbing crates by hand or lasso to keep your load aboard. Upgrade your raft, find items and cosmetics, all while trying to meet a quota that continuously gets larger and larger.

4896960.title: Daemon Doors
4896960.short_description: Defeat all Daemon Guardians through the Doors of the Daemon Server. Your only job is to choose the best Doors. Use inventory management and risk taking choices to enhance your buffs and prevent a Weak late game.

4897130.title: The Curse of Stuzhiy
4897130.short_description: A short trip through the winter taiga to check on a comrade who's gone quiet turns into a story that should never have begun. Atmospheric first-person horror: explore the empty snowbound forest, follow the tracks, uncover the secrets these places keep. And yes - you're not alone out here...

4897260.title: Nekolpos — Colossal Cat Care Simulation —
4897260.short_description: Shrunk to just 5 cm tall, you’re now being cared for by the cat you once owned. Talk freely with a gigantic nekomata, cuddle her fluffy fur, ride on her back, and enjoy a life together with your roles completely reversed.

4897500.title: Oxygen Frontier
4897500.short_description: Explore the oxygen-ravaged frontier, battle mutated creatures, recruit bio-companions, and lead your squad to survival in a turn-based tactical adventure.

4897520.title: Baan Khok
4897520.short_description: If the city feels too big for you, come home to Baan Khok — a peaceful little village in the Thai countryside. Start anew: work the fields, grow vegetables, raise animals, and wander the lively temple fairs. Let life drift with the breeze, find love, and build a warm family of your own.

4898090.title: Vector Noir
4898090.short_description: A twin-stick arena roguelite. The Moonlight Sonata drives the choreography. Enemies spawn placed by beat, by hand. Hard on purpose, you will hate Beethoven.

4898120.title: Little Adventurer Treasure Hunt 2
4898120.short_description: Little Adventurer Treasure Hunt 2 is a lighthearted and fun hidden-object adventure game. A little girl from Earth and an alien kitten embark on a brand-new adventure, solving all kinds of quirky and unusual problems for the locals in a picture-book world.

4898220.title: End of War: Global Front
4898220.short_description: Build towers, defend two sectors and your shared reactor against endless machine waves—alone or in online co-op. Every battle matters: In THE GREAT WAR, the global frontline shaped by all players grants unique bonuses and penalties in every match.

4898330.title: Give or Take: Pawn Shop
4898330.short_description: Step behind the counter and run a small-town pawn shop. Inspect items to reveal hidden traits, make deals with quirky locals, clean, repair, and sell secondhand finds for profit while helping a town recover. All it takes is old junk and a good deal.

4898400.title: Fitness Gym Bodybuilding Pump
4898400.short_description: Build your dream body in the ultimate gym simulator and bodybuilding game! Experience real-time body transformation, train with other players online, break strength records, dominate arm wrestling, and knock out rivals in physics-based multiplayer boxing. Rise from amateur to global champion!

4898420.title: CodePhantom
4898420.short_description: "CodePhantom" is a 3D action game where you pilot the humanoid combat mech PHANTOM and take on a variety of missions. Experience the thrill of controlling a powerful mech with smooth, responsive gameplay. Enjoy intense, no-nonsense mech action designed for fans of authentic robotic combat.

4898460.title: Outspin Champions
4898460.short_description: Outspin Champions is a local competitive PvP / Co-op brawler where the spinning never stops. It blends party-game chaos with Souls-like precision, mastering physics-driven weapon weight to deflect foes. Outspin. Outsmart. Outlast.

4898600.title: The Human Cockroach
4898600.short_description: Track, Hunt, and be Hunted through a series of dark tunnels. In the pitch-black depths of the caves, you can never be sure whether you are aiming down the right corridor. Think while the footsteps grow louder and louder.

4898650.title: For The Witch
4898650.short_description: For The Witch is a cute fantasy top-down tower-defense roguelite. Protect a sleeping witch from mosquito swarms, develop both the soldier and the witch, combine mechanic-changing items, and awaken them into new effects to hold out through each night.

4898730.title: General Jeon
4898730.short_description: From a peasant boy in peninsula, to the most powerful man in the nation — and finally, to a criminal facing the judgment of history —— Sixty years of turbulence. One road from a thatched hut to the Blue House. How far will you go?

4898760.title: Bossfall
4898760.short_description: Bossfall is a Sci-Fi Action RPG where you fight the galaxy's most powerful warriors and monsters to claim legendary loot. Shoot and dash through relentless incoming attacks, customize your character's build, and conquer the arena to become the ultimate coliseum champion.

4899050.title: Pokremental
4899050.short_description: Pokremental is an incremental game where you flip poker cards to earn money. Buy cards and upgrades to earn more money, or hire helpers to automate the process. Gamble at the casino or on the skill tree to progress faster.

4899160.title: On The Hook
4899160.short_description: You owe the casino boss a debt you can never repay—one that snowballs with compounding interest, growing heavier by the night. Several young female agents, themselves ensnared in the trap, are ready to take your orders. Make it out of the casino before the debt buries you alive.

4899190.title: Lifebearers
4899190.short_description: In a battlefield under heavy fire, your only mission is to save lives! Lifebearers is a 2-player co-op rescue game. Step into the boots of medics with a friend: find wounded soldiers, carry them on a stretcher, and reach the safe zone. Coming out in one piece demands tight coordination!

4899570.title: Amadea
4899570.short_description: Run, jump, and climb your way to the summit of an ancient world in this freerunning Metroidvania adventure! Solve the mysteries of the land to correct the course of fate and save the Mountain from eternal winter.

4899580.title: Saving Yellow Ox
4899580.short_description: A chaotic co-op climbing race for 2–4 players! Scramble through a floating countryside full of traps, moving platforms, and wild obstacles. A UFO stole your yellow ox — climb higher, shove your rivals, rewind and fast-forward time to carve new paths, and survive to save it.

4899640.title: Neural Spaceship Sandbox
4899640.short_description: Build a spaceship block by block, then watch a neural network learn to fly it. Every block can be destroyed and changes the ship's stats mid-fight. Lead your fleets across a turn-based galaxy, or battle friends online.

4899650.title: Domain Paradox: Growth
4899650.short_description: Search. Remember. Escape. Or you will never leave the domain. Explore anomalies and unravel the story of a scientist sent on an expedition, avoiding dangers and clinging to the last shred of hope: finding a way out.

4899940.title: Dyeversion
4899940.short_description: Dyeversion is a color-routing tower defense. Drag liquid hoses from color sources to your towers, mix colors to forge powerful COMBO towers, and route your pipes around the enemy path. Battle dozens of levels, earn tokens, and unlock a deep skill tree.

4900160.title: Dungeon Convenience Store
4900160.short_description: Take on the role of a slime part-timer in a convenience store hidden deep within a dungeon! In this 2D top-down logistics simulation, organize chaotic items from portals, manage unpredictable customers and weather, and survive a 7-day shift by optimizing your workflow.

4900290.title: Jigsaw Panic
4900290.short_description: Put together giant jigsaw puzzles online with your friends while dealing with chaotic curses, environments, hazards, time limits, and rising difficulty. Also you play as rotund monkeys and you can customize their fur color, butt cheek color, and accessories.

4900330.title: Tiny Track Labs
4900330.short_description: Build a tiny toy race track piece by piece: loops, wall rides, barrel rolls, jumps, a 3-lane viaduct and portals. Then sit back. Little toy cars race, flip and crash on their own, and a tiny mechanic runs out to fix them. A relaxing idle racer you watch grow.

4900350.title: Galacto
4900350.short_description: A cozy idle game that lives at the bottom of your screen. Run a space gas station, refuel ships, hire bots, chain combo for fat payouts, and rebuild an outpost into the busiest stop in the galaxy!

4900380.title: The Eminence in Shadow: Phantom Echoes
4900380.short_description: Lurk in the shadows and hunt the shadows. The curtain rises on The Eminence in Shadow: Phantom Echoes, a full-scale action roguelite game!

4900400.title: Oblivions Garden
4900400.short_description: Claim a hex anywhere on a 1:1 reconstruction of real Earth and build a city that never stops growing. Real satellite terrain, real building outlines, a hierarchical economy from one parcel to a continent — and an AI that grows the world while you sleep.

4900740.title: METAMORPH PROTOCOL
4900740.short_description: Online co-op horror for up to 5 players. Descend into Army Facility 7, a buried military lab where sample M-7 copies the shapes, voices and faces of whatever it touches. Carry your fallen friends, survive every floor and get out together, or not at all.

4900760.title: Stellar Harvest
4900760.short_description: Harvest energy across the solar system. Build generators on alien worlds, prestige for Dark Energy, and construct a Dyson Sphere around the Sun. Ten planets. Infinite power. One way home.

4900890.title: Grr Grr Gnomes
4900890.short_description: A co-op adventure about tiny gnomes on a very big ocean. Sail from island to island, scavenge for supplies, fight strange creatures, survive whatever goes horribly wrong, and keep your ship moving toward one goal, finding the way home...

4901220.title: Ashen Blade
4901220.short_description: Step into a dark, atmospheric world where every descent brings you closer to doom or glory. Ashen Blade is a high-stakes, fast-paced action game set in a shattered realm overcome by darkness. Explore a cursed, vertical land where danger lurks at every level.

4901440.title: Digital Druid
4901440.short_description: Build synergistic Gardens in this abstract roguelike deckbuilder. Push your luck and find the balance between growth and corruption. The Garden must Bloom.

4901580.title: Staircore
4901580.short_description: The staircore has a final destination, but it is not a physical destination. The transitional phase between high and low has become thin, and I have fallen inbetween. Will I ever get out?

4902520.title: CardTavern
4902520.short_description: Everything is a card, from ingredients and dishes to customers. Drag cards to stack, combine, trade, cook and upgrade as you grow a tiny tavern into a thriving business. Fulfill customer orders, expand your tavern, and send adventurers into dangerous dungeons to gather rare materials and treasures.

4902530.title: Perfect·K·Night
4902530.short_description: Perfect·K·Night is a narrative game where you play as a pastry chef crafting parfaits. In a near-future virtual world where millions spend their sleep living a second life, your sweet, velvety creations heal weary souls and safeguard every perfect night.

4902580.title: Jay and Silent Bob's Joint Venture
4902580.short_description: Turn a rundown backyard into your own cozy cannabis farm. Crossbreed plants to discover unusual effects and grow the strains your neighbors need. Build friendships as you explore the town with Jay and Silent Bob, surrounded by the spirit of ’90s comedy.

4902640.title: Attack Only
4902640.short_description: Experience a retro RPG as a princess who can only attack. Defeat enemies by targeting the game window and console itself! Before long, you’ll awaken to face a monster in the real world. Enjoy a multi-layered metafiction experience built on a classic RPG foundation.

4903480.title: Last Writes
4903480.short_description: Last Writes is a sound-based puzzle game with very sparse and cryptic instructions, reflecting on what remains of religion in a world that has long strived to overcome it. Follow the signal and confront a rogue AI that sees you as its God.

4903500.title: Specters of the Void Sea: VR Pirate Battle Royale
4903500.short_description: Gather your crew and sail the Void Sea in a fully physical, multicrew VR pirate adventure. Engage in brutal PvPvE with flintlock firearms, melee weapons, gesture magic, and naval combat. Sail procedural worlds, patch leaks, and do what you can to survive the entities and players hunting you.

4903560.title: Nothing Goes Right: Bad Business
4903560.short_description: A co-op restaurant management game where every successful day creates bigger problems. Cook, serve, survive chaos, pay the bills, and see how long your business can stay alive.

4903640.title: DIBARO CryptoHunter Dice Battle Royal
4903640.short_description: Online battles for up to 6 players. Roll dice, command Fire, Water, Earth and Wind mana, and clash on a hex board where six factions fight at once. Affinity settles every attack, and reordering your mana is deckbuilding. Raise over 60 Hunters across Challenge, Survival and hidden-role Demon & Hero.

4903720.title: Time Stop Tower Defense
4903720.short_description: A fast-paced, time-focused twist on tower defense with a strong emphasis on story, gameplay progression, and world-building.

4903810.title: Thousand Ward
4903810.short_description: Thousand Ward is a tactical collector RPG where you build a 3x3 Band of Wardens, master turn-based Hold, Break, and Surge combat, conquer 1,000 levels across 10 realms, collect 200+ Wardens, and climb ranked online battles through strategy, synergy, and smart play.

4904060.title: Roll and Die
4904060.short_description: A push-your-luck dice roguelite. Greed gets you power. Greed gets you killed. Keep the rolls you like, push the rest, and pray you do not hit a skull. Climb the Pit to the god who runs it.

4904080.title: Feastfall
4904080.short_description: Feastfall is a cooking roguelike deckbuilder. Plate ingredient cards into recipes, stack game-breaking charm synergies, and feed ravenous monsters. This is not a kitchen sim. It's a life-or-death gamble at the dinner table — and the house is starving.

4904110.title: Cute & Dead
4904110.short_description: A fast, absurd VR arcade shooter about a nerd, a zombie apocalypse, and thirty girls who need rescuing. Ridiculous weapons, a very good dog, and a dance floor waiting at the end of every run.

4904380.title: Climb the Fools
4904380.short_description: An insanely difficult climbing game begins here. Knocking others down—it is truly a world of survival of the fittest. There can be only one winner.

4904550.title: Atomic Delivery
4904550.short_description: The General Staff has one objective for you: build an atomic weapon aboard a nuclear bomber. Pilot through hostile skies, refine uranium, run industrial machines, assemble the bomb, keep the aircraft airborne and survive everything standing between you and the Atomic Delivery.

4904560.title: The Waking Grove
4904560.short_description: A cozy incremental idle about restoring a dead garden, one tile at a time. Spread life across the seasons and let the soil remember everything you grew.

4904700.title: Vanguard's Descent
4904700.short_description: Build a three-hero party in a 3D action roguelite where you dodge attacks in real time, command your characters using powerful abilities, and combine character-specific archetypes into powerful synergies. Recruit new Vanguard and eradicate the Plagued!

4905060.title: Pogo to the Moon
4905060.short_description: You are a sheep equipped with a pogo stick, and you want to reach the Moon! Collect coins, upgrade your abilities, and master various platforms as you climb from your home all the way to the Moon.

4905380.title: Hellmate - Chess Deck Builder
4905380.short_description: Roguelike deckbuilding chess in the seven floors of Hell. Each floor belongs to a deadly sin, and every sin crowns its own king. Summon pieces, sling spells, and brand your army with sigils to melt the king's HP before your turns run out. Seven sins, seven kings, one deck.

4905780.title: The Apothecary Diaries: The False Imperial Brother
4905780.short_description: Investigate mysteries, craft medicine, and uncover the truth in this brand-new story from The Apothecary Diaries. Explore the rear palace and capital to gather evidence and question witnesses, then assemble what you've learned into theories and deductions to solve thrilling mysteries in this sprawling adventure game.

4906400.title: 大收藏家
4906400.short_description: "The Collector" is a multiplayer auction game of sealed bids and hidden information. Face three players in five-round auctions for a container of unknown treasures. Use cards to uncover clues, place secret bids, and compete for the highest profit margin. Spend less, earn more.

4906410.title: Classroom 3B
4906410.short_description: Investigate an abandoned Indian school where the truth was buried — literally. Manage a failing power system, monitor live CCTV feeds, and piece together a tragedy through documents, audio logs, and authentic Hindi work in this psychological horror investigation.

4906800.title: The Witch Simulator
4906800.short_description: Experience the life of a witch in a medieval village, co-op or solo! Gather ingredients, hunt monsters, brew potions to solve villagers' problems while keeping your magic hidden from the Inquisition. Build your reputation, earn passage into the kingdom, and overthrow the Grand Inquisitor.

4906950.title: Can't Escape It
4906950.short_description: Can't Escape It is a first-person, found-footage, psychological horror game. You are trapped in a looping apartment. Search for clues to solve puzzles and find a way out, evade a clown that chases you, navigate the dark using your night vision, and manage your batteries. CAN YOU ESCAPE IT?

4907030.title: The Exorcist's Apprentice
4907030.short_description: A first-person short psychological horror about exorcism. A victim is bound to a bed. A demon lurks inside her. Explore a confined apartment, rely on your mentor's guidance, and discover the precise ritual needed to drive it out.

4907220.title: Fall Off Reach
4907220.short_description: Fall Off Reach is a first-person narrative survival game and the sequel to Drift Into Eternity. Alone in the wreck of the WANDERER IV, explore, repair failing systems, and delay the inevitable as everything keeping you alive collapses.

4907780.title: Luck in the Dark
4907780.short_description: Luck in the Dark is a turn-based roguelike with slot machines and backpack management. Pack your bag to improve your odds, spin the reels, and find your way out of the dark.

4908120.title: Outbreak Z
4908120.short_description: A post-apocalyptic party-based auto battler RPG. Recruit three survivors with nothing in common, loot a dead city for their gear, level each one down their own tree, and send them into the horde. They fight every wave on their own. Whether they come home is on you.

4908180.title: Spinvestor
4908180.short_description: Spinvestor is a fun, risk-free alternative to winning millions while gambling in a casino where the house doesn't have the edge for once. Win big, invest in stocks, and run your own businesses while becoming the highest ranking VIP at Steak, the best casino where the house always loses.

4908460.title: Flame and Blame
4908460.short_description: A first-person co-op comedy for up to 4 firefighters who are very bad at their job. Drive the truck, blast the fire, rescue the panda, and blame each other when it all goes up in smoke. Bad at fires. Great at friendship.

4908780.title: Tallawa Game Nights
4908780.short_description: A Caribbean Tabletop Game Collection. Slam dominoes, throw 3D dice around the room, team up as allies or betray them and challenge 10 different AI personalities with hidden grudges in Arcade and Story. No copy? No problem! Play together using your phones!

4908970.title: Dandy Rat Cricket Club
4908970.short_description: DANDY RAT CRICKET CLUB IS ARCADE CRICKET FOR THE UPPER CRUST. Bat, bowl and field in an easy-to-learn and impossible-to-master setting. Bamboozle your opponents with deceptively deep and engaging tactics, and magical bowling power-ups. Captain your ragtag team of posh rats from obscurity to glory.

4909250.title: Midnight Moving Crew
4909250.short_description: Midnight Moving Crew is a 1-4 player co-op horror sim. Clock in, pack the house, and survive the shift. Buy EMF detectors and defensive wards to repel any entities in the house before you become the next permanent resident.

4909300.title: REDHAND
4909300.short_description: A psychotic-horror (psychological, surreal survival horror) with dark, oppressive atmosphere, brutal action and grotesque creatures.

4909780.title: Medium Rare
4909780.short_description: Eat people and conserve ammo as you hike to the top of a mountain where a human meat factory is about to process your kidnapped wife in this turn based survival dungeon crawler.

4910030.title: Beasts of Ephesus
4910030.short_description: Lead Dawn from Division 5. Scout prospects, negotiate transfers and personal terms. Train 21 attributes; manage condition, injuries, and wages. Build 5v5, 3v3, and 2v2 plans, make live calls and lead 5- or 10-person raids for gear and mastery. Turn winnings into freedom, then reinvest in the squad.

4910350.title: Antopolis: The Ant Colony Simulator
4910350.short_description: Found a colony, dig a nest, and raise an empire of ants in a giant's back garden. A top-down colony sim of pheromone trails, brood and castes, foraging, and three-way war. Survive a whole backyard food chain of spiders, birds, frogs, and rival ant colonies.

4910360.title: Annie's DineInn
4910360.short_description: A cooking game with cozy themed days and horror themed nights. You and your daughter are now owners of an abandoned motel and diner. Start cooking, renting rooms, and do other work to pay off the loan. But beware of the choices you make as they might come back to haunt you. (Solo developer project)

4910490.title: Ignite the Depths
4910490.short_description: Ignite the Depths is an atmospheric dark-fantasy PvE dungeon crawler set within a sprawling, hand-crafted labyrinth. Descend into the darkness alone or unite with up to 4 players in a co-op adventure. Will you conquer the Abyss?

4910990.title: Day by day：东京留子生存日记
4910990.short_description: A pixel-art life simulation about studying, surviving, and chasing your dreams as an international student in Tokyo. Every day, every choice, shapes your future.

4911450.title: shatAAAAp!
4911450.short_description: Exponentially bigger waves of cute animals require increasingly absurd means of destruction. Shoot, burn, electrocute, explode... and make sure no one ever helps you.

4911770.title: Mind Over Dice
4911770.short_description: Mind Over Dice is a tactical roguelike where luck becomes a weapon. Roll dice, assign values to your heroes, and outsmart cunning enemies. Heroes, acts, secrets, artifacts, and much more! Every roll is a choice. Every face is fate.

4911910.title: Pirates Life
4911910.short_description: Build your own island, explore unique seas, uncover buried treasure, join or create crews, battle in naval PvP, and sink rival ships in an online pirate sandbox where every adventure shapes your legacy.

4912000.title: What Was That?!
4912000.short_description: A cozy-spooky roguelite deckbuilder where you play as a household pet exploring a home full of mysterious encounters after dark.

4912160.title: Unwanted Guest
4912160.short_description: Unwanted Guest is a first-person survival horror game where players explore a haunted mansion, solve environmental and painting-based puzzles, evade a relentless ghost, and uncover the mystery behind the mansion while searching for a way to escape alive.

4912390.title: Battle Quads
4912390.short_description: Command a squad of six specialists in explosive 4v4 multiplayer battles. Make real-time tactical decisions as a commander, or take direct control of any specialist at critical moments.

4913190.title: Croaking Buzz
4913190.short_description: Croaking Buzz is an asymmetric co-op platformer, starring a frog and a particular mosquito, capable of spawning and manipulating bubbles. Play together helping each other to overcome challenges based on physics, coordination and emergent gameplay!

4913230.title: Seed of Light
4913230.short_description: Seed of Light is a cozy roguelite city builder about bringing light into a world swallowed by a dark fog. Manage your resources, find synergies, generate enough light to overcome the darkness and expand your territory!

4913250.title: SCP Idle: SECURE. CONTAIN. PROGRESS.
4913250.short_description: In this incremental game you are in charge of managing a SCP facility site. Construct and upgrade new containment chambers, prevent devastating breaches and complete the Thaumiel Containment Engine.

4913350.title: MindGate CornerGet
4913350.short_description: A free-to-play hack-and-slash that fights on in your taskbar. Chibi heroes meet the enemy inside a thin strip at the bottom of your screen. All you do is swap the gear they picked up and respec their skills when you feel like it. No connection needed; the rest happens in the corner of your screen.

4914130.title: Lootbox Inc.: The TCG Card Battler
4914130.short_description: The TCG autobattler. Lootbox Inc. is the ultimate number-go-up deckbuilder. Collect powerful loot, build crazy decks, discover unexpected synergies, and stack insane combos. Easy to learn, hard to master. Play at your own pace, solo or against other players!

4914150.title: Holod
4914150.short_description: You are an American spy. But cold and hunger don’t care who you are. Maintain a Soviet polar station, analyze samples and venture into uncharted Antarctica. Master the work of a polar researcher to survive. And keep your cover — the KGB is always watching.

4914230.title: A Tidy Konbini
4914230.short_description: Let's Tidy Up! Konbini is a cozy organizing simulator where you need to return over 1000 scattered products their proper place in a Japanese convenience store. No Skills, no time limits. Just a relaxing tidy up experience.

4914500.title: LITERA
4914500.short_description: Enter a true name and an essence, then watch a one-of-a-kind Textus take shape with its own abilities, moves, and battle role. Build a team from the creatures your words create in this fantasy 3v3 summoning RPG.

4914850.title: Bonded in Darkness
4914850.short_description: Fall in love with your worst enemy in this gothic vampire romance BL visual novel about two men pushed to the edges of society learning to trust each other.

4914960.title: ORION
4914960.short_description: ORION is a real-time sci-fi 4X grand strategy game where you explore a procedurally generated galaxy, build an interstellar empire, shape its society, design powerful fleets, and conquer, unite, or outlast your rivals.

4915100.title: Who Got In?
4915100.short_description: A driving simulator where every passenger is different. Meet unforgettable characters, make dialogue choices, earn money, upgrade your garage, and discover the unexpected stories waiting behind every ride.

4915110.title: マキコマレイド
4915110.short_description: Lure enemy bullets, sweep them in, and send them crashing back! An intuitive shooter anyone can enjoy! A boy named Alta stumbles upon a mysterious disc—and sets off into the vast "Sea of Data" that lies within.

4915180.title: EXORCISMUS: Vade Retro Satana
4915180.short_description: A psychological exorcism horror featuring the unique Presence System and a 3D Jumpscare effect that makes demons burst out of your screen. Every sound has a source. The demon sees you, hears you, senses your fear. Forget predictable jumpscares.

4915260.title: Nexaris: Starweb Dominion
4915260.short_description: Lead a living star network in this real-time 3D sci-fi strategy game. Expand from one stellar core, link orbital nodes, secure resources, and launch coordinated assaults as every connection reshapes your economy, defenses, and territorial control.

4915490.title: MoonHack
4915490.short_description: MoonHack is an emotional cyber-noir adventure game where songs rewrite the rules of the world. The story segments are closely integrated with 3D rhythm-action gameplay synchronized with vocal performances, and through songs, the rules behind a system that controls happiness will be rewritten.

4915570.title: Tapis
4915570.short_description: Tapis is a score-chasing roguelike played on a game table. Tokens fall onto the board, each with its own effect based on its position and family. Your goal: score a huge amount of points. To help you, you'll have repositioning moves to strategically place your tokens and maximize your score.

4915640.title: Log Drop
4915640.short_description: A physics sandbox with one noble goal: get more logs into the core than physically reasonable. Chop the trees, build the contraption, then unleash a wave of logs for combo-fueled cash. Kick back and let it flow, or engineer the perfect cascade. Your sandbox, your rules.

4915790.title: Magical Girl
4915790.short_description: A pixel-art magical-girl action adventure. Transform, chain attacks, time Perfect Guards, and master new fighting styles. Explore a haunted city and collect forbidden books, then return to school life, phone chats, and a place to call home.

4916020.title: Crack the Stone
4916020.short_description: Minimalist desktop idle game that lives in the corner of your screen. Upgrade the water flow from a single drop to a steady stream and keep wearing the stone down. Someday it will crack. Patience always wins.

4916420.title: Path of Damned
4916420.short_description: A roguelike where combat is a slot machine you build yourself. Weapons, shields, and potions are reel symbols: every spin hits, heals, and grants armor. Pack your bag, spend souls on talents, and hunt the Source on a cursed island.

4916730.title: Christmas Inc
4916730.short_description: Build a toy factory in this first-person incremental game. Place machines, run conveyor belts to delivery, cash in and upgrade. Unlock 20 presents, prestige for Stars and deck the halls.

4917230.title: Nightshift Remastered
4917230.short_description: Welcome to the Nightshift! Spend six nights at a totally normal office job in this branching narrative. Bond with your dayshift coworker, uncover fantastical mysteries, and experience unexpected transformations. With an optional card game and plenty of endings, what will you make of your time here?

4917620.title: PREEMINENCE: World on the Brink
4917620.short_description: You promised not to touch pensions. The debt says otherwise. Lead one of 200 real countries, alone or with friends: push your laws through parliament, face the streets, ride out global crises. Every number has a reason, and every decision has a price.

4918080.title: Campaign Forge
4918080.short_description: Infinity grows - Your story never ends. Create worlds, heroes, and play your legends chapter by chapter. Fight, explore, and shape a world that remembers you and your Party. Generate it free and fully offline, then change it how you want. Campaign Forge - The 2D Infinite Story RPG.

4918370.title: Alia Domus
4918370.short_description: Explore and colonize an unknown planet in this pixel art survival RPG. Collect resources, complete quests, and craft technologies from different eras of humanity to turn Alia Domus into a home. Start with basic survival and reach civilizational splendor.

4918680.title: LEXICON: Lingua Obscura
4918680.short_description: An old terminal in an abandoned office is still on, long after everyone has left. Why is ECHO-7, a cryptic AI, still running? Why does it want you to play? Twist strange rules and chain letter combos in a word roguelite where every run feels one step away from revealing something bigger.

4918750.title: Grid Poker
4918750.short_description: GridPoker is a roguelike deckbuilder. Master grid-linking strategies to unleash vastly different scoring potentials from the exact same divine card combo. Beat diverse bosses across changing poker layouts, and enjoy another layer of fun via casual asynchronous card swapping.

4919010.title: Exoset
4919010.short_description: An inventory-management airship-building auto-battler. Design your battlecruiser, pack its hull with powerful weapons, and arrange support systems to create synergies that multiply its firepower from hundreds to millions, then watch it battle ever-escalating threats.

4919130.title: MONSTERGOTCHI
4919130.short_description: Feed and grow your own monster in the virtual pet game MONSTERGOTCHI! 😀 The type of pet you get depends entirely on you!😮 Explore a dangerous world, find food, and give it to them! 😍 Hurry up, IT'S HUNGRY!

4919330.title: Cloud Arch Simulator
4919330.short_description: A reverse tower-defense puzzle for engineers. Architect cloud systems that survive brutal traffic surges — place CDNs, caches, load balancers and databases, hit deploy, and watch your design hold or collapse under a live storm. Real patterns, real tradeoffs, a live YAML mirror.

4919700.title: Tumbal 1985
4919700.short_description: Tumbal 1985 is an atmospheric and psychological horror-mystery game set within the confines of an Indonesian tobacco distributor office. Explore, clean, collect, and solve mysteries as a night janitor to uncover the insidious truth behind the paranormal.

4919750.title: Sea of Silence
4919750.short_description: Sea of Silence is a turn-based naval fleet-building card strategy game. Buy, combine, and upgrade warships, balance immediate strength against long-term shop growth, arrange formations of up to six ships, and test your fleet against other players' lineups across a 20-round campaign.

4920240.title: Pinetrail
4920240.short_description: Deliver packages across Pinetrail in an overloaded rusty rickshaw truck! Meet the locals, uncover mysteries, and explore beautiful hidden spots. Use your vehicle's unique abilities to cross rivers, glide over trees, and battle cargo-stealing boars!

4920620.title: Summer Feed
4920620.short_description: Grow your PIA account and become an influencer with a million followers! "Summer Feed" is a game that blends social media management with a romantic storyline. PIA is launching its "Summer Star Program"—the first new account to hit a million followers will be crowned the star of the season!

4920690.title: Rigor Movers
4920690.short_description: By day, your clients trust you with their boxes. By night, you come back to steal their furniture. A first-person burglary game. Get the sofa out without waking anyone up. Play solo or in online co-op with up to 4 players.

4920890.title: The Ignition Protocol
4920890.short_description: The Ignition Protocol is a slow-paced, top-down incremental asteroid-mining game. Fly your ship in zero-g, mine and tow asteroids, transport resources, automate your base, and ignite a new star - the last light in a fading universe.

4921100.title: It Could Be Worse
4921100.short_description: Speed bends time. Build momentum with weapons designed for movement to slow the world around you and tear through enemies at superhuman velocity.

4921540.title: Liminull
4921540.short_description: Liminull is an atmospheric journey through liminal spaces. Explore, find secrets, solve puzzles, and interact with the world if you want - or simply keep moving forward, toward a place where everything feels so familiar, yet long forgotten.

4921770.title: MANIC MINER
4921770.short_description: Experience a milestone in video game history in a completely reimagined version! This reboot of the 1983 classic combines the distinctive and challenging gameplay of MANIC MINER with modern graphics, improved controls, newly arranged music, and extensive historical bonus content.

4922110.title: Felzi
4922110.short_description: Felzi is a cozy retro 3D platformer. Roll through crates, stomp, climb and glide on a leaf across handcrafted worlds. Collect every gem and finish each level.

4922180.title: Payday Poker
4922180.short_description: Play a fresh spin on traditional Poker centered around receiving a payout to bet with at the beginning of the round instead of betting real money! Play as one of several outlaws all wagering their own cut of the spoils as you duke it out to take the entire stack home. Are you ready? NOW DRAW!

4922280.title: Lethal Tournament
4922280.short_description: Lethal Tournament is a deckbuilding roguelike set in a dystopian megastructure. Build a deck, reshape it with Items, and bend the rules with Charms as you fight your way up the Tournament to find out what it's actually for.

4922380.title: Neural Defense
4922380.short_description: Neural Defense is a sci-fi Tower Defense where you can sync with any of your towers and take manual control in third-person to defend your base against waves of corporate drones.

4922740.title: Core!1!
4922740.short_description: Core Miner is a cozy incremental mining adventure where every swing takes you deeper into Earth. Break rock, collect ores, relics and pet eggs, upgrade your tools and build powerful loadouts on the journey toward the planet's core.

4922750.title: We Don't Exist
4922750.short_description: A single-player, first-person psychological horror game. You wake up in a facility where every room wants you dead and a voice records everything. The worst trap is the other subjects: trust them, betray them, sacrifice yourself? Training modes playable by two, online or in split screen.

4922820.title: Hellkick
4922820.short_description: One kick, one survivor. HELLKICK is an early 2000s inspired lightning-fast two-button fighter: divekick your way down the circles of Hell, snap spines in x-ray FATAL KICKS, and duel on arenas that fight back. No combos to memorize! Every single hit is death, yours or theirs.

4922890.title: Flag Conquest
4922890.short_description: An incremental roguelite auto-battler. Build a persistent army, program its tactics with Gambits, and take a fallen kingdom back one flag at a time across zones that never stop scaling. Retreat, bank what you earned, come back stronger. Deep prestige, an endless Tower, and King of the Hill.

4922910.title: Settlers of Pineshore
4922910.short_description: On the edge of a new continent, you are responsible for connecting the wild region of Pineshore and its settlers to the rest of the world. Hire workers, gather resources, defend your venture from unknown dangers, and keep building the railway!

4922990.title: Riftmoor
4922990.short_description: A colony sim plus dungeon crawler where you build a thriving settlement, manage your citizens, create a powerful army, venture through mysterious rifts into dangerous dungeons, and return with the resources needed to grow your kingdom.

4923150.title: Schnudergoof
4923150.short_description: Figure out the demonic secrets of MANA – A freakish phone that has fallen into your hands. Can you make it through the Upper Echelon? Solve riddles from fallen angels, cyber with demons on GRINDAER and choose well who you are talking to. Do you believe: if I can eat god, god has to exist?

4923220.title: The Lower Worlds I: Valenfeld
4923220.short_description: Valenfeld is a Co-Op RPG with a procedurally generated Open World and Dungeons. Combine Warrior, Rogue, Wizard, Cleric, Druid, and Necromancer into custom classes, with in depth talent trees and combinations. Join a living world of factions, monsters and war where your choices matter.

4923360.title: Books & Blood
4923360.short_description: Survive in a post-apocalyptic bookstore in this horror game. Fetch books for your customers to complete your daily quota. Explore the abandoned bookstore, and don't get caught by the horrors stalking the shelves.

4923390.title: Its a Trap
4923390.short_description: Build devious traps. Survive ingenious contraptions. It’s a Trap is a physics platformer and level-building sandbox. Combine deadly hazards, reactive liquids, ropes and wired mechanisms, then brave your creations and share them through Steam Workshop.

4923470.title: slice
4923470.short_description: A cozy and nostalgic life simulator. Play a second life, alone or with friends! Lead life on your terms.

4924140.title: Allegedly Innocent: Justice for Sale
4924140.short_description: 팀 관포지교가 선보이는 가장 유쾌한 피카레스크! 진실보다는 현실을 좇는 변호사가 되어 반성의 여지 없는 의뢰인을 변호하는 게임입니다. 사건의 단서를 모아 '입맛대로' 진상을 재구성하고, 누가 봐도 죄가 깊은 의뢰인을 무죄로 만들어줍시다.

4924280.title: Chain Reaction: Breakshot
4924280.short_description: Chain Reaction: Breakshot combines the precise aiming of classic billiards with the strategic deckbuilding of roguelikes. Within a retro CRT visual style, combining various mechanics turns every shot into a feast of strategy and fun.

4924320.title: Hex & Tonic
4924320.short_description: A poker-hand roguelike deckbuilder about brewing potions. Draw reagents, brew reactions, stack catalysts until the numbers get silly — then break the Hex. Six covens, fifty hidden recipes, a Daily Brew and an Endless cauldron. Fair odds, shown to you. No hidden RNG.

4924430.title: Doomsday Anchor
4924430.short_description: Do a completely normal... anomaly containment job. It's just the fate of the entire world in your hands, no big deal, don't stress!

4924680.title: Cratebreaker: Wasteland Workshop
4924680.short_description: Cratebreaker: Wasteland Workshop is a post-apocalyptic idle clicker and strategy game about smashing crates, salvaging relics, building vehicles, running factories, scanning radio signals, and raiding bandit bases to rebuild your place in the wasteland.

4924870.title: Can Collector Simulator
4924870.short_description: Pick up piles of scattered cans in a casual first-person collecting sim. Recycle your haul at reverse vending machines, cash out printed receipts, upgrade your pickup speed and capacity, and look for oversized prize pull tabs hidden in the mess.

4925240.title: RULES OF RESIDENCE
4925240.short_description: You bought your dream home... but it wasn't all you chalked it up to be. As a member of its management committee, rewrite the rules to change the lives of your neighbours and your family for the better in this singleplayer management simulator. Or will you become what you sought to fight against?

4925500.title: Companions' Chronicles
4925500.short_description: This AI sandbox RPG features diverse world themes for instant immersive adventures. Customize world rules, character sheets and stories; share or import player-created themes. The full version adds dynamic backgrounds, emotion avatars and personal AI chat API support.

4925600.title: Kitten Wool Cup
4925600.short_description: A cozy kitten life with a silly streak. Make your snug room by the fire your own, dress your kitten in hats and a Santa beard, and invite friends round. Then curl up and dream of football: chaotic kitten matches with a giant ball of wool, runaway roombas and laser pointers.

4925690.title: Gofoot
4925690.short_description: Gofoot is a fast, lightweight, and nostalgic football management game. Create your manager, build squads, compete in championships, and customize leagues, clubs, and players in a simple, addictive sandbox experience built for the community.

4925790.title: Wilds of Lumithra
4925790.short_description: Explore the hand-crafted open-world of Wilds of Lumithra, where every cliff, chasm, and hidden path is yours to discover. Turn natural obstacles into shortcuts as you gather, craft, build, and fight your way to survival - solo or online with friends.

4925990.title: My Beautiful Aquarium
4925990.short_description: A fish tank that lives on your screen. Real species, and every fish is an individual you can name. In Cozy mode nothing can die, so you can leave it running all day. Challenge mode is proper fishkeeping: water types, breeding, sickness, mistakes. Play it, or just let it swim.

4926090.title: SHORAPAN
4926090.short_description: SHORAPAN — a dark parable of a strange city beneath an eternal crimson sky. Those who doubt it aloud are the first it takes.

4926120.title: Stellar Wreck
4926120.short_description: Repair your spaceship, explore mysterious planets, battle strange creatures, and survive in this sci-fi sandbox RPG where every journey becomes a new adventure.

4926330.title: Dodo Factory
4926330.short_description: An incremental game where you construct a giant meat factory to raise dodos and mass murder them (ethically). Grow your factory from a small dodo grinder to a huge processing facility as you collect meat to upgrade buildings and unlock new crazy dodo types.

4926390.title: Crown & Banner
4926390.short_description: Crown & Banner™ is an MMORTS inspired by the browser games of the 2000s, where the roads and outposts your empire builds become the battleground of the endgame. Buy once, play anywhere, forever free-to-win, Crown & Banner is a game where strategy and diplomacy (not money!) determine the outcome.

4926590.title: Umbraelum
4926590.short_description: A human and a specter, fused into one being, venture into the heart of darkness in this isometric action roguelite. Combine ancient artifacts and shards of corrupted power to unleash devastating synergies. The more power you embrace, the deadlier the consequences.

4926600.title: Steps To The Stars
4926600.short_description: A single player puzzle game following the journey of two stars as they climb to return to the constellation from which they have fallen.

4926630.title: The Fledge
4926630.short_description: Lost adrift in the Antarctic, your hatchling is all that matters. Hunt, evade predators, feed and protect your only offspring in this short, atmospheric penguin survival experience. Each day is a race to stay alive, as the frozen oceans you once called home are overwhelmed by unfamiliar forces.

4926680.title: Rebuilt: Last Settlement
4926680.short_description: Manage the last farmhouse settlement in a zombie-infested city. Grow food, craft weapons, send teams to scavenge, and defend your settlement every night from relentless zombie hordes until you are strong enough to escape.

4926690.title: Weed Out
4926690.short_description: A bullet heaven with a slot machine for a level-up. The crops have risen — mow down hordes of mutant plants, spin the reels, and build around whatever drops: buffs, curses and nearly a hundred game-warping Jokers.

4926800.title: Dreams of Suffering
4926800.short_description: A cinematic psychological horror game where you explore a haunting dream world, investigate mysterious environments, solve surreal puzzles, and face unknown entities. Experience a deeply atmospheric journey where sound, fear, and instinct guide you through the darkness.

4926820.title: Amara
4926820.short_description: Manage and grow your cozy café from scratch in a world full of adorable talking cats. Craft authentic coffee drinks inspired by real barista techniques, upgrade your shop, serve your fluffy customers, and become beloved by all.

4926900.title: Bato Battle
4926900.short_description: Bato Battle is a chaotic submarine party combat game for 2-8 players. Pilot a whale, ram a shark, dive like a dolphin, and torpedo your friends across a pile of ridiculous gamemodes and maps!

4927020.title: Purrgeist
4927020.short_description: A cozy-spooky ghost-catching incremental. You're a little cat with a spectral vacuum: explore a haunted mansion room by room, suck up ghosts, harvest essences, sell your loot, and pour it into a massive talent tree. Short runs, satisfying progression, and always one more.

4927040.title: Devil's Cut
4927040.short_description: A casino shooter roguelite. Aim and shoot your way through endless waves of demons, run and dodge, fire off abilities, and gamble your loot for busted upgrades and cursed items. Build your stats, pay off your soul's debt, and climb the ranks — or lose it all to the house.

4927170.title: SIGABRT
4927170.short_description: You write the while(1) loop that fights for you. Assemble code-edits into an auto-battling program, descend a crashing OS from /tmp to the kernel, and debug your build every run. No two compiles are the same. Debug your code. Try one more time.

4927240.title: Ruptured Floor
4927240.short_description: Dive into a surreal and dark office space made of distorted floors. Traverse them all, one at the time, to find an exit. Ruptured Floor is a horror puzzle game with a unique twist. Every floor requires a combination to open the door. The code is known. The lock, however, will need to be found.

4927270.title: DELVERS: Dragon's Hoard
4927270.short_description: A party autobattler incremental. Recruit heroes under their zodiac signs, gear them from a hoard of rolled loot, grow a skill tree that is the sky — then send four into the depths and watch them fight. Climb the cursed city of Greymarrow for gear no delve will ever drop. Every run reaches further.

4927840.title: B.O.D.E. (Beast Of Despair Exiled)
4927840.short_description: A crazy roguelite straight from Hell! B.O.D.E. (Beast Of Despair Exiled) is a wild 2D shooter with chaotic movement mechanics.

4927990.title: Arcane Beyond
4927990.short_description: Arcane Beyond is a living magical world where players rise from humble spellcasters to legendary mages. Every action pushes you toward Radiance or Umbra, unlocking unique abilities, transformations, and story paths.

4928080.title: Seikyu Let’s Go!
4928080.short_description: A 1-4 player co-op campervan trip through the yokai-filled wilderness. Snap photos of elusive creatures, decorate your van together, and help the locals you meet along the way. Camp, cook, and clamber across diverse biomes, from misty swamps to snowy mountains. Adventure awaits, so Let’s Go!

4928230.title: Super Tag
4928230.short_description: Tag, with super powers! Super Tag is a 2D chase platformer: swing, blink and wall-jump away from the endless hord, or hunt down your friends in multiplayer mode.

4928500.title: Wiener Rumble
4928500.short_description: A fast first-person arena brawler! Try to get other players out of the arena with a weapon that shoots different items. Enjoy multiple game modes and maps, and customize your character. Prove your skills in the ultimate chaos and be the last one standing!

4928550.title: Knights vs. Dinosaurs
4928550.short_description: An isometric co-op action romp: charge in as a knight — or a kangaroo — against hordes of hungry dinosaurs. Explore a farm overworld and procedural dungeons, smash barrels for chocolate coins, gear up in the shop, and topple bosses in online co-op. Fast, chaotic, gleefully absurd.

4928730.title: Hold the Line
4928730.short_description: Hold the Line is a top-down 2D roguelite survival game. Survive on a procedurally generated island, prepare by day, endure the night, forge your survival build, adapt to dynamic events, and face the final trial on Day 7.

4928760.title: Scrapman Simulator
4928760.short_description: Start by collecting cardboard from the streets, turn scrap metal into cash, upgrade your home and vehicle, and grow your business. Build your own recycling empire by playing solo or with your friends in a living city inspired by Istanbul.

4928970.title: Incremental Magic
4928970.short_description: A 2D action clicker where you click, drag, and scroll to hunt monsters yourself with your mouse. Aim your skills to break the bosses of 8 dungeons, and grow your skill tree into a build of your own. Not idle — aim, shoot, smash.

4929090.title: The Wyoming Incident
4929090.short_description: A Wyoming town evacuated overnight in 1982. Your car is dead. The TV is on. Hold onto your sanity while the broadcast gets inside your head, dive into corrupted TVs to silence the towers, and find six keys to get out. Psychological horror with six endings, inspired by the infamous creepypasta.

4929170.title: Lane Glitch
4929170.short_description: Lane Glitch is a fast-paced cyberpunk combat racing game where you drive an armed car through neon-lit highways, dodging obstacles and destroying enemy vehicles. Choose your path on a branching map, upgrade your ride, and face powerful bosses.

4929280.title: Act Normal
4929280.short_description: Everyone looks like an NPC. Some of them are players. Blend in, spot the others, and outsmart your opponents across chaotic multiplayer game modes. Just remember one thing: Act Normal.

4929450.title: Slay the King
4929450.short_description: Chess, but you build an army, bolt game-breaking augments onto your pieces, and tear through realms of enemies. Exploding pawns, bishops that cleanse the board with holy fire, a king that ascends into a demon slaying god. Stack upgrades, ascend, get rich, Slay The King.

4929470.title: Whisker Cat Shelter
