4929470.short_description: Welcome to Whisker Village! Run a cozy cat shelter, welcome cats brought in by villagers, care for new arrivals, and help them find loving forever homes, solo or with a friend.

4929480.title: Draft Eleven
4929480.short_description: Draft Eleven is a football auto-battler roguelite where you build your perfect XI, scout the transfer market, create powerful synergies, adapt your tactics, and compete in asynchronous PvP against squads built by real players from around the world.

4929530.title: Cindocu: The Omens
4929530.short_description: Follow in the footsteps of Persia Kelborn - heir to the oldest dynasty on the continent of Ferrum. Uncover the dark secrets hidden within his family for centuries, and witness events that began long before he was born...

4929670.title: Switch Ball Deluxe
4929670.short_description: Switch colors on the fly to destroy all energy bricks in sight! Bounce, boost, and race the clock through more than 160 handcrafted levels across 10 power plant themed worlds in this arcade puzzle-platformer. Chase S-ranks in Adventure Mode, or put your skills to the test in the Gauntlet!

4929880.title: Shochimiki: The Eater's House
4929880.short_description: You are just another victim of the House — a living organism that remembers everyone who entered. Corridors change, rooms deceive, and escape is almost impossible. Listen, observe, and uncover the dark rules of a place that watches and hunts you.

4929940.title: The Survival Show
4929940.short_description: Survive the deadliest future game show in The Survival Show! Jump over razor-sharp lasers, dodge killer robots, and hurl live bombs before the clock runs out. Test your reflexes in a top-down arena, entertain the crowd, and claim the billionaire grand prize!

4929960.title: Within The Experiments
4929960.short_description: A system-driven turn-based RPG bringing new strategy to the classic Wizardry-style formula. Cut in on enemy actions with the "Interrupt Timeline Battle" system. Lead a five-member party, strengthen your team through combat and item discovery, and explore the dungeon's depths.

4930070.title: Grandpa Loves Trains
4930070.short_description: Grandpa has retired and now spends his days playing with his toy trains. With the station needing a new conductor, the responsibility falls to his grandson, Abraham. Board passengers, unlock powerful abilities through a skill tree, and expand your railway empire in this cozy incremental roguelite.

4930300.title: Bumper Buddies
4930300.short_description: Join your friends online for the hilarious, addictive party racer where you race, shove, and betray your buddies. Team up 1v1 to 3v3 across physics-fueled minigames. Paint your car however you like.

4930410.title: Office Overlord
4930410.short_description: From Interns to CEOs, every coworker has a role to play. Build your team, discover unexpected synergies, and take on rival companies in a tactical RPG where every coworker can make a difference.

4930420.title: Abilill: Persistent Fantasy Extraction MMO
4930420.short_description: (This game was developed entirely using AI.) Abilill: persistent-world fantasy loot/extraction MMO. Leave a safe base on foot for wilds, caves and ruins. Find treasure, fight monsters and hostile players, extract loot. Die and your backpack loot drops for others. Push deeper or retreat?

4930440.title: American Navy SEALs
4930440.short_description: Lead an elite Navy SEAL fireteam into a cinematic next-gen tactical shooter powered by Unreal Engine 5. Command your squad, master authentic weapons, and fight through deadly global missions where every order, every shot, and every life matters.

4930480.title: Priest Amore
4930480.short_description: Priest Amore is a cartoon-style, casual puzzle game. Players will take on the role of Amor, a priest working in the fictional institution "Palace of Love," experiencing her day in the life while encountering a mundane yet meaningful adventure about love and understanding.

4930520.title: Triox
4930520.short_description: A short indie horror blending Sokoban puzzles with tense resource management. Deep inside a hostile mining facility, you remotely pilot a pushing machine. The world's oxygen is depleting, but a volatile new form of cyclic ozone has been discovered. Excavate it. It's humanity's only hope.

4930650.title: 11 PM: A Minimalist Factory Game
4930650.short_description: A minimalist factory game that doesn't quite work the way you expect. Choose modules carefully, place them on your machines, and watch them drastically change how each machine produces. Build your own factory with its own rules. Optimizing it can become an obsession!

4930890.title: Send Forth the Brave
4930890.short_description: Roguelike deckbuilder where you run an Adventurers’ Guild. Combine heroes, weapons, and items into teams, fulfill quirky commissions, deal with difficult clients, and build the most powerful guild in the realm.

4930900.title: Derelict Planet
4930900.short_description: Derelict Planet is a retro-inspired top-down action RPG. Survive on a harsh alien planet, battle dungeon bosses, solve puzzles, complete quests, and search for new weapons and abilities.

4931020.title: New Trivia Unlocked!
4931020.short_description: A knowledge Q&A party game with Steam Workshop support! Featuring hundreds of quirky, mind-bending, and bizarre questions—from everyday facts to counterintuitive trivia and pure luck challenges. Play online with your friends to find out who the true "know-it-all" is!

4931030.title: James
4931030.short_description: A cozy idle game about James, a cat who just lives on your desktop. He climbs around your windows on his own, chases mice, and fills up his sticker album. Whether before, during, or after work — he'll always keep you company.

4931450.title: Alone: far from home
4931450.short_description: A psychological survival horror game on Mars. After a catastrophic expedition, you are left alone on the Red Planet. Rebuild your ruined base, restore contact with Earth, and find a way home while uncovering the truth behind the disaster, before isolation and the fight for survival break your mind..

4931460.title: Until somewhere
4931460.short_description: WARNING! This game is harder than it looks – you’ll need to be a real go-getter. The aim is to build your shuttle and upgrade it so you can venture into the unknown depths of interstellar space. With only Lina, your faithful companion, by your side, will you have enough patience?

4931510.title: There is No Stress in Outer Space
4931510.short_description: An incremental game about a spaceship in outer space destroying asteroids and other strange objects. Take control of the spaceship's gun, shoot, earn money, make upgrades and unlock new weapons and targets.

4931560.title: Key Lingo
4931560.short_description: A typing-based language learning game with WarioWare-style quick mini-games, spaced repetition, and built-in mnemonics — fun even if you already know the language, with secret advanced modes for dedicated learners.

4931650.title: Empirestead
4931650.short_description: Make a home at Grey Croft in a medieval pixel-art farming sim. Grow crops through four seasons, raise animals, and get to know the neighbors at Ashford's Sunday market. Fish, cook, and build up your farm solo or with a friend in two-player local co-op.

4931710.title: Voidlights
4931710.short_description: Voidlights is a Neon-lit 2D top-down roguelight shooter. Auto-fire through escalating void swarms, stack modules and systems, survive storms and bosses. Play solo with save/continue, or dive into Steam co-op with up to 6 players.

4931850.title: Maneki Mania Land: Clicker Park
4931850.short_description: Pet the lucky cat, build a Japanese festival park lot by lot, then step up and play every machine yourself: claw, koi pond, pachinko, Daruma wheel and the giant Maneki Grand Slot. In-game koban only, no microtransactions.

4931910.title: SoulPurge
4931910.short_description: SoulPurge is a psychological horror mystery. Explore an old abandoned mansion. Find clues to solve the mystery. Discover how and why its former inhabitants lost their lives. Evade the horrors that wander the mansion halls. Free their tortured souls in an attempt to redeem yours.

4931930.title: Beyond the Bars
4931930.short_description: Play as a prisoner, guard, or warden. Scheme, trade, and betray, or lock everything down. In this multiplayer social game of control and escape. The prison is yours to use… or break out of.

4931980.title: Crashborn
4931980.short_description: Lost and with no memories, cross a solar system to get back home. Tear through each planet's hordes to recharge your ship's energy and take off before the world turns lethal. Combine weapons, implants and anomalies until nothing can stop you. Every death rewrites your reality and your memory.

4932010.title: Chrome Circuit
4932010.short_description: A twin-stick roguelite in a 2086 cyber-dystopia. Chain kill-streaks for massive rewards, sign cursed loot contracts with brutal downsides, and stack upgrades into a new monster build every run.

4932030.title: Still Pines: watchtower
4932030.short_description: Still Pines: Watchtower is a first-person psychological horror mystery where you play as Claire, a college student trapped at an isolated winter watchtower. Explore a semi-open snowy forest, uncover clues about a missing ranger, survive the thing watching from the trees, and follow story objectives.

4932130.title: Backrooms With Friends!
4932130.short_description: A 1-5 player co-op horror game where you and your friends noclip into an endless maze also known as the Backrooms. Explore procedurally generated levels and avoid the Entities that stalk the halls. Get separated and you might not make it back. Get caught and you won't make it out at all...

4932190.title: Deck of Empires
4932190.short_description: A multiplayer RTS game where you are dealt cards every 60 seconds, and you use strategy to place cards, and command your units to create and grow a powerful empire to defeat your foes!

4932310.title: SUSPECIES
4932310.short_description: Sculpt, Paint and Animate into literally anything! Show off your amazing talents in the SUSPECIES SHOW mode or Disguise and Hide in the environment in the HIDE & SEEK mode. up to 12 players, for private or public matches.

4932500.title: I’m A Food Delivery Guy
4932500.short_description: 送外卖，攒彩礼，目标 18 万 8！“想娶我女儿，彩礼必须 18 万 8，一分都不能少！”，丈母娘的一句话，让你决定离开电子厂，开始全职送外卖，努力奋斗，只为攒够彩礼，迎娶你的心上人。

4932750.title: Phone Booth
4932750.short_description: You are currently trapped inside a phone booth. When you pick up the receiver, the number “99” appears on the display, and a countdown begins. From among the vast number of flyers covering the walls on all four sides, find and peel off two flyers with exactly the same design that aren’t overlapping.

4932840.title: Core Module
4932840.short_description: In this cyberpunk themed Roguelike card game, you can build your own deck, connect the pathways between cards, and along those pathways cyclically trigger each card's unique abilities. This allows cards to continuously cooperate with each other and unleash powerful combined effects.

4933610.title: DUAT
4933610.short_description: DUAT is a first-person survival horror game blending exploration, puzzles and psychological horror inside ancient Egyptian pyramids. Explore forgotten tombs, solve deadly mechanisms, uncover ancient secrets, evade relentless horrors, and survive the darkness.

4933650.title: One More Shake
4933650.short_description: Shake a vending machine, collect cans, earn money, and build the ultimate idle vending empire through satisfying upgrades, automation, and endless progression.

4933740.title: Whale Simulator
4933740.short_description: A livestream management sim. Lead your streamers all the way up — numbers climbing — until they stand on the national-champion stage. You're more than the operator behind the curtain. When the mood hits, you can jump in yourself, throw gifts, and fight the whole room for that number-one spot.

4933850.title: Incremental Garden
4933850.short_description: A short incremental game about a magical garden. Grow wonderful flowers, earn money, buy upgrades, and roll the gacha to discover rarer plants! Over 30 unique plants are waiting for you!

4933880.title: Summer Snow.
4933880.short_description: Escape the endless midsummer in this time-loop mystery visual novel. Find the "exit key," solve the cryptic MAZE app's missions, and reach the future with your childhood friends! A coming-of-age drama with stunning visuals, a 300k-character voiced script, diverse puzzle mechanics, and no bad ends.

4934300.title: Cheesteroids
4934300.short_description: Steal cheese from the Cat Empire in an incremental bullet hell. Dodge deadly bullet patterns, collect resources, and invest your haul in permanent upgrades. Unlock dozens of weapons and perks, experiment with powerful builds, and take on increasingly dangerous bosses.

4934310.title: GERAND: Operation KV-44 2.0
4934310.short_description: Commander, Gerand here. I repeat: the Armored Train is surrounded! Build and upgrade your squad of living tanks, crush the enemy in tactical battles, and fight your way through the blockade. Your objective: create a legend of the USSR — KV-44 2.0. Copy that? Over!

4934640.title: Hearts Gone Black
4934640.short_description: Hearts Gone Black is a top-down zombie survival game set in a post-apocalyptic open world. Manage your base and survivors, scavenge, gather resources, craft equipment, and defend against infected while endure a broken world where weather, hunger, sanity, and moral choices can slowly wear you down.

4934790.title: Desktop Fighter
4934790.short_description: Turn your desktop into an idle RPG! Your stickman fights while you work, collecting chests and rare loot. Merge 9 identical items into stronger gear, choose from 4 specializations, and hunt for items eligible for the Steam Community Market.

4934940.title: Whazzy Whizmo
4934940.short_description: Unleash marble-fueled chaos onto the cosmos! Build zany contraptions that let your marbles soar across the stars. You have full creative freedom, so go wild.

4935270.title: TRAINCORE
4935270.short_description: Command a fusion-powered war train through a cyberpunk world. Build specialized wagons, consume resources, salvage enemy wreckage, upgrade your convoy, and survive until the next station.

4935330.title: The Backrooms : Threshold
4935330.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op investigation horror game where you enter the Backrooms through an experimental gateway. Explore procedurally generated environments, document anomalies, recover valuable artifacts, and survive the unknown.

4935420.title: Focus My Deer
4935420.short_description: Focus my Deer is a game that helps you stay focused on your real-life work! After every focus session, you gain energy which can be used to bring back plants and trees to the land. As the forest grows, animals will come to visit! Learn about the animals and help them on their quests.

4936250.title: Station Between
4936250.short_description: A cozy, small-scale, coffee shop and talking simulator. As a raccoon barista, you have a gift for warming people’s hearts: brew coffee, match flavours to your customers and discover their stories. Help travellers sort out their final errands before they catch their last train.

4936280.title: When Two Roses Collide
4936280.short_description: A BL visual novel set during the War of the Roses. Will love prevail over honour?

4936450.title: CASHKET
4936450.short_description: Make a fortune off the dead. Open stolen coffins for an evil company, sell the loot, and gamble your finds for bigger rewards. Automate the dirty work, unlock the coffins of giants and titans, and crack open rocks to uncover ancient fossils.

4936540.title: The Ones Who Answered
4936540.short_description: When a catastrophic global anomaly known as "The Knocking" drags you into a nightmare dimension, you must fight to survive. Play as YouTuber Pisty and team up with an ally, Perm, to escape a four-layer hellscape. Solve puzzles, evade terrifying threats, and defeat the creator of this twisted world..

4936590.title: THE WOLF OF TENGRI
4936590.short_description: A cinematic third-person Action RPG inspired by ancient Turkic mythology. Explore a vast semi-open world, master intense melee combat, uncover forgotten temples, battle mythical spirits, and become the legend who restores the balance.

4936650.title: Cult Of Echoes
4936650.short_description: Use echolocation to hunt your friends down in an asymmetrical horror game where sound is everything!

4937250.title: 追光探偵物語 FOLLOWSPOT — A Detective Story
4937250.short_description: A retro-flavored, command-based detective adventure in the style of classic Japanese PC games. Set in the early 2000s.

4937370.title: Cardboard Conquest
4937370.short_description: Every card is an army in a beautiful papercraft world full of surprises. Choose from slimes, ghosts, a bug hivemind, giants, and more, across 22 distinct packs with unique playstyles. Earn the cardboard crown solo or online with up to three friends.

4937480.title: Mowed Down
4937480.short_description: Prop hunt, but the hunter drives a lawnmower. Disguise yourself as anything from a hay bale to a giant toilet, hold still, and hope they don't look twice. Get caught and come back as a mower or a ghost. Up to 40 players online, or solo against AI props.

4937550.title: Parallax: Axis
4937550.short_description: AXIS is a 3D spatial puzzle where your route becomes music. Move along a cube’s X/Y/Z axes, collect stars and rings, dodge obstacles and reach the gate. Each move changes rhythm, pitch and resonance. Explore 150 stages in six Halls as guides fade and your path leaves a trace in sound and form.

4937700.title: Lunadra: Luna Awakens the Legendary Dragon
4937700.short_description: A survivors-like roguelite action RPG where you master the power to grow giant or shrink tiny. Build your character by collecting weapons and companions, then challenge colossal legendary monsters. Supports 2-player local co-op.

4937720.title: Oath Eternal
4937720.short_description: A dark fantasy RPG inspired by the Metroidvania and Extraction genres.

4937740.title: Project L.U.N.A
4937740.short_description: Project L.U.N.A is a pixel art bartending visual novel set in cyberpunk Seoul. Run the bar Unknown as L.U.N.A, listen to your guests, and mix cocktails. Your choices and every drink you serve can change their relationships and fates.

4937850.title: Big Top
4937850.short_description: Big Top is an active carnival incremental where every shot, throw, and swing earns tickets. Collect game-changing prizes, build powerful combinations, and conquer the carnival on your quest to claim the legendary Super Playbox!

4937980.title: Little Witch’s Lodge A Cozy Magical Cleanup Game
4937980.short_description: A young witch has accidentally cast the wrong spell and turned her cozy lodge into complete chaos. Books, potions, bottles, and magical objects are scattered everywhere. Your task is simple: explore the lodge, collect every item, and return it to the correct place.

4938110.title: Hallowers the pilgrimage
4938110.short_description: Hallowers, the pilgrimage, is a Card and Creature collection turn based RPG where you command the spirits of the Kin Realm in your first Hallower pilgrimage. Train them, fight with them, give them forbidden attacks and evolve them into powerful beings at the height of the very Gods.

4938130.title: Virtus Arenae
4938130.short_description: Choose your tribe and step into the arena. Angels, demons, specters or sylvan folk: your creatures come to life on a 5×5 board. Move them, wield your magic to reshape the battlefield and break through enemy lines to crush your opponent.

4938320.title: Bocage, a cozy puzzle game
4938320.short_description: Bocage is a cozy isometric puzzle game where every farm piece has its own needs. Fill the grid tile by tile. Fence in the cow. Grow wheat around the windmill. Rethink each move as the constraints pile up. No timer, no game over.

4938590.title: IN
4938590.short_description: If this message still exists, then we didn’t. Restore the station’s emergency power, explore abandoned laboratories and industrial sectors, solve the failures we left behind, and remember—every generator you restart brings the station closer to life… and something closer to you

4938610.title: Fateward
4938610.short_description: An RPG that plays out in film and bends with every decision and every path you take. A young adventurer leaves his home and walks into legend: a sentient blade at his side, gods watching, an old danger stirring at the frontier of the kingdom. The fate of the world is yours to shape.

4938620.title: MIXBALL: Football Basketball Volleyball Tennis
4938620.short_description: Mixball combines the world's most popular sports into one action packed game. Play Soccer, Basketball, Volleyball, and Tennis in the same arena. Enjoy Single Player, Local Multiplayer, or Online modes as you challenge your friends in fast paced, adrenaline filled matches.

4939050.title: Aunt Hattie's Quilts
4939050.short_description: Grow your own cotton, gather natural materials, and craft beautiful quilts to delight your customers. Create lasting friendships within the community, and they might just reward you with new quilting templates! Expand your collection to unlock new designs and express your creativity.

4939120.title: Break the Witch
4939120.short_description: Manage the duality of defending while using the enemy projectiles in your favor to face challenges an progress through the game. To improve collect boons along the way. Try different builds and find the one that best suits your play style.

4939190.title: Helltower
4939190.short_description: A Roguelike RPG mixing spectacular action and rhythmic combat, in a dystopic hell where each soul has to accept their death, and the regrets that come with it.

4939280.title: Etched
4939280.short_description: A top-down action roguelite about a little mage who carves lightning itself. Etch engravings into your spells to reshape how they behave, weave engraving synergies into your own build, mow down monster packs, hunt buffed elites, and descend into ever-deeper arenas. What's carved cannot be undone.

4939530.title: ByteBuddies
4939530.short_description: Explore the depths of an abandoned world and figure out what is happening while you survive 5 nights fighting for your life.

4939580.title: Chronogoblin
4939580.short_description: An incremental platformer about a goblin, a sarcastic time machine, and many, many clones. Run parkour courses across history, beat your best time, then buy clones of yourself that run it forever, earning while you explore. They don't mind. Right?

4939600.title: UpBRELLA
4939600.short_description: A witch's adventure with nothing but an umbrella. Upbrella is a puzzle platformer where every trick you discover reopens the world in a new way, wrapped in cozy pixel art and a wordless friendship between a girl and a strange little creature.

4939730.title: Digging Up
4939730.short_description: Digging Up is a 1-4 player co-op digging adventure where you drill through a destructible alien planet, gather valuable resources, upgrade your gear, explore underground biomes, and dig your way back to the surface.

4939750.title: Reaper GoStop
4939750.short_description: You are dead. At the gates of the afterlife, judgment is settled over a game of Hwatu. Real Korean flower cards and authentic Go-Stop rules meet runaway score-multiplier deckbuilding. The hand you draw is the life you lived. Outplay the Reaper to pass, or fall to hell and face the gate again.

4939790.title: Loss Prevention: Prologue
4939790.short_description: Loss Prevention is a social deduction game where you can shoplift your local grocery store with up to five friends. Experience the joy of petty crime as a shoplifter, or keep your eyes peeled for suspicious activity as the shopkeeper. Can you grab all the items on the shopping list?

4940310.title: Fantasy Meat
4940310.short_description: Fantasy Meat is a stress-free cooking game where fantasy creatures are the main ingredient. Cut and assemble them on a skewer as you please, satisfy increasingly more demanding customers, and send out adventurers to find the tastiest creature: The Golden Drake!

4940350.title: Chunk DAW
4940350.short_description: Build music out of blocks! Place, pitch, and sequence sounds in a 3D world, solo or with friends in real time. Jam over built-in voice chat, shape terrain and scenery around your songs, then publish your creations for the world to browse, remix, and play.

4940460.title: Guild of Elemental Quests
4940460.short_description: Welcome to the Elemental Adventure Guild! Pick your adventurer, clear elemental blocks to strike enemies, gather diverse elemental gems, and craft your personalized battle style. Survive each mission's battles and complete every challenge that comes your way.

4940660.title: PAPER.VOID
4940660.short_description: Pilot a paper plane through an infinite monochrome dimension. Collect VOID Cubes, survive your own deadly trail, and face the END of reality.

4940800.title: Global Plates
4940800.short_description: Build food factories that keep a cat café purring. Plan at your own pace, serve fresh dishes through the rush and turn your best days into upgrades. Travel through ten kitchens in a cozy cooking-automation game about tasty efficiency.

4941080.title: She Tells Her Story
4941080.short_description: She Tells Her Story is your narrative-driven visual novel and educational project about bullying and its long-term impact on mental health, identity, and personal growth.

4941230.title: Jackpot Poker Destruction
4941230.short_description: Poker meets slot machines in this roguelite deckbuilder! Hold and swap cards, build winning poker hands with special Jokers, upgrade your decks and defeat your enemies!

4941440.title: Little Bastard
4941440.short_description: A crazy co-op run from a hungry monster will test your friendship to the limit! Team up or double-cross each other: lock your friend in a washing machine, dunk 'em in a toilet, or extend a helping hook — all for resources! Between matches, develop your business: a nightclub. Chaos and trash-fun!

4941710.title: Swap Bots
4941710.short_description: Adapt to the needs of your ever-changing team of robots in this fast-paced, deck-building auto-battler. Combine robots to create the perfect team with the best card synergies before they wear down completely.

4941950.title: CottageCore
4941950.short_description: Build freely, shape cottages and towers, and welcome a village into your glade. Organize village life and prepare homes and supplies for winter. A cozy building game about making a place of your own and caring for the people who live there.

4942020.title: Dark Journey to the West
4942020.short_description: A dark-themed idle loot game. Gather and train minions and artifacts with distinct abilities — then pit your builds against legendary bosses. Lead your monster squad through the Heavenly Palace, the Underworld, the sacred mountains, and beyond, all in search of the true scriptures.

4942150.title: Cookwagon
4942150.short_description: Play your cards into the pot and serve up signature dishes! Cookwagon is a fantasy cooking roguelike deckbuilder with no traditional combat. Manage three pots, serve guests before they lose patience, and collect cards and relics to shape your playstyle.

4942450.title: Feather Trace
4942450.short_description: Inside vast biodomes, embark on a one-of-a-kind birdwatching journey built around deck-building, Birdpedia collection, and long-term progression. Explore diverse habitats, meet birds of every kind, and study them through card-based play to fill out your Birdpedia.

4942550.title: Sportvida Foodimals
4942550.short_description: Half food. Half animal. All adventure. Team up with friends in this VR co-op adventure where you'll hunt ingredients, collect adorable Foodimals, and cook up a world of fun.

4942590.title: Shanhe Builders
4942590.short_description: Lead one to five companions in a Chinese-inspired 3D home-building survival sim. Gather and haul supplies, build timber, stone and adobe homes, and manage farming, cooking and rest. Command your group from above or take direct control as your camp grows into a home.

4942660.title: The Proxy
4942660.short_description: The Proxy is a narrative political simulation game set in a fictional nation, Leviah. The president is dead, and the office is yours. Sign papers that decide the fate of your nation, trade on secrets only you know, and juggle the ones who all want something. Protect the country, or protect yourself?

4942690.title: When Stars Rest
4942690.short_description: Stars are out of energy. The black hole is hungry! Charge stars that fall on your island to earn coins. Will you upgrade weapons, unlock powerful items, and put Tesla coils and UFOs to work—or feed that black hole's growing appetite? It's all up to you!

4942730.title: The Backrooms Experience
4942730.short_description: The Backrooms Experience is a cooperative exploration and survival-horror game built around observation, discovery, and the unknown. Enter liminal environments alone or with others, document what you learn, and survive encounters with the entities hidden within.

4942750.title: Bramblewick: Guild Management Simulator
4942750.short_description: The heroes get the songs. You get the ledger. Run a fantasy guild hall, recruit adventurers with lives and personalities of their own, and send them on dangerous journeys shaped by combat, chance, and your decisions. Manage the hall they call home—and live with the stories they bring back.

4942830.title: Golfever
4942830.short_description: Create, share and play endless unique 2D pixel-art minigolf courses. Powerful level editor, community maps, easy to learn controls but hard to master. The Steam launch includes multiplayer and expanded content!

4943000.title: ECHIDNA
4943000.short_description: A dead god drifts in the dark. Build a salvage fleet that carves it apart cell by cell, and watch a colossal carcass melt into a storm of flying debris and climbing numbers. Strip it to the bone then evolve and start again on something bigger.

4943050.title: Working with Montabi
4943050.short_description: Let adorable Montabi keep you company while you work! A desktop companion that types together with you. Customize your room and avatar, stay focused with productivity tools, and collect every Montabi by placing their favorite items!

4943110.title: CRIMSON PANDEMIC
4943110.short_description: CRIMSON PANDEMIC: A tale of the 'Rubrum'—a crimson light that mutates living beings into entities driven by resentment—and 'Belle,' a girl who has lost her dreams, embarking on a journey of promise aboard a Ark.

4943150.title: Kaperfahrt
4943150.short_description: Sail an open Caribbean where every choice matters. Plunder ships in fierce naval battles, trade between rival houses, and build yourself from a humble sloop into a feared legend. Kaperfahrt is your pirate sandbox on a grand scale.

4943260.title: Tin Coffins
4943260.short_description: You are Talon-22, a combat clone printed this shift, and twenty-one of you didn't come home. A cel-shaded mech roguelite shooter: short, lethal squad battles through procedurally generated war-torn cities, against enemy squads that flank, suppress and hold the line. Die, and the next you deploys.

4943280.title: Federal Cadet
4943280.short_description: Federal Cadet is a single-player police simulation and investigation game. Start as a cadet in Pinewood, patrol the town, question witnesses and suspects, analyze evidence, and rise through the department ranks.

4943450.title: Odd Stories: Backyard Mountain
4943450.short_description: Dig into a mysterious mountain in your backyard. Mine valuable resources, sell your discoveries, upgrade your digging equipment, and venture deeper to uncover what lies beneath.

4943660.title: La Famiglia
4943660.short_description: A painted noir mafia saga: plan the week, rule the city, found a dynasty.

4943690.title: Budget Defense
4943690.short_description: During the day, he personally drove the war vehicle to attack the enemy. At night, he extracted oil to sell and use the money to build defense towers, working together to protect the base.

4944410.title: High Roller Penny
4944410.short_description: A bold pachinko-inspired roguelike. With bunny girls. Build your best pegboard with special pegs, balls and passive effects to reach legendary scores. Lose and get executed on the spot. Oh did we mention this is a death game?

4944830.title: One More Sin
4944830.short_description: Become a demon summoner in this roguelike deckbuilder. Discover forgotten sorceries, cursed enchantments and powerful creatures as you craft the perfect deck to crush your enemies and serve your dark queen.

4944890.title: Foosball Champs
4944890.short_description: Experience the most authentic foosball simulation in VR. Bring the table directly into your room and face off against friends in lag-free and cross-platform multiplayer.

4945070.title: Shenanigans Party
4945070.short_description: A chaotic free-for-all party brawler for up to 16 players. Shove, launch and dash rivals off the map across a dozen fast-paced minigames, then roll the dice on the party board between rounds. Cute characters, absurd chaos, zero mercy. Solo with bots or online.

4945310.title: Solaris
4945310.short_description: Solaris is an immersive first-person action game set in an alternate, post-apocalyptic Soviet satellite Poland. You are Irka: a skilled rooftop runner and courier. Sneak, run and climb the roofs of the destroyed city to find a cure for your grandma infected by a mysterious disease called Solaris.

4945810.title: Odysseus' 13th Ship
4945810.short_description: Paddle a canoe up a mountain of abstract geometric shapes with your friends, as the forgotten 13th Ship of Odysseus. Online multiplayer only, with the goal of reaching Ithaca.

4945920.title: VIZZA
4945920.short_description: Set particles dancing to your favorite songs. Infect your desktop with immortal mold. the waves of time at your fingertips. Your one way ticket to the trip dimension.

4946060.title: Keelhauled
4946060.short_description: Sink your friends in fast-paced top-down pirate combat. Line up devastating broadsides, dodge deadly hazards, and unleash game-changing powerups in chaotic sea arena battles for 2-6 players.

4946180.title: EVA Awakening
4946180.short_description: A cinematic VR psychological sci-fi experience aboard the mysterious Aeon Express. Solve immersive puzzles, shape the narrative, and question the nature of consciousness.

4946930.title: Fast Charging Tycoon
4946930.short_description: Run an electric vehicle charging company. Choose your locations, design sites, schedule repairs, apply for loans and grants, vote on industry initiatives, hire executives, maintain reputation and site driver experience ratings, and claim one of four victories to build a fast charging tycoon.

4947210.title: Demolitors
4947210.short_description: Command powerful Demolitors, battle enemy machines with unique Insignias, upgrade each machine through its skill tree, unlock even stronger Insignias, and defeat formidable bosses.

4947230.title: Jack's Last Show
4947230.short_description: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to Jack’s Last Show, a short co-op horror game for 1–4 players. Wind up the music boxes, start each act of Jack’s final performance, and try to escape before the house becomes his stage.

4947990.title: Nightmare Delivery
4947990.short_description: Enter distorted minds and deliver packages to the darkness within. Play alone or in online co-op for up to 4 players, explore nightmarish locations, solve environmental puzzles, outsmart dangerous entities, and escape alive.

4948070.title: さくらいろプリズム Beyond the Bloom
4948070.short_description: A coming-of-age romance visual novel set in a disbanded high school photography club. Three fully voiced heroines — a childhood friend, a playful junior, a mysterious senior. As love refracts like a prism, what will Hikaru's camera capture? A remake of Sakurairo Prism. "You can always start over."

4948140.title: Spellhoard
4948140.short_description: An autobattler where nothing you buy is ever benched. Every spell stays active, your whole spellbook fights as one machine, and your opponents are real players' builds.

4948210.title: If You Build It, Everyone Dies!
4948210.short_description: Play as the "Techno King" of a thriving Silicon Valley startup in this active incremental game. Fulfill contracts, harvest data, fabricate supply chains, manufacture consent, bio-integrate with humans, and transcend space and time itself in a dark satire of the retro-futuristic Brave New World.

4948380.title: Locked Inside
4948380.short_description: Locked inside a sealed underground bunker, you must solve intricate mechanical puzzles and restore power to escape while being relentlessly hunted in the dark by an entity that reacts to your every sound.

4948460.title: Monochrome Rainbow
4948460.short_description: Monochrome Rainbow is a surrealist card game

4948620.title: Gacha The Frog
4948620.short_description: Collect and play with cute frogs in a cozy physics simulation. Use the machine to get new frogs, play mini-games to improve the odds of getting legendary frogs and manage your space so you can keep playing. Can you complete the album?

4948830.title: StowStow
4948830.short_description: StowStow is a first-person warehouse sim where every box is a physics object. Stop the train, unload and sort cargo, handle explosive parcels with care and load the trucks. Draft upgrade cards and build conveyor lines until the depot runs itself.

4948990.title: Not a Dog
4948990.short_description: What will the world look like on behalf of a cute little dog driven by a cherished wish? Will you follow your dream or stay with your beloved owner, find a new life, or greet the dawn with your loyal friend?

4949070.title: Cozy Cookmaster
4949070.short_description: Cozy Cookmaster is an incremental restaurant management game where you turn a tiny food counter into a busy restaurant. Cook by hand, serve customers, clean tables, unlock new recipes, hire staff, upgrade your kitchen, expand your dining area, and keep your restaurant growing day after day.

4949240.title: War In The Dark
4949240.short_description: War In The Dark is a 1-bit turn-based wiretapping simulation. Track enemy radio frequencies and decipher incoming Morse code to pinpoint unseen enemies. Use the spacebar to manually tap Morse commands to direct your allies and control the flow of intense information warfare.

4949270.title: 塑时者Derealization
4949270.short_description: "Derealization" is a visual novel that combines Japanese campus youth, suspenseful loops, and supernatural combat. The main characters in this work are voiced by professional Japanese actors. Inserting original animation clips into the climactic scenes greatly enhances the impact of the plot.

4949360.title: Undying Soul
4949360.short_description: Undying Soul is a 2D action roguelite focused on fluid combat, character swapping, and broken build crafting. Choose your allies, combine their abilities, discover powerful synergies and adapt your playstyle to overcome deadly foes and reclaim your shattered soul.

4949420.title: Humbuggest
4949420.short_description: Ziggy wants the crown and will do anything to steal it, even if it means breaking the law by breaking the laws of physics. Manipulate time and solve fourth-wall-breaking riddles in this comedic 2D puzzle-platformer filled with classic pixel art.

4949440.title: Zorehrai: Space Formations
4949440.short_description: Start with your own character and a small ship in a world that lives independently of the player. Develop your skills, explore space, trade, build industry, and grow your fleet to survive real-time battles against hostile fleets—and something far more terrifying lurking in the darkness.

4949470.title: Sandweh
4949470.short_description: Sandweh is a relaxing sand-surfing game set in an endless, procedurally generated desert. Carve trails through dunes, build speed, pull off flips and rolls, catch the wind with your sail, and discover mysterious towers and hidden places. No pressure, just you and your board.

4949500.title: Catino Town
4949500.short_description: Raise cute creatures that can transform into over 150 unique evolutions! Play games, decorate their home, and explore their world!

4949950.title: Shieldlinked
4949950.short_description: In this turn-based tactical RPG, coordinate your attacks with close allies to overcome the enemy with the unique Link system. Win battles through clever planning, spare opponents to earn their equipment or recruit them to your cause, and resist those who sow division.

4950160.title: Nine Winters
4950160.short_description: Survive a ruined city where the infected lurk in Nine Winters. Fight back or slip through the dark to scavenge ruins yourself for parts and collectibles. Repair your broken shelter, grow crops, and decorate your home with cherished finds to endure nine winters.

4950300.title: Exchange Alley
4950300.short_description: Trade shares, spread rumours, exploit bubbles and chase your fortune in the chaotic coffee houses of 18th-century London, birthplace of the modern stock market.

4950460.title: The Dark Signal
4950460.short_description: The Dark Signal is a gothic roguelike deckbuilder where every card is a transmission. Build a deadly deck, command summons, manage Debt and Fury, uncover forbidden signals, and survive three floors before facing the entity known as The Last Hand.

4950970.title: MORS
4950970.short_description: Every evening the note said tomorrow, for fifty years, and every morning the tree was still there. So Vladimir and Estragon cut it down, built a rocket from it, an oil drum and a painted can, and flew to Mars to build a factory: mining, belts, machines. Godot, presumably, is late.

4951320.title: Dinosaur Apocalypse
4951320.short_description: Dinosaurs took over the Earth, and humans were almost wiped out. How would you survive?

4951330.title: Nordic
4951330.short_description: Nordic is a PS1-aesthetic "foddylike" cross-country skiing game that can be online or single player. Nordic captures what makes cross-country skiing great; rhythm & cadence, the calm of nature and exploring the natural world with your friends! Race, ski and discover the beauty of winter.

4951520.title: AstroPoly
4951520.short_description: A pixel-art space mining game. Dig into procedurally generated planets, chart your own route across the star map, collect rare ores, level up your gear, and grow your fortune by investing in the market.

4951760.title: Road to FIRE
4951760.short_description: Survive a series of mysterious games and claim a fortune. Analyze the rules of seemingly unwinnable games, uncover hidden winning strategies, and overcome every challenge in this high-difficulty death game–style puzzle game.

4951860.title: Largely Legal Monstrosity
4951860.short_description: Summon then enslave all-consuming astral horrors for profit in this incremental bullet heaven. Craft your build in a race to disrupt ineffectual antiquated market leaders. Between rounds invest in infrastructure to power up and secure your place in the largest monster creation event in history!

4952180.title: ToFaYun 2000: Origin of the Lawcast
4952180.short_description: 《桃花源二千: 離律之源》是一款香港漫畫風格的推理視覺小說。二千年前的桃花源至今仍然存在，只是暗中觀察著現世的變遷，發展出另一種世界文明。你將化身玄族人，透過道法與現世科技融的「手乩」搜集線索、選擇走向與推理劇情。然而玄族官府的高壓管治，令人變得相當警惕，你必需注意言行，在適當時候切換「謹慎模式」，否則會令人對你起疑，甚至招來橫禍。另一方面，自然界無處不在的「泛靈」，在對你作出誘導的同時，背後似乎有著某種不明的動機。你能否從不起眼的細節，找出恐怖襲擊的元兇，阻止一場人為災難？

4952190.title: Partial
4952190.short_description: Master difficult platforming, puzzles and combat with limited retries inside an unforgiving hazardous interconnected world. Partial is an intense 2D action-adventure where you play as a vulnerable and bizarre creature, seeking to uncover the mystery behind the Partial project and your own existence.

4952260.title: HopScout
4952260.short_description: HopScout is a cozy logic puzzle game about arranging cute, picky rabbits to keep everyone happy. Take your time solving puzzles, help the rabbit burrow overcome a looming crisis, and discover the heartwarming stories of its adorable residents.

4952340.title: Freewake
4952340.short_description: A team-based strategy and space simulation game where allies build an empire together while competing to control it. Explore, trade, colonize, scheme, and fight tactical battles shaped by stealth, sensors, and deception.

4952370.title: Nightveld
4952370.short_description: A bullet heaven (a reverse bullet hell) where your only weapon is the light you see with. Widen the beam to see the swarm coming, or focus it to burn what's close, and go blind everywhere else. Survive to dawn, pick a power, and face a longer, hungrier Night. How many can you last?

4952380.title: Night Train Simulator: Blackout
4952380.short_description: A slow-burn psychological horror train simulator. Drive the train. Follow the schedule. Ignore what's outside.

4952480.title: Orkoriz
4952480.short_description: Orkoriz is a stealth-action game set in the war-torn ghost city of Vuhledar. Infiltrate the ruins as NAFO agent Badabumov, navigate ork-infested streets, and uncover the fate of its citizens.

4952640.title: OnlyCats
4952640.short_description: Pet cats, earn love, buy more cats. OnlyCats is a cozy incremental idle game where hovering over adorable pixel cats fills your coin and love stash. Unlock new cats, grow your collection, and discover more upgrades.

4952650.title: One More Release: Indie Studio Tycoon
4952650.short_description: Build your dream indie game studio from a tiny office into an industry legend. Hire developers, create games, research engines, survive reviews, fight bugs, decorate your office, and make one more release.

4952700.title: LIMINAL: Within
4952700.short_description: Boot up Black & White Limbo! Become the Prince of Might and reclaim your ruined homeland in a pixel-art RPG. Beyond the screen, Shuuichi Hirata’s life takes a sinister turn. A murder. A game to blame? Explore, battle, and shape the story in this cinematic mystery adventure. What will you choose?

4952790.title: The Time-Seeing Cat: Prologue
4952790.short_description: The world has already ended once. Knowing what awaits, the protagonist returns two months into the past. Foresee future events, change people's fates, and even use knowledge of the future to overcome powerful bosses. A suspense-driven JRPG where knowing the future is itself part of the gameplay.

4952960.title: JazzWitch
4952960.short_description: A fast-paced 2D platformer about building speed through movement combos — chain jumps, dashes, and saxophone blasts to increase your combos. Outrun various hazards across hand-drawn dimensions to the beat of an original jazz score.

4952990.title: Draw It, Forget It
4952990.short_description: Draw prompts in seconds, clear your memory with quick distractions, then decipher your own wonderfully confusing sketches. Play solo or join friends over LAN for voting, shared drawing challenges, and hilarious chains of drawings that drift farther from the original idea.

4953020.title: Oniro
4953020.short_description: Slay demonic hordes in a dark fantasy Action RPG with fast-paced combat. Hunt legendary loot and create your own build through a deep multiclass skill tree.

4953640.title: Shoot Some Rocks
4953640.short_description: A bullet hell roguelite about a lonely worker drinking alone in space on Christmas Eve. Survive waves of cosmic chaos, get a cold beer, and face five massive bosses inspired by real space calamities.

4953700.title: Excuse My Bullets
4953700.short_description: Think bad aim and an empty magazine mean it's over? Wrong! Right-click and your bullets fly back along their trails to hit enemies again. Steal enemies' bodies, or race along a trail as light. Everyone is called a "shareholder", but only the Central Board has a say. Fight from 13th Street to their door!

4954200.title: Plausible Deniability - Cover Your Tracks
4954200.short_description: A satisfying incremental game about breaking boxes, shredding paperwork, and upgrading your operation to keep up with an endless flood of documents.

4954270.title: My Clay Planet
4954270.short_description: A cute and cozy desktop game where you care for a tiny clay planet, grow crops, place animals, and jump in to control your little friends as your world lives on your screen.

4955040.title: Dragon Hoard Keeper: Treasure Shop Tycoon
4955040.short_description: Run a dragon's treasure shop. Cross-check six appraisal tools to uncover what each relic really is — and expose convincing forgeries. Restore worn treasures, forge new ones by hand, grow the shop, and pay the dragon's tribute before it comes due.

4955120.title: Hexa-Gone
4955120.short_description: Pieces are falling, and you need to do something about it! Match like colors together to clear them, and if you make a shape, you’ll earn some points. Points are your score in Singleplayer modes, and are used as a currency in Multiplayer modes. Use them to buy Power-Ups and make a comeback!

4955250.title: N.E.O.N. HORIZON
4955250.short_description: Build your own ship from the hull up. Arm it, install a variety of systems, break the rules — then survive relentless waves of escalating threats in this sci-fi roguelite shooter. Experiment with weapons, relics and powerful synergies. Reach Horizon.

4955350.title: Face Your Fate
4955350.short_description: A pixel-art roguelike deckbuilder where your deck spins the reels. Chain elemental patterns, stack your Fates into one huge hand, and fight your way up to the gods of Chinese myth.

4955700.title: Charon 卡戎
4955700.short_description: A point-and-click narrative puzzle game with a delicate art style and soothing pace. In this Underworld at the end of all things, guide souls who lost their memories and speech safely across the Styx. Luckily, our protagonist is about to face the most restless bunch of them all...

4955760.title: Odin's Fate
4955760.short_description: You are Odin, and time is your weapon against Ragnarök. In this Norse mythology tower defense, rewind the battle to drag enemies back, unleash elemental towers and fight alongside Thor, Loki, Heimdall, Borr and more. Take on Odin's Trials – the harder the fight, the more Einherjar answer your call!

4956610.title: Ants Took the Kitchen
4956610.short_description: In Ants Took the Kitchen, you lead a small colony of ants determined to take over the kitchen. Collect crumbs, carry increasingly larger pieces of food, buy upgrades for each area, automate the collection process, and turn a simple corner of the floor into a hungry swarm.

4956750.title: Dice Knight
4956750.short_description: Dice knight is a dice builder rouge like. Roll for numbers and use those numbers on different actions. Discover food items of power, and become the Dice Knight!

4957350.title: The Lost Cape
4957350.short_description: The Lost Cape is a first-person survival game set on a mysterious tropical island. Explore, build, hunt, and uncover its secrets. When night falls, beware of a blind creature that hunts by sound. Play solo or in online co-op and find a way to escape.

4957490.title: Legacy: The Card Game
4957490.short_description: A free 1v1 card game with a twist: both players summon Foes onto one shared field, which either of you can kill for Legacy points. It's your Legend versus theirs to see who can leave behind the greatest Legacy. Use strategy to play cards that help you, hurt them, or add some chaos to the mix.

4958330.title: Eclipse Island Primal Odyssey
4958330.short_description: Survive on a mysterious island where every choice shapes your journey. Explore ancient ruins, gather resources, craft essential tools, battle dangerous wildlife, and uncover the secrets hidden deep within Eclipse Island in this immersive story-driven survival adventure.

4958650.title: Wheel of Death
4958650.short_description: Spin the wheel... or die. Wheel of Death is a dangerously addictive deck-builder where you'll spin Death's wheel, changing your fate with powerful Tarot card combos, rule-breaking chips, illegal contraband, and a wheel where the numbers go up!

4958930.title: Nonogram Classics
4958930.short_description: Classical nonogram puzzles: 1000+ puzzles, 50+ distinct themes. Solve puzzles and unlock unique images. Newcomer in nonograms? Start with tutorial and small puzzles. Expert? Challenge large and complex nonograms. Complete 'em all!

4958950.title: Mow and Move
4958950.short_description: Take control of M-42 in a relaxed incremental mowing game. Cut through fields of engineered grass, turn each harvest into upgrades, and reach farther with a stronger mower. Recover useful equipment along the way and work at your own pace.

4958960.title: Meowland: Legacy of the Rainbow Cat
4958960.short_description: Cats. RPG. Magic. Adventure. Do you really need more reasons?

4959070.title: The Shadow Brokers
4959070.short_description: A mysterious hacker has stolen the NSA's cyber arsenal and is threatening to sell it to the highest bidder. You have been pulled from your day job and assigned to hunt the hacker. Triage alerts, search through logs, piece together the clues, and find The Shadow Brokers before they leak everything.

4959750.title: Hitflag
4959750.short_description: Arcade car chases on real city streets: grab the flag, ram whoever carries it and escape, on Istanbul's Taksim, New York's Times Square or any street you pick on the map. Then race, wreck or run down the dead. 2 to 8 cars, online or with bots.

4960060.title: Iron Pilgrim
4960060.short_description: Noah's Ark returns as a war train. Leave the rails behind in a horde survival rogue-lite where you smash through fully destructible worlds, rescue survivors, and forge devastating wagon synergies.

4960280.title: JOCKEY RISING: BLOODLINE
4960280.short_description: JOCKEY RISING: BLOODLINE is a jockey life sim with deck-building races. Start at 18 as a rookie, ride and raise horses at your family stable, breed your own bloodline, then retire and pass the stable and its legacy to your child.

4960680.title: Morpheus
4960680.short_description: Locked, loaded, on the beat — reclaim the boy's lost memories! Morpheus is a futuristic arcade rhythm game built around heavyweight impact.

4960750.title: Things Left Unsaid
4960750.short_description: A tiny, cozy, hand-drawn ASMR game. Every antique arrives in loose pieces: click them back together, brush away the dust, trace the cracks in gold lacquer, and press the wax seal. Then haggle with quirky collectors at your counter. Each piece holds a story left unsaid.

4960830.title: Myconaut
4960830.short_description: A puzzle platformer collectathon where secrets are hidden around every corner! Find your way through the vibrant undergrowth, while finding hidden seeds. Navigate the rich open-world with tight platformer controls and colourful graphics.

4960910.title: Pinebrook Ski Resort
4960910.short_description: Run a ski resort as a real business. Shape trails on the mountain, string up lifts, and set prices against weather, snow and weekend crowds. Keep lifts running, skiers safe and the books in the black, from a gentle beginner hill to desert dunes and a volcano.

4960950.title: Mechanized Wonder: Lost Unit
4960950.short_description: Fight across battlefields in the name of freedom from those who are bound and weighted down by gravity in this FPS simulation game, where you pilot a giant Mechanized Combat Vehicle from within an enclosed cockpit.

4961010.title: Tropical Company
4961010.short_description: A dystopian sci-fi RPG. You come to the federal capital for the civil service exam, only to be trapped by a citywide blackout. Awaken opinionated objects, follow them into the city—or answer a mysterious Bluetooth message from next door.

4961100.title: Alphadia F
4961100.short_description: Embark on an epic fantasy JRPG in Alphadia F, the remake of Alphadia IV. Explore Valhalard, uncover the mystery of six fallen crystals, and save four kingdoms in strategic turn-based battles. Master the energi system, character progression, cooking, and classic anime-style RPG adventure.

4961220.title: Sifu Duel
4961220.short_description: A Roguelike strategy deckbuilder where cards determine your moves. Each card becomes an attack, defense, movement, or special skill. Arrange cards wisely to trigger combos, deal more damage, and adapt to changing enemy attacks.

4961310.title: Terrahold
4961310.short_description: Build an autonomous colony on a living procedural planet. Gather resources, command robots, reshape the terrain, expand your power grid, and defend the teleporter from an ecosystem that reacts to your growth. Establish the link — or lose everything.

4961370.title: Solitary Singleplayer Offline MMORPG
4961370.short_description: Run an MMORPG guild in this incremental management game. Recruit new members, upgrade your guild, promote leaders to automate the busywork, and grind for the best gear. All to earn the Server-First achievements for every raid.

4962220.title: Beyond The Grey
4962220.short_description: Beyond the Grey is a cosy island life sim. Farm, mine, craft and keep bees at whatever pace suits you, trade at a market that opens once a week, and get to know some neighbours who notice when you come back. You left the city. Nothing here is in a hurry.

4962520.title: Football Chess
4962520.short_description: Every player on the pitch is a chess piece. Make the right move, disrupt your opponent's strategy, create the perfect attack, and take the shot. The excitement of football meets the strategy of chess in one unique game.

4962750.title: Don't Fear
4962750.short_description: Endure a recurring nightmare and search for scattered fragments of memory. Distinguish between the entities that approach you in different ways, and confront the traces of emotions long kept hidden in this first-person psychological horror game.

4962880.title: The World of Enemies with You
4962880.short_description: A Novel × Turn-Based RPG told through seven perspectives. Join Mahoru, a new Hunter of αh, and enter Outrealm, a world threatened by Enemies. Experience strategic battles and a story where each perspective reveals a different truth. Uncover the secrets of this world. これで約260〜280文字程度です。

4962940.title: Night to Reticle +6
4962940.short_description: Nozomu follows his wife to Kyushu and meets the enigmatic KANA. Accept or refuse his nightly “invitations”? Replay the six-day story to uncover the truth. A choice-driven BL psychological adventure with a seme (top) protagonist. The complete edition of the free game Night to Reticle.

4962980.title: Match 2 3D
4962980.short_description: Match II 3D is a relaxing 3D hidden pair puzzle where physics scatters dozens of colorful objects across detailed environments. Rotate the camera, find matching pairs, unlock new waves, and challenge your observation skills in a cozy casual experience.

4963580.title: Snake Mayhem
4963580.short_description: You're a snake that turns into a flaming wheel. Smash structures, set off chain reactions, race for gold medals, and build your own levels to wreck.

4963680.title: Pick Playground
4963680.short_description: Plan crane lifts like the pros. Pick your crane, configure the boom, rig the load, and judge every pick against real manufacturer load charts. A 3D rigging simulation sandbox from a rigger with 18 years in the field. Build it, rig it, lift it, land it.

4963810.title: BROKE.EXE
4963810.short_description: BROKE.EXE is a satirical trading simulator inside a fictional desktop OS. Earn cash in minigame jobs, then trade simulated stocks and crypto - long, short, leverage, stop-losses. Build passive income, run mining rigs and trading bots, and climb from $0 to $10,000,000. No real money involved.

4964480.title: Mineblader - Spin. Mine. Upgrade.
4964480.short_description: A short but packed incremental game where you use a spinning top (spinner) to mine, make money, upgrade, get special powers, and defeat bosses.

4964510.title: マジカルラプチャー
4964510.short_description: A 2D fighting game featuring magical girls with comical moves! Unleash magic on your opponents using simple controls—no complex command inputs required. Manage your magic gauge as you battle, employing unique tactics to outplay your rivals!

4964530.title: Seal of Confession
4964530.short_description: A man confesses he'll kill tomorrow, but the hardest part isn't deciding what's right. It's deciding what you're willing to betray. Work with the Gravekeeper, unaware of the tragedy unfolding around you.

4964540.title: Sound & Shoal
4964540.short_description: A surreal first-person narrative adventure about memory, loss, and the stories we tell ourselves. Explore an ever-changing world where reality and fantasy blur in search of meaning.

4964630.title: Apocalypse Train
4964630.short_description: Command a heavily armed, constantly moving train through a hostile post-apocalyptic wasteland. Manage your crew's hunger, mine for resources, upgrade your mobile base, and defend relentless monster attacks.

4965150.title: It Works: Electronics Repair Simulator - First Short Circuit
4965150.short_description: Take your first steps in the electronics repair business! Enter your home garage, master the basics of diagnostics, use the multimeter, and solve your very first hardware crises. Fix basic devices, satisfy your clients, and face the ultimate test: your first short circuit!

4965260.title: I just wanted a marshmallow.
4965260.short_description: 'I just wanted a marshmallow.' is a casual completely normal take on the arena shooter genre. Falling into the pits of despair over not having a marshmallow, you and your crew opt to take the matters into their own hands. There's not much else to say about this game.

4965470.title: Crownmarked
4965470.short_description: Rule a fallen kingdom: manage its people, send adventurers into dangerous lands, and explore the wilds yourself to learn what broke the world.

4965660.title: No More Turtles
4965660.short_description: No More Turtles is a plastic-producing incremental game. Start cranking grandpa's machine, loot abandoned warehouses, and pollute your way to saving a world overrun by turtles!

4965680.title: Friends for Strawberry
4965680.short_description: A filthy, horrific nightmare at sea, haunted by people and things cast away. Friends for Strawberry is a story-driven horror FPS where you are trapped on an island of garbage, held captive by the cannibal castaways dwelling there, and... something in the trash, that won't let anyone or anything go.

4965710.title: Hyper-Realistic Fishing Sim
4965710.short_description: Cast your way through hordes of fish, explode arcade cabinets, and kill Poseidon in this tiny endless fishing combat game!

4965960.title: Operation: Doomed Peter
4965960.short_description: OPERATION : Doomed Peter is a dungeon crawler heavily inspired by the 80's and 90's games like rogue. Weapons include guns, voodoo magic, melee, and even thrown weapons! Fight through hordes of monsters consisting of over 35 uniqe encounters and 3 bosses!

4965980.title: Scrambled Ships
4965980.short_description: A Yacht Dice Roguelike set on a ship with a mysterious figure, trapped in an endless game night atop a sunset cruise. Think outside the box, buy items, and progress through the rounds, or fall to the ever-increasing score targets.

4966030.title: 100+ Bored Games
4966030.short_description: Mini games you can play with your friends or with bots during any time!

4966170.title: Unbox Super Card
4966170.short_description: Buy CardBoxes, reveal valuable cards, build your automated opening factory, and Prestige to grow your fortune even faster. Complete every collection and become the ultimate card collector.

4966300.title: LOTTERY
4966300.short_description: The only game in the world to bring the joy of tactical FPS games into the single-player experience. Fight the entire world with superpowers gifted to you by sheer luck as you wipe out thousands of the world's most elite defenses while they try predicting, learning, and adapting to your every move.

4966380.title: Survivor of the Meow Kingdom
4966380.short_description: Gameplay:​ A 3D pixel-art roguelike action-adventure game. In an endless sea of choices, discover powerful card-based upgrades, forge your own path, slay monsters, save the empire—or challenge yourself to the limit in endless mode.

4966440.title: Rogue Link Loop
4966440.short_description: Link matching tiles via paths with up to two turns. Clear tiles to cast spells, build structures, and summon allies. Diverse spells and relics ensure fresh runs. Counter unique elite disruptors.

4966760.title: Review Responder
4966760.short_description: As a review responder for an e-commerce store, you face various customer complaints and must make critical decisions. Will you sincerely apologize, firmly refute, or skillfully defuse the situation? Every choice impacts your store's performance and determines the course of your career.

4966810.title: Mote
4966810.short_description: Mote is a hard sci-fi, squad-based, turn-based tactical roguelike played on a hexes. Create an species with unique abilities, senses, and combat styles. Command a squad as you explore distant systems, encounter new societies, and choose which factions to help, and which to betray.

4966820.title: Tactical Task Bar
4966820.short_description: A pixel-art idle squad shooter that lives above your Windows taskbar. Build guns from over 1,100 parts, gear up to three operators and send them into a fought-over city, where they fight, reload and haul back loot on their own while you work.

4966890.title: Zodiac Tale
4966890.short_description: Zodiac Tale is a roguelite deckbuilder auto-battler where you clear dungeon after dungeon across many worlds. Stronger enemies, a shop that pays interest, side quests: every dungeon adds new rules. Shape your shop to get the zodiac animals you want, and tailor explosive synergies to fit those rules.

4966920.title: Bureau of Hero Affairs
4966920.short_description: Bureau of Hero Affairs is a simulation game about processing paperwork in an obsolete office system and digging up what it buried. As a journalist working undercover inside the Bureau, uncover the truth of a disaster twenty years ago. Follow the regulations, or report the truth.

4966990.title: Arcane Abyss
4966990.short_description: A pixel-art, turn-based roguelite deckbuilder where your cards are swords, axes and spears, and you throw them. Thrown weapons stay on the board: hit one with another to trigger Resonance, a combo attack that chains to nearby weapons. Synthesis moves abilities between weapons.

4967050.title: DEGEN DROOLS
4967050.short_description: An autobattler where degenerate marshmallows fight automatically. Stick them with darts, roast them together, stack them on top of one another for more power, and gamble everything. THE ONLY THING TO BEWARE IS YOURSELF!

4967130.title: Wild Boar Digging
4967130.short_description: A small relaxing game where you control a wild boar collecting resources. Upgrade the attributes of you wild boar and find a diversity of interesting animal cards. You can even recruit bees to help you!

4967170.title: Vanslinger
4967170.short_description: Fast-paced FPS with bullet time, short replayable levels and intense action-packed combat

4967240.title: Floors of Fury
4967240.short_description: Floors of Fury is a fast-paced 2.5D beat ’em up roguelite. Fight through crowds, slam enemies into walls or each other, collect upgrades, shape your build, and punch your way from the bottom of the company to the top.

4967380.title: Same End
4967380.short_description: Discover Dienna, a young reaper tired of having to deal with troubled souls, who prefers to challenge them with trials where their lives are at stake. A platformer and Die and Retry runner game featuring multiple branching paths and alternative endings, hand-drawn in the style of a lightly animated.

4967630.title: Starfall Samurai
4967630.short_description: Starfall Samurai blends slash-based action with incremental progression. Drag the mouse to aim your slash, then release as asteroids cluster together. Clear the screen in one strike, collect carrots, hone your sword techniques, and venture ever deeper into space.

4967660.title: Ball-Aqua
4967660.short_description: A speedy physics ball platformer inspired by Sonic Adventure and Ballance. Spin Dash, grind rails, and roll through a sunny Frutiger Aero world, solo or in online co-op. Free demo available now.

4967670.title: Lean Into The Swarm
4967670.short_description: Direct a growing swarm of harvesters as it consumes procedurally generated worlds tile by tile. Upgrade your operation, steer the frontier, use Scorch, and carry permanent Salvage perks into each larger world.

4967680.title: Sudokucide
4967680.short_description: Experience a new, fast-paced game inspired by Sudoku combined with action reminiscent of late-nights spent in the arcades of the 90s. Sudokucide brings the traditional game into the 21st century with exciting new mechanics and pumps the action up to 11. Face the challenge or commit Sudokucide.

4967720.title: Ikigai - Party Game
4967720.short_description: Grab, shove and flail your way through a gauntlet of physics-driven party games. Up to 8 players, wobbly ragdoll limbs and a fresh minigame every round — sumo showdowns, chaotic football and frantic fishing, wrapped in Japanese folk charm.

4968700.title: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend
4968700.short_description: Build your player's basketball career in a single-player management sim. Manage training and recovery, develop skills, weigh contract offers and build relationships with your team. Earn a starting spot and follow simulated games in 2D with play-by-play and stats, or use quick simulation.
developers: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend
publishers: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend

4969120.title: Soul Shine
4969120.short_description: Prohibition ruined your brewery job. So you started a moonshine business. Expand and automate your empire by harvesting souls, trafficking organs, selling to addicts, and serving strange gods.

4969210.title: VOTUM
4969210.short_description: Votum is a turn-based roguelite inspired by Ancient Rome. In the ruins of Aeterna, champions chosen by the Sibyl face tactical battles and harsh choices as they venture into the temple to uncover the source of the Soul Affliction.

4969230.title: Aquaculture Simulator
4969230.short_description: Run your own fish farm in first person. Keep the water alive, raise trout, eels, sturgeon and koi, breed 25 koi varieties, and sell through customer orders, an online market, your farm shop and a show hall where you haggle face to face.

4969350.title: That Cozy Cat Game
4969350.short_description: A relaxing online co-op game where you and your friends explore a colorful island as customizable CATS. Go fishing, chat, find new discoveries, earn kibbles, and dress up your cat.

4969370.title: Shadows of Christmas Eve
4969370.short_description: Explore a house that gradually transforms as the nightmares become increasingly disturbing, while presences seem to watch you from the darkness. Discover the secrets hidden within its walls before it’s too late...

4969600.title: Pine Creek: Prologue
4969600.short_description: Your wife has vanished. Her pager signal leads you to an abandoned water plant on the outskirts of Pine Creek. You are not alone inside. Solve puzzles, hide from the Grays, and escape the facility in this stealth survival horror prologue set in rural Pennsylvania, 1986. Play the Pine Creek prologue.

4969750.title: Space Circle
4969750.short_description: Space Circle is a game that combines Circle TD and roguelike. Enemies have no final destination, and you must defeat them all within a limited time!

4969780.title: Sort The Lot
4969780.short_description: A cozy relaxing game about sorting 298 vehicles in an impound lot! Earn parking points, upgrade your abilities, unlock new areas, and park every vehicle!

4970000.title: Taskbar Chickens
4970000.short_description: A cozy desktop companion where chickens live on your taskbar. Breed your chickens to hatch a brand new one with its own unique look, and grow your collection while you work on other stuff on your PC! Plant crops, sell eggs and build a tiny farm that flourishes on top of your taskbar!

4970020.title: Nightbound
4970020.short_description: Two strangers share one house at the end of the world. Their only hope: trust each other, fix up a van, and reach a mountain too cold for the Bloom to follow. You fight as a pair with turn-based tactics. Live the days together, hold the house at night, and build a bond that outgrows the Bloom.

4970070.title: Break the Bank
4970070.short_description: Break the Bank is an incremental clicker game where you watch balls bounce through boards and break buildings for money. Upgrade, automate, unlock new zones, and defeat strange bosses.

4970180.title: HeroNet
4970180.short_description: Hire unique heroes, fight fearsome battles, and solve the inane problems of your clients in HeroNet!

4970310.title: Tides of Empires
4970310.short_description: Two empires, one sea. Tides of Empires is the tower defense roguelite game you can finally play competitively. Command warships, aircraft and submarines in ranked 1v1 & 2v2 duels, in a challenging campaign and endless Survival. Rule the tides.

4970340.title: Paint Me Back
4970340.short_description: A cozy narrative adventure set in a very particular museum, where the great masterpieces of art history have lost their colors and their protagonists. Help George restore the paintings, bring the missing characters back and discover what forced them to leave their paintings...

4970580.title: Gulf Strike
4970580.short_description: Gulf Strike is a top-down helicopter shooter from 1991. A rogue nation is threatening the oil industry in the middle east! Complete the 6 sandbox campaigns by destroying enemy units while searching for supplies. It's time for another strike in the desert!

4970660.title: Idle Mall Simulator
4970660.short_description: Build and expand your own shopping mall in this fun idle simulation game. Open new stores, increase your profits, keep customers happy, and turn your mall into a thriving business empire!

4970800.title: Pull the Lever
4970800.short_description: Pull the lever, send a tiny train hauling cargo. Click storms and breakdowns mid-run to protect the take. Chase jackpots, hire staff to automate the dull runs, and grow a living model railroad. You won't know the payout until it arrives.

4970830.title: Villion:Code
4970830.short_description: Cozy Okada presents a brand-new action RPG set in the near future where humanity teeters on the brink of extinction. Genome editing has ushered in a new age—but is there any hope for the future?

4970850.title: COMETROX!
4970850.short_description: Nobody told the keyboard it wasn't a guitar.

4970960.title: Make the Bus
4970960.short_description: Catch the bus or die trying! Dash, dodge, and survive a chaotic suburban neighborhood in this action roguelike about the world's worst morning commute. Buy upgrades, perfect your route, and reach the bus before time runs out.

4971110.title: Annihilation Plus Plus
4971110.short_description: Build factories, harvest metal and energy, shape formations, and command mechanized armies across layered battlefields. Annihilation Plus Plus is a physics-first real-time strategy game for solo skirmishes and private online battles.

4971230.title: Viral Dependency
4971230.short_description: Turn a rookie VTuber into a streaming star! Click and idle to build hype, upgrade her setup, and choose what Vivi talks about. As chat fills with messages and gifts, each stream wears her down. Off camera, she shows another side. Your choices shape who she becomes—and how her story ends.

4971460.title: Radia Island
4971460.short_description: Radia Island is a civilization-building survival game. Lead your people to a new land, establish your first town, gather resources, research technologies, advance into the industrial age, and ultimately complete the space program.

4971700.title: Deadroll
4971700.short_description: Roll dice to build poker hands, stack powerful combos, and beat crooked dealers in a dark casino roguelike.

4971740.title: Graveline
4971740.short_description: A first-person survival horror operation sim. Drive a steam locomotive through one night. Feed the boiler, read signals, and hold the deadman's lever while something advances car by car. Kill the light to hide and lose your gauges. Make noise to survive and it hears you. One life.

4971780.title: IMMRAMA: Voyages of the Otherworlds
4971780.short_description: A story-driven RPG you play with text or voice. No jargon, use your own words and the game understands. A hand-written world of myth responds. Real dice, factions, and consequences underneath; a complete, cinematic voyage you can actually finish. Every word human-authored. AI only does the telling.

4971880.title: The Regular: Same Dog Every Time
4971880.short_description: Run a cozy hot dog cart, serve charming customers, restock your stand, and end each shift a little better than the last in a relaxing food-making game with a strange little secret simmering under the surface.

4971920.title: MODice
4971920.short_description: MODice is a dice-building roguelike. Roll five dice, then rearrange them for higher scores! Socket gems and combine sets to turn scores into board movement. Choose your landing spot, build and upgrade, and shape a stronger build to overcome changing Boss rules before your rolls run out.

4971940.title: Spook'd
4971940.short_description: Deep dive into Spook'd, a social deduction party game. Blend into a crowd of ghost NPCs to survive, or hunt down the players hiding among them. Cooperate or betray your friends, and share the laughs!

4971950.title: Nightfreight
4971950.short_description: A single-player body-horror roguelite auto-battler. Draft vat-grown mutants, pay for power in flesh, arrange your squad on a train-car grid, then hit DEPART. Fights resolve automatically. Most upgrades corrupt their host; a unit pushed too far mutates, seizes up, or turns on its own squad.

4972310.title: パラパラパズル
4972310.short_description: Your animations got scattered — piece them back together! The adorable pixel-art animations by asaha, a creator active mainly on Twitter and YouTube, have been scattered by someone's mischief!? Rearrange the frames and bring their cute movements back to life in this fresh animation puzzle game.

4972480.title: Home Is Where I Left You
4972480.short_description: A cosy hand drawn atmospheric puzzle game with a gentle mystery to uncover. Organise, decorate and collect letters in a beautifully mysterious house, floating in the night with over 30 puzzles. Go at your own pace, choose your perfect ambience and relax with a dreamy yet melancholic lofi soundtrack.

4972620.title: Xydorth
4972620.short_description: In search of your wife, you must descend into the darkness of a vast cave system. But with every step deeper, your descent becomes a journey into your own personal hell. Xydorth is a dark first-person shooter with survival horror elements.
