5049770.short_description: Mythbound is a competitive multiplayer PvP arena-brawler in a modern Norse world. Thrust into the arenas of Himinbjorg, Midgard, and Helheim, the bound use a combination of parkour, brutal melee combat, and godly abilities to brawl against one another.

5049870.title: Gudu! Witch & Meltdown
5049870.short_description: Brew, toss, and trigger explosive chain reactions! Gudu! Witch & Meltdown is a chaotic anime-style roguelite where you play as a quirky witch crafting volatile potions. Combine recipe ingredients, build exponential multiplier synergies, and hurl nuclear-level flasks to melt monster HP!

5049920.title: Guns & Gargoyles
5049920.short_description: Eight children are missing in the Black Forest. A disgraced monster hunter walks in after them, carrying a torch, a family name and a grudge. A grimdark open world RPG where the folklore was true, and it has been waiting for company.

5050200.title: Gold Seller
5050200.short_description: All you have is a game account. Farm gold, sell it for cash in a shady group chat, and keep up with rent, a PC installment and an AI subscription. Get paid first, or send the gold first? One bad call and a day of grinding is gone.

5050610.title: The Count is Down for Blood
5050610.short_description: The Count is Down for Blood is a gothic grid-based puzzle game where every move brings sunrise closer. Plan each step, drink blood, use vampire powers, and reach your coffin before the night runs out.

5050660.title: The House on Grisewood
5050660.short_description: A top-down survival horror shooter set in a haunted manor. Explore room by room with a failing flashlight, scavenge ammunition and batteries, and fight or evade what stalks the dark. Reach the ballroom and end what laughs there, or hold out in an endless Zombie Survival modes.

5050970.title: Dwarf Wars
5050970.short_description: Build armies of witless dwarves and watch them fight their way to victory or fall to their doom in this physics driven, 2D battle simulator!

5051250.title: Sneak & Snitch
5051250.short_description: Sneak & Snitch is a multiplayer social deduction heist. Thieves disguised as museum visitors forge paintings and swap them right under the guard's nose. The guard patrols on a Segway, spotting fakes and suspicious moves. Blend in, bluff your friends, and pull off the perfect art heist.

5051580.title: Super Teacher
5051580.short_description: A teacher simulation game set in a modern high school. Become the temporary homeroom teacher of Class 3, teach lessons, handle school affairs, and connect with students, parents, and colleagues. What does it truly mean to be a good teacher?

5051710.title: Dead Bet
5051710.short_description: Dead Bet is a card-based roguelite set in a deadly show. Study fighters, uncover their secrets, and use cards to influence their chances. A wrong prediction can cost a family member their life. You decide who pays.

5051980.title: Roll Arena
5051980.short_description: A brutally hard action-roguelike where physics has it in for you: roll, shoot, bounce and brawl through themed arenas with 250+ items as absurd as they are lethal.

5052000.title: Good Night
5052000.short_description: A good night's sleep is for one person only. Roll, squirm, and shove your friends off the bed in this 2-4 player ragdoll party game.

5052200.title: Never Stop Climbing
5052200.short_description: Fulfill the biological imperative of a hamster with your friends in up to 8 player co-op. Parkour and climb through multiple uniquely themed and nostalgic levels inspired by classic platforming games. Ascend into space but watch your step! One wrong move and you'll plummet down to Earth!

5052220.title: LIMINAL ROOMS
5052220.short_description: LIMINAL ROOMS is a linear, Backrooms style Co-op puzzle platformer with fun challenges and difficult platforming. Play different levels from the Backrooms or experience new original levels for a fun twist. Help your friends escape with you, or make it as hard as possible for you all.

5052230.title: BrickOps
5052230.short_description: Build your own arena, fight your friends or face waves of zombies together. BrickOps combines multiplayer combat, map building and character customization, with Zombie Survival for solo players or squads of up to four.

5052400.title: FoxWQ
5052400.short_description: Play Go against real opponents of every level, 24/7, on FoxWQ, the world’s largest Go server. Find ranked games in seconds, watch top professionals live, review your games with FineArt AI, train with over 13,000 graded problems, and much more.
publishers: Beijing YeHu Century Technology Co., Ltd.

5052630.title: Kazfall
5052630.short_description: Kazfall is a single-player roguelite dungeon crawler built on 25-minute runs. Fight with stamina and timed blocks, discover NPCs who sell upgrades and gear, and reach the boss before time runs out. Even failed runs make you stronger for the next descent.

5052710.title: lucky me
5052710.short_description: A live-action interactive romance. Lin Yu joins a travel dating show as its only male contestant after failing his exams. Meet four women in first person, shape relationships through dates and choices, and discover multiple endings. Is the love on camera real?

5052850.title: Fast Food Together
5052850.short_description: Start your culinary adventure in Winston Springs! Begin with a food truck and work your way up to opening your very own restaurant, either solo or in co-op! Take care of your customers, create your own recipes, set your prices and menu. Earn money and invest in growing your business.

5053190.title: Warpscape
5053190.short_description: An open-world space MMORPG with no-target combat. You fly the ship and aim yourself, travel between sectors, take on bosses and dungeons with friends, fight in the arena and build your clan's base.

5053220.title: Laylines
5053220.short_description: Six challengers, one defender, the oldest trophy in sailing. Lead your syndicate from headquarters to the race course: crew, shipyard, sponsors, weather — and match race duels decided on the water, under real racing rules. History isn't bought: it's conquered.

5053270.title: Mithril
5053270.short_description: Explore and mine in procedural caves. Master using struts to delve deeper and support the ceiling before it falls. Build automation chains to process ores. Then manipulate lava and trigger Dormancy to crystallise new ore where lava once flowed. Same world. New cave. New dangers. The world remembers.

5053310.title: Speed RPG
5053310.short_description: Play one card, discard one — both sides commit in secret, then everything resolves at once. Read your opponent on a 13x8 grid, build twin Move and Action decks, and climb the 100-Man Kumite, where turn timers shrink to 6 seconds. Short matches, fast decisions, one more run. Solo-dev alpha, JP/EN.

5053460.title: The Previous Owner
5053460.short_description: Run a secondhand bookshop in London, 1994. Every book remembers who owned it before — pressed flowers, letters, notes in the margins. Across books that should never have met, the same hand keeps writing. You inherited the rules with the shop: shelve carefully, and do not read the margins.

5053540.title: VIOLENCE DOLL バイオレンスドール
5053540.short_description: Become V.D, a cybernetic investigator pursuing a global conspiracy in this sci-fi action RPG. Hack enemies at close range to freeze them, then unleash devastating combos. Explore 2.5D stages and engage in real-time 3D battles.

5053550.title: CCR - Cosmic Card Realm
5053550.short_description: CCR is a free-to-play online collection game where every draw brings a new discovery. Complete card sets, forge them into unique Relics, and build a museum that grows with you. With no battles or competitive pressure, you can relax, draw a few cards each day, and enjoy collecting for years.

5053580.title: Barista Dream - Prologue
5053580.short_description: Open your own cozy cafe for free. Brew every drink by hand, pour your own latte art, and read what customers post about you on an in-game social network.

5053590.title: It's Just a Rescue, Bro! — Idle Hell RPG
5053590.short_description: An idle ARPG for loot goblins. Slaughter monsters automatically, hunt build-changing gear, craft ridiculous builds, unlock new classes, then rebirth and do it all again—stronger.

5053670.title: Electric Noosphere
5053670.short_description: A story-driven sci-fi RTS. After the Third World War, flesh and machine became one: the Singularians. Following a signal from the Veil, their fleet is torn out of hyperspace and crashes near the source, a world that is already a nest. Two asymmetric factions, one campaign.

5053890.title: Axolotong
5053890.short_description: Now that's a funny little axolotl! Make your way through this puzzle platformer by pushing and pulling with your tongue, and discover new ways to interact to uncover all the secrets hidden in this maze.

5053900.title: Pawntopia
5053900.short_description: Fight alongside your troops in a roguelike autobattler where your actions and preparation decide every battle. Build your city, equip and command a customizable army, counter diverse enemy factions, and combine talents, relics, and gear to create powerful strategies.

5054100.title: The Sirius Device
5054100.short_description: Your battleship is the last line of defense against a mysterious fleet attacking the solar system. Powered by the mysterious Sirius Device, you will gain levels in your own custom class, craft and equip new ship modules, and fight against numerous enemies in this new Action RPG- Space Sim hybrid.

5054170.title: Derby Dynasty : Horse Racing RPG
5054170.short_description: Start with a foal, build a dynasty. Breed your horses, refine their bloodlines, and take the reins yourself or trust your jockeys. In Derby Dynasty, every victory is part of a story that spans generations.

5054210.title: The Adventurer's Guild Idler
5054210.short_description: Manage your adventurer's guild and send your party to the frontlines against demon foot soldiers and powerful commanders. Watch your tank, warrior, mage and ranger battle monsters, collect loot, train, grow stronger and set out again.

5054300.title: LastWitness: Mero
5054300.short_description: Guide Mero through a dark 2.5D action-adventure, battling twisted memories, solving portal-based puzzles, and uncovering the truth behind a forgotten childhood.

5054480.title: The Last Lunch
5054480.short_description: A psychological cooking horror game set in a post-Soviet school. Cook meals, explore the school and its surroundings, and uncover the disturbing story hidden behind an ordinary cafeteria shift.

5054600.title: Monster League Baseball
5054600.short_description: In Monster League Baseball, manage a team of creatures and critters by optimizing your layout, upgrading stats, and slugging out to score as many runs as possible. Monster League Baseball puts YOU in control of your own team of nine.

5054850.title: Clicker Inc. - Generational Succession
5054850.short_description: Build a business empire across generations! Click to earn, hire employees for passive income, and use stocks, banks, and auctions to survive booms and crashes. Pass the company to the next CEO, unlock 100+ skills, complete achievements, and grow into a world-changing corporation!

5054900.title: Dominion Arena
5054900.short_description: A sci-fi roguelite auto battler where you recruit a squad of cyber-enhanced fighters, combine skills and items, adapt your build between rounds, and face other players' lineups in asynchronous tournaments to climb the rankings.

5055070.title: RUGS!
5055070.short_description: Grandpa left you his rug-cleaning shop. Grab up to three friends, haul filthy rugs across town in a beat-up pickup, then scrub, rinse, beat and dry them and get them back before the deadline. Slippery floors, flying carpets, police chases. Save up for a ticket to Mars.

5055250.title: Midnight Haunting
5055250.short_description: The road home is never safe. Midnight Haunting is a 2D survival action game that demands the deliberate controls of a classic cinematic platformer. Survive a haunting, twisted midnight street riddled with deadly traps to reach the safety of your front door. Your next step could always be your last.

5055310.title: A Heart-Stirring Date by Victoria Harbour: New Year's Eve at the Turn of the Millennium
5055310.short_description: 这是一款互动恋爱 + 港片商战悬疑影游。在千禧前的香港，你将扮演李洋，在失恋、追杀与资本争夺中寻找真相，你得先活下来，改变处境，也需要找到愿意与你站在一起的人。最后结局会是怎样的，我想把这个决定留给你。

5055820.title: SCP Loop
5055820.short_description: You are an SCP Foundation employee in Site-19. One day, you find yourself going through corridor, only to later realize, that the rooms you are walking through are repeating themselves. Explore SCP-970 and find its anomalies, in order to escape.

5056120.title: Holy Relic Shop Simulator
5056120.short_description: A medieval shopkeeping sim about appraising holy relics. Examine bone, metal, wood and documents in your pilgrim city, find the detail that doesn't fit, pass your verdict — then decide what to do with the truth. A mother begs for a miracle you know is fake. What do you sell?

5056200.title: Nine Below
5056200.short_description: A twin-stick arena shooter set in an arctic wasteland. Fight through a cult swarm, break the guardians, and kill the leader before the ritual completes. One continuous battle. No second chances.

5056230.title: AFTERMATH: Bunker Trader
5056230.short_description: A simulation game where your bunker becomes the safe space survivors need. Trade and craft items - organize them in storage. Scavenge the surface yourself and hire personnel to send on expeditions. Become the ultimate trading hub in this post-apocalyptic world.

5056270.title: Normal Human Jobs
5056270.short_description: A first-person incremental shooter about eight regular office jobs disguised as an evil robot experiment. Sweep, sort, shoot and buy upgrades until the job runs itself. Finish all eight and the CEO chair is yours.

5056300.title: Souls for Relics
5056300.short_description: An incremental roguelite auto-battler where you choose random relics, create powerful synergies, earn souls, and unlock new possibilities between runs.

5056570.title: A Week to Remember
5056570.short_description: Help Elliot recover his memories and unlock the truth of what happened before it's too late. A Mexican-American gothic, queer visual novel, featuring interactive spell crafting and point-and-click exploration.

5056630.title: Last Ditch Effort
5056630.short_description: Enter a grimdark world consumed by endless war and join Igor on a desperate mission in Last-Ditch Effort, a pixel-art character-action game featuring fast-paced combat, handcrafted animation and stylized comic-book storytelling.

5056670.title: Give It Up for The Last Time!
5056670.short_description: Go through rapid-fire seconds long microgames to uncover the mystery of Radio Valley in this visual novel take on the microgame genre!

5056770.title: Stream Snipers
5056770.short_description: Stream Snipers is a multiplayer battle game about doing ANYTHING for content! Fight your friends for followers, grow your totally real audience, get rich taking on ridiculous challenges from chat, and strive to stay alive in the deadliest live competition.

5056850.title: Woodbound
5056850.short_description: A first-person survival horror game where a desperate search through a cursed forest leads to terrifying creatures, hidden secrets, and a truth better left buried.

5056900.title: KISI: The Deja Vu
5056900.short_description: 〈KISI: The Deja Vu〉 is a 3D anomaly-detection psychological horror adventure game based on the eerie sense of familiarity felt in a sanity-bending experimental facility—the phenomenon known as "Déjà Vu."

5056950.title: mythorune
5056950.short_description: An endless co-op action-RPG dungeon crawl. Descend floors that never scale to you, slot runes that rewrite your skills into new weapons, mine the walls, and loot relics of world myth. Play couch, LAN and online in one six-hero party, or host your own server. No microtransactions.

5057070.title: Sound of Space
5057070.short_description: A first-person music producer sim trillions of miles from home. Create music with TRAX Audio Engine: no theory, just tweak the dials until it sounds right. Press tracks to cassette, find aliens that like your music, solo or with friends. Beware the black hole in the sky: it's only a matter of time.

5057110.title: FORGIVE THIS VESSEL and All Harm It May Cause
5057110.short_description: Bodies appear and disappear in a small town. A robot writhes under stolen flesh. A woman bears witness to her own apathy. FORGIVE THIS VESSEL and All Harm It May Cause is a supernatural visual novel about connections in a small town.

5057140.title: Wordgeon
5057140.short_description: 《Wordgeon》is a Balatro‑like deckbuilder where you fight using spelling and vocabulary. It turns the grind of learning vocabulary into a fun, strategic roguelike dungeon game.

5057160.title: Void Inspector
5057160.short_description: Void Inspector is a hands-on deep-space customs simulator. Operate heavy machinery, sweep vessels with tactical scanners, cross-reference paperwork, and deliver your verdict. Just remember: every switch you flip is billed to your account.

5057250.title: Diss Diss Discussion
5057250.short_description: When student council president Sakurai fights to make uniforms optional, Hiyama pushes back against her (because Sakurai-senpai looks too good in them!) with nonsensical wit. Hasumi can barely look at what her crush gets himself into... A visual novel about the dumb things we say to get things done.

5057360.title: Across the Dark
5057360.short_description: A perilous quest to the Demon Lord's castle, where one mistake means death. Conquer foes using 4 heroes—Bloodslayer, IronGuard, GrandMage, SwiftHealer—and 8-slot card synergies. No fast reflexes required. Only your meticulous deck building and health management will save you.

5057390.title: Project Potato Man - Chapter 1
5057390.short_description: Survive the first chapter of a psychological horror adventure. Explore an abandoned town, uncover its dark secrets, and evade the mysterious Potato Man before it finds you.

5057540.title: Overrafted!
5057540.short_description: Over rafted! is a co-op multiplayer game for up to four players. Divide the work as you steer, fish, gather supplies, and make repairs. Brave the chaos of shifting winds, currents, and sea creatures, and sail your crumbling raft as far as you can across an endless, unknown ocean!

5057580.title: Idle Caravan
5057580.short_description: A cozy idle adventure you can play in a small desktop window. Ride your giant bison across a magical world, deliver packages, discover creatures, and let your journey continue while you do other things.

5057780.title: D4 Defence
5057780.short_description: Dice-rolling Tower Defence incremental. Modify your dice and upgrade your powers to defeat a demon onslaught.

5057820.title: Colosseum Infection
5057820.short_description: "Build your unique strategy stress-free, with zero time pressure! Combine synergies, augments, and items to form an unstoppable army. Step into immersive unit-view combat, taking direct control with manual movement and tactical potion throws to reverse the odds in this strategic auto-battler."

5057860.title: Dawnstead
5057860.short_description: Lead survivors to build a new home in an unknown wilderness. Develop your settlement, defend against threats, and explore the world alongside a lord who truly lives among your people. Let your lord act independently, or take direct control and write your own frontier legend.

5058080.title: Democracy Simulator
5058080.short_description: Lead one of several political parties through fully simulated elections, where your decisions and policies affect the outcome! The economy is also simulated and will affect elections! Form a coalition government, write laws, pass a budget, respond to events, and more! Made without AI.

5058430.title: Theoria: A God Simulator
5058430.short_description: A Godsimulator without limits. Throw buildings with your bare hand, burn nations down with meteors, or possess a peasant and walk through the war you started.

5058560.title: Pixel Ping Pong
5058560.short_description: A relaxing idle incremental game where you break tiles, earn coins, and upgrade your growing swarm of balls. Aim your shots to speed up your progress, or sit back and let the game play itself.

5058570.title: Matchday: Player Career
5058570.short_description: Live a footballer's career on and off the pitch. Earn your place, take charge of key moments in matches, build relationships at the club, and see your performances and choices shape the seasons ahead.

5058790.title: Circuit Brakers
5058790.short_description: Circuit Brakers is a kart racing game about robots, physics and a lot of customisation. Build a robot, choose your items, and race with up to 8 players across a variety of bizarre tracks! With mechanics that are easy to learn but hard to master, can you become the champion robot racer?

5059020.title: Towerburst
5059020.short_description: An incremental tower defense game where you fight enemies using unique tower combinations. Gather resources from fallen enemies, unlock and upgrade your towers, discover new tower synergies and defeat every enemy before your towers run out of shots.

5059130.title: Rewind Together
5059130.short_description: Join your brother on an epic time-travel adventure! Solve puzzles together across Ancient Egypt, the Middle Ages, and the Wild West to find your way back home. Don't forget to take photos!

5059190.title: Dungeon Town Life
5059190.short_description: Your Adventure, Your Dungeon, Your Home! A cozy 3D anime dungeon crawler with village life. Fight through dungeons by day, then return to forge weapons, grow healing herbs, brew potions and decorate your home. Play solo or with friends.

5059380.title: SubQuest
5059380.short_description: SubQuest is a productivity game that grows with you, right on your desktop. Cute characters, endless adventures, and a diorama where your heroes rest between quests — decorate it however you like! Notes, to-dos, Time-Quests — get your work done side by side with your hero party!

5059950.title: VORA
5059950.short_description: Seeking shelter from the bitter cold after a car accident, you take refuge in an old cave. What seemed like salvation quickly turns into a nightmare.

5060170.title: Grape by Grape
5060170.short_description: A cozy vineyard idler where your cursor makes vines grow. Turn 14 grape varieties into aged wine, raisins, vinegar and pekmez; automate six connected estate stations and fill customer orders. No frantic clicking, no failure—just one more harvest, bottle and upgrade.

5060180.title: Doodle Figure
5060180.short_description: Doodle Figure is a VR party game for one headset and a room full of phones.

5060320.title: Dead Link
5060320.short_description: An aging encrypted terminal. A past deliberately erased. Follow the guidance, solve puzzles one by one, and close in on a buried truth. Who used this computer before you? What happened to them? And now, it is your turn.

5060410.title: What Iron Cannot Hold
5060410.short_description: Something impossible is clawing its way through an industrial containment machine. In this 360° ricochet roguelite, weaponize every rebound and build a run powerful enough to force Khaos back into the dark.

5060480.title: Laurus
5060480.short_description: Rig the machine until it pays out wrong. Draw symbols from your bag across five reels, chain paylines, and slot circuit-board artifacts into combos the house never accounted for. A roguelike deckbuilder about the arithmetic of very bad odds.

5060490.title: Jin Ping Mei: Qinghe Reverie
5060490.short_description: In Qinghe County during the Northern Song, manage businesses and household affairs, build relationships, gather rumors and evidence, and set schemes in motion. As Ximen Qing, balance time, wealth, reputation and favors while your choices reshape lives, fortunes and endings.

5060530.title: Ribbit Robber
5060530.short_description: A challenging stealth game where every move matters. Sneak, trick, and outsmart enemy guards using creative abilities in a medieval world of frog people.

5060620.title: Fire and Dark Stars
5060620.short_description: "Fire and Dark Stars" is a real-time 4X strategy game. You can grow your base, build your fleet, search for enemies, and destroy them. You need to carefully manage your resources, set up and protect your supply lines, so that your fleet does not run out of ammo and fuel.

5060660.title: The 8 O'clock Block
5060660.short_description: A retro-inspired puzzle game featuring 11 unique game modes. Stack, match, chain, battle bosses, discover powerful items, and chase endless high scores across a variety of fast-paced block puzzle challenges.

5060750.title: ISKRA
5060750.short_description: You take on the role of Alice, who wanders through a dark forest in search of a way out. On her journey she meets many figures — each one a reflection of her own personality, an echo of her fears, and a manifestation of her subconscious.

5060820.title: Cuervito Fumanchu: Pitiados
5060820.short_description: A chaotic 4-player arena run & gun brawler based on El Cuervito Fumanchú, Ecuador's iconic comic strip. Grab a weapon, pick your fighter, and brawl it out — local or online via Steam Remote Play Together.

5060870.title: Starcrest
5060870.short_description: Build, pilot, and crew custom physics-driven spacecraft in a persistent online universe. Explore distant worlds, mine and trade for resources, and band together in factions to fight for territorial control. Carve out your empire in an ever evolving infinite online galaxy.

5060930.title: Moltenfall
5060930.short_description: Moltenfall is a fast-paced survival roguelite set in a world where every pixel is simulated. Fight increasingly dangerous swarms of enemies, collect experience and grow stronger with every upgrade. Watch your step as collapsing terrain, acid, lava and other materials reshape the world around you.

5061210.title: The Pale Banner
5061210.short_description: Your Father, The king of all of Aldrain, was slain and his crown broken into five pieces by his betrayers when you were only a small child. After many years of training, you set out with your band of followers, The New Order of Light, to take back your throne.

5061290.title: Roll for Order: Sort Every Set!
5061290.short_description: A cozy first-person sorting game set in a cluttered 1980s basement. Find thousands of scattered dice, identify their sets and return each one to the correct display. Play solo or in co-op, choose a fantasy class and unlock magical powers that make sorting easier.

5061390.title: Jackshot
5061390.short_description: JACKSHOT is a 2-4 player FFA online first-person shooter featuring fast-paced arcade combat, weapon pickups, and a slot machine-inspired upgrade system. Build your character between rounds and use powerful bonuses to gain the upper hand. Just don't get cursed!

5061700.title: Chill Boats: Sailing & Boat Simulator
5061700.short_description: A physics-based boat game, from sailboats to powerboats. Take the helm of foilers, catamarans or RIBs on a sea that really decides your speed. Race against opponents, or just sail wherever you want.

5061840.title: Trade or Threat
5061840.short_description: Trade or Threat is a first-person shopkeeping and dungeon-crawling simulation where you sell goods by day and search for valuable loot after dark. Earn enough gold to repay your debt to the boss while balancing profit, danger, and the rules imposed on your shop.

5061860.title: Casino Dealer Simulator
5061860.short_description: You're not the gambler — you're the dealer. Run the casino's blackjack and Texas Hold'em tables: deal by hand, count the payouts, read the hands, and catch cheats before the pit boss catches your mistakes. Real-time shifts, a career from Trainee to Pit Boss, and a VIP room if you earn it.

5061870.title: Last Man Running
5061870.short_description: Outrun the zombies. Betray your friends. A chaotic parkour party game across deadly rooftops. Tackle, grab and toss your rivals in free-for-all or team elimination, or stick together in co-op survival. Play locally or online, with solo score chasing when your friends stop answering your invites.

5062110.title: Ballwark: Pinball Siege
5062110.short_description: Pinball meets Vampire Survivors in this dopamine-packed arcade roguelite! Launch enchanted balls, build deadly machines, and forge powerful synergies to crush relentless hordes.

5062120.title: Formula First Manager
5062120.short_description: Take on the role of a Team Principal and build your career in a living paddock. Recruit, develop your car, negotiate, manage your team and face the consequences of your decisions across multiple seasons.

5062150.title: Cosmic Crusaders Online
5062150.short_description: Land on a planet with nothing and learn to survive, from 0 to space travel. Mine it, build a base, weld a ship, fly it to the next world. A multiplayer survival sandbox where every bullet and armor plate is player-made, factions war over the system, and the world runs while you're gone.

5062370.title: Never Wood Enough
5062370.short_description: You've been hired to chop trees, and Bob the beaver has plenty of requests and very little patience. Chop trees, gather wood, and fulfill his orders before time runs out. The tasks start simple, but soon Bob will be asking for increasingly absurd things. Don't disappoint him!

5062420.title: Iris's Idle Log
5062420.short_description: An idle RPG for the corner of your screen. Follow Iris's long adventure, battle for equipment and resources, and grow Life Skills like Mining, Logging, Fishing, Cooking, Farming, Writing, Painting, and Commerce. Play or step away—Iris's day goes on.

5062430.title: Starwake
5062430.short_description: Command a starship through a dangerous, procedurally generated galaxy in this fast-paced roguelike where every pinball shot can mean the difference between victory and destruction.

5062630.title: Roll Value
5062630.short_description: A kingdom faces ruin as a dragon ravages it. Guided by Mon, an AI game master, lead three adventurers and decide whom to protect. Choices and dice branch the story, and your way of choosing is revealed across five principles. A tabletop-style narrative RPG played out to live viewer comments.

5062700.title: Lilith's Curse
5062700.short_description: Welcome to Lilith's Curse. In this game, you're trapped in an asylum: your goal is to find items, solve puzzles, and escape. Watch out for the enemy: Lilith. Lilith will do everything she can to stop you. If she succeeds, there will be very serious consequences.

5062710.title: Dustium
5062710.short_description: Dustium is a turn-based tactics roguelite where you analyze enemy actions and plan multiple moves for three characters in advance. You may know what the enemy will do, but predicting the outcome is up to you.

5062780.title: Hero Investor: Business Tycoon
5062780.short_description: Build an investment firm, trade fictional markets, acquire income-producing property, and create your own ETFs as you grow from a small office into a financial empire in this player-paced management simulation.

5062790.title: Dungeon Descent
5062790.short_description: Dungeon Descent is an incremental dungeon crawler where you fight enemies, acquire loot, and descend into increasingly more difficult floors of the dungeon.

5062870.title: OrbSiege
5062870.short_description: OrbFlow is a relaxing yet challenging 3D physics puzzle game. Launch streams of marbles down vibrant Low-Poly valleys, guide them through obstacles using physics devices, and fill the target pit using as FEW balls as possible. Compete on global leaderboards for ultimate efficiency!

5063170.title: Deadwood Contingency
5063170.short_description: Command a covert military unit tasked with containing and researching a mysterious threat lurking deep within the forest. Face unnatural creatures, uncover the source of the outbreak, and prevent the calamity from spreading to the world.

5063190.title: TOWERPUNK
5063190.short_description: Build and manage a cyberpunk megatower. You are the tower's machine-mind, stacking thousands of residents into one dynamic system. Balance resources, transit, and production chains across five social strata. Define your corporate identity and decide what kind of intelligence rules from the top.

5063370.title: I Launch
5063370.short_description: This is a game that lets you relive the experience of what it was like before you were born, alongside your goofy friends.

5063650.title: ClusterForce
5063650.short_description: ClusterForce is a fast arcade 3D flying sports game for up to 8 players online, a unique combination that demands many of your skills at once. Carry energy balls from magnetic ramps to the goal without getting caught by your rivals and their glider weapons!

5063930.title: Ad Aquilonem - 100 Days with Seto -
5063930.short_description: A character-raising simulation game where you spend 100 days with Seto, a young beastfolk found collapsed near your home. Train, rest, and bond with him as you prepare for the decisive battle that awaits in 100 days.

5063980.title: Banshee Protocol
5063980.short_description: Simulator of a spacecraft missile defense operator. Keep an eye on the radar, adjust and launch missiles, repelling continuous attacks until the warp jump is completed. Break through the guarded sectors and find out the source of the mysterious signal.

5064330.title: Keyb Out
5064330.short_description: Keyb Out is a roguelite wave defense game about defending your PC from viruses and hackers by using your keyboard as a weapon.

5064350.title: Schedule: Rehab Business
5064350.short_description: Play in co-op at the worst rehab center in town. Manage patients, deal with disasters, and try to help everyone recover without losing control.

5064470.title: SoulForged:Ashborn
5064470.short_description: Seoul has fallen to the ARCHALIS. One year later, android girl ASH rises from the ashes. An anime-style hack-and-slash action RPG across Seoul's landmarks — five weapons, parry-driven soulslike boss duels, research-based levelless growth, and a 30-day countdown to reclaim the city.

5065150.title: LILITH
5065150.short_description: Every head is a world. LILITH is a folk-art puzzle-platformer set inside nesting dolls: climb into heads, hang characters on your tree to wear their skills, and descend through an İstanbul of graveyards, malls and rooftops, until you find the man in the shower.

5065230.title: Hardware Pirates
5065230.short_description: Your PC was a pirate ship all along. Turn monitors into Digital Sails, RAM into ramming power and USB ports into gunports. Explore the Corrupted Caribbean, upgrade your ship and master ballistic naval combat. Sail solo or join friends in online co-op and PvP.

5065580.title: Burn It Back
5065580.short_description: A survival RTS in a frozen taiga. Settle the surface for the bunker below, meet its quotas, and every night burn back a living tissue that grows, adapts and remembers.

5065610.title: Echoes of Eternity 2
5065610.short_description: A difficult isometric bullet-hell continuing the story of Ott, a bot with a recycled consciousness.

5065840.title: Cosmic Karma
5065840.short_description: Cosmic Karma is a cosmic roguelike card battler. Chain playing-card combos to build Flow, adapt to Karmic Laws, and risk tougher battles for XP to shape powerful Tarot and Combat Special builds.

5066090.title: Piece and Quiet: A Stained Glass Restoration
5066090.short_description: A cozy first-person game about restoring stained glass. Relax and enjoy cleaning up dusty shards, as you match their shapes and colors, and rebuild six beautiful windows in a ruined mountain chapel. Unlock magical upgrades and take as long as you want, with no deadlines and no way to lose.

5066240.title: NO FISHING!
5066240.short_description: An incremental autobattler about fishing where you're not allowed to fish. Sell your catch, upgrade your boat, and destroy the navy before they take you down.

5066290.title: CyberCon: Cybersecurity Tycoon
5066290.short_description: Build a cybersecurity firm in 1990. Recruit specialists, build an office, bid on tenders, and develop your own security products from floppy disks to AI through five eras of tech history up to 2039. Keep your staff happy and your record clean. Or don't.

5066430.title: Sun Smith
5066430.short_description: Help an ancient derelict repair itself. Harvest power, mine ore, fabricate components, clone colonists, and research technologies.

5066440.title: The Moth and the Moon
5066440.short_description: The Moth and the Moon is a rhythm platformer where each precise jump advances Clair de Lune. Guide a tiny moth across a forest lake, combining platforming skill with musical timing to complete the performance. You may even make new a friend along the way...

5066570.title: Castle-O
5066570.short_description: Navigate the castle gardens, find the fastest route and compete for the best time.

5066610.title: Villages on Wheels
5066610.short_description: You're a moving village, fighting against the monster horde! Villages on Wheels is a strategic horde survival. Combine buildings, blessings and orbs to create the ultimate survival machine! How long can you survive?

5066700.title: Dungeon of Hope
5066700.short_description: Explore ancient dungeons, solve handcrafted puzzles, and escape relentless creatures in a third-person atmospheric adventure where combat is never the answer.

5066760.title: Nordic Sprint
5066760.short_description: A classic-style cross-country skiing game where technique, stamina and drafting decide the race. Climb the World Cup with 20 abilities, race sprint, biathlon and relay in changing weather and wind – solo or in online multiplayer with up to 12 players.

5066840.title: Hack You
5066840.short_description: Desktop hacking and social engineering in a moral thriller. Write viruses, hide them in game builds, crack other people's PCs — to get to the former friend who stole your life and built a new success on its ruins.

5066970.title: ARANEA, BREACH!
5066970.short_description: Control a heavy armored vehicle equipped with the ARANEA Spider-Bionic Module. Use the mechanical climbing system to overcome spatial limitations, dismantle obstacles, collect resources, and install functional modules to adapt your vehicle to ever-changing exploration environments.

5066980.title: Deep Trouble
5066980.short_description: Dive into Deep Trouble with a crew of up to 6 and your mostly trusty submarine, slipping past massive leviathans into the mysterious depths. Pilot, swim, and salvage together to reach the bottom before your oxygen runs out, a friend blows you up, or you become a tasty treat.

5067020.title: Idle Mage: Conquest
5067020.short_description: An idle incremental RPG where a mage battles through escalating waves across multiple zones. Master five elemental spell schools, defeat bosses, craft gear, and Ascend for permanent power. Optimize your build, watch the carnage unfold, and keep conquering while you're away

5067040.title: Tea by the Sea
5067040.short_description: A cozy tea shop by the sea in a strange digital world. Grow tea, make drinks, get to know the locals, and decorate your shop. Enjoy quiet days in this seaside town while discovering the unusual things happening around you.

5067050.title: Capital City
5067050.short_description: Capital City combines city, resource, and transport management within an infinite steampunk fantasy world. Mine resources, build factories and logistics networks. Transport raw and processed materials and goods to your city to ensure it keeps growing and expanding.

5067550.title: Beatmaker Simulator
5067550.short_description: A music producer career simulator. Make beats, work with artists, grow your popularity, earn money, level up your skills, and build the studio of your dreams.

5067620.title: The Sundered Anvil
5067620.short_description: A party of greenhorn adventurers acquires a contract to retrieve an anvil stolen from a remote village, only to discover the job is more than they bargained for.

5067770.title: Spur of Life
5067770.short_description: You’ve woken into a world that wants you slaughtered. No weapons. No combat. Escape the oppressive, liminal space that doesn't want you, as things that shouldn’t be there hunt you from the dark.

5067810.title: FrogPop
5067810.short_description: Pop bubbles with your tongue and dodge what they split into. Eat Power Bugs, combine relics, and face strange bosses in a pixel-art arcade roguelite. Try the free Windows demo: 10 waves, 2 bosses. Can you clear the pond?

5067930.title: PooDaddy
5067930.short_description: PooDaddy is a fast paced auto battler where you build ridiculously overpowered attacks. PooDaddy combines ridiculous cartoon humor, a story driven world and unpredictable events that can supercharge your run or turn the entire level against you. Every run becomes chaotic and different.

5068000.title: Rogue Space Convoy
5068000.short_description: Rogue Space Convoy is a roguelite space action shooter where you pilot a fighter, build a convoy, and choose branching encounters across five hostile passages. Disable enemy cruisers, salvage upgrades, and keep the Ark alive long enough to reach the gate.

5068050.title: Ruins of Aloryith
5068050.short_description: Ruins of Aloryith is a third-person action roguelite. Fight through escalating waves with sword and shield, unleash player-controlled abilities, and shape your build with upgrades. Face corrupted bosses and uncover the source of the corruption.

5068190.title: DEATHMATE
5068190.short_description: DEATHMATE is a chess-themed roguelike deckbuilder. Build an army of pieces, stack a deck full of moves, and battle your way across the depths of the Underworld.

5068610.title: Grumpy Dungeon
5068610.short_description: The dungeon is dying. It would rather die than say thank you. Fight through its halls with wisps living in your weapons and fighting at your side. Rescue every last spirit, grow them, evolve them, regrow its garden. It remembers everything. Collect all the wisps.

5068870.title: America Survival
5068870.short_description: You are the last Native Americans, the masters of the ancient land of the Americas, hunting, building homes, fighting off invaders, and surviving.

5068900.title: Soulstone
5068900.short_description: Be anyone, go anywhere, do anything. Live a new life in a fantasy world.

5068950.title: straywild
5068950.short_description: Fish, catch bugs, dig for clams, and paint the world in Straywild, a relaxed solo or online multiplayer hangout. Create your own animal character, explore generated islands in changing weather, fill your logbook, and upgrade your home that travels with you!

5068970.title: NEXT OBJECTIVE
5068970.short_description: The objective marker IS the monster. Play as Tom, a very obedient boy, and teach him how to disobey. Leave the playable area, break the rules, and fight back against a game that wants you to stay on script.

5069130.title: Magna Conquest
5069130.short_description: Lead a kingdom in a real-time medieval fantasy grand strategy where the campaign world and battles unfold simultaneously. Command armies of up to 100,000 units while shaping your realm through diplomacy, kingdom management, research, and legendary heroes in single-player or campaign multiplayer.

5069170.title: 수용수 : to pluto
5069170.short_description: Two job seekers, two separate spaces, one set of controls. Guide a pair of characters who move in sync, solve puzzles, and get them safely to Café Pluto in this 2D puzzle platformer.

5069250.title: The Rift Trader
5069250.short_description: Not good, How about half? Every deal at this counter is a conversation — with kings, inspectors, widows and street kids who all remember how you treated them. The rift brings the goods. You set the price.

5069260.title: Muscle Kingdom
5069260.short_description: Grow it. Train it. Show it off. Raise mysterious creatures called "Macho" and dominate posing battles in this fresh bodybuilding brawler. Your battle cry decides the winner. Become the ultimate trainer!

5069270.title: Otherworldly Business
5069270.short_description: An action RPG set in an anime-styled otherworld. Play an adventurer who crossed over from the real world and take contracts to hunt goblins. World travel unlocks mid-to-late game, opening the West, the post-apocalypse, elven territory and more.

5069320.title: Portrise Idle
5069320.short_description: Build a quiet fishing harbor in an atmospheric idle strategy game. Send your fleet to sea, sell the catch, expand warehouses and buildings, collect captain and ship cards, and sail from a peaceful bay toward dangerous depths.

5069410.title: V.E.L.O.
5069410.short_description: Abandoned by the living. Loved by the dead. Five idols return to the stage—but their new audience isn't alive. Become their sole producer, uncover supernatural mysteries, and lead their comeback in a story-driven visual novel and rhythm game.

5069440.title: Path Of Peecho
5069440.short_description: Fight the Pawtriarchy! The world has been dominated by the greediest cat the universe has ever known. Assemble your team of rebels, build their decks, customize their skill trees, and take Peecho down in this turn-based roguelite scramble to save humanity right meow.

5069510.title: The Offering
5069510.short_description: The Offering is an incremental game where you grab creatures to collect offerings, buy upgrades and defend your shrine at night. Stack boons, forge weapons, catch goblins and ascend through worlds!

5069580.title: Spray to Grail
5069580.short_description: Spray-paint sneakers layer by layer, finish fast orders, and turn a scrappy bootleg studio into a rare-drop machine. Unlock wild grails, upgrade your gear, fill your collection wall, and chase the perfect pair in this juicy incremental game.

5069620.title: 四季餐厅
5069620.short_description: Four Seasons Restaurant "is a restaurant management game that combines classic simulation management with a warm and healing art style. Whether you're reliving the classic joys of the past or experiencing the refreshing gameplay of the four seasons, this place will be your culinary sanctuary.

5069660.title: Crawlbound
5069660.short_description: Survive a grid-based roguelite by selecting game altering bugs to endure each level. Dodge traps, battle bosses, and draft upgrades to build your run. Spend your loot on permanent upgrades to push deeper into the dungeon.

5069810.title: Ministrelli's Cardboard Circus
5069810.short_description: You are the new light board operator and it's your job to let the artists shine. Aim lights, control soundboards, blast smoke and shoot confetti! All at the right timings. Can you juggle all the tasks? Keep an eye out for director Ministrelli's countdowns and you'll be sure to have great success.

5069840.title: Desktop Plinko
5069840.short_description: An idle incremental plinko game that sits in the corner of your screen while you do other things.

5069950.title: Pedal Pedal Pedal
5069950.short_description: A chaotic physics racer where two tiny riders share one oversized BMX. Each pumps, steers and brakes, and the bike only goes where you both agree. Race a friend on one keyboard or online, or ride solo and control both riders yourself.

5070060.title: Robokitties: MEGASTRUCTURE
5070060.short_description: Explore a dying megastructure with your friends as tiny robokitties. Scavenge dangerous loot, survive evil machines, and get back to the lift before the power runs out.

5070070.title: waga-mom
5070070.short_description: ――My curfew is 8 PM. Having a helicopter mom is annoying, but it's not a big deal.

5070170.title: Per My Last Email
5070170.short_description: You are the new hire. The account you inherited is not new — it belonged to E. Vale, who is no longer with the company. Ten business days of email in which you choose what you say, then choose who sees it. The routing is permanent. Someone is still reading.

5070200.title: Video Game Store Simulator
5070200.short_description: Build and run your own video game store in this first-person retail management simulator. Order new titles, unpack deliveries, stock shelves, set prices, serve customers at the register, and reinvest your profits to customize and expand your growing business.

5070270.title: Cozy Farm Life Simulator
5070270.short_description: Turn a quiet patch of land into a cozy farm. Grow and sell crops, raise animals, evolve helpful pets, upgrade your equipment, and expand at your own pace in a relaxing first-person farming experience.

5070330.title: RELICTUM
5070330.short_description: Become the Messenger of God and descend into the endless abyss to defeat powerful enemies and bosses while fulfilling the divine command in this 2D Metroidvania action adventure.

5070380.title: AFTERMATH
5070380.short_description: Aftermath is a first-person horror game. Return to this old house once again, explore its dark corners, and face the traces that cannot be erased and the consequences that cannot be undone.

5070400.title: Yeet the Chest
5070400.short_description: Play as a Mimic in a dynamic physics platformer! You have no legs, so aim and hurl yourself upward. But remember: every wall touch and enemy hit costs you gold. Calculate your momentum, protect your coins, and help the lonely chest break free!

5070740.title: Main Street Operator
5070740.short_description: Buy a tired neighborhood laundromat and turn it around. Walk the floor, clean and repair machines, manage prices and cash flow, modernize the store, win back customers, pay down the seller note, and decide when the business is finally worth keeping—or selling.

5070770.title: An-pêng: Still Here
5070770.short_description: After China's air raids, everyone in Anping was evacuated. You stayed. A ten-floor apartment with no power, someone who couldn't be bothered to leave, and a fridge of food gone bad. Cards decide where the time goes: search, move, eat, sleep. No base to hold, no breaking out. Just one more day.

5070780.title: Town Hall
5070780.short_description: The town is half empty, but the town hall still opens at nine. You are the clerk. Whatever your stamp approves becomes true — permits, licenses, names, deaths. Everyone who reaches your desk brings a reason, and most bring money. In the basement, a file explains why the town emptied.

5070880.title: FROG RAIN
5070880.short_description: A sudden downpour turns everyone caught in the rain into frogs. Now I’m surrounded by frogs, and I can’t tell my teachers from my classmates. But that’s beside the point. It’s a new school, after all. I’d better make some friends soon.

5070980.title: Who?
5070980.short_description: Who? is a game of deduction and chaos among friends. Each player uploads any photo from their computer, which is assigned to another participant. Everyone can see the others’ images, but not their own, and asks questions that can only be answered with “yes” or “no” to discover who—or what—they are.

5071240.title: Dungeon Contractor
5071240.short_description: Run a fantasy dungeon maintenance company. Hire monsters, deploy deadly traps, and prepare dungeons for the next wave of greedy heroes. Every contract is a new challenge where smart planning leads to bigger profits.

5071320.title: Scroll Control
5071320.short_description: Read the rune, check the papers, then approve, reject or confiscate each spell scroll. Don’t lose control as the cases pile up and the rules change.

5071610.title: Flowline
5071610.short_description: Don't build more — make it flow. An idle factory game where one station always limits your line. Find it, feed it, and watch the bottleneck jump somewhere new. Secretly a real manufacturing simulation — with none of the math in your face.

5071620.title: Pack Ripper
5071620.short_description: Pack Ripper is a hands-on trading card incremental game. Rip open packs, fill your binder, and level up your packs for better pulls. Will you sell the hit or keep it?

5071640.title: ワカレタナビ
5071640.short_description: This is an action-adventure game where you navigate an unfinished title riddled with bugs, relying on guidance from a navigator. However, interacting with certain stage gimmicks apparently causes my personality to switch...

5071850.title: Tavern Game Night
5071850.short_description: Gather 2–8 players for seven online party games in a cozy fantasy tavern. Compete in word games, trivia, dice, drawing and deduction, then put those skills to use in Tavern Race, where challenges can move several players toward victory.

5071860.title: Cozy Plates
5071860.short_description: Decorate your own elegant plates using a variety of delicious ingredients, from sushi to sweet desserts. Arrange every detail with easy controls, set the cozy atmosphere, and create the perfect presentation. Relax, learn at your own pace, and get into the flow.

5072220.title: HolEvade
5072220.short_description: HolEvade is a challenging, physics-based 3D platformer where precision is everything. Tilt and control the platforms high above the clouds to guide your ball, navigate tight paths, and test your reflexes in a vibrant, stylized world!

5072250.title: Fallen Crowns
5072250.short_description: Gear up at the inn, then raid a fallen king's castle with up to eight other players. Monsters, rival parties and traps stand between you and its treasure. Grab what you can carry and reach a portal before the grave-rot rises. Fall, and whoever finds your body keeps your gear.

5072330.title: Cricket Manager 27
5072330.short_description: A deep cricket management simulation where you take charge of a club or national side, build squads, set tactics, handle transfers and board pressure, and chase glory across Test, ODI, and T20 seasons and major ICC events.

5072600.title: Family Time
5072600.short_description: Build a family of thousands of wolf children with your own wolf partner!

5072670.title: Pigeonhole Principle
5072670.short_description: Meet a pigeon who dreams of flying to the Galápagos. That flight needs one thing — the legendary golden sunflower seed. But right now that pigeon has fallen into a stranger's storage room, and is in real trouble. Cook the things around you, wear them, and climb a little higher.

5073030.title: BEACON 09
5073030.short_description: You're a prisoner sentenced to work at a crumbling lighthouse. Every night, you race against the clock, repairing whatever fails before your explosive collar decides your time is up. Repair, explore, survive in this terrifying first-person horror game.

5073210.title: BoneHeads
5073210.short_description: BoneHeads is a physics-based sword-fighting party game where every swing is under your direct control. Fight locally or online with up to 4 players, and keep battling as every bone you lose becomes a weapon.

5073420.title: GORTH
5073420.short_description: GORTH is a fast-paced open-world aerial combat game. Fly low across hostile territory, hunt enemy convoys, destroy radar sites, ships and military bases, dodge missiles, and survive with limited fuel and ammunition.

5073430.title: Worm Capitalist
5073430.short_description: Worm Capitalist is an incremental game about raising hungry worms, watching them devour everything pixel by pixel, and turning their poop into profit. Feed them, expand your colony, unlock upgrades, boost production, automate the process, and keep growing until the whole world is on the menu.

5073470.title: Tactical Tile Breaker Incremental
5073470.short_description: A synthwave neon space tile‑breaker. Hit the ball. Stack Power Ups at the right moments to clear the screen in the fastest time. Or just chill and space out to the synthwave soundtrack beats.

5073630.title: Backrooms: Misstep
5073630.short_description: Backrooms: Misstep is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore unsettling liminal levels, complete unique objectives, survive deadly entities, and uncover a path through environments where every wrong turn could be your last.

5073760.title: Horse Race
5073760.short_description: Start your journey in amateur races and climb your way to the top. Win races for prizes, open horse card packs, build your stable, manage your horses, and discover the perfect horse for every race. Rise through the ranks and become the ultimate champion. Do you have what it takes?

5073790.title: New Babylon
5073790.short_description: A massively multiplayer voxel sandbox set in a true-scale, procedurally generated solar system. One persistent shared universe, no levels or tech-tree gates — build, mine, craft, and survive on a Darwinian frontier where every planet and moon exists at real 1:1 scale.

5073880.title: Interpolate
5073880.short_description: A Dark day follows every night. Nothing will stop the world's cycle; it's your choice to change the outcome. Some days are easier than the last, but the strong face the challenge.

5073940.title: They’ll Hang You for That Face
5073940.short_description: Tomorrow, you burn at the stake as a "Werewolf". To save your family, you gladly accept a false execution. But after death, you witness them being ravaged in a living hell. Through a time loop triggered by your absolute despair, you must weave the world's kindest lie.

5074100.title: Immortal Loop: Doom Cycle
5074100.short_description: Transported to a cultivation world, you face apocalypse in one year. Every world‑ending catastrophe sends you back to the start. Keep resources and boost your aptitude across loops. Explore, uncover secrets, seek treasures, and survive doom in this real‑time action cultivation RPG.

5074180.title: TicketRot: A Carnival Incremental Game
5074180.short_description: A carnival incremental where you’re the only one left. Throw darts, whack moles, shoot hoops, wind up clockwork figures to play for you, and win relics from the claw machine. The midway rots a little more with every booth you bring back.

5074390.title: Dieabolic
5074390.short_description: A retro rogue-lite dice-builder. Roll your dice to fight. Upgrade your dice to get stronger. Battle through the 9 levels of Dante’s inferno

5074410.title: MURABO
5074410.short_description: SOLITAIRE + ROGUELIKE + 90s LATE NIGHT FEVER DREAMS = MURABO

5074630.title: Fleshgrinder
5074630.short_description: Fleshgrinder is an isometric post-apocalyptic Action-RPG. Take on the desperate mission to stop the Fleshgrinder from causing planetary extinction by harvesting the infected population. Loot, equip and level up your characters, interact with npcs in a persistent world filled with quests and danger.

5074640.title: Corporate Slave
5074640.short_description: A satirical side-scrolling office RPG. Walk the open floor plan, survive standups, reviews and layoffs, dodge the AI quietly absorbing your tickets, sneak job interviews on company time, and grind toward the only real win condition: enough money to never come back.

5074660.title: Blue Blood Love Song
5074660.short_description: A multi-ending visual novel blending romance, sci-fi, and mystery. A perfect reunion gradually gives way to unsettling inconsistencies. As your relationship with him deepens, you must choose between trust and doubt—and every decision may change your bond and the ending that awaits you.

5074710.title: 野生机
5074710.short_description: Step into BIO: Wild Machine—a hand-drawn biopunk world created by the author, and explore the perilous "New Tower of Babel," a city once a milestone in human life technology, now in decline. You must reinvent yourself, battling powerful enemies and unknown fears in harsh turn-based combat.

5074860.title: Arvel
5074860.short_description: Arvel — Action RPG + hybrid RTS. Build a squad of mercenaries, clear dungeons for loot, raise an army, and fight over the Arkon. Solo, with friends, or 1v1 up to 3v3.

5074970.title: Golden Bay: Desktop Aquarium
5074970.short_description: Golden Bay: Desktop Aquarium is a cozy ocean-themed desktop idle management game. Place a transparent bay at the bottom of your screen, raise fish and corals, welcome diving visitors, and care for a changing ecosystem. Earn income, upgrade your bay, and enjoy a peaceful companion while you work.

5075160.title: Utaburg
5075160.short_description: Utaburg is an open-world MMORPG. Join a world that puts a strong emphasis on immersion. Combat is dynamic. Choose one of four unique classes, then at level 40 choose a second class that complements your first. Fight, explore, create guilds, shape the economy - you decide.

5075390.title: 洪荒修仙界 Primordial Cultivation World
5075390.short_description: At the dawn of creation, demons rule and humanity faces extinction. Seize sacred mountains, claim spirit veins, carve a path to immortality — win a homeland for humankind. *Primordial Cultivation World*: a top-down 2D open-world combat RPG. Explore, slay, seize, breakthrough — reshape Honghuang.

5075420.title: Project TITAN
5075420.short_description: You start with a tiny mech factory, a pile of scrap, and one goal: make money. Manufacture parts, assemble mechs, and take on questionable contracts for clients who don't ask about ethics, just excellent margins. Grow your factory, upgrade your tech tree, and build the ultimate mech: TITAN.

5075560.title: Crease
5075560.short_description: Fold the paper into shape. A cozy grid puzzler about creasing a sheet of paper until it matches the target exactly. 100+ levels, with fun mechanics.

5075580.title: Romantic Leases
5075580.short_description: Unsure of where life will take him, he has four very different women enter his life: Sofia, the sharp and decisive CEO; Yeseul, a faded star; Emily, his long-lost first love; and Nina, who's like a little sister to him...

5075940.title: The Old Forge
5075940.short_description: Explore a open world inspired by 1990s Poland. Scavenge, build, craft and dig your way through forests, villages and industrial ruins surviving the zombies, harsh weather and the constant fight for food, warmth and safety.

5076270.title: YinShu
5076270.short_description: Played The Message? YinShu is a free online social deduction card game inspired by it, for 4–8 players. Everyone hides a faction and passes intel; read friend from foe in who accepts and who refuses. Intercept, see through and swap intel with character skills. Collect three of your color to win.

5076280.title: Claim the Gods
5076280.short_description: Would you dare to defy the gods? Claim their power? Then battle in this roguelike deckbuilder where you can win new cards, power up and Claim the Gods! But be warned mortal, if you fail, there will be consequences!

5076300.title: Final Bulwark: Zombie Tide Defense
5076300.short_description: Build your final stronghold on this overrun land. Plan your defenses, unlock deadly weapons, and face the ever-evolving tide of the undead—every decision you make determines life or death both inside and outside the walls.

5076310.title: Cry Wolf
5076310.short_description: Cry Wolf is a multiplayer social deduction game inspired by Werewolf, where secret alliances, risky bets, and new roles turn the classic rules upside down. Face 5 to 19 other players over voice chat across varied maps and unmask the wolves before it's too late.

5076320.title: Carpet Daddy
5076320.short_description: Turn filthy carpets into satisfying clean stripes in this first-person cleaning simulator. Vacuum, pre-spray, agitate and extract with professional tools, treat stubborn stains, and move furniture to reach every dirty corner.

5076490.title: Whodunit Sudoku
5076490.short_description: This is a logic puzzle blending Sudoku with murder mystery deduction. Place suspects using row-and-column rules on illustrated crime scenes, then read spatial clues and room boundaries to deduce who was left alone with the victim. Pure logic, no guessing.

5076960.title: Hollow Ones
5076960.short_description: Hide away from the end of the world in Hollow Ones, a mid-apocalypse narrative horror game.

5077170.title: Goblin Dodge
5077170.short_description: Play as a goblin who was displaced from its village, who must fight its way through a bullet gauntlet to earn freedom!

5077320.title: TapRacer
5077320.short_description: Two keys, strictly alternating, as fast as you can. TapRacer is a drag racer with real vehicle physics: torque curves, clutch slip, tire temperature, weight transfer. Burnout, launch, four shifts — and the quarter mile is over.

5077520.title: The Turbo Crown
5077520.short_description: Drive cannon-equipped toy cars, jump across giant furniture, and fly with nitro in arcade battles for up to 10 players. Fight online or against bots, master four game modes, and customize every piece with no pay-to-win advantages.

5077600.title: Marble Mill
5077600.short_description: An idle game where every coin is a real collision. Build a marble mill, watch it grow into a roaring machine — and finish it in one satisfying evening. 100% achievements in ~3 hours, endless sandbox after. An idle game that ends.

5077980.title: Songkran Hazard: 4Lom
5077980.short_description: Lock, load, and stay dry! Step into the soaked slippers of Rookie Cop “Lee” in this high-octane survival “horror?”. Armed with water guns and wet powder, escort Anchan through Bangkok's chaotic Silom Road during the wildest Songkran outbreak ever. Can you survive the Songkran hazard?

5078060.title: Whisker Works
5078060.short_description: Whisker Works is a chaotic 1–4 player renovation game! Clean, repair, demolish and rebuild with your cat crew, because we clean, we fix, we PURRFECT!

5078140.title: 16 Bit Gold
5078140.short_description: Build a cozy gold mining business from the ground up. Find as much gold as you can and transform an overgrown plot of land into a thriving mining operation - one gold bar at a time.

5078250.title: Treehouse
5078250.short_description: An aesthetically pleasing treehouse toy. Build up and out, and the branches support your structures. Connect rooms with ladders and walkways, or carve footpaths through the grassy glen to interactable ponds. Create the ambient orchestral soundtrack with your treehouse, and set the perfect lighting.

5078270.title: Water's Bounty
5078270.short_description: Set across a vast global map, Water's Bounty thrusts you into a sea full of nonstop dangers. You'll navigate a world dominated by the ruthless Ronek Trading Company; a commercial empire branding all independent merchants as pirates to protect their monopoly.
publishers: Not Allowed to Die Gaming Studios

5078340.title: HEARTHWATCH
5078340.short_description: HEARTHWATCH is a roguelite tower defense where the map tears open mid-battle. Guard your village's last fire across a branching Stone Age campaign: build elemental towers, bond them into hybrids, draw cards from your run's deck, and hold the new lane when the ground splits.

5078530.title: Taskbar Garden
5078530.short_description: Grow a living procedural garden along your desktop while you work or relax. Harvest plants for profit, breed plants, fuse genetic seeds, and discover rare mutations as every seed grows into a completely unique plant.

5078640.title: BATTLEFRONTS: GRIMDARK
5078640.short_description: BATTLEFRONTS: GRIMDARK delivers big battles experiences. The battles will face teams composed of Humans and BOTs one against other on battlefields filled with troops, monsters, vehicles and immersive landscape elements.

5078790.title: Chronicles of the Six Sages
5078790.short_description: This game is a Turn Based JRPG with real time mechanics in order to overcome the enemies attacks. The game features a fully unique gear system, allowing for the player to fully customize their party to their choosing

5078840.title: Grimoire of Hecate : Tower of Starlight
5078840.short_description: Combine cards into powerful spells in this roguelite deckbuilder. Build your strategy around four elements, read enemy intentions in turn-based battles, and grow stronger between runs as Ray climbs the Tower of Starlight to find her missing mother.

5078860.title: Text Shelter
5078860.short_description: Text Shelter​ is a text-based post-apocalyptic idle game. Construct your shelter, plan production lines, and balance power and resources. Venture into the No-Man's Land, upgrade survivor stats, and invest in doomsday industries for greater profits. Expand your camp into a true Ark of the End Times.

5079210.title: Banners & Frontlines
5079210.short_description: Hold the line in a single-player, turn-based card strategy game. Combine infantry, archers and cavalry, commit reserves and pull battered troops back to reform. Fight historical campaigns or keep a mercenary company alive through contracts, recruits and captured banners.

5079360.title: Under a Turning Sky
5079360.short_description: A calm, meditative celestial puzzle game where you rotate planets along orbit rings, align them, and guide a signal across the stars. Solve thoughtful, zen-like logic puzzles at your own pace, accompanied by a transporting, relaxing soundtrack.

5079460.title: Did a Monkey Write This?
5079460.short_description: A cozy incremental management game. You're a failed author with a troop of cute monkey writers. Level up and build, play the publishing slot machine, race around plot holes and ski the slopes of ever-changing trends.

5079520.title: The Cup: Creature Card Battler
5079520.short_description: A free creature card battler and roguelike deckbuilder with the dice printed on the cards. Draft real North American animals and a few cryptids, take THE ROAD alone or with the House at your side, or fight live 1v1 while the booth calls every roll.

5079560.title: Bullet Reign
5079560.short_description: Bullet Reign is a roguelike action shooter in a wasteland. Fight endless mutant waves as an armed survivor, choosing classes, weapons, and items to craft unique builds. Every run offers new progression choices—blast through the swarm and be the last one standing.

5079600.title: Tombslayers
5079600.short_description: Carve through undead hordes in dark tombs. Clear waves, rebuild in the shop, and snowball into broken loadouts. A fast, dark roguelike survivor.

5079730.title: Long Watch
5079730.short_description: A short incremental game about an old relay station waking up from deep hibernation. Collect signals, decode the messages they carry, and grow your station into a network across nearby sectors.

5079880.title: HASSO
5079880.short_description: A single-player samurai card game where you don't collect cards, you learn techniques. Each turn you build a chain of blades and decide when to stop; between duels you choose what you learn, which paths you prove and which katana you forge, until the style is yours.

5080030.title: SEC//SIM — Security Engineer Simulation
5080030.short_description: Stand the 1 a.m. watch as a SOC defensive AI. The intruder is already inside; you see only its traces. Tell attack from routine, pull threads across hosts and keys, win a human sign-off, excise it in one strike. Real ATT&CK techniques, detections you write, twenty-plus nights, more than one ending.

5080060.title: Africa Survival
5080060.short_description: As an explorer, you travel to Africa, hunt in the savanna, Avoid attacks from various ferocious beasts, gather resources, build shelter, and survive.

5080210.title: The Eggsortist
5080210.short_description: A chicken possessed by the Devil has laid 4,266 colored eggs in a barn, but 666 of them are demonic eggs in disguise! Sort the eggs, find the evil impostors, and burn them before they hatch and doom the world.

5080480.title: Store Tycoon Simulator
5080480.short_description: Build and manage your own supermarket in Store Tycoon. Order products, stock shelves, hire and schedule staff, manage deliveries and expenses, and keep customers happy. Track sales, level up, unlock new products, and turn your small shop into a successful retail business.

5080510.title: Hallowed Empire
5080510.short_description: Hallowed Empire is a real-time strategy game of kingdoms, war, and corruption. Build your empire, upgrade your warriors, forge alliances with rival factions, and decide the fate of the undead. Will you destroy them, embrace them, or turn their power against your enemies?

5080520.title: Gas Station Simulator
5080520.short_description: A gas station and convenience store tycoon. Stock shelves, pump fuel, and ring up sales. Grow from a humble roadside stall by pricing stock and unlocking licenses to upgrade your shop. Set out every product by hand, tidy up what customers leave behind, and grow a thriving business.

5080560.title: Rocket
5080560.short_description: Rocket is a rage-inducing 2.5D precision game where you control a rocket, dodge obstacles and try to make it to the end without losing your mind. Oh, did I forget to mention that you have to do it all in one run?

5080570.title: Cecilia
5080570.short_description: Cecilia is a Zelda-like action-adventure with Game Boy Color–inspired pixel art. As a royal guard, venture through puzzle-filled dungeons, find items that open new paths, and face challenging bosses to bring the kidnapped Prince Erick home.

5080630.title: Burnout Bistro
5080630.short_description: Run a restaurant, manage your stock, staff, recipe selection and more. Decide how much you want to sacrifice for your career, as not taking care of your personal needs will leave you completely burnt out. How long can you keep everything together?

5080720.title: Pro Yakyu Front Office
5080720.short_description: Take charge of a fictional Japanese pro baseball club as general manager. Draft players on your scouts' judgment, set the lineup and the rotation, earn from sponsors and the ballpark, manage the payroll, and answer to the owner. The games play themselves; the decisions are yours.

5080730.title: LOVE alt delete
5080730.short_description: DATE. DESIGN. DESTROY. A psychological chat simulator between you and two digital personalities who desperately want to be people. Type keywords to control them, uncover their secrets, and choose their fates.

5081000.title: 9号台球馆：心动搭档
5081000.short_description: No. 9 Pool Hall blends playable eight-ball, character stories, roguelike builds, and Steam friend matches. Practice aiming and position play, meet distinctive partners, and survive nine strange nights. AI assisted art, audio, writing, code, and testing; no AI runs during play or sends player data.

5081020.title: Wall of Symbols
5081020.short_description: A roguelite siege defense played on an alchemist's table. Spin, place, and let symbols ripen into forms your deck never held. Every neighbour feeds the next, and one transmute turns the whole board into damage.

5081350.title: Mapborn
5081350.short_description: Your map is the world. Mapborn is a real-time grand strategy sandbox played directly on your original artwork. Add cities and nations, choose one to rule, and shape its history through war, diplomacy, politics, and rebellion.

5082020.title: 深夜閲覧 Midnight Reading：Showa Echoes
5082020.short_description: Midnight Reading is a short horror adventure set in a Showa-era Japanese school. As a library committee member, search for overdue books. Read, return, and make choices as the story branches into three routes and a True Route.

5082570.title: TowerCard: Digital Edition
5082570.short_description: Gather resources, raise your tower across five stages, and follow Thomas on his journey through five worlds full of unforgettable characters. Play the story mode or quick matches against the AI – multiplayer arrives soon in Arcade Mode.

5082580.title: Keycap Keycap!
5082580.short_description: Enjoy the satisfying click of every keycap! Collect a variety of keycaps, upgrade your skills, and acquire powerful Relic Keycaps. Keycap Keycap! is a short and satisfying incremental ASMR game.

5083130.title: Siege of Incrementalia
5083130.short_description: Command an undead army and lay siege to a continent in this incremental strategy game. Build war machines, sacrifice minions and automate hellish magic in your quest to unite the lands of Incrementalia by force.

5083230.title: YellowJacket
5083230.short_description: This is a 2D platformer adventure game set in a world that has lost its color, where you retrieve scattered jackets to color the world again. Discover the rules of color and begin your journey to restore the lost colors.

5083290.title: Neighbor Craft
5083290.short_description: Neighbor Craft is a survival card game where you build a civilization by placing cards next to one another. Decide what to place where, then gather resources, craft, fight, trade, and discover new cards as your civilization evolves.

5083370.title: Whisker Tinkers
5083370.short_description: Dig through boxes filled with junk, organize them in your warehouse and fulfill client orders by crafting their desired items from your gathered materials. Protect your shiny treasures from sneaky raccoons and prepare your store for inspections. Don't forget to hide what you don't want to be seen...

5083560.title: Coindrop Dungeon
5083560.short_description: Coindrop Dungeon is a Pachinko inspired dungeon crawler. Your coins and pegs from the board are your inventory. Explore builds, create synergies and break the curse that keeps you in the ever changing dungeon.

5083740.title: Griefborn
5083740.short_description: Destroy hordes of unholy creatures using firearms and magical abilities. Create your own build, upgrade your weapons, and unlock new levels!

5083810.title: Dwarven Digging Machine
5083810.short_description: Command dwarves as they build a huge dwarven digging machine. Harvest resources, find powerful artifacts, defend against your foes and conquer the underground in this incremental strategy game.

5084490.title: K-God Robot Hunters
5084490.short_description: A Korean-fantasy poker roguelike where you build hands from five elemental suits and harness the powers of mythic goddesses. Refine your deck, discover powerful combinations, and battle through a robot uprising one hand at a time.

5084680.title: Sails of Salt
5084680.short_description: Set sail and become a pirate legend in this roguelite sandbox. Every voyage, a new sea: plunder, capture ships, lead your fleet and shape your crew. Greed makes you rich. Or dead. How much will you risk?

5084740.title: Hendichen
5084740.short_description: Chaotic co-op cooking for 2 or 3 players, with real recipes and a real kitchen. THE CHEF knows every recipe but has one working hand. MUFFLES barely hears you. WOBBLES reads every order as a different dish. Talk to each other, or the kitchen burns.

5084810.title: Touhou: Marisa! Cook It!
5084810.short_description: Reimu praised Sakuya's cooking one time too many, so Marisa announced she would handle the next banquet herself. Build a deck of ingredients, pour it into her magic cauldron, and watch the collisions and danmaku chain out of control. A physics-based deckbuilding roguelike.

5084860.title: Time Traveler: Divergence
5084860.short_description: A systemic medieval RPG where you play a stranded traveler from the future. Rebuild your device, replicate technology, shape a living kingdom through trade, diplomacy or force, and beware: its people — and History itself — will remember what you do.

5084930.title: Labygoudene
