5084930.short_description: Welcome to Labygoudène ! A cooperative game that will put your friendship to the test. Explore a shifting, unstable maze of menhirs filled with surprises, where every turn can bring you closer to the exit… or tear your team apart for good. Stick together !

5085050.title: Calibration Sequence
5085050.short_description: Calibration Sequence is a bullet hell game where you play as a nanobot undergoing its factory calibration.

5085180.title: Blind Gavel
5085180.short_description: The auctioneer is lying, and he has secret partners hiding among the bidders. Blind Gavel is a 4 to 8 player social deduction party game: bid on items you cannot value, find the partners, and send the accused into a deadly minigame

5085300.title: The City Knows
5085300.short_description: A story-driven deduction game set in Okayama, Japan, where everyone has an answer—but you need evidence. Examine evidence and records, cross-reference witness accounts, reconstruct timelines, and separate plausible theories from provable facts across six murder investigations.

5085390.title: BLACKROT
5085390.short_description: BLACKROT is a fast-paced top-down action game of brutal dashes, parried bullets and random generated levels. Time only runs when you move. Dash through enemies, keep your combo going and paint the walls red.

5085730.title: Innkeeping
5085730.short_description: A cozy medieval inn-management sim. Build your inn, brew your ale, set your prices, and take care of your guests. Grow your reputation and business while balancing happy patrons and rising costs to turn a quiet roadside stop into a legendary landmark.

5086200.title: Water & Healing
5086200.short_description: An immersive 3D art experience exploring water, nature and healing. Wander through atmospheric virtual worlds, discover watercolor artworks, meet characters and complete gentle quests while experiencing stories of peace, connection and renewal.

5086350.title: 罐头成长计划
5086350.short_description: 一款养成游戏，在游戏中，你将扮演妈妈，收养一只来自孤儿院的小罐头生物，前往罐头小镇抚养它，通过各种方式的培养来引导小罐成长为不同性格和职业，形成不同的人际关系 9名有感情线路的角色，游戏内包含钓鱼，换装，喂食，打工，战斗，抽卡机，五子棋，阵营选择，npc小任务等游玩方式 ·养成游戏 ·自由选择多结局

5086650.title: A FAREWELL TO AI
5086650.short_description: It began with something strange. Something unsettling. In a future where drawing is forbidden, you dare to take up your pen and join the revolution. Solve mysteries. Complete drawing missions. This story needs your art. No one else's.

5086730.title: Holon
5086730.short_description: Build factories inside factories. Extract shapes, automate production, and deliver increasingly complex designs to the Hub. Enter a Nest to build its machinery, reuse it as a single building, then fit smaller Nests inside larger ones to take your factory further. About this game

5086750.title: Item TD
5086750.short_description: Every Tower Is a Backpack! Item TD combines Tower Defense and Inventory Management in a strategy game featuring 15 stages, 3 difficulty levels. Arrange weapons and support items in your character's and Towers' inventories to maximize their synergies and fend off waves of monsters.

5086800.title: Islands
5086800.short_description: Island Island Island is a low-poly cartoon-style sandbox survival crafting game. Set in an infinitely dynamically generated world of floating islands, all terrain unfolds in real time as you move—the map has no boundaries.

5086870.title: meowtopia
5086870.short_description: See the world through a cat’s eyes and explore your home! From sunny balconies to cozy bedrooms, unlock new rooms, collect items, and solve light puzzles. Play mini-games and grow daily to turn this cozy house into a true "Meowtopia." Pure immersion and heartwarming companionship await.

5086920.title: The Grooming
5086920.short_description: The Grooming is a 2.5D psychological horror adventure where a girl follows a cat through familiar streets that slowly distort. Explore unsettling spaces, investigate strange phenomena with your phone and camera, and make choices that can change what you experience—and whether you survive.

5086950.title: Hotel Carnivalia
5086950.short_description: Hotel Carnivalia is a first-person social deduction game for 4-15 players. Roam a gothic hotel on foot, hunt your prey as a predator, or follow the traces left behind to find the predators hiding among you.

5086980.title: Rich PaPa
5086980.short_description: Rich PaPa - Short Description Rich PaPa is a third-person action shooter where you literally shoot money. Blast through hordes of zombies, bank ricochet shots off the environment, and spin the roulette for risky upgrades while balancing survival against the cash you have left.

5087090.title: Elixir of Immortality
5087090.short_description: A cultivation incremental game where alchemy is the key to survival. Recruit minions, manage your alchemy room, seek elixirs to extend your lifespan, and reincarnate when your time runs out. Reincarnate again and again on your path to immortality.

5087400.title: Colony on the Run
5087400.short_description: Start as a single bacterium, multiply into a colony, and race through the human body! Escape white blood cells, evolve, adapt to each organ, and survive the massive antibiotic wave after three minutes in this roguelite action-strategy game.

5087650.title: Bunny Bring Bits
5087650.short_description: You are a grumpy rabbit restoring the game world. Clean up rubbish, wipe away dirt with a rag, recycle junk into elements of the world, and activate mechanisms. And after the heroes' fight with the boss, don't forget to clean up the unlucky heroes.

5087800.title: Meowgic Laundry
5087800.short_description: Run a magical laundry on the verge of chaos! Toss single-use detergents into a physics-driven washer, chain collisions into escalating scores, buy machine parts, sign contracts, and survive nine rounds of increasingly unruly laundry.

5087810.title: Pennants Of Glory: Condottiere
5087810.short_description: Run a medieval mercenary company with Battle Brothers-style management in a living world. Command up to 600 soldiers in Total War-style real-time 3D formation battles as factions wage wars, besiege towns, and reshape campaign. Break formations with unique stance mechanics.

5087940.title: DuskLand
5087940.short_description: Poker Roguelike RPG. DuskLand is a unique roguelike RPG where you deal heavy damage using poker hands and optimize character-specific inventories. Discover explosive synergies, find the best layout, and unleash powerful combos!

5088250.title: Buzzle
5088250.short_description: Move the blocks around the field to assemble the exact shape required for each level. Move them into the correct positions and see if you can advance to the next level.

5088460.title: My Oshi, the Supernatural, and Livestreaming
5088460.short_description: In this horror adventure game, the player takes on the role of a viewer who watches Sana Okuizumi’s live stream, issues instructions, and experiences firsthand how she overcomes various crises.

5088580.title: Vectorfall
5088580.short_description: Defend against massive waves with 5,000 enemies. Master 14 towers, pick your favorite upgrades and tear through huge waves of enemies with powerful abilities. Progress with 120+ skills and push your limits in endless mode. Take the fight anywhere with Steam Deck and full controller support. No AI.

5088590.title: Armory Chaos: Tidy Up
5088590.short_description: Clock in as a robot and bring order to a chaotic armory. Sort weapons, pack ammo, and haul crates solo or with up to 3 friends. Use magnets and air cannons to get the job done, and watch a stray explosion turn your tidy shift into a glorious mess.

5088770.title: Arctic Shop Simulator
5088770.short_description: Run a small shop at the edge of the Arctic wilderness. Ride your snowmobile into frozen regions, track and sedate wildlife, fish, survive brutal weather, and return home to sell your finds. Negotiate with customers, expand your shop, and build a thriving business in the far north.

5088790.title: Who Pressed It?!
5088790.short_description: A chaotic 2–4 player co-op puzzle game. Work together to solve test rooms, interact with giant buttons, and try not to press the wrong thing. Every mistake sends the facility further into chaos!

5088940.title: Trigger-Happy Chainsaw Girl
5088940.short_description: Konoko Kobazaki is a deadbeat shut-in. Saddled with multiple debts, he heads to an abandoned building with the naive hope of turning his life around by becoming a "paranormal YouTuber." Will he actually manage to pay off his debts?

5089150.title: DO NOT MISS
5089150.short_description: DO NOT MISS is a fast-paced arena FPS where every missed shot adds an enemy to the next wave. Fight back, grab weapons and upgrades, and use bizarre vending machines. Don't let your own mistakes doom your run.

5089480.title: 2027 毕业生工作
5089480.short_description: Where should the Class of 2027 go? (This game is only in Simplified Chinese)

5089490.title: EXTRAKTOR K.R.Y.P.T.
5089490.short_description: EXTRAKTOR K.R.Y.P.T. Explore abandoned places, face terrifying creatures, and complete missions as a team. Play with up to 6 friends, but be careful: every monster has its own unique mechanics. Will you survive and uncover the hidden lore?

5089650.title: Before the First Fire
5089650.short_description: Survive, teach, and evolve across 5.6 million years of human prehistory. Gather resources, build a tribe of companions, and guide your species through 7 eras, from the forest floor to the eve of civilization.

5089860.title: Slot Crawler
5089860.short_description: Explore. Kill. Loot. Die. Feed your hard-earned tokens to a slot machine with questionable intentions, then unlock new ways to make terrible decisions on the next run. Slot Crawler is a top-down action roguelike with procedural maps, chaotic builds, and combinations that definitely should not work.

5089930.title: Genuine Article
5089930.short_description: Vienna, 1901. A bureau that authenticates antiques: without your certificate the piece is worth nothing. Silver, paintings, watches, papers — each carries a truth and a lie about its history. A predecessor’s debt makes bribes tempting. And you won’t get this right every time — mistakes cost.

5090030.title: DiscPods
5090030.short_description: Party chaos for up to 8 friends! Pilot a DiscPod, a small hover-robot that leaves a solid trail behind it. Touch any trail and you're out! Cut friends off, slip through the gaps, bounce discs off walls and raid the Overlord together. Online, 4 on one screen, or against Bots.

5090120.title: NICO DRAW
5090120.short_description: Your doodle just got up and ran. Draw legs, arms or wings with limited ink and take your creation through 45 stages in a hand-drawn 2D puzzle platformer. Play solo, with two on one PC, or with up to four online.

5090150.title: Ball Game
5090150.short_description: Ball Game is a game about making weaponified balls face each other using physics. Choose between many powerful cards, go through the rounds and watch slowly as the destruction rises!

5090320.title: Star Driver Ultra
5090320.short_description: year 2050 ULTRA high speed combat racing on the Moon

5090430.title: TALES UNFOLD
5090430.short_description: Explore different worlds, share clues, and change each other’s surroundings as you restore tangled tales. TALES UNFOLD is a two-player online co-op puzzle adventure inspired by Korean folklore.

5090760.title: Cairnforge
5090760.short_description: A sandbox based fantasy survival game. Invent. Craft. Use. Flourish.

5090990.title: MAFIA HOTEL
5090990.short_description: MAFIA HOTEL is a first-person social deduction party game for up to 16 players—a hub for board game nights with friends. Play classic Mafia and other modes full of secrets and bluffing. Question your friends, defend your story, and confidently blame the wrong person.

5091570.title: T-Shirt Kingdom
5091570.short_description: Driven by boundless creativity, this is an idle game where every visual element—from the storefront to the battlefield—is yours to design. Paired with a deep strategic core that spawns endless idle and combat builds, T-Shirt Kingdom places the art of creation and warfare entirely in your hands.

5091680.title: Marbled Memories
5091680.short_description: Marbled Memories is a psychological horror game based on true events. Play as Derek, a young man severely mistreated and neglected by his mother. This game contains a story, puzzles, dark humor, many objects to interact with, collectibles, along with a few startling moments.

5091690.title: Dodgeball Disorder
5091690.short_description: Dodgeball Disorder is a chaotic online multiplayer dodgeball game where throwing, dodging and staying on your feet are equally important. Score hits, survive ridiculous ragdoll physics and compete across multiple game modes in a school gym with questionable supervision and crazy face expressions.

5091770.title: Ascend from Dis
5091770.short_description: A comic-ink roguelike deckbuilder where noise is a resource. Scavenge loud and the horde answers in waves — or fight quiet and stay poor. Outplay enemies that run decks of their own: peek, steal, and sabotage their next move while an infection ticks toward turning you.

5092000.title: TRACE
5092000.short_description: TRACE is a rhythm game combining arcade-style elements with the precision and competitiveness of PC rhythm games. Follow the music and experience the full energy of an arcade in the comfort of your own home!

5092050.title: King of Puzzles
5092050.short_description: A cosy little kingdom-building puzzle. Lay dominoes around your castle, grow the biggest patch of each terrain you can, and see how your kingdom compares. A new board whenever you want one, a daily everybody shares, and a crown for whoever leads the most boards.

5092190.title: Horror Club: Grandpa's House
5092190.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where you stay with your grandfather for a few days after he starts acting strangely. Help him with everyday tasks, follow his unusual rules, and experience unsettling events around the house as the story unfolds.

5092350.title: Semblature: A Deduction Game
5092350.short_description: A single-player logic deduction game. Every unit looks identical from the outside, and the statements about them are true or false based on their relative positions. Deduce the status and position of each unit, which can always be solved without guessing.

5092450.title: Labyrinth: The Descent
5092450.short_description: The maze is alive. The gold is bait. You're the meal. A permadeath dungeon crawler where the dungeon is keeping score: ten floors, one rogue, turn-based tactics on a grid. When you die that's it for the run — but your grave heals the next hero who finds it.

5092620.title: Corpo Dog
5092620.short_description: Deploy turrets, build defence lines, and shoot guns. Unlock powers through a rogue-like system and become unstoppable. Cyberrot has infested the city of New Meridian, and you are the cure. Fight your way through and become a true corpo dog. Remember, nothing is free in this place.

5092670.title: NULL VECTOR
5092670.short_description: Defend a central core in a neon geometric survival tower defense. Move and aim your operator, construct fortifications, research permanent upgrades, collect enemy ability modules, face evolving bosses, unlock endless mode, or cooperate online with up to four players.

5092820.title: Carry On
5092820.short_description: Carry On is a chaotic 1-4 player local co-op baggage handling game. Grab, wash, wrap and hurl colour-coded luggage down the conveyors to fill every departing flight's manifest before the clock runs out. Miss the plane and the whole terminal pays for it.

5093060.title: Always Fear The Unknown
5093060.short_description: Always Fear The Unknown is an asymmetrical multiplayer horror game where fear is personal. Complete a psychological profile before the match, then survive as a human team against a relentless hunter while sanity, objectives, and adaptive scare events push back.

5093380.title: Zombie Car: Kaiju Killer
5093380.short_description: Mow down relentless zombie hordes, turn carnage into cash, and upgrade your war rig into an unstoppable death machine! In this action-packed incremental roguelite, every run brings you closer to facing colossal Kaiju bosses. Gear up, smash through, and dominate!

5093440.title: Literally A Flying Brick
5093440.short_description: "Literally A Flying Brick" is a spaceship-building 2.5D action-shooter game. The year is 2088, and humanity is at war with AI and aliens in space. Triumph in intense battles using your own fully customizable spaceship and a strategic skill deck!

5093580.title: Get to Work! Girls of Gensokyo
5093580.short_description: A pixel-art idle fan game set in Gensokyo. Jealous of Kourindou's success, a broke Reimu decides to set up shops on the shrine grounds to make bank! Recruit youkai, gather resources, and build a bustling commercial street in this relaxing Gensokyo management sim.

5093710.title: Illusion Remix
5093710.short_description: Wake a forgotten museum of optical illusions with your robot curator, Luna. Explore its wonders, fill the galleries with your own creations, and go as deep as you like: shape every detail, make illusions dance to your music, and stage whole shows. Cozy, psychedelic, endlessly remixable.

5093720.title: Valkyrie Match
5093720.short_description: Gather the star-gems that can restore the fallen sky citadel. Match gems, awaken your Valkyrie cards, and outplay your rival turn by turn in this fantasy puzzle card battler.

5093960.title: Touhou Recastlift
5093960.short_description: Cards you play come back to your hand over time. Team up two Touhou Project characters and battle with a deck of just 10 cards in this 1v1 card game. Which card to play when, and which to bring back first? Reading your opponent decides the match. Free to play, no gacha.

5094030.title: Four Busted Buttons
5094030.short_description: Smash enemies by unlocking and upgrading four unique attack buttons in this short, minimalist incremental game.

5094110.title: Thirst Game
5094110.short_description: Good evening, viewers! Welcome to The Thirst Games! Tonight’s lucky contestants are you and your unlucky friends! Place your bets, run the gauntlet, trip each other up—and see who gets rich overnight and who ends up as roadkill.

5094230.title: Army Factory
5094230.short_description: Build your settlement into a war machine. Gather resources, raise massive armies, prepare your regiments, and watch your battle plan unfold as thousands of soldiers clash.

5094290.title: Haunted House Hellshift
5094290.short_description: Fight through a haunted house full of monsters and traps while a live TV audience watches. Collect eyeballs to open cursed doors, find the exit, and try to make it out alive—solo or with a friend in local 2-player co-op.

5094320.title: Build or be sniped
5094320.short_description: A chaotic physics-based party game built to test friendships. Every match switches things up: build a staircase to steal a sniper’s rifle, shoot rivals off giant jenga blocks over open water, climb a wall covered in knives, throw chairs off a ledge, draw shapes to cast spells and much more...

5094420.title: Tactical Squad
5094420.short_description: Outthink your opponent in brutal 1v1 turn-based firefights. Lead a six-unit SWAT team or criminal crew, blast through walls, destroy cover, and attack from unexpected angles. Hone your tactics in a challenging single-player campaign, then settle the score in PvP.

5094450.title: Sudden Death Golf
5094450.short_description: Minigolf that ruins friendships! Ball-to-ball collisions, crazy powerups, chaotic game modes and a powerful map editor. Nobody said it would be a fair fight :)

5094460.title: Buildot
5094460.short_description: Help Buildot save the world of Godot from the tyranny of the Unreal Union! Solve clever puzzles using diodes, logic gates, and conveyor belts. Beware of slippery surfaces and ice, where a single move can change everything. Full version planned to include 100 levels plus extra challenges!

5094510.title: Deliwhere?
5094510.short_description: Run a chaotic air cargo business across floating islands in 1-4 player co-op or solo! Pick from 4 unique roles, board your flying platform, dodge incoming rockets and aerial mines, upgrade your hangar, and deliver packages to pay off your massive bank loan!

5094560.title: INNER EKO
5094560.short_description: A dreamlike first-person platformer about the thoughts you can't let go of. Explore a strange world, meet mysterious beings, and face yourself.

5094770.title: Golf Orbit
5094770.short_description: Hit the perfect shot and launch your golf ball into orbit! Time your swings, smash through obstacles, earn coins, and upgrade your abilities to reach incredible distances. Break your records, explore new worlds, and see just how far your ball can go!

5094840.title: Murder Sudoku
5094840.short_description: A single-player logic puzzle game. A series of mysterious murders that seem unrelated are, in fact, connected by countless threads. Use Sudoku-style logical deduction to organize suspects, evidence, and clues, and uncover the secrets behind the cases.

5094990.title: Dungeonhand
5094990.short_description: A single-player horror game about being hunted while you work. The contractors have given you ten nights to dig your debt out of an ancient dungeon. Everything you are carrying is lost when you die, and every death costs you one of the nights.

5095000.title: Bonbaran!
5095000.short_description: Bonbaran! is a 2D action puzzle about using bombs and digging to make your own way. Place, stack, kick, ignite, and chain bombs, reshape terrain, and find your own solution. If an attempt fails, take control partway through the replay and try a different move.

5095060.title: AsterMaster
5095060.short_description: A beat-driven roguelite shooter on a hex grid. Bosses and elites are clouds of thousands of glowing shards: every hit carves a real crater, strip the plating and parts tear off. Everything moves on the beat. Stack weapon mods, break bosses, haul your ore back out alive. Steam Deck friendly.

5095270.title: Rush Hour of the Dead
5095270.short_description: A roguelite action game where ordinary people - firefighters, electricians, bank tellers - fight for survival against relentless zombie hordes. Mix and match 20+ jobs and 60+ abilities, adapt to shifting weather, and rescue civilians for powerful rewards in this deep, replayable build system.

5095330.title: Thirty Days with My First Love Sister
5095330.short_description: A pure love story with your childhood sweetheart who returns from abroad. Spend thirty heartwarming days together, make choices, deepen your bond, and unlock multiple sweet endings in this fully video-based interactive romance game.

5095350.title: TREUD
5095350.short_description: Rule your society through 12,000 years – from the Stone Age to the present day – in a grand strategy game with a living simulation where real historical processes are recreated, but nothing is predetermined. Build, conquer, exploit. Crisis is part of history: keep power or side with the revolution

5095490.title: beautiful freaks of the desert
5095490.short_description: A hyper brutal SPEEDRUN-FPS with a stylized boomer-shooter aesthetic and a heart of gold, that requires lightning fast reactions as well as strategic thinking in mapping out the best run through the bite-sized levels. But all of this is just the surface of the trip...

5095600.title: Forklift Logistics Simulator
5095600.short_description: Take control of a physics-based forklift as you move pallets, stack cargo and load trucks through increasingly challenging warehouse missions. Precision, balance and careful handling are at the heart of the experience.

5095790.title: Auction Simulator
5095790.short_description: Build an auction career where every bid is a tell. Buy, research and sell valuable objects, read rivals in poker-inspired psychological auctions, build collections, run your own auction house, or become a dealer in the dark market. Every bid is information. Every object could be an opportunity.

5095800.title: DNA NEMESIS
5095800.short_description: Survive in the wildest Battle Royale! Choose from 10 animal species, each with its own unique ability based on its natural attack and defence mechanisms. Master an extreme experience and become the ultimate species. In DNA NEMESIS there are no heroes; only predators and prey.

5095840.title: Click & Loot
5095840.short_description: Click & Loot is a short autobattle incremental clicker about looting dungeons. Level up, upgrade your gear and delve into the dungeons to pay off your ever increasing debt. And don't forget to renew your dungeon license!

5095980.title: Operation Blackwaste
5095980.short_description: Scavenge, fight, and survive in a zombie-ravaged wasteland. Build your safe house, take quests, manage hunger and thirst, craft your build with gear and ability trees, clear wave-based Purge stages — or let auto-combat grind for you. Every sortie and extraction makes you stronger.

5096020.title: LYSSA: Goddess of Rage
5096020.short_description: A tactical PvP card RPG in a world run by mercenaries. Climb the rankings in short, brutal real-time battles, recruit legendary fighters, and build a deck around your Commander. Seize territory with your alliance and get to know your crew off the battlefield.

5096340.title: Polygrounds
5096340.short_description: Master rally-car physics in a neon 2D roguelite physics shooter. Navigate procedural vector dungeons, survive claustrophobic ambushes, face interesting foes, pick new guns, and draft run-defining cards. Will you build a game breaking deck or face an untimely end?

5096400.title: Unhex
5096400.short_description: Unhex is a replayable co-op survival-horror game. Your goal is to figure out which demon has possessed the victim, and to exorcise it once you know it. You do this by searching for occult items and observing the possessed’s behavior and interactions with the environment - all without being caught.

5096490.title: Tether and Talon
5096490.short_description: Tethter and Talon is deckbuilding turn based combat game that borrows elements from creature collectors and roguelites. Draft your team of Yokai, play their moves as cards and make your way through rounds of enemies and send evil back in the Nether.

5096580.title: Warcaste TCG
5096580.short_description: The Warcaste TCG is a tactical sci-fi digital trading card game where battlefield positioning matters. Choose a Doctrine, command your fleet, and outmaneuver your enemy across a 3 zone battlefield. Play in story mode, solo play, or online PvP.

5096600.title: Highways & Co.
5096600.short_description: Do you hate building cities but love managing traffic? Design the perfect road network in this traffic simulator. Build interchanges, roundabouts, bridges, and tunnels with powerful road-building tools. Keep traffic flowing, solve congestion, and avoid a pile-up!

5096860.title: PactSworn
5096860.short_description: Fight through hordes of eldritch monsters to purge the source of the corruption! Earn gold, buy weapons, and level up to create unique and powerful builds to cut through the chaos. Unlock different warlocks and weapon sets to explore all the different ways to play!

5097030.title: JANISSARY: ECLIPSE
5097030.short_description: A first-person survival RPG set in a sealed-off Crimea, overrun by the Stained: zombies that run on sunlight. They sprint in daylight. After dark they go blind and hunt by sound. You wake up bandaged, memory gone, stuck between two armies. Pick a side or burn it all down.

5097110.title: SLICKWAVE
5097110.short_description: A fast illustrated action roguelite where every level-up reshapes your run. Choose abilities, evolve powers, combine relics, and turn four heroes into arena-clearing storms across four hostile worlds.

5097320.title: Shard Squad: Onyx Rising
5097320.short_description: Build a squad of elemental Shards in this roguelike auto-battler. Draft, position and level up your team, collect Relics, and chart a branching path through events, shops and bosses, or face other players’ squads in asynchronous multiplayer.

5097660.title: Keystrike
5097660.short_description: Craft powerful synergies and overcome game-changing drawbacks in this bullet-hell roguelike where the enemies evolve with you.

5097740.title: Potion Drifter
5097740.short_description: A cozy first-person alchemy game with hands-on physics. Cast out of the city of alchemists, travel from village to village with a fold-out cart. Throw herbs into your cauldron, pour water, and grind ingredients to brew potions for people you meet. Discover recipes, explore, and grow as an alchemist.

5097820.title: Astonishia Story
5097820.short_description: Relive this retro-styled RPG classic with refined visuals and other enhancements! The time has come to recover a stolen relic and your honor.

5097920.title: Scrap to Strip
5097920.short_description: Rescue a rust-bucket, build the engine bolt by bolt, and drag-race it for cash and pink slips. Hunt parts, tune it, and climb from parking-lot teens to King of the Strip — a nostalgic garage sim where every part, rival, and run is earned. Hand-built, no AI art.

5097940.title: Kristi Sky Islands
5097940.short_description: Kristi Sky Islands is a turn-based strategy game. Lead a group of heroes, face various foes, upgrade and equip your heroes, fuse your items to obtain higher-rarity items, and conquer bosses.

5098280.title: RIGGED2EXPLODE
5098280.short_description: A tactical shooter where running out of bullets sets off a bomb strapped to your chest. Sneak through levels, take out enemies, and use the environment to your gain the advantage. Take your time and make every bullet count.

5098410.title: Super Kanji Flash
5098410.short_description: A cute anime action runner where you fight off ink aliens by reading the kanji they stole. Answer each one with a single press mid-run, and your brush strikes the alien down. Learn 6,000+ kanji, from zero to JLPT N1 and beyond. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 8.

5098660.title: Five Hearts Under One Roof season3
5098660.short_description: Mal-sook and Gran return for the finale, feelings deeper than ever! After a work disaster, Yuman heads to Jeju with Gran, only for Mal-sook to appear and reignite their love triangle. New faces enter the mix as old bonds change. This time, choose where your heart belongs.

5099130.title: Fast Food Fortune
5099130.short_description: Fast Food Fortune is a simulation management game. Hire and train your crew. Upgrade and maintain your equipment. Unlock upgrades that will help you on your way. You are graded on how well you do and profits are multiplied. In order to be profitable you will have to lock in when you clock in!

5099140.title: Three Kingdoms Story
5099140.short_description: Choose a faction, recruit officers, raise troops, and conquer rival strongholds across board-style maps in large-scale real-time battles.

5099200.title: Everything We Brought Here
5099200.short_description: A last-stand auto-battler on a dead magic world. Choose your heroes, upgrade their abilities, and try to hold on one more night.

5099220.title: Five to Fire
5099220.short_description: A showdown of quick hands! The instant the table holds exactly five bullets, hit the lever and load your revolver. Shoot down every rival and survive as a gunslinging legend. A real-time multiplayer party game for 2-6 players.

5099280.title: Bake It Tight
5099280.short_description: A cute, real-time cookie factory puzzle. Animal customers keep pouring in, but you only have a few machines. Place them, link them to the ovens with rails, and bake the cookies your customers want. Can you fill every order on time?

5099410.title: Cargo Tempo
5099410.short_description: Turn delivery chaos into a plan that works. Assign orders, optimize routes and build your fleet in this route-planning management game. Plan at your own pace, then watch your vehicles put your decisions to the test across short, multi-day runs.

5099420.title: THE FIRST ZOMBIE
5099420.short_description: You are the walking dead—literally! In this casual action game, play as a cute zombie and take over the streets of Tokyo! Take down humans and animals, turn them into zombies, then build an ever-growing zombie horde!
developers: THE FIRST ZOMBIE 製作委員会
publishers: THE FIRST ZOMBIE 製作委員会

5099440.title: Lost Museum -Echoes of the Chromageists-
5099440.short_description: Forgotten masterpieces with stories still left to be told... Lost Museum -Echoes of the Chromageists- is an adventure game that tells the story of Chromageists, beings with strange faces born of paintings. Through their memories, unravel the meaning each piece of art holds.

5099810.title: Hearth Fable
5099810.short_description: Hearth Fable is an ink-wash city-building management sim. Start with a blank scroll: gather wood, build trades, govern people, raise exotic beasts, and repel invaders as you paint your mountain-and-sea scroll step by step toward a paradise of your dreams.

5099850.title: Simple Football League Manager
5099850.short_description: A football management game for people who love football but don't want to spend hours on every detail. Choose from 5,909 clubs, build your team, play in leagues and cups, and get insights from your assistant Rob. Includes 2 difficulty modes, local multiplayer and a customizable database.

5099900.title: Bundoro
5099900.short_description: A Pomodoro timer, desktop companion, and Steam Inventory game.

5099910.title: Mist Seekers
5099910.short_description: Venture into a forbidden zone shrouded in mist. Jump, wall-climb and dash, scavenge loot, and reach extraction before you fall. The fuller your pack, the more you stand to lose: push deeper, or extract now? Your haul makes the squad stronger, and rescued allies open paths you couldn't reach before.

5100090.title: The Painting War: Three Thrones
5100090.short_description: A grid-based formation-building autobattler set in the Three Kingdoms. Lay paper, scenery, and illustrated warriors onto a limited board, then rotate, merge, and connect them into an army. Your units fight automatically from their original tiles—study the outcome and rebuild for the next battle.

5100350.title: Fungus Co.
5100350.short_description: Grow and spread mycelium from spores across a dark substrate in this relaxing incremental.

5100730.title: Titan Sword
5100730.short_description: Sword. Giant. Boom. Grab a massive sword, hunt titans, and cut through everything in your way.

5100960.title: Projekt Gartenzwerg
5100960.short_description: Projekt Gartenzwerg is a co-op horde defense FPS for 1 to 4 players. Night falls, and thousands of ceramic garden gnomes march on your position. Grab a WW2 arsenal, build your defenses and hold the line until dawn, alone or with your friends.

5101030.title: Strategic Command: Korea
5101030.short_description: Command United Nations or Communist forces in the first major conflict of the Cold War. Fight across a vast, highly detailed map of Korea, master new units and mechanics, and reshape the course of the war from the Pusan Perimeter to the Chosin Reservoir and beyond.

5101130.title: Seaside Shop Simulator
5101130.short_description: Grow your very own seaside shop! Sell products, earn profits, expand your store, plan the layout, and experience the journey of building a successful business from the ground up.

5101170.title: Fangjie:Shattered Altars
5101170.short_description: Wake in a shattered voxel world and set out to restore its lost altars. Explore wilds that are different every time, shape your playstyle with a class, skill tree and styles, tame nearly forty companions, and take on bosses with NPC allies or friends on Steam.

5101300.title: Sideways Motorways
5101300.short_description: Turns and corners? No thank you! In this traffic-simulation game all roads are straight and cars never brake. A smart city planner like you would do the sensible thing and move the houses around instead, to avoid intersections. Or would you rather take the thrill of a close call for a higher score?

5101320.title: First-Person Jigsaw
5101320.short_description: Play jigsaw puzzles from a first-person perspective! Sort, organize, and assemble huge piles of pieces at your own pace. Chill out solo or play online with up to 16 players. Import your own images to create custom puzzles, then play them yourself or share them online.

5101340.title: Eye of the Giant
5101340.short_description: Put history on trial in a cosmic courtroom. Manipulate Sanity, Guilt, and Arrogance to psychologically dismantle legendary figures, uncover the truth, and deliver your verdict in this roguelike deckbuilder.

5101360.title: Break Free
5101360.short_description: Break Free is a First person speedrunning game about breaking free of your restraints, including the level itself.

5101550.title: Kaartel
5101550.short_description: Hunt a moving thief across Europe. Ask questions, eliminate cities, predict their next move, block escape routes, and intercept them before they get away.

5101720.title: CastleGuard: Operation Graveyard
5101720.short_description: CastleGuard: Operation Graveyard is a round-based co-op shooter in low-poly. Survive wave after wave, earn points for every hit and every kill, and spend them to push deeper into the base — before the next round starts.

5101750.title: Ramen Haven
5101750.short_description: Turn a humble ramen cart into the shop of your dreams in this cozy cooking and management game. Prepare delicious ramen, delight customers, unlock new recipes, upgrade and decorate your space, and grow your small business into a thriving restaurant.

5101860.title: Angry Tanks
5101860.short_description: Angry Tanks is an arcade tank shooter. Move forward, performing front flips and destroying enemy tanks.

5102190.title: YokaiRou: Shoppe of Mystique
5102190.short_description: A cozy supernatural mystery about listening to your customers' stories, uncovering the yokai troubling them through divination and deduction, and finding the right ritual to set things right.

5102750.title: Beach Manager Simulator
5102750.short_description: Clean, rent, build, and play! Run your own beach in this first-person management sim. Earn money from gear rentals, expand your facilities, hire staff, and tow banana boats full of guests. Go fishing, dig up treasure, and make the beach your own.

5103030.title: a sproutingale
5103030.short_description: A hand-made dual-story delivered through handwriting and mixed media illustrations: Ek'mer guides the fae-kind on their journey through Hell while two doctoral students, Gus & Gwen, become friends.

5103220.title: Skewered Up!
5103220.short_description: Stack absurd combos onto a skewer. Fill your inventory with unique ingredients and skewer them to discover deliciously broken synergies. Grill, cash out, upgrade your skewer, and serve customers with unique demands in this fast, physical roguelike deckbuilder. Easy to learn. Hard to Master.

5103280.title: Mercenary Galactic
5103280.short_description: Synergize your fleet and fight your way toward the notorious Blackstar! Mercenary Galactic is a starship autobattler featuring rogue-lite elements and powerful fleet customization. Upgrade, recruit, and optimize your way through the Velle galaxy and beyond.

5103520.title: POP ‘EM ALL
5103520.short_description: One million balloons. One tiny pin. Pop them all in a satisfying balloon-popping game! Who left them here, and why? Keep popping to uncover the mystery.

5103720.title: Tell me Your Tale
5103720.short_description: Take on the role of an F.T.I.D. inspector and uncover who truly belongs in the tales. Question characters, examine documents and appearances, find contradictions, and compare every detail with official records. At the end of each inspection, decide who is Original, Impostor, or Aberration.

5103780.title: Assault Commander RTS
5103780.short_description: Assault Commander RTS is a fast-paced real-time military strategy game. Fight a 30+ mission story campaign with two distinct factions, build and defend your base, command land, air and naval forces, unleash super weapons and climb the online leaderboards.

5104270.title: Demon Kitty: Trials!
5104270.short_description: Demon Kitty: Trials! is a hidden object adventure that plays like a roguelite. Help countless kitties across multiple runs, find lost objects in mysterious ancient ruins. Gain powers, transform your kitty, find the objects and collect as many kitties as you can!

5104350.title: The Last Code
5104350.short_description: Your gun shoots, pulls and pushes. Move objects and enemies, solve puzzles and use portals in this 2D sci-fi puzzle-platformer. You are an AI awakening on a space station overrun by machines.

5104370.title: Neironaut
5104370.short_description: Solve a mysterious case of disappearance with an unexpected help from your own dreams!

5104470.title: Odd Shop
5104470.short_description: Manage a haunted pawn shop in this cozy horror game. Cursed items are your most popular wares, but keeping them all under one roof can have deadly consequences. Upgrade and maintain the shop to build a retail reputation that cannot be denied...or make your money and get out before it’s too late.

5104500.title: Own The Map
5104500.short_description: Build a fictional property empire on the real-world map in this Early Access online tycoon. Claim locations, earn game cash and grow with a shared community. Active development: features may change, bugs may occur and progress may be reset.

5104590.title: SoulGraft
5104590.short_description: The spell-crafting bullet heaven where you earn your god-tier endgame. Graft runic circles to your soul, then unleash your creations on the daemonic hordes. Create 10^30 possible spell combinations and ascend to godhood.

5104650.title: Fluff 'N Tumble
5104650.short_description: Fluff ‘N Tumble is a one-vs-many online party game for friends who deserve each other. Tackle, hunt, or team up with your friends across a handful of cute, chaotic games. This is a collection of dynamic multiplayer party games, each one changing how one player takes on the rest of the party.

5104730.title: UNSEAM
5104730.short_description: An action platformer set in a world stitched shut. Ride the cracks your attacks leave for high-speed movement, carve terrain that falls the way you cut it, and journey to recover the memories of a girl who woke from her coffin.

5104790.title: Augment Mahjong
5104790.short_description: A single & multiplayer game blending Riichi Mahjong with a rule-breaking Augment system. Acquire cards each round to override the board's rules. Combine System Overrides and your Augments to create powerful synergies! Enjoy this thrilling variant with friends or sophisticated AI.

5104810.title: Radical Centrists
5104810.short_description: A deckbuilder where your cards are real politicians with questionably historical abilities. Discover new combos and accumulate wealth and influence. Push your luck with volatile politicians and make sure your party doesn't go off the deep end!

5104870.title: Pool Royalty: World Tour
5104870.short_description: Jump it. Curve it. Sink it. Then hear about it. Take on 24 rivals with real personalities on a 12-tournament World Tour, with authentic physics, official rules in six game types, online and couch multiplayer, and slow-mo replays you can save as GIFs.

5104900.title: Historiker
5104900.short_description: You have inherited a train station from a family that never mentioned it. Walk its platforms into Berlin, Paris, New York and Hong Kong across the last century, and learn how a single clue found in one decade rewrites the meaning of another.

5105050.title: Fish Tankfully
5105050.short_description: Fish Tankfully is a desktop idle aquarium sim that blends relaxing fishkeeping with a realistic ecosystem. Raise 200 ornamental fish, build tanks with plants, driftwood and gear, and manage lighting, filtration, stocking and compatibility with ease, even as a beginner.

5105100.title: Minesweeper Online
5105100.short_description: Minesweeper isn't a solitary game. Race on identical boards, cooperate with 2–8 players on a shared minefield, or clear a persistent world of 336 regions. Master advanced techniques, chase 3BV/s and IOE records, climb rankings, complete missions, unlock cosmetics, and play with friends.

5105140.title: Death Knell
5105140.short_description: A challenging gothic deckbuilding roguelike where your turn never ends. Collect cards to conquer rival cults and monstrous horrors and ascend to the realm of godhood in a decaying, abandoned world.

5105490.title: Sorcerous 2 City of Cults
5105490.short_description: Kick down doors, hunt sinister cults, and face bloodthirsty gods in a dark diesel-punk metropolis. Lead a group of magic-school students into turn-based battles with carefully chosen spells, talismans, and occult weapons.

5106100.title: Rage and Fury
5106100.short_description: Rage and Fury is a fast-paced 2D beat ’em up built like a lost ’90s action movie. Fight through the streets, unleash devastating combos, turn the environment into a weapon, and follow Logan Hunter through a cinematic story packed with action, attitude and humor.

5106440.title: Atomic Hockey
5106440.short_description: Every hockey player is strapped to their own rail. So what now? You pass... and you pass before the bomb goes off under your stick. Atomic Hockey is a wild couch game for up to 12 people. Each of you controls hockey players on rails, trying to beat the other team. Usually not the way you’d expect.

5106460.title: Feet in Food
5106460.short_description: What could possibly be better than food? That’s right! Feet in food! LOTS OF FEET! Create food arrangements around the girls, then wash their feet clean of all the food and sauces afterward. You wouldn’t want them to stay dirty, would you?

5106490.title: Her Milk, My Coffee
5106490.short_description: The tastiest coffee is made with milk. Or, more precisely, with her milk... Brew coffee, add all kinds of ingredients, serve it to cats, and make money. And you are going to need a lot of money, because you will be spending it all on gifts to take the cow girl on dates.

5106500.title: Misohagi Crossing
5106500.short_description: On his first visit to his father's rural hometown in seven years, Hotaru reunites with his first love—only to learn that she died three years ago. Explore Yokomizo, uncover the truth behind a family tragedy, and escape supernatural otherworlds in this Japanese horror mystery adventure.

5106680.title: DIGITRE:SUM 10/20
5106680.short_description: Link adjacent numbers to total 10 or 20 on a rising board—a fast math action puzzle. Build CHAINs, collect TARGETs, chase SCORE, and cut CLEAR TIME. Soon, 10s and 20s jump out at you. Classic arcade play where every run shows your progress. Includes VS, PUZZLE, 50-clear BLITZ, and ENDLESS.

5106760.title: Tip-Top Tortoise Truck
5106760.short_description: Tip-Top Tortoise Truck is a grid-based puzzle game where you rescue toppled tortoises and send them home while keeping track of your fuel! Venture through the arid desert, drive through portals, and find your lost lunchboxes. Will you find out exactly who tipped all the tortoises over?

5106780.title: Pikapo
5106780.short_description: Pikapo is an incremental underwater exploration game. Dive into the abyssal depths and discover the creatures that inhabit them. Create chain reactions using waves to collect resources, purchase upgrades, and progress deeper.

5107070.title: Dicey Darlings
5107070.short_description: Dicey Darlings is a tabletop-style, turn-based tactical roguelike. Lead standees across hex battlefields as physical dice tumble into play. Choose your route, combine skills and items, and use positioning and terrain to beat tough foes. The dice bring chance. You choose your next move.

5107380.title: Spirit Fox
5107380.short_description: Spirit Fox is a short, atmospheric, third-person narrative adventure in which you step into the paws of a young fox who, following an unexpected tragedy, finds himself completely alone in an unfamiliar place. What lies in store in this place?

5107550.title: Chase Buddies
5107550.short_description: Team up as four magical Runners or become the Chaser in a colorful 1v4 multiplayer game of pursuit, powers, and narrow escapes. Activate Obelisks, rescue your friends, outsmart your rival, and reach the exit before the chase is over.

5108020.title: Brute Tusk : Feral
5108020.short_description: Play a wild boar in an open wilderness: click to run and forage, right-click to dodge or wind up a charge—smash obstacles and send wolves flying. Eat your fill, pick evolution upgrades, and fight through four seasons to topple each land’s apex predator.

5108590.title: Drellnathor
5108590.short_description: Drellnathor is a roguelite dungeon crawler where you grow stronger between runs. Kill monsters, collect loot, and slay powerful bosses for permanent upgrades. Can you discover why you're trapped in a cycle of life and death?

5108680.title: Maybe... I'll go to the beach
5108680.short_description: It's a perzine-like spatial programming puzzle game about my experience of being an artist in the present landscape.

5108770.title: THE CROSSING
5108770.short_description: Explore a world inspired by the landscapes of the Gobi Desert behind the wheel of a rally car. Find your way using nothing more than a paper map, amongst vast steppes and seas of dunes. A sensitive and intimate story of Misheel’s return to the land of her childhood.

5108820.title: Explosive Express
5108820.short_description: Explosive Express is a chaotic 1–4 player co-op physics game where tiny workers transport unstable bombs through a giant world. Work together, load the van, survive the hazards, and get the bomb home before time runs out.

5109330.title: C3 Nightfall
5109330.short_description: Collect relics. Combine their powers. Forge magical weapons. Fight monsters from beyond the skies in a third-person medieval fantasy adventure. Survive the night, harvest Cosmic Crystals, and reclaim the King's castle from the creatures that fell from the comet cloud.

5109440.title: One More Planet
5109440.short_description: Mine asteroids, build defenses, and conquer planets across distant galaxies. Explore open space, complete missions, unlock new technologies, and defend your settlements against attackers. One More Planet is an action & exploration game set in a physics-driven 2D space sandbox.

5109630.title: Orbit Anomaly
5109630.short_description: Orbit Anomaly is a cooperative sci-fi horror game about robots exploring abandoned space facilities, scavenging scrap to upgrade their base, and trying not to become prey for the monsters lurking within.

5109810.title: Punching a Dirty Wizard
5109810.short_description: The Dirty Wizard wants you to punch him, he wants you to kill him. One strike at a time.

5109940.title: A Normal Quiz Game where you try to solve questions but the questions have tricks and gimmicks and if you get them wrong you have to beat a wacky punishment but they are kinda fun so you lowkey wanna do them even if it means getting the question wrong.
5109940.short_description: Solve puzzles, test your reflexes, and do your taxes in this normal quiz game that is actually quite unusual.

5110030.title: Echo Era
5110030.short_description: Build a party, explore a kingdom under tyranny, and choose your battles in this classic-style JRPG. Recruit adventurers by class, uncover side quests and secrets, and face enemies in turn-based combat. The goddess has called, now lead your journey to where ever it may end.

5110040.title: Make Them Mine
5110040.short_description: An incremental game where you build slime-shooting cannons to mine gold... wait, what? That's right: build cannons on a grid and shoot slimes to mine gold, smash enemies and activate mysterious mechanisms. Complete the skill tree to unlock new cannons, slime upgrades, and new mechanics.

5110050.title: Armada Ascendant
5110050.short_description: Command modular fleets in a top-down tactics game where every shot is aimed by hand. Build warships socket by socket, flick projectiles across drifting battlefields, and carry damage, veterans, and hard choices through a 60-mission campaign.

5110140.title: Plinko Mining
5110140.short_description: Drop pickaxes, mine resources, and grow your mining empire! Plinko Mining is a relaxing incremental idle game where axes bounce through rocks, extracting valuable resources with every hit. Unlock new axes, increase your production, and expand your Skill Tree to become a mining master!

5110190.title: Marry Anyone
5110190.short_description: Get married within one month—or lose your job!? Solve puzzles, use items, and change your stats (Intelligence, Age, Cleanliness, Height, and Income) as you work your way toward marriage in this matchmaking puzzle game!

5110200.title: La Bidouillerie
5110200.short_description: A real electronics simulator: build robots, a 1970s pinball table and a 1980s dart machine from real parts (solenoids, gears, connecting rods, relays, transistors). Wire the circuit, switch on, find out why it won't run: every current is computed, every fault has a cause.

5110250.title: Timberlord Clicker
5110250.short_description: An idle clicker about cutting down trees. As a newly appointed noble, tame the wilderness, build your domain, and unlock new technologies. Recruit unique characters, uncover their secrets, and fight the corruption spreading through the forest.

5110300.title: RecycleShopECO
5110300.short_description: 3-Match Puzzle × Human Observation × Horror Novel Recycle Shop ECO is a binary art style 3-match puzzle and horror novel game. Fulfill customers' requests, gather information about them, and explore a hidden world of horror.

5110640.title: Royal Bomb Squad POP!
5110640.short_description: Blast colorful jawbreakers in this cartoon bubble shooter! Eight delightful weirdos with eight different playstyles, across Story, Score Attack, Time Attack, and head-to-head VS modes - on the couch or online with Remote Play Together! The Dream Kingdom is counting on you!

5110750.title: Coinfetti
5110750.short_description: A pinball city-builder roguelike. Build your district and send customers bouncing through it. Every hit triggers a chain of spending. The denser your city gets, the better it feels, until the screen floods with coins. The neon never dims. The crowds keep coming. Happiness is counted in coins.

5110980.title: Fieldmade
5110980.short_description: Everything in this world is something you drew. Sketch a hoe and till the soil with it. Sketch an axe, a watering can, a fishing rod... and they become real, working tools with real stats. You can draw literally anything you want.

5111040.title: Echoes of Aether
5111040.short_description: A hardcore indie action RPG exploring a post-purification world and uncovering the truth.

5111070.title: Rokujo Hitoma
5111070.short_description: A 1-bit action-adventure, a shy shut-in descending from his tiny six-tatami room into the underground. Top-down exploration, enemy battles, key hunting, and the power of true friendship. (There is no friendship.)

5111190.title: MASA
5111190.short_description: In a world where magic lives through the power of the spirits, you are a mage of the battlefield. MASA is a strategy card game set in a fantasy world. Use the power of the elements and magic to earn the most victory points across five battles.

5111280.title: Dear My Son
5111280.short_description: Raise a family, carry on through generations, and fight demons to break a curse passed down through your bloodline in this family legacy simulation game.

5111450.title: Driver Wars
5111450.short_description: A chaotic and satirical late-stage capitalistic driving simulator. In this low-poly 3D world, live out the fantasies and nightmares of countless commuters gridlocked in traffic as you ram, blow up, set ablaze, toss donuts at, honk, grapple, and total hordes of terrible and aggressive NPC drivers.

5111580.title: Mindvale
5111580.short_description: Master frantic bullet-hell runs, turn hard-won knowledge into game-breaking builds and bring resources back to the surface. Craft, expand your base against the ever-enclosing corruption, produce more to heal your land’s mysterious affliction and defeat the Death Core.

5111640.title: Ledger of Names
5111640.short_description: You've taken over your uncle's shop for 100 days. Stock up from your suppliers, read what customers really need, and set your own prices. Follow the town's news, grow your trade partners, and keep the shelves ready. As the fog thickens, one sale today can change someone's tomorrow.

5111810.title: Hanafuda Solitaire
5111810.short_description: Ever wished Hanafuda had a way to play alone? Capture pairs and form yaku in pure Hanafuda, with new rules that let you play it solo, solitaire-style.

5112120.title: 28 Days Train Wreck Survivor
5112120.short_description: A hardcore first-person survival simulator. Explore a wrecked freight train, loot containers, hunt, gather resources, craft weapons and gear, and manage hunger, thirst, fatigue, and warmth to make it through 28 days of cold and predators.

5112150.title: Steel Wolverines: Modern Armored Combat
5112150.short_description: A turn-based tactical wargame inspired by the classics of the 1990s. Build your own battlegroup and fight on a modern battlefield where detecting the enemy, choosing the right weapon, and landing the first accurate shot decide the outcome.

5112250.title: Trinity Descent
5112250.short_description: A dark idle RPG about descending into the deep: assemble a party from ten classes, pick your route through branching zones and let them fight on their own. Bank your loot in time or lose it all. Enhance your gear, forge the great sets and climb down the Endless Mine.

5112440.title: Neon Gamble Trail
5112440.short_description: Cyberpunk roguelike slot game. Enter a neon tavern. Roll three numbers 1–9 for winning combos to battle rivals. Collect numbers and tokens to strengthen your build. Explore branching paths, encounter random events, and recover at supply stops. Strategize, spin reels, and create an unbeatable lineup.

5112580.title: Cozy Island Cleaner
5112580.short_description: Cozy Island Cleaner is a relaxing game where you clean up a trash-covered island with the help of the cat who lives there. Collect the trash on the beach, upgrade your gear, and restore the island to its former beauty step by step.

5112790.title: Pray & Slay
5112790.short_description: Wipe out hordes of monsters with holy magic in this action-packed incremental game. Multiply your gold with darts and grow stronger with every run. Corrupt your holy spells to unleash devastating dark powers.

5112950.title: Camedieo
5112950.short_description: A score chase roguelike deckbuilder played with dice. Every hand splits in two: the dice you Cast and the ones you Outcast. The points from each are multiplied together to produce your score. Collect cameos, upgrade your deck using cups and try to break the scoreboard!

5113210.title: MEGALITH
5113210.short_description: Traverse an endless winter alongside the last human on Earth.

5113330.title: Empty Throne
5113330.short_description: Create your hero, recruit a warband and lead them across a dying kingdom. Battles unfold in real time in 3D while you play cards from your hand. If your hero falls, the run is over.

5113410.title: Incident 24
5113410.short_description: （This game does not use AI.）A hand-drawn 2D action platformer set in a sci-fi world. Explore the perilous Ancient Ruins No. 24, master fluid movement to dodge deadly traps, and utilize precise combat mechanics to fight mutated monsters for survival.

5113550.title: SOGUL: Den of the Deep
5113550.short_description: Fight with your right hand, keep the beat with your left. Every note you land sharpens your strike — and every enemy blow can be parried on rhythm. Descend 50 floors to the Lich below with four companions you named yourself, in this rhythm-driven turn-based roguelite.

5113920.title: Frathouse Beerpong
5113920.short_description: 4 player beerpong. frathouse rules. public lobbies. proximity chat. beer(s).

5114190.title: The Word
5114190.short_description: Decipher hundreds of cryptograms that recount the story of Jesus Christ. From His birth and baptism, to His many healings and teachings, and ultimately to His death and resurrection.

5114510.title: My Empire MUST Grow
5114510.short_description: Your village is tiny, and that is a problem, because it MUST become an empire. Three neighbouring kingdoms disagree. Gather, build, raise the walls, hold the waves and finish the Wonder before they burn it all down.

5114540.title: Champion Trainer
5114540.short_description: The next level of horse racing sims. Genuine Thoroughbred lineages spanning over 300 years, 30 real UK/IRE courses featuring full race calendars, online head to heads, Mendelian and polygenic inheritance, Chef-de-Race dosage, Bruce Lowe families, nicks built from real-world race records... and more.

5114640.title: Ever Closer Union
5114640.short_description: Ever Closer Union is a turn-based political strategy game where you slip into the role of the President of the European Commission and guide the EU through the next term. Win over 27 member states, push your Agenda forward, deal with events and both national and European Parliament elections.

5114950.title: Desktop Buddy
5114950.short_description: Desktop buddy is an active sandbox companion game where you can paint, shoot, crush and decorate your very own ragdoll on your desktop. Use familiar paint tools to fully customize your desktop buddy to your liking so you can treat it well, or don't.

5115040.title: Quest Dice
5115040.short_description: A solo gamebook with a real, physics-rolled d20. Read the story, make your choices, roll the dice and live with the result. Create your hero, play handcrafted adventures in 22 languages, or write and share your own books.

5115440.title: Duck Duck Shoot!
5115440.short_description: A top-down 2D Survivors-like where you play as a chicken! Face hordes of menacing poultry and collect powerful upgrades in an attempt to get stronger. Fight bosses, choose your own upgrades, and bring a couple together? Get ready to Duck Duck Shoot!

5115560.title: Arcade Vault Manager
5115560.short_description: Arcade Vault Manager:Game Sell Simulator is a cozy management game where you buy, inspect, collect, price, and sell games and consoles. Design and expand your store, adapt to changing customer demands across new generations, build a development team, and create games and sell them in your own store.

5115580.title: Hypnagogia 催眠術
5115580.short_description: Hypnagogia is a short, surreal, and explorative platforming game involving deep dreams, liminal spaces, and sleep paralysis demons. Navigate strange worlds, chat with weird folk, discover secrets, and escape before your nightmares finally take hold.

5116080.title: Civil Twilight
5116080.short_description: Go into a fog-sealed city every night and carry salvage back out. You only see what your flashlight touches, you can't shoot while your hands are full, and every gunshot calls the anomalies. Find an exit before sunrise. Solo or up to 4 players.

5116390.title: Newton Street
5116390.short_description: Newton Street is a game about the cruel treatment of people, their lives, and the power that doesn’t always cope with everything.

5116420.title: Dirty Derby
5116420.short_description: Dirty Derby is a multiplayer party game for 2-4 players. Read the animals that line up differently each round, and shape the finish order your contract demands. Grab your gear and jump onto the track — knock down anyone in your way. Only results remain: outdo the rest and prove yourself.

5116770.title: Blooming Solitude: Priestess of Hanafuda / 花札ノ巫孤
5116770.short_description: Hanafuda × Roguelite × Action! Explore dungeons, collect Hanafuda cards, and grow stronger as a Miko. Battle enemies with the power of your cards, then face powerful bosses in Hanafuda battles. Form winning hands and unleash devastating attacks!

5116890.title: PaintScape
5116890.short_description: PaintScape is a 3D coloring book you can step into. Every map starts as a blank line drawing. Pick any brush and paint freely, or color by numbers. As you paint, sleepy flowers wake up and little chimneys begin to puff smoke. Walk around inside your painting, where every mistake is a happy accident.

5116920.title: Pixel Sky Waystation
5116920.short_description: Become the new manager of the Sky Island, make warm food and cool drinks there, and help those traveling long roads rest comfortably

5117390.title: CARNAGE
5117390.short_description: Fast isometric crash-for-cash arcade action. Floor it, smash traffic, steer your burning wreck into the city's most expensive real estate, and rack up a multi-million dollar repair bill. Drive, crash, upgrade, repeat.

5117420.title: Farmbound
5117420.short_description: An addictive idle farming simulation where you build a massive agricultural empire from a single wheat plot. Harvest crops, adopt cute animals, automate production, unlock powerful skills, and prestige to multiply your yields into astronomical profits.

5117490.title: Punch The Monkey
5117490.short_description: Action boss rush game where every fight is a final boss. Throw bananas, dodge attacks, and learn the patterns of hostile animal bosses in the zoo. You have one goal. Find your stolen plushie.

5117520.title: Dude, Trust Me
5117520.short_description: Get hopelessly misunderstood by your two best friends. One of you goes blind, one goes deaf, one loses their voice, and no puzzle here can be solved by one person. Can the three of you work out how to understand each other?

5117550.title: Fart Together
5117550.short_description: Fart Together is a physics-based co-op game where 2–4 players steer a shared raft using fart power. Coordinate your direction, timing and gas power with friends to overcome challenging obstacle courses.

5117630.title: Gamble Hunters
5117630.short_description: A first-person casino action roguelite for 1-4 players. One wallet, four hunters, zero trust. Hunt monsters for 60 seconds to fill the shared pot, then race your friends to gamble it into your own Gold. Upgrade guns, mix traits and artifacts, beat bosses, and pay off the shared debt or go bust.

5117710.title: Lost Cat Showa Town
5117710.short_description: Explore a nostalgic Japanese town as a cat! Wander through the streets, climb onto rooftops, interact with other cats, find food, and discover all kinds of little adventures in Lost Cat Showa Town.

5117720.title: Dreadmark
5117720.short_description: A top-down gothic action RPG set over one long night, in a parish that raised its own dead. The big enemies show where each blow will land, loot gets better the deeper you go, and every endgame map lays out a new road. On hardcore a death is permanent, and the live ladder remembers it.

5117740.title: The Golden Seam
5117740.short_description: A quiet game about mending what's broken and learning to wear the seams. Turn each fracture, slide the pieces home and seal the crack in gold. No timers, no score, no way to fail. Break and mend. The gold remembers.

5117760.title: Alchemist's Apprentice
5117760.short_description: The classroom is a mess! You’d think a troll had been through it. Sort the potions, tidy the shelves and brew up a little chaos in this cozy game about an alchemist’s apprentice. Class is nearly in session, and there’s so much to do!

5117810.title: Frankenship
5117810.short_description: A co-op space mining game for 1-4 players, on one couch or online. Drill through hostile moons, blast crystal seams open and haul the ore home to your patched-together ship while the hive closes in. Then run for the pod.

5118460.title: Snap Scrap
5118460.short_description: Online co-op mech sandbox for 1-4 players. Loot scrap from dwarf planets, snap it onto your mech piece by piece, and survive against packs of scavenger drones.

5118580.title: ARCHSCROLL
5118580.short_description: An indie action RPG set in a fantasy world. Experience a deep storyline and immersive action featuring beautiful characters and environments!

5118590.title: Night Drive VR - Anomaly
5118590.short_description: Night Drive VR - Anomaly is a supernatural driving horror game where you must navigate a mysterious endless night, spot anomalies, choose the right road, and survive until morning to escape the loop.

5118600.title: Prism Panic
5118600.short_description: A fast-paced arcade shooter where you blast through waves of baddies, collect power-ups, survive curses, and chase the high score. Easy to pick up, hard to put down.

5118690.title: Randventure
5118690.short_description: Randventure is a 1-bit, turn-based roguelite played in a single swipe: slide your heroes left or right to make your choices. Build your team of three heroes, journey through three acts, evolve them along the way, and overcome every obstacle on your road.

5118820.title: FIND ALL 10: Greece
5118820.short_description: Immerse yourself in an exciting adventure in Find All 10: Greece. You will explore an ancient Greek city, the colorful streets of a historic town and the unique scenery of a modern Greek city. Look for hidden objects and color this mysterious painted world.

5118950.title: Slips Happen
5118950.short_description: Penguins weren’t made for climbing. Except this one! Run, slide and build momentum to nail your jumps and reach the top of a slippery mountain. Be careful as one bad landing can send you tumbling all the way back down! Slips will happen. A lot.

5119040.title: Dreamcore: Liminal Spaces
5119040.short_description: Step into a surreal dreamlike world in this atmospheric walking simulator. Explore strange liminal spaces, wander through mysterious environments, and experience a world where reality follows the rules of a dream.

5119550.title: Soul of Slime
5119550.short_description: Build your slime with cards, combine six elements and watch your strategy unfold in automatic battles. Survive 10 rounds, then take the same build into Endless mode and push on for as long as your lives last.

5119720.title: Warlords Gambit
5119720.short_description: Lead the heroes of the Three Kingdoms against an invading Abyss in this roguelite strategy game. Build powerful teams, plan formations, combine heroes, equipment, treasures, and Seals, explore changing maps, and overcome bosses with unique mechanics.

5119840.title: Blackpaw
5119840.short_description: A short stealth horror game. You are a cat searching for your three kittens in a darkening forest. Meowing is the only way to find them — and the only way to be found. A black panther hunts by sound. Stay low in the tall grass, climb to look, and carry them home one by one.

5119880.title: Comic Shop Tycoon
5119880.short_description: Run the comic shop of your dreams! Discover collectible back issues, build your collection, prepare for New Comic Book Day, and stock comics, figures, dice, and RPG books. Set prices, serve customers, customize your store, and turn a small shop into a thriving business.

5120270.title: National Volley
5120270.short_description: Take charge of Japan's national volleyball team in this management sim. Discover promising players, select and train your squad, and pursue the world title. Watch the team you built take the court in fully simulated 3D matches. Japanese language only.

5120320.title: Faultfinder
5120320.short_description: She kept the machine that holds the city up for eleven years, and last night it killed her. You have her program and a recording of everything it did. Work back through it until you can point at the line that did it, then prove it. You never write any code, you only read hers.

5120610.title: HYPERSCALE
5120610.short_description: Build infastructure, manage the grid, fight thermal runaway, and keep the community alive. This is a data centre and grid management simulator/idle clicker

5120680.title: Dead & Delicious
5120680.short_description: Dead & Delicious is a chaotic co-op burger shop simulator for 1-4 players. Serve customers out front while zombies pour in from the back. Shoot them, slice them apart, and feed the pieces into the grinder. Fresh patties, happy customers, and nobody ever asks where the meat came from.

5120800.title: Below Lethe
5120800.short_description: The River Lethe holds memories of the dead. Use its memories to uncover what happened and prove a soul's guilt in the Underworld. His guilt seemed clear—until truth shook the verdict. Knowing all the truth, can you still call him guilty? A story-driven psychological horror about memory and judgment.

5120820.title: Grumble Burger
5120820.short_description: Grumble Burger is a first-person cooking thriller where you take over your late Uncle Frank's food truck. Frank believed the bond between cook and customer was paramount. However, you'll soon discover that orders are handled differently here. And the customers are not your typical diner patrons...

5120880.title: Dungeon Flow: Vertical Idle
5120880.short_description: Dungeon Flow is a vertical idle dungeon crawler where Blackstep fights automatically while you shape the build. Explore the Forgotten Crypts, collect and equip loot, face escalating encounters, elites and bosses, and push deeper with every run.

5121150.title: Twilight Tavern
5121150.short_description: Run a shop for supernatural customers in a cozy first-person sim. Stock shelves, brew potions, haggle over prices, and spot counterfeit coins. Shape each day with magical charms, explore a curious village and snowy floating islands, and follow Aunt Hesper’s trail through hidden paths and puzzles.

5121190.title: Sort Cats Together
5121190.short_description: A toy store full of cats needs sorting! Play solo or team up with friends in this cozy 1–4 player co-op game. Find 200 different cat designs, sort 4,000 toys onto their matching shelves, and unlock upgrades to turn a mountain of cats into a tidy collection.

5121300.title: Winnie's Arcade Pizza
5121300.short_description: Run your newly bought old arcade pizza center, restore it back to it's former glory and find out about the strange past behind the walls of this place. fill the place up with arcades and pizzas and keep your customers happy. See if you can you reach the perfect end, or the worst...

5121370.title: DES: Hyperspace Racer
5121370.short_description: A 6DOF space racing game built around pure piloting skill. Race through procedurally generated tracks, master extreme turns, beat your best times, and compete against other pilots in multiplayer.

5121450.title: Industeria
5121450.short_description: Build and defend a growing industrial colony on a hostile alien world. Mine resources, automate production lines, expand a massive factory, and protect your territory from relentless alien attacks in this top-down 3D strategy game.

5122020.title: GNAP GNAP
5122020.short_description: GNAP GNAP is a horde roguelite shooter where you pop ominous balloons that keep multiplying. Unlock items, harpoons and grow stronger with each run. Equip your harpoon, max your stats and defeat all the entities keeping you against your will.

5122120.title: Sussy NPC
5122120.short_description: You're a sussy NPC in a crowd of NPCs. Hunters are hunting you. Act normal, blend in, don't flinch. Or be the Hunter, read the room and catch them. In-game voice chat is recommended for the best experience.

5122900.title: Tide of the Depths
5122900.short_description: Build a team of mighty sea creatures in a lane-based tower defense where the battlefield reshapes your strategy. Harness environmental powers, trigger elemental chain reactions, and adapt your defenders to stop the corruption.

5123030.title: Saboteer
5123030.short_description: A 3-12 player extraction game about digging for treasure as a loyal team of dwarves... Or most of you are loyal anyway; someone is secretly trying to sabotage the group. Explore and excavate, scavenge for items and treasure, and put your perception and deception skills to the test.

5123170.title: Autolantis
5123170.short_description: Welcome to Autolantis, a light roguelite strategy city builder where you rule an isolated continent and forge an empire of your own. Shape its future through Tiles, Workers, and Policies, unleash explosive automated production, and lead your empire to the pinnacle of civilization.

5123310.title: Trash to Trees: Tidy up the forest!
5123310.short_description: Clean up, sort, recycle, and restore the forest in this cozy tidy-up simulator with over 10,000 trash items. Unlock abilities to improve your efficiency. Enjoy the satisfying experience of bringing the forest back to life at your own pace, alone or with friends.

5123340.title: BAKA TAO
5123340.short_description: What begins as an ordinary road trip slowly takes an unsettling turn when an unexpected encounter leaves you searching for answers in the surrounding wilderness.

5123690.title: Ember Gold Valkyrie
5123690.short_description: "Ember Gold Valkyrie" is a 2.5D pixel-art roguelite action game where you aim for the top of the arena with diverse skills. Saddled with a billion-gold debt, a young girl fights on for her freedom and wish in an arena where victory means gold.

5123730.title: Altstadt
5123730.short_description: A tiny old town that grows under your hands. Set down a house, then another, let a canal wander through, and stay for dusk, when the windows light up one by one. Nothing to manage. Just building.

5123870.title: You Should Have Stopped
5123870.short_description: A turn-based roguelite with one simple bet, over and over: stake your health, gold or attack, watch the number climb, and stop before it crashes. Your enemies are parts of your own body. Hand-drawn, sketchy and ugly.

5124000.title: 太一剑歌
5124000.short_description: 《太一剑歌》是一款独特的东方幻想开放世界MMORPG！游戏拥有超过6万平方公里的超大无缝地图，你将在这个充满剑与魔法的世界中展开一场惊险刺激的自由冒险之旅！你的每一个行为将影响周围的世界，并决定这个世界的未来！

5124080.title: Blackbeam
5124080.short_description: BLACKBEAM is a light top-down sci-fi action adventure. Drive a rover, smash crystals, battle alien wildlife, expand your base, and venture ever farther. Explore more freely by day. At night, darkness, energy demands, and hostile creatures raise the stakes.

5124170.title: Paw's Boba Shop
5124170.short_description: Paw's Boba Shop is a boba shop management game where you can mix tea bases and serve drinks to cute animal customers. Muddle fruit, juice fruit, blend smoothies, and top drinks with candy, cookies, and more. No timers. No pressure. Play at your own pace.

5124310.title: Bartend With Your Friends
5124310.short_description: Online 1-4 player co-op robot-bartender roguelike full of physics-driven chaos. Work together to mix drinks, manage demanding customers, and pick upgrades to hit the bar's daily quota before your shift ends - or the bar shuts down for good.

5124450.title: Maid Mech : Backpack TD
5124450.short_description: Maid Mech: Backpack TD – A grid tower defense game. Lead the last Dragoon maid mecha against mutant hordes. Collect shape modules after each wave, build defenses on a 14×7 grid, and deploy mecha to fight automatically. Backpack management meets tactical TD.

5124580.title: Überlauf
