5235560.short_description: Activate beacons, summon the horde, and shoot your way out! Survive a 25-day train journey in this first-person zombie shooter. Return aboard between battles to gear up and shape your build. Fulfill a mysterious company's contract and reach the survivors' camp alive.

5235620.title: The Goodnight Potion
5235620.short_description: The Goodnight Potion! is a pixel-art fantasy puzzle game in which you help an old mage with a troubling potion addiction. Choose which potion to drink first, combine elemental reactions, and use spells and transformations to survive until the next night.

5235780.title: Voodoo You Chasing?
5235780.short_description: Voodoo You Chasing? is a freeze tag game but someone brought magic and bad decision-making. Play as a Wizard: collect glyphs to complete the ritual. Or be the Voodoo Hunter: capture them all to protect your mojo.

5235830.title: Sword Dancer
5235830.short_description: Inspired by Gongsun Daniang, the legendary sword dancer of Tang Dynasty China. Chart her blade-dance through enemy ranks—every step is set before the first strike. Route planning × roguelite building: choreograph the perfect dance, then watch it cut through the chaos.

5235870.title: Bottled Gleams
5235870.short_description: A cozy incremental idle game for your desktop. Cats collect dried fish in the Cat Squeeze bottle. Pick one up and pet it. In the Deck of Harvest bottle, moles mine and ship goods for coins. Tap keys or click to boost yields. Spend idle earnings on capsules for skins, weather and decorations.

5235890.title: Before Dawn Bakery
5235890.short_description: Flour, heat, and bake away the hours before sunrise. A cozy solo baking sim where every stage — ferment, proof, bake, cool — has its own feel and timing, and one pair of hands to meet them all. Fill the morning's orders and close out before the town wakes.

5235910.title: Whisperborne
5235910.short_description: Turn-based collection JRPG on a continent the gods walked away from. Gather the lost heirs of the Sword-King, build a ten-slot weapon board for each of six elements, and raid alongside up to 30 players against the things still walking through Mira.
developers: Liufenyu Games 六分鱼游戏工作室

5236190.title: Power Showdown
5236190.short_description: Power Showdown is a turn-based tactical superhero strategy game where positioning, powers, terrain, and team composition determine every battle.Build a squad from a growing collection of heroes and villains. Build your team. Master your powers. Win the showdown.

5236290.title: EchoMon: Pack & Stack!
5236290.short_description: Transform a chaotic store into a pristine collector's haven. EchoMon is a cozy first-person shop simulator where you organize an incredible 3,600 elemental trading cards. Upgrade your skills, unleash magical sorting abilities, and experience the pure satisfaction of a perfect shelf.

5236400.title: 无冕之龙 | Uncrowned Dragon
5236400.short_description: Uncrowned Dragon is a fantasy CRPG in development. Lead a six-person party across a land scarred by fallen dragons, awaken dragon powers, and create your own class builds. Switch between real-time with pause and turn-based modes outside combat.

5236420.title: Packlore
5236420.short_description: Packlore is a cozy incremental TCG where you open magical booster packs! Earn money from cards, upgrade, and hire helpers. Can you complete the collection and uncover the mystery of the secret page?

5236520.title: After closing
5236520.short_description: After Closing is a 1–4 player co-op horror puzzle game. Explore an abandoned amusement park, solve puzzles, avoid the clown, and escape together.

5236550.title: THE IRON GAMES
5236550.short_description: The Iron Games is a medieval battle royale where 24 players fight to the death. Loot armor and weapons, build unique combinations to become as strong as possible, and fight to be the last team alive.

5236670.title: COILBREAKER
5236670.short_description: A survivor roguelite where you steer a scrap-metal snake through hordes of machines. Its weapons fire on their own, and where they sit on the head, body or tail changes how they fire.

5236940.title: Coming Through!
5236940.short_description: You're a little penguin plotting world domination. First things first: get out of the zoo. And cause a little trouble for the humans while you're at it.

5237210.title: Tamer Survivors
5237210.short_description: Team up with adorable animal companions and combine their abilities to defeat hordes of trash monsters! Evolve a variety of weapons, create a new build with every run, and cleanse a polluted world in this casual roguelite survival action game.

5237500.title: Folder Escape
5237500.short_description: "Wait, this is a game?" A puzzle game played inside a file explorer. Rename files, change extensions, show hidden items and switch view modes to escape each folder your own way. 30 stages, and every fifth one is a .zip that demands all of it at once.

5237520.title: Leila's Adventure
5237520.short_description: Join Leila on a colourful 3D platforming adventure inspired by collectathons of the 90s. Explore vibrant levels, collect treasures, overcome obstacles and uncover secrets as you journey across unique worlds.

5237600.title: Warring Kingdoms: Chronicles of War
5237600.short_description: A RPG where you build and rule a fantasy kingdom, manage resources, command large-scale battles, and use your character's abilities to change the course of war.

5237650.title: Demon Slayer Rome
5237650.short_description: A dark fantasy turn-based RPG. Battle demons and absorb their abilities, uncover secrets and progress in power, and save an Empire lost to sin as you go up against eight demon princes and the hordes of Hades! Demon Slayer Rome is turn-based Mega Man set in the time of the Roman Empire.

5237680.title: Deepdelver
5237680.short_description: Deepdelver is a 2D pixel-art action-RPG about mining, crafting, and fighting your way through a mysterious dungeon. Break stone, harvest rare ores, and upgrade your gear between runs as you dig deeper than ever before.

5237800.title: hooooook
5237800.short_description: Gold Miner + Roguelike — Classic hook-and-grab gameplay fused with roguelike building. Hooks with unique abilities ; hundreds of relics can be freely combined to forge your own playstyle. Venture deep into the earth — mines, swamps, tombs… each new zone hides its own mechanics and threats.

5238110.title: Roll N' Rage
5238110.short_description: A difficult physics-based platforming game about a golf ball's journey home. Roll, fall, rage, repeat... or quit. It's up to you.

5238330.title: Incremental Dungeoncrawler
5238330.short_description: An Incremental Party-Based RPG inside an endless ASCII dungeon. Command a squad of 4 unique heroes, crawl through procedurally generated grids, and strategically unlock massive, custom skill trees. No mindless backtracking! Only forward progression, permanent prestige, and numbers going up!

5238790.title: Everlasting Curse
5238790.short_description: Enter the witch’s hidden house, explore mysterious parallel worlds, switch between day and night, solve unique puzzles and minigames, uncover dark secrets, and break an ancient curse.

5238800.title: Temporal Minesweeper
5238800.short_description: Reason across time: a cell that is safe now may be a mine the next moment. With only the clues and rules, solve the puzzle step by step — without ever guessing. Combined rules build on one another for a pure brain-teaser.

5238860.title: Autobrawl Arena
5238860.short_description: BUILD A TEAM of autonomous nanobots from countless parts. COMBINE DNA to arm them with hybrid bioweapons. WATCH THEM FIGHT FOR YOU against rival teams in an ever-changing microscopic arena. Sign sponsors, defend towers, place bets, and win the grand tournament!

5238870.title: Archemyst: Alchemy Shop
5238870.short_description: An incremental game of spell-driven gathering and alchemy shopkeeping. Summon skeletons and goblins, gather materials, craft goods and run your shop. Unlock recipes, expand the shop and follow the talent tree to relearn elemental magic and regain your powers as an archmage.

5238900.title: Shiverin' Shillelagh
5238900.short_description: it's Halloween night, strange pumpkins roam the land. In this FPS, grab your shotgun & shillelagh to do battle in 8 atmospheric levels!

5239100.title: To Whom It May Fall
5239100.short_description: A brutal vertical rage-platformer about an old mailman, a rocket-powered monobike, and one very important letter. Climb the castle, master the jumps, and try not to fall all the way back down.

5239410.title: Area [No Love]
5239410.short_description: Fall in love, and you explode?! Explosive Love Cells have made love itself a danger and a crime. A boy who swore off romance gets tangled up with three girls... Will you survive? No Love Virus is a visual novel where you must keep affection just right to win a heroine's heart.

5239450.title: Factory Tour →
5239450.short_description: Factory Tour → is a 3D horror game where you explore a mysterious robot factory.

5239470.title: Hollow Covenant
5239470.short_description: A grim dark-fantasy MMORPG in a world kept alive by corrupted gods. You are nobody: your father is buried and his killer is still walking. Level, craft, guild up, and decide how each fallen deity ends - purify, slay, or bind. No one chose you. You chose to cross.

5239500.title: Desk Sushi Idle
5239500.short_description: Desk Sushi Idle is a cozy animal sushi shop at the bottom of your screen. Keep working while guests grab plates, check out, and your restaurant grows. Build belts and stations, unlock dishes, and expand at your own pace—an idle desktop companion with real conveyor-sushi charm.

5239610.title: Five Star Crew
5239610.short_description: Run a tour boat with up to three friends through waters full of deadly sea life. Steer, cook, patch leaks and protect your guests on the way to the next dock. They paid for five-star service. Try to keep them alive long enough to leave a review.

5239710.title: 横浜機動暴走族 ROCK 'N' ROLL SUICIDE
5239710.short_description: Explore Yokohama through real-world photographs and brawl with biker gangs in giant robots! A dramatic action-adventure following a coup led by the city’s “Mobile Biker Gangs.”

5239850.title: SPP: Stream Party Pack
5239850.short_description: Up for a friendly challenge with your TikTok LIVE viewers? Pick one of three games. Deliver parcels, paint a canvas, or knock cubes into a pit. You set the effects for likes, follows, and gifts. Your viewers decide when to lend a hand and when to get in your way.

5240490.title: DETRITUS
5240490.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder inspired by the classic card game Trash. Arrange cards sequentially to open packs, discover game-changing modifiers, and build broken synergies to complete over 10 unique contracts.

5240560.title: Trox The Reversal
5240560.short_description: Trox The Reversal is a first person horror game set in an alternate reality where the Cold War became a global nuclear war. With food supplies collapsing, the Soviet government introduces the Sustainable Meat Act, making cannibalism legal and forcing every household to contribute.

5240600.title: Mame, Kana Desktop Companion
5240600.short_description: Learn hiragana and katakana without sitting down for it. Mame is a desktop companion who turns your idle moments into tiny, painless reviews: spaced-repetition drills for kana and vocabulary, with no streaks and no guilt. A study buddy in the corner of your screen.

5240620.title: 수복
5240620.short_description: In a Korea torn by war, Seo-hun fights to reclaim the everyday life he lost. Follow a character-driven story and fight alongside infantry and tanks in top-down 2D battles, moving, aiming, and taking cover on the front line.

5240650.title: S.O.V.A.
5240650.short_description: S.O.V.A. is a first-person psychological horror about a Yugoslav AI built to predict wars and disasters, then shut down under suspicion it was also influencing them. Inspired by a real bunker and re-imagined history.

5241040.title: Twilight Pretender
5241040.short_description: His ex-girlfriend returns the day after their breakup—but she is now a “pretender,” a creature that devours and mimics humans. To save the real Chise, Hiroto must become her fake girlfriend’s boyfriend—for a limited time. But when a fake romance becomes real… Can he still call her a monster?

5241380.title: You Go First!
5241380.short_description: A 4–12 player multiplayer deathrun about surviving deadly obstacle courses while one of you secretly controls the traps.

5242110.title: Oscilloscopia
5242110.short_description: Oscilloscopia is a puzzle game built around an authentically simulated oscilloscope. Build signals, patch modules and tune the instrument until the phosphor trace matches the target. Experiment with signal processing and find your own solutions.

5242180.title: Paw Works Co.
5242180.short_description: Run your repair shop in a cosy animal neighborhood. Diagnose and repair your customers' broken belongings, and organize your workshop your way. Grow your shop, unlock upgrades like delivery, and manage it all from your computer.

5242260.title: Packsmith
5242260.short_description: Pack your customers’ inventories, build clever item combinations, and earn enough points to keep your cozy medieval shop alive. Every item, every space, every decision counts!

5242330.title: PENTO
5242330.short_description: Five blocks instead of four change everything. Rotate and place pentominoes, clear lines, and learn to read the board in a whole new way. Chase high scores, take on different challenges, or unwind with music in your own neon lounge.

5242410.title: Textures Not Included
5242410.short_description: [Textures Not Included] is a p̷s̷y̷c̷h̷o̷l̷o̷g̷i̷c̷a̷l̷ ̵h̵o̵r̵r̵o̵r̵ incremental game about perception, progression, and the ̶p̶r̶i̶c̶e̶ ̶o̶f̶ ̶v̶i̶s̶u̶a̶l̶ ̶c̶l̶a̶r̶i̶t̶y̶. N̄othîng ēxīsts ûntîl yōu p̄āy f̄ōr īt. Click to earn, buy [TE X T UR E S], and r̵e̵n̵d̵e̵r̵ your surrounding bit by bit.

5242590.title: Somewhere Else
5242590.short_description: A cozy 2-player co-op puzzle platformer. Play as Chimp and Chip on one couch or online with Remote Play Together, explore six strange and beautiful worlds, solve puzzles that need both of you, beat bosses and find your way back home.

5242660.title: The Dust of Battle
5242660.short_description: A lightning‑fast turn-based tactical game with explosive progression across 40‑minute campaigns, where every battle becomes a high‑stakes Strike vs Counter duel.

5243200.title: My Penguin Friend
5243200.short_description: Jump into the adorable flippers of Dindim. Think like a penguin and tackle tricky physics puzzles across the gorgeous deep waters and sunny beaches of a tropical fishing village. Leave little footprints as you build a cosy nest, and gather keepsakes to discover a heartwarming story about friendship.

5243360.title: Hello Golem
5243360.short_description: Deep in the bowels of Cocoa Co. lays a terrible evil… Thankfully, June is on the case! Her courageous friend, Golem (that's you!), will venture the building in search of this evil. But be careful: you never know what else you may find there…

5243490.title: BibimBoB
5243490.short_description: BibimBob is a simple game: just keep jumping and dashing forward. All you need to do is pass the traps and reach the goal.

5243570.title: The Caretaker: Block 9
5243570.short_description: "The Caretaker: Block 9" is a horror game set in 2000s Poland. You play as Janusz Nowakowski, former caretaker who returns to his initial occupation. At the beginning everything seems to be just a little scary but at the same moment ordinary...

5243750.title: Doug's Playground
5243750.short_description: JOIN THE FIGHT AGAINST WATER! For generations, the Muck have suffered under the tyranny of water. Now Doug’s patented Playground Protocol lets you simulate war scenarios to assist those in the field. Support your Muck troops today!

5243930.title: ZAPLOOPA 4040
5243930.short_description: ZAPLOOPA is a post-apocalyptic dark humor competition game show. Set in 4040, in space. You are the contestants. An online 3D party game for up to 8 players: complete outrageous fill-in-the-blank sentences, vote for the funniest, sabotage your rivals with jokers. No place for snowflakes here.

5243950.title: Ugly Jack: The Halloween Curse
5243950.short_description: A painterly folk-horror game set on a colonial frontier, 1666. Something below the fields has begun taking the people who work them. By day, tend the harvest and set your scarecrows. By night, walk as Stingy Jack, lantern in hand, and keep what comes out of the dark from reaching the village

5243990.title: READ: 3AM
5243990.short_description: READ: 3AM tells the story of two lonely souls, the need to be seen, and something that should not be able to message you. Told through a mix of visual novel storytelling and chat-sim interactions, you'll navigate friendships, make choices, and get to know someone who shouldn't exist.

5244100.title: Late Night Check-In
5244100.short_description: A psychological horror game where you work the night shift as a hotel receptionist. Welcome uncanny guests, prepare delicious drinks to fulfill room-service requests, and watch your peaceful night job slowly turn into a living nightmare.

5244190.title: TerraHeist
5244190.short_description: Explore procedurally generated alien planets, steal valuables, and get your haul home. TerraHeist is a top-down sci-fi action game for solo play or online co-op. Capture creatures as companions, turn their attacks into weapon gems, and gear up for the next expedition.

5244330.title: MOTHERLODE
5244330.short_description: Dig into a persistent world of prospecting, mining and industrial engineering. Discover finite deposits, excavate real material, process it through machines, build power, water and logistics networks, sell your haul, upgrade your operation, and expand your claims alone or with friends.

5244440.title: Sandpipers! The Sea-Quell
5244440.short_description: The King Crab smashed the moon to break the tides and drown the sandpipers, and his criminal empire is loving it. Gather your flock, lead them beak-first through brick, bombs and steel, and bring the moon back one piece at a time. 80 levels of pure bird chaos. Beak first. Questions later.

5244650.title: RIPPLES
5244650.short_description: Gather the group. Negotiate. Take risks. Rule the board. RIPPLES is an online board game for up to 6 players where strategy, negotiation, and luck collide every match.

5244840.title: FallChess: Wizard's Chess
5244840.short_description: Mount, move, and command chess pieces in a fully 3D duel. Choose your character, ride your piece across the board, and face your opponents up close. Capture pieces, outmaneuver your enemies, and experience chess like never before, brought to life in first-person action.

5244870.title: エンゼルモール
5244870.short_description: Four girls and an android awaken in the deserted "Angel Mall". Explore under a time limit across repeated attempts, piecing together clues and records left behind to uncover the mall’s secrets in this puzzle adventure.

5244970.title: Elroy: King of the Jungle
5244970.short_description: A Brand-New 30-Year-Old Game. This 90's animated point-and-click adventure is finally released! Crash-land in a dangerous jungle with Elroy, his sidekick Blue AND Elroy’s annoying little brother Slim. Solve puzzles, survive crazy calamities, and navigate challenges to bring everyone home safe.

5245080.title: Polliwoggle
5245080.short_description: A pixel-art roguelite where you're a frog going on a fishing trip. Roll and allocate dice to catch the biggest fish. Draft trinkets and stickers to help you out on your journey and race the clock to get a train ticket and continue your fishing trip.

5245670.title: RenewCity
5245670.short_description: Small budget. Hard choices. No perfect fixes. Revitalize real neighborhoods in Detroit, Seoul, and Leipzig, and find out whether you helped the people who live there or replaced them.

5245880.title: Wagerborn
5245880.short_description: A slot-machine roguelite where your RPG equipment becomes the reel. Equip weapons and relics, manipulate your symbol pool, complete powerful matches, merge gear, and build increasingly broken combinations across each run.

5245990.title: Programming Maze
5245990.short_description: A coding-focused dungeon puzzle game. Write real JavaScript or Python code to move your character through maze dungeons. Use loops, conditional logic and arrays to solve puzzles. Run your code and watch your character act. Beginners learn core programming logic gradually via trial and error.

5246050.title: Kill the Thing
5246050.short_description: Kill The Thing is a challenging turn-based tactical RPG. Keep the corruption under control while searching for its origin. Undertake missions across four distinct regions, targeting key resources, upgrading your base, and building your roster of heroes. For the final confrontation.

5246420.title: Dash It!
5246420.short_description: A pixel platformer about jumping and dashing. Race up to 8 players in real time, chase the world No. 1 ghost in Time Attack, clear 72 stages across 12 themes, and build and share your own maps. Hang out in the lobby, change outfits and decorate your own house.

5246510.title: The Inkwell
5246510.short_description: Monitor. Identify. Purge. Watch haunted cartoon feeds, identify entities by the anomalies they leave behind, and perform precise exorcisms. Keep the corruption contained, or the broadcast will claim you next.

5246700.title: Defilade
5246700.short_description: Defilade is an ambitious real-time strategy game that brings a never-before-seen smart AI soldier system to the genre. Set in the modern day, it has three factions (West, East and Rebels) fighting it out from advanced trench warfare to urban combat to the desert plains.

5246770.title: Countryside Big Catch
5246770.short_description: Our protagonist moves to a countryside island. Here, the rent is free as long as you can fish. On this mysterious little island, a good hand with a rod is all it takes to make all his wishes come true.
developers: サークル☆フェアリーフラワー

5246790.title: Condotta
5246790.short_description: Lead a fifteenth-century mercenary company in Condotta, a historical tactical roguelike. Hire fighters, command them in turn-based battles, and decide what trouble to take on as you travel. Fulfill your contract—and live to collect your pay.

5246910.title: Orthodoxía
5246910.short_description: A first-person action game where you play as a witch infiltrating a cult-controlled town. Use black magic and telekinesis to fight your way through enemies and uncover the dark secrets of the place.

5247460.title: 水球啪啦Splash Party
5247460.short_description: Splash Party is a colorful water-balloon action game. Place balloons, dodge bursts, break crates, and collect power-ups. Challenge another player in online PvP, practice solo, or face enemies and bosses in the single-player campaign.

5247470.title: Skywatch
5247470.short_description: You work at a small observatory as scientist, studying the sky and making sure nothing unsual goes unnoticed. Explore worlds, launch satelites, receive signals from outer space, solve mystries and connect the dots. Welcome to Skywatch.

5248020.title: By Royal Charter
5248020.short_description: Solitaire's one-more-card appeal meets the satisfaction of building a thriving colony. Place facility cards, recruit specialists, and connect production chains in approachable turn-based strategy. Play your cards. Build your colony.

5248370.title: Buildmaxxing
5248370.short_description: Build together on floating islands in this 1-4 player co-op building game. Each player has a unique role. Memorize blueprints, communicate with your team, and build from memory before time runs out!

5248600.title: Trickstir
5248600.short_description: Solve puzzles by rotating the environment to drop ingredients in your cauldron. Discover blocks and ingredients with special twists across six different worlds. Collect the ingredients to help the witch create the ultimate potion!

5249330.title: HIGHEST STAKES
5249330.short_description: HIGHEST STAKES is a game of Heads-Up five-card poker against the dealer with roguelite elements. Use a variety of chaotic charms and items to cheat the game in your favour. You have a large debt to pay, and at her table, your life is the wager.

5249420.title: Where is Starlingdive
5249420.short_description: A college radio DJ has vanished, but the school says she withdrew. Search forum posts and confidential records to uncover the people behind anonymous handles. Piece together what happened to Starlingdive in a deduction mystery spanning three connected cases, from college radio to the music industry.

5249750.title: Unsound
5249750.short_description: Unsound is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore unsettling environments, solve puzzles, and uncover a dark mystery. Things are not always as they seem, and the deeper you go, the stranger things become. Pay attention to your surroundings and piece together the clues.

5250650.title: Pounce Brigade
5250650.short_description: Recruit a brigade of cats, arrange them on the living-room rug, and combine their talents in this auto-battling roguelite. Protect a nap or take on enemy packs through twelve rounds, solo or in private two-player co-op.

5250680.title: Arborist
5250680.short_description: Build a garden, survive the forecast, and follow a trail of birds through wild habitats in this cozy roguelike card game. Discover new cards, tools, and enchantments as you shape unique builds that keep every run feeling fresh.

5250720.title: GoldRush
5250720.short_description: Build your fortune in a 2D mining strategy game set during the American Gold Rush. Bid for land, scan for deposits, mine gold and rare treasures, and upgrade your equipment. Time your sales as prices shift, manage debt, and outsmart rival prospectors.

5251020.title: Relic Spire: The Barrel Reborn
5251020.short_description: “Relic Spire: The Barrel Reborn” is a Tower of the Sorcerer-like strategy game.You start out as just a barrel,explore a monster-infested magic tower.Collect relics,assemble the body.Choose the best route,and conquer the magic tower!No manual input during battles — strategy is everything!

5251350.title: Chechelevo Mainland
5251350.short_description: Chechelevo Mainland is a procedurally generated sandbox game focused on resource gathering. Carve your path through the landscape, upgrade your robot, uncover hidden stashes, and build your own underground world, progress is saved locally, and every world is unique thanks to seed-based generation.

5251590.title: Castlefolk
5251590.short_description: Build a medieval kingdom from a small settlement, gather resources, recruit an army, battle dangerous creatures, and expand your realm across a charming pixel-art world.

5251600.title: Fish on the Floor
5251600.short_description: Rescue sea creatures from chaotic floors in a first-person cleanup game. Explore the seafood market and aquarium, toss creatures into matching tanks, and unlock upgrades.

5251680.title: Banana Guy Running Hard
5251680.short_description: A compact fast-paced platformer! Run everywhere, jump everywhere and get everything!

5251800.title: Z-Defender
5251800.short_description: Tired of the military always losing to the zombie horde? Not here. Hold your base through wave after wave, earn cash from every kill, upgrade your guns, man your posts, and call in airstrikes. Hold the line.

5251910.title: Prison Chef Simulator
5251910.short_description: Step behind the counter of a high-security prison cafeteria. Prepare daily meals, manage scarce ingredients, and survive volatile inmates who throw trays at your face. Keep the dining hall from rioting and guard your cutlery, or your shift might be your last in this tense kitchen sim.

5251980.title: Strikemania
5251980.short_description: You are the missile. Launch. Strike. Repeat. Kamikaze your way through defenses, master each route, and use previous missiles to help clear the path in this fast-paced retro arcade time-attack game.

5252060.title: Monster Farm
5252060.short_description: Fit your defenses together. Bring the monsters home. Monster Farm combines backpack-style placement with tower defense. Shop, upgrade, and reshape your lineup between waves, defeat bosses across five chapters, and collect monsters and treasures that strengthen future attempts.

5252170.title: Boomfish
5252170.short_description: Captain, open fire! Blast swarms of monster fish! Combine special ammo, secondary weapons and crew support. Boost your firepower with salvage upgrades and return with a hold full of loot. Unlock 50+ armaments, recruit and train 100+ crew, earn deep-sea blessings and brave deadlier waters!

5252250.title: Just One More Season
5252250.short_description: A roguelike esports management sim: take charge of a team and climb from Iron league to Diamond. Recruit and train players, manage finances and fans across seasons that play out differently every run. Lost the final? Just one more season.

5252430.title: Emergency Warp
5252430.short_description: Command a customizable Starship in this tactical space defense roguelite. Intercept missile swarms, deploy combat drone wings, and mine hostile asteroid belts. When your shields fail, do you risk everything for more loot—or initiate an Emergency Warp to escape with your haul?

5252500.title: Blueshift Breakdown
5252500.short_description: Bring destructibility to the extreme in this Asteroids-inspired shoot 'em up. Travel the galaxy and encounter a wide variety of fully destructible asteroids and enemies. Upgrade your ship and annihilate everything in your path, pixel by pixel.

5252570.title: Dark Dawn: Stellar Expanse
5252570.short_description: 《Dark Dawn: Stellar Expanse》 is an interstellar strategy game set in vast deep space. As explorers, players chart paths in a seamless universe: uncover secrets, fight battles, build stations, trade, and shape factions via diplomacy. You define the universe’s scale and destiny.

5252590.title: Escape Space 127
5252590.short_description: Escape Space 127 is a first-person 3D maze escape game. In a mysterious maze, you must avoid deadly traps, manage your hunger, repair motors, and pick locks. Uncover your true identity and lost memories, and escape this place.

5252690.title: Break the Planet
5252690.short_description: A satisfying, meditative incremental game about shooting balls to destroy planets. Find the white voxel hidden in each world, unlock more balls, and uncover the secrets to destroy a 10-billion-voxel planet.

5252930.title: LAKESIDE HEAVEN
5252930.short_description: For every long story, there is also a short one.LAKESIDE HEAVEN is a short game rooted in dystopian science fiction, packed with a variety of gameplay experiences within its relatively brief runtime.

5253200.title: Little Bear`s Honey Shop
5253200.short_description: Little Bear's Honey Shop is an incremental game where you battle magical plants, gather flowers and ingredients, and craft sweet honey products. Build powerful combinations on a honeycomb skill tree, sell honey to customers, and grow a tiny shop into a bustling honey empire.

5253210.title: 股魂誓約－Stockbound: Oath of Souls
5253210.short_description: An online side-scrolling idle RPG where fantasy battles meet a stock-market-inspired economy. Build your knight, recruit allies, challenge bosses and embed virtual stock certificates in equipment. Requires a game account and internet connection.

5253350.title: Lootale Slash
5253350.short_description: Lootale Slash is a pixel-art action MMORPG. Explore a shared world, choose from six classes, conquer dungeons and world bosses, hunt rare gear, and create a playstyle that is truly your own.

5253400.title: Rogue Tithe
5253400.short_description: A traditional turn-based roguelike of tempo and uncertainty. Roll an adventurer blind, outpace enemies to act twice, sneak past what you cannot fight, and descend twelve floors for the Barrow Relic. Death keeps what you carry, but the crows will fly your gold home for a fee.

5253490.title: Hazard Shift
5253490.short_description: A third-person PvE extraction shooter for 1–4 players. Fight corrupted machines, scavenge gear, and reclaim city sectors. Harvest corruption to power your squad’s weapons and equipment, every shot drains your shared energy. Extract with your loot and build up your base for the next shift.

5253810.title: Last Ones Down
5253810.short_description: A social survival game for up to 16 players. Reveal your traits, argue your case, and vote on who gets into the bunker. There’s only room for half of you, and keeping the wrong people could doom everyone inside.

5253820.title: shanghai ghost pawnshop
5253820.short_description: Run a pawnshop in Republican-era Shanghai, trading with the living and the dead. Appraise goods, read customers, and bargain with incomplete information. As night deepens, strange deals promise riches—or death. Prove yourself, repay your debts, and uncover how deep they truly run.

5253930.title: Gideon Unleashed
5253930.short_description: The last wizard. The world's greatest mistake. Every hunter in the kingdom wants him dead, and all he wants is to get home. Walk the road through four lands, build a ring of spells that feed each other, then hold Ravenhold against an army that never stops coming.

5254000.title: Shunt
5254000.short_description: The Devil has scattered Rex's bones all over his house. One press slides Rex, the clay dog, until he hits something, and shoves everything in his path. Line the bones up in a row or column to win them back. 338 hand-built puzzles, 16 worlds, no timer, level editor.

5254050.title: The Iconoclast
5254050.short_description: A sci-fi turn-based RPG and a homage to the great RPGs of the past, featuring an innovative battle system where you can fight with up to 6 of your party members at once. Plus several fully 3D animated PS1-style FMV cutscenes!

5254220.title: Pawtings! Hidden Dogs
5254220.short_description: Find hidden dogs in real museum paintings. Explore dozens of artworks, spot the hand-drawn dogs hiding in the details, and watch the color come back into each canvas. Play solo or hunt with up to three friends in a split screen or online. Enjoy a relaxing hidden-object game set to classical music.

5254360.title: RogueForge
5254360.short_description: Draw your own weapons and build a place to call home. RogueForge is a 3D open-world survival crafting game with gathering, farming, cooking, building and combat. Trade with local communities, engrave runes into your gear, and explore dungeons and challenge bosses.

5254470.title: Down to Business
5254470.short_description: Turn every dig into a bigger operation. Mine for valuable ore, take on contracts, upgrade your vehicle, and build your bases to reach as deep into the planet as possible.

5255090.title: Death Falls: Zombies Are Coming
5255090.short_description: Death Falls is a zombie tower defense game with you on the front line. By day, build towers and fences, scavenge weapons and recruit survivors. By night, fight beside your defenses as the horde closes in. Survive each stop, fix up your RV and drive on.

5255270.title: Little Mages 3D
5255270.short_description: Blast through undead hordes and build a devastating spell loadout in this retro first-person arena roguelite! Choose your mage, combine spells and perks, defeat bosses, and grow stronger between runs. Play solo or with up to 4 players in LAN co-op.

5255290.title: HOLD THE COOP!
5255290.short_description: HOLD THE COOP! is an incremental auto-battler where you protect your coop from waves of coyotes. Earn gold, buy upgrades, unlock stronger chicken units, and survive tougher rounds. Lose, upgrade, and come back stronger!

5255300.title: Rekisen TCG
5255300.short_description: With its signature "Rekisen Summoning" system, this snappy arcade card game offers a unique experience with 80 carefully balanced cards. Play your favorite modes, earn gold, and open booster packs to collect cards and build custom decks.

5255700.title: Mixed Waste Tidy Up the Landfill
5255700.short_description: One million pieces of trash. Five hungry mouths. One enormous cleanup.

5255710.title: The Understack Society
5255710.short_description: Build a society of misfits, one card at a time. Stack cards to gather food, craft equipment and expand your settlement in this dark fantasy survival game. Recruit citizens, open mysterious parcels and explore new districts. Keep everyone fed, armed and alive.

5255910.title: Fewer Mornings
5255910.short_description: A short first-person game about everything you do before you leave the house. Unpack, cook, do the dishes, feed Saki, answer your mom, leave by eight. Five days in one apartment across twelve years, and there's never time for all of it.

5256430.title: G-MODE Archives+ THE LABYRINTH OF DRUAGA
5256430.short_description: Queen Ki has been captured once again. Take control of Gil and rescue Ki from the underground labyrinth!

5256450.title: Please Fix!
5256450.short_description: You're the entire IT department. Dash between desks, untangle cables, rescue printers and tackle increasingly ridiculous tickets in this funny single-player time-management game. Keep the office happy, upgrade your toolkit, and bring an emotional support duck. No IT knowledge required.

5256530.title: Eyes Blue
5256530.short_description: A psychological survival horror game about grief and guilt. Traverse the distorted memories of Walter Johnson as his mind teeters between life and death, set in a world with a retro aesthetic inspired by the classic era of horror.

5256650.title: Mind Forge
5256650.short_description: A calm, data-driven cognitive trainer. 14 science-based drills sharpen attention, memory, logic, space and reaction: Stroop inhibition, n-back, paper folding, stop-signal tasks. Transparent stats, adaptive difficulty, auto review scheduling. No account; all data stays on your device.

5256760.title: Green Guy Goes Grappling
5256760.short_description: Green Guy Goes Grappling is a fast-paced 2D platformer where Green Guy has to save the universe!

5256860.title: Wobblebound
5256860.short_description: A physics stacking roguelite where every toy has a face. Draft toys and lucky charms at every bell, spend coins at the toy shop and beat six bosses as one of six toymakers. Then race friends or robots, or build one tower together, with up to four players on one PC or online.

5256960.title: 弥莎莉尔的救赎
5256960.short_description: Guide Misa through a dreamlike world in a single-player story and card-battling adventure. Shape your deck with helms, accessories and new cards, plan actions across three combat phases, and choose your path along a road of sacrifice.

5257250.title: Keep Rising
5257250.short_description: A medieval tower defense incremental where the castle outlives every run. Hold the wall against endless waves, Rebirth stronger and find every room you built still standing. 8 towers, 28 spell combinations and a 17-chapter Campaign.

5257260.title: The White Witch of White Winter
5257260.short_description: A short letter from Mom leaves young witch Kore in charge of a winter island. She recalls lost recipes in memories of Mom, brews potions to ease her neighbors' worries, flies on her staff, dives into the deep spring, and fills her empty cottage. Join Kore and uncover the secret Mom left behind.

5257440.title: Buns and Poops
5257440.short_description: A poop-collecting sim that turns your entire desktop into a bunny playground. Over 80 pixel-art bunnies hop across your screen as you work, settle into loaves, flop over, and leave poops behind. Trade the poops you collect for furniture and treats to make life with the bunnies even cozier.

5257830.title: Gun for Your Life
5257830.short_description: A top-down Western roguelite shooter. Your bullets fly to where you aim, so you can shoot past one bounty hunter and hit the one behind him. Build your outlaw between waves, then hide in the bushes or rush in the open. Somewhere out there is the man who put a price on your head.

5258030.title: Chimp!
5258030.short_description: A monkey dreams of owning his own hair salon. To make his dream come true, help him to collect gold. The gold is locked behind doors ... the keys are protected by whimsical and absurd animal enemies. Fight them with bananas, get the keys and steam the golden coins.

5258080.title: Legacy of the Griffin
5258080.short_description: A narrative horror experience where you unravel the disturbing history of Michael Dubh. Your morality guides each decision, leading to multiple endings as you confront the secrets buried within his mansion and the fate that emerges from the shadows of your past.

5258170.title: Cinephile: Tidy Up The Movie Store
5258170.short_description: A hilarious cozy first-person tidying game for movie lovers! Hand crafted movie posters parodying real movies. No Generative AI! Plus, a level editor to create your own packs and the same familiar game loop you’re familiar with in the genre.

5258180.title: XiSiTeLing with Infinite Winding
5258180.short_description: Xisiteling and the Infinite Winding A pixel-art deck-building RPG Roguelike. Black fire traps worlds in cycles. Play amnesiac Xisiteling, sword in hand, in the Infinite Corridor. Fight, learn skills, meet others, unlock cards. Choices forge your power. Recover memories; face the truth

5258490.title: An Eggcellent Sorting Game
5258490.short_description: Sort thousands of colorful eggs by matching their patterns in this relaxing organizing game. Turn a giant mess into satisfying order, level up 8 skills, meet quirky characters, and complete quests. No rush, no pressure. Just you and an eggnormous pile of eggs!

5258500.title: Naptide: Fortune Islands
5258500.short_description: 6 islands, 6 different games! In this cozy incremental game full of cats, collect as many eggs as you can in 20-second rounds, grow wheat to bring in new cats and spend your earnings in skill trees. As your islands grow, they power each other up.

5258740.title: Sweep Together
5258740.short_description: The world’s famous monuments are closed. The reason? Mountains of trash! Join the Sweeper Crew, upgrade your tools, and get these iconic sights ready to reopen. Clean solo, team up in online co-op, or work for rival companies in PvP. Race to finish your cleanup first and claim the prize!

5258780.title: Strashnovekovie
5258780.short_description: 2D action RPG. The game’s unique feature is that instead of the usual character leveling, at each level you’ll be joined by an ally with their own unique abilities. By using your allies’ abilities — you’ll be able to complete the game .

5258860.title: MotoBox
5258860.short_description: Motobox is a Sandbox game where you freely ride your motorcycle and weave through traffic at high speed. Experiment with a collection of Motorcycles , Maps & Sandboxes to Ride in , and freely experience how it feels to drive at high speeds through crowded city traffics.

5259080.title: WHERE MEMORY FAILS
5259080.short_description: Where Memory Fails is a dark fantasy memory-and-deduction roguelite. Read the dungeon's clues, reveal a path through the grid, collect gold, survive its dangers, and find the exit before your health and steps run out.

5259150.title: Are You Smarter Than a Troll?
5259150.short_description: Classic trivia meets the builds and strategic combat of a roguelike! Answer questions to attack enemies, use skills to turn the odds in your favor, and collect artifacts that change how you play. Outsmart the Troll and claim his treasure!

5259350.title: Heartreave
5259350.short_description: A turn-based hack-and-slash where every fight is played with cards. Assemble a party, solo or in online co-op, and craft unique builds by combining cards, passives, talents, relics, creature hearts and island hearts to find the best synergies and push ever deeper.

5259380.title: Mayonaka no Yaiba
5259380.short_description: After falling from the fourth floor of his school and losing nearly a year of memories, high school student Chenxing is caught between two conflicting romantic pasts. When a girl in white and the blade of light known as the Night Blade appear at 3 a.m., he must choose whose truth to face.

5259470.title: Boreal Steel
5259470.short_description: A physics-driven WWII tank game set in a fog-bound northern forest. Push pines over with your hull, and fight where every plate, module and track can be hit, and every HE shell can set the woods alight.

5259500.title: Doughjo
5259500.short_description: Recruit battling pastries, build your perfect team, and master fast-paced tactical grid combat in a turn-based RPG where every fighter has their own skills, strengths, and flavor.

5259530.title: French Tax Simulator
5259530.short_description: Take on the role of a tax inspector and track down tax evaders! Your mission: to reduce the public deficit. Cross-check the supporting documents, uncover inconsistencies and decide who to audit. Your career in the civil service depends on it....

5259580.title: Between Us
5259580.short_description: You were just supposed to bring medicine home to your wife. Now you're trapped in a seemingly endless cornfield. In this first-person psychological horror, your only companion is your own voice in your head. Talk to your alter ego, step through portals into your dark past, and try to find a way out.

5259590.title: TIC.EXE
5259590.short_description: Three in a row is not a win — it is a discharge. A tactical grid roguelite: fight hostile processes on a shifting board, build an engine out of 30 modules, and clear eight sectors before the machine answers its own launch request. Duel a friend online or on one screen.

5259860.title: Pickle & Biscuit
5259860.short_description: A high fantasy action RPG at the end of the world. Outrun an evil Fog that takes anyone too slow, with a fire-mad young mage and her sharp-tongued healer brother. Outthink the Taken and bandits that each fight their own way, and laugh through thousands of voiced lines.

5259970.title: Shot Rock
5259970.short_description: Shot Rock is a curling game where you call the shot, throw it, and sweep it home, presented like curling on TV. Two full teams take the ice in arenas and club venues. Play the AI, a friend, or players online.

5260000.title: Rollamon
5260000.short_description: Raise one monster on your stat sheet. Draft dice, spend XP, race for Arena Medals, and win on Contest Points. Four-player dice placement strategy.

5260350.title: Doji Run: Stock Market 3.0
5260350.short_description: Welcome to Stock Market 3.0. DOJI RUN is a real-time cyberpunk stock market roguelite deckbuilder: play chips onto a live 60-second chart, draw the lines the price bounces off, pump it, short it, and beat the boss the Exchange sends every Friday. 100+ edge chips. One rigged market.

5260960.title: Utopia '97
5260960.short_description: A twin-stick shooter set in a perfect world with no conflict and no bad guys. Blow kisses at your friends and teleport them to a happy-go-lucky carnival for the day.

5261000.title: 汉阳造
5261000.short_description: Made in Hanyang is a top-down real-time tactics game. Lead outgunned Chinese resistance fighters through impossible missions—and find the courage to keep shooting when surrender is not an option. Currently available in Simplified Chinese only. English localization is planned for a future update.

5261090.title: Best Dam Game
5261090.short_description: Chew trees, throw logs, blow stuff up. Best Dam Game is co-op physics chaos for up to 4 beavers building one seriously big dam. Take the contract, beat the rising river, fire your friends out of a cannon, and hunt down some very important hats.

5261120.title: Star Ring Convenience Store
5261120.short_description: A supernatural adventure about working for a living and getting stuck in a time loop. On her first day on the job, intern Amo is trapped in the same day. Meet eccentric late-night customers, connect clues in your Mind Palace, and uncover the secrets hidden inside Star Ring Convenience Store.

5261210.title: TOKUGI ARENA
5261210.short_description: Generate energy by typing, solving Tsume Shogi and completing other challenges, then spend it on projectiles, blades and barriers. A team-based action game with CPU practice, solo challenges, Score Attack and compatible VRM avatars.

5261270.title: 修仙：但天道是AI
5261270.short_description: An AI-driven cultivation text adventure. You are a fading soul who seizes a cultivator's body. Debate elders, bond with or rival fellow disciples, survive deadly realms—every choice reshapes your fate. The deeper you go, the more the Heavenly Dao feels like running code. The Dao is an AI.

5261320.title: ARTEMIS' Miscalculation
5261320.short_description: This is the one case the police must never know about. A murder at a Japanese inn, where every guest has secrets. AI Thriller × Logic-Driven Mystery in a world policed and judged by AI. A linear visual novel with no choices. Includes Episode 1, a self-contained case lasting about two hours.

5261450.title: Ayakashi Profile
5261450.short_description: One button per ally. Chain four fighters’ attacks, special attacks, and spells into launches, follow-ups, and devastating ultimates in this Japanese fantasy battle RPG. Meet a cast of nine, build a party of four, and try the free First Gate demo.

5261500.title: A Weird Village
5261500.short_description: Welcome to A Weird Village, a chaotic multiplayer game where little animals fight over territory, unlock ridiculous powers, destroy pretty much everything in sight, and eventually tear the enemy village to pieces. Pick your favorite little creature, grab a weapon, and join the mayhem.

5261540.title: Mechanical Salvage Works
5261540.short_description: A light, bite-sized incremental game where you zap runaway machines, salvage parts, fulfill orders, and customize your machines!
developers: 为什么不问问神奇海螺呢
publishers: 为什么不问问神奇海螺呢

5261650.title: May the Best Craft Win
5261650.short_description: Send four adventurers into a dungeon while you are away. Come back to a haul of sealed loot and rare ore, then gamble it all at the forge: refine, socket, enchant, and sell the surplus on a living market. An idle party RPG where the dungeon is the input and the crafting is the game.

5261680.title: Gleam Tavern
5261680.short_description: Hunt by day. Run a tavern by night. Venture into the wilds for unusual ingredients, turn your haul into hearty meals, and build a welcoming tavern in this fantasy action-and-management adventure. Grow crops, brew drinks, and get to know the people who keep coming back.

5261830.title: Battle to Go
5261830.short_description: A short incremental auto-battler where you build and command a growing army of tiny pixel soldiers. Unlock new troops, research powerful upgrades, and push through increasingly dangerous goblin armies in automatic battles.

5262180.title: BountySisters
5262180.short_description: Three bounty-hunting sisters take on a wild cast of villains in this fully voiced vertical shoot ’em up! Choose from three unique aircraft, master a variety of weapons, tackle gimmick-packed stages, and face powerful bosses in a colorful world with character designs by Shuzilow.HA.

5262550.title: A Walk in the Park
5262550.short_description: Become a landscaper, take on missions in beautiful parks and gardens, and create the perfect layout to satisfy every visitor.

5262660.title: Micro Generals
5262660.short_description: Micro Generals is a 2D SideScrolling Tug Of War RTS featuring 6 distinct factions with 100+ distinct units with their own strenghts and weaknesses , upgrades system , deep tactical play , 56 levels and faction superpowers

5262750.title: RIFTW ARDEN
5262750.short_description: Side-scrolling mech action game. Three guardian mechs, three ways to play, with fighting moves designed by a world fighting champion. Protect the core and survive thirty waves of monsters.

5262990.title: Mailed It!
5262990.short_description: You're the new night-shift intern at a postal sorting facility. Hit your quota and survive the shift, or build machines to do the work for you. Sorters, fans, conveyors, bizarre contraptions… whatever keeps the mail moving. Because the mail never stops!

5263170.title: Starets
5263170.short_description: Starets is a narrative walking sim set in the historical context of 14th-century Rus, in the lands of the Principality of Tver. Nikodim, a former princely scribe, is on his way to a monastery.

5263260.title: Amnesty
5263260.short_description: Multiplayer survival FPS set over one night in a sealed-off city district. Your crew claims a house and boards it up. While the radio on your safe still works, dying just sends you back inside. Gold cases are loose in the streets, and every other crew wants the same ones.

5263350.title: Cat Cat Meowdow
5263350.short_description: Your grandmother’s letter brings you to a cottage in a quiet valley, and to its cats. Win their trust one by one, cook and garden for them, watch the seasons turn, and wander beyond the valley to find cats most players will never see. No timers, no rush.

5263400.title: Goldgrave
5263400.short_description: An incremental auto-battler dungeon crawler where you build a synergized hero to slay hordes and loot gear. Pick a class with its own attack style and learn its skills. Gear up, sweep the gold and descend against floors of enemies, bosses and legendary drops.

5263800.title: GobliWin
5263800.short_description: A casual 2D swarm RTS with auto-battler combat! Build your goblin war camp and fight through a six-act campaign, from murky swamps to royal fortresses. Unlock and upgrade units, command your growing horde, crush human defenses, and repel counterattacks.

5263820.title: Kintsugi Master
5263820.short_description: Find beauty in the broken. Restore treasured objects through the art of Kintsugi, fulfill commissions, and upgrade your materials as you grow into a master artisan. A cozy, relaxing experience with soothing ASMR sounds and increasingly intricate creations.

5263850.title: Don't Lose the Wheels!
5263850.short_description: Build, survive, and keep rolling in Don't Lose the Wheels! — a chaotic physics-based vehicle party game. Assemble wacky contraptions, navigate brutal obstacle tracks, and battle the elements solo or with up to 4 players in co-op. Whatever happens, don’t lose your wheels!

5263940.title: Wilderune
5263940.short_description: Explore a voxel world across seven biomes, face towering guardians and find your style among 49 weapons. Craft equipment, combine movement accessories and tame animal companions in Wilderune, an action RPG built around exploration.

5263980.title: Dig to Escape
5263980.short_description: Dig to Escape is a co-op digging game where you search a mysterious island for buried objects. Turn your discoveries into scrap, upgrade your tools and uncover the missing boat motor parts you need to escape. Play alone or dig irresponsibly with your friends.

5264460.title: Tooth And Tusk
5264460.short_description: Play as Dr. Chompers, a T-Rex dentist in a cozy miniature voxel clinic for animals. Scrape plaque, fill cavities, polish teeth, drain saliva, and forge custom grillz while rival Dr. Sterling heckles from across the street.

5264540.title: Under One Roof
5264540.short_description: Under One Roof is a pixel-art apartment management sim. Furnish rooms, welcome tenants, collect rent, and help them grow. Watch them build careers, make friends, fall in love, and start families as you create your dream apartment, grow a lively community, and follow stories across generations.

5264570.title: The Hearts of War Avert 2: Furies Vengeance
5264570.short_description: Command your armies and conquer her heart! A new student joins a gaming club where friendships, rivalries, and possible romance unfold between actual real-time strategy matches. Get to know Lillian, Rina and Yara in a story-driven visual novel where the game at the table is only part of the story.

5264650.title: Toothpick Museum
5264650.short_description: You are the curator of the Toothpick Museum. The day before opening, your exhibits shattered! Carefully pick up the scattered toothpicks, avoid getting pricked, and rebuild the museum's masterpiece before the doors open!

5264670.title: Uprooted: Meal Replacement Game
5264670.short_description: Don’t play with your food, fight with it! Build up your farm with different equipment, tools, and abilities, then grow powerful crops to throw at your opponents. Stop an evil tech start-up from destroying your farm in this turn-based battling twist on the classic farming game formula.

5264810.title: What a Wish
5264810.short_description: Pop bubbles, find people's wishes, and decide which ones to grant. From silly everyday requests to surprisingly heartfelt pleas, every wish is a little glimpse into someone's life. Earn Faith Points, upgrade your abilities, and unlock new ways to play in this relaxing incremental game.

5264870.title: Clean Record
5264870.short_description: A cozy first-person cleanup sim on a deep space mining station. A generator blew and scattered crystals through every compartment. Sweep, blow and vacuum them up, buy better tools, and read the notes left behind. Find out what happened to the crew, and decide how their story ends.

5264940.title: MORTISCRIPT: Undead Auto Battler
5264940.short_description: Raise the dead and write the rules they fight by. In MORTISCRIPT, a gothic auto battler, you program your undead army with simple logic blocks, watch every instruction play out, find out why the plan broke, and fix it, until the kingdom that betrayed you falls.

5265140.title: Unsainted
5265140.short_description: Dva roky po zmizení svých přátel se mladý Lucas vrací na místo, kde je naposledy viděl. Místo toho však odhalí temné tajemství, které propojuje minulost s přítomností. Ponořte se do hluboce psychologického příběhu odehrávajícího se na opuštěném panství uprostřed amerického lesa.

5265310.title: Bonfire Room
5265310.short_description: A cozy, low-key multiplayer hangout for 2-4 players around a quiet campfire. Feed the fire, sit back and watch the flames, and share six wordless emotes to connect. No goals, no competition, no pressure to talk — just being there together is the point. Works solo too, as ambient background company.

5265330.title: Slender Island
5265330.short_description: Slender Island is a first-person survival horror game where you find yourself on an abandoned island with a goal of stealing all the treasures hidden in its dungeons. However, Slender Mouse and other monsters won't give them up without a fight.

5265390.title: Snap out.
5265390.short_description: A doomscrolling adventure. Scroll a feed that never ends, answer the five people who keep asking, and take the X in the corner before it erodes away. However long you stay decides how dark the platformer you escape into gets.

5265550.title: 奇迹觉醒之大天使传奇
5265550.short_description: 在剑与魔法的世界中开启属于你的冒险，这是一款以角色成长、装备收集、BOSS挑战和多人战斗为核心的魔幻动作角色扮演游戏。选择你的职业，不断升级、转职、强化装备，挑战更强大的敌人，与其他冒险者共同争夺大陆至高荣耀。

5265640.title: Click or Wait
5265640.short_description: An idle and clicker game about a machine that is never finished. Build seesaws and mills and let items fall through them: every single piece with real physics. Decide for yourself whether you click, wait or let the machines work. Plus a Teamwork mode with a shared monthly goal.

5265810.title: Hit the Anvil
5265810.short_description: Hammer the anvil, forge gear, sell it for gold and grow your forge. Advance to Swordmaster, Mage, Necromancer or Shadow Rogue and unleash class skills that fill the screen and reinforce all your loot at once. A pixel-art incremental crafting game with masteries, gems, charms and puzzles. Free demo.

5266070.title: Rescue the Celestia
5266070.short_description: Command a deep space rescue operation in this space management game, where you manage a fleet of ships, build bases, coordinate resources distribution, and explore uncharted planets to find and save the scattered crew of the ISS Celestia.

5266320.title: 水浒：无限江山
5266320.short_description: 《水浒：无限江山》是一款水浒题材的自走棋游戏，合成，升级，战斗！五十余位水浒英雄，百种技能自由组合，由你排兵布阵，共谱一页水泊梁山传奇。是延续绘本故事，忠义招安；还是不理这昏庸朝廷，替天行道。这一切将由你亲自决定！

5266670.title: Stone & Throne
5266670.short_description: Dig beneath the mountain, march against its walls. Hook ore from the depths to fund your army, line your units across the hex battlefield, fuse the ones that stand together, and break fifteen fortress gates in a rogue-lite siege where what you mine below decides the war above.

5266700.title: Prosecutor Absolution
5266700.short_description: You have been appointed Deputy Chief Prosecutor of Davelia. Your goal is to pay off your mortgage. Your tool is other people's prison sentences. Your conscience is your problem. The State of Davelia will not forget about you.

5266920.title: River Hallucination
5266920.short_description: River Hallucination is a mystery game set in a hotel by the river, where every guest hides a different challenge. Win at games of chance, bluff, and strategy to uncover what's really going on.

5267090.title: Idle Raiders: Second Run
5267090.short_description: Idle Raiders: Second Run is an idle RPG about a band of pixel art heroes who farm, raid and loot on their own. You build their town, pick their gear, skills and AI, and send them out farming or into more than 25 raids. Version 2.0 of the browser classic from Pit Forest, rebuilt on a new engine.

5267640.title: Forever
5267640.short_description: Forever is a free-to-play, old-school 2D fantasy MMORPG. Create your character, level up, master your class, fight in open PvP duels and tournaments, found a clan and trade in a persistent world shared with players on PC and other devices.

5268270.title: Stack Heroes
5268270.short_description: Stack cards to cook, craft and build your own outlaw stronghold. Recruit heroes from Water Margin, keep your camp fed with automated supply routes, and lead your band in pausable real-time battles. A single-player survival and management game.

5268380.title: Green Again!
5268380.short_description: A pure logic puzzle that combines Minesweeper-style number deduction with water-line coverage on a hexagonal grid.

5268400.title: Weirdoku: The Files
5268400.short_description: Weirdoku: the Files is a horror puzzle game. You play as a new recruit at the Anomaly Bureau, reconstructing the scene from the clues and identifying the Anomaly hidden among the people.

5268480.title: Goblin Apocalypse: Open World Survival
5268480.short_description: The human king is dead, and the fragile peace of Turtek died with him. Survive as a goblin in an open world, solo or in co-op: sneak past raiders, fight with stamina-based combat, rescue goblins and peaceful humans, and build a colony that keeps working while you explore.

5268540.title: Idle Process
5268540.short_description: An incremental game played entirely through typed commands in a terminal window. You are a machine under contract. Spawn autonomous agents to perform work for you and use the tokens they create to research new improvements to your process.

5268640.title: Shrouded Aura
5268640.short_description: Shrouded Aura is a psychological horror experience where trauma, memory, and perception distort reality. Explore shifting environments, uncover conflicting diary entries, and survive disturbing manifestations as you piece together the truth. Play in VR or on PC.

5268890.title: Amaterasu in Hell
5268890.short_description: You are Amaterasu, the Japanese sun goddess, and circumstances force you to explore the realms of shadow to retrieve the former pets you once mistreated and cast into the Buddhist underworld. Between descents into the underworld, players can unwind in a cavern hub and converse with their animals.

5268930.title: Dokapon Kingdom: Connect 2
5268930.short_description: An all-new entry in the Dokapon series, the RPG-style board game you can enjoy with up to four players! Take on gigantic monsters together, and create your very own hero with the Character Creation system! Friendship or betrayal? Money or power? Sacrifice your friendships and seize victory!

5269050.title: Ranked Rock Paper Scissors
5269050.short_description: Win. Rip. Repeat. In this PvP Roguelike Deckbuilder. Face off in 1v1, 2v2, or 4v4 ranked matches and climb your way to the top of the Leaderboard. Show off your card drops in combat, on your profile, or trade them on the Steam Market. Master this battle of bluffs, counters, and calculated risks.

5269270.title: RUNGEON: Auto Roguelike
5269270.short_description: Fight through 100 dungeon rooms in this roguelite RPG with automatic turn-based combat. Choose upgrades after every victory, build your hero, defeat powerful bosses, and see how far you can survive.

5269300.title: TIP or RIP
5269300.short_description: TIP or RIP is a fast-paced action roguelike where you serve hungry monsters before they lose patience and eat you. Dash between tables, throw food, build ridiculous serving abilities, survive three increasingly dangerous restaurants, and feed the final mega-boss.

5269330.title: Rebirth: Monarch of the Dead
5269330.short_description: WEBTOON's No. 1 Action Comic, now an Interactive Game! Become the world's strongest Necromancer, but you've lost everyone on your path to power. Now, fate grants you a second chance! Change your destiny and save your loved ones through choices and battles. Rise again as Rebirth: Monarch of the Dead!

5269700.title: Gravity Trials
5269700.short_description: Manipulate gravity, move objects, and solve handcrafted physics puzzles in a mysterious sci-fi facility. Discover new mechanics, explore strange environments, uncover secrets, and rethink space, direction, and movement.

5269890.title: Biden Blast
5269890.short_description: Brawls on the island, cigarette-butt tossing, and a stealthy hunt for lightbulbs in the stairwell—welcome to Biden Blast. Play solo or compete against friends in absurd challenges where accuracy and audacity are everything.

5269910.title: Travellin Cats in Canada
5269910.short_description: Find many cats hidden across Canada in this cute hand-drawn hidden object game by Travellin Cats - the original viral hidden cat game creator! Can you find them all?

5269940.title: Battleterm
5269940.short_description: Battleterm is a drone combat simulator, a fusion of a simulator and a strategy game. It aims to simulate a real drone battlefield. Your task is to defeat the enemy by spawning different drones and coordinating their strategies. And the game economy matters too.

5270260.title: Desktop Cozy Sheep
5270260.short_description: Meet your new office companions! Watch your sheep and goats sleep, eat, and frolic while you work or relax. Unlock new animals and decorate the little pasture at the bottom of your screen!

5270310.title: Tin Happens!
5270310.short_description: Tin Happens is a realistic squash game built by squash players. Master drives, crosscourts, drops and boasts, outplay challenging AI, compete locally or online, and experience the speed, tactics and pressure of the sport.

5270330.title: SNATCH & BETRAY
5270330.short_description: SNATCH & BETRAY is a living tabletop treasure hunt. Explore the jungle, find gold, deal with traps, and decide when to cooperate with other adventurers — and when to take the treasure for yourself.

5270660.title: HOI! あっちむいてロケット
5270660.short_description: Lose at "look away" and you become the rocket. Once you're the rocket, crash into another player and pass it on. A party game for up to 4 players. Local, or online with friends.

5270720.title: Grow and Tell
5270720.short_description: Grow a garden, take care of your messenger bird and send anonymous letters to real people. Grow and Tell is an online incremental game that lives on your Windows desktop.

5270760.title: Tetrilaunch
5270760.short_description: An arcade physics puzzle where you aim and fire tetromino shipments into a compacting bay, build full rows, and survive escalating ten-bay runs.

5270820.title: Pixel Sorter Factory
5270820.short_description: First day at the factory: extract pixels, sort them, sell them. Then let the machines take over, until the factory runs itself. A blend of clicker, incremental gameplay, and pixel art… with a touch of mystery: where do all those pixels go?

5271010.title: Acorn Heist!
5271010.short_description: A rock-paper-scissors roguelike deckbuilder. See your opponent’s hand and read what they’ll throw next — a battle of wits, not luck. Build your deck, play after the reveal, force wins, and break the rules of rock-paper-scissors to steal acorns from the forest’s cute animal-eared girls.

5271020.title: Cookie Cartel
5271020.short_description: Sugar is illegal, the bakeries are shut, and Christmas tastes like nothing. But Grandma's recipe book survived. Bake in the back room with up to eight players, sell at the back door, and keep the Department of Sugar Affairs out of your kitchen.

5271080.title: Tillow
5271080.short_description: Tillow is a cozy isometric farm builder that keeps working while you do. Lay out fields, keep animals, make your own wine or distil grappa, and let your workers take over. Docked as a narrow bar at the edge of your screen, it keeps you company while you do other things. No losing, no timers.

5271100.title: Tales of Weak People
5271100.short_description: The centennial ritual failed, trapping the United Army inside the Cataclysm. A dark visual novel with Point & Click elements. Explore locations and unite with survivors, gather clues, and make choices to forge a path to the epicenter through madness and death.

5271150.title: Globecide
5271150.short_description: Fly a warship around a living planet and take it apart. Steer nukes into capitals, drop its moon on it, crack its crust, flood its coasts. Every crater stays, and the planet fires back. 72 worlds, a roguelite Rampage mode, and a Forge that turns any picture into a planet.

5271240.title: Swaggerfall
5271240.short_description: Swaggerfall is a first-person open world fantasy RPG that plays in the terminal. The graphics are ascii based and limited to what the command line offers. Playable with keyboard or gamepad.

5271310.title: Kingside Break
5271310.short_description: A chess game where you lead a customizable fantasy army through 1,500 levels of curated puzzles and real chess matches. Face checkpoint commanders, recruit new races, and customize your hero and army. Key chess concepts encountered are logged in a Sage Ledger for education and future reference.

5271330.title: Beezarr
5271330.short_description: Endless insect swarms, over a dozen bosses, 16 weapon evolutions: fight through 4 worlds as a tiny bee, rescue eggs from guarded nests and hatch 39 pets that fight by your side – from a goldfish to a cat with a minigun. A honey-sweet survivors-like for PC & Steam Deck.

5271490.title: Monsterpiece!
5271490.short_description: Battle rogue art tools and splatter them with color as you work to recreate beautiful paintings in this fast-paced combat game. Dodge enemy attacks, navigate obstacles, and experiment with your own creative strategies to bring each chaotic canvas to life!

5271550.title: Hungry Cataway
5271550.short_description: Chomp your way through levels, dodge enemies and escape! Hungry Cataway is a charming grid-based pixel-art arcade game. Blast through walls with bombs, outmaneuver hazards, and unleash your ultimate vomit attack to clear the path.

5271570.title: 1,000,000 Lentils & Ashes
5271570.short_description: Separate lentils from ash. By hand. One million items, two sorting pits, and you. A minimalist first-person game where every correctly sorted item brings you slightly closer to the end. Good luck.

5271580.title: Shred Inc.
5271580.short_description: Welcome to the NSA — the National Shredding Agency. Your job: destroy classified files, one sheet at a time. Feed the shredder, hit your quota, climb the ranks. And whatever you do, don't read the paperwork. Some files were just meant to be destroyed.

5271600.title: Nephele
5271600.short_description: You are the first eukaryote of Nephele! You have nothing but wisdom! Use your wisdom, to survive in such a cell-eat-cell world, and construct your cell civilization!

5271610.title: Cyber Sweeper
5271610.short_description: A top-down action survivor set in cyberspace. Sweep virus swarms, stack explosive builds, and clear sector after sector as a firewall defense program.

5271900.title: Fishbrary
5271900.short_description: Keep a mysterious fishing library on your desktop. Open six books to discover real fish, oddly adorable mutants, and prehistoric creatures. Display your catches in an aquarium, enjoy Idle or timed Focus Mode, and uncover an investigator's notes as your collection grows.

5271920.title: BOBA:3
5271920.short_description: A cozy merge puzzle in a boba cup. Drop kawaii animal pearls, merge matching pairs into bigger (and weirder) lil guys, and don't let the cup overflow. Survive chaotic modifier pearls and unlock new boba flavors as your high score climbs.

5271980.title: WANGZHA: Dou Dizhu Roguelike
5271980.short_description: WANGZHA is a roguelike deckbuilder built on Dou Dizhu, the Chinese shedding game (think President or Big Two) where a 2 beats an Ace. Play straights, planes and bombs against landlords who keep raising the rent. Multipliers aren't drawn here, they're grown, one hand at a time.

5272000.title: Gravitonia
5272000.short_description: Build and pilot custom war machines in space. Shred enemy ships, installations, and terrain pixel by pixel. Capture fortresses, upgrade your arsenal, and refit at Spacedocks. Conquer a single-player campaign, then create and share war machines, maps, and custom campaigns with the community.

5272230.title: Station 12
5272230.short_description: Station 12 is a chaotic sci-fi horror party game for 4–6 players, with larger lobbies up to 12. Find keycards and race to escape a doomed station while a friend hunts you as the Monster. Land the shot that saves your crew, or give away your hiding spot over proximity chat.

5272260.title: ALL HANDS LOST
5272260.short_description: A top-down mercenary space shooter. Take contracts across the Cassian Expanse, command a wing of fighters and drones, and hunt the pirate warlord Captain Bastard. Death costs your gear, cargo and half your credits; your data cores, ships and star charts carry on.

5272330.title: 供犠層 KYOGI STRATUM 操作員を募集しています
5272330.short_description: エネルギーが枯渇した日本社会。あなたは本日から操作手となる。 マウス操作で発電を行い、レバーを操作し、送電先を決める。時間制限が迫るなか、社会と自分に責任を持って供給先を判断しよう。謎の巨大装置を操作し、電力を供給するディストピア発電管理スリラー。

5272640.title: Midnight Callers
5272640.short_description: Spend an evening with friends in a regency-esque society with a monstrous twist! Supernatural suitors await a chance for romance, but family secrets, rumors, and your fellow players just might sabotage your prospects before the season comes to an end.

5272700.title: PAWSHOT
5272700.short_description: PAWSHOT - a deadly roulette for true predators. Count your shells, put your paws, fangs, and shotgun to use. Your life is on the line. Good luck.

5272710.title: Roadshift
5272710.short_description: Roadshift is a fast-paced arcade racing game featuring 42 handcrafted circuits, a full Career mode, challenging AI, local split-screen multiplayer, Time Attack, custom races and cups across seven distinctive environments.

5272860.title: Cook Or Get Cooked
5272860.short_description: A first-person cooking game on a television contest. Fetch, wash, chop, fry and plate real dishes against a clock, then hand them to a judge who eats them in front of you and marks them out of a hundred. Lowest mark of the round goes home.

5272880.title: Yes, Your Majesty!
5272880.short_description: Outrageous! A century on the throne—peace and prosperity across the realm—yet my flag covers but a speck on the map? I keep an elite army, and all they do is parade for me! Guards! A grand campaign begins! — Yes! Your Majesty!

5272890.title: Mammoth
5272890.short_description: Guide a dawning civilization through the early stages of humanity in this RTS roguelite. Discover new technologies and face enemies that will try to destroy you before reaching your full potential. But every time your tribe dies, their sons grow stronger and more powerful.

5273200.title: Harem of Lies
5273200.short_description: She's hoping you'll banish the wrong woman. How sweet. Unveil 30 adult anime characters in a single-player deduction roguelike, expose disguised succubi, and unlock their stories. Every Court can be won by reasoning alone. No forced guesses.

5273220.title: Spellsanity: Wizard Survival
5273220.short_description: Cleanse five realms of an arcane corruption in this dark fantasy survivors roguelite. Draft a new set of spells every run, build around your playstyle and cut down hordes of corrupted foes. Hunt powerful items, forge game-breaking synergies and grow stronger with every death.

5273310.title: Together Forever!
5273310.short_description: Together Forever! is a fast-paced ricochet roguelite where pachinko physics meets backpack management. Launch bouncing balls with flipping gravity, discover crazy relic synergies, and help an angel and demon couple defend their forbidden love against the hordes of Heaven and Hell!

5273490.title: BOZÓ!
5273490.short_description: BOZÓ is a dice roguelite where every roll can change your run. Build powerful combinations, use unique cards and relics, face dangerous challenges, and discover how far your luck can take you.

5273530.title: Spellspill: Magic Destruction Sandbox
5273530.short_description: A roguelite where your spells mess with the world around you. You can burn the grass under your enemies, but you can also freeze the pond and walk across it, or drop lightning into the water they stand in. Enemies ragdoll, houses fall apart, and every run takes a different route.

5273550.title: Ecos de Valdrenne
5273550.short_description: A dark, turn-based JRPG where the Resonator reads traces, changes enemy intentions and steals techniques. Explore a top-down 2D world of secrets, solve puzzles with eight divine powers, and decide what to preserve when memory itself fractures.

5273700.title: Kira the Fox: Crystals of Harmony
5273700.short_description: Free demo out now: all of World 1. A pixel-art 2D platformer where you earn your speed: the cleaner you chain, the faster Kira gets. Ten worlds, ten Crystals of Harmony to take back from King Crystus, bosses, a grapple, a rhythm mode. Made by one person in Quebec.

5273880.title: Squirrel Hood
5273880.short_description: Squirrel Hood is an adventure puzzle-fighting game where you will fight badgers with your bow and solve puzzles. The badgers have captured most of the squirrels and taken them to their island. Your mission is simple: find the captured squirrels and bring them home.

5274100.title: Karesansui
5274100.short_description: Karesansui is a zen garden meditative sandbox. Rake and decorate your desktop garden as you listen to the calming sounds of nature. Experiment with different patterns, lighting, and materials, and share the perfect photos with your friends.

5274450.title: Fading Youth
5274450.short_description: This is an interactive visual novel about youth, redemption, and a diary, with a playtime of 3 to 5 hours.

5274600.title: MINES SET!
