5274600.short_description: The roguelike minesweeper. MINES SET! is a satisfying puzzle game where you open an endless board, find game-changing sponsors and set off huge combos.

5274630.title: Infinite Fireball
5274630.short_description: Shout your incantations to cast spells in this chaotic co-op party game for up to 20 players! Play Colossus Guard, brawl in free-for-all or team deathmatches, and customize your magic words and character look. Embrace the chaos and show your unique style!

5274670.title: Revengeful dwell
5274670.short_description: This is a first-person horror adventure game. From horror game developer Akumu Yuko comes the third installment, “Revengeful dwell.”

5274840.title: A Mirror Apart
5274840.short_description: Explore a world inspired by Infinity Mirror Rooms. Guide Kagami through peaceful, handcrafted isometric puzzles, where every move echoes through imperfect mirrored spaces and each reflection becomes part of the solution.

5274850.title: Our Art Show
5274850.short_description: Open an art show with friends. Paint at the teaching easel while everyone watches the big screen. Hold up a finished canvas, find it a frame and a spot on the wall, and pass the music player to whoever brought the good songs.

5274880.title: Merchants Demise
5274880.short_description: A dark roguelike trading RPG where you lead a caravan through a dangerous kingdom, buy low, sell high, recruit a crew, survive brutal encounters, and gamble everything on one more, profitable journey.

5275040.title: Orbit Foundry
5275040.short_description: Turn a handful of machines into a bustling factory around a growing star. Orbit Foundry is a space incremental idle game where you reinvest your output, research upgrades, and automate your fleet. Watch production climb as your star changes color.

5275130.title: Machine Madness
5275130.short_description: Build your machine, connect moving parts, set goals, and watch physics take over. Professor Otto Correct has a workshop, a cat, and many parts that were never meant to go together.

5275380.title: Pico32: The Lost Pages
5275380.short_description: A magical book appears in the woods, transported somehow from another dimension. Pico32: The Lost Pages is packed cover-to-cover with 32 creative games spanning every genre. Its chapters recall the history of a doomed world, and whisper a warning for our own.

5275410.title: Tomb Extraction
5275410.short_description: A multiplayer tomb-raiding horror game supporting up to four players, where you infiltrate ancient tombs, loot valuable burial treasures, and escape alive. Players can assume the role of a Taoist priest and use incantations to subdue the evil spirits within the tombs

5275590.title: Dirt Town
5275590.short_description: Use incredible physics to create roads by pushing dirt, felling trees, moving rocks, hauling gravel. Dig a pit for resources, build a race track for the dirt bike! Get paid and buy more machines. Multiplayer for up to four players

5275640.title: Heroes Never Die
5275640.short_description: Choose your hero, rally your troops, and carve a path through hordes of foul creatures in a fast-paced fusion of strategy and survivor gameplay. Grow your army as you march, change your tactics on the fly, and lead soldiers, goblins, minotaurs and more into glorious, chaotic battle.

5275690.title: Pocket Partner
5275690.short_description: A lightweight, fully customizable desktop companion. Bring 3D anime characters to your screen with full VRM support. Experience unprecedented control: import your own animations, edit materials, change facial expressions, save custom outfits, and interact with physics while you work or play.

5275750.title: Epsilon Aurigae
5275750.short_description: Stranded in a nebula with a broken hyperdrive. Interact with peculiar creatures that call this corner of the galaxy their home in order to trade for items and ultimately get the parts that you need to fix your ship.

5275760.title: All That Glitters
5275760.short_description: Faites vos jeux! Step into the Gombling's Lair of Sin and push your luck to earn ludicrous amount of riches in a casino themed roguelike dungeon crawler! Go bling or go home, and remember that is not gold all that glitters!

5275840.title: AI Startup Manager: Race to AGI
5275840.short_description: Build an AI lab in a deep management sim about the race to AGI. Recruit researchers, train models, secure funding and outmaneuver rival labs. Balance growth against safety, manage your team and face the consequences of every launch.

5275920.title: Crimson Nova: The Star Gear Jobs
5275920.short_description: A masked hero for hire. A starship crew who need his ship far more than his opinions. Six jobs that were all meant to be easy, in a fully voiced sci-fi comedy visual novel with animated characters and choices the crew remember.

5275930.title: Grave Company
5275930.short_description: A chaotic co-op zombie game for up to 10 players! Fight your way into creepy cemeteries overrun by hordes of zombies, grab bizarre objects and race against the clock. A random toilet in the middle of a cemetery? No time to ask questions!

5275950.title: NEARBY: 3 LIKES
5275950.short_description: A photoreal cinematic gay romance adventure set in Tokyo. Three men have liked Yuto's profile. Meet them in person, talk over coffee, walk by the river — and choose how close you get. Japanese voice, written choices, and three relationships.

5276060.title: How Deep
5276060.short_description: A co-op extraction mining game for 1-4 players. Ride the elevator down into procedurally generated caves, dig up treasure, fight off what lurks in the dark, then decide whether to head back to the surface or risk going deeper.

5276180.title: Mission Nuts
5276180.short_description: More than a colorful 2D action-adventure platformer, Mission Nuts is a personal artistic vision blending exploration, humor, original poetry, hidden lore and philosophical reflection. Follow Wiewiu on a heartfelt journey about friendship, hope and finding light in life's darkest moments.

5276230.title: Revenge For Two
5276230.short_description: Revenge For Two is a narrative-driven 3D action-adventure game featuring platforming and puzzle elements, with two unique playable characters between whom the player can switch at almost any time.

5276510.title: The Dust Remembers
5276510.short_description: A fallen world. On the wasteland, survival is all that matters. You walked alone—until you met them. Together or against, Trust or doubt, Closer or apart. Every choice leaves a mark, changing the story and your ending. Your decisions define this journey.

5276760.title: THREADMILL
5276760.short_description: Write code that controls an entire robotic workforce. Start with one worker, then scale to 128. Share jobs, feed machines, and adapt when power fails. Test your code in new facilities, then tune it to do more with less.

5276790.title: Everyone Expire
5276790.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you're the Dungeon Master and the party trusts you completely. Bait the room, rig the dice, and keep them alive just long enough to die at the boss. The paladin can't swim. The bard licks things. You've taken notes.

5276840.title: Doc, I Don't Want to Die! Slice the Infection
5276840.short_description: Pilot a tiny ship in this 2D shooter, upgrade your weapons and battle a variety of bacterial enemies. Blast, dash and slice your way through the infection.

5277020.title: Jenoria
5277020.short_description: Create your own Jeno companions, lead them into battle, and build a town together. Explore a voxel sandbox action RPG where you can storm forts, delve into dungeons, and sail the skies in a custom-built airship. Shape your companions, your army, and the world you call home.

5277210.title: The Chair Game
5277210.short_description: A slightly tricky physics action game about going home in an office chair. Casters are less obliging than you'd think: hills are hard work, stopping isn't easy, and one pebble can send you tumbling into the sea. Push off with your feet, spin the seat, lean back, chair and all — and still, go home.

5277350.title: Corporate Simulator
5277350.short_description: Climb from intern to CEO in this idle/incremental game where your company runs on a living spreadsheet. Hire, crush morale, rig the audits, and rack up ISO certifications... all the way to burnout or a golden retirement. 18 playable visual themes, dozens of hours of progression.

5277420.title: Omega Transmission
5277420.short_description: Omega Transmission is a short PSX-styled action-platformer, set in a dystopian future where AI has taken over civilization. Humanity's last chance is a secret network deployed through antennas on the tallest skyscrapers of the Megalopolis. Activate the antenna in each city to enable the revolution.

5277740.title: Locked In: The Ward
5277740.short_description: Locked In: The Ward is a first-person psychological horror set inside the abandoned Ravenrock Research Facility. Explore its medical ward, solve environmental puzzles, survive the darkness, and uncover the truth behind Subject #0012 as stress distorts your perception.

5277890.title: Desperatea
5277890.short_description: A dish-pushing, liquid-pouring puzzle game all about a strange substance known as 'tea'.

5277960.title: The Arcane Open
5277960.short_description: A fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where the only enemy is the golf course.

5278260.title: Fire Buller
5278260.short_description: Throw a flaming bull from a baseball stadium as far as it goes: over the city, past the Moon and Mars, to the edge of the universe and on to 10^1000 km. Wherever it lands, it crashes and rampages. Distance times destruction buys a stronger arm and twenty wilder bulls.

5278280.title: Terminal Depth
5278280.short_description: An incremental digging game where buried salvage fuels a growing excavation to unearth ancient artifacts and piece together a lost history with every layer you uncover. Upgrade your tools, unlock automated helpers, and blast through tougher layers with powerful abilities.

5278380.title: The Millionth Ticket
5278380.short_description: The Millionth Ticket is a lottery simulator: Buy tickets, pick numbers and watch live draws on TV. Manage your money and pay rent so your asshole landlord won't kick you out. Hit the jackpot and escape your shitty life to spend your days drinking and watching TV.

5278520.title: ARUFA - The Blade of Fate
5278520.short_description: An anime-inspired 3D hack-and-slash game where you chain attacks, dodge enemy strikes, unleash powerful abilities, and challenge yourself to defeat a dangerous boss.

5278530.title: Rosalia: Match-3 Puzzle
5278530.short_description: Solve puzzles, collect magical outfits, decorate your home, and help the heroine save the world.

5278570.title: Take Your Time - A Relaxing Collection of Minigames
5278570.short_description: The most hectic relaxing game you'll ever play

5278600.title: Dwarven King
5278600.short_description: Build a dwarven kingdom inside a mountain. Dig tunnels, hire miners to gather resources, and expand your settlement. Explore hidden halls, collect relics, and rally soldiers and sorcerers against the goblins and trolls you uncover.

5278740.title: Tiny Tyrant: Dungeon Master
5278740.short_description: Build and Customize your dungeon, place deadly traps, defenses and monsters to fight alongside in this FPS / Tower Defense hybrid. Stop those dastardly heroes from stealing your hard-earned treasure.

5278920.title: Arena Shooter
5278920.short_description: Hop in a tank. Call in a nuke. Flatten the fortress. Battle your friends and bots in a top-down arena shooter with 20 unique maps and modes, 60+ vehicle types, 40+ perks, zombie hordes and a classic Zombie Boss, in a fully destructible world where everything goes.

5278970.title: Sketchy Warfare
5278970.short_description: A turn-based tactical war game where stick-figure armies from across history collide. Command 11 unique teams, master dozens of units and weapons, and fight through a campaign for every era—from cavemen and pirates to modern soldiers, fantasy warriors, and the armies of the future.

5279010.title: Tide Pools
5279010.short_description: Rake the beach before the tide comes in! Uncover shells, fossils and lost treasures, fill your seaside museum with visitors and grow your rake across ten shores in a cozy pixel-art incremental.

5279070.title: TENEGRAD
5279070.short_description: You have a new job. There’s only you, concrete megastructures, snow and cold. Deliver cargo, maintain the base, repair vehicles, explore. Just don't stare into the dark for too long and always lock the doors.

5279320.title: Taco Truck Simulator
5279320.short_description: You will run your own food truck: take orders, cook fresh ingredients, and quickly assemble delicious tacos while hungry customers wait in line. But running a food truck is about more than speed: source supplies wisely, maintain steady cash flow, and win over diners with every satisfying bite

5279340.title: Ladder Knight
5279340.short_description: A small hero, a trusty ladder, and a world full of trouble. Explore strange lands, solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and face mighty bosses in this pixel-art platformer. Put your ladder to work in ways it was never built for.

5279430.title: Devilcoin
5279430.short_description: A coin-flip roguelite. You traded your soul for money, and now the only way out of this occult purgatory is to keep flipping. Bet on heads or tails, collect Artifacts that bend the odds, and hit the score before your flips run out.

5279710.title: Glitch Front
5279710.short_description: Glitch Front is a tactical cyberpunk card battler where team chemistry matters as much as the cards you draw. Build your crew, combine powerful faction synergies, master separate Play and Combat decks, and fight for control of a shared Warzone.

5279820.title: Bladehold
5279820.short_description: Demolish monstrous hordes on horseback or foot, unleash devastating abilities, build the ultimate hero, and protect your fortress with deadly automated defenses in this fast-paced action roguelite.

5279840.title: SCRAPSCRAP
5279840.short_description: You're a lone robot that was left behind to clean up all of humanity's trash. Break down trash piece by piece and recycle them into tools, upgrades and a whole crew of helper bots. Stack up all the trash and restore the planet in this physics-driven incremental game.

5280000.title: CARTACLYSM
5280000.short_description: A chaotic, physics-based party game. Compete against your friends. Sabotage your opponents with power-ups, physics and pure pettiness. Honk your way towards your rightful spot as the Top Goose.

5280020.title: The Golfing Hour
5280020.short_description: A realistic-that-turns-goofy Golf incremental game! Earn cash as you golf to buy powerful upgrades. Golf enough and you can turn pro, one step closer to becoming OVERPOWERED! Play with friends, launch your golf ball across different worlds, and see how far one swing can go!

5280300.title: Dolphincremental
5280300.short_description: Become a dolphin and turn the world into a Frutiger Aero utopia by collecting gems and making friends under the sea in this incremental mining game! Danger lurks in the deep, will you survive and make it back to the surface?

5280310.title: Himekishi Survivor
5280310.short_description: Protect dragon eggs and fight enemy hordes with auto-attacking skills and rideable dragons. Collect and fuse gear, unlock outfits that change your starting skill, and turn defeat into Awakening powers. Conquer four stages and their mighty bosses in Himekishi Survivor.

5280900.title: Asteroid Lanes
5280900.short_description: Draw trade lanes across a single seamless universe drawn in symbols and lines, and let your ships mine, haul and sell on their own. Chase the materials you lack and the regions you want, push your network outward, and hold the lanes against pirates.

5281050.title: Just A DVD Incremental
5281050.short_description: Remember waiting for the DVD logo to hit the exact corner of the TV screen? Now you don't have to wait. Upgrade speed, efficiency, and special effects to maximize your bounces in this relaxing incremental idle game. Will it hit the corner?

5281120.title: Super Doodle Mega War
5281120.short_description: Bring your notebook doodles to life! Build an army of scribbled soldiers, upgrade and merge your auto-battling troops, and unleash skills against overwhelming enemy hordes. A roguelite auto-battler where one little doodle becomes a mighty army.

5281140.title: 国gal笑笑传
5281140.short_description: 当国产galgame占领了整个世界。吃饭、睡觉、打工、购买，这个世界的一切都围绕国产galgame发生。你将在这里体验到超过50款“有趣”的galgame游戏。努力打工然后购买更多galgame吧！

5281350.title: Wuchang: Three Kingdoms Survivors
5281350.short_description: Wuchang: Three Kingdoms Survivors is a dark Three Kingdoms roguelite survivor game. Customize your background and destiny talents, ally with deities and summon reincarnated stellar generals. Build unique builds with randomized affix gear & divine bonds, fight through endless enemy hordes.

5281790.title: Illyrium: Chronicles
5281790.short_description: Recruit heroes and craft powerful builds from masteries, classes, spells and equipment. Use these systems to build each character your way, then command your party in challenging turn-based tactical combat.

5281800.title: Life in Frydenlund
5281800.short_description: A story-driven cozy game set in 1930. A hand-crafted story with many unique characters. Build, grow, plant and fish your way to drive the storyline forward while befriending the local villagers. Enjoy your Life in Frydenlund!

5281870.title: Tailgun
5281870.short_description: A minimalist snake-survivor roguelite. Steer through enemy swarms, build your arsenal with weapons and upgrades, and unlock new content with every run.

5281900.title: Leave Them Outside
5281900.short_description: A life sim. Except you're in the real world. After the bombs fall, Shelter 38 beneath Kadıköy is yours to run. You decide who gets in, and you do whatever it takes to keep everyone inside alive. Multiple endings, shaped by your choices.

5281920.title: Cry Of Monster CH2
5281920.short_description: After escaping the first creature, the flesh fungus infection has torn through the neighboring city. You wake up at its gates to find your best friend safe. However, bound by morality, you must witness and endure the grotesque transformation of a sovereign people. Survive the horrors to come.

5282130.title: Last Pasture
5282130.short_description: Enemies swarm every night. Gather resources, upgrade your weapons, and protect your livestock alongside your companions.

5282260.title: CULET
5282260.short_description: Strike a glowing crystal monolith until it shatters. Every click cracks it further, shards break off and become currency, and upgrades carry you through twelve crystals, from Amethyst to Diamond. A focused, finite clicker about one beautiful object and the joy of breaking it.

5282270.title: SEAM VR
5282270.short_description: SEAM is a VR voxel survival sandbox where your hands reshape the world. Use gravity gloves to gather resources, dig into the landscape, and build a home block by block. Explore, craft, and turn the wilderness into a place of your own.

5282420.title: Border Pastoral Tale
5282420.short_description: A relaxing, wholesome cartoon-style herding simulation game. Become a sheepdog and guide scattered flocks back to their pens across vast grasslands while fending off wolf attacks. Supports local 2-player co-op with simple controls. Experience pure fun through agile movement and precise herding!

5282430.title: Fastfood Burger Stories
5282430.short_description: Manage your own fast-food restaurant: take orders, cook meals, serve customers, and hire staff. Furnish and customize your restaurant, manage supplies, upgrade equipment, and grow a small burger joint into a large restaurant.

5282530.title: Toad Roller
5282530.short_description: A timed nervous arcade platformer where a punk toad spirals his way up rotating towers. 3 worlds, 30 towers, 3 stars per tower to earn against the clock, local and world best times, and a level editor to build your own towers.

5282630.title: Until You're Empty
5282630.short_description: A fast-paced action platformer set in a vertical arena. Dash, leap and slash through waves of enemies and deadly bosses. Manage your stamina carefully: every jump and sword strike costs you, and one mistake can leave you running on empty. One hit is all it takes to die.

5282710.title: Quiet Bloom
5282710.short_description: Quiet Bloom is a cozy idle game. Awaken the wind, dig wells, and call the rain to tend your land for you. Gather wood, stone, and water, raise wind vanes and solar panels, and watch a cracked desert slowly bloom into a luxuriant green oasis.

5282750.title: We'll Meet Again
5282750.short_description: When someone takes their own life, the pain doesn't end with them. It passes to those left behind. A short story about the guilt, anger and unanswered questions of the people who stay.

5282860.title: Necrolord
5282860.short_description: Command an undead army in this dark fantasy auto-battler roguelite. Raise fallen enemies, equip your troops and turn battles with powerful spells. Explore procedurally generated lands. Lose your army, reincarnate and rebuild with your retained magic and lich abilities.

5282880.title: Bloodloader
5282880.short_description: A fast top-down roguelite where every rifle shot is earned with the bayonet. Stab to load, shoot to kill: build a weapon from a bayonet and a rifle, take favours from four old powers and climb four hellish realms to take your flight back from the Redeemer.

5282970.title: AI 位面旅者：无限世界
5282970.short_description: 《AI 位面旅者：无限世界》是一款由 AI 实时驱动的团队冒险 RPG。你带着队伍在位面之间穿梭：探索区域、完成任务、打怪、升级、招募同伴；也可以在信标塔手填世界观、区域、角色与部队，造一个完全属于自己的位面。剧情、敌人、事件全部由 AI 现场生成，没有两次冒险是一样的。每个角色都有自己的记忆与打算，会按自己的目标行动；你不在的时候，区域里的角色仍在自行流动。角色、装备、技能、血统分 D 到 SSS 品级，敌人与友军部队是成建制的单位；回合制战斗可手动指挥每一次出手。买断制，需自备 AI 服务商 API Key 驱动剧情。

5283230.title: DEKABUTU
5283230.short_description: The giant raid boss is played by a human. DEKABUTU is an asymmetric shooter where one player becomes the boss and faces a squad of soldiers. Tanks, healers and attackers team up in first person, while the boss surveys the field and picks where and when to strike. Outwit friends, then swap roles.

5283250.title: We Are Bodies
5283250.short_description: Drag a sinner to Hell, where he belongs! In this physics-based co-op puzzle platformer for 1-2 players, you play as rookie devils who can only control one leg each. Stumble, dodge and solve your way through the chaos to drop him into the pit of Hell.

5283270.title: MAMA
5283270.short_description: Mama is a psychological horror game with a dark, unsettling atmosphere, set on the abandoned fifth floor of an old Soviet apartment building. As you explore, you will slowly uncover what happened there and why the entire floor was left behind.

5283280.title: MEGAMINE
5283280.short_description: Dig up, not down. Pilot a mining pod through an endless shaft, six biomes and the boss guarding each one. Eighteen weapons that fire themselves, twenty-nine items to find, six miners to choose from, and one loaf of bread a biome for when your hearts run low

5283350.title: Above Water, Below Hell
5283350.short_description: Fight your way through a zombie-infested high-rise in flooded Chicago. Inspect survivors, track their symptoms, and lead them to safety in this first-person horror shooter. Fortify your route and protect your group. One missed infection can turn a rescue into a massacre.

5283550.title: Debt & Daylight
5283550.short_description: Aim every coin drop in a tactile 3D coin-pusher roguelike. Upgrade the machine, chase special coins, and beat six midnight bills before debt takes it all.

5283780.title: What Da Font: Tidy Up the Print Shop
5283780.short_description: A cozy first person organizing game. Thieves turned over every case in a 1920s print shop: gather 5,000 pieces of lead type from two floors, tell one typeface from another, and put them back. Every case you finish opens a job to print, and the ten printed posters keep the combination to a safe.

5284030.title: Soft 17
5284030.short_description: A blackjack roguelite, then a poker one. Every winning hand scores chips × MULT, and your items push the MULT higher. Beat four casinos, furnish your cellar, then cheat at the tables of four poker houses under the dealers' eyes. Solo, or up to four players online.

5284050.title: Waymark
5284050.short_description: Waymark blends scenic jigsaw puzzles with deckbuilding and spell combos. Build your spell deck, rotate and place puzzle pieces, and chain effects to take on monsters. Explore city landmarks, collect local souvenirs, and fill your travel journal with the places you discover.

5284120.title: Beneath the Pile
5284120.short_description: A cozy first-person organization and tidying game. Sift through piles, recover broken workstations, process materials at five hands-on stations, and build a magical production line to complete the King's shipment.

5284180.title: SUPRA CAELIS
5284180.short_description: Crash-landed on an alien world, fleeing a war you no longer believe in. You'll have to cross two planets on opposite ends of existence, guided by a dormant robot carrying secrets of its own. Explore. Scavenge. Uncover the truth behind the conflict that shaped both your fates.

5284300.title: Froggy's Delivery
5284300.short_description: A chaotic co-op cooking and delivery game. Team up with your friends, cook food on the go, keep the orders coming, and somehow make it to the customer intact!

5284380.title: CARD SHOP SHUFFLE!
5284380.short_description: CARD SHOP SHUFFLE! is a cozy, single-player organizing sim about identifying and sorting 2,500 cards scattered across the floor of a card shop. There are no timers or game overs, so you can work at your own pace. Appraise each card, unlock skills to work more efficiently, and maximize your profits.

5284410.title: Whispers
5284410.short_description: Whispers is a psychological horror game where you explore an abandoned hospital, investigate its dark secrets, and follow the final footage of a missing vlogger. Listen for unsettling whispers, uncover clues, and navigate a reality where you can no longer trust what you see or hear.

5284470.title: Railminer
5284470.short_description: Turn a tiny drill into a massive mining machine. Extract resources, sell your haul, and expand your train with cutters, lasers, rockets, and drones. Every run pays for your next upgrade in this incremental mining game.

5284970.title: Spirits: Wake Up!
5284970.short_description: SPIRITS: WAKE UP! is a 2–8 player online horror party game. Speak into your mic to chase as a Hunter, or float through retro sewers, complete tasks, and rescue friends as a Ghost. Just don't let your screams give you away!

5285090.title: Ruinhand
5285090.short_description: Turn the room into your weapon in this tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Ignite oil, chain lightning and shove guards into mines. Climb ten Ruin levels per hero, uncover each hero's story, chase the Daily Ruin, race up to four friends live, or bring one into co-op.

5285410.title: The Grander
5285410.short_description: Settle a 10,000 year war in this comedic Top Down Action RPG where God is just a guy in jeans. Gather powerful weapons and even more powerful allies as you dash, slice, shoot, and bomb your way through a war-torn world.

5285620.title: One More Candle
5285620.short_description: A cozy candle shop simulator where you take customer orders, melt and mix wax with colors and herbs, pour candles into unique molds, decorate each creation, and grow your little business one warm glow at a time.

5285630.title: Dead Descent
5285630.short_description: Dead Descent is a 4-player, online co-op, psychological horror game. You and your team of urban explorers will enter a secret underground lab filled with failed experiments and try to gather as much evidence against the company as you can. Use your survival skills to make it out alive... If you can.

5285780.title: Undertow
5285780.short_description: Scavenge the island for anything that floats, build a raft with your team, and battle other players in casual online PvP to be the last raft floating.

5285800.title: Driver Survivor
5285800.short_description: A driving survivors-like where your car is the weapon. Drift through zombie hordes, stack automatic weapons and upgrades, smash through a destructible city, and rescue survivors in a branching story—or push your build to its limit in endless mode.

5285840.title: Leif's Garden Tower
5285840.short_description: Grow plants, tend the greenhouse, and fall in love with the customers of Leif's Garden Tower. Leif's Garden Tower is a cozy 2D tower-builder about a lonely leaf spirit rebuilding an abandoned greenhouse, help him restore the tower and learn its secrets.

5286260.title: VoxKart: Combat Circuit Racing
5286260.short_description: Combat racing against a pack of computer rivals or your friends online, in cars built from voxels. Draft, drift and shoot your way through 10 circuits, upgrade 55 cars in your garage, and watch rivals come apart block by block when their armour gives out.

5286460.title: Orbital  Sweeper
5286460.short_description: Become an Orbital Sweeper: explore the orbit, clear the debris, return to run your factory and upgrade your ship, challenge each layer's boss, then play a round of Space Mahjong in your downtime.

5286530.title: Minds & Myths
5286530.short_description: Human-authored adventures, made interactive by AI. A story map keeps the plot on track while every character thinks for itself. Bring your own AI key: buy once, no subscription, your stories stay on your PC.

5286760.title: Imp Pact
5286760.short_description: An incremental where an ageing man who cannot read makes his mark on an imp's contract, puts the imps to work on the rats in his cellar, and is billed for the trial period. Keep the interest current, in blood, every forty-five seconds, or he takes imps back, and is apologetic about it.

5286990.title: MAGEKIN
5286990.short_description: Battle rival mages, collect spells, and build ridiculous combos in a third-person multiplayer arena. Grow stronger as you fight players and waves of monsters, grab powerful loot, and finish with the highest score to win.

5287130.title: House of 21
5287130.short_description: Fight cursed enemies in a blackjack roguelike deckbuilder set inside a phantom casino purgatory. Push your luck, upgrade your cards with unique badges, collect relics, and uncover strange events as you battle your way out of the House. If the House lets you…

5287140.title: Nine Tenths
5287140.short_description: In San Verde, the law is absolute— except for you. A text-based crime management game where you evade the law to rule the underworld. Launder your cash, vet your buyers, deploy the right crew, and manage your firepower to build an empire beyond the reach of the law.

5287250.title: Path to Transcendence（追境）
5287250.short_description: Path to Transcendence : a Chinese story driven auditory puzzle game. The story takes place in the Northern Song Dynasty, spanning 30 years from Qinling Mountains to Bianjing. The narrative mainly revolves around light puzzles. Make an appointment to follow and wait for good news.

5287540.title: 8plus9
5287540.short_description: 8plus9 is an isometric action RPG inspired by Taiwanese temple folklore. Slash through spirits, cast talisman magic, tame cats and dogs, and challenge five elemental dragons. Forge your gear, ride a spirit beast, or keep growing with auto-hunting and offline rewards.

5287690.title: PUYON
5287690.short_description: A fresh take on mouse action! PUYON is a level-based, top-down 2D action game where you use your mouse to reach the goal without bumping into walls or objects.

5287980.title: Backpack Legion
5287980.short_description: Build an army in your backpack! Place soldiers next to weapons and watch them fight to destroy the enemy base. Send in a huge army, or fully equip a few elite troops to beat bigger forces. Mix soldiers, weapons and gems to try all kinds of builds. Fight other players' saved armies—no waiting!

5288040.title: Spin Tide
5288040.short_description: Spin to win in this open-sea survivors-like where a lone wind turbine becomes a force of nature. Stack wild upgrades into game-breaking builds, turn oil-guzzling pirate hordes into driftwood and defy colossal oil tankers to clean up the seas one spin at a time.

5288270.title: Mightmancer
5288270.short_description: An old-school first-person action RPG set across a vast open world. Explore dungeons, fight hordes of enemies, master four mixable classes, recruit companions. Relive the iconic blend of 2D and 3D art unique to late-90s RPGs.

5288530.title: Silent Fright
5288530.short_description: A co-op survival horror game for up to six players. You are a crew of elves sent to save a space station knocked out of orbit. Gather dark matter to power your gear, but stay quiet, because something is sleeping in the dark. Wake it and it hunts you. Charge up, and hunt it back.

5288650.title: Love Locks
5288650.short_description: Love is forever. Until you bring bolt cutters. Remove 100,000 love locks solo or near friends in this relaxing cleanup game. Fish for keys with a magnet in the Seine in Paris, unlock tools from lockpicks to lasers, and turn romantic gestures into scrap metal 🔐

5288740.title: Lumi: A Cat in the Mist
5288740.short_description: Lumi returns to find her village lost in mist. Ghosts linger where the villagers once lived. Creep through bushes, scramble over rooftops and let your magic amulet lead you into trouble. Solve puzzles to help lost spirits find peace. Keep out of reach of the rest.

5288780.title: Schooligans
5288780.short_description: A chaotic school party game for 1 to 8 players. Pull off the dumbest stunts, film everything on your phone, outsmart teachers who can hear your voice, sneak out at night and betray your friends to become the most popular kid at Coolischool. A stunt nobody filmed never happened.

5288840.title: Stolen Sun
5288840.short_description: Stolen Sun is a co-op game for 1–4 players. You are astronauts crash-landed on a planet in impenetrable darkness. Light is your only tool and greatest threat. Explore procedural locations, gather resources, upgrade your base on a giant turtle, and escape to see the sun.

5288880.title: Feste Feiern: German Festival Tycoon
5288880.short_description: Funfair, Christmas market, festival of lights, Halloween, wine festival, flea market and more: run the festivals of a German town – each with its own stalls, visitors, season and way of making money. Steer the crowds and turn an empty meadow into the best festival in town.

5289120.title: Nectar Spines
5289120.short_description: You encounter your handsome model neighbor in the story, but he harbors dark intentions toward you… A stormy night approaches. Evade his pursuit and struggle desperately. Yet the second you launch the game, escape is impossible.

5289390.title: Alarion: The Ruined King
5289390.short_description: Alarion: The Ruined King is a dark fantasy action game. A dead king awakens through the power of his own blood and sets out across a demon-infested kingdom. unleash forbidden blood powers, battle deadly enemies and bosses, and face Malachar to end his reign.

5289450.title: Tower of Sequence
5289450.short_description: Tower of Sequence is a beginner-friendly anime-style DBG developed by a solo developer.

5289670.title: Soul Gathering
5289670.short_description: No mana. Unleash your entire hand. But every card wears down with use, until it shatters. Run out of cards, and you lose—even with HP remaining. Play now or save for later? Survive your own decisions. A roguelike deckbuilder with seven unique souls.

5289730.title: The Lostwood
5289730.short_description: The Lostwood combines a hardcore turn-based roguelike of strategy and resource management with PvP mind games full of laughs. Prepare your loadout, automate combat loops and explore a dark forest. Or join 2–8 player Steam battles for bold reads, clutch plays and wild comebacks.

5290030.title: Spellvoc
5290030.short_description: A chaotic co-op game where 2–4 apprentice wizards use magic to fill orders, on the couch or online. Pull ingredients closer with telekinesis and fire up the cauldron with a fireball. Bridges collapse and trains barrel through, but your creations still have to reach the owl on time!

5290540.title: Skiing Red
5290540.short_description: A physics-based rage game about skiing to the bottom of a mountain. Control your skis individually, dodge questionable obstacles and try not to crash.. You will crash.. A lot.

5290610.title: Slime Break
5290610.short_description: Tower defense against a horde of thousands of slimes. Build walls, towers and traps along a funnel, pick level cards that bend each run, and watch the mass pile up, split and break through. Spend essence between runs to grow stronger.

5290620.title: Wind and Splinters
5290620.short_description: Play as a musketeer in boarding fights, a gunner in cannon duels, or the helmsman of a 17th-century ship, all in first person. Fight solo or team up with friends, battle each other or the AI, and command your crew. Snap masts, smash hulls, tear ships apart — literally. Use the wind to win.

5290810.title: The Last Encore
5290810.short_description: The Last Encore is a wave-based arena shooter set in a marionette theatre, and nothing auto-fires here: you aim, and you count every round. You're the last puppet in the workshop, and the whole cast has taken the stage to find you.

5291380.title: Panning Out
5291380.short_description: Pan a sleepy creek for gold, melt it down at your forge and craft rings, coins and crowns for your village. Panning Out is a cozy gold rush: no hurry, no stress, just the joy of a nugget glinting in your pan.

5291570.title: Patadas
5291570.short_description: Quesito & Turrón are two ducks with puzzles to solve. Coordinate, push things around, and find your way to the end of each level in this small free game for two. Play on the same screen or remotely with Steam Remote Play Together.

5291660.title: Withstand The Horde
5291660.short_description: Withstand The Horde is a strategy and base-building game. Raise a walled city, recruit soldiers and hold off waves of enemies: 4,000 zombies simulated, up to 1,050 drawn on screen. Includes a guided tutorial. Build, defend, expand, and withstand the horde.

5291750.title: Knights of Jikan
5291750.short_description: Six heroes must travel back in time to defeat a powerful enemy and save the kingdom of Jikan!

5292590.title: PW7A
5292590.short_description: You awaken from a long sleep as a robot. All you know is that this game is called PW7A. Turn your insights into the power to open new paths in this compact 2D pixel-art puzzle adventure.
developers: スイカ食べ食べうさぎ
publishers: スイカ食べ食べうさぎ

5292790.title: Honk
5292790.short_description: Honk is a free-to-play, one-button precision platformer where you race real players online. Tap to jump past spikes, pipes and rocket cats, climb the ranked ladder, battle through tournaments every few hours, build your own levels, and hatch over 100 skins for your collection!

5292860.title: Tidy Slot Cars
5292860.short_description: Tidy a slot car club and take your favourites to the track! Sort 1,497 cars by model and colour in this cozy first-person organising game. Unlock cars as you tidy, build your own circuits, and race your cat or a friend in local split-screen.

5293090.title: FACULA
5293090.short_description: Explore, Build, and Fight in this handcrafted solar system with many secrets to discover and enemies to defeat! FACULA is an open world exploration and base-building focused game where you fight monsters and survive on an array of unknown worlds.

5293460.title: The Fallen Merman
5293460.short_description: An officially licensed visual novel based on Lin Qian's The Fallen Merman. A distress call from an abandoned aquarium reunites Bai Chunian and Lanbo. In a world of genetic modification and supernatural powers, relive their journey from wary encounters to a love that defies species and death.

5293780.title: Balliators
5293780.short_description: Build a deck of wild balls, throw them into the arena and watch them bounce, collide and explode for points. A roguelike deckbuilder where every ball bends the rules: draft, roll, shop and beat four stages of bosses.

5294180.title: Hollywood Hacker
5294180.short_description: Type fast, hack everything. An arcade typing game of movie-style hacking: lock onto firewalls, ICE and drones by typing, chain combos up to x64, and rob a bank, a casino, a satellite, a city and a megacorp across 100 levels and five guardian AIs.

5294620.title: Barbe-Yeux
5294620.short_description: A comedy narrative adventure in 6 chapters. Explore islands, lead your crew into battle, go fishing, play dice at the tavern and lose all your gold again. You play a captain convinced he's a legend, flanked by two companions whose entire vocabulary is almost "Gloubi".

5295080.title: Silent Frequency
5295080.short_description: One night. A dead mountain road. An abandoned radio tower where your grandfather stopped answering. All he left behind: handwritten notes, scattered frequencies and his voice on tape. Bring the tower back to life and listen closely. Something out there is listening back.

5295110.title: Gate B7
5295110.short_description: Verify documents, stamp boarding passes, and uphold the regime's strict laws at a dystopian airport terminal. Every decision matters: take bribes to keep your family alive, or stay loyal to survive your 20-day shift. But be careful: Some anomalies aren't found on paper.

5295290.title: Paladin HC
5295290.short_description: Command a 3D Paladin self-propelled howitzer in this tactical artillery simulator game. Join historical military operations. Calculate firing ranges, manage resources, and support allies. Add Paladin HC to your Steam wishlist and support our indie team!

5296090.title: Runecast
5296090.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where the cards are letters. Draft runes, spell real words to cast spells, collect powerful relics and scrolls and fight your way up the tower. Seven modes, including an asynchronous online Arena. Play in English or Greek: two dictionaries, two different games.

5296170.title: Peso Pena
5296170.short_description: Train, build your fight plan, and watch it play out. A boxing game with incremental training and automatic bouts, where winning is only half the job: eleven owners share your contract. Buy yourself back, one share at a time.

5296510.title: A Million Trees
5296510.short_description: A logging and automation game that is solo or co-op. Set in a forest with A Million Trees you can Chop down. Each tree is then processed into smaller chunks or planks then sold. Using this money you can then buy chainsaws, upgrades, conveyors and machines for automation.

5296730.title: Dawn of Embers
5296730.short_description: Build a town. Raise an army. Command the elements. A real-time strategy game where ancient Pillars wake on the battlefield and leave magic in their embers. Choose your Calling, drill your Disciplines, and lead your kingdom through the Day of Ruin.

5298030.title: Gospel of Garbage
5298030.short_description: Gospel of Garbage is an Incremental Auto Battler about leading a fanatical troop of raccoons. Stack trash to stop the train, and protect your pile from heretical cleanup crews!

5298260.title: Power Washing: Bear Cemetery
5298260.short_description: Take over the care of Bear Hollow’s overgrown cemetery. Wash weathered headstones, mow the grass, and bring a little peace to its residents. Your predecessor left you the tools for the job—but looking after this place means more than keeping it tidy.

5298270.title: The Crash
5298270.short_description: Wake up or run! The Crash is a high tension 5-minute horror game where you are trapped inside a dream maze. Navigate the panic, avoid the monsters and find the way out.

5298360.title: Reverie
5298360.short_description: Reverie is an award-winning psychedelic horror adventure where you explore and investigate an esoteric open world, slash through grotesque monsters, and stitch together your new reality. Prepare to die, adapt, and grow stronger as you find strange abilities and learn the secrets of this dying world.

5298370.title: Starward Era
5298370.short_description: Dig deep into an alien world, gather resources, explore the unknown, and build interconnected power, oxygen, and production systems. Upgrade your gear, expand your base, and automate logistics with drones as manual work gradually grows into an efficient production network.

5299400.title: Dino Warband
5299400.short_description: Build your dinosaur warband! Recruit, evolve, and position prehistoric giants and pack hunters, then watch your strategy clash with rival beasts. Adapt between battles and take down mighty bosses in this thrilling single-player auto battler.

5299520.title: Star Replica
5299520.short_description: Mine, build, and replicate. Pilot a modular spacecraft through an unexplored universe, then put your replicas to work with autonomous mining and crafting. Transfer your consciousness between ships, grow your fleet, and follow mysterious signals into deep space.

5300260.title: KOI-KOI!
5300260.short_description: A stylish roguelite anime card game about luck, strategy, and risk. Build card combinations, bet your chips, and face three dealers in high-stakes games where your fate is at stake.

5300280.title: Great Lakes Captain
5300280.short_description: Start with small boats and work your way up to massive Great Lakes freighters. Navigate ports, bridges, narrow channels, changing weather, and open water in a first-person maritime simulator focused on realistic vessel handling, progression, and life on the lakes.

5300440.title: ARIA
5300440.short_description: An AI. A fly brain. An underwater facility. Wake alone in first-person survival horror: bring ARIA back online, rewire a flooding station and open the capsule yourself. Then lure the specimen hunting you into quarantine—if ARIA's memory can be trusted.

5300870.title: CATLINES
5300870.short_description: You're part of the sorting service, it's your final day on the job! Build your way through different worlds, use your skills, and deliver 8,196 cat-boxes to their owners. Drink milk, enjoy chocolate mint, sort every last cat-box

5300990.title: Entangled Logic
5300990.short_description: Survive a failing research facility in Entangled Logic, a top-down action game with programmable quantum devices. Battle swarms, upgrade your build, and defeat six bosses. Use preset circuits or design your own. No quantum physics knowledge required.

5301160.title: Baseline Basketball Manager 27
5301160.short_description: Take control of a professional basketball organization in Baseline Basketball Manager. Build your roster, scout prospects, make trades, manage contracts, set tactics and shape your team’s future in a deep, long-term management simulation.

5301440.title: KEYLINGS
5301440.short_description: Every key on your keyboard becomes a tiny living creature. The more you type, the more your Keylings grow. They play, fall in love, and sometimes even fight in this charming life simulation. Compatible RGB devices can also react with synchronized lighting.

5302100.title: Ultimate Memory Elevator!?
5302100.short_description: Observe on the move. Survive by memory. Which floor was that bird on? Memorize the birds and climb to your absolute limit!
developers: インフィニットクリエイト
publishers: インフィニットクリエイト

5302430.title: Foturians: Myth and Reality
5302430.short_description: Foturians: Myth and Reality is a non-linear visual novel where you change the probability of events. Your power depends on mood, character, and experience, while the universe's fate is decided by a dice roll. Every choice shapes who you become in the cosmic game's finale.

5302510.title: ThrottleWave: Powerboats
5302510.short_description: Take the wheel of high-powered speedboats and battle your friends on the open water. Race for the finish line in high-speed circuits or test your precision in Gate Catching, where you must blast through spawning gates before your rivals steal the points.

5302630.title: Path & Match
5302630.short_description: Path & Match is a strategic puzzle game where you must clear a path by matching spheres. Earn moves, overcome traps, obstacles and enemies, and adapt your route to reach the exit in time. Analyze the board and plan your moves.

5302680.title: Mushrooooooom
5302680.short_description: A numerical incremental game about spreading spores. There are mushrooms aplenty here, giving you countless ways to take root and spread across procedurally generated planets. Cross the seas, burrow underground, climb into the clouds, and turn the entire map into your own color.

5303380.title: Fih🥀🥀
5303380.short_description: Your monitor is the aquarium. Type and click as you always do: your input becomes food, fish grow on your desktop, and gold piles up while you work. Collect 29 crayon-drawn species, roll for rare ones, chase off sharks, paint your own fish. Clicks pass through, and keystrokes are never recorded.

5303410.title: Freeway Fever
5303410.short_description: Very fast-paced arcade street racing with crashes and chaos. Risk is rewarded: trail closely behind traffic vehicles for a huge slipstream boost, but be careful not to crash! Featuring a curated 97 event championship, plus arcade mode with virtually unlimited procedurally-generated track layouts.

5303490.title: Pantania:wedge of time
5303490.short_description: Fulfill your mission, scavenge for supplies.With the power to control time, you can be a savior who saves people—or a ruthless monster who slaughters them all.

5303590.title: northern mythology
5303590.short_description: Northern mythology is a northern-myth themed hardcore action fantasy game. Traverse frozen wilderness and ancient ruins. Fight mythical creatures with skillful parry and dodge. Gather relics, customize your warrior and face epic bosses to reveal the secrets of the old gods.

5303930.title: CORE//PULSE
5303930.short_description: Defend a stationary Core against escalating waves of geometric enemies. Build each run with upgrade cards, satellites, orbital weapons and automated skills, defeat unique bosses, earn currency, and return stronger for the next run.

5304080.title: Doubloon: Pirate Dice Roguelike
5304080.short_description: Doubloon is a pirate deckbuilding roguelike played with dice. Keep the dice you need and reroll the rest to build hands and pay each captain's ransom. Hire crew and carve dice in port to grow both your stake and multiplier.

5304120.title: Conflict 2026
5304120.short_description: Step into the shoes of Israel’s or Iran’s leader. Can you outmaneuver your rival, control the escalation, and win this historic struggle? A fast, turn-based geopolitical strategy game for 1–2 players

5304310.title: 10 Million Cubes
5304310.short_description: Break through 10 million voxels to find the Prismatic Cube. A short incremental game about satisfying destruction with really bouncy balls.

5304480.title: Thunder Arrow: Arcade
5304480.short_description: Pilot the HX-21 “Thunder Arrow” prototype and relive the intensity of 1980s arcades in a modern tribute to classics like After Burner and Thunder Blade.

5304760.title: Scentkeeper: Tidy Up the Perfume Archive!
5304760.short_description: Bring order to a perfume archive of 3,240 bottles, solo or with a friend, in this relaxing first-person organizing game. Read labels, place bottles on the right shelves, develop helpful skills, and watch completed collections light up the archive.

5305500.title: StickType
5305500.short_description: Can you evolve from a simple circle to scale a tower and save...well, whoever is crying out for help at the top?

5305620.title: HINEKURE QUEST
5305620.short_description: It's Daifugo, but run out of cards and you die. Fight enemies with Daifugo rules: the mighty 2, the 3 that beats it, 8 Cut, 7 Give, 10 Discard, J Back and Revolution. But an empty hand can't attack, 7 Give can corner you, and Luck may self-destruct. Daifugo alone won't win. Break the rules.

5305850.title: ArcMages
5305850.short_description: Choose your spellbook and blast your rivals off the map in turn-based online artillery battles. Hurl fireballs, call down meteors, summon dragons, and carve the destructible battlefield into fortresses or craters. One turn, one spell, one perfect shot.

5306140.title: 30Lily
5306140.short_description: Play as Emily in the otherworld to save your dying sister Lily. Only 30 days left. Gameplay: TPS, linear chapters.

5306500.title: Lumengard
5306500.short_description: Explore the fallen kingdom of Lumengard in a procedurally generated hex world. Gather, craft, and fight turn-based battles with cards from gear, skills, companions, and pets. Build a village and shape a persistent world through your choices.

5306870.title: Psst!
5306870.short_description: Sit down with friends, give a few hints, and try not to give your secret away. In this party game, close guesses earn you points, but an exact answer knocks you out. Play as cats across five word-game modes, online with friends or solo with bots.

5307120.title: A Place for Hue
5307120.short_description: A relaxing single-player sorting game where you restore 30 hand-crafted color gradients by finding the perfect spot for each piece! Pick up, sort and place over 6,000 mosaic pieces of all shapes and colors, earn money, unlock helpful upgrades, and watch your messy gallery slowly come to life!

5307680.title: Pickle Factory
5307680.short_description: Grow cucumbers, pickle them and sell jars to tourists from Warsaw, then ship them by the pallet. A first-person business sim from rural Poland. Your uncle left you a pickle works, a radio stuck on disco polo and a 400 zloty debt to Rysiek. Due Friday.

5308950.title: Abyss Driller: An Incremental Mining Game
5308950.short_description: An incremental mining game beneath the ocean. Pilot a drill-equipped submarine, gather ore and turn each haul into permanent upgrades. Fight deep-sea creatures with your spotlight, dodge their attacks and dive deeper.

5309190.title: 冒牌特攻队
5309190.short_description: A comic-style top-down survival action game. Fight solo or in online co-op, wield multiple weapons, and modify their attacks with attachments. Move, aim, and adapt your equipment as waves of enemies close in, building a loadout that suits your playstyle.

5309220.title: Relicbearer TD
5309220.short_description: Build your defences, unleash devastating abilities, and claim powerful Relics in this 2D Tower Defence Strategy game.

5309780.title: CONTRACT #001
5309780.short_description: A 1-4 player physics based demolition simulator. On your first job, you knocked down the wrong house. Now you owe Shady Solutions LLC $80,080. Tear down buildings, crush the scrap and pay it off.

5310790.title: Paradice Run Club
5310790.short_description: Roll dice, gather resources, and hit the target! Paradice Run Club is a precision strategy roguelike where players get as close as possible to a target number. Compete with other runners or against your own records to follow those targets as they climb from 17, to 21, to 100!

5311410.title: Mini Chess
5311410.short_description: Turn your Steam Deck or Steam Machine into a simple hand drawn lightweight Mini Chess board for two.

5311780.title: ABLATION
5311780.short_description: A first person puzzle game where you carry one material at a time, and what you take from one surface, you can give to another.

5312180.title: Slide or Fry
5312180.short_description: A chaotic 1–4 player co-op rage game about chained polar bears, slippery ice, deadly lava, and friendships under pressure. Master brutal precision routes, fight enemies, survive with limited hearts, and try not to take everyone down with you.

5312340.title: The Invisible Ruins
5312340.short_description: You came for a lost treasure hidden beneath the ocean floor. You will have to decrypt an ancient language to find the way

5312460.title: The Lost Future
5312460.short_description: The Lost Future is a pixel art RPG blending fantasy and mechanical civilization. Follow Ark from peaceful Windmill Village through bustling harbors, mysterious elven forests, mechanical cities, and frozen northern lands. Explore seven chapters filled with adventure, companions, and hidden secrets.

5312560.title: Lycans 2
5312560.short_description: A chaotic social deduction game for 4 to 16 players with proximity voice chat. Werewolves hide among your friends! Bluff, vote, bonk and fight to survive. Goofy effects, terrible plans and betrayals turn every match into a messy night with friends.

5312620.title: Last Gnome Standing
5312620.short_description: You’re a gnome playing poker with friends. Lose a hand, eat a magic mushroom. Keep losing and the trip gets wild: cards shift, names swap, voices warp. Last gnome standing wins.

5313980.title: THE WINTER SOLSTICE
5313980.short_description: After years of suffering from guilt, Thomas Mason believes he is finally ready to move on. He returns to Blackwood Forest to spread his family’s ashes, hoping to leave them at their happiest. What he discovers is another man's story, guided by a dark presence. Your decisions will shape the story.

5314270.title: Oceans - Survival
5314270.short_description: Oceans - Survival is set in an endless procedurally generated ocean filled with tropical islands to discover and explore. Discover treasure on islands, different flora and fauna and ocean currents that take you anywhere and everywhere.

5314460.title: Job Hopper
5314460.short_description: Fight for a better job in this pixel-art action roguelite. Wield four office weapons, combine Specs, and train after hours. Start at a tiny startup and climb toward bigger companies, where familiar coworkers and office machines reveal monstrous forms.

5314530.title: PULLFINITY
5314530.short_description: Open a pack, sell the cards, buy a faster machine. PULLFINITY is a pack-opening incremental with 300 cards in five sets. It starts with one pack on a felt table and ends with 500 packs in a single batch, and nothing you have pulled ever leaves your collection.

5314570.title: Sins of the Broken
5314570.short_description: Your teammate just went down in the open. He's bleeding out, your cover is coming apart, and the other squad is waiting for you to move. A squad-based tactical FPS where getting your people home alive wins the fight.

5314630.title: Just Until Morning
5314630.short_description: Rural 17, eleven at night. A gas station in the fog, and the lamps are going out one at a time. A slow-burn first-person horror about a small place after dark, and the night shift that has to keep it lit. Just until morning.

5314950.title: Age of Nightfall: Tactics
5314950.short_description: Fight for Dracula or Van Helsing in a turn-based strategy game. The towns you build and the research you choose shape your army. Follow either side's story campaign, battle the computer in skirmishes or face other players online.

5315070.title: Innards
5315070.short_description: Innards is a deranged non-Euclidean adventure, set in the hyperbolic folds of the long-abandoned Internet, with a unique eccentric visual style.

5315460.title: TIC, TAC & TOE
5315460.short_description: The worst bounty hunters in the galaxy take every job going and ruin each one in a way nobody could have predicted. A hand-painted couch co-op brawler for 1-3 players who deserve better teammates.

5315630.title: ボンドセレクション
5315630.short_description: 「きんかんなまなま」が楽しめるのは、ともゆき先生のゲームだけ！新種の接着剤を開発し品評会で最優秀金賞を目指せ！石川県珠洲市狼煙町を舞台に新種の接着剤の開発にかける者たちの苦悩を描く調合RPG（体験版）。ご当地ネタ満載！石川県の事が気になっていたけど、クラスの友達に噂されると恥ずかしいから……気にせずプレーして良し！言葉遊びが面白いゲームをやってみたい……？テキストが面白いゲームをやってみたい……？ここに、あるぞ！読み応えしかない……ッ！ 純文学を読んだような読後感！自称世界で2番目に面白いモンスター図鑑を搭載！圧倒的クオリジナリティー（クオリティー+オリジナリティー）殆ど神ゲーここに、あるぞ！
developers: ともゆき（紀元前 幹部）
publishers: ともゆき（紀元前 幹部）

5316070.title: Defenders of Cinderkeep
5316070.short_description: Defenders of Cinderkeep is a dark fantasy incremental auto-battler. Battle endless waves of orcs, demons, dragons, and other mythic creatures in defense of the last bastion of humanity. Upgrade your heroes and equip them with a variety of spells and powers to unleash upon the demonic hordes.

5316250.title: Grimlane
5316250.short_description: Build a deck of towers, buildings, and spells to defend your town against endless waves. Grow your economy, upgrade your defenders, and try new combinations on random maps. Play solo or with a friend, and meet Grimlane's characters in the story campaign.

5316320.title: Carpet Combat
5316320.short_description: Turn the living room into a battlefield in Carpet Combat, a free-to-play game of turn-based tactics and physics-driven toy battles. Position your squad, line up your shots and knock rivals down in solo AI matches or online multiplayer.

5316370.title: Stock Escape
5316370.short_description: Trade 50 stocks, dodge loan sharks and con men, and blow your fortune on mansions, yachts and private jets. A funny stock market life sim where every hot tip comes with a catch, a kidnapping or a shark. Escape to your dreams.

5316840.title: Desktop Farm
5316840.short_description: Desktop Farm is a farm management game that lives on your desktop. Plant crops, raise animals, fish, mine, and run a little stall. Tuck it away when you're busy, and press Alt+W to return when you're free. It stays out of your way and quietly keeps you company.

5317130.title: Panic at the Pole
5317130.short_description: Grab up to 5 friends and try to save Christmas! Team up to build and wrap toys, feed reindeers, chase away the gift gremilins and appease a high-maintenance Santa. Work together to earn enough coins to buy your way out of an endless contract before Christmas morning!

5317330.title: Marsfall: Origins
5317330.short_description: A desert RTS: lead an armored expedition, build a frontier base, harvest Emburrn, command combined arms, and survive sandworms.

5317730.title: Lost in the Blizzard Abyss
5317730.short_description: Welcome to the Blizzard Abyss! Explore a vast, mysterious frozen wilderness filled with dangers and exciting discoveries. Brave the blizzard, find five Crystals, obtain the Frost Crown, and offer it at the altar to stop the storm. Can you survive for 60 minutes? Your frozen adventure begins here!

5317790.title: Crimson Ark
5317790.short_description: Forge your own magic build in Crimson Ark, a single-player dark fantasy action RPG. Choose from three heroines, hunt for gear, and refine it through upgrades and reforging. Grow through auto-hunting, take direct control against bosses, and journey with Maria through a world of endless night.

5317860.title: Slavlands: Tribes at War
5317860.short_description: Build a Slavic stronghold from a few huts, feed your people and lead your warband across a great map of the early medieval Slavic lands. A 90s-style real-time strategy with a deep simulation, where wars are won with granaries, supply trains, weather and faith long before the first blow.

5317970.title: Skate N Chill
5317970.short_description: Build your own skatepark, find your line, and take it easy. Skate N Chill is a relaxed single-player skateboarding sandbox: shape bowls and rails, customize your crew, learn new tricks, or kick back and watch the park come to life.

5318120.title: 撕下你的伪装
5318120.short_description: A modern suspense game. Follow Lin Mo, undercover in a nightclub to find her missing brother. She uncovers organ trafficking—and his lookalike runs the crime group. 4 romanceable leads, multiple endings.

5318570.title: The Guy Downstairs
5318570.short_description: A cozy life sim that lives at the bottom of your screen. While you work, Alex works too: he cooks, levels up skills, dates, adopts a dog and saves his way from a mattress on the floor to a Sky Villa. Check in when you like, or let him live his own life.

5318630.title: Gridways
5318630.short_description: Traffic is your problem now. Draw roads, paint arrows, time the lights and stack overpasses so every vehicle reaches the right hub. Congestion costs you points - gridlock ends the round. Over 100 handmade puzzles, three difficulties, a level editor and Workshop support.

5318740.title: Peasants in the Summer
5318740.short_description: A first-person roguelite puzzle mystery. The same summer day repeats, and every morning the Village redraws itself. Draft which places emerge from the mist, learn the villagers' routines, solve puzzles and remember what no one else can.

5319080.title: Iron Trails
5319080.short_description: Build a railway across a living valley, then run it by the book. Survey grades, plant signals, line routes from the CTC board, and switch industries with air brakes and coupler slack you can feel. You are the dispatcher and the engineer.

5319100.title: Closed Case
5319100.short_description: Team up with a friend and help Marcus and Cloe escape in this co-op point-and-click puzzle game! In Closed Case, you and your partner must solve a variety of riddles to escape the mysterious house while uncovering the identity of its enigmatic owner.

5319180.title: Your New Family
5319180.short_description: They offer you a bed, a seat at the table and a new family. All you have to do is stay. A narrative psychological horror adventure in a community where everyone is kind and nobody quite answers your questions.

5319240.title: Dream Island Simulator
5319240.short_description: A desert-island survival sim played live by AI: every survivor is a large language model — they chat, dream, hold grudges, and get on with life while you're away. Start from firewood and thatch, and rebuild the knowledge the end of the world turned back into legend.

5319340.title: AUTOGENESIS
5319340.short_description: AUTOGENESIS is a roguelike deckbuilder where any number can be exploited. Swap, Bind and Multiply endlessly to build overwhelming strategies, recursively self-improve, and rewrite the system containing you. Break the experiment. Achieve AUTOGENESIS.

5319350.title: Skribline
5319350.short_description: Draw lines to help the skribman cross gaps and avoid neon hazards! Try Endless mode, or beat levels to unlock new skins, effects and backgrounds.

5319510.title: Orb God
5319510.short_description: In a distant future, war between humans and orbs has destroyed nearly half the galaxy. Save a broken world and awaken your frenzied kin in a top-down action roguelite. Combine gear and Divine Gifts; play solo or with 2–4 players via Steam or LAN, as allies or rivals.

5319600.title: Figure It Out! Together
5319600.short_description: Your cat knocked over your Anime figure collection. Sort and tidy up over 2,875 mini, life-size and giant figures. Hunt for rare finds and unlock handy gadgets in this cozy Anime organizing game. Mechas, chibis, and maids… everyone belongs on a shelf. Your cat is “helping.” What could go wrong?

5319740.title: Frogball
5319740.short_description: Classic 90's GameBoy style Pinball... this time with frogs! Super cute retro fantasy pinball, packed to the gills with old-school fun.

5320000.title: Sort the Red Pandas: Tidy Up & Shelve
5320000.short_description: Sort the Red Pandas: Tidy Up & Shelve is a single-player cozy organizing simulator where you sort 5,140 cute red pandas onto the correct shelves. Earn money, unlock powerful sorting abilities, and enjoy the satisfying transformation of a messy store from complete chaos into perfect order.

5320050.title: Alice and the Necromancer
5320050.short_description: A first-person point-and-click of dark fantasy and horror. Alice finds a voice behind a sealed door. It promises to teach her magic. The first lesson is free. Solve puzzles and make choices that open paths to different endings.

5320140.title: The Legend of Pepino
5320140.short_description: Level up your character, battle hordes of monsters, earn money to unlock items and spells for your class, and face powerful bosses along the way.

5320360.title: LUMENKEEP
5320360.short_description: A dark hex board. Shadow-crystal creatures march on your last lantern. Build no towers, build light. Aim emitters, bend beams with mirrors, and cross colors to unleash new effects. Every placement re-traces the whole board. A roguelite tower defense made of pure light.

5320500.title: Task Bar Dungeons
5320500.short_description: A new dark-fantasy Task Bar idle RPG. Six heroes, twelve specializations and hordes that fight back — right above your taskbar while you work. Loot, upgrade, rebirth. Free to play, with Steam Community Market trading planned after launch.

5320520.title: Cyber Ninja: Tokyo Rumble
5320520.short_description: Cyber Ninja: Tokyo Rumble is a high-speed VR ninja action game set across multiple eras of Japan. Wield blades, unleash devastating energy techniques, and battle robotic armies in immersive arenas.

5320720.title: Pack Party
5320720.short_description: The drawing party game where you and your friends make a deck of absurd cards to answer ridiculous prompts. 4 to 10 players.

5321040.title: Grid Mage
5321040.short_description: A puzzle game about battling demons with magic. Figure out the rules behind enemy actions and exploit them with an expanding set of spells.

5321080.title: Compost Apocalypse Survivors
5321080.short_description: Survive the hordes and defeat the bosses in steam(ed)punk bullet heaven where the vegetables bite back. Wield ridiculous weapons, upgrade and evolve, and mulch monstrous bosses solo or in 2-player online or couch co-op. Gather Scrap, grow stronger, and fight your way up the compost heap.

5321090.title: Dicebound
5321090.short_description: Dicebound is a single-player dice roguelike about pushing your luck. Roll, score, and bank points before a Farkle wipes the turn. Build powerful Charm synergies, survive escalating Blinds, and chase bigger scores with every throw.

5321230.title: 永恒传奇之六道觉醒
5321230.short_description: 围绕这个奇幻大陆展开探索、战斗与角色成长，将传奇系列的装备追求、职业配合和公会对抗融入立体世界。 ⛏️ 独自深入矿洞，寻找成长所需的资源；与队友挑战首领，追寻稀有装备；或集结公会，在沙巴克城下争夺荣誉。选择你的职业与伙伴，开启属于自己的传奇征程！

5321350.title: Put the Ball in the Hole
5321350.short_description: The instructions are in the title. A physics trickshot game with 70 levels and 10 ways to shoot: basketball, golf, pool, bowling, baseball, soccer, ping pong, marbles, slingshots and cannons. Every shot is one motion with your mouse.

5321490.title: Pongzi Scheme
5321490.short_description: Pong for funds that never existed. Bat capital with a stock candle, pay old investors with new money and buy time against the SEC. A finite incremental: 4 acts, offshore prestige, 5 endings. When The Case hits 100%, the raid comes. What you keep offshore is up to you.

5321690.title: KARAOKE x LOVE 💖
5321690.short_description: A fun anime-style karaoke simulator! Run your own bar, serve drinks, clean up after wild nights, and grow your business with three charming assistants. Make friends, build relationships, and unlock exciting karaoke performances along the way!

5322090.title: InCrimiNation
5322090.short_description: A cutthroat mob twist on the classic property-trading board game. Buy up territories, run protection rackets, launder your dirty cash before the Feds catch on, and settle scores with Turf Wars, Hits, and Arson. Full lobby multiplayer — every player runs their own copy.

5322140.title: Tidy Bakery
5322140.short_description: Your cozy bakery is a little… messy 🍰 Sort, organize, and put away about 3,000 freshly baked treats. Take your time, enjoy the cozy atmosphere, and turn bakery chaos into perfect order.

5322820.title: Drillionaire
5322820.short_description: Dig deep, get rich, and let the machines take over. Jetpack through infinite layers of ever-stranger ore, dodge explosions, gas and lava, then build a fleet of automatons and drones that keep mining while you're away. Prestige, then dig deeper.

5322880.title: IT'S NOT A DEER
5322880.short_description: First-person horror game where mimicking creatures hide among ordinary wildlife. Study animal behavior and spot anomalies before you shoot. Sell meat and hides, upgrade your gear, and retreat to your cabin when you become the prey.

5322900.title: Local Game Store Simulator
5322900.short_description: Run your own local game store and rewrite the rules. Crack packs, haggle over trade-ins and chase numbered pulls with up to 8 players in co-op or rival stores. Build your own cards, packs, games and consoles and share them on Steam Workshop.

5322990.title: Tidy Teddy
5322990.short_description: Tidy Teddy is a cozy organizing game where you restock an animal-themed plushie shop. Bring the store back to its former glory by sorting thousands of animal plushies by species and color at your own pace.

5323740.title: Christmas Yarn 5
5323740.short_description: A heartwarming match-3 adventure set in the snowy, sleepy village of Glimmerdale. When the frost wind created by a frightened frost-fox pup whisks away every child's Christmas wish into the Whispering Woods, only you and your magic yarn can save the day!

5323900.title: Rift Fighter
5323900.short_description: Auto-attacks keep the pressure on; you control four equipped arts. Find manuals, evolve arts through use, and combine elements and gear across four chapters. Upgrade your equipment and permanent talents between expeditions. Play solo or team up in two-player local co-op.

5323940.title: Airport Land: Air Traffic Control
5323940.short_description: An air traffic control game in the tower: sequence takeoffs and landings, call the go-around, and hear pilots answer in real ATC radio. Grow a one-runway island into a hub, then work Haneda, Heathrow, Kai Tak and Lukla by their real rules.

5324000.title: Barista
5324000.short_description: A cozy audio game. Be a barista in a wacky world and listen to your customers' funny stories. Designed to be fully playable without sight.

5324080.title: Dungeon: The Lantern Bearer
5324080.short_description: Dungeon: Lanternbearer is a RPG built around loot and buildcraft. Take up your lantern and delve into dungeons lost to the Dark Erosion. Slay monsters, gather loot, and combine Arts and gear into your own build. Recover memories of your sister A-Ning and bring her home before the world forgets her.

5324140.title: Arkforge-方舟锻造
5324140.short_description: A space sandbox game. Build your mobile factory ship to mine, smelt, produce, fight, and research in space. Design unique ships, equip them with various modules, and set up production lines to supply your fleet.

5324270.title: Chessboxing Arcade
5324270.short_description: Chess Boxing Arcade is a 2D arcade take on the real sport: alternate between timed chess rounds and fast-paced boxing rounds. Win by checkmate, knockout or the clock against adaptive AI, friends locally, or opponents online.

5324330.title: Plinko Squad
5324330.short_description: Drop balls down a plinko board to recruit your squad, arrange them on a hex grid, and send them auto-battling up a 25-floor tower. Stack augments into explosive synergies, but every unit that falls is gone for good.

5324620.title: Four Seasons Store: Tidy Up
5324620.short_description: Turn chaos into a cozy seasonal paradise! Sort 5000+ misplaced items, find their perfect spots, and transform a cluttered store into beautiful displays celebrating spring, summer, autumn, and winter. Find matching pieces, assemble objects, and enjoy the satisfaction of putting everything in order.

5324630.title: Tidy Up Bukkos!
5324630.short_description: Hope you had fun making a mess by throwing all the Bukkos around because you're not going anywhere before putting everything back to its place! Tidy up this eccentric library and its puzzle shelves in this comedy oriented organizing game.

5324700.title: DoBato: Coo Coo Collector
5324700.short_description: Fly over real Tokyo, from old downtown streets to the city center, as the leader of a pigeon flock. Land at pigeon spots, wait, and strays join you one by one. Gather white, brown, black and pied pigeons, each with its own perk, and race home with 1,000 birds. A heartwarming pigeon-gathering game.

5324800.title: Old Yon. New thief
5324800.short_description: The abandoned port of Old Yon. Bandits at the gates. You're a thief with no memory and a 200-mark debt. Pick pockets, sell to the fence before the loot goes stale, and save up for better gloves. Greed, Empathy and Paranoia argue in your head. Whatever you do, stay calm: anxiety draws the shadows.

5325100.title: Make GAL together!
5325100.short_description: Make GAL together! is a visual novel where you play as Xiao Lu, an unemployed copywriter. Move in with an energetic producer, a sharp-tongued tsundere artist, and a quiet programmer. Amid the daily chaos, can you create an unforgettable game together?

5325120.title: Flowfish
5325120.short_description: Catch cute, hand-drawn water creatures in Flowfish! Race your fastest catches and use their unique skills to earn money. Hunt for rare and legendary fish, train your favorites, try your luck at the black market, and upgrade your gear at the fishing shop.

5325140.title: Shoot Mine Upgrade Repeat
5325140.short_description: Fire bouncing bullets into a mine of breakable blocks. Collect gold, equip unusual abilities, and merge items into stronger upgrades. Shape your next shot with lasers, explosions, and cactus needles, then invest in permanent upgrades and dig deeper.

5325340.title: Prospects
5325340.short_description: Strip the solar system of its bountiful resources, all for the betterment of mankind - and your corporation's bottom line. Build and command your fleet of industrial vessels, establish manufacturing outposts, and seek out the richest prospects to expand your mining empire.

5325440.title: TAKEN
5325440.short_description: A first-person found-footage horror FMV game across five chapters. Answer the riddles. Complete the rituals. Satisfy the cult. Eight endings are waiting. Most of them are not escape.

5325760.title: The Playtester
5325760.short_description: A first-person roguelite about being the aliens' playtester. Wake up in a cell, slot cartridges into a PC and survive their homemade minigames. Spend your pay on furniture that changes how the games play. Perform badly and you're eliminated. The next human wakes up in the room you furnished.

5325890.title: それでも僕らは廻っている。
5325890.short_description: Stars revolve around you. Stars are both weapons and shields. Create, strengthen, and advance in the strongest star system in this hack-and-slash game.

5325980.title: Sayara's Path
5325980.short_description: Join Sayara on a journey through the snow-covered Vad-Hidek to find a way to bring her brother back to the world of the living. Here everyone’s fate depends on the will of the Spirits, and the path to resurrection becomes a trial the result of which is unknown.

5326060.title: Deforest a Planet
5326060.short_description: A cosy idle game about clearing an entire planet, one tree at a time. Hire woodcutters, raise lumbermills and watch your crew spread across a tiny spinning world, until the last tree falls and a bigger planet waits.

5326080.title: Tidy Up The Backrooms
5326080.short_description: A store's items have gone missing in the Backrooms, and it's your job to bring it back.
