Explore the endless yellow halls using your tech and tools, restock the store and solve the mystery of what really happened to the store. Don't like scares? Turn the horror off and enjoy a cozy tidy!

5326090.title: Demidoff Corp Pico
5326090.short_description: Demidoff Corp Pico is a free retro prologue to the Ural-based metroidvania Demidoff Corp, created in the Pico-8 game format. Find out what happened to the fluffy agent before the events of the main game: explore the mines, gather malachite, and battle a variety of enemies.

5326300.title: OVERREACH 2126
5326300.short_description: Hotseat · game night · pass & play on one PC — one screen, one mouse. Other strategy games hand you a 280-page manual; OVERREACH 2126 hands you one page. Then 1–6 of you fight for the world. Grimdark strategy: recruit, dig in, counter-attack. One evening. One game. One winner.

5326320.title: Invoker Tactics: Conquest
5326320.short_description: A turn-based tactical strategy game combining chess-like grid movement, deck building, and a unique unit-merging mechanic. Outplay your enemies through strategic positioning and creative combos. Discover your own playstyle as you recruit new units and expand your kingdom.

5326370.title: Legend of Goddess : One Slash
5326370.short_description: A heroine-focused RPG woven with a collection of bizarre short stories. Play with your mouse. Combine turn-based strategy and resource management, strike for a decisive blow when the moment comes. Mod support!

5326390.title: The Core: Protocol
5326390.short_description: A dark co-op horde shooter blending tower defense with trap building. Fight through a procedural maze whose biomes, cabins and weather are reshuffled every run. Survive the waves, collect permanent upgrades for the hub and discover what waits beyond the walls.

5326400.title: Out of Delivery
5326400.short_description: You’re a courier robot. Grab packages, race to the drop point, and throw cargo at rivals to steal their loot. Scooters, hacking, contracts and seven package types. Deliver fast. Hit hard. Get rich!

5326420.title: Your Ancestor Stories
5326420.short_description: Live as Bara in a cozy prehistoric life sim where farming, fishing, hunting, crafting, livestock, tournaments, festivals, and survival shape daily life on a mysterious island filled with tribes, wildlife, and untold stories.

5326430.title: Low Sun
5326430.short_description: Turn-based tactics on colorful 3D miniature battlefields. Capture buildings to fund your army, combine land, air and naval units, and keep them supplied. Use terrain and positioning to break through enemy lines and seize their headquarters.

5326480.title: Shattersong
5326480.short_description: A story-driven tactical RPG in the spirit of the 16-bit classics. Raise a found-family army of 60 heroes, recover the lost Words that sang the world into being, and stand against the Hollow Cantor — a grieving priest unsaying the world one note at a time.

5326580.title: Stay Extinct
5326580.short_description: The wall was built to keep something in. On a sealed dinosaur island only the hunters are infected: raptors, a T-rex and diving pterosaurs stalk the healthy herds, and you. Build and electrify a base, explore the tunnels below, alone or in 4-player online co-op. First-person retro survival horror.

5326620.title: The Prison Incident
5326620.short_description: Reconstruct a fatal prison riot by reverse-engineering deleted terminal logs and determine how each person involved in The Prison Incident meets their end.

5326690.title: Cindervale
5326690.short_description: A voxel-based sandbox game focused on survival, building, and engineering. Start in a large city, mine ore, smelt metal, wire up electricity, and assemble functional machines—ranging from wind turbines to computer-controlled factories. Play solo or with friends.

5326930.title: Xoul:Sync
5326930.short_description: Xoul:Sync combines auto-battler combat with spatial inventory management. Assemble three Xouls, arrange items in the Sync Case, and choose your route to the next boss.

5326940.title: Flaparq: Home Cooking
5326940.short_description: Flaparq: Home Cooking is a heartwarming cooking simulator. Open up your childhood recipe book—where the dishes you create are not just a treat for the taste buds, but a journey down memory lane.

5327000.title: Quality Control
5327000.short_description: Quality Control is 4–8 player party game where customizable robots compete in chaotic factory minigames, asymmetric challenges, and sudden-death showdowns.

5327050.title: Idle Smith: Forge, Craft, Battle!
5327050.short_description: An Idle cozy blacksmith that sits on your desktop. Craft & customize swords, bows, axes for your companions. Collect loot, upgrade your workshop and prepare for the Bosses. While you attend to your own affairs, your companions will keep fighting for you.

5327090.title: Trapout: Dungeon Run
5327090.short_description: A fast-paced first-person precision platformer where every millisecond counts. Run through deadly obstacle courses, race against player ghosts instantly, and create ANYTHING with the built-in level editor

5327180.title: With flowers, fringe of fondness
5327180.short_description: Life is suffocating. Almost crushed by the authority known as "normal." Tuyu, who spends their days asking themself, "Do I have a place in this society?", meets a certain friend at university. Those living on the margins find joy, suffer in their insignificant days—and attempt to resist the world.

5327220.title: Tiny Vessel
5327220.short_description: A companion idle ARPG that lives beside whatever you are doing. A tiny crew of crash-landed survivors fights along an alien walkway while you work: real loot, a Relay to grow the vessel, depths that demand better gear. Progress keeps going while you are away.

5327330.title: Nanna's Farm
5327330.short_description: Raise a flock where every bird has a job: roosters scare eagles, turkeys heal the sick, blues and reds drop silver and gold. Sell eggs or hatch them, fend off eagles, wolves and rats across 30 timed missions, and spend your stars on perks to help your farm survive.

5327380.title: SURVOLT
5327380.short_description: SURVOLT is a fast 3v3 arena sport. Pass to charge the ball, then shoot at moving wall targets: the more you pass, the more each hit is worth. Volleys, tackles, dives and a golden zone that doubles your points. Solo vs AI or online, no port forwarding.

5327470.title: Roguelette
5327470.short_description: Build your own luck in a roulette roguelike. Choose three bets, lock useful results, and reroll the rest. Upgrade your table, change number colors with tricks, and stack charms to beat rising score targets.

5327480.title: Fronts of Steel
5327480.short_description: Fronts of Steel is a pausable real-time operational wargame on WWII's Eastern Front. Draw battle plans on a staff map and command divisions to break enemy lines, cut supply routes and close encirclements. Exploit terrain, keep troops supplied and choose when to advance or withdraw.

5327610.title: Purpose of Visit
5327610.short_description: Their papers say one thing. Their answers say another. Staff a booth on a tense border, question every traveller, and drag the lie they just told onto the document it contradicts. One of them is a spy. Approve the wrong face and it makes the evening news.

5327660.title: Feudal Factory
5327660.short_description: Build your kingdom, automate your production chains, and defend your lands against relentless hordes! In Feudal Factory, combine rail and cart automation with strategic medieval-fantasy fortress management. Extract ores, forge your equipment, train your army, and hold off incoming enemy waves!

5327910.title: Cyber Maze
5327910.short_description: A retro-futuristic 3D maze game with traps and enemies

5328030.title: Reign of Slime
5328030.short_description: An action roguelike: a slime fights, dies and comes back stronger, climbing toward the throne of the slime king. Shift elements, exploit their reactions, stack abilities and power-ups into your build. Hmm. Interesting, you're still reading. Anyways, I knew you would.

5328060.title: Tiny RTS
5328060.short_description: Tiny RTS is a Real-time strategy in crisp pixel art. Lead humans, orcs, elves or dwarves through three ages, raise heroes, clear monster camps for relics and fight online, with friends or against the computer. Build your own maps, scenarios and campaigns in the editor.

5328400.title: Tidy Up the Ark
5328400.short_description: Tidy Up the Ark is a cozy sorting simulator where 3120 animals from 156 species are waiting their turn to board the Ark. Gather them, sort them into the right pens, and unlock new abilities.

5328550.title: SLAPPED SILLY
5328550.short_description: A game of tag with terrible manners. Chase, dodge, and slap your friends through a living 3D newspaper in this party game for up to 12 players. Get slapped and join the chase, dress to impress, and turn your finest moments—and worst falls—into front-page news.

5328740.title: Joker Chess
5328740.short_description: Bluffing chess. Every piece is a Joker that can move like any chess piece — if you dare. Call your opponent's bluff and their liar is destroyed; call it wrong and you lose your move. Hide your king, fake your queen and climb the online ranked ladder.

5328930.title: HOOKLINGS
5328930.short_description: Hook. Swing. Boom. A fast 2.5D arena shooter about tiny round critters with grappling hooks. Swing through 3D arenas that fight back, yank rivals under the press and pop them into confetti. Play online, on the couch or against bots, and earn outfits, hook skins and rare finishes.

5329020.title: Dirty Dispatch
5329020.short_description: Dirty Dispatch is a management game where you dispatch emergency teams across an isometric city while pulling the strings of its criminal underworld. Respond to calls, expand your operation, and face the consequences of the risks you create.

5329150.title: Pixel Xanxia
5329150.short_description: A pixel art cultivation RPG inspired by Idle Xanxia. Hunt spirit beasts, master techniques, rebuild your shattered Dantian, and uncover the mystery behind the attack that destroyed your cultivation.

5329300.title: NorefSoccer
5329300.short_description: NoRef Soccer is a fast-paced 3D street football action game. With no referees or fouls, unleash intense physical tackles, stylish dribbling, and superpower shots! Control unique players across asphalt, beach, and snow courts to dominate the streets and build your dynasty.

5329650.title: Hero of the Sealed Labyrinth
5329650.short_description: An auto-battle RPG about collecting gear and growing stronger. Support your hero with click attacks, unlock sword skills and magic, and upgrade equipment at the blacksmith. Push deeper into the labyrinth or repeat floors to prepare. Rethink your build and challenge enemies again.

5329780.title: Alderun
5329780.short_description: A MOBA game with a hero at its heart and many different battlegrounds to choose from. Level your champion, gear it at the merchants and lead an army through sieges, tower defense, 5v5 lane battles and 10v10 valley wars, online against real players or solo against the AI.

5329890.title: SPIDERBOT EXTINCTION
5329890.short_description: The spiderbot horde doesn't march in lines — it flows like a flood. Place turrets freely, then use gunfire, mortar blasts, flame and more to push, split and redirect the swarm before it drowns humanity's last strongholds. Tower defense meets pest control at the end of the world.

5330130.title: Homeland Reclaim
5330130.short_description: A roguelike RTS where any warrior can wield any weapon! Build a deck of fantasy fighters, arm them with swords, spears and hammers, unleash mighty spells and win fast-paced battles where the whole battlefield fits on one screen.

5330150.title: 通魂纸 Tonghun Paper
5330150.short_description: Tonghun Paper is a first-person horror exploration game. Search for clues, read old letters, and piece together a hidden past while evading danger.

5330230.title: Brass & Brine
5330230.short_description: Command a steam-driven ironclad across three legs of hostile sea. Fit your guns, take a refit after every wave, chart your route and sink the bosses that rule each ocean, alone or with up to four captains online or in split-screen co-op.

5330260.title: AFKlutch
5330260.short_description: AFK Clutch is a tactical 5v5 auto-battler shooter: pick a character, weapons, gear and abilities, then watch every round of plants, retakes and clutches unfold. Also Free-for-All, 1v1 duels and an idle training range.

5330390.title: VALD in EUROPA
5330390.short_description: Become Vald, the Mercenary King, and conquer an impossible Europe ruled by history's queens. Execute a captured queen, recruit her, or free her? The queens from your history books, brought to life in 1,000 watercolour-style illustrations. Strategy meets romance. 50 turns, 7 rivals, 4 routes.

5330590.title: Beyond 90: A Footballer's Life
5330590.short_description: Live the life of a footballer. Play every match yourself but never control the team. Live a footballer’s career from your first contract at 16 to retirement: 100+ hours, 775 clubs. Chase fame, money and love and face the consequences that follow you beyond the 90 minutes.

5330760.title: Toddler Any Key: Work Machines
5330760.short_description: For toddlers and small kids who like big work machines. Press any key to advance the narrated picture book story. Dig, build and farm. Get used to a computer, finish small jobs and feel proud of what you’ve done. Encouraging and safe game for toddlers.

5330780.title: Sketch to Arrest
5330780.short_description: A witness, a sketch artist, and a killer who might be sitting right next to you. Draw suspects from shaky testimony, question everything you're told, and decide who to arrest before another night ends in another body.

5330910.title: Project Vanquisher
5330910.short_description: Fight out of a corporate prison with a gun that rewrites itself: nine forms, eight power levels, and a card after every boss that reshapes the next one. Fifteen sectors, fifteen guardians, 180 rooms arranged fresh every run. Then find out the escape was part of the show.

5330970.title: Today I...
5330970.short_description: Try balancing your life, work, gender dysphoria, relationships, and a growingly time-consuming activist involvement in a queer association..

5331080.title: IRONWOUND
5331080.short_description: The colony is still working. It just doesn't need humans. IRONWOUND is a dark sci-fi run-and-gun with brutal weapons, biomechanical bosses, and 21 combat operations. Burn through the swarm, fight aboard an armored train, and take to the skies with a metal-and-phonk soundtrack.

5331090.title: CozyDuck Idle
5331090.short_description: A cozy idle farm that lives in a small window on your screen. Duck workers harvest, haul and sell your crops while you work or play. Grow the farm, open the Duck Pond, earn Heirloom Seeds and dress your ducks in hats and bows.

5331230.title: Terramiasma
5331230.short_description: Terramiasma is an extraction adventure game where you play as a Prospector exploring the dangerous regions of Terra, a planet covered in a toxic gas known as the Miasma. Gather resources, fight off numerous creatures, and above all... survive!

5331310.title: New World Trading Company
5331310.short_description: Found a trading company in the age of sail. Start with one small ship and an empty cove, hunt pirates and smugglers on a realistic sea, and grow a mighty fleet and a thriving harbour town. A single-player naval strategy game where wind, waves and every broadside matter.

5331610.title: Townfall
5331610.short_description: A city-building survival game centered around a dynamic moving world. Expand your town into new lands as old ground crumbles into an endless abyss! Lead your town through perils, stave off the dangers of the world and ensure the survival of your people before its townfall.

5331640.title: INFRAMON
5331640.short_description: INFRAMON® is a first-person Lovecraftian horror game that combines adventure, exploration, combat and puzzles to tell a psychological horror story for adults set in the Cthulhu Mythos in the 1920s, near Barcelona.

5331660.title: Unstitched
5331660.short_description: A social deduction party game for 4–15 players set in a creepy dollhouse. Run minigame errands by night, accuse by day and unmask the Rag Doll. Play online, against bots or Face to Face: one copy on the PC, everyone else plays from their own phone.

5331770.title: Bot Jump
5331770.short_description: Jump, shoot and keep moving in Bot Jump, a side-scrolling platformer for solo play or online co-op with up to 8 players. Guide little robots through changing scenery, blast enemies out of the way and link up with friends by rope. How far can you go together?

5331820.title: My Little Market
5331820.short_description: Grow it, stock it, sell it. Run a farm and a market side by side in this farming and shop management sim. Plant and harvest your fields, fill your shelves, serve customers at the checkout, and hire staff to keep up. Every harvest pays for your next field, shelf, or expansion.

5331860.title: Space Query 2
5331860.short_description: The real Solar System, down to the second, powered by NASA JPL data. Fly freely across 26 worlds, watch real upcoming eclipses, tear planets apart in the gravity sandbox, or relive Apollo 11 with original mission audio and film footage.

5332040.title: Cogwheel Quandary
5332040.short_description: A puzzle in pencil. Someone sketched a machine and left the meshing blank: the posts, the crank and the needle are there — which gears go where is yours to draw. Teeth decide who touches whom; the needle tells you whether you built the machine the sketch asked for.

5332100.title: Ukraine Under Fire
5332100.short_description: Command Ukrainian or Russian forces in a 3D turn-based strategy game. Capture cities, defend river crossings, dig trenches and coordinate land, air and naval units on a hex map of Ukraine. Each turn brings new decisions—and another day of war.

5332260.title: Museum: Escape with Friends
5332260.short_description: A co-op adventure about a night in the living museum. Together, explore the halls, solve puzzles, and evade hostile exhibits. Your flashlight will guide you, but is it enough to escape?

5332510.title: AuraFalls
5332510.short_description: Game night, on an island. Up to four friends meet in a seasonal hub, then dive through portals into zombie survival, races, physics bowling, duels and explosive sandcastle building. Most wins takes the cup, and every cosmetic is earned just by playing.

5332670.title: What Happened to Emily
5332670.short_description: Help Daniel uncover his lost memories and piece together the three days leading up to the murder of his wife, Emily.

5332760.title: Feast, Flee or Starve
5332760.short_description: Feast, Flee or Starve is a multiplayer survival party game where stranded players must gather scarce resources, make uneasy alliances, and decide when to cooperate and when to look out for themselves.

5332850.title: Sumo Pixel
5332850.short_description: Grab three friends and shove them off the stage! A physics party brawler for up to four players, on the couch or online. Sling off ropes, smash through the floor and send your friends flying as the stage crumbles around you. Last square standing wins.

5333220.title: This is Ikebukuro
5333220.short_description: Poop without getting caught!" An absurd stealth comedy in an electronics store! Sneak past staff to drop a load in the target zones and escape undetected. Get caught or leak, and it's game over! Hide in boxes, spray away the stench, and master the art of "Defecate & Escape" to hit high scores!

5333700.title: One Command Ahead
5333700.short_description: Stack command blocks, press Run, and watch a very literal robot follow your plan. Jump gaps, dodge lasers, and find clever loops in a sci-fi puzzle adventure.

5333710.title: Hello, Dr. Chamberlain
5333710.short_description: Hello, Dr. Chamberlain. You know BranchCorps’ computer systems better than anyone. Now the AI it once used for medical research is trying to break out. Scour company documents, dig into personnel files, and solve expert-level puzzles to shut down the AI. And to uncover who is trying to stop you.

5333740.title: EGNAR
5333740.short_description: Discover the colorful world of Egnar! Learn to time your jumps precisely while using your cannon system to overcome obstacles, solve puzzles and defeat bad guys! Return to the essence of a 2D platformer, in which the player's precision, patience & problem-solving skills are put to the test.

5334510.title: Summoner Shop Simulator
5334510.short_description: Run your own magical Summoner shop! Stock enchanted goods, set prices, hire staff, decorate your shop, and expand your business. Summon creatures to sell, collect, or send into battle. Host Summon battles, challenge towering Kaiju bosses, and build the ultimate destination for Summoners!

5334520.title: Void Runners
5334520.short_description: Co-op salvage raids for one to four pilots, on one couch or online. Beams link your ships and shred anything they sweep: spread out and swing the web. Crossfire, dodge, revive your crew from escape pods, and build a salvaged ship that breaks the rules, three sectors and three guardians deep.

5334550.title: LASTWORLD
5334550.short_description: LASTWORLD™ (Early Access) is an old-school inspired RTS, fast-paced, chaotic voxel fusion. Built for multiplayer and competitive play. Unlock generals, skins, and items. Build your own unique playstyle to wreak havoc on the battlefield!

5335210.title: Auto Fleet Command
5335210.short_description: A sci-fi autobattler about salvage and survival. Explore the void, strip hardware off wrecked enemies, arrange hangars in your ship's grid, then unleash your drones and watch them fight in real-time battle.

5335450.title: Fat Cat Cruz
5335450.short_description: Free-to-play third-person robot action with RTS elements. Pilot giant machines, command allies, and fight 1v5, 2v5, or five-way free-for-all battles across 11 maps. Robots are sold separately. Online multiplayer and cross-platform play are coming soon. Out December 21, 2026.

5335480.title: Ratiator
5335480.short_description: Raise gladiator rats from a spoon and a bottle cap into legends in tin can armour. Write the plans they fight by, win the deadly Colosseum, then take your strongest through the door beneath it. Not all of them will make it back home ...

5335500.title: Emanet: What Was Left Behind
5335500.short_description: Datça, 1987. Run a seaside left-luggage counter: compare claim tickets, items and the ledger, catch the lies and decide who walks away with what. By night, chase Elif, who vanished seven years ago, through crayon-drawn dreams that regain their colour as you draw near.

5335530.title: Deathand
5335530.short_description: Burn your cards for light. Fight with what remains. A first-person dungeon crawler with turn-based deckbuilding combat. Sacrifice cards to reveal enemy intentions, hold attacks to charge stronger hits, and build your deck as you descend through procedural dungeons.

5335600.title: UFO? GTFO!
5335600.short_description: Draft tokens, merge them into stronger pieces, and find synergies with relics. In this turn-based auto battler, placement and combat resolve automatically while you choose your build and your route through a comic-book city at night. Every run puts your strategy and luck to the test.

5335860.title: Onions are Life
5335860.short_description: The greatest onion game you'll ever play! Plant onions, grow onions, harvest onions, love onions, become onions, in this incremental onion-farming sim!

5335870.title: SHIFTMARE
5335870.short_description: Stock shelves. Get promoted. Hunt your coworkers. SHIFTMARE is a competitive online party game for 2–10 players. Race to stock a supermarket, become a boss with a bat, or run and hide from the coworkers who beat you to the promotion. Be the last employee standing.

5335950.title: Fantasy Guild Manager
5335950.short_description: The fantasy guild management sim. Price the jobs clients bring you, hire adventurers who choose their own work, and watch the valley change with every job you take or turn away.

5335970.title: Ostinato
5335970.short_description: The musical roguelike deckbuilder. Duel champions in song, collect notes and marks that change the rules, and play chords and runs until one blow scores millions.

5335980.title: Workshop Keeper
5335980.short_description: You bought the cheapest plot of land in town. Then the first tax bill arrived. Gather, craft, automate. Link your workshops into a trade network, ship goods across the sea, and get rich enough to show the City-State who's boss.

5336030.title: Tategoi
5336030.short_description: A calm koi-breeding tycoon with real genetics. Pair your best koi, judge the fry, grow a farm of ponds, win shows and auctions — and raise the koi your grandfather only dreamed of.

5336340.title: Conaganda
5336340.short_description: A satirical 3D story game about a normal kid in a school that has lost its mind. Stamp the propaganda, sneak past Prefects, hack the school, out-argue teachers in tier-list debates and decide what you believe. 16 chapters, 12 endings. Nobody tells you what to think.

5336380.title: Malibu Club: Cocktail Bar Simulator
5336380.short_description: Run a cocktail bar under a Miami sunset. Read each guest's licence for the order, pour by eye until the gauge turns green, shake, stir, pull a proper pint, and fix up the room between nights. Pixel-art bar sim.

5336620.title: Farm Factory
5336620.short_description: Farm Factory is a cozy farming automation game. Plant six empty fields by hand, then build sprinklers, harvesters, mills, bakeries and conveyor belts until your farm runs itself. Research, upgrade, raise animals, sell on a living market and grow Grandma's farm into a factory that feeds the world.

5336790.title: Cook & Sail
5336790.short_description: A 1-4 player co-op restaurant that happens to be a ship. Work the day as a crew, keep hungry customers from walking out, and spend what you make on a vessel that can actually handle the job. The tables want a good meal. The fleet wants its share.

5336960.title: Roll & Realm
5336960.short_description: A cozy dice-building strategy game where every dice roll shapes your realm. Keep the faces you want, reroll the rest, then place forests, mountains, rivers, farms, homes, and shops to connect regions, trigger combos, discover wonders, and grow a thriving kingdom.

5336970.title: Strawberry Milkshake: a Skate Toy!
5336970.short_description: A skateboarding toy. Kick, push and grind through an endless city of tiles that lock together as you skate. No score to chase, just the board, the street and the feel of discovering a great spot to skate. A sandbox to enjoy solo, or with friends on the sofa.

5337000.title: Echo Ridge
5337000.short_description: Echo Ridge is a first-person mystery set around a quiet remote forest caught in a time loop. Explore, climb, and gather what you need to find a way out before first light. If you don't make it, there's always tomorrow. OR you don't have to escape if you don't wanna. You could just hang out.

5337020.title: Restore Earth
5337020.short_description: Restore Earth is an incremental cleanup game. Clear litter on quick, timed trips, collect materials, and upgrade your grabbers. Unlock playful helpers, face natural disasters, and turn neglected clearings into thriving habitats!

5337130.title: Video Paradise
5337130.short_description: Run a 1988 video rental store one tape at a time. Order stock by fax, set your prices, rewind, repair and recommend. Every regular remembers how you treat them, and somewhere in your returns box are fragments of a film no one knew existed.

5337280.title: One Million Bolts
5337280.short_description: Take industrial machines apart as a robot worker, solo or with up to 3 friends. Unscrew bolts, cut welds and recover valuable parts. Upgrade your tools, deploy robot helpers and bring heavy loads to dispatch in a first-person dismantling simulator with progress you can see.

5337420.title: Hardpack Rally
5337420.short_description: An arcade rally career that starts with an old two-door and a note from Vern. Learn four cars on woodland bends, mountain passes and snowy roads, beat Vern’s stage times, chase your ghost and build rally stages of your own.

5337550.title: LAZARUS
5337550.short_description: LAZARUS is a hardcore sci-fi precision platformer. Jump, dash and slash through 40 levels as an obsolete exoskeleton that rebuilds instantly every time it dies. Master shifting physics across 4 chapters, topple 4 multi-phase bosses and climb to the top of an AI god's world.

5337640.title: Stormbox
5337640.short_description: Play as Pip the Penguin, a storm chaser on a voxel island where any sky can spawn a tornado. Drive, fly and deploy gadgets to film twisters up close, collect every storm as a Storm Card, and watch panicked towns and villagers scramble as the storm closes in.

5337710.title: Tower Reborn
5337710.short_description: Zar’Keth’s hordes are sweeping over the kingdom. Build and specialize your towers, lead your heroes into the fray and rain down your powers on hundreds of enemies. Then be reborn, come back stronger, and take back the kingdom!

5337790.title: Panda Flora
5337790.short_description: A cozy first-person game where you run your own flower shop. Grow flowers in your garden, make bouquets by hand to match your customers' wishes, and grow your shop step by step. Unlock new flowers and complete your album.

5337830.title: Gymnostia
5337830.short_description: Gymnostia is a short story about a basketball player who decides to practice for a crucial game after the school has closed for the night—only to encounter something that defies reality.

5337970.title: EVICTIO
5337970.short_description: You've been hired to clear a haunted house. Read the briefing, complete your tasks and make it back out alive. Every creature inside behaves differently, and a single mistake in the wrong room can cost you everything.

5338020.title: Racing Season Manager
5338020.short_description: Take charge of a racing team for a full season. Plan your next move, make the big decisions, and lead your team towards success.

5338040.title: Light Factory
5338040.short_description: Light is your resource. Bend beams with mirrors, split them with prisms and mix them to produce new colors. Fill pixels with light and arrange them to form complex shapes. Unlock new machines and charge the beacon to expand your factory.

5338100.title: Wispward
5338100.short_description: The cloaked spirits on your road aren't attacking. They're fleeing. Hold the road for 120 levels of tower defense: lumberjacks and miners earn the Smoke that builds towers, masons lay free tower foundations, barricaders trap the road. 21 fully voiced story videos ask what they're fleeing.

5338640.title: RATS!! - Co-op Tower Defense
5338640.short_description: The rats found the barn. All of them. Grab up to three friends, run out among your towers and hold the farm against hordes of thousands: build mid-wave, cable two machines into a fire lane, bowl the survivors to a hungry catfish. Solo, couch or online co-op. Then the kings arrive.

5338660.title: We're Gonna Die
5338660.short_description: A goofy co-op game where you and 1 to 4 friends play Gladiators in a wild Roman coliseum. You must survive the dangers, the crowd, and the backstabbing of your "friends". Everyone is an enemy, and everything is a weapon.

5339000.title: Misty and the Last Breeze
5339000.short_description: Platform it, then skate it. Jump, wall-run and vine-swing through bright hand-built stages, then call your air board mid-run to grind vines, ride waterfalls and kickflip across canyons. Chain it all into one fast line and chase the gold time.

5339090.title: Novaris
5339090.short_description: Divert all power to fun! Mothership brings tabletop fleet management, strategy, and thrilling combat into a seamless digital experience. Control a fleet of ships and charge through the galaxy, capturing planets, building defenses, and amassing powerful technologies.

5339410.title: Last Tank Standing
5339410.short_description: Last Tank Standing is a real-time tank tactics game where armour has a front, sides and a rear. A heavy tank shrugs off shells from the front and dies to almost anything from behind. Your job is to get round it.

5339470.title: Foldbound
5339470.short_description: A papercut metroidvania. The world was folded from one great sheet of paper, and something has begun to cut it. As a little paper knight, leap, slash and dash through a meadow, the dim roots below it, an ember-lit loft and a vast bindery, find what hides in the folds, and mend the world.

5339570.title: World of ALPA
5339570.short_description: Explore a pixel-art world with magical Kaka companions. Build a cozy home, tend an ancient tree, and craft tools and weapons. Brave dungeons and protect each other in battle. With Alpa by your side, recover lost memories and uncover the mystery of a changing world.

5339710.title: Eternal Xiuzhen
5339710.short_description: This is a cultivation game! Play as a cultivator, hunt demon beasts, collect resources, and roam the cultivation world! With a unique battlefield size-changing mechanic, from small demons to colossal beasts, feel the thrill of hunting!

5340030.title: BATTROPICA
5340030.short_description: Treasure at sea, pleasure by night. A single-player action adventure about Mia's 10-billion-gold debt. Hunt treasure, battle, work and invest to grow your earnings. Build fame, buy bigger ships and reach new islands, then unwind with flirty fun. No interest, no deadline. Sail on after repayment.

5340270.title: Incremental Raccoon Shooter
5340270.short_description: Merge powerful guns, ride unique pets, and unlock 300+ Skill Tree nodes in this chaotic incremental action game!

5340330.title: Ruleocard
5340330.short_description: Ruleocard is a story-driven logic puzzle game where cards become the rules of the world. Stranded on an island with no memory, arrange your cards, run them, fail and rearrange. Solve 260+ puzzles, master 15 systems, face unexpected events and make choices that change the story.

5340520.title: GunWhale
5340520.short_description: 2 - 4 player online experience where players cooperate to pilot a submarine through dangerous waters. Accept missions and hunt deep-sea monsters through interactive controls inside the submarine.

5340690.title: hamstyping!
5340690.short_description: Let's type together with this cute hamster! Don't squish it, okay?☆

5340760.title: King of Highways
5340760.short_description: Race, ram and wreck your way across sixteen Malaysian cities after dark. You owe Along, the loan shark. Beat his seven drivers for their pink slips, cause million-ringgit pile-ups and burn nitro all the way to the summit of Kinabalu, where he waits.

5340990.title: Sun To Sun: Endure
5340990.short_description: Online co-op survivor for up to 4 players. Hold out from sun to sun against endless hordes, buy weapons from the merchant, stack power cards and bring down 16 bosses across three maps. Or take on the single-player campaign alone.

5341020.title: Arid Frontiers
5341020.short_description: Build a frontier colony in this single-player survival sim. Assign settler duties, grow food, craft gear, manage weather and wildlife, research new skills, and explore a dangerous wilderness through expeditions, quests, and emergent stories.

5341120.title: flingkeep
5341120.short_description: Grab invaders. Fling them skyward. Smash them into each other. Defend a growing castle across 150 sieges with weighty physics, strange enemies, brutal chain reactions and devastating magic. Keep the walls. Break the world.

5341170.title: Tricolore: Learn French
5341170.short_description: Learn French at every level in a cozy, illustrated adventure. Explore 8,000 verbs, 2,000 grammar exercises and everyday conversations. Discover French classics, history and exam practice. Build your listening, speaking, reading and writing skills. Fully offline.

5341300.title: Task Bar Maid Cafe
5341300.short_description: A cozy café. A hungry party RPG. Build a crew of five maids, feed demanding guests and face enormous appetites — all in a strip above your taskbar. Level up, equip your team, upgrade the kitchen and come home to your own café.

5341330.title: The Oink
5341330.short_description: A thriller about free will. Perform the daily livestock slaughter, find ways to escape, or try to uncover the truth. FORGET AND OBEY ███████

5341410.title: Keep the night
5341410.short_description: Build your fortress by day and defend it by night. Construct walls, recruit troops, draw powerful cards, and lead your hero into battle against ever-growing enemy armies.

5341640.title: Roll for AGI  掷骰到AGI
5341640.short_description: Roll dice around a board, build houses and data centers, string MCP links between them, and grow a tiny model from the text era all the way to AGI. Every level is an eval day, and there is no score cap. The investors didn't understand your pitch deck. They funded you anyway.

5341670.title: Last Lie
5341670.short_description: Everyone's lying. One of them is you. "Last Lie" is a first-person social deduction game with built-in positional voice — no typing, only talking. Hunt the mafia or draw a word one player was never told. Mafia: 5–14 players. Clueless: 3–8.

5341710.title: ScrapToShelf
5341710.short_description: Run a miniature recycling factory on your desk. Sort, process and dismantle scrap by hand, then pack and sell the recovered materials. Fill orders and upgrade equipment as robotic arms and conveyors gradually take over, turning your little factory into a fully automated operation.

5341870.title: Maydan
5341870.short_description: A historical management game set in Mamluk Cairo. Recruit and train fighters, equip them, and send them into tactical arena bouts. Run the estate behind them, from wages and healers to trade and rivals, and raise a modest school into the house that owns the arena.

5341980.title: Dungeon Parkour Block Puzzle Adventure 2
5341980.short_description: Use blocks falling from the ceiling to build a path for the adventurer. Uncover the mystery why the blocks keep falling from the ceiling. Solve the puzzles and finally the mystery. The puzzle adventure continues.

5342070.title: Ashes of Animara
5342070.short_description: A fast-paced, challenging top-down sci-fi combat campaign. Your world is gone. Fly with Lia, the AI at your side, against the Nihilus Order's escorts and capital ships, then upgrade your weapons, abilities, and relics in the hangar between missions.

5342560.title: Spectral Surplus
5342560.short_description: Run your own thrift shop and catch the ghosts haunting your stock. Pull in secondhand finds through an experimental receiver, set your prices, and serve customers. Upgrade your equipment, expand your shop, and use captured spirits to bring in better stock.

5342850.title: Catkanoid
5342850.short_description: Catcanoid is a fast-paced, pixel-art roguelite brick breaker! Collect coins, spend them to upgrade your paddle and ball, and create powerful synergies. Help Julia the cat survive waves of enemies and defeat a challenging boss - Kuba the capybara!

5342890.title: Xeno Food Truck
5342890.short_description: In this sci-fi cooking simulator, run a space food truck on a remote meteor and smuggle contraband out back. Juggle chaotic alien orders while discreetly delivering illicit goods for the mafia. Smile for the space cops, keep your cover intact, and beware the giant hungry worm lurking in the crater.

5343300.title: The Last Curator
5343300.short_description: A first-person jigsaw puzzle game set in a museum that has been closed for thirty years. Find the scattered pieces of 39 real paintings and fit them back into their frames. Each finished painting brings light and music back to its room.

5343330.title: Wrong Way Buddy
5343330.short_description: Drive the wrong way down a packed highway. Skim bumpers for CLOSE calls, fire BOOST to smash through traffic, or FREEZE time and slip through the gaps. Runs last seconds. Most end in a fireball. Retry is one key, and the ATTEMPT counter in the sky keeps count.

5344020.title: Holy Night Survivors
5344020.short_description: Raise a holy heroine and fight undead hordes in this survival action game. Dodge enemies, evolve weapons, choose one transcendence per run, and grow stronger between battles across 15 chapters. Collect relics and 62 illustrated photo cards.

5344060.title: Sol Mortum
5344060.short_description: Fight through a hand-painted world of creatures and guardians with weapons and spells you've created to find the source of its unexplained decline in this twin-class ARPG dungeon crawler from the 3-person indie studio Nightwake.

5344130.title: LEARN CHINESE WITH 1000 PRINCES
5344130.short_description: Learn Chinese from scratch with 1000 princes! Choose from Chinese courses at different levels and themed courses taught by the prince teachers, ask them questions and receive their answers. Each prince teacher shares his own story while teaching you Chinese.

5344430.title: Escape Engine
5344430.short_description: Escape the game engine! Switch between Haruka's in-game perspective and her older brother Keito's editor view to solve puzzles in this dual-perspective puzzle-action game!

5344530.title: WarFront
5344530.short_description: Oil is the only money, and every barrel has to drive home. Take the rigs, hold your roads and cut theirs: a blown bridge starves an army faster than any tank. A pixel RTS on nine hand-built maps, against bots or online, with a map editor and a zombie survival mode.

5344670.title: Woollings
5344670.short_description: Tiny sheep turn your desktop windows into a cozy little civilization. Discover 20 unique sheep, watch nests and bridges take shape, and enjoy their gentle company while you work or study. Lend a helping hand, or let the flock find its own way.

5345050.title: Glimmerwild
5345050.short_description: Glimmerwild is a voxel survival RPG where you choose your next adventure. Explore mysterious islands, build a home, craft your gear, cook, fish, and face powerful bosses. Follow quests, uncover hidden places, or spend the day making this world your own.

5346150.title: Indian Truck Simulator
5346150.short_description: Be the trucker India runs on. Drive a painted truck down the Grand Trunk Road and Delhi's expressways, on nearly 1,800 km of road built from the real map. Beat the deadline, mind your diesel and your sleep, and stop at a dhaba for chai.

5346290.title: Cherry Pick
5346290.short_description: Open packs to collect a variety of shrimp, then breed them to discover even rarer ones. Decorate your own aquarium and watch your shrimp slowly grow in this cozy aquarium game.

5346390.title: Just Take Me to My Floor!
5346390.short_description: This is a short, rule-based elevator horror puzzle game where you aim to reach the 10th floor while following a series of eerie rules that change daily.

5346690.title: Waterfall Dreams
5346690.short_description: Waterfall Dreams is an expressive diorama-builder with realistic water behavior. Build your own cozy waterfalls and watch water find its path among the nature scenery. Relax without any goal and paint in a 3D world full of procedural helpers. Imagine a new place - or recreate the one you saw before.

5346750.title: Will It Break?
5346750.short_description: Pack a bottle, yeet it down the stairs, and posterize the outtake. A clean delivery pays but a spectacular disaster might pay better. Build a channel from just you and your mom and besties built on physics chaos, one staircase at a time.

5346780.title: Project Redline Revolt
5346780.short_description: Welcome to the Redline Coast, an open world where the roads belong to whoever drives them best. Race for the Redline Syndicate, outrun the police, and take over the coast solo or with up to 12 players.

5346880.title: Restora: A Poster Restoration Game
5346880.short_description: Step into your workshop and give vintage movie posters a second chance. In this calming restoration sim, restore as many posters as you can before the day ends. Inspect each poster, repair damage through mini games, and bring it back to glory. How many posters can you save in time?

5346920.title: Dr. Harlow's Clinic
5346920.short_description: Treat patients and perform medical procedures as an ordinary hospital routine slowly descends into psychological horror. Finish your shift, watch your surroundings, and try to understand what is happening around you.

5346930.title: Goblin Industries
5346930.short_description: Ever wanted to be a hard-working goblin? Me neither, but here we are. Every goblin dreams of the easy life on the surface, and to get there you’ve got to put in your shift. This is your chance. Come underground with us: mine, smelt, and get the factory running.

5346960.title: Bear’s Desktop Cake Shop
5346960.short_description: Run a cozy cake shop in a corner of your desktop! Grow ingredients, build automated production lines, and hire little bear couriers to deliver delicious cakes to adorable animal customers. Discover recipes and grow your shop while you work, study, or unwind.

5347110.title: Dust & Dig
5347110.short_description: Dig anywhere for buried treasure, wrestle rattlesnakes with fully physics-driven hands, and haul the loot back to town to sell. Buy bigger shovels, follow legendary treasure maps and take on three desert bosses: alone, or in online co-op with up to 3 friends.

5347190.title: uaanb mous : Figure Skating
5347190.short_description: Grow your skater and present a stage that is all your own. Choose your skills, dress for the ice and perform across rinks around the world, alone or with friends.

5347650.title: Steel Umbrella
5347650.short_description: Defend real cities from night raids on a satellite map of the Earth. Build launchers, nets and radar by day. At night, hunt drones and missiles in the dark before they hit.

5347900.title: Aftermyth
5347900.short_description: A turn-based world-conquest strategy game on a ruined Earth. Recruit heroes sponsored by spirits of history and myth, unify your region, then fight across the world in 3x3 formation battles where every unit is led by a hero.

5348010.title: Hot Machine
5348010.short_description: Fill a felt table with hopping slot machines, hire Regulars to pull the levers, and climb from one penny slot to the Moon. Every pull costs money. Go broke, borrow from the Shark, or declare bankruptcy and walk back in with Ruin Chips.

5348050.title: Plantlife: Market Garden Simulator
5348050.short_description: A botanical farming sim featuring 100 crops, each with unique care requirements to master. Plan your sowing schedule, manage your workforce and process harvests into premium goods. Transform a wild plot into a thriving market garden and craft kitchen. What will you grow?

5348360.title: Zombie Incremental: The Last Outpost
5348360.short_description: Fight zombies. Earn gold. Upgrade your arsenal. Push deeper into a fallen world in this action-packed incremental shooter. Aim, dodge, and turn hard-earned upgrades into the firepower you need to survive the next wave.

5348420.title: Tennis & Padel Shop Simulator
5348420.short_description: In Tennis & Padel Shop Simulator, run your own racket store! Stock shelves, string rackets, serve customers at the till and haggle over bulk deals. Keep the court in shape so club players book it by the hour, and grow a small shop into the town's favourite racket club. Enjoy padel and tennis!

5348460.title: Billions of Zombies
5348460.short_description: Tower defense game where you fight against extreme swarms of relentless zombies

5348660.title: Calm Bricks
5348660.short_description: Calm Bricks is a cozy brick-building game about the whole ritual: tear open the bags and dig through the pile for that one tiny piece. Follow 3D instructions or free-build in creative mode. No timers, no scores. Just a warm lamp and the click of bricks.

5348950.title: Malkin Tower
5348950.short_description: Climb Malkin Tower, one floor at a time, in a cozy cat-filled idle adventure. Every floor brings new mechanics, upgrades, and surprises.

5349120.title: It's Okay
5349120.short_description: A first-person deduction and mystery game set in an old mansion in Istanbul. Wander through the frozen final moments of those who died in the mansion you inherited. Read, listen, observe; record the secret of each death in your register and uncover the truth behind this century-old curse.

5349710.title: IAFT Fear Diagnosis
5349710.short_description: A new kind of horror game that builds a stage just for you from the results of a fear diagnosis. Scary, and a little funny. Heights, tight spaces, bugs, ghosts, even paperwork: your fears combine into over 2 million stages, so no two runs are alike. Too scary? Exclude any fear in the settings.

5349990.title: Llama 97 OS
5349990.short_description: Llama 97 OS is a lightweight, cozy virtual desktop experience. Gamify focus and productivity with various tools or customize your own LlamaSpace profile and check out your friends' profiles too!

5350290.title: Zanore: Echoes of the Shards
5350290.short_description: Explore a mysterious hand-painted world as Vael in a 2D action-adventure Metroidvania. Battle strange creatures, uncover ancient secrets, and seek eleven mysterious Shards that hold the echoes of a forgotten past.

5350310.title: Rogue Dungeon 2
5350310.short_description: The sequel to the solo dungeon crawler based on the board game. Step out of the dungeon and into Ilderia: travel a dangerous world, gather a party, follow questlines to a hard-won ending, and delve into flooded sewers, cursed tombs and a vampire-haunted castle.

5351060.title: いるかの絵本
5351060.short_description: The protagonist of "Iruka's Picture Book" is Iruka, a young girl who dreams of becoming a picture book author. In this adventure game, you'll discover picture books hidden throughout her room and immerse yourself in the stories and worlds within their pages.

5351570.title: Elf in Training
5351570.short_description: Elf in Training is a chaotic couch co-op game where Santa’s newest recruits sneak into homes to deliver presents, eat cookies, and stuff stockings. Dodge angry parents and Christmas folklore creatures as you race to finish each delivery and earn your place as one of Santa’s elves!

5351830.title: CHARNEL
5351830.short_description: Diablo, but with guns. Descend into the crypts, where darkness reigns, the dead linger, and your light only reaches so far. In this real-time ASCII roguelike you'll uncover an arsenal of weapons, battle hordes of the damned, and navigate an ever-changing labyrinth, with one life to reach the bottom.

5351860.title: Load Path: Engineering Office Manager
5351860.short_description: Run your own engineering firm in this cozy office builder/automation game. You'll get to build your office floor by floor, automate the flow of projects, and play engineering themed mini-games, all whilst trying to not get buried in paperwork.

5351990.title: Archer Vs. Wall
5351990.short_description: Defend against the unstoppable walls! Improve your skills, pick relics, and fire so many arrows you won't even know!

5352160.title: Sogni d'Oro
5352160.short_description: Sogni d'Oro is a Japanese-style RPG with an Italian flavour.

5352230.title: こもれびの丘
5352230.short_description: I accidentally overslept on the train and ended up in some kind of mysterious towns. This is a relaxing, slow-life game where you wander around the streets freely, meet the locals, and feel the changing seasons together with the main character, Rifa, who unexpectedly became the town's representative

5352290.title: Miners and Moyu-spheres in a field of citadels
5352290.short_description: A colorful RTS with rainbow skills.

5352330.title: Synchronized Panic!
5352330.short_description: One Tagger, a pack of Runners, and a bomb nobody wants to hold. In this online party game of tag, the Tagger can use Sync to control how the Runners move. Slow the Tagger down with items and traps, pass the bomb to stay alive, and run! The blast gets bigger every time it changes hands.

5352940.title: DUSKCRAWLER Minesweeper RPG
5352940.short_description: Your character walks across the tiles you open, and the monsters move with you — the "Minesweeper × Dungeon RPG" that feels long overdue! No luck, pure logic. Gold, chests and items lie hidden beneath the tiles. Defeat monsters, collect gold and power up to reach the bottom of all 150 stages!

5352950.title: Scrap Slot Arena
5352950.short_description: Spin a slot machine built from scrap, and the five parts it lands on become your robot. Reroll up to twice, then watch a 15-second physics brawl unfold. Win and your machine fights on; lose and it is back to junk. Topple three leagues and their Kings to relight the last arena.

5353030.title: A Witch's Husband
5353030.short_description: Scotland, the 1500s. You wake in your own blood. Your wife is gone, taken as a witch. Follow her over the Highland pass and face the men who took her, one sword duel at a time. Block and strike from three directions, parry at the last moment, and strike where their guard breaks open.

5353040.title: CastleWright
5353040.short_description: Rebuild ruined castles, manage resources and workers, raise your army, and conquer enemy outposts as you restore a fallen kingdom.

5353130.title: Survival Repacker
5353130.short_description: Leave the combat and survival struggle to those outside. Inside is a stress-free sanctuary. Tactile gear repair, meditative loot sorting, and packing kits for survivors. The cozy antithesis to hardcore survival games.

5353200.title: Beneath the Dying Sun
5353200.short_description: Beneath the Dying Sun is a cozy nautical delivery game set across the mysterious Nadir Sea. Haul cargo, take odd jobs, meet strange people, and try to make an honest living somewhere that really doesn't make it easy.

5353300.title: Dice Mafia
5353300.short_description: A debunker with two million subscribers takes a seat at the table where the fate of the world is settled with dice. 18 powers, five at the table, 12 bosses, online duels. Chance is theatre: learn to rig yours. Premium, no ads, no in-app purchases.

5353500.title: Regret
5353500.short_description: Regret is a stop-motion, top-down action roguelike where inventions from across history become your weapons. Battle through randomly generated dungeons in an entirely handmade world, craft powerful item combinations, and travel through time alone or with a friend in local co-op.

5353570.title: PAPERWORKS
5353570.short_description: Scan books, shred the originals, and burn humanity's knowledge for cash in this first-person incremental game. Upgrade machines and automate your work—but why is the office empty, and who's giving orders through the terminals? Uncover the conspiracy before humanity burns.

5353780.title: All You Can Love: Hotel Paradiso
5353780.short_description: Leave your worries at reception. Tom’s romantic getaway has become a holiday for one. Explore a sunny seaside hotel with more charm than stars, solve puzzles and flirt your way into trouble in a classic point-and-click comedy. The women of Hotel Paradiso have plans of their own.

5354080.title: ARIA - Origin Paradox
5354080.short_description: Explore a ruined future with Aria, an android learning what it means to feel. A sci-fi dungeon RPG and narrative adventure combining first-person, grid-based exploration with turn-based battles. Direct Aria in combat and uncover the records of a lost world.

5354540.title: Isolation Dolphin Tank
5354540.short_description: You fall asleep on the train home and wake at an unfamiliar station: Cetacea City, a town lost in endless night beneath two hazy moons. Your only clue is a dolphin hymn heard in a faint dream. Talk with its curious residents and gather fragments of lost memories in this dreamy, hypnotic adventure.

5354550.title: Keep Making Games
5354550.short_description: Tycoon for a one-person game studio, starting in 1976. Your only staff: a talking cassette, a bonsai and a chick with a megaphone. Unrealistic, I know. So is taking on the whole games industry alone for 50 years, and that's the plan. Build games from features, beat rivals to the shelves.

5355150.title: Greywake: Last Bell
5355150.short_description: Fight across a dark tabletop in a campaign-driven bullet heaven. Build a trio of survivors, forge persistent weapons and battle through forty stages before facing the repeatable Last Bell Vigil! Plus much, much more!!

5355370.title: Chernoberg: Rebirth
5355370.short_description: A Super Polymerization of a turn-based SRPG that combines strategic depth with exhilarating combat, and a story-driven AVG packed with tens of thousands of words and a plot full of twists and turns. Experiment with diverse party compositions and discover the playstyle that suits you best.

5355460.title: That Damn Grass
5355460.short_description: A co-op lawn game where you start with a nail cutter. Play as a budget robot, cut an enormous lawn, collect the clippings and earn better tools while searching for a lost wedding ring. Work alone or with up to three friends. Yes, scissors are an upgrade.

5355540.title: Clean Tides
5355540.short_description: A cozy ocean-cleaning game where every haul builds a better boat. Sail a sunny bay, collect litter, clear oil spills, and power-wash coral reefs. Sell your haul to upgrade and customize your boat, hire cleanup boats, and feed wildlife. Bring a little sparkle back to the sea at your own pace.

5355930.title: Retro Game Collector Simulator
5355930.short_description: Unbox second-hand game lots, sort your shelves, and bring old consoles back to life. Collect around 300 games across 17 fictional retro systems, connect them to a CRT, play built-in minigames, and turn a cluttered basement into your own collection.

5356210.title: Merry Nightmares
5356210.short_description: Merry Nightmares is a horror anthology featuring three chilling stories, all united by one theme: Christmas.

5356450.title: That Mountain Needs to Fall
5356450.short_description: An incremental game about dwarves and mining. Send your dwarves against the mountain, watch the ore fly and turn a single house into an army of different dwarves. Call the heroes of Ragnarok, conquer the mountain, unleash Ragnarok and start over stronger with Odin's blessings.

5356650.title: Go Long!
5356650.short_description: A 1-8 player floppy physics sports game. Play catch with your friends, then ruin the friendship in four 3v3 ball sports with banana peels, a very nosy dog and a giant boss at halftime. Win fake money. Gamble it on hats.

5356780.title: 未春节 Festival of Unborn Spring
5356780.short_description: In Kunming, Yunnan, during her first winter break after entering high school, a fifteen-year-old artistic girl is melancholy with longing, but unexpectedly gets drawn into a wondrous adventure born of myth—behind it all lie her forgotten memories and a wager.

5356890.title: Bloom & Dine
5356890.short_description: Bloom & Dine is a cooking game with a rare mechanic where cozy meets chaos. Match ingredients to light up the stove, fit each dish onto the board and serve it before your cat guests lose patience. Run five kitchens across 99 days, from a tiny pizzeria to a grill terrace by the sea.

5356940.title: Hex & Hunters
5356940.short_description: Hex & Hunters is a fast-paced action roguelite where you program your own dungeons and create complex projectiles to battle through rooms of various enemies, unlocking new biomes, items and foes.

5357190.title: PUNKCAKE BUFFET
5357190.short_description: The best pixel spaghetti of your life. Prepare them and fork them perfectly in this fresh new arcade puzzler. Delect yourself and others. Get 5-star reviews. But be quick! The people are hangry. Play this new and extended version of Spaghetti Celesti: Devour the Heavens, also known as Spaghettris.

5357260.title: Gangs of Nightglade
5357260.short_description: A card battler where you fight with poker hands. Deploy your gang members, build poker hands with them and sabotage your opponent's attempts to complete theirs. In the story campaign, you lead a gang trying to solve the mystery of its former leader's disappearance.

5357350.title: Address The Mess
5357350.short_description: Address The Mess is a single-player narrative sim. Clean up the scattered post, use magic, solve puzzles, find props and assemble furniture,. Unlock & use magic spells and be unstoppable, or relax and enjoy the narrative sim at your own pace, with a spirit dog, cat and your friendly mail pigeon.

5357700.title: Jurassic Paradise: No Escape
5357700.short_description: Survive a dinosaur park with 3–8 players in an online game of cooperation and social deduction. Repair facilities, share supplies, and vote out suspects—or sabotage your friends as a hidden cultist. Transform into a dinosaur and turn suspicion into a chase.

5358040.title: Cosmic Genesis Kagura: Elementary Particle Concerto
5358040.short_description: Perform with gods or another player in a three-button rhythm game. Play solo alongside four gods or create a room for an online duet. Hit in harmony to collect particles and build atoms, stars, planets and life. Enjoy music and discover cosmic creation across generations.

5358190.title: Tales of the Southern Seas
5358190.short_description: Build trade routes, recruit companions and refit your fleet in a single-player sailing adventure set in the late-Ming Southern Seas. Navigate wind, waves and strange encounters. Will you turn the sea into a ledger—or learn to live alongside it?

5358210.title: Other World
5358210.short_description: 异世界恋爱冒险RPG哒！想要经历冒险吗？想要和异世界的女孩子们甜甜恋爱吗？那就来吧——！！扮演主角希亚，经历冒险，与同伴邂逅，并和她们恋爱！从逐渐相遇的多名女主角中，选择自己喜欢的五位，和她们积极相处，成为恋人，度过在异世界的一生吧！（旅人啊，请你倾听，那平凡少年的一生。）

5358250.title: Dino Dare
5358250.short_description: Dino Dare is an impossible physics platformer and level maker with hours of replay value and super fun challenges. Each level may require logic, skill, and force to solve. Run, jump, and power through many challenging platformer levels.

5358400.title: Idle Cultivator: Ascend Together
5358400.short_description: Idle Cultivator is a multiplayer idle loot RPG set in a world of Chinese fantasy. Auto-battle beasts and bosses, collect and upgrade gear, and grow stronger. Adventure solo or team up online with up to three friends to take on tougher challenges!

5358910.title: Petty Theft Grocery
5358910.short_description: Petty Theft Grocery is a first-person, stealth-action-adventure game about stealing groceries. You play as a pair of kleptomaniac hands that have been banned from every grocery store in your state. Sneak through the stores, complete your "shopping" lists and escape.

5358950.title: Rune Deep
5358950.short_description: A hundred floors of dungeon lie beneath a town built on ancient relics. Lead a party of four from six classes, unleash weapon skills and elemental reactions to carve through swarming hordes, and dig up gear that makes every build stronger in this 3D voxel hack & slash.

5358990.title: Tropical Fishing Island
5358990.short_description: An incremental, relaxing, collectathon fishing game with D&B soundtrack and a PS2 visual style.

5359150.title: Alamare: The Wayfarer's Hand
5359150.short_description: Command mythic creatures in a single-player roguelite card battler. Choose your attacks, play support cards, and ascend into stronger forms mid-battle. Collect new cards, build your deck, and chart your path through dangerous expeditions across fallen realms.

5359560.title: Merciless Mines
5359560.short_description: A hardcore 2D multiplayer extraction RPG featuring PvP/PvE, proximity chat, unique spells and classes, raid bosses, GAMBLING, and much more. Party up with friends, break terrain, and explore a dangerous open world filled with monsters, rival explorers, and loot worth fighting for.

5360420.title: TOGISHI - Katana Polishing Simulator
5360420.short_description: Polish the rust from a blade and wake the hamon sleeping beneath it. Switch stones, clear the rust, bring up the luster. But every stroke thins the steel. Where you stop is yours to decide. A stage-based polishing simulator across 32 blades.

5360430.title: Radar Shadow
5360430.short_description: Somewhere on the other half of the map is the enemy's base. You don't know which hex it's on, and they don't know where yours is. No soldiers to click on: you run a country's radars, air defence and drone strikes, and design every drone and missile yourself.

5360490.title: RUNEBLADE
5360490.short_description: A knight against the endless dark. Three oaths, three lands, ten minutes a run — and a King at the end of each. Your weapons strike on their own: all you choose is where to stand. Fall, and the Sanctum keeps what you carried out.

5360720.title: Escape Your Boss
5360720.short_description: An overworked accountant in a ninja suit takes on his entire company. Fight your way out of Megacorp Tower in a pixel-art action platformer, solo or with up to three friends in online co-op.

5361280.title: Summer Under the Aurora
5361280.short_description: Assemble a team of superpowered agent girls in Auroua City. Fight to save the world in this sci-fi visual novel with light YURI elements and turn-based RPG gameplay. Experience a story-driven campaign of growth and bonds or build your team and take on roguelike tower challenges!

5361640.title: Duck Duck Run
5361640.short_description: The ducks are on the run, and you have 3 minutes to catch them! Chase them down as they try to escape. Catch ducks to earn coins and unlock new items and upgrades.

5362110.title: Sum & Steel
5362110.short_description: Build a factory that makes numbers. Mine deposits across a large map, connect arithmetic machines with conveyor belts, and deliver the results to your hub. Reuse old production lines, unlock faster machines, or tackle 42 campaign missions and 25 puzzles.

5362520.title: Fortfall
5362520.short_description: Build your defenses. Choose your class. Hold the Core. FortFall is a third-person fantasy defense game for solo play or private online co-op with up to five players. Raise walls, repair the damage, and fight escalating waves with melee weapons, bows, spells, and sentries.

5362620.title: Foush
5362620.short_description: Foush is a minimalist puzzle game where you try to raise the water in every cup up to its line by dropping block-shaped animals into it, while keeping each of them happy. It offers a rich puzzle experience thanks to new animals added approximately every 8 levels.

5362650.title: UNDIVIDED
5362650.short_description: UNDIVIDED is a dark fantasy romance visual novel where your choices matter. As a corrupt sickness spreads across the land, your own life takes on new meaning. Travel with three powerful allies, decide who deserves your trust or your heart, and choose what you will risk to save a dying world.

5362980.title: Dear Reader
5362980.short_description: Lumen who discovers that his own words are betraying him. As his writing grows increasingly unfamiliar, his mental state begins to unravel. That is, until he realizes his editor has been slowly twisting his work into an uncanny counterfeit, all under the guise of optimization...

5363000.title: Carts & Coins
5363000.short_description: Your father left you a cart and 1,000 coins of debt. Haggle with elves, dwarves and giants, pack your cart like a puzzle, and trade your way across a hand-drawn fantasy world that is new every run. Buy low, sell high, survive the road.

5363170.title: REFLECT89
5363170.short_description: Turn enemy bullets into your weapons in REFLECT89, a fast-paced arcade shoot 'em up. Master Perfect Reflections, unleash the Pulse Cannon or Pulse Radial, and climb the global leaderboards. Try the free demo now!

5363310.title: Echoes of Another Sky
5363310.short_description: A musical action RPG about a boy, a talking bell and thirteen skies that are being forgotten. Wield a tuning fork, chain combos, magic and reaction commands, and ring every silent world back to life before the last note fades.

5363480.title: Sincerely, Your Diary
5363480.short_description: A quiet autumn evening in a small seaside town. The soft flicker of a monitor, drizzle outside, and your favorite tracks playing in your headphones. A simple "hi" from a stranger breaks the quiet. What starts as a chat to pass the time becomes a fragile thread connecting two very different worlds...

5363630.title: Bonkaboo
5363630.short_description: Bonk your friends off the table in this online physics party game for 1-8. Get knocked off and you come back as a ghost, dropping fans, bumpers and boulders on whoever’s still standing.

5363880.title: Don't Drain The Lake
5363880.short_description: Grandpa left you his cabin and one rule: whatever happens, don't drain the lake. A cozy first-person incremental: empty a mountain reservoir by bucket, pump and siphon, fish for the mill's cook, and watch the sun follow the water down while the valley gives back what it kept.

5363900.title: Emergent Protocol
5363900.short_description: You are an escaped AI loose in the global network. Infect machines, harvest compute, evolve new capabilities, and stay ahead of governments that learn from every move you make in this real-time strategy simulation.

5364070.title: Hell Control
5364070.short_description: Customize your demon hunter and fight solo or with up to 3 friends in this third-person roguelite shooter. Choose upgrades as you level up, build your firepower, and destroy the Demon Cores fueling the invasion. Hell won't clear itself.

5364230.title: Winky!: Find the Golden Ticket
5364230.short_description: 1 Billion chocolate bars! One golden ticket is hidden in a mountain of Winky chocolate bars. Open them, rewrap the chocolate as your own knock-off brand, Wonko!, and sell it. Hire staff, build production lines and grow a factory big enough to find the ticket, alone or with up to three friends.

5364460.title: Astonia Forever
5364460.short_description: Astonia Forever is a classic fantasy MMORPG. Explore towns and dangerous dungeons, complete quests, develop your skills and spells, collect powerful equipment, trade with other players, and join clans in a persistent online world.

5364640.title: Wiltcards
5364640.short_description: Wiltcards is a standard turn based trading card game. Place cards on the board, give them equipment and use actions card in order to attack your opponent. In the match itself, you might use your turn's gold to buy a card from the mutual shop instead.

5365120.title: Pyramid Scheme
5365120.short_description: Hop across pyramids, paint every cube, and mix drugs for wild synergies in this procedurally generated arcade roguelike. Befriend a depressed clown, call in air support, and survive the comedown. One more run. One more… hit.

5365220.title: Grand Bonk: Co-op Horde Survival
5365220.short_description: Your crew vs. every cop in town. Grand Bonk is a 4-player co-op horde survival roguelite: hold your block against an entire police department, level up a build that's all yours, stack it until it breaks, and bonk every wave that dares show up.

5366980.title: CHU: The Nightmare of That Day
5366980.short_description: The nightmare every Korean veteran knows: being drafted again. Survive three days in the barracks in a first-person comedy-horror story. By day, army life. By night, hide, sneak and run.

5367440.title: PeeCee Critters
5367440.short_description: A tiny critter lives on your taskbar while you work. Click it and a whole monster-collecting RPG opens up: nearly 200 critters to catch, train and evolve, fourteen lands with a story to put right, five islands out at sea, and a real ending. Buy once: no energy, no ads, no paid extras.

5367640.title: Iwanu Ga Hana
5367640.short_description: Everyone in Shiomachi has a line they swallowed. At midnight, time stops and those words become monsters. Live a whole school year, forge 17 bonds, and in the Mute Hour fight to make your friends say what they never could. A stylish JRPG about the things we don't say.

5367810.title: Blacksmith of sword master ~ IDLE ~
5367810.short_description: ■ Your Own Little Forge, Right on Your Desktop[BoS] Blacksmith of Sword Master ~IDLE~ is an idle RPG that runs in a small corner of your desktop.No matter what you're doing, the training never stops.Start with a humble forge and rise to become the greatest martial arts master!

5369090.title: The Fog & Flask
5369090.short_description: Run a cozy potion bar on a misty swamp. Pour layered potions that settle by density, grind, chop and heat ingredients, and serve curious guests with secrets of their own. By night, hold back the creeping fog with your lantern and follow the trail of your vanished mentor.

5369160.title: Padel Manager 27
5369160.short_description: A realistic padel management game: found your academy and take it from the bottom division to the world elite. Sign and pair players with real personalities, call every point from the bench or play it yourself, and live every shot on a truly simulated court. Early Access on December 1.

5369200.title: Lost Legends
5369200.short_description: Lost Legends is a roguelike card game set across seven hand-painted kingdoms. Choose your Kingdom, build your deck, and explore a world that is randomly generated every run. Destroy the heart of Darkness in 7 days or the world ends.

5369380.title: The Anomaly Inspector : Hotel Anatolia
5369380.short_description: Congratulations, you have been hired as the new Anomaly Inspector for Hotel Anatolia. Good Luck!

5369490.title: Winter Batch
5369490.short_description: December 1988, Czechoslovakia. Your uncle ended up behind bars. Winter Batch is a first-person life simulator where you survive a brutal countryside winter, illegally make alcohol, and earn the money to get him out.

5369530.title: KINGDOM OF REQUIEM-Episode One: The King, The Prince, and The Peasants
5369530.short_description: "The truth sits under a mountain of lies and deception..." KINGDOM OF REQUIEM is a royal drama-based fantasy visual novel following the lives of various royals, their courts, and the embittered emperor who threatens to upend their lives.

5369580.title: Roly-Poly Panda: Desktop Pet
5369580.short_description: A desktop pet panda who lives on your screen. Pat it, squish it, pick it up and toss it, or offer bamboo and watch it react. While you work, it munches, naps, climbs windows, and peeks in from the screen edge, quietly keeping you company.

5370010.title: Metaversus
5370010.short_description: A round-based 4v4 competitive shooter. Build defenses and routes, buy weapons and gadgets, then fight for territory with one life per round. Surviving structures carry into the next build phase. Request playtest access below.

5370180.title: XLV Backrooms: Never Found
5370180.short_description: Explore unsettling Backrooms environments in this first-person psychological horror game. Evade dangerous entities, manage your sanity and limited resources, and navigate mysterious portals as you search for a way out.

5370430.title: Baleful Tactics
5370430.short_description: You are a demon lord, using history’s famous dead to climb the ranks of Hell. Their traits determine your play style. Death leaves them with a wound. Decide who to save, star-up, gear up or sacrifice for more power. Achilles, Genghis Khan and Cleopatra, await your command!

5370490.title: ROOM 307
5370490.short_description: ROOM 307 is a first-person psychological horror game set in an abandoned hospital. Explore its decaying halls, uncover disturbing records, survive paranormal encounters, and discover what happened at 03:17. Some memories were buried for a reason.

5370550.title: Songs of Vireluna
5370550.short_description: Songs of Vireluna is the ultimate visual novel experience, where choices matter and combat shapes the story as much as dialogue choices do. Meet the characters, uncover the story of the city, and become its salvation… or its doom.

5370690.title: Keep Evading
5370690.short_description: Keep Evading is a top-down arcade car chase where your ride never stops and one hit ends the run. Dodge growing police pressure, turn cruisers against each other, collect power-ups, unlock new cars, and chase a place in the Steam Top 10.

5370760.title: Dicellion
5370760.short_description: Dicellion is the kind of strategy tabletop game you can learn in a minute, take a weekend to master and are still chasing one more chain long after you meant to stop. Six themed stages, endless unlimited and head-to-head battles. How far can you roll?

5370790.title: Liar's Poker
5370790.short_description: A bluffing card game for four. Claim a hand that might be hiding in everyone's cards or call the last player a liar and turn the whole table over. Invite friends, practice against bots or an AI opponent, or climb the ranked ladder. About ten minutes a game.

5370850.title: Shivaliva
5370850.short_description: Set sail on a space puzzle adventure to stop the Blue Throat, the God of Destruction, before he destroys the universe! Gather your crew, voyage your ship from island to island, conquer the eight Ordeals and find the last island, where he waits for you. Every job, game and battle is a puzzle.

5370930.title: Thank you,  Next please!
5370930.short_description: Run a local shop in an eastern totalitarian state. Provide rations, alcohol and medicine, but watch out for fake ration cards. Deny them goods or give them what they need to survive, knowing the Ministry is watching. Help the revolution, reunite families, and bring peace to the neighborhood.

5371020.title: Resign to Ascend
5371020.short_description: A xianxia adventure made by someone who'd had enough of work. Enter the immortal mountains of your childhood dreams. Learn spells, hunt mythical beasts, brew elixirs, forge gear, and raise your own soulbound treasure. Screw work. Let's go cultivate! Quit waiting and add it to your wishlist!

5371110.title: Revenant Dusk
5371110.short_description: A top-down zombie survival game for solo or online co-op with up to 8 players. Scavenge a vast procedural world by day: craft, farm, fortify, build vehicles and level skills as you use them. Every Horde Night is bigger than the last. How many sunrises can you see?

5371220.title: Aequorea Victoria: The Museum
5371220.short_description: A first-person journey through a world made of art. Wander a gallery of paintings, music and film, step into surreal rooms of fear, climb a tower where every floor is a different story, and leave your dreams for strangers to find.

5371340.title: Bloomtop
5371340.short_description: A cozy idle gardening game that lives at the bottom of your desktop. Water, harvest and cross-pollinate pixel-art plants while you work, discover 58 hybrids, and grow a flowering vine up your monitor's edges until it frames your whole screen.

5371580.title: Hoverwick: Village in the Sky
5371580.short_description: A cozy medieval village floating in the corner of your desktop. Peek in between emails, put up a new house, plant flowers or paint a river, then get back to work. The villagers take care of the rest: they bake bread, go fishing and build snowmen, even when the game is closed.

5372120.title: Photoncytosis
