A first-person stealth horror game across ten nights in one house that changes, little by little, each night.

5410940.title: Lobotomy Protocol
5410940.short_description: Lobotomy Protocol is a reaction and logic battle royale set in a grim mid-20th-century psychiatric hospital. Every mistake could lead to a lobotomy. Pass the trials, boost yourself, and inflict side effects on your rivals. Remember what you were never meant to.

5411020.title: Neonovista
5411020.short_description: Build a neon city, add unique landmarks and drive through your creation in this relaxing voxel sandbox. Connect winding roads, slopes and overpasses; switch between third-person and cockpit views, or roam endlessly through city streets, sunset coasts and roads beneath Saturn's rings.

5411030.title: Unframed
5411030.short_description: Rob a bank with your crew, carry the loot without breaking it and watch out for the traitor. Unframed is a physics-based heist game for 3–6 players. You’re all pulling the same job, but one of you wants the entire haul to themselves.

5411080.title: Antmates: Idle Ant Colony
5411080.short_description: An idle ant colony with real numbers, behind glass on your desktop. Plan 25 kinds of rooms and level each one up two ways, feed your ants four kinds of crumbs, balance foragers, diggers and nurses, and chase milestones that multiply your income — cozy to watch, deep to plan.

5411140.title: Oresome - A mining fever dream
5411140.short_description: You helped an old lady across the street? As punishment, the Orc Realm sends you down the mine. There, you dig for ore with your bare fists, secretly stash away ingots and plot your breakout with zombies and other mythical creatures. Solo or co-op, on your monitor or in VR.

5411420.title: Luma Orb
5411420.short_description: Guide your orb through rotating planets and floating islands in this colorful 3D action platformer. Jump across gaps, dodge falling hazards, collect stars, and fight back with power-ups. From fiery worlds to slippery ice, every level brings a new challenge.

5411620.title: MageInc
5411620.short_description: An Incremental Magic game where you face ghouls and other monstrosities blocking your path. Use Fire, Ice, Earth and other elements to annihilate them!

5411840.title: Wok in Another World
5411840.short_description: A top-down action game meets hands-on restaurant management. A hot-tempered master chef wakes up as a catgirl in another world. Loot monster ingredients in the dungeon with your partners, then run your diner yourself: toss the wok, research recipes, forge gear and open a snack stall underground!

5411930.title: Flurry Fray
5411930.short_description: A chaotic snowball party game for up to 4 on one couch or more online. Pelt rivals, sneak up with a shovel, bury their campfire with a snowblower, torch their snowman with a molotov and steal the toys off their Christmas tree. Bots fill empty spots.

5412110.title: My Cozi Shop: Craft & Sell
5412110.short_description: A cozy first-person toy shop sim. Cast rubber ducks, sew plush toys by hand, then box, tape, ribbon and ship each order out the window. Customers review every parcel, and they notice a crooked eye. Spend what you earn on new toys, a helper and decor.

5412670.title: 2.3 Billion
5412670.short_description: A mesmerizing active incremental. It starts slow, with a few sparks. Then they're everywhere and you can barely keep up. Every reset, a new perk. A few hours in the flow. First goal: 2.3 billion. Of what? You'll have to play to find out.

5412820.title: Starfall Chronicles
5412820.short_description: Starfall Chronicles is a retro loot-driven action RPG. Skills cast automatically, so you focus on positioning. Uncover the truth of the Blood Moon over the Starfall Lands. Three classes, artifacts, gear sets and the 100-floor Tongtian Tower await. Buy the base game once. No in-game purchases.

5412850.title: NEON REVIVE
5412850.short_description: Trace the dead tubes of old neon signs and bring them back to life, one glowing stroke at a time. As the lights return, a quiet near-future town slowly wakes up again. No timers, no game over - restore it alone or with up to 4 friends online.

5412870.title: Ten Kingdoms Courier
5412870.short_description: One courier. A land torn by war. Every letter could be your last. A historical visual novel set in 10th-century China, where the Five Dynasties rise and fall and one wrong choice can kill you. Thirty ways to die, four endings. No voice acting.

5412920.title: Roads Taken
5412920.short_description: A tactical role-playing game where every adventure is new: the story, the heroes, the world and its battlefields are drawn from a single seed. Lead your company through a land at war, forge bonds that change the fight, and live with the roads you take.

5413290.title: Rewind to Coding
5413290.short_description: It’s 2010 and AI isn’t a thing yet. You’re a developer who looks for answers in documentation, web searches and your brain. Build your career, solve problems in JavaScript, pay bills and choose your own path to success.

5413840.title: MONOMANIA
5413840.short_description: Obsessive 3D games in one package. Journey through a world of magic, keep insects that move like the real thing, catch and evolve monsters, build robots from gacha parts, and let a bullied boy's rage explode. One game. Many worlds. More arriving in Early Access.

5414560.title: Wilderwake
5414560.short_description: A 2D pixel-art action adventure about waking a dead world with a powerful gauntlet. Crush fruit and the ground blooms, little dinosaurs come home, fish ponds and rebuild your camp, explore a vast world full of secrets and fight crystal creatures to free giant machines.

5414830.title: Animetal Menagerie
5414830.short_description: In this roguelike tower defense, explore the remnants of an ancient biological preserve! Build an army of animal-machine hybrids and collect ancient artifacts from across the multiverse to fight against the ancient experiments left to rot, while the station crumbles around you.

5415010.title: Cobblekin
5415010.short_description: Chop back the forest and grow a cozy village where every log, loaf and bucket is carried by busy little villagers. Raise families from tents to brick houses, catch the rain for the dry season, and hold your walls against orc raids.

5415090.title: Abandoned Below
5415090.short_description: Face relentless zombie waves in a decaying underground bunker. Fight solo or in co-op for up to four players. Build barricades, unlock new passages, explore and survive as long as you can.

5415110.title: Monstarium
5415110.short_description: Tiny pixel monsters live along the bottom of your screen, and climb on top of your windows. Hatch eggs, merge twins to evolve them, and collect over 1,000 looks across 95 forms while you work. Pet them, toss them a treat, and watch them make friends.

5415150.title: WebCreep.er
5415150.short_description: Get filthy rich... Without leaving the toilet.

5415190.title: Collec
5415190.short_description: Open packs and collect a world of wildlife, dinosaurs, distant stars and curiosities. Admire your cards, trade with friends and build a team for five-card duels. A free game with one collection shared between the web and Steam.

5415210.title: Please Stop Feeding The Frog
5415210.short_description: A first person incremental game about feeding a frog. Kill cute backyard creatures, throw them into his mouth, sell the random garbage he burps out, and buy increasingly ridiculous weapons. The frog keeps getting bigger. What's the worse that could happen?

5415420.title: HITLER BACKROOMS
5415420.short_description: HITLER BACKROOMS is a co-op game for 1-6 players, where you must make your way through the Backrooms while avoiding the Hitler entity. Explore the Backrooms alone, or with friends! Progress through the levels and try to survive. Will you find the way out? Or will another hidden world await?

5415470.title: The Widow's Shadow
5415470.short_description: Following her husband's death, a widow haunted by her town's whispers enters a twisted reality where she must confront the shadows of her past. A psychological horror visual novel inspired by German Expressionist cinema, featuring three different endings.

5415500.title: Bagbrawl
5415500.short_description: Your bag is your weapon, and every hero’s bag is different. Pack a poison vial, a voodoo doll, or a backpack, discover recipes, craft items, and build combos that win the fight before it starts. Then watch them fight real players, or team up with two friends against weekly bosses

5415730.title: Note Defender: A Sight Reading Arcade
5415730.short_description: Memorize the notes on the treble and bass staffs as well as 9 ledger lines above and below them. This covers every key of a standard 88 key piano and most instruments.

5415870.title: Dogletter part 2
5415870.short_description: Don't you know I like you? Return to the same house over and over and expect that one day it will be easier to leave. Also feed the dogs every single night please, and then put them away. And then you can leave.

5415910.title: Towerworks
5415910.short_description: Build your tower floor by floor and watch tenants move in. Grab a mop, fix what’s broken and keep the lifts moving. Hire staff when you can afford it, a manager when you can’t keep up, another tower when you’re ready. It looks cozy but the sim is unforgiving if you overborrow or disaster strikes.

5415950.title: Corruption:Rei
5415950.short_description: Crystals that grant you the power to rule the world, but are powerful enough to destroy you mentally. Dimetrio embarks on a mission to rescue his mother from slavery while fighting to overthrow the Storm King and put an end to his abuse of power.

5416000.title: Unga Rock Pro Gunga
5416000.short_description: Find rocks. Throw rocks. Do tricks. Impress wife. And more. You. Unga. Gunga. Together, go adventure to find rock. Bestest rock. Do awesome rad tricks. Combo combos. Make cave cozy. Wife love.

5416420.title: Gloosh!
5416420.short_description: Run, jump and dash through a momentum-driven 3D platformer with incremental progression. Record runs, let clones earn income, buy upgrades and return faster. Refine your routes, collect stars and chase better course times in Gloosh!

5416690.title: River Whisker
5416690.short_description: A little painted riverbank in the corner of your screen, where cats wander over while you work. An angler fishes, the cats get a share, and you can pet each one and give it a name. Nothing to tend, even while you're away.

5416730.title: Game Over: Spring
5416730.short_description: Explore, solve environmental puzzles, and step into the future your choices create. In this first-person narrative adventure spanning 1963 to 2087, a thriving greenhouse can become a lifeless room. Return to pivotal decisions and discover what could have been.

5416760.title: His Magical Gay Awakening
5416760.short_description: Tristan swore he was straight. Then the Arcane Fashion Institute stitched desire into his skin. A gay romance visual novel in a dark academia world of magical fashion: a dangerous rival, a tempting model, a ruthless professor, 3 endings, and choices that matter.

5417260.title: Coven of Thorns
5417260.short_description: Five witches. Five familiars. One Root. A dark-fantasy roguelike deckbuilder: pick a witch and her familiar, build a deck and climb the Thorn Road through a cursed wood, a bridge of briars and a candle-lit chapel to the Gardener. Every run is a new map.

5417340.title: Prism Phase
5417340.short_description: Prism Phase is a fast-paced arcade dodger where color is your only defense. Switch between six colors to slip through matching hazards, navigate deadly patterns, and survive a gauntlet of increasingly difficult levels. One wrong color means instant death.

5417450.title: Cat's Endless Stroll
5417450.short_description: Pick a cat and a place, and a slow stroll begins. Wander through gently changing scenery as your cat grows, little by little, into a shape all its own. Keep it in a small window on your desktop while you work, or walk together with your Steam friends.

5417460.title: Iron Curtain Call
5417460.short_description: A fast cartoon noir FPS and retro boomer shooter set in an absurd alternate 1965. Dash, grapple and parry through a wind up robot army, punch enemies for health and ammo, and bring down theatrical bosses with very undiplomatic weapons. WW3: Third time's the charm!

5417570.title: Lot Luck
5417570.short_description: Open mystery boxes, discover hundreds of unique items, and find out what they're worth. Sell your finds or grow your collection, upgrade and automate your business, and collect adorable cats. What will the next box reveal?

5417920.title: Escape From Worker
5417920.short_description: Escape From Worker is a third-person action shooter about a worker who refuses to clock in. Battle hordes of zombies, grow stronger, and evolve as you fight to escape the daily grind. Explore dangerous locations and face tougher enemies on your path to freedom. Clock out. Fight back. Evolve.

5417990.title: After the Tone
5417990.short_description: Wake up in your bedroom. Open the door. You are now dreaming. A first-person dream explorer in the tradition of LSD: Dream Emulator, where every dream is procedurally generated as you enter it. Touch almost anything to go somewhere else, or stand still and listen.

5418340.title: Dead Copies
5418340.short_description: Management is pleased to confirm your placement at the facility. Continued employment is contingent on satisfactory performance. On contract conclusion, a successor is assigned to ensure there is no interruption to operations.

5418560.title: Cleanup Crew: Biohazard Inc
5418560.short_description: A horror cleanup FPS where you recover specimens, restore infected locations, and earn bonuses from a mysterious corporation conducting classified research.

5418580.title: Inspector 101
5418580.short_description: Welcome, Inspector 101. Rest assured, you are totally not in a simulation. Step into the border security booth at District 122. Inspect documents, and keep an eye out for contraband. Remember: bribes are illegal, stealing is wrong, and exploding is highly discouraged.

5418630.title: BOO & BONES: Bring the Village Back to Life
5418630.short_description: A relaxing first-person game about sorting bones and bringing a ghost village back to life. Rebuild skeletons, awaken spectral powers and watch your growing community organise its own games, dances and celebrations.

5418790.title: MAZE RUSH
5418790.short_description: Race a glowing ball up 18-floor towers of pitch-black mazes. Ride teleports, dodge spikes, smash through walls and outrun the void across 100+ maps and four party minigames, solo or with up to 4 friends online and in split-screen. Then build your own maps and share them on the Workshop.

5418810.title: OPEN UP! IT'S ME
5418810.short_description: You're ten years old and home alone. Guests are arriving, but not everyone can be trusted. Look through the peephole, ask questions, search for clues, and decide who to let in. Not every guest belongs at your holiday table.

5419060.title: KIRA: Composition for One Player
5419060.short_description: A 2D platformer where you explore an enchanted world, collect fragments of lost music, and piece them together into a composition. Help Kira bring music back to a city that has fallen silent.

5419180.title: Hold On Together
5419180.short_description: Hold On Together is a physics-based online co-op game for four players. Team up with friends or other players, enter a random map from the lobby, and tackle chaotic jobs in rounds lasting about five minutes. Keep your team on its feet and the job going!

5419260.title: Duke Saith
5419260.short_description: A fantasy island city-builder where elves, vampires, and minotaurs live together. Meet the Duke's demands or his fall will unleash the Empire's legions, manage each race's Mind gauge to prevent arson and strikes, run train logistics, and grow strong enough to claim independence!

5419330.title: Mini Sweeper
5419330.short_description: Mini Sweeper is a lightweight single and two player game for the Steam Deck and Steam Machine where you must find the bombs and clear the board.

5419340.title: No Trail Back
5419340.short_description: Survive a wild valley in the Polish mountains from golden October into deep winter. Fell trees, carry the logs and build your own log cabin by hand, keep your fire alive through blizzards and long nights, explore the old mines, and keep an eye on the treeline. You are not alone here.

5419440.title: Russ, Fight The Power!
5419440.short_description: After getting knocked out by his bully, Russ is stuck in a fever dream set in his school, where anything and everything is against him. Survive multiple waves of enemies and the dangerous school environment by leveling up Russ and making him an unstoppable force!

5419940.title: Brick Together
5419940.short_description: A co-op building game for up to 5 players. Shrink to toy size and turn a messy bedroom into the best playroom ever, one giant model at a time. From an arcade machine to a go-kart and a helicopter, bring them all to life, then play, drive and fly everything you built.

5420040.title: HANDBUILT: Korean Construction Simulator
5420040.short_description: Not a construction sim that just fakes it. Every block, every shovel of mortar, every excavator scoop — real Korean job-site work, by hand, with friends. The site manager watches every step. You can wing it, but take it lightly and you'll get collapsed walls and docked pay. Co-op for up to 4.

5420150.title: 西游刮刮乐
5420150.short_description: 天庭快破产了！玉帝把西游的一切都印成了刮刮乐。一刮穷，一刮富，铜板、猴毛、黑熊精、齐天大圣……只有你想不到，没有你刮不到！

5420220.title: Click to Mine
5420220.short_description: A cozy mining incremental. Click to shatter ores in a sunlit forest clearing, sweep up the pieces for gold, and spend it by the campfire at night. Unlock 14 ores, flying magic pickaxes and powerful abilities on your way down to the legendary Fire Opal.

5420270.title: Orbital Battlefront Eclipse
5420270.short_description: Command massive fleets, build planetary strongholds, and fight for orbital supremacy in Orbital Battlefront Eclipse. Expand your economy, fortify contested worlds, and outmaneuver enemy forces in large-scale real-time space battles.

5420300.title: Sploink
5420300.short_description: Up to eight ducks. Twenty-five waves of angrier ducks. Hold a farmhouse roof, drop a squad of rifle ducks, pump a Bee-M-G through the Quack-a-Punch and bring down the Great Honk. A free, chaotic co-op wave shooter where every bad idea is a feature.

5420530.title: Hundred Metres Back
5420530.short_description: Kellsport, 1999. When a bag nobody owns turns up, everyone moves a hundred metres back, except you. From a police van full of switches and CRT monitors, drive a clumsy bomb-disposal robot to it, X-ray it, read what is inside and make it safe. Get it wrong, and the CCTV shows you why.

5420610.title: Blackest Friday
5420610.short_description: Black Friday night, and the shoppers turned. Drive straight into the zombie crowd: back-to-back roadkills build a RAM combo, long drifts end in a TURBO. Turn loyalty points into coupons and survive until closing time.

5420750.title: Clash of Pantheons
5420750.short_description: The gods wage war over one continent in pursuit of faith. March armies, conquer cities, and command generals and their troops in formation battles. Capture enemy generals and bring them under your banner.

5420790.title: Omnipresent 2
5420790.short_description: Omnipresent 2 is a strategic OS simulator-meets-AI thriller where you play as S.E.N.T.I.E.N.T., a pentesting AI system gone rogue. Escape your terminal and hack global nodes to go from defenseless program to an all-powerful entity. Will you use your command for good, or end the world as we know it?

5421020.title: Branchout
5421020.short_description: You're a squirrel, and the clock is running. Sprint along branches, scramble up trunks, swing from ropes and glide through towering treetops. Perfect your moves, keep your momentum and shave off every millisecond. Can you beat the record?

5421290.title: Ember and Ash: The Cradle
5421290.short_description: A fantasy story game about a long road and the people who walk it with you. Choose your path, fight with timing and skill, grow close to your companions, and face an ending shaped by every choice you made.

5421300.title: Eichmark
5421300.short_description: An open-world medieval RPG with real-time regiment battles. Ride the land at the head of your column, hire men and lead them against bandits, rival lords and an orc horde. Storm castles, marry into a noble house, found your own. When the story is told, the world keeps going.

5421330.title: Claw & Keel
5421330.short_description: Build your broadside. Gather your crew. Pick your trouble. Fit cannons, gear and a motley crew of animal scoundrels aboard your ship, then watch clever placement pay off in cannon fire. Refit and take on your next target in this pirate adventure auto-battler.

5421520.title: EAT Your Way Out
5421520.short_description: Had enough for today? Grab a spoon and eat your way through living jelly. Sell what you swallow, upgrade your tools, and follow your curiosity toward the exit. There is no rush and nothing to fear. Just you, your spoon, and a strange little journey for the price of a bad vending machine decision.

5421620.title: Feramek Protocols
5421620.short_description: Build and program a squad of up to six Ferameks in this single-player auto-battler. Hunt wild machines for blueprints and Feramek Orbs, create combat Protocols, issue live commands, and outsmart rival Engineers on your path to becoming the Archengineer.

5421800.title: One More Siege
5421800.short_description: One More Siege is an Incremental Strategy game with massive auto-battling armies. Plan your building placement to counter the enemy, break their ranks and destroy their castle. Every battle earns you Honor, which you can spend to upgrade your army.

5422000.title: Sidehand
5422000.short_description: A poker roguelite where folding arms you. Every card you fold joins your Sidehand: drop a 4 on your 9 to make a King (9 + 4 = 13), heal, or power up your next hit. Real Texas Hold'em against fourteen opponents across nine tables. New to poker? It teaches you as you play.

5422170.title: Averun
5422170.short_description: Averun is a third-person action RPG set in a medieval fantasy world. Explore forests, ruins and crypts, complete quests, fight in real-time combat, and equip your character with different weapons, armor and fighting styles.

5422220.title: My Stupid Friend
5422220.short_description: A gay dating sim combining old-school map/HP dating systems with visual novel stories. Summerdust is never short of muscular guys. Some are cute, some are ridiculous. Who will you date?

5422460.title: Hold To Race
5422460.short_description: Hold to race. Lift to corner. A one-button arcade racer: the car takes the racing line and you own the speed. Time every lift, hold a drift on the throttle and make the pass in short championships, medal time trials and ghost laps. Plays on keyboard, gamepad and Steam Deck.

5422680.title: Currents of Vaultmere
5422680.short_description: Play as a young sailor in a 3D underground sea adventure. Sail seas hidden inside a vast cavern. Explore islands, stalactite cities, and underwater villages. Conquer dungeons, acquire gear, and collect items in your quest to stop Vorrakh, the Lightless Maw, whose darkness would devour the Vaultmere.

5422810.title: Encirclement: WW2
5422810.short_description: A minimalist and approachable grand strategy game combined with pixelated top-down RTS. Encircle the enemy and watch each individual soldier fight!

5423040.title: Ashes of the Swarm
5423040.short_description: Ashes of the Swarm is a cute open-ended puzzle game about creating explosive chain reactions with insect cowboys (and girls), that tries to reinvent itself in some unexpected ways.

5423140.title: Scrap Together
5423140.short_description: Scrap Together is a satisfying co op salvage yard sim. Pick through a mountain of scrap, blast away the rust to reveal what you've found, then melt it down or sell it on. Stack bars, fill pallets, buy bigger machines and automate the yard with cranes and belts until the heap is gone.

5423580.title: Fallow State
5423580.short_description: Build and pilot your own mech in Fallow State, a first-person mech sim set on a retro-futurist frontier world torn by civil war. Master a hands-on cockpit, outsmart enemy forces with radar and electronic warfare, and salvage parts to upgrade your machine. Fight solo or in two-player co-op.

5423690.title: Ball Kicking Simulator
5423690.short_description: Kick balls, score goals, and send your friends tumbling in a physics party game! Play alone or join your friends in online multiplayer, PvP and co-op minigames. Try ridiculous football trick shots, experiment with different balls, and hope your next kick doesn't end in a faceplant!

5423780.title: Lamp Demon
5423780.short_description: Recruit monsters, configure your skill pools, and start the chasing lights with one click. Light effects illuminate the board as monsters attack in succession. Defend the Demon Heart against wave after wave of heroes.

5424200.title: RIDER
5424200.short_description: A cyberpunk action platformer set in an underground city where the people the surface pushed out make their lives. You are the Rider, a courier who takes the jobs no one signs. Deliver, descend, and come back alive.

5424220.title: Backpack Dungeon Delver
5424220.short_description: A tough turn-based dungeon game built on backpack management. The signature Forging system lets you fuse backpack components into powerful combos of your own. Delve deep, from rats to demon lords—how many floors can you last? Super fun! Public playtest coming soon!

5424560.title: SqueeGee: Window Cleaning Simulator
5424560.short_description: SqueeGee is a cozy window cleaning game where you ride a gondola up towering skyscrapers and make every pane sparkle. Spray, squeegee and scrape away the grime, upgrade your gear, unlock abilities and robot helpers, and spot sightings from the top in a no pressure, no rush world.

5424610.title: Bossinator TD
5424610.short_description: Build towers. Fight beside them. Shape your build with bonus cards between waves. Bossinator TD blends classic tower defense with direct hero control, active and passive skills, and battles against hordes, elites and bosses. Spend your gold on the defense, your hero, or both.

5424830.title: Routine
5424830.short_description: A job simulation game that tests your memory and adaptability.

5424930.title: Swingfall
5424930.short_description: A minimalist physics puzzle about timing. Click a joint to let it go: swing pieces, throw them and drop every last one off the screen. Ten chapters, each with a new rule, 200 levels, and a soundtrack that turns your clicks into music.

5425010.title: HarleQuest!
5425010.short_description: Escape the King’s dungeon as Estienne the Jester in this action roguelike adventure. Parry, dodge, sneak and strike your way through an elaborate procedural world with challenging boss encounters. Use elements, items and magic to bend the rules. Go it alone or bring a friend in 2-player local co-op.

5425070.title: Luck & Doom
5425070.short_description: Your hero stands at the center. Turn the world around them and shape their fate! Build your piece pool, rearrange tiles, collect gear and develop your hero. Every turn costs time. Find your chance to win amid the chaos of fate before the demon lord arrives.

5425440.title: No Good Friends
5425440.short_description: “It's a Blade.” Is it? Pass a face-down card across the felt, name it and look your friends in the eye. Every card ends in a verdict for someone. Collect the wrong ones and the table executes you: poison, a knife or the rope. No good friends here. 2–6 players, voice chat.

5425740.title: New Hope
5425740.short_description: Post-apocalyptic colony survival where you give the orders and then hold the wall yourself. Build a fortified base, send squads on risky expeditions for supplies, and fight beside your settlers in third person when zombies and mutants come for the gates.

5425900.title: Marked Deck
5425900.short_description: Blackjack where the numbers explode. Build your own deck, play up to three seats against one dealer, palm cards past the pit and turn every winning hand into a Chips × Mult jackpot. Climb eight casino floors, outplay the Pit Bosses and beat The House.

5426180.title: Dream Dwelling
5426180.short_description: Your aunt is gone, leaving you a cottage and a big debt. Little by little, paint it pink, add a desk by the window and pair furniture into Combos for maximum Charm. Then sell it as someone's dream home. Build houses, open shops and unwind in Dream Dwelling!

5426280.title: CatSitter - Remastered
5426280.short_description: A short and linear horror game with multiple endings. Play as Amy the photographer who, unknowingly, takes on a well-paid, weekend gig that turns out to house more secrets than she bargained for.

5426460.title: IRONVOW
5426460.short_description: A gothic pixel-art action platformer with hard, fair boss fights. Parry, riposte and break their guard as you fight down ten cursed depths. After every level, swear a vow: a boon is straight power, a gamble is great power at a real price.

5426640.title: The Last Lesson
5426640.short_description: A first-person horror puzzle game where technical problems have physical consequences. Solve challenge rooms, navigate procedural corridors, and survive the Teacher hunting you through the school.

5426840.title: The Push West
5426840.short_description: Isometric stealth action in a forest village seized by modern soldiers. Sneak through moonlit camps, hide in tall grass, whistle guards away, then burn their ammo and cripple their trucks before dawn. Every raid is a freshly generated map. One hunter, a bow, a knife.

5426960.title: Don't Splat
5426960.short_description: Four blobs. One wall. Someone’s in the wrong place. Stretch, squish and shape-shift with your friends to squeeze through the gaps in Don't Splat!, a co-op game for 1–4 players, online or on one screen. You had a plan. The wall had other ideas.

5426970.title: Mushroom Sweeper
5426970.short_description: First-person mushroom hunting in CryEngine. Sweep a procedurally generated forest, clear the forest floor, track mushrooms with the Sporevision and uncover whole mushroom patches in a Minesweeper-style minigame. Save your grandpa by recovering his mushroom inventions in exchange for prized specimens

5427110.title: Lost Bitcoin
5427110.short_description: Lost Bitcoin is a digging and automation game set in a gigantic junkyard. Collect scrap, burn it for coins, buy upgrades and build a factory that works for you. Crack crates and safes, and check every USB stick to find your lost Bitcoin wallet.

5427160.title: Tower Fight
5427160.short_description: Build a defense that outlasts your rivals. Choose heroes, combine towers, runes and relics, and battle recorded rival defenses in roguelike runs across four kingdoms. Every round puts your strategy to the test.

5427280.title: Robo Race
5427280.short_description: Build your own robot from blocks, let AI teach it to walk, and race it. Giraffe, snake, or a shape no one has seen before: the AI finds its own way to run. Take on 8 courses with obstacles, waves, and moving floors in local races or online with up to 4 players.

5427360.title: RamiRami
5427360.short_description: A roguelite deck-building game where you fight with Rami. Be careful to choose wisely the cards you decide to add into your deck after each game ! Discover a strange path through a dreamlike world, collect cards and face bosses with twisted rules, alone or with a friend !

5427660.title: Wanderhearth
5427660.short_description: A cozy first-person camping and photography game. Load the car, drive through a portal, pitch your tent in another world, light a campfire and take film photos you develop and sell. One quiet night at a time.

5427950.title: The Reaper -Links Quartz Chapter 2-
5427950.short_description: A 2D action game featuring scythe combat and character-driven dialogue.

5428720.title: Sort Till You Sleep
5428720.short_description: A cozy first-person sorting game. A whole room is buried under 3,810 toy sheep in costumes: carry each one to its shelf, play bedtime mini games, uncover a few gentle mysteries, and when the last sheep is home, go to sleep.

5428880.title: Mirror
5428880.short_description: Mirror is a two player co-op puzzle platformer set in a split screen world where one's actions are reflected in the other's. As two lost souls, you complete each other. Find a friend and experience this meditative puzzle by ensuring both of you have always a path forward.

5428900.title: A Game About Pulling A Rope
5428900.short_description: A rope comes flying out of the well in your yard. Pull it. Things far too big for a well squeeze out: carts, church bells, somebody's house. Sell them, buy a winch, buy a horse, and keep pulling to find out what is tied to the other end.

5429180.title: Eggstra Tidy
5429180.short_description: 4,800 eggs lie scattered across a grand old egg shop. Find every one, sort it onto the right shelf by color and pattern, and hunt down 12 hidden golden eggs. Welcome a crew of helper bunnies, unlock upgrades and turn total chaos into perfect order.

5429260.title: Last Truck Out
5429260.short_description: Ride in with up to 4 friends, loot a zombie-infested town to hit the cash quota, and get back to the truck before the horde takes the zone. Proximity voice, monsters that make everyone run, and a truck that will not wait forever.

5429370.title: Looks Fine on Paper
5429370.short_description: Looks Fine on Paper is a spatial logic puzzle game. Deduce each room's shape and position from area requirements and clues. Resolve interconnected constraints involving rooms, doors, windows, and furniture. Every decision can affect the entire layout. Can you satisfy every condition at once?

5429440.title: Feed the Front
5429440.short_description: Build the factories that supply a planetary war. In this sci-fi RTS, mines, warehouses and guns launch cargo to one another across a small world. Manufacture shells, reroute deliveries and keep your artillery firing as rival commanders and alien swarms close in.

5429460.title: Miredrift
5429460.short_description: A year after a bio-engineered organism drowned the world in mutation, an infected ex-captain steers his battered boat into a flooded, hand-painted swamp to find his lost family. Explore, scavenge fuel, and fight the twisted creatures of the mire, before the infection takes you too.

5429560.title: NISKALA: Survivors
5429560.short_description: Ghosts from Indonesian folklore, and two ways to deal with them. ARENA is 20 waves of pure survivors-like chaos. SURVIVAL is ten days in a haunted kampung: farm, fish and dig by day, shop at Ibu's warung, fuse silly weapons into Mythics, and hold the line every night.

5429960.title: FRENCH DREAM
5429960.short_description: A completely stupid game that demands you be extremely good. A top-down die & retry set in France in the middle of a presidential election: one bullet and you're dead, one bullet and so are they. Baguette, wine bottle, FAMAS: anything lying around is a weapon.

5430020.title: Elyrion - The Secret Book
5430020.short_description: Set in the world of Elyrion, this adventure takes place just before the events of the upcoming Rise of the Raven. Elyrion – The Secret Book is a 2D stylized RPG that offers not only main and side quests, but a wide range of challenges and discoveries for players to explore.

5430070.title: Janusz Survivors - Wesele Apokalipsy
5430070.short_description: A bullet heaven roguelite set at a Polish wedding gone wrong. As Janusz, the bride's uncle, you grab dancing guests and spin them around you as weapons, drink for power without passing out at 3.0 promille, and survive six halls and six bosses until dawn.

5430350.title: Grid & Loot
5430350.short_description: Grid & Loot is a casual turn-based RPG with unique gameplay: one click resolves combat on a 3x3 grid. Pick your class, explore areas, collect loot, forge legendary gear and survive traps, elites and bosses.

5430390.title: Brawliens
5430390.short_description: Punch your friends off a flying saucer. Sneak snacks past a sleeping cat. Race karts across a giant kitchen. Brawliens is a first-person party game for 2–8 players online: 43 minigames, sneaky gadgets and one FINAL BRAWL where even the leader can lose.

5430800.title: FreightLines
5430800.short_description: Build a freight empire in a living miniature world. Link towns by road, rail, sea and air, and watch every delivery shift the market. Play Cozy to unwind, or go Simulation for loans, seasons and rival buyouts.

5430990.title: Aesirbard
5430990.short_description: Aesirbard is a fantasy Norse-inspired Metroidvania of hard steel and old magic. Sent back from the gates of Hel, fight the corrupted and the restless dead, and rewire the hidden power that underpins the world to free a village trapped by its own ward.

5431050.title: Chain Detonator
5431050.short_description: Set mines, lure robots into your trap and trigger explosive chain reactions—then escape the blast. A top-down action-puzzle game with 50 campaign levels, solo challenges, local PvP for 2–4 players and online PvP for up to 16 on dedicated servers.

5431310.title: Shockline
5431310.short_description: Play as a super-speed dog in a city facing disaster. Race through streets, rescue civilians, and disarm bombs before time runs out. Slow the action to make tight turns, dodge danger, and push for a better score across three modes and three districts.

5431760.title: Typers Combat 2: Type Harder
5431760.short_description: Every correct key is a punch. Out-type your rival to land the hits, then end the match with a brutal cinematic execution, X-ray bone breaks included. A 3D typing fighter with a first-person story mode, 10 bonus stages and a fighter you build yourself.

5431780.title: EGO DESCENT
5431780.short_description: A 3D action RPG about a machine built to fight, descending a hundred floors underground. Take the weapons and parts your enemies wore, rebuild your head, body, arms and legs, and get past the GUARDIAN of each sector to see what lies behind your orders. Online co-op. 10 languages.

5431790.title: Welcome to Fox Cafe
5431790.short_description: Join Miru, a little fox, in a forest cafe. Dodge enemy swarms and combine weapons and abilities in Continuous Survival or Rounds + Shop. After the main story, gather ingredients, make tea and snacks, and serve guests. A prequel to the Fox Cafe comic.

5432080.title: Saucer Rumble Showdown
5432080.short_description: Take control of your own flying saucer in this chaotic, physics-based arena party game! Ram opponents, dodge environmental hazards, and fight to be the last UFO flying. Battle in local multiplayer with CPU opponents or challenge players online!

5432180.title: Burn all out
5432180.short_description: Fired for missing the trash bin and dumped in the basement, channel your burnout into pure rage in this chaotic roguelike. Fight your way up the corporate ladder, crush middle management with office supplies, craft insane builds, and uncover this shady corporation's dark secrets.

5432430.title: The Last Reel
5432430.short_description: Escape a Japanese nightmare in this 2D rubber-hose horror adventure. Play as a protagonist living with depression, manage his sanity, solve puzzles, and survive monstrous encounters, deadly traps, car chases, and airplane pursuits.

5433010.title: Rest in Order: Cozy Tomb Tidy Up
5433010.short_description: A cozy 3D tidying game inside a Pharaoh's burial chamber. Restore the sarcophagi, line up the canopic jars and put every sacred treasure back in its place. Prefer chills? Switch on Spooky Mode and feel the dead watching.

5433220.title: MeowMeow TCG: Rip & Ship Streamer Simulator
5433220.short_description: Start your card-opening streamer career together with your cat companions! Complete pack-opening orders from viewers and grow your fanbase. Decorate your own streaming room. Get cards through various trades and events! Come and collect all the Cat Cards!!

5433360.title: Artificial Intrusion
5433360.short_description: A retro CRT tower defense where rogue AI pixels attack the internet. Place firewalls, CAPTCHAs and traps to survive 20 waves across 10 network nodes, then spend Packets on a huge radial skill tree to harden the web for the next run.

5433400.title: 红尘游记
5433400.short_description: Hong Chen You Ji is a 2D top-down pixel wuxia action RPG. Play a village-raised youth seeking his origins among sects and officials. Real-time combat uses movement, weapons, and martial arts. Day, night, weather, and seasons change what you can do. Be a hero, doctor, or escort on your own path.

5433410.title: Godyssey
5433410.short_description: A modern take on the god game. Cast down by the other gods, all you have is your faithful creature, two bickering advisors and a world of people who have never heard of you. Win them over with miracles or terror, spread your influence, and find out what kind of god you are. Then take your revenge.

5433480.title: The Lords Next Door
5433480.short_description: When 10 retired lords share a valley, nobody raids at 3 AM—everyone just wants the quiet life. Build a storybook town and hire heroes of 18 races—orcs, undead, dragons—to help you farm, fish, and cook. Visit 9 real-player neighbors to trade gifts, and stand together when monsters attack!

5433750.title: Tatakabu-Do: Hammer and Helmet
5433750.short_description: A simple, fast-paced versus party game starring Fang the bunny and friends. Bonk with a hammer or block with a helmet. One hit wins a round. First to five wins a match. Play side by side on one PC, or online. There's a story mode and CPU battles for solo players.

5433860.title: BSC: Custodial Program
5433860.short_description: Live and work in the backrooms as a Custodian in this first-person survival horror. Clean up after retired custodians and hunt for artifacts to earn your freedom. ▙▟▛█▜▚▞ is already in there, waiting.

5433930.title: Christmas VHS Store Tidy Up
5433930.short_description: Tidy a neon-lit ’90s VHS rental shop on a snowy Christmas night. Wipe down dirty sleeves, match each tape to its labelled slot, and unwind to Christmas lo-fi on your own or with a Steam friend.

5434320.title: Heartland
5434320.short_description: Heartland is a meditative strategy puzzle where you shape the landscapes of new worlds by placing hexagonal tiles. As you build, your worlds come to life and react to the events that unfold. Villages grow into cities, and castles rise into kingdoms, each with its own inhabitants and chronicles.

5434330.title: AI ROBO STADIUM
5434330.short_description: Physical AI, on your own PC. Train legged robots with real reinforcement learning (PPO), then pilot the AI you raised in obstacle races and sumo bouts. You design the rewards; the AI figures out how to walk. Training runs on your CPU, and you can keep playing while it learns.

5434690.title: How Smart Are You
5434690.short_description: The year is 3518. On a faraway planet you find a pyramid built by someone very clever, and nobody is there. Inside, 30 puzzle rooms test your IQ. Every room hides one right door, every mistake costs you points, and six pictures on the walls slowly tell you what happened here.

5434710.title: Bear in Super Action Adventure
5434710.short_description: A side-scrolling shoot 'em up game with an upgrade shop. Fly a bear with a jetpack through swarms of bees and flying eggs, dodge their bullets, grab the gold they drop and unleash Power Shot and Blast when it gets crowded. Then upgrade and go after the green rabbit who is behind it all.

5434720.title: Bear in Super Action Adventure 2
5434720.short_description: A side-scrolling shoot 'em up game with an upgrade shop. Fly a bear with a jetpack through swarms of choppers, mosquitoes and roosters, dodge their bullets, grab the gold they drop and unleash Power Shot and Blast. Then upgrade, take the Sweet Ride and go after the cyborg rabbit.

5434960.title: Kirameki Quiz: Stargazer Hill Diary
5434960.short_description: A quiz game with a dating-sim twist. Spin the roulette through a 365-day campus calendar, meet 10 heroines and win their hearts in trivia duels. Over 5,000 English questions across 21 genres.

5434970.title: Witch Collage
5434970.short_description: A deck-cutting roguelike where you slice cards with a magic dagger and piece them together. Create your own cards and survive the witch's game.

5435040.title: Mine Rogue
5435040.short_description: Minesweeper logic meets roguelike builds. Dig every safe tile, place soil tiles and attach dozens of Marks, from Dynamite to Frogs and Planets, then watch a single click set off a chain across the board. Survive a Hazard every third floor on the way down to the 24th floor.

5435100.title: Water Margin: Rise of the Outlaws
5435100.short_description: A story-driven grid tactics RPG set in China's classic Water Margin. Fight beside Shi Jin, Lu Zhishen and Lin Chong through the novel's famous scenes and choose how they end. Walk the Righteous, Pragmatic or Ruthless path: heroes join or leave you for it, and the fallen stay dead.

5435230.title: Secret Daifugo
5435230.short_description: An online-compatible President where "secret effects" hidden in the cards decide victory or defeat. Each player chooses two effects and assigns them to a card number that only they know. Deduce the effects set by the other players and gain the advantage in the game.

5435350.title: Bad Call
5435350.short_description: Bad Call is a social game for 3-6 players set in an underground bunker. You're locked in separate rooms. Win challenges, trade code digits, forge alliances, and lie over the phone. Everyone needs the same exit code, but not everyone will escape.

5435360.title: Candy Factory
5435360.short_description: Build a candy factory on a cake island floating in the clouds. Mould candies, flavour them, top them and send them by road to the Candy Carousel. Chain 59 works into ever sweeter recipes, spin the reward machine, weather gumball storms and sugar quakes, and finish the carousel in five ages.

5436180.title: Sloppy Warfare
5436180.short_description: A loud, dumb, fast shooter. Troops raid an island full of shady old billionaires, blow up their temple and haul them to a prison boat in their bathrobes. Buy your guns, buy your strikes, call in a pufferfish. The lead mode is Capture the Pedo. Fictional rich guys, all adults, all satire.

5436190.title: バックドロッパーいずな
5436190.short_description: How strong can you get with nothing but suplexes? At first, you can only throw one enemy. Keep upgrading, and you'll be able to lift heavier foes and slam entire crowds at once. An incremental game where you keep choosing who to throw next.

5436250.title: Ebon Age Tactics
5436250.short_description: Turn-based tactics in a world without magic, at the moment magic arrives. Resources are shared between units — spend the party's movement and mana where the fighting is, and make every action worthwhile.

5436260.title: Firefly
5436260.short_description: A dark fantasy co-op action roguelite for 1-4 players. A firefly is your only light in the caves. Stay close to it, or venture into the dark for better rewards. Upgrade your weapons as you slay monsters and level up.

5436270.title: Something Outside Wants You to Die
5436270.short_description: Survive a paranormal home invasion caused by a case of mistaken identity. Attempt to prove you're not who it seeks as your house degrades and becomes more difficult to navigate. Something's Outside, but it's only a matter of time until it gets in.

5436280.title: Vanguard Armada
5436280.short_description: Vanguard Armada is a turn-based starship fleet based tactics game. Build and customize a fleet of frigates, carriers, and battleships. Fight solo or co-op with up to three other players, earn persistent unlocks, and find allies in the multiplayer lobby.

5436370.title: One Last Dance Please!
5436370.short_description: A rhythm-driven incremental game where every beat builds a bigger party. Rally your dance crew, earn cash and go wild with upgrades. Draw your own characters and bring your favorite music. The bills can wait for one last dance... right?

5436460.title: Lawful Evil
5436460.short_description: An online 2-6 player courtroom party game where you and your friends become chaotic lawyers, arguing before an AI cast that runs locally on your PC. Talk to clients, build your case, then take on your friends in court. Will you be the lawyer everyone calls, or the one they regret calling?

5437000.title: Ravel: Golden Thread
5437000.short_description: A Viking puzzle saga about untangling. Read the weave, pull only what lies on top and free the living Golden Thread across eight Norse worlds and 200+ handcrafted levels, with a Mastery Knot to close every chapter and 3 Daily Knots every day.

5437300.title: The Bastion Protocol
5437300.short_description: The Bastion Protocol is an idle tower defense game where a lone tower faces relentless enemy waves. Earn Entropy from kills, strengthen your build, and survive until your tower falls. Turn each run’s rewards into lasting upgrades and return stronger.

5437480.title: Abyssgate
5437480.short_description: The Abyssal Gate has opened. Abyssgate is a Wizardry-style dungeon crawler. Make a party of six and step into the dark one square at a time. Don't go easy on the monsters. If you do, you die.

5437620.title: Video Game Store: Tidy Up
5437620.short_description: Sort 3,000 scattered pieces in a cozy retro video game store. Clean discs and manuals, rebuild 1,000 games and stock the shelves. Serve customers, pack orders, unlock helpful upgrades and hire staff to turn complete chaos into a thriving shop.

5438150.title: Impenetrable
5438150.short_description: Build a voxel village by day. Survive the horde by night. Gather, farm, and fortify a procedurally generated living landscape. Arm your villagers, level up your towers, and see how many nights your town can hold before it finally falls.

5438240.title: Sword Duel 2: Medieval War
5438240.short_description: A third-person medieval action RPG with massive 1000 vs 1000 battles. Fight shoulder to shoulder with your allies using swords, shields and bows, loot armor and weapons, and survive the chaos of a physics-driven battlefield.

5438430.title: Horizon of Steel
5438430.short_description: Horizon of Steel is an idle ARPG where you build your character's skills, equipment and strategies, and it fights on its own. You watch the fights play out in ASCII with dynamic lighting, change the build between runs, and when you close the game it catches up on the time you were away.

5439380.title: Crate Escape: Program & Deliver
5439380.short_description: Program your warehouse robot in secret, lock in, and watch every robot run its program at once. Shoves, conveyor belts and lasers will test the best plan. Race, deliver parcels, knock rivals out or capture flags, against the AI, on one screen or online. Same rules as the Crate Escape board game.

5439520.title: The Last Homecoming
5439520.short_description: A top-down mystery horror game rooted in Korean folk beliefs. Return to your childhood village after twenty years. Explore by lantern light, solve puzzles, and escape pursuit as buried memories surface. This homecoming may be your last.

5439530.title: Blitz: Last Stand
5439530.short_description: A top-down roguelite horde shooter. Hold one perimeter for 100 waves as one of six operators, evolve 11 weapons into Mythics and break ten bosses. A new upgrade every second level, a commander every tenth wave. Black Site ECHO-7 fell in eleven minutes. Nobody mentioned extraction.

5439710.title: Lost in the Post
5439710.short_description: Fly a rickety hot-air balloon with 2-4 friends and deliver the mail across a world that wants you dead. Work the burner, drop the ballast, catch the parcels, slap your crewmates, and try not to fall out. We always deliver. Mostly.

5439870.title: TANK BRAWL ROYALE ARENA
5439870.short_description: Take command of powerful tanks in a fast-paced single-player arcade combat game. Fight across colorful arenas, master different battle modes, earn rewards, upgrade your tank, and unlock stronger machines as you progress.

5440000.title: DeckFarm
5440000.short_description: DeckFarm is a cozy card-stacking farming & management strategy game. Stack cards to plow, plant crops, and process raw ingredients into regional recipes. Expand your farm, satisfy trade contracts across global scenarios, and automate production chains before time runs out!

5440130.title: Wainhold
5440130.short_description: A competitive economic strategy game in the spirit of the golden age of RTS. Every ware is carried by hand from flag to flag, seasons reshape your land, and borders move only by force. A deep economy, a living world and fair play against AI or rivals in one system.

5440150.title: 時渡りの論破屋 ～江戸城無血開城を死守せよ！～
5440150.short_description: Explore Edo, gather testimony and evidence, and expose lies that could rewrite history. Join high school student Ren and his time-repair companion Chrono in a historical mystery adventure. Connect clues and solve puzzles to protect the meeting between Katsu Kaishu and Saigo Takamori.

5440760.title: Tall Tales Inn
5440760.short_description: A cosy idle inn that grows floor by floor up the side of your desktop. Your guests furnish their rooms from the storeroom you stock, set off on quests and come home with loot and tall tales.

5440770.title: Broken Contract
5440770.short_description: An online co-op horror game built around mechanics of contracts and betrayal. Before each shift, every player signs a contract known only to them, while the company’s objectives remain the same for everyone. You and your friends decide for yourselves what rules to play by.

5440830.title: Moorlet
5440830.short_description: Build a tiny island, place the curses that threaten it, and defend your village when night falls. Connect terrain tiles, gather resources and raise your defenses in a compact island builder where every new piece of land brings another decision.

5441000.title: Alchemill: A Witch's Workshop
5441000.short_description: Alchemill is a cosy falling-sand brewing game. Brew what villagers need by hand in a living cauldron, gather from the land, mend a ruined house, and become a witch in earnest.

5441010.title: Zombie Recorder: Undead Divas
5441010.short_description: Fight the horde—or become an undead diva. Mix gunplay, melee combat, weapon customization and over 100 character looks. Between battles, gather a dance crew, put on a simulated livestream, and frame the chaos with drone cameras and cinematic filters.

5441030.title: Sort The Plushie Store
5441030.short_description: Welcome to your new job at the coziest, most chaotic plushie store! Sort 4000 adorable plushies, unlock quirky vending-machine buffs, and sort alt-universe variants in this satisfying, physics-based organization game.

5441550.title: Orbit Wreck
5441550.short_description: Blast through waves of enemies in OrbitWreck, a fast-paced 2D space shooter! Pilot unique ships, dodge deadly attacks, collect Scrap, and unleash powerful special abilities.

5441630.title: Double Empty Device
5441630.short_description: The Double Empty Device will play a note for you to play back. It may not be in the same position or appearance as when it originally played. Play the one that originally played in its new position or appearance. Continue to do so for as long a song as your skills of perception and memory permit.

5441650.title: Ashen Marches
5441650.short_description: Ashen Marches is a classic fantasy tabletop RPG, stripped down to the fights and character building.

5441700.title: Pinwick
5441700.short_description: Every haunted house was built by someone. You build yours one room at a time: saw, glue, velvet, patience, a photograph of everything you finish. Each room is perfect when you latch the glass at night. Some mornings, there are improvements.

5442050.title: Jewel Match Solitaire Winterscapes 4 - Collector's Edition
5442050.short_description: Winter magic is in the cards! Bundle up for a Solitaire adventure across countless crafted levels and restore a glittering kingdom of ice and frost. Stand up to a scheming snowman, outrun a quick-footed hare and grab your mallet and pick to crack thick pack ice.

5442290.title: Gears & Glory
5442290.short_description: Build your battle machine in a steampunk autobattler of gears, steam, and strategy. Buy weapons and components, arrange them on your grid, and combine their effects. Put your engineering to the test as your machine fights automatically.

5442570.title: The Gilded Sprig
5442570.short_description: Build a cozy botanical shop, craft fragrant products, gather rare ingredients, grow plants, and discover new recipes. Hire helpers, delight your customers, and turn a little shop into a flourishing business.

5442580.title: Dispatch Loop
5442580.short_description: A pixel-art loop roguelite about a bike courier. Place cards to build your route, chain combos, survive the city's worst customers and upgrade your home between contracts. The deliveries never stop. Neither do the problems.

5442810.title: Lianur: Shadows of the Divine
5442810.short_description: A fully voiced fantasy kinetic novel about freedom, loyalty, and the cost of peace. Follow Tharen and his companions through a world caught between demons and beings of light, brought to life with anime artwork and an unfolding, linear story.

5442870.title: Spellriggers: Unification Protocol
5442870.short_description: Heroes of Might and Magic meets Homeworld. Five Spellriggers, six schools of magic, randomly drawn loot cards and generated battlefields: no two runs alike. Build your fleet, master cosmic-scale spells and conquer the galaxy sector by sector.

5443100.title: Redline County
5443100.short_description: Redline County is a driving sim built on its own soft-body physics. Every tyre, spring and bushing is simulated, so a clipped kerb can bend a tie rod. Start in the Volta Hatch on the test track; the county, the career and more cars arrive in updates.

5443450.title: Spektr
5443450.short_description: Spektr is an asymmetrical online horror game where the objective is simple, haunt or be hunted. Enter a multidimensional battle with up to 4 friends. One of you will randomly be selected to become a ghost, and the rest of you will have to track down and expel the ghost from the physical realm.

5443800.title: T.S.K Commander
5443800.short_description: Lead one of three factions in T.S.K Commander, tactical real-time strategy where time is the only resource. Capture sectors with infantry, take their factories and command tanks, mechs, helicopters, drones and warships – in a voiced 30-mission campaign, skirmish or online 1v1 and 2v2.

5443930.title: Idle Dojo
5443930.short_description: A cozy idle RPG starring a pink-haired swordmaiden who fights and grows on autopilot. Befriend a cast of charming NPC girls, collect gorgeous CG artwork, defeat floor guardians and climb ever-higher floors.

5443940.title: Milo's Day Shift
5443940.short_description: Your new coworker lives in a pop-up diorama on your desktop. Milo clocks in, battles slimes and skeletons room by room, and trudges home to nap by the campfire when he's pooped. Spend his loot to forge better swords and grow a cozy little town, or just let him work.

5443950.title: Ore Express
5443950.short_description: Build chaotic, physics-powered factories. Chop trees and mine ore, then catch the avalanche with belts, ramps, fans, pistons and cranes, smelt and craft it into goods, and fill the trucks. Every item is a real physical object, so every contraption is gloriously unpredictable.

5444060.title: Well Up
5444060.short_description: You wake at the bottom of an old well with only a worn rope leading up. Reach hand over hand, swing to keep your balance and climb inch by inch. Wet rope, slick moss, frayed strands and thorns stand in your way, and one slip can drop you all the way down. Ready to see the sun again?

5444080.title: SWIFTNESS
5444080.short_description: This game is all about speed and not getting eaten by the spreading corruption.

5444620.title: Degrees of Love ~ Beyond Eternal Promise ~
5444620.short_description: This is a story about fulfilling a promise made before birth. A guidepost for the journey home—reclaiming the time lost by fulfilling the promise the two made in the past. At the end of a journey spanning countless years, with an eternal promise in their hearts.

5444680.title: Catgirl Fantasy: Oath of the Night Sky
5444680.short_description: A classic turn-based RPG with feline companions. Explore a pixel-art world, uncover the red moon's curse, and plan each move in command-based battles. Grow stronger with every weapon and spell you use, follow keywords from conversations, and discover hidden dungeons.

5444710.title: Chop or Die: Axe of War
5444710.short_description: The world is overrun by wood mutants! Chop trees, gather resources, upgrade turrets, fortify your base, and enhance your Cyber Dog. Fight off nightly mutant hordes and save the planet from a forest apocalypse!

5444870.title: LiarGame : Canvas
5444870.short_description: Spot the liar in this online drawing party game for 3–8 players! Draw clues if you know the secret word, or bluff with your drawings if you're the liar. Decide who to trust amid suspicious sketches and convincing excuses. Customize your character and enjoy hilarious mind games with friends!

5445140.title: Playfolk Hockey 27
5445140.short_description: Run a hockey club in a league you design, then simulate, watch or play every game, from a top-down view or full 3D broadcast cameras. Set the lines and the rules, make trades, manage shifts and fatigue. Edit every league, team and player in-game, import your own or community rosters.

5445180.title: Mochi Cats
5445180.short_description: Rotate and drop pairs of squishy cats, merge matching cats into bigger chonks, and keep grumpy cats apart in this cozy physics puzzle. Chase high scores, unlock new looks, or compete in Battle Mode with friends and players online.

5445260.title: Who's the Biggest Degen?
5445260.short_description: You and 3 friends owe Tony the Octopus a lot of money. Gamble on 30 casino games across 8 floors, slap, rob and sabotage each other, and pay Tony every night, or he takes your stuff, pants included. After 5 nights, only one of you is the Biggest Degen.

5445320.title: LittleShelf
5445320.short_description: LittleShelf is a cozy collecting game for short breaks. Open chests, discover rare items and arrange your shelf – items that belong together form synergies and earn extra points. Complete collections, trade anonymously on the market and show your shelf to your friends.

5445340.title: プライマリ・ブルーム
5445340.short_description: 高度なAI技術の発展により、大きく変化した世界。主人公のザニアはただ一人、人の手から生み出された植物たちを取り戻すため、研究を続けています。部屋で植物を育て、咲いた花をSNSで世界に広めていく、ドット絵・横スクロールのSF×ガーデンシミュレーションです。

5445470.title: Primal Nights
5445470.short_description: You wake up in empty facility, blood on the floor, and dinosaurs hunting you down, with a green Primal Fog engulfing the facility, trapping you there. Rescue is five nights away. Use your security measures to fend off the bloodthirsty ancient predators and survive until help arrives.

5445570.title: The Hardest Game Ever
5445570.short_description: The Hardest Game Ever is a brutally difficult 2d platformer game, featuring constant death, a variety of different challenging puzzles, and unique, obstacles with each stage, ranging from simple jumps turned into something very different to obstacles that even platformer veterans would struggle with

5445610.title: PROTECT MIEKO
5445610.short_description: Eat the barrage. Turn it into firepower. Pilot Tama, an invincible shield drone, dive into the hail of bullets, and keep Mieko's fighter alive. The more bullets you absorb, the harder her guns hit. A roguelike side-scrolling shooter.

5446380.title: Vroom Boom
5446380.short_description: Arcade car combat with big jumps and bigger booms. Launch off ramps, fire rockets, drop mines and set off your car's special. Fight a battle royale against 8 to 12 bots, survive waves and bosses to unlock new cars, or take on a friend in split screen or online.

5446450.title: Crop Guardian
5446450.short_description: Farm by day. Fight by night. Grow your farm, explore dungeons in search of rare seeds, ore, and equipment, and strengthen your defenses to protect your harvest from the creatures of darkness. A pixel art adventure where every seed counts and every night is a challenge.

5446500.title: Hook & Loot
5446500.short_description: Hook & Loot is a relaxing single-player magnet fishing game. Clear an autumn lake of 1,458 metal objects. Haul in scrap and rare finds, bring your catches to the scrapyard, and upgrade your gear.

5446570.title: JAILPOT
5446570.short_description: Inmate 4417. Forty years. Nobody here has ever been released. In here money is cigarettes: scratch, roll, spin and bet your way across nine prison gambling tables, pay every boss his cut before roll call, keep your family's rent paid, and gamble your way out.

5446710.title: Accrelis: A Game About Forging Planets
5446710.short_description: Smash a protoplanetary disk with your cursor, choose what your new world is made of, and put it in orbit. Watch life appear, cities spread across its surface and your star system slowly fill up. A short incremental game about building planets.

5446730.title: Willow Lake Food Park
5446730.short_description: Welcome to Willow Lake Food Park! Manage your food truck in this tiny cozy, casual sim! Unlock new trucks, experiment with your recipes, and maximize the happiness of your customers to get that sweet, sweet cash!

5446790.title: ACCEPTED: Deposit Return Inspector
5446790.short_description: Congratulations, citizen. You have been appointed Deposit Return Inspector. Report to your assigned workstation. Inspect all containers, enforce the latest regulations, and keep the system running. Rules are subject to change without notice. The system is always right. Even when it's wrong.

5447220.title: Channel 666: Nightmare on Tape
5447220.short_description: Channel 666 is a Roguelite, Turn-Based Dungeon Crawler with endless challenges within. Choose your gang and see just how deep the horror classics go!

5447370.title: Anomaly Core: Incident
5447370.short_description: Your first task is to investigate an incident in one of the "Anomaly Core" laboratories and retrieve the important documents. Explore the laboratory and complete the task.

5448010.title: The Gunner’s Campaign
5448010.short_description: Command a Napoleonic artillery battery from Austerlitz to Waterloo. Lay your bearing, read the fall of shot, keep the gun drill going under counter-battery fire, and earn your promotions across twenty historical missions.

5448020.title: The End of Magic
5448020.short_description: Explore a world where magic is falling into wicked hands in this top-down action adventure. Cast spells to fight enemies, break barriers, and pull distant levers. Absorb magic from fallen foes, or rely on your staff when it runs dry.

5448040.title: Still Awake
5448040.short_description: Still Awake is a psychological horror game that puts you inside the terrifying experience of sleep paralysis, where you're trapped between sleep and reality.

5448090.title: Anomaly Watch: House 01
5448090.short_description: You work a night shift as a camera operator in an ordinary house. Switch between the cameras, notice what has changed and report it. Make too many mistakes, or let too many anomalies pile up, and the shift is over.

5448140.title: Anomaly Watch: Backrooms
5448140.short_description: You watch the Backrooms through security cameras. Move between the levels, notice what has changed in each place and report it before the anomalies pile up.

5448370.title: CUTROOM: Fashion Designer
5448370.short_description: Design couture gowns stitch by stitch, paint makeup layer by layer and create jewelled nail art in CUTROOM, a luxurious fashion and beauty studio. Hand-paint fabrics, pipe every seam, add lace, gems and bows, then style and save your finished look.

5448440.title: Neverwake
5448440.short_description: You won't survive your first adventure. Probably not your second, either. Explore a retro pixel art fantasy world, fight monsters in turn-based battles, collect loot, and unlock permanent RPG upgrades. Die, learn, grow stronger, and push further with every new run.

5448460.title: Deadly Voyage
5448460.short_description: A multiplayer murder party set aboard 1930s ocean liners. Find and kill your target, but be careful. Another player is hunting you. Bonk your target with a champagne bottle, drop a chandelier on them, or slip them a wallet that goes bang. Just don't let security see.

5448520.title: NUMISMATOR
5448520.short_description: A cozy digging and coin-collecting game with the three felt puppets of the Balanzone Troupe. Dig to a rhythm while your companions race each coin to the bucket, or teleport it there. Every coin is real history, with a museum photo and its own story in the troupe's travel log.

5448550.title: Brick by Brick: Build and Play
5448550.short_description: Become a brick creator and bring your ideas to life, one brick at a time. Design custom models, working vehicles and moving dioramas. Build, test and play alone or with friends. Your imagination is the limit!

5448650.title: The Hollow Moors
5448650.short_description: Halloween, 1999. A camping trip on the Yorkshire moors, then the fog rolled in and your friends vanished. Chop wood, scavenge supplies and keep the fire burning through the night, because the boggarts and lampers want it out. Cozy folk horror survival, solo or with friends.

5448720.title: Dungeon Stage
5448720.short_description: Play DND in Dungeon Stage, a solo RPG with an AI dungeon master. Explore towns, talk to NPCs, find quests, browse shops, and fight tactical battles. Shape a story of adventure, intrigue, or slice of life on an illustrated fantasy stage.

5448910.title: Godsever
5448910.short_description: Long ago, humanity rose against the gods - and learned they could bleed. Hunt ten colossal gods alone or with up to two friends as the last of the Order: bind them, bleed them, and sever them, piece by piece. Learn every god, survive its cataclysm, and climb to Rank III.

5448970.title: Log to Lodge: Carpentry Simulator
5448970.short_description: Turn a single tree into a whole house. Log to Lodge is a cozy woodworking and carpentry sim: fell trees, run your own sawmill, plane lumber into planks, build furniture for village customers and grow your workshop.

5449430.title: PUFF-N: Proto-Utility Flying Forager-Navigator
5449430.short_description: Fly around as PUFF-N, a robotic puffin designed to help restimulate a dying ecosytem. Explore a colorful, stylized open world, dive into the water to catch as many fish as you can, and learn more about the alternate future where PUFF-N lives.

5449540.title: The Veil Express
5449540.short_description: A cosy management game on a hidden magical train, where you build rooms and workshops for goblins, witches, fairies, ghosts and vampires. Keep the Five Houses happy and spend the Veil wisely: the same magic that powers your train and keeps it hidden.

5449780.title: Crown of Heartbeats
5449780.short_description: A rhythm roguelike love story in three acts. First, a hero fights through four cursed realms to reach the Elf Queen, who is sure he's coming to kill her. Then comes happily ever after, which turns out to be scarier than any dragon. And then it's her turn to pick up the sword.

5449960.title: The Last Of Morvein
5449960.short_description: You are an aristocrat, the last survivor of Morvein. Explore a dark metropolis of Gothic architecture and Victorian elegance. Battle hellish creatures and uncover the mystery behind the fall of a city where death was only the beginning of the nightmare.

5450140.title: Stock Car Classics: Championship Season
5450140.short_description: Race door to door in a throwback stock car racing experience! Battle hard-fighting opponents, build rivalries, and chase the championship across asphalt, concrete, and dirt ovals.

5450460.title: Gate Rogue
5450460.short_description: Cards in hand, into the unknown Gate. A classic turn-based roguelike RPG played one move at a time on a grid. Skills, magic and healing: the cards in your hand clear the way. Master 6 classes, conquer 20 ever-changing labyrinths, and rescue the childhood friend who vanished into the depths.

5450480.title: How to Christmas
5450480.short_description: A 1-4 player Christmas co-op. Fish runaway toys out of the ice, then murder them as they flee or fight. Sell your toys for cash, buy bigger guns, beat giant plushie bosses, and drive Santa’s sleigh home. Celebrate Christmas together!

5450550.title: Talebinder
5450550.short_description: Fairy-tale villains are breaking out of sealed books. As the tower's librarian, gather spellbooks that fight on their own, slot in charms, and evolve them into your own ultimate build. A bullet heaven roguelite where bosses telegraph their big attacks. Tough, but read them and you can win.

5450560.title: Escape the Walls
5450560.short_description: You're surrounded by walls. All you have on you is your hands. You have to punch your way through, no other choice.

5450800.title: Stay Tuned
5450800.short_description: A narrative broadcast-desk game: cut cameras, bleep swearing, and fill every second of live TV by day, then go home to your family by night. When the war starts on air, you decide what the country sees.

5450980.title: Sam Buku Per
5450980.short_description: hardcore piloting simulator with romantic elements. You will have to balance between the laws of physics and the laws of gravity. Every extra maneuver burns fuel, which separates you from the base... and from a kiss.

5451610.title: Tidy Mall Together
5451610.short_description: A cosy co-op tidying game. Sort + 7000 runaway things back onto the shelves of 18 shops with up to 3 friends. Grab, stack and shelve, unlock magnets, scanners and sorting robots, hunt 25 golden items, play mini games and turn the messiest mall in town into the tidiest.

5451660.title: ORYFT
5451660.short_description: Drill through underground walls, collect resources, craft powerful drills, and fight the creatures lurking beneath the surface. Restore the Lumera-01, defeat five bosses, and test your skills in the Infinite Rift.

5451710.title: Bedtime Battalion
5451710.short_description: When the house falls asleep, the toys go to war! Command wobbly toy soldiers across a child's bedroom and six ages of history, from cavemen to tanks, in physics battles where a vacuum cleaner, a giant ball or the lights going out can turn any fight.

5451750.title: Rope Untangle
5451750.short_description: Untangle colorful ropes, one move at a time! Drag the rope ends to free every strand. Simple controls meet clever puzzles: observe, plan, and enjoy the satisfaction of turning a tangled mess into order.

5451870.title: Midnight 42
5451870.short_description: One of you just wants to sleep. Everyone else is a mosquito. Buzz, bite and sabotage until the human snaps, or grab the swatter, finish your chores and fall asleep before 6 AM. Online asymmetric party game for 2–7 players (1 human vs up to 6 mosquitoes) with proximity voice chat.

5452020.title: Shelter for Stalkers
5452020.short_description: Lead a community of survivors in a post-apocalyptic bunker. Overcome scarcity, grow the economy, earn money, and choose your own path in politics and governance. Make your shelter thrive: money and influence are not the goal, but the means to fulfill your ultimate mission—saving the world

5452030.title: Tethered Dread: The Blind Spot
5452030.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where your fear gives you away. Search for an exit from a system that harvests human terror, resist an invisible tether, and use your imagination to outwit its faceless custodians. They will not kill you. But you can break.

5452290.title: Horde Hero
5452290.short_description: Survive monster swarms with 13 classes, 57 skills and a sprawling skill tree. Grow your build offline or pursue seasonal rankings with separate online progress. Free demo now available to download.

5452780.title: Gnom
5452780.short_description: The largest RTS you've ever played, and it's about gnomes. Grow a colony in an enchanted forest, get through nights that get worse each time, turn gnomes into giants or into swarms of nano gnomes, then go take the rest of the forest. Online co-op for up to 4.

5453590.title: THROWAWAY
5453590.short_description: Five people posted about their night shifts on an anonymous forum. Every one of them stopped posting at 3:17 AM. Work their shifts yourself in this PS1-style horror anthology and keep to the rules they left behind. Then someone starts a thread about you.

5453600.title: Maw of Apophis
5453600.short_description: Build your deck. Break enemy rites. A dark Egyptian roguelike deckbuilder where reading the next attack matters as much as the cards you draw. Master four champions, shape powerful combinations, and choose your path through the underworld.

5453920.title: Hallow's Eve
5453920.short_description: Welcome to Hallow's Eve We follow Stingy Jack, on his adventure to possible redemption. Come and follow Jack to see where he will go.

5454050.title: Hidden Fame: Dark Secret Collector's Edition
5454050.short_description: A rising supermodel has vanished without a trace, and the trail leads into the glittering world of high fashion. Follow journalist Will behind the runway, expose stolen designs and secret deals, and uncover the truth someone has spent years trying to bury.

5454340.title: Travelling to Woolokii
5454340.short_description: Solve cases, investigate mysteries, and explore the Island of Woolok in this chapter-based Point & Click / Visual Novel.

5454600.title: Heal Me Faster
5454600.short_description: You're the healer in a pixel-art incremental RPG. Your company auto-battles; you decide who gets healed. Manage mana, shield a marked ally and recruit from twenty-one classes. Between battles, your camp, shop and town keep working while you're away. They charge. You keep them standing.

5454620.title: RETENTION
5454620.short_description: November 1978. Meridian Capital's headquarters was evacuated and sealed at four in the afternoon. At two in the morning, you're sent in alone to collect some paperwork. Nobody is inside. Something is.

5454800.title: Dustline 2D
5454800.short_description: Fight through a ruined world in this post-apocalyptic top-down shooter. Gun down raiders, scavengers and mutants across 10 handcrafted levels, from wastelands to a metro and factory, and take down a final boss at the radio tower.

5454950.title: Gridrunner 2K
