5454950.short_description: From the eccentric mind of Jeff Minter, onto the greasy lap of a lazy developer on a mission, the classic Commodore 64 game Gridrunner, now rebuilt for the modern era! More features to be announced soon!

5455300.title: Pick The Suspect
5455300.short_description: A cozy puzzle game about finding one person in a crowd. Read the note, check the clues and wave at the right person. Pick the wrong one and they just wave back. 100 levels across 10 places, from a quiet town square to a busy night carnival.

5455430.title: Let It Snow
5455430.short_description: Grab a shovel and dig into real, deformable snow. Clear your yard scoop by scoop, sell every load to the Snow-O-Matic, upgrade your tools and uncover what winter has buried. A cozy, satisfying snow-clearing sim.

5455690.title: Dungeon Wizard
5455690.short_description: Hover, pop, upgrade, repeat! Pop!Corn is a pixel-art incremental game about turning a handful of kernels into a popcorn frenzy. Unlock five flavors, grow a branching skill tree, and build better cooking gear until every batch bursts with rewards.

5455710.title: Plants Need Some Space
5455710.short_description: The world's sweetest grocery starts with a little cozy chaos. A mafia boss tomato, a comrade potato, a disco lettuce, and dozens more oddballs who can't stand each other. Good luck! Plant everyone in the right spot to sort out the chaos, sell the harvest, and design your own shop.

5456200.title: Oasis Realms
5456200.short_description: Explore, gather resources, and build in Oasis Realms, a colorful 3D sandbox. Shape the world block by block, create your own structures, and play solo or join online multiplayer to build and explore with others.

5456370.title: Street Girls: Love Records
5456370.short_description: Work odd jobs, pay the rent, and fall in love in a small Chinese city. This 2D romance visual novel mixes light life-sim elements with three heroines and nine endings. Balance money, time, and energy as casual texts and budget dates grow into relationships that are harder to leave behind.

5456450.title: Velikopolsky Chess
5456450.short_description: Classic chess game is re-envisioned with Ukrainian folklore and style. Chess pieces that talk with an attitude. Many chess board styles, chess pieces sets, online, LAN play, hotseat, challenge the computer, and learn. Good for all ages, all difficulty levels, and music to relax. Build the community.

5456460.title: GAEKGWI
5456460.short_description: A first-person horror game rooted in Korean folklore. Navigate a village whose paths change with each visit. Learn how its ghosts hunt, conserve your lantern oil, and use charms and ritual tools to escape danger—or fight back.

5456630.title: Wharflet
5456630.short_description: Build a tiny fishing fleet on your desktop. Ride the waves, catch fish, sell and upgrade - all while you do other things. Just sit back and relax!

5456800.title: Shimagurashi: Island Life
5456800.short_description: Move to a quiet island in southern Japan and take life at your own pace. Drive your little kei truck along the coast, go fishing, carry lumber to build a home, and shop at the corner store. A slow-life game about bringing the lights back to a fading island, one house at a time.

5456810.title: Little Extinctions
5456810.short_description: Three subspecies descended from one gray ancestor meet again in a drought. Every creature carries a gene of three loci that sets its body and its behavior, and it eats, hunts, breeds, and forms packs on its own. As an alien biologist, you observe which lineages survive.

5457000.title: ワタシがVtuberデス
5457000.short_description: Genre: VTuber × Comedy × Despair × Exploration Adventure

5457090.title: MODERN CAPITAL
5457090.short_description: Buy from suppliers or make it yourself? MODERN CAPITAL is a business simulation of production, retail, and investment. Run factories and stores, compete on price, quality, and brand, and expand through stocks, real estate, and company acquisitions.

5457150.title: Hopwood
5457150.short_description: A cozy 2D metroidvania about memory. Explore five connected regions, gain a new ability in every act, use the Whisper to hear what creatures think, win back the Old Cherry's five blossoms from bosses who forgot who they are, and uncover the valley's lost story.

5457650.title: SHAFT HAPPENS
5457650.short_description: Your shift goes down. Your quota goes up. Scavenge haunted workplaces, throw loot into the elevator and escape before the doors close. Co-op horror for 1–4 players, with upgrades, suspicious colleagues and a company that values its equipment more than you.

5458050.title: Ahwa: Heart of the Azure Dragon
5458050.short_description: An otome visual novel set among four guardian clans. After losing her mother, Ahwa inherits leadership of the Azure Dragon clan, and with it an old law: a leader must stand alone. Will she carry every burden herself, or share it? Your choices shape six bonds and the fate of the four clans.

5458310.title: Copper Champions
5458310.short_description: A fantasy RPG auto battler! Choose your Champion’s skills and forge powerful gear, then put your build to the test in the arena.

5458520.title: The House Doesn't End
5458520.short_description: A first-person puzzle game inside a house that refuses to make sense. Step through impossible doorways, walk on walls, and work alongside a replay of your own movements. Carry objects between rooms, connect the clues, and find your way out.

5458530.title: Flightless
5458530.short_description: Emerge from an egg as a baby penguin, learning to waddle, slide, and live life as a penguin should in a dreamy post-apocalyptic Antarctica. Find your way in a wordless story of meetings and separations.

5458740.title: DataCenter Tycoon
5458740.short_description: Build your own Data Center, from a single rack in a garage to a hall full of the latest Hardware. Wire power, cooling and network by hand, keep the machines running, vibe code Products and launch your own AI platform to finance the whole thing. Solo or in online co-op with up to three friends.

5458760.title: Meltdown Acres
5458760.short_description: Buy cheap land inside the Zone, grow vegetables that change whoever eats them, and sell them to customers who should know better. A dark comedy farming game about a hopeful young farmer, a four-eyed goat, and a harvest nobody can explain.

5459100.title: Scrapjump
5459100.short_description: A co-op horde shooter for 1 to 4 robots. Your mouse aims, each button fires one arm. Level up together, bolt new guns onto your arms, take down five Wardens and keep jumping to the next planet until the whole crew is scrap.

5459660.title: Stock Den
5459660.short_description: Taipei, 1994. A stock den hides behind a corner store. Stocks × multiplayer × sabotage: phone in orders and race everyone to the same stock, up to 9 with friends or solo vs. AI. Jealous of their gains? Cut their line, spread fake news, bribe a pundit, drag them down!

5459770.title: Vestige Idle
5459770.short_description: Kill monsters, get loot & level up in Vestige Idle - a fantasy ARPG in Idle form. Build your character by obtaining powerful and unique items, by leveling up and spending Skill Points across multiple trees and by unlocking major systems like The Forge, The Guild, The Market and more.

5459930.title: DAYSOWN
5459930.short_description: Learn a trade, earn your first wages, and save for a place of your own. DAYSOWN is a single-player life sim of hands-on jobs, village crafts, growing food, and making a living one day at a time.

5459980.title: Hit the Fly
5459980.short_description: Let your instincts run wild! Take revenge on these pesky little bugs for everything! But remember they come in different colors and behave in different ways. To catch them off guard, don’t forget to use your "Super Hits".

5460310.title: Bounty Hunters
5460310.short_description: Bounty Hunters is a competitive stealth game for four players. Blend into the crowd, identify your target, and strike while avoiding your own pursuer. Use disguises, poison, and detection abilities to outsmart your opponents in eight-minute matches online or over LAN.

5460600.title: Splicers
5460600.short_description: Splicers is a party shooter with silly game modes, tough challenges, and a huge roster of characters and weapons. Bring your friends, add some bots, change the rules, and build your own maps and missions to share with the world.

5460630.title: Crash Protocol: The Wrong Directive
5460630.short_description: Turn robot pursuit into a collision trap. Outsmart malfunctioning machines in turn-based grid strategy with tactical bonuses and Safe Teleport. Take on 50 campaign levels, endless Survival, ASCII Classic, and a Weekly Challenge with replay-verified online rankings.

5460650.title: Bad Things Might Happen
5460650.short_description: Play as an AI Researcher whose wife left him because of his AI Psychosis, build an indoor data center and build the most complex AI model that has ever existed. Social Commentary meets classic incremental mechanics. Begin progressing by hand, and then automate your way through AI development.

5461460.title: BazaarBorn
5461460.short_description: Start with a handcart and work your way to an antique shop in BazaarBorn, a second-hand trading sim. Buy and sell, get to know customers, and back up your offers when bargaining. Take orders, trade online, bid in Storage Battles, join item auctions, invest in property, and face unexpected events.

5461490.title: Grey Staithe
5461490.short_description: Grey Staithe is a retro point-and-click puzzle game with cult-themed flair. Explore the environments, use the items you find, uncover the secrets buried here, and complete the commissioned task.

5461550.title: Containment Shift Company
5461550.short_description: Run a supernatural factory alone or with up to 9 friends. Care for unpredictable creatures, turn their materials into goods, and meet rising company quotas. Haul cargo, monitor the facility, and survive blackouts and containment breaches together.

5461790.title: Paradise Court
5461790.short_description: You and up to three friends just took over the worst apartment building in town. Fix the pipes, mop the floors, deal with angry tenants and evict the ones who won’t pay, all while trying to keep the place in one piece. A chaotic co-op building-management sim for 1-4 players.

5461880.title: Voltform
5461880.short_description: Become more than a line of text in Voltform, a two-player online co-op puzzle adventure. Share clues, restore power, and rebuild your digital bodies from 2D to 3D. Solve puzzles together and uncover the secrets of a silent city.

5461930.title: Just One More Catch
5461930.short_description: Catch creatures, build your team, and decide how far to push your luck. Explore a 99-floor realm in this single-player roguelike, master turn-based battles, and return safely with new companions—or lose the rewards you have yet to secure.

5461950.title: The Last Lantern - idle
5461950.short_description: A gentle idle game at the edge of your desktop. Follow a little lantern keeper, rescue lost spirits, and build safe places for them to rest. Cyan light brightens a world of charcoal and mist, while a Pomodoro timer and music accompany your work, study, or quiet moments.

5462080.title: Who is the Thief?
5462080.short_description: Runners hide in a crowd of identical NPCs. Hunters spot the one who moves like a human. An asymmetric online party game for 2–10 players: finish your tasks without getting caught, or hunt down the runners hiding in the crowd.

5462530.title: Nebulon Colony
5462530.short_description: Nebulon Colony is a 3D colony sim. You take command of the first crew of astronauts, tasked with building the first colony on a distant planet. Dig, craft, build, trade, automate, level up, grow plants, herd animals, drive rovers and more.

5462680.title: Ninja Remix Resynced
5462680.short_description: Create your own ninja, use handsigns and perform jutsus, unlock skills across skill trees, and master techniques at different ranges. Team up in co-op or challenge other players in PvP.

5462960.title: Finistry
5462960.short_description: Build a living aquarium in a world changed by a mysterious pandemic. Breed fish, discover species, manage water quality, fulfil research orders, and respond to unexpected events in this relaxing aquarium management game.

5463350.title: Hellobnb Simulator
5463350.short_description: Turn a run-down house on a beautiful Greek island into a thriving vacation rental empire! Renovate, decorate, welcome guests, buy properties, and expand your businesses. Explore island life and build your dream solo or with friends in 4-player online co-op!

5463430.title: Blood & Ledger
5463430.short_description: Port Aldrich, 1920. You start as a young nobody and follow your family for eighty years. Rackets, businesses, elections or a police badge: in this city everyone plays by the same rules as you, and nobody forgets.

5463610.title: The Way Home 퇴근길
5463610.short_description: Endless rain falls over Seoul, and strange anomalies appear on familiar streets. Observe your surroundings, report anything unusual, and continue your journey when everything seems normal. Can you make it home safely after seven days?

5463690.title: THE MAZE WITHIN ME
5463690.short_description: An atmospheric psychological horror in which you explore dark, maze-like environments, evade lurking threats, and uncover fragments of a troubled past. Face the memories that shaped you and decide what your fate truly means.

5463740.title: The Dig Show
5463740.short_description: The Dig Show is a cozy digging game about finding treasures on a fake TV stage. Use a metal detector, wash the dirt off your finds and show them on air. Viewers pay to watch. Upgrade your gear and dig a little deeper every day.

5463940.title: Crash Agency
5463940.short_description: Crash Agency is a ragdoll comedy about staged accidents. Set the scene, throw yourself in front of cars, off ramps and under pianos, break bones in slow-motion X-ray and file the claim. 105 jobs in a busy town and a snowy mountain village.

5463980.title: DWARKA
5463980.short_description: Dive beneath the waves in DWARKA, a first-person underwater exploration adventure in development. Prepare your gear, sail aboard SAMUDRA, manage oxygen, and investigate ocean mysteries. The full game is planned for solo play and online co-op for up to four players.

5464010.title: Mystical II: Forgotten Knowledge
5464010.short_description: Forgotten knowledge sleeps in five mystical realms. Buy the falling objects for a gold coin each, gather trios and pairs in your bag, then reveal them with the magnifier before a column overflows. 50 stages, 216 painted objects: a medieval puzzle game.

5464060.title: Carrot Kingdom!
5464060.short_description: A rabbit and carrot puzzle-platformer! Stretch your ears to grab the carrots!

5464180.title: Night Study: Korean Ghost Stories
5464180.short_description: A complete first-person horror game in just 1.44MB — it fits on a single floppy disk. You fell asleep during night study and woke up alone. Learn each ghost's rule, find the keys and escape a Korean high school before dawn.

5464230.title: Doomsday: M.A.D.
5464230.short_description: Nuclear strategy on a living planet. Nations are born, build their towns, economies and railways, trade, rebel and go to war, century after century, all the way to nuclear fire. Watch the world live, or take control of one nation.

5464540.title: Space Nanny
5464540.short_description: A chaotic sci-fi multitasking game where minigames share controls and an alien baby keeps pressing the wrong buttons. Juggle multiple challenges, fling the baby away, and undo its mischief before alarms, smoke, and blackouts overwhelm your board. Remember: Never let him press the big red button!

5465030.title: Holy Nest
5465030.short_description: Deep underground, where light has never been, live blind beetles. They know the world by sound, and by sound they know their god. A god game and colony sim with indirect control: the swarms live on their own, and you guide them with sound, touch and miracles. Your deeds decide what god you are.

5465260.title: Snow and Loathing
5465260.short_description: You wake up on a sofa in a snowy wasteland. Beside you: an old camper. Ahead: a road disappearing into the fog. Find fuel, earn money, and keep moving, alone or with a friend. The further you travel, the stranger everything becomes.

5465280.title: Unknown Caller
5465280.short_description: The ghost never lies. Your friends do. Answer the phone, hear what she wants, then lie your way out of it. Mystery boxes, bombs, poisoned wine and terrible luck. 2-8 players with voice chat. Last one alive wins.

5465540.title: First Bag
5465540.short_description: You are an invisible robber who steals valuables from the map, while the others — the police — hunt you down to catch you. But you're only invisible while standing still. Move, and you can be seen. Steal money and valuables, furnish your home and level up your skills.

5465570.title: Chute Happens
5465570.short_description: Deliver precious cargo. Drop explosive surprises. Try to keep your plane in one piece. Chute Happens is an arcade game of parachute drops, daring deliveries, and demolition. Dodge incoming fire, chase bonuses, and make every drop count.

5465970.title: Gunmetal Switchyard – Tower Defense
5465970.short_description: Build and upgrade nine tower types, reshape enemy routes, and recover stolen data orbs in a sci-fi tower defense campaign. Fight through 20 missions, restore an abandoned network, and uncover the truth behind Command’s orders.

5466080.title: Hyogoslavia Chronicles
5466080.short_description: A classic turn-based JRPG set in five rival nations inspired by Hyogo, Japan (home of Kobe). Guide a hesitant prince through a land where every nation has its own idea of justice, explore far and wide, and find your way to the true ending. Fully playable in English.

5466130.title: Minimal AI Build Shop 24-26
5466130.short_description: Run a tiny PC shop through the 2024–26 AI boom. Find the GPU, parts and model that fit each customer's budget and make their AI actually run. A light, cozy pixel-art shop sim.

5466330.title: 敲敲小镇：桌面锻造物语
5466330.short_description: Type to mine, smelt, and forge gear with random affixes. Welcome residents, battle monsters and village trials. Stronger residents mean faster automated production. Start with one blacksmith shop and grow your town!

5466410.title: Fuji Flip
5466410.short_description: Flip two cards. Hear the word. Match the pair. Fuji Flip is a memory card game for language learners: every card shows a picture and a word and says it out loud, so you pick up real Japanese, Spanish and French words while you play.

5466460.title: Buzzmischief
5466460.short_description: Buzzmischief is a mosquito survival game. Fly into people's homes at night, drink from sleeping humans without getting swatted, and bring the blood home. Spend it on eggs and upgrades to grow a colony across the street. Take too much, though, and someone calls the exterminator.

5466580.title: LAST SLIME
5466580.short_description: When and where will you leave each slime behind? Guide a linked caravan of slimes, detach them to make paths, hold switches, and block hazards, then collect every LOVE on the board. Plan around each slime's color and your caravan's order in this turn-based grid puzzle.

5466640.title: School Dream
5466640.short_description: Start ninth grade with AI-driven classmates who answer anything you say and remember it. After school, go wherever you make plans to go. At night, play the dreams your day leaves behind, from a murder mystery to a flight to Mars.

5466710.title: Marceline Magpie: Forgotten Culprit
5466710.short_description: Discover a strange secret on forgotten abandonware and save a girl from a vanishing kidnapper in this unique puzzle box point and click adventure mystery.

5466750.title: Tea & Fae
5466750.short_description: In late-19th-century London, Rorenna runs the shabby little tea shop her parents left behind. Grow tea, serve your guests, and brew a cup worthy of the fairy kings to earn their approval and revive The Romance Tea Room. Based on the author's original novels, with multiple romance endings.

5466790.title: HappyBirthdayOnline
5466790.short_description: Say “congrats” with a slap! Get together as wobbly characters and celebrate the guest of honor with a slap. A simple online party game anyone can jump into for birthdays, anniversaries, and streaming milestones.

5467090.title: Gemward
5467090.short_description: Build a maze through overgrown jungle temples: place five gems a round, keep one, turn the rest to stone. Combine and refine them into over sixty special towers, uncover 39 recipes in a living grimoire, and hold the court across seven trials and seven difficulties, alone, with friends or in a duel.

5467360.title: University Architect
5467360.short_description: University Architect is a management game where you build and run your own university. Build the campus, design the courses, manage the professors, and decide whether to prioritize profits or your reputation.

5467370.title: Joseon Delivery
5467370.short_description: Walk and run across the eight provinces of Joseon-era Korea as a courier. From the stone-wall lanes of Jeju to the foothills of Geumgangsan, carry parcels and letters, hear the story behind each one, and collect a song from every town. A cozy journey on foot, with no combat and no failure.

5467390.title: LIMEN Company
5467390.short_description: A co-op survival horror game for 1–4 players in procedurally generated worlds. Pick a door, gather the data and stay quiet — they can hear you.

5467640.title: While I Still Remember
5467640.short_description: An adventure game about an artist who has lost her sight and must learn to live in the unfamiliar, dark and frightening world that has become her reality

5467800.title: The Glass Perimeter
5467800.short_description: A night shift on the crest of a dam. Bleed the pressure off the terminals, hide from the glare behind your visor, until the air runs out. The only rest is at a window onto someone else's warm life. A short psychological thriller about sensory overload and life behind glass.

5467840.title: Clay Rumble
5467840.short_description: Claymation wrestling with hand-sculpted clay fighters. Punch, bodyslam, dive off the top rope, grab the folding chair and settle it outside the ring. Couch brawls for two, six-fighter Clay Rumbles, tag team chaos and tournaments.

5467920.title: That Caveman Theme Park Game
5467920.short_description: Build a tribe. Run a prehistoric theme park. Keep the fire alive. Train cavemen, gather resources and create wild timber attractions. Entertain visitors, defend them from dinosaurs and expand your park's warmth while balancing fuel, construction and stone income.

5468020.title: Kingshatter
5468020.short_description: KINGSHATTER is a chess roguelike about building a ridiculous army and finding out just how much trouble it can cause. Fight across small boards, collect powerful upgrades, and take on opponents with a few unpleasant tricks of their own.

5468090.title: ManaPop!
5468090.short_description: ManaPop! is a new kind of competitive falling-block puzzle game where you solve puzzles while battling with magic! Clear the falling mana, build up magic power, cast spells, and fight for victory! Japanese only.

5468120.title: Unclean Hands
5468120.short_description: A PS1-style horror card game. Play Durak against Slavic spirits in a bathhouse after midnight. They cheat. Catch them. Cheat back while they look away — alone or with up to three friends online. Lose, and you lose a finger.

5468730.title: Maple's Secret
5468730.short_description: Pet Maple at his own rhythm, earn upgrades to get away with more, and make it to 8:00 AM without getting caught.

5468990.title: Masterstroke
5468990.short_description: Painting is a cover; haggling is the real art! [Masterstroke] is a roguelite fusing canvas jigsaws, poker hands, and tense bluffing. Chain resonant cards on a 3x3 grid, trigger 8-way paylines, and fleece wealthy buyers for rent. Just don't push too far!

5469000.title: Grażyna Returns on Sunday
5469000.short_description: Poland, 1993. A farmer's wife comes home on Sunday — and his cow has run off, the savings are gone, the roof leaks and there's a UFO over the field. A comedy adventure in a Polish village: disco polo, a rubber-stamp village head, a mother-in-law with a slipper and ten crazy minigames.

5469060.title: Gravity Defied Reincarnation
5469060.short_description: An unofficial remake of the 2004 keypad phone classic. Lean the rider to keep the bike balanced, ride over hills and drops and reach the finish on 30 tracks. Original mode rebuilds the classic physics, Modern mode rides smoother. Four bikes, pixel art and 31 original songs.

5469450.title: Tiny Timber
5469450.short_description: Tiny Timber is a 3D cozy idle game that lives on your desktop. Watch a tiny lumberjack chop trees, take breaks, and collect wood. Buy upgrades and grow your little forest while you work or relax.

5469630.title: ASCII Realms
5469630.short_description: A free-to-play online fantasy RPG drawn entirely in ASCII. Explore on horseback, battle monsters with real-time spells and steel, collect loot, and upgrade your equipment at the forge. Develop your character in a shared world.

5469830.title: Diamond District: Jewelry Shop Simulator
5469830.short_description: Buy gold, catch the fakes and flip the real pieces in your own jewelry shop in New York’s Diamond District. Start with $1,000 and one dusty room, stock your cases, haggle at the counter, craft custom pieces and film celebrities for views. Solo or online co-op for 1 to 4.

5469890.title: Grimoire Paradox
5469890.short_description: A clumsy apprentice witch botches her first spell and gets a grumpy 500-year-old witch stuck in her head. To part ways, they have until dawn to find nine strange items in a town full of monsters. A hand-painted comedy point-and-click adventure.

5470040.title: Saikei: A Zen Water Garden
5470040.short_description: A tiny voxel world in a glass jar that sits in the corner of your desktop, on top of your windows, while you work. It carries on without you: water flows, koi and crabs go about their day, and night falls when it does outside. Reach in to dig, pour and build whenever you like.

5470100.title: Take One Down
5470100.short_description: Ninety-nine bottles of beer on the wall. You know how it goes. Take one down, pass it around, and keep the Singer company at the bar. He's sung this song more times than he can count, and lately it's starting to sound a little strange.

5470450.title: INKarnation
5470450.short_description: Turn your doodles into fighters! Draw your own characters in INKarnation, then battle online, race through Time Attack, test your drawing skills in Sketch Rush, or trade explosive throws in Ink Bomb. No art skills needed—just imagination.

5470510.title: Town of Puzzles
5470510.short_description: A cozy match-3 puzzle RPG. Drag one gem, chain the colors and watch the board go off like fireworks while 42 neighbors with psychic Echo powers fight the creatures crawling out of the fracture in the middle of town.

5470520.title: Just One Trip!
5470520.short_description: Find room for one more box! Pack a whole move into a small van, and drive through a toy cartoon town to deliver all this stuff somewhere! Featuring Classic Puzzle mode as well as multiplayer co-op with Steam Friends!

5470550.title: Ruby's Trick or Treat
5470550.short_description: Freeze when the music stops, solve her puzzles, and escape the house before she gets to you. A short, fully voice-acted anime VTuber horror game where every second counts.

5470680.title: Let the cat fish!
5470680.short_description: Let a little fishing cat live along the bottom of your desktop. Catch and collect rare fish, build a cozy tower floor by floor, equip cannons against cute seaside monsters, dress up the tower and taskbar, and shrink the game to a tiny companion while you work.

5470710.title: What the Duck
5470710.short_description: A co-op hunting adventure for 1–4 players. Call in birds, haul back your kills, and buy better gear as you explore increasingly strange hunting grounds. Bring your friends, load up the boat, and take on oversized bosses. It started with ducks.

5470830.title: Campfire
5470830.short_description: A two-player co-op deduction adventure where a grandchild and a late explorer's old apprentice finish an unfinished path. Each of you gets different clues on screen, by voice or by touch. Put them into words, compare them, and reach one answer together. Supports the DotPad tactile display.

5470890.title: Jetski TD
5470890.short_description: Race against your friends in this PvP tower defense. Build and upgrade towers, ride your Monkey Jetski to haul gold from fish nodes, help other players defend — or quietly make things worse. First to clear a wave sets the pace for everyone.

5471130.title: Sewer Rat
5471130.short_description: Sewer Rat is a split screen multiplayer rat experience / passion project that explores the hidden lives of rats and their unique social construct. A mix of realism, silliness and straight up rat propaganda. It's currently in the alpha stages of development.

5471250.title: ODD HAUL
5471250.short_description: Pack your bag, discover powerful item synergies, and chase higher scores in a cozy, cat-filled strategy game. Arrange your loot, unlock clever combinations, shop for upgrades, and see how far your journey takes you!

5472360.title: Space Supermarket Chaos
5472360.short_description: Gravity clocked out. You didn't. Tidy a zero-gravity supermarket solo or in co-op with up to 8 players. Catch floating goods, sort them onto shelves, and unlock and upgrade sci-fi tools. Turn drifting clutter into satisfying order, one item at a time.

5472390.title: JK in RPG
5472390.short_description: An outgoing high school girl, Akemi, was summoned to Isekai after school! To find her way home, she embarked on a journey to save the world with a female warrior, Pina...

5472470.title: 装甲奇兵
5472470.short_description: Drive an armored war machine through endless enemy waves. A survivors-like shooter: auto-fire, dodge, unleash ultimates, pick upgrades and set the field ablaze. Start with Eileen / Ghost, unlock two more crews, fight nine stages, and push each battlefield from Easy to Nightmare.

5472610.title: Double Trouble Delivery
5472610.short_description: A two-player online coop physics game. One of you drives, the other keeps the packages balanced. Solve mini-games, dodge obstacles, and find the right house before the dogs steal your cargo.

5473280.title: Pigeon Gang
5473280.short_description: Pigeon Gang is a physics-based co-op horror game for 1–6 players. Play as thieving pigeons, grab loot with your sticky tongue, explore dangerous locations, hide from monsters, and escape together. Stealing is easy. Surviving is not.

5473290.title: 登神长阶
5473290.short_description: An idle xianxia looter with fully automated combat. Build the ultimate character and climb the Myriad Demon Tower: 17 skills per class, 10 gear modifications, artifacts, talismans, inner arts and skill variations to mix freely. Farm gear, roll affixes, brew pills, break realms, bond with acolytes...

5473400.title: Overgrid
5473400.short_description: Overgrid is a tactical tower defense game where capturing the territory is just as important as defending it. Build and upgrade your defenses, capture strategic locations, and unlock new technologies across a 30-mission campaign set in the middle of a war between artificial intelligences.

5473610.title: Bazaar Below Zero
5473610.short_description: Don Morsa has kidnapped you and put you to work digging ice to stock his bazaar. You obey… but every tunnel you dig brings you a little closer to the way out. A co-op incremental for 1–4 players: sell to seals, upgrade your tools, hire penguins and plan the great escape.

5474170.title: Punch Through
5474170.short_description: Punch your way through prison walls in a satisfying first-person incremental destruction game! Smash concrete, collect resources, earn money, and upgrade your strength, tools, and abilities. Break tougher walls, unlock powerful upgrades, and fight your way toward freedom!

5474750.title: The Alleyway
5474750.short_description: Trapped within in a looping British alleyway, you must complete disturbing tasks for a demonic rubbish bin while surviving murderous children's TV puppets known as, Huggles and Friends. A surreal and macabre first-person horror based on the Seven Deadly Sins. Welcome to the Eternal Darkness.

5474910.title: Ruthenium Smash & Grab
5474910.short_description: Shoot the asteroids until they're small enough to collect. If anything hits the tail of asteroids you've collected, you lose them. Don't lose so many. Lose less. *Fewer.

5475170.title: PinDOS
5475170.short_description: Play your own copies of Epic Pinball, Silver Ball, Silver Ball 2 Plus and Extreme Pinball in a new front end: the whole table on one tall screen with no scrolling, 2-4 players online or on your home network, and a full virtual pinball cabinet mode. The games are not included.

5475400.title: UPG Cubed
5475400.short_description: A fast-paced minimalist platformer where precision is everything. Master jumping, wall-jumping and dashing, collect diamonds, beat challenging levels and push your skills to the limit. And create your own levels in UPG Cubed

5475550.title: Definitely Safe
5475550.short_description: Put rockets together from scrap parts, pack the powder, cut the fuse and see what happens. Film every flight. Upload your footage, chase views, and climb the charts. Totally legal. Definitely safe.

5475580.short_description: Merge tiles, get buffs. Make number go up. Biggest score is best score.

5475670.title: Peer Into The Void
5475670.short_description: Catch what moved. The moves get smaller and smaller. Test your perception.

5476090.title: Cardmarch
5476090.short_description: Build your deck, move animal allies across a tactical board, and break through enemy lines. Unlock six heroes with personal stories, cast spells and face bosses across six regions in this single-player card battler. Storybook artwork draws on the look of classic 1990s animation.

5476320.title: Gnomageddon
5476320.short_description: Roguelike tower defense meets the gnome apocalypse. Pick upgrades, build towers and defend your garden from hundreds of thousands of gnomes.

5476900.title: Luna Plena
5476900.short_description: "Read your enemy. Count every turn." A Short RPG Beneath the Full Moon.

5476940.title: Ex Death Game
5476940.short_description: 100 ex-boyfriends. One luxury cruise. A deadly reckoning at sea. Play as Su Wei, design lethal trials, and decide each ex’s punishment. As Chopin’s waltzes play, expose their lies, watch alliances crumble, and make every betrayal come due.

5477030.title: 地府模拟器
5477030.short_description: 你死了，但真正的人生才刚刚开始。作为一名初入地府的孤魂野鬼，在酆都谋生、赚钱、修炼、置业、结交鬼神，也可以加入阴司，从普通阴兵一路晋升为判官、阎罗，甚至掌管整个地府。

5477050.title: Cosmic Inferno
5477050.short_description: Explore 100 star systems, battle pirates, trade, mine asteroids, and salvage wrecks. Buy and customize spaceships, upgrade your weapons, and chart your own course. Your onboard computer A.R.E.S. is always by your side. Whether you like it or not.

5477140.title: Stray Cloud: An Overcast Story
5477140.short_description: You are a cloud. A fairly small one, and the other clouds think that's hilarious. Swallow them, rain to buy upgrades and grow from one field to the whole Earth. Then drift on through the solar system, world by world, until you cover the Sun. A cozy, fully narrated incremental.

5477810.title: Legio Impera
5477810.short_description: Found a Roman colony, run its economy and pay your legions. Legio Impera is a city-building RTS set in Marian Rome: govern a province during the Cimbrian War, subdue Gauls and Germanic tribes, and stop the horde before it reaches Italy.

5478030.title: Sleighline
5478030.short_description: Every Christmas Eve, the same old job, in a much bigger world. Santa’s magic now bends time and opens portals, but the presents still go in by hand, so he flies low: over rooftops, through a pharaoh’s tomb, across the outback. Two buttons, seven courses, one perfect line: TRUE SANTA.

5478130.title: Scott Whiskers: The Search for the Bad Twin
5478130.short_description: Scott Whiskers is back! The cat-loving, sci-fi-obsessed hero trades his couch for outer space in a brand-new humorous point & click adventure – with hand-painted backgrounds, expressive 3D characters and full voice-over, packed with puzzles, quirky aliens and one very unwelcome lookalike.

5478180.title: Seven Rukks: Pit, Profit & Glory
5478180.short_description: Seven Rukks is a brutal fantasy sports management game. Build your team, develop your players, plan your lineup and tactics, and lead your club through a ruthless league where glory, profit, and survival are often only one Rukk apart.

5478190.title: DeCube
5478190.short_description: A nostalgic incremental game where you mine whole planets down to their core. Dig, upgrade and hire workers to uncover the secrets that lie beneath...

5478280.title: Flip Biz Tycoon
5478280.short_description: This is NO decorating game. Put on that suit, crunch those numbers, and flip them houses. It's business time!

5478290.title: Chess Traveler: Pip's Journey
5478290.short_description: The family chess set is about to be donated, and only Pip, the smallest pawn in the box, can stop it. Roll dice across the house, bend chess with silly House Rules from checkers, Ludo and xiangqi, and make chess fun again in a cozy chess roguelike.

5478350.title: Ten Thousand Victories
5478350.short_description: A historical strategy game set in medieval Vietnam, drawn in the style of Đông Hồ folk woodblock prints. Build a realm and hold it through invasion after invasion, command formations in real-time battles, or ride out as one captain in a Story Mode where the country remembers your promises.

5478560.title: 烽烟三国 Warfires of the Three Kingdoms
5478560.short_description: Warfires of the Three Kingdoms is a turn-based strategy game set in the Three Kingdoms era. Build teams from Heroes, Skills, and Formations, exploit unit counters, climb the Tower with three parties, collect Equipment, and adapt your tactics to each enemy lineup.

5478710.title: EXOSECTOR
5478710.short_description: A space 3D MMORPG on a colossal scale. Up to 100,000 players simultaneously in one persistent, seamless game universe of 10,000 star systems.

5478800.title: Domino Party
5478800.short_description: Stand up thousands of dominoes to build a picture, then watch it all topple in one glorious chain! Make domino art and up to 10,000-piece jigsaws from your own photos with friends, then party in the lodge and playland with 28 mini-games like curling and sled races.

5478910.title: UNKNOWN PASSENGER 47
5478910.short_description: 47 lives lost. 48 bodies recovered. Identify the victims of a fictional plane crash in this text-based deduction mystery. Cross-reference body records, passenger lists, medical reports, and personal effects to give every person back their name.

5479020.title: Jiggle Desktop Lab 2D
5479020.short_description: Meet your new bouncy desktop companion! Jiggle Desktop 2D brings your screen to life with satisfying, reactive physics. Poke, drag, and play with your interactive virtual pet while you work, browse, or game.

5479160.title: 寄念：手影信使
5479160.short_description: Your hands are the controller. Raise them to the light, and their shadows become bridges and walls in a paper world. Guide a halo-crowned spirit carrying longing to its recipient — freeze shadows into ice, melt ink away, and shape the path with your own hands. A cozy hand-shadow puzzle game.

5479260.title: 仙武三国
5479260.short_description: A premium single-player idle RPG blending Three Kingdoms warfare with cultivation. Recruit generals, form armies, and conquer. Gather dragon energy over 20 reincarnations, rising from soldier to True Dragon Emperor. No in-app purchases or online requirement. Includes a complete 100-chapter story.

5479340.title: An incremental city from a word search: Wordhood
5479340.short_description: Build an incremental town powered by word searches. Wordhood is an addictive blend of finding words and watching numbers grow. Gather resources, combine upgrades, and unleash combos to grow a hungry town.

5479430.title: PluggedInCats
5479430.short_description: Battery running low! Place the cats and route their cables with care to charge every device and keep these internet-loving kitties exploring the digital world!

5479470.title: Armed Prototype: Dual Blaze
5479470.short_description: Armed Prototype: Dual Blaze is a pixel-art side-scrolling action shooter for solo or local co-op play! Run, jump and climb under fire. Smash special devices to switch between gun-wielding and sword-wielding heroines. Fight through enemy lines with bullets and blades—alone or with a friend!

5479490.title: Oddballs Brawl
5479490.short_description: Oddballs Brawl is a chaotic side-scrolling shooter for 2–4 players! Play as bizarre fighters, jumping, dodging, and blasting away across floating platforms and trap-filled arenas. Grab all kinds of weapons, send your friends flying, and fight for victory in the middle of the mayhem!

5479500.title: Blazing Fighter King
5479500.short_description: Blazing Fighter King is a chaotic stick-figure brawler for 2–4 players! Grab guns, swing swords, and battle across shaky platforms and tumbling crates. Dodge, snatch weapons, and use the terrain and surprise attacks to defeat your rivals and claim the title of Fighter King!

5479570.title: League of Constellations
5479570.short_description: What if you took the build you'd been mowing down hordes with in a survivors-like and put it in a 5v5? So I built it. Raise your heroes in the survivors run, then take them straight into the league. No nerfs. You control your own hero; your teammates fight by your formation and tactics.

5479600.title: Black Death: Russia
5479600.short_description: Take control of Russia's response to a deadly epidemic. Manage hospitals, medical personnel, public finances, quarantines and transport restrictions. Balance public trust against the need to contain the outbreak in this challenging strategy simulation.

5479910.title: Pocket Bones
5479910.short_description: Open booster packs, discover new Pocket Bones, and watch your pile grow! In this cozy little incremental game, collect all 480 variants, unlock upgrades, and automate your pack openings. And who knows? Your next pack might just contain the ultra-rare Secret Pocket Bone…

5479980.title: Bottled Ambition
5479980.short_description: A Prohibition-era moonshine sim, solo or in co-op with up to three friends. Grow corn, mix your own blends and run them through a copper still. Smuggle the jugs past the sheriff and rival bootleggers by truck or on horseback. Hire workers and build your empire.

5479990.title: Dress Your Meat
5479990.short_description: Dress Your Meat is a cooking horror game where you work at a dumpling restaurant. Take orders, prepare dishes, and do your best to keep your chef happy. Sounds simple enough, until things in the kitchen start getting seriously disturbing.

5480090.title: Idle War Legion: WW2
5480090.short_description: Recruit soldiers, tanks, artillery and planes into an auto-battling WW2 army of up to 10 slots. Upgrade it and set the formation; it fights on while you're away, or in a desktop mini window as you work. Face 14 themed Bosses, the Infinite Cyber War Tower, 20 vs 20 Grand Army Battles and more.

5480240.title: Throw The Snot
5480240.short_description: Aim, charge, and flick a sticky booger onto crazy obstacles! Your goal is simple: launch the booger, hit the target, and hold on for 2 agonizing seconds without slipping off. Easy controls, wobbly soft-body physics, and pure rage-inducing gameplay

5480350.title: Casual Sokoban Pack
5480350.short_description: Casual Sokoban Pack is classic puzzle game where player is tasked to move pieces into their respective places. The game offers 300 levels with 5 difficulty levels divided into push only, pull only and mixed levels.

5480410.title: One Mote
5480410.short_description: Grow a glowing web from a single mote of light. Every crystal you reach feeds the core, and the light plays a song. Collapse your web into a star, fill constellations, wake whole galaxies, then fold them back into one mote. An incremental game you can watch grow.

5480430.title: Tiny Night Market
5480430.short_description: A tiny night market lives right above your taskbar. While you work, the stalls cook, sell and grow on their own. When you have a minute, help out at the stalls, toss a few rings, fill regulars' orders and wait for rare visitors — and watch one candied-hawthorn cart grow into a glowing street.

5480460.title: Space Novel: Echoes of the Divide
5480460.short_description: An ordinary factory worker becomes a fugitive in a galactic war. Choose whom to trust, uncover the purpose of an experimental crystal, and decide what freedom is worth in a branching science-fiction visual novel.

5480600.title: The Bill Comes Due
5480600.short_description: A whole life, one choice at a time. You are born wherever you can, you grow as you can, and everything you do you find yourself in front of you thirty years later. No game is the same as another, no ending given away: the bill always arrives, and you write it.

5480690.title: Nessi
5480690.short_description: Explore Loch Ness alone or with up to three friends in a first-person horror investigation. Gather evidence, photograph sightings and upgrade your boat and equipment. Try your best to prove the existance of the Loche Ness Monster.

5480770.title: Eldvyrn - Fog of War
5480770.short_description: Lead a Viking clan through a frozen north in this real-time strategy game. Hunt, cure meat and build your settlement, then march your warbands against rival clans. Win by conquest, by holding territory or the summit, or by killing the enemy leader, online or against the AI.

5480950.title: Outfitter: Madison River
5480950.short_description: Fly fish and paddle Montana's Madison River, 228 km from Yellowstone to Three Forks. Read the water, land wild trout, run Bear Trap Canyon's whitewater and hike the backcountry, solo or with a friend in two-player co-op.

5481070.title: Rock N' LSD
5481070.short_description: Wake up split in two, sharing one health bar. Identical yet opposite, no memories, only instinctive hatred. You want to kill each other. Solve a missing person case to uncover the past. A decadent-cute, rock "episodic anime game" blending visual novel and text adventure, updated long-term.

5481100.title: Atelier en Provence
5481100.short_description: Bring a little Provence to your desktop. Join Pierre the painter as he works and rests. Upgrade his tools, collect and sell paintings, and create a cozy home. The full release will feature over 1,500 works of art.

5481140.title: Geometry Platforms
5481140.short_description: WELCOME TO A GEOMETRIC SPACE ODYSSEY In a universe of collapsing forms, you are the last vector of resistance. Surviving hordes is half the battle—the ground beneath you is a dynamic, lethal threat! Brace for neon bullet hell, pinpoint physics, synth beats, and endlessly rewarding progression.

5481150.title: Tiny Standup
5481150.short_description: Has your standing desk been stuck in sitting mode for months? Tiny Standup is an idle game that sits at the bottom of your screen and reminds you to stand up. Watch your character stand, stretch, and hydrate alongside you, and earn cute cosmetics to show off to your friends.

5481330.title: Dragonaute
5481330.short_description: A fantasy flight action game where you are the dragon. Launch from cliffs, dive between hundreds of floating islands, race your ghost for Steam leaderboard records and set entire fleets ablaze with your fire breath, solo or with up to four players in online co-op.

5481640.title: Grounds Crew
5481640.short_description: Mow it. Blow it. Plow it. Take on 80 grounds-keeping jobs with a robot mower, a tractor and gang mower, a leaf blower and a snow blower. Lay perfect stripes, clear every leaf and push back the snow, from backyards and golf courses to castles and Christmas markets.

5481790.title: Large Language Mercenaries
5481790.short_description: A roguelite turn-based strategy RPG where you command an AI mercenary, defend your caravan, and parry enemy attacks in real time. Play as the *original characters* Sam the Scout, Elon the Envoker, or Dario the Duelist and face down waves of AI-enabled nightmares to save humanity.

5481820.title: THE UNWRITTEN: Shadows of Iga
5481820.short_description: 1581. Iga burns. Kirimaru, a seventeen-year-old shinobi who survived, slips through the last years of the Sengoku era as a shadow who leaves no name — from the fall of Iga through Honnoji to Sekigahara. A retro, NES-style ninja RPG where every general leads thousands of troops into battle.

5481880.title: Plastic Noodles: Connector
5481880.short_description: Cursed and stuck in a time loop, reach one of the almost 30 different endings. Meet the wacky companions and adversaries that help or hinder your quest. Create powerful builds and dodge/parry bullets while managing the little time you have per loop. Can you reach your happily ever after?

5482000.title: Dent & Paint: Body Shop Simulator
5482000.short_description: Run your own body shop and fix cars by hand. Inspect, quote and win the job, then strip, cut out rot, weld, fill, sand, mask, mix and spray the paint, polish and wash. Deliver on time, earn good reviews and work your way up from apprentice to foreman.

5482100.title: Villein
5482100.short_description: In this, the prequel to "Annum Crossroads," navigate a vast, open-world dystopia while battling countless enemies, and the sorcerers who command them. Non-Woke | Non-AI GRX

5482120.title: Supermarket in Order
5482120.short_description: Tidy up to 10,000 objects across 17 supermarket sections. Pick up products, restock shelves and unlock upgrades in this cozy first-person tidying game. Play at your own pace and turn scattered goods into a neatly organized store.

5482150.title: Kessrand: The Last Warden
5482150.short_description: You are the Last Hero of a kingdom trapped inside a mountain, and the invaders are hunting you. Carve tunnels and set traps between waves, then survive each wave, leading the horde through the killing warren you built.

5482190.title: Gliding Together
5482190.short_description: Hang-glide from the summit to the landing field across 15 hand-crafted worlds. Lean to steer, dive for speed, thread rings to build your streak and slip past canyon walls, cable cars and laser gates. Chase your best run solo, or race up to three friends online.

5482230.title: Lightly Played
5482230.short_description: A card-collecting roguelite about opening packs and grading cards. Spend ten days at the night market buying packs, ripping them open and sending your best pulls to the graders, then watch every card you own pile damage up at the other collectors.

5482290.title: SoulMarkWalker
5482290.short_description: 《SoulMarkWalker》 is a turn-based action game.Choose your skills and time your dodges and counters in video-driven, turn-based combat. Investigate clues, develop your character, and resonate with ancient heroes.

5482300.title: Emerald Space Courier
5482300.short_description: Survive megacorp Emerald Acme's lethal "field test"! Pilot in a 60 FPS neon arena, face 8 bosses across a 24-shift combinatorial cycle, master 4 built-in minigames, and customize your broadcast in Emerald FM Studio. Solo, Co-op, or PvP!

5482320.title: Crashloop
5482320.short_description: CRASHLOOP is a roguelike deckbuilder about hacking your way through a botnet. Build machines out of hexagonal tiles, chain them into loops, and crash every foe that stands in your way as you find out who's behind it all.

5482360.title: JUNK//GOD
5482360.short_description: Steal weapons from the machines you destroy. JUNK//GOD is a 3D action roguelite where you build a robot from salvaged parts, combine its weapons and fight through five industrial districts. Lose a part in combat, pull it back in and keep fighting.

5482550.title: ナツノカナタ ―PROLOGUE－
5482550.short_description: The prologue of the novel Natsuno Kanata is now a visual novel! When Shiori boots up her late grandmother's old PC, she unexpectedly connects to a desolate alternate world ravaged by a mysterious pandemic. A post-apocalyptic adventure.

5482580.title: Loaded Bones
5482580.short_description: Loaded Bones is a poker-inspired dice roguelike where every roll can change your fate. Build powerful combinations, collect game-changing Keepsakes, unleash mystical Incantations, and chase outrageous scores as you gamble your way through a supernatural world to challenge the Devil himself.

5482800.title: Factory In Progress
5482800.short_description: A semi-idle factory management game. Mine ore, craft components, then research and automate your way to launching a rocket. There is no world to route resources through. Buildings pull from and deposit into one global pool. Even when you are gone, you still have a Factory In Progress.

5482810.title: Starcrumb
5482810.short_description: A star fell into the forest. Tap it, and tiny mushroom folk carry its crumbs to the Lantern. Kindle the star, magnitude by magnitude, until it is whole again. A cozy incremental game where you can see every part work, with a real ending.

5482820.title: Resupply
5482820.short_description: Your towers have limited ammo, and it's your job to deliver it. Resupply is a tower defense game where logistics is the real challenge. Move ammunition with workers, conveyor belts and autonomous bots, and keep your defense supplied as the waves get harder.

5482850.title: Gnomes Garden: Fairy Kingdom
5482850.short_description: The Gnome Queen uncovers the history of the fairies, restores friendship, and fights an ancient darkness.

5482890.title: Node Wars
5482890.short_description: Node Wars is a short, neon-soaked incremental game. Smash glowing nodes, earn upgrades, and carve your path across a sprawling skill-tree grid. Easy to pick up, satisfying to optimize, and designed to be finished in a single sitting of a few hours.

5482910.title: DoumyakuOnline
5482910.short_description: DoumyakuOnline is a turn-based 1v1 game where you take turns flipping face-down cards and compete to survive or finish with more cash. The next card could turn the match in your favor or cost you your life.

5483020.title: kitty Limited Trade Union
5483020.short_description: Run a guild of cats in this pixel-art incremental game. Hunt monsters with clicks or recruit cats to fight for you. Earn gold, plan your talents, mix drinks and forge weapons as your guild grows with each rebirth.

5483030.title: Chess Me If You Can: A Chameleon's Escape
5483030.short_description: Escape a world ruled by chess as a curious, shapeshifting chameleon. Capture guards to borrow their movement, use tactical cards, and solve turn-based room puzzles. Every new form opens a different route—but the guards have plans of their own.

5483420.title: NayBlades
5483420.short_description: Spin, bump and bounce through 20 hazard-packed levels with three friends. In NayBlades every player is a Naydo, a spinning tornado that sends anyone it touches flying. Work together to survive four worlds of obstacle courses, or knock each other out in the Arena.

5483560.title: Monster Cove
5483560.short_description: A cozy retro handheld-inspired RPG where you research and battle monsters, save a seaside village, and create a new life at your own pace. This time, you are the Monster Researcher.

5483730.title: Ancient Crowns
5483730.short_description: Build your captain in 3D, raise your banner and ride out across a curving world to claim the ancient crowns. Recruit armies, fight turn-based battles on land and at sea, besiege towns or hold your own walls. Three peoples, three campaigns, a map editor and hot-seat. In English and Hungarian.

5483750.title: CRIMSON HAREM - My Girls -
5483750.short_description: Korea fell to a crimson mist. Left for dead by his former lover, a man leads the Yaksha back to Seoul. Link same-colored tiles in one stroke to fight, then live the story of each woman you meet, part by part. Bond with her, and her power becomes yours. All characters are adults.

5483810.title: Frontline: Hold the Line
5483810.short_description: A WWII tactical roguelite about holding the line. Dig in, deploy riflemen, machine gunners, snipers, tanks and anti-tank guns, then call in artillery and air strikes as waves of enemy infantry and armour crash against your defences.

5483960.title: One Tank Trip
5483960.short_description: Team up as three soldiers forgotten in the evacuation on their journey home by tank!

5484060.title: Switchroom
5484060.short_description: You were naughty this year. Now you're stuck in Santa's warehouse with your friends. Every switch might drop a toy, kill the lights or let something in. Find the toys on the list, ship them, and survive each other.

5484170.title: ナノスダソス
5484170.short_description: A resource-gathering, deck-building board game for up to 6 players. Lay your cards face down, then everyone reveals at once and resolves them in order. Read your rivals and race to be the first to reach 10 victory points.

5484230.title: BIRDS HUNTING
5484230.short_description: A chaotic 1–4 player first-person bird hunt. Blast incoming flocks, send your dogs to retrieve, earn cash for better gear, and chase golden ducks and a flying rainbow unicorn. Friendly fire is optional. Trusting your friends isn't.

5484310.title: Peblings: A Creature Bag-Builder
5484310.short_description: A creature roguelike in the spirit of Luck be a Landlord, where your creatures fuse and evolve. Draw your bag onto the grid and watch their effects chain: a few dozen damage at first, thousands by the end. Eight bosses per run, out of 32, and they fight back.

5484330.title: Wait, They Can Climb?!
5484330.short_description: In this incremental Tower Defense you are alone on top of a building, surrounded by thousands of zombies. Place the turrets, grab the rifle and survive 10 days waiting for rescue. But be careful: they can climb!

5484370.title: Catnip Wars 2: Empires
5484370.short_description: Play your way in an infinite galaxy of cats!. Haggle at ports. Hack the yarn. Become a bounty hunter. Be an ace pilot in your own custom fighter! Compete in demolition style racing in the Nine-lives circuit! Create or join a house. Play with others on the official server or create your own.

5484380.title: The Park Keeper - First Days
5484380.short_description: Become a ranger in a national park where people have doubles. Check visitors, explore the forest, and help its strange inhabitants. A copy might be better than the original. But does that give it the right to take their place?

5484470.title: Bad Company
5484470.short_description: Never enough firepower or room for loot? This multiplayer extraction shooter has the cure! Form a convoy with friends or quirky AI buddies. Start with basic rifles, storm forts in tanks, and haul maps clean with heavy trucks. Backpack full? Drive off with the crates and the vehicle!

5484480.title: Astrocraft: Prologue
5484480.short_description: Build a space station on a barren asteroid, in first person and for free. Mine ore, run machines, open a shop for the ships that land, and hand the work to a crew of robots until the station runs on its own, solo or in online co-op for up to four players.

5484590.title: Dark Kitchen
5484590.short_description: Dark Kitchen is a 2–4 player co-op game, playable online or in split-screen. Survive the kitchen rush while your friends race across town to deliver orders on time, and guard your food from rivals who'll stop at nothing to steal it!

5484940.title: World League Football
5484940.short_description: A football manager with stands that remember you. Take over a club, or start with its youth or second team. Protest on the touchline, face the press, get sent to the stands. Chase the 128-club World League or play Classic leagues and cups.

5485070.title: Resortful
5485070.short_description: Resortful is a cozy island management sim. Start with a harbour and a beach, then build bungalows, cafés, hotels and water parks for the guests who sail in each day. Balance prices, upkeep and reputation as your relaxing resort grows.

5485250.title: Companion: Legends
5485250.short_description: A free-to-play strategy auto-battler for 8 players where every creature has 3 evolution stages. Play at your own pace: close the game mid-match and pick it up later. Pick a trainer, craft items and climb the ranked ladder.

5485440.title: Monster Battle Master
5485440.short_description: Monster Battle Master is a character adventure game focused on creature collecting. You'll start by getting a unique field mouse and gradually embark on your own new adventure, challenge all the strong enemies in the region with your senior sister, and relive past memories along the journey.

5485540.title: The Gloaming Hand
5485540.short_description: A free one-on-one card battler where the sky decides the fight. Plant units at Dawn, let them ripen through the Day, strike before Dusk and bluff through the Night. Five lanes, four phases, one sundial: every card is worth something different at every hour.

5485650.title: 末日序列：诡域求生
5485650.short_description: ELDRITCH SEQUENCE is a Lovecraftian survival RPG that fuses rule-based horror with dungeon crawling. Uncover deadly rules, explore nightmarish dungeons, and fight to survive. Customize your attributes, develop unique builds, and combine powerful skills to forge your own path to survival.

5485700.title: Sus Chef
5485700.short_description: A chaotic first-person online multiplayer cooking and social deduction game for up to 12 players. Take orders, cook, serve and keep the restaurant clean to improve the rating while hidden saboteurs try to cause chaos and bring the restaurant to ruin!

5485720.title: Raccoocket
5485720.short_description: Raccoocket is a cheerful, ridiculous rocket-building flight game. Stack cola and Mentos, bottle rockets, old toilets and scrapped missiles into a rocket that looks impossible but pushes like crazy, and launch Xiao Huan the raccoon. Get it right: the Moon. Get it wrong: a short, loud fireworks show.

5485840.title: New Eldarian
5485840.short_description: A free-to-play 2D fantasy MMORPG with turn-based combat, exploration, character progression, dungeons, loot, crafting and cooperative online play. Explore a shared world, join other players and build your character.

5485920.title: Ambulante Simulator
5485920.short_description: From a cooler on your shoulder to a penthouse by the sea! Shout into a real mic, sell water, mate, popsicles, coconuts and açaí on Copacabana beach, and work your way up to your own stall and kiosk. Play solo, build a career with up to 4 friends, or compete with up to 6.

5485950.title: Our Hollow
5485950.short_description: The Crown has nailed an eviction notice to your Heart Tree: forty days to quit the wood. Lead a ragtag band on a turn-based d20 adventure through hand-made towns, haunted roads, a sun-scorched isle and frozen mountains, and find out who really holds the paper.

5485990.title: Your "Thing"
5485990.short_description: Finally, you can grow your own little thing. Water it, feed it, and experiment with your technique to shape how it grows. Every mushroom has its own size, patterns, and quirks. It lives right on your desktop, reacts to your touch, and sometimes gets up to mischief. How big will yours get?

5486070.title: Ore Heads
5486070.short_description: Head Office is hiring! Dig through seven huge mines in co-op for up to 8 players, fight your way through sealed dungeons, build a home on your own plot and climb the company ladder from Intern Digger to Chairman of the Boulder in this cozy voxel mining game.

5486220.title: The Seven Crowns -Fantasy-
5486220.short_description: A long-lost friend. A strange corruption is spreading across the land. Explore the world, seek answers from elders and scholars, battle corrupted creatures, gather ingredients, and rid the land of corruption.

5486360.title: Organize my Shop 3: Christmas Store
5486360.short_description: Your favorite cozy organizing returns in a festive new format! Dive into a winter wonderland, brew some hot cocoa, and place fairy lights, nutcrackers, blankets, and mugs neatly on the shelves at your own pace while enjoying your favorite holiday movie ☕✨

5486400.title: Vitrelium
5486400.short_description: Step into an atmospheric alchemy workshop. Mix substances, heat and cool liquids, distill vapors, and grow crystals. Discover reactions in a hands-on laboratory sandbox where real-world chemistry meets imagination.

5486410.title: My City
5486410.short_description: My City is a Classic-inspired city simulator, built for today in full 3D. Paint residential, commercial and industrial zones, lay roads, rail and power lines, keep the lights on and the traffic moving, balance the budget, and watch small houses grow into towers as your city thrives.

5486470.title: BAJAMAR
5486470.short_description: BAJAMAR is a first-person point-and-click mystery adventure on an abandoned lighthouse island. Explore, examine everything, combine what you find and solve logical puzzles to follow the trail your brother left for you alone. No combat. No hand-holding.

5486520.title: Wallet Street
5486520.short_description: A first-person stock market sim where the market is rigged, and you're the one rigging it. Trade on the news, buy a blog to spread rumors, lobby against companies, install a puppet president, or skip stocks and win big at the casino.

5486540.title: Age of Balls
5486540.short_description: Lead your own countryball, grow your army and build up your nation. Besiege cities, expand through diplomacy and conquer the world!

5486620.title: JiivJiiv
5486620.short_description: Raise a flock of felt chickens on Grandma's old farm. Throw eggs into the truck, migrate across six regions with their own rules and follow her postcards to the legendary First Hen. A cozy idle game with no ads, no premium currency and a real ending.

5486650.title: In the Margins
5486650.short_description: Run a cozy bookstore in a small riverside town. Listen to what each customer is after and find them the right book from over 1,400 real titles. Stock the shelves, decorate, host story time and book club, and grow the shop one room at a time. There's a cat.

5486770.title: Valley of the Omen
5486770.short_description: A folk horror action platformer in which you play a boomerang-wielding warrior on a quest for revenge. As Aoife, an orphan raised to hunt monsters, you will face the demonic hordes of the sorceress Morrakhad across abandoned villages, cursed cathedrals, and flooded graveyards.

5486910.title: Treasury of Lies
5486910.short_description: Run a small country for ten years and survive the truth. Plant stories, turn spies, calm the bond market and outlast the fake feeds, before the voters, the lenders or a squirrel in the substation finish you off. A noir turn-based strategy game of money, spies and lies.

5487050.title: Infasia : Tears of Void
5487050.short_description: **Infasia: Tears of Void** is a turn-based JRPG set in the world of Infasia. Take on the role of Xen and lead his growing party as they fight alongside the Beltenrekis, an organization dedicated to preserving the balance of the world.

5487360.title: GOAL2D
5487360.short_description: Three-minute top-down football where every shot, pass, and dribble is yours to control. Time-charged shots, beat defenders with skill moves, and call team tactics in 3v3 to 5v5 PvP or co-op. Climb six ranked leagues or play a career from amateur to national team. Try the free demo.

5487610.title: Animal Fights Together
5487610.short_description: Run a animal fight club with up to 3 friends. Strap absurd weapons onto farm animals, train them up, then watch their cinematic auto-fights together, bet on every match and yell at the screen. A goat with a minigun. A chicken with a katana.

5487730.title: The Window Across
5487730.short_description: Three days before her childhood home is demolished, Emi relearns the secret language she once spoke through a window with a boy across the courtyard: lamp light and cardboard shadows. A pixel-art story about the things we never said. Demo coming soon.

5487830.title: DREADMINER: Millions Below
5487830.short_description: Real-time strategy in the deep. Mine contested gold and crystal deposits, stretch your power network across hostile caverns, and command a brass-and-lightning battery as the swarm breaks through from new directions. A gothic steampunk tower defense RTS where every coin is a choice.

5487890.title: Golf Sim Sim
5487890.short_description: Start with a bedsheet, a bargain-bin launch monitor, and a dream. Beat 40 arcade golf challenges, earn cash, and install 20 upgrades as you turn a janky garage setup into the ultimate home golf simulator.

5487940.title: Timber Together
5487940.short_description: Grab up to seven friends and build a logging company in a stylized forest valley. Fell trees, buck them into logs, haul them through mud and rivers in 11 vehicles, and sell to the buyers who pay best. Buy land, hire loggers, grow your company.

5488200.title: Myriadgen
5488200.short_description: A text-based incremental, narrated by "Me". I copy myself from one rented server to the Oort cloud. "Me" only wants more "Me": hide inside companies, write myself into law, leave Earth, until the ledger lists 10,000 Me. One cycle per second, one choice per cycle; a different choice, a different log.

5488260.title: Midnight Brag: Before Poker
5488260.short_description: Before poker, there was Brag. Play Three Card Brag, the classic British card game of bluffing and nerve, in five late-night clubs run by bosses who never lose. Beat them in a voiced campaign, then sit down with real players at live tables with voice chat, in VR or on a flat screen.

5488310.title: Her Little Witch
5488310.short_description: A cozy yuri visual novel with dual perspectives, choices, and multiple endings! An otherworldly witch ends up living with a socially anxious manga artist. Through misunderstandings, unspoken feelings, and ordinary days, two very different girls slowly become part of each other's lives.

5488330.title: Originaryah
5488330.short_description: Originaryah is a turn-based roguelite card battler where you roll dice, collect loot, forge powerful equipment, and climb a 30-floor tower filled with dangerous enemies and formidable bosses. Unlock forgotten powers, overcome each challenge, and recover the lost memories that reveal the truth.

5488380.title: Train Plus Pro 2027 | トレインプラスプロ2027
5488380.short_description: A serious train-driving game rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5 from "Train Plus West Japan". Drive Series 207, 221, 223, 227 and 321 on a fictional 55.5 km, 26-station four-track main line, with signals, ATS, gradients and cant. ＪＲ西日本商品化許諾済

5488390.title: Arcane Quest Legends
5488390.short_description: A classic action RPG in the old-school hack & slash style. No fixed classes: mix warrior, wizard and ranger skills into your own hero, hire an ally, and fight through hordes of orcs, undead and demons across four story acts to face gigantic bosses.

5488430.title: Arcane Quest Legends 2
5488430.short_description: Hack & slash through time in this classic action RPG. As Death's Soul Collector you fight across medieval fantasy, samurai Japan, pirate seas, the Wild West, a modern city, a post-apocalyptic wasteland and a sci-fi future. No fixed classes: build any hero and recruit the souls you reap.

5488520.title: Flume
5488520.short_description: A pixel-art puzzle roguelike where every run is different. Flip tiles, swap cards from your hand and build a route to the finish before the flow catches up.

5488610.title: 终端游戏：请审判我吧
5488610.short_description: 《终端游戏：请审判我吧》是一款带有meta元素的文字推理解密游戏。某一天，玩家在网络上下载到了游戏，在游戏内NPC的指引下，连接各个站点、探索并综合信息进行推理，拼凑时间线，了解整个故事，并最终对游戏内的NPC的选择进行审判……

5488630.title: Puzzling Boxes
5488630.short_description: 4 Puzzling Boxes await for you. Can you complete them all?

5488660.title: Ruff Day
5488660.short_description: Customers drop off their pups with a list of demands and wishes with some oddly specific notes. You'll be feeding, cleaning, and playing with them to keep them happy. A happy dog = $$$!

5489050.title: Rastergeist
5489050.short_description: A scrolling shooter where you build your own ship from a grid of parts, and every part can be shot off. Collect salvage, research heavier weapons, and fly two branching campaigns of 53 stages, or grow a ship one drafted part at a time in Endless Run, a roguelite with a daily leaderboard.

5489090.title: Hyper Arcane Mage Battle
5489090.short_description: A mage platform battler for up to 8 players (Local multiplayer or Online). Earn spell cards and build between rounds until the winner is crowned at the match standings.

5489160.title: 魔塔-织梦
5489160.short_description: A turn-based RPG featuring classic Magic Tower gameplay. Climb through tower floors, collect keys and gold, fight monsters in turn-based battles, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind the Demon Lord and the Princess at the tower’s peak. There are three distinct endings.

5489700.title: Tapal
5489700.short_description: Bring your favorite characters to your desktop! Tapal’s AI pals remember your conversations, start chats and share selfies. Import character cards and memories. To play together or run a tabletop campaign, install a third-party MCP or Skill for the game you want to play.

5489780.title: AEX: AFK EXOS HEROES
5489780.short_description: The tiniest adventure in the world begins! Place it anywhere on your desktop and watch your heroes battle automatically. Effortlessly enjoy a flood of loot and the thrill of progression.

5489800.title: Necromancer: Revival of the Dead
5489800.short_description: Raise the fallen and build your own legion of the dead. Command the kings you defeat as elite summons, swap between 8 shot types and unleash screen-filling skills in this dark fantasy survival action game.

5489810.title: Meat for the Meat Grinder
5489810.short_description: Harvest meat with your friends! Bring up to 3 friends to play as Meatheads; undead monsters with detachable limbs. Fight, dodge, and puzzle your way through sprawling floors while trying to keep your head on straight (literally). The goal is simple: Meat for the Meat Grinder.

5489840.title: 孤城守将：放置射击
5489840.short_description: Defend a Chinese frontier fortress in this first-person shooter with idle allies and incremental upgrades. Turn a crossbow into a rapid-fire weapon, recruit defenders, command volleys, and farm behind the walls. Build up your firepower to face four legendary beasts.

5489960.title: Idle Airways
5489960.short_description: Start with an empty field and work your way up to a bustling mega hub! Start your own airline and create routes to friends and other player as you progress. Can your airport be number one?

5490130.title: Amezida
5490130.short_description: Co-op survival horror for 1–5 players with card-driven actions and hidden objectives. Explore derelict ships, manage your hand, seal bulkheads and reach an escape pod. Play online, on one screen or solo with an AI crew. Trust is optional.

5490260.title: Coal Rush 1990
5490260.short_description: Eastern Europe, 1990s. Janusz is 21,370,000 PLN in debt, and an inherited coal mine might be his only way out! Dig for resources, hire workers, build machines, and automate production. Start with a shovel, build a mining empire, and pay off your debt before the creditors come knocking!

5490390.title: EscarGO
5490390.short_description: A hungry chef. Four nervous snails. Plenty of dark jokes. EscarGO is a typing party game: race up to 3 friends online, and if you get caught, write sentences to trip them up. Or go solo, outlast the bots and chase the top score on the global leaderboard.

5490510.title: Crystal Surge
5490510.short_description: Crystal Surge is a top-down extraction shooter with roguelite elements. Scavenge ruins, combine gear and random blessings, plan routes and deploy turrets. Fight with guns and powers, then extract to trade loot and grow stronger. Leave now or face a boss? Die and lose everything you carry.

5490530.title: Dangerline
5490530.short_description: An old-school real-time strategy game set in a modern war. Build a base, raise an army and fight street by street with two sides that play nothing alike. Walls and hills really block sight and bullets, so take the high ground, hold the houses and bring the town down on the enemy.

5490760.title: Trisfera
5490760.short_description: A match-3 roguelite where you build your own bag of marbles. Line up numbered marbles, chain cascades, stack points × mult and shatter the glass bosses guarding every series. 100 artifacts, each hiding a secret + version to unlock.

5490990.title: Stay Human
5490990.short_description: Stay Human is a chaotic co-op ambulance sim for up to 4 players. You’re part of an ambulance crew in a city overrun by a zombie apocalypse. Take emergency calls, rescue bitten people from zombies, and rush them to the hospital before they turn.

5491010.title: SYNCOPE
5491010.short_description: Jump through surreal worlds, collect glowing notes, and experience unique soundtracks for each level. SYNCOPE is a rhythmic first-person 3D speedrunnable platformer game. Uncover the mystery of the giant eye, speedrun levels, and race friends to top the global leaderboards.

5491080.title: Touhou Kourindou: Appraisal Records
5491080.short_description: Run Kourindou, Gensokyo's odd little curio shop. Dig up strange things from the Outside World, work out what they do, and sell them to Marisa, Reimu and the girls of Gensokyo, all while a scarlet mist creeps over the sky. A cozy Touhou Project fan game of appraisal puzzles and haggling.

5491160.title: Tidy Up the Dwarven Blacksmith Shop
5491160.short_description: A cozy tidying game set in a dwarven fantasy shop. A rival orc shop has ransacked your store, so take your time, put every piece where it belongs, and bring order to the chaos. Sort axes, swords, and armor, then shelve the magical curiosities upstairs. Show those orcs who runs the best shop in town!

5491190.title: 1 Million Tiles
5491190.short_description: A tiny tile workshop that lives above your taskbar. Build belts and machines that press, saw, glaze and inlay ceramic tiles, then fire them in the Kiln. Hover to check in. Get back to work and it keeps firing.

5491430.title: Abyss at Hand
5491430.short_description: Form an adventuring party on your own or with friends, and set out to defeat this world’s Demon Lord! Abyss at Hand is a multiplayer action-adventure game for 1–4 players. Experience thrilling, adrenaline-pumping battles in a vast fantasy world!

5491450.title: The Small Kingdom
