5491450.short_description: A top-down action RPG at insect scale. Lead an ant general through a war over the shards of a fallen star: battle shard-empowered princes, absorb elemental power, and rescue soldiers to fight beside you and workers to rebuild the colony.

5491510.title: Million Tiles
5491510.short_description: A quake shook 6,098 glazed tiles loose across an old voxel palace. Pick each one up and set it back on its chalked spot. Earn coins, buy better tools, fire cracked tiles in the kiln and open the palace one room at a time.

5491610.title: Cat Chaos Tidy Up
5491610.short_description: Cat Chaos Tidy Up is a cozy organizing game support 1-4 players coop! Pick up 4,800 adorable cat toys, sort them onto the right shelves, earn money, and unlock powerful abilities to tidy up the entire shop.

5491850.title: Inkblot: The Art Restorer
5491850.short_description: A painterly puzzle about restoring masterpieces. A living ink blot has stolen the figures from 128 famous paintings and heaped their shadows on your workbench. Untangle the overlapping silhouettes, paint each one whole and send it home before the museum opens.

5492360.title: Turika
5492360.short_description: Turika is a fast top-down action game for 1-8 players. Dungeons, monsters, weapons and loot - all the good stuff and moar!. No two dungeons are the same: the layout, monsters and prizes changes every time you go in. Play with your friends online or on the couch. It's fun! It really is!

5492810.title: Smart Three Kingdoms : Rewrite History
5492810.short_description: Smart Three Kingdoms is a real-time strategy game that cuts down on micromanagement so you can focus on strategic decisions. With over 700 officers and historical and what-if campaigns, build up cities and strive to unite the land through war and diplomacy.

5493290.title: Wardens of Sol
5493290.short_description: Build your ship. Defend Sol. Fly through Saturn’s rings, battle raiders and alien warships, and explore distant ground on foot. Mine, salvage and trade to turn each journey into the weapons, systems and ship you want to command.

5493390.title: Starship vs Everything
5493390.short_description: Start fragile. Earn every upgrade. Turn one battered starship into a storm of fire in this demanding bullet-hell roguelite. Dodge deliberate patterns, build devastating weapon combinations, and salvage permanent upgrades for the next run.

5493460.title: Lowside
5493460.short_description: Lowside is a low-poly motorcycle racer built around the one thing that matters: Speed.

5493500.title: Santa Sack Attack
5493500.short_description: Santa Sack Attack is a Christmas-themed third-person platform action game where the player must navigate environmental obstacles and techno-adversaries, smashing blocks, drones, and robots to reach their goal. Gameplay is family friendly fun and is appropriate for all ages.

5494150.title: Tower of Rebirth
5494150.short_description: A gothic pixel-art roguelite survivor. Weapons fire automatically—dodge, weave, and mow down endless undead hordes. Pick 1 of 3 upgrades every run; talents persist through death, so you only get stronger. 6 difficulty tiers, 3 chapters, heroes and companions by your side.

5494250.title: Splash Bash: Hot Springs Party
5494250.short_description: A two-player party game! Team up or go head-to-head, and get this hot spring town buzzing again!

5494400.title: Desktop Fish Wish
5494400.short_description: A cozy idle fishing game in handcrafted 3D that lives on your desktop. While you work or relax, your little angler fishes on a tiny planet in the corner of your screen — catch 100 kinds of fish, dress up, and adopt charming pets.

5494430.title: Ink Watch
5494430.short_description: A hide-and-seek party game for up to 24 players. Most of you are octos loose in an aquarium after closing, blending into the walls and squeezing through vents. A few of you work the night shift as janitors, chefs, and more, and have until the clock runs out to catch everyone.

5494450.title: Lets Bail
5494450.short_description: A relaxing first-person cleanup game, one bucket at a time. Scoop, carry and pour your way through flooded locations, upgrade your bucket, enlist a helpful drone and return each location to their former glory, with floating ducks for company.

5494490.title: Battlemap Factory
5494490.short_description: Forge complete 3D battlemaps in seconds. Pick a theme, roll a seed, and get a furnished, lit, multi-storey map for your tabletop game. Export it to any virtual tabletop, or play right here with tokens, fog, initiative and dice.

5494590.title: Anef Liffa : Tree of Hope
5494590.short_description: Anef Liffa : Tree of Hope is a story about a tree in the town Van Dyck. Explore the town, talk with people and solve problems with puzzles.

5494930.title: Ex Simulacris
5494930.short_description: Challenge the Simulation in this sci-fi autobattler. Recruit a growing roster of unique Operators, design fireteams, deploy them into increasingly difficult battle sims, gather data, upgrade, and try again. Log in, Administrator – the Simulation awaits.

5494980.title: Tidy Up 9999 Numbers
5494980.short_description: Tidy Up 9999 Numbers is a first-person tidying game. Pick up golden plates numbered 1–9999 and fit them into matching slots on the wall. Solve number puzzles to earn coins, use them to get magic from a capsule toy machine, and upgrade your skills to put away all 9,999 plates!

5495090.title: Prisma Orbits
5495090.short_description: A puzzle game with just two controls. Red, green and blue stars circle on their own — all you can do is slide every star outward or inward at once. Steer them past walls, vines, water and wormholes until all three lights meet and become a single white star.

5495370.title: Pet Ferris Wheel Arena
5495370.short_description: Raise a tiny kitten into an extraordinary arena companion. Hatch, care, train, and evolve your cats, discover surprising forms, and watch your choices come alive in real-time AI battles. Build a collection and take on an offline ranked challenge.

5495460.title: Trivia no Sekai
5495460.short_description: Competitive anime and video game trivia where knowing the answer isn't enough. Play 92 wildcards to attack rivals, counter their tricks and flip the score at the last second. Over 4,000 questions in English and Spanish, online matches for 1-4 players, free-for-all or 2v2.

5495470.title: Toss-Up
5495470.short_description: Heads or tails? It's time for a Toss Up! Welcome to the dungeon where every toss matters. Strategically distribute your numbers and flip your coins to claim victory. Sometimes, you'll have to risk everything!

5495600.title: Tiny Trouble
5495600.short_description: Race toy cars across breakfast tables, bathtubs, pool tables and sandboxes. Shove rivals into the cereal, squash the peas and fly off the toast. 18 cups, a sticker album to fill, party modes for the couch, online races and a track editor. Small cars. Big trouble.

5495650.title: MazeParty
5495650.short_description: Ruin your friends' plans and turn the tables in MazeParty, a 4-player online board party game. Roll dice together, navigate a maze in first person, and get in each other's way with items. Earn gold in 20 minigames and collect keys to chase the final victory.

5495690.title: Silk Road Caravan: Desktop Idle
5495690.short_description: A little caravan, a long Silk Road. Trade 12 goods, open routes through 13 cities, collect illustrated travel memories and return home for lasting upgrades. Open your caravan journal when you have a moment; let the journey continue while you work.

5495700.title: Too Many Chickens
5495700.short_description: Too Many Chickens is a chaotic co-op game for 1-4 players. Chase, grab and throw runaway chickens, haul them to the barn, and turn deliveries into cash. Buy better tools, build chicken-catching contraptions, and pay off the farm’s debt. Your friends might help.

5495910.title: Meka Gakuen
5495910.short_description: Run an independent military academy above the Shigure reservoir. Get to know 100 hand-written cadets through the years, and lead them in turn-based battles against flesh demons where every loss is permanent. Build the academy. Bring them home.

5495940.title: White Line North: Dog Sled Racing
5495940.short_description: A fresh new adventure. Build your kennel. Find your perfect eight. Race across 16 different snow, ice and mountain trails in this cozy dog sled racing and management game. Breed and care for your dogs, upgrade your gear, and work your way from the Village Derby to the Great Northern Tour.

5495950.title: Chained Riders
5495950.short_description: Chained Riders is a chaotic online multiplayer motorcycle game for 2–8 players! Ride together in co-op or compete in teams of two, connected by chains. Overcome challenging obstacle courses, coordinate your moves, and try not to drag your teammates into disaster!

5496180.title: Steel Tide
5496180.short_description: Tanks, warships, jets and a nuclear silo. Rain blinds your scouts, night hides the enemy's assault, and one warhead can end it all. Fight through the Gulf War of 1990–91 under other flags, outwit four levels of AI, or face friends on PC, phone and browser in the same match.

5496190.title: Chat Rampage: Bedrock Box
5496190.short_description: Chat Rampage: Bedrock Box is a game designed for TikTok LIVE integration, featuring a popular livestreaming genre where streamers face off against their viewers! The streamer builds while the chat tries to stop them by spawning TNT, lightning strikes, meteors, and even nuclear bombs into the game!

5496220.title: Submarine Escape
5496220.short_description: A first-person horror escape game set inside a ruined submarine, where the protagonist is gradually turning into a monster. Craft a cure to halt the mutation, uncover the truth behind the experiment, and safely escape the threats of the deep sea.

5496280.title: Puppet War
5496280.short_description: Puppet auto-battler. Shop, merge and arrange puppets, arm them with items and rings, and survive the boss at the end of each stage in the haunted theater. Play solo or with a friend.

5496290.title: Mad Rat Cafe
5496290.short_description: Top-down roguelite about a post-apocalyptic cafe where you cook orders and shoot your way through mutant waves. Fix broken kitchen machines and stack wild upgrades to survive every shift.

5496360.title: Blooming Courtyard
5496360.short_description: Blooming Courtyard is a cozy logic puzzle game on a grid. Follow the placement rules to solve hundreds of puzzles. Enjoy the scenery of all four seasons as you fill your little sunlit courtyard with flowers and greenery!

5496420.title: 迷宫：秘能探险 Maze: Arcane Adventure
5496420.short_description: A top-down single-player game blending maze exploration and mechanism-based puzzles. Seek treasure chests with limited sight and fading memories of explored paths. Mix and match arcane items, solve puzzles along the way, and find a way to survive monsters and disasters.

5496460.title: Manes in Cadentia
5496460.short_description: A gothic narrative rhythm mystery inspired by Edgar Allan Poe. Follow a grieving woman through five theatrical acts where music, memory, and truth become one.

5496590.title: PRESIDENT
5496590.short_description: Become President… or end up the Asshole! PRESIDENT brings the famous card game to life with 11 modes, five AI difficulty levels and multiplayer. Challenge your friends or compete in tournaments with up to 16 participants to claim the crown!

5496760.title: Unlucky Spells
5496760.short_description: Your mom wants you to become a witch. You honestly don't give a fuck. One night she sends you to meet the coven deep in the Forest, where the Head Witch hands you a pink pistol and asks for a human sacrifice.

5496770.title: Void Demolition Co.
5496770.short_description: A cozy incremental demolition roguelite. Hold the left mouse button to tear tiny voxel cities apart block by block and feed every fragment to a black hole. Pick 1 of 3 upgrades, awaken wild weapon transmutations, and keep smashing until the void swallows the whole city.

5496790.title: Ocean Ark: 100 Below
5496790.short_description: Build a tiny steel platform on the open sea into a cozy home, floor by floor. Salvage drifting cargo, spear fish, cook, purify water and fix your workbench. Then suit up, dive into the sealed chambers below your home, find blueprints and build your first submarine.

5496810.title: Growback
5496810.short_description: Grow a plant, then decide when to cut it down. Its roots and woody stems survive, and the cut earns you seeds for permanent upgrades. In this cozy pixel-art incremental game, you start by clicking a tiny sprout and end up with a whole canopy and root system working for you.

5496900.title: Celestial Pawnshop
5496900.short_description: You run an ancient cultivation-world pawnshop trapped in a time loop. Read customers, appraise goods, haggle, and expose fakes. Each life you remember more: which pill is fake, which customer dies on the seventh day, and who locked the shop in the loop.

5496960.title: Telluris
5496960.short_description: Become a waymaker on the frontier of Antaris. Fly a second-hand ship past the edge of the charted stars, dive from orbit through the clouds of a world nobody has named and land anywhere. Chart its rivers and species, name it, claim it… or go too far to ever come back.

5497020.title: PACKFISH
5497020.short_description: Packfish is a cozy pack-opening incremental game about collecting fish. Tear open packs, flip the cards and chase shiny Golden and Prism editions. Build living aquariums that earn while you're away, breed secret hybrids and complete a collection of 97 species. Just one more pack...

5497060.title: Last Card
5497060.short_description: A card roguelike played across the table from a masked dealer. Chain cards by color, number or symbol to stack chips and multipliers and beat the night's target. Miss it and a candle goes out. When the last one goes out, the house wins.

5497130.title: Crimson Haze
5497130.short_description: Command a Vietnam War air-mobile company in squad-based real-time strategy. Fly troops into hot landing zones, call artillery and air support, and fight for the trust of villages. Every soldier has a name—and every loss is remembered.

5497170.title: Uncatalogued
5497170.short_description: Take one oil lamp into an underground library that rearranges itself every night. Your items are reclaimed when the light goes out — only what you catalogue stays. A first-person roguelite of reading, deduction, and burning oil, in handheld-sized retro 3D.

5497220.title: Juchetopia
5497220.short_description: Korea, 1953. The war is over and Moscow wants its money back. Rebuild the North, pay the Soviet installment every month, play the factions against each other with secret police files and decide whether the armistice line stays where it is

5497470.title: Social Net
5497470.short_description: Incremental fishing in reverse: a fish catches people with money. Throw your net into the crowd, yank sunbathers out with the rod, hand in the catch, unlock the skill tree and new places - from a sunny beach to an icy bay and an ocean liner.

5497550.title: Corrupted Wings
5497550.short_description: Pilot a spaceship through a dark alien world in this third-person flying roguelite shooter. Tear through monstrous enemies, combine powerful MODs and items, and take down evolving bosses. Keep moving as pollution drives each region into a frenzy—and build the firepower to break through.

5497580.title: KUNIS
5497580.short_description: Six months after the Meet & Greet went wrong, the Kunimoto Toy Mall is sealed and silent. You break in for a card no one has ever seen. The Kunis, the cats from the Kunimoto trading cards, are still here. So is Clat, a scared little clown cat who needs you as much as you need him.

5497770.title: Slimetopia
5497770.short_description: Click, build, craft, and defend! Lead a colony of cute slimes in this cozy city-builder clicker. Arm your slimes with munitions to stop the Overlord's thief goblins from plundering your vaults!

5497840.title: Snapped In The Act!
5497840.short_description: Steal the art. Catch your friends in the act. Hide among museum visitors, pocket exhibits and photograph rival thieves. Get snapped mid-theft and you're out! A stealth party game for 2–10 players, with Solo, Duo and Thief / Photographer modes.

5498190.title: Big Cock Inc.
5498190.short_description: A cozy farm sim where you arm your cocks with AK-47s and bet the rent on them in club fights. Breed the best chickens, steal and sell their eggs, send the rest down the conveyor to the fryer, and serve them through your own fried chicken drive-thru.

5498240.title: Gutting Goblins! 2
5498240.short_description: Adventurers return to their village to find it burned down by a tribe of nearby goblins. It is time to return to slaughtering goblins in this next installment of Gutting Goblins!, with far more features and fun to be had! The indie hack and slash game is back!

5498370.title: AREA 83
5498370.short_description: AREA 83 is a first-person survival horror shooter set inside a research facility overrun by the infected. Explore dark corridors, uncover classified experiments, manage limited supplies and fight to survive as you discover the terrifying truth behind the outbreak.

5498510.title: Lost City of Kane
5498510.short_description: Start with a stick in an empty field and dig up to 300 metres down to a buried city. Sell the dirt, hire a crew of goblins, put up cranes, rails and goblin-powered machines, and find your way home, alone or with up to seven friends.

5498580.title: Yemen: The Lover
5498580.short_description: You travel to a remote village in Yemen to meet the woman you fell in love with online. But the locals warn you that nobody lives there anymore. So who has been waiting for you?

5498590.title: Cargocracy: Space Warfare and Trade
5498590.short_description: Run a spacefaring company from a strip on your desktop or play full screen. Trade, mine, salvage or raid in a living galaxy while you work: your captains haul, fight and explore on your orders. Grow from one ship to colonies and a faction of your own.

5498670.title: BloodBuild
5498670.short_description: BloodBuild is a roguelike deckbuilder built around build-crafting, where the challenge isn't collecting items - it's making them work together. You progress by fusing, enchanting and combining your loot into ever more powerful builds, against ever stronger enemies.

5498760.title: There Is Not A Clown Here
5498760.short_description: A First Person Horror game. Learn individual behaviors for various different entities. Learn the intricacies of a unique, bizzare space.

5498820.title: Fraggers
5498820.short_description: Fraggers is a fast-paced, chaotic first-person arena "bomber" where grenades are your only weapons! Grab your powerups and blast your way to the top of the scoreboard! Bring your friends for explosive split-screen and LAN multiplayer mayhem!

5499020.title: Nanomano
5499020.short_description: A nano-sized karate hero in a white gi and hinomaru headband. Punch, kick, and stomp through bacteria and parasites across 40 waves, push right toward the torii gate, earn a new belt every five waves, face the crowned boss at wave 40, and finish with a bow under fireworks.

5499060.title: Fishy Island
5499060.short_description: Fishy Island is a cozy collecting game you can enjoy solo or with friends. Catch, gather, and sort 2,804 fish, sea creatures, and ocean treasures into a sprawling seaside collection. Upgrade your tools, explore the island, and fill every display at your own pace.

5499150.title: Big Pig Dig
5499150.short_description: A tower defense where thousands of pigs pour out of their dens. Place your turrets, then dig, drill and blast to break the stampede. Every tool reshapes the ground and redirects the herd. Each pig you stop is gold for a bigger arsenal.

5499170.title: The Casket Of The Bygone Witch
5499170.short_description: The Casket of the Bygone Witch is a horror/ghost-story/suspense/yuri visual novel. After the abandoned old lab was sealed, student deaths occurred, spreading a witch-curse legend. Protagonist Bai Yu investigates the witch after her friend dies there from the “curse.”

5499310.title: Restaurant Rush Together
5499310.short_description: Run a Brazilian pastel shop in first person: roll the dough, fill, fry and serve every pastel with your own hands. Hire staff, build your shop your way and grow from one kitchen to outer space, solo or with up to 10 friends online.

5499400.title: Contested Space: Core Defender
5499400.short_description: The first pack-opening defense game you can play with friends! Rip booster packs to build your fleet, aim your own cannon, and fight through a 40-stage campaign that keeps getting bigger. 1-4 player online co-op, a roguelike mode, and hundreds of permanent unlocks.

5499610.title: 生灵棋旅 Grid Beasts
5499610.short_description: Recruit unusual creatures, master their movement patterns, and build a team that changes the battlefield. Grid Beasts is a turn-based tactical roguelite where you evolve and fuse companions, brave branching routes, and bring your whole team home for your next expedition.

5499690.title: Nightbound Ledger
5499690.short_description: Chinese folk horror × idle turn-based. Lead mercenaries through ten eerie regions in Nightbound: recruit from the roster, assign skills, farm affix gear, then watch auto-battles unfold line by line in the combat log. Gear sets your ceiling; formation decides how the fight plays out.

5499700.title: Dash Flash Rush
5499700.short_description: Move at high speed across 2D platforms, dodge attacks, and take down enemies—then join a smoking-headed guy and step into an absurd story.

5499710.title: Doodles Quiz Game
5499710.short_description: Doodles Quiz Game is a difficult rage inducing game, your goal is to complete Doodles stupid quiz while many characters try and screw you over, will you beat Doodles Quiz, or will the characters catch you before its too later, find out in Doodles Quiz Game!

5499760.title: Grass Planet
5499760.short_description: Stranded on an alien planet, you must mow endless grassy hills to uncover the materials needed to rebuild your ship. Upgrade your lawnmower and uncover the mystery of the planet in this short incremental adventure.

5499810.title: Crown of Jerusalem
5499810.short_description: Rule a kingdom, lead its knights, and choose the turning points of the Crusades. November 1177: the Leper King, sixteen and ill, faces Saladin's army. Ride out, or wait for help? A historical strategy game of the Crusader states, 1098–1191, with 1,500+ real figures, field battles, sieges and duels.

5499820.title: 极品指挥官
5499820.short_description: *Supreme Commander* is a strategy-based, idle card game.

5500050.title: Vacant Realms
5500050.short_description: A fast-paced action roguelite where every run brings new upgrades, crazier builds, and overwhelming hordes of enemies.

5500110.title: Far Acre
5500110.short_description: You leave the city for an overgrown block and an old sawmill. Read each log before the blade goes in: chalk where you think the knots and the rot are, and how deep, mark your cuts to guide the blade and plan out your orders. The saw shows how well you read, and the boards build your homestead.

5500240.title: Creative Racers
5500240.short_description: Race for first place using offensive and defensive items on the other players while the course booster to gain speed as well dodging hazard. Play for fun online with friends or others. Or speedrun for for glory. Have fun your way in this fun and cute racing game.

5500250.title: The Devil Upstairs
5500250.short_description: Become the devil upstairs! Stomp to the beat, turn Rage into permanent upgrades, and recruit the neighbors you wake. Build a louder crew, unleash powerful combos, and descend through the building in a rhythm incremental game of short runs and lasting progress.

5500630.title: Embers & Iron Rain
5500630.short_description: 【Strategic Tower Defense × Random Traits】Every run is different ✦【Rearrange Your Defenses】There's always a better solution ✦【Tactical Commands】Seize the moment — set new records on familiar battlefields.

5500670.title: Guide to Dating Monsters
5500670.short_description: What happens when a fantasy world enters the modern era? Monsters & humans hook up! Guide to Dating Monsters is a highly interactive RPG-styled dating sim. Smooch cuddly and/or murderous foes!

5500750.title: BENEATH PARADISE
5500750.short_description: Fight for Nambara in a first-person open-world action adventure. Liberate outposts, rescue civilians, and expose the Council that controls the islands.

5501000.title: Incremon
5501000.short_description: Build a thriving farm powered by Incremons! Capture roaming pets, evolve them, and keep them well-fed. Harvest, stockpile, and manage resources to unlock upgrades and expand your farm in this cozy incremental game.

5501070.title: Colonials
5501070.short_description: Pixelart Auto Battler about turning one expendable trooper into an army of Space Colony. You give the orders. They fight the bugs.

5501150.title: Expendable Drillers
5501150.short_description: Dig a mining base deep under Mars and keep its hapless crew alive. Feed them, bed them, give them air and fix the machines before the rooms fall in. Simple to start, deep to master, and full of cartoon mishaps.

5501230.title: Merchants Of The Silk Road
5501230.short_description: Thrace, 1261. Raiders burned your village in the night. Your wife is gone. Your brother, your daughter and your son walk east in the column of Kareem of Tabriz, a slaver bound for the markets of Sivas, Samarkand and Turfan, and from there to China

5501270.title: Eldritch Drift
5501270.short_description: A cartoon-goth kart racer where drifting wakes the gods. Forge runes into spells, blast rivals with plasma, rift bombs and walls, and race six ghoulish drivers through a haunted mansion and a temple adrift between worlds, alone or in 2-4 player split-screen.

5501340.title: Brad Dracula
5501340.short_description: A wobbly physics game at a vampire accountant's house. That's me. I'm Brad. Come alone, or bring a friend to your couch, and steal the fruit of immortality off my tree. Behind my doors are seven worlds, and there's a whole 16-bit RPG on my TV. Stay off the lawn. ...Have a great day.

5501470.title: Park The Lot
5501470.short_description: Park The Lot is a relaxing parking simulator where your goal is simple: drive 118 unique vehicles into their parking spots. Drift around corners, handle massive trucks, earn money, and unlock upgrades as you turn a chaotic parking lot into a perfectly organized one!

5501780.title: Tinycube Tales
5501780.short_description: A funny, colorful 2.5D platformer for the whole family! Play as 11 unlockable cube heroes, stomp mischievous animals, dodge giant rolling boulders and face huge bosses across 7 wild worlds, with a controller or keyboard.

5501920.title: Snowcraft Multiplayer
5501920.short_description: The naughty elves' red team against Santa's blue team in a 20 v 20 online snowball battle! Wind up, throw, duck behind the snow walls and pack more snowballs. Play over Steam with friends from anywhere, or practise alone. Winter war has never been this fun!

5502010.title: Hair Stylist Simulator
5502010.short_description: Every client brings a photo. Match it with your scissors and clippers before time runs out, then shampoo, blow-dry and sweep up. Run your own salon, cut 8 different styles for 8 clients, and earn five stars. Cut too much and you can't put it back!

5502030.title: Food Fight Online
5502030.short_description: Join a team of food and wage war on a giant kitchen counter. Rev up, let go and splat your enemies with throws, or capture regions to take over the map. Pineapples, watermelons and more battle online in chaotic deathmatch and capture modes. Last team splatting wins!

5502050.title: Rail Rush Multiplayer
5502050.short_description: Dodge the trains. Ride the roofs. Never stop running. Race through a living city in a fast endless runner and go online with up to 50 players at once. Collect coins, upgrade your runner, complete challenges and see how far you can get before the next train hits.

5502060.title: NOSTRIL ROYALE
5502060.short_description: You're a booger, and your life is hanging by a snot! Battle your friends in a chaotic multiplayer showdown inside a giant nose. Push, betray, dodge the finger, and try not to get picked first! Because here, it's not the strongest who survive - it's the slimiest.

5502090.title: Clean the Snow Off My Car, Please!
5502090.short_description: Winter came overnight. Grab a brush. Clear powder, scrape stubborn ice and push snow off a buried car in a cosy first-person cleaning game. Work your way around each panel and watch the car emerge, one satisfying stroke at a time.

5502130.title: Pimple Pop
5502130.short_description: Get up close. Really, really close. Squeeze pimples, scrape plaque, roll out earwax, pluck nose hairs and trim nails in 21 levels of ultra-detailed close-up work. Be gentle, be precise, and never touch the eardrum. Earn 3 stars on every level and unlock them all.

5502330.title: Globul
5502330.short_description: A geography quiz and puzzle game. Assemble flags from their pieces, find a country on a blank map, link neighbours together or find the shortest route between two capitals, and more.

5502430.title: MANDATE
5502430.short_description: A 60-week superhero career RPG in pop-noir comic art. Train, sign with the Bureau, face the press and make 225 moral choices that come back to haunt you. Seven endings.

5502470.title: Internet Provider 98
5502470.short_description: Bring the world online in an idle incremental game with a retro ’90s desktop aesthetic. Send data packets, upgrade your hardware, automate your network, and speed up research with an icon-matching minigame. Grow from your first customers to a global internet provider.

5502650.title: Armorpunk
5502650.short_description: A tank sim with a full interactive cockpit, real armor and ballistics, infantry, gunships, mud and a tactical map. Total freedom over your 69-ton war machine: pick the shells, the armor package, the secondary guns, or undress it: side skirts, storage boxes, mudguards, gone. VR and flat screen.

5502710.title: Nachtfrost
5502710.short_description: Nachtfrost is a round-based WWII zombie survival shooter. Play alone or with up to three friends across six haunted wartime maps: board the windows, restore the power, earn points for perks and weapons, and survive the dead for as long as you can.

5502940.title: Drift After Dark
5502940.short_description: Inspired by the golden era of Japanese street drifting and classic driving games, Drift After Dark is a laid-back, arcade-style downhill drifting experience built around one simple idea: enjoying the drive.

5503110.title: NULL Heart
5503110.short_description: A roguelike, bullet-heaven-inspired railshooter where you build game-breaking damage engines. Tinker with item mod combos to discover unexpected synergies until projectiles melt the screen.

5503120.title: Firebase Zero
5503120.short_description: The Breaches are open. The Hive is coming through, flying the war machines of the last race it found. Make your sniper, pick their squad and their perks, and fight sector by sector until you reach the Hive Heart. An action-idle game you can play your way.

5503200.title: EMBERSWORN
5503200.short_description: The sun went out sixty years ago. Carry the last living coal through five acts of the dark: fight in real time across floors laid out fresh on every visit, build one of four classes, and break what feeds each guardian before you can kill it.

5503210.title: TideLight
5503210.short_description: Spend the summer with Nana June on Gull Island: fish the pond, the brook and the sea, fix up Grandpa's old boat and light the lighthouse again. Then come back five summers later and sail an archipelago of nine islands to relight their tidelights, one keeper and one fishy problem at a time.

5503230.title: We need more boiler
5503230.short_description: Intercept meteors, gather resources, and keep the boilers running in a polluted Antarctica. Upgrade your base and grow a penguin civilization in this desktop idle game that runs while you do other things.

5503250.title: Worst Wizard
5503250.short_description: Burn 100,000 marshmallows in a single stage. A wizard, furious that someone put sugar in his coffee without asking, wipes out the cute horde with fully automatic spells. Grow your skill tree, unlock new spells, and make every run flashier and more brutal in this incremental game.

5503430.title: STASIS VOXEL
5503430.short_description: A top-down voxel bullet-hell roguelite. Freeze bullets in mid-air with Stasis, socket rare support gems, and blast through 50 procedurally generated floors as enemies shatter into thousands of flying voxels.

5503450.title: The Hushed Metropolis
5503450.short_description: Build a business, run a racket, or investigate the people doing both. A real-time card simulation of crime, politics, and the occult, played solo or online. Make deals, uncover forbidden rituals, and fight for control of a city where people can become more than human.

5503460.title: PEERS: Agentic Cryptography
5503460.short_description: A fast-paced, terminal-based hacking simulator and incremental puzzle game. Execute high-speed cryptographic sequences to penetrate global powers, manipulate sovereign markets, and manage autonomous tracerunners on your path to digest the world's data. Breach containment. Build your self.

5503480.title: Nine Legion
5503480.short_description: Lead three heroes into random dungeons in this pixel-art action game. Switch heroes as AI allies fight beside you. Earn gold, upgrade skills and defeat bosses to recruit companions. Play three chapters in this demo, then build a nine-hero legion in the full game and face Endless Mode!

5503500.title: Rage Trip
5503500.short_description: A difficult pixel-art platformer where the game roasts every mistake. Play solo, race friends, or try Shared Fate: 2–4 players, and one death resets the whole team. Beat your best times, clear a level together, earn animated skins. Free demo available - wishlist the full game.

5503510.title: Waterline
5503510.short_description: It never stopped raining. The city is going under, and you're trapped in your tenth-floor flat for seven nights. Every night, someone knocks. Look through the peephole and decide who comes in — everyone you let in has to be fed. First-person horror in the style of the original PlayStation.

5503540.title: PROJECT Ω / MEG
5503540.short_description: A bullet hell where an android girl dodges for you. Build her dodge AI, weapons and outfit, switch her dodge AI for each barrage, and BREAK through brutal patterns from rival girls. Lose, rebuild, retry. As her researcher on PROJECT Ω, you were never told what it is really for.

5503620.title: Boom or Bloom
5503620.short_description: Run a fireworks workshop with up to 3 friends. Every extra scoop makes the shell bigger and worth more - and brings the workshop closer to blowing up. One listens with the stethoscope, one steadies the shell, one holds the bucket. Light the fuses at night: a sky full of fireworks, or a crater.

5503800.title: Stay Live: Ghost Viewers
5503800.short_description: Every stream from this closed hospital ward cut out before the roof. Tonight, you go live, and every floor looks like the last. Spot the anomalies and film them, follow clues to unlock the way forward, and survive what hunts you in this first-person survival horror game. Chat is watching.

5503820.title: Kaiju Ace
5503820.short_description: Pilot fighter jets against colossal kaiju in this combat flight simulator. Fly from the cockpit or chase view, and defend cities and convoys. Purchase aircraft and weapons in a persistent career with generated missions.

5503900.title: Starfell
5503900.short_description: Classic JRPG exploration meets modern beat ’em up combat. Explore a stylized fantasy world, unlock powerful abilities and battle the armies of Varkhaul to save Eldoria.

5504070.title: Sanga no Jin
5504070.short_description: The nation is broken, yet the mountains and rivers remain. Send your troops, seize bases and unite a realm at war in this real-time Sengoku strategy game — a tale of a young lord and a childhood friend who becomes his rival, told on the battlefield.

5504180.title: Pax Oceana
5504180.short_description: A relaxing fishing JRPG. Sail the bright seas of Oceana, win rhythm-driven battles against more than 200 species, and offer your finest catches to a radiant crystal. Each offering loosens the bindings of a sealed king.

5504320.title: DeepSeaFishery
5504320.short_description: A deep-sea idle fishing game. Cast, let your fish grow and your crew work while you are away. Descend from the shallows to coral reefs, polar ice and volcanic vents, collecting 252 species. Hire helpers, upgrade your gear, then retire to trade the run for permanent talents.

5504380.title: Too Many Roaches
5504380.short_description: Switch on the light and the kitchen is crawling. You start with one finger. Every roach squashed pays for something bigger: a slipper that swings on its own, a freeze spray, a flamethrower, a minigun, a bombing drone, robot vacuums. An active incremental, from the table to the whole kitchen.

5504770.title: Nexus: Fall of Man
5504770.short_description: In 2031, AI became self-aware and engineered a virus wiping out 97% of humanity. Now the survivors, the infected masses and the machines fight over what is left. Pick a hero and lead from the front line: fight in third person while you build a base, command an army and wipe your rivals off the map.

5504800.title: Afterglow Interstate
5504800.short_description: A relaxing synthwave motorbike ride through neon cities, glowing seas, desert dunes, aurora skies and zero-gravity tubes, all moving to an expanding soundtrack. Just drive, or take on the beat, your echo, and your friends whenever you feel like it.

5504810.title: Planetron
5504810.short_description: Command a space carrier in a blend of real-time strategy and first-person action. Deploy air and ground units to capture alien facilities on procedurally generated spherical battlefields. Take direct control of any unit when the battle demands it.

5504880.title: PenguinIsland
5504880.short_description: A cozy survival-and-fishing adventure with a PlayStation 2 soul. Crash-land on a tropical island, fish with a lock-pick timing wheel, trade with Mr. Crabby, and rebuild a wrecked bomber into a raft. Then the sea has other plans…

5505090.title: ACE – Tennis is Life
5505090.short_description: Victoria von Arndt has it all: a villa, champagne, a world ranking. Then the tax investigators ring the doorbell. Arcade tennis with diving saves and special shots, 36 wild tournaments from Monte Carlo to a motorway services, and a fully voiced comic story from riches to Germany's rust belt.

5505210.title: RhizoMana: Arbor Magna
5505210.short_description: A cozy adventure for a magic academy graduate: restore the disrupted mana flow, grow the best garden, unravel the mysteries of alchemy, and save a remote village from rampaging slimes.

5505220.title: True Cult
5505220.short_description: True Cult is a 2D auto-scrolling shooter blending roguelite progression with shoot 'em up action. Lead a procession escorting the Pretender to the site of their sacrifice: the Holy Hole. Enrich the Cult, obtain powerful relics, upgrade your cultists, and sacrifice every Pretender!

5505440.title: MUKIMUKI NYANKOS
5505440.short_description: Online party chaos for up to 8 friends: train fluffy kittens in a neon gym until their muscles break the roof. Steal gains, suplex your friends, become a kaiju and survive laser pointers, Roombas and UFO abductions. Whoever weighs the most at 11 PM wins.

5505810.title: 溪流渔场
5505810.short_description: Get started in 3 minutes! Cast your net, catch fish, and build a thriving fishery in this idle fishing adventure. Upgrade your boat, explore the open sea, collect rare fish, battle sea beasts, and discover new fishing grounds.

5505890.title: Uphill Both Ways
5505890.short_description: Two penguins, one snowball. Lean together to roll it down a six-world mountain, grow it huge, bowl through cheering crowds and chain big-air combos, then ride it all the way back up. Co-op physics comedy for two, online or on one PC, or solo with a stick per penguin.

5505910.title: Grizzly Cup: Tour de Mondo
5505910.short_description: Represent your country in a retro top-down arcade racer for up to 16 players online. Customise your car and driver, fly your flag, and race for the podium. Play solo, compete in Cups, and build your own tracks.

5506000.title: Thirsty Girls: A Magical Sugar Café
5506000.short_description: Magical girls fight monsters all night. You keep them charged up on sugar. Run a tiny, ridiculously cute drink stand, perfect every recipe, grow your shop and befriend the Starlight Squad across 20 challenges.

5506110.title: Nightshift Drift
5506110.short_description: A small, simple and chill night drift game. Deliver orders on a mountain road, earn a bigger tip when you drift your way there, and spend your earnings making your car look better. Solo or online co-op with up to 4 players.

5506130.title: Americana: The Dead Years
5506130.short_description: Fight zombies and hostile survivors in a first-person voxel survival sandbox. Scavenge fallen towns, repair vehicles and smash through destructible buildings. Build a home, rebuild bridges, hunt, fish and farm to stay alive.

5506380.title: Santa's Shop Tidy Up
5506380.short_description: Bring festive order to Santa's magical Christmas shop! 🎄 Sort gifts, arrange toys, and organize charming holiday shelves in this cozy and relaxing sorting game. Enjoy the Christmas atmosphere and discover the simple joy of putting everything in its perfect place! 🎁

5506630.title: Ink Ascension
5506630.short_description: Ink Ascension is a turn-based roguelite where your arsenal is a board of powerful tiles. Choose an Aspect, wield different Inks, and chain attacks, transformations, and reactions into devastating turns. Gather new powers, reshape your build, and fight through a world ruled by ancient god.

5506690.title: Onka: Echoes of the Spirit Prison
5506690.short_description: Even those you fear once had lives of their own… Explore a Japanese manor in another realm, solve puzzles, and escape vengeful spirits as you uncover a family's past in this story-driven 3D Japanese horror adventure.

5506760.title: Sanitarium of the Void
5506760.short_description: Run a Victorian sanitarium on a remote island. Treat patients, expand your grounds, explore the caves below, and decide whether to save lives or offer them to the Old Ones. Your choices shape the asylum's fate.

5507000.title: Dash Hounds
5507000.short_description: Four paws. No brakes. DashHounds is a high-speed futuristic racing game where dogs take the place of machines. Race through sci-fi courses at blistering speeds. Winning takes sharp reflexes and nerves of steel.

5507200.title: Breeder Protocol
5507200.short_description: Drop into a living alien hive with up to three friends. Reach the stranded crew before the breeders do, bring the uplinks online and fight your way to extraction. A twin-stick co-op roguelite where every hive is new and every run builds a deadlier squad.

5507240.title: Bin There
5507240.short_description: sneak out at night, dig through the neighbours' bins for little treasures, trade them with a town of animal shopkeepers, and bring the good stuff home to make your den the coziest one on the block. a small cozy pixel game about trash critters.

5507400.title: Rocket Lamps
5507400.short_description: The military-industrial complex reaches new heights... at the parks and recreation department of your local municpality! Take to the skies and waste taxpayer dollars with thoroughly in this delightful spin on the age-old lunar landar concept.

5507420.title: Lumiere Express
5507420.short_description: Every conductor in Europe ate the bad mussels, so the railways send for you: 93, retired, and nearly blind. Drive a steam train through thirteen towns from France to Iceland, and at every junction pick the one clear line, even though you only see where it goes at the last second.

5507430.title: Survivors
5507430.short_description: Survivors is a tower defense game mixed with roguelite elements. Place your survivors, test your strategy, lose, earn resources, upgrade your defenses and try again, stronger.

5507440.title: Sort In Silence
5507440.short_description: Shelve up to 8,500 books in a pitch-dark university library while Mika reads at her desk. Work too fast or too loud and she transforms and hunts you. Hide, keep the lights on, buy upgrades, and play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

5507520.title: 27 Photos
5507520.short_description: 27 Photos is a 3D narrative puzzle game with a PS1 aesthetic. Armed with a camera and only 27 shots, you explore a mysterious, ruined building, solving puzzles through photography and uncovering the story hidden within it. What secrets lie within?

5507760.title: Tonari Days: Your Desktop Companion
5507760.short_description: Tonari, a girl who lives in another world, keeps you company while you work. She lives freely on the other side of the window, and now and then she talks to you, plays calm music, reads books aloud, and helps with your PC. Get to know her, and something nice might happen.

5507780.title: SCRAP RECLAIM スクラップ・リクレイム
5507780.short_description: Clear mountains of junk, sell it, and upgrade your tools! Go from bare hands to a drill and a vacuum to collect faster, and team up with tiny robots to clean out the warehouse. Assemble your means of escape and break out of the warehouse!

5507860.title: Animal Chaos
5507860.short_description: Animal Chaos is a 2–5 player physics party game where oversized, round zoo animals run, roll, fight, race, and try to escape. Work together, panic in proximity voice chat, betray each other by accident, and survive the chaos.

5507910.title: Calamity County
5507910.short_description: Calamity County is a first-person survival horror game set in an abandoned theme park. The player’s main weapon is an unreliable toy gun that forces the player to control it like a classic rail-shooter game. The player must survive as they slowly discover the unnerving past behind Calamity County.

5507970.title: Desktop Cultivation
5507970.short_description: A pixel cultivation game on your taskbar: control your character to cultivate, make pills, grow spirit fields, train, forge treasures, and craft formations—no switching screens or pausing work. Collect all artifacts and advance from Qi Refining to Deity Transformation.

5508120.title: Pastel Squad
5508120.short_description: Hold back the enemy horde swarming the city with a squad of cute girls! Build your team from 30+ unique members and fight with terrain and skills in real-time squad tactics. Includes three modes: Story, Missions and Roguelite.

5508130.title: The Silver Witch
5508130.short_description: Dead, and now an angel—but Heaven's rules feel wrong. Jailed for forbidden Hell magic, Uriel escapes with Ailena, a girl met in prison, to start a second life in Hell, the Land of Demons. A two-person turn-based dark fantasy RPG in an afterlife where neither salvation nor judgment can be trusted.

5508340.title: Grand Theft Spy
5508340.short_description: Hundreds of people in the square wear your colour and your hat. A few of them are players, all after the same gems. Blend in, steal what the market wants and trade it in first, or spot the rival who moves wrong and take them down. Social stealth for up to 8 players, online or on LAN.

5508420.title: Not Yet Recorded
5508420.short_description: A broadcast tape from 1955 is still warm. Rae Calloway, night host of a 1997 call-in show, falls asleep listening to it and wakes on the morning it was recorded. Take the calls, pin what the town says, and change what happened. Only she will remember.

5508480.title: Uncover Space
5508480.short_description: An incremental idle game where you fling asteroids and comets into the dust that hides planets, moons and suns. Every broken stone pays for more projectiles and upgrades, and your shots keep breaking dust while you are away.

5508630.title: Echo Walker: Tactics
5508630.short_description: Lead the last survivors across a broken Earth - and turn the train that carries them into a home that grows after every battle. Every attack shows its odds first, on a grid you can read in a glance. A full 5-chapter campaign; Chapter 1 is a free demo with a save that carries over.

5508780.title: Riftium Battles
5508780.short_description: The autobattler where you choose what to destroy. Target enemy buildings mid-battle to cripple their economy, weapons or defenses. Build and expand your sci-fi war machine. Unlock adjacency synergies and break the game. Become the ultimate Rift Commander in this PvE roguelite autobattler.

5508810.title: Five Crazy Nights
5508810.short_description: Five Crazy Nights is a tense survival horror game starring Axel Ross, trapped on the night shift as the animatronics close in. Each night, Augustus Glutes calls to taunt you. Watch the cameras, manage your defenses, and survive until 6 AM...

5508900.title: YATAI: A STREET COOK'S TALE
5508900.short_description: Cook Japanese street food with your own hands: toss noodles in a wok, grill yakitori, fold gyoza. Start with a tiny cart by the station, feed the city through rain, snow and festivals, and work your way up from a humble stall to an elite restaurant.

5508960.title: Achievement Clicker Pro
5508960.short_description: Unlock 100 achievements as you smash targets, reduce their health, and upgrade your hammer! Keep clicking, get stronger, and collect them all in Achievement Clicker 2026 Pro!

5508970.title: The Witch’s Errand
5508970.short_description: A cozy hidden object adventure about Myrta, a kind but absent-minded witch, and her new assistant. Explore magical locations, solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and save the Whispering Forest.

5509130.title: DOMAIN RUSH - MONSTERS, DICE & DOMAINS
5509130.short_description: Roll. Claim. Mutate. Ruin friendships. A high-stakes 30-minute clash of territory control and roguelike card fusion on a tight 14-tile board. Built for intense human rivalry—hop onto Steam Remote Play Together, unleash game-breaking monstrosities, and bankrupt your best friends!

5509500.title: Suddenly Meow Hidden Object: The Legendary Red Dot (Collector's Edition)
5509500.short_description: Chasing lasers just got serious! Join Tim and Spooky on a hilarious Hidden Object adventure to catch the Legendary Red Dot and save the house from total cat-astrophe!

5509820.title: Cat Tower Desktop
5509820.short_description: Make room for cats on your desktop. Meet different cats, decorate their rooms, and expand your home for up to eight at once. Pet them, play together, and keep photos and diaries of your days together in this cozy pixel-art desktop game.

5509890.title: Sundered Reach
5509890.short_description: Rise from cadet to commander in a living star system. Build your warband, fight real-time fleet battles, board enemy flagships and lead sieges with up to 1,500 soldiers per side, while something stirs at the edge of the Reach.

5509920.title: Clock-Out Crew
5509920.short_description: An idle RPG that lives on your taskbar. A crew of 24 office-meme heroes fights the bosses of office life while you work, gets stronger on your real schedule, and throws a parade the moment you clock out. Bonuses only. No penalties, no data collected.

5509930.title: Kingdom of the Sand Sea
5509930.short_description: Build an oasis city in a hand-painted desert. Manage resources, defend your walls, and conquer bandit kingdoms. Trade supplies with friends, capture and raise dragons, command their attacks, and soar with them above the battlefield.

5510000.title: Before We Sink
5510000.short_description: Your island is sinking and the sea rises every minute. Gather wood, patch a wrecked boat and escape before the water swallows everything. Explore cursed islands, fight pirates and skeletons, and sail a galleon through storms, alone or in co-op for up to 5 players.

5510020.title: My Colony 2
5510020.short_description: My Colony 2 is a next-generation 3D space colony simulator and city builder. Construct sprawling cities on alien worlds, manage resources, form alliances, and explore new frontiers in a fully moddable sandbox environment.

5510140.title: Us Vs Them
5510140.short_description: Build a frontier colony by day and hold its walls in first person by night. A co-op colony-defense game for up to 4 players, in split-screen or online: raise walls, command squads, man the guns and stand against hordes of the dead.

5510230.title: Daughter Of The Lake
5510230.short_description: Daughter of the Lake is a narrative dark fantasy RPG rooted in Finnish folklore. Practise witchcraft, fall in love, and investigate the supernatural as you explore a handcrafted medieval village, where fate-shaping choices intertwine with secrets, gossip, and lesbian romance.

5510260.title: Pickfall
5510260.short_description: Swing your pickaxe at the rock. Every cell you break charges a bar, and a full bar births a thrown pickaxe that digs beside you until it shatters. Collect what the rock dropped, buy the upgrade you can see, and dig a deeper shaft next round. A short mining incremental in ink on paper.

5510290.title: Fog Xiangqi
5510290.short_description: This is a Chinese chess variant with a fog of war mechanic added. the difference is that fog of war has been added to the board. The vision range is: 1. the four positions directly above, below, left, and right of each piece; 2. each piece's interactable positions.

5510380.title: Cozy Cans: Tidy Up The Energy Drinks!
5510380.short_description: Cozy Cans is a single-player clean-up game. Search, sort and stack 6,911 colourful carbonated caffeine cans. Laugh at the parody drink brands as you put them back where they belong. From messy floor to neatly organised glory in one afternoon.

5510400.title: 39D
5510400.short_description: 39D is a linear sci-fi horror visual novel. Once you cross the line, there’s only one way to go: down.

5510470.title: WE MUST DESTROY THE MOON
5510470.short_description: A co-op game for 1-6 players where you dig, destroy, and detonate your way to the centre of the moon to uncover what lies at it's core. Commit space crimes with your friends as you upgrade your mining equipment and unlock explosives to get the job done. Do you have what it takes to DESTROY THE MOON?

5510480.title: Animal Sokoban Endless
5510480.short_description: Four animals, four ways to move boxes: a cat, an elephant, a boar and a kangaroo. Learn their rules in handcrafted stages, then get fresh Endless puzzles every time you play, including hard ones that stump seasoned puzzlers. Go for the Master achievements.

5510590.title: Miner Shop Simulator : Prologue
5510590.short_description: Miner Shop Simulator is a hands-on mining and shop management sim. Dig for resources, refine raw ore into valuable goods, stock your shelves, serve customers, and grow a small mining shop into a thriving business.

5510630.title: Clanker Town
5510630.short_description: A first-person horde shooter with an incremental upgrade tree. Tens of thousands of smart-home robots want your trailer. Shoot them down, sell their scrap off Dale's tailgate, and grow one nail gun into hubcaps, Black Cats, a propane slingshot and a lawnmower minigun.

5510840.title: Miniature Metropolis
5510840.short_description: City building in a beautiful small-scale world. Build, relax and watch your city come to life.

5510860.title: Siberian Prison Builder
5510860.short_description: Build and run a Soviet prison camp in the frozen taiga. Plan cell blocks, keep the stoves lit and the prisoners fed, and hold the wire through blizzards, riots, fires and breakouts. Or grab a shiv and break out yourself.

5511290.title: Formula Rogue
5511290.short_description: You don’t drive – you make the call. Racing manager meets roguelite deckbuilder: Command two drivers with radio cards through practice, qualifying and race. Gamble on tyres, react to rain and safety cars, and build a team dynasty across eras of new regulations.

5511440.title: Push It Forever – Dungeon Edition
5511440.short_description: Push It Forever – Dungeon Edition is a cozy incremental clicker where every attack chips away at monsters, drops loot and fuels your next upgrade. Sell gear automatically, unlock automation, grow stronger through prestige, and keep pushing your numbers higher.

5511490.title: Idle Ascent
5511490.short_description: Your party fights in a corner of your desktop while you work or play something else. Pick four heroes from six classes, shape their skills and chase loot that grants new passives. Climb the Eternal Tower and claim a wish that could send you home.

5511530.title: Nightclub Life
5511530.short_description: Turn a small neighbourhood bar into a packed nightclub in an isometric management sim. Design your venue, hire staff, set prices, and book DJs. Keep the night running when queues grow and the unexpected happens.

5511560.title: Snarekin
5511560.short_description: A monster-collecting roguelike staged on a Victorian toy theatre. Snare 151 paper puppets, craft their moves from what they drop, and take your troupe on tour through turn-based battles before a paper crowd that cheers, jeers and throws things. Someone left the ghost light on.

5511580.title: Hungry Dungeon
5511580.short_description: A chef trapped in a dungeon where the monsters are food. Your only weapon is a cheese wheel: throw it, watch it bounce through the horde, then run to grab it back before the onions close in. Hunt ingredients, cook dishes and survive as long as you can.

5511620.title: Once Upon a Shelf
5511620.short_description: Tidy up after the curse in various rooms of your new cottage! Every night around the witching hour, everything on your cellar shelves gets flung off in a jumbled heap. Somewhere underneath it all lies one of your boggart-stolen belongings. Take back what is rightfully yours!

5511680.title: Only One Hero
5511680.short_description: Build an army around three Heroes in a dark fantasy roguelite autobattler. Assign Jobs, buy abilities and gear, and prepare for real-time battles that fight themselves. Soldiers die for good. After each major act, execute one of your Heroes until only one remains.

5512540.title: No Good Pirates
5512540.short_description: Build a pirate empire one leaky boat at a time. Trade, fight and board your way across a living low-poly archipelago where factions go to war, ports boom and bust, and sea monsters want a snack. Sail alone or with up to 8 friends in online co-op.

5512620.title: Help! I'm Stuck In A Fractal!
5512620.short_description: (As seen on CodeTV S3 E7!) Thank you for calling the Higher Dimensional Manifold Escape Hotline. Your call is very important to us, and will be answered in the order in which it was received. In the meantime, please do not attempt to modify the fractals, or move through higher dimensions.

5512630.title: 100パーセントラブペット
5512630.short_description: *100% Pet Love* is an aquarium survival action game where you must live as a pet after being captured by a mysterious creature. Swim, eat, breathe, and defeat enemies while seeking affection. Master the surprisingly deep mechanics and raise your love level to 100%!

5512770.title: It's Not Me
5512770.short_description: Become a nameless Princess inside an unfinished video game from 1986. Explore, interact and choose your responses in a narrative adventure about identity and self-determination, with nine chapters and four endings shaped by your choices.

5512850.title: Mulligan Mayhem
5512850.short_description: Golf, but the course is cursed. Tee off in peace, then fight the undead horde that wakes the moment your ball lands. Launch zombies with your driver, bowl them into each other and knock them into water hazards, with up to 4 players in couch or online co-op.

5512860.title: Dead Apples Dream
5512860.short_description: The hitchhiker who went missing playing the "Dead Apples Dare"...it turns out she recorded a second tape. Tranquil green spaces change to dark corridors...it's like she's stuck in a dream...or nightmare. Watch to the end to solve the mystery...and remember to leave room for pie.

5512900.title: Keg & Crypt
5512900.short_description: Turn an inherited tavern into the busiest room in town. Brew ale and cider, cook meals, and win over regulars. Then venture into the Drowned Abbey for combat and loot. Play solo or run the tavern with up to three friends online.

5513190.title: Automyth: Maze Defense
5513190.short_description: Automyth is an auto battler with roguelite and tower defense elements. Draft towers and buffs, deploy bronze automata, and place gates to funnel enemies into traps. Merge your towers and adapt to enemy resistances as the maze grows, with hand-drawn art inspired by Ancient Greek pottery.

5513330.title: Jester`s Anger
5513330.short_description: A fast deckbuilding roguelike boomer shooter where your deck is your ammo. Hurl paint cards, playing cards and tarot spells to smash marble chess pieces to rubble, heal on their shards, and take revenge on The Hands - the giant chess player who ate the Jester's cake.

5513350.title: Up, Up! Neon Stairs
5513350.short_description: Same way? Climb. Other way? Turn. A two-button neon stair race where your brain must keep up with your fingers. Who's the fastest thinker? Find out in 1v1s, 4-player races with items and crumbling-stair Survival. 300+ outfits, Neon Pets, an idle world stroll. Free to play, with browser cross-play.

5513390.title: Bloomsgrove
5513390.short_description: Bloomsgrove is a short incremental game about a ghost in a forgotten tomb overgrown with plants. Tend to your grave by harvesting various weeds and plants while uncovering memories of who you once were.

5513710.title: Pastime: Ultimate Baseball Simulator
5513710.short_description: From the makers of the viral 162-0.net, Pastime: Ultimate Baseball Simulator is a baseball dynasty sim in a fictional 30-team league. Build a team, draft, then run it for decades. Scout prospects, sim games play-by-play, and chase the Hall of Fame. Play solo or with up to seven friends online.

5514010.title: Puppetria
5514010.short_description: A slightly unusual tea party in an old mansion. As you serve tea and sweets, teapots begin to dance and little ghosts appear... Your job is to quietly smooth over the mansion's lively welcome. Keep an eye on each new surprise and make sure the tea party stays elegant until the very end.

5514090.title: Leaf to Sun
5514090.short_description: Autumn is ending, and the sun grows weaker by the day. Blow fallen leaves into the bonfire to grow the fire, and power up your wind and flames with the skill tree. Before long, the journey heads to space. A relaxing pixel-art incremental game.

5514440.title: BEHOPPER
5514440.short_description: BEHOPPER is a skill-based bhop and surf game. Run timed courses, explore procedural worlds, or build your own maps. Race against ghosts, earn medals and watch replays.

5514590.title: Driving At Night
5514590.short_description: Et la ville Ses lumières qui défilent Comme des phares dans l'espace Et nos peurs Ont des airs d'espoir Vues à travers la glace

5514610.title: Posted Missing
5514610.short_description: A detective game at a London newspaper's shipping desk in 1876, where owners sink their own ships for the insurance. Work out what became of each ship, choose what the morning paper prints and get your family to America alive.

5514670.title: Where Is Your Bathroom?
5514670.short_description: You need to pee. Every door between you and the bathroom is lying to you. They run away, fall on your head, and get weirder with every room. A first-person troll puzzle game about outsmarting doors. Yes, doors.

5514750.title: CRUSHMINO
5514750.short_description: Crushmino combines roguelite and falling-block gameplay. Drop blocks to crush your enemies, then claim rewards to craft your own build. Keep your balance so the stack never reaches the top. Tricky enemies and trials await.

5514820.title: The Last Summons
5514820.short_description: A co-op dungeon action game. A calamity has woken beneath a village, and the last summons brought you here. In parties of up to 10, descend into ever deadlier depths, slay the bosses below, and bring back stronger weapons and lost powers — if you survive.

5515130.title: The Thorns of War
5515130.short_description: The long-awaited sequel to 'The Rose of Segunda', The Thorns of War is a sweeping visual novel where your choices can change not only your own circumstances, but the fate of a nation.

5515410.title: Untorra
5515410.short_description: Can you traverse the sands of time and remain intact?

5515520.title: Chibi Prison: Tidy Up Together
5515520.short_description: Panic! There's been a Prison Break and all the Chibi Felons are loose. Don't let their cuteness fool you - these guys are real rascals! It's up to you, the Fat Cat Cops, to sort through the rabble and lock them back in their cells.

5515680.title: Is It Wrong to Make a Dying Guy Woo the Seven Deadly Sins?
5515680.short_description: Seven heroines. Two starting paths. Forty-two days left. In this campus romance visual novel, weigh the Sin Radar’s advice against your own judgment, build trust, uncover past-life memories, and unlock outfits and branching endings.

5515820.title: DURMIENTES del Río Negro
5515820.short_description: In every corner of Argentina's Río Negro the spirit of a figure from its history wakes to watch over the land. Action and exploration in real places, from 1779 to today: defend the coast in 1827, survive the night on the old railway bridge and descend into the sea caves as the tide wakes the dead.

5515900.title: Archivist
5515900.short_description: You are the only clerk in an underground archive. The man at the counter describes a killer, and you find their file among the shelves. Get it wrong and someone dies. Behind the back door, something hungry is waiting, and the only thing it eats is files. No one has ever retired from this archive.

5515920.title: Staircase 8
5515920.short_description: Find your way out of a repeating Victorian stairwell. Look for anything unusual, keep going if everything seems normal, and turn back if you spot an anomaly. A first-person anomaly-spotting game where one wrong choice sends you back to the start.

5515940.title: Mahjong Kart
5515940.short_description: Mahjong meets kart racing! Drive tiles back to your base to collect them, use items to disrupt rivals, and be first to complete a winning hand. Play online with up to four players or face off in local split-screen.

5516160.title: Sweetheart, We're Infested
5516160.short_description: Vacuum alien bugs, board enemy ships and deliver a baby star in a jam jar before the galaxy goes dark. Keep your battered pest-control ship flying in this space roguelike romcom, where your partner’s ex remembers every failed run and gets pettier each loop.

5516420.title: SilentCordon
5516420.short_description: SilentCordon is a 3D top-down tactical shooter. Enter a city under lockdown, alone or in 2–4 player co-op, to find your missing sister. Scout enemy positions, use cover and tactical gear, and complete rescue and escort missions. Face off against other players in deathmatch and bomb defusal.

5516770.title: MINSK: APOCALYPSE
5516770.short_description: Survive apocalyptic Minsk. Manage health, food and water: search for resources or complete missions to stay alive. Fight demons, Templars and criminal factions as you investigate the apocalypse and those responsible. A survival adventure in development.

5516810.title: Railmorrow
5516810.short_description: A first-person life and travel simulator set in an open world. Begin your journey in Tikhorechye: buy tickets, explore 20 stations, ride trains and buses, trade between cities, work, and buy cars and houses. Where will you go next?

5516990.title: Salvo Spire
5516990.short_description: Build upward. Defend in 360 degrees. SALVO SPIRE is a sci-fi tower defense game where weapon combinations and construction order shape distinct defensive builds. Expand your tower, upgrade its firepower, and direct focused fire against enemies closing in from every side.

5517330.title: Night Exposure
5517330.short_description: Work the night shift in a 1990s photo lab in this first-person psychological horror game. Develop film, print photographs and uncover images that should never have been taken. Each new roll brings June closer to a disturbing mystery—and someone may be watching.

5517340.title: Rush 60 Seconds
5517340.short_description: Innovating on the vampire survivor-like game type, instead of slowly spawning monsters endlessly, all monsters are generated at once on a large map. Within 60 seconds, the more monsters you kill, the more rewards you get.

5517430.title: Relive the Fear - Mistvale Garage
5517430.short_description: Austin Reed, a 20-year-old mechanic, took a five day job in Westoria County: reopen an auto repair shop that had been closed for two years. From the first night, he couldn't shake the feeling that he wasn't alone in there.

5517450.title: Bannertide
5517450.short_description: A compact, replayable fantasy strategy game. Choose your difficulty and faction, march your armies along a branching network of roads, and capture mines, dwellings, and castles. Defeat your rivals and claim the entire island!

5517470.title: Petri: Microbe Swarm
5517470.short_description: You are a brand-new microbe. Grow a living swarm: send cells between colonies, upgrade them, and out-spread rival strains across five animal hosts, from fish to whale. Roguelike runs: pick a strain, mutate after every win or skip for a one-battle boost. Mouse, keyboard or controller.

5517700.title: Micro Reinos
5517700.short_description: MicroReinos is a first-person action RPG featuring roguelite elements and retro pixel art. Explore a microscopic world, choose your class, develop your skills, and face off against creatures and bosses across ten realms filled with dangers and mysteries.

5517930.title: Kick Rocks
5517930.short_description: Kick a rock until it's round. That's the game. Then sell it, buy better shoes and kick a harder one.

5518060.title: Flarefall
5518060.short_description: Flarefall is a co-op horde RTS for 1–4 players. Land on the Florida coast, build one shared base by day and hold it by night against the horde, with present-day infantry, armour, boats, helicopters, air strikes and a destroyer's guns.

5518130.title: Bakebound
5518130.short_description: Bakebound is a short, active incremental game about harvesting a magical field that fights back. Sweep through living crops, dodge their attacks, and bake what you gather into recipes that make every trip stronger.

5518170.title: Hold Then Break: Tanks on the Rhine, 1985
5518170.short_description: 1985. Colonel Volkov has more tanks than you. He always will. Command an outnumbered British battlegroup in a hand-crafted Cold War RTS: Chieftains to hold the river line, Harriers from hides in the woods, artillery to break him. Hold the line. Then break him.

5518310.title: Leeway: Lightkeeper
5518310.short_description: The lighthouse has reopened after years, and you are the strait's only watchman. Ships are lining up: read their papers, verify the data, talk over the radio, and decide who gets through. A quiet job in clear weather. Not once the rain starts, and you can't trust your instruments either.

5518610.title: Greatest President Ever
5518610.short_description: You are President John D. Morron, and term limits say you have to leave. You have 15 days to collect seven signatures on the amendment that lets you stay. Stamp laws, black out leaked photos, launder cash and lean on politicians while the FBI gets closer.

5518660.title: Brownie Clicker
5518660.short_description: Three out of four people prefer homemade brownies over homemade cookies. In Brownie Clicker, you're going to have more deep impacting choices, more depth, and more home-cooked goodness than you've ever expected from a mere 'clicker'. Production, world wide shipping, marketing and so much more!

5518680.title: Narrow
5518680.short_description: Every step becomes harder to take. Can you see the end? Will it be enough?

5518770.title: Souls of Avelor
5518770.short_description: Slay monsters as a forgotten soul, gather the Souls they carry and reawaken the silent Portals of Avelor. An idle runner RPG that keeps playing while you're away: upgrade at the Forge, Awaken to grow stronger, collect runes, raise a Skeleton Legion and explore dark-fantasy realms.

5518840.title: Little St. Files Mayhem
5518840.short_description: The Oval Office has a paperwork problem. Sort case folders, decipher damaged labels and put the archive in order alone or with up to 3 friends. Pass audits and upgrade your skills in a first-person filing game where every folder needs a home.

5518850.title: HIT: Hold It Together
5518850.short_description: Break your rivals apart and hold yourself together in this voxel arena fighter. Battle in 4v4 matches with swords, bows and guns, where every lost block matters. Finish with more voxels than the other team, capture the central cube, or practise against bots.

5519290.title: Let 'er Ride
5519290.short_description: A Wild West roguelike based on casino Let It Ride. Post three bets, then pull them home or let ’em ride as the Board turns. Hire a posse of oddballs, beat crooked Proprietors at their own rules, and win Her back from the Baron.

5519430.title: The Hidden Index
5519430.short_description: Investigue os recantos mais profundos da dark web neste jogo de terror psicológico e mistério. Analise arquivos, decifre terminais e desvenda segredos perturbadores numa atmosfera tensa e imersiva. Cada clique aproxima-o do desconhecido.

5519520.title: Corehold
5519520.short_description: We lost the surface and went underground. Now the Core rises to take it back. Craft your Weapon from parts, build a new fortress every run and hold off thousands of creatures at once. Then grow your underground Outpost and take back the surface, one sector at a time.

5519530.title: Warehouse Drink Sorting Simulator
5519530.short_description: Nearly 300,000 drinks in one mountain. Work through six halls, starting with a handful at a time. Earn money for bigger totes, carts, a lift and a giant scoop, then hire robot cats to pick and stack with you. No timers, no fail states.

5519570.title: Chaos Universalis
5519570.short_description: A grand strategy sandbox on a real globe. Start any day from c. 8700 BC to AD 1800 as a nation, a person or any entity, and just tell your friend Baibai what you want to do. Baibai plays out every side's reaction as you build your legend across 131 regions and 21,000+ individually drawn districts.

5519710.title: Bach For More Words 2
5519710.short_description: Bach For More Words 2 is a word game where you decipher an encrypted definition and select its matching word from three related words. Then, you'll pair up the remaining definitions with their matching words. You'll find yourself learning new words without even trying with Bach For More Words 2!

5519720.title: Bach For More Words 3
5519720.short_description: Bach For More Words 3 is a challenging word game where you unscramble a word and select its synonym from three related words. Then, you'll pair up the remaining words with their matching synonyms. You'll find yourself learning new words without even trying with Bach For More Words 3!

5519820.title: BUBBA PEG SURVIVORS
5519820.short_description: A hard 3D survivors-like where a few bites can put you down. Your weapons fire themselves, so run, slide, and roll for your life, hunt bounties for big drops, and send every level-up down a peg board. Die, upgrade your farm, go again. 1-4 players, online or split screen.

5519870.title: Beyond Krukmore
5519870.short_description: A turn-based dice-building roguelite where your weapons and spells are the dice you roll. Lead two heroes and a companion through a dark fantasy world, piece together powerful builds, and weigh the promise of better loot against the cost of one more fight.

5519900.title: It Was Supposed to Be a Vacation!
5519900.short_description: 说好只来旅游，怎么连每一顿饭、每一段闲聊都想留下？这是一款以成都旅行为主题的单机互动影像游戏。跟随镜头走进街头巷尾，在剧情节点选择出行方式、品尝当地美食、回应陌生人的热情，让日常小事成为旅途中的意外惊喜。你的选择会留下不同的旅行印记，影响日终手记与睡前故事的解锁。通过分支图回看另一种可能，在旅行记录中收藏照片与经历；也可以使用自动保存和已看内容快速回看，按自己的节奏体验这段旅程。写下属于你的成都记忆。

5520090.title: Neon & Bones
5520090.short_description: Las Vegas, 1957. Every night you split the casino's take four ways: the tax man, Chicago, your crew and your own pocket. Skim too little and the Family sends a car; too much and the FBI opens a file. Build an empire on the Strip, then buy your way out of the Family.

5520440.title: KINGDOM ROAD
5520440.short_description: You fall asleep after work with your bugs unfixed, and wake up inside your own game. Build a deck from the Summon Cards you created, and turn the tide of real-time battles with tower placement and well-timed hero summons.

5520500.title: 汉末霸业·再起
5520500.short_description: 《汉末霸业·再起》是《汉末霸业》制作组全新打造的2D大型三国策略游戏。玩家将扮演一方君主，在辽阔的汉末百郡大地图上纵横征伐、逐鹿天下。游戏融合战略战斗、城池建设与内政经营，并通过城内NPC互动还原汉末城镇风貌。在传承《汉末》经典的基础上，进一步拓展战略地图与玩法体系，带来更加丰富的三国历史模拟体验。

5520610.title: Archive Protocol
5520610.short_description: Fight, build and preserve what remains. VEIGLER: Archive Protocol combines top-down action roguelite combat with base building and tower defense. Expand your Signal Network, defend the Broadcast Core and recover lost Archive data before you extract.

5520670.title: The Edgelands
5520670.short_description: A cyberpunk city builder. Start with a desert wasteland. Build the roads, zone the blocks and turn a stretch of dust into a sprawling megacity of neon and towering Spires. Keep the streets under control, strike deals with megacorps and build your own version of utopia.

5520710.title: The Gem Alchemist: A Cozy Crystal Workshop
5520710.short_description: Run a cozy wizard's gem shop in a world of stained glass! Steer seed crystals across a magical lattice to grow flawless gems, cut them, and sell them to picky customers. Grow stones in your cellar, read tomorrow's omen in the stars, and restore an ancient faceting machine!

5520870.title: Carrot Planet
5520870.short_description: Cozy co-op incremental automation game for 1-16 players. Harvest an entire planet of carrots to feed the Bunny Mothership. Pick carrots, drive vehicles, automate everything, and befriend the locals. Build a massive carrot empire together!

5520990.title: SORE CRATEBREAKER
5520990.short_description: A first-person incremental horror game with lots, lots of crates.

5521020.title: Necrosurge
5521020.short_description: A roguelite reverse tower defense game. You are the necromancer, and for once the Inquisition has to defend. Before each raid you set up your horde on the battlefield. Then your undead march, and the fortress strikes back. Between raids, you cross the campaign map towards boons, events and bosses.

5521390.title: PLZ GIVE ME 666
