Shape your formation, equip heroes, and unlock a vast tech tree. Battle through four chapters and giant bosses, then rebirth with your gear and unlocked factions intact.

5577970.title: CORN!
5577970.short_description: Shuck corn to buy tools, buy tools to shuck corn. It couldn’t be more simple! Fend off wasps, children, bears, and Mean Gary! Stay inside the garage, you never know what’s waiting outside for you. Uncover all the secrets that this corn holds.

5578020.title: Internet Cafe Simulator 3
5578020.short_description: Internet Cafe Simulator 3 is a first-person business simulator where you build and manage your own internet cafe. Assemble PCs piece by piece, customize your space, and hire staff. Keep customers happy and reinvest your earnings to grow your business.

5578110.title: Waterscape Atlas
5578110.short_description: Not a lake, not a river: the sea, fished the Japanese way. Surf, breakwaters, island rocks and boats on one life-size coast. 40 ways to fish from sabiki to squid jigging, 40+ species, real tackle logic, and every bite through a vibrating controller. Five dioramas included.

5578120.title: Saw Down
5578120.short_description: Turn a tiny robot with a saw into a machine that grinds through mountains of scrap. Gather resources, choose your upgrades, and unleash explosions, flying sawblades, and chain lightning. Grow stronger with every haul and cut your way deeper.

5578150.title: Come Pick Me Up
5578150.short_description: Your sister texts you from a hospital after visiting hours. She needs you to pick her up. Search the wards, follow her messages, examine belongings and piece together unsettling records in this first-person psychological horror game.

5578190.title: Fortress of the Fallen II
5578190.short_description: Build by day. Fight by night. Lead one of six heroes through a branching campaign of thirteen outposts. Rebuild each fortress, carry research forward, and fight beside towers and troops. Then face eighteen nights of Classic Defense and its unlockable challenges.

5578210.title: Slotspire
5578210.short_description: A pixel-art slot-machine RPG. Spin the reels and draw one line through your heroes to attack, heal, and break enemy attacks. Rescue heroes to rebuild your camp, customize your reels with new moves and charms, and risk it all on one more floor.

5578240.title: Okerum
5578240.short_description: Okerum is a fantasy card game of melds, bluffs and abilities. Play five modes (Okerum, Okerum 101, Slapi, Solus and ReFa) against friends, online rivals or clever bots, and turn the table with powers like Freeze, Shield and Energy Thief.

5578410.title: Mop & Plot
5578410.short_description: Clock in, clean up, and watch your back: in this chaotic online social deduction game for up to 12 players, paint walls, scrub floors, and finish the job while hidden Saboteurs wreak havoc. Use proximity voice chat to spot the culprits and vote them out!

5578430.title: Seedborne Chronicle
5578430.short_description: One seed grows a whole continent: towns with their own stories, deep labyrinths, and companions with dreams of their own. Lead a party through quick turn-based battles, grow old, and hand the adventure to an heir as a new foe rises from the last one.

5578490.title: Two Shells Home
5578490.short_description: A top down zombie shooter with a double barrel shotgun and never enough shells. Walk home through a dark, misty forest one stretch of trail at a time, pick your route, grow a six branch skill tree, and get past the Butcher to reach your door.

5578530.title: Bare Metal Billionaire
5578530.short_description: An idle game for people with jobs. A pixel-art data center sits in the corner of your desktop and quietly makes you a billionaire. If anyone asks, you're monitoring the servers.

5578700.title: Nobody Watching
5578700.short_description: Your inner child wants to kill you. A strategy game against cigarettes, sugar, coffee and beer.

5578730.title: No, I'm Not Addicted to Opening Packs
5578730.short_description: Rip open packs in this incremental trading card game! Collect hundreds of unique cards across themed sets, upgrade your packs, sacrifice cards for rewards and complete challenges to earn stars for permanent upgrades. Chase the rarest pulls and build your ultimate collection!

5578770.title: MOONWRIGHT
5578770.short_description: A lunar mining sim where the time lag is part of the game. A new Gold Rush has begun, and you are one of the first prospectors on the Moon. Drive a rover, find and mine lunar ores, and sell what you mine. Use money to upgrade the rover and Moon base. Receive new missions and try your luck there.

5578780.title: DYNASTY: Silk & Blood
5578780.short_description: 1980. You have $5 million and a family name. Build companies, conquer markets, marry, raise your heirs. Rival dynasties never rest and the world never waits. You will die. Your dynasty must not.

5578820.title: Corrupted Seal
5578820.short_description: A dark action RPG in pixel art. The seal that held back the Corruption has been broken. Fight with sword, bow, staff or wand, hunt for loot, grow your seal trees and close the Rifts before the Abyss swallows the world.

5578830.title: The Last Coin
5578830.short_description: Bet your soul against other players in a casino you can't escape. Take turns dropping coins into a glass of whiskey about to overflow, keep your hand steady and cheat with items. Whoever overflows it loses their soul.

5579060.title: AWZ Wrestling : THE VIDEO GAME
5579060.short_description: PLAY THE LIFE OF THE WRESTLERS! Featuring over 25 real wrestlers! Travel the world! Playable in airports, on the streets, at the gym… A complete wrestler experience. Discover a wrestling game different any other you've ever played!

5579170.title: Starfuse
5579170.short_description: A cozy fireworks incremental. Launch shells, pop drifting lanterns and set off huge chain reactions. Every upgrade you buy is a star in the night sky: light them all and rekindle the dead Sun. Short and complete, about 3 hours.

5579180.title: Kesselgrid
5579180.short_description: Turn-based grand strategy on a hex map, set in the First and Second World Wars. Run a nation's industry, politics and diplomacy, command its armies, fleets and air force, and break the enemy front. Play alone against the AI, in co-op or online against your friends.

5579290.title: Broom - The Card Game
5579290.short_description: A solitaire inspired by the italian game "Scopa". Complete the challenges before you run out of cards! Empower your Cups, collect Coins, transmute with Clubs, and cut through with Swords. And don’t forget the Brooms!

5579310.title: Build a Sand Castle
5579310.short_description: Build a Sand Castle. Complete the task from the rich man and earn yourself 1M Dollars. The Castle is Enormous so you will be here for a while... But it would be faster if you used the Abilities and "Sugar" the man gave to you.

5579400.title: Galaxization
5579400.short_description: A galaxy and civilization simulator on your Windows wallpaper. While you work, civilizations sprout, rise, trade, fight and fall among 200,000 stars. Pick the view: the whole galaxy, the black hole, a star system, or the sky from a planet's surface. Built in Rust: light on CPU and battery.

5579420.title: Crown & Courtiers
5579420.short_description: Rule a medieval kingdom through the people around your throne. Hear petitions, bargain with nobles and clergy, and take part in hunts, tournaments and feasts. Manage supplies, weather crises and pass the crown—and your unfinished promises—to the next ruler.

5579450.title: Escape from the abandoned mansion haunted by spirits!!
5579450.short_description: Kanae Yamada, a reporter for an occult magazine, visits a vast Japanese mansion abandoned for over 20 years and now notorious as a haunted location. Trapped inside, she must solve mysterious puzzles, uncover the intentions of an unseen presence, and find a way to escape.

5579530.title: Dragonwing-Rampage
5579530.short_description: Unleash your fury and blast through enemy lines! Dragonwing Rampage is a 2D bullet hell roguelite. Catch wild beasts, raise dragons, and build a ranch on your sky island. Gear up, dodge through bullet storms, and stack blessings to unleash the firepower you need to defend your home from the Void.

5579920.title: White Lotus: Vows Beneath Heaven
5579920.short_description: A historical narrative management game set in eighteenth-century China. Guide a White Lotus community through fragile livelihoods, conflicting loyalties, and promises that come due. Plan each turn, care for your companions, and shape the lives they leave behind.

5579970.title: Sprinkle Gnomes
5579970.short_description: Sprinkle Gnomes is a cozy first-person co-op game about bringing the scorched badlands back to life. Find hidden wells, build watering automations and ride camels across the dry land until grass springs up again. Play solo or team up with friends and turn every dusty corner green.

5580030.title: Secret of Nox
5580030.short_description: Immerse yourself in this action roguelike game, turn defeated enemies into your minions. Explore 12+ unique classes, endless playstyles, battle through 50+ maps, epic bosses and discover the Secret of Nox.

5580080.title: Void Drive
5580080.short_description: Chain your cars together and drive across roads hanging over the void. If one falls, everyone falls. Jump, crash and laugh through 17 trap-filled worlds with up to 3 friends online, or go solo and chase your best time.

5580090.title: Monolith Zero - An Incremental Odyssey
5580090.short_description: A pixel art incremental game of mining and drones. "Captain, the mothership has lost control near an unknown structure. We're stuck. It's pulling iron-laden asteroids towards us… It seems to want to help us."

5580140.title: SpaceVivor
5580140.short_description: Lost beyond a wormhole, command a modular starship in a survival game that aims for the realism of time passing in space: long, relaxing voyages, adrenaline-fuelled battles, countless discoveries and incredible alien scenery. Rebuild your ship module by module and lead a crew of four races.

5580180.title: SERPENTER
5580180.short_description: A fast, colorful 3D snake adventure across 9 floating worlds and 63 levels! Dodge crumbling floors, slippery ice and wild hazards, unleash power-ups, tackle endless runs and daily challenges, or play with up to 4 friends. Help Zip find Ray!

5580310.title: Tonald Dump: Make News Fake Again
5580310.short_description: Lead Tonald Dump through a satirical, turn-based presidential campaign! Manipulate the media, influence voter groups, build political connections and navigate 600+ events across four campaign stages. Control the headlines. Win the election!

5580450.title: 牛马的涌现
5580450.short_description: A lightweight idle management game that lives along the bottom of your desktop. Hire quirky workers, pair them up to discover new offspring, collect breeds, traits and coats, decorate the office, and expand your company while you work.

5580470.title: Touhou Chihaya Battle Festival
5580470.short_description: A fan-made Touhou Project 5v5 and 3v3 multiplayer battle game. Most of the Touhou cast is here, with free choice of items, lanes and skill loadout. Even leaving mid-match is free: something came up? No problem, your teammates take over your character. Oh, and a rabbit delivers your items.

5580500.title: The Ashen Crown
5580500.short_description: A roguelite tower defense where towers are empty vessels and runes are the build. March across a generated world, socket the loot you find, and play every wave with the Crown's own abilities. When you fall, only the Worldtree remembers, and it opens new ways to play, not bigger numbers.

5580510.title: Beyond 33 Days
5580510.short_description: A story-driven, top-down survival shooter spanning thirty-three days of a collapsing city. Follow Su Nuan and Lin Shen, fight the infected, gather supplies, upgrade weapons and defend a shelter at night as you search for a way back to each other.

5580660.title: DELTA // SURGE
5580660.short_description: DELTA // SURGE is an action roguelike bullet hell shooter with deckbuilding. Draft cards mid-run, fight 30 waves of enemy fleets and bosses, and unlock new Flight Frames and permanent upgrades to push your next run further.

5580860.title: Mars Divided
5580860.short_description: A turn-based grand strategy game about factions fighting over Mars. Research technologies, trade with Earth, wage war and forge alliances, push laws through your parliament, ride out dust storms. And beneath it all live tens of thousands of colonists — and the game simulates every one.

5580910.title: Spellthief: The Borrowed Galaxy
5580910.short_description: Steal the powers of every enemy you defeat. Combine them into your own constellation, dodge bullet-hell patterns, and take down towering guardians in a top-down sci-fi roguelike. Bring back the dawn.

5580940.title: Decorate with flowers
5580940.short_description: Decorate with flowers is a cozy, stress-free tidy up game where you arrange vibrant plants, fragrant blossoms, and aesthetic decor onto shelves. No timers, no rush - just pure floral bliss.

5581010.title: Someone Else's Number
5581010.short_description: Your new phone number used to belong to someone else. At 2:14 AM, a stranger still writes to it. A romance played entirely on your phone in 2011: make friends, fall for someone, and decide what to do with a secret that was never meant for you.

5581020.title: Fishlings: A Cozy Fish Collector
5581020.short_description: A cozy idle aquarium where every fish comes out of a card pack. Rip packs, flip cards, chase the 1-in-1,000 Prismatic and collect 80+ odd little fish in four variants. Your tank keeps growing and earning while you're away, or swims in a tiny window on your desktop while you work.

5581150.title: Aevalore 2
5581150.short_description: Fight through the world of Aevalore II, a fast action roguelike. Pick your hero, build your skills, defeat giant bosses, and survive alone or with friends in online co-op

5581170.title: Heartwood TD
5581170.short_description: A maze tower defense roguelite where every tower is also a wall. Plant Wardens to shape the path the nightmares walk, combine their powers into chain reactions, and grow a stronger maze with every run.

5581240.title: Soul Gear
5581240.short_description: A retro-evolved 3D Metroidvania that fuses the fast-paced third-person shooter gameplay with strategic RPG spellcasting! Play as Auruma, a soldier from the steampunk town of Iron Junction, and uncover the mystery surrounding her people as they realize their reality is a lie.

5581250.title: Full Bleed
5581250.short_description: A knight doodled in the margin of a cursed bestiary wakes unarmed in a plague abbey overrun by its monsters. Cleave, shoot and bleed through four episodes of fast, gory boomer-shooter carnage, drawn in heavy stylized comic ink and dither, where blood is the reddest thing on the page.

5581340.title: Moenie Kyk Nie
5581340.short_description: Inherit your late oupa's farm in the South African Karoo and clean it out to sell. Rebuild childhood memories you lost through old portraits, Afrikaans tapes and flashbacks that turn the house new again. Follow his handwritten rules. Above all: moenie kyk nie. Don't look.

5581370.title: FIRMWARE
5581370.short_description: FIRMWARE is an assembly programming puzzle game. Challenge yourself with hundreds of puzzles and different game types: Multi-core systems with shared buses and I/O pins, programming microcontrollers driving circuits, shuffling instructions to fix programs, and large programs for encoding messages.

5581540.title: Pixel Life
5581540.short_description: A cozy pixel-art life sim. Start in a tiny studio, make friends with twelve townsfolk, adopt a dog, climb eight careers, collect cards for a full card game inside the game, and decide what to do with your money at the bank. Your life, your way.

5581620.title: Idleplace
5581620.short_description: Place hovering land on your sky island. Close a region to construct your buildings, then muster an army to fight the invaders landing. Collect gear from bosses as well as gaining gear in village. In battle turn on auto and your island fights on while you're idle, even floating on your desktop.

5581640.title: Until You’re Better
5581640.short_description: A first-person ASMR game in a wellness center in orbit. Every real day your nurse gives you a check-up: follow her light, guess sounds with your eyes closed, tell her which ear a sound was in. Progress your treatment to unlock new activities and more of the center. No ending, only unwinding.

5581670.title: Moorhouse
5581670.short_description: First-person horror for up to four players on a remote farm in the moors of northern Germany. Work together as survivors or play as the Moorfrau. Repair three pumps, drain the moor and burn her heart before the fifth night ends.

5581690.title: Doodle Survivors
5581690.short_description: Fight through 10 stages in a survival roguelite full of stick figures, monster hordes and ridiculous weapons. Attacks fire automatically: you dodge, collect upgrades and discover powerful evolutions. Earn gold, recruit new characters and build up permanent upgrades.

5581730.title: Phantom Shapes
5581730.short_description: An online co-op horror party game for 2 to 7 players. The Phantom hides a cursed shape that looks like a normal object and protects it. Up to 6 Workers search the map, argue about which thing is fake and confirm it before the Phantom catches them all. No microtransactions.

5581770.title: Kid on Couch Quest
5581770.short_description: Welcome to Kid On Couch Quest – an action-packed 2D platform shooter where adorable characters face dangerous monsters, powerful bosses, and tons of loot! Fight your way through hordes of monsters alone or with your friends, or challenge each other in thrilling arena battles!

5581820.title: Couch Potato
5581820.short_description: A collection of party games for up to sixteen people on one TV, with the phones already in your pockets as controllers. Hop on the couch, scan the code and you're in. Fight, fish, feast, hop and scrum, and unlock new weapons, arenas, pets and rods as the night goes on.

5581850.title: The Last Duck
5581850.short_description: The Last Duck is a top-down roguelite shooter where you play as a rebellious duck battling hordes of farm animals. Wield up to 6 weapons, collect powerful items, create unique builds, and fight your way through the farm and into the wild!

5581890.title: Warelings
5581890.short_description: A tiny 2000s gadget that lives in the corner of your desktop. Feed your Ware, take it on walks and send it into battle while you work. Every creature is a post from an internet forum that no longer exists.

5582080.title: Assassins for Hire
5582080.short_description: Four mercenaries, six contracts, one plan. Sneak, distract, knife and sabotage your way through guarded compounds in a real-time tactics game in the classic style, solo or with up to four players in online co-op.

5582130.title: Christmas TCG Tidy Up Together
5582130.short_description: Tidy up nearly 5,000 festive trading cards scattered across the floor of a Christmas TCG store, solo or with up to two friends online. Clean your finds and complete 15 festive sets in regular and holo finishes. Earn coins for boosters packs, hunt for exclusive rare cards.

5582230.title: On The Come Up
5582230.short_description: Start small and work your way up in On The Come Up, a co-op crime game about making money, stealing cars, dodging police, and building a home for your crew. Follow a story that gets personal, or take a break from the missions and see what you can get away with around the city.

5582240.title: Total Chemistry
5582240.short_description: A chemistry study app for the MCAT and General Chemistry, with over 6,800 practice items, a lesson for every topic, flashcards and mock exams. It also includes Life Support, a game where you keep an orbital station breathing with real chemistry.

5582360.title: AstroTec
5582360.short_description: Build a ship out of snap-together blocks & fly it on its own thrusters. Mine the rocks, fight the raiders, then pull the blocks off whatever you beat & bolt them onto your own ship. Bring friends, dock your ships together & fly them as one.

5582380.title: Dread Arcana
5582380.short_description: Descend beneath the Ash Mountains in an isometric action roguelike. Fight with sword and bow, explore procedural dungeons, and defeat the guardians of four realms. Choose one of six heroes and venture alone or in local co-op for up to 4 players.

5582390.title: Dynasty Divided: A Three Kingdoms Saga
5582390.short_description: Unite a shattered Han China in 190, 194, 200 or 208 AD. Govern cities, raise spearmen, swordsmen, archers, cavalry and catapults, court allies and betray them. Every officer has a face, a history and a grudge. Turn-based grand strategy with tactical hex battles. Single player, no microtransactions.

5582410.title: VERDANT — Forest Archer
5582410.short_description: Turn one arrow into a storm. Dodge attacks, scoop up gold, and build a bow that fires piercing, ricocheting volleys in this top-down incremental action game. Choose from three archers and fight your way through five areas, one short round at a time.

5582430.title: Death Draft
5582430.short_description: A team FPS where every round adds a new bad idea. Draft cards that give enemies huge heads, turn you into a giant or bend the fight in your favor. Everyone gets the same weapons. The cards are up to you. Play with friends or bots in matches up to 5v5.

5582460.title: The Water Listens
5582460.short_description: Every splash gives you away. Something lurks in the water, listening for your next move. Stay quiet, stay together, and pray it finds someone else first. Water Listens is a co-op horror game where the water carries your sound and the monster follows.

5582500.title: Toy or Not ?
5582500.short_description: Toy or Not ? is an online hide-and-seek party game for up to 8 players. Sneak around as a toy, collect batteries, and rescue your teammates—or play as a kid, spot suspicious toys, and send them back to the toy box. Turn an ordinary room into a playground of sneaky tricks and surprises!

5582660.title: INTAKE
5582660.short_description: Cut tape, adjust the scales, and label boxes in a small underground inspection room. Compare each delivery with its sample: Intake or Detain. Complete eight inspections a day for eight days. One wrong decision sends you back to that morning.

5582710.title: Gun Party
5582710.short_description: Roll for stars. Sabotage your friends. Gun Party packs 5 boards and 79 mini-games into one chaotic party night, from cart crashes to crew disasters and horror rounds. Play with 2–10 online or up to 4 in couch split-screen. Full controller support. Add bots to any match.

5582740.title: Secret Shelter
5582740.short_description: Once a corporate tycoon, you now run a shelter in a nuclear wasteland. Use cards at your corporate terminal to oversee production and research. Decide who you can spare for expeditions, fight with skill cards, and choose which survivors to trust as you piece together the truth behind the war.

5582750.title: HEIRS OF VARNA 灰冠の継承者
5582750.short_description: Command Aster and her companions in a turn-based tactical RPG told across 24 chapters. Read enemy ranges, choose who crosses first, and make good on a promise to a child waiting at the border gate.

5582780.title: Pawprint Trails
5582780.short_description: Solve cozy animal logic puzzles and help little friendships bloom. Find every friend's place across 128 puzzles, create ten shared sanctuary projects, and collect memories of picnics, stargazing, baking, and more.

5582790.title: Competition
5582790.short_description: Coach a college track & field and cross country program in a shared online world. Recruit athletes, plan their training, enter them in meets and watch them race live against other coaches' teams. Seasons follow the real calendar: one game day is one real day.

5582870.title: Suck It Dry! with Your Friends
5582870.short_description: Your boss wants the ocean empty. You get a teaspoon. Scoop, schlep and sabotage your way through an impossible job with up to 16 friends – but one of you secretly works for NEPTUN Resorts and wants the sea to stay full.

5582900.title: One More Potato
5582900.short_description: One More Potato is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort over 2,000 potatoes into their correct places across a countryside farm. Pick up potatoes, complete collections, unlock helpful upgrades, and turn a messy farm into a perfectly organized potato paradise, solo or with friends.

5583080.title: NEW COLD WAR
5583080.short_description: Lead the United States or China in a turn-based strategy board game. Play cards, expand your influence, and compete across six regions while managing the technology race and a global crisis that could end the game.

5583160.title: Outpost Survivors
5583160.short_description: Build your defenses, recruit survivors, and fight relentless zombie hordes! Upgrade weapons, manage resources, command your team, or take direct control of a survivor. Battle through dangerous environments, survive special events, and face increasingly powerful enemies and bosses.

5583220.title: You Said Last Wave
5583220.short_description: “Didn't you say this was the last wave?” The guns are still firing as another horde scales the wall. Auto-battling meets tower defense: combine machine guns, shotguns, fire, and chain lightning while your soldiers fight on their own. Can your setup hold until the last wave?

5583240.title: If you die, you die!
5583240.short_description: A one-life horror game inside the corpse of God. Photograph what lives in the dark. Die, and you can never play again.

5583420.title: Planet Defender
5583420.short_description: An incremental shooter about protecting Earth from meteor storms. Upgrade your rockets, build an orbital arsenal of lasers, railguns and moons, and get strong enough to face the Titan.

5583560.title: Stone Gambling Simulator
5583560.short_description: Start from a street stall. Pick stones, read them under a flashlight, haggle, cut, craft, and price your jade. One cut can make or break you — win it with an eye for stone and a tight ledger.

5583630.title: Desperate City
5583630.short_description: The primary objective involves entering a battlefield where a toxic zone continuously shrinks, forcing you to contend with over a hundred other enemies—you must evade them and attempt to eliminate everyone else to secure victory.

5583750.title: Tavern of Tells
5583750.short_description: A social deduction game where you uncover the lucky number of each hero gathered at the tavern! Read their clues, work out who is lying, and place enchanted coins across 100 levels. Correct matches stay put, so every deduction brings you closer.

5583880.title: Cartastrophe
5583880.short_description: CARTASTROPHE is a party game for 1–4 players, streamed live as the internet's most exciting death game. Crash, shoot and stab your way through minigames for likes, and survive the Final Showdown to walk out famous.

5583980.title: Six Kingdoms: Eternal War
5583980.short_description: Six Kingdoms: Eternal War is a fantasy card battler about six races at war: humans, undead, elves, dwarves, demons and elementals. Build your deck and lead your hero through a campaign of battles and bosses, or fight real players in the ranked online Arena and its tournaments.

5584020.title: PAEBACTORY
5584020.short_description: A 3D automation game in an asteroid belt for 1 to 4 players. Mine and crack open asteroids, automate production with belts and drones, and keep your turrets supplied when announced raids hit, even while you work in another sector.

5584050.title: AI Mogul
5584050.short_description: AI Mogul is a management sim about running an AI company. You start with a small team, find enough GPUs and power to train your models, and then try to sell them in a market where several other AI companies want the same customers.

5584110.title: PixelHeroLegend
5584110.short_description: Build a team of heroes in this pixel-art idle RPG. Collect equipment, adjust tactics, explore regions, and take on enemies in automatic battles.

5584340.title: Drive Beyond Horizons City
5584340.short_description: Driving a vehicle over long distances requires a significant amount of supplies. While cities contain plenty of resources, they are also swarming with zombies and mercenaries; the plan is to drive toward the outskirts of the city.

5584390.title: Of Bells and Hills
5584390.short_description: Leave the city behind for a shepherd’s life in the Taurus Mountains. Guide your flock to fresh pasture and water, keep watch with your Kangal, and bring your sheep safely through the night. A single-player shepherding sim rooted in Anatolian highland life.

5584670.title: Hide & Prey
5584670.short_description: Night falls on the orphanage, and the nun has awakened. In this 1 to 5 player cooperative horror game, hide, run, and unite to escape before she catches you. The slightest noise can betray you. Play as the orphans, or embody the nun and hunt your friends.

5584840.title: Sort the Bazaar
5584840.short_description: Sort The Bazaar is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort a variety of items and bring life and color back to a faded roadside market. Unlock new skills, automate tasks, and enjoy the satisfying process of turning a dull, messy bazaar into a vibrant, organized marketplace at your own pace.

5584920.title: TILELIA
5584920.short_description: Collect cards, place buildings, and forge your own army in this roguelite auto-battler. Combine units, spells, and relics from different factions. Make the most of limited space and gold, and discover new combinations to overcome each battle.

5584940.title: Tanks 2026
5584940.short_description: A tank battle in the spirit of old 8-bit games. Hold the base across 35 stages or in RANDOM mode, where enemies hunt you down. Clear stages clean to earn rewards you keep for good. Play solo or with a friend, in pixel art or HD.

5584970.title: Don't Sell the Cat
5584970.short_description: Seven nights behind the counter of a pawnshop that opened in 1958. Check what people bring in with a loupe, a UV lamp, a scale and the shop cat. Pay the rent. The ledger writes lines you didn't write, and someone knocks on the back shutter after closing. Don't open it.

5584980.title: Trivia Arena: The Grand Stage
5584980.short_description: A party trivia game show on a grand velvet stage. Up to 8 friends join with their phones as controllers: no app, just scan the QR code. Answer wrong and your plush drops through a trapdoor. Three game modes, thousands of questions, seasonal events and online play with friends.

5585000.title: Lights Out Pact
5585000.short_description: Lights Out Pact is a multiplayer hide-and-seek game. Everyone hides a random item in a freshly generated room, then searches for others'. You can't take your own. Miss an item and lose a body part. Last one standing wins. Modes: find everything, hunt your target, or last one to find loses.

5585060.title: Videogame Automation Engineer
5585060.short_description: In this visual programming game, you become a video game tester for different clients. Using intuitive image sensors and logic wiring, you automate a vast collection of minigames to make your circuit press the right virtual gamepad buttons at the right time.

5585090.title: Mine a Little
5585090.short_description: Mine a Little is a fun and relaxing mining game! Control your pickaxe with your mouse, smash rocks, and collect valuable ores! Upgrade your pickaxe, break tougher rocks, and unlock new mining areas as you work your way toward becoming the ultimate miner!

5585140.title: The Dungeon
5585140.short_description: An idle RPG in pixels: your hero fights, shops and descends on its own, even while you are away, through 600 floors in three realms. On Mythic every archfoe has an ability of its own, and you fight it yourself. Twelve classes, no ads, money only buys looks.

5585200.title: Twenty Till Him
5585200.short_description: Kidnapped by a serial killer. Twenty seconds per room. Four ways out, and only one lets you live. Read the dust, the draft, the blood and the silence, then choose before the masked old man comes back. One mistake and you wake up tied in the first room again. 100 rooms. One house. No happy ending.

5585310.title: MAGOS
5585310.short_description: Master your spells and stay one step ahead of your rivals in simultaneous turn-based wizard duels. Combine elements that react with each other and transform the environment, unleashing chaotic battles. Discover powerful combos that could wipe out your enemies... or backfire on you!

5585360.title: 200 OK
5585360.short_description: A node-based idle game about running a server. Wire up requests, tune the bottlenecks, research your way from one uplink to a global edge. Calm, steady and fully offline-friendly.

5585770.title: Motkin
5585770.short_description: Charge pistons, grow bridges, and turn gravity sideways. Guide Motkin, a one-wheeled maintenance robot, through 75 handcrafted physics puzzles by clicking the machinery around him and figuring out how its parts work together.

5585850.title: My Tennis Story
5585850.short_description: 🎾 Learn real tennis tactics and choose your shots. 🤝 Train, make friends and shape Mateo’s story. 🏆 Climb the leagues and win a tennis scholarship before he turns 16.

5585860.title: SEE YOU ON THE ROOF
5585860.short_description: August 31. The lift is broken again, and your friends are on the roof waiting for the last sunset of summer. Tonight your neighbours are out on the landings, and each of them has something to say to you. Hurry. The sun won't wait.

5585980.title: Bibliopyre
5585980.short_description: A magical storm and a goblin horde tore a million forbidden pages from the Great Library. As the Warden Mage, burn them all: sweep piles with waves of fire, send ash flying home, and hear every book chime into place to the beat of the music.

5586070.title: FYOF: I Swear I Didn't Download That
5586070.short_description: Your files are coming for you! Become a weaponized Recycle Bin, blast endless waves of hostile data, collect powerful perks, and survive the ultimate digital apocalypse in this chaotic bullet heaven roguelite!

5586130.title: Sluismaker
5586130.short_description: Build a blocky warship in your own dry dock, flood the dock and hope it floats, then sail out and sink the enemy. Real buoyancy and flooding physics, cannons, rams and grenades, and crews of up to 5 per side online, over LAN or against AI captains.

5586170.title: Ashenreach
5586170.short_description: Home lies in ashes. Follow a fallen star into Ashenreach, an old-school online RPG for small groups: tab-target combat, 4 classes, 260 voiced quests, dungeons, a raid, 14 crafts, your own home. Closed playtest: December 2026, dates to be announced.

5586190.title: Elf Raid!
5586190.short_description: Storm the castle with a band of brave little elves and rescue Fairycorn before Sir Grumblebottom marries her! Couch co-op for 1 to 3 kids aged 3 to 10: pick a boy or girl elf in your own colours, choose your own difficulty, and nobody gets left behind.

5586200.title: CTRL+ALT+BURN
5586200.short_description: Keep the company online. Avoid the boss. CTRL+ALT+BURN is a chaotic co-op IT game for 1 to 6 players: reboot crashed servers, swap dead disks, answer the helpdesk, put out the microwave fire and climb a 60-floor office tower, one shift at a time.

5586210.title: Midnight Debt
5586210.short_description: A first-person night shop sim set in a town swallowed by fog. Read the news, stock up, haggle with strangers and serve shady buyers to pay off your debt. At 04:30 the street lamps begin to die. At 05:00 the fog takes anyone still outside.

5586370.title: Strange Plains
5586370.short_description: Roam as a buffalo through seven strange eras in this single-player action roguelite. Graze to survive, restore the prairie, and protect a growing herd. Face hunters, cryptids and visitors from above, then carry your surviving family home to the Wallow.

5586390.title: Can We Cook?
5586390.short_description: Get ready to run a chaotic restaurant with your friends! Three friends: one blind, one deaf, and one mute. One restaurant, endless misunderstandings! The one taking orders can't speak, the one who speaks can't hear, and the cook can't see! Work together to get the meals right!

5586420.title: POKUS
5586420.short_description: Sling spells and shatter friendships in a chaotic wizard tavern. In this online card battler for 2-6 player, play as petty mages whose hexes hilariously backfire. Break fragile alliances and haunt your friends from the grave in frantic 15-minute bouts of magical mayhem.

5586550.title: Construction Site: Tidy Up Together
5586550.short_description: The delivery truck just tipped a whole building into one giant heap. Dig out bricks, logs, steel beams and Sash Windows, check the plan and fit every part into its glowing blueprint slot. Then bin the rubbish, return the tools and watch the lights come on, solo or with your crew.

5586660.title: Selling Stars: An Idle Space Game
5586660.short_description: Grow your little solar energy company into a galactic business! Build Dyson spheres to harvest stellar energy, then put your profits toward automated production and interstellar trade. Settle into a cozy idle rhythm as you expand at your own pace.

5586930.title: DeadPoly Desert
5586930.short_description: Use resources from the teleportation islands to build back in the desert, and attempt to reach even more distant worlds.

5586960.title: Super Empire
5586960.short_description: Build a supermarket from a corner store to a hypermarket. Stock shelves that really empty, staff real shifts, price against rival stores, and keep every shopper happy, from dawn delivery to closing time, through every season.

5586990.title: Boo! Boo! Train!
5586990.short_description: A cozy train journey through a valley that keeps its own time. Drive slowly, pick a line at every junction, stop for the view and whistle at the neighbours. One real hour is one day in Pinewind Valley, and the season turns every week. Nothing to build, nothing to fail.

5587410.title: Cleared for Profit: Airline Management
5587410.short_description: Run an airline in one evening. Open routes across North America, set every fare and buy or lease every aircraft, then watch the month play out. Every number explains itself, Corvane Air fights back, and you can go broke. Buy once, no timers.

5587500.title: Cumin
5587500.short_description: Run a convenience store inside a train station in this hands-on, first-person management game. Order stock, fill the shelves and serve customers at the register. Experiment with your product range and prices to grow your profits.

5587540.title: Mystery Blocks: Polyomino Puzzle
5587540.short_description: Master the grid in Mystery Blocks: Polyomino Puzzle! Drag and drop geometric polyomino shapes into boxes, solve relaxing tangram-style logic puzzles, and experience the ultimate satisfying fit. Play at your own pace!

5587660.title: Cinema Together
5587660.short_description: Run a small neighborhood cinema with your friends. Sell tickets, pop the popcorn, keep the 3D and 4D halls running. Then rewrite a script next door, shoot your own movie, and screen it in your own theater. A PS1-style first-person cinema sim for up to 4 players.

5587680.title: Send More Squires
5587680.short_description: The King has been captured by another kingdom, and every letter ends the same way: "Send more squires." Train your squires, conquer region after region in an endless march, gather loot to grow your kingdom, and rescue His Majesty!

5587840.title: BRAZUELA
5587840.short_description: Start from scratch and build your own path in Brazuela, a political and life simulation game set in Brazil. Work, study, join a political party, run for office, build relationships, earn positions of power, and take part in the decisions that shape the world around you. Which path will you choose?

5587850.title: Seabreeze Atelier
5587850.short_description: Seabreeze Atelier is a cozy island-building game. Shape coastlines, carve rivers, and connect gardens and cottages with paths and bridges. Cast a line from your pier, then turn the island you built into a live Windows wallpaper and watch the boats drift by.

5587990.title: 麻将塔防 MahJong Tower Defense
5587990.short_description: Mahjong Tower Defense is an innovative game that combines mahjong with tower defense. Each turn you draw and discard tiles, then use classic mahjong calls such as Chow, Pung, Kong and Hu (declaring a winning hand) to earn different types of towers. languages: Chinese, English and Japanese.

5588000.title: AFK Throne
5588000.short_description: A chibi dark-fantasy squad idle looter that lives at the bottom of your desktop. Between work and study, spend your idle earnings to power up and push further, team up with other players against bosses, or duel them. With luck, you'll find rare tradable items to sell on the Steam Community Market.

5588110.title: RUGGED
5588110.short_description: RUGGED is first-person survival for one to four players. Fell trees, haul logs back to camp, craft tools, and hunt for food. Build a cabin on your own or host your existing world for friends through online or LAN co-op.

5588160.title: One Twisted Boxing Day
5588160.short_description: Build a manic gift-making factory as you buy upgrades, race the clock, chase quotas, fight off inspectors, and gently... unalive your employees in this comedic Christmas-themed real-time automation game. For the good of the company!

5588310.title: Matter of State
5588310.short_description: Boil, freeze, melt and condense matter on its way across small island boards, in as few parts as you can. 184 puzzles, a new one every day, and a level editor with Workshop sharing.

5588330.title: 纸牌矿工
5588330.short_description: Card Miner is a casual strategy game blending poker, resource gathering, and deck building. Play cards to earn points and rewards, collect wood, grass, and ore to buy upgrades, and use special cards and multipliers to maximize earnings within limited plays on your way to a million coins.

5588440.title: Casus Foederis: 1815
5588440.short_description: Your ally is attacked and calls you into a war you never wanted. Answer, and you fight. Refuse, and every court in Europe remembers. Lead one of twelve powers from 1815 to 1871; grow too fast and the continent unites against you. A turn-based strategy game of diplomacy. Single-player.

5588570.title: My Cat Cafe Simulator
5588570.short_description: Build your dream cat café! Adopt adorable cats, care for them, and fill your café with love. Decorate your space, collect unique cats, play with your furry friends, and welcome happy customers. Grow your business and create the ultimate cozy paradise for CAT !!!

5588590.title: Revive The Beast
5588590.short_description: A short story-based active incremental game where you reanimate animals by drawing inscription patterns. Learn about the tragic past of the necromancer and become powerful once again.

5588630.title: The Iliad - Wrath of Achilles
5588630.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder of Greek myth that faithfully follows Homer's Iliad. Achilles' wrath is your weapon: the angrier he grows, the harder he strikes and the more Troy fears him. But to win the last fight, he must master it. Told in real engravings and paintings from the 17th to the 19th century.

5588680.title: Save the Dateless Guy: Case.1 Sakura Hayase
5588680.short_description: A "realistic" dating ADV that tests your "dating skills." As an Apprentice God, you must make the love of a man with no romantic experience come true. A one-of-a-kind, controversial game by an executive at a marriage agency.

5588810.title: IDEAL DEATH GAMBLING
5588810.short_description: Challenge Death in a dark fantasy poker roguelike deckbuilder. Build powerful hands, combine supernatural Jokers and Soul Cards, bargain in the Black Market, and survive seven deadly contracts against cursed dealers. Risk everything, master your multipliers, and face Death itself.

5589040.title: Alura Quest
5589040.short_description: A top-down action adventure in the spirit of the classic 8- and 16-bit quests: one big overworld, dungeons, caves and secrets everywhere. Unravel the mystery of the world of Gildilox and overcome the darkness that overtakes it.

5589210.title: Nonogram Kingdom
5589210.short_description: Turn numbers into pictures. Solve 1,400 color nonograms across 28 themes, choose a board you like, and watch each finished picture rise from the grid.

5589250.title: BookBuster
5589250.short_description: The bookies ban winners. Become their worst nightmare in this incremental management game: find the odds they got wrong, hide your winnings across a network of accounts, and let your models and bots do the work until every bookmaker is bankrupt.

5589330.title: Dokimon Frontier
5589330.short_description: The first FREE Dokimon experience: A Monster-Tamer Roguelike! Collect monsters, discover rare items, and battle to your heart's content.

5589470.title: Starry Paws
5589470.short_description: Lost animals have stopped on the road. Guide them to the stars with the crow.

5589520.title: 50 Trillion Grains Of Sand
5589520.short_description: Dig through 50 trillion grains of sand in a first-person incremental digging sim. Start with a spoon, buy bigger tools, and put machines and Egyptian gods to work as you uncover a buried pyramid and discover the treasure hidden in its tomb.

5589660.title: Wrapocalypse
5589660.short_description: 1,000,000 boxes! You start with bare hands: scan, wrap and upgrade your factory until it runs itself! Team up in co-op crews of up to 5, online or split screen, and become the kings of warehouse automation! Slapping sleeping coworkers is allowed!

5589700.title: Bordertide
5589700.short_description: Grow a small banner into an empire, one tile at a time — alone against cunning computer nations, or online with up to 7 friends. Expand, build, sail, strike and make pacts in quick 10-minute matches, on fresh maps or a real map of the Earth.

5589760.title: Multi Miner Madness
5589760.short_description: A mining party game for up to four players. Drill for ore, haul it up and sell it, then spend the money on bigger drills, bombs and rams. Play on one screen with friends on the couch, or online through Steam.

5589790.title: Club XV: Rugby Manager
5589790.short_description: Take charge of a rugby club in a management simulation. Recruit players, develop young talent, manage your squad and shape your tactics. Watch your team compete in 3D matches as you build your club for long-term success.

5589920.title: SAIJAN: Dice Mahjong
5589920.short_description: A dice mahjong roguelite for riichi players. Roll tile dice, place Melds, stack Charms and send Fu × Han soaring. 22 Yaku from Riichi to Big Three Dragons, plus 10 SAIJAN Yaku for columns, diagonals and Pip totals. Beat every Boss to complete a 15–20 minute run. 2–4 player co-op with Steam friends.

5590000.title: Lily's Little Golf Game
5590000.short_description: Party golf for up to four players, all on the same hole at once. Race to the cup on wild mini golf courses, sabotage your rivals on the open links, or turn your clubs into weapons in the battle arena. Play on one screen or play online. You can even build your own minigolf courses!

5590040.title: Lily's Little Dart Game
5590040.short_description: Couch party darts for up to four players. Race from 301 down to zero, cause mayhem in a three-minute Chaos match, or steer your dart in slow motion through an obstacle course in The Gauntlet. Play on one screen or online with friends.

5590120.title: Card Thunder
5590120.short_description: Select cards from a 5x5 grid, stack powerful boosters and perks, and outscore escalating target scores in this spatial poker roguelike.

5590280.title: World Trails: Hiking Simulator
5590280.short_description: Walk 30 real hiking trails across six continents, from the Dolomites to Everest Base Camp. Scramble up steep slopes, camp in huts and tents, survive snow, fog and thin air, and photograph the world's great peaks. A third-person hiking simulator.

5590510.title: AntiClimatic
5590510.short_description: A physics based weather simulator where you change the weather patterns throughout 30+ scenarios.

5590590.title: Brilliancy!!
5590590.short_description: Solve real chess puzzles in a roguelike where chess skill drives the score. Seat Tutors and upgrades that reward forks, sacrifices and quiet moves, beat each Set’s Target, outlast Bosses and hunt for the hidden Brilliancy. No invented pieces, no bent rules: the best chess is always rewarded.

5590860.title: Hose to Mars
5590860.short_description: Your mission is to terraform Mars. However, a crash landing destroyed all your gear leaving you with just a spoon! Start watering the soil with your spoon, earn MarsCoin, and upgrade your equipment. Turn the Red Planet green solo or with friends!

5590870.title: Moscow Lizards vs Aliens
5590870.short_description: Long, long ago, lizard-folk settled near Moscow. They grew fond of all things Russian: *kosovorotka* shirts, *ushanka* fur hats, pickled cucumbers, and, of course, vodka. For centuries, they quietly guarded the land of Rus’… until aliens arrived from the planet Nibiru.

5590880.title: Gop-Stop Increment: Defend the Block
5590880.short_description: A clicker-meets-tower-defense game set in the meme-filled 90s. Hustle vodka, snap up kiosks and video rental shops, and use sunflower seeds to build your entryway defenses—think a granny with a stool, a boombox blasting *shanson* (Russian outlaw folk music), and a chained-up bear.

5590960.title: Biathlon Manager 2027
5590960.short_description: Biathlon Manager 2027 puts you in charge of a national biathlon team. Plan the summer training, choose who starts each race and follow your athletes as they fight for results all winter. Season after season the team changes as veterans retire and young athletes come through

5590990.title: Mutoid 2
5590990.short_description: Fight east through mutant hordes in a top-down survival shooter where heads pop and limbs come off. Revive fallen allies to fight beside you until the infection turns them back. Find and unlock an arsenal of guns, gear and perks to power your next run.

5591090.title: Perfect Ninja Painter 2
5591090.short_description: This ninja master is back in action in the second installment of this fast-paced, vibrant puzzle-platformer - and this time, he’s brought a friend along.

5591100.title: Perfect Ninja Painter 3
5591100.short_description: New part of the puzzle platformer about ninja painters

5591120.title: Perfect Ninja Painter 4
5591120.short_description: Slide, paint, and outsmart every level in this new installment of a vibrant ninja-themed puzzle-platformer!

5591240.title: Spellstorm
5591240.short_description: Eight wildly asymmetrical wizards do battle for Storm Shards in this highly original tactical deckbuilder.

5591280.title: This Arcade Is Broken
5591280.short_description: This Arcade Is Broken is a short incremental game about a kid with a screwdriver secretly rewiring three classic arcade cabinets until they print tokens on their own. Upgrade their circuit boards, build helper paddles and drones, unleash fever mode... and don’t let the grumpy owner catch you.

5591310.title: かみひより ～弓張り編～
5591310.short_description: Command four humans and four spirits in real-time tactical battles. Transfer spirits, manage spiritual energy, and analyze the lunar army to uncover its weaknesses. Combine careful planning with quick decisions to turn a desperate defense into a counteroffensive.

5591420.title: WRECKRUN RACING
5591420.short_description: Free arcade racing with competitive AI, 14 race maps, a rally stage and a sandbox. Race five rivals, beat the clock and hold the perfect line. Keyboard, gamepad and steering wheel supported. A high school graduation project.

5591540.title: Hollow Galley
5591540.short_description: When deep-sea research vessel Thessaly goes silent, Rin Kessler docks alone to find her missing brother. Manage scarce ammunition against mutated crew members and unearth the Nocturne program in this story driven 3D cel-shaded third-person survival horror mystery with multiple endings.

5591600.title: Ash Company
5591600.short_description: A command-and-management game about running a mercenary company. Hire mercs, fit their gear, mark routes on the op map and send them into the ruins. During an op, the only way to intervene is by radio. Loot carried out by the squad pays wages and grows the base.

5591660.title: Final Kastle
5591660.short_description: Orc hordes march on your castle wave after wave. Man the cannons, call down lightning, freeze the field and fight on the walls, alone or with up to 16 players online, in a third-person castle defense shooter with a living castle to explore.

5591830.title: Main Event Mogul
5591830.short_description: Book the card, manage the roster and run the business of your own pro wrestling promotion, then watch every match play out in 3D as a live TV broadcast with entrances, commentary and a roaring crowd.

5591840.title: BIG. BAD. BOOM!
5591840.short_description: A hand-drawn Cold War strategy game. Spend three years making decisions, building up your army, culture, science and birth rate, and spying on your neighbors. The red button is dealt at random: wipe your neighbor off the face of the earth or win without firing a single shot.

5592080.title: Bricked
5592080.short_description: Bricked is a city-building sandbox set on a tabletop above the clouds. Build a toy-brick city piece by piece, set kaiju, mechs and armies against each other, and watch every strike tear it apart. Put every brick back with one click, then fly, drive and ride through the city you made.

5592650.title: Everpixel
5592650.short_description: Everpixel is what happens when you combine tactical RPG, pixels, and wiener dogs. Lead your motley crew to pixelated dominance--or die trying.

5592710.title: The Perfect Crime
5592710.short_description: 1974, a city where it always rains. You are the cleaner: you have fifteen minutes before the police arrive to make a death tell another story. Then the detective walks in, and you watch the reasoning unfold, step by step. If it reaches the truth, you lose.

5592890.title: Cat Shelter Simulator
5592890.short_description: Build a cozy cat shelter, rescue abandoned kittens, and give every feline a loving home! Feed, groom, heal and play with your cats, build friendships, and discover the joy of finding them their forever families.

5592920.title: Last Embers : Fire Hero
5592920.short_description: Grab the hose, rookie. The city is on fire! Drown roaring flames, rescue a city full of characters, spend your coins on 90+ upgrades and race across town to answer every call... but something is lurking deep in the flames.

5592980.title: Bermuda Trial
5592980.short_description: Party Based Autobattler RPG where you choose team of three survivor to explore the wonders and dangers of the mysterious Bermuda Island.

5593090.title: Tessera
5593090.short_description: Tessera is an open-world sandbox fantasy RPG. Create your own character, explore a seamless hand-crafted continent, gather and craft, delve into ever-changing dungeons, and build a home of your own. Play solo or invite friends into your world.

5593360.title: Sandgrave
5593360.short_description: Rise, Captain! Sandgrave is a pixel-art, top-down sandbox about big flying ships, real-time fleet combat and life between trading and fighting pirates across the vast desert! Design your vessel, fight by boarding, broadsides or bombardment! Play solo or in an online open world!

5593450.title: DAN DAN THE TIER LIST TOGETHER!
5593450.short_description: A co-op party game about tier lists. Only the host needs a copy; up to 111 guests join free in a browser on a phone or PC. Guess secret ranks and add words or images as your list grows. Build lists with no right or wrong answers in Tier Together!, or play solo with “My Tier!”.

5593520.title: Touhou Hikouroku ~ Flight Risk
5593520.short_description: Marisa fires her Master Spark and the recoil sends her flying. Blast your way around the great library, steal the books, and watch Patchouli's bill grow.

5593660.title: Dean Archer Stories: Escape the Rusty Bell
5593660.short_description: Your partner, detective Dean Archer, walked into The Rusty Bell and never came back. Slip into Riverton's harbor bar on a rainy night, explore every room in first person, solve puzzles and find the evidence that can bring down the city's most powerful man. Then get out before dawn.

5593890.title: Bricks in Place: Tidy Up the Manor!
5593890.short_description: Build a miniature manor in this relaxing first-person building sim. Find the right pieces in a mountain of bricks, follow 3D blueprints, and bring six buildings to life with a helpful cat. Build solo or team up in co-op for up to four players.

5593910.title: Alchemist's Codex
5593910.short_description: Run a small alchemy shop and discover recipes by experiment. Grind, boil, distill and brew real ingredient properties, not fixed recipes. Take commissions, buy from the merchant, gather in your yard, and fill your Codex on the way to becoming a master alchemist.

5594030.title: SQUISH N POPS
5594030.short_description: Fire a moonbeam straight up and split every bouncing bubble into two smaller ones until the sky is empty. A 200-level campaign in five acts, each ending in a boss, with 19 bubble traits and eight powerups, then all 200 again with the camera in close. Chain pops into FEVER and earn new looks.

5594260.title: Kill 1 Million Mosquitoes
5594260.short_description: 1 million insects are invading your place! Grab your weapons and kill 'em all! Explore your farm, help your neighbors fight off the infestation, complete missions, burn swarms of mosquitoes and bugs, and upgrade your weapons.

5594450.title: Still on Display
5594450.short_description: Ten nights alone in a clothing store. Finish the closing chores, compare the displays with your security tablet, and watch for changes in the mannequins. Decide whether the night was normal. A wrong call sends the calendar back to day one.

5594580.title: Arcana Clash
5594580.short_description: A 2–6 player tarot card battler. Each of the 78 cards has two faces — upright and reversed — and you choose which one to unleash every time you play. Strike, curse, or turn the whole table upside down, and outlast your rivals before the Clock of Fate swallows everyone.

5594850.title: Night Shift: Grandma's Rules
5594850.short_description: You are the last night guard at a closed Thai hospital. Follow your grandmother's rules, solve what each night leaves behind, and find out why the building is still counting its dead.

5595120.title: Dig Up
5595120.short_description: You are Elliot: broke, jobless, out of options. You sign up for a contest with a huge prize and wake up 48 meters underground with a shovel in your hand. Dig, sell, buy ladders and crack the door code hidden in the notes of those who never made it out. The cameras are always watching.

5595170.title: Ninmarch
5595170.short_description: Hold the border. Seal the rift. Ninmarch is a hand-painted 3D tower defense in the spirit of classic fantasy RTS: build and branch six towers, lead a hero with four skills into battle, and stop 39 kinds of abyssal foes — 12 bosses among them — across 12 handcrafted levels.

5595270.title: Run away from BLEB
5595270.short_description: You are a young female streamer trapped in a terrifying house by a maniac named Bleb. Outsmart him and escape... If you can.

5595350.title: Ah Sheep, Here We Go Again
5595350.short_description: An incremental game about a hungry flock that eats straight through the Earth, all the way to New Zealand. Sweep your cursor over the sheep and they bite the ground beneath them. Grow the flock, hire dogs and shepherds, and keep going down.

5595460.title: Tidal Tales
5595460.short_description: Master fluid parkour, raid evil pirate hideouts, and tackle environmental puzzles across islands where nature defies all expectations. Sail with style as a young treasure hunter seeking the road to El Dorado.

5595530.title: You Can’t Clock Out
5595530.short_description: You dozed off at your desk. Now your coworkers have horses’ heads. You Can’t Clock Out is a first-person horror game about escaping an office gone terribly wrong. Gather clues, solve puzzles, and follow company rules as you make your way downstairs. Don’t let your coworkers catch you.

5595560.title: WHO'S LIVE?
5595560.short_description: Hide among NPCs and stream live! WHO'S LIVE? is an online stealth and deduction game for up to 4 players. Streamers earn donations while staying hidden, while Enforcers use livestream footage delayed by about 2 seconds to track them down. Play solo or with friends!

5595650.title: SARUR
5595650.short_description: SARUR is a single-player action adventure in a royal steampunk city above the clouds. Find out what happened.

5595690.title: 万仙
5595690.short_description: 开局即挂机，招募弟子、炼丹炼器、闯秘境占世界——一款桌面修仙放置网游。

5595860.title: DEFCON 89
5595860.short_description: OLD-SCHOOL ZOMBIES ARE BACK. Survive endless rounds solo or in 4-player co-op in a Cold War nightmare set in 1989. Powered by Unreal Engine 5, explore sinister maps, find secret weapons and unravel each map's hidden main story. How long can you last?

5595950.title: Pinball Bonanza Live
5595950.short_description: Run a live stream from your garage and build a seven-floor pinball machine with your viewers’ donations. Flip, nudge and chase multiball while chat cheers you on — then automate it all in a hands-on incremental pinball game.

5596240.title: AquaScape Desk
5596240.short_description: A planted aquarium sim that lives on your desktop. Build a hardscape from stones and driftwood, plant it, and let the fish swim. Plants grow in real time, so trimming matters. You can even scan real stones and driftwood and drop them straight in. Reef tanks with corals, too.

5596280.title: Mall Chaos
5596280.short_description: The mall is closed, and your shift has just begun. Explore a multi-floor shopping mall in first person, pick up scattered products, and return them to the right shelves, tables, and racks.

5596400.title: Grain Master
5596400.short_description: Enjoy a relaxing ASMR sorting experience in Grain Master! Sort grains one by one using chopsticks, upgrade your tools, improve your speed, and immerse yourself in a world of relaxation and enjoyment.

5596440.title: JETLINE
5596440.short_description: A jet-powered roadster with a suction fan, loose in Budapest. Ride up walls, backflip over spike strips, outrun the police through back streets, and race across a city rebuilt from real-world map data.

5596460.title: The Old Circle: Ecos da Masmorra
5596460.short_description: A pixel-art action RPG for 1 to 4 players. Choose one of five classes, master real-time combat, shape your build with glyphs, runes and 50 gear sets, and descend through 21 dungeons with their own deadly rules to face 21 bosses, solo or in online co-op.

5596800.title: It's Not Funny
5596800.short_description: Blind, deaf, mute, armless, legless: five friends, one escape! Every player sees only part of the puzzle, so talk fast, trust each other and don't panic. One mistake and the whole team starts over. Can you reach the elevator together?

5597010.title: Wool Shop
5597010.short_description: A cozy idle game that lives along the edge of your screen. Your sheep graze, their wool is spun and knitted, and customers shop at your little store while you work. Your sheepdog follows your cursor and helps herd the flock.

5597120.title: Okey Dokey
5597120.short_description: The tile-rummy roguelite. Lay runs and groups, outplay a rival at every table and stack boosts with regulars, drinks and enchanted tiles on a tour of the world's tile clubs, from Lisbon to the Grand Salon.

5597140.title: Horror Simulator
5597140.short_description: A night shift at the precinct turns into a nightmare when the terrifying "Subject #4" breaks free from the basement. No weapons, locked doors, dead comms. Navigate a maze of hallways, crack safes, and hide in the dark. Your shift lasts until 08:00. Will you live to see the dawn?

5597470.title: サッカークラブ運営をやろう！
5597470.short_description: 監督になって草サッカーリーグからワールドリーグの頂点を目指すサッカークラブ運営シミュレーション。練習を選び、メンバーと作戦を決めたら、あとは選手たちを信じて見守ろう！

5597620.title: Weekend at Ease
5597620.short_description: Weekend at Ease is a casual puzzle game centered on interacting with objects, set against the backdrop of a relaxing weekend shared by two girls. Solve puzzles by dragging, arranging, rotating, and swapping objects, and experience new interaction rules across different chapters.

5597630.title: Vector Rush
5597630.short_description: Sink into space and music in this neon sci-fi twin-stick shooter. Blast through swarms of vector enemies, take down the giants guarding each world, grow stronger with every run, and escape a collapsing star system.

5597670.title: Feudal Fall
5597670.short_description: The king burned your village to the ground. Raise your capital on its ashes, keep your people alive through the winters and muster armies hundreds strong. Bring down the lords of the feudal pyramid one by one, then lay siege to the king's own city. A real-time city builder and siege strategy game.

5597690.title: Arcane Reckoning
5597690.short_description: Skill-shot wizard battles for up to 12 players. Aim every spell by hand, knock rivals into lava and the void, and survive arenas guarded by ancient bosses. Free-for-all or 2–4 teams, a spell shop between rounds, and bots that fill every empty slot.

5598400.title: Redressement
5598400.short_description: Welcome to the Élysée Palace. You have five years to turn France around and avoid being ousted. In this turn-based political management game, saving the country means making some rather unusual decisions. Every choice counts.

5598430.title: Paint The Wall
5598430.short_description: 400 meters of bare concrete. Out you go! Paint the Wall is a satisfying painting sim where the higher you climb, the more you earn. Upgrade to paint cannons and hot air balloons, hire robots and drones, and paint it all, solo or with friends. That wall won't paint itself!

5598520.title: The Garden of Forgotten Blooms
5598520.short_description: A watercolor gothic idle RPG. Build a party of 42 flower-named companions, enjoy automatic battles and offline rewards, and explore a 15-chapter story. Japanese and Chinese character voices. No microtransactions.

5598540.title: Campaign Season
5598540.short_description: A turn-based tactical board game that sees the player take on the role of an Officer in the Empire's army, recruit Soldiers, lead them on Campaign, and command them in battle.

5598580.title: Tower of Misfits
5598580.short_description: A first-person co-op roguelite from one to 6 players. Pick one of twelve misfits, each with a weapon and an ultimate of their own, and climb a tower that never ends: a new world on every floor, bosses, perks, curses, and friends to fight over the chest with.

5598640.title: Neon Turf: Cyberpunk Auto-Battler
5598640.short_description: A cyberpunk auto-battler where you buy buildings, not units. Build noodle bars, clubs and clinics. They earn cash each round, and some send fighters to battle rival gangs. Buying the same building multiple times levels it up. Clubs draw police attention, which results in police raids on your base.

5598690.title: Sons of Mercury
5598690.short_description: Atlantic, 1765. Start with a small ship and, turn by turn, build a trading house across 39 ports on four continents. A price is as fresh as the ship that brought it, so the news you buy, steal, or ignore matters. Spy, smuggle, or keep your hands clean. Every house and crown you cross remembers.

5598710.title: Million Layer Gift Simulator
5598710.short_description: A giant gift with 1,000,000 layers of wrapping paper. Peel it strip by strip, sell the paper, and buy better tools, from nail clippers to a leaf blower. Play alone or with up to 4 friends. What’s inside? There’s only one way to find out.

5598740.title: Blind Dial
5598740.short_description: A pixel-art co-op action RPG for 1-4 players, online or on one screen. Dial a Gate to worlds nobody has charted, fight your way down, and decide when to turn back. What you bring home rebuilds the base. What you lose stays out there.

5599050.title: Kicked Out
5599050.short_description: The bailiffs are at the door and you have only one minute. Throw what you can out of the window, then jump after it. Beg, dig through the trash, survive the nights and save $100 before the street breaks you.

5599530.title: I'd Choose the Bear
5599530.short_description: Thirty days to save your late Nana's cottage in Honeywood, a lakeside town where bears and people live side by side. Date six very different bears (one of them is technically a human), outwit a resort developer, and decide who you'd really rather meet in the woods.

5599580.title: Universe of the Damned
5599580.short_description: The Year is 2150 and Earth is on the brink of collapse. Humans have resorted to colonizing other planets to prevent their demise. The EFS received a distress call from one of their colonies on Mars. An elite unit is sent down to the surface to find out what has happened.

5599590.title: Sir, You see that Dons?
5599590.short_description: The donkeys are coming. Thousands of them. Draw walls to bend their path, raise barracks, play cards and lead a stubborn little army in a roguelike mix of tower defense and deckbuilding. Just don't get too attached to your walls.

5599600.title: Fullower
5599600.short_description: Plant 100,456 flowers to decorate the Vegetable Boys' stage. A cozy first-person game about filling the empty terraced field around the stage with flowers, color by color.

5599650.title: Trash Nights
5599650.short_description: Autumn, 1998. You take the night shift on garbage truck No. 7 in Maple Hollow, a quiet suburb whose last crew quit without notice. One street a night, 11 PM to 4 AM. Every house leaves its trash on the curb, and one neighbor's bags should not exist.

5599790.title: Chicken Origins
5599790.short_description: Chicken Origins is a cozy incremental game about one very special chicken. Wash eggs for double the price, build coops and barns, hire sellers and catch Golden Eggs for big bonuses, watch every building you buy appear on your farm, and reach the stars! Multiple endings are waiting for you!

5599800.title: Earth Unbound
5599800.short_description: Lead a clandestine resistance in the occupied American Midwest of the 1920s. Recruit and train operatives, coordinate dangerous missions, and outwit the Occupation Bureau. Every assignment risks exposure, capture or death—and every outcome shapes your campaign.

5599970.title: Sire, We Must Redraw!
5599970.short_description: Sire, the raiders are coming. Play building cards to grow your town, troop cards to raise an army, and pick champions and relics that change how every run plays.

5600330.title: Doppel Echo
5600330.short_description: You can't trust a familiar face or voice. DOPPELECHO is a first-person multiplayer horror and social deduction game where an impostor can steal a crewmate's appearance and voice. Work together to repair a space station and escape, or become the impostor and deceive the crew.

5601220.title: A Sheet-ton of Bingo
5601220.short_description: Fill one whole bingo sheet out of a thousand before the old regular across the hall yells BINGO. Call numbers, dab squares and buy auto-daubers in this incremental race to find the bingo in a sheet haystack. He has been doing this for decades. You have no idea how good he is.

5601240.title: OVERSPRAY
5601240.short_description: OVERSPRAY is a free-to-play tactical 4v4 paintball shooter. Buy your gear every round and fight over a single flag in the middle of the map. Nobody dies — everybody gets soaked.

5601460.title: Click the Stone: Active Incremental and Idler
5601460.short_description: Click the Stone is an incremental game about clicking a stone to receive rocks and coins that deliver incredible rewards. Build game-changing upgrade combos, and let your tribespeople join the fun. Improve your skills to become the strongest.

5601480.title: SEA CATCH
5601480.short_description: Look, think, catch! SEA CATCH is a cute, fast-paced ocean puzzle game where shapes and colors hold the key. Make quick choices, build combos in the 60-second challenge, beat your best score, and unlock 10 adorable Sea Friends!

5601540.title: Muka
5601540.short_description: Fast, brutal, unforgiving. A 90s boomer shooter reborn with modern light and darkness, set in a twisted Eastern Bloc, from Chernobyl to the Czech Republic, where the evening news says everything is fine.

5601570.title: CRIMSON GATE
5601570.short_description: A roguelite RPG where auto battler meets tower defense! Summon and deploy 30 battle dolls. Grow your legion with gear and card combos, and take on the final boss waiting at the end of 100 waves.

5601590.title: Aldorian Saga:Farming Hero
5601590.short_description: You are the last survivor of the royal family, and the power the goddess gave you is... just farming? But you won't give up! Sell crops for gold, open up mines and forests to craft trade goods, brave dangerous trade routes, and earn the funds and raise the army to take your kingdom back!

5601650.title: Saint Hallow
5601650.short_description: An nice little adventure game with a SPRINKLE of horror on top, this Cat and Mouse game is a steady paced, action oriented experience! Gather coins, find notes, and escape the claws of the Traeger Wolf. Be sure to utilize your powers, they may come in handy later.

5601670.title: Sengoku Fields of Empire 2
5601670.short_description: ⛩️ Sengoku Fields of Empire 2 You ride out from a Tokugawa castle. Behind you lies the province you are responsible for. Ahead begins the territory of another Daimyō.

5601810.title: Windwhisper Saga
5601810.short_description: Set out from Windbell as an adventurer in a pixel-art, side-scrolling action RPG. Explore dungeons, face bosses, and craft gear from the materials you bring home. Get to know the locals along the way, or take on a Demon Pact when you’re ready to risk more for better loot.

5601820.title: 过关斩将
5601820.short_description: The chessboard is a map, and the squares that haven't been flipped are still wet ink. How many hidden troops can you spot before the pursuers surround you?

5601990.title: RE: Rags to Royalties
5601990.short_description: Build a web-novel empire in this incremental management game set in 2004. Tap, upgrade and unleash FEVER; win readers, sign contracts and run a busy studio. With AI-assisted creation, turn your own ideas into a novel you can actually read. Your cat is already on the keyboard.

5602250.title: Rolling Toolman 3: Darkness
5602250.short_description: Toolman is back in this 3prd person adventure game. Roll and try to reach goal as soon as you can and avoid falling from map and beware obstacles and traps

5602420.title: Break Even
5602420.short_description: You owe your boss a billion dollars. Smash repossessed furniture with a hammer, set off chain reactions, and spend the coins on bigger hammers and upgrades in this active incremental roguelite. Can’t make the payment? You’re fired.

5602450.title: Secant
5602450.short_description: A short incremental ARPG where your cursor is the weapon. Defend the Origin against waves of figures, loot gear with rolled affixes, craft it, grow a huge skill tree, and take your hits from single digits to octillions. One final boss, a real ending.

5602770.title: Witch, Gnomes, Faun and Others
5602770.short_description: Put your gnomes to work, build a settlement, and keep the local witch happy in this first-person mix of village management and fairy-tale horror. Rebuild the Gnomehenge to get everyone home.

5603020.title: Carry Crew
5603020.short_description: “We can fit one more!” Pick your cargo, stack it high, and grab opposite ends of the board in this physics-based co-op delivery game for two. Take tight turns together and count down to each jump. The finish line is in sight, and the top box just started to slide.

5603030.title: Hapaxes
5603030.short_description: You work at Hapaxes, you are their asset. Drive your way through hordes of zombies in this top-down action-adventure roguelike using solar-powered weapons in this apocalyptic world. Will you be able to save the world from all these threats?

5603040.title: Tick or Kick!
5603040.short_description: Grab them by the leg, check their ticket and throw the freeloaders off the bus. Or ride for free, blend into the crowd and blame someone else. A physics party game about tickets, chaos and flying passengers, for up to 16 friends.

5603070.title: GIGALANCE
5603070.short_description: Build a planet-shattering beam cannon from scratch. Combine reactors, accelerators, and cooling systems to unleash devastating firepower. But push too far, and your own weapon could melt or tear itself apart. Design, rebuild, and fire your ultimate creation to save Earth.

5603090.title: Spin & Win: Casino Business Sim
5603090.short_description: Their luck. Your business. Build your casino, work the floor, and hire a crew to keep the cash flowing. Draw crowds with live shows, then join your guests for poker, blackjack, or a spin on the slots.

5603120.title: Save the North Pole
5603120.short_description: Oh no! A snowstorm has buried Santa’s village at the North Pole! The wind blew the ornaments off the giant tree and hid them in the snow, and Christmas is tomorrow! Become an elf and team up with friends to clear the paths, dig up the ornaments and hang them on the tree. Save Christmas!

5603230.title: Sad Virus Mythic Land
5603230.short_description: Sad virus third person simulation adventure game series continue now in small map which include forest and castle themed adventure where mission avoid traps and collect bottles

5603340.title: Pawn Shop Tycoon
5603340.short_description: Run a pixel-art pawn shop, from a tiny corner store to a city emporium. Haggle with every customer, learn what things are really worth, spot fakes and stolen goods, gamble on storage units and drive your rival out of business.

5603370.title: Zoo Life Tycoon
5603370.short_description: Inherit a run-down zoo at the edge of town and turn it into the pride of the city. Repair pens, care for 21 species, welcome families and juggle your own life too: eat, sleep, make friends and upgrade your home in this cozy pixel-art zoo tycoon and life sim.

5603670.title: Imprint
5603670.short_description: A counterfeiting sim in a small harbor town. Print and cut fake bills, slip them past cashiers, bartenders and the casino cage, and hope nobody looks too closely. Expand your print shop, dodge the police, crack the bank vault, and run the racket solo or in online co-op with friends.

5603680.title: Desktop Reimu
