5603680.short_description: Desktop Reimu is a Touhou Project fan-made idle game that sits along the bottom edge of your screen. Your key presses and clicks turn into donations while you work, and Reimu heads out to resolve incidents.

5603700.title: Infinity Card Battle
5603700.short_description: A card duel in deep space – free forever: 140+ cards, five factions, one market table. Build your fleet, buy and scrap cards, charge abilities and break the enemy hull. 1v1, 3+ or campaign. Alpha – feedback welcome.

5603760.title: The Last Engineer on Earth
5603760.short_description: Survive alone on a wild Earth, ten thousand years after the machines won. Craft by hand, then build robots and program them with drag-and-drop blocks to run your base. The map is the whole real planet, and you choose where to land.

5603800.title: Fishy Tidy Up
5603800.short_description: Grandpa's aquarium museum had a rough night: every tank cracked and 3,600 fish ended up on the floor. Fix the tanks, sort each fish into its own home by species, look and size, and bring nine rooms of sea life back in this cozy first-person tidy-up game.

5603920.title: I Shall Seek Immortality
5603920.short_description: An idle xianxia game for the corner of your desktop — with online duels, a ten-seat arena, world bosses and Steam Market trading. Eight origins, retro stick-figure battles, companions and sects in an open world, plus a stealth mode and boss key.

5604040.title: Hallbound Baseball Life
5604040.short_description: Live a whole baseball life in this baseball career RPG. Hear your name on draft day, ride the buses through the minors, earn the call to the Grand League, play your own at-bats and pitches, raise a family and chase the Hall of Fame. Then life after baseball begins.

5604090.title: Corner Club
5604090.short_description: A tiny pixel nightclub living in the corner of your desktop. Put on any music and the dancers move on its beat!

5604160.title: Lost Places - Lonely Town - Collector's Edition
5604160.short_description: Embark on an exciting expedition through a lonely town in the middle of nowhere. Explore detailed hidden-object scenes and solve mini-games to uncover the secrets of this abandoned place.

5604240.title: Necro Helix
5604240.short_description: Necro helix is a roguelike RPG with 2-player online co-op. Explore 5 unique destinations, master 8 playable characters, and create powerful builds with 280 traits, 300 pieces of equipment, and the Flower Pact system. Face 40 bosses and uncover the secrets of the Deathlands!

5604250.title: Signs of Fear - The Hunt of Graystone
5604250.short_description: A first-person psychological horror adventure. In 1897, the brother of Everett Holloway disappeared in the town of Graystone, Montana. 11 years later the town held a record for most missing person cases in North America. Now a grown adult Everett returns to the town to look for his lost brother.

5604570.title: Kit Keeper
5604570.short_description: Be the Kit Keeper of a football shirt shop. A truck dumps 540 shirts on the floor. Read the badge and number, find the player in the Kit Catalog, print the name and hang the shirt where it belongs. A cozy first-person sorting game.

5604610.title: ALL PASSENGERS BUCKLE UP
5604610.short_description: Run a budget airline in 1-6 player co-op. Check passports, load the bags, fly the route and keep the passengers fed while the jet catches fire around you. Take bribes, dodge storms and climb onto the roof mid-flight. Hit the quota or the whole crew is fired.

5604730.title: Broke2Blocks: Crypto Mining Simulator
5604730.short_description: Start in your parents' basement with a single USB stick miner. Plug in every cable yourself and sell your coins. Move into an old gym, then into a huge warehouse full of racks. Buy broken miners on the black market, fix them screw by screw and keep the heat under control.

5604770.title: 검 강화하기
5604770.short_description: Hammer a rusty dagger into a legendary blade. Every press of the forge can succeed, fail or break your sword. Evolve 151 swords across ten lines, sell high and reinvest, then take your blade into real-time 1v1 duels and race tournaments against other players.

5604930.title: Maiden Taskbar
5604930.short_description: A little adventure begins at the bottom of your screen. Keep this idle RPG running above your taskbar and build a squad of maidens from 100+ cards across five races.

5605090.title: Catnip Wars : Labyrinth
5605090.short_description: Drop into a Necronazi labyrinth with up to three friends, or a squad of Catbot companions. Your weapons fire on their own: you steer, dodge and pick upgrades. Fight to the stairs at the centre of every floor, twenty floors down, before the Oberst comes for you. Then keep going.

5605180.title: Old School Golf
5605180.short_description: Master the swing, shape your shots, and sink the putt in a retro arcade golf game featuring 14 unique courses, dynamic weather, tournaments, and a full season career.

5605190.title: Rat Cleaning Crew
5605190.short_description: One of your friends is the rat. Four cleaners grab their brooms and have ten minutes to sweep it into the box, before its bites make the whole crew too sick to stand. A chaotic 5-player online party chase with voice chat.

5605260.title: The Atomic Mage
5605260.short_description: Mix hundreds of unique spells into thousands of wild builds! Mod wands and guns, link auto-casting crystals into chain reactions, and defend walls from tanks, jets and steel giants in a side-view defense Roguelite. Reunite with old friends and uncover a reborn Earthling's secrets across two worlds.

5605290.title: Haoru: Desktop Chaos
5605290.short_description: A chibi anime girl moves onto your real Windows desktop: she keeps you company while you work, reads, naps and plays on your windows, and wrecks everything on screen with 27 over-the-top weapons and 15 pranks. Dress her up, build an island village, befriend Kitsune and Neko. Only pixels get hurt.

5605350.title: 叉车推箱 | Forklift Sokoban
5605350.short_description: Forklift Sokoban is a sokoban-style puzzle game: you drive a forklift with an old TV face in a tidy grid world. Forward, reverse, turn, raise and lower the forks — push, lift and stack boxes, hold buttons, power up machines and wake them. Every level hides an “oh, that works too” solution.

5605440.title: Arcade Anxiety
5605440.short_description: Run an EVIL retro arcade and feed people to the machines, you sicko.

5605450.title: Slaysurge
5605450.short_description: The world shattered and its shards rose into the sky. You are the last Warden. Leadyour company across eight floating realms, march through the Firmament and ride asteam citadel into the Gorges in a fast, never-stalling idle RPG.

5605730.title: Modan's Book of Myths: The Nameless Knight
5605730.short_description: Control a party of up to four unique heroes in this turn-based RPG to rid the nation of Haven from evil forces both supernatural and humanoid in nature!

5605790.title: I, TANK
5605790.short_description: The machines have taken over the world. Blast them all with WW2-era tanks and take back our cities, with heavy metal playing in the Background. A stylized survivors-like with interesting mechanics. Play with historic tanks such as the T-34 or the Tiger 1, or make your own tank in the workshop.

5605880.title: Core 31
5605880.short_description: You wake alone in an Arctic research station with no memory and a name written on your wrist. Eleven people are gone. Follow the notes you left yourself, get out across the ice, and find out what Core 31 brought up from under three kilometres of glacier.

5606020.title: Jungle Survivors
5606020.short_description: Survive the wild jungle in this pixel-art action survival adventure! Battle deadly creatures, unlock powerful abilities, command animal companions and defeat colossal bosses across five unique chapters. Gather the cure and save your village!

5606100.title: shooter
5606100.short_description: SHOOTER is a pixel-art Wild West quick-draw duel. Play solo, local two-player, or online. Free download for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

5606120.title: Rock Racer GOLD
5606120.short_description: Rock Racer GOLD, Is A (1 To 4 Player), Old-school Battle Racer Game. challenge your friends to the ultimate race circuit, and see who is the best racer. Then verify you are still the best whenever the challenge arises with infinite replay ability.

5606250.title: Block Party Apocalypse
5606250.short_description: A blocky third-person zombie shooter for 1–4 players. Fight 30 waves across three days of the outbreak, stack upgrade cards, grab miniguns and flamethrowers from supply drops, and reach the last evacuation helicopter out of Port Haven.

5606340.title: ExoImperium: Space Tycoon
5606340.short_description: ExoImperium: Space Tycoon is a sci-fi strategy and factory management game. Colonize 70+ planets, automate production with worker drones, manage real-time interstellar logistics, research advanced technologies, and command powerful battle fleets across the galaxy.

5606370.title: The Resilience Protocol
5606370.short_description: An incremental game about a switch. Wake up in a small room. Flip the switch. Watch the number go up. A calm voice thanks you for your contribution. Upgrade, automate, sleep, repeat, and listen carefully to what the voice says, and to what it corrects.

5606550.title: Lazarus Colony
5606550.short_description: The colony ship Lazarus crashed on a hostile planet and you are the only doctor. Save the wounded crew, build a colony and run it by talking to your onboard AI: ask for what you need with your voice and it organizes everyone else.

5606560.title: Psycho Santa
5606560.short_description: Pilot Santa’s weaponized sleigh, smash through houses, and deliver presents with the police on your tail. When Krampus knocks you out of the sky, fight on foot, hijack tanks, and decide who gets a second chance in this darkly comic Christmas action game.

5606660.title: Dead North
5606660.short_description: A hardcore survival game set in the north, solo or in co-op for up to 4 players. Built as an immersive sim, it has no scripted encounters. Fire a gun and everything in earshot hears it. Steal from a village and they remember your face. Light a fire at night and something will come to see it.

5606970.title: We Have a Robot Problem
5606970.short_description: Every robot in the vault has wandered off its charging rack. Catch them, stack them in your arms and put each one back in its own spot. Thousands of robots with hats and costumes, handy tools and a Workshop full of upgrades. A cosy, silly tidy up game.

5607180.title: Bottom Feeders: Crab Crew
5607180.short_description: Haul up crab pots with 1–6 friends in this silly co-op crabbing game. Throw pots off the pier, pull up 37 kinds of ridiculous crabs, sell them, and trade your leaky rowboat for a solid gold yacht. Or just shove your crew into the sea.

5607210.title: Touhou Gomoku
5607210.short_description: In Touhou Gomoku, you're one stone from five in a row when Marisa's Last Spell, Final Spark, wipes out your line. 50 spell cards freeze points, steal stones and cut lines. Beat nine Kourindou regulars to win their cards, or play a friend locally or online. From the makers of Touhou Chess.

5607420.title: Golden Town Card Shop
5607420.short_description: Run a fantasy card shop and venture into dungeons with a deck of your own. Bring sealed cards home to appraise, then choose what to collect, display, or sell. Turn your earnings into a better shop and prepare for your next adventure.

5607430.title: Retro Cinema - Movie Theater Simulator
5607430.short_description: It's 1988 and the neighborhood cinema is yours. Tear tickets at the box office, pop fresh popcorn, pour sodas and slushies, and thread the reels in the projection booth. A cozy, nostalgic single-player sim about the simple satisfaction of running your own movie theater.

5607470.title: My Summer, Your Silence
5607470.short_description: Linus thought a new city could leave the past behind. But summer lingers: a heartbeat sounds in the woods, an old school lies beneath the water, and a girl says she has been waiting for him. A story-driven visual novel of school days, surreal repetition, and buried memories.

5607540.title: Mahjong: Forever
5607540.short_description: A calm mahjong solitaire journey across six hand-painted worlds. Clear 79 hand-crafted boards, earn up to 237 stars, try timed and hidden-tile challenges, and come back every day for a fresh Daily Challenge. Every deal is guaranteed solvable.

5607570.title: 锯刃之心 Sawheart
5607570.short_description: SAWHEART is a third-person survival action game. You play as Xi, who wakes in an unfamiliar room to find the streets outside packed with the infected — and all you have to do is survive what is left of Tidewatch.

5607700.title: 武侠奶瓦的青春冒险
5607700.short_description: One milk frog. Five roommates. One cyber-wuxia city. A short comedy visual novel about rent, assassination attempts, and the most chaotic shared apartment in Jiangcheng. 12 endings. Chinese & English.

5607810.title: Animal Fort Defense
5607810.short_description: Survive waves of monsters in a colorful tower defense game for 1-5 players. Build and upgrade animal-themed towers, manage your resources, and defend your base against powerful bosses. Play solo, team up in online co-op, or fight to be the last one standing in Competitive mode.

5608020.title: Flag Boom! Chronicles
5608020.short_description: Plant your flag on a fort and your WHOLE ARMY DOUBLES! A pixel-art RTS where hundreds of archers, spearmen and cavalry clash in a rock-paper-scissors war. Pick a unit type, march, seize forts and watch your army explode. 20 stages, 4 giant bosses.

5608300.title: Eldritch Survivors
5608300.short_description: Eldritch Survivors is a Lovecraftian roguelite where you kill swarms of enemies, gain insight to the Mythos, and unlock otherworldly powers. Can you survive long enough to stop The Cosmic Conspiracy’s nefarious plans?

5608340.title: Little Kingdom Xiangqi
5608340.short_description: Xiangqi (Chinese Chess) with adorable characters! Learn the rules, battle an AI from beginner to master, solve 200 puzzles and dress up your pieces in 11 outfits (5 included, 6 in the Outfit Pack DLC). Offline, no ads.

5608420.title: Yuzan's Drive: First Gear
5608420.short_description: A comic-book style racing game where you start in neighborhood street races and work your way up to the legends. Race on circuits, rally stages and city streets, spend your prize money on parts in the garage, and beat rivals whose names might sound a little familiar.

5608440.title: The Scent Of Home
5608440.short_description: A lost puppy follows the scent of his family across forests, farms, lakes and mountains, helping the animals he meets along the way. A gentle, wordless adventure for children and the grown-ups who play with them.

5608870.title: Smash Arena
5608870.short_description: An online party game for up to 12 players: brick-built toys clash in wild, physics-driven challenges. Run, jump, shove, survive the glass bridge and Red Light… and climb onto the podium. Dress up your toy and challenge your friends!

5609050.title: Clumsy Robot
5609050.short_description: A clumsy robot wants to prove he's useful. Walk him through 33 physics-based obstacle courses, from farms and offices to airports and banks. Carry fragile cargo, compete against ridiculous rivals, and fall in hilarious ways. Then challenge up to 7 friends in online races!

5609150.title: Earth-ish
5609150.short_description: The oceans swallowed the world. Grab your sand gun, relight old lighthouses and pull the real Earth back out of the sea, coast by coast, country by country. Build machines, raise famous landmarks again and play solo or with up to 7 friends online.

5609350.title: Grandma's Button Shop
5609350.short_description: Grandma's button shop has gotten out of hand. Pick up the buttons scattered across her cozy old house and sort each one into its own labelled drawer, tray, tin or card. Unlock skills that light up, gather and auto-place buttons, and try your luck at the plinko board.

5609510.title: GLIMWARD
5609510.short_description: A day-and-night tower defense. By day, build inside your light; by night, thousands of shadow creatures surge toward the sun core from every side. Shape your tower layout, alternate red, green and blue light to trigger spectral reactions, and hold the last light.

5609520.title: Final Sin
5609520.short_description: A turn-based tactical roguelike deckbuilder where you play as both the Dungeon Master and the heroes. Build a deck of monsters to create the challenges your heroes will face, then switch sides and fight through the dungeon you created. The stronger the enemies you choose, the greater the rewards.

5609660.title: We Can Get Stronger Without All the Hassle!
5609660.short_description: After being cast out of your sect, you decide to grow stronger your own way. This idle cultivation game combines automatic combat, equipment progression, and combat skill builds. Train in twelve classes, refine it to higher tiers as you face hordes of monsters and powerful bosses.

5610110.title: Dog Soup
5610110.short_description: Your significant other is coming home in a few minutes. The pot is empty. And a hungry beast is running around the house eating your vegetables. Grab them, carry them, throw them in the soup, and try not to get hit with a rolling pin!

5610360.title: Sidepeak
5610360.short_description: A tiny climber lives on the edge of your screen. Every key you press, in any app, carries them from Montmartre to Everest, real peaks at their real altitude. Take a break and they pitch camp, which you decorate with their finds. And when the mountains run out? That's for you to find out.

5610550.title: 돌깨
5610550.short_description: Break rocks, uncover minerals, and build up your pixel-art mining workshop. Upgrade tools, automate the work, and start fresh with permanent abilities. Chase rare finds and jackpot rewards in this single-player incremental game.

5610780.title: Drug Shop: Tidy Up Together
5610780.short_description: Talwer and Pesse finally went legit, but their shop is a disaster. A first-person sorting game for 1 to 4 players: put thousands of products on the right shelves, cook in the lab and stock the store, alone or in online co-op.

5610840.title: 精灵星球：任务栏大冒险
5610840.short_description: Your desktop is now a tiny planet. MONOVA is a cozy auto-battler ARPG about collecting adorable creatures, building a trio of battlers, and hunting game-changing loot — all while your pets live right on your taskbar.

5610880.title: Baked Blocks
5610880.short_description: 《Baked Blocks》 is a single-player grid-based puzzle game with an animal cookie theme. It features 210 puzzles across seven chapters, 30 of which have two or three different ways to solve them, allowing you to create different finished photos from the same box of cookies.

5611240.title: 迷途远征队
5611240.short_description: Choose from six classes in a co-op action roguelite. Play solo with AI companions or team up with a friend on the same screen. Pick routes, build your character, and face bosses across three regions. Automatic attacks give you room to dodge, use skills, and rescue allies.

5611350.title: Hero Sling
5611350.short_description: Pull back the slingshot and launch your mounted hero into the sky! Slash monsters mid-flight, slam down for combos and smash giant bosses. Collect 60 mounts, master 6 classes and fly farther every run.

5611850.title: Newbie Dentist Simulator
5611850.short_description: You've just opened a small dental clinic in town — and all you can afford is a toothbrush. Scrape tartar, drill out cavities and pull wisdom teeth, then spend your earnings on new equipment and build the best clinic in town.

5611890.title: Sink My Heart
5611890.short_description: She matched with you on a dating app and brought you back to a roadside motel. Now she wants to play a game. On the board, the pieces are your organs, and every part she hits is an ability you lose. "It's just a game," she says. A one-night horror board game.

5612690.title: Every Castle Needs a Wizard
5612690.short_description: Every Castle Needs a Wizard is a turn-based roguelite. Customize your magic projectiles with multiple runes to change how they behave and create countless combos. Ricochet through hordes, gather loot, rebuild your castle, research upgrades, and recruit heroes to survive!

5612780.title: Orb Immortal
5612780.short_description: Roll your god's crystal orb through 150+ hand-built stages across the heavens, into the cosmos, and beyond the halls of the divine. Tilt the world to chase medals and leaderboards and shatter the statues of your rivals. Race your friends and compete to be the first to reach the secret levels.

5613240.title: Snowman Left Behind
5613240.short_description: A cozy team snowball fight for up to eight friends. Build a snow fort, pelt the other team until they're snowmen, then hurry over to rescue your frozen friends. Nineteen wintry maps, each with its own trick: sleds, toy trains, catapults, sheep and Grandma's cookies.

5613590.title: Dreams to Studio
5613590.short_description: Build your dream career from a small room to your own gaming empire! Create content, stream, develop games, upgrade your equipment and shape your future in an open-ended life and management simulation where every decision matters.

5614290.title: FLIP MACHINA
5614290.short_description: Reversi meets roguelike. Plant machine stones on the board, flank them to fire them off, and chain your score through charms and upgrades. Build your own scoring engine and go for the legendary eight-way OCTAFLIP in a cozy late-night puzzle shop.

5614450.title: Rocco’s Card Shop
5614450.short_description: Rip open packs, pull Golden cards and turn Rocco's tiny card shop into an empire. Flip cards on a live market, grade your best, run the auction house, dodge the loan shark, then close up shop and come back bigger. One more pack. Just one more.

5614570.title: One Tiny Delivery
5614570.short_description: A exploration game about delivering packages. Deliver various stuff to people residing on an island using one small three-wheeled truck. Explore the island and drive to the peak of the mountain to deliver one final package. Hear people's stories and take in the view around you as you drive along.

5614580.title: Total Physiology
5614580.short_description: A physiology study app for the MCAT and college physiology, with over 6,000 practice items, a lesson for every topic, flashcards, mock exams and finals. It also includes The Expedition, a game where you are the doctor on Everest, up the North Side in the 1920s and the South Side in the 1950s.

5614600.title: Pull the Weeds
5614600.short_description: Start by pulling weeds by hand, then upgrade to sickles, boomerangs, wind magic, and a giant robot! Cut, collect, and burn weeds to earn better tools. Clear overgrown fields and enjoy watching your progress take shape.

5614760.title: BONKABIND
5614760.short_description: Ever forgotten how to shoot in the middle of a gunfight? In BONKABIND, players can swap each other's keyboard and mouse controls! One round you're a sharpshooter. The next, you're running backward, crouching by accident, and wondering where your shoot button went.

5614790.title: One Million Pounds of Snow
5614790.short_description: A cozy Christmas incremental game. Scoop one million pounds of snow, sell it and upgrade from a tiny shovel to sleighs and flamethrowers. Hire penguins in knit sweaters, light AFK fire pits and melt the whole pit before Christmas!

5614870.title: BogKnight
5614870.short_description: A broken sword, a talking raven, and a city preserved beneath the mist. Explore a nonlinear dark fantasy action-adventure of wraiths, swordplay, and strange magic. Find your own way through the bog.

5614990.title: Brokie
5614990.short_description: You went all in with borrowed money and lost everything. Start over with $3,000 in a share house: work part-time jobs, gather clues from news, rumors and store shelves, trade 18 fictional stocks and keep your stress in check. How far can you climb in one year?

5615030.title: Spare Parts: Episode 3
5615030.short_description: Unit 02 wants nothing more than to hide away in the basement, passing the days doing nothing of consequence with Unit 04. But Unit 03—now Melanie—seeks to run a cafe for humans upstairs, and it's only a matter of time before their secret is out and their lives are ruined. Where can 02 find peace?

5615210.title: Semaphore
5615210.short_description: A train simulator with systemic horror. You are the driver and the conductor of a night train in the People's Republic of Ordovia. Drive the train, meet the passengers, check their papers and look after them. Solve the mysteries of Ordovia's railways and fulfil the state's plan.

5615550.title: Crazy Alchemy
5615550.short_description: Crazy Alchemy is a roguelike where you take over a bankrupt alchemy workshop, draw ingredients from a bottomless bag, shake your cauldron to merge them, and combine tools to fulfill commissions and get the workshop back on its feet.

5615600.title: Defend the Village
5615600.short_description: Build towers along winding waterways and Defend your Village against pirate fleets. Combine mythic powers, grow crops, research upgrades, and face powerful bosses across multiple maps in an epic single-player fantasy tower defense adventure.

5615730.title: Kyrie
5615730.short_description: Kyrie is a first-person parkour roguelite built for speed. Sprint, slide, wall-kick and parry through procedurally generated worlds, outrun what hunts you, beat each world's boss and chase a better time, solo or in online co-op.

5616110.title: Sushi Bar Manager
5616110.short_description: Run a conveyor-belt sushi shop in Japan. Buy fish, keep the plates moving, wash every dish and pay the bills each night. Hire staff, decorate, survive bad weather and clumsy customers, and see how many days your shop can last. 🍣🥢

5616350.title: Become an AI Company Boss
5616350.short_description: Run an AI company in the wildest race in tech. Survive a congressional grilling, chase your own runaway robot through Chinatown, smuggle chips under frozen fish, outfly helicopters in a flying sports car and ship three thousand robots to Mars. Every choice rewrites the ending.

5616380.title: FUCHI's Chick: Mini Many PANIC
5616380.short_description: Up to 4 players hatch baby chicks and lead them to the shipping yard! A cute, chaotic party game starring the deadpan chicks of FUCHI, the illustrator behind the hugely popular LINE stickers. Lead a wobbly parade, dodge thieves and enemies, and dress up in collected outfits. Play locally or online.

5616480.title: Santa's Sweatshop
5616480.short_description: A first-person incremental game set in Santa's warehouse. Wrap gifts, load the conveyor belt and meet a daily quota that grows every day. Earn cookies to buy upgrades, expand the warehouse and hire elves to help you.

5616970.title: Deepfold: One Day Deep
5616970.short_description: Deepfold is a papercraft mining story about letters from your grandmother, trapped 66 million years in the past since a 2019 accident. She lived there 20 years. Plant ore in the past, fast-forward millions of years, and dig it up by hand. Each upgrade brings up her next letter. Take your time.

5617060.title: Project Polaris
5617060.short_description: Project Polaris is an action roguelike following Eunhasu's story. Combine weapons and drones to create your own combat build, and shape her fate as Corruption changes her appearance, abilities, and how others react to her.

5617150.title: Shardfall
5617150.short_description: A classic real-time strategy war for the crystal that fell from the sky. Build a base, harvest Vitrium and command the Concordat, the Ascendancy or the alien Harrow through three campaigns, then wake the Mandate. Fight five levels of AI in skirmish, or battle your friends online.

5617280.title: Worm Overworld
5617280.short_description: A 360° tank-defense shooter. Giant worms burst out of Pit B-7 from every side: spin your turret, time your shockwave, skill and ultimate, call in your squad, and fight through 20 boss stages and 3 secret nests to reach the Worm Queen.

5617340.title: Football Tactics: Dare to Dream
5617340.short_description: A turn-based football tactics roguelite with superpowers. Move your five kids across the grid, check your odds, then pass, lob, volley and shoot. Break the rules with lasers, meteors and unsaveable overhead kicks, and build your squad between matches.

5617520.title: REAL GO: Go Game (Baduk · Weiqi)
5617520.short_description: Light Go that opens straight to the board. Play Go against an AI that plays like a real person of your rank, from 20 kyu to 9 dan. Ask for advice and see live position analysis mid-game, solve 1,800+ classic tsumego, and pick from 13 boards and 39 stone sets in 3D or 2D. From beginner to pro.

5617710.title: The Last Bookshop
5617710.short_description: Reopen your father's bookshop. Stock the shelves, find the right book for each reader, and make friends around town. Follow the trail of your family's missing books.

5617950.title: Dark Gothic Doll Party
5617950.short_description: Before her mainspring stops, a wind-up doll girl climbs a gothic clock-tower theatre to meet its master. A bullet-hell shooter across five acts and an extra stage: gather screws to buy time, face six doll bosses, and reach one of four endings that change with difficulty. Relief Mode included.

5618230.title: SNOWBALLZ
5618230.short_description: Snowball fights with your friends — online, loud and completely ridiculous. Pack, throw, dodge, and smack your buddies off rooftops across snowy city streets. Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch and Hold the Fort. No friends online? Warm up against bots.

5618440.title: CRUCIBLE OF THE ABYSS
5618440.short_description: Slot, fuse, and discover. A dark fantasy first-person dungeon crawler where you build every action from parts, melt them together into new powers, and descend fifty floors into the abyss.

5618490.title: KaroKowe Jam
5618490.short_description: Pick a song, mute your instrument's stem, and play along with the rest of the band. Slow it down, loop the hard parts and record your take. Coming soon.

5618520.title: Voices from the Vase
5618520.short_description: Voices from the Vase is a story-driven psychological horror game about a young couple forced to take odd jobs to make ends meet. But some jobs come with a price far greater than money.

5618650.title: Lords, Land & Levy
5618650.short_description: Build a living medieval village, defend its walls in real time, then march out to lead the assault yourself. Marry, scheme and make war across a realm of rival lords, rise from village lord to king, and hold the west against the Great Khan.

5618700.title: Nothing Was Deleted
5618700.short_description: A used laptop, €180, never wiped. Its owner is in Portugal, supposedly. His mail, photos and chats are all still here – and at 3:12 am something starts typing back. Horror played entirely on a fake desktop: five nights, four endings, and a cursor that isn’t only yours.

5618740.title: ELECTRONIKA 8
5618740.short_description: A puzzle game about electronics on real circuit physics, set in a Soviet research lab of the 1970s. Wire lamps, resistors, capacitors, transistors and chips on a breadboard, measure with a multimeter and an oscilloscope, keep to a budget, and work up from one lamp to a real device on your own chips.

5618770.title: Gravity Caverns
5618770.short_description: Explore vast underground caverns in this physics-based spaceship adventure. Master gravity, manage your fuel, recover containers, assist scientists, and overcome hostile robots. Navigate 30 challenging levels and safely return to your starting platform!

5618840.title: Please, let me fish.
5618840.short_description: All you want is to fish, but the Tide has other plans. Hold off endless swarms of cute monsters on tiny planets, collect 60 Devices, fuse them into Overclocks, and grow strong enough to face the Tide Lords! Then maybe you’ll cast your line again...

5618920.title: Too Many Dudes!
5618920.short_description: A cozy tidy-up game with over 7,000 sleepy dudes in 104 colorful costumes. Match them to their shelves, watch completed rows come alive, and unlock upgrades across 8 themed wings. No timers. No rush. Just too many dudes.

5618940.title: Diving Club
5618940.short_description: Diving Club is a pixel-art diving game. Dive from springboards, high platforms and 20 m cliffs. The judges score each dive on difficulty and execution. Win competitions, grow your club and work your way up to the World Games. Compete against other players in online tournaments.

5619350.title: Midgard Arena
5619350.short_description: Lead a party of four anime heroes across a shared 3D world. Hunt in real time on the same maps as other players, take down world bosses together, trade at the player market and test your build in 5v5 Arena and Battle Royale.

5619950.title: Dudo
5619950.short_description: How good are you at lying? Everyone cheats, and cheating is the rules in Dudo. Peek under cups, nudge your dice, lie to a table of crooks and climb through smoky back rooms to find out who is the Owner. A roguelike deckbuilder of bluffs, loaded dice and bad company.

5620120.title: Sort & Sorcery
5620120.short_description: Run a tiny magic shop at the edge of the woods. Every night a portal tips a mountain of potions, tomes, keys and curios onto the floor. Sort it all onto the right shelves before morning, chase off the thieving imp, and grow your little shop into the finest in the land.

5620150.title: AnkhForge
5620150.short_description: Tower defense in ancient Egypt: build by day, shape-shift into divine forms by night.

5620330.title: Sylvia Sparrow and the Witch's Paintings
5620330.short_description: A Short Hike meets a late-night Adult Swim show. A witch just set her cat on fire, and now she wants Sylvia Sparrow to hunt down her lost paintings. Adventure across Witch Isle and meet mean, creepy, ugly and brutally honest characters who’ll help you find every last one.

5620430.title: Pantheon Wars: Auto Battler
5620430.short_description: Command 198 gods and legends from 18 pantheons in a mythology auto battler. Draft from a shared pool, merge copies into 3 star legends, stack pantheon bonuses and outlast 7 rivals.

5620460.title: The Ludic Wound
5620460.short_description: Beneath the wallpaper, a cursor blinks in a language older than sleep. The apartment remembers you. The machine dreams of the one dreaming it. Somewhere between the pixel and the void, a wound is opened.

5621720.title: Stress Relief Bamboo Fighter 2 Super Bamboo Man
5621720.short_description: Two players, one bamboo fighter! Pull one string each with a friend in this tabletop physics action game. Jump in sync, clear stationery obstacles, protect your balloon, and collect candy as you tackle every stage together.

5622120.title: SiegeLine
5622120.short_description: SiegeLine is a four-way fantasy strategy battle. Your barracks send waves at your neighbors on their own. You decide where the gold goes: income, upgrades, heroes and base spells. No unit control: every choice is about timing. Inspired by the classic Survival Chaos custom map.

5622200.title: Sorting Waifu Figures!
5622200.short_description: Sorting Waifu Figures is a cozy anime figure sorting game for solo play or a group of friends. Discover over 2500 cute figures, shelves to tidy up, and a pleasant atmosphere with beautiful music!

5622300.title: Smash the Walls
5622300.short_description: Make the wall pay for your escape. Start with your fists, vacuum up the rubble, and trade it for a cannon in this first-person incremental game. Punch a crack in the plaster. Come back and blast a hole through steel.

5622700.title: Basis Factory
5622700.short_description: Basis Factory is a top-down automation game. Start with a single piece of ore, let raw materials automatically become parts and components, then assemble them step by step into complex industrial products. No enemies, no countdown—just a factory built from scratch, entirely yours.

5622730.title: Silent Hunt: Horror Escape
5622730.short_description: Investigate a house marked by a massacre, solve puzzles, and uncover what lurks in the darkness. But be careful… you're not alone.

5622850.title: Nedi Multiplayer TD
5622850.short_description: Build a maze, line it with towers and grow it for weeks. Collect creature cards and send them in one ordered wave into other players' mazes, then defend yours while you are away. Beat the weekly World Boss, climb the Sky Race and wake Nedi, the stone titan.

5623160.title: LATENT – Fragment 01
5623160.short_description: You wake up in a rotting clinic. No one is here. Almost no one. LATENT – Fragment 01 is an anime-style survival horror game.

5623230.title: Desktop Doodle
5623230.short_description: Draw a desktop companion or import a PSD file to create one automatically. Give it your voice, feed it, interact with it, and watch it react to your PC activity while you work, study, or play. Share creations and find new friends on Steam Workshop.

5623410.title: BetterAtGambling
5623410.short_description: Think you're the best gambler in your friend group? Prove it. Hit the tables, survive the minigames, and if luck runs out, just take the chips from whoever's in the lead. In the end, only one of you is better at gambling.

5623500.title: Through the Varnish
5623500.short_description: A love letter to art. Walk into fifteen of the most beloved paintings ever made, explore them as living 3D worlds, and meet the people who live inside them.

5623820.title: Pinata
5623820.short_description: Hit a giant piñata with up to 3 friends in first-person co-op. Coins fall out, roll down a spiral funnel into your vault and buy you bigger weapons: a bow, a machine gun, a hwacha, archers. When it bursts, a bigger one comes down from the clouds.

5623920.title: FIREDAMP
5623920.short_description: Ostrava region, November 1994. Following a methane explosion, the entire shift—including your younger brother—remains trapped in the Terezie mine. Descend 900 meters underground with a headlamp, a canary, and a pickaxe. The buried can't see you, but they can hear you.

5623950.title: Star Archive: Tidying Up Is a Kind of Magic
5623950.short_description: The library's a mess, and it won't let you leave. Sort and stack books at your own pace in this cozy first-person game. Cast spells to send books back to their shelves, open new wings, and carry permanent upgrades into the next time loop.

5623990.title: The Gods' Tower
5623990.short_description: Climb a cursed voxel tower with up to six friends. Every champion who dies stays behind as a Fallen, still carrying all their gear, until you beat it or pay to bring the body home. Fight the Wardens, find the secrets and see what waits at the top.

5624010.title: Rugby Playbook
5624010.short_description: Rugby, played with cards. Take a village club from the cow field to the World Cup, one cup at a time. Read what the other team is about to do, play your hand, win the scrum, keep the referee sweet. Between matches, fill your playbook, fight for the table and grow your club.

5624570.title: Crash Sequence
5624570.short_description: Crash-landed alone on an alien world, you survive by sequencing alien bacteria, building custom plasmids, and engineering living cultures for oxygen, food and power. A turn-based sci-fi RPG / strategy simulation where your choices shape how the story ends.

5624580.title: Hellward Pilgrimage
5624580.short_description: Hell’s gates can only be sealed from the inside. Descend alone or with up to three friends in this dark fantasy bullet heaven. Wield six hovering weapons, survive the horde, and choose which bridge to cross. When a run ends, your pilgrim keeps their level.

5624700.title: Ragtown
5624700.short_description: A slapstick 2D physics sandbox built from voxels and full of ragdolls. Pick them up, fling them, drop an anvil on them or tell them who to fight. Everyone has a name, and they remember who threw them. At Ragtown Studios you set the dynamite to just miss your star and cut the film for three judges.

5624770.title: Politics Tycoon: Corrupt State
5624770.short_description: A darkly comic politics tycoon: grow a dusty little shop into a skyline empire, rig public tenders, play the stock market, buy ministers and newspapers, and climb all the way to the presidency before the prosecutors catch up.

5624880.title: Blindsens
5624880.short_description: Find your best mouse sensitivity by testing it blind. Play short aim blocks at five hidden sensitivities in random order. Blindsens fits a curve to how you actually perform and only recommends a change when the data is statistically confident.

5625030.title: Breach Inc.
5625030.short_description: 3:12 a.m. The medical practice is encrypted, the extortionists are very polite, and your admin went for coffee. Run a tiny IT security firm through the night shift: stop attacks, pay the ransom or don’t, and grow your basement office into your own SOC.

5625130.title: Snow Yard
5625130.short_description: Dig out your yard after an overnight snowstorm in this cozy first-person snow-clearing game. Push snow into piles, sweep the steps clean, and save up for a snowblower. Your missing car keys are out there somewhere. So are ten little garden gnomes.

5625200.title: Billard Masters Legacy
5625200.short_description: Precision cue sports powered by deterministic 1,000 Hz physics! Play 8-Ball, 9-Ball, Snooker, 3-Cushion & Carom in the Online Club or vs PC. Conquer 30 Master Challenges, build custom layouts, and collect 84 cues with live match chronicles across 15 atmospheric 3D venues.

5625450.title: Ship Maneuvering Simulator
5625450.short_description: Handle real ships the way a pilot does. Berth a loaded bulker with tugs, take her into a lock, anchor on the river and moor with six lines, in wind up to force 10, current and swell. Built on the MMG model used in professional ship handling simulators, by a working maritime pilot.

5625470.title: Train Keeper
5625470.short_description: A cozy first-person organizing simulator aboard a night train. Make beds, set tables and sort up to 2,443 objects across 22 cars before the train reaches the station. Unlock helpful skills, restore order at your own pace, or race the clock in Hardcore mode.

5625830.title: Greena
5625830.short_description: Your uncle stopped answering his phone. Tonight you drive out to his farm at the end of a valley road, through a storm that won't move on. A short first-person horror game with a PS1 look.

5625860.title: MistTower
5625860.short_description: Every battle has a cost. MistTower is a grid-based strategy RPG where you preview damage, plan routes, and weigh every key, coin, and upgrade. Bypass stronger enemies, return when ready, and conquer four seasonal towers without spending your last strength before the boss.

5625880.title: Penguin Trails Together
5625880.short_description: It all starts with a line. Draw a ramp and send Pengu soaring toward the stars on a sled. Or team up with up to three friends, build a track full of loops, and see who sticks the landing.

5625940.title: Cat-Eye: Nail Salon Simulator
5625940.short_description: Soak off old polish, file and shape real 3D nails, then pull a glowing cat-eye band to life with a magnet. A cozy nail salon sim with fair scoring, regulars with stories, disaster rescues and influencer ready one-click vertical clips to share every set.

5626390.title: Brennia
5626390.short_description: Brennia is a fantasy RPG featuring turn-based combat and an open world. Explore biomes, solve puzzles, and craft gear for your next dungeon run! Between expeditions, grow crops and expand your island. Play solo or with up to three friends.

5626430.title: Last Name Standing
5626430.short_description: A deduction game about finding one name among thousands. Read the clues, walk rooms papered with names and cross out everyone it can't be, until only the last name is left standing. Every case is a new run, with a Daily Case and leaderboards.

5627390.title: Millennium Classics
5627390.short_description: Millennium Classics brings back the simple, satisfying elegance of classic puzzle games, free from ads, invasive tracking, or distracting progress bars. Just pure relaxation and mental exercise, just like in the good old days.

5627550.title: Tower of Trials and Wishes
5627550.short_description: Conquer a 100-floor tower together with the adorable final boss! Simple is best — a hack-and-slash, field-less RPG!

5627680.title: Orbitfall
5627680.short_description: Launch your fleets into orbit and let physics fly them. Low orbits are fast, high orbits slow, and every meeting counts down on the map. Seven factions, up to eight players against AI or friends online: claim the planet, bomb it from orbit and outplan everyone.

5627920.title: Mead & Embers: A Viking Tavern
5627920.short_description: Take over a Viking tavern in the cold North and make it shine again: build it up, furnish it and look after your guests. With a living village, a tech tree and a winter that is a real opponent. Keep the embers alive.

5627940.title: Drift Isle
5627940.short_description: Sail a shipful of clay heroes between drifting islands. By day they go ashore on their own to hunt and gather; at dusk they muster on the pier; by night they hold the ship against the horde. Recruit, promote, forge, refit, and face nine difficulties and world bosses a whole season shares.
developers: 亞瑟先生 Mister Arthur Games
publishers: 亞瑟先生 Mister Arthur Games

5628870.title: fogpost
5628870.short_description: Guide a courier and a delayed echo through 250 turn-based puzzles. Collect the letter, plan around tides, bridges and shifting routes, and light both beacons on the same turn. Undo, use hints, then refine your route to earn gold stamps.

5629150.title: A Chat with Naila
5629150.short_description: A Chat with Naila is a psychological horror visual novel disguised as a casual encounter. Grab a warm cup of coffee, sit down, and enjoy a nice conversation. Sounds great, right? I mean, what could go wrong anyway...?

5629230.title: Just One More Load
5629230.short_description: Swing a magnet crane over a cartoon scrapyard, grab as much junk as your battery allows and drop it in the press for combo cash. Grow a 250-node skill tree, collect 17 magnet heads, clear five yards and tell yourself: just one more load.

5629250.title: Used Car Empire
5629250.short_description: You cannot see the car. You can only read it. Buy used cars off strangers, work out what is wrong with them before it costs you, and decide what to tell the next owner. A 2D deduction game about the motor trade, in a small town that remembers every car you sell.

5629410.title: ALKKAGI
5629410.short_description: An incremental game about flicking go stones, where every clack pays. Smash four walls from wood to diamond for Kifu, crack Boss Walls for run boosts, then rank up and grow a 253-node Kifu Tree. Short runs, big numbers, real pixel-art physics.

5629440.title: Quagmire
5629440.short_description: A co-op strategy game for 1 to 4 players. You sit in a Cold War bunker, command your branch of the army on a flickering map, and try to meet the state's quota before the money runs out. Every tank you lose comes out of your budget. Everything goes wrong anyway.

5629640.title: Project Galaxia
5629640.short_description: Earth is dying, and humanity has bet everything on its colony ships. You're in command of one. Out there, 467 million stars are waiting, and every planet and moon can be visited. How you survive is up to you: drain the worlds dry, trade with the other commanders... or take what's theirs.

5629810.title: Spin Spin Top: Scrap League
5629810.short_description: Drop your scrap-built top into the bowl, smash rival tops and take their parts. Rebuild between rounds, pick new powers and climb five leagues from the alley to the Nationals. Play it hands-on, or let it spin on its own.

5629890.title: Othria
5629890.short_description: Othria is a dark pixel-art action RPG with survivors-like autocast combat. Fight endless hordes, watch them burst into loot, craft gear with orbs and grow your passive tree. Beat each island's boss to open the next. One permanent hero, nothing resets: every level, item and point you earn stays.

5630370.title: Cozy Critter Empire
5630370.short_description: A relaxing colony builder in a woodland archipelago. Turn simple resources into goods, link production chains, ship cargo between six islands, meet the critter residents and their pets and fill a nature book of thirty animals, offline and at your own pace.

5630400.title: OVERDRIVE
5630400.short_description: Drive the all-female rock band VELOURIA from Sapporo to Fukuoka in this road-trip dating sim. Plan your stops, sell merch, and choose who to spend time with after each show. A late-night talk could spark a romance. Your choices shape how the tour ends.

5630590.title: Fifty-Fifty
5630590.short_description: Fifty-fifty is a Balatro-inspired coin-tossing roguelike. Heads score. Tails boost your multiplier. Coins fly, collide, stack and shatter in chain reactions. Collect quirky coins, engrave them, add paint and stickers. The casino demands more at every table. Break the score counter and get out alive.

5630870.title: Froggy Tidy Up
5630870.short_description: Froggy Tidy Up is a relaxing cozy organizing simulator. Enjoy perfectly sorting your collection of over 3300 ceramic frogs and turning your pottery studio's messy chaos into order.

5631570.title: Quiet Please
5631570.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where your microphone is your flashlight. You are the new night clerk at the Ashgrove Public Library, 1994. Something blind lives in the stacks and hears everything. Whisper, clap or shout to light up the dark, and it will know where you are.

5631680.title: Mailu — A Chaotic Memory Game
5631680.short_description: Mailu is a memory game with a paper circus inside. Matching a pair is free, missing one costs you — and just when you swear you've memorized the table, a boss pulls a brand-new rule out of its hat. Featuring 18 bosses, 37 effect cards and 5 game modes.

5631950.title: SPELLOT
5631950.short_description: A survivors-like where your spells are written by a slot machine. Stop three reels and the spell parts you land combine into a spell. Burning swords rain down. Frozen shields circle you. Giant hammers pierce the horde. Fight off the horde and defeat the boss.

5632120.title: Ember & Tide
5632120.short_description: Ember is fire, Tide is water. Team up in a fire-and-water puzzle platformer for couch co-op or solo play: fuse into steam, outsmart lava and ice, and solve 30 handcrafted levels. Then build your own in the Level Editor!

5632310.title: Wintermarkt
5632310.short_description: Build a cosy German Christmas market from Advent to Christmas Eve. Place mulled wine, bratwurst and gingerbread stands, open an Advent door every few days for a new card, and earn enough to pay the town's lease. Each season plays out differently.

5632670.title: Cerulean Climb
5632670.short_description: Play as Lark in a story-driven 2.5D RPG about climbing an endless tower to become God. Explore its wildly different floors, solve puzzle-box dungeons, and break enemy shields in turn-based battles. The higher Lark climbs, the easier it gets to justify what he does to keep going.

5632800.title: Evidence of Grace
5632800.short_description: Evidence of Grace is a vertical shoot 'em up up with experimental gameplay focused on defense and shooting.

5633100.title: Homicidy
5633100.short_description: Somebody had a very bad night. Now it's your shift. Scrub fifty crime scenes spotless in this cozy-macabre pixel-art cleaning game: mop, foam, vacuum and luminol your way to three stars, then spend the pay on a nicer mop. You do the crime. We do the grime.

5633140.title: Soul Of Sin
5633140.short_description: One spear. Seven Sins. A single hit ends each phase, for them and for you. Climb a ruined cathedral as the Penitent, face the Sins one by one, and watch your body change with every Sin you slay.

5633330.title: Zero Ops: Covert Warfare
5633330.short_description: Zero Ops: Covert Warfare is a tactical third-person squad shooter. Join up to 16 players in tense, one-life, objective-driven rounds across Brazil, Algeria, Russia and Albania, with modular gear, clans and rankings, and cross-play with PlayStation 5.

5633560.title: Remix Lolita
5633560.short_description: An avant-garde, charming multi-mode rhythm game. Dodge and dash, side-scrolling parkour, classic lane-based play, and more! 24 original tracks across three concept albums, each with a handcrafted stage for a captivating audiovisual experience.

5633710.title: MANBIKI MAYHEM
5633710.short_description: Steal! Catch them! Thieves carry products and whole shelves to the exit. Undercover G-Men blend in with shoppers, zap thieves with a stun gun, cuff and jail them. Hold the key to break teammates out, or throw the furious store manager at someone else. A first-person team game for friends.

5634180.title: Das Hochhaus
5634180.short_description: Build and manage your own high-rise in a 2D business simulation. Combine apartments, offices, hotels, shops and cafés, plan elevators and utilities, and balance rental income, running costs and your tenants’ needs as your tower grows.

5634700.title: 奶瓦的归来
5634700.short_description: Short Description The bell falls silent and Naiwa becomes a fugitive. Wall-jump, double-jump, and air-dash through a 2D Metroidvania. Open shortcuts, knock foes back with a three-hit combo, and wipe out small foes with a belly laugh. Face four guardians and uncover why the bell stopped.

5634800.title: Starship Salvagers
5634800.short_description: One last haul. Dive a dead starship deck by deck: clear sealed rooms of aliens, bolt salvaged upgrades onto your suit, keep your kill multiplier alive and bring down the boss waiting at the bottom. Six contractors, five story tiers and an Endless mode for the greedy.

5634990.title: Святки
5634990.short_description: Three friends try to divine whom they will marry in a snowbound 19th-century Russian village. A stranger appears in the mirror, whispers drift from the crossroads, and old superstitions come alive by candlelight. Svyatki is a folk horror visual novel inspired by Slavic folklore.

5635020.title: Gold, Guns & Grudges
5635020.short_description: Blast ore with a pistol, forge stronger weapons, and build a dwarven settlement. Survive quarry ruptures and fill your trophy room with the spoils of your rise.

5635520.title: THE SUNDERED AEGIS
5635520.short_description: A strategy and tactics simulation in which humanity, having gained routes between star systems through great Gates, has split into ten warring nations. Research technology, design warships, organise fleets and command them in battle as you seek to unite the human world under the nation you lead.

5635550.title: The Snake Catcher
5635550.short_description: The Snake Catcher is an investigation horror game set in the rural South, with no ghosts, only snakes. Track them through people’s clutter, tell venomous from harmless, and bag them before they bite. You think there’s just one. Under the burlap sacks, there’s a whole nest.

5636110.title: Elf Ops
5636110.short_description: Aliens abducted Santa! Online co-op for 1–6 players, or play solo. Sneak into a house at night to deliver presents, then hold off alien thieves with snowballs until dawn, free your friends from cocoons and earn candy to refuel Santa's sleigh.

5636150.title: Dart Career Manager
5636150.short_description: Rise from a pub amateur to darts world champion. Train your trebles and doubles, throw every dart yourself or simulate, earn your tour card at Q-School and battle the stars on the Pro Tour. Manage money, staff, sponsors and rivals in a deep darts career manager.

5636640.title: Forge Frenzy
5636640.short_description: A blacksmith roguelite about pushing your luck. Every hammer strike adds a modifier of your choice and raises the chance the weapon shatters. Keep it or strike again, then watch the hero take your creation into an auto-battle across 20 fights and four bosses.

5637240.title: Basileia
5637240.short_description: A classic city-builder in Byzantium, 330–562 AD. Gather resources, trade, raise great churches and fight off the Huns, then walk among citizens who each live their own life.

5637250.title: Glimmerpine: A Tree-Keeper's Christmas
5637250.short_description: Your grandmother left you her cabin in Glimmerpine Hollow, a woodcarvers' valley where every candle has gone out. Decorate a real Christmas tree for each neighbour's wish, one chiming ornament at a time, and the carved village lights again, window by window. The flame in her lantern has opinions.

5637340.title: Sir, We Have 100 Million Rocks!
5637340.short_description: Start with a rusty spoon and crush your way through 100 million rocks! Mine, sell, upgrade, hire goblins, and unleash outrageous abilities in this first-person mining adventure. Play solo or with up to 8 players, topple giant golems, and dig toward the heart of the planet.

5637550.title: Smoking at 2 am
5637550.short_description: A tiny late-night hangout by the water. Breathe out smoke, sculpt it into art, pull off 36 slow-motion smoke tricks and snap photos of the night while ambient music plays. Just don't chain-smoke - the night gets dizzy, with a cartoon rainbow ending.

5637560.title: Fifth Ace Casino: A 70s Vegas Tycoon
5637560.short_description: Run five casinos through 1970s Las Vegas, from a sawdust joint downtown to a marble palace on the Strip. Real cards, wheels, dice and keno draws, cheats and card counters, a pit boss on the floor, staff with quirks, headliner shows, and a corporation that wants your house.

5637870.title: Mercenary Survivors
5637870.short_description: Your mercenaries are your weapons in this horde-survival action game. Dodge monsters while your company fights, then hire, train and promote with each level. Lead 22 careers through 30 stages, defeat their guardians and build lasting strength with 28 relics.

5638060.title: The Wolfheaded
5638060.short_description: A pixel survival horror in an autumn forest. By day you chop wood, gather stones and berries and build a shelter. By night a tall creature with the head of a dog comes out of the trees. Keep the fire burning, hide, hold the walls and last until dawn. Alone or with friends.

5638180.title: Do Not Stop : Co-op
5638180.short_description: Do Not Stop is a co-op survival horror driving game. Keep your car moving on dark highways to outrun a terrifying entity. Master drifting and crank your windows closed to survive!

5638200.title: RETROPULSE Valentine
5638200.short_description: RETROPULSE Valentine is a relaxing neon puzzle game with romantic retrowave and retro-anime art. Connect matching colored dots with glowing lines, fill the grid, and reveal Valentine’s Day illustrations across 50 levels. Enjoy warm pink and red tones and atmospheric electronic music.

5638560.title: Desktop Trickshot
5638560.short_description: Desktop Trickshot is a desktop companion game where you can enjoy a variety of trickshots anytime, even while working on other things. Earn gold in different ways to unlock new trickshots, new cats, and new hats!

5638920.title: Evolicious
5638920.short_description: Hunt. Eat. Evolve. Survive relentless waves in a 2D action roguelike where your creature visibly transforms as you grow stronger. Discover extraordinary Evolution Fusions and millions of possible combinations across five dangerous worlds.

5639000.title: Frogtory
5639000.short_description: High above the clouds, a tiny island is waiting for its first pond. Put a few frogs to work and watch lily pads roll down the conveyors and cauldrons bubble. Frogtory is a cozy factory game to play at your own pace: no timers, no wrong moves. The Frog King awaits you.

5639050.title: Aether Soul
5639050.short_description: A pixel-art roguelite metroidvania. You are Ves, a construct of threads rewoven by the Great Loom after every death. Cross eight regions of a world torn by the Fracture, defeat six guardians and decide the fate of the Loom.

5639190.title: Dead Freight
5639190.short_description: The cargo roguelike. Pack your holds with 88 cargo types that combo, multiply and devour each other, pick the port that pays the most, and watch the coins stack up. A loan shark owns your ship and wants ten cuts, each bigger than the last. Miss one and he takes it back.

5640210.title: Mushrooms: Quiet Hunt
5640210.short_description: Explore a lifelike forest in a relaxing first-person mushroom-hunting adventure. Find real mushroom species, discover hidden places, complete foraging requests, and make your woodland cabin feel like home.

5640650.title: Snooker Career Manager
5640650.short_description: Take a young player from amateur clubs to the top of the world rankings. Play every shot on a 3D table with real snooker physics, or watch and manage from the chair. Plan training, handle money and sponsors, and make the decisions that shape a career.

5640830.title: Penny Acres
5640830.short_description: Fence off farmland while farm animals bounce around. A cozy roguelike deckbuilder: play fence cards, wall off open pasture before an animal knocks your fence down, and chain bushels × mult combos through a year of seasons, bosses and farm helpers.

5641480.title: Total Biology
5641480.short_description: A biology study app for the MCAT, AP Biology and college biology, with over 5,700 practice items, a lesson for every topic, flashcards and mock exams. It also includes The Fly Room, a game where you breed and count fruit flies in a 1910 genetics laboratory.

5641660.title: Digging Deeper Digger
5641660.short_description: Swipe your mouse and the ground gives way. Dig as deep as you can before your oxygen runs out, spend the ore on a stronger pickaxe, and dive again. A 3D low-poly digging incremental that starts on a grassy hill and goes through lava, ice and the Earth's core, all the way out into space.

5642130.title: GLOWDEAD: The Long Road Home
5642130.short_description: A top-down pixel-art survival shooter. A bio-bomb has turned everyone into the glowing dead, and you are the only survivor. Choose from sixteen gun styles, build a robot army from scratch, and enjoy the rush of mowing down the horde by the hundreds!

5642410.title: The Willing
5642410.short_description: A dark, third-person psychological horror experience. Explore an isolated property surrounded by hilltop ruins, an abandoned cemetery maze and a unsettling swamp. Discover the secrets hidden within each location, but beware of who waits among the trees.

5642590.title: Oshi Knockout!
5642590.short_description: A rhythm action game where a cat-eared idol punches overeager fans who leap at her and kicks eager photographers who slide in, all on the beat. A 30-minute story across 10 Japanese vocal songs, from a rooftop dojo to a dome graduation concert.

5643730.title: Million Ball Pit
5643730.short_description: A giant ball pit with one million colorful balls is waiting to be emptied. Sort balls by hand, bucket and vacuum, dig up lost treasures, unlock upgrades and finally build your own sorting machine with conveyor belts, switches and robot arms.

5643750.title: 2045: Drone Aces
5643750.short_description: Tear colossal machine bosses apart, weapon by weapon. A 3D arcade shoot 'em up with vertical and horizontal combat, solo or two-player local co-op. Dodge bullet storms, slow time, turn enemy fire into points, and take on twelve bosses in Boss Rush.

5643840.title: Paranormal Countermeasure AI LARU: The 4:44 Tunnel
5643840.short_description: Your phone becomes a ghost-hunting tool. Move your real phone, linked to the PC game in real time, to look around and photograph anything strange. The AI LARU analyzes your photos to reveal the truth. At 4:44 a.m., everyone who enters the tunnel dies. Which victim will you be, and can you end it?

5644330.title: Due a Refund
5644330.short_description: You're a tax clerk with connections, a boss who loves synergies and an AI that makes up numbers and never admits it. File returns, follow the law… or don't. Dark-comedy satire of Spanish bureaucracy. C.O.B.R.A. sees everything, eventually.

5644600.title: Salt the Road
5644600.short_description: De-ice a road with a salt shaker. That's the game. Then get paid, buy a better shaker and de-ice a longer road.

5644700.title: Full Stretch
5644700.short_description: Intuitive goalkeeper controls. Do not think. All you have to do is make the save.

5644890.title: Swarmageddon
5644890.short_description: Swarmageddon is a cozy first-person roguelite where you swat the flies, mosquitoes, wasps and all kinds of other bugs invading your house at night. Pick a class, upgrade your skills, beat the boss of every room and keep swatting until bugs cover your whole screen.

5644900.title: Gorgeous Blocks
5644900.short_description: A casual game about clearing falling blocks.

5648780.title: Huerto en Apuros: Garden in Trouble
5648780.short_description: Defend your clay garden with up to 4 friends! Catch greedy rabbits by day and survive the Red Moon: endless rounds, 7 huge bosses, wild traps and garden weapons. Co-op in split-screen, LAN and online.

5649340.title: Lights Out
5649340.short_description: The lights go out and Mr. Snuffles comes looking for you: a giant, much-repaired plush pig who can't see in the dark but hears everything. Hide with up to 3 friends, stay quiet and survive till morning... or be the pig.

5650910.title: Three Kingdoms: Chronicles of Generals
5650910.short_description: Rise as a warlord in the chaos of the late Han and unite the realm. Recruit from over 1,100 officers, build your strength through domestic affairs and espionage, then win turn-based battles on 3D hex battlefields with tactics and schemes. Duels and debates let a single officer turn the tide.

5654260.title: NEONOVA Puzzle: Pink
5654260.short_description: NEONOVA Puzzle: Pink is a relaxing anime jigsaw puzzle game blending Valentine-inspired cyberpunk, glowing pink neon art, and futuristic anime girls. Assemble 50 atmospheric picture puzzles, unlock vibrant illustrations, and unwind to soothing electronic music.

5659130.title: MENHERA RAFFLESIA -CLASSIC REMASTER-
5659130.short_description: Five girls, five twisted forms of love. The 2017 yandere psychological horror visual novel MENHERA RAFFLESIA returns in HD while preserving the original atmosphere. Follow five heroine routes, make your choices, and discover all 11 endings.
